transliteration: ṛṣyamūkātsa dharmātmā kiṣkindhāṃ lakṣmaṇāgrajḥ| jagāma sahasugrīvo vālivikramapālitām4.13.1||
meaning: Lakshmana's righteous elder brother left Rishyamuka with Sugriva for Kishkinda protected by Vali's valour.

sanskrit: सर्वे ते त्वरितं गत्वा किष्किन्धां वालि पालिताम्। वृक्षैरात्मानमावृत्य व्यतिष्ठन् गहने वने4.14.1।।
transliteration: sarve te tvaritṃ gatvā kiṣkindhāṃ vāli pālitām| vṛkṣairātmānamāvṛtya vyatiṣṭhan gahane vane4.14.1||
meaning: They all at once went to Kishkinda ruled by Vali and there waited hiding behind the trees in the dense forest.

sanskrit: अथ तस्य निनादं तं सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। शुश्रावान्तः पुर गतो वाली भ्रातुरमर्षणः4.15.1।।
transliteration: atha tasya ninādṃ tṃ sugrīvasya mahātmanḥ| śuśrāvāntḥ pura gato vālī bhrāturamarṣaṇḥ4.15.1||
meaning: The indignant Vali, who was in the harem, heard the roaring of his venerable brother, Sugriva.

sanskrit: तामेवं ब्रुवतीं तारां ताराधिपनिभाननाम्। वाली निर्भर्त्सयामास वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्4.16.1।।
transliteration: tāmevṃ bruvatīṃ tārāṃ tārādhipanibhānanām| vālī nirbhartsayāmāsa vacanṃ cedamabravīt4.16.1||
meaning: To these words of Tara with her Moonlike face, Vali replied reproachfully:

sanskrit: ततश्शरेणाभिहतो रामेण रणकर्कशः। पपात सहसा वाली निकृत्त इव पादपः4.17.1।।
transliteration: tataśśareṇābhihato rāmeṇa raṇakarkaśḥ| papāta sahasā vālī nikṛtta iva pādapḥ4.17.1||
meaning: A tyrant in war, Vali struck by4.54.24 Rama's arrow, collapsed instantaneously like a tree felled down.

sanskrit: इत्युक्तः प्रश्रितं वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम्। परुषं वालिना रामो निहतेन विचेतसा4.18.1।।
transliteration: ityuktḥ praśritṃ vākyṃ dharmārthasahitṃ hitam| paruṣṃ vālinā rāmo nihatena vicetasā4.18.1||
meaning: To these harsh words though seemingly wellmeaning, courteous and righteous, Vali who had been mortally wounded and confused in mind, Rama replied:

sanskrit: स वानरमहाराजश्शयानश्शरविक्षतः। प्रत्युक्तो हेतुमद्वाक्यैर्नोत्तरं प्रत्यपद्यत4.19.1।।
transliteration: sa vānaramahārājaśśayānaśśaravikṣatḥ| pratyukto hetumadvākyairnottarṃ pratyapadyata4.19.1||
meaning: The king of monkeys lying on the ground struck by the arrow did not offer to reply after listening to Rama's appropriate answers (to his objections).

sanskrit: तौ तु दृष्ट्वा महात्मानौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। वरायुधधरौ वीरौ सुग्रीवश्शङ्कितोऽभवत्4.2.1।।
transliteration: tau tu dṛṣṭvā mahātmānau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau| varāyudhadharau vīrau sugrīvaśśaṅkito'bhavat4.2.1||
meaning: On seeing the two great souls, heroic Rama and Lakshmana wielding the best of weapons, Sugriva was alarmed.

sanskrit: रामचापविसृष्टेन शरेणान्तकरेण तम्। दृष्ट्वा विनिहतं भूमौ तारा ताराधिपानना4.20.1।। सा समासाद्य भर्तारं पर्यष्वजत भामिनी।
transliteration: rāmacāpavisṛṣṭena śareṇāntakareṇa tam| dṛṣṭvā vinihatṃ bhūmau tārā tārādhipānanā4.20.1|| sā samāsādya bhartārṃ paryaṣvaj
meaning: Beholding her husband lying on the ground pierced by a deathdealing arrow released by Rama, the lovely moonfaced Tara went and embraced him.

sanskrit: ततो निपतितां तारां च्युतां तारामिवाम्बरात्। शनैराश्वासयामास हनुमान्हरियूथपः4.21.1।।
transliteration: tato nipatitāṃ tārāṃ cyutāṃ tārāmivāmbarāt| śanairāśvāsayāmāsa hanumānhariyūthapḥ4.21.1||
meaning: Thereafter Hanuman, leader of the monkey clan, slowly consoled Tara who was (standing before her husband) like a star fallen from the sky.

sanskrit: वीक्षमाणस्तु मन्दासुस्सर्वतो मन्दमुच्छ्वसन्। आदावेव तु सुग्रीवं ददर्शत्वात्मजाग्रतः4.22.1।।
transliteration: vīkṣamāṇastu mandāsussarvato mandamucchvasan| ādāveva tu sugrīvṃ dadarśatvātmajāgratḥ4.22.1||
meaning: Vali, gazing all around, breathing slowly and sighing feably beheld Sugriva at first instance, Sugriva who was standing in front of his own son.

sanskrit: ततस्समुपजिघ्रन्ती कपिराजस्य तन्मुखम्। पतिं लोकाच्च्युतं तारा मृतं वचनमब्रवीत्4.23.1।।
transliteration: tatassamupajighrantī kapirājasya tanmukham| patiṃ lokāccyutṃ tārā mṛtṃ vacanamabravīt4.23.1||
meaning: Tara kissed (smelt) the forehead of the king of monkeys who had departed and said:

sanskrit: तां चाश्रुवेगेन दुरासदेन त्वभिप्लुतां शोकमहार्णवेन। पश्यंस्तदा वाल्यनुजस्तरस्वी भ्रातुर्वधेनाप्रतिमेन तेपे4.24.1।।
transliteration: tāṃ cāśruvegena durāsadena tvabhiplutāṃ śokamahārṇavena| paśyṃstadā vālyanujastarasvī bhrāturvadhenāpratimena tepe4.24.1
meaning: Sugriva, the unassailable younger brother of Vali, perceiving Tara overwhelmed in the ocean of grief felt agonized for the killing of his brother of incomparable power.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवं चैव तारां च साङ्गदं सहलक्ष्मणः। समानशोकः काकुत्स्थ स्सान्त्वयन्निदमब्रवीत्।।4.25.1।।
transliteration: sugrīvṃ caiva tārāṃ ca sāṅgadṃ sahalakṣmaṇḥ| samānaśokḥ kākutstha ssāntvayannidamabravīt||4.25.1||
meaning: Rama and Lakshmana were equally sad. Rama, scion of the Kakutstha race, consoled Sugriva, Tara as well as Angada in the following words:

sanskrit: ततश्शोकाभिसन्तप्तं सुग्रीवं क्लिन्नवाससम्। शाखामृगमहामात्राः परिवार्योपतस्थिरे4.26.1।।
transliteration: tataśśokābhisantaptṃ sugrīvṃ klinnavāsasam| śākhāmṛgamahāmātrāḥ parivāryopatasthire4.26.1||
meaning: Then the chiefs of the army of the monkeys surrounded Sugriva, who was overcome with grief and was still in wet clothes (since he had taken bath at the conclusion of the funeral rites) and waited.

sanskrit: अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे प्रविष्टे वानरे गुहाम्। आजगाम सह भ्रात्रा रामः प्रस्रवणं गिरिम्4.27.1।।
transliteration: abhiṣikte tu sugrīve praviṣṭe vānare guhām| ājagāma saha bhrātrā rāmḥ prasravaṇṃ girim4.27.1||
meaning: After the consecration, Sugriva entered the cavecity (of Kishkinda) and Rama accompanied by his brother reached mountain Prasravana.

sanskrit: स तदा वालिनं हत्वा सुग्रीवमभिषिच्य च। वसन्माल्यवतः पृष्ठे रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्4.28.1।।
transliteration: sa tadā vālinṃ hatvā sugrīvamabhiṣicya ca| vasanmālyavatḥ pṛṣṭhe rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt4.28.1||
meaning: After the killing of Vali and installation of Sugriva as king, Rama arrived at mountain Malyavan to reside.He said to Lakshmana:

sanskrit: समीक्ष्य विमलं व्योम गतविद्युद्वलाहकम्। सारसाकुलसङ्घुष्टं रम्यज्योत्स्नानुलेपनम्4.29.1।। समृद्धार्थं च सुग्रीवं मन्दधर्म
transliteration: samīkṣya vimalṃ vyoma gatavidyudvalāhakam| sārasākulasaṅghuṣṭṃ ramyajyotsnānulepanam4.29.1|| samṛddhārthṃ ca sugrīvṃ man
meaning: Hanuman, son of the Windgod, saw the clear sky flooded with lovely moonlight, free from clouds and lightning and cackling of herons. He noticed that because Sugriva had attained abundant wealth and merit, he was not taki

sanskrit: वचो विज्ञाय हनुमान् सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। पर्वतादृश्यमूकात्तु पुप्लुवे यत्र राघवौ।।4.3.1।।
transliteration: vaco vijñāya hanumān sugrīvasya mahātmanḥ| parvatādṛśyamūkāttu pupluve yatra rāghavau||4.3.1||
meaning: Listening to great Sugriva, Hanuman leaped from mount Rishyamuka on to the location of the Raghavas.

sanskrit: गुहं प्रविष्टे सुग्रीवे विमुक्ते गगने घनैः। वर्षरात्रोषितो रामः कामशोकाभिपीडितः4.30.1।। पाण्डुरं गगनं दृष्ट्वा विमलं चन्
transliteration: guhṃ praviṣṭe sugrīve vimukte gagane ghanaiḥ| varṣarātroṣito rāmḥ kāmaśokābhipīḍitḥ4.30.1|| pāṇḍurṃ gaganṃ dṛṣṭvā vimalṃ
meaning: While Sugriva was in his residence, Rama was (in Prasravana mountain) spending his rainy nights tormented by passion (for Sita). Sugriva was engaged in love, forgetting the time fixed for taking up the search for Sita. W

sanskrit: स कामिनं दीनमदीनसत्त्वं शोकाभिपन्नं समुदीर्णकोपम्। नरेन्द्रसूनुर्नरदेवपुत्रं रामानुजः पूर्वजमित्युवाच4.31.1।।
transliteration: sa kāminṃ dīnamadīnasattvṃ śokābhipannṃ samudīrṇakopam| narendrasūnurnaradevaputrṃ rāmānujḥ pūrvajamityuvāca4.31.1||
meaning: Seeing the indomitable hero, his elder brother, son of a king, lovesick, dejected and overcome by anger and grief, spoke prince Lakshmana:

sanskrit: अङ्गदस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवस्सचिवैस्सह। लक्ष्मणं कुपितं श्रुत्वा मुमोचासनमात्मवान्4.32.1।।
transliteration: aṅgadasya vacaśśrutvā sugrīvassacivaissaha| lakṣmaṇṃ kupitṃ śrutvā mumocāsanamātmavān4.32.1||
meaning: On hearing about Lakshmana's anger from Angada, prudent Sugriva consulted his counsellors.

sanskrit: अथ प्रतिसमादिष्टो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। प्रविवेश गुहां घोरां किष्किन्धां रामशासनात्।।4.33.1।।
transliteration: atha pratisamādiṣṭo lakṣmaṇḥ paravīrahā| praviveśa guhāṃ ghorāṃ kiṣkindhāṃ rāmaśāsanāt||4.33.1||
meaning: Instructed by Rama, and having been permitted, Lakshmana, the slayer of enemies entered the frightful cave of Kishkinda.

sanskrit: तमप्रतिहतं क्रुद्धं प्रविष्टं पुरुषर्षभम्। सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः।।4.34.1।।
transliteration: tamapratihatṃ kruddhṃ praviṣṭṃ puruṣarṣabham| sugrīvo lakṣmaṇṃ dṛṣṭvā babhūva vyathitendriyḥ||4.34.1||
meaning: On seeing the angry Lakshmana, a bull among men, who could not be obstructed, enter in, Sugriva was disturbed.

sanskrit: तथा ब्रुवाणं सौमित्रिं प्रदीप्तमिव तेजसा। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं तारा ताराधिपनिभानना।।4.35.1।।
transliteration: tathā bruvāṇṃ saumitriṃ pradīptamiva tejasā| abravīllakṣmaṇṃ tārā tārādhipanibhānanā||4.35.1||
meaning: While Lakshmana, the son of Sumitra, was glowing like fire with his brilliance, thus spoke the moonfaced Tara:

sanskrit: इत्युक्तस्तारया वाक्यं प्रश्रितं धर्मसंहितम्। मृदुस्वभावस्सौमित्रिः प्रतिजग्राह तद्वचः।।4.36.1।।
transliteration: ityuktastārayā vākyṃ praśritṃ dharmasṃhitam| mṛdusvabhāvassaumitriḥ pratijagrāha tadvacḥ||4.36.1||
meaning: Thus the gentlenatured Saumitri accepted Tara's courteous words sanctioned by dharma.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना। हनूमन्तं स्थितं पार्श्वे सचिवन्त्विदमब्रवीत्।।4.37.1।।
transliteration: evamuktastu sugrīvo lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā| hanūmantṃ sthitṃ pārśve sacivantvidamabravīt||4.37.1||
meaning: Having heard the great Lakshmana Sugriva said to Hanuman, the minister who stood by his side:

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य च तत्सर्वमुपायनमुपाहृतम्। वानरान्सान्त्वयित्वा च सर्वानेव व्यसर्जयत्।।4.38.1।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya ca tatsarvamupāyanamupāhṛtam| vānarānsāntvayitvā ca sarvāneva vyasarjayat||4.38.1||
meaning: On receiving all the gifts presented by the monkeys, Sugriva permitted them to go happy.

sanskrit: इति ब्रुवाणं सुग्रीवं रामो धर्मभृतां वरः। बाहुभ्यां सम्परिष्वज्य प्रत्युवाच कृताञ्जलिम्।।4.39.1।।
transliteration: iti bruvāṇṃ sugrīvṃ rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varḥ| bāhubhyāṃ sampariṣvajya pratyuvāca kṛtāñjalim||4.39.1||
meaning: On hearing Sugriva who stood with folded hands, Rama, the foremost among the upholders of righteousness, hugged him and said:

sanskrit: ततः प्रहृष्टौ हनुमान्कृत्यवानिति तद्वचः। श्रुत्वा मधुरसम्भाषं सुग्रीवं मनसा गतः4.4.1।।
transliteration: tatḥ prahṛṣṭau hanumānkṛtyavāniti tadvacḥ| śrutvā madhurasambhāṣṃ  sugrīvṃ manasā gatḥ4.4.1||
meaning: After listening to the sweet words of Lakshmana, Hanuman, having done what he had to do felt happy and thought of Sugriva.

sanskrit: अथ राजा समृद्धार्थस्सुग्रीवः प्लवगेश्वरः। उवाच नरशार्दूलं रामं परबलार्दनम्।।4.40.1।।
transliteration: atha rājā samṛddhārthassugrīvḥ plavageśvarḥ| uvāca naraśārdūlṃ rāmṃ parabalārdanam||4.40.1||
meaning: Sugriva, lord of monkeys, who was supported by a massive army informed Rama, the tiger among men and a crusher of the enemy army

sanskrit: ततः प्रस्थाप्य सुग्रीवस्तन्महद्वानरं बलम्। दक्षिणां प्रेषयामास वानरानभिलक्षितान्।।4.41.1।।
transliteration: tatḥ prasthāpya sugrīvastanmahadvānarṃ balam| dakṣiṇāṃ preṣayāmāsa vānarānabhilakṣitān||4.41.1||
meaning: Sugriva then sends in the southern direction another vanara army known for their excellence.

sanskrit: अथ प्रस्थाप्य सुग्रीवस्तान्हरीन्दक्षिणां दिशम्। अब्रवीन्मेघसङ्काशं सुषेणं नाम यूथपम्।।4.42.1।।
transliteration: atha prasthāpya sugrīvastānharīndakṣiṇāṃ diśam| abravīnmeghasaṅkāśṃ suṣeṇṃ nāma yūthapam||4.42.1||
meaning: After sending the monkeys in the southern direction, Sugriva said to the cloudlike troop leader called Sushena.

sanskrit: ततस्सन्दिश्य सुग्रीवश्श्वशुरं पश्चिमां दिशम्। वीरं शतवलिं नाम वानरं वानरर्षभः।।4.43.1।।
transliteration: tatassandiśya sugrīvaśśvaśurṃ paścimāṃ diśam| vīrṃ śatavaliṃ nāma vānarṃ vānararṣabhḥ||4.43.1||
meaning: Sugriva, the bull among monkeys, having sent his fatherinlaw in the western direction, said to Satavali, troop leader of the monkeys:

sanskrit: विशेषेण तु सुग्रीवो हनूमत्यर्थमुक्तवान्। स हि तस्मिन्हरिश्रेष्ठे निश्चितार्थोऽर्थसाधने।।4.44.1।।
transliteration: viśeṣeṇa tu sugrīvo hanūmatyarthamuktavān| sa hi tasminhariśreṣṭhe niścitārtho'rthasādhane||4.44.1||
meaning: Sugriva mentioned about the capacity of Hanuman, the best of monkeys as he knew he would surely succeed in accomplishing the task.

sanskrit: सर्वांश्चाहूय सुग्रीवः प्लवगान् प्लवगर्षभः। समस्तानब्रवीद्भूयो रामकार्यर्थसिद्धये।।4.45.1।। एवमेतद्विचेतव्यं यन्मया परिक
transliteration: sarvāṃścāhūya sugrīvḥ plavagān plavagarṣabhḥ| samastānabravīdbhūyo rāmakāryarthasiddhaye||4.45.1|| evametadvicetavyṃ yan
meaning: Summoning the entire body of vanaras, Sugriva, the bull among monkeys, said, 'Go to the places I have described and look for Sita in order to fulfil Rama's objective'.

sanskrit: गतेषु वानरेन्द्रेषु रामस्सुग्रीवमब्रवीत्। कथं भवान्विजानीते सर्वं वै मण्डलं भुवः।।4.46.1।।
transliteration: gateṣu vānarendreṣu rāmassugrīvamabravīt| kathṃ bhavānvijānīte sarvṃ vai maṇḍalṃ bhuvḥ||4.46.1||
meaning: When the chieftains of the monkeys left, Rama enquired Sugriva, how he had come to know the regions of the entire earth (which is a mandala. a circular form).

sanskrit: दर्शनार्थं तु वैदेह्यास्सर्वतः कपियूधपाः। व्यादिष्टाः कपिराजेन यथोक्तं जग्मुरञ्जसा।।4.47.1।।
transliteration: darśanārthṃ tu vaidehyāssarvatḥ kapiyūdhapāḥ| vyādiṣṭāḥ kapirājena yathoktṃ jagmurañjasā||4.47.1||
meaning: The leaders of vanara troops went fast in all directions to look for Vaidehi following the instructions of the king of vanaras.

sanskrit: सह ताराङ्गदाभ्यां तु गत्वा स हनुमान्कपिः। सुग्रीवेण यथोद्दिष्टं तं देशमुपचक्रमे।।4.48.1।।
transliteration: saha tārāṅgadābhyāṃ tu gatvā sa hanumānkapiḥ| sugrīveṇa yathoddiṣṭṃ tṃ deśamupacakrame||4.48.1||
meaning: Hanuman, the monkey accompanied by Tara and Angada proceeded as instructed by Sugriva in the (South) direction.

sanskrit: अथाङ्गदस्तदा सर्वान्वानरानिदमब्रवीत्। परिश्रान्तो महाप्राज्ञस्समाश्वास्य शनैर्वचः।।4.49.1।।
transliteration: athāṅgadastadā sarvānvānarānidamabravīt| pariśrānto mahāprājñassamāśvāsya śanairvacḥ||4.49.1||
meaning: Wise Angada, exhausted after the search, collected the monkeys, and consoling them, said slowly:

sanskrit: ऋश्यमूकात्तु हनुमान्गत्वा तु मलयं गिरिम्। आचचक्षे तदा वीरौ कपिराजाय राघवौ4.5.1।।
transliteration: ṛśyamūkāttu hanumāngatvā tu malayṃ girim| ācacakṣe tadā vīrau kapirājāya rāghavau4.5.1||
meaning: Leaving Rishyamuka, Hanuman reached the Malaya mountain. Seeing the chief of monkeys there, he announced the arrival of the heroic Raghavas.

sanskrit: सह ताराङ्गदाभ्यां तु सङ्गम्य हनुमान्कपिः। विचिनोति स्म विन्ध्यस्य गुहाश्च गहनानि च।।4.50.1।।
transliteration: saha tārāṅgadābhyāṃ tu saṅgamya hanumānkapiḥ| vicinoti sma vindhyasya guhāśca gahanāni ca||4.50.1||
meaning: Hanuman, together with the monkeys, Tara and Angada, searched in the impenetrable places and caves of Vindhya.

sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा हनुमांस्तत्र पुनः कृष्णाजिनाम्बराम्। अब्रवीत्तां महाभागां तापसीं धर्मचारिणीम्।।4.51.1।।
transliteration: ityuktvā hanumāṃstatra punḥ kṛṣṇājināmbarām| abravīttāṃ mahābhāgāṃ tāpasīṃ dharmacāriṇīm||4.51.1||
meaning: On meeting the distinguished, righteous ascetic woman robed in deer skin, Hanuman said:

sanskrit: अथ तानब्रवीत्सर्वान्विश्रान्तान्हरियूथपान्। इदं वचनमेकाग्रा तापसी धर्मचारिणी।।4.52.1।।
transliteration: atha tānabravītsarvānviśrāntānhariyūthapān| idṃ vacanamekāgrā tāpasī dharmacāriṇī||4.52.1||
meaning: After the monkey leaders had taken rest, the noble ascetic with undiverted attention said these words:

sanskrit: एवमुक्तश्शुभं वाक्यं तापस्या धर्मसंहितम्। उवाच हनुमान्वाक्यं तामनिन्दितचेष्टिताम्।।4.53.1।।
transliteration: evamuktaśśubhṃ vākyṃ tāpasyā dharmasṃhitam| uvāca hanumānvākyṃ tāmaninditaceṣṭitām||4.53.1||
meaning: To the auspicious words of the righteous, blameless hermitess Hanuman replied:

sanskrit: तथा ब्रुवति तारे तु ताराधिपतिवर्चसि। अथ मेने हृतं राज्यं हनूमानङ्गदेन तत्।।4.54.1।।
transliteration: tathā bruvati tāre tu tārādhipativarcasi| atha mene hṛtṃ rājyṃ hanūmānaṅgadena tat||4.54.1||
meaning: Hanuman listened to the proposal of Tara, whose face was like the Moon, lord of the stars. (After listening to Tara) he thought Angada might take over the kingdom from Sugriva.

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं प्रश्रितं धर्मसंहितम्। स्वामिसत्कारसंयुक्तमङ्गदो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।4.55.1।।
transliteration: śrutvā hanumato vākyṃ praśritṃ dharmasṃhitam| svāmisatkārasṃyuktamaṅgado vākyamabravīt||4.55.1||
meaning: On hearing Hanuman's humble words (of advice) consistent with righteousness and full of devotion to his master, the king, Angada said:

sanskrit: उपविष्टास्तु ते सर्वे यस्मिन्प्रायं गिरिस्थले। हरयो गृध्रराजश्च तं देशमुपचक्रमे।।4.56.1।। सम्पातिर्नाम नाम्ना तु चिरञ्जी
transliteration: upaviṣṭāstu te sarve yasminprāyṃ giristhale| harayo gṛdhrarājaśca tṃ deśamupacakrame||4.56.1|| sampātirnāma nāmnā tu cir
meaning: While the monkeys were preparing to fast unto death on the plateau of the mountain, Sampati, the prosperous king of vultures, the longlived elder brother of Jatayu widely known for his strength, appeared there.

sanskrit: तत्तु श्रुत्वा तथा वाक्यमङ्गदस्य मुखोद्गतम्। अब्रवीद्वचनं गृध्रस्तीक्ष्णतुण्डो महास्वनः।।4.57.1।।
transliteration: tattu śrutvā tathā vākyamaṅgadasya mukhodgatam| abravīdvacanṃ gṛdhrastīkṣṇatuṇḍo mahāsvanḥ||4.57.1||
meaning: On hearing the words that came from Angada's mouth, the sharpbeaked, loudvoiced vulture (Sampati) said:

sanskrit: इत्युक्तः करुणं वाक्यं वानरैस्त्यक्तजीवितैः। सबाष्पो वानरान्गृध्रः प्रत्युवाच महास्वनः।।4.58.1।।
transliteration: ityuktḥ karuṇṃ vākyṃ vānaraistyaktajīvitaiḥ| sabāṣpo vānarāngṛdhrḥ pratyuvāca mahāsvanḥ||4.58.1||
meaning: On hearing the pathetic words from the monkeys who had given up hope of life, the loudvoiced vulture wailing replied:

sanskrit: ततस्तदमृतास्वादं गृध्रराजेन भाषितम्। निशम्य मुदिता हृष्टास्ते वचः प्लवगर्षभाः।।4.59.1।।
transliteration: tatastadamṛtāsvādṃ gṛdhrarājena bhāṣitam| niśamya muditā hṛṣṭāste vacḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ||4.59.1||
meaning: The mighty monkeys were delighted to hear the nectarlike words of the king of vultures.

sanskrit: पुनरेवाब्रवीत्प्रीतो राघवं रघुनन्दनम्। अयमाख्याति मे राम सचिवो मन्त्रिसत्तमः4.6.1।। हनुमान्यन्निमित्तं त्वं निर्जनं वनमा
transliteration: punarevābravītprīto rāghavṃ raghunandanam| ayamākhyāti me rāma sacivo mantrisattamḥ4.6.1|| hanumānyannimittṃ tvṃ nirjanṃ
meaning: Sugriva was pleased to say to Rama, delight of the Raghu race once again, 'O Rama, Hanuman, jewel among Ministers, has told me the cause of your coming to this desolate forest. While you were residing in the forest, a de

sanskrit: ततः कृतोदकं स्नातं तं गृध्रं हरियूथपाः। उपविष्टा गिरौ रम्ये परिवार्य समन्ततः।।4.60.1।।
transliteration: tatḥ kṛtodakṃ snātṃ tṃ gṛdhrṃ hariyūthapāḥ| upaviṣṭā girau ramye parivārya samantatḥ||4.60.1||
meaning: Sampati bathed and offered libations to Jatayu. Then all the monkeys sat round him on the beautiful mountain.

sanskrit: ततस्तद्दारुणं कर्म दुष्करं सहसात्कृतम्। आचचक्षे मुनेस्सर्वं सूर्यानुगमनं तथा।।4.61.1।।
transliteration: tatastaddāruṇṃ karma duṣkarṃ sahasātkṛtam| ācacakṣe munessarvṃ sūryānugamanṃ tathā||4.61.1||
meaning: 'Then I revealed everything to the sage,including the arrogant, impetuous action of rashly following the Sun (for challenging Indra).

sanskrit: एवमुक्ता मुनिश्रेष्ठ मरुदं दुःखितो भृशं। अथ ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं तु भगवानिदमब्रवीत्।।4.62.1।।
transliteration: evamuktā muniśreṣṭha marudṃ duḥkhito bhṛśṃ| atha dhyātvā muhūrtṃ tu bhagavānidamabravīt||4.62.1||
meaning: 'When thus I spoke to the venerable sage in that manner roaring very painfully the divine sage replied after reflecting silently for a moment:

sanskrit: एतैरन्यैश्च बहुभिर्वाक्यैर्वाक्यविशारदः। मां प्रशस्याभ्यनुज्ञाप्य प्रविष्टस्स स्वमालयम्।।4.63.1।।
transliteration: etairanyaiśca bahubhirvākyairvākyaviśāradḥ| māṃ praśasyābhyanujñāpya praviṣṭassa svamālayam||4.63.1||
meaning: 'The sage who was skilful in speech, having praised me thus and in many other ways, permitted me to leave and entered his dwelling.

sanskrit: आख्याता गृध्रराजेन समुत्प्लुत्य प्लवङ्गमाः। सङ्गताः प्रीतिसंयुक्ता विनेदुर्भीमविक्रमाः।।4.64.1।।
transliteration: ākhyātā gṛdhrarājena samutplutya plavaṅgamāḥ| saṅgatāḥ prītisṃyuktā vinedurbhīmavikramāḥ||4.64.1||
meaning: Hearing the words spoken by the king of vultures, the highly courageous monkeys assembled together and leaped with joyscreaming.

sanskrit: अथाङ्गदवचश्श्रुत्वा ते सर्वे वानरर्षभाः। स्वं स्वं गतौ समुत्साहमूचुस्तत्र यथाक्रमम्।।4.65.1।। गजो गवाक्षो गवयश्शरभो गन्ध
transliteration: athāṅgadavacaśśrutvā te sarve vānararṣabhāḥ| svṃ svṃ gatau samutsāhamūcustatra yathākramam||4.65.1|| gajo gavākṣo gavaya
meaning: Thereafter, on hearing Angada, all the leaders among the monkeys, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Mainda, Dvivida, Sushena and Jambavan as well expressed one after the other their capability for leaping.

sanskrit: अनेकशतसाहस्रीं विषण्णां हरिवाहिनीम्। जाम्बवान्समुदीक्ष्यैवं हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत्।।4.66.1।।
transliteration: anekaśatasāhasrīṃ viṣaṇṇāṃ harivāhinīm| jāmbavānsamudīkṣyaivṃ hanūmantamathābravīt||4.66.1||
meaning: Then Jambavan observed the worries of several hundred thousands of the monkey army and said to Hanuman:

sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा जृम्भमाणं ते क्रमितुं शतयोजनम्। वीर्येणापूर्यमाणं च सहसा वानरोत्तमम्।।4.67.1।। सहसा शोकमुत्सृज्य प्रहर्षेण स
transliteration: tṃ dṛṣṭvā jṛmbhamāṇṃ te kramituṃ śatayojanam| vīryeṇāpūryamāṇṃ ca sahasā vānarottamam||4.67.1|| sahasā śokamutsṛjya prah
meaning: 'In order to cross a hundred yojanas, Hanuman, the best of monkeys expanded his might and strength. Seeing him, a warrior of great strength, all the monkeys, filled with enthusiasm at once gave up grief and collected tog

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो रामेणार्तेन वानरः। अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं सबाष्पं बाष्पगद्गदः।।4.7.1।।
transliteration: evamuktastu sugrīvo rāmeṇārtena vānarḥ| abravītprāñjalirvākyṃ sabāṣpṃ bāṣpagadgadḥ||4.7.1||
meaning: On hearing the words of Rama in deep distress, the monkey replied to him with folded hands, his throat choked with tears:

sanskrit: परितुष्टस्तु सुग्रीवस्तेन वाक्येन वानरः। लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो राममिदं वचनमब्रवीत्4.8.1।।
transliteration: parituṣṭastu sugrīvastena vākyena vānarḥ| lakṣmaṇasyāgrato rāmamidṃ vacanamabravīt4.8.1||
meaning: Sugriva, the monkey was very pleased with Rama's words and said to him in front of Lakshmana:

sanskrit: वाली नाम मम भ्राता ज्येष्ठश्शत्रुनिषूदनः। पितुर्बहुमतो नित्यं ममापि च तथा पुरा4.9.1।।
transliteration: vālī nāma mama bhrātā jyeṣṭhaśśatruniṣūdanḥ| piturbahumato nityṃ mamāpi ca tathā purā4.9.1||
meaning: 'My elder brother called Vali, capable of exterminating enemies was always highly regarded by my father and me.

sanskrit: ततो रावणनीतायाः सीतायाः शत्रुकर्शनः। इयेष पदमन्वेष्टुं चारणाचरिते पथि।।5.1.1।।
transliteration: tato rāvaṇanītāyāḥ sītāyāḥ śatrukarśanḥ| iyeṣa padamanveṣṭuṃ cāraṇācarite pathi||5.1.1||
meaning: Hanuman, crusher of enemies resolved to find the whereabouts of Sita, carried away by Ravana. He followed the path of the Charanas, celestial bards.

sanskrit: तत्र दिव्योपमं मुख्यं स्फाटिकं रत्नभूषितम्। अवेक्षमाणो हनुमान् ददर्श शयनासनम्।।5.10.1।। दान्तकाञ्चनचित्राङ्गैर्वैडूर्यैश
transliteration: tatra divyopamṃ mukhyṃ sphāṭikṃ ratnabhūṣitam| avekṣamāṇo hanumān dadarśa śayanāsanam||5.10.1|| dāntakāñcanacitrāṅgairva
meaning: Looking around, Hanuman noticed a bed chamber, with a heavenly dais on which he saw a couch encrusted with crystals, vaidurya, and inlaid with colourful ivory and gold. It had an exquisite rich covering.

sanskrit: अवधूय च तां बुद्धिं बभूवावस्थितस्तदा। जगाम चापरां चिन्तां सीतां प्रति महाकपिः।।5.11.1।।
transliteration: avadhūya ca tāṃ buddhiṃ babhūvāvasthitastadā| jagāma cāparāṃ cintāṃ sītāṃ prati mahākapiḥ||5.11.1||
meaning: The great vanara, having rejected his judgement, started thinking again.

sanskrit: स तस्य मध्ये भवनस्य मारुति र्लतागृहांश्चित्रगृहान्निशागृहान्। जगाम सीतां प्रति दर्शनोत्सुको न चैव तां पश्यति चारुदर्शनाम
transliteration: sa tasya madhye bhavanasya māruti rlatāgṛhāṃścitragṛhānniśāgṛhān| jagāma sītāṃ prati darśanotsuko na caiva tāṃ paśyati c
meaning: Anxious to find Sita, Hanuman revisited the bowers of creepers, picture galleries and domitories located in the midst of the mansion, but did not find that beautiful Sita.

sanskrit: विमानात्तु सुसम्क्रम्य प्राकारं हरियूथपः। हनुमान्वेगवानासीद्यथा विद्युद्घनान्तरे।।5.13.1।।
transliteration: vimānāttu susamkramya prākārṃ hariyūthapḥ| hanumānvegavānāsīdyathā vidyudghanāntare||5.13.1||
meaning: Hanuman, the vanara leader, jumped from the aerial chariot to the boundary wall like a flash of lightning in the clouds.

sanskrit: स मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वा मनसा चाधिगम्य ताम्। अवप्लुतो महातेजाः प्राकारं तस्य वेश्मनः।।5.14.1।।
transliteration: sa muhūrtamiva dhyātvā manasā cādhigamya tām| avapluto mahātejāḥ prākārṃ tasya veśmanḥ||5.14.1||
meaning: Mighty Hanuman lost in thought for a moment, jumped down (the harem) to the boundary wall of the palace.

sanskrit: स वीक्षमाणस्तत्रस्थो मार्गमाणश्च मैथिलीम्। अवेक्षमाणश्च महीं सर्वां तामन्ववैक्षत।।5.15.1।।
transliteration: sa vīkṣamāṇastatrastho mārgamāṇaśca maithilīm| avekṣamāṇaśca mahīṃ sarvāṃ tāmanvavaikṣata||5.15.1||
meaning: Hanuman looked out from the simsupa tree all around for Mythili scanning the ground below.

sanskrit: प्रशस्य तु प्रशस्तव्यां सीतां तां हरिपुङ्गवः। गुणाभिरामं रामं च पुनश्चिन्तापरोऽभवत्।।5.16.1।।
transliteration: praśasya tu praśastavyāṃ sītāṃ tāṃ haripuṅgavḥ| guṇābhirāmṃ rāmṃ ca punaścintāparo'bhavat||5.16.1||
meaning: Hanuman, the bull among monkeys, admired the laudable Sita and the virtuous Rama and once again began to lament.

sanskrit: ततः कमुदषण्डाभो निर्मलं निर्मलोदयः। प्रजगाम नभश्चन्द्रो हंसो नीलमिवोदकम्।।5.17.1।।
transliteration: tatḥ kamudaṣaṇḍābho nirmalṃ nirmalodayḥ| prajagāma nabhaścandro hṃso nīlamivodakam||5.17.1||
meaning: Then the Moon shining like a bed of lilies rose stainless, ascended the clear sky and looked like a swan swimming through blue water.

sanskrit: तथा विप्रेक्ष्यमाणस्य वनं पुष्पितपादपम्। विचिन्वतश्च वैदेहीं किंचिच्छेषा निशाऽभवत्।।5.18.1।।
transliteration: tathā viprekṣyamāṇasya vanṃ puṣpitapādapam| vicinvataśca vaidehīṃ kiṃciccheṣā niśā'bhavat||5.18.1||
meaning: The night came to a close while Hanuman went searching and looking for Sita at Ashoka grove full of flowering trees.

sanskrit: तस्मिन्नेव ततः काले राजपुत्री त्वनिन्दिता। रूपयौवनसम्पन्नं भूषणोत्तमभूषितम्।।5.19.1।। ततो दृष्ट्वैव वैदेही रावणं राक्षसा
transliteration: tasminneva tatḥ kāle rājaputrī tvaninditā| rūpayauvanasampannṃ bhūṣaṇottamabhūṣitam||5.19.1|| tato dṛṣṭvaiva vaidehī rāv
meaning: On just seeing Ravana, the lord of demons from a distance, adorned with the best of ornaments the charming, young, blameles princess Vaidehi of beautiful waist trembled like a banana plant shaken by a strong wind.

sanskrit: स सागरमनादृष्यमतिक्रम्य महाबलः। त्रिकूटशिखरे लङ्कां स्थितां स्वस्थो ददर्श ह।।5.2.1।।
transliteration: sa sāgaramanādṛṣyamatikramya mahābalḥ| trikūṭaśikhare laṅkāṃ sthitāṃ svastho dadarśa ha||5.2.1||
meaning: The mighty Hanuman crossed the inviolable sea, stood comfortably on the peak of Trikuta mountain and looked at Lanka.

sanskrit: स तां परिवृतां दीनां निरानन्दां तपस्विनीम्। साकारैर्मधुरैर्वाक्यैर्न्यदर्शयत रावणः।।5.20.1।।
transliteration: sa tāṃ parivṛtāṃ dīnāṃ nirānandāṃ tapasvinīm| sākārairmadhurairvākyairnyadarśayata rāvaṇḥ||5.20.1||
meaning: Ravana expressed his intention in sweet words to the depressed and griefstricken ascetic Sita surrounded by demon guards:

sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सीता रौद्रस्य रक्षसः। आर्ता दीनस्वरा दीनं प्रत्युवाच शनैर्वचः।।5.21.1।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanṃ śrutvā sītā raudrasya rakṣasḥ| ārtā dīnasvarā dīnṃ pratyuvāca śanairvacḥ||5.21.1||
meaning: On hearing the demon's haughty words, oppressed, pitiable Sita replied slowly in a sorrowful tone.

sanskrit: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा परुषं राक्षसाधिपः। प्रत्युवाच ततः सीतां विप्रियं प्रियदर्शनाम्।।5.22.1।।
transliteration: sītāyā vacanṃ śrutvā paruṣṃ rākṣasādhipḥ| pratyuvāca tatḥ sītāṃ vipriyṃ priyadarśanām||5.22.1||
meaning: Hearing the sharp words of pleasing Sita, the lord of demons replied in unpleasant terms:

sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा मैथिलीं राजा रावणः शत्रुरावणः। सन्दिश्य च ततः सर्वा राक्षसीर्निर्जगाम ह।।5.23.1।।
transliteration: ityuktvā maithilīṃ rājā rāvaṇḥ śatrurāvaṇḥ| sandiśya ca tatḥ sarvā rākṣasīrnirjagāma ha||5.23.1||
meaning: King Ravana, tormentor of enemies, having thus spoken to Mythili commanded the demonesses and departed.

sanskrit: ततः सीतामुपागम्य राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः। परुषं परुषा नार्य ऊचुस्तां वाक्यमप्रियम्।।5.24.1।।
transliteration: tatḥ sītāmupāgamya rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ| paruṣṃ paruṣā nārya ūcustāṃ vākyamapriyam||5.24.1||
meaning: Then the hideous ogresses approached Sita and spoke these harsh words in an unbecoming manner:

sanskrit: अथ तासां वदन्तीनां परुषं दारुणं बहु। राक्षसीनामासौम्यानां रुरोद जनकात्मजा।।5.25.1।।
transliteration: atha tāsāṃ vadantīnāṃ paruṣṃ dāruṇṃ bahu| rākṣasīnāmāsaumyānāṃ ruroda janakātmajā||5.25.1||
meaning: On hearing the many harsh words of dire threat by the ugly ogresses, the daughter of Janaka wept.

sanskrit: प्रसक्ताश्रुमुखीत्यवं ब्रुवन्ती जनकात्मजा। आधोगतमुखी बाला विलप्तुमुपचक्रमे।।5.26.1।।
transliteration: prasaktāśrumukhītyavṃ bruvantī janakātmajā| ādhogatamukhī bālā vilaptumupacakrame||5.26.1||
meaning: The young daughter of king Janaka thus speaking, began to cry, her face bent down.

sanskrit: इत्युक्तास्सीतया घोरं राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्छिताः। काश्चिज्जग्मुस्तदाख्यातुं रावणस्य तरस्विनः।।5.27.1।।
transliteration: ityuktāssītayā ghorṃ rākṣasyḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ| kāścijjagmustadākhyātuṃ rāvaṇasya tarasvinḥ||5.27.1||
meaning: Hearing Sita's words, some terrifying demonesses, overwhelmed with anger, went to inform Ravana, who was quick to act.

sanskrit: सा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वचो निशम्य तद्रावणस्याप्रियमप्रियार्ता। सीता वितत्रास यथा वनान्ते सिंहाभिपन्ना गजराजकन्या।।5.28.1।।
transliteration: sā rākṣasendrasya vaco niśamya tadrāvaṇasyāpriyamapriyārtā| sītā vitatrāsa yathā vanānte siṃhābhipannā gajarājakanyā||5.
meaning: After hearing the unpleasant words spoken by the king of demons, which caused restlessness and sorrow to Sita, she was terrified like the young calf of a lordly elephant fallen into the clutches of a lion in the midst of

sanskrit: तथागतां तां व्यथितामनिन्दितां व्यपेतहर्षां परिदीनमानसाम्। शुभां निमित्तानि शुभानि भेजिरे नरं श्रिया जुष्टमिवोपजीविनः।।5.
transliteration: tathāgatāṃ tāṃ vyathitāmaninditāṃ vyapetaharṣāṃ paridīnamānasām| śubhāṃ nimittāni śubhāni bhejire narṃ śriyā juṣṭamivopa
meaning: Like wellwishers flocking round a person on whom fortune is smiling, omens foretelling auspicious happenings in near future appeared to Sita. She was unimpeachable. She was in agony, distressed in mind, bereft of all joy

sanskrit: स लम्बशिखरे लम्बे लम्बतोयदसन्निभे। सत्त्वमास्थाय मेधावी हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः।।5.3.1।। निशि लङ्कां महासत्त्वो विवेश कपिकुञ
transliteration: sa lambaśikhare lambe lambatoyadasannibhe| sattvamāsthāya medhāvī hanumān mārutātmajḥ||5.3.1|| niśi laṅkāṃ mahāsattvo vi
meaning: The mighty son of the Windgod, intelligent Hanuman, an elephant among vanaras, standing on the peak of the Lamba which looked like a high rainbearing cloud and relying on his energy, entered by night the city of Lanka, r

sanskrit: हनुमानपि विक्रान्तः सर्वं शुश्राव तत्त्वतः। सीतायास्त्रिजटायाश्च राक्षसीनां च तर्जनम्।।5.30.1।।
transliteration: hanumānapi vikrāntḥ sarvṃ śuśrāva tattvatḥ| sītāyāstrijaṭāyāśca rākṣasīnāṃ ca tarjanam||5.30.1||
meaning: The valiant hero Hanuman heard everything including the lamentation of Sita and the dream of Trijata and the threats of the demonesses.

sanskrit: एवं बहुविधां चिन्तां चिन्तयित्वा महाकपिः। संश्रवे मधुरं वाक्यं वैदेह्या व्याजहार ह।।5.31.1।।
transliteration: evṃ bahuvidhāṃ cintāṃ cintayitvā mahākapiḥ| sṃśrave madhurṃ vākyṃ vaidehyā vyājahāra ha||5.31.1||
meaning: After deliberating in several ways the great Hanuman spoke these sweet words to Vaidehi:

sanskrit: ततश्शाखान्तरे लीनं दृष्ट्वा चलितमानसा। वेष्टितार्जुनवस्त्रं तं विद्युत्सङ्घातपिङ्गलम्।।5.32.1।।
transliteration: tataśśākhāntare līnṃ dṛṣṭvā calitamānasā| veṣṭitārjunavastrṃ tṃ vidyutsaṅghātapiṅgalam||5.32.1||
meaning: Sita got perplexed on seeing him (Hanuman), who was tawny in complexion and looked like a cluster of lightnings, clad in white and hidden in between the branches.

sanskrit: सोऽवतीर्य द्रुमात्तस्माद्विद्रुमप्रतिमाननः। विनीतवेषः कृपणः प्रणिपत्योपसृत्य च।।5.33.1।। तामब्रवीन्महातेजा हनूमान्मारुता
transliteration: so'vatīrya drumāttasmādvidrumapratimānanḥ| vinītaveṣḥ kṛpaṇḥ praṇipatyopasṛtya ca||5.33.1|| tāmabravīnmahātejā hanūmānmā
meaning: Hanuman, son of the Windgod whose face shone like coral, dressed in a sober manner climbed down the tree, went close to Sita, offered salutations with his palms on his head and spoke in sweet words:

sanskrit: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान्हरिपुङ्गवः। दुःखाद्दुःखाभिभूताया स्सान्त्वमुत्तरमब्रवीत्।।5.34.1।।
transliteration: tasyāstadvacanṃ śrutvā hanumānharipuṅgavḥ| duḥkhādduḥkhābhibhūtāyā ssāntvamuttaramabravīt||5.34.1||
meaning: Hearing the words of Sita who was overwhelmed with grief, the monkey leader Hanuman felt sad and thus spoke comforting her:

sanskrit: तां तु रामकथां श्रुत्वा वैदेही वानरर्षभात्। उवाच वचनं सान्त्वमिदं मधुरया गिरा।।5.35.1।।
transliteration: tāṃ tu rāmakathāṃ śrutvā vaidehī vānararṣabhāt| uvāca vacanṃ sāntvamidṃ madhurayā girā||5.35.1||
meaning: On hearing about Rama from the bull among vanaras, thus spoke Vaidehi politely in a sweet voice:

sanskrit: भूय एव महातेजा हनूमान्पवनात्मजः। अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं सीताप्रत्ययकारणात्।।5.36.1।।
transliteration: bhūya eva mahātejā hanūmānpavanātmajḥ| abravītpraśritṃ vākyṃ sītāpratyayakāraṇāt||5.36.1||
meaning: Mighty Hanuman, the son of the Windgod again spoke to Sita humbly to inspire confidence in her.

sanskrit: सीता तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना। हनूमन्तमुवाचेदं धर्मार्थसहितं वचः।।5.37.1।।
transliteration: sītā tadvacanṃ śrutvā pūrṇacandranibhānanā| hanūmantamuvācedṃ dharmārthasahitṃ vacḥ||5.37.1||
meaning: To the righteous words (about Rama's grief) of Hanuman, Sita with a face like the full moon replied.

sanskrit: ततस्स कपिशार्दूलस्तेन वाक्येन तोषितः। सीतामुवाच तच्छृत्वा वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः।।5.38.1।।
transliteration: tatassa kapiśārdūlastena vākyena toṣitḥ| sītāmuvāca tacchṛtvā vākyṃ vākyaviśāradḥ||5.38.1||
meaning: Satisfied with the words of Sita, the tiger among monkeys, who was eloquent in speech said:

sanskrit: मणिं दत्त्वा ततः सीता हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत्। अभिज्ञानमभिज्ञातमेतद्रामस्य तत्त्वतः।।5.39.1।।
transliteration: maṇiṃ dattvā tatḥ sītā hanūmantamathābravīt| abhijñānamabhijñātametadrāmasya tattvatḥ||5.39.1||
meaning: Sita gave the jewel to Hanuman and said, "This signet ornament is known to Rama very well".

sanskrit: स निर्जित्य पुरीं श्रेष्ठां लङ्कां तां कामरूपिणीम्। विक्रमेण महातेजा हनुमान् कपिसत्तमः।।5.4.1।। अद्वारेण च महाबाहुः प्रा
transliteration: sa nirjitya purīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ laṅkāṃ tāṃ kāmarūpiṇīm| vikrameṇa mahātejā hanumān kapisattamḥ||5.4.1|| advāreṇa ca mahābāhuḥ
meaning: Hanuman, the strongshouldered, mighty monkey chief having defeated the (presiding) deity of Lanka who could assume any form at her will, leaped over the boundary wall of the rear entrance of the excellent city by his pro

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य वायुसूनोर्महात्मनः। उवाचात्महितं वाक्यं सीता सुरसुतोपमा।।5.40.1।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu vacanṃ tasya vāyusūnormahātmanḥ| uvācātmahitṃ vākyṃ sītā surasutopamā||5.40.1||
meaning: Sita who was like the daughter of the gods heard the son of the Windgod for her benefit and replied:

sanskrit: स च वाग्भिः प्रशस्ताभिर्गमिष्यन्पूजितस्तया। तस्माद्देशादपक्रम्य चिन्तयामास वानरः।।5.41.1।।
transliteration: sa ca vāgbhiḥ praśastābhirgamiṣyanpūjitastayā| tasmāddeśādapakramya cintayāmāsa vānarḥ||5.41.1||
meaning: Having been honoured and praised by Sita's words, Hanuman prepared to depart from Sita's presence.

sanskrit: ततः पक्षिनिनादेन वृक्षभङ्गस्वनेन च। बभूवुस्त्राससम्भ्रान्तास्सर्वे लङ्कानिवासिनः।।5.42.1।।
transliteration: tatḥ pakṣininādena vṛkṣabhaṅgasvanena ca| babhūvustrāsasambhrāntāssarve laṅkānivāsinḥ||5.42.1||
meaning: The residents of Lanka panicked at the shrieking sounds of birds and cracking sounds of trees.

sanskrit: ततस्स किङ्करान्हत्वा हनुमान्ध्यानमास्थितः। वनं भग्नं मया चैत्यप्रासादो न विनाशितः।।5.43.1।। तस्मात्प्रासादमप्येवं भीमं व
transliteration: tatassa kiṅkarānhatvā hanumāndhyānamāsthitḥ| vanṃ bhagnṃ mayā caityaprāsādo na vināśitḥ||5.43.1|| tasmātprāsādamapyevṃ b
meaning: Having slain the kinkaras, Hanuman stood and reflected, ' I have ruined the garden and not the palatial buildings that are like temples (Chaityas)'. Then Hanuman, son of the Windgod, decided in his mind to show his stren

sanskrit: सन्दिष्टो राक्षसेन्द्रेण प्रहस्तस्य सुतो बली। जम्बुमाली महादंष्ट्रो निर्जगाम धनुर्धरः।।5.44.1।। रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरस्स्रग्व
transliteration: sandiṣṭo rākṣasendreṇa prahastasya suto balī| jambumālī mahādṃṣṭro nirjagāma dhanurdharḥ||5.44.1|| raktamālyāmbaradharas
meaning: Commanded by the demon king, Jambumali the invincible son of Prahasta, who had large teeth in front, big rolling eyes, red flower garland, red robes and a chaplet with beautiful earrings. He went round twanging his produ

sanskrit: ततस्ते राक्षसेन्द्रेण चोदिता मन्त्रिणस्सुताः। निर्ययुर्भवनात्तस्मात्सप्तसप्तार्चिवर्चसः।।5.45.1।। महाबलपरीवारा धनुष्मन्त
transliteration: tataste rākṣasendreṇa coditā mantriṇassutāḥ| niryayurbhavanāttasmātsaptasaptārcivarcasḥ||5.45.1|| mahābalaparīvārā dhanu
meaning: Commanded by Ravana, the seven sons of minister blazing like fire followed by large army of experts in archery, possessing great valour, armed with weapons, being distinguished wielders of weapons, skilled in the use of

sanskrit: हतान्मन्त्रिसुतान् बुद्ध्वा वानरेण महात्मना। रावणस्संवृताकारश्चकार मतिमुत्तमाम्।।5.46.1।।
transliteration: hatānmantrisutān buddhvā vānareṇa mahātmanā| rāvaṇassṃvṛtākāraścakāra matimuttamām||5.46.1||
meaning: Coming to know that the seven sons of the ministers were slain by the great vanara, Ravana, who had concealed his feelings of agony thought of a good plan.

sanskrit: सेनापतीन्पञ्च स तु प्रमापितान् हनूमता सानुचरान्सवाहनान्। समीक्ष्य राजा समरोद्धतोन्मुखं कुमारमक्षं प्रसमैक्षताग्रतः।।5.47
transliteration: senāpatīnpañca sa tu pramāpitān hanūmatā sānucarānsavāhanān| samīkṣya rājā samaroddhatonmukhṃ kumāramakṣṃ prasamaikṣatāg
meaning: Hearing the sad news of death of the five army generals including their followers and destruction of their vehicles, King (Ravana) gave a suggestive look at prince Aksha who was inclined to fight the war.

sanskrit: ततस्तु रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा हनूमताक्षे निहते कुमारे। मनस्समाधाय सदेवकल्पं समादिदेशेन्द्रजितं सरोषः।।5.48.1।।
transliteration: tatastu rakṣodhipatirmahātmā hanūmatākṣe nihate kumāre| manassamādhāya sadevakalpṃ samādideśendrajitṃ saroṣḥ||5.48.1||
meaning: Thereafter the great demon king, mighty angry at the death of Aksha in the hands of Hanuman, controlled his feeling and ordered Indrajit who was like a godhead.

sanskrit: ततस्स कर्मणा तस्य विस्मितो भीमविक्रमः। हनुमान्रोषताम्राक्षो रक्षोधिपमवैक्षत।।5.49.1।।
transliteration: tatassa karmaṇā tasya vismito bhīmavikramḥ| hanumānroṣatāmrākṣo rakṣodhipamavaikṣata||5.49.1||
meaning: The highly courageous Hanuman, astonished at the action (of binding and dragging him to the court) by the demon king looked at him with eyes turned red in anger.

sanskrit: ततः स मध्यंगतमंशुमन्तं ज्योत्स्नावितानं महदुद्वमन्तम्। ददर्श धीमान् दिवि भानुमन्तं गोष्ठे वृषं मत्तमिव भ्रमन्तम्।।5.5.1।
transliteration: tatḥ sa madhyṃgatamṃśumantṃ jyotsnāvitānṃ mahadudvamantam| dadarśa dhīmān divi bhānumantṃ goṣṭhe vṛṣṃ mattamiva bhramant
meaning: Then intelligent Hanuman observed the Moon in the central part of the sky spreading a canopy of his luminescence like the Sun, and looking like an intoxicated mighty (white) bull moving in a stable.

sanskrit: तमुद्वीक्ष्य महाबाहुः पिङ्गाक्षं पुरत स्थितम्। कोपेन महताऽविष्टो रावणो लोकरावणः।।5.50.1।। शङ्काहृतात्मा दध्यौ स कपीन्द्र
transliteration: tamudvīkṣya mahābāhuḥ piṅgākṣṃ purata sthitam| kopena mahatā'viṣṭo rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇḥ||5.50.1|| śaṅkāhṛtātmā dadhyau sa k
meaning: The mighty armed Ravana, a tormentor of all worlds, overcome with anger beheld the tawnyeyed brilliant lord of monkeys who stood before him and started thinking in his mind full of apprehensions.

sanskrit: तं समीक्ष्य महासत्त्वं सत्त्ववान्हरिसत्तमः। वाक्यमर्थवदव्यग्रस्तमुवाच दशाननम्।।5.51.1।।
transliteration: tṃ samīkṣya mahāsattvṃ sattvavānharisattamḥ| vākyamarthavadavyagrastamuvāca daśānanam||5.51.1||
meaning: Hanuman, the best of monkeys, looking at the very powerful Ravana spoke slowly these highly meaningful words.

sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वानरस्य महात्मनः। आज्ञापयद्वधं तस्य रावणः क्रोधमूर्छितः।।5.52.1।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanṃ śrutvā vānarasya mahātmanḥ| ājñāpayadvadhṃ tasya rāvaṇḥ krodhamūrchitḥ||5.52.1||
meaning: Hearing the great vanara's speech, Ravana overwhelmed with anger ordered the execution of Hanuman.

sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवो महात्मनः। देशकालहितं वाक्यं भ्रातुरुत्तरमब्रवीत्।।5.53.1।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanṃ śrutvā daśagrīvo mahātmanḥ| deśakālahitṃ vākyṃ bhrāturuttaramabravīt||5.53.1||
meaning: The tenheaded Ravana heard his brother, the greatsoul Vibhishana's timely advice which was in keeping with the laws of the land and replied.

sanskrit: वीक्षमाणस्ततो लङ्कां कपिः कृतमनोरथः।।5.54.1।। वर्धमानसमुत्साहः कार्यशेषमचिन्तयत्।
transliteration: vīkṣamāṇastato laṅkāṃ kapiḥ kṛtamanorathḥ||5.54.1|| vardhamānasamutsāhḥ kāryaśeṣamacintayat|
meaning: With his objectives achieved, the monkey gazed at Lanka with growing zeal and pondered over the remaining work.

sanskrit: लङ्कां समस्तां सन्दीप्य लाङ्गूलाग्निं महाबलः। निर्वापयामास तदा समुद्रे हरिसत्तमः।। सन्दीप्यमानां विध्वस्तां त्रस्तरक्षोग
transliteration: laṅkāṃ samastāṃ sandīpya lāṅgūlāgniṃ mahābalḥ| nirvāpayāmāsa tadā samudre harisattamḥ|| sandīpyamānāṃ vidhvastāṃ trastar
meaning: Powerful Hanuman, having burnt the entire city of Lanka, put out the fire on his tail in the ocean. Beholding the burning city, the destroyed gardens and the panic stricken ogres, he began to think:

sanskrit: ततस्तु शिंशुपामूले जानकीं पर्युपस्थिताम्। अभिवाद्याब्रवीद्दिष्ट्या पश्यामि त्वामिहाक्षताम्।।5.56.1।।
transliteration: tatastu śiṃśupāmūle jānakīṃ paryupasthitām| abhivādyābravīddiṣṭyā paśyāmi tvāmihākṣatām||5.56.1||
meaning: Then Hanuman offered salutations to Janaki, stationed at the foot of the simsupa tree, and said, "Luckily I see you unscathed."

sanskrit: स चन्द्रकुमुदं रम्यं सार्ककारण्डवं शुभम्। तिष्यश्रवणकादम्बमभ्रशैवालशाद्वलम्।।5.57.1।। पुनर्वसुमहामीनं लोहिताङ्गमहाग्रहम्
transliteration: sa candrakumudṃ ramyṃ sārkakāraṇḍavṃ śubham| tiṣyaśravaṇakādambamabhraśaivālaśādvalam||5.57.1|| punarvasumahāmīnṃ lohitā
meaning: Hanuman leaped ike the Windgod, unwearied across the sky, as a huge boat crosses an ocean. The ocean was graced with a swan, the sky with constellation of Swati with fullblown lotuses and water lilies, like the nagas, ya

sanskrit: ततस्तस्य गिरेः शृङ्गे महेन्द्रस्य महाबलाः। हनुमत्प्रमुखाः प्रीतिं हरयो जग्मुरुत्तमाम्।।5.58.1।।
transliteration: tatastasya gireḥ śṛṅge mahendrasya mahābalāḥ| hanumatpramukhāḥ prītiṃ harayo jagmuruttamām||5.58.1||
meaning: Then the mighty Hanuman and other vanaras having assembled on the summit of mountain Mahendra and felt vey much happy.

sanskrit: एतदाख्याय तत्सर्वं हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। भूयस्समुपचक्राम वचनं वक्तुमुत्तरम्।।5.59.1।।
transliteration: etadākhyāya tatsarvṃ hanumānmārutātmajḥ| bhūyassamupacakrāma vacanṃ vaktumuttaram||5.59.1||
meaning: Hanuman, son of the Windgod having narrated in detail all that had happened again started disclosing further details৷৷

sanskrit: स निकामं विमानेषु निषण्णः कामरूपधृत्। विचचार पुनर्लङ्कां लाघवेन समन्वितः।।5.6.1।।
transliteration: sa nikāmṃ vimāneṣu niṣaṇṇḥ kāmarūpadhṛt| vicacāra punarlaṅkāṃ lāghavena samanvitḥ||5.6.1||
meaning: The mighty Hanuman, who could assume any form at will, not finding Sita in the tall mansions, again started rapidly ranging in Lanka.

sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वालिसूनुरभाषत। अयुक्तं तु विना देवीं दृष्टवद्भिश्च वानराः।।5.60.1।। समीपं गन्तुमस्माभी राघवस्य महा
transliteration: tasya tadvacanṃ śrutvā vālisūnurabhāṣata| ayuktṃ tu vinā devīṃ dṛṣṭavadbhiśca vānarāḥ||5.60.1|| samīpṃ gantumasmābhī rāg
meaning: After hearing Hanuman, Vali's son said" O vanaras (Hanuman) having seen Sita it is not proper on our part to go without Sita to the great soul Rama.

sanskrit: ततो जाम्बवतो वाक्यमगृह्णन्त वनौकसः। अङ्गदप्रमुखा वीरा हनुमांश्च महाकपिः।।5.61.1।।
transliteration: tato jāmbavato vākyamagṛhṇanta vanaukasḥ| aṅgadapramukhā vīrā hanumāṃśca mahākapiḥ||5.61.1||
meaning: In the midst of all the leaders of the monkeys including Angada, Hanuman accepted Jambavan's advice.

sanskrit: तानुवाच हरिश्रेष्ठो हनुमान्वानरर्षभः। अव्यग्रमनसो यूयं मधु सेवत वानराः।।5.62.1।। अहमावारयिष्यामि युष्माकं परिपन्थिनः।
transliteration: tānuvāca hariśreṣṭho hanumānvānararṣabhḥ| avyagramanaso yūyṃ madhu sevata vānarāḥ||5.62.1|| ahamāvārayiṣyāmi yuṣmākṃ par
meaning: Hanuman, the foremost of the monkeys, bull among vanaras said, 'Enjoy the honey devoid of any fear. I shall prevent those who object to your action'.

sanskrit: ततो मूर्ध्ना निपतितं वानरं वानरर्षभः। दृष्ट्वैवोद्विग्नहृदयो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह।।5.63.1।।
transliteration: tato mūrdhnā nipatitṃ vānarṃ vānararṣabhḥ| dṛṣṭvaivodvignahṛdayo vākyametaduvāca ha||5.63.1||
meaning: Feeling anxious on seeing Dadhimukha touching his feet with his forehead, Sugriva, the bull among vanaras said:

sanskrit: सुग्रीवेणैवमुक्तस्तु हृष्टो दधिमुखः कपिः। राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव सुग्रीवं चाभ्यवादयत्।।5.64.1।।
transliteration: sugrīveṇaivamuktastu hṛṣṭo dadhimukhḥ kapiḥ| rāghavṃ lakṣmaṇṃ caiva sugrīvṃ cābhyavādayat||5.64.1||
meaning: Pleased with Sugriva's command (to send forth Angada and Hanuman) Dadhimukha offered salutations to Sugriva, Rama and Lakshmana.

sanskrit: ततः प्रस्रवणं शैलं ते गत्वा चित्रकाननम्। प्रणम्य शिरसा रामं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्।।5.65.1।। युवराजं पुरस्कृत्य सुग्रीवमभिवा
transliteration: tatḥ prasravaṇṃ śailṃ te gatvā citrakānanam| praṇamya śirasā rāmṃ lakṣmaṇṃ ca mahābalam||5.65.1|| yuvarājṃ puraskṛtya su
meaning: Thereafter the vanaras arrived at the Prasrvana mount, with wonderful forests and bowed down to Sri Rama and mighty Lakshaman and Sugriva placing their leader, heir apparent in front. Then they began telling the story of

sanskrit: एवमुक्तो हनुमता रामो दशरथात्मज:। तं मणिं हृदये कृत्वा प्ररुरोद सलक्ष्मणः।।5.66.1।।
transliteration: evamukto hanumatā rāmo daśarathātmaja:| tṃ maṇiṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā praruroda salakṣmaṇḥ||5.66.1||
meaning: Thus addressed by Hanuman, Rama held the token (Chudamani) against his bosom and wept with Lakshmana.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान् राघवेण महात्मना। सीताया भाषितं सर्वं न्यवेदयत राघवे।।5.67.1।।
transliteration: evamuktastu hanumān rāghaveṇa mahātmanā| sītāyā bhāṣitṃ sarvṃ nyavedayata rāghave||5.67.1||
meaning: Thus asked by Sri Rama, Hanuman repeated everything spoken by Sita to Rama.

sanskrit: अथाहमुत्तरं देव्या पुनरुक्त स्ससम्भ्रमम्। तव स्नेहान्नरव्याघ्र सौहार्दादनुमान्य वै।।5.68.1।।
transliteration: athāhamuttarṃ devyā punarukta ssasambhramam| tava snehānnaravyāghra sauhārdādanumānya vai||5.68.1||
meaning: "O tiger among men In view of her regards for me and and her love for you she was confident and once again addressed me:

sanskrit: स वेश्मजालं बलवान् ददर्श व्यासक्तवैडूर्यसुवर्णजालम्। यथा महत् प्रावृषि मेघजालं विद्युत्पिनद्धं सविहङ्गजालम्।।5.7.1।।
transliteration: sa veśmajālṃ balavān dadarśa vyāsaktavaiḍūryasuvarṇajālam| yathā mahat prāvṛṣi meghajālṃ vidyutpinaddhṃ savihaṅgajālam||
meaning: Powerful Hanuman beheld the conglomeration of buildings with golden lattices encrusted with vaidurya, with flocks of birds comparable to a complex of clouds pierced by lightning during rainy season.

sanskrit: स तस्य मध्ये भवनस्य संस्थितं महद्विमानं मणिवज्रचित्रितम्। प्रतप्तजाम्बूनदजालकृत्रिमं ददर्श वीरः पवनात्मजः कपिः।।5.8.1।।
transliteration: sa tasya madhye bhavanasya sṃsthitṃ mahadvimānṃ maṇivajracitritam| prataptajāmbūnadajālakṛtrimṃ dadarśa vīrḥ pavanātmajḥ
meaning: The courageous son of the Windgod, Hanuman, the vanara saw the aerial chariot kept in the middle of the mansion inlaid with gems and diamonds latticed with artificial windows of barnished gold.

sanskrit: तस्यालयवरिष्ठस्य मध्ये विपुलमायतं। ददर्श भवनश्रेष्ठं हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः।।5.9.1।।
transliteration: tasyālayavariṣṭhasya madhye vipulamāyatṃ| dadarśa bhavanaśreṣṭhṃ hanumānmārutātmajḥ||5.9.1||
meaning: The son of the Windgod, Hanuman, saw a huge, spacious and excellent of all mansions in the centre of the palace.

sanskrit: प्राप्तराज्यस्य रामस्य राक्षसानां वधे कृते । आजग्मुर्ऋषयः सर्वे राघवं प्रतिनन्दितुम् ।। 7.1.1 ।।
transliteration: prāptarājyasya rāmasya rākṣasānāṃ vadhe kṛte | ājagmurṛṣayaḥ sarve rāghavaṃ pratinanditum || 7.1.1 ||

sanskrit: अथाब्रवीन्मुनिं रामः कथं ते भ्रातरो वने । कीदृशं तु तदा ब्रह्मंस्तपस्तेपुर्महाबलाः ।। 7.10.1 ।।
transliteration: athābravīnmuniṃ rāmaḥ kathaṃ te bhrātaro vane | kīdṛśaṃ tu tadā brahmaṃstapastepurmahābalāḥ || 7.10.1 ||

sanskrit: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य युधाजित्केकयो नृपः । स्वगुरुं प्रेषयामास राघवाय महात्मने । गार्ग्यमङ्गिरसः पुत्रं ब्रह्मर्षिममितप्रभ
transliteration: kasyacittvatha kālasya yudhājitkekayo nṛpaḥ | svaguruṃ preṣayāmāsa rāghavāya mahātmane | gārgyamaṅgirasaḥ putraṃ brahmar

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा सेनापतिं प्राप्तं भरतं केकयाधिपः । युधाजिद्गार्ग्यसहितं परां प्रीतिमुपागमत् ।। 7.101.1 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā senāpatiṃ prāptaṃ bharataṃ kekayādhipaḥ | yudhājidgārgyasahitaṃ parāṃ prītimupāgamat || 7.101.1 ||

sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा हर्षमापेदे राघवो भ्रातृभिः सह । वाक्यं चाद्भुतसङ्काशं तदा प्रोवाच लक्ष्मणम् ।। 7.102.1 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā harṣamāpede rāghavo bhrātṛbhiḥ saha | vākyaṃ cādbhutasaṅkāśaṃ tadā provāca lakṣmaṇam || 7.102.1 ||

sanskrit: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य रामे धर्मपरे स्थिते । कालस्तापसरूपेण राजद्वारमुपागमत् ।। 7.103.1 ।।
transliteration: kasyacittvatha kālasya rāme dharmapare sthite | kālastāpasarūpeṇa rājadvāramupāgamat || 7.103.1 ||

sanskrit: शृणु राजन्महासत्व यदर्थमहमागतः । पितामहेन देवेन प्रेषितो ऽस्मि महाबल ।। 7.104.1 ।।
transliteration: śṛṇu rājanmahāsatva yadarthamahamāgataḥ | pitāmahena devena preṣito 'smi mahābala || 7.104.1 ||

sanskrit: तथा तयोः संवदतोर्दुर्वासा भगवानृषिः । रामस्य दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी राजद्वारमुपागमत् ।। 7.105.1 ।।
transliteration: tathā tayoḥ saṃvadatordurvāsā bhagavānṛṣiḥ | rāmasya darśanākāṅkṣī rājadvāramupāgamat || 7.105.1 ||

sanskrit: अवाङ्मुखमथो दीनं दृष्ट्वा सोममिवाप्लुतम् । राघवं लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं हृष्टो मधुरमब्रवीत् ।। 7.106.1 ।।
transliteration: avāṅmukhamatho dīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā somamivāplutam | rāghavaṃ lakṣmaṇo vākyaṃ hṛṣṭo madhuramabravīt || 7.106.1 ||

sanskrit: विसृज्य लक्ष्मणं रामो दुःखशोकसमन्वितः । पुरोधसं मन्त्रिणश्च नैगमांश्चेदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.107.1 ।।
transliteration: visṛjya lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmo duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ | purodhasaṃ mantriṇaśca naigamāṃścedamabravīt || 7.107.1 ||

sanskrit: ते दूता रामवाक्येन चोदिता लघुविक्रमाः । प्रजग्मुर्मधुरां शीघ्रं चक्रुर्वासं न चाध्वनि ।। 7.108.1 ।।
transliteration: te dūtā rāmavākyena coditā laghuvikramāḥ | prajagmurmadhurāṃ śīghraṃ cakrurvāsaṃ na cādhvani || 7.108.1 ||

sanskrit: प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां पृथुवक्षा महायशाः । रामः कमलपत्राक्षः पुरोधसमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.109.1 ।।
transliteration: prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ pṛthuvakṣā mahāyaśāḥ | rāmaḥ kamalapatrākṣaḥ purodhasamathābravīt || 7.109.1 ||

sanskrit: सुमाली वरलब्धांस्तु ज्ञात्वा चैतान्निशाचरान् । उदतिष्ठद्भयं त्यक्त्वा सानुगः स रसातलात् ।। 7.11.1 ।।
transliteration: sumālī varalabdhāṃstu jñātvā caitānniśācarān | udatiṣṭhadbhayaṃ tyaktvā sānugaḥ sa rasātalāt || 7.11.1 ||

sanskrit: अध्यर्धयोजनं गत्वा नदीं पश्चान्मुखाश्रिताम् । सरयूं पुण्यसलिलां ददर्श रघुनन्दनः ।। 7.110.1 ।।
transliteration: adhyardhayojanaṃ gatvā nadīṃ paścānmukhāśritām | sarayūṃ puṇyasalilāṃ dadarśa raghunandanaḥ || 7.110.1 ||

sanskrit: एतावदेतदाख्यानं सोत्तरं ब्रह्मपूजितम् । रामायणमिति ख्यातं मुख्यं वाल्मीकीना कृतम् ।। 7.111.1 ।।
transliteration: etāvadetadākhyānaṃ sottaraṃ brahmapūjitam | rāmāyaṇamiti khyātaṃ mukhyaṃ vālmīkīnā kṛtam || 7.111.1 ||

sanskrit: राक्षसेन्द्रो ऽभिषिक्तस्तु भ्रातृभ्यां सहितस्तदा । ततः प्रदानं राक्षस्या भगिन्याः समचिन्तयत् ।। 7.12.1 ।।
transliteration: rākṣasendro 'bhiṣiktastu bhrātṛbhyāṃ sahitastadā | tataḥ pradānaṃ rākṣasyā bhaginyāḥ samacintayat || 7.12.1 ||

sanskrit: अथ लोकेश्वरोत्सृष्टा तत्र कालेन केनचित् । निद्रा समभवत्तीव्रा कुम्भकर्णस्य रूपिणी ।। 7.13.1 ।।
transliteration: atha lokeśvarotsṛṣṭā tatra kālena kenacit | nidrā samabhavattīvrā kumbhakarṇasya rūpiṇī || 7.13.1 ||

sanskrit: ततस्तु सचिवैः सार्धं षड्भिर्नित्यं बलोद्धतैः । महोदरप्रहस्ताभ्यां मारीचशुकसारणैः ।। 7.14.1 ।।
transliteration: tatastu sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ ṣaḍbhirnityaṃ baloddhataiḥ | mahodaraprahastābhyāṃ mārīcaśukasāraṇaiḥ || 7.14.1 ||

sanskrit: ततस्ताँल्लक्ष्य वित्रस्तान्यक्षेन्द्रांश्च सहस्रशः । धनाध्यक्षो महायक्षं माणिचारमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.15.1 ।।
transliteration: tatastāँllakṣya vitrastānyakṣendrāṃśca sahasraśaḥ | dhanādhyakṣo mahāyakṣaṃ māṇicāramathābravīt || 7.15.1 ||

sanskrit: स जित्वा धनदं राम भ्रातरं राक्षसाधिपः । महासेनप्रसूतिं तद्ययौ शरवणं महत् ।। 7.16.1 ।।
transliteration: sa jitvā dhanadaṃ rāma bhrātaraṃ rākṣasādhipaḥ | mahāsenaprasūtiṃ tadyayau śaravaṇaṃ mahat || 7.16.1 ||

sanskrit: अथ राजन्महाबाहुर्विचरन्स महीतले । हिमवद्वनमासाद्य परिचक्राम रावणः ।। 7.17.1 ।।
transliteration: atha rājanmahābāhurvicaransa mahītale | himavadvanamāsādya paricakrāma rāvaṇaḥ || 7.17.1 ||

sanskrit: प्रविष्टायां हुताशं तु वेदवत्यां स रावणः । पुष्पकं तु समारुह्य परिचक्राम मेदिनीम् ।। 7.18.1 ।।
transliteration: praviṣṭāyāṃ hutāśaṃ tu vedavatyāṃ sa rāvaṇaḥ | puṣpakaṃ tu samāruhya paricakrāma medinīm || 7.18.1 ||

sanskrit: अथ जित्वा मरुत्तं स प्रययौ राक्षसाधिपः । नगराणि नरेन्द्राणां युद्धकाङ्क्षी दशाननः ।। 7.19.1 ।।
transliteration: atha jitvā maruttaṃ sa prayayau rākṣasādhipaḥ | nagarāṇi narendrāṇāṃ yuddhakāṅkṣī daśānanaḥ || 7.19.1 ||

sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवस्य महात्मनः । कुम्भयोनिर्मिहातेजा राममेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.2.1 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ | kumbhayonirmihātejā rāmametaduvāca ha || 7.2.1 ||

sanskrit: ततो वित्रासयन्मर्त्यान्पृथिव्यां राक्षसाधिपः । आससाद घने तस्मिन्नारदं मुनिपुङ्गवम् ।। 7.20.1 ।।
transliteration: tato vitrāsayanmartyānpṛthivyāṃ rākṣasādhipaḥ | āsasāda ghane tasminnāradaṃ munipuṅgavam || 7.20.1 ||

sanskrit: एवं सञ्चिन्त्य विप्रेन्दो जगाम लघुविक्रमः । आख्यातुं तद्यथावृत्तं यमस्य सदनं प्रति ।। 7.21.1 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ sañcintya viprendo jagāma laghuvikramaḥ | ākhyātuṃ tadyathāvṛttaṃ yamasya sadanaṃ prati || 7.21.1 ||

sanskrit: स तस्य तु महानादं श्रुत्वा वैवस्वतः प्रभुः । शत्रुं विजयिनं मेने स्वबलस्य च सङ्क्षयम् ।। 7.22.1 ।।
transliteration: sa tasya tu mahānādaṃ śrutvā vaivasvataḥ prabhuḥ | śatruṃ vijayinaṃ mene svabalasya ca saṅkṣayam || 7.22.1 ||

sanskrit: ततो जित्वा दशग्रीवो यमं त्रिदशपुङ्गवम् । रावणस्तु रणश्लाघी स्वसहायान्ददर्श ह ।। 7.23.1 ।।
transliteration: tato jitvā daśagrīvo yamaṃ tridaśapuṅgavam | rāvaṇastu raṇaślāghī svasahāyāndadarśa ha || 7.23.1 ||

sanskrit: निवर्तमानः संहृष्टो रावणस्सुदुरात्मवान् । जह्रे पथि नरेन्द्रर्षिदेवगन्धर्वकन्यकाः ।। 7.24.1 ।।
transliteration: nivartamānaḥ saṃhṛṣṭo rāvaṇassudurātmavān | jahre pathi narendrarṣidevagandharvakanyakāḥ || 7.24.1 ||

sanskrit: स तु दत्त्वा दशग्रीवो वनं घोरं स्वरस्य तत् । भगिनीं च समाश्वास्य हृष्टः स्वस्थतरो ऽभवत् ।। 7.25.1 ।।
transliteration: sa tu dattvā daśagrīvo vanaṃ ghoraṃ svarasya tat | bhaginīṃ ca samāśvāsya hṛṣṭaḥ svasthataro 'bhavat || 7.25.1 ||

sanskrit: स तु तत्र दशग्रीवः सह सैन्येन वीर्यवान् । अस्तं प्राप्ते दिनकरे निवासं समरोचयत् ।। 7.26.1 ।।
transliteration: sa tu tatra daśagrīvaḥ saha sainyena vīryavān | astaṃ prāpte dinakare nivāsaṃ samarocayat || 7.26.1 ||

sanskrit: कैलासं लङ्घयित्वाथ दशग्रीवः स रावणः । आससाद महातेजा इन्द्रलोकं निशाचरः ।। 7.27.1 ।।
transliteration: kailāsaṃ laṅghayitvātha daśagrīvaḥ sa rāvaṇaḥ | āsasāda mahātejā indralokaṃ niśācaraḥ || 7.27.1 ||

sanskrit: सुमालिनं हतं दृष्ट्वा वसुना भस्मसात्कृतम् । स्वसैन्यं विद्रुतं चापि लक्षयित्वा ऽर्दितं सुरैः ।। 7.28.1 ।।
transliteration: sumālinaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā vasunā bhasmasātkṛtam | svasainyaṃ vidrutaṃ cāpi lakṣayitvā 'rditaṃ suraiḥ || 7.28.1 ||

sanskrit: ततस्तमसि सञ्जाते सर्वे ते देवराक्षसाः । अयुद्ध्यन्त बलोन्मत्ताः सूदयन्तः परस्परम् ।। 7.29.1 ।।
transliteration: tatastamasi sañjāte sarve te devarākṣasāḥ | ayuddhyanta balonmattāḥ sūdayantaḥ parasparam || 7.29.1 ||

sanskrit: अथ पुत्रः पुलस्त्यस्य विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः । अचिरेणैव कालेन पितेव तपसि स्थितः ।। 7.3.1 ।।
transliteration: atha putraḥ pulastyasya viśravā munipuṅgavaḥ | acireṇaiva kālena piteva tapasi sthitaḥ || 7.3.1 ||

sanskrit: जिते महेन्द्रे ऽतिबले रावणस्य सुतेन वै । प्रजापतिं पुरस्कृत्य ययुर्लङ्कां सुरास्तदा ।। 7.30.1 ।।
transliteration: jite mahendre 'tibale rāvaṇasya sutena vai | prajāpatiṃ puraskṛtya yayurlaṅkāṃ surāstadā || 7.30.1 ||

sanskrit: ततो रामो महातेजा विस्मयात्पुनरेव हि । उवाच प्रणतो वाक्यमगस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम् ।। 7.31.1 ।।
transliteration: tato rāmo mahātejā vismayātpunareva hi | uvāca praṇato vākyamagastyamṛṣisattamam || 7.31.1 ||

sanskrit: नर्मदापुलिने यत्र राक्षसेन्द्रः सुदारुणः । पुष्पोपहारं कुरुते तस्माद्देशाददूरतः ।। 7.32.1 ।।
transliteration: narmadāpuline yatra rākṣasendraḥ sudāruṇaḥ | puṣpopahāraṃ kurute tasmāddeśādadūrataḥ || 7.32.1 ||

sanskrit: रावणग्रहणं तत्तु वायुग्रहणसन्निभम् । ततः पुलस्त्यः शुश्राव कथितं दिवि दैवतैः ।। 7.33.1 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇagrahaṇaṃ tattu vāyugrahaṇasannibham | tataḥ pulastyaḥ śuśrāva kathitaṃ divi daivataiḥ || 7.33.1 ||

sanskrit: अर्जुनेन विमुक्तस्तु रावणो राक्षसाधिपः । चचार पृथिवीं सर्वामनिर्विण्णस्तथा कृतः ।। 7.34.1 ।।
transliteration: arjunena vimuktastu rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ | cacāra pṛthivīṃ sarvāmanirviṇṇastathā kṛtaḥ || 7.34.1 ||

sanskrit: अपृच्छत तदा रामो दक्षिणाशाश्रमं मुनिम् । प्राञ्जलिर्विनयोपेत इदमाह वचो ऽर्थवत् ।। 7.35.1 ।।
transliteration: apṛcchata tadā rāmo dakṣiṇāśāśramaṃ munim | prāñjalirvinayopeta idamāha vaco 'rthavat || 7.35.1 ||

sanskrit: ततः पितामहं दृष्ट्वा वायुः पुत्रवधार्दितः । शिशुकं तं समादाय उत्तस्थौ धातुरग्रतः ।। 7.36.1 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pitāmahaṃ dṛṣṭvā vāyuḥ putravadhārditaḥ | śiśukaṃ taṃ samādāya uttasthau dhāturagrataḥ || 7.36.1 ||

sanskrit: अभिषिक्ते तु काकुत्स्थे धर्मेण विदितात्मनि । व्यतीता या निशा पूर्वा पौराणां हर्षवर्धिनी ।। 7.37.1 ।।
transliteration: abhiṣikte tu kākutsthe dharmeṇa viditātmani | vyatītā yā niśā pūrvā paurāṇāṃ harṣavardhinī || 7.37.1 ||

sanskrit: एवमास्ते महाबाहुरहन्यहनि राघवः । प्रशासत्सर्वकार्याणि पौरजानपदेषु च ।। 7.38.1 ।।
transliteration: evamāste mahābāhurahanyahani rāghavaḥ | praśāsatsarvakāryāṇi paurajānapadeṣu ca || 7.38.1 ||

sanskrit: ते प्रयाता महात्मानः पार्थिवास्ते प्रहृष्टवत् । गजवाजिसहस्रौघैः कम्पयन्तो वसुन्धराम् ।। 7.39.1 ।।
transliteration: te prayātā mahātmānaḥ pārthivāste prahṛṣṭavat | gajavājisahasraughaiḥ kampayanto vasundharām || 7.39.1 ||

sanskrit: श्रुत्वागस्त्येरितं वाक्यं रामो विस्मयमागतः । कथमासीत्तु लङ्कायां सम्भवो रक्षसां पुरा ।। 7.4.1 ।।
transliteration: śrutvāgastyeritaṃ vākyaṃ rāmo vismayamāgataḥ | kathamāsīttu laṅkāyāṃ sambhavo rakṣasāṃ purā || 7.4.1 ||

sanskrit: तथा स्म तेषां वसतामृक्षवानररक्षसाम् । राघवस्तु महातेजाः सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.40.1 ।।
transliteration: tathā sma teṣāṃ vasatāmṛkṣavānararakṣasām | rāghavastu mahātejāḥ sugrīvamidamabravīt || 7.40.1 ||

sanskrit: विसृज्य च महाबाहुर्ऋक्षवानरराक्षसान् । भ्रातृभिः सहितो रामः प्रमुमोद सुखं सुखी ।। 7.41.1 ।।
transliteration: visṛjya ca mahābāhurṛkṣavānararākṣasān | bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito rāmaḥ pramumoda sukhaṃ sukhī || 7.41.1 ||

sanskrit: स विसृज्य ततो रामः पुष्पकं हेमभूषितम् । प्रविवेश महाबाहुरशोकवनिकां तदा ।। 7.42.1 ।।
transliteration: sa visṛjya tato rāmaḥ puṣpakaṃ hemabhūṣitam | praviveśa mahābāhuraśokavanikāṃ tadā || 7.42.1 ||

sanskrit: तत्रोपविष्टं राजानमुपासन्ते विचक्षणाः । कथानां बहुरूपाणां हास्यकाराः समन्ततः ।। 7.43.1 ।।
transliteration: tatropaviṣṭaṃ rājānamupāsante vicakṣaṇāḥ | kathānāṃ bahurūpāṇāṃ hāsyakārāḥ samantataḥ || 7.43.1 ||

sanskrit: विसृज्य तु सुहृद्वर्गं बुद्ध्या निश्चित्य राघवः । समीपे द्वाःस्थमासीनमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। 7.44.1 ।।
transliteration: visṛjya tu suhṛdvargaṃ buddhyā niścitya rāghavaḥ | samīpe dvāḥsthamāsīnamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 7.44.1 ||

sanskrit: तेषां समुपविष्टानां सर्वेषां दीनचेतसाम् । उवाच वाक्यं काकुत्स्थो मुखेन परिशुष्यता ।। 7.45.1 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ samupaviṣṭānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dīnacetasām | uvāca vākyaṃ kākutstho mukhena pariśuṣyatā || 7.45.1 ||

sanskrit: ततो रजन्यां व्युष्टायां लक्ष्मणो दीनचेतनः । सुमन्त्रमब्रवीद्वाक्यं मुखेन परिशुष्यता ।। 7.46.1 ।।
transliteration: tato rajanyāṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ lakṣmaṇo dīnacetanaḥ | sumantramabravīdvākyaṃ mukhena pariśuṣyatā || 7.46.1 ||

sanskrit: अथ नावं सुविस्तीर्णां नैषादीं राघवानुजः । आरुरोह समायुक्तां पूर्वमारोप्य मैथिलीम् ।। 7.47.1 ।।
transliteration: atha nāvaṃ suvistīrṇāṃ naiṣādīṃ rāghavānujaḥ | āruroha samāyuktāṃ pūrvamāropya maithilīm || 7.47.1 ||

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा दारुणं जनकात्मजा । परं विषादमागम्य वैदेही निपपात ह ।। 7.48.1 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā dāruṇaṃ janakātmajā | paraṃ viṣādamāgamya vaidehī nipapāta ha || 7.48.1 ||

sanskrit: सीतां तु रुदतीं दृष्ट्वा ते तत्र मुनिदारकाः । प्राद्रवन्यत्र भगवानास्ते वाल्मीकिरुग्रधीः ।। 7.49.1 ।।
transliteration: sītāṃ tu rudatīṃ dṛṣṭvā te tatra munidārakāḥ | prādravanyatra bhagavānāste vālmīkirugradhīḥ || 7.49.1 ||

sanskrit: सुकेशं धार्मिकं दृष्ट्वा वरलब्धं च राक्षसम् । ग्रामणीर्नाम गन्धर्वो विश्वावसुसमप्रभः ।। 7.5.1 ।।
transliteration: sukeśaṃ dhārmikaṃ dṛṣṭvā varalabdhaṃ ca rākṣasam | grāmaṇīrnāma gandharvo viśvāvasusamaprabhaḥ || 7.5.1 ||

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तु मैथिलीं सीतामाश्रमे सम्प्रवेशिताम् । सन्तापमगमद्घोरं लक्ष्मणो दीनचेतनः ।। 7.50.1 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu maithilīṃ sītāmāśrame sampraveśitām | santāpamagamadghoraṃ lakṣmaṇo dīnacetanaḥ || 7.50.1 ||

sanskrit: तथा सञ्चोदितः सूतो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना । तद्वाक्यमृषिणा प्रोक्तं व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे ।। 7.51.1 ।।
transliteration: tathā sañcoditaḥ sūto lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā | tadvākyamṛṣiṇā proktaṃ vyāhartumupacakrame || 7.51.1 ||

sanskrit: तत्र तां रजनीमुष्य केशिन्यां रघुनन्दनः । प्रभाते पुनरुत्थाय लक्ष्मणः प्रययौ तदा ।। 7.52.1 ।।
transliteration: tatra tāṃ rajanīmuṣya keśinyāṃ raghunandanaḥ | prabhāte punarutthāya lakṣmaṇaḥ prayayau tadā || 7.52.1 ||

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणस्य तु तद्वाक्यं निशम्य परमाद्भुतम् । सुप्रीतश्चाभवद्रामो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.53.1 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya tu tadvākyaṃ niśamya paramādbhutam | suprītaścābhavadrāmo vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.53.1 ||

sanskrit: रामस्य भाषितं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः परमार्थवित् । उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं राघवं दीप्ततेजसम् ।। 7.54.1 ।।
transliteration: rāmasya bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā lakṣmaṇaḥ paramārthavit | uvāca prāñjalirvākyaṃ rāghavaṃ dīptatejasam || 7.54.1 ||

sanskrit: एष ते नृगशापस्य विस्तरो ऽभिहितो मया । यद्यस्ति श्रवणे श्रद्धा शृणुष्वेहापरां कथाम् ।। 7.55.1 ।।
transliteration: eṣa te nṛgaśāpasya vistaro 'bhihito mayā | yadyasti śravaṇe śraddhā śṛṇuṣvehāparāṃ kathām || 7.55.1 ||

sanskrit: रामस्य भाषितं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा । उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं राघवं दीप्ततेजसम् ।। 7.56.1 ।।
transliteration: rāmasya bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā | uvāca prāñjalirvākyaṃ rāghavaṃ dīptatejasam || 7.56.1 ||

sanskrit: तां श्रुत्वा दिव्यसङ्काशां कथामद्भुतदर्शनाम् । लक्ष्मणः परमप्रीतो राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। 7.57.1 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ śrutvā divyasaṅkāśāṃ kathāmadbhutadarśanām | lakṣmaṇaḥ paramaprīto rāghavaṃ vākyamabravīt || 7.57.1 ||

sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवति रामे तु लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा । प्रत्युवाच महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा ।। 7.58.1 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvati rāme tu lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā | pratyuvāca mahātmānaṃ jvalantamiva tejasā || 7.58.1 ||

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तूशनसं क्रुद्धं तदा ऽ ऽर्तो नहुषात्मजः । जरां परमिकां प्राप्य यदुं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। 7.59.1 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tūśanasaṃ kruddhaṃ tadā ' 'rto nahuṣātmajaḥ | jarāṃ paramikāṃ prāpya yaduṃ vacanamabravīt || 7.59.1 ||

sanskrit: तैर्वध्यमाना देवाश्च ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः । भयार्ताः शरणं जग्मुर्देवदेवं महेश्वरम् ।। 7.6.1 ।।
transliteration: tairvadhyamānā devāśca ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | bhayārtāḥ śaraṇaṃ jagmurdevadevaṃ maheśvaram || 7.6.1 ||

sanskrit: तयोः संवदतोरेवं रामलक्ष्मणयोस्तदा । वासन्तिकी निशा प्राप्ता न शीता न च घर्मदा ।। 7.60.1 ।।
transliteration: tayoḥ saṃvadatorevaṃ rāmalakṣmaṇayostadā | vāsantikī niśā prāptā na śītā na ca gharmadā || 7.60.1 ||

sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवद्भिर्ऋषिभिः काकुत्स्थो वाक्यमब्रवीत् । किं कार्यं ब्रूत मुनयो भयं तावदपैतु वः ।। 7.61.1 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvadbhirṛṣibhiḥ kākutstho vākyamabravīt | kiṃ kāryaṃ brūta munayo bhayaṃ tāvadapaitu vaḥ || 7.61.1 ||

sanskrit: तथोक्ते तानृषीन्रामः प्रत्युवाच कृताञ्जलिः । किमाहारः किमाचारो लवणः क्व च वर्तते ।। 7.62.1 ।।
transliteration: tathokte tānṛṣīnrāmaḥ pratyuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ | kimāhāraḥ kimācāro lavaṇaḥ kva ca vartate || 7.62.1 ||

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण परां व्रीडामुपागमत् । शत्रुघ्नो वीर्यसम्पन्नो मन्दं मन्दमुवाच ह ।। 7.63.1 ।।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa parāṃ vrīḍāmupāgamat | śatrughno vīryasampanno mandaṃ mandamuvāca ha || 7.63.1 ||

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा च काकुत्स्थं प्रशस्य च पुनः पुनः । पुनरेवापरं वाक्यमुवाच रघुनन्दनः ।। 7.64.1 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā ca kākutsthaṃ praśasya ca punaḥ punaḥ | punarevāparaṃ vākyamuvāca raghunandanaḥ || 7.64.1 ||

sanskrit: प्रस्थाप्य च बलं सर्वं मासमात्रोषितः पथि । एक एवाशु शत्रुघ्नो जगाम त्वरितं तदा ।। 7.65.1 ।।
transliteration: prasthāpya ca balaṃ sarvaṃ māsamātroṣitaḥ pathi | eka evāśu śatrughno jagāma tvaritaṃ tadā || 7.65.1 ||

sanskrit: यामेव रात्रिं शत्रुघ्नः पर्णशालामुपाविशत् । तामेव रात्रिं सीतापि प्रसूता दारकद्वयम् ।। 7.66.1 ।।
transliteration: yāmeva rātriṃ śatrughnaḥ parṇaśālāmupāviśat | tāmeva rātriṃ sītāpi prasūtā dārakadvayam || 7.66.1 ||

sanskrit: अथ रात्र्यां प्रवृत्तायां शत्रुघ्नो भृगुनन्दनम् । पप्रच्छ च्यवनं विप्रं लवणस्य यथा बलम् ।। 7.67.1 ।।
transliteration: atha rātryāṃ pravṛttāyāṃ śatrughno bhṛgunandanam | papraccha cyavanaṃ vipraṃ lavaṇasya yathā balam || 7.67.1 ||

sanskrit: कथां कथयतां तेषां जयं चाकाङ्क्षतां शुभम् । व्यतीता रजनी शीघ्रं शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः ।। 7.68.1 ।।
transliteration: kathāṃ kathayatāṃ teṣāṃ jayaṃ cākāṅkṣatāṃ śubham | vyatītā rajanī śīghraṃ śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ || 7.68.1 ||

sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः । क्रोधामाहारयत्तीव्रं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ।। 7.69.1 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā bhāṣitaṃ tasya śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ | krodhāmāhārayattīvraṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt || 7.69.1 ||

sanskrit: नारायणगिरिं ते तु गर्जन्तो राक्षसाम्बुदाः । ववर्षुः शरवर्षेण वर्षेणेवाद्रिमम्बुदाः ।। 7.7.1 ।।
transliteration: nārāyaṇagiriṃ te tu garjanto rākṣasāmbudāḥ | vavarṣuḥ śaravarṣeṇa varṣeṇevādrimambudāḥ || 7.7.1 ||

sanskrit: हते तु लवणे देवाः सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः । ऊचुः सुमधुरां वाणीं शत्रुघ्नं शत्रुतापनम् ।। 7.70.1 ।।
transliteration: hate tu lavaṇe devāḥ sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ | ūcuḥ sumadhurāṃ vāṇīṃ śatrughnaṃ śatrutāpanam || 7.70.1 ||

sanskrit: ततो द्वादशमे वर्षे शत्रघ्नो रामपालिताम् । अयोध्यां चकमे गन्तुमल्पभृत्यबलानुगः ।। 7.71.1 ।।
transliteration: tato dvādaśame varṣe śatraghno rāmapālitām | ayodhyāṃ cakame gantumalpabhṛtyabalānugaḥ || 7.71.1 ||

sanskrit: तं शयानं नरव्याघ्रं निद्रा नाभ्यागमत्तदा । चिन्तयन्तमनेकार्थं रामगीतमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.72.1 ।।
transliteration: taṃ śayānaṃ naravyāghraṃ nidrā nābhyāgamattadā | cintayantamanekārthaṃ rāmagītamanuttamam || 7.72.1 ||

sanskrit: प्रस्थाप्य तु स शत्रुघ्नं भ्रातृभ्यां सह राघवः । प्रमुमोद सुखी राज्यं धर्मेण परिपालयन् ।। 7.73.1 ।।
transliteration: prasthāpya tu sa śatrughnaṃ bhrātṛbhyāṃ saha rāghavaḥ | pramumoda sukhī rājyaṃ dharmeṇa paripālayan || 7.73.1 ||

sanskrit: तथा तु करुणं तस्य द्विजस्य परिदेवनम् । शुश्राव राघवः सर्वं दुःखशोकसमन्वितम् ।। 7.74.1 ।।
transliteration: tathā tu karuṇaṃ tasya dvijasya paridevanam | śuśrāva rāghavaḥ sarvaṃ duḥkhaśokasamanvitam || 7.74.1 ||

sanskrit: नारदस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा ऽमृतमयं तदा । प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे लक्ष्मणं चेदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.75.1 ।।
transliteration: nāradasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā 'mṛtamayaṃ tadā | praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe lakṣmaṇaṃ cedamabravīt || 7.75.1 ||

sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । अवाक्छिरास्तथाभूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.76.1 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ | avākchirāstathābhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.76.1 ||

sanskrit: पुरा त्रेतायुगे राम बभूव बहुविस्तरम् । समन्ताद्योजनशतं विमृगं पक्षिवर्जितम् ।। 7.77.1 ।।
transliteration: purā tretāyuge rāma babhūva bahuvistaram | samantādyojanaśataṃ vimṛgaṃ pakṣivarjitam || 7.77.1 ||

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु भाषितं वाक्यं मम राम शुभाक्षरम् । प्राञ्जलिः प्रत्युवाचेदं स स्वर्गी रघुनन्दन ।। 7.78.1 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu bhāṣitaṃ vākyaṃ mama rāma śubhākṣaram | prāñjaliḥ pratyuvācedaṃ sa svargī raghunandana || 7.78.1 ||

sanskrit: तदद्भुततमं वाक्यं श्रुत्वागस्त्यस्य राघवः । गौरवाद्विस्मयाच्चैव पुनः प्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे ।। 7.79.1 ।।
transliteration: tadadbhutatamaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvāgastyasya rāghavaḥ | gauravādvismayāccaiva punaḥ praṣṭuṃ pracakrame || 7.79.1 ||

sanskrit: हन्यमाने बले तस्मिन्पद्मनाभेन पृष्ठतः । माल्वान्सन्निवृत्तो ऽथ वेलामेत्य इवार्णवः ।। 7.8.1 ।।
transliteration: hanyamāne bale tasminpadmanābhena pṛṣṭhataḥ | mālvānsannivṛtto 'tha velāmetya ivārṇavaḥ || 7.8.1 ||

sanskrit: एतदाख्याय रामाय महर्षिः कुम्भसम्भवः । अस्यामेवापरं वाक्यं कथायामुपचक्रमे ।। 7.80.1 ।।
transliteration: etadākhyāya rāmāya maharṣiḥ kumbhasambhavaḥ | asyāmevāparaṃ vākyaṃ kathāyāmupacakrame || 7.80.1 ||

sanskrit: स मुहूर्तादुपश्रुत्य देवर्षिरमितप्रभः । स्वमाश्रमं शिष्यवृतः क्षुधार्तः सन्न्यवर्तत ।। 7.81.1 ।।
transliteration: sa muhūrtādupaśrutya devarṣiramitaprabhaḥ | svamāśramaṃ śiṣyavṛtaḥ kṣudhārtaḥ sannyavartata || 7.81.1 ||

sanskrit: ऋषेर्वचनमाज्ञाय रामः सन्ध्यामुपासितुम् । उपाक्रमत्सरः पुण्यमप्सरोगणसेवितम् ।। 7.82.1 ।।
transliteration: ṛṣervacanamājñāya rāmaḥ sandhyāmupāsitum | upākramatsaraḥ puṇyamapsarogaṇasevitam || 7.82.1 ||

sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्य रामस्याक्लिष्ट कर्मणः । द्वास्स्थः कुमारावाहूय राघवाय न्यवेदयत् ।। 7.83.1 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā bhāṣitaṃ tasya rāmasyākliṣṭa karmaṇaḥ | dvāssthaḥ kumārāvāhūya rāghavāya nyavedayat || 7.83.1 ||

sanskrit: तथोक्तवति रामे तु भरते च महात्मनि । लक्ष्मणो ऽथ शुभं वाक्यमुवाच रघुनन्दनम् ।। 7.84.1 ।।
transliteration: tathoktavati rāme tu bharate ca mahātmani | lakṣmaṇo 'tha śubhaṃ vākyamuvāca raghunandanam || 7.84.1 ||

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा शत्रुनिबर्हणः । वृत्रघातमशेषेण कथयेत्याह सुव्रत ।। 7.85.1 ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā śatrunibarhaṇaḥ | vṛtraghātamaśeṣeṇa kathayetyāha suvrata || 7.85.1 ||

sanskrit: तदा वृत्रवधं सर्वमखिलेन स लक्ष्मणः । कथयित्वा नरश्रेष्ठः कथाशेषं प्रचक्रमे ।। 7.86.1 ।।
transliteration: tadā vṛtravadhaṃ sarvamakhilena sa lakṣmaṇaḥ | kathayitvā naraśreṣṭhaḥ kathāśeṣaṃ pracakrame || 7.86.1 ||

sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणेनोक्तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः । प्रत्युवाच महातेजाः प्रहसन्राघवो वचः ।। 7.87.1 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā lakṣmaṇenoktaṃ vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ | pratyuvāca mahātejāḥ prahasanrāghavo vacaḥ || 7.87.1 ||

sanskrit: तां कथामिलसम्बद्धां रामेण समुदीरिताम् । लक्ष्मणो भरतश्चैव श्रुत्वा परमविस्मितौ ।। 7.88.1 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ kathāmilasambaddhāṃ rāmeṇa samudīritām | lakṣmaṇo bharataścaiva śrutvā paramavismitau || 7.88.1 ||

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा किम्पुरुषोत्पत्तिं लक्ष्मणो भरतस्तदा । आश्चर्यमिति चाब्रूतामुभौ रामं जनेश्वरम् ।। 7.89.1 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā kimpuruṣotpattiṃ lakṣmaṇo bharatastadā | āścaryamiti cābrūtāmubhau rāmaṃ janeśvaram || 7.89.1 ||

sanskrit: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य सुमाली नाम राक्षसः । रसातलान्मर्त्यलोकं सर्वं वै विचचार ह ।। 7.9.1 ।।
transliteration: kasyacittvatha kālasya sumālī nāma rākṣasaḥ | rasātalānmartyalokaṃ sarvaṃ vai vicacāra ha || 7.9.1 ||

sanskrit: तथोक्तवति रामे तु तस्य जन्म तदद्भुतम् । उवाच लक्ष्मणो भूयो भरतश्च महायशाः ।। 7.90.1 ।।
transliteration: tathoktavati rāme tu tasya janma tadadbhutam | uvāca lakṣmaṇo bhūyo bharataśca mahāyaśāḥ || 7.90.1 ||

sanskrit: एतदाख्याय काकुत्स्थो भ्रातृभ्याममितप्रभः । लक्ष्मणं पुनरेवाह धर्मयुक्तमिदं वचः ।। 7.91.1 ।।
transliteration: etadākhyāya kākutstho bhrātṛbhyāmamitaprabhaḥ | lakṣmaṇaṃ punarevāha dharmayuktamidaṃ vacaḥ || 7.91.1 ||

sanskrit: तत्सर्वमखिलेनाशु प्रस्थाप्य भरताग्रजः । हयं लक्षणसम्पन्नं कृष्णसारं मुमोच ह ।। 7.92.1 ।।
transliteration: tatsarvamakhilenāśu prasthāpya bharatāgrajaḥ | hayaṃ lakṣaṇasampannaṃ kṛṣṇasāraṃ mumoca ha || 7.92.1 ||

sanskrit: वर्तमाने तथाभूते यज्ञे च परमाद्भुते । सशिष्य आजगामाशु वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुङ्गवः ।। 7.93.1 ।।
transliteration: vartamāne tathābhūte yajñe ca paramādbhute | saśiṣya ājagāmāśu vālmīkirmunipuṅgavaḥ || 7.93.1 ||

sanskrit: तौ रजन्यां प्रभातायां स्नातौ हुतहुताशनौ । यथोक्तमृषिणा पूर्वं सर्वं तत्रोपगायताम् ।। 7.94.1 ।।
transliteration: tau rajanyāṃ prabhātāyāṃ snātau hutahutāśanau | yathoktamṛṣiṇā pūrvaṃ sarvaṃ tatropagāyatām || 7.94.1 ||

sanskrit: रामो बहून्यहान्येवं तद्गीतं परमं शुभम् । शुश्राव मुनिभिः सार्धं पार्थिवैः सह वानरैः ।। 7.95.1 ।।
transliteration: rāmo bahūnyahānyevaṃ tadgītaṃ paramaṃ śubham | śuśrāva munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ pārthivaiḥ saha vānaraiḥ || 7.95.1 ||

sanskrit: तस्यां रजन्यां व्युष्टायां यज्ञवाटगतो नृपः । ऋषीन्सर्वान्महातेजाः शब्दापयति राघवः ।। 7.96.1 ।।
transliteration: tasyāṃ rajanyāṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ yajñavāṭagato nṛpaḥ | ṛṣīnsarvānmahātejāḥ śabdāpayati rāghavaḥ || 7.96.1 ||

sanskrit: वाल्मीकिनैवमुक्तस्तु राघवः प्रत्यभाषत । प्राञ्जलिर्जगतो मध्ये दृष्ट्वा तां वरवर्णिनीम् ।। 7.97.1 ।।
transliteration: vālmīkinaivamuktastu rāghavaḥ pratyabhāṣata | prāñjalirjagato madhye dṛṣṭvā tāṃ varavarṇinīm || 7.97.1 ||

sanskrit: रसातलं प्रविष्टायां वैदेह्यां सर्ववानराः । चुक्रुशुः साधु साध्वीति मुनयो रामसन्निधौ ।। 7.98.1 ।।
transliteration: rasātalaṃ praviṣṭāyāṃ vaidehyāṃ sarvavānarāḥ | cukruśuḥ sādhu sādhvīti munayo rāmasannidhau || 7.98.1 ||

sanskrit: रजन्यां तु प्रभातायां समानीय महामुनीन् । गीयतामविशङ्काभ्यां रामः पुत्रावुवाच ह ।। 7.99.1 ।।
transliteration: rajanyāṃ tu prabhātāyāṃ samānīya mahāmunīn | gīyatāmaviśaṅkābhyāṃ rāmaḥ putrāvuvāca ha || 7.99.1 ||

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं यथावदभिभाषितम् । रामः प्रीतिसमायुक्तो वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत् ।।6.1.1।।
transliteration: śrutvā hanumato vākyṃ yathāvadabhibhāṣitam | rāmḥ prītisamāyukto vākyamuttaramabravīt ||6.1.1||
meaning: Having heard Hanuman's words, full of love, Rama replied.

sanskrit: ततःप्रत्युषसिप्राप्तेप्राप्तधर्मार्थनिश्चयः । राक्षसाधिपतेर्वेश्मभीमकर्माविभीषणः ।।6.10.1।।
transliteration: tatḥpratyuṣasiprāpteprāptadharmārthaniścayḥ | rākṣasādhipaterveśmabhīmakarmāvibhīṣaṇḥ ||6.10.1||
meaning: Thereafter, determined to relate about righteous and material gains, Vibheeshana of fierce tasks got up early in the morning when the Sun rose and set himself to go to the residence of Lord of Rakshasas.

sanskrit: महोदरमहापार्श्वौहतौदृष्टवातुराक्ष । तस्मिंश्चनिहतेवीरेविरूपाक्षेमहाबले ।।6.100.1।। आविवेशमहान् क्रोधोरावणंतुमहामृधे । सू
transliteration: mahodaramahāpārśvauhataudṛṣṭavāturākṣa | tasmiṃścanihatevīrevirūpākṣemahābale ||6.100.1|| āviveśamahān krodhorāvaṇṃtumah
meaning: On seeing Mahodara and Mahaparsva killed in the great war, Virupaksha of extraordinary might also killed, Ravana was highly infuriated and addressed the charioteer in the following words.

sanskrit: तस्मिन्प्रतिहतेऽस्त्रेतुरावणोराक्षसाधिपः । क्रोधं च द्विगुणंचक्रेक्रोधाच्चास्त्रमनन्तरम् ।।6.101.1।।
transliteration: tasminpratihate'streturāvaṇorākṣasādhipḥ | krodhṃ ca dviguṇṃcakrekrodhāccāstramanantaram ||6.101.1||
meaning: Missile being counteracted, Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, doubled the army later in anger.

sanskrit: शक्त्याविनिहतंदृष्टवारावणेनबलीयसा । लक्ष्मणंसमरेशूरंरूधिरौघपरिप्लुतम् ।।6.102.1।। स दत्त्वातुमुलंयुद्धंरावणस्यदुरात्मनः
transliteration: śaktyāvinihatṃdṛṣṭavārāvaṇenabalīyasā | lakṣmaṇṃsamareśūrṃrūdhiraughapariplutam ||6.102.1|| sa dattvātumulṃyuddhṃrāvaṇas
meaning: Seeing Lakshmana struck by exceedingly mighty, evil minded Ravana's javelin and soaked in blood Rama giving intense fight by discharging arrows also spoke as follows to Sushena.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणेनतुतद्वाक्यमुक्तंश्रुत्वा स राघवः । सन्दधेपरवीरघ्नोधनुरादायवीर्यवान् ।।6.103.1।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇenatutadvākyamuktṃśrutvā sa rāghavḥ | sandadheparavīraghnodhanurādāyavīryavān ||6.103.1||
meaning: Courageous Raghava, the destroyer of enemies on hearing the words spoken by Lakshmana took up his bow and fixed it.

sanskrit: तस्यक्रुद्धस्यवदनंदृष्टवारामस्यधीमतः ।।6.104.1।। सर्वभूतानिवित्रेसुःप्राकम्पत च मेदिनी ।
transliteration: tasyakruddhasyavadanṃdṛṣṭavārāmasyadhīmatḥ ||6.104.1|| sarvabhūtānivitresuḥprākampata ca medinī |
meaning: Seeing enraged wise Rama's countenance, all beings on earth were shaken in fear.

sanskrit: स तेनतुतदाक्रोधात्काकुत्स्थेनार्दितोरणे । रावणस्समरश्लाघिमहाक्रोधामुपागमत् ।।6.105.1।।
transliteration: sa tenatutadākrodhātkākutsthenārditoraṇe | rāvaṇassamaraślāghimahākrodhāmupāgamat ||6.105.1||
meaning: Ravana, who was proud of his skill in warfare, became very angry when he was pained by Kakuthsa's arrows.

sanskrit: सतुमोहात्सुसङ्क्रुद्धःकृतान्तबलचोदितः । क्रोधसंरक्तनयनोरावणंसूतमब्रवीत् ।।6.106.1।।
transliteration: satumohātsusaṅkruddhḥkṛtāntabalacoditḥ | krodhasṃraktanayanorāvaṇṃsūtamabravīt ||6.106.1||
meaning: Enraged out of delusion, by force of destiny, Ravana's eyes turned red in anger and spoke to his charioteer.

sanskrit: ततोयुद्धपरिश्रान्तंसमरेचिन्तयास्थितम् । रावणंचाग्रतोदृष्टवायुद्धायसमुपस्थितम् ।।6.107.1।। दैवतैश्चसमागम्यद्रष्टुमभ्यागतो
transliteration: tatoyuddhapariśrāntṃsamarecintayāsthitam | rāvaṇṃcāgratodṛṣṭavāyuddhāyasamupasthitam ||6.107.1|| daivataiścasamāgamyadra
meaning: Then seeing Sri Rama standing and thinking of the war, duly prepared, Rishi Agastya came with Devatas to witness the war with Ravana and spoke as follows.

sanskrit: स रथंसारथिःहृष्टंपरसैन्यप्रधर्षणम् । गन्धर्वनगराकारंसमुच्छ्रितपाताकिनम् ।।6.108.1।। युक्तंपरमसम्पन्नैर्वजिभिर्हेममालिभिः
transliteration: sa rathṃsārathiḥhṛṣṭṃparasainyapradharṣaṇam | gandharvanagarākārṃsamucchritapātākinam ||6.108.1|| yuktṃparamasampannairv
meaning: Delighted charioteer drove the chariot of Ravana with speed. It was of the shape of the abode of Gandharvas, capable of destroying enemy's army. It had rows of excellent flags, richly endowed, like the best piece of artw

sanskrit: ततःप्रवृत्तंसुक्रूरंरामरावणयोस्तदा । सुमहदद्वैरथंयुद्धंसर्वलोकभयावहम् ।।6.109.1।।
transliteration: tatḥpravṛttṃsukrūrṃrāmarāvaṇayostadā | sumahadadvairathṃyuddhṃsarvalokabhayāvaham ||6.109.1||
meaning: Then there ensued a fierce duel between Rama and Ravana that was fearsome to the whole world.

sanskrit: सबभूवकृशोराजामैथिलीकाममोहितः । असन्मानाच्चसुहृदांपापंपापेनकर्मणा ।।6.11.1।।
transliteration: sababhūvakṛśorājāmaithilīkāmamohitḥ | asanmānāccasuhṛdāṃpāpṃpāpenakarmaṇā ||6.11.1||
meaning: Infatuated with passion towards Mythili, disregarded by his dear ones on account of sinful actions, sinner Ravana became weak.

sanskrit: तौतथायुध्यमानौतुसमरेरामरावणौ । ददृशुस्सर्वभूतानिविस्मितेनान्तरात्मना ।।6.110.1।।
transliteration: tautathāyudhyamānautusamarerāmarāvaṇau | dadṛśussarvabhūtānivismitenāntarātmanā ||6.110.1||
meaning: As Rama and Ravana were thus fighting in war, all beings watched with astonishment in mind.

sanskrit: अथसंस्मारयामासमातलिराघवंतदा । अजानन्निवकिंवीरत्वमेनमनुवर्तसे ।।6.111.1।।
transliteration: athasṃsmārayāmāsamātalirāghavṃtadā | ajānannivakiṃvīratvamenamanuvartase ||6.111.1||
meaning: Matali reminded Rama in this way," O heroic Rama, why are you doing this way, as if you do not know?"

sanskrit: भ्रातरंनिहतंदृष्टवाशयानंनिर्जितंरणे । शोकवेगपरीतात्माविललापविभीषणः ।।6.112.1।।
transliteration: bhrātarṃnihatṃdṛṣṭavāśayānṃnirjitṃraṇe | śokavegaparītātmāvilalāpavibhīṣaṇḥ ||6.112.1||
meaning: Vibheeshana, seeing his brother killed and lying in the battlefield, lamented immersed in sorrow.

sanskrit: रावणंनिहतंदृष्टवाराघवेणमहात्मना । अन्तःपुराद्विनिष्पेतूराक्षस्यश्शोककर्शिताः ।।6.113.1।।
transliteration: rāvaṇṃnihatṃdṛṣṭavārāghaveṇamahātmanā | antḥpurādviniṣpetūrākṣasyaśśokakarśitāḥ ||6.113.1||
meaning: On seeing Ravana killed by the great soul Raghava, the Rakshasas from the gynaeceum stricken with grief rushed out.

sanskrit: तासांविलपमानानांतदाराक्षसयोषिताम् । ज्येष्ठापत्नीप्रियाजीनाभर्तारंसमुदैक्षत ।।6.114.1।।
transliteration: tāsāṃvilapamānānāṃtadārākṣasayoṣitām | jyeṣṭhāpatnīpriyājīnābhartārṃsamudaikṣata ||6.114.1||
