meaning: Then from among the wives lamenting, the first wife, dear to Ravana gazed at her husband lamenting piteously.

sanskrit: तेरावणवधंदृष्टवादेवगन्धर्वदानवाः । जग्मुस्स्वैस्वैर्विमानैस्तेकथयन्तश्शुभाःकथाः ।।6.115.1।।
transliteration: terāvaṇavadhṃdṛṣṭavādevagandharvadānavāḥ | jagmussvaisvairvimānaistekathayantaśśubhāḥkathāḥ ||6.115.1||
meaning: In the meantime, Devas, Gandharvas, Danavas speaking to each other an auspicious story of Ravana's destruction went in their respective aerial cars.

sanskrit: इतिप्रतिसमादिष्टोहनूमान्मारुतात्मजः । प्रविवेशपुरींलङ्कांपूज्यमानोनिशाचरैः ।।6.116.1।।
transliteration: itipratisamādiṣṭohanūmānmārutātmajḥ | praviveśapurīṃlaṅkāṃpūjyamānoniśācaraiḥ ||6.116.1||
meaning: Having been commanded, Hanuman offered prayers to Vibheeshana and entered Lanka.

sanskrit: स उवाचमहाप्रामस्सोऽभिवाद्यप्लवङ्गमः । रामंवचनमर्थज्ञोवरंसर्वधनुष्मताम् ।।6.117.1।।
transliteration: sa uvācamahāprāmasso'bhivādyaplavaṅgamḥ | rāmṃvacanamarthajñovarṃsarvadhanuṣmatām ||6.117.1||
meaning: Highly learned Hanuman greeted and spoke meaningfully to Rama, the foremost among the wielders of bow.

sanskrit: तांतुपाश्वस्थितांप्रह्वांरामस्सम्प्रेक्ष्यमैथिलीम् । हृदयान्तर्गतंक्रोधव्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे ।।6.118.1।।
transliteration: tāṃtupāśvasthitāṃprahvāṃrāmassamprekṣyamaithilīm | hṛdayāntargatṃkrodhavyāhartumupacakrame ||6.118.1||
meaning: Observing Mythili who stood near him, Rama started to give expression to what was in his heart.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तातुवैदेहिपरुषंरोमहर्षणम् । राघवेणसरोषेणश्रुत्वाप्रव्यथिताऽभवत् ।।6.119.1।।
transliteration: evamuktātuvaidehiparuṣṃromaharṣaṇam | rāghaveṇasaroṣeṇaśrutvāpravyathitā'bhavat ||6.119.1||
meaning: Vaidehi heard the harsh horripilating words spoken by Rama in anger and was very much afflicted.

sanskrit: सतांपरिषदंकृत्स्नांसमीक्ष्यसमितिञ्जयः । प्रचोदयामासतदाप्रहस्तंवाहिनीपतिम् ।।6.12.1।।
transliteration: satāṃpariṣadṃkṛtsnāṃsamīkṣyasamitiñjayḥ | pracodayāmāsatadāprahastṃvāhinīpatim ||6.12.1||
meaning: Then Ravana who is victorious in wars, looking at the vast assembly (of Rakshasas) ordered Prahastha, the chief of the army.

sanskrit: ततोहिदुर्मनाराम्श्रुत्वैवंवदतांगिरः । दध्यौमुहूर्तंधर्मात्माबाष्पव्याकुललोचनः ।।6.120.1।।
transliteration: tatohidurmanārāmśrutvaivṃvadatāṃgirḥ | dadhyaumuhūrtṃdharmātmābāṣpavyākulalocanḥ ||6.120.1||
meaning: Then righteous Rama, hearing the wailing of the people, whose eyes were dimmed with tears, remained for a moment.

sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वाशुभंवाक्यंपितामहसमीरितम् । अङ्केनादायवैदेहिमुत्पपातविभावसुः ।।6.121.1।।
transliteration: etacchrutvāśubhṃvākyṃpitāmahasamīritam | aṅkenādāyavaidehimutpapātavibhāvasuḥ ||6.121.1||
meaning: On hearing creator Brahma's address to Rama, fire god emerged picking auspicious Vaidehi in his arms.

sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वाशुभंवाक्यंराघवेणानुभाषितम् । ततश्शुभतरंवाक्यंव्याजहारमहेश्वरः ।।6.122.1।।
transliteration: etacchrutvāśubhṃvākyṃrāghaveṇānubhāṣitam | tataśśubhatarṃvākyṃvyājahāramaheśvarḥ ||6.122.1||
meaning: On hearing the sweet reply of Raghava, Lord Maheswara delivered an auspicious message.

sanskrit: प्रतिप्रयातेकाकुत्स्थेमहेन्द्रःपाकशासनः । अब्रवीत्परमप्रीतोराघवंप्राञ्जलिंस्थितम् ।।6.123.1।।
transliteration: pratiprayātekākutsthemahendrḥpākaśāsanḥ | abravītparamaprītorāghavṃprāñjaliṃsthitam ||6.123.1||
meaning: Mahendra, the tamer of demon Paka, spoke very affectionately to Rama, who stood with joined palms before Dasharatha who had returned.

sanskrit: तांरात्रिमुषितंरामंसुखोत्थिमरिन्दमम् । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यंजयंपृष्टवाविभीषणः ।।6.124.1।।
transliteration: tāṃrātrimuṣitṃrāmṃsukhotthimarindamam | abravītprāñjalirvākyṃjayṃpṛṣṭavāvibhīṣaṇḥ ||6.124.1||
meaning: Rising in the morning after comfortable rest that night, Vibheeshana saw Rama the subduer of enemies, offered salutations and asked him of the victory and spoke.

sanskrit: उपस्थितंतुतंकृत्वापुष्पकंपुष्पभूषितम् । अविदूरेस्थितोराममित्युवाचविभीषणः ।।6.125.1।।
transliteration: upasthitṃtutṃkṛtvāpuṣpakṃpuṣpabhūṣitam | avidūresthitorāmamityuvācavibhīṣaṇḥ ||6.125.1||
meaning: Offering to Sri Rama the Pushpak decorated with flowers to sit, Vibheeshana stood at a distance and spoke.

sanskrit: अनुज्ञातंतुरामेणतद्विमानमनुत्तमम् । हंसयुक्तंमहानादमुत्पपातविहायसम् ।।6.126.1।।
transliteration: anujñātṃturāmeṇatadvimānamanuttamam | hṃsayuktṃmahānādamutpapātavihāyasam ||6.126.1||
meaning: Swan shaped Pushpak, unsurpassed in appearance like swan, making great sound started to fly with the permission of Rama.

sanskrit: पूर्णेचतुर्दशेवर्षेपञ्चम्यांलक्ष्मणाग्रजः । भरद्वाजाश्रमंप्राप्यववन्देनियतोमुनिम् ।।6.127.1।।
transliteration: pūrṇecaturdaśevarṣepañcamyāṃlakṣmaṇāgrajḥ | bharadvājāśramṃprāpyavavandeniyatomunim ||6.127.1||
meaning: After the fourteenth year of exile, on the fifth day of the bright half of lunar month Sri Rama and Lakshmana reached Bharadwaja's hermitage. They bent their heads down (as a mark of respect) and offered salutations.

sanskrit: अयोध्यांतुसमालोक्यचिन्तयामासराघवः । प्रियकामःप्रियंरामस्ततस्त्वरितविक्रमः ।।6.128.1।।
transliteration: ayodhyāṃtusamālokyacintayāmāsarāghavḥ | priyakāmḥpriyṃrāmastatastvaritavikramḥ ||6.128.1||
meaning: There upon Raghava who was quick in exhibiting his prowess started thinking with his friends looking at Ayodhya (from Pushpaka).

sanskrit: बहूनिनामवर्षाणिगतस्यसुमहद्वनम् । शृणोम्यहंप्रीतिकरंममनाथस्यकीर्तनम् ।।6.129.1।।
transliteration: bahūnināmavarṣāṇigatasyasumahadvanam | śṛṇomyahṃprītikarṃmamanāthasyakīrtanam ||6.129.1||
meaning: "I am hearing the good news of my Lord returning from the forest, who was living in the great forest for many years."

sanskrit: रावणंक्रुद्धमाज्ञायमहापार्श्वोमहाबलः । मुहूर्तमनुसञ्चिन्त्यप्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.13.1।।
transliteration: rāvaṇṃkruddhamājñāyamahāpārśvomahābalḥ | muhūrtamanusañcintyaprāñjalirvākyamabravīt ||6.13.1||
meaning: Having realized that Ravana has become angry, Mahaparsva of extraordinary strength, thinking of pleasing him for a while greeting him with folded palms, spoke.

sanskrit: श्रुत्वातुपरमानन्दंभरतस्सत्यविक्रमः । हृष्टमाज्ञापयामासशत्रुघ्नंपरवीरहा ।।6.130.1।।
transliteration: śrutvātuparamānandṃbharatassatyavikramḥ | hṛṣṭamājñāpayāmāsaśatrughnṃparavīrahā ||6.130.1||
meaning: Hearing the delightful news, Bharata of truthful prowess, the destroyer of enemies, was very happy and ordered Shatrughna.

sanskrit: शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधायकैकेय्यानन्दवर्धनः । बभाषेभरतोज्येष्ठंरामंसत्यपराक्रमम् ।।6.131.1।।
transliteration: śirasyañjalimādhāyakaikeyyānandavardhanḥ | babhāṣebharatojyeṣṭhṃrāmṃsatyaparākramam ||6.131.1||
meaning: Bharata, the enhancer of Kaikeyi's joy, of unfailing valour, with folded palms on head submitted to his elder brother.

sanskrit: निशाचरेन्द्रस्यनिशम्यवाक्यंसकुम्भकर्णस्यचगर्जितानि । विभीषणोराक्षसराजमुख्यमुवाचवाक्यंहितमर्थयुक्तम् ।।6.14.1।।
transliteration: niśācarendrasyaniśamyavākyṃsakumbhakarṇasyacagarjitāni | vibhīṣaṇorākṣasarājamukhyamuvācavākyṃhitamarthayuktam ||6.14.1|
meaning: On hearing the statement of the Lord of Rakshasas and roaring of Kumbhakarna, looking at Ravana the king of Rakshasas, Vibheeshana said these good words appropriate of a noble person.

sanskrit: बृहस्पतेस्तुल्यमतेर्वचस्तन्निशम्ययत्नेनविभीषणस्य । ततोमहात्मावचनंबभाषेतत्रेन्द्रजिन्नैरृतयूथमुख्यः ।।6.15.1।।
transliteration: bṛhaspatestulyamatervacastanniśamyayatnenavibhīṣaṇasya | tatomahātmāvacanṃbabhāṣetatrendrajinnairṛtayūthamukhyḥ ||6.15.1
meaning: Thus spoke Indrajith, the great leader of the Rakshasa army, having heard the words spoken by the highly intelligent Vibheeshana who was equal to Brhaspathi in wisdom.

sanskrit: सुनिविष्टंहितंवाक्यमुक्तवन्तंविभीषणम् । अब्रवीत्परुषंवाक्यंरावणःकालचोदितः ।।6.16.1।।
transliteration: suniviṣṭṃhitṃvākyamuktavantṃvibhīṣaṇam | abravītparuṣṃvākyṃrāvaṇḥkālacoditḥ ||6.16.1||
meaning: While Vibheeshana advised in Ravana's favour with all good intention, Ravana who was under the influence of death spoke harsh words.

sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वापरुषंवाक्यंरावणंरावणानुजः । आजगाममुहूर्तेनयत्ररामस्सलक्ष्मणः ।।6.17.1।।
transliteration: ityuktvāparuṣṃvākyṃrāvaṇṃrāvaṇānujḥ | ājagāmamuhūrtenayatrarāmassalakṣmaṇḥ ||6.17.1||
meaning: Vibheeshana, having addressed Ravana in harsh language, reached Rama and Lakshmana in a short while.

sanskrit: अथरामःप्रसन्नात्माशृत्वावायुसुतस्यह । प्रत्यभाषतदुर्धषश्रुतवानात्मनिस्थितम् ।।6.18.1।।
transliteration: atharāmḥprasannātmāśṛtvāvāyusutasyaha | pratyabhāṣatadurdhaṣaśrutavānātmanisthitam ||6.18.1||
meaning: Having heard Hanuman (son of wind god) formidable Rama was highly pleased at heart and started to tell his opinion.

sanskrit: राघवेणाभयेदत्तेसन्नतोरावणानुजः । विभीषणोमहाप्राज्ञोभूमिंसमवलोकयन् ।।6.19.1।।
transliteration: rāghaveṇābhayedattesannatorāvaṇānujḥ | vibhīṣaṇomahāprājñobhūmiṃsamavalokayan ||6.19.1||
meaning: When wise Vibheeshana, the brother of Ravana was assured of security by Raghava, he looked around the ground and prepared (to descend).

sanskrit: तंतुशोकपरिद्यूनंरामंदशरथात्मजम् । उवाचवचनंश्रीमान् सुग्रीवश्शोकनाशनम् ।।6.2.1।।
transliteration: tṃtuśokaparidyūnṃrāmṃdaśarathātmajam | uvācavacanṃśrīmān sugrīvaśśokanāśanam ||6.2.1||
meaning: Glorious Sugriva spoke such words of advice to remove the agony of Rama,son of Dasaratha, who was filled with sorrow.

sanskrit: ततोनिविष्टांध्वजिनींसुग्रीवेणाभिपालिताम् । ददर्शराक्षसोऽभ्येत्यशार्दूलोनामवीर्यवान् ।।6.20.1।।
transliteration: tatoniviṣṭāṃdhvajinīṃsugrīveṇābhipālitām | dadarśarākṣaso'bhyetyaśārdūlonāmavīryavān ||6.20.1||
meaning: Then the heroic Rakshasa called Shardula entered into the area encamped by the army under Sugriva's command and saw the sign flag of the army.

sanskrit: ततस्सागरवेलायांदर्भानास्तीर्यराघवः । अञ्जलिंप्राङ्मुखःकृत्वाप्रतिशिश्येमहोदधेः ।।6.21.1।। बाहुंभुजगभोगाभमुपधायारिसूदनः ।
transliteration: tatassāgaravelāyāṃdarbhānāstīryarāghavḥ | añjaliṃprāṅmukhḥkṛtvāpratiśiśyemahodadheḥ ||6.21.1|| bāhuṃbhujagabhogābhamupad
meaning: Then Raghava the destroyer of foes, offered his obeisance turning his face towards east, spread the kusa grass mat on the seashore and lay down resting his head upon his shoulders like a coiled serpent.

sanskrit: अथोवाचरघुश्रेष्टस्सागरंदारुणंवचः । अद्यत्वांशोषयिष्यामिसपाताळंमहार्णव: ।।6.22.1।।
transliteration: athovācaraghuśreṣṭassāgarṃdāruṇṃvacḥ | adyatvāṃśoṣayiṣyāmisapātāळṃmahārṇava: ||6.22.1||
meaning: Thereafter, Rama uttered, "I shall make you dry up to the underworld", to the ocean that made his terrific presence.

sanskrit: निमित्तानिनिमित्ताज्ञोदृष्टवालक्ष्मणपूर्वजः । सौमित्रिंसम्परिष्वज्यइदंवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.23.1।।
transliteration: nimittāninimittājñodṛṣṭavālakṣmaṇapūrvajḥ | saumitriṃsampariṣvajyaidṃvacanamabravīt ||6.23.1||
meaning: Perceiving the portents, Rama spoke these words embracing Saumithri who was aware of the portents.

sanskrit: सावीरसमितीराज्ञाविरराजव्यवस्थिता । शशिनाशुभनक्षत्रापौर्णमासीवशारदी ।।6.24.1।।
transliteration: sāvīrasamitīrājñāvirarājavyavasthitā | śaśināśubhanakṣatrāpaurṇamāsīvaśāradī ||6.24.1||
meaning: The army of Vanaras settled that way by Rama's command shone like the autumnal full moon with auspicious stars.

sanskrit: सबलेसागरंतीर्णेरामेदशरथात्मजे । अमात्यौरावणश्रीमानब्रवीच्छुकसारणौ ।।6.25.1।।
transliteration: sabalesāgarṃtīrṇerāmedaśarathātmaje | amātyaurāvaṇaśrīmānabravīcchukasāraṇau ||6.25.1||
meaning: On hearing about Rama, the son of Dasaratha crossing the shore of the ocean along with the army, exuberant Ravana spoke to his ministers Suka and Saarana.

sanskrit: तद्वचःपथ्यमक्लीबंसारणेनाभिभाषितम् । निशम्यरावणोराजाप्रत्यभाषतसारणम् ।।6.26.1।।
transliteration: tadvacḥpathyamaklībṃsāraṇenābhibhāṣitam | niśamyarāvaṇorājāpratyabhāṣatasāraṇam ||6.26.1||
meaning: Perceiving the truthful and beneficial words spoken by Saarana, without hesitation, King Ravana replied.

sanskrit: तांस्तुतेऽहंप्रवक्ष्यामिप्रेक्षमाणस्ययूथपान् । राघवार्थेपराक्रान्तायेनरक्षन्तिजीवितम् ।।6.27.1।।
transliteration: tāṃstute'hṃpravakṣyāmiprekṣamāṇasyayūthapān | rāghavārtheparākrāntāyenarakṣantijīvitam ||6.27.1||
meaning: "I will describe the Vanara force, who are not caring for their lives for the cause of Raghava. You may see."

sanskrit: साराणस्यवचश्श्रुत्वारावणंराक्षसाधिपम् । बलमादिश्यतत्सर्वंशुकोवाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।।6.28.1।।
transliteration: sārāṇasyavacaśśrutvārāvaṇṃrākṣasādhipam | balamādiśyatatsarvṃśukovākyamathābravīt ||6.28.1||
meaning: Then Ravana the king of Rakshasas having heard Saarana's words and described the strength (of Vanaras) Suka spoke these words.

sanskrit: शुकेनतुसमाख्यातान्दृष्ट्वासहरियूथपान् । समीपस्थंचरामस्यभ्रातरंस्वंविभीषणम् ।।6.29.1।। लक्ष्मणंचमहावीर्यंभुजंरामस्यदक्षिण
transliteration: śukenatusamākhyātāndṛṣṭvāsahariyūthapān | samīpasthṃcarāmasyabhrātarṃsvṃvibhīṣaṇam ||6.29.1|| lakṣmaṇṃcamahāvīryṃbhujṃrā
meaning: There after Ravana having heard the words spoken by Suka about the army of Vanara heroes, seeing Lakshmana of extraordinary valour, the right shoulder of Rama standing close by Rama his own brother Vibheeshana close by t

sanskrit: सुग्रीवस्यवचश्श्रुत्वाहेतुमत्परमार्थवत् । प्रतिजग्राहकाकुत्स्थोहनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत् ।।6.3.1।।
transliteration: sugrīvasyavacaśśrutvāhetumatparamārthavat | pratijagrāhakākutsthohanūmantamathābravīt ||6.3.1||
meaning: Rama the scion of Kakuthsa dynasty having accepted the wellmeaning words of Sugriva, who spoke the truth with deep understanding, turned to Hanuman and said.

sanskrit: ततस्तमक्षोभ्यबलंलङ्काधिपतयेचराः । सुवेलेराघवंशैलेनिविष्टंप्रत्यवेदयन् ।।6.30.1।।
transliteration: tatastamakṣobhyabalṃlaṅkādhipatayecarāḥ | suvelerāghavṃśaileniviṣṭṃpratyavedayan ||6.30.1||
meaning: Thereafter, the spies reported to the king of Lanka that Raghava had camped with an unshakable army at the Suvela mountain.

sanskrit: ततस्तमक्षोभ्यबलंलङ्काधिपतयेचराः । सुवेलेराघवंशैलेनिविष्टंप्रत्यवेदयन् ।।6.31.1।।
transliteration: tatastamakṣobhyabalṃlaṅkādhipatayecarāḥ | suvelerāghavṃśaileniviṣṭṃpratyavedayan ||6.31.1||
meaning: There upon the spies described the unshakeable army of Raghava staying at Suvela mountain, to the king of Lanka.

sanskrit: सासीतातच्छिरोदृष्टवातच्चकार्मुकमुत्तमम् । सुग्रीवप्रतिसंपर्गमाख्यातंचहनूमता ।।6.32.1।। नयनेमुखवर्णंचभर्तुस्तत्सदृशंमुखम्
transliteration: sāsītātacchirodṛṣṭavātaccakārmukamuttamam | sugrīvapratisṃpargamākhyātṃcahanūmatā ||6.32.1|| nayanemukhavarṇṃcabhartusta
meaning: On seeing the esteemed Rama's head and bow, remembering the description made by Hanuman about the friendship with Sugriva thinking of the eyes, complexion of the face, the hair, and curls of her husband at the end Sita r

sanskrit: सीतांतुमोहितांदृष्टवासरमानामराक्षसी । आससादाथवैदेहींप्रियांप्रणयिनींसखी ।।6.33.1।।
transliteration: sītāṃtumohitāṃdṛṣṭavāsaramānāmarākṣasī | āsasādāthavaidehīṃpriyāṃpraṇayinīṃsakhī ||6.33.1||
meaning: Then seeing Sita in distraught, a Rakshasi by name Saarana who was very dear and friendly with Vaidehi approached her.

sanskrit: अथतांजातन्तापांतेनवाक्येनमोहिताम् । सरमाह्लादयामासमहींघौरीमिवाम्भसा ।।6.34.1।।
transliteration: athatāṃjātantāpāṃtenavākyenamohitām | saramāhlādayāmāsamahīṃghaurīmivāmbhasā ||6.34.1||
meaning: Thus, Sita's agony was put off by Saarana's consoling words and Sita was glad just as the parched earth was delighted with shower of rain.

sanskrit: तेनशङ्खविमिश्रेणभेरीशब्देनराघवः । उपयातिमहाबाहूरामःपरपुरञ्जयः ।।6.35.1।।
transliteration: tenaśaṅkhavimiśreṇabherīśabdenarāghavḥ | upayātimahābāhūrāmḥparapurañjayḥ ||6.35.1||
meaning: The mighty armed Rama, the conqueror of enemy cities, Raghava marched forth with the noise of the blowing of conches and the sounds of drums.

sanskrit: तत्तुमाल्यवतोवाक्यंहितमुक्तंदशाननः । नमर्षयतिदुष्टात्माकालस्यवशमागतः ।।6.36.1।।
transliteration: tattumālyavatovākyṃhitamuktṃdaśānanḥ | namarṣayatiduṣṭātmākālasyavaśamāgatḥ ||6.36.1||
meaning: The tenheaded Ravana, having fallen under the sway of death could not tolerate Malyavatha's words of advice.

sanskrit: नरवानरराजौतौसतुवायुसुतःकपिः । जाम्बवानृक्षराजश्चराक्षसश्चविभीषणः ।।6.37.1।। अङ्गदोवालिपुत्रश्चसौमित्रिश्शरभःकपिः । सुषेण
transliteration: naravānararājautausatuvāyusutḥkapiḥ | jāmbavānṛkṣarājaścarākṣasaścavibhīṣaṇḥ ||6.37.1|| aṅgadovāliputraścasaumitriśśarab
meaning: Sugriva the king of men and monkeys, Hanuman the son of wind god, Jambavan the king of Bears, Vibheeshana, Vali's son Angada, Sarabha, accompanied by his kin Sushena, Mainda, Dwivida, Gaja, Gavaksha, Kumuda, the wise Nal

sanskrit: सतुकृत्वासुवेलस्यमतिमारोहणंप्रति । लक्ष्मणानुगतोरामःसुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.38.1।। विभीषणंचधर्मज्ञमनुरक्तंनिशाचरम् । मन्त
transliteration: satukṛtvāsuvelasyamatimārohaṇṃprati | lakṣmaṇānugatorāmḥsugrīvamidamabravīt ||6.38.1|| vibhīṣaṇṃcadharmajñamanuraktṃniśā
meaning: Rama, the well wisher of Lakshmana climbing up the Suvela mountain thought in his mind and thus spoke to Sugriva and the righteous, affectionate Vibheeshana, a counsellor, knower of right action and facts of Lanka, and a

sanskrit: तांरात्रिमुषितास्तत्रसुवेलेहरिपुङ्गवाः । लङ्कायांददृशुर्वीरावनान्युपवनानिच ।।6.39.1।।
transliteration: tāṃrātrimuṣitāstatrasuveleharipuṅgavāḥ | laṅkāyāṃdadṛśurvīrāvanānyupavanānica ||6.39.1||
meaning: The heroic leader of the monkeys kept awake that night on the Suvela and saw forests and gardens there in Lanka.

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं यथावदनुपूर्वशः । ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा रामस्सत्यपराक्रमः ।।6.4.1।।
transliteration: śrutvā hanumato vākyṃ yathāvadanupūrvaśḥ | tato'bravīnmahātejā rāmassatyaparākramḥ ||6.4.1||
meaning: Glorious Rama, of truthful valour, having heard Hanuman in the aforesaid manner, there after spoke (to Hanuman).

sanskrit: ततोरामस्सुवेलाग्रंयोजनद्वयमण्डलम् । अरुरोहससुग्रीवोहरियूधपसम्वृतः ।।6.40.1।।
transliteration: tatorāmassuvelāgrṃyojanadvayamaṇḍalam | arurohasasugrīvohariyūdhapasamvṛtḥ ||6.40.1||
meaning: Rama accompanied by Vanara troop and Sugriva, ascended the peak of Suvela mountain spread over yojanas.

sanskrit: अथतस्मिन्निमित्तानिदृष्टवालक्ष्मणपूर्वजः । सुग्रीवंसम्परिष्वज्यतथावचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.41.1।।
transliteration: athatasminnimittānidṛṣṭavālakṣmaṇapūrvajḥ | sugrīvṃsampariṣvajyatathāvacanamabravīt ||6.41.1||
meaning: Rama, brother of Lakshmana, seeing the signs of war, embraced Sugriva and spoke these words.

sanskrit: ततस्तेराक्षसास्तत्रगत्वारावणमन्दिरम् । न्यवेदयन्पुरींरुद्धांरामेणसहवानरैः ।।6.42.1।।
transliteration: tatasterākṣasāstatragatvārāvaṇamandiram | nyavedayanpurīṃruddhāṃrāmeṇasahavānaraiḥ ||6.42.1||
meaning: Then the Rakshasas proceeding to Ravana's abode informed that Rama along with the vanaras have occupied the whole of Lanka.

sanskrit: युध्यतांतुततस्तेषांवानराणांमहात्मनाम् । रक्षसांसम्बभूवाथबलकोपस्सुदारुणः ।।6.43.1।।
transliteration: yudhyatāṃtutatasteṣāṃvānarāṇāṃmahātmanām | rakṣasāṃsambabhūvāthabalakopassudāruṇḥ ||6.43.1||
meaning: Thereafter the gigantic army of Vanaras were fighting with exceedingly terrific Rakshasas and the anguished Rakshasas could not tolerate the sight.

sanskrit: युध्यतामेनतेषांतुतदावानरराक्षसाम् । रविरस्तंगतोरात्रिःप्रवृत्ताप्राणहारिणी ।।6.44.1।।
transliteration: yudhyatāmenateṣāṃtutadāvānararākṣasām | ravirastṃgatorātriḥpravṛttāprāṇahāriṇī ||6.44.1||
meaning: Thus, as the Vanaras and Rakshasas were battling, the Sun began to set, which is not favourable to the life of Vanaras.

sanskrit: सतस्यगतिमन्विच्छन्राजपुत्रःप्रतापवान् । दिदेशातिबलोरामोदशवानरयूथपान् ।।6.45.1।।
transliteration: satasyagatimanvicchanrājaputrḥpratāpavān | dideśātibalorāmodaśavānarayūthapān ||6.45.1||
meaning: Rama, the son of the king, a powerful and strong warrior, ordered ten Vanaras to know the whereabouts (of Indrajith).

sanskrit: ततोद्यांपृथिवींचैववीक्षमाणावनौकसः । ददृशुःसन्ततौबाणैर्भ्रातरौरामलक्ष्मणौ ।।6.46.1।।
transliteration: tatodyāṃpṛthivīṃcaivavīkṣamāṇāvanaukasḥ | dadṛśuḥsantataubāṇairbhrātaraurāmalakṣmaṇau ||6.46.1||
meaning: Thereafter looking at the sky and the ground for Rama and Lakshmana, the Vanara leaders saw the two brothers, lying on the ground hurt by arrows.

sanskrit: प्रतिप्रविष्टेलङ्कायांकृतार्थेरावणात्मजे । राघवंपरिवार्यार्तुरक्षुर्वानरर्षभाः ।।6.47.1।।
transliteration: pratipraviṣṭelaṅkāyāṃkṛtārtherāvaṇātmaje | rāghavṃparivāryārturakṣurvānararṣabhāḥ ||6.47.1||
meaning: After accomplishing the task Ravana's son entered Lanka while the bull among monkeys guarded Raghava staying around.

sanskrit: भर्तारंनिहतंदृष्टवालक्ष्मणंचमहाबलम् । विललापभृशंसीताकरुणंशोककर्शिता ।।6.48.1।।
transliteration: bhartārṃnihatṃdṛṣṭavālakṣmaṇṃcamahābalam | vilalāpabhṛśṃsītākaruṇṃśokakarśitā ||6.48.1||
meaning: On seeing her husband killed and also mighty Lakshmana, Sita became emotional in intense sorrow and cried piteously.

sanskrit: घोरेणशरबन्धेनबद्धौदशरथात्मजौ । निःश्वसन्तौयथानागौशयानौरुधिरोक्षितौ ।।6.49.1।। सर्वेतेवानरश्रेष्ठास्ससुग्रीवामहाबलाः । पर
transliteration: ghoreṇaśarabandhenabaddhaudaśarathātmajau | niḥśvasantauyathānāgauśayānaurudhirokṣitau ||6.49.1|| sarvetevānaraśreṣṭhāss
meaning: Sugriva, the very powerful one and all the best of Vanaras stood immersed in sorrow surrounding the great sons of Dasaratha, who were lying on the ground bound by a network of arrows like serpents, sighing, bodies covere

sanskrit: सातुनीलेनविधिवत्स्वारक्षासुसमाहिता । सागरस्योत्तरेतीरेसाधुसेनानिवेशिता ।।6.5.1।।
transliteration: sātunīlenavidhivatsvārakṣāsusamāhitā | sāgarasyottaretīresādhusenāniveśitā ||6.5.1||
meaning: Nila settled the army successfully by making them reside on the northern shore of the sea, as per tradition.

sanskrit: अथोवाचमहातेजाहरिराजोमहाबलः । किमियंव्यथितासेनामूढवातेवनौर्जले ।।6.50.1।।
transliteration: athovācamahātejāharirājomahābalḥ | kimiyṃvyathitāsenāmūḍhavātevanaurjale ||6.50.1||
meaning: Extremely brilliant and mighty Sugriva looking at the army of Vanaras said, "Why are you worried like a boat tossed by wind in water?"

sanskrit: तेषांसुतुमुलंशब्दंवानराणांतरस्विनाम् । नर्दतांराक्षसैस्सार्धंतदाशुश्रावरावणः ।।6.51.1।।
transliteration: teṣāṃsutumulṃśabdṃvānarāṇāṃtarasvinām | nardatāṃrākṣasaissārdhṃtadāśuśrāvarāvaṇḥ ||6.51.1||
meaning: Then Ravana and all the Rakshasas heard the increasing and highly tumultuous sound made by the courageous Vanaras.

sanskrit: धूम्राक्षंप्रेक्ष्यनिर्यान्तंराक्षसंभीमविक्रमम् । विनेदुर्वानरास्सर्वेप्रहृष्टायुद्धकाङ् क्षिणः ।।6.52.1।।
transliteration: dhūmrākṣṃprekṣyaniryāntṃrākṣasṃbhīmavikramam | vinedurvānarāssarveprahṛṣṭāyuddhakāṅ kṣiṇḥ ||6.52.1||
meaning: Seeing Dhumraksha of terrible prowess returning, the vanaras made loud noises out of joy and desire to wage war.

sanskrit: धूम्राक्षंनिहतंश्रुत्वारावणोराक्षसेश्वरः । क्रोधेनमहताऽविष्टोनिश्श्वसन्नुरगोयथा ।।6.53.1।। दीर्घमुष्णंविनिश्श्वस्यक्रोधे
transliteration: dhūmrākṣṃnihatṃśrutvārāvaṇorākṣaseśvarḥ | krodhenamahatā'viṣṭoniśśvasannuragoyathā ||6.53.1|| dīrghamuṣṇṃviniśśvasyakrod
meaning: The Lord of Rakshasas was overcome with anger on hearing about Dhumraksha's death. He was hissing like a serpent, heaving a deep burning sigh, for having done a dirty task. He spoke to cruel Vajradamshtra of mighty prowe

sanskrit: बलस्यचविघातेनअङ्गदस्यजयेनच । राक्षसःक्रोधमाविष्टोवज्रदंष्ट्रोमहाबलः ।।6.54.1।।
transliteration: balasyacavighātenaaṅgadasyajayenaca | rākṣasḥkrodhamāviṣṭovajradṃṣṭromahābalḥ ||6.54.1||
meaning: Vajradamshtra, the mighty Rakshasa became enraged with the destruction of his army and victory of Angada.

sanskrit: वज्रदंष्ट्रंहतंश्रुत्वावालिपुत्रेणरावणः । बलाध्यक्षमुवाचेदंकृताञ्जलिमुपस्थितम् ।।6.55.1।।
transliteration: vajradṃṣṭrṃhatṃśrutvāvāliputreṇarāvaṇḥ | balādhyakṣamuvācedṃkṛtāñjalimupasthitam ||6.55.1||
meaning: On hearing about Vajradamshtra being killed by Vali's son, Ravana spoke to the chief of the army who stood with folded hands.

sanskrit: तद्दृष्टवासुमहत्कर्मकृतंवानरतस्तमैः । क्रोधमाहारयामासयुधितीव्रमकम्पनः ।।6.56.1।।
transliteration: taddṛṣṭavāsumahatkarmakṛtṃvānaratastamaiḥ | krodhamāhārayāmāsayudhitīvramakampanḥ ||6.56.1||
meaning: Observing the great action and accomplishment of the foremost Vanaras in the battle, Akampana exhibited violent anger.

sanskrit: अकम्पनवधंश्रुत्वाक्रुद्धोवैराक्षसेश्वरः । किञ्चिददीनमुखश्चापिसचिवांस्तानुदैक्षत ।।6.57.1।।
transliteration: akampanavadhṃśrutvākruddhovairākṣaseśvarḥ | kiñcidadīnamukhaścāpisacivāṃstānudaikṣata ||6.57.1||
meaning: The king of Rakshasas hearing about the death of Akampana, was pale and a little angry and looked at his ministers.

sanskrit: ततःप्रहस्तंनिर्यान्तंदृष्टवाभीमपराक्रमम् । उवाचसस्मितंरामोविभीषणमरिन्दमः ।।6.58.1।।
transliteration: tatḥprahastṃniryāntṃdṛṣṭavābhīmaparākramam | uvācasasmitṃrāmovibhīṣaṇamarindamḥ ||6.58.1||
meaning: Then Rama seeing Prahastha, the tamer of enemies of terrific valour coming towards him, said to Vibheeshana, having a gentle smile.

sanskrit: तस्मिन्हतेराक्षससैन्यपालेप्लवङ्गमानामृषभेणयुद्धे । भीमयुधंसागरतुल्यवेगंविदुद्रुवेराक्षसराजसैन्यम् ।।6.59.1।।
transliteration: tasminhaterākṣasasainyapāleplavaṅgamānāmṛṣabheṇayuddhe | bhīmayudhṃsāgaratulyavegṃvidudruverākṣasarājasainyam ||6.59.1||
meaning: Commander in chief of the Rakshasa army killed by Neela, the bull of Vanaras, the army Rakshasas with dreadful weapons which were like the fury of an ocean, ran.

sanskrit: लङ्कायांतुकृतंकर्मघोरंदृष्टवाभयावहम् । राक्षसेन्द्रोहनुमताशक्रेणेवमहात्मना ।।6.6.1।। अब्रवीद्राक्षसान् सर्वान्ह्रियाकिञ्
transliteration: laṅkāyāṃtukṛtṃkarmaghorṃdṛṣṭavābhayāvaham | rākṣasendrohanumatāśakreṇevamahātmanā ||6.6.1|| abravīdrākṣasān  sarvānhriyā
meaning: Considering the terrifying, dreadful action that was carried by the great soul Hanuman who was like Indra in might, the Lord of Rakshasas felt a bit shy and bending down his head addressed all Rakshasas.

sanskrit: सप्रविश्यपुरींलङ्कांरामबाणभयार्धितः । भग्नदर्पस्तदाराजाबभूवव्यथितेन्द्रियः ।।6.60.1।।
transliteration: sapraviśyapurīṃlaṅkāṃrāmabāṇabhayārdhitḥ | bhagnadarpastadārājābabhūvavyathitendriyḥ ||6.60.1||
meaning: Then the king of Lanka after entering the city of Lanka, felt humiliated by Rama's arrow, vanity crushed and had lost control over his senses.

sanskrit: ततोरामोमहातेजाधनुरादायवीर्यवान् । किरीटिनंमहाकायंकुम्भकर्णंददर्श ह ।।6.61.1।।
transliteration: tatorāmomahātejādhanurādāyavīryavān | kirīṭinṃmahākāyṃkumbhakarṇṃdadarśa ha ||6.61.1||
meaning: On taking up a bow Rama saw Kumbhakarna of extraordinary energy, prodigious, and of large body, adorned with a crown.

sanskrit: स तुराक्षसशार्दूलोनिद्रामदसमाकुलः । राजमार्गंश्रियाजुष्टंययौविपुलविक्रमः ।।6.62.1।।
transliteration: sa turākṣasaśārdūlonidrāmadasamākulḥ | rājamārgṃśriyājuṣṭṃyayauvipulavikramḥ ||6.62.1||
meaning: He (Kumbhakaran), who was endowed with indomitable prowess, a tiger among Rakshasas, was sleepy and inebriated, marched along the splendid royal path.

sanskrit: तस्यराक्षसराजस्यनिशम्यपरिदेवितम् । कुम्भकर्णोबभाषेदंवचनंप्रजहास च ।।6.63.1।।
transliteration: tasyarākṣasarājasyaniśamyaparidevitam | kumbhakarṇobabhāṣedṃvacanṃprajahāsa ca ||6.63.1||
meaning: Hearing the lament of the Rakshasa king, Kumbhakarna replied laughing.

sanskrit: तदुक्तमतिकायस्यबलिनोबाहुशालिनः । कुम्भकर्णस्यवचनंश्रुत्वोवाचमहोदरः ।।6.64.1।।
transliteration: taduktamatikāyasyabalinobāhuśālinḥ | kumbhakarṇasyavacanṃśrutvovācamahodarḥ ||6.64.1||
meaning: Hearing the words of mighty Kumbhakarna, of massive body and round arms Mahodara said.

sanskrit: स तथोक्तस्तुनिर्भर्त्स्यकुम्भकर्णोमहोदरम् । अब्रवीद्राक्षसश्रेष्ठंभ्रातरंरावणंततः ।।6.65.1।।
transliteration: sa tathoktastunirbhartsyakumbhakarṇomahodaram | abravīdrākṣasaśreṣṭhṃbhrātarṃrāvaṇṃtatḥ ||6.65.1||
meaning: Kumbhakarna having heard Mahodara, warned him not to speak that way and spoke to Ravana, the foremost of Rakshasas.

sanskrit: स लङ्घयित्वाप्राकारंगिरिकूटोपमोमहान् । निर्ययौनगरात्तूर्णंकुम्भकर्णोमहाबलः ।।6.66.1।।
transliteration: sa laṅghayitvāprākārṃgirikūṭopamomahān | niryayaunagarāttūrṇṃkumbhakarṇomahābalḥ ||6.66.1||
meaning: Mighty Kumbhakarna, a gigantic one, resembling a mountain peak, having swiftly crossed over the boundary of the city roared.

sanskrit: तेनिवृत्तामहाकायाश्श्रुत्वाङ्गदवचस्तदा । नैष्ठिकींबुद्धिमास्थायसर्वेसङ्ग्रामकाङ्क्षिणः ।।6.67.1।।
transliteration: tenivṛttāmahākāyāśśrutvāṅgadavacastadā | naiṣṭhikīṃbuddhimāsthāyasarvesaṅgrāmakāṅkṣiṇḥ ||6.67.1||
meaning: Having heard Angada's words, the Vanaras of gigantic body firmly decided to wage war and returned back.

sanskrit: कुम्भकर्णंहतंदृष्टवाराघवेणमहात्मना । राक्षसाराक्षसेन्द्रायरावणायन्यवेदयन् ।।6.68.1।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇṃhatṃdṛṣṭavārāghaveṇamahātmanā | rākṣasārākṣasendrāyarāvaṇāyanyavedayan ||6.68.1||
meaning: Seeing Kumbhakarna slain by the glorious Raghava, the Rakshasas informed Ravana, the king of Rakshasas.

sanskrit: एवंविलपमानस्यरावणस्यदुरात्मनः । श्रुत्वाशोकाभितप्तस्यत्रिशिरावाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.69.1।।
transliteration: evṃvilapamānasyarāvaṇasyadurātmanḥ | śrutvāśokābhitaptasyatriśirāvākyamabravīt ||6.69.1||
meaning: Hearing the lamentations of the evilminded Ravana, Trisira spoke to him.

sanskrit: इत्युक्ताराक्षसेन्द्रेणराक्षसास्तेमहाबलाः । ऊचुःप्रान्जलयःसर्वेरावणंराक्षसेश्वरम् ।।6.7.1।।
transliteration: ityuktārākṣasendreṇarākṣasāstemahābalāḥ | ūcuḥprānjalayḥsarverāvaṇṃrākṣaseśvaram ||6.7.1||
meaning: All the Rakshasas of mighty strength, having heard the Lord of Rakshasas, thus spoke to their leader, greeting with folded hands.

sanskrit: नरान्तकंहतंदृष्टवाचुक्रुशुर्नैरृतर्षभाः । देवान्तकस्त्रिमूर्धा च पौलस्त्यश्चमहोदरः ।।6.70.1।।
transliteration: narāntakṃhatṃdṛṣṭavācukruśurnairṛtarṣabhāḥ | devāntakastrimūrdhā ca paulastyaścamahodarḥ ||6.70.1||
meaning: Seeing the bulls among Rakshasas Naranthaka, Devanthaka, Trisira and Mahodara a scion of Paulastya and Mahodara, killed the Rakshasas cried aloud.

sanskrit: स्वबलंव्यथितंदृष्टवातुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् । भ्रातृ़ंश्चनिहतान् दृष्टवाशक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् ।।6.71.1।। पितृव्यौचापिसनृदृश्यसमरे
transliteration: svabalṃvyathitṃdṛṣṭavātumulṃromaharṣaṇam | bhrātṛ़ṃścanihatān dṛṣṭavāśakratulyaparākramān ||6.71.1|| pitṛvyaucāpisanṛdṛś
meaning: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused hor

sanskrit: अतिकायंहतंश्रुत्वालक्ष्मणेनमहौजसा । उद्वेगमगमद्राजावचनंचेदमब्रवीत् ।।6.72.1।।
transliteration: atikāyṃhatṃśrutvālakṣmaṇenamahaujasā | udvegamagamadrājāvacanṃcedamabravīt ||6.72.1||
meaning: On hearing that Atikaya was killed by highly energetic Lakshmana, the king was overtaken by emotion and spoke as follows.

sanskrit: ततोहतान्राक्षसपुङ्गवांस्तान् देवान्तकादित्रिशिरोतिकायान् । रक्षोगणास्तत्रहतावशिष्टास्तेरावणायत्वरिताश्शशंसुः ।।6.73.1।।
transliteration: tatohatānrākṣasapuṅgavāṃstān devāntakāditriśirotikāyān | rakṣogaṇāstatrahatāvaśiṣṭāsterāvaṇāyatvaritāśśaśṃsuḥ ||6.73.1||
meaning: Then the Rakshasas who survived the killings, hurriedly reported to the Rakshasa king, Ravana about the killing of Devanthaka, Trisira and Atikaya.

sanskrit: तयोस्तदासादितयोरणाग्रेमुमोहसैन्यंहरिपुङ्गवानाम् । सुग्रीवनीलाङ्गदजाम्बवन्तो न चापिकिञ्चित्प्रतिपेदिरेते ।।6.74.1।।
transliteration: tayostadāsāditayoraṇāgremumohasainyṃharipuṅgavānām | sugrīvanīlāṅgadajāmbavanto na cāpikiñcitpratipedirete ||6.74.1||
meaning: The two brothers (Rama and Lakshmana) become unconscious in the forefront of the battle the monkey leaders lose senses. Sugriva, Neela, Angada and Jambavantha did not know What to do.

sanskrit: ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजास्सुग्रीवोवानराधिपः । अर्थ्यंविज्ञापयंश्चापिहनूमन्तमिदंवचः ।।6.75.1।।
transliteration: tato'bravīnmahātejāssugrīvovānarādhipḥ | arthyṃvijñāpayṃścāpihanūmantamidṃvacḥ ||6.75.1||
meaning: Sugriva, the king of Vanaras called Hanuman to make him know the task ahead and said these words.

sanskrit: प्रवृत्तेसङ्कुलेतस्मिन् घोरेवीरजनक्ष्ये । अङ्गदःकम्पनंवीरमाससादरणोत्सुकः ।।6.76.1।।
transliteration: pravṛttesaṅkuletasmin ghorevīrajanakṣye | aṅgadḥkampanṃvīramāsasādaraṇotsukḥ ||6.76.1||
meaning: While the fierce fight brought destruction of heroes in the ongoing combat, Angada eager to fight, assailed gallant Kampana.

sanskrit: निकुम्भोभ्रातरंदृष्टवासुग्रीवेणनिपातितम् । प्रदहन्निवकोपेनवानरेन्द्रमवैक्षत ।।6.77.1।।
transliteration: nikumbhobhrātarṃdṛṣṭavāsugrīveṇanipātitam | pradahannivakopenavānarendramavaikṣata ||6.77.1||
meaning: Seeing his brother struck down by Sugriva, Nikumbha gazed at him as if to burn him in wrath.

sanskrit: निकुम्भंनिहतंश्रुत्वाकुम्भं च विनिपातितम् । रावणःपरमामर्षीप्रजज्वालानलोयथा ।।6.78.1।।
transliteration: nikumbhṃnihatṃśrutvākumbhṃ ca vinipātitam | rāvaṇḥparamāmarṣīprajajvālānaloyathā ||6.78.1||
meaning: On hearing that Nikumbha and Kumbha had been killed, Ravana was very furious and burning in anger.

sanskrit: निर्गतंमकराक्षंतेदृष्टवावानरपुङ्गवाः । आप्लुत्यसहसासर्वेयोद्धुकामाव्यवस्थिताः ।।6.79.1।।
transliteration: nirgatṃmakarākṣṃtedṛṣṭavāvānarapuṅgavāḥ | āplutyasahasāsarveyoddhukāmāvyavasthitāḥ ||6.79.1||
meaning: On seeing Maka raksha all the Vanara chiefs returned, jumped, and stood ready enthusiastically to fight.

sanskrit: ततोनीलाम्बुदनिभ: प्रहस्तोनामराक्षसः । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यंशूरस्सेनापतिस्तदा ।।6.8.1।।
transliteration: tatonīlāmbudanibha: prahastonāmarākṣasḥ | abravītprāñjalirvākyṃśūrassenāpatistadā ||6.8.1||
meaning: Then a Rakshasa whose body was like a dark cloud, called Prahastha, the heroic chief of the army, spoke these words with folded palms.

sanskrit: मकराक्षंहतंश्रुत्वारावणस्समितिञ्जयः । रोषेणमहताविष्टोदन्ताङ्कटकटाय्य च ।।6.80.1।। कोपितश्चतदातत्रकिंकार्यमितिचिन्तयन् ।
transliteration: makarākṣṃhatṃśrutvārāvaṇassamitiñjayḥ | roṣeṇamahatāviṣṭodantāṅkaṭakaṭāyya ca ||6.80.1|| kopitaścatadātatrakiṃkāryamitic
meaning: Ravana, who was always victorious in warhearing that Maka raksha had been killed, became highly enraged and grinding his teeth in anger was engrossed in thinking. He commanded his son Indrajith to go to battle.

sanskrit: विज्ञायतुमनस्तस्यराघवस्यमहात्मनः । स निवृत्याहवात्तस्मात् प्रविवेशपुरींततः ।।6.81.1।।
transliteration: vijñāyatumanastasyarāghavasyamahātmanḥ | sa nivṛtyāhavāttasmāt praviveśapurīṃtatḥ ||6.81.1||
meaning: Knowing the highsouled Raghava's mind, Indrajith departed from there and entered the city.

sanskrit: श्रुत्वातुभीमनिर्ह्रादंशक्राशनिसमस्वनम् । वीक्षमाणादिशस्सर्वादुद्रुवुर्वानरर्षभा: ।।6.82.1।।
transliteration: śrutvātubhīmanirhrādṃśakrāśanisamasvanam | vīkṣamāṇādiśassarvādudruvurvānararṣabhā: ||6.82.1||
meaning: The bulls among Vanaras heard the roar which was like thunder and looking at Indrajith fled in all directions.

sanskrit: राघवश्चापिविपुलंतंराक्षसवनौकसाम् । श्रुत्वासङ्ग्रामनिर्घोषंजाम्बवन्तमुवाच ह ।।6.83.1।।
transliteration: rāghavaścāpivipulṃtṃrākṣasavanaukasām | śrutvāsaṅgrāmanirghoṣṃjāmbavantamuvāca ha ||6.83.1||
meaning: Hearing the great noise of war between Rakshasas and Vanaras, Rama said to Jambavantha.

sanskrit: राममाश्वासयानेतुलक्ष्मणेभ्रातृवत्सले । निक्षिप्यगुल्मान् स्वस्थानेतत्रागच्छद्विभीषणः ।।6.84.1 ।।
transliteration: rāmamāśvāsayānetulakṣmaṇebhrātṛvatsale | nikṣipyagulmān svasthānetatrāgacchadvibhīṣaṇḥ ||6.84.1 ||
meaning: As Lakshmana was comforting his affectionate brother, Vibheeshana came to Rama assigning the troops to reach their respective places.

sanskrit: त्तस्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वाराघवश्शोककर्शितः । नोपधारयतेव्यक्तंयदुक्तंतेनरक्षसा ।।6.85.1।।
transliteration: ttasyatadvacanṃśrutvārāghavaśśokakarśitḥ | nopadhārayatevyaktṃyaduktṃtenarakṣasā ||6.85.1||
meaning: Immersed in grief, Raghava could not make out the words spoken by Vibheeshana.

sanskrit: अथतस्यामवस्थायांलक्ष्मणंरावणानुजः । परेषामहितंवाक्यमर्थसाधकमब्रवीत् ।।6.86.1।।
transliteration: athatasyāmavasthāyāṃlakṣmaṇṃrāvaṇānujḥ | pareṣāmahitṃvākyamarthasādhakamabravīt ||6.86.1||
meaning: Ravana's brother seeing Lakshmana spoke these words of advice to accomplish the task and which is not good for the enemies.

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वातुसौमित्रिंजातहर्षोविभीषणः । धनुष्पाणिंनमादायत्वरमाणोजगामसः ।।6.87.1।।
transliteration: evamuktvātusaumitriṃjātaharṣovibhīṣaṇḥ | dhanuṣpāṇiṃnamādāyatvaramāṇojagāmasḥ ||6.87.1||
meaning: Vibheeshana, having spoken that way, Saumithri was satisfied. Wielding a bow Saumithri went quickly with Vibheeshana.

sanskrit: विभीषणवच्श्रुत्वारावणिःक्रोधमूर्छितः । अब्रवीत्परुषंवाक्यंवेगेनाभ्युत्पपात च ।।6.88.1।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇavacśrutvārāvaṇiḥkrodhamūrchitḥ | abravītparuṣṃvākyṃvegenābhyutpapāta ca ||6.88.1||
meaning: Hearing Vibheeshana's words, Indrajith was deluded with fury, spoke harshly and advanced.

sanskrit: ततश्शरान् दाशरथिस्सन्धायामित्रकर्शणः । ससर्जराक्षसेन्द्रायकृद्धस्सर्पइवश्वसन् ।।6.89.1।।
transliteration: tataśśarān dāśarathissandhāyāmitrakarśaṇḥ | sasarjarākṣasendrāyakṛddhassarpaivaśvasan ||6.89.1||
meaning: Then Lakshmana, the tamer of enemies, sighs in anger like a serpent, fixing his arrows discharged on Rakshasa king.

sanskrit: ततोनिकुम्भोरभसस्सूर्यशत्रुर्महाबलः । सुप्तघ्नोयज्ञहारक्षोमहापार्श्वमहोदरौ ।।6.9.1।। अग्निकेतुश्चदुर्धर्षोरश्मिकेतुश्चराक
transliteration: tatonikumbhorabhasassūryaśatrurmahābalḥ | suptaghnoyajñahārakṣomahāpārśvamahodarau ||6.9.1|| agniketuścadurdharṣoraśmike
meaning: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Raks

sanskrit: युध्यमानौतुतौदृष्टवाप्रसक्तौनरराक्षसौ । प्रभिन्नाविवमातङ्गौपरस्परवधैषिणौ ।।6.90.1।। तौद्रष्टुकामस्सङ्ग्रामेपरस्परगतौबली
transliteration: yudhyamānaututaudṛṣṭavāprasaktaunararākṣasau | prabhinnāvivamātaṅgauparasparavadhaiṣiṇau ||6.90.1|| taudraṣṭukāmassaṅgrā
meaning: Lakshmana (man) and Indrajith (Rakshasa) were fond of battle and intending to win in the fight overcoming each other. Each of them were like elephants but were broken into pieces. Vibheeshana, with eagerness to witness t

sanskrit: स हताश्वोमहातेजाभूमौतिष्ठन्निशाचरः । इन्द्रजित्परमक्रुद्धस्सजज्वालतेजसा ।।6.91.1।।
transliteration: sa hatāśvomahātejābhūmautiṣṭhanniśācarḥ | indrajitparamakruddhassajajvālatejasā ||6.91.1||
meaning: The nightranger, effulgent Indrajith standing on the ground very angry, with horses lost, was flaming with energy.

sanskrit: रुधिरक्लिन्नगात्रस्तुलक्ष्मणःशुभलक्षणः । बभूवहृष्टस्तंहत्वाशक्रजेतारमाहवे ।।6.92.1।।
transliteration: rudhiraklinnagātrastulakṣmaṇḥśubhalakṣaṇḥ | babhūvahṛṣṭastṃhatvāśakrajetāramāhave ||6.92.1||
meaning: Body having auspicious marks, smeared with blood, Lakshmana experienced the joy of having won Indra in battle.

sanskrit: ततःपौलस्त्यसचिवा्श्रुत्वाचेन्द्रजितोवधम् । आचचक्षुरभिज्ञायदशग्रीवायसव्यथा: ।।6.93.1।।
transliteration: tatḥpaulastyasacivāśrutvācendrajitovadham | ācacakṣurabhijñāyadaśagrīvāyasavyathā: ||6.93.1||
meaning: Then, having known about the distressing fall of Indrajith, the ministers of Ravana reported to the tenheaded Ravana.

sanskrit: स प्रविश्यसभांराजादीनःपरमदुःखितः । निषपादासनेमुख्येसिंहःक्रुद्धइवश्वसन् ।।6.94.1।।
transliteration: sa praviśyasabhāṃrājādīnḥparamaduḥkhitḥ | niṣapādāsanemukhyesiṃhḥkruddhaivaśvasan ||6.94.1||
meaning: Ravana, the king entered the council, angry like a lion, looking piteous, very sad and sat on the seat.

sanskrit: तानितानिसहस्राणिसारोहाणां च वाजिनाम् । रथानांत्वग्निवर्णानांसध्वजानांसहस्रशः ।।6.95.1।। राक्षसानांसहस्राणिगदापरिघयोधिनाम
transliteration: tānitānisahasrāṇisārohāṇāṃ ca vājinām | rathānāṃtvagnivarṇānāṃsadhvajānāṃsahasraśḥ ||6.95.1|| rākṣasānāṃsahasrāṇigadāpar
meaning: "Rama who can work without getting tired put an end to thousands of Rakshasa warriors with his sharp glowing arrows decked with gold. Thousands of warriors sent by king Ravana, mounted on chariots, yoked to horses, of th

sanskrit: आर्तानांराक्षसीनांतुलङ्कायांवैकुलेकुले । रावणःकरुणंशब्दंशुश्रावपरिदेवितम् ।।6.96.1।।
transliteration: ārtānāṃrākṣasīnāṃtulaṅkāyāṃvaikulekule | rāvaṇḥkaruṇṃśabdṃśuśrāvaparidevitam ||6.96.1||
meaning: Ravana heard from every house in Lanka sounds of piteous cries and pathetic sounds of the afflicted.

sanskrit: तथातैःकृत्तगात्रैस्तुदशग्रीवेणमार्गणैः । बभूववसुधातत्रप्रकीर्णाहरिभिस्तदा ।।6.97.1।।
transliteration: tathātaiḥkṛttagātraistudaśagrīveṇamārgaṇaiḥ | babhūvavasudhātatraprakīrṇāharibhistadā ||6.97.1||
meaning: That time the battlefield was strewn with bodies of Vanaras whose limbs had been severed by the arrows of Ravana.

sanskrit: हन्यमानेबलेतूर्णमन्योन्यंतेमहामृथे । सरसीवमहाघर्मेसोपक्षीणेबभूवतुः ।।6.98.1।।
transliteration: hanyamānebaletūrṇamanyonyṃtemahāmṛthe | sarasīvamahāgharmesopakṣīṇebabhūvatuḥ ||6.98.1||
meaning: In the major conflict, each one destroying the other army, it seemed like the midsummer lakes totally lost its water.

sanskrit: महोदरेतुनिहतेमहापार्श्वोमहाबलः । सुग्रीवेणसमीक्ष्याथक्रोधात्सम्ररक्तलोचनः ।।6.99.1।। अङ्गदस्यचमूंभीमांक्षोभयामाससायकैः ।
transliteration: mahodaretunihatemahāpārśvomahābalḥ | sugrīveṇasamīkṣyāthakrodhātsamraraktalocanḥ ||6.99.1|| aṅgadasyacamūṃbhīmāṃkṣobhayā
meaning: Gazing at Mahodara killed by Sugriva, mighty Mahaparsva's eyes turned red in anger. He created a commotion in the army of Angada.

sanskrit: कुशचीरपरिक्षिप्तं ब्राह्म्या लक्ष्म्या समावृतम्। यथा प्रदीप्तं दुर्दर्शं गगने सूर्यमण्डलम्।।3.1.2।।
transliteration: kuśacīraparikṣiptṃ brāhmyā lakṣmyā samāvṛtam| yathā pradīptṃ durdarśṃ gagane sūryamaṇḍalam||3.1.2||
meaning: They (the hermitages) were strewn all over with kusa grass and robes by bark with auspicious sacrificial materials around and hence dazzling like the orb of the sun in the sky difficult to gaze.

sanskrit: शरण्यं सर्वभूतानां सुसम्मृष्टाजिरं सदा। मृगैर्बहुभिराकीर्णं पक्षिसङ्घैस्समावृतम्।।3.1.3।।
transliteration: śaraṇyṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ susammṛṣṭājirṃ sadā| mṛgairbahubhirākīrṇṃ pakṣisaṅghaissamāvṛtam||3.1.3||
meaning: The courtyards (of the hermitages) were cleanswept, sprinkled with water and decorated. They provided shelter to all kinds of creatures and were filled all over with flocks of birds and antelopes.

sanskrit: पूजितं च प्रनृत्तं च नित्यमप्सरसां गणैः। विशालैरग्निशरणैः स्रुग्भाण्डैरजिनैः कुशैः।।3.1.4।। समिद्भिस्तोयकलशैः फलमूलैश्च
transliteration: pūjitṃ ca pranṛttṃ ca nityamapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ| viśālairagniśaraṇaiḥ srugbhāṇḍairajinaiḥ kuśaiḥ||3.1.4|| samidbhistoyakala
meaning: The hermitages looked glorified with dances by celestial damsels. They were adorned with vast fire sanctuaries, ladles for sacrificial ceremonies, deerskins and kusa grass faggots for pots of water, roots and fruits. The

sanskrit: बलिहोमार्चितं पुण्यं ब्रह्मघोषनिनादितम्। पुष्पैश्चान्यैः परिक्षिप्तं पद्मिन्या च सपद्मया।।3.1.6।। फलमूलाशनैर्दान्तैश्चीर
transliteration: balihomārcitṃ puṇyṃ brahmaghoṣanināditam| puṣpaiścānyaiḥ parikṣiptṃ padminyā ca sapadmayā||3.1.6|| phalamūlāśanairdāntai
meaning: The hermitages where various sacrificial offerings were made reverberated with Vedic chantings. Flowers were scattered all over. There was a lotuspond with lotuses. There were aged, selfrestrained sages glowing like the

sanskrit: पुण्यैश्च नियताहारैः शोभितं परमर्षिभिः। तद्ब्रह्मभवनप्रख्यं ब्रह्मघोषनिनादितम्।।3.1.8।।
transliteration: puṇyaiśca niyatāhāraiḥ śobhitṃ paramarṣibhiḥ| tadbrahmabhavanaprakhyṃ brahmaghoṣanināditam||3.1.8||
meaning: The hermitages echoing with the sounds of Vedic recitations and resembling the very abode of Brahma were adorned with great, holy sages living on regulated diet.

sanskrit: ब्रह्मविद्भिर्महाभागैर्ब्राह्मणैरुपशोभितम्। तद्दृष्ट्वा राघवः श्रीमांस्तापसाश्रममण्डलम्।।3.1.9।। अभ्यगच्छन्महातेजा विज्य
transliteration: brahmavidbhirmahābhāgairbrāhmaṇairupaśobhitam| taddṛṣṭvā rāghavḥ śrīmāṃstāpasāśramamaṇḍalam||3.1.9|| abhyagacchanmahātej
meaning: The illustrious, effulgent Rama saw groups of hermitages adorned with venerable brahmins, with knowledge of the Supreme Spirit. On seeing them he loosened the string of his great bow and went forward.

sanskrit: दिव्यज्ञानोपपन्नास्ते रामं दृष्ट्वा महर्षयः।।3.1.10।। अभ्यगच्छन्स्तदा प्रीता वैदेहीं च यशस्विनीम्।
transliteration: divyajñānopapannāste rāmṃ dṛṣṭvā maharṣayḥ||3.1.10|| abhyagacchanstadā prītā vaidehīṃ ca yaśasvinīm|
meaning: On seeing Rama with illustrious Sita, the great sages, richly endowed with divine knowledge, went forward to greet him.

sanskrit: ते तं सोममिवोद्यन्तं दृष्ट्वा वै धर्मचारिणम्।।3.1.11।। लक्ष्मणं चैव दृष्ट्वा तु वैदेहीं च यशस्विनीम्। मङ्गलानि प्रयुञ्जा
transliteration: te tṃ somamivodyantṃ dṛṣṭvā vai dharmacāriṇam||3.1.11|| lakṣmaṇṃ caiva dṛṣṭvā tu vaidehīṃ ca yaśasvinīm| maṅgalāni prayu
meaning: The sages, steadfast in their vows, saw Rama who was shining like the rising Moon, Lakshmana and the famed Sita went forward and received them with words of benediction.

sanskrit: रूपसंहननं लक्ष्मीं सौकुमार्यं सुवेषताम्। ददृशुर्विस्मिताकारा रामस्य वनवासिनः।।3.1.13।।
transliteration: rūpasṃhananṃ lakṣmīṃ saukumāryṃ suveṣatām| dadṛśurvismitākārā rāmasya vanavāsinḥ||3.1.13||
meaning: Those sages living in the forest were wonderstruck to see the handsome, graceful, delicate and welldressed Rama.

sanskrit: वैदेहीं लक्ष्मणं रामं नेत्रैरनिमिषैरिव। आश्चर्यभूतान्ददृशुः सर्वे ते वनचारिणः।।3.1.14।।
transliteration: vaidehīṃ lakṣmaṇṃ rāmṃ netrairanimiṣairiva| āścaryabhūtāndadṛśuḥ sarve te vanacāriṇḥ||3.1.14||
meaning: All the foresters looked at the wonderful figures of Rama, Sita and Lakshmana with unblinking eyes.

sanskrit: अत्रैनं हि महाभागा स्सर्वभूतहिते रताः। अतिथिं पर्णशालायां राघवं संन्यवेशयन्।।3.1.15।।
transliteration: atrainṃ hi mahābhāgā ssarvabhūtahite ratāḥ| atithiṃ parṇaśālāyāṃ rāghavṃ sṃnyaveśayan||3.1.15||
meaning: Ever engaged in the welfare of all beings, the sages made Rama, their guest, sit in their leafy hut.

sanskrit: ततो रामस्य सत्कृत्य विधिना पावकोपमाः। आजह्रुस्ते महाभागाः सलिलं धर्मचारिणः।।3.1.16।।
transliteration: tato rāmasya satkṛtya vidhinā pāvakopamāḥ| ājahruste mahābhāgāḥ salilṃ dharmacāriṇḥ||3.1.16||
meaning: The great sages comparable to the firegod and followers of righteousness honoured Rama according to tradition by offering water.

sanskrit: पुष्पं मूलं फलं सर्वमाश्रमं च महात्मनः। निवेदयित्वा धर्मज्ञास्ते ततः प्राञ्जलयोऽब्रुवन्।।3.1.17।।
transliteration: puṣpṃ mūlṃ phalṃ sarvamāśramṃ ca mahātmanḥ| nivedayitvā dharmajñāste tatḥ prāñjalayo'bruvan||3.1.17||
meaning: The sages who were knowers of dharma saluted the noble Rama, offered fruits, roots and flowers available at the hermitage and with folded palms said thus:

sanskrit: धर्मपालो जनस्यास्य शरण्यस्त्वं महायशाः। पूजनीयश्च मान्यश्च राजा दण्डधरो गुरुः।।3.1.18।।
transliteration: dharmapālo janasyāsya śaraṇyastvṃ mahāyaśāḥ| pūjanīyaśca mānyaśca rājā daṇḍadharo guruḥ||3.1.18||
meaning: O king of great reputation, you are the refuge of the people, a protector of dharma, a chastiser of wrongdoers, a worshipful and respectable preceptor.

sanskrit: इन्द्रस्येह चतुर्भागः प्रजा रक्षति राघव। राजा तस्माद्वरान्भोगान्रम्यान् भुङक्तेलोकनमस्कृतः।।3.1.19।।
transliteration: indrasyeha caturbhāgḥ prajā rakṣati rāghava| rājā tasmādvarānbhogānramyān bhuṅaktelokanamaskṛtḥ||3.1.19||
meaning: O Rama, in this world a king is considered the fourth part of Indra as he protects the people. Therefore, he is respected and he enjoys the choicest pleasures of life.

sanskrit: ते वयं भवता रक्ष्या भवद्विषयवासिनः। नगरस्थो वनस्थो वा त्वं नो राजा जनेश्वरः।।3.1.20।।
transliteration: te vayṃ bhavatā rakṣyā bhavadviṣayavāsinḥ| nagarastho vanastho vā tvṃ no rājā janeśvarḥ||3.1.20||
meaning: Since we are the residents of your territory we deserve to be protected by you. Whether you live in the city or in the forest, you are the lord of the people and our king.

sanskrit: न्यस्तदण्डा वयं राजञ्जितक्रोधा जितेन्द्रियाः। रक्षणीयास्त्वया शश्वदगर्भभूतास्तपोधनाः।।3.1.21।।
transliteration: nyastadaṇḍā vayṃ rājañjitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ| rakṣaṇīyāstvayā śaśvadagarbhabhūtāstapodhanāḥ||3.1.21||
meaning: O king, we have conquered our anger and have controlled our senses. We ascetics have cast aside all our authority. We are like your children and need to be protected by you forever

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा फलैर्मूलैः पुष्पैर्वन्यैश्च राघवम्। अन्यैश्च विविधाहारैः सलक्ष्मणमपूजयन्।।3.1.22।।
transliteration: evamuktvā phalairmūlaiḥ puṣpairvanyaiśca rāghavam| anyaiśca vividhāhāraiḥ salakṣmaṇamapūjayan||3.1.22||
meaning: Having said so, the ascetics offered with reverence fruits, roots, flowers and other forest products to Rama and Lakshmana.

sanskrit: हितमुक्तं त्वया देवि स्निग्धया सदृशं वचः। कुलं व्यपदिशन्त्या च धर्मज्ञे जनकात्मजे।।3.10.2।।
transliteration: hitamuktṃ tvayā devi snigdhayā sadṛśṃ vacḥ| kulṃ vyapadiśantyā ca dharmajñe janakātmaje||3.10.2||
meaning: O daughter of Janaka, you are conversant with dharma. Whatever you have admonished out of affection for me is befitting your race.

sanskrit: किन्तु वक्ष्याम्यहं देवि त्वयैवोक्तमिदं वचः। क्षत्रियैर्धार्यते चापो नार्तशब्दो भवेदिति।।3.10.3।।
transliteration: kintu vakṣyāmyahṃ devi tvayaivoktamidṃ vacḥ| kṣatriyairdhāryate cāpo nārtaśabdo bhavediti||3.10.3||
meaning: But permit me, Devi, you have already stated, when a kshatriya holds a bow there will be no cry of distress. (it means you approve of my holding a bow)

sanskrit: ते चार्ता दण्डकारण्ये मुनयस्संशितव्रताः। मां सीते स्वयमागम्य शरण्याश्शरणं गताः।।3.10.4।।
transliteration: te cārtā daṇḍakāraṇye munayassṃśitavratāḥ| māṃ sīte svayamāgamya śaraṇyāśśaraṇṃ gatāḥ||3.10.4||
meaning: O Sita, the sages who perform rigorous penance in Dandaka forest came to me personally, seeking shelter although they can be their own protection.

sanskrit: वसन्तो धर्मनिरता वने मूलफलाशनाः। न लभन्ते सुखं भीता राक्षसैः क्रूरकर्मभिः।।3.10.5।।
transliteration: vasanto dharmaniratā vane mūlaphalāśanāḥ| na labhante sukhṃ bhītā rākṣasaiḥ krūrakarmabhiḥ||3.10.5||
meaning: The sages living in the forest, eating roots and fruits and ever engaged in righteous activities are afraid of the depredations of the demons, with their happiness gone.

sanskrit: काले काले च निरता नियमैर्विविधैर्वने। भक्ष्यन्ते राक्षसैर्भीमैर्नरमांसोपजीविभिः।।3.10.6।।
transliteration: kāle kāle ca niratā niyamairvividhairvane| bhakṣyante rākṣasairbhīmairnaramāṃsopajīvibhiḥ||3.10.6||
meaning: The sages engrossed in various austerities in the forest have been victims to the dreadful demons living on human flesh.

sanskrit: ते भक्ष्यमाणा मुनयो दण्डकारण्यवासिनः। अस्मानभ्यवपद्येति मामूचुर्द्विजसत्तमा।।3.10.7।।
transliteration: te bhakṣyamāṇā munayo daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinḥ| asmānabhyavapadyeti māmūcurdvijasattamā||3.10.7||
meaning: The ascetics, the best of brahmins living in Dandaka forest being eaten up like that besought me to come to their rescue.

sanskrit: मया तु वचनं श्रुत्वा तेषामेवं मुखाच्च्युतम्। कृत्वा चरणशुश्रूषां वाक्यमेतदुदाहृतम्।।3.10.8।।
transliteration: mayā tu vacanṃ śrutvā teṣāmevṃ mukhāccyutam| kṛtvā caraṇaśuśrūṣāṃ vākyametadudāhṛtam||3.10.8||
meaning: On hearing the words that came from their mouth, I bowed at their feet and said:

sanskrit: प्रसीदन्तु भवन्तो मे ह्रीरेषा हि ममातुला। यदीदृशैरहं विप्रैरुपस्थेयैरुपस्थितः।।3.10.9।।
transliteration: prasīdantu bhavanto me hrīreṣā hi mamātulā| yadīdṛśairahṃ viprairupastheyairupasthitḥ||3.10.9||
meaning: Be pleased That brahmins like you have approached me while I should have come to you has put me to shame immeasurable .

sanskrit: किं करोमीति च मया व्याहृतं द्विजसन्निधौ। सर्वैरेतैस्समागम्य वागियं समुदाहृता।।3.10.10।।
transliteration: kiṃ karomīti ca mayā vyāhṛtṃ dvijasannidhau| sarvairetaissamāgamya vāgiyṃ samudāhṛtā||3.10.10||
meaning: I enquired about what I could do for them. And all the brahmins in one voice said:.

sanskrit: राक्षसैर्दण्डकारण्ये बहुभिः कामरूपिभिः। अर्दितास्स्म दृढं राम भवान्नस्तत्र रक्षतु।।3.10.11।।
transliteration: rākṣasairdaṇḍakāraṇye bahubhiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ| arditāssma dṛḍhṃ rāma bhavānnastatra rakṣatu||3.10.11||
meaning: 'O Rama, the demons who can assume any form at their will are mercilessly tormenting us in Dandaka forest. Do protect us from them'.

sanskrit: होमकालेषु सम्प्राप्ताः पर्वकालेषु चानघ। धर्षयन्ति सुदुर्धर्षा राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः।।3.10.12।।
transliteration: homakāleṣu samprāptāḥ parvakāleṣu cānagha| dharṣayanti sudurdharṣā rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ||3.10.12||
meaning: 'O sinless one, these cannibals are invincible. They arrive at the time of our sacrificial rituals, on the days of festivities or at the time of lunar conjunctions like no moon or full moon days and attack us.

sanskrit: राक्षसैर्धर्षितानां च तापसानां तपस्विनाम्। गतिं मृगयमाणानां भवान्नः परमा गतिः।।3.10.13।।
transliteration: rākṣasairdharṣitānāṃ ca tāpasānāṃ tapasvinām| gatiṃ mṛgayamāṇānāṃ bhavānnḥ paramā gatiḥ||3.10.13||
meaning: 'You are the supreme refuge for us ascetics, tormented by demons, helpless men in search of shelter.

sanskrit: बहुविघ्नं तपो नित्यं दुश्चरं चैव राघव। तेन शापं न मुञ्चामो भक्ष्यमाणाश्च राक्षसैः।।3.10.15।।
transliteration: bahuvighnṃ tapo nityṃ duścarṃ caiva rāghava| tena śāpṃ na muñcāmo bhakṣyamāṇāśca rākṣasaiḥ||3.10.15||
meaning: 'O Rama it is difficult to perform penance which is ever full of obstacles. Therefore, we do not pronounce curses even if eaten up by demons'.

sanskrit: तदर्ध्यमानान्रक्षोभिर्दण्डकारण्यवासिभिः। रक्ष नस्त्वं सह भ्रात्रा त्वन्नाथा हि वयं वने।।3.10.16।।
transliteration: tadardhyamānānrakṣobhirdaṇḍakāraṇyavāsibhiḥ| rakṣa nastvṃ saha bhrātrā tvannāthā hi vayṃ vane||3.10.16||
meaning: 'The demons, dwelling in the Dandaka forest are tormenting us. You alone are our lord in the forest. Do protect us with your brother.'

sanskrit: मया चैतद्वचश्श्रुत्वा कार्त्स्न्येन परिपालनम्। ऋषीणां दण्डकारण्ये संश्रुतं जनकात्मजे।।3.10.17।।
transliteration: mayā caitadvacaśśrutvā kārtsnyena paripālanam| ṛṣīṇāṃ daṇḍakāraṇye sṃśrutṃ janakātmaje||3.10.17||
meaning: O daughter of Janaka, on hearing the words of the sages I promised to undertake the entire protection of sages of the Dandaka forest.

sanskrit: संश्रुत्य च न शक्ष्यामि जीवमानः प्रतिश्रवम्। मुनीनामन्यथा कर्तुं सत्यमिष्टं हि मे सदा।।3.10.18।।
transliteration: sṃśrutya ca na śakṣyāmi jīvamānḥ pratiśravam| munīnāmanyathā kartuṃ satyamiṣṭṃ hi me sadā||3.10.18||
meaning: Having promised the sages, I cannot do otherwise as long as I have life in me. To me truth is always dear.

sanskrit: अप्यहं जीवितं जह्यां त्वां वा सीते सलक्ष्मणाम्। न तु प्रतिज्ञां संश्रुत्य ब्राह्मणेभ्यो विशेषतः।।3.10.19।।
transliteration: apyahṃ jīvitṃ jahyāṃ tvāṃ vā sīte salakṣmaṇām| na tu pratijñāṃ sṃśrutya brāhmaṇebhyo viśeṣatḥ||3.10.19||
meaning: O Sita I may forfeit my life forsake, even Lakshmana and you but will not break the promise made specially to the brahmins৷৷

sanskrit: तदवश्यं मया कार्यमृषीणां परिपालनम्। अनुक्तेनापि वैदेहि प्रतिज्ञाय तु किं पुनः।।3.10.20।।
transliteration: tadavaśyṃ mayā kāryamṛṣīṇāṃ paripālanam| anuktenāpi vaidehi pratijñāya tu kiṃ punḥ||3.10.20||
meaning: Even before the sages requested me I should have protected them. What to speak of the promise I have already made ?

sanskrit: मम स्नेहाच्च सौहार्दादिदमुक्तंत्वयाऽनघे। परितुष्टोऽस्म्यहं सीते न ह्यनिष्टोऽनुशिष्यते।।3.10.21।।
transliteration: mama snehācca sauhārdādidamuktṃtvayā'naghe| parituṣṭo'smyahṃ sīte na hyaniṣṭo'nuśiṣyate||3.10.21||
meaning: O sinless one all that has been said by you is out of your love and affection for me. I am pleased. What is harmful is never advised.

sanskrit: सदृशं चानुरूपं च कुलस्य तव चात्मनः। सधर्मचारिणी मे त्वं प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी।।3.10.22।।
transliteration: sadṛśṃ cānurūpṃ ca kulasya tava cātmanḥ| sadharmacāriṇī me tvṃ prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī||3.10.22||
meaning: Your auspicious words are quite befitting your lineage. You are the follower of my dharma and so dearer to me than my life.

sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं महात्मा सीतां प्रियां मैथिलराजपुत्रीम्। रामो धनुष्मान्सह लक्ष्मणेन जगाम रम्याणि तपोवनानि।।3.10.23।।
transliteration: ityevamuktvā vacanṃ mahātmā sītāṃ priyāṃ maithilarājaputrīm| rāmo dhanuṣmānsaha lakṣmaṇena jagāma ramyāṇi tapovanāni||3.
meaning: Having said this to Sita, the princess of Mithila, Rama along with Lakshmana, bow in hand, moved about the delightful penancegrove. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे दशमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the tent

sanskrit: तौ पश्यमानौ विविधान् शैलप्रस्थान्वनानि च। नदीश्च विविधा रम्या जग्मतुस्सीतया सह।।3.11.2।।
transliteration: tau paśyamānau vividhān śailaprasthānvanāni ca| nadīśca vividhā ramyā jagmatussītayā saha||3.11.2||
meaning: Both Rama and Lakshmana walked on, accompanied by Sita, watching several beautiful mountain ranges, forests and rivers.

sanskrit: सारसांश्चक्रवाकांश्च नदीपुलिनचारिणः। सरांसि च सपद्मानि युक्तानि जलजैः खगैः।।3.11.3।।
transliteration: sārasāṃścakravākāṃśca nadīpulinacāriṇḥ| sarāṃsi ca sapadmāni yuktāni jalajaiḥ khagaiḥ||3.11.3||
meaning: (Watching) the swans and ruddy geese on river banks and lakes full of lotuses, and birds on water and in the sky.

sanskrit: यूथबद्धांश्च पृषतान्मदोन्मत्तान् विषाणिनः। महिषांश्च वराहांश्च नागांश्च द्रुमवैरिणः।।3.11.4।।
transliteration: yūthabaddhāṃśca pṛṣatānmadonmattān viṣāṇinḥ| mahiṣāṃśca varāhāṃśca nāgāṃśca drumavairiṇḥ||3.11.4||
meaning: (Watching) herds of deer, intoxicated horned buffaloes, wild boars and elephants who are enemies of trees (elephants uproof trees).

sanskrit: ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं लम्बमाने दिवाकरे। ददृशुस्सहिता रम्यं तटाकं योजनायतम्।।3.11.5।। पद्मपुष्करसम्बाधं गजयूथैरलङ्कृतम्। सा
transliteration: te gatvā dūramadhvānṃ lambamāne divākare| dadṛśussahitā ramyṃ taṭākṃ yojanāyatam||3.11.5|| padmapuṣkarasambādhṃ gajayūth
meaning: As the Sun was setting, they had covered a long distance, watching a yojanalong tank adorned with lotuses, and crowded with herds of elephants and flocks of cranes, swans and aquatic animals.

sanskrit: प्रसन्नसलिले रम्ये तस्मिन्सरसि शुश्रुवे। गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषो न तु कश्चन दृश्यते।।3.11.7।।
transliteration: prasannasalile ramye tasminsarasi śuśruve| gītavāditranirghoṣo na tu kaścana dṛśyate||3.11.7||
meaning: In that lake of clear waters they heard the sounds of songs and musical instruments, while there were none around.

sanskrit: ततः कौतूहलाद्रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। मुनिं धर्मभृतं नाम प्रष्टुं समुपचक्रमे।।3.11.8।।
transliteration: tatḥ kautūhalādrāmo lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalḥ| muniṃ dharmabhṛtṃ nāma praṣṭuṃ samupacakrame||3.11.8||
meaning: Out of curiosity, mighty Rama, and Lakshmana started enquiring about the matter from sage Dharmabrata by name:

sanskrit: इदमत्यद्भुतं श्रुत्वा सर्वेषां नो महामुने। कौतूहलं महज्जातं किमिदं साधु कथ्यताम्।।3.11.9।। वक्तव्यं यदि चेदविप्र नातिगुह
transliteration: idamatyadbhutṃ śrutvā sarveṣāṃ no mahāmune| kautūhalṃ mahajjātṃ kimidṃ sādhu kathyatām||3.11.9|| vaktavyṃ yadi cedavipra
meaning: O great sage, this very wonderful sound, has whetted our great curiosity. If there is no top secret about this, do disclose it.

sanskrit: तेनैवमुक्तो धर्मात्मा राघवेण मुनिस्तदा।।3.11.10।। प्रभवं सरसः कृत्स्नमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे।
transliteration: tenaivamukto dharmātmā rāghaveṇa munistadā||3.11.10|| prabhavṃ sarasḥ kṛtsnamākhyātumupacakrame|
meaning: Thus addressed by Rama, the righteous sage narrated the entire origin of the lake.

sanskrit: इदं पञ्चाप्सरो नाम तटाकं सार्वकालिकम्।।3.11.11।। निर्मितं तपसा राम मुनिना माण्डकर्णिना।
transliteration: idṃ pañcāpsaro nāma taṭākṃ sārvakālikam||3.11.11|| nirmitṃ tapasā rāma muninā māṇḍakarṇinā|
meaning: O Rama this lake called Panchapsara filled with water at all times has been created through penance by a sage called Mandakarni.

sanskrit: स हि तेपे तपस्तीव्रं माण्डकर्णिर्महामुनिः।।3.11.12।। दशवर्षसहस्राणि वायुभक्षो जलाश्रयः।
transliteration: sa hi tepe tapastīvrṃ māṇḍakarṇirmahāmuniḥ||3.11.12|| daśavarṣasahasrāṇi vāyubhakṣo jalāśrayḥ|
meaning: Great sage Mandakarni standing in water and living on air performed rigorous penance for ten thousand years.

sanskrit: ततः प्रव्यथितास्सर्वे देवास्साग्निपुरोगमाः।।3.11.13।। अब्रुवन् वचनं सर्वे परस्परसमागताः।
transliteration: tatḥ pravyathitāssarve devāssāgnipurogamāḥ||3.11.13|| abruvan vacanṃ sarve parasparasamāgatāḥ|
meaning: Thereafter very much perturbed, all the gods led by Agni gathered together at one place and started deliberating among themselves.

sanskrit: अस्माकं कस्यचित् स्थानमेष प्रार्थयते मुनिः।।3.11.14।। इति संविग्नमनसस्सर्वे ते त्रिदिवौकसः।
transliteration: asmākṃ kasyacit sthānameṣa prārthayate muniḥ||3.11.14|| iti sṃvignamanasassarve te tridivaukasḥ|
meaning: 'The gods of heaven became agitated in their minds thinking the sage might usurp one of their places.

sanskrit: तत्र कर्तुं तपोविघ्नं देवैस्सर्वैर्नियोजिताः।।3.11.15।। प्रधानाप्सरसः पञ्च विद्युच्चलितवर्चसः।
transliteration: tatra kartuṃ tapovighnṃ devaissarvairniyojitāḥ||3.11.15|| pradhānāpsarasḥ pañca vidyuccalitavarcasḥ|
meaning: All the gods then engaged five of the important nymphs, glittering like lightning, to disturb the penance of the sage.

sanskrit: अप्सरोभिस्ततस्ताभिर्मुनिर्दृष्टपरावरः।।3.11.16।। नीतो मदनवश्यत्वं सुराणां कार्यसिद्धये।
transliteration: apsarobhistatastābhirmunirdṛṣṭaparāvarḥ||3.11.16|| nīto madanavaśyatvṃ surāṇāṃ kāryasiddhaye|
meaning: The sage, a knower of the inner self and the world of plurality, was gripped by passion for the apsaras, who had come to achieve the target of the gods.

sanskrit: ताश्चैवाप्सरसः पञ्च मुनेः पत्नीत्वमागताः।।3.11.17।। तटाके निर्मितं तासामस्मिन्नन्तर्हितं गृहम्।
transliteration: tāścaivāpsarasḥ pañca muneḥ patnītvamāgatāḥ||3.11.17|| taṭāke nirmitṃ tāsāmasminnantarhitṃ gṛham|
meaning: The five apsaras, got the status of wives to the sage who built them an invisible home inside the lake.

sanskrit: तथैवाप्सरसः पञ्च निवसन्त्यो यथासुखम्।।3.11.18।। रमयन्ति तपोयोगान्मुनिं यौवनमास्थितम्।
transliteration: tathaivāpsarasḥ pañca nivasantyo yathāsukham||3.11.18|| ramayanti tapoyogānmuniṃ yauvanamāsthitam|
meaning: The apsaras lived happily with the sage who remained youthful by virtue of his penance.

sanskrit: तासां सङ्क्रीडमानानामेष वादित्रनिस्स्वनः।।3.11.19।। श्रूयते भूषणोन्मिश्रो गीतशब्दो मनोहरः।
transliteration: tāsāṃ saṅkrīḍamānānāmeṣa vāditranissvanḥ||3.11.19|| śrūyate bhūṣaṇonmiśro gītaśabdo manoharḥ|
meaning: While the apsaras played their musical instruments, their melodious songs mingled with the sounds of ornaments are heard.

sanskrit: आश्चर्यमिति तस्यैतद्वचनं भावितात्मनः।।3.11.20।। राघवः प्रतिजग्राह सह भ्रात्रा महायशाः।
transliteration: āścaryamiti tasyaitadvacanṃ bhāvitātmanḥ||3.11.20|| rāghavḥ pratijagrāha saha bhrātrā mahāyaśāḥ|
meaning: Glorious Rama and his brother heard the wonderful words of the selfrealised sage and exclaimed, 'How strange '

sanskrit: एवं कथयमानस्य ददर्शाश्रममण्डलम्।।3.11.21।। कुशचीरपरिक्षिप्तं ब्राह्म्या लक्ष्म्या समावृतम्।
transliteration: evṃ kathayamānasya dadarśāśramamaṇḍalam||3.11.21|| kuśacīraparikṣiptṃ brāhmyā lakṣmyā samāvṛtam|
meaning: When the sage Dharmabrata was telling the story, Rama saw a hermitage strewn all over with kusa grass and bark garments, and endowed with pure brahminic grace.

sanskrit: प्रविश्य सह वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च राघवः।।3.11.22।। उवास मुनिभिस्सर्वैः पूज्यमानो महायशाः।
transliteration: praviśya saha vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena ca rāghavḥ||3.11.22|| uvāsa munibhissarvaiḥ pūjyamāno mahāyaśāḥ|
meaning: Illustrious Rama accompanied by Vaidehi and Lakshmana entered the hermitage and, honoured by all the sages, stayed there.

sanskrit: तदा तस्मिन्सकाकुत्थ्सः श्रीमत्याश्रममण्डले।।3.11.23।। उषित्वा तु सुखं तत्र पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः। जगाम चाश्रमांस्तेषां पर्
transliteration: tadā tasminsakākutthsḥ śrīmatyāśramamaṇḍale||3.11.23|| uṣitvā tu sukhṃ tatra pūjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ| jagāma cāśramāṃsteṣā
meaning: Rama, the scion of the Kakutstha race, wielder of great weapons, stayed in that beautiful hermitage, accepting the hospitality of the sages extended with due honour, He visited in turn their penancegroves where he repeat

sanskrit: क्वचित्परिदशान्मासानेकं संवत्सरं क्वचित्।।3.11.25।। क्वचिच्छ चतुरो मासान् पञ्च षट्चापरान्क्वचित्। अपरत्राधिकं मासादप्यर्
transliteration: kvacitparidaśānmāsānekṃ sṃvatsarṃ kvacit||3.11.25|| kvaciccha caturo māsān pañca ṣaṭcāparānkvacit| aparatrādhikṃ māsādap
meaning: Rama lived happily here for about ten months, there one year, here four or five or six months and there over one or half a month or three or eight months in another.

sanskrit: तथा संवसतस्तस्य मुनीनामाश्रमेषु वै।।3.11.27।। रमतश्चानुकूल्येन ययुस्संवत्सरा दश।
transliteration: tathā sṃvasatastasya munīnāmāśrameṣu vai||3.11.27|| ramataścānukūlyena yayussṃvatsarā daśa|
meaning: Thus enjoying their stay in the hermitages, Rama, Sita and Lakshmana spent ten favourable years.

sanskrit: परिवृत्य च धर्मज्ञो राघवस्सह सीतया।।3.11.28।। सुतीक्ष्णस्याश्रमं श्रीमान्पुनरेवाजगाम ह।
transliteration: parivṛtya ca dharmajño rāghavassaha sītayā||3.11.28|| sutīkṣṇasyāśramṃ śrīmānpunarevājagāma ha|
meaning: Rama went round who was full of grace and full of knowledge on dharma went round with Sita and came back to Suthikshna's hermitage.

sanskrit: स तमाश्रममासाद्य मुनिभिः प्रतिपूजितः।।3.11.29।। तत्रापि न्यवसद्रामः कञ्चित्कालमरिन्दमः।
transliteration: sa tamāśramamāsādya munibhiḥ pratipūjitḥ||3.11.29|| tatrāpi nyavasadrāmḥ kañcitkālamarindamḥ|
meaning: On his arrival, Rama, the subduer of enemies, was honoured by the sages at the hermitage where he stayed for a short time.

sanskrit: तदाश्रमस्थो विनयात्कदाचित्तं महामुनिम्।।3.11.30।। उपासीनस्सकाकुत्स्थस्सुतीक्ष्णमिदमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: tadāśramastho vinayātkadācittṃ mahāmunim||3.11.30|| upāsīnassakākutsthassutīkṣṇamidamabravīt|
meaning: Once while sitting beside sage Sutikshna at the hermitage Rama humbly addressed him:

sanskrit: अस्मिन्नरण्ये भगवानगस्त्यो मुनिसत्तमः।।3.11.31।। वसतीति मया नित्यं कथाः कथयतां श्रुतम्।
transliteration: asminnaraṇye bhagavānagastyo munisattamḥ||3.11.31|| vasatīti mayā nityṃ kathāḥ kathayatāṃ śrutam|
meaning: I have heard others saying that lord Agastya, the great sage, lives in this forest.

sanskrit: न तु जानामि तं देशं वनस्यास्य महत्तया।।3.11.32।। कुत्राश्रमपदं रम्यं महर्षेस्तस्य धीमतः।
transliteration: na tu jānāmi tṃ deśṃ vanasyāsya mahattayā||3.11.32|| kutrāśramapadṃ ramyṃ maharṣestasya dhīmatḥ|
meaning: I am unable to locate the sacred hermitage of that sagacious sage due to the vastness of this forest.

sanskrit: प्रसादात्तत्र भवतस्सानुजस्सह सीतया।।3.11.33।। अगस्त्यमभिगच्छेयमभिवादयितुं मुनिम्।
transliteration: prasādāttatra bhavatassānujassaha sītayā||3.11.33|| agastyamabhigaccheyamabhivādayituṃ munim|
meaning: By your grace, I wish to go there with Sita and my brother Lakshmana to offer our respectful salutations.

sanskrit: मनोरथो महानेष हृदि मे परिवर्तते।।3.11.34।। यद्यहं तं मुनिवरं शुश्रूषेयमपि स्वयम्।
transliteration: manoratho mahāneṣa hṛdi me parivartate||3.11.34|| yadyahṃ tṃ munivarṃ śuśrūṣeyamapi svayam|
meaning: There is a great desire in my heart to serve in person the best of sages, Agastya.

sanskrit: इति रामस्य स मुनिश्श्रुत्वा धर्मात्मनो वचः।।3.11.35।। सुतीक्ष्णः प्रत्युवाचेदं प्रीतो दशरथात्मजम्।
transliteration: iti rāmasya sa muniśśrutvā dharmātmano vacḥ||3.11.35|| sutīkṣṇḥ pratyuvācedṃ prīto daśarathātmajam|
meaning: Hearing the words of Rama, the righteous son of Dasaratha, sage Sutikshna was pleased to reply:

sanskrit: अहमप्येतदेव त्वां वक्तुकामस्सलक्ष्मणम्।।3.11.36।। अगस्त्यमभिगच्छेति सीतया सह राघव।
transliteration: ahamapyetadeva tvāṃ vaktukāmassalakṣmaṇam||3.11.36|| agastyamabhigaccheti sītayā saha rāghava|
meaning: I also wished you, O Raghava, to visit Agastya along with Sita and Lakshmana.

sanskrit: दिष्ट्या त्विदानीमर्थेऽस्मिन् स्वयमेव ब्रवीषि माम्।।3.11.37।। अहमाख्यामि ते वत्स यत्रागस्त्यो महामुनिः।
transliteration: diṣṭyā tvidānīmarthe'smin svayameva bravīṣi mām||3.11.37|| ahamākhyāmi te vatsa yatrāgastyo mahāmuniḥ|
meaning: Luckily you have asked me on your own. I will tell you where the great sage Agastya lives.

sanskrit: योजनान्याश्रमात्तात याहि चत्वारि वै ततः।।3.11.38।। दक्षिणेन महान् श्रीमानगस्त्यभ्रातुराश्रमः।
transliteration: yojanānyāśramāttāta yāhi catvāri vai tatḥ||3.11.38|| dakṣiṇena mahān śrīmānagastyabhrāturāśramḥ|
meaning: Dear Rama, walk from here a distance of four yojanas. There in the southerly direction stands the great, beautiful hermitage of Agastya's brother.

sanskrit: स्थलप्राये वनोद्देशे पिप्पलीवनशोभिते।।3.11.39।। बहुपुष्पफले रम्ये नानाशकुनिनादिते।
transliteration: sthalaprāye vanoddeśe pippalīvanaśobhite||3.11.39|| bahupuṣpaphale ramye nānāśakuninādite|
meaning: This plain land in the beautiful forest tract is adorned with fig trees,filled with flowers, fruits, and delightful sounds of different birds.

sanskrit: पद्मिन्यो विविधास्तत्र प्रसन्नसलिलाश्शिवाः।।3.11.40।। हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णाश्चक्रवाकोपशोभिताः। तत्रैकां रजनीं व्युष्य प्रभात
transliteration: padminyo vividhāstatra prasannasalilāśśivāḥ||3.11.40|| hṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇāścakravākopaśobhitāḥ| tatraikāṃ rajanīṃ vyuṣya
meaning: O Rama, there are lotusponds filled with clear, sacred waters, with different kinds of swans, ducks and ruddy geese. Spend one night there and proceed early in the morning.

sanskrit: दक्षिणां दिशमास्थाय वनषण्डस्य पार्श्वतः। तत्रागस्त्याश्रमपदं गत्वा योजनमन्तरा।।3.11.42।।
transliteration: dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthāya vanaṣaṇḍasya pārśvatḥ| tatrāgastyāśramapadṃ gatvā yojanamantarā||3.11.42||
meaning: If you go in the southern direction for a yojana you will find Agasthya's hermitage by the side of a cluster of trees.

sanskrit: रमणीये वनोद्धेशे बहुपादपसंवृते। रंस्यते तत्र वैदेही लक्ष्मणश्च सह त्वया।।3.11.43।। स हि रम्यो वनोद्देशो बहुपादपसङ्कुलः।
transliteration: ramaṇīye vanoddheśe bahupādapasṃvṛte| rṃsyate tatra vaidehī lakṣmaṇaśca saha tvayā||3.11.43|| sa hi ramyo vanoddeśo bahu
meaning: Vaidehi will feel happy in your company in that delightful forest region full of many trees.So too will Lakshmana.

sanskrit: यदि बुद्धिः कृता द्रष्टुमगस्त्यं तं महामुनिम्।।3.11.44।। अद्यैव गमने बुद्धिं रोचयस्व महायशः।
transliteration: yadi buddhiḥ kṛtā draṣṭumagastyṃ tṃ mahāmunim||3.11.44|| adyaiva gamane buddhiṃ rocayasva mahāyaśḥ|
meaning: O glorious one, if you have made up your mind to visit that great sage Agastya, think of starting today itself.

sanskrit: इति रामो मुनेश्श्रुत्वा सह भ्रात्राभिवाद्य च।।3.11.45।। प्रतस्थेऽमुद्दिश्य सानुजस्सीतया सह।
transliteration: iti rāmo muneśśrutvā saha bhrātrābhivādya ca||3.11.45|| pratasthe'muddiśya sānujassītayā saha|
meaning: Rama heard the words of the sage, offered him reverential salutations and set out along with his brother and Sita.

sanskrit: पश्यन्वनानि रम्याणि पर्वतांश्चाभ्रसन्निभान्।।3.11.46।। सरांसि सरितश्चैव पथि मार्गवशानुगाः। सुतीक्ष्णेनोपदिष्टेन गत्वा ते
transliteration: paśyanvanāni ramyāṇi parvatāṃścābhrasannibhān||3.11.46|| sarāṃsi saritaścaiva pathi mārgavaśānugāḥ| sutīkṣṇenopadiṣṭena
meaning: Enjoying the sight of delightful forests, cloudlike mountains, lakes and rivers on the way, and following the directions given by Sutikshna, Rama was happy. He said to Lakshmana:

sanskrit: एतदेवाश्रमपदं नूनं तस्य महात्मनः।।3.11.48।। अगस्त्यस्य मुनेर्भ्रातुर्दृश्यते पुण्यकर्मणः।
transliteration: etadevāśramapadṃ nūnṃ tasya mahātmanḥ||3.11.48|| agastyasya munerbhrāturdṛśyate puṇyakarmaṇḥ|
meaning: Surely this is the hermitage of great Agastya's brother, a man of holy deeds.

sanskrit: यथा हि मे वनस्यास्य ज्ञाताः पथि सहस्रशः।।3.11.49।। सन्नताः फलभारेण पुष्पभारेण च द्रुमाः।
transliteration: yathā hi me vanasyāsya jñātāḥ pathi sahasraśḥ||3.11.49|| sannatāḥ phalabhāreṇa puṣpabhāreṇa ca drumāḥ|
meaning: This is the glade we were told about with thousands of trees drooping down with abundant fruits and flowers.

sanskrit: पिप्पलीनां च पक्वानां वनादस्मादुपागतः।।3.11.50।। गन्धोऽयं पवनोक्षिप्तस्सहसा कटुकोदयः।
transliteration: pippalīnāṃ ca pakvānāṃ vanādasmādupāgatḥ||3.11.50|| gandho'yṃ pavanokṣiptassahasā kaṭukodayḥ|
meaning: Feel this sudden astringent smell of ripe figs wafted by the breeze from the forest.

sanskrit: तत्र तत्र च दृश्यन्ते सङ्क्षिप्ताः काष्ठसञ्चयाः।।3.11.51।। लूनाश्च पथि दृश्यन्ते दर्भा वैडूर्यवर्चसः।
transliteration: tatra tatra ca dṛśyante saṅkṣiptāḥ kāṣṭhasañcayāḥ||3.11.51|| lūnāśca pathi dṛśyante darbhā vaiḍūryavarcasḥ|
meaning: Heaps of firewood are seen here and there on the path. There are blades of grass (used for sacrificial ceremonies) shining like vaidurya (gems).

sanskrit: एतच्च वनमध्यस्थं कृष्णाभ्रशिखरोपमम्।।3.11.52।। पावकस्याश्रमस्थस्य धूमाग्रं सम्प्रदृश्यते।
transliteration: etacca vanamadhyasthṃ kṛṣṇābhraśikharopamam||3.11.52|| pāvakasyāśramasthasya dhūmāgrṃ sampradṛśyate|
meaning: In the middle of the forest can be seen like the tip of the dark clouds columns of smoke coming out of the top of hermitages.

sanskrit: विविक्तेषु च तीर्थेषु कृतस्नाना द्विजातयः।।3.11.53।। पुष्पोपहारं कुर्वन्ति कुसुमैस्स्वयमर्जितै।
transliteration: vivikteṣu ca tīrtheṣu kṛtasnānā dvijātayḥ||3.11.53|| puṣpopahārṃ kurvanti kusumaissvayamarjitai|
meaning: Priests are coming out of the solitary sacred spots after their bath and making offerings of flowers they had themselves plucked.

sanskrit: तत्सुतीक्ष्णस्य वचनं यथा सौम्य मया श्रुतम्।।3.11.54।। अगस्त्यस्याश्रमो भ्रातुर्नूनमेष भविष्यति।
transliteration: tatsutīkṣṇasya vacanṃ yathā saumya mayā śrutam||3.11.54|| agastyasyāśramo bhrāturnūnameṣa bhaviṣyati|
meaning: O handsome one, surely this is the hermitage of Agastya's brother about which I heard from Sutikshna.

sanskrit: धारयन् ब्राह्मणं रूपमिल्वलस्संस्कृतं वदन्।।3.11.56।। आमन्त्रयति विप्रान्स्मश्राद्धमुद्दिश्य निर्घृणः।
transliteration: dhārayan brāhmaṇṃ rūpamilvalassṃskṛtṃ vadan||3.11.56|| āmantrayati viprānsmaśrāddhamuddiśya nirghṛṇḥ|
meaning: Assuming the form of a brahmin and using Sanskrit language, Ilvala would invite brahmins for offering shraddha to the dead

sanskrit: भ्रातरं संस्कृतं कृत्वा ततस्तं मेषरूपिणम्।।3.11.57।। तान् द्विजान्भोजयामास श्राद्धदृष्टेन कर्मणा।
transliteration: bhrātarṃ sṃskṛtṃ kṛtvā tatastṃ meṣarūpiṇam||3.11.57|| tān dvijānbhojayāmāsa śrāddhadṛṣṭena karmaṇā|
meaning: Ilvala would keep his brother sanctified, so that he is fit for offering, Then he would feed the brahmins with mutton according to the rituals.

sanskrit: ततो भुक्तवतां तेषां विप्राणामिल्वलोऽब्रवीत्।।3.11.59।। वातापे निष्क्रमन्वेति स्वरेण महता वदन्।
transliteration: tato bhuktavatāṃ teṣāṃ viprāṇāmilvalo'bravīt||3.11.59|| vātāpe niṣkramanveti svareṇa mahatā vadan|
meaning: Then when the brahmins finished eating, Ilvala would call aloud, 'O Vatapi come out'.

sanskrit: ततो भ्रातुर्वचश्श्रुत्वा वातापिर्मेषवन्नदन्।।3.11.60।। भित्त्वा भित्त्वा शरीराणि ब्राह्मणानां विनिष्पतत्।
transliteration: tato bhrāturvacaśśrutvā vātāpirmeṣavannadan||3.11.60|| bhittvā bhittvā śarīrāṇi brāhmaṇānāṃ viniṣpatat|
meaning: Then hearing his brother's voice, Vatapi would bleat like a sheep and jump out, tearing open the bodies of those brahmins.

sanskrit: ब्राह्माणानां सहस्राणि तैरेवं कामरूपिभिः।।3.11.61।। विनाशितानि संहत्य नित्यशः पिशिताशनैः।
transliteration: brāhmāṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi tairevṃ kāmarūpibhiḥ||3.11.61|| vināśitāni sṃhatya nityaśḥ piśitāśanaiḥ|
meaning: In this manner, thousands of brahmins used to be killed daily by those carnivorous demons who assumed any form at their free will.

sanskrit: अगस्त्येन तदा देवैः प्रार्थितेन महर्षिणा।।3.11.62।। अनुभूय किल श्राद्धे भक्षितस्समहासुरः।
transliteration: agastyena tadā devaiḥ prārthitena maharṣiṇā||3.11.62|| anubhūya kila śrāddhe bhakṣitassamahāsurḥ|
meaning: Urged by the gods, Agastya came for the shradda . The mighty demon played the same routine trick and Vatapi, for sure, was eaten by the great sage.

sanskrit: ततस्सम्पन्नमित्युक्त्वा दत्त्वा हस्तोदकं ततः।।3.11.63।। भ्रातरं निष्क्रमस्वेति चेल्वलस्सोऽभ्यभाषत।
transliteration: tatassampannamityuktvā dattvā hastodakṃ tatḥ||3.11.63|| bhrātarṃ niṣkramasveti celvalasso'bhyabhāṣata|
meaning: Saying, the ritual is complete Ilvala offered water in the palm of Agastya and called his brother to come out.

sanskrit: स तं तथा भाषमाणं भ्रातरं विप्रघातिनम्।।3.11.64।। अब्रवीत्प्रहसन्धीमानगस्त्यो मुनिसत्तमः।
transliteration: sa tṃ tathā bhāṣamāṇṃ bhrātarṃ vipraghātinam||3.11.64|| abravītprahasandhīmānagastyo munisattamḥ|
meaning: Wise Agastya, the best among the ascetics, laughing aloud, said to Ilvala, the destroyer of brahmins:

sanskrit: कुतो निष्क्रमितुं शक्तिर्मया जीर्णस्य रक्षसः।।3.11.65।। भ्रातुस्ते मेषरूपस्य गतस्य यमसादनम्।
transliteration: kuto niṣkramituṃ śaktirmayā jīrṇasya rakṣasḥ||3.11.65|| bhrātuste meṣarūpasya gatasya yamasādanam|
meaning: I have digested the demon Vatapi your brother, who assumed the form of a sheep. He has reached the abode of Yama, Lord of death. Where does he have the power to come out?

sanskrit: अथ तस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा भ्रातुर्निधनसंश्रयम्।।3.11.66।। प्रधर्षयितुमारेभे मुनिं क्रोधान्निशाचरः।
transliteration: atha tasya vacaśśrutvā bhrāturnidhanasṃśrayam||3.11.66|| pradharṣayitumārebhe muniṃ krodhānniśācarḥ|
meaning: On hearing the news of the death of his brother, the demon Ilvala, out of anger, started attacking the sage.

sanskrit: सोऽभिद्रवन्मुनिश्रेष्ठं मुनिना दीप्ततेजसा।।3.11.67।। चक्षुषानलकल्पेन निर्दग्धो निधनं गतः।
transliteration: so'bhidravanmuniśreṣṭhṃ muninā dīptatejasā||3.11.67|| cakṣuṣānalakalpena nirdagdho nidhanṃ gatḥ|
meaning: Ilvala who pounced upon Agastya, the best among the sages whose lustre lay consumed by the fire of his eyes which were in flames.

sanskrit: तस्यायमाश्रमो भ्रातुस्तटाकवनशोभितः।।3.11.68।। विप्रानुकम्पया येन कर्मेदं दुष्करं कृतम्।
transliteration: tasyāyamāśramo bhrātustaṭākavanaśobhitḥ||3.11.68|| viprānukampayā yena karmedṃ duṣkarṃ kṛtam|
meaning: This hermitage surrounded by beautiful lakes and forests belongs to his brother (Sudarsana). Out of sympathy for Agastya, he has accomplished this difficult task.

sanskrit: एवं कथयमानस्य तस्य सौमित्रिणा सह। रामस्यास्तं गतस्सूर्यस्सन्ध्याकालोऽभ्यवर्ततः।।3.11.69।।
transliteration: evṃ kathayamānasya tasya saumitriṇā saha| rāmasyāstṃ gatassūryassandhyākālo'bhyavartatḥ||3.11.69||
meaning: While Rama was thus narrating to Lakshmana (the story of Agastya), the Sun set and evening closed in.

sanskrit: उपास्य पश्चिमां सन्ध्यां सह भ्रात्रा यथाविधि। प्रविवेशाऽश्रमपदं तमृषिं सोऽभ्यवादयत्।।3.11.70।।
transliteration: upāsya paścimāṃ sandhyāṃ saha bhrātrā yathāvidhi| praviveśā'śramapadṃ tamṛṣiṃ so'bhyavādayat||3.11.70||
meaning: Rama with his brother Lakshmana duly offered oblations at twilight, entered the hermitage and greeted the sage (Sudarsana) with folded palms.

sanskrit: सम्यक् प्रतिगृहीतश्च मुनिना तेन राघवः। न्यवसत्तां निशामेकां प्राश्य मूलफलानि च।।3.11.71।।
transliteration: samyak pratigṛhītaśca muninā tena rāghavḥ| nyavasattāṃ niśāmekāṃ prāśya mūlaphalāni ca||3.11.71||
meaning: Warmly received by the sage, Rama shared the roots and fruits and slept the night there.

sanskrit: तस्यां रात्य्रां व्यतीतायां विमले सूर्यमण्डले। भ्रातरं तमगस्त्यस्य ह्यामन्त्रयत राघवः।।3.11.72।।
transliteration: tasyāṃ rātyrāṃ vyatītāyāṃ vimale sūryamaṇḍale| bhrātarṃ tamagastyasya hyāmantrayata rāghavḥ||3.11.72||
meaning: When the night passed and the Sun became bright, Rama took leave of the brother of Agastya.

sanskrit: अभिवादये त्वां भगवन् सुखमध्युषितो निशाम्। आमन्त्रये त्वां गच्छामि गुरुं ते द्रष्टुमग्रजम्।।3.11.73।।
transliteration: abhivādaye tvāṃ bhagavan sukhamadhyuṣito niśām| āmantraye tvāṃ gacchāmi guruṃ te draṣṭumagrajam||3.11.73||
meaning: O Lord, the night has been wellspent. Now we humbly seek leave of you to see your respectable elder brother.

sanskrit: गम्यतामिति तेनोक्तो जगाम रघुनन्दनः। यथोद्दिष्टेन मार्गेण वनं तच्चावलोकयन्।।3.11.74।।
transliteration: gamyatāmiti tenokto jagāma raghunandanḥ| yathoddiṣṭena mārgeṇa vanṃ taccāvalokayan||3.11.74||
meaning: With his permission, Rama, the delight of the Raghu race, proceeded along the path indicated, watching (the beauty of) the forest.

sanskrit: नीवारान्पनसांस्तालांस्तिमिशान्वञ्चुलान्धवान्। चिरिबिल्वान्मधूकांश्च बिल्वानपि च तिन्दुकान्।।3.11.75।।
transliteration: nīvārānpanasāṃstālāṃstimiśānvañculāndhavān| ciribilvānmadhūkāṃśca bilvānapi ca tindukān||3.11.75||
meaning: They passed by wild rice fields, jackfruit trees, palmyra and various other trees like Ashoka, trees with white flowers, old trees that existed for a long time, mahva trees, bilva trees and tindukas.

sanskrit: पुष्पितान्पुष्पिताग्राभिर्लताभिरनुवेष्टितान्। ददर्श रामश्शतशस्तत्र कान्तारपादपान्।।3.11.76।। हस्तिहस्तैर्विमृदितान्वानरै
transliteration: puṣpitānpuṣpitāgrābhirlatābhiranuveṣṭitān| dadarśa rāmaśśataśastatra kāntārapādapān||3.11.76|| hastihastairvimṛditānvāna
meaning: Rama saw hundreds of trees crushed by the trunks of elephants and by monkeys. He saw some trees echoing with notes of hundreds of intoxicated birds. He saw tree tops coiled with creepers in full bloom.

sanskrit: ततोऽब्रवीत्समीपस्थं रामो राजीवलोचनः। पृष्ठतोऽनुगतं वीरं लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिवर्धनम्।।3.11.78।।
transliteration: tato'bravītsamīpasthṃ rāmo rājīvalocanḥ| pṛṣṭhato'nugatṃ vīrṃ lakṣmaṇṃ lakṣmivardhanam||3.11.78||
meaning: Then the lotuseyed Rama said to the chivalrous, graceful Lakshmana who stood behind him:

sanskrit: स्निग्धपत्रा यथा वृक्षा यथा क्षान्ता मृगद्विजाः। आश्रमो नातिदूरस्थो महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः।।3.11.79।।
