transliteration: snigdhapatrā yathā vṛkṣā yathā kṣāntā mṛgadvijāḥ| āśramo nātidūrastho maharṣerbhāvitātmanḥ||3.11.79||
meaning: The leaves of the trees here are glossy, the animals and birds are peaceful. It appears the hermitage of the selfrealized great sage Agastya is not very far from here.

sanskrit: अगस्त्य इति विख्यातो लोके स्वेनैव कर्मणा। आश्रमो दृश्यते तस्य परिश्रान्तश्रमापहः।।3.11.80।।
transliteration: agastya iti vikhyāto loke svenaiva karmaṇā| āśramo dṛśyate tasya pariśrāntaśramāpahḥ||3.11.80||
meaning: Here is the hermitage of Agastya, wellknown in the world for his deeds a place of rest for those tired with hard work.

sanskrit: प्राज्यधूमाकुलवनश्चीरमालापरिष्कृतः। प्रशान्तमृगयूथश्च नानाशकुनिनादितः।।3.11.81।।
transliteration: prājyadhūmākulavanaścīramālāpariṣkṛtḥ| praśāntamṛgayūthaśca nānāśakunināditḥ||3.11.81||
meaning: This forest is enveloped with the smoke rising from the sacrificial altar. There are rows of bark robes hanging. Herds of quiet animals lying and different kind of birds chirping around.

sanskrit: तस्येदमाश्रमपदं प्रभावाद्यस्य राक्षसैः। दिगियं दक्षिणा त्रासाद्दृश्यते नोपभुज्यते।।3.11.82।।
transliteration: tasyedamāśramapadṃ prabhāvādyasya rākṣasaiḥ| digiyṃ dakṣiṇā trāsāddṛśyate nopabhujyate||3.11.82||
meaning: This is his hermitage. On account of his (Agastya's) impact the demons look south but cannot eat the hermits out of fear (for the sage).

sanskrit: यदा प्रभृति चाक्रान्ता दिगियं पुण्यकर्मणा। तदा प्रभृति निर्वैराः प्रशान्ता रजनीचराः।।3.11.83।।
transliteration: yadā prabhṛti cākrāntā digiyṃ puṇyakarmaṇā| tadā prabhṛti nirvairāḥ praśāntā rajanīcarāḥ||3.11.83||
meaning: Since the time Agastya of sacred deeds occupied this direction the demons are quiet, leaving all enmity.

sanskrit: नाम्ना चेयं भगवतो दक्षिणा दिक्प्रदक्षिणा। प्रथिता त्रिषु लोकेषु दुर्धर्षा क्रूरकर्मभिः।।3.11.84।।
transliteration: nāmnā ceyṃ bhagavato dakṣiṇā dikpradakṣiṇā| prathitā triṣu lokeṣu durdharṣā krūrakarmabhiḥ||3.11.84||
meaning: The southern side favourable to the people was famous by the name Agastya in the three worlds and stood unassailable to the demons.

sanskrit: मार्गं निरोद्धुं निरतो भास्करस्याचलोत्तमः। निदेशं पालयन्यस्य विन्ध्यशैला न वर्धते।।3.11.85।। अयं दीर्घायुषस्तस्य लोके वि
transliteration: mārgṃ niroddhuṃ nirato bhāskarasyācalottamḥ| nideśṃ pālayanyasya vindhyaśailā na vardhate||3.11.85|| ayṃ dīrghāyuṣastasy
meaning: This is the hermitage of the longlived Agastya who is renowned for his deeds and is served by humble people. The great mountain Vindhya that was growing incessantly and obstructing the path of the Sun stopped growing any

sanskrit: एष लोकार्चितस्साधुर्हिते नित्यरतस्सताम्। अस्मानभिगतानेष श्रेयसा योजयिष्यति।।3.11.87।।
transliteration: eṣa lokārcitassādhurhite nityaratassatām| asmānabhigatāneṣa śreyasā yojayiṣyati||3.11.87||
meaning: We are going to join this sage honoured by the people of the world and ever engaged in the welfare of the virtuous. This augurs well for us.

sanskrit: आराधयिष्याम्यत्राहमगस्त्यं तं महामुनिम्। शेषं च वनवासस्य सौम्य वत्स्याम्यहं प्रभो।।3.11.88।।
transliteration: ārādhayiṣyāmyatrāhamagastyṃ tṃ mahāmunim| śeṣṃ ca vanavāsasya saumya vatsyāmyahṃ prabho||3.11.88||
meaning: O noble, handsome Lakshmana, I will spend the rest of the exile in this forest in the worship of the great sage Agastya.

sanskrit: अत्र देवास्सगन्धर्वास्सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। अगस्त्यं नियताहारं सततं पर्युपासते।।3.11.89।।
transliteration: atra devāssagandharvāssiddhāśca paramarṣayḥ| agastyṃ niyatāhārṃ satatṃ paryupāsate||3.11.89||
meaning: The gods along with gandharvas, siddhas and great sages always serve Agastya, observing discipine in their food habits.

sanskrit: नात्र जीवेन्मृषावादी क्रूरो वा यदि वा शठः। नृशंसः कामवृत्तो वा मुनिरेष तथाविधः।।3.11.90।।
transliteration: nātra jīvenmṛṣāvādī krūro vā yadi vā śaṭhḥ| nṛśṃsḥ kāmavṛtto vā munireṣa tathāvidhḥ||3.11.90||
meaning: This sage is such type that he (his spiritual power) will not allow a liar or a cruel man or a deceitful or lustful or wicked person to thrive here.

sanskrit: अत्र देवाश्च यक्षाश्च नागाश्च पतगैस्सह। वसन्ति नियताहारा धर्ममाराधयिष्णवः।।3.11.91।।
transliteration: atra devāśca yakṣāśca nāgāśca patagaissaha| vasanti niyatāhārā dharmamārādhayiṣṇavḥ||3.11.91||
meaning: Here gods, yakshas, nagas and birds live, following the righteous path and observing discipline in food habits.

sanskrit: अत्र सिद्धा महात्मानो विमानैजस्सूर्यसन्निभैः। त्यक्तदेहा नवैर्देहैः स्वर्याताः परमर्षयः।।3.11.92।।
transliteration: atra siddhā mahātmāno vimānaijassūryasannibhaiḥ| tyaktadehā navairdehaiḥ svaryātāḥ paramarṣayḥ||3.11.92||
meaning: Here great souls like sages and siddhas gave up the ghost and with renewed bodies left for heaven on aerochariot resembling the Sun (in brightness).

sanskrit: यक्षत्वममरत्वं च राज्यानि विविधानि च। अत्र देवाः प्रयच्छन्ति भूतैराराधिताश्शुभैः।।3.11.93।।
transliteration: yakṣatvamamaratvṃ ca rājyāni vividhāni ca| atra devāḥ prayacchanti bhūtairārādhitāśśubhaiḥ||3.11.93||
meaning: Worshipped by benevolent beings, the gods here bestow on them the status of demigods or of the immortals or several kinds of kingdoms.

sanskrit: राजा दशरथो नाम ज्येष्ठस्तस्य सुतो बली। रामः प्राप्तो मुनिं द्रष्टुं भार्यया सह सीतया।।3.12.2।।
transliteration: rājā daśaratho nāma jyeṣṭhastasya suto balī| rāmḥ prāpto muniṃ draṣṭuṃ bhāryayā saha sītayā||3.12.2||
meaning: The valiant eldest son of king Dasaratha has come along with his wife Sita to see the sage.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणो नाम तस्याहं भ्राता त्ववरजो हितः। अनुकूलश्च भक्तश्च यदि ते श्रोत्रमागतः।।3.12.3।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇo nāma tasyāhṃ bhrātā tvavarajo hitḥ| anukūlaśca bhaktaśca yadi te śrotramāgatḥ||3.12.3||
meaning: I am his younger brother Lakshmana, his wellwisher and faithful devotee if you have at all heard about me.

sanskrit: ते वयं वनमत्युग्रं प्रविष्टाः पितृशासनात्। द्रष्टुमिच्छामहे सर्वे भगवन्तं निवेद्यताम्।।3.12.4।।
transliteration: te vayṃ vanamatyugrṃ praviṣṭāḥ pitṛśāsanāt| draṣṭumicchāmahe sarve bhagavantṃ nivedyatām||3.12.4||
meaning: By the command of our father, we have entered this dense forest and desire to see the divine sire. Please report.

sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य तपोधनः। तथेत्युक्त्वाऽग्निशरणं प्रविवेश निवेदितुम्।।3.12.5।।
transliteration: tasya tad vacanṃ śrutvā lakṣmaṇasya tapodhanḥ| tathetyuktvā'gniśaraṇṃ praviveśa niveditum||3.12.5||
meaning: The ascetic heard Lakshmana, and saying, 'let it be so', entered the firesanctuary to report.

sanskrit: स प्रविश्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं तपसा दुष्प्रधर्षणम्। कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदं रामागमनमञ्जसा।।3.12.6।। यथोक्तं लक्ष्मणेनैव शिष्योऽगस्त्य
transliteration: sa praviśya muniśreṣṭhṃ tapasā duṣpradharṣaṇam| kṛtāñjaliruvācedṃ rāmāgamanamañjasā||3.12.6|| yathoktṃ lakṣmaṇenaiva śiṣ
meaning: Having promptly entered, Agastya's favourite disciple with folded hands reported as he was told by Lakshmana about Rama's arrival to the great sage who was armed with the inviolable powers of penance :

sanskrit: पुत्रौ दशरथस्येमौ रामो लक्ष्मण एव च।।3.12.7।। प्रविष्टावाश्रमपदं सीतया सह भार्यया।
transliteration: putrau daśarathasyemau rāmo lakṣmaṇa eva ca||3.12.7|| praviṣṭāvāśramapadṃ sītayā saha bhāryayā|
meaning: Rama and Lakshmana, the two sons of Dasaratha along with Sita, wife of Rama, have arrived at the hermitage.

sanskrit: द्रष्टुं भवन्तमायातौ शुश्रूषार्थमरिन्दमौ।।3.12.8।। यदत्रानन्तरं तत्त्वमाज्ञापयितुमर्हसि।
transliteration: draṣṭuṃ bhavantamāyātau śuśrūṣārthamarindamau||3.12.8|| yadatrānantarṃ tattvamājñāpayitumarhasi|
meaning: Both the subduers of enemies have come here now to see and serve your Holiness. You may order what is to be done next.

sanskrit: ततश्शिष्यादुपश्रुत्य प्राप्तं रामं सलक्ष्मणम्।।3.12.9।। वैदेहीं च महाभागामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: tataśśiṣyādupaśrutya prāptṃ rāmṃ salakṣmaṇam||3.12.9|| vaidehīṃ ca mahābhāgāmidṃ vacanamabravīt|
meaning: Having heard from the disciple about the arrival of Rama, Lakshmana and great daughter of the king of Videha the sage said :

sanskrit: दिष्ट्या रामश्चिरस्याद्य द्रष्टुं मां समुपागतः।।3.12.10।। मनसा काङ्क्षितं ह्यस्य मयाप्यागमनं प्रति।
transliteration: diṣṭyā rāmaścirasyādya draṣṭuṃ māṃ samupāgatḥ||3.12.10|| manasā kāṅkṣitṃ hyasya mayāpyāgamanṃ prati|
meaning: It is good fortune that Rama has come here after a long time to see me. I was longing for his arrival.

sanskrit: गम्यतां सत्कृतो रामस्सभार्यस्सहलक्ष्मणः।।3.12.11।। प्रवेश्यतां समीपं मे किं चासौ न प्रवेशितः।
transliteration: gamyatāṃ satkṛto rāmassabhāryassahalakṣmaṇḥ||3.12.11|| praveśyatāṃ samīpṃ me kiṃ cāsau na praveśitḥ|
meaning: Go quickly and with due hospitality conduct Rama, his wife Sita and brother Lakshmana into my presence. Why was he not ushered in so long?

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु मुनिना धर्मज्ञेन महात्मना।। 3.12.12।। अभिवाद्याब्रवीच्छिष्यस्तथेति नियताञ्जलिः।
transliteration: evamuktastu muninā dharmajñena mahātmanā|| 3.12.12|| abhivādyābravīcchiṣyastatheti niyatāñjaliḥ|
meaning: 'So be it ' said the disciple respectfully with folded palms in response to what the great sage, knower of dharma, commanded.

sanskrit: ततो निष्क्रम्य सम्भ्रान्तश्शिष्यो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।।3.12.13।। क्वासौ रामो मुनिं द्रष्टुमेतु प्रविशतु स्वयम्।
transliteration: tato niṣkramya sambhrāntaśśiṣyo lakṣmaṇamabravīt||3.12.13|| kvāsau rāmo muniṃ draṣṭumetu praviśatu svayam|
meaning: Then the disciple in a state of excitement came out of the hermitage and said to Lakshmana, 'Where is Rama? Let him come himself to see the sage'.

sanskrit: ततो गत्वाऽऽश्रमपदं शिष्येण सह लक्ष्मणः।। 3.12.14।। दर्शयामास काकुत्स्थं सीतां च जनकात्मजाम्।
transliteration: tato gatvā''śramapadṃ śiṣyeṇa saha lakṣmaṇḥ|| 3.12.14|| darśayāmāsa kākutsthṃ sītāṃ ca janakātmajām|
meaning: Then Lakshmana reached the entrance of the hermitage with the disciple and showed Rama of the Kakutstha race and Sita, daughter of Janaka .

sanskrit: तं शिष्यः प्रश्रितो वाक्यमगस्त्यवचनं ब्रुवन्।।3.12.15।। प्रावेशयद्यथान्यायं सत्कारार्हं सुसत्कृतम्।
transliteration: tṃ śiṣyḥ praśrito vākyamagastyavacanṃ bruvan||3.12.15|| prāveśayadyathānyāyṃ satkārārhṃ susatkṛtam|
meaning: The disciple humbly reported Agastya's words and ushered him in with befitting hospitality.

sanskrit: प्रविवेश ततो रामस्सीतया सहलक्ष्मणः।।3.12.16।। प्रशान्तहरिणाकीर्णमाश्रमं ह्यवलोकयन्।
transliteration: praviveśa tato rāmassītayā sahalakṣmaṇḥ||3.12.16|| praśāntahariṇākīrṇamāśramṃ hyavalokayan|
meaning: Then Rama, Sita and Lakshmana entered the hermitage, watching herds of quietly moving deer (undisturbed by their entry).

sanskrit: स तत्र ब्रह्मणः स्थानमग्नेः स्थानं तथैव च।।3.12.17।। विष्णोः स्थानं महेन्द्रस्य स्थानं चैव विवस्वतः। सोमस्थानं भगस्थानं
transliteration: sa tatra brahmaṇḥ sthānamagneḥ sthānṃ tathaiva ca||3.12.17|| viṣṇoḥ sthānṃ mahendrasya sthānṃ caiva vivasvatḥ| somasthān
meaning: Rama saw at the hermitage, the places (altars) of Brahma, Visnu, Agni (firegod), Indra, Sun, Moon, Bhaga, Kubera, Dhata (supreme spirit), Vidhata (creator Brahman), Vayu (Windgod), Ananta (great serpentking), Gayatri, Va

sanskrit: स तत्र ब्रह्मणः स्थानमग्नेः स्थानं तथैव च।।3.12.17।। विष्णोः स्थानं महेन्द्रस्य स्थानं चैव विवस्वतः। सोमस्थानं भगस्थानं
transliteration: sa tatra brahmaṇḥ sthānamagneḥ sthānṃ tathaiva ca||3.12.17|| viṣṇoḥ sthānṃ mahendrasya sthānṃ caiva vivasvatḥ| somasthān
meaning: Rama saw at the hermitage, the places (altars) of Brahma, Visnu, Agni (firegod), Indra, Sun, Moon, Bhaga, Kubera, Dhata (supreme spirit), Vidhata (creator Brahman), Vayu (Windgod), Ananta (great serpentking), Gayatri, Va

sanskrit: स तत्र ब्रह्मणः स्थानमग्नेः स्थानं तथैव च।।3.12.17।। विष्णोः स्थानं महेन्द्रस्य स्थानं चैव विवस्वतः। सोमस्थानं भगस्थानं
transliteration: sa tatra brahmaṇḥ sthānamagneḥ sthānṃ tathaiva ca||3.12.17|| viṣṇoḥ sthānṃ mahendrasya sthānṃ caiva vivasvatḥ| somasthān
meaning: Rama saw at the hermitage, the places (altars) of Brahma, Visnu, Agni (firegod), Indra, Sun, Moon, Bhaga, Kubera, Dhata (supreme spirit), Vidhata (creator Brahman), Vayu (Windgod), Ananta (great serpentking), Gayatri, Va

sanskrit: ततश्शिष्यैः परिवृतो मुनिरप्यभिनिष्पतत्।।3.12.21।। तं ददर्शाग्रतो रामो मुनीनां दीप्ततेजसाम्।
transliteration: tataśśiṣyaiḥ parivṛto munirapyabhiniṣpatat||3.12.21|| tṃ dadarśāgrato rāmo munīnāṃ dīptatejasām|
meaning: Thereafter surrounded by the disciples the sage came out. Rama saw him coming in front of the effulgent sages.

sanskrit: अब्रवीद्वचनं वीरो लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिवर्धनम्। 3.12.22।। एष लक्ष्मण निष्क्रामत्यगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः। औदार्येणावगच्छामि निधानं
transliteration: abravīdvacanṃ vīro lakṣmaṇṃ lakṣmivardhanam| 3.12.22|| eṣa lakṣmaṇa niṣkrāmatyagastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ| audāryeṇāvagacchāmi
meaning: The valiant Rama said to Lakshmana, the enhancer of prosperity, O Lakshmana, sage Agastya is coming out. By virtue of his noble appearance, I know this sage to be a great treasuretrove of penances.

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुरगस्त्यं सूर्यवर्चसम्। जग्राह परमप्रीतस्तस्य पादौ परन्तपः।।3.12.24।।
transliteration: evamuktvā mahābāhuragastyṃ sūryavarcasam| jagrāha paramaprītastasya pādau parantapḥ||3.12.24||
meaning: Having said so, the mightyarmed Rama, the scorcher of enemies, grasped the feet of Agastya who was shining like the Sun.

sanskrit: अभिवाद्य तु धर्मात्मा तस्थौ रामः कृताञ्जलिः। सीतया सह वैदेह्या तदा रामः सलक्ष्मणः।।3.12.25।।
transliteration: abhivādya tu dharmātmā tasthau rāmḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ| sītayā saha vaidehyā tadā rāmḥ salakṣmaṇḥ||3.12.25||
meaning: Then righteous Rama with Sita, the princess of Videha, and Lakshmana offered respects with folded palmsstanding.

sanskrit: प्रतिजग्राह काकुत्स्थमर्चयित्वासनोदकैः। कुशलप्रश्नमुक्त्वा च आस्यतामिति चाब्रवीत्।। 3.12.26।।
transliteration: pratijagrāha kākutsthamarcayitvāsanodakaiḥ| kuśalapraśnamuktvā ca āsyatāmiti cābravīt|| 3.12.26||
meaning: Agastya received Rama by offering him seat and water, enquired about his wellbeing and said: Please be seated,

sanskrit: अग्निं हुत्वा प्रदायार्घ्यमतिथीन् प्रतिपूज्य च। वानप्रस्थ्येन धर्मेण स तेषां भोजनं ददौ।। 3.12.27।।
transliteration: agniṃ hutvā pradāyārghyamatithīn pratipūjya ca| vānaprasthyena dharmeṇa sa teṣāṃ bhojanṃ dadau|| 3.12.27||
meaning: After giving oblations to the fire, and providing respectful offerings, the sage worshipped the guests according to the tradition of hermits and served them food.

sanskrit: प्रथमं चोपविश्याथ धर्मज्ञो मुनिपुङ्गवः। उवाच राममासीनं प्राञ्जलिं धर्मकोविदम्।।3.12.28।।
transliteration: prathamṃ copaviśyātha dharmajño munipuṅgavḥ| uvāca rāmamāsīnṃ prāñjaliṃ dharmakovidam||3.12.28||
meaning: And then the great sage Agastya, knower of dharma first took his seat and addressed Rama, an export in the knowledge of dharma, seated with folded palms.

sanskrit: अग्निं हुत्वा प्रदायार्घ्यमतिथिं प्रतिपूजयेत्। अन्यथा खलु काकुत्स्थ तपस्वी समुदाचरन्।।3.12.29।। दुःसाक्षीव परे लोके स्वा
transliteration: agniṃ hutvā pradāyārghyamatithiṃ pratipūjayet| anyathā khalu kākutstha tapasvī samudācaran||3.12.29|| duḥsākṣīva pare lo
meaning: O scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, only after offering oblations to the Firegod, a guest should be worshipped with water etc. Otherwise the host will have to eat his own flesh in the other world like a false witness.

sanskrit: राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य धर्मचारी महारथः।।3.12.30।। पूजनीयश्च मान्यश्च भवान् प्राप्तः प्रियातिथिः।
transliteration: rājā sarvasya lokasya dharmacārī mahārathḥ||3.12.30|| pūjanīyaśca mānyaśca bhavān prāptḥ priyātithiḥ|
meaning: You are king of all the worlds, a follower of dharma, a great warrior worthy of worship and an esteemed self. O Rama you are such a dear guest come to me.

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा फलैर्मूलैः पुष्पैरन्यैश्च राघवम्।। 3.12.31।। पूजयित्वा यथाकामं पुनरेव ततोऽब्रवीत्।
transliteration: evamuktvā phalairmūlaiḥ puṣpairanyaiśca rāghavam|| 3.12.31|| pūjayitvā yathākāmṃ punareva tato'bravīt|
meaning: Having said this to Rama, (the sage) honoured him by offering fruits, roots, flowers and other things as desired. He then said to Rama once again:

sanskrit: इदं दिव्यं महच्चापं हेमरत्नविभूषितम्।।3.12.32।। वैष्णवं पुरुषव्याघ्र निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा। अमोघस्सूर्यसङ्काशो ब्रह्मदत्त
transliteration: idṃ divyṃ mahaccāpṃ hemaratnavibhūṣitam||3.12.32|| vaiṣṇavṃ puruṣavyāghra nirmitṃ viśvakarmaṇā| amoghassūryasaṅkāśo brah
meaning: O best among men this divine bow studded with gold and gems belongs to Visnu and designed by Visvakarma. This excellent, unfailing arrow, bright like the Sun, was given to me by Brahma.

sanskrit: दत्तौ मम महेन्द्रेण तूणी चाक्षयसायकौ। सम्पूर्णौ निशितैर्बाणैर्ज्वलद्भिरिव पावकैः।।3.12.34।। महारजतकोशोऽयमसिर्हेमविभूषितः
transliteration: dattau mama mahendreṇa tūṇī cākṣayasāyakau| sampūrṇau niśitairbāṇairjvaladbhiriva pāvakaiḥ||3.12.34|| mahārajatakośo'yam
meaning: These two quivers filled fully with sharp inexhaustible arrows, shining like flames of fire and this sword adorned with gold and this big silver sheath were given to me by Indra.

sanskrit: अनेन धनुषा राम हत्वा संख्ये महासुरान्।।3.12.35।। आजहार श्रियं दीप्तां पुरा विष्णुर्दिवौकसाम्।
transliteration: anena dhanuṣā rāma hatvā sṃkhye mahāsurān||3.12.35|| ājahāra śriyṃ dīptāṃ purā viṣṇurdivaukasām|
meaning: In ancient times Visnu killed the demons in a battle with this bow and brought back the glittering prosperity for the gods.

sanskrit: तद्धनुस्तौ च तूणीरौ शरं खङ्गं च मानद।। 3.12.36।। जयाय प्रतिगृह्णीष्व वज्रं वज्रधरो यथा।
transliteration: taddhanustau ca tūṇīrau śarṃ khaṅgṃ ca mānada|| 3.12.36|| jayāya pratigṛhṇīṣva vajrṃ vajradharo yathā|
meaning: O bestower of honour, receive this bow, the two quivers, the sword and the arrow for your victory just like Indra accepts the thunderbolt.

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजाः समस्तं तद्वरायुधम्। दत्वा रामाय भगवानगस्त्यः पुनरब्रवीत्।।3.12.37।।
transliteration: evamuktvā mahātejāḥ samastṃ tadvarāyudham| datvā rāmāya bhagavānagastyḥ punarabravīt||3.12.37||
meaning: The luminous lord Agastya, having said this, gave all the excellent weapons to Rama. And continued : इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे द्वादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twelfth sarga of Aranyakanda of

sanskrit: अध्वश्रमेण वां खेदो बाधते प्रचुरश्रमः। व्यक्तमुत्कण्ठते वापि मैथिली जनकात्मजा।।3.13.2।।
transliteration: adhvaśrameṇa vāṃ khedo bādhate pracuraśramḥ| vyaktamutkaṇṭhate vāpi maithilī janakātmajā||3.13.2||
meaning: Both of you are tired due to the journey. It is evident that Sita, daughter of Janaka, is anxious (to rest).

sanskrit: एषा हि सुकुमारी च दुःखैश्च न विमानिता। प्राज्यदोषं वनं प्राप्ता भर्तृस्नेहप्रचोदिता।।3.13.3।।
transliteration: eṣā hi sukumārī ca duḥkhaiśca na vimānitā| prājyadoṣṃ vanṃ prāptā bhartṛsnehapracoditā||3.13.3||
meaning: Even though delicate, Sita never feels discouraged by difficulties. She has come to the forest full of obstacles, since she is motivated by her love for her husband.

sanskrit: यथैषा रमते राम इह सीता तथा कुरु। दुष्करं कृतवत्येषा वने त्वामनुगच्छती।।3.13.4।।
transliteration: yathaiṣā ramate rāma iha sītā tathā kuru| duṣkarṃ kṛtavatyeṣā vane tvāmanugacchatī||3.13.4||
meaning: O Rama, help Sita enjoy herself in whatever manner she likes. By following you into the forest, she has accomplished the most difficult task৷৷

sanskrit: एषा हि प्रकृतिः स्त्रीणामासृष्टे रघुनन्दन। समस्थमनुरज्यान्ति विषमस्थं त्यजन्ति च।।3.13.5।।
transliteration: eṣā hi prakṛtiḥ strīṇāmāsṛṣṭe raghunandana| samasthamanurajyānti viṣamasthṃ tyajanti ca||3.13.5||
meaning: O Rama, the delight of the Raghu dynasty from the beginning of the creation women, by nature, keep the husband company when all goes well and give them up when hard times come.

sanskrit: शतह्रदानां लोलत्वं शस्त्राणां तीक्ष्णतां तथा। गरूडानिलयोश्शैघ्र्यमनुगच्छन्ति योषितः।।3.13.6।।
transliteration: śatahradānāṃ lolatvṃ śastrāṇāṃ tīkṣṇatāṃ tathā| garūḍānilayośśaighryamanugacchanti yoṣitḥ||3.13.6||
meaning: Women are fickle like lightning, sharp like weapons and fast like Garuda or the windgod.

sanskrit: इयं तु भवतो भार्या दोषैरेतैर्विवर्जिता। श्लाघ्या च व्यपदेश्या च यथा देवी ह्यरुन्धती।।3.13.7।।
transliteration: iyṃ tu bhavato bhāryā doṣairetairvivarjitā| ślāghyā ca vyapadeśyā ca yathā devī hyarundhatī||3.13.7||
meaning: Your wife is free from such blemishes. She is praiseworthy and worthy of mention as an example just like the revered Arundhati.

sanskrit: अलङ्कृतोऽयं देशश्च यत्र सौमित्रिणा सह। वैदेह्या चानया राम वत्स्यसि त्वमरिन्दम।।3.13.8।।
transliteration: alaṅkṛto'yṃ deśaśca yatra saumitriṇā saha| vaidehyā cānayā rāma vatsyasi tvamarindama||3.13.8||
meaning: O Rama, subduer of enemies the place where you reside along with Lakshmana and Vaidehi will look adorned, indeed.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्समुनिना राघवस्संयताञ्जलिः। उवाच प्रश्रितं वाक्यमृषिं दीप्तमिवानलम्।।3.13.9।।
transliteration: evamuktassamuninā rāghavassṃyatāñjaliḥ| uvāca praśritṃ vākyamṛṣiṃ dīptamivānalam||3.13.9||
meaning: Thus addressed, Rama held his palms together and said politely to the sage shining like fire:

sanskrit: धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यस्य मे मुनिपुङ्गवः। गुणैस्सभ्रातृभार्यस्य वरदः परितुष्यति।।3.13.10।।
transliteration: dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yasya me munipuṅgavḥ| guṇaissabhrātṛbhāryasya varadḥ parituṣyati||3.13.10||
meaning: I consider myself blessed and favoured by a great sage like you, bestower of boons as you have been pleased with me, my brother and my life.

sanskrit: किन्तु व्यादिश मे देशं सोदकं बहुकाननम्। यत्राश्रमपदं कृत्वा वसेयं निरतस्सुखम्।।3.13.11।।
transliteration: kintu vyādiśa me deśṃ sodakṃ bahukānanam| yatrāśramapadṃ kṛtvā vaseyṃ niratassukham||3.13.11||
meaning: Direct me to a place with water and dense forest where we can build an ashram and live happily.

sanskrit: ततोऽब्रवीन्मुनिश्रेष्ठश्श्रुत्वा रामस्य तद्वचः। ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं धर्मात्मा धीरो धीरतरं वचः।।3.13.12।।
transliteration: tato'bravīnmuniśreṣṭhaśśrutvā rāmasya tadvacḥ| dhyātvā muhūrtṃ dharmātmā dhīro dhīratarṃ vacḥ||3.13.12||
meaning: On hearing the words of Rama, Agastya, the best among the sages, coolheaded and righteous, thought a while and uttered these words coolly :

sanskrit: इतो द्वियोजने तात बहुमूलफलोदकः। देशो बहुमृगश्श्रीमान्पञ्चवट्यभिविश्रुतः।।3.13.13।।
transliteration: ito dviyojane tāta bahumūlaphalodakḥ| deśo bahumṛgaśśrīmānpañcavaṭyabhiviśrutḥ||3.13.13||
meaning: O dear two yojanas away is a place wellknown as Panchavati, a beautiful resort with many roots, fruits, plenty of water and many animals.

sanskrit: तत्र गत्वाऽऽश्रमपदं कृत्वा सौमित्रिणा सह। रमस्व त्वं पितुर्वाक्यं तथोक्तमनुपालयन्।।3.13.14।।
transliteration: tatra gatvā''śramapadṃ kṛtvā saumitriṇā saha| ramasva tvṃ piturvākyṃ tathoktamanupālayan||3.13.14||
meaning: Reaching there, you wikk build a hermitage with Lakshmana and enjoy your life given to the fulfilment of the pledge to the father.

sanskrit: कालोऽयं गतभूयिष्ठो यः काल स्तव राघव। समयो यो नरेन्द्रेण कृतो दशरथेन ते।।3.13.15।। तीर्णप्रतिज्ञः काकुत्स्थ सुखं राज्ये न
transliteration: kālo'yṃ gatabhūyiṣṭho yḥ kāla stava rāghava| samayo yo narendreṇa kṛto daśarathena te||3.13.15|| tīrṇapratijñḥ kākutstha
meaning: O Rama, scion of the Kakutsthas much of the period of exile king Dasaratha had assigned has passed. You will fulfil your promise and live happily in the kingdom.

sanskrit: धन्यस्ते जनको राम स राजा रघुनन्दन।।3.13.16।। यस्त्वया ज्येष्ठपुत्रेण ययातिरिव तारितः।
transliteration: dhanyaste janako rāma sa rājā raghunandana||3.13.16|| yastvayā jyeṣṭhaputreṇa yayātiriva tāritḥ|
meaning: O Rama, joy of the Raghu family with the eldest son like you, your father is blessed and liberated like king Yayati.

sanskrit: विदितो ह्येष वृत्तान्तो मम सर्वस्तवानघ।।3.13.17।। तपसश्च प्रभावेण स्नेहाद्दशरथस्य च।
transliteration: vidito hyeṣa vṛttānto mama sarvastavānagha||3.13.17|| tapasaśca prabhāveṇa snehāddaśarathasya ca|
meaning: O sinless one, I have kown all these facts about you by the power of penance and love for Dasaratha.

sanskrit: हृदयस्थश्च ते छन्दो विज्ञातस्तपसा मया।।3.13.18।। इहावासं प्रतिज्ञाय मया सह तपोवने। अतश्च त्वामहं ब्रूमि गच्छ पञ्चवटीमिति
transliteration: hṛdayasthaśca te chando vijñātastapasā mayā||3.13.18|| ihāvāsṃ pratijñāya mayā saha tapovane| ataśca tvāmahṃ brūmi gacch
meaning: I know your heart by virtue of my penance. I, therefore, ask you to proceed to Panchavati, after ensuring your stay here with me in this penancegrove for the time being.

sanskrit: स हि रम्यो वनोद्देशो मैथिली तत्र रंस्यते। स देशश्श्लाघनीयश्च नातिदूरे च राघव।।3.13.20।।
transliteration: sa hi ramyo vanoddeśo maithilī tatra rṃsyate| sa deśaśślāghanīyaśca nātidūre ca rāghava||3.13.20||
meaning: O Raghava, that forest tract is delightful and beautiful. It is not far away(from here). Maithili (Sita) will enjoy her stay there.

sanskrit: गोदावर्यास्समीपे च मैथिली तत्र रंस्यते। प्राज्यमूलफलश्चैव नानाद्विजगणायुतः।।3.13.21।। विविक्तश्च महाबाहो पुण्योरम्यस्तथै
transliteration: godāvaryāssamīpe ca maithilī tatra rṃsyate| prājyamūlaphalaścaiva nānādvijagaṇāyutḥ||3.13.21|| viviktaśca mahābāho puṇyo
meaning: O longarmed Rama,that place has plenty of roots and fruits. It is a solitary, holy and beautiful place teeming with various kinds of birds. Sita will enjoy her stay in the vicinity of river Godavari.

sanskrit: भवानपि सदारश्च शक्तश्च परिरक्षणे। अपि चात्र वसन्राम तापसान्पालयिष्यसि।।3.13.22।।
transliteration: bhavānapi sadāraśca śaktaśca parirakṣaṇe| api cātra vasanrāma tāpasānpālayiṣyasi||3.13.22||
meaning: O Rama, while staying with your wife, you will look after the ascetics living there since you are capable of giving protection.

sanskrit: एतदालक्ष्यते वीर मधूकानां महद्वनम्। उत्तरेणास्य गन्तव्यं न्यग्रोधमभिगच्छता।।3.13.23।।
transliteration: etadālakṣyate vīra madhūkānāṃ mahadvanam| uttareṇāsya gantavyṃ nyagrodhamabhigacchatā||3.13.23||
meaning: O valiant Rama look at the great forest of madhuka trees. Walk north to the forest till you see a great banyan tree.

sanskrit: ततः स्थलमुपारुह्य पर्वतस्याविदूरतः। ख्यातः पञ्चवटीत्येव नित्यपुष्पितकाननः।।3.13.24।।
transliteration: tatḥ sthalamupāruhya parvatasyāvidūratḥ| khyātḥ pañcavaṭītyeva nityapuṣpitakānanḥ||3.13.24||
meaning: Then climb the elevated ground not very far from the mountain. There is the wellknown Panchavati with forests, ever in full bloom.

sanskrit: अगस्त्येनैवमुक्तस्तु रामस्सौमित्रिणा सह। सत्कृत्यामन्त्रयामास तमृषिं सत्यवादिनम्।।3.13.25।।
transliteration: agastyenaivamuktastu rāmassaumitriṇā saha| satkṛtyāmantrayāmāsa tamṛṣiṃ satyavādinam||3.13.25||
meaning: Thus addressed by Agastya, Rama with Lakshmana paid respects to the sage wedded to truth and took leave of him.

sanskrit: तौ तु तेनाभ्यनुज्ञातौ कृतपादाभिवन्दनौ। तदाश्रमात्पञ्चवटीं जग्मतुस्सीतया सह।।3.13.26।।
transliteration: tau tu tenābhyanujñātau kṛtapādābhivandanau| tadāśramātpañcavaṭīṃ jagmatussītayā saha||3.13.26||
meaning: Both of them worshipped the feet of sage Agastya, and proceeded to Panchavati with his permission.

sanskrit: गृहीतचापौ तु नराधिपात्मजौ विषक्ततूणौ समरेष्वकातरौ। यथोपदिष्टेन पथा महर्षिणा प्रजग्मतुः पञ्चवटीं समाहितौ।।3.13.27।।
transliteration: gṛhītacāpau tu narādhipātmajau viṣaktatūṇau samareṣvakātarau| yathopadiṣṭena pathā maharṣiṇā prajagmatuḥ pañcavaṭīṃ samā
meaning: Both the princes, unafraid of battles, held their bows, tied the quivers and carefully proceeded towards Panchavati along the path suggested by the sage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे त्रयोदशस्

sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा तौ महाभागौ वटस्थं रामलक्ष्मणौ। मेनाते राक्षसं पक्षिं ब्रुवाणौ को भवानिति।।3.14.2।।
transliteration: tṃ dṛṣṭvā tau mahābhāgau vaṭasthṃ rāmalakṣmaṇau| menāte rākṣasṃ pakṣiṃ bruvāṇau ko bhavāniti||3.14.2||
meaning: Seeing the bird on the banyan tree, venerable Rama and Lakshmana mistook him for a demon and enquired who he was.

sanskrit: स तौ मधुरया वाचा सौम्यया प्रीणयन्निव। उवाच वत्स मां विद्धि वयस्यं पितुरात्मनः।।3.14.3।।
transliteration: sa tau madhurayā vācā saumyayā prīṇayanniva| uvāca vatsa māṃ viddhi vayasyṃ piturātmanḥ||3.14.3||
meaning: With a sweet, pleasing, and gentle voice he said to both of them, O dear know me to be a friend of your father.

sanskrit: स तं पितृसखं बुद्ध्वा पूजयामास राघवः। स तस्य कुलमव्यग्रमथ पप्रच्छ नाम च।।3.14.4।।
transliteration: sa tṃ pitṛsakhṃ buddhvā pūjayāmāsa rāghavḥ| sa tasya kulamavyagramatha papraccha nāma ca||3.14.4||
meaning: Rama knew he was a friend of his father. So he enquired in a cool, composed voice his name and his lineage.

sanskrit: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वभूतसमुद्भवम्। आचचक्षे द्विजस्तस्मै कुलमात्मानमेव च।।3.14.5।।
transliteration: rāmasya vacanṃ śrutvā sarvabhūtasamudbhavam| ācacakṣe dvijastasmai kulamātmānameva ca||3.14.5||
meaning: On hearing Rama's words, the bird started narrating the origin of all beings including his own family:

sanskrit: पूर्वकाले महाबाहो ये प्रजापतयोऽभवन्। तान्मे निगदतस्सर्वानादितश्शृणु राघव।।3.14.6।।
transliteration: pūrvakāle mahābāho ye prajāpatayo'bhavan| tānme nigadatassarvānāditaśśṛṇu rāghava||3.14.6||
meaning: O mightyarmed Rama hear from me while I am telling you about the lords of creation from the very beginning.

sanskrit: कर्दमः प्रथमस्तेषां विक्रीतस्तदनन्तरः। शेषश्च संश्रयश्चैव बहुपुत्रश्च वीर्यवान्।।3.14.7।। स्थाणुर्मरीचिरत्रिश्च क्रतुश्च
transliteration: kardamḥ prathamasteṣāṃ vikrītastadanantarḥ| śeṣaśca sṃśrayaścaiva bahuputraśca vīryavān||3.14.7|| sthāṇurmarīciratriśca
meaning: O Rama among the lords of all beings the first was Kardama, the next was Vikritha, followed by Sesha, Samsrya Bahuputra, Sthanu, Mareechi, Atri and mighty Kratu, Pulastya, Angirasa, Pracheta, similarly Pulaha and Daksha.

sanskrit: प्रजापतेस्तु दक्षस्य बभूवुरिति विश्रुतम्। षष्टिर्दुहितरो राम यशस्विन्यो महायशः।।3.14.10।।
transliteration: prajāpatestu dakṣasya babhūvuriti viśrutam| ṣaṣṭirduhitaro rāma yaśasvinyo mahāyaśḥ||3.14.10||
meaning: O glorious Rama it is wellknown that Daksha, the creator had sixty daughters of great fame.

sanskrit: काश्यपः प्रतिजग्राह तासामष्टौ सुमध्यमाः। अदितिं च दितिं चैव दनुमप्यथ कालिकाम्।।3.14.11।। ताम्रां क्रोधवशां चैव मनुं चाप्
transliteration: kāśyapḥ pratijagrāha tāsāmaṣṭau sumadhyamāḥ| aditiṃ ca ditiṃ caiva danumapyatha kālikām||3.14.11|| tāmrāṃ krodhavaśāṃ ca
meaning: Out of them(daughters of Daksha) Kasyapa married eight women of beautiful waist called Aditi, Diti, Danu also Kalika,Tamra, Krodhavasa, Anala and Manu.

sanskrit: तास्तु कन्यास्ततः प्रीतः काश्यपः पुनरब्रवीत्।।3.14.12।। पुत्रां स्स्रैलोक्यभर्तृ़न्वै जनयिष्यथ मत्समान्।
transliteration: tāstu kanyāstatḥ prītḥ kāśyapḥ punarabravīt||3.14.12|| putrāṃ ssrailokyabhartṛ़nvai janayiṣyatha matsamān|
meaning: Kasyapa, pleased with them said to his young wives, Beget sons of my stature who can rule over the three worlds.

sanskrit: अदितिस्तन्मना राम दितिश्च मनुजर्षभ।।3.14.13।। कालिका च महाबाहो शेषास्त्वमनसोऽभवन्।
transliteration: aditistanmanā rāma ditiśca manujarṣabha||3.14.13|| kālikā ca mahābāho śeṣāstvamanaso'bhavan|
meaning: O best of men, O longarmed Rama while Aditi, Diti and Kalika seriously considered his advice, the rest of the wives did not.

sanskrit: अदित्यां जज्ञिरे देवात्रयस्त्रिंशदरिंदम।।3.14.14।। आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा ह्यश्विनौ च परन्तप।
transliteration: adityāṃ jajñire devātrayastriṃśadariṃdama||3.14.14|| ādityā vasavo rudrā hyaśvinau ca parantapa|
meaning: O Rama, subduer and scorcher of enemies to Aditi were born twelve Adityas, eight Vasus, eleven Rudras, and two Asvins, thirtythree deities in all.

sanskrit: दितिस्त्वजनयत्पुत्रान् दैत्यांस्तात यशस्विनः।।3.14.15।। तेषामियं वसुमती पुराऽसीत्सवनार्णवा।
transliteration: ditistvajanayatputrān daityāṃstāta yaśasvinḥ||3.14.15|| teṣāmiyṃ vasumatī purā'sītsavanārṇavā|
meaning: O dear Rama, Diti bore glorious sons called Daityas and this earth with all the forests and seas belonged to them.

sanskrit: दनुस्त्वजनयत्पुत्रमश्वग्रीवमरिन्दम।।3.14.16।। नरकं कालकंचैव कालिकापि व्यजायत।
transliteration: danustvajanayatputramaśvagrīvamarindama||3.14.16|| narakṃ kālakṃcaiva kālikāpi vyajāyata|
meaning: O subduer of enemies, to Danu was born Hayagriva and to Kalika, Naraka and Kalaka.

sanskrit: क्रौञ्चीं भासीं तथा श्येनीं धृतराष्ट्रीं तथा शुकीम्।।3.14.17।। ताम्रापि सुषुवे कन्याः पञ्चैता लोकविश्रुताः।
transliteration: krauñcīṃ bhāsīṃ tathā śyenīṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrīṃ tathā śukīm||3.14.17|| tāmrāpi suṣuve kanyāḥ pañcaitā lokaviśrutāḥ|
meaning: To Tamra were born, Krounchi, Bhasi, Syeni, Dhrutharashtri and Suki. Altogether they were five beautiful young maids famous in the world.

sanskrit: उलूकाञ्जनयत्क्रौञ्ची भासी भासान्व्यजायत।।3.14.18।। श्येनी श्येनांश्च गृध्रांश्च व्यजायत सुतेजसः। धृतराष्ट्रीतु हंसांश्च
transliteration: ulūkāñjanayatkrauñcī bhāsī bhāsānvyajāyata||3.14.18|| śyenī śyenāṃśca gṛdhrāṃśca vyajāyata sutejasḥ| dhṛtarāṣṭrītu hṃsāṃ
meaning: Krounchi gave birth to owls, Bhasi to Bhasa birds, Synei to bright hawks and vultures, Dhrutharashtri to swans and chakravakas with sweet notes.

sanskrit: चक्रवाकांश्च भद्रं ते विजज्ञे सापि भामिनी। शुकी नतां विजज्ञे तु नताया विनता सुता।।3.14.20।।
transliteration: cakravākāṃśca bhadrṃ te vijajñe sāpi bhāminī| śukī natāṃ vijajñe tu natāyā vinatā sutā||3.14.20||
meaning: Dhrutharashtri, a female bird of great lustre gave birth to chakravakas too. Suki gave birth to Nata and from Nata, Vinata was born. Be blessed, O Rama

sanskrit: दश क्रोधवशा राम विजज्ञे ह्यात्मसम्भवाः। मृगीं च मृगमन्दां च हरीं भद्रमदामपि।।3.14.21।। मातङ्गीमपि शार्दूलीं श्वेतां च सु
transliteration: daśa krodhavaśā rāma vijajñe hyātmasambhavāḥ| mṛgīṃ ca mṛgamandāṃ ca harīṃ bhadramadāmapi||3.14.21|| mātaṅgīmapi śārdūlī
meaning: O Ramato Krodhavasa were born Mrugi, Mrugamanda, Hari, Bhadramada, Mathangi, Sardooli, Sweta, Surabhi and Surasa, Kadruva and endowed with all virtues.

sanskrit: अपत्यं तु मृगास्सर्वे मृग्या नरवरोत्तम। ऋक्षाश्च मृगमन्दायास्सृमराश्चमरा स्तथा।।3.14.23।।
transliteration: apatyṃ tu mṛgāssarve mṛgyā naravarottama| ṛkṣāśca mṛgamandāyāssṛmarāścamarā stathā||3.14.23||
meaning: O best of men, all kinds of animals were born of Mrugi.To Mrugamanda were born bears and chamara (a different kind of deer).

sanskrit: हर्याश्च हरयोऽपत्यं वानराश्च तरस्स्विनः। ततस्त्विरावतीं नाम जज्ञे भद्रमदा सुताम्।।3.14.24।।
transliteration: haryāśca harayo'patyṃ vānarāśca tarassvinḥ| tatastvirāvatīṃ nāma jajñe bhadramadā sutām||3.14.24||
meaning: To Hari were born lions, and swiftmoving monkeys and to Bhadramada, a daughter by name Iravati.

sanskrit: तस्यास्त्वैरावतः पुत्रो लोकनाथो महागजः। मातङ्ग्या स्त्वथ मातङ्गा अपत्यं मनुजर्षभ।।3.14.25।।
transliteration: tasyāstvairāvatḥ putro lokanātho mahāgajḥ| mātaṅgyā stvatha mātaṅgā apatyṃ manujarṣabha||3.14.25||
meaning: O bull among men Matangi gave birth to elephants.The mighty elephant Airavata who became the lord of the world was born to Iravati.

sanskrit: गोलाङ्गूलांश्च शार्दूली व्याघ्रांश्चाजनयत्सुतान्। दिशागजांश्च काकुत्स्थ श्वेताप्यजनयत्सुतान्।।3.14.26।।
transliteration: golāṅgūlāṃśca śārdūlī vyāghrāṃścājanayatsutān| diśāgajāṃśca kākutstha śvetāpyajanayatsutān||3.14.26||
meaning: O Rama, Sarduli gave birth to tigers and playful, roundbodied monkeys called Golangula and Sweta delivered elephants as sons for guarding the eight quarters.

sanskrit: ततो दुहितरौ राम सुरभिर्द्वेव्यजायत। रोहिणीं नाम भद्रं ते गन्धर्वीं च यशस्स्विनीम्।।3.14.27।।
transliteration: tato duhitarau rāma surabhirdvevyajāyata| rohiṇīṃ nāma bhadrṃ te gandharvīṃ ca yaśassvinīm||3.14.27||
meaning: Surabhi gave birth to Rohini and Gandharvi,the two famous daughters. May you be happy, Rama

sanskrit: रोहिण्यजनयद् गावो गन्धर्वी वाजिनः सुतान्। सुरसाऽजनयन्नागान्राम कद्रूस्तु पन्नगान्।।3.14.28।।
transliteration: rohiṇyajanayad gāvo gandharvī vājinḥ sutān| surasā'janayannāgānrāma kadrūstu pannagān||3.14.28||
meaning: O Rama Rohini procreated cows, and Gandharvi, horses as offsprings. Surasa delivered cobras and Kadru, ordinary serpents.

sanskrit: मनुर्मनुष्यान् जनयद्राम पुत्रान् यशस्विनः। ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियान् वैश्यान् शूद्रांश्च मनुजर्षभ।।3.14.29।।
transliteration: manurmanuṣyān janayadrāma putrān yaśasvinḥ| brāhmaṇān kṣatriyān vaiśyān śūdrāṃśca manujarṣabha||3.14.29||
meaning: O Rama, bull among men Manu procreated brahmins, kshatriyas, vaisyas and sudras all famed human beings.

sanskrit: सर्वान् पुण्यफलान्वृक्षाननलापि व्यजायत। विनता च शुकीपौत्री कद्रूश्च सुरसास्वसा।।3.14.30।।
transliteration: sarvān puṇyaphalānvṛkṣānanalāpi vyajāyata| vinatā ca śukīpautrī kadrūśca surasāsvasā||3.14.30||
meaning: Anala (wife of Kasyapa) procreated trees with sacred fruits. Vinata was the granddaughter of Suki, and Kahdruva and Surasa were her sisters.

sanskrit: कद्रूर्नागं सहस्रास्यं विजज्ञे धरणीधरम्। द्वौ पुत्रौ विनतायास्तु गरुडोऽरुण एव च।।3.14.31।।
transliteration: kadrūrnāgṃ sahasrāsyṃ vijajñe dharaṇīdharam| dvau putrau vinatāyāstu garuḍo'ruṇa eva ca||3.14.31||
meaning: Kadhru produced a thousandhooded serpent(Adisesha) who held the whole earth on his head and Vinata, two sons, Garuda and Aruna.

sanskrit: तस्माज्जातोऽहमरुणात्सम्पातिस्तु ममाग्रजः। जटायुरिति मां विद्धि श्येनीपुत्रमरिन्दम।।3.14.32।।
transliteration: tasmājjāto'hamaruṇātsampātistu mamāgrajḥ| jaṭāyuriti māṃ viddhi śyenīputramarindama||3.14.32||
meaning: I am born to Aruna and my elder brother is Sampati. O subduer of enemies, know me as Jatayu, son of Syeni.

sanskrit: सोऽहं वाससहायस्ते भविष्यामि यदीच्छसि। इदं दुर्गं हि कान्तारं मृगराक्षस सेवितम्।।3.14.33।। सीतां च तात रक्षिष्ये त्वयि या
transliteration: so'hṃ vāsasahāyaste bhaviṣyāmi yadīcchasi| idṃ durgṃ hi kāntārṃ mṛgarākṣasa sevitam||3.14.33|| sītāṃ ca tāta rakṣiṣye tv
meaning: If you so desire I will be helpful to you in guarding your hut. O dear, it is a difficult forest full of wild animals and demons. When you and Lakshmana are away I will protect Sita.

sanskrit: जटायुषं तं प्रतिपूज्य राघवो मुदा परिष्वज्य च सन्नतोऽभवत्। पितुर्हि शुश्राव सखित्वमात्मवान् जटायुषा सङ्कथितं पुनः पुनः।।3
transliteration: jaṭāyuṣṃ tṃ pratipūjya rāghavo mudā pariṣvajya ca sannato'bhavat| piturhi śuśrāva sakhitvamātmavān jaṭāyuṣā saṅkathitṃ p
meaning: Rama worshipped Jatayu and bending down, embraced him. He heard from him again and again several events relating to Jatayu's friendship with his father.

sanskrit: स तत्र सीतां परिदाय मैथिलीं सहैव तेनातिबलेन पक्षिणा। जगाम तां पञ्चवटीं सलक्ष्मणो रिपून्दिधक्षञ्छलभानि वानलः।।3.14.35।।
transliteration: sa tatra sītāṃ paridāya maithilīṃ sahaiva tenātibalena pakṣiṇā| jagāma tāṃ pañcavaṭīṃ salakṣmaṇo ripūndidhakṣañchalabhān
meaning: Entresting the protection of Sita, the princess of Mithila, to that strong vulture, Jatayu, and accompanied by Lakshmana Rama went to Panchavati wishing to destroy the enemies like fire burning the moths. इत्यार्षे श्रीम

sanskrit: आगताः स्म यथोद्दिष्टममुं देशं महर्षिणा। अयं पञ्चवटीदेशस्सौम्य पुष्पितपादपः।।3.15.2।।
transliteration: āgatāḥ sma yathoddiṣṭamamuṃ deśṃ maharṣiṇā| ayṃ pañcavaṭīdeśassaumya puṣpitapādapḥ||3.15.2||
meaning: O handsome one, following the directions of the great sage, we have arrived at Panchavati, a place full of blossoming trees.

sanskrit: सर्वतश्चार्यतां दृष्टिः कानने निपुणोह्यसि। आश्रमः कतरस्मिन्नो देशे भवति सम्मतः।।3.15.3।।
transliteration: sarvataścāryatāṃ dṛṣṭiḥ kānane nipuṇohyasi| āśramḥ katarasminno deśe bhavati sammatḥ||3.15.3||
meaning: O Lakshmana cast your eyes all around the forest for a suitable place (for building a hermitage). Indeed, you are good at judging things.

sanskrit: रमते यत्र वैदेही त्वमहं चैव लक्ष्मण। तादृशो दृश्यतां देशस्सन्निकृष्टजलाशयः।।3.15.4।। वनरामण्यकं यत्र स्थलरामण्यकं तथा। स
transliteration: ramate yatra vaidehī tvamahṃ caiva lakṣmaṇa| tādṛśo dṛśyatāṃ deśassannikṛṣṭajalāśayḥ||3.15.4|| vanarāmaṇyakṃ yatra sthal
meaning: Look, O Lakshmana for a place to the liking of Sita, a place where there is water source nearby where both of us can enjoy. Find a beautiful location where the surrounding forest is beautiful and where faggots, flowers,

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण लक्ष्मण संयताञ्जलिः। सीतासमक्षं काकुत्स्थमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.15.6।।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇa sṃyatāñjaliḥ| sītāsamakṣṃ kākutsthamidṃ vacanamabravīt||3.15.6||
meaning: Having been thus instructed by Rama, Lakshmana said with folded palms in the presence of Sita:

sanskrit: परवानस्मि काकुत्स्थ त्वयि वर्षशतं स्थिते। स्वयं तु रुचिरे देशे क्रियतामिति मां वद।।3.15.7।।
transliteration: paravānasmi kākutstha tvayi varṣaśatṃ sthite| svayṃ tu rucire deśe kriyatāmiti māṃ vada||3.15.7||
meaning: O Rama, I shall be dependent on you, even if I live for a hundred years. You only need to indicate a beautiful place of your choice.

sanskrit: सुप्रीतस्तेन वाक्येन लक्ष्मणस्य महात्मनः। विमृशन्रोचयामास देशं सर्वगुणान्वितम्।।3.15.8।।
transliteration: suprītastena vākyena lakṣmaṇasya mahātmanḥ| vimṛśanrocayāmāsa deśṃ sarvaguṇānvitam||3.15.8||
meaning: Rama was pleased with the words of great Lakshmana. Deliberating over it, he agreed upon a site suitable in all respects.

sanskrit: स तं रुचिरमाक्रम्य देशमाश्रमकर्मणि। हस्तौ गृहीत्वा हस्तेन रामस्सौमित्रिमब्रवीत्।।3.15.9।।
transliteration: sa tṃ ruciramākramya deśamāśramakarmaṇi| hastau gṛhītvā hastena rāmassaumitrimabravīt||3.15.9||
meaning: Having come to a beautiful spot suitable for the asram, Rama took both the hands of Lakshmana in his own and said:

sanskrit: अयं देशस्समश्रीमान् पुष्पितैस्तरुभिर्वृतः। इहाऽश्रमपदं सौम्य यथावत्कर्तुमर्हसि।।3.15.10।।
transliteration: ayṃ deśassamaśrīmān puṣpitaistarubhirvṛtḥ| ihā'śramapadṃ saumya yathāvatkartumarhasi||3.15.10||
meaning: This place is level, surrounded by beautiful trees in full bloom. O handsome one, you may build the hermitage here.

sanskrit: इयमादित्यसङ्काशैः पद्मैस्सुरभिगन्धिभिः। अदूरे दृश्यते रम्या पद्मिनी पद्मशोभिता।।3.15.11।।
transliteration: iyamādityasaṅkāśaiḥ padmaissurabhigandhibhiḥ| adūre dṛśyate ramyā padminī padmaśobhitā||3.15.11||
meaning: There, not very far, is a beautiful lotustank shining like the Sun, fragrant with lotuses.

sanskrit: यथातख्यातमगस्त्येन मुनिना भावितात्मना। इयं गोदावरी रम्या पुष्पितैस्तरुभिर्वृता।।3.15.12।। हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णा चक्रवाकोपशोभ
transliteration: yathātakhyātamagastyena muninā bhāvitātmanā| iyṃ godāvarī ramyā puṣpitaistarubhirvṛtā||3.15.12|| hṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇā cakr
meaning: As said by the selfrealised soul, sage Agastya, this Godavari is beautiful, surrounded by trees with flowers in bloom, filled with flocks of swans, ducks and ruddy geese.

sanskrit: नातिदूरे न चासन्ने मृगयूथपिपीडिताः।।3.15.13।। मयूरनादिता रम्याः प्रांशवो बहुकन्दराः। दृश्यन्ते गिरयः सौम्य फुल्लैस्तरुभि
transliteration: nātidūre na cāsanne mṛgayūthapipīḍitāḥ||3.15.13|| mayūranāditā ramyāḥ prāṃśavo bahukandarāḥ| dṛśyante girayḥ saumya phul
meaning: O handsome one, neither far nor near are seen tall mountains and flowering trees and herds of deer. Their numerous caves echo with sounds of peacocks.

sanskrit: सौवर्णैराजतैस्ताम्रैर्देशे देशे च धातुभिः। गवाक्षिता इवाभान्ति गजाः परमभक्तिभिः।।3.15.15।।
transliteration: sauvarṇairājataistāmrairdeśe deśe ca dhātubhiḥ| gavākṣitā ivābhānti gajāḥ paramabhaktibhiḥ||3.15.15||
meaning: These mountains, with streaks of minerals like gold, silver and copper forming decorative designs, look beautiful like colourful windows, and appear like huge elephants.

sanskrit: सालैस्तालैस्तमालैश्च खर्जूरपनसाम्रकैः। नीवारैस्तिमिशैश्चैव पुन्नागैश्चोपशोभिताः।।3.15.16।। चूतैरशोकैस्तिलकैश्चम्पकैः केत
transliteration: sālaistālaistamālaiśca kharjūrapanasāmrakaiḥ| nīvāraistimiśaiścaiva punnāgaiścopaśobhitāḥ||3.15.16|| cūtairaśokaistilaka
meaning: The place is covered with sal and palmyrah trees including mango, jackfruit, dates, kadamba, punnaga, ashoka, champak, tilaka, ketaka, sandalwood, spandan, dhava, asvakarna parnasha, khadira, sami, kimsuka and patala tre

sanskrit: इदं पुण्यमिदं मेध्यमिदं बहुमृगद्विजम्। इह वत्स्याम सौमित्रे सार्धमेतेन पक्षिणा।।3.15.19।।
transliteration: idṃ puṇyamidṃ medhyamidṃ bahumṛgadvijam| iha vatsyāma saumitre sārdhametena pakṣiṇā||3.15.19||
meaning: This is a holy place fit for sacrifice. There are many animals and birds here.Hence we will reside here with Jatayu.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। अचिरेणाऽश्रमं भ्रातुश्चकार सुमहाबलः।।3.15.20।।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇḥ paravīrahā| acireṇā'śramṃ bhrātuścakāra sumahābalḥ||3.15.20||
meaning: Thus directed by Rama, the mighty Lakshmana, destroyer of enemy warriors, soon built a hermitage for his brother.

sanskrit: पर्णशालां सुविपुलां तत्र सङ्खातमृत्तिकाम्। सुस्तम्भां मस्करैर्दीर्घैः कृतवंशां सुशोभनाम्।।3.15. 21।। शमीशाखाभिरास्तीर्य
transliteration: parṇaśālāṃ suvipulāṃ tatra saṅkhātamṛttikām| sustambhāṃ maskarairdīrghaiḥ kṛtavṃśāṃ suśobhanām||3.15. 21|| śamīśākhābhir
meaning: Lakshmana who was quick to act dug the clay with nippers, planted long bamboo poles, put branches of sami trees across and tied them with strong ropes. He spread kusa and kasa grass and leaves on the levelled ground. He

sanskrit: सहसा लक्ष्मणः श्रीमान् नदीं गोदावरीं तदा। स्नात्वा पद्मानि चादाय सफलः पुनरागतः।।3.15.24।।
transliteration: sahasā lakṣmaṇḥ śrīmān nadīṃ godāvarīṃ tadā| snātvā padmāni cādāya saphalḥ punarāgatḥ||3.15.24||
meaning: Lakshmana then went to river Godavari, had his bath, and returned with some lotuses.

sanskrit: ततः पुष्पबलिं कृत्वा शान्तिं च स यथाविधि। दर्शयामास रामाय तदाश्रमपदं कृतम्।।3.15.25।।
transliteration: tatḥ puṣpabaliṃ kṛtvā śāntiṃ ca sa yathāvidhi| darśayāmāsa rāmāya tadāśramapadṃ kṛtam||3.15.25||
meaning: Lakshmana offered oblation of flowers, invoked peace as per tradition (before occupying a newly made home) and showed Rama the cottage he had built.

sanskrit: स तं दृष्ट्वा कृतं सौम्यमाश्रमं सीतया सह। राघवः पर्णशालायां हर्षमाहारयत्परम्।।3.15.26।।
transliteration: sa tṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtṃ saumyamāśramṃ sītayā saha| rāghavḥ parṇaśālāyāṃ harṣamāhārayatparam||3.15.26||
meaning: Rama and Sita saw the beautiful hermitage built by Lakshmana, and expressed much happiness over the leafthatched cottage.

sanskrit: सुसंहृष्टः परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यां लक्ष्मणं तदा। अतिस्निग्धं च गाढं च वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्।।3.15.27।।
transliteration: susṃhṛṣṭḥ pariṣvajya bāhubhyāṃ lakṣmaṇṃ tadā| atisnigdhṃ ca gāḍhṃ ca vacanṃ cedamabravīt||3.15.27||
meaning: Deeply pleased with Lakshmana, he hugged him tightly and said those loving words :

sanskrit: प्रीतोऽस्मि ते महत्कर्म त्वया कृतमिदं प्रभो। प्रदेयो यन्निमित्तं ते परिष्वङ्गो मया कृतः।।3.15.28।।
transliteration: prīto'smi te mahatkarma tvayā kṛtamidṃ prabho| pradeyo yannimittṃ te pariṣvaṅgo mayā kṛtḥ||3.15.28||
meaning: O my master, you have done a great task for which I have given you what I could give at the moment a hug.

sanskrit: भावज्ञेन कृतज्ञेन धर्मज्ञेन च लक्ष्मण। त्वया पुत्रेण धर्मात्मा न संवृत्तः पिता मम।।3.15.29।।
transliteration: bhāvajñena kṛtajñena dharmajñena ca lakṣmaṇa| tvayā putreṇa dharmātmā na sṃvṛttḥ pitā mama||3.15.29||
meaning: O Lakshmana with a son like you who can understand others' feelings, who has a sense of gratitude and a sense of duty my father is not dead yet.

sanskrit: एवं लक्ष्मणमुक्त्वा तु राघवो लक्ष्मिवर्धनः। तस्मिन् देशे बहुफले न्यवसत्सुसुखं वशी।।3.15.30।।
transliteration: evṃ lakṣmaṇamuktvā tu rāghavo lakṣmivardhanḥ| tasmin deśe bahuphale nyavasatsusukhṃ vaśī||3.15.30||
meaning: Rama who was an enhancer of fortunes and who had his senses under control said thus to Lakshmana and lived happily there in that place filled with fruits.

sanskrit: कञ्चित्कालं स धर्मात्मा सीतया लक्ष्मणेन च। अन्वास्यमानो न्यवसत्स्वर्गलोके यथामरः।।3.15.31।।
transliteration: kañcitkālṃ sa dharmātmā sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca| anvāsyamāno nyavasatsvargaloke yathāmarḥ||3.15.31||
meaning: Righteous Rama, served by Lakshmana, and Sita lived there for some time like a god in heaven. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चदशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fifteenth sarga of Aranyakanda of the h

sanskrit: स कदाचित्प्रभातायां शर्वर्यां रघुनन्दनः। प्रययावभिषेकार्थं रम्यां गोदावरीं नदीम्।।3.16.2।।
transliteration: sa kadācitprabhātāyāṃ śarvaryāṃ raghunandanḥ| prayayāvabhiṣekārthṃ ramyāṃ godāvarīṃ nadīm||3.16.2||
meaning: Once Rama, delight of the Raghu race, went to the beautiful river Godavari for ablution in the early hours of the morning.

sanskrit: प्रह्वः कलशहस्तस्तं सीतया सह वीर्यवान्। पृष्ठतोऽनुव्रजन्भ्राता सौमित्रिरिदमब्रवीत्।।3.16.3।।
transliteration: prahvḥ kalaśahastastṃ sītayā saha vīryavān| pṛṣṭhato'nuvrajanbhrātā saumitriridamabravīt||3.16.3||
meaning: While valiant Lakshmana, walking behind Sita who was carrying a pitcher in her hand bent down a little and told Rama thus:

sanskrit: अयं स कालः सम्प्राप्तः प्रियो यस्ते प्रियंवद। अलङ्कृत इवाभाति येन संवत्सरः शुभः।।3.16.4।।
transliteration: ayṃ sa kālḥ samprāptḥ priyo yaste priyṃvada| alaṅkṛta ivābhāti yena sṃvatsarḥ śubhḥ||3.16.4||
meaning: O sweetspeaking brother, the season which is dear to you has arrived. It appears the auspicious year is going to be embellished with this season.

sanskrit: नीहारपरुषो लोकः पृथिवी सस्यशालिनी। जलान्यनुपभोग्यानि सुभगो हव्यवाहनः।।3.16.5।।
transliteration: nīhāraparuṣo lokḥ pṛthivī sasyaśālinī| jalānyanupabhogyāni subhago havyavāhanḥ||3.16.5||
meaning: People feel frozen with fog, and water is no more enjoyable. The earth is full of crops and fire is so agreeable.

sanskrit: नवाग्रयणपूजाभिरभ्यर्च्य पितृदेवताः। कृताग्रयणकाः काले सन्तो विगतकल्मषाः।।3.16.6।।
transliteration: navāgrayaṇapūjābhirabhyarcya pitṛdevatāḥ| kṛtāgrayaṇakāḥ kāle santo vigatakalmaṣāḥ||3.16.6||
meaning: Pious men offer their libations of the first crop at Agnistoma sacrifice and thereby please their manes and get rid of their sins.

sanskrit: प्राज्यकामा जनपदास्सम्पन्नतरगोरसाः। विचरन्ति महीपाला यात्रास्था विजिगीषवः।।3.16.7।।
transliteration: prājyakāmā janapadāssampannataragorasāḥ| vicaranti mahīpālā yātrāsthā vijigīṣavḥ||3.16.7||
meaning: People in the countryside with their desires satisfied obtain abundant cow's milk at this time. Rulers of the earth are out on their expedition with a desire for victory.

sanskrit: सेवमाने दृढं सूर्ये दिशमन्तक सेविताम्। विहीनतिलकेव स्त्री नोत्तरा दिक्प्रकाशते।।3.16.8।।
transliteration: sevamāne dṛḍhṃ sūrye diśamantaka sevitām| vihīnatilakeva strī nottarā dikprakāśate||3.16.8||
meaning: As the Sun has resorted to the direction (south) that serves the god of death, the north devoid of (the Sun) shines like a woman without the vermilion mark on the forehead.

sanskrit: प्रकृत्या हिमकोशाढ्यो दूरसूर्यश्च साम्प्रतम्। यथार्थनामा सुव्यक्तं हिमवान्हिमवान्गिरिः।।3.16.9।।
transliteration: prakṛtyā himakośāḍhyo dūrasūryaśca sāmpratam| yathārthanāmā suvyaktṃ himavānhimavāngiriḥ||3.16.9||
meaning: Presently with the Sun far away, the Himalayas abounding in snow has naturally justified its name.

sanskrit: अत्यन्तसुखसञ्चारा मध्याह्ने स्पर्शतस्सुखाः। दिवसास्सुभगादित्याश्चायासलिलदुर्भगाः।।3.16.10।।
transliteration: atyantasukhasañcārā madhyāhne sparśatassukhāḥ| divasāssubhagādityāścāyāsaliladurbhagāḥ||3.16.10||
meaning: The days are enjoyable at noon as it is pleasant to move about during this time since the sun is not scorching. But the shade and water seem to be unfortunate (as they are not liked by any one.

sanskrit: मृदुसूर्यास्सनीहाराः पटुशीतास्समारुताः। शून्यारण्या हिमध्वस्ता दिवसा भान्तिसाम्प्रतम्।।3.16.11।।
transliteration: mṛdusūryāssanīhārāḥ paṭuśītāssamārutāḥ| śūnyāraṇyā himadhvastā divasā bhāntisāmpratam||3.16.11||
meaning: The days will be frostsmitten. The Sun will also be mild. Due to heavy dewfall the weather will be cold with the blowing of the wind. Forests will be empty (as no animals would be seen moving around.)

sanskrit: निवृत्ताकाशशयनाः पुष्यनीता हिमारुणाः। शीता वृद्धतरायामास्त्रियामा यान्ति साम्प्रतम्।।3.16.12।।
transliteration: nivṛttākāśaśayanāḥ puṣyanītā himāruṇāḥ| śītā vṛddhatarāyāmāstriyāmā yānti sāmpratam||3.16.12||
meaning: At this time people do not sleep under the open sky. With the month of Pushya approaching, nights feel cool and look red due to frost. They prolong into three yamas.

sanskrit: रविसङ्क्रान्तसौभाग्य स्तुषारारुणमण्डलः। निश्श्वासान्ध इवादर्शन्छन्द्रमा न प्रकाशते।।3.16.13।।
transliteration: ravisaṅkrāntasaubhāgya stuṣārāruṇamaṇḍalḥ| niśśvāsāndha ivādarśanchandramā na prakāśate||3.16.13||
meaning: With the radiance of the Sun dimmed, with its orb reddened by frost, the moon does not shine clear like a mirror blurred with breath.

sanskrit: ज्योत्स्न तुषारमलिना पौर्णमास्यां न राजते। सीतेव चातपश्यामा लक्ष्यते न तु शोभते।।3.16.14।।
transliteration: jyotsna tuṣāramalinā paurṇamāsyāṃ na rājate| sīteva cātapaśyāmā lakṣyate na tu śobhate||3.16.14||
meaning: On a fullmoon night the beams of the moon faded by forest look pale, dull like Sita scorched by the heat of the Sun.

sanskrit: प्रकृत्या शीतलस्पर्शो हिमविद्धश्च साम्प्रतम्। प्रवाति पश्चिमो वायुः काले द्विगुणशीतलः।।3.16.15।।
transliteration: prakṛtyā śītalasparśo himaviddhaśca sāmpratam| pravāti paścimo vāyuḥ kāle dviguṇaśītalḥ||3.16.15||
meaning: The west wind which by nature feels cold at this time blows doubly cold, hit by snow.

sanskrit: बाष्पच्छन्नान्यरण्यानि यवगोधूमवन्ति च। शोभन्तेऽभ्युदिते सूर्ये नद्भि क्रौञ्चसारसैः।।3.16.16।।
transliteration: bāṣpacchannānyaraṇyāni yavagodhūmavanti ca| śobhante'bhyudite sūrye nadbhi krauñcasārasaiḥ||3.16.16||
meaning: The snowcold forest terrains are fertile with barley and wheat crops. As the Sun rises the swans and kraunchas produce pleasing notes.

sanskrit: खर्जूरपुष्पाकृतिभिश्शिरोभिः पूर्णतण्डुलैः। शोभन्ते किञ्चिदानम्राश्शालयः कनकप्रभाः।।3.16.17।।
transliteration: kharjūrapuṣpākṛtibhiśśirobhiḥ pūrṇataṇḍulaiḥ| śobhante kiñcidānamrāśśālayḥ kanakaprabhāḥ||3.16.17||
meaning: The tops of rice crops shining like gold resemble the flowers of datepalm.The fields full of ripe paddy bending a little (under the weight of grains) look delightful.

sanskrit: मयूखैरुपसर्पद्भिर्हिमनीहारसंवृतैः। दूरमभ्युदितस्सूर्यश्शशाङ्क इव लक्ष्यते।।3.16.18।।
transliteration: mayūkhairupasarpadbhirhimanīhārasṃvṛtaiḥ| dūramabhyuditassūryaśśaśāṅka iva lakṣyate||3.16.18||
meaning: The Sun risen at the distant horizon looks like the Moon, his lengthening rays covered with snow and dew.

sanskrit: अग्राह्यवीर्यः पूर्वाह्णे मध्याह्ने स्पर्शतस्सुखः। संरक्तः किञ्चिदापाण्डुरातपश्शोभते क्षितौ।।3.16.19।।
transliteration: agrāhyavīryḥ pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne sparśatassukhḥ| sṃraktḥ kiñcidāpāṇḍurātapaśśobhate kṣitau||3.16.19||
meaning: The heat of the Sun which we do not feel in the forenoon is comfortable during midday when the Sun shines slightly reddish white on earth.

sanskrit: अवश्यायनिपातेन किञ्चित्प्रक्लिन्नशाद्वला। वनानां शोभते भूमिर्निविष्टतरुणातपा।।3.16.20।।
transliteration: avaśyāyanipātena kiñcitpraklinnaśādvalā| vanānāṃ śobhate bhūmirniviṣṭataruṇātapā||3.16.20||
meaning: As the miadows are wet with dewdrops, the land looks delightful with mild Sunlight shining on the surface.

sanskrit: स्पृशंस्तु विमलं शीतमुदकं द्विरदस्सुखम्। अत्यन्ततृषितो वन्यः प्रतिसंहरते करम्।।3.16.21।।
transliteration: spṛśṃstu vimalṃ śītamudakṃ dviradassukham| atyantatṛṣito vanyḥ pratisṃharate karam||3.16.21||
meaning: The wild tusker, extremely thirsty, touches the clean, cold water joyfully, but immediately withdraws its trunk unable to bear the cold.

sanskrit: एते हि समुपासीना विहगा जलचारिणः। नावगाहन्ति सलिलमप्रगल्भा इवाहवम्।।3.16.22।।
transliteration: ete hi samupāsīnā vihagā jalacāriṇḥ| nāvagāhanti salilamapragalbhā ivāhavam||3.16.22||
meaning: Just as inefficient warriors do not enter the warfield, aquatic birds sitting near water do not venture to take a plunge into it.

sanskrit: अवश्यायतमोनद्धा नीहारतमसाऽवृताः। प्रसुप्ता इव लक्ष्यन्ते विपुष्पा वनराजयः।।3.16.23।।
transliteration: avaśyāyatamonaddhā nīhāratamasā'vṛtāḥ| prasuptā iva lakṣyante vipuṣpā vanarājayḥ||3.16.23||
meaning: The flowerless forest ranges appear as if they are asleep, enveloped in the darkness of frost and snow .

sanskrit: बाष्पसञ्छन्नसलिला रुतविज्ञेयसारसाः। हिमार्द्रवालुकैस्तीरैस्सरितो भान्ति साम्प्रतम्।।3.16.24।।
transliteration: bāṣpasañchannasalilā rutavijñeyasārasāḥ| himārdravālukaistīraissarito bhānti sāmpratam||3.16.24||
meaning: Now the rivers are not visible as the waters are covered with vapour. They are only inferred through the cackling of swans and the sands of the bank moistened with dewdrops.

sanskrit: तुषारपतनाच्चैव मृदुत्वाद्भास्करस्य च। शैत्यादगाग्रस्थमपि प्रायेण रसवज्जलम्।।3.16.25।।
transliteration: tuṣārapatanāccaiva mṛdutvādbhāskarasya ca| śaityādagāgrasthamapi prāyeṇa rasavajjalam||3.16.25||
meaning: Due to snowfall, mildness of the Sun, and coldness (of weather) even the water flowing from the mountain top is not generally tasty.

sanskrit: जराजर्जरितैः पद्मैशशीर्णकेसरकर्णिकैः। नालषेर्हिमध्वस्सैर्न भन्ति कमलाकराः।।3.16.26।।
transliteration: jarājarjaritaiḥ padmaiśaśīrṇakesarakarṇikaiḥ| nālaṣerhimadhvassairna bhanti kamalākarāḥ||3.16.26||
meaning: The lotuses in the tank no more shine (bright) as they are decayed by age, their filaments and pericarps withered with only stalks remaining.

sanskrit: अस्मिंस्तु पुरुषव्याघ्रः काले दुःखसमन्वितः। तपश्चरति धर्मात्मा त्वद्भक्त्या भरतः पुरे।।3.16.27।।
transliteration: asmiṃstu puruṣavyāghrḥ kāle duḥkhasamanvitḥ| tapaścarati dharmātmā tvadbhaktyā bharatḥ pure||3.16.27||
meaning: At this time, righteous Bharata, the best among men, with his devotion to you must be sadly performing penance at his residence.

sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा राज्यं च मानं च भोगांश्च विविधान्बहून्। तपस्स्वी नियताहारश्शेते शीते महीतले।।3.16.28।।
transliteration: tyaktvā rājyṃ ca mānṃ ca bhogāṃśca vividhānbahūn| tapassvī niyatāhāraśśete śīte mahītale||3.16.28||
meaning: Giving up his kingdom, honour and pleasures of many kinds, Bharata will be living like an ascetic, sleeping on the ground in cold weather, his food under restriction.

sanskrit: सोऽपि वेलामिमां नूनमभिषेकार्थमुद्यतः। वृतः प्रकृतिभिर्नित्यं प्रयाति सरयूं नदीम्।।3.16.29।।
transliteration: so'pi velāmimāṃ nūnamabhiṣekārthamudyatḥ| vṛtḥ prakṛtibhirnityṃ prayāti sarayūṃ nadīm||3.16.29||
meaning: At this time, Bharata, accompanied by his subjects, must be daily going to river Sarayu for ablution.

sanskrit: अत्यन्तसुखसंवृद्धस्सुकुमारस्सुखोचितः। कथं न्वपररात्रेषु सरयूमवगाहते।।3.16.30।।
transliteration: atyantasukhasṃvṛddhassukumārassukhocitḥ| kathṃ nvapararātreṣu sarayūmavagāhate||3.16.30||
meaning: How can Bharata who was brought up in luxury, who is delicate, and deserves all comfort, take a dip in river Sarayu (in cold morning) ?

sanskrit: पद्मपत्रेक्षणो वीरश्श्यामो निरुदरो महान्। धर्मज्ञ स्सत्यवादी च ह्रीनिषेधो जितेन्द्रियः।।3.16.31।। प्रियाभिभाषी मधुरो दीर
transliteration: padmapatrekṣaṇo vīraśśyāmo nirudaro mahān| dharmajña ssatyavādī ca hrīniṣedho jitendriyḥ||3.16.31|| priyābhibhāṣī madhur
meaning: He has a blue complexion, a pair of eyes like lotus petals, a thin waist and long arms. He is selfrestrained, softspoken, sweettempered and truthful. He knows his duty and maintains a low profile. A subduer of enemies, h

sanskrit: जितस्स्वर्गस्तव भ्रात्रा भरतेन महात्मना। वनस्थमपि तापस्ये यस्त्वामनुविधीयते।।3.16.33।।
transliteration: jitassvargastava bhrātrā bharatena mahātmanā| vanasthamapi tāpasye yastvāmanuvidhīyate||3.16.33||
meaning: Although you dwell in the forest, your great brother Bharata has won the kingdom of heaven by faithfully adopting your asceticism.

sanskrit: न पित्र्यमनुवर्तन्ते मातृकं द्विपदा इति। ख्यातो लोकप्रवादोऽयं भरतेनान्यथा कृतः।।3.16.34।।
transliteration: na pitryamanuvartante mātṛkṃ dvipadā iti| khyāto lokapravādo'yṃ bharatenānyathā kṛtḥ||3.16.34||
meaning: The saying that men follow mother's path but not the path of the father, has been disproved by Bharata.

sanskrit: भर्ता दशरथो यस्यास्साधुश्च भरतस्सुतः। कथं नु साऽम्बा कैकेयी तादृशी क्रूरशीलिनी।।3.16.35।।
transliteration: bhartā daśaratho yasyāssādhuśca bharatassutḥ| kathṃ nu sā'mbā kaikeyī tādṛśī krūraśīlinī||3.16.35||
meaning: How could mother Kaikeyi, who has a husband like Dasaratha and a noble son like Bharata, be so wicked by nature ?

sanskrit: इत्येवं लक्ष्मणे वाक्यं स्नेहाद्ब्रुवति धार्मिके। परिवादं जनन्यास्तमसहन्राघवोऽब्रवीत्।।3.16.36।।
transliteration: ityevṃ lakṣmaṇe vākyṃ snehādbruvati dhārmike| parivādṃ jananyāstamasahanrāghavo'bravīt||3.16.36||
meaning: When pious Lakshmana said thus to Rama out of his love for him, Rama replied, unable to tolerate the words of censure against mother (Kaikeyi) :

sanskrit: स तेऽम्बा मध्यमा तात गर्हितव्या कथञ्चन। तामेवेक्ष्वाकुनाथस्य भरतस्य कथां कुरु।।3.16.37।।
transliteration: sa te'mbā madhyamā tāta garhitavyā kathañcana| tāmevekṣvākunāthasya bharatasya kathāṃ kuru||3.16.37||
meaning: O dear, Kaikeyi, our second mother, is never to be criticised like that. You may, however, speak more of Bharata, the lord of the Iksvakus.

sanskrit: निश्चिताऽपि हि मे बुद्धिर्वनवासे दृढव्रता। भरतस्नेहसन्तप्ता बालिशीक्रियते पुनः।।3.16.38।।
transliteration: niścitā'pi hi me buddhirvanavāse dṛḍhavratā| bharatasnehasantaptā bāliśīkriyate punḥ||3.16.38||
meaning: Even though I have made up my mind to dwell in the forest and keep my vow, my love for Bharata makes me waver like a child (Rama does not want Bharata to suffer on his account).

sanskrit: संस्मराम्यस्य वाक्यानि प्रियाणि मधुराणि च। हृद्यान्यमृतकल्पानि मनःप्रह्लादनानि च।।3.16.39।।
transliteration: sṃsmarāmyasya vākyāni priyāṇi madhurāṇi ca| hṛdyānyamṛtakalpāni manḥprahlādanāni ca||3.16.39||
meaning: I remember his dear, sweet, ambrosial words, soothing to the heart and pleasing to the mind.

sanskrit: कदान्वहं समेष्यामि भरतेन महात्मना। शत्रुघ्नेन च वीरेण त्वया च रघुनन्दन।।3.16.40।।
transliteration: kadānvahṃ sameṣyāmi bharatena mahātmanā| śatrughnena ca vīreṇa tvayā ca raghunandana||3.16.40||
meaning: O enhancer of joy of the Raghus when shall I meet great Bharata, brave Satrughna and you all together?

sanskrit: इत्येवं विलपंस्तत्र प्राप्य गोदावरीं नदीम्। चक्रेऽभिषेकं काकुत्स्थस्सानुजस्सह सीतया।।3.16.41।।
transliteration: ityevṃ vilapṃstatra prāpya godāvarīṃ nadīm| cakre'bhiṣekṃ kākutsthassānujassaha sītayā||3.16.41||
meaning: Expressing his grief in such manner, Rama reached Godavari where he took his bath with his brother and Sita.

sanskrit: तर्पयित्वाऽथ सलिलैस्ते पितृ़न्दैवतानि च। स्तुवन्ति स्मोदितं सूर्यं देवताश्च समाहिताः।।3.16.42।।
transliteration: tarpayitvā'tha salilaiste pitṛ़ndaivatāni ca| stuvanti smoditṃ sūryṃ devatāśca samāhitāḥ||3.16.42||
meaning: And then poised, they offered libations of water to their forefathers and gods and prayer to the rising Sun.

sanskrit: कृताभिषेकस्सरराज रामः सीताद्वितीयस्सह लक्ष्मणेन। कृताभिषेको गिरिराजपुत्र्या रुद्रस्सनन्दी भगवानिवेशः।।3.16.43।।
transliteration: kṛtābhiṣekassararāja rāmḥ sītādvitīyassaha lakṣmaṇena| kṛtābhiṣeko girirājaputryā rudrassanandī bhagavāniveśḥ||3.16.43||
meaning: Accompanied by Sita and Lakshmana,Rama finished his bath in the river.He looked splendid like Lord Rudra followed by Nandi and the daughter of the king of the mountains (Parvati). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिका

sanskrit: आश्रमं तमुपागम्य राघवस्सह लक्ष्मणः। कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकं कर्म पर्णशालामुपागमत्।।3.17.2।।
transliteration: āśramṃ tamupāgamya rāghavassaha lakṣmaṇḥ| kṛtvā paurvāhṇikṃ karma parṇaśālāmupāgamat||3.17.2||
meaning: On reaching the hermitage, Rama and Lakshmana performed the forenoon rituals and entered the leafthatched cottage.

sanskrit: उवास सुखितस्तत्र पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा चकार विविधाः कथाः।।3.17.3।।
transliteration: uvāsa sukhitastatra pūjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ| lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā cakāra vividhāḥ kathāḥ||3.17.3||
meaning: Honoured by the ascetics , Rama stayed there peacefully with brother Lakshmana, discussing diverse matters (from time to time).

sanskrit: स रामः पर्णशालायामासीनस्सह सीतया। विरराज महाबाहुश्चित्रया चन्द्रमाः इव।।3.17.4।।
transliteration: sa rāmḥ parṇaśālāyāmāsīnassaha sītayā| virarāja mahābāhuścitrayā candramāḥ iva||3.17.4||
meaning: Longarmed Rama seated with Sita in the cottage, appeared like the Moon in conjunction with constellation Chitra.

sanskrit: तदाऽऽसीनस्य रामस्य कथासंसक्तचेतसः। तं देशं राक्षसी काचिदाजगाम यदृच्छया।।3.17.5।।
transliteration: tadā''sīnasya rāmasya kathāsṃsaktacetasḥ| tṃ deśṃ rākṣasī kācidājagāma yadṛcchayā||3.17.5||
meaning: While Rama was thus seated, engrossed in conversation, there incidentally appeared a demoness.

sanskrit: सा तु शूर्पणखा नाम दशग्रीवस्य राक्षसः। भगिनी राममासाद्य ददर्श त्रिदशोपमम्।।3.17.6।।
transliteration: sā tu śūrpaṇakhā nāma daśagrīvasya rākṣasḥ| bhaginī rāmamāsādya dadarśa tridaśopamam||3.17.6||
meaning: Surpanakha, sister of the tenheaded demon (Ravana) approached Rama shining like a god.

sanskrit: सिंहोरस्कं महाबाहुं पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणम्। आजानुबाहुं दीप्तास्यमतीव प्रियदर्शनम्।।3.17.7।। गजविक्रान्तगमनं जटामण्डलधारिणम्।
transliteration: siṃhoraskṃ mahābāhuṃ padmapatranibhekṣaṇam| ājānubāhuṃ dīptāsyamatīva priyadarśanam||3.17.7|| gajavikrāntagamanṃ jaṭāmaṇ
meaning: The demoness was infatuated with Rama, whose chest was like that of a lion, who was strongarmed, who had a glowing face, pleasing to the eyes, who walked with the gait of an elephant, whose hair was matted, who was gentl

sanskrit: सुमुखं दुर्मुखी रामं वृत्तमध्यं महोदरी। विशालाक्षं विरूपाक्षी सुकेशं ताम्रमूर्धजा।।3.17.10।। प्रीतिरूपं विरूपा सा सुस्वर
transliteration: sumukhṃ durmukhī rāmṃ vṛttamadhyṃ mahodarī| viśālākṣṃ virūpākṣī sukeśṃ tāmramūrdhajā||3.17.10|| prītirūpṃ virūpā sā susv
meaning: Rama's face was lovely, Surpanakha's was hideous. Rama had a slender waist, she had a huge belly. His eyes were large, hers were deformed. His hair was black and beautiful, hers was coppercoloured. He was lovely in appea

sanskrit: जटी तापसरूपेण सभार्यश्शरचापधृत्। आगतस्त्वमिमं देशं कथं राक्षससेवितम्।।3.17.13।। किमागमनकृत्यं ते तत्त्वमाख्यातुमर्हसि।
transliteration: jaṭī tāpasarūpeṇa sabhāryaśśaracāpadhṛt| āgatastvamimṃ deśṃ kathṃ rākṣasasevitam||3.17.13|| kimāgamanakṛtyṃ te tattvamāk
meaning: O Rama you are wearing matted hair like an ascetic, but living with your wife and holding bow and arrows. What brings you to this place haunted by demons ? You should tell me the truth ?

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु राक्षस्या शूर्पणख्या परन्तपः।।3.17.14।। ऋजुबुद्धितया सर्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे।
transliteration: evamuktastu rākṣasyā śūrpaṇakhyā parantapḥ||3.17.14|| ṛjubuddhitayā sarvamākhyātumupacakrame|
meaning: Thus asked by the demoness Surpanakha, Rama, scorcher of foes began telling her everything due to his simplemindedness.

sanskrit: अनृतं न हि रामस्य कदाचिदपि सम्मतम्।।3.17.15।। विशेषेणाऽश्रमस्थस्य समीपे स्त्रीजनस्य च।
transliteration: anṛtṃ na hi rāmasya kadācidapi sammatam||3.17.15|| viśeṣeṇā'śramasthasya samīpe strījanasya ca|
meaning: To Rama untruth is never acceptable at the hermitage and especially in the presence of a woman.

sanskrit: आसीद्धशरथो नाम राजा त्रिदशविक्रमः।।3.17.16।। तस्याहमग्रजः पुत्रो रामो नाम जनैश्श्रुतः।
transliteration: āsīddhaśaratho nāma rājā tridaśavikramḥ||3.17.16|| tasyāhamagrajḥ putro rāmo nāma janaiśśrutḥ|
meaning: (Rama replied) There was a king named Dasaratha who was mighty like the gods. I am his eldest son known among the people as Rama.

sanskrit: भ्राताऽयं लक्ष्मणो नाम यवीयान्मामनुव्रतः।।3.17.17।। इयं भार्या च वैदेही मम सीतेति विश्रुता।
transliteration: bhrātā'yṃ lakṣmaṇo nāma yavīyānmāmanuvratḥ||3.17.17|| iyṃ bhāryā ca vaidehī mama sīteti viśrutā|
meaning: Here is Lakshmana , my younger brother, who always follows me . And this is the daughter of the king of Videha and my wife, wellknown as Sita.

sanskrit: नियोगात् तु नरेन्द्रस्य पितुर्मातुश्च यन्त्रितः।।3.17.18।। धर्मार्थं धर्मकाङ्क्षी च वनं वस्तुमिहागतः।
transliteration: niyogāt tu narendrasya piturmātuśca yantritḥ||3.17.18|| dharmārthṃ dharmakāṅkṣī ca vanṃ vastumihāgatḥ|
meaning: I have come here, commanded by the king, my father and mother.Intending to obey the orders of my father, and impelled by duty to establish righteousness I have come to reside here.

sanskrit: त्वां तु वेदितुमिच्छामि कस्य त्वं कासि कस्य वा।।3.17.19।। त्वं हि तावन्मनोज्ञाङ्गी राक्षसी प्रतिभासि मे।
transliteration: tvāṃ tu veditumicchāmi kasya tvṃ kāsi kasya vā||3.17.19|| tvṃ hi tāvanmanojñāṅgī rākṣasī pratibhāsi me|
meaning: I wish to know who you are. Tell me who your kins are. With lovely limbs you do not appear to be a demoness.

sanskrit: इह वा किंनिमित्तं त्वमागता ब्रूहि तत्त्वत:।।3.17.20।। साब्रवीद् वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसी मदनार्दिता।
transliteration: iha vā kiṃnimittṃ tvamāgatā brūhi tattvata:||3.17.20|| sābravīd vacanṃ śrutvā rākṣasī madanārditā|
meaning: Tell me truly what you have come here for. Having heard the words of Rama and overtaken by passion, the demoness said:

sanskrit: श्रूयतां राम वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वार्थं वचनं मम। 3.17.21।। अहं शूर्पणखा नाम राक्षसी कामरूपिणी। अरण्यं विचरामीदमेका सर्वभयङ्कर
transliteration: śrūyatāṃ rāma vakṣyāmi tattvārthṃ vacanṃ mama| 3.17.21|| ahṃ śūrpaṇakhā nāma rākṣasī kāmarūpiṇī| araṇyṃ vicarāmīdamekā s
meaning: My name is Surpanakha. I am a demoness who can assume any form at will, I move in this forest alone, unleashing a reign of terror.

sanskrit: रावणो नाम मे भ्राता बलीयान्राक्षसेश्वरः। वीरो विश्रवसः पुत्रो यदि ते श्रोत्रमागतः।।3.17.23।।
transliteration: rāvaṇo nāma me bhrātā balīyānrākṣaseśvarḥ| vīro viśravasḥ putro yadi te śrotramāgatḥ||3.17.23||
meaning: My brother is Ravana, son of Visrava, and lord of all demons. You have heard his name I suppose.

sanskrit: प्रवृद्धनिद्रश्च सदा कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः। विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा न तु राक्षसचेष्टितः।।3.17.24।। प्रख्यातवीर्यौ च रणे भ्रातरौ
transliteration: pravṛddhanidraśca sadā kumbhakarṇo mahābalḥ| vibhīṣaṇastu dharmātmā na tu rākṣasaceṣṭitḥ||3.17.24|| prakhyātavīryau ca r
meaning: Kumbhakarna is another brother of mine. He is very strong. He is always in deep sleep. Vibhisna another brother. He is righteous free from any demoniac trait. My other two brothers are Khara and Dusana who are wellknown

sanskrit: तानहं समतिक्रान्ता राम त्वा पूर्वदर्शनात्।।3.17.25।। समुपेतास्मि भावेन भर्तारं पुरुषोत्तमम्।
transliteration: tānahṃ samatikrāntā rāma tvā pūrvadarśanāt||3.17.25|| samupetāsmi bhāvena bhartārṃ puruṣottamam|
meaning: Setting them aside, I came here, as soon as I saw you. You are the finest among men and I am here wishing you to be my husband.

sanskrit: अहं प्रभावसम्पन्ना स्वच्छन्दबलगामिनी।।3.17.26।। चिराय भव मे भर्ता सीतया किं करिष्यसि।
transliteration: ahṃ prabhāvasampannā svacchandabalagāminī||3.17.26|| cirāya bhava me bhartā sītayā kiṃ kariṣyasi|
meaning: I have influence over others, I have capacity to move wherever I want. Be my husband forever. What will you do with Sita?

sanskrit: विकृता च विरूपा च न चेयं सदृशी तव।।3.17.27।। अहमेवानुरूपा ते भार्या रूपेण पश्य माम्।
transliteration: vikṛtā ca virūpā ca na ceyṃ sadṛśī tava||3.17.27|| ahamevānurūpā te bhāryā rūpeṇa paśya mām|
meaning: She is ugly, deformed, unsuitable for you. I am alone fit for you. Look upon me as your wife.

sanskrit: इमां विरूपामसतीं करालां निर्णतोदरीम्।।3.17.28।। अनेन ते सह भ्रात्रा भक्षयिष्यामि मानुषीम्।
transliteration: imāṃ virūpāmasatīṃ karālāṃ nirṇatodarīm||3.17.28|| anena te saha bhrātrā bhakṣayiṣyāmi mānuṣīm|
meaning: I will devour your brother along with this disfigured, unchaste and fearful lady with a flat belly.

sanskrit: ततः पर्वतशृङ्गाणि वनानि विविधानि च।।3.17.29।। पश्यन्सह मया कान्त दण्डकान्विचरिष्यसि।
transliteration: tatḥ parvataśṛṅgāṇi vanāni vividhāni ca||3.17.29|| paśyansaha mayā kānta daṇḍakānvicariṣyasi|
meaning: O darling, thereafter you can keep wandering with me in this Dandaka forest, enjoying the beauty of the mountain tops and forests.

sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्तः काकुत्स्थः प्रहस्य मदिरेक्षणाम्।।3.17.30।। इदं वचनमारेभे वक्तुं वाक्यविशारदः।
transliteration: ityevamuktḥ kākutsthḥ prahasya madirekṣaṇām||3.17.30|| idṃ vacanamārebhe vaktuṃ vākyaviśāradḥ|
meaning: Thus addressed, Rama, skilled in speech, laughed and started speaking to that woman of bewitching eyes. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्तदशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventeenth sarga of Aranyaka

sanskrit: कृतदारोऽस्मि भवति भार्येयं दयिता मम। त्वद्विधानां तु नारीणां सुदुःखा ससपत्नता।।3.18.2।।
transliteration: kṛtadāro'smi bhavati bhāryeyṃ dayitā mama| tvadvidhānāṃ tu nārīṇāṃ suduḥkhā sasapatnatā||3.18.2||
meaning: O lady I am married and here is my wife who is dear to me. To be a cowife to some one is indeed painful for people like you.

sanskrit: अनुजस्त्वेष मे भ्राता शीलवान्प्रियदर्शनः। श्रीमानकृतदारश्च लक्ष्मणो नाम वीर्यवान्।।3.18.3।।
transliteration: anujastveṣa me bhrātā śīlavānpriyadarśanḥ| śrīmānakṛtadāraśca lakṣmaṇo nāma vīryavān||3.18.3||
meaning: Here is my younger brother Lakshmana. He is a man of good conduct, good look, valiant and virtuous. (Besides) he is not with his wife.

sanskrit: अपूर्वी भार्यया चार्थी तरुणः प्रियदर्शनः। अनुरूपश्च ते भर्ता रूपस्यास्य भविष्यति।।3.18.4।।
transliteration: apūrvī bhāryayā cārthī taruṇḥ priyadarśanḥ| anurūpaśca te bhartā rūpasyāsya bhaviṣyati||3.18.4||
meaning: He is not with his wife, and is in need of one. He is young, handsome and worthy. He will be an appropriate husband to you.

sanskrit: एनं भज विशालाक्षि भर्तारं भ्रातरं मम। असपत्ना वरारोहे मेरुमर्कप्रभा यथा।।3.18.5।।
transliteration: enṃ bhaja viśālākṣi bhartārṃ bhrātarṃ mama| asapatnā varārohe merumarkaprabhā yathā||3.18.5||
meaning: O woman of large eyes and fine hips, my brother is fit for you. You will (with him) shine like the radiant Sun on mount Meru. You will enjoy yourself without a cowife. You may approach him.

sanskrit: इति रामेण सा प्रोक्ता राक्षसी काममोहिता। विसृज्य रामं सहसा ततो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।।3.18.6।।
transliteration: iti rāmeṇa sā proktā rākṣasī kāmamohitā| visṛjya rāmṃ sahasā tato lakṣmaṇamabravīt||3.18.6||
meaning: Thus told by Rama, the demoness, deluded with lust, left him suddenly, and said to Lakshmana:

sanskrit: अस्य रूपस्य ते युक्ता भार्याहं वरवर्णिनी। मया सह सुखं सर्वान्दण्डकान्विचरिष्यसि।।3.18.7।।
transliteration: asya rūpasya te yuktā bhāryāhṃ varavarṇinī| mayā saha sukhṃ sarvāndaṇḍakānvicariṣyasi||3.18.7||
meaning: With my fine complexion, I will be a suitable wife for you. You can happily wander about in Dandaka forest with me.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु सौमित्री राक्षस्या वाक्यकोविदः। ततश्शूर्पणखीं स्मित्वा लक्ष्मणो युक्तमब्रवीत्।।3.18.8।।
transliteration: evamuktastu saumitrī rākṣasyā vākyakovidḥ| tataśśūrpaṇakhīṃ smitvā lakṣmaṇo yuktamabravīt||3.18.8||
meaning: Thus addressed by the demoness Lakshmana, son of Sumitra, wellversed in the use of words gave her a befitting reply :

sanskrit: कथं दासस्य मे दासी भार्या भवितुमिच्छसि। सोऽहमार्येण परवान्भ्रात्रा कमलवर्णिनि।।3.18.9।।
transliteration: kathṃ dāsasya me dāsī bhāryā bhavitumicchasi| so'hamāryeṇa paravānbhrātrā kamalavarṇini||3.18.9||
meaning: O lotuscomplexioned woman , how can you act as a maid to a slave ? Why do you intend to be so? I am already dependent on my revered brother.

sanskrit: समृद्धार्थस्य सिद्धार्था मुदितामलवर्णिनी। आर्यस्य त्वं विशालाक्षि भार्या भव यवीयसी।।3.18.10।।
transliteration: samṛddhārthasya siddhārthā muditāmalavarṇinī| āryasya tvṃ viśālākṣi bhāryā bhava yavīyasī||3.18.10||
meaning: O largeeyed one, you have a clear complexion. You may become the younger wife of my master who is lord of great wealth. And live a happy, fulfilled life.

sanskrit: एनां विरूपामसतीं करालां निर्णतोदरीम्। भार्यां वृद्धां परित्यज्य त्वामेवैष भजिष्यति।।3.18.11।।
transliteration: enāṃ virūpāmasatīṃ karālāṃ nirṇatodarīm| bhāryāṃ vṛddhāṃ parityajya tvāmevaiṣa bhajiṣyati||3.18.11||
meaning: He will abandon this uglylooking, unchaste, frightening old woman of drooping belly and accept you alone as his wife.

sanskrit: को हि रूपमिदं श्रेष्ठं संत्यज्य वरवर्णिनि। मानुषीषु वरारोहे कुर्याद्भावं विचक्षणः।।3.18.12।।
transliteration: ko hi rūpamidṃ śreṣṭhṃ sṃtyajya varavarṇini| mānuṣīṣu varārohe kuryādbhāvṃ vicakṣaṇḥ||3.18.12||
meaning: O lady of fair complexion and beautiful hips, which wise man will fall in love with any other female giving up a fine figure like you ?

sanskrit: इति सा लक्ष्मणेनोक्ता कराला निर्णतोदरी। मन्यते तद्वचस्तथ्यं परिहासाविचक्षणा।।3.18.13।।
transliteration: iti sā lakṣmaṇenoktā karālā nirṇatodarī| manyate tadvacastathyṃ parihāsāvicakṣaṇā||3.18.13||
meaning: While Lakshmana was thus making fun of the dreadful, droopingbellied Surpanakha, she presumed his words to be true.

sanskrit: सा रामं पर्णशालायामुपविष्टं परन्तपम्। सीतया सह दुर्दर्षमब्रवीत्काममोहिता।।3.18.14।।
transliteration: sā rāmṃ parṇaśālāyāmupaviṣṭṃ parantapam| sītayā saha durdarṣamabravītkāmamohitā||3.18.14||
meaning: Deluded with passion, Surpanakha said to formidable Rama, the scorcher of foes, seated in the leafthatched hut along with Sita:

sanskrit: एनां विरूपामसतीं करालां निर्णतोदरीम्। वृद्धां भार्यामवष्टभ्य मां न त्वं बहुमन्यसे।।3.18.15।।
transliteration: enāṃ virūpāmasatīṃ karālāṃ nirṇatodarīm| vṛddhāṃ bhāryāmavaṣṭabhya māṃ na tvṃ bahumanyase||3.18.15||
meaning: You are holding on to this lady who is ugly, unchaste, fiercelooking, flatbellied and aged and not caring for me.

sanskrit: अद्येमां भक्षयिष्यामि पश्यतस्तव मानुषीम्। त्वया सह चरिष्यामि निस्सपत्ना यथासुखम्।।3.18.16।।
transliteration: adyemāṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmi paśyatastava mānuṣīm| tvayā saha cariṣyāmi nissapatnā yathāsukham||3.18.16||
meaning: I shall eat up this woman now before your very eyes and I can move about happily with you without a cowife.

sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा मृगशाबाक्षीमलातसदृशेक्षणा। अभ्यधावत्सुसङ्कृद्धा महोल्कां रोहिणीमिव।।3.18.17।।
transliteration: ityuktvā mṛgaśābākṣīmalātasadṛśekṣaṇā| abhyadhāvatsusaṅkṛddhā maholkāṃ rohiṇīmiva||3.18.17||
meaning: While speaking this, Surpanakha, with eyes like flaming amber ran to the fawneyed Sita in great anger like a giant meteor hurtling towards the constellation of Rohini :

sanskrit: तां मृत्युपाशप्रतिमामापतन्तीं महाबलः। निगृह्य रामः कुपित स्ततो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।।3.18.18।।
transliteration: tāṃ mṛtyupāśapratimāmāpatantīṃ mahābalḥ| nigṛhya rāmḥ kupita stato lakṣmaṇamabravīt||3.18.18||
meaning: Mighty Rama in a rage restrained her who was falling upon Sita like the noose of death, and said to Lakshmana:

sanskrit: क्रूरैरनार्यै स्सौमित्रे परिहासः कथञ्चन। न कार्यः पश्यवैदेहीं कथञ्चित्सौम्य जीवतीम्।।3.18.19।।
transliteration: krūrairanāryai ssaumitre parihāsḥ kathañcana| na kāryḥ paśyavaidehīṃ kathañcitsaumya jīvatīm||3.18.19||
meaning: O handsome Lakshmana it is not proper to cut jokes with wicked, uncivilized persons. Now see Sita who has somehow survived.

sanskrit: इमां विरूपामसतीमतिमत्तां महोदरीम्। राक्षसीं पुरुषव्याघ्र विरूपयितुमर्हसि।।3.18.20।।
transliteration: imāṃ virūpāmasatīmatimattāṃ mahodarīm| rākṣasīṃ puruṣavyāghra virūpayitumarhasi||3.18.20||
meaning: O tiger among men, this uncouth, bigbellied, unchaste and highly passionate demoness deserves to be formed.

sanskrit: इत्युक्तो लक्ष्मणस्तस्याः क्रुद्धो रामस्य पार्श्वतः। उद्धृत्य खङ्गं चिच्छेद कर्णनासं महाबलः।।3.18.21।।
transliteration: ityukto lakṣmaṇastasyāḥ kruddho rāmasya pārśvatḥ| uddhṛtya khaṅgṃ ciccheda karṇanāsṃ mahābalḥ||3.18.21||
meaning: Thus instructed (by Rama), powerful Lakshmana took position by the side of Rama, angrily lifted the sword and cut off her nose and ears.

sanskrit: निकृत्तकर्णनासा तु विस्वरं सा विनद्य च। यथागतं प्रदुद्राव घोरा शूर्पणखा वनम्।।3.18.22।।
transliteration: nikṛttakarṇanāsā tu visvarṃ sā vinadya ca| yathāgatṃ pradudrāva ghorā śūrpaṇakhā vanam||3.18.22||
meaning: Dreadful Surpanakha with her ears and nose cut off, roared in a hoarse voice and ran away into the forest in the same direction as she came.

sanskrit: सा विरूपा महाघोरा राक्षसी शोणितोक्षिता। ननाद विविधान्नादान्यथा प्रावृषि तोयदः।।3.18.23।।
transliteration: sā virūpā mahāghorā rākṣasī śoṇitokṣitā| nanāda vividhānnādānyathā prāvṛṣi toyadḥ||3.18.23||
meaning: The dreadful demoness who thus was disfigured. Drenched in blood, she thundered like a cloud in rainy season.

sanskrit: सा विक्षरन्ती रुधिरं बहुधा घोरदर्शना। प्रगृह्य बाहू गर्जन्ती प्रविवेश महावनम्।।3.18.24।।
transliteration: sā vikṣarantī rudhirṃ bahudhā ghoradarśanā| pragṛhya bāhū garjantī praviveśa mahāvanam||3.18.24||
meaning: Dripping blood profusely, the frightful demoness lifted her arms and entered the great forestroaring.

sanskrit: ततस्तु सा राक्षससङ्घसंवृतं खरं जनस्थानगतं विरूपिता। उपेत्य तं भ्रातरमुग्रदर्शनं पपात भूमौ गगनाद्यथाऽशनिः।।3.18.25।।
transliteration: tatastu sā rākṣasasaṅghasṃvṛtṃ kharṃ janasthānagatṃ virūpitā| upetya tṃ bhrātaramugradarśanṃ papāta bhūmau gaganādyathā'
meaning: A disfigured demoness, she fell down like the thunderbolt from the sky on the ground while her fiercelooking brother Khara sat surrounded by demons at Janasthana.

sanskrit: ततस्सभार्यं भयमोहमूर्छिता सलक्ष्मणं राघवमागतं वनम्। विरूपणं चात्मनि शोणितोक्षिता शशंस सर्वं भगिनी खरस्य सा।।3.18.26।।
transliteration: tatassabhāryṃ bhayamohamūrchitā salakṣmaṇṃ rāghavamāgatṃ vanam| virūpaṇṃ cātmani śoṇitokṣitā śaśṃsa sarvṃ bhaginī kharas
