meaning: Thereafter the sister of Khara, wild with fear and delusion and drenched in blood, narrated all about the arrival of Rama, Sita and Lakshmana in the forest and her disfigurement. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव

sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठ तावदाख्याहि प्रमोहं जहि सम्भ्रमम्। व्यक्तमाख्याहि केन त्वमेवं रूपा विरूपिता।।3.19.2।।
transliteration: uttiṣṭha tāvadākhyāhi pramohṃ jahi sambhramam| vyaktamākhyāhi kena tvamevṃ rūpā virūpitā||3.19.2||
meaning: Get up, give up your confusion and stupefaction. Tell me clearly by whom you have been disfigured like this ?

sanskrit: कः कृष्णसर्पमासीनमाशीविषमनागसम्। तुदत्यभिसमापन्नमङ्गुल्यग्रेण लीलया।।3.19.3।।
transliteration: kḥ kṛṣṇasarpamāsīnamāśīviṣamanāgasam| tudatyabhisamāpannamaṅgulyagreṇa līlayā||3.19.3||
meaning: Who will hurt an innocent, venomous black serpent and stay away quietly close by for fun with his finger tip?

sanskrit: कः कालपाशं समासज्य कण्ठे मोहान्न बुध्यते। यस्त्वामद्य समासाद्य पीतवान्विषमुत्तमम्।।3.19.4।।
transliteration: kḥ kālapāśṃ samāsajya kaṇṭhe mohānna budhyate| yastvāmadya samāsādya pītavānviṣamuttamam||3.19.4||
meaning: Who is he who has tied has tied his throat with the noose of death out of ignorance and yet does not know the implications ? Who is he who has caused this injury to you, but does not understand that he has drunk deadly p

sanskrit: बलविक्रमसम्पन्ना कामगा कामरूपिणी। इमामवस्थां नीता त्वं केनान्तकसमागता।।3.19.5।।
transliteration: balavikramasampannā kāmagā kāmarūpiṇī| imāmavasthāṃ nītā tvṃ kenāntakasamāgatā||3.19.5||
meaning: You have sufficient strength and courage. You are capable of moving as you like and taking any form at your will. By whom have you been brought to this state and drawn close to death?

sanskrit: देवगन्धर्वभूतानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्। कोऽयमेवं विरूपां त्वां महावीर्यश्चकार ह।।3.19.6।।
transliteration: devagandharvabhūtānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca mahātmanām| ko'yamevṃ virūpāṃ tvāṃ mahāvīryaścakāra ha||3.19.6||
meaning: Which valiant person among gods, gandharvas, sages and other great people, has disfigured you like this ?

sanskrit: न हि पश्याम्यहं लोके यः कुर्यान्मम विप्रियम्। अमरेषु सहस्राक्षं महेन्द्रं पाकशासनम्।।3.19.7।।
transliteration: na hi paśyāmyahṃ loke yḥ kuryānmama vipriyam| amareṣu sahasrākṣṃ mahendrṃ pākaśāsanam||3.19.7||
meaning: I can see none in this world who can offend me, nor even the thousandeyed Indra among the gods.

sanskrit: अद्याहं मार्गणैः प्राणानादास्ये जीवितान्तकैः। सलिले क्षीरमासक्तं निष्पिबन्निव सारसः।।3.19.8।।
transliteration: adyāhṃ mārgaṇaiḥ prāṇānādāsye jīvitāntakaiḥ| salile kṣīramāsaktṃ niṣpibanniva sārasḥ||3.19.8||
meaning: Just as the swan drinks only milk from water (mixed with milk), my arrows will (unerringly) drain the life from the enemy's body right now.

sanskrit: निहतस्य मया सङ्ख्ये शरसंकृत्तमर्मणः। सफेनं रुधिरं रक्तं मेदिनी कस्य पास्यति।।3.19.9।।
transliteration: nihatasya mayā saṅkhye śarasṃkṛttamarmaṇḥ| saphenṃ rudhirṃ raktṃ medinī kasya pāsyati||3.19.9||
meaning: Whose foamy, red blood will the earth drink while I strike his vital organs with my arrows in the fight ?

sanskrit: कस्य पत्ररथाः कायान्मांसमुत्कृत्य सङ्गताः। प्रहृष्टा भक्षयिष्यन्ति निहतस्य मया रणे।।3.19.10।।
transliteration: kasya patrarathāḥ kāyānmāṃsamutkṛtya saṅgatāḥ| prahṛṣṭā bhakṣayiṣyanti nihatasya mayā raṇe||3.19.10||
meaning: Whose flesh will be eaten by cheerful flocks of (vultures), biting and tearing his body when he is killed by me in the battle ?

sanskrit: तं न देवा न गन्धर्वा न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः। मयापकृष्टं कृपणं शक्तास्त्रातुं महाहवे।।3.19.11।।
transliteration: tṃ na devā na gandharvā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ| mayāpakṛṣṭṃ kṛpaṇṃ śaktāstrātuṃ mahāhave||3.19.11||
meaning: Neither gods nor devils nor gandharvas nor even demons will have the power to rescue that hapless creature dragged by me ruthlessly in the battle.

sanskrit: उपलभ्य शनैस्संज्ञां तं मे शंसितुमर्हसि। येन त्वं दुर्विनीतेन वने विक्रम्य निर्जिता।।3.19.12।।
transliteration: upalabhya śanaissṃjñāṃ tṃ me śṃsitumarhasi| yena tvṃ durvinītena vane vikramya nirjitā||3.19.12||
meaning: You should tell me as you slowly regain your consciousness which bragart has overpowered you in the forest with his strength.

sanskrit: इति भ्रातुर्वचश्श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धस्य च विशेषतः। ततश्शूर्पणखा वाक्यं सबाष्पमिदमब्रवीत्।।3.19.13।।
transliteration: iti bhrāturvacaśśrutvā kruddhasya ca viśeṣatḥ| tataśśūrpaṇakhā vākyṃ sabāṣpamidamabravīt||3.19.13||
meaning: On hearing her angry brother, Surpanakha replied with words choked with tears:

sanskrit: तरुणौ रूपसम्पन्नौ सुकुमारौ महाबलौ। पुण्डरीकविशालाक्षौ चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरौ।।3.19.14।। फलमूलाशनौ दान्तौ तापसौ धर्मचारिणौ। प
transliteration: taruṇau rūpasampannau sukumārau mahābalau| puṇḍarīkaviśālākṣau cīrakṛṣṇājināmbarau||3.19.14|| phalamūlāśanau dāntau tāpa
meaning: Here are two young sons of Dasaratha, Rama and Lakshmana, who are gentle, handsome, strong, with eyes like white lotus, wearing deerskin and bark robes, living on fruits and roots, selfrestrained like ascetics and follow

sanskrit: गन्धर्वराजप्रतिमौ पार्थिवव्यञ्जनान्वितौ। देवौ वा मानुषौ वा तौ न तर्कयितुमुत्सहे।।3.19.16।।
transliteration: gandharvarājapratimau pārthivavyañjanānvitau| devau vā mānuṣau vā tau na tarkayitumutsahe||3.19.16||
meaning: They are kings of the gandharvas with all royal insignia. I was not able to discern whether they are gods or humans.

sanskrit: तरुणी रूपसम्पन्ना सर्वाभरणभूषिता। दृष्टा तत्र मया नारी तयोर्मध्ये सुमध्यमा।।3.19.17।।
transliteration: taruṇī rūpasampannā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā| dṛṣṭā tatra mayā nārī tayormadhye sumadhyamā||3.19.17||
meaning: I saw between them a young, beautiful woman of slender waist, adorned with all kinds of jewels.

sanskrit: ताभ्यामुभाभ्यां सम्भूय प्रमदामधिकृत्य ताम्। इमामवस्थां नीताहं यथानाथासती तथा।।3.19.18।।
transliteration: tābhyāmubhābhyāṃ sambhūya pramadāmadhikṛtya tām| imāmavasthāṃ nītāhṃ yathānāthāsatī tathā||3.19.18||
meaning: I have been subjected to this state of an orphan unfaithful woman by both of them for the sake of that lady.

sanskrit: तस्याश्चानृजुवृत्तायास्तयोश्च हतयोरहम्। सफेनं पातुमिच्छामि रुधिरं रणमूर्धनि।।3.19.19।।
transliteration: tasyāścānṛjuvṛttāyāstayośca hatayoraham| saphenṃ pātumicchāmi rudhirṃ raṇamūrdhani||3.19.19||
meaning: I wish to drink the foamy blood of that crooked woman and of both the brothers slain on the battle front.

sanskrit: एष मे प्रथमः कामः कृतस्तात त्वया भवेत्। तस्यास्तयोश्च रुधिरं पिबेयमहमाहवे।।3.19.20।।
transliteration: eṣa me prathamḥ kāmḥ kṛtastāta tvayā bhavet| tasyāstayośca rudhirṃ pibeyamahamāhave||3.19.20||
meaning: O dear this is my first wish and you must fulfil it. I will drink her blood and of the two brothers, in the battle.

sanskrit: इति तस्यां ब्रुवाणायां चतुर्दश महाबलान्। व्यादिदेश खरः क्रुद्धो राक्षसानन्तकोपमान्।।3.19.21।।
transliteration: iti tasyāṃ bruvāṇāyāṃ caturdaśa mahābalān| vyādideśa kharḥ kruddho rākṣasānantakopamān||3.19.21||
meaning: As she was speaking, the inflamed Khara ordered fourteen very strong demons, comparable to Yama, the god of death, to proceed.

sanskrit: मानुषौ शस्त्रसम्पन्नौ चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरौ। प्रविष्टौ दण्डकारण्यं घोरं प्रमदया सह।।3.19.22।।
transliteration: mānuṣau śastrasampannau cīrakṛṣṇājināmbarau| praviṣṭau daṇḍakāraṇyṃ ghorṃ pramadayā saha||3.19.22||
meaning: Two human beings equipped with weapons, clad in bark robes and deerskin have entered the dreadful Dandaka forest along with a woman of bewitching beauty.

sanskrit: तौ हत्वा तां च दुर्वृत्तामपावर्तितुमर्हथ। इयं च रुधिरं तेषां भगिनी मम पास्यति।।3.19.23।।
transliteration: tau hatvā tāṃ ca durvṛttāmapāvartitumarhatha| iyṃ ca rudhirṃ teṣāṃ bhaginī mama pāsyati||3.19.23||
meaning: I want you to get both of them along with that notorious woman killed. This sister of mine will drink their blood.

sanskrit: मनोरथोऽयमिष्टोऽस्या भगिन्या मम राक्षसाः। शीघ्रं सम्पाद्यतां तौ च प्रमथ्य स्वेन तेजसा।।3.19.24।।
transliteration: manoratho'yamiṣṭo'syā bhaginyā mama rākṣasāḥ| śīghrṃ sampādyatāṃ tau ca pramathya svena tejasā||3.19.24||
meaning: O demons quickly go and crush them with your power and fulfil my sister's sincere wish.

sanskrit: इति प्रतिसमादिष्टा राक्षसास्ते चतुर्दश। तत्र जग्मुस्तया सार्धं घना वातेरिता यथा।।3.19.25।।
transliteration: iti pratisamādiṣṭā rākṣasāste caturdaśa| tatra jagmustayā sārdhṃ ghanā vāteritā yathā||3.19.25||
meaning: Thus commanded, the fourteen demons along with Surpanakha rushed there like windblown clouds.

sanskrit: ततस्तु ते तं समुदग्रतेजसं तथापिऽतीक्ष्णप्रदरा निशाचराः। न शेकुरेनं सहसा प्रमर्दितुं वनद्विपा दीप्तमिवाग्निमुत्थितम्।।3.1
transliteration: tatastu te tṃ samudagratejasṃ tathāpi'tīkṣṇapradarā niśācarāḥ| na śekurenṃ sahasā pramardituṃ vanadvipā dīptamivāgnimutt
meaning: The nightrangers were unable to crush him(Rama) despite their sharp, glowing weapons just as wild elephants cannot face all at once the rising flame of the forest fire. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यक

sanskrit: नानामृगगणाकीर्णमृक्षशार्दूल सेवितम्। ध्वस्तवृक्षलतागुल्मं दुर्दर्शसलिलाशयम्।।3.2.2।। निष्कूजनानाशकुनिझिल्लिकागणनादितम्।
transliteration: nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇamṛkṣaśārdūla sevitam| dhvastavṛkṣalatāgulmṃ durdarśasalilāśayam||3.2.2|| niṣkūjanānāśakunijhillikāgaṇan
meaning: With Lakshmana following, Rama went through the forest, filled with herds of animals and inhabited by bears and tigers. It was a place where trees, creepers and bushes were crushed (by frequent visits of demons). It was

sanskrit: सीतया सह काकुत्स्थस्तस्मिनघोरमृगायुते। ददर्श गिरिशृङ्गाभं पुरुषादं महास्वनम्।।3.2.4।।
transliteration: sītayā saha kākutsthastasminaghoramṛgāyute| dadarśa giriśṛṅgābhṃ puruṣādṃ mahāsvanam||3.2.4||
meaning: While Rama along with Sita was wandering in the forest infested with dreadful animals, he saw a roaring cannibal resembling the peak of a mountain.

sanskrit: गम्भीराक्षं महावक्त्रं विकटं विषमोदरम्। बीभत्सं विषमं दीर्घं विकृतं घोरदर्शनम्।।3.2.5।।
transliteration: gambhīrākṣṃ mahāvaktrṃ vikaṭṃ viṣamodaram| bībhatsṃ viṣamṃ dīrghṃ vikṛtṃ ghoradarśanam||3.2.5||
meaning: He was of dreadful appearance with deep eyes, a huge face and a big belly. He looked tall, ugly and frightening.

sanskrit: वसानं चर्म वैयाघ्रं वसार्द्रं रुधिरोक्षितम्। त्रासनं सर्वभूतानां व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम्।।3.2.6।।
transliteration: vasānṃ carma vaiyāghrṃ vasārdrṃ rudhirokṣitam| trāsanṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ vyāditāsyamivāntakam||3.2.6||
meaning: Wearing a tigerskin, he resembled the god of death. With a wide, open mouth, wet with marrow and drenched with blood, he struck terror into all beings.

sanskrit: त्रीन्सिम्हान्श्चतुरो व्याघ्रान्द्वौ वृकौ पृषतान्दश। सविषाणं वसादिग्धं गजस्य च शिरो महत्। अवसज्यायसे शूले विनदन्तं महास्
transliteration: trīnsimhānścaturo vyāghrāndvau vṛkau pṛṣatāndaśa| saviṣāṇṃ vasādigdhṃ gajasya ca śiro mahat| avasajyāyase śūle vinadantṃ
meaning: Roaring loudly, he carried an iron spit in which were pierced three lions, four tigers, two wolves, ten deer and the huge head of an elephant with its tusks smeared with the fat of flesh.

sanskrit: स रामं लक्ष्मणं चैव सीतां दृष्ट्वा च मैथिलीम्। अभ्यधावत्सुसङ्कृद्धः प्रजाः काल इवान्तकः।।3.2.8।।
transliteration: sa rāmṃ lakṣmaṇṃ caiva sītāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca maithilīm| abhyadhāvatsusaṅkṛddhḥ prajāḥ kāla ivāntakḥ||3.2.8||
meaning: Looking extremely furious, he ran towards Rama, Lakshmana and Sita like the god of death rushes towards the (dying) people.

sanskrit: स कृत्वा भैरवं नादं चालयन्निव मेदिनीम्। अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीमपक्रम्य ततोऽब्रवीत्।।3.2.9।।
transliteration: sa kṛtvā bhairavṃ nādṃ cālayanniva medinīm| aṅkenādāya vaidehīmapakramya tato'bravīt||3.2.9||
meaning: Making a dreadful sound, as if shaking the earth, he took Sita on his lap, stepped aside and said:

sanskrit: युवां जटाचीरधरौ सभार्यौ क्षीणजीवितौ। प्रविष्टौ दण्डकारण्यं शरचापासिधारिणौ।।3.2.10।।
transliteration: yuvāṃ jaṭācīradharau sabhāryau kṣīṇajīvitau| praviṣṭau daṇḍakāraṇyṃ śaracāpāsidhāriṇau||3.2.10||
meaning: You both clad in bark and wearing matted hair, holding bows, arrows and swords have entered into the Dandaka forest with your wife. Your life has been cut short indeed৷৷

sanskrit: कथं तापसयोर्वां च वासः प्रमदया सह। अधर्मचारिणौ पापौ कौ युवां मुनिदूषकौ।।3.2.11।।
transliteration: kathṃ tāpasayorvāṃ ca vāsḥ pramadayā saha| adharmacāriṇau pāpau kau yuvāṃ munidūṣakau||3.2.11||
meaning: How is it that you both, dressed in the robes of ascetics, live with a woman? Leading an unrighteous and sinful life, who are you who have brought disgrace to the ascetic discipline ?

sanskrit: अहं वनमिदं दुर्गं विराधो नाम राक्षसः। चरामि सायुधो नित्यमृषिमांसानि भक्षयन्।।3.2.12।।
transliteration: ahṃ vanamidṃ durgṃ virādho nāma rākṣasḥ| carāmi sāyudho nityamṛṣimāṃsāni bhakṣayan||3.2.12||
meaning: I am a demon named Viradha. I move in this dense forest with my weapons eating the flesh of the sages.

sanskrit: इयं नारी वरारोहा मम भार्या भविष्यति। युवयोः पापयोश्चाहं पास्यामि रुधिरं मृधे।।3.2.13।।
transliteration: iyṃ nārī varārohā mama bhāryā bhaviṣyati| yuvayoḥ pāpayoścāhṃ pāsyāmi rudhirṃ mṛdhe||3.2.13||
meaning: This woman of fine hips shall be my wife. You sinners I shall drink the blood of both of you in the fight.

sanskrit: तस्यैवं ब्रुवतो दुष्टं विराधस्य दुरात्मनः। श्रुत्वा सगर्वितं वाक्यं सम्भ्रान्ता जनकात्मजा।।3.2.14।।
transliteration: tasyaivṃ bruvato duṣṭṃ virādhasya durātmanḥ| śrutvā sagarvitṃ vākyṃ sambhrāntā janakātmajā||3.2.14||
meaning: Sita, daughter of Janaka was bewildered out of fear when she heard the cruel and boastful words of that wicked Viradha.

sanskrit: सीता प्रवेपतोद्वेगात् प्रावाते कदली यथा।।3.2.15।। तां दृष्ट्वा राघवः सीतां विराधाङ्कगतां शुभाम्। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं
transliteration: sītā pravepatodvegāt prāvāte kadalī yathā||3.2.15|| tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rāghavḥ sītāṃ virādhāṅkagatāṃ śubhām| abravīllakṣmaṇṃ vāk
meaning: Seeing the auspicious Sita in the lap of Viradha shaken out of anxiety, like a plantain tree in a strong wind, Rama with his throat parched said to Lakshmana:

sanskrit: पश्य सौम्य नरेन्द्रस्य जनकस्यात्मसम्भवाम्। मम भार्यां शुभाचारां विराधाङ्के प्रवेशिताम्।।3.2.17।। अत्यन्तसुखसंमव़ृद्धां र
transliteration: paśya saumya narendrasya janakasyātmasambhavām| mama bhāryāṃ śubhācārāṃ virādhāṅke praveśitām||3.2.17|| atyantasukhasṃma
meaning: Gentle Lakshmana, see the illustrious daughter ofJanaka, a lady of good conduct, brought up in utmost comfort caught in the lap of Viradha

sanskrit: यदभिप्रेतमस्मासु प्रियं वरवृतं च यत्।।3.2.18।। कैकेय्यास्तु सुसंवृत्तं क्षिप्रमद्यैव लक्ष्मण।
transliteration: yadabhipretamasmāsu priyṃ varavṛtṃ ca yat||3.2.18|| kaikeyyāstu susṃvṛttṃ kṣipramadyaiva lakṣmaṇa|
meaning: O Lakshmana whatever Kaikeyi desired through her boons has now come true so soon.

sanskrit: या न तुष्यति राज्येन पुत्रार्थे दीर्घदर्शिनी।।3.2.19।। ययाहं सर्वभूतानां प्रियः प्रस्थापितो वनम्। अद्येदानीं सकामा सा या
transliteration: yā na tuṣyati rājyena putrārthe dīrghadarśinī||3.2.19|| yayāhṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ priyḥ prasthāpito vanam| adyedānīṃ sakāmā s
meaning: Kaikeyi, my middle mother is farsighted indeed Not content with the kingdom alone see sent me, beloved of all beings, away to the forest. Let her cherished desire be fulfilled.

sanskrit: परस्पर्शात्तु वैदेह्याः न दुःखतरमस्तिमे। पितुर्विनाशात्सौमित्रे स्वराज्यहरणात्तथा।।3.2.21।।
transliteration: parasparśāttu vaidehyāḥ na duḥkhataramastime| piturvināśātsaumitre  svarājyaharaṇāttathā||3.2.21||
meaning: O Lakshmana nothing is more sorrowful to me than the touch of Vaidehi by another. It is more painful to me than the death of my father or loss of my kingdom.

sanskrit: इति ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे बाष्पशोकपरिप्लुते। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धो रुद्धो नाग इव श्वसन्।।3.2.22।।
transliteration: iti bruvati kākutsthe bāṣpaśokapariplute| abravīllakṣmaṇḥ kruddho ruddho nāga iva śvasan||3.2.22||
meaning: As Rama was thus full of tears of sorrow, Lakshmana sighed heavily in anger like a hissing serpant in confinement. And said:

sanskrit: अनाथ इव भूतानां नाथस्त्वं वासवोपमः। मया प्रेष्येण काकुत्स्थ किमर्थं परितप्यसे।।3.2.23।।
transliteration: anātha iva bhūtānāṃ nāthastvṃ vāsavopamḥ| mayā preṣyeṇa kākutstha kimarthṃ paritapyase||3.2.23||
meaning: O Rama, you are, like Indra, lord of all beings. What makes you feel sad like an orphan when I am at your service like a servant?

sanskrit: शरेण निहतस्याद्य मया क्रुद्धेन रक्षसः। विराधस्य गतासोर्हि मही पास्यति शोणितम्।।3.2.24।।
transliteration: śareṇa nihatasyādya mayā kruddhena rakṣasḥ| virādhasya gatāsorhi mahī pāsyati śoṇitam||3.2.24||
meaning: The earth will drink the blood of Viradha with his life gone, slain by my angry arrow.

sanskrit: राज्यकामे मम क्रोधो भरते यो बभूव ह। तं विराधे प्रमोक्ष्यामि वज्री वज्रमिवाचले।।3.2.25।।
transliteration: rājyakāme mama krodho bharate yo babhūva ha| tṃ virādhe pramokṣyāmi vajrī vajramivācale||3.2.25||
meaning: Like Indra who hits the mountain with his thunderbolt, I shall release on Viradha the anger I felt against Bharata for his passion for the kingdom.

sanskrit: मम भुजबलवेगवेगितः पततु शरोऽस्य महान्महोरसि। व्यपनयतु तनोश्च जीवितं पततु ततस्समहीं विघूर्णितः।।3.2.26।।
transliteration: mama bhujabalavegavegitḥ patatu śaro'sya mahānmahorasi| vyapanayatu tanośca jīvitṃ patatu tatassamahīṃ vighūrṇitḥ||3.2.2
meaning: Spurred by the speed of my strong arms, my arrow will fall on his broad chest and separate his life from his body. Then his body reeling round and round will fall on the ground. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्

sanskrit: ते रामं पर्णशालायामुपविष्टं महाबलम्। ददृशुस्सीतया सार्धं वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च।3.20.2।।
transliteration: te rāmṃ parṇaśālāyāmupaviṣṭṃ mahābalam| dadṛśussītayā sārdhṃ vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena ca|3.20.2||
meaning: They saw mighty Rama together with Vaidehi and Lakshmana sitting in the leafthatched cottage.

sanskrit: तान्दृष्ट्वा राघवश्श्रीमानागतांस्तां च राक्षसीम्। अब्रवीद्भ्रातरं रामो लक्ष्मणं दीप्ततेजसम्।।3.20.3।।
transliteration: tāndṛṣṭvā rāghavaśśrīmānāgatāṃstāṃ ca rākṣasīm| abravīdbhrātarṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇṃ dīptatejasam||3.20.3||
meaning: Seeing the demons along with Surpanakha arrive, said the handsome Rama, scion of the Raghu dynasty to his brother Lakshmana, who was blazing like fire :

sanskrit: मुहूर्तं भव सौमित्रे सीतायाः प्रत्यनन्तरः। इमानस्या वधिष्यामि पदवीमागतानिह।।3.20.4।।
transliteration: muhūrtṃ bhava saumitre sītāyāḥ pratyanantarḥ| imānasyā vadhiṣyāmi padavīmāgatāniha||3.20.4||
meaning: O Lakshmana stand by Sita for a while. I shall kill these demons who have come here.

sanskrit: वाक्यमेतत्ततश्श्रुत्वा रामस्य विदितात्मनः। तथेति लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं रामस्य प्रत्यपूजयत्।।3.20.5।।
transliteration: vākyametattataśśrutvā rāmasya viditātmanḥ| tatheti lakṣmaṇo vākyṃ rāmasya pratyapūjayat||3.20.5||
meaning: Lakshmana heard him and in turn honoured the word of Rama, knower of the self.

sanskrit: राघवोऽपि महच्चापं चामीकरविभूषितम्। चकार सज्यं धर्मात्मा तानि रक्षांसि चाब्रवीत्।।3.20.6।।
transliteration: rāghavo'pi mahaccāpṃ cāmīkaravibhūṣitam| cakāra sajyṃ dharmātmā tāni rakṣāṃsi cābravīt||3.20.6||
meaning: Righteous Rama too, lifted up his great bow decked with gold and fastened the string and then said to the demons:

sanskrit: पुत्रौ दशरथस्यावां भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। प्रविष्टौ सीतया सार्धं दुश्चरं दण्डकावनम्।।3.20.7।।
transliteration: putrau daśarathasyāvāṃ bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau| praviṣṭau sītayā sārdhṃ duścarṃ daṇḍakāvanam||3.20.7||
meaning: We, Rama and Lakshmana, sons of Dasaratha, are brothers, who have entered the inaccessible Dandaka forest along with Sita.

sanskrit: फलमूलाशनौ दान्तौ तापसौ धर्मचारिणौ। वसन्तौ दण्डकारण्ये किमर्थमुपहिंसथ।।3.20.8।।
transliteration: phalamūlāśanau dāntau tāpasau dharmacāriṇau| vasantau daṇḍakāraṇye kimarthamupahiṃsatha||3.20.8||
meaning: Feeding on fruits and roots and following the righteous path, we are living in Dandaka forest like ascetics. Why are you torturing us?

sanskrit: युष्मान्पापात्मकान्हन्तुं विप्रकारान्महाहवे। ऋषीणां तु नियोगेन प्राप्तोऽहं सशरायुधः।।3.20.9।।
transliteration: yuṣmānpāpātmakānhantuṃ viprakārānmahāhave| ṛṣīṇāṃ tu niyogena prāpto'hṃ saśarāyudhḥ||3.20.9||
meaning: I came here equipped with bows, arrows and weapons, asked by ascetics to kill in the battle sinners like you who are offending them.

sanskrit: तिष्ठतैवात्र सन्तुष्टा नोपावर्तितुमर्हथ। यदि प्राणैरिहार्थो वा निवर्तध्वं निशाचराः।।3.20.10।।
transliteration: tiṣṭhataivātra santuṣṭā nopāvartitumarhatha| yadi prāṇairihārtho vā nivartadhvṃ niśācarāḥ||3.20.10||
meaning: If you care for your life, you may return, or else, if you please you may remain (die) here, O demons.

sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसास्ते चतुर्दश। ऊचुर्वाचं सुसंक्रुद्धा ब्रह्मघ्नाश्शूलपाणयः।।3.20.11।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanṃ śrutvā rākṣasāste caturdaśa| ūcurvācṃ  susṃkruddhā brahmaghnāśśūlapāṇayḥ||3.20.11||
meaning: At these words, the destroyers of brahmins, the fourteen demons were inflamed. They lifted their spears and spoke:

sanskrit: क्रोधमुत्पाद्य नो भर्तुः खरस्य सुमहात्मनः। त्वमेव हास्यसे प्राणानद्यास्माभिर्हतो युधि।।3.20.12।।
transliteration: krodhamutpādya no bhartuḥ kharasya sumahātmanḥ| tvameva hāsyase prāṇānadyāsmābhirhato yudhi||3.20.12||
meaning: You have incited the wrath of Khara, our great master for which you will now pay with your life in the fight.

sanskrit: का हि ते शक्तिरेकस्य बहूनां रणमूर्धनी। अस्माकमग्रतः स्थातुं किं पुनर्योद्दुमाहवे।।3.20.13।।
transliteration: kā hi te śaktirekasya bahūnāṃ raṇamūrdhanī| asmākamagratḥ sthātuṃ kiṃ punaryoddumāhave||3.20.13||
meaning: How can you face us alone? We outnumber you? Leave alone fighting, you cannot even stand in front of us.

sanskrit: एहि बाहुप्रयुक्तैर्नः परिघैश्शूलपट्टिसैः। प्राणांस्त्यक्षसि वीर्यं च धनुश्च करपीडितम्।।3.20.14।।
transliteration: ehi bāhuprayuktairnḥ parighaiśśūlapaṭṭisaiḥ| prāṇāṃstyakṣasi vīryṃ ca dhanuśca karapīḍitam||3.20.14||
meaning: Come on with daggers and sharpedged spears hurled, you will give up your life,your prowess as well as the bow held in your hand.

sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्त्वा सङ्कृद्धा राक्षसास्ते चतुर्दश। चिक्षिपुस्तानि शूलानि राघवं प्रति दुर्जयम्।।3.20.15।।
transliteration: ityevamuktvā saṅkṛddhā rākṣasāste caturdaśa| cikṣipustāni śūlāni rāghavṃ prati durjayam||3.20.15||
meaning: Saying these words, the fourteen infuriated demons hurled their spears at invincible Rama.

sanskrit: तानि शूलानि काकुत्स्थस्समस्तानि चतुर्दश। तावद्भिरेव चिच्छेद शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः।।3.20.16।।
transliteration: tāni śūlāni kākutsthassamastāni caturdaśa| tāvadbhireva ciccheda śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ||3.20.16||
meaning: All the fourteen spears hurled turned into splinters by the same number of golden arrows released by Rama.

sanskrit: ततः पश्चान्महातेजा नाराचान्सूर्यसन्निभान्। जग्राह परमक्रुद्धश्चतुर्दश शिलाशितान्।।3.20.17।।
transliteration: tatḥ paścānmahātejā nārācānsūryasannibhān| jagrāha paramakruddhaścaturdaśa śilāśitān||3.20.17||
meaning: Then the effulgent Rama, mighty angry, took fourteen arrows sharpened by stones and glowing like the Sun.

sanskrit: गृहीत्वा धनुरायम्य लक्ष्यानुद्दिश्य राक्षसान्। मुमोच राघवो बाणान्वज्रानिव शतक्रतुः।।3.20.18।।
transliteration: gṛhītvā dhanurāyamya lakṣyānuddiśya rākṣasān| mumoca rāghavo bāṇānvajrāniva śatakratuḥ||3.20.18||
meaning: Rama took the bow, stretched it and aimed at his target, the demons and sent the arrows as Indra would release the thunderbolt.

sanskrit: रुक्मपुङ्खाश्च विशिखा दीप्ता हेमविभूषिताः। ते भित्त्वा रक्षसां वेगाद्वक्षांसि रुधिराप्लुताः।3.20.19।। विनिष्पेतुस्तदा भू
transliteration: rukmapuṅkhāśca viśikhā dīptā hemavibhūṣitāḥ| te bhittvā rakṣasāṃ vegādvakṣāṃsi rudhirāplutāḥ|3.20.19|| viniṣpetustadā bh
meaning: Goldfeathered blazing arrows decorated with gold, released by Rama flew fast and pierced the chests of the demons. Drenched in blood they (the arrows) thundered (out of their chests) and plunged into the earth.

sanskrit: ते भिन्नहृदया भूमौ छिन्नमूला इव द्रुमाः।।3.20.20।। निपेतुश्शोणितार्द्राङ्गा विकृता विगतासवः।
transliteration: te bhinnahṛdayā bhūmau chinnamūlā iva drumāḥ||3.20.20|| nipetuśśoṇitārdrāṅgā vikṛtā vigatāsavḥ|
meaning: With their hearts split, their bodies drenched in blood, disfigured and lifeless, the demons fell down on earth like trees cut at the roots.

sanskrit: तान् दृष्ट्वा पतितान्भूमौ राक्षसी क्रोधमूर्छिता।।3.20.21।। परित्रस्ता पुनस्तत्र व्यसृजद्भैरवस्वनान्।
transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā patitānbhūmau rākṣasī krodhamūrchitā||3.20.21|| paritrastā punastatra vyasṛjadbhairavasvanān|
meaning: Seeing the demons fallen on the ground, the demoness wild with anger and fear roared.

sanskrit: उपगम्य खरं सा तु किञ्चित्संशुष्कशोणिता।।3.20.22।। पपात पुनरेवार्ता सनिर्यासेव सल्लकी।
transliteration: upagamya kharṃ sā tu kiñcitsṃśuṣkaśoṇitā||3.20.22|| papāta punarevārtā saniryāseva sallakī|
meaning: Her blood slightly dried up, she came back afflicted to Khara and fell down like a sallaki tree, its sap oozing.

sanskrit: भ्रातुस्समीपे शोकार्ता ससर्ज निनदं मुहुः।।3.20.24।। सस्वरं मुमुचे बाष्पं विषण्णवदना तदा।
transliteration: bhrātussamīpe śokārtā sasarja ninadṃ muhuḥ||3.20.24|| sasvarṃ mumuce bāṣpṃ viṣaṇṇavadanā tadā|
meaning: Then desperately screaming and shedding tears with a sad face beside her brother, she roared again and again.

sanskrit: निपातितान् दृश्य रणे तु राक्षसान् प्रधाविता शूर्पणखा पुनस्ततः। वधं च तेषां निखिलेन रक्षसां शशंस सर्वं भगिनी खरस्य सा।।3.
transliteration: nipātitān dṛśya raṇe tu rākṣasān pradhāvitā śūrpaṇakhā punastatḥ| vadhṃ ca teṣāṃ nikhilena rakṣasāṃ śaśṃsa sarvṃ bhaginī
meaning: When Surpanakha saw the demons fall dead on the battleground, she ran to Khara,her brother and told in detail about the death of the demons. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे विंशस्सर्गः।। Thus end

sanskrit: मया त्विदानीं शूरास्ते राक्षसा रुधिराशनाः। त्वत्प्रियार्थं विनिर्दिष्टाः किमर्थं रुद्यते पुनः।।3.21.2।।
transliteration: mayā tvidānīṃ śūrāste rākṣasā rudhirāśanāḥ| tvatpriyārthṃ vinirdiṣṭāḥ kimarthṃ rudyate punḥ||3.21.2||
meaning: The valiant demons who feed on blood have been commissioned for your pleasure. Why are you crying again?

sanskrit: भक्ताश्चैवानुरक्ताश्च हिताश्च मम नित्यशः। हन्यमाना न हन्यन्ते न न कुर्युर्वचो मम।।3.21.3।।
transliteration: bhaktāścaivānuraktāśca hitāśca mama nityaśḥ| hanyamānā na hanyante na na kuryurvaco mama||3.21.3||
meaning: They are loyal and faithful to me. They are always my wellwishers. Even when attacked, they cannot be killed. They never fail to carry out my orders.

sanskrit: किमेतच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि कारणं यत्कृते पुनः। हा नाथेति विनर्दन्ती सर्पवल्लुठसि क्षितौ।।3.21.4।।
transliteration: kimetacchrotumicchāmi kāraṇṃ yatkṛte punḥ| hā nātheti vinardantī sarpavalluṭhasi kṣitau||3.21.4||
meaning: I wish to know what makes you lament and roll on the ground like a serpent and hissing?

sanskrit: अनाथवद्विलपसि नाथे तु मयि संस्थिते। उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ माभैषीर्वैक्लव्यं त्यज्यतामिह।।3.21.5।।
transliteration: anāthavadvilapasi nāthe tu mayi sṃsthite| uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha mābhaiṣīrvaiklavyṃ tyajyatāmiha||3.21.5||
meaning: When I am here like a lord to protect you, why do you weep like an orphan? Get up. Give up your anxiety. Be not afraid.

sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्ता दुर्धर्षा खरेण परिसान्त्विता। विमृज्य नयने सास्रे खरं भ्रातरमब्रवीत्।।3.21.6।।
transliteration: ityevamuktā durdharṣā khareṇa parisāntvitā| vimṛjya nayane sāsre kharṃ bhrātaramabravīt||3.21.6||
meaning: Thus consoled by Khara, invincible Surpanakha wiped her tearful eyes and said to her brother:

sanskrit: अस्मीदानीमहं प्राप्ता हृतश्रवणनासिका। शोणितौघपरिक्लिन्ना त्वया च परिसान्त्विता।।3.21.7।।
transliteration: asmīdānīmahṃ prāptā hṛtaśravaṇanāsikā| śoṇitaughapariklinnā tvayā ca parisāntvitā||3.21.7||
meaning: My ears and nose sliced off, drenched with blood, I came to you and you pacified me.

sanskrit: प्रेषिताश्च त्वया वीर राक्षसास्ते चतुर्दश। निहन्तुं राघवं क्रोधान्मत्प्रियार्थं सलक्षणम्।।3.21.8।।
transliteration: preṣitāśca tvayā vīra rākṣasāste caturdaśa| nihantuṃ rāghavṃ krodhānmatpriyārthṃ salakṣaṇam||3.21.8||
meaning: O warrior you had sent, out of anger, fourteen demons to put an end to Rama along with Lakshmana in order to please me.

sanskrit: ते तु रामेण सामर्षाः शूलपट्टसपाणयः। समरे निहतास्सर्वे सायकैर्मर्मभेदिभिः।।3.21.9।।
transliteration: te tu rāmeṇa sāmarṣāḥ śūlapaṭṭasapāṇayḥ| samare nihatāssarve sāyakairmarmabhedibhiḥ||3.21.9||
meaning: The demons who went with spears in their hands were killed, their hearts pierced by Rama's arrows.

sanskrit: तान्दृष्ट्वा पतितान्भूमौ क्षणेनैव महाबलान्। रामस्य च महत्कर्म महांस्त्रासोऽभवन्मम।।3.21.10।।
transliteration: tāndṛṣṭvā patitānbhūmau kṣaṇenaiva mahābalān| rāmasya ca mahatkarma mahāṃstrāso'bhavanmama||3.21.10||
meaning: Seeing the powerful demons collapse on the ground in a moment's time through Rama's action, I was frightened.

sanskrit: अहमस्मि समुद्विग्ना विषण्णा च निशाचर। शरणं त्वां पुनः प्राप्ता सर्वतोभयदर्शिनी।।3.21.11।।
transliteration: ahamasmi samudvignā viṣaṇṇā ca niśācara| śaraṇṃ tvāṃ punḥ prāptā sarvatobhayadarśinī||3.21.11||
meaning: O demon I am scared and sad. To me everything looks frightening. I, therefore, seek refuge in you.

sanskrit: विषादनक्राध्युषिते परित्रासोर्मिमालिनि। किं मां न त्रायसे मग्नां विपुले शोकसागरे।।3.21.12।।
transliteration: viṣādanakrādhyuṣite paritrāsormimālini| kiṃ māṃ na trāyase magnāṃ vipule śokasāgare||3.21.12||
meaning: I am drowned in a vast sea of sorrow where crocodiles in the form of distress reside. It is full of rows of waves of fright. Why do you not save me?

sanskrit: एते च निहता भूमौ रामेण निशितैः शरैः। येऽपि मे पदवीं प्राप्ता राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः।।3.21.13।।
transliteration: ete ca nihatā bhūmau rāmeṇa niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ| ye'pi me padavīṃ prāptā rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ||3.21.13||
meaning: The demons who live on flesh, who came following me fell down on earth and lay dead, shot by the sharp arrows of Rama.

sanskrit: मयि ते यद्यनुक्रोशो यदि रक्षस्सु तेषु च। रामेण यदि ते शक्तिस्तेजो वास्ति निशाचर।3.21.14।। दण्डकारण्यनिलयं जहि राक्षसकण्ट
transliteration: mayi te yadyanukrośo yadi rakṣassu teṣu ca| rāmeṇa yadi te śaktistejo vāsti niśācara|3.21.14|| daṇḍakāraṇyanilayṃ jahi r
meaning: O demon if you have compassion for me or for the demons, if you have the power and energy to face Rama, kill the enemy of the demons living in Dandaka forest.

sanskrit: यदि रामं ममामित्रं न त्वमद्यवधिष्यसि।।3.21.15।। तवैव चाग्रतः प्राणांस्त्यक्षामि निरपत्रप।
transliteration: yadi rāmṃ mamāmitrṃ na tvamadyavadhiṣyasi||3.21.15|| tavaiva cāgratḥ prāṇāṃstyakṣāmi nirapatrapa|
meaning: If now you do not kill that Rama, my enemy, O shameless one, I will give up my life in your very presence.

sanskrit: बुद्ध्याहमनुपश्यामि न त्वं रामस्य संयुगे।।3.21.16।। स्थातुं प्रतिमुखे शक्तस्सबलश्च महात्मनः।
transliteration: buddhyāhamanupaśyāmi na tvṃ rāmasya sṃyuge||3.21.16|| sthātuṃ pratimukhe śaktassabalaśca mahātmanḥ|
meaning: Instinctively I can foresee that you and your army do not have the capability to encounter that great Rama in a fight.

sanskrit: शूरमानी न शूरस्त्वं मिथ्यारोपितविक्रमः।।3.21.17।। मानुषौ यो न शक्नोषि हन्तुं तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।
transliteration: śūramānī na śūrastvṃ mithyāropitavikramḥ||3.21.17|| mānuṣau yo na śaknoṣi hantuṃ tau rāmalakṣmaṇau|
meaning: You call yourself a hero, yet are not able to kill two humans like Rama and Lakshmana. Your claim to heroism is false. You are not a hero at all.

sanskrit: रामेण यदि ते शक्तिस्तेजो वास्ति निशाचर।।3.21.18।। दण्डकारण्यनिलयं जहि तं कुलपांसन।
transliteration: rāmeṇa yadi te śaktistejo vāsti niśācara||3.21.18|| daṇḍakāraṇyanilayṃ jahi tṃ kulapāṃsana|
meaning: O demon you are a disgrace to the family. If you have power or energy, kill that Rama dwelling in Dandaka forest.

sanskrit: निस्सत्वस्याल्प वीर्यस्य वासस्ते कीदृशस्त्विह।।3.21.19।। अपयाहि जनस्थानातत्वरितस्सहबान्धवः।
transliteration: nissatvasyālpa vīryasya vāsaste kīdṛśastviha||3.21.19|| apayāhi janasthānātatvaritassahabāndhavḥ|
meaning: You have little strength and less heroism. You with your relations should immediately leave Janasthana. What kind of position do you have here?

sanskrit: रामतेजोभिभूतो हि त्वं क्षिप्रं विनशिष्यसि।3.21.20।। स हि तेजस्समायुक्तो रामो दशरथात्मजः। भ्राता चास्य महावीर्यो येन चास्
transliteration: rāmatejobhibhūto hi tvṃ kṣiprṃ vinaśiṣyasi|3.21.20|| sa hi tejassamāyukto rāmo daśarathātmajḥ| bhrātā cāsya mahāvīryo ye
meaning: Let down by the brilliance of Rama, son of Dasaratha, you will be soon destroyed. He is mighty and his brother who has disfigured me is very valiant.

sanskrit: एवं विलप्य बहुशो राक्षसी विततोदरी। कराभ्यामुदरं हत्वा रुरोद भृशदुःखिता।।3.21.22।।
transliteration: evṃ vilapya bahuśo rākṣasī vitatodarī| karābhyāmudarṃ hatvā ruroda bhṛśaduḥkhitā||3.21.22||
meaning: Overcome by sorrow, the bigbellied demoness cried in several ways and being very sad started beating her chest with both hands. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकविंशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the twenty

sanskrit: तवावमानप्रभवः क्रोधोऽयमतुलो मम। न शक्यते धारयितुं लवणाम्भ इवोल्बणम्।।3.22.2।।
transliteration: tavāvamānaprabhavḥ krodho'yamatulo mama| na śakyate dhārayituṃ lavaṇāmbha ivolbaṇam||3.22.2||
meaning: Like the overslowing salt sea water, I am unable to contain this my excessive anger arising out of your insult.

sanskrit: न रामं गणये वीर्यान्मानुषं क्षीणजीवितम्। आत्मदुश्चरितैः प्राणान्हतोयोऽद्य विमोक्ष्यते।।3.22.3।।
transliteration: na rāmṃ gaṇaye vīryānmānuṣṃ kṣīṇajīvitam| ātmaduścaritaiḥ prāṇānhatoyo'dya vimokṣyate||3.22.3||
meaning: Rama is a shortlived human. I do not care for his valour. His life span will be shortened (he will be killed) now for his own misdeeds.

sanskrit: बाष्पस्संह्रियतामेष सम्भ्रमश्च विमुच्यताम्। अहं रामं सह भ्रात्रा नयामि यमसादनम्।।3.22.4।।
transliteration: bāṣpassṃhriyatāmeṣa sambhramaśca vimucyatām| ahṃ rāmṃ saha bhrātrā nayāmi yamasādanam||3.22.4||
meaning: Restrain your tears and your anxieties I will send Rama along with his brother to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit: परश्वथहतस्याद्य मन्दप्राणस्य संयुगे। रामस्य रुधिरं रक्तमुष्णं पास्यसि राक्षसि।।3.22.5।।
transliteration: paraśvathahatasyādya mandaprāṇasya sṃyuge| rāmasya rudhirṃ raktamuṣṇṃ pāsyasi rākṣasi||3.22.5||
meaning: With his life ebbing out, killed by my axe in the fight, you will drink today, O demoness, Rama's red, hot blood.

sanskrit: सा प्रहृष्टा वचश्श्रुत्वा खरस्य वदनाच्च्युतम्। प्रशशंस पुनर्मौर्ख्याद्भ्रातरं रक्षसां वरम्।।3.22.6।।
transliteration: sā prahṛṣṭā vacaśśrutvā kharasya vadanāccyutam| praśaśṃsa punarmaurkhyādbhrātarṃ rakṣasāṃ varam||3.22.6||
meaning: On hearing the words that came out of Khara's mouth, she was pleased. And in stupidity began praising her brother once again as the best of demons.

sanskrit: तया परुषितः पूर्वं पुनरेव प्रशंसितः। अब्रवीद्दूषणं नाम खरस्सेनापतिं तदा।।3.22.7।।
transliteration: tayā paruṣitḥ pūrvṃ punareva praśṃsitḥ| abravīddūṣaṇṃ nāma kharassenāpatiṃ tadā||3.22.7||
meaning: Khara, accused by her earlier and admired again, said to Dusana, chief of army:

sanskrit: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि मम चित्तानुवर्तिनाम्। रक्षसां भीमवेगानां समरेष्वनिवर्तिनाम्।।3.22.8।।
transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi mama cittānuvartinām| rakṣasāṃ bhīmavegānāṃ samareṣvanivartinām||3.22.8||
meaning: There are fourteen thousand demons at my command ready to act according to my will. They are warriors of terrific speed and will not retreat from the fight.

sanskrit: नीलजीमूतवर्णानां घोराणां क्रूरकर्मणाम्। लोकहिंसाविहाराणां बलिनामुग्रतेजसाम्।।3.22.9।।
transliteration: nīlajīmūtavarṇānāṃ ghorāṇāṃ krūrakarmaṇām| lokahiṃsāvihārāṇāṃ balināmugratejasām||3.22.9||
meaning: They are of the colour of the dark blue cloud, dreadful and merciless, strong and powerful fighters who roam about forturing people.

sanskrit: तेषां शार्दूलदर्पाणां महास्यानां महौजसाम्। सर्वोद्योग मुदीर्णानां रक्षसां सौम्य कारय।।3.22.10।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ śārdūladarpāṇāṃ mahāsyānāṃ mahaujasām| sarvodyoga mudīrṇānāṃ rakṣasāṃ saumya kāraya||3.22.10||
meaning: O handsome one, get them all, powerful like tigers, demons with large countenances, mighty and arragant, ready (for the fight).

sanskrit: उपस्थापय मे क्षिप्रं रथं सौम्य धनूंषि च। शरांश्चित्रांश्च खङ्गांश्च शक्तीश्च विविधाश्शिताः।।3.22.11।।
transliteration: upasthāpaya me kṣiprṃ rathṃ saumya dhanūṃṣi ca| śarāṃścitrāṃśca khaṅgāṃśca śaktīśca vividhāśśitāḥ||3.22.11||
meaning: O goodnatured one, get my chariot, bows and arrows, wonderful swords of different kinds and sharp missiles ready quickly.

sanskrit: अग्रे निर्यातुमिच्छामि पौलस्त्यानां महात्मनाम्। वधार्थं दुर्विनीतस्य रामस्य रणकोविदः।।3.22.12।।
transliteration: agre niryātumicchāmi paulastyānāṃ mahātmanām| vadhārthṃ durvinītasya rāmasya raṇakovidḥ||3.22.12||
meaning: O expert in warfare, I wish to lead those great warriors of Paulasthya family, to kill that immodest Rama.

sanskrit: इति तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य सूर्यवर्णं महारथम्। सदश्वैश्शबलैर्युक्तमाचचक्षेऽथ दूषणः।।3.22.13।।
transliteration: iti tasya bruvāṇasya sūryavarṇṃ mahāratham| sadaśvaiśśabalairyuktamācacakṣe'tha dūṣaṇḥ||3.22.13||
meaning: While Khara was speaking thus, Dusana reported that a huge chariot of the colour of the Sun yoked with good horses of variegated hues stood ready.

sanskrit: तं मेरुशिखराकारं तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम्। हेमचक्रमसम्बाधं वैदूर्यमयकूबरम्।।3.22.14।। मत्स्यैः पुष्पैर्द्रुमैश्शैलैश्चन्द्रसूर्य
transliteration: tṃ meruśikharākārṃ taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇam| hemacakramasambādhṃ vaidūryamayakūbaram||3.22.14|| matsyaiḥ puṣpairdrumaiśśaila
meaning: Then the impatient Khara mounted the chariot that looked like the peak of mount Meru. It was decorated with pure gold, had golden wheels, poles studded with vaidurya. The carriage of the chariot was engraved with golden

sanskrit: निशाम्य तु रथस्थं तं राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः। तस्थुस्संपरिवार्यैनं दूषणं च महाबलम्।।3.22.17।।
transliteration: niśāmya tu rathasthṃ tṃ rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ| tasthussṃparivāryainṃ dūṣaṇṃ ca mahābalam||3.22.17||
meaning: The demons of terrific prowess surounded Khara and Dusana and stood by, when they saw both of them mounting the chariot.

sanskrit: खरस्तु तान्महेष्वासान्घोरवर्मायुधध्वजान्। निर्यातेत्यब्रवीद्दृष्ट्वा रथस्थस्सर्वराक्षसान्।।3.22.18।।
transliteration: kharastu tānmaheṣvāsānghoravarmāyudhadhvajān| niryātetyabravīddṛṣṭvā rathasthassarvarākṣasān||3.22.18||
meaning: Khara mounted the chariot, saw the demons holding great weapons, wearing dreadful shields and holding flags, and ordered them to march.

sanskrit: ततस्तद् राक्षसं सैन्यं घोरचर्मायुधध्वजम्। निर्जगाम जनस्थानान्महानादं महाजवम्।।3.22.19।।
transliteration: tatastad rākṣasṃ sainyṃ ghoracarmāyudhadhvajam| nirjagāma janasthānānmahānādṃ mahājavam||3.22.19||
meaning: Then the army of the demons wearing dreadful shields, holding weapons and flags, and making a loud noise started in great speed from Janasthanam.

sanskrit: मुद्गरैः पट्टिसैश्शूलैस्सुतीक्ष्णैश्च परश्वधैः। खङ्गैश्चक्रैश्च हस्तस्थैर्भ्राजमानैश्च तोमरैः।।3.22.20।। शक्तिभिः परिघैर
transliteration: mudgaraiḥ paṭṭisaiśśūlaissutīkṣṇaiśca paraśvadhaiḥ| khaṅgaiścakraiśca hastasthairbhrājamānaiśca tomaraiḥ||3.22.20|| śakt
meaning: The fourteen thousand demons loyal to the wishes of Khara, took in their hands, maces, piercing weapons, spears, sharp axes used in battle, swords, wheels, splinters, iron clubs, powerful missiles, dreadful iron bars of

sanskrit: तांस्त्वभिद्रवतो दृष्ट्वा राक्षसान् भीमविक्रमान्। खरस्यापि रथः किञ्चिज्जगाम तदनन्तरम्।।3.22.23।।
transliteration: tāṃstvabhidravato dṛṣṭvā rākṣasān bhīmavikramān| kharasyāpi rathḥ kiñcijjagāma tadanantaram||3.22.23||
meaning: Khara's chariot moved a bit behind the army of demons of frightening prowess who rushed forward to attack (Rama).

sanskrit: ततस्ताञ्छबलानश्वास्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषितान्। खरस्य मतिमाज्ञाय सारथिस्समचोदयत्।।3.22.24।।
transliteration: tatastāñchabalānaśvāstaptakāñcanabhūṣitān| kharasya matimājñāya sārathissamacodayat||3.22.24||
meaning: Knowing the mind of Khara, the charioteer hastened the horses of the colourful chariot decorated with pure gold.

sanskrit: स चोदितो रथश्शीघ्रं खरस्य रिपुघातिनः। शब्देनापूरयामास दिशश्च प्रदिशस्तदा।।3.22.25।।
transliteration: sa codito rathaśśīghrṃ kharasya ripughātinḥ| śabdenāpūrayāmāsa diśaśca pradiśastadā||3.22.25||
meaning: Spurred by the charioteer, the chariot of Khara, the slayer of enemies, produced a rattle that filled all four quarters and the intermediate directions.

sanskrit: प्रवृद्धमन्युस्तु खरः खरस्वनो रिपोर्वधार्थं त्वरितो यथान्तकः। अचूचुदत्सारथिमुन्नदन्घनं महाबलो मेघ इवाश्मवर्षवान्।।3.22.2
transliteration: pravṛddhamanyustu kharḥ kharasvano riporvadhārthṃ tvarito yathāntakḥ| acūcudatsārathimunnadanghanṃ mahābalo megha ivāśma
meaning: Khara in extreme anger hastened, like Yama, to slay his enemy. He roared loudly like a cloud raining hail stones and impelled his charioteer to speed up. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वालल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे द्वाविंश

sanskrit: निपेतुस्तुरगास्तस्य रथयुक्ता महाजवाः। समे पुष्पचिते देशे राजमार्गे यदृच्छया।।3.23.2।।
transliteration: nipetusturagāstasya rathayuktā mahājavāḥ| same puṣpacite deśe rājamārge yadṛcchayā||3.23.2||
meaning: The swift horses yoked to the chariot stumbled casually while galloping on the plane highway sprinkled with flowers.

sanskrit: श्यामं रुधिरपर्यन्तं बभूव परिवेषणम्। अलातचक्रप्रतिमं परिगृह्य दिवाकरम्।।3.23.3।।
transliteration: śyāmṃ rudhiraparyantṃ babhūva pariveṣaṇam| alātacakrapratimṃ parigṛhya divākaram||3.23.3||
meaning: A dark ring, bloodred in colour appeared on the border of the Sun's orb, dark in the middle. This phenomenon of the Sun appeared like a ring of moving charcoal covering the Sun.

sanskrit: ततो ध्वजमुपागम्य हेमदण्डं समुच्छ्रितम्। समाक्रम्य महाकायस्तस्थौ गृध्रस्सुदारुणः।।3.23.4।।
transliteration: tato dhvajamupāgamya hemadaṇḍṃ samucchritam| samākramya mahākāyastasthau gṛdhrassudāruṇḥ||3.23.4||
meaning: A huge vulture, frightening to look at flew up and sat on top of the flag on the staff of gold.

sanskrit: जनस्थानसमीपे तु समागम्य खरस्वनाः। विस्वरान्विविधांश्चक्रुर्मांसादा मृगपक्षिणः।।3.23.5।।
transliteration: janasthānasamīpe tu samāgamya kharasvanāḥ| visvarānvividhāṃścakrurmāṃsādā mṛgapakṣiṇḥ||3.23.5||
meaning: Flesheating beasts and birds flocked at Janasthana producing a cacophony.

sanskrit: व्याजह्रुश्च प्रदीप्तायां दिशि वै भैरवस्वनम्। अशिवं यातुधानानां शिवा घोरा महास्वनाः।।3.23.6।।
transliteration: vyājahruśca pradīptāyāṃ diśi vai bhairavasvanam| aśivṃ yātudhānānāṃ śivā ghorā mahāsvanāḥ||3.23.6||
meaning: The dreadful jackals making ghastly howls turning towards the illuminated direction and produced frightening sounds indicating inauspicious time for the demons.

sanskrit: प्रभिन्नगिरिसङ्काशास्तोयशोणितधारिणः। आकाशं तदनाकाशं चक्रुर्भीमा वलाहकाः।।3.23.7।।
transliteration: prabhinnagirisaṅkāśāstoyaśoṇitadhāriṇḥ| ākāśṃ tadanākāśṃ cakrurbhīmā valāhakāḥ||3.23.7||
meaning: The clouds looked like shattered mountains pouring down bloodlike rain which filled the sky and made it appear frighteningly different.

sanskrit: बभूव तिमिरं घोरमुद्धतं रोमहर्षणम्। दिशो वा विदिशो वापि न च व्यक्तं चकाशिरे।।3.23.8।।
transliteration: babhūva timirṃ ghoramuddhatṃ romaharṣaṇam| diśo vā vidiśo vāpi na ca vyaktṃ cakāśire||3.23.8||
meaning: A terrific darkness, spread all over, produced frightening horripilation. Even the four quarters and the intermediary zones were not discernible.

sanskrit: क्षतजार्द्रसवर्णाभा सन्ध्याकालं विना बभौ। खरस्याभिमुखा नेदुस्तदा घोरमृगाः खगाः।।3.23.9।। कङ्कगोमायुगृध्राश्च चुक्रुशुर्भ
transliteration: kṣatajārdrasavarṇābhā sandhyākālṃ vinā babhau| kharasyābhimukhā nedustadā ghoramṛgāḥ khagāḥ||3.23.9|| kaṅkagomāyugṛdhrāś
meaning: Even before Sunset the twilight looked like a fresh wound. Then wild animals, birds, kankas, jackals and vultures facing towards Khara screeched, indicating danger.

sanskrit: नित्याशुभकरा युद्धे शिवा घोरनिदर्शनाः।।3.23.10।। नेदुर्बलस्याभिमुखं ज्वालोद्गारिभिराननैः।
transliteration: nityāśubhakarā yuddhe śivā ghoranidarśanāḥ||3.23.10|| nedurbalasyābhimukhṃ jvālodgāribhirānanaiḥ|
meaning: Bad omens that always bring inauspiciousness were a dreadful evidence of what is going to happen. Jackals howled, facing Khara's army with their mouths emitting fire.

sanskrit: कबन्धः परिघाभासो दृश्यते भास्करान्तिके।।3.23.11।। जग्राह सूर्यं स्वर्भानुरपर्वणि महाग्रहः। प्रवाति मारुतश्शीघ्रं निष्प्र
transliteration: kabandhḥ parighābhāso dṛśyate bhāskarāntike||3.23.11|| jagrāha sūryṃ svarbhānuraparvaṇi mahāgrahḥ| pravāti mārutaśśīghrṃ
meaning: The planet Ketu appeared like an iron beam near the Sun. Although it was not the fullmoon or newmoon day, Rahu eclipsed the Sun. Wind blew hard and the Sun was lustreless.

sanskrit: उत्पेतुश्च विना रात्रिं ताराः खद्योतसप्रभाः। संलीनमीनविहगा नलिन्यश्शुष्कपङ्कजाः।।3.23.13।। तस्मिन् क्षणे बभूवुश्च विना प
transliteration: utpetuśca vinā rātriṃ tārāḥ khadyotasaprabhāḥ| sṃlīnamīnavihagā nalinyaśśuṣkapaṅkajāḥ||3.23.13|| tasmin kṣaṇe babhūvuśca
meaning: The stars rose in the sky and glittered like fireflies even before night arrived. The fishes and the aquatic birds in the lotusponds hid themselves under water. Lotuses dried up in tanks and the trees stood bereft of flo

sanskrit: उद्धूतश्च विना वातं रेणुर्जलधरारुणः।।3.23.14।। वीचीकूचीति वाश्यन्त्यो बभूवुस्तत्र शारिकाः।
transliteration: uddhūtaśca vinā vātṃ reṇurjaladharāruṇḥ||3.23.14|| vīcīkūcīti vāśyantyo babhūvustatra śārikāḥ|
meaning: Although there was no wind, dust rose like a brown cloud and the sarika birds sang (vichi kuchi) thoughtlessly.

sanskrit: उल्काश्चापि सनिर्घाता निपेतुर्घोरदर्शनाः।।3.23.15।। प्रचचाल मही सर्वा सशैलवनकानना।
transliteration: ulkāścāpi sanirghātā nipeturghoradarśanāḥ||3.23.15|| pracacāla mahī sarvā saśailavanakānanā|
meaning: Dreadful to watch were the thunderstorms and the meteors that dropped down from the sky. The earth trembled all over with mountains, groves and forests.

sanskrit: खरस्य च रथस्थस्य नर्दमानस्य धीमतः।।3.23.16।। प्राकम्पत भुजस्सव्यस्स्वरश्चास्यावसज्जत।
transliteration: kharasya ca rathasthasya nardamānasya dhīmatḥ||3.23.16|| prākampata bhujassavyassvaraścāsyāvasajjata|
meaning: While the intelligent and courageous Khara was seated on the chariot and shouting, his left shoulder shook violently and throat throttled.

sanskrit: सास्रा सम्पद्यते दृष्टिः पश्यमानस्य सर्वतः।।3.23.17।। ललाटे च रुजा जाता न च मोहान्यवर्तत।
transliteration: sāsrā sampadyate dṛṣṭiḥ paśyamānasya sarvatḥ||3.23.17|| lalāṭe ca rujā jātā na ca mohānyavartata|
meaning: While watching all this, his eyes brimmed with tears. His forehead ached. Yet he was too deluded to beat a retreat.

sanskrit: तान्समीक्षय महोत्पातानुत्थितान्रोमहर्षणान्।।3.23.18।। अब्रवीद्राक्षसान्सर्वान्प्रहसन्सखरस्तदा।
transliteration: tānsamīkṣaya mahotpātānutthitānromaharṣaṇān||3.23.18|| abravīdrākṣasānsarvānprahasansakharastadā|
meaning: Looking at these dreadful, horripilating occurrences Khara laughed and said to the demons:

sanskrit: महोत्पातानिमान्सर्वानुत्थितान्घोरदर्शनान्।।3.23.19।। न चिन्तयाम्यहं वीर्याद्बलवान्दुर्बलानिव।
transliteration: mahotpātānimānsarvānutthitānghoradarśanān||3.23.19|| na cintayāmyahṃ vīryādbalavāndurbalāniva|
meaning: Valiant and strong, I do not take seriously these terrifying omens boding calamity just as a strong man does not care for the weak.

sanskrit: तारा अपि शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः पातयामि नभस्स्थलात्।।3.23.20।। मृत्युं मरणधर्मेण सङ्क्रुद्धो योजयाम्यहम्।
transliteration: tārā api śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ pātayāmi nabhassthalāt||3.23.20|| mṛtyuṃ maraṇadharmeṇa saṅkruddho yojayāmyaham|
meaning: With my sharp arrows I can even bring down the stars from the sky. If angered, I can cause mortality to the god of death.

sanskrit: राघवं तं बलोत्सिक्तं भ्रातरं चास्य लक्ष्मणम्।।3.23.21।। अहत्वा सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नोपावर्तितुमुत्सहे।
transliteration: rāghavṃ tṃ balotsiktṃ bhrātarṃ cāsya lakṣmaṇam||3.23.21|| ahatvā sāyakaistīkṣṇairnopāvartitumutsahe|
meaning: I do not wish to return, without killing with my sharp arrows that Rama who is proud of his strength and his brother Lakshmana.

sanskrit: सकामा भगिनी मेऽस्तु पीत्वा तु रुधिरं तयोः।।3.23.22।। यन्निमित्तस्तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणस्य विपर्ययः।
transliteration: sakāmā bhaginī me'stu pītvā tu rudhirṃ tayoḥ||3.23.22|| yannimittastu rāmasya lakṣmaṇasya viparyayḥ|
meaning: Let my sister be satisfied by drinking the blood of both Rama and Lakshmana on whose account this adversity has come.

sanskrit: न क्वचित्प्राप्तपूर्वो मे संयुगेषु पराजयः।।3.23.23।। युष्माकमेतत्प्रत्यक्षं नानृतं कथयाम्यहम्।
transliteration: na kvacitprāptapūrvo me sṃyugeṣu parājayḥ||3.23.23|| yuṣmākametatpratyakṣṃ nānṛtṃ kathayāmyaham|
meaning: I have never faced defeat in wars, and all of you have seen it with your eyes. I am not telling you a lie.

sanskrit: देवराजमपि क्रुद्धो मत्तैरावतयायिनम्।।3.23.24।। वज्रहस्तं रणे हन्यां किं पुनस्तौ कुमानुषौ।
transliteration: devarājamapi kruddho mattairāvatayāyinam||3.23.24|| vajrahastṃ raṇe hanyāṃ kiṃ punastau kumānuṣau|
meaning: When angry, I can kill even (Indra) the wielder of the thunderbolt, rider of the intoxicated Airavata and lord of the gods. What to speak of these two petty humans?

sanskrit: सा तस्य गर्जितं श्रुत्वा राक्षसस्य महाचमूः।।3.23.25।। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे मृत्युपाशावपाशिता।
transliteration: sā tasya garjitṃ śrutvā rākṣasasya mahācamūḥ||3.23.25|| praharṣamatulṃ lebhe mṛtyupāśāvapāśitā|
meaning: Fallen into the deathtrap, the great army of the demon, felt very happy on hearing Khara roaring.

sanskrit: समीयुश्च महात्मानो युद्धदर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः।।3.23.26।। ऋषयो देवगन्दर्वास्सिद्धाश्च सहचारणैः।
transliteration: samīyuśca mahātmāno yuddhadarśanakāṅkṣiṇḥ||3.23.26|| ṛṣayo devagandarvāssiddhāśca sahacāraṇaiḥ|
meaning: Great souls like sages, gods, gandharvas, and siddhas including celestial bards assembled to see the battle.

sanskrit: समेत्य चोचुस्सहितास्तेऽन्योन्यं पुण्यकर्मणः। स्वस्ति गोब्राह्मणेभ्योऽस्तु लोकानां येऽभिसङ्गताः।।3.23.27।।
transliteration: sametya cocussahitāste'nyonyṃ puṇyakarmaṇḥ| svasti gobrāhmaṇebhyo'stu lokānāṃ ye'bhisaṅgatāḥ||3.23.27||
meaning: Holy men assembled and uttered benedictions, saying, 'let there be wellbeing for the cows and brahmins associated with men of pious deeds in all the (three) worlds.

sanskrit: जयतां राघवस्संख्ये पौलस्त्यान् रजनीचरान्।।3.23.28।। चक्रहस्तो यथा युद्धे सर्वानसुरपुङ्गवान्।
transliteration: jayatāṃ rāghavassṃkhye paulastyān rajanīcarān||3.23.28|| cakrahasto yathā yuddhe sarvānasurapuṅgavān|
meaning: 'Let Rama conquer the descendants of Paulasthya in the war like Visnu, the wielder of the wheel had defeated great demons'.

sanskrit: एतच्चान्यच्च बहुशो ब्रुवाणाः परमर्षयः।।3.23.29।। जातकौतूहलास्तत्र विमानस्थाश्च देवताः। ददृशुर्वाहिनीं तेषां राक्षसानां ग
transliteration: etaccānyacca bahuśo bruvāṇāḥ paramarṣayḥ||3.23.29|| jātakautūhalāstatra vimānasthāśca devatāḥ| dadṛśurvāhinīṃ teṣāṃ rākṣ
meaning: The great ascetics were talking thus and more. The gods waiting eagerly on heavenly chariots saw the army of the demons whose life span was shortened (who were doomed to death).

sanskrit: रथेन तु खरो वेगादुग्रसैन्यो विनिस्सृतः। तं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसं भूयो राक्षसाश्च विनिस्सृताः।।3.23.31।।
transliteration: rathena tu kharo vegādugrasainyo vinissṛtḥ| tṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasṃ bhūyo rākṣasāśca vinissṛtāḥ||3.23.31||
meaning: Seeing Khara, their chief on the chariot driving fast, the army of demons too marched forward.

sanskrit: श्येनगामी पृथुग्रीवो यज्ञशत्रुर्विहङ्गमः। दुर्जयः करवीराक्षः परुषः कालकार्मुकः।।3.23.32।। मेघमाली महामाली सर्वास्यो रुधि
transliteration: śyenagāmī pṛthugrīvo yajñaśatrurvihaṅgamḥ| durjayḥ karavīrākṣḥ paruṣḥ kālakārmukḥ||3.23.32|| meghamālī mahāmālī sarvāsyo
meaning: Surrounded by twelve valiant warriors like Syenagami, Pruthugreeva, Yagnasatru, Vihangama, Durjaya, Karaviraksha, Parusha, Kalakarmuka, Meghmali, Mahamali, Sarpasya and Rudhirasana, Khara proceeded.

sanskrit: महाकपालिस्स्थूलाक्षः प्रमाथी त्रिशिरास्तथा। चत्वार एते सेनान्यो दूषणं पृष्ठतो ययुः।।3.23.34।।
transliteration: mahākapālissthūlākṣḥ pramāthī triśirāstathā| catvāra ete senānyo dūṣaṇṃ pṛṣṭhato yayuḥ||3.23.34||
meaning: Similarly Dusana proceeded with four Mahakapali, Sthulaksha, Pramathi and Trisira around him.

sanskrit: सा भीमवेगा समराभिकामा महाबला राक्षसवीरसेना। तौ राजपुत्रौ सहसाभ्युपेता माला ग्रहाणामिव चन्द्रसूर्यौ।।3.23.35।।
transliteration: sā bhīmavegā samarābhikāmā mahābalā rākṣasavīrasenā| tau rājaputrau sahasābhyupetā mālā grahāṇāmiva candrasūryau||3.23.3
meaning: The mighty, swiftfooted army of valiant demons surrounded the princes (Rama and Lakshmana) all on a sudden like the planets around the Sun and the Moon. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे त्रयोविंशस

sanskrit: तानुत्पातान्महोघोरानुत्थितान्रोमहर्षणान्। प्रजानामहितान्दृष्ट्वा रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।।3.24.2।।
transliteration: tānutpātānmahoghorānutthitānromaharṣaṇān| prajānāmahitāndṛṣṭvā rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt||3.24.2||
meaning: When Rama saw the most dreadful, horripilating phenomena foreboding calamity, he said to Lakshmana:

sanskrit: इमान्पश्य महाबाहो सर्वभूतापहारिणः। समुत्थितान्महोत्पातान्संहर्तुं सर्वराक्षसान्।।3.24.3।।
transliteration: imānpaśya mahābāho sarvabhūtāpahāriṇḥ| samutthitānmahotpātānsṃhartuṃ sarvarākṣasān||3.24.3||
meaning: O longarmed Lakshmana see these calamitous phenomena that forebode mass destruction of men and demons.

sanskrit: अमी रुधिरधारास्तु विसृजन्तः खरस्वनाः। व्योम्नि मेघा विवर्तन्ते परुषा गर्दभारुणाः।।3.24.4।।
transliteration: amī rudhiradhārāstu visṛjantḥ kharasvanāḥ| vyomni meghā vivartante paruṣā gardabhāruṇāḥ||3.24.4||
meaning: These rumbling clouds, brownishred like the colour of a donkey, are moving about in the sky showering streams of blood.

sanskrit: सधूमाश्च शरास्सर्वे मम युद्धाभिनन्दिनः। रुक्मपृष्ठानि चापानि विचेष्टन्ते च लक्ष्मण।।3.24.5।।
transliteration: sadhūmāśca śarāssarve mama yuddhābhinandinḥ| rukmapṛṣṭhāni cāpāni viceṣṭante ca lakṣmaṇa||3.24.5||
meaning: O Lakshmana all my arrows are smoking and this goldplated bow welcomes me to war.

sanskrit: यादृशा इह कूजन्ति पक्षिणः वनचारिणः। अग्रतो नो भयं प्राप्तं संशयो जीवितस्य च।।3.24.6।।
transliteration: yādṛśā iha kūjanti pakṣiṇḥ vanacāriṇḥ| agrato no bhayṃ prāptṃ sṃśayo jīvitasya ca||3.24.6||
meaning: The way the forestbirds are screeching makes me foresee danger and makes survival doubtful.

sanskrit: सम्प्रहारस्तु सुमहान्भविष्यति न संशयः। अयमाख्याति मे बाहुस्स्फुरमाणो मुहुर्मुहुः।।3.24.7।। सन्निकर्षे तु न श्शूर जयं शत्
transliteration: samprahārastu sumahānbhaviṣyati na sṃśayḥ| ayamākhyāti me bāhussphuramāṇo muhurmuhuḥ||3.24.7|| sannikarṣe tu na śśūra ja
meaning: A mass destruction of life is going to take place. There is no doubt about it. O brave Lakshmana my right shoulder trembles again and again, indicating the defeat of the enemy. Your beaming visage presages victory.

sanskrit: उद्यतानां हि युद्धार्थं येषां भवति लक्ष्मण। निष्प्रभं वदनं तेषां भवत्यायुः परिक्षयः।।3.24.9।।
transliteration: udyatānāṃ hi yuddhārthṃ yeṣāṃ bhavati lakṣmaṇa| niṣprabhṃ vadanṃ teṣāṃ bhavatyāyuḥ parikṣayḥ||3.24.9||
meaning: O Lakshmana, while preparing for war, those whose faces look pale are, for sure, going to die.

sanskrit: रक्षसां नर्दतां घोरश्श्रूयते च महाध्वनिः। आहतानां च भेरीणां राक्षसैः क्रूरकर्मभिः।।3.24.10।।
transliteration: rakṣasāṃ nardatāṃ ghoraśśrūyate ca mahādhvaniḥ| āhatānāṃ ca bherīṇāṃ rākṣasaiḥ krūrakarmabhiḥ||3.24.10||
meaning: A dreadful roar of demons and the loud sound of wardrums beaten by the wicked demons are heard.

sanskrit: अनागतविधानं तु कर्तव्यं शुभमिच्छता। आपदं शङ्कमानेन पुरुषेण विपश्चिता।।3.24.11।।
transliteration: anāgatavidhānṃ tu kartavyṃ śubhamicchatā| āpadṃ śaṅkamānena puruṣeṇa vipaścitā||3.24.11||
meaning: A wise man who apprehends danger or one who desires his own good should plan his defence even before the onset of danger.

sanskrit: तस्माद्गृहीत्वा वैदेहीं शरपाणिर्धनुर्धरः। गुहामाश्रय शैलस्य दुर्गां पादपसङ्कुलाम्।।3.24.12।।
transliteration: tasmādgṛhītvā vaidehīṃ śarapāṇirdhanurdharḥ| guhāmāśraya śailasya durgāṃ pādapasaṅkulām||3.24.12||
meaning: Therefore, take shelter along with Sita in the inaccessible mountain cave, overgrown with trees, ready with your bow and arrows.

sanskrit: प्रतिकूलितुमिच्छामि न हि वाक्यमिदं त्वया। शापितो मम पादाभ्यां गम्यतां वत्स मा चिरम्।।3.24.13।।
transliteration: pratikūlitumicchāmi na hi vākyamidṃ tvayā| śāpito mama pādābhyāṃ gamyatāṃ vatsa mā ciram||3.24.13||
meaning: O dear, I do not like you to oppose this word of honour. You must touch my feet and go without delay.

sanskrit: त्वं हि शूरश्च बलवान्हन्याह्येतान्न संशयः। स्वयं तु हन्तुमिच्छामि सर्वानेव निशाचरान्।।3.24.14।।
transliteration: tvṃ hi śūraśca balavānhanyāhyetānna sṃśayḥ| svayṃ tu hantumicchāmi sarvāneva niśācarān||3.24.14||
meaning: You are valiant and strong. There is no doubt that you can kill all these demons. But I desire to kill them.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण लक्ष्मणस्सह सीताया। शरानादाय चापं च गुहां दुर्गां समाश्रयत्।।3.24.15।।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇassaha sītāyā| śarānādāya cāpṃ ca guhāṃ durgāṃ samāśrayat||3.24.15||
meaning: Thus ordered by Rama, Lakshmana took the arrows and the bow and accompanied by Sita took shelter in the inaccessible cave.

sanskrit: तस्मिन्प्रविष्टे तु गुहां लक्ष्मणे सह सीतया। हन्त निर्युक्तमित्युक्त्वा रामः कवचमाविशत्।।3.24.16।।
transliteration: tasminpraviṣṭe tu guhāṃ lakṣmaṇe saha sītayā| hanta niryuktamityuktvā rāmḥ kavacamāviśat||3.24.16||
meaning: With Lakshmana and Sita inside the cave, Rama heaved his shield, saying, Oh the work is accomplished.

sanskrit: स तेनाग्नि निकाशेन कवचेन विभूषितः। बभूव राम स्तिमिरे विधूमोऽग्निरिवोत्थितः।।3.24.17।।
transliteration: sa tenāgni nikāśena kavacena vibhūṣitḥ| babhūva rāma stimire vidhūmo'gnirivotthitḥ||3.24.17||
meaning: Adorned with the shield, Rama shone like smokeless fire rising in darkness.

sanskrit: स चापमुद्यम्य महच्छरानादाय वीर्यवान्। बभूवावस्थितस्तत्र ज्यास्वनैः पूरयन्दिशः।।3.24.18।।
transliteration: sa cāpamudyamya mahaccharānādāya vīryavān| babhūvāvasthitastatra jyāsvanaiḥ pūrayandiśḥ||3.24.18||
meaning: Valiant Rama lifted the huge bow and arrows and stood there, filling the directions with the twangs of his bow.

sanskrit: ततो देवास्सगन्धर्वास्सिद्धाश्च सह चारणैः। समेयुश्च महात्मानो युद्धदर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः।।3.24.19।।
transliteration: tato devāssagandharvāssiddhāśca saha cāraṇaiḥ| sameyuśca mahātmāno yuddhadarśanakāṅkṣiṇḥ||3.24.19||
meaning: Then the gods along with gandharvas, siddhas, and celestial bards assembled there, wishing to witness the war.

sanskrit: ऋषयश्च महात्मानो लोके ब्रह्मर्षिसत्तमाः। समेत्य चोचुस्सहिता अन्योन्यं पुण्यकर्मणः।।3.24.20।।
transliteration: ṛṣayaśca mahātmāno loke brahmarṣisattamāḥ| sametya cocussahitā anyonyṃ puṇyakarmaṇḥ||3.24.20||
meaning: Great ascetics of the world, distinguished brahmarsis, accomplishers of pious deeds assembled and said to one another:

sanskrit: स्वस्ति गोब्राह्मणेभ्योऽस्तु लोकानां येऽभिसङ्गताः। जयतां राघवो युद्धे पौलस्त्यान् रजनीचरान्।।3.24.21।। चक्रहस्तो यथा युद
transliteration: svasti gobrāhmaṇebhyo'stu lokānāṃ ye'bhisaṅgatāḥ| jayatāṃ rāghavo yuddhe paulastyān rajanīcarān||3.24.21|| cakrahasto ya
meaning: 'Let there be wellbeing for the cows, brahmins, and all the worlds. Let Rama, the scion of the Raghu race, conquer the Paulastyas (demons) in war like lord Visnu, wielder of the disc, who defeated the most powerful demon

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा पुनः प्रोचुरालोक्य च परस्परम्।।3.24.22।। चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्। एकश्च रामो धर्मात्मा कथं युद्ध
transliteration: evamuktvā punḥ procurālokya ca parasparam||3.24.22|| caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ bhīmakarmaṇām| ekaśca rāmo dharmātmā k
meaning: Thus looking at one another they discussed among themselves how there can be war between the righteous Rama fighting singlehanded on the one hand and the fourteen thousand demons, performers of terrific deeds, on the oth

sanskrit: इति राजर्षयस्सिद्धास्सगणाश्च द्विजर्षभाः। जातकौतूहलास्तस्थुर्विमानस्थाश्च देवताः।।3.24.24।।
transliteration: iti rājarṣayassiddhāssagaṇāśca dvijarṣabhāḥ| jātakautūhalāstasthurvimānasthāśca devatāḥ||3.24.24||
meaning: Rajarsis, siddhas, great brahmins with their clan and gods on the celestial chariots waited to see the war whetted with curiosity.

sanskrit: आविष्टं तेजसा रामं सङ्ग्रामशिरसि स्थितम्। दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि भूतानि भयाद्विव्यथिरे तदा।।3.24.25।।
transliteration: āviṣṭṃ tejasā rāmṃ saṅgrāmaśirasi sthitam| dṛṣṭvā sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhayādvivyathire tadā||3.24.25||
meaning: Seeing Rama standing on the war front, engrossed and radiating heroic lustre, all beings were alarmed.

sanskrit: रूपमप्रतिमं तस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। बभूव रूपं क्रुद्धस्य रुद्रस्येव पिनाकिनः।।3.24.26।।
transliteration: rūpamapratimṃ tasya rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇḥ| babhūva rūpṃ kruddhasya rudrasyeva pinākinḥ||3.24.26||
meaning: Rama, who is unwearied in action and who is of an incomparable (lovely) form, looked ferocious like the wielder of Pinaka (Lord Siva).

sanskrit: ततो गम्भीरनिर्ह्रादं घोरवर्मायुधध्वजम्। अनीकं यातुधानानां समन्तात्प्रत्यदृश्यत।।3.24.27।।
transliteration: tato gambhīranirhrādṃ ghoravarmāyudhadhvajam| anīkṃ yātudhānānāṃ samantātpratyadṛśyata||3.24.27||
meaning: Then appeared on all sides the wellequipped army of demons raising deep sounds with dreadful shields, weapons and banners.

sanskrit: सिंहनादं विसृजतामन्योन्यमभिगर्जताम्। चापानि विस्फ़ारयतां जृम्भतामप्यभीक्ष्णशः।।3.24.28।। विप्रघुष्टस्वनानां च दुन्धुभींश
transliteration: siṃhanādṃ visṛjatāmanyonyamabhigarjatām| cāpāni vispha़ārayatāṃ jṛmbhatāmapyabhīkṣṇaśḥ||3.24.28|| vipraghuṣṭasvanānāṃ ca
meaning: The forest was filled with tumultuous sounds of the warriors roaring like lions, shouting at one another, stretching the bowstrings constantly, yawning, proclaiming loudly and beating the drums.

sanskrit: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ताश्वापदा वनचारिणः। दुद्रुवुर्यत्र निश्शब्दं पृष्ठतो न व्यलोकयन्।।3.24.30।।
transliteration: tena śabdena vitrastāśvāpadā vanacāriṇḥ| dudruvuryatra niśśabdṃ pṛṣṭhato na vyalokayan||3.24.30||
meaning: The ferocious animals of the forest got frightened and ran away to silent spots without looking back.

sanskrit: तत्त्वनीकं महाघोरं रामं समुपसर्पत। धृतनानाप्रहरणं गम्भीरं सागरोपमम्।।3.24.31।।
transliteration: tattvanīkṃ mahāghorṃ rāmṃ samupasarpata| dhṛtanānāpraharaṇṃ gambhīrṃ sāgaropamam||3.24.31||
meaning: The fierce army, deep like the sea, equipped with various missiles approached Rama.

sanskrit: रामोऽपि चारयंश्चक्षुस्सर्वतो रणपण्डितः। ददर्श खरसैन्यं तद्युद्धाभिमुखमुत्थितम्।।3.24.32।।
transliteration: rāmo'pi cārayṃścakṣussarvato raṇapaṇḍitḥ| dadarśa kharasainyṃ tadyuddhābhimukhamutthitam||3.24.32||
meaning: Rama, wellversed in warfare, cast his eyes on all sides to see the army of Khara that had come prepared for war.

sanskrit: वितत्य च धनुर्भीमं तूण्याश्चोद्धृत्य सायकान्। क्रोधमाहारयत्तीव्रं वधार्थं सर्वरक्षसाम्।।3.24.33।।
transliteration: vitatya ca dhanurbhīmṃ tūṇyāścoddhṛtya sāyakān| krodhamāhārayattīvrṃ vadhārthṃ sarvarakṣasām||3.24.33||
meaning: Rama stretched the formidable bow and lifted the arrows from his quiver to kill the demons and assumed intense anger.

sanskrit: दुष्प्रेक्ष्यस्सोऽभवत्कृद्धो युगान्ताग्निरिव ज्वलन्। तं दृष्ट्वा तेजसाविष्टं प्राद्रवन्वनदेवताः।।3.24.34।।
transliteration: duṣprekṣyasso'bhavatkṛddho yugāntāgniriva jvalan| tṃ dṛṣṭvā tejasāviṣṭṃ prādravanvanadevatāḥ||3.24.34||
meaning: Rama stood burning in anger like the fire of the doom's day. It was difficult even to look at him. Seeing him full of glow even the sylvan deities ran away.

sanskrit: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य रूपं तु रामस्य ददृशे तदा। दक्षस्येव क्रतुं हन्तुमुद्यतस्य पिनाकिनः।।3.24.35।।
transliteration: tasya kruddhasya rūpṃ tu rāmasya dadṛśe tadā| dakṣasyeva kratuṃ hantumudyatasya pinākinḥ||3.24.35||
meaning: Rama in anger looked like Lord Siva ready to destroy the sacrifice of Daksha.

sanskrit: आविष्टं तेजसा रामं सङ्ग्रामशिरसि स्थितम्। दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि भूतानि भयार्तानि प्रदुद्रुवुः।।3.24.36।।
transliteration: āviṣṭṃ tejasā rāmṃ saṅgrāmaśirasi sthitam| dṛṣṭvā sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhayārtāni pradudruvuḥ||3.24.36||
meaning: Seeing Rama flashing (in anger) and standing on the warfront all creatures ran away frightened.

sanskrit: तत्कार्मुकैराभरणैर्ध्वजैश्च तैर्वर्मभिश्चाग्निसमानवर्णैः। बभूव सैन्यं पिशिताशनानां सूर्योदये नीलमिवाभ्रबृन्दम्।।3.24.37।
transliteration: tatkārmukairābharaṇairdhvajaiśca tairvarmabhiścāgnisamānavarṇaiḥ| babhūva sainyṃ piśitāśanānāṃ sūryodaye nīlamivābhrabṛn
meaning: The army of demons equipped with blazing armour, bows and banners appeared like a mass of blue clouds at Sunrise. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे चतुर्विंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyfourth sar

sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा सशरं चापमुद्यम्य खरनिस्स्वनम्। रामस्याभिमुखं सूतं चोद्यतामित्यचोदयत्।।3.25.2।।
transliteration: tṃ dṛṣṭvā saśarṃ cāpamudyamya kharanissvanam| rāmasyābhimukhṃ sūtṃ codyatāmityacodayat||3.25.2||
meaning: On seeing Rama, Khara held his terribly twanging bow and arrow, stood facing him, and ordered the charioteer to drive towards him.

sanskrit: स खरस्याज्ञया सूतस्तुरगान् समचोदयत्। यत्र रामो महाबाहुरेको चुन्वन्स्थितो धनुः।।3.25.3।।
transliteration: sa kharasyājñayā sūtasturagān samacodayat| yatra rāmo mahābāhureko cunvansthito dhanuḥ||3.25.3||
meaning: Commanded by Khara, the charioteer also urged the horses towards the mightyarmed Rama standing alone and wielding the bow.

sanskrit: तं तु निष्पतितं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे ते रजनीचराः। नर्दमाना महानादं सचिवाः पर्यवारयन्।।3.25.4।।
transliteration: tṃ tu niṣpatitṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve te rajanīcarāḥ| nardamānā mahānādṃ sacivāḥ paryavārayan||3.25.4||
meaning: Seeing Khara attacking (Rama) all the demon ministers surrounded him roaring.

sanskrit: स तेषां यातुधानानां मध्ये रथगतः खरः। बभूव मध्ये ताराणां लोहिताङ्ग इवोदितः।।3.25.5।।
transliteration: sa teṣāṃ yātudhānānāṃ madhye rathagatḥ kharḥ| babhūva madhye tārāṇāṃ lohitāṅga ivoditḥ||3.25.5||
meaning: Seated on a chariot in the midst of the demons, Khara looked like the rising Mars in the middle of the stars.

sanskrit: ततश्शरसहस्रेण राममप्रतिमौजसम्। अर्दयित्वा महानादं ननाद समरे खरः।।3.25.6।।
transliteration: tataśśarasahasreṇa rāmamapratimaujasam| ardayitvā mahānādṃ nanāda samare kharḥ||3.25.6||
meaning: Khara struck Rama of immeasurable prowess with a thousand arrows and roared loudly.

sanskrit: ततस्तं भीमधन्वानं क्रुद्धाः सर्वे निशाचराः। रामं नानाविधैः शस्स्रैरभ्यवर्षन्त दुर्जयम्।।3.25.7।।
transliteration: tatastṃ bhīmadhanvānṃ kruddhāḥ sarve niśācarāḥ| rāmṃ nānāvidhaiḥ śassrairabhyavarṣanta durjayam||3.25.7||
meaning: Thereafter all the infuriated demons showered on invincible Rama, wielder of a fierce bow, many kinds of weapons.

sanskrit: मुद्गरैः पट्टसैश्शूलैः प्रासैः खङ्गै परश्वथैः। राक्षसास्समरे रामं निजघ्नू रोषतत्पराः।।3.25.8।।
transliteration: mudgaraiḥ paṭṭasaiśśūlaiḥ prāsaiḥ khaṅgai paraśvathaiḥ| rākṣasāssamare rāmṃ nijaghnū roṣatatparāḥ||3.25.8||
meaning: Overtaken by anger, the demons continuously hurled at Rama hammers, spears, spikes, barbed missiles, swords and battleaxes.

sanskrit: ते वलाहसङ्काशा महानादा महौजसः। अभ्यधावन्त काकुत्स्थं रथैर्वाजिभिरेव च।।3.25.9।। गजैः पर्वतकूटाभै रामं युद्धे जिघांसवः।
transliteration: te valāhasaṅkāśā mahānādā mahaujasḥ| abhyadhāvanta kākutsthṃ rathairvājibhireva ca||3.25.9|| gajaiḥ parvatakūṭābhai rāmṃ
meaning: Very powerful demons like huge clouds roared, eager to kill Rama in war. They ran forward on chariots, horses and tall elephants, looking like mountain tops.

sanskrit: ते रामे शरवर्षाणि व्यसृजन् रक्षसां गणाः।।3.25.10।। शैलेन्द्रमिव धाराभिर्वर्षमाणा वलाहकाः।
transliteration: te rāme śaravarṣāṇi vyasṛjan rakṣasāṃ gaṇāḥ||3.25.10|| śailendramiva dhārābhirvarṣamāṇā valāhakāḥ|
meaning: The battalions of demons sent down streams of arrows on Rama just like clouds downpour on mountains.

sanskrit: स तैः परिवृतो घोरैः राघवो रक्षसां गणैः।।3.25.11।। तिथिष्वि महादेवो वृत परिषदाङ्गणै
transliteration: sa taiḥ parivṛto ghoraiḥ rāghavo rakṣasāṃ gaṇaiḥ||3.25.11|| tithiṣvi mahādevo vṛta pariṣadāṅgaṇai
meaning: Surrounded by the terrible demons Rama appeared like Lord Siva at dusk with hosts of his retinues arounds.

sanskrit: तानि मुक्तानि शस्त्राणि यातुधानैस्सराघवः। प्रतिजग्राह विशिखैर्नद्योघानिव सागरः।।3.25.12।।
transliteration: tāni muktāni śastrāṇi yātudhānaissarāghavḥ| pratijagrāha viśikhairnadyoghāniva sāgarḥ||3.25.12||
meaning: Rama resisted the weapons released by the demons like the sea, the inflow of river waters.

sanskrit: स तैः प्रहरणैर्घोरैर्भिन्नगात्रो न विव्यथे। रामः प्रदीप्तैर्बहुभिर्वज्रैरिव महाचलः।।3.25.13।।
transliteration: sa taiḥ praharaṇairghorairbhinnagātro na vivyathe| rāmḥ pradīptairbahubhirvajrairiva mahācalḥ||3.25.13||
meaning: Rama remained unhurt like a great mountain struck by many glowing thunderbolts. He felt no pain even though his limbs were hit by the dreadful weapons.

sanskrit: स विद्धः क्षतजादिग्धः सर्वगात्रेषु राघवः। बभूव रामः सन्ध्याभ्रैर्दिवाकर इवावृतः।।3.25.14।।
transliteration: sa viddhḥ kṣatajādigdhḥ sarvagātreṣu rāghavḥ| babhūva rāmḥ sandhyābhrairdivākara ivāvṛtḥ||3.25.14||
meaning: Wounded all over the body, bleeding through the wounds caused by weapons, Rama looked like the evening Sun covered with clouds.

sanskrit: विषेदुर्देवगन्धर्वास्सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। एकं सहस्रैर्भहुभिस्तदा दृष्ट्वा समावृतम्।।3.25.15।।
transliteration: viṣedurdevagandharvāssiddhāśca paramarṣayḥ| ekṃ sahasrairbhahubhistadā dṛṣṭvā samāvṛtam||3.25.15||
meaning: Seeing Rama left alone surrounded by many thousands of demons, the gods, ghandarvas and siddhas became very sad.

sanskrit: ततो रामस्सुसङ्कृद्धो मण्डलीकृतकार्मुकः। ससर्ज विशिखान्बाणाञ्छतशोऽथ सहस्रश।।3.25.16।।
transliteration: tato rāmassusaṅkṛddho maṇḍalīkṛtakārmukḥ| sasarja viśikhānbāṇāñchataśo'tha sahasraśa||3.25.16||
meaning: Thereafter Rama, mighty angry, bent his bow and released hundreds and thousands of unfeathered arrows.

sanskrit: दुरावारान्दुर्विषहान्कालदण्डोपमान् रणे। मुमोच लीलया रामः कङ्कपत्रानजिह्मगान्।।3.25.17।।
transliteration: durāvārāndurviṣahānkāladaṇḍopamān raṇe| mumoca līlayā rāmḥ kaṅkapatrānajihmagān||3.25.17||
meaning: As if sporting, Rama discharged the arrows attached with herons' feathers. The arrows were inescapable, unbearable like that of Yama's staff, that went straight without missing the target.

sanskrit: ते शराश्शत्रुसैन्येषु मुक्ता रामेण लीलया। अददू रक्षसां प्राणान्पाशाः कालकृता इव।।3.25.18।।
transliteration: te śarāśśatrusainyeṣu muktā rāmeṇa līlayā| adadū rakṣasāṃ prāṇānpāśāḥ kālakṛtā iva||3.25.18||
meaning: The arrows like the noose of the god of death released by Rama on the enemy army easily destroyed the lives of the demons.

sanskrit: भित्त्वा राक्षसदेहां स्तांस्ते शरा रुधिराप्लुताः। अन्तरिक्षगता रेजुर्दीप्ताग्निसमतेजसः।।3.25.19।।
transliteration: bhittvā rākṣasadehāṃ stāṃste śarā rudhirāplutāḥ| antarikṣagatā rejurdīptāgnisamatejasḥ||3.25.19||
meaning: Rama's arrows pierced the bodies of the demons and drenched in blood, they, looking like burning fire, shone in the sky.

sanskrit: असङ्ख्येयास्तु रामस्य सायकाश्चापमण्डलात्। विनिष्पेतुरतीवोग्रा रक्षःप्राणापहारिणः।।3.25.20।।
transliteration: asaṅkhyeyāstu rāmasya sāyakāścāpamaṇḍalāt| viniṣpeturatīvogrā rakṣḥprāṇāpahāriṇḥ||3.25.20||
meaning: From Rama's bow bent into a cirle, countless fierce arrows able to take the lives of demons were released.

sanskrit: तैर्धनूंषि ध्वजाग्राणि वर्माणि च शिरांसि च। बाहून्सहस्ताभरणानूरून्करिकरोपमान्।।3.25.21।। चिच्छेद रामस्समरे शतशोऽथ सहस्रश
transliteration: tairdhanūṃṣi dhvajāgrāṇi varmāṇi ca śirāṃsi ca| bāhūnsahastābharaṇānūrūnkarikaropamān||3.25.21|| ciccheda rāmassamare śa
meaning: In war Rama cut asunder the bows, flag tops, armour and heads of demons, their shoulders and thighs that were like the trunks of elephants, in their hundreds and thousands.

sanskrit: हयान्काञ्चनसन्नाहान्रथयुक्तान्ससारथीन्।।3.25.22।। गजांश्च सगजारोहान्सहयान्सादिनस्तथा। पदातीन्समरे हत्वा ह्यनयद्यमसादनम्।
transliteration: hayānkāñcanasannāhānrathayuktānsasārathīn||3.25.22|| gajāṃśca sagajārohānsahayānsādinastathā| padātīnsamare hatvā hyanay
meaning: He killed horses with golden armours yoked to the chariots along with charioteers, elephants along with riders, the cavalry along with their horses and infantry and sent them all to the abode of death.

sanskrit: ततो नालीकनाराचैस्तीक्ष्णाग्रैश्च विकर्णिभिः। भीममार्तस्वरं चक्रुर्भिद्यमाना निशाचराः।।3.25.24।।
transliteration: tato nālīkanārācaistīkṣṇāgraiśca vikarṇibhiḥ| bhīmamārtasvarṃ cakrurbhidyamānā niśācarāḥ||3.25.24||
meaning: The bodies of the demons torn into pieces by the very sharp iron arrows and by the arrows called vikarni, they cried and shouted aloud in pitiable voices.

sanskrit: तत्सैन्यं निशितैर्बाणैरर्दितं मर्मभेदिभिः। रामेण न सुखं लेभे शुष्कं वनमिवाग्निना।।3.25.25।।
transliteration: tatsainyṃ niśitairbāṇairarditṃ marmabhedibhiḥ| rāmeṇa na sukhṃ lebhe śuṣkṃ vanamivāgninā||3.25.25||
meaning: Just like the dried up forest burnt by the fire, the army was totally destroyed by Rama's arrows that pierced into the vital parts of the soldiers.

sanskrit: केचिद्भीमबलाश्शूराश्शूलान्खङ्गान्परश्वधान्। रामस्याभिमुखं गत्वा चिक्षिपुः परमायुधान्।।3.25.26।।
transliteration: kecidbhīmabalāśśūrāśśūlānkhaṅgānparaśvadhān| rāmasyābhimukhṃ gatvā cikṣipuḥ paramāyudhān||3.25.26||
meaning: A few warriors of fierce strength approached Rama and hurled at him very powerful weapons, spears, swords and axes.

sanskrit: तानि बाणैर्महाबाहुश्शस्त्राण्यावार्य राघवः। जहार समरे प्राणांश्चिच्छेद च शिरोधरान्।।3.25.27।।
transliteration: tāni bāṇairmahābāhuśśastrāṇyāvārya rāghavḥ| jahāra samare prāṇāṃściccheda ca śirodharān||3.25.27||
meaning: Strongarmed Rama attacked them with his arrows and cut off their heads and took their lives.

sanskrit: ते छिन्नशिरसः पेतुश्चिन्नवर्मशरासनाः। सुपर्णवातविक्षिप्ता जगत्यां पादपा यथा।।3.25.28।।
transliteration: te chinnaśirasḥ petuścinnavarmaśarāsanāḥ| suparṇavātavikṣiptā jagatyāṃ pādapā yathā||3.25.28||
meaning: The heads, armour and bows fell down broken on the ground like trees in the wind gererated by Garuda's wings.

sanskrit: अवशिष्टाश्च ये तत्र विषण्णाश्च निशाचराः। खरमेवाभ्यधावन्त शरणार्थं शरार्दिताः।।3.25.29।।
transliteration: avaśiṣṭāśca ye tatra viṣaṇṇāśca niśācarāḥ| kharamevābhyadhāvanta śaraṇārthṃ śarārditāḥ||3.25.29||
meaning: The rest of the demons hit by the arrows ran desperate towards Khara for refuge.

sanskrit: तान्सर्वान्पुनरादाय समाश्वास्य च दूषणः। अभ्यधावत काकुत्स्थं क्रुद्धो रुद्रमिवान्तकः।।3.25.30।।
transliteration: tānsarvānpunarādāya samāśvāsya ca dūṣaṇḥ| abhyadhāvata kākutsthṃ kruddho rudramivāntakḥ||3.25.30||
meaning: Pacifying them all, Dusana regathered them again and ran towards Rama like an angry Yama rushing towards Rudra.

sanskrit: निवृत्तास्तु पुनस्सर्वे दूषणाश्रयनिर्भयाः। राममेवाभ्यधावन्त सालतालशिलायुधाः।।3.25.31।।
transliteration: nivṛttāstu punassarve dūṣaṇāśrayanirbhayāḥ| rāmamevābhyadhāvanta sālatālaśilāyudhāḥ||3.25.31||
meaning: Under Dusana's protection, all of them felt relieved from fear and, carrying sal and palm trees and stones as weapons, advanced towards Rama again.

sanskrit: शूलमुद्गरहस्ताश्च चापहस्ता महाबलाः। सृजन्तश्शरवर्षाणि शस्त्रवर्षाणि संयुगे।।3.25.32।। द्रुमवर्षाणि मुञ्चन्तश्शिलावर्षाणि
transliteration: śūlamudgarahastāśca cāpahastā mahābalāḥ| sṛjantaśśaravarṣāṇi śastravarṣāṇi sṃyuge||3.25.32|| drumavarṣāṇi muñcantaśśilāv
meaning: Holding spears, hammers and bows in their hands, the mighty demons rained on Rama weapons like arrows, trees and stones.

sanskrit: तद्बभूवाद्भुतं युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम्। रामस्य च महाघोरं पुनस्तेषां च रक्षसाम्।।3.25.33।।
transliteration: tadbabhūvādbhutṃ yuddhṃ tumulṃ romaharṣaṇam| rāmasya ca mahāghorṃ punasteṣāṃ ca rakṣasām||3.25.33||
meaning: The thrilling, fierce, horrifying and horripilating battle again ensued betwen Rama and the demons.

sanskrit: ते समन्तादतिक्रुद्धा राघवं पुनरभ्ययुः।।3.25.34।। तैश्च सर्वा दिशो दृष्ट्वा प्रदिशश्च समावृताः। राक्षसैरुद्यतप्रासैश्शरवर
transliteration: te samantādatikruddhā rāghavṃ punarabhyayuḥ||3.25.34|| taiśca sarvā diśo dṛṣṭvā pradiśaśca samāvṛtāḥ| rākṣasairudyataprā
meaning: As the infuriated demons again hurtled towards Rama, filling the quarters and the intermediate directions and raining missiles, Rama aimed at them dazzling gandharvastras, producing a frightening warcry.

sanskrit: ततश्शरसहस्राणि निर्ययुश्चापमण्डलात्। सर्वा दश दिशो बाणैरावार्यन्त समागतैः।।3.25.37।।
transliteration: tataśśarasahasrāṇi niryayuścāpamaṇḍalāt| sarvā daśa diśo bāṇairāvāryanta samāgataiḥ||3.25.37||
meaning: Rama then let out from his bow, stretched round, thousands of arrows that covered all the ten quarters.

sanskrit: नाददानं शरान्घोरान्नमुञ्चन्तं शिलीमुखान्। विकर्षमाणं पश्यन्ति राक्षसास्ते शरार्दिताः।।3.25.38।।
transliteration: nādadānṃ śarānghorānnamuñcantṃ śilīmukhān| vikarṣamāṇṃ paśyanti rākṣasāste śarārditāḥ||3.25.38||
meaning: The demons, though wounded, could not see whereform the terrible arrows came. They only saw Rama shooting the arrows.

sanskrit: शरान्धकारमाकाशमावृणोत्सदिवाकरम्। बभूवावस्थितो रामः प्रवमन्निव ताञ्छरान्।।3.25.39।।
transliteration: śarāndhakāramākāśamāvṛṇotsadivākaram| babhūvāvasthito rāmḥ pravamanniva tāñcharān||3.25.39||
meaning: Through the darkness created by the arrows that covered the sky and the Sun, Rama looked as though he was vomitting them.

sanskrit: युगपत्पतमानैश्च युगपच्च हतैर्भृशम्। युगपत्पतितैश्चैव विकीर्णा वसुधा भवत्।।3.25.40।।
transliteration: yugapatpatamānaiśca yugapacca hatairbhṛśam| yugapatpatitaiścaiva vikīrṇā vasudhā bhavat||3.25.40||
meaning: It seemed as if it all happened at the same time, the entire earth filling with demons seriously injured, slain and fallen down on the ground.

sanskrit: निहताः पतिताः क्षीणाश्छिन्ना भिन्ना विदारिताः। तत्र तत्र स्म दृश्यन्ते राक्षसास्ते सहस्रशः।।3.25.41।।
transliteration: nihatāḥ patitāḥ kṣīṇāśchinnā bhinnā vidāritāḥ| tatra tatra sma dṛśyante rākṣasāste sahasraśḥ||3.25.41||
meaning: There were bodies of demons pierced and torn, thinned and fallen down, destroyed, broken and cut into pieces scattered in their thousands.

sanskrit: सोष्णीषैरुत्तमाङ्गैश्च साङ्गदैर्बाहुभिस्तथा। ऊरुभिर्जानुभिश्छिन्नैर्नानारूपैविभूषणैः।।3.25.42।। हयैश्च द्विपमुख्यैश्च रथ
transliteration: soṣṇīṣairuttamāṅgaiśca sāṅgadairbāhubhistathā| ūrubhirjānubhiśchinnairnānārūpaivibhūṣaṇaiḥ||3.25.42|| hayaiśca dvipamukh
meaning: Slain thus by Rama's arrows, the ground was littered with (bodies of) demons with limbs dismembered, headdresses and shoulders cut off, arms, thighs and knees decked with various ornaments amputated, chariots, horses, be

sanskrit: ते शूलैः पट्टिशैः खङ्गै शिलावर्षैर्द्रुमैरपि।।3.26.2।। शरवर्षैरविच्छिन्नं ववर्षुस्तं समन्ततः।
transliteration: te śūlaiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ khaṅgai śilāvarṣairdrumairapi||3.26.2|| śaravarṣairavicchinnṃ vavarṣustṃ samantatḥ|
meaning: The demons continuously hurled at him (Rama) spears and swords and rained stones, trees and arrows from all sides

sanskrit: स दृमाणां शिलानां च वर्षं प्राणहरं महत्।।3.26.3।। प्रतिजग्राह धर्मात्मा राघवस्तीक्ष्णसायकैः।
transliteration: sa dṛmāṇāṃ śilānāṃ ca varṣṃ prāṇaharṃ mahat||3.26.3|| pratijagrāha dharmātmā rāghavastīkṣṇasāyakaiḥ|
meaning: Righteous Rama, retaliated with his sharp arrows such as the rain of trees and stones, the mighty destroyers of life.

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य च तद्वर्षं निमीलित इवर्षभः।।3.26.4।। रामः क्रोधं परं भेजे वधार्थं सर्वरक्षसाम्।
transliteration: pratigṛhya ca tadvarṣṃ nimīlita ivarṣabhḥ||3.26.4|| rāmḥ krodhṃ parṃ bheje vadhārthṃ sarvarakṣasām|
meaning: Rama retaliated in great anger to kill without caring for the shower of weapons like a bull with its eyes closed.

sanskrit: ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टः प्रदीप्त इव तेजसा।।3.26.5।। शरैरवाकिरत्सैन्यं सर्वतस्सहदूषणम्।
transliteration: tatḥ krodhasamāviṣṭḥ pradīpta iva tejasā||3.26.5|| śarairavākiratsainyṃ sarvatassahadūṣaṇam|
meaning: Overpowered by anger, Rama, with a blazing glow, covered Dusana and his army with his arrows.

sanskrit: ततस्सेनापतिः क्रुद्धो दूषणश्शत्रुदूषणः।।3.26.6।। शरैरशनिकल्पैस्तं राघवं समवाकिरत्।
transliteration: tatassenāpatiḥ kruddho dūṣaṇaśśatrudūṣaṇḥ||3.26.6|| śarairaśanikalpaistṃ rāghavṃ samavākirat|
meaning: Thereafter Dusana, chief of the army, angrily released at Rama equally powerful arrows comparable to thunderbolt.

sanskrit: ततो रामस्सुसङ्कृद्धः क्षुरेणास्य महद्धनुः।।3.26.7।। चिच्छेद समरे वीरश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्।
transliteration: tato rāmassusaṅkṛddhḥ kṣureṇāsya mahaddhanuḥ||3.26.7|| ciccheda samare vīraścaturbhiścaturo hayān|
meaning: Heroic Rama, mighty angry, then, broke the big bow of Dusana, with his swordlike arrow. And with a series of four arrows cut his four horses to pieces.

sanskrit: हत्वा चाश्वान्शरैस्तीक्ष्णैरर्धचन्द्रेण सारथेः।।3.26.8।। शिरो जहार तद्रक्षस्त्रिभिर्विव्याध वक्षसि।
transliteration: hatvā cāśvānśaraistīkṣṇairardhacandreṇa sāratheḥ||3.26.8|| śiro jahāra tadrakṣastribhirvivyādha vakṣasi|
