meaning: After killing the horses with sharp arrows Rama severed the charioteer's head with an arrow of the shape of the crescent moon and pierced Dusana's chest with a set of three arrows.

sanskrit: स च्छिन्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः।।3.26.9।। जग्राह गिरिशृङ्गाभं परिघं रोमहर्षणम्। वेष्टितं काञ्चनैः पट्टैर्देवसैन्यप
transliteration: sa cchinnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ||3.26.9|| jagrāha giriśṛṅgābhṃ parighṃ romaharṣaṇam| veṣṭitṃ kāñcanaiḥ paṭ
meaning: With his bow and chariot broken, charioteer and horses killed, Dusana took up a spear in his hand that appeared like a huge mountain top. Bound by golden bands, covered the iron nails, wetted with the enemy's marrow it c

sanskrit: तं महोरगसङ्काशं प्रगृह्य परिघं रणे। दूषणोऽभ्यद्रवद्रामं क्रूरकर्मा निशाचरः।।3.26.12।।
transliteration: tṃ mahoragasaṅkāśṃ pragṛhya parighṃ raṇe| dūṣaṇo'bhyadravadrāmṃ krūrakarmā niśācarḥ||3.26.12||
meaning: With the spear that looked like a mighty serpent, Dusana, the cruel demon, advanced towards Rama.

sanskrit: तस्याभिपतमानस्य दूषणस्य स राघवः। द्वाभ्यां शराभ्यां चिच्छेद सहस्ताभरणौ भुजौ।।3.26.13।।
transliteration: tasyābhipatamānasya dūṣaṇasya sa rāghavḥ| dvābhyāṃ śarābhyāṃ ciccheda sahastābharaṇau bhujau||3.26.13||
meaning: Seeing Dusana going to pounce upon him, Rama cut off with two arrows both his arms adorned with armlets.

sanskrit: भ्रष्टस्तस्य महाकायः पपात रणमूर्धनि। परिघश्छिन्नहस्तस्य शक्रध्वज इवाग्रतः।।3.26.14।।
transliteration: bhraṣṭastasya mahākāyḥ papāta raṇamūrdhani| parighaśchinnahastasya śakradhvaja ivāgratḥ||3.26.14||
meaning: With the hands amputated, his huge spear, like the banner of Indra, slipped off his hands and fell down on the ground on the battle front.

sanskrit: स कराभ्यां विकीर्णाभ्यां पपात भुवि दूषणः। विषाणाभ्यां विशीर्णाभ्यां मनस्वीव महागजः।।3.26.15।।
transliteration: sa karābhyāṃ vikīrṇābhyāṃ papāta bhuvi dūṣaṇḥ| viṣāṇābhyāṃ viśīrṇābhyāṃ manasvīva mahāgajḥ||3.26.15||
meaning: Dusana fell down on the ground with broken hands like a proud elephant with both his tusks shattered.

sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ दूषणं निहतं रणे। साधुसाध्विति काकुत्स्थं सर्वभूतान्यपूजयन्।।3.26.16।।
transliteration: tṃ dṛṣṭvā patitṃ bhūmau dūṣaṇṃ nihatṃ raṇe| sādhusādhviti kākutsthṃ sarvabhūtānyapūjayan||3.26.16||
meaning: Seeing Dusaana collapse dead on the ground, all beings hailed Rama, saying, 'Well done, well done'.

sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धास्त्रयः सेनाग्रयायिनः। संहृत्याभ्यद्रवन् रामं मृत्युपाशावपाशिताः।।3.26.17।। महाकपालः स्थूलाक्षः प
transliteration: etasminnantare kruddhāstrayḥ senāgrayāyinḥ| sṃhṛtyābhyadravan rāmṃ mṛtyupāśāvapāśitāḥ||3.26.17|| mahākapālḥ sthūlākṣḥ pr
meaning: Meanwhile all the three army chiefs, Mahakapala, Sthulaksha, and the mighty Pramathi ran towards Rama in anger, bound (as though) by the noose of death.

sanskrit: महाकपालो विपुलं शूलमुद्यम्य राक्षसः।।3.26.18।। स्थूलाक्षः पट्टिसं गृह्य प्रमाथी च परश्वधम्।
transliteration: mahākapālo vipulṃ śūlamudyamya rākṣasḥ||3.26.18|| sthūlākṣḥ paṭṭisṃ gṛhya pramāthī ca paraśvadham|
meaning: Mahakapala had a huge spear, Sthulaksha, a sharpedged spear and Pramathi, a battleaxe.

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वैवापततस्तूर्णं राघवस्सायकैश्शितैः।।3.26.19।। तीक्ष्णाग्रैः प्रतिजग्राह सम्प्राप्तानतिथीनिव।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvaivāpatatastūrṇṃ rāghavassāyakaiśśitaiḥ||3.26.19|| tīkṣṇāgraiḥ pratijagrāha samprāptānatithīniva|
meaning: On seeing them rushing to attack him with sharp weapons, Rama received them quickly with pointed arrows as though they were guests.

sanskrit: महाकपालस्य शिरश्चिच्छेद परमेषुभिः।।3.26.20।। असङ्ख्येयैस्तु बाणौघैः प्रममाथ प्रमाथिनम्। स पपात हतो भूमौ विटपीव महाद्रुमः
transliteration: mahākapālasya śiraściccheda parameṣubhiḥ||3.26.20|| asaṅkhyeyaistu bāṇaughaiḥ pramamātha pramāthinam| sa papāta hato bhū
meaning: Mahakapala's head was cut to pieces with sharp arrows and Pramathi was killed with a countless series of arrows. Pramathi's body, like a huge tree with many branches collapsed on the ground.

sanskrit: स्थूलाक्षस्याक्षिणी तीक्ष्णैः पूरयामास सायकैः। दूषणस्यानुगान्पञ्चसहस्रान्कुपितः क्षणात्।।3.26.22।। बाणौघैः पञ्चसाहस्रैरन
transliteration: sthūlākṣasyākṣiṇī tīkṣṇaiḥ pūrayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ| dūṣaṇasyānugānpañcasahasrānkupitḥ kṣaṇāt||3.26.22|| bāṇaughaiḥ pañcasāha
meaning: Rama filled the eyes of Sthulaksha with sharp arrows, and in anger shot five thousand arrows at the five thousand followers of Dusana in a moment and sent them to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit: दूषणं निहतं दृष्ट्वा तस्य चैव पदानुगान्।।3.26.23।। व्यादिदेश खरः क्रुद्धः सेनाध्यक्षान्महाबलान्।
transliteration: dūṣaṇṃ nihatṃ dṛṣṭvā tasya caiva padānugān||3.26.23|| vyādideśa kharḥ kruddhḥ senādhyakṣānmahābalān|
meaning: Seeing Dusana and his followers killed, enraged Khara commanded his extremely strong army chiefs this way:

sanskrit: अयं विनिहतस्संख्ये दूषणस्सपदानुगः।।3.26.24।। महत्या सेनया सार्धं युद्ध्वा रामं कुमानुषम्। शस्त्रैर्नानाविधाकारैर्हनध्वं
transliteration: ayṃ vinihatassṃkhye dūṣaṇassapadānugḥ||3.26.24|| mahatyā senayā sārdhṃ yuddhvā rāmṃ kumānuṣam| śastrairnānāvidhākārairha
meaning: Dusana and his followers are killed in the battle. You, all the demons, along with your great army and different kinds of weapons should kill that wicked human being, Rama.

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा खरः क्रुद्धो राममेवाभिदुद्रुवे। श्येनगामी पृथुग्रीवो यज्ञशत्रुर्विहङ्गमः।।3.26.26।। दुर्जयः करवीराक्षः परुषः
transliteration: evamuktvā kharḥ kruddho rāmamevābhidudruve| śyenagāmī pṛthugrīvo yajñaśatrurvihaṅgamḥ||3.26.26|| durjayḥ karavīrākṣḥ par
meaning: Having spoken thus, angry Khara ran towards Rama. Syenagami, Pruthugriva, Yajnasatru, Vihanga, Durjaya, Karaveeraksha, Parusha, Kalakarmuka, Meghamali, Mahamali, Sarpasya, Rudhirasanaall these twelve valiant army chiefs

sanskrit: ततः पावकसङ्काशैर्हेमवज्रविभूषितैः। जघान शेषं तेजस्वी तस्य सैन्यस्य सायकैः।।3.26.29।।
transliteration: tatḥ pāvakasaṅkāśairhemavajravibhūṣitaiḥ| jaghāna śeṣṃ tejasvī tasya sainyasya sāyakaiḥ||3.26.29||
meaning: Powerful Rama thereafter slayed the remaining army with his weapons studded with gold and diamonds and glowing like fire.

sanskrit: ते रुक्मपुङ्खा विशिखास्सधूमा इव पावकाः। निजघ्नुस्तानि रक्षांसि वज्रा इव महाद्रुमान्।।3.26.30।।
transliteration: te rukmapuṅkhā viśikhāssadhūmā iva pāvakāḥ| nijaghnustāni rakṣāṃsi vajrā iva mahādrumān||3.26.30||
meaning: The goldtipped arrows which resembled fire covered with smoke shattered the army of demons like huge trees knocked down by thunder.

sanskrit: रक्षसां तु शतं रामश्शतेनैकेन कर्णिना। सहस्रं च सहस्रेण जघान रणमूर्धनि।।3.26.31।।
transliteration: rakṣasāṃ tu śatṃ rāmaśśatenaikena karṇinā| sahasrṃ ca sahasreṇa jaghāna raṇamūrdhani||3.26.31||
meaning: Rama killed a hundred demons with one hundred arrows by a single stroke. The same way he killed a thousand of them with a thousand arrows on the battle front.

sanskrit: तैर्भिन्नवर्माभरणाश्छिन्नभिन्नशरासनाः। निपेतुश्शोणितादिग्धा धरण्यां रजनीचराः।।3.26.32।।
transliteration: tairbhinnavarmābharaṇāśchinnabhinnaśarāsanāḥ| nipetuśśoṇitādigdhā dharaṇyāṃ rajanīcarāḥ||3.26.32||
meaning: The demons fell down on the ground with their shields and ornaments broken, their bows stained with blood splintered.

sanskrit: तैर्मुक्तकेशैस्समरे पतितैश्शोणितोक्षितैः। आस्तीर्णा वसुधा कृत्स्ना महावेदिः कुशैरिव।।3.26.33।।
transliteration: tairmuktakeśaissamare patitaiśśoṇitokṣitaiḥ| āstīrṇā vasudhā kṛtsnā mahāvediḥ kuśairiva||3.26.33||
meaning: The entire ground was littered with bodies of demons fallen in the battle with loose hair and with drops of blood on them looking like a great sacrificial altar strewn all over with kusa grass.

sanskrit: क्षणेन तु महाघोरं वनं निहतराक्षसम्। बभूव निरयप्रख्यं मांसशोणितकर्दमम्।।3.26.34।।
transliteration: kṣaṇena tu mahāghorṃ vanṃ nihatarākṣasam| babhūva nirayaprakhyṃ māṃsaśoṇitakardamam||3.26.34||
meaning: With the slaughtered bodies of demons lying on the ground, the forest in a moment looked very dreadful like hell with the mud of soil soaked with flesh and blood.

sanskrit: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्। हतान्येकेन रामेण मानुषेण पदातिना।।3.26.35।।
transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ bhīmakarmaṇām| hatānyekena rāmeṇa mānuṣeṇa padātinā||3.26.35||
meaning: Fourteen thousand formidable demons were killed by Rama, a pedestrian human, singlehanded.

sanskrit: तस्य सैन्यस्य सर्वस्य खरश्शेषो महारथः। राक्षसस्त्रिशिराश्चैव रामश्च रिपुसूदनः।।3.26.36।।
transliteration: tasya sainyasya sarvasya kharaśśeṣo mahārathḥ| rākṣasastriśirāścaiva rāmaśca ripusūdanḥ||3.26.36||
meaning: Of that entire army great warrior Khara,Trisira and Rama, destroyer of foes alone remained.

sanskrit: शेषा हता महासत्वा राक्षसा रणमूर्धनि। घोरा दुर्विषहाः सर्वे लक्ष्मणस्याग्रजेन ते।।3.26.37।।
transliteration: śeṣā hatā mahāsatvā rākṣasā raṇamūrdhani| ghorā durviṣahāḥ sarve lakṣmaṇasyāgrajena te||3.26.37||
meaning: The rest of the mighty, dreadful, intolerable demons were killed on the war front by Rama, elder brother to Lakshmana.

sanskrit: ततस्तु तद्भीमबलं महाहवे समीक्ष्य रामेण हतं बलीयसा। रथेन रामं महता खरस्तदा समाससादेन्द्र इवोद्यताशनिः।।3.26.38।।
transliteration: tatastu tadbhīmabalṃ mahāhave samīkṣya rāmeṇa hatṃ balīyasā| rathena rāmṃ mahatā kharastadā samāsasādendra ivodyatāśaniḥ
meaning: Thereafter seeing the formidable army killed by mighty Rama, Khara lifted a thunderbolt like Indra, and advanced towards Rama in a great chariot. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वालमिकिय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षङ्विंशस्सर्गः।। T

sanskrit: मां नियोजय विक्रान्त सन्निवर्तस्व साहसात्। पश्य रामं महाबाहुं संयुगे विनिपातितम्।।3.27.2।।
transliteration: māṃ niyojaya vikrānta sannivartasva sāhasāt| paśya rāmṃ mahābāhuṃ sṃyuge vinipātitam||3.27.2||
meaning: O valiant one assign this work to me. Refrain from this audacity. See how I am going to put down the mightyarmed Rama in the battle.

sanskrit: प्रतिजानामि ते सत्यमायुधं चाहमालभे। यथा रामं वधिष्यामि वधार्हं सर्वरक्षसाम्।।3.27.3।।
transliteration: pratijānāmi te satyamāyudhṃ cāhamālabhe| yathā rāmṃ vadhiṣyāmi vadhārhṃ sarvarakṣasām||3.27.3||
meaning: I promise you on my weapon that I will kill Rama.He who killed all demons deserves to be slain.

sanskrit: अहं वास्य रणे मृत्युरेष वा समरे मम। विनिवृत्य रणोत्साहान्मुहूर्तं प्राश्निको भव।।3.27.4।।
transliteration: ahṃ vāsya raṇe mṛtyureṣa vā samare mama| vinivṛtya raṇotsāhānmuhūrtṃ prāśniko bhava||3.27.4||
meaning: Restrain yourself for a moment from the enthusiasm to fight the war. Please act as an arbitrator and see who is killing whom.

sanskrit: प्रहृष्टो वा हते रामे जनस्थानं प्रयास्यसि। मयि वा निहते रामं संयुगायोपयास्यसि।।3.27.5।।
transliteration: prahṛṣṭo vā hate rāme janasthānṃ prayāsyasi| mayi vā nihate rāmṃ sṃyugāyopayāsyasi||3.27.5||
meaning: If Rama is killed be happy and go to Janasthana or else if I am killed you can fight.

sanskrit: खरस्त्रिशिरसा तेन मृत्युलोभात्प्रसादितः। गच्छ युध्येत्यनुज्ञातो राघवाभिमुखो ययौ।।3.27.6।।
transliteration: kharastriśirasā tena mṛtyulobhātprasāditḥ| gaccha yudhyetyanujñāto rāghavābhimukho yayau||3.27.6||
meaning: When Khara was prevailed upon by Trisara in that manner with a wish to face death, Khara permitted him by saying 'You may go and fight'.Accordingly he advanced towards Rama.

sanskrit: त्रिशिराश्च रथेनैव वाजियुक्तेन भास्वता। अभ्यद्रवद्रणे रामं त्रिशृङ्ग इव पर्वतः।।3.27.7।।
transliteration: triśirāśca rathenaiva vājiyuktena bhāsvatā| abhyadravadraṇe rāmṃ triśṛṅga iva parvatḥ||3.27.7||
meaning: Trisira who looked a mountain with three peaks also got horses harnessed to a shining chariot and to attack Rama proceeded.

sanskrit: शरधारासमूहान्स महामेघ इवोत्सृजन्। व्यसृजत्सदृशं नादं जलार्द्रस्य तु दुन्दुभेः।।3.27.8।।
transliteration: śaradhārāsamūhānsa mahāmegha ivotsṛjan| vyasṛjatsadṛśṃ nādṃ jalārdrasya tu dundubheḥ||3.27.8||
meaning: Trisira unleashed a stream of arrows like a huge cloud (releasing rain). They produced sound, a drum drenched with water, creates.

sanskrit: आगच्छन्तं त्रिशिरसं राक्षसं प्रेक्ष्य राघवः। धनुषा प्रतिजग्राह विधुन्वन्सायकान् शितान्।।3.27.9।।
transliteration: āgacchantṃ triśirasṃ rākṣasṃ prekṣya rāghavḥ| dhanuṣā pratijagrāha vidhunvansāyakān śitān||3.27.9||
meaning: On seeing demon Trisira advancing towards him, Rama shook sharp arrows off his bow.

sanskrit: स सम्प्रहारस्तुमुलो रामत्रिशिरसोर्महान्। बभूवातीव बलिनोस्सिंहकुञ्जरयोरिव।।3.27.10।।
transliteration: sa samprahārastumulo rāmatriśirasormahān| babhūvātīva balinossiṃhakuñjarayoriva||3.27.10||
meaning: The tumultuous combat between Rama and Trisira looked like the strong fight between a lion and an elephant.

sanskrit: ततस्त्रिशिरसा बाणैर्ललाटे ताडितस्त्रिभिः। अमर्षी कुपितोरामस्संरब्धमिदमब्रवीत्।।3.27.11।।
transliteration: tatastriśirasā bāṇairlalāṭe tāḍitastribhiḥ| amarṣī kupitorāmassṃrabdhamidamabravīt||3.27.11||
meaning: Then Rama hit with three arrows on the forehead by Trisira flew into a fury and said in a state of great excitement:

sanskrit: अहो विक्रमशूरस्य राक्षसस्येदृशं बलम्। पुष्पैरिव शरैर्यस्य ललाटेऽस्मिन्परिक्षतः।।3.27.12।।
transliteration: aho vikramaśūrasya rākṣasasyedṛśṃ balam| puṣpairiva śarairyasya lalāṭe'sminparikṣatḥ||3.27.12||
meaning: Oh see the strength of this undaunted demon whose arrows fell like flowers on my forehead and only left a scratch.

sanskrit: ममापि प्रतिगृह्णीष्व शरांश्चापगुणाच्च्युतान्। एवमुक्त्वा तु संरब्धश्शरानाशीविषोपमान्।3.27.13।। त्रिशिरोवक्षसि क्रुद्धो न
transliteration: mamāpi pratigṛhṇīṣva śarāṃścāpaguṇāccyutān| evamuktvā tu sṃrabdhaśśarānāśīviṣopamān|3.27.13|| triśirovakṣasi kruddho nij
meaning: Receive the arrows released from my bowstring. Saying so, the angry and agitated Rama discharged fourteen arrows, venomous like a snake, on the chest of Trisira .

sanskrit: चतुर्भिस्तुरगानस्य शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः।।3.27.14।। न्यपातयत तेजस्वी चतुरस्तस्य वाजिनः।
transliteration: caturbhisturagānasya śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ||3.27.14|| nyapātayata tejasvī caturastasya vājinḥ|
meaning: With four arrows having strong joints, the mighty hero (Rama) threw down his enemy's four swiftfooted horses.

sanskrit: अष्टभिस्सायकैस्सूतं रथोपस्थान्न्यपातयत्।।3.27.15।। रामश्चिच्छेद बाणेन ध्वजं चास्य समुच्छ्रितम्।
transliteration: aṣṭabhissāyakaissūtṃ rathopasthānnyapātayat||3.27.15|| rāmaściccheda bāṇena dhvajṃ cāsya samucchritam|
meaning: Rama brought down the charioteer with eight arrows and with one tore down the lofty banner of the chariot to shreds.

sanskrit: ततो हतरथात्तस्मादुत्पतन्तं निशाचरम्।।3.27.16।। बिभेद रामस्तं बाणैर्हृदये सोऽभवज्जडः।
transliteration: tato hatarathāttasmādutpatantṃ niśācaram||3.27.16|| bibheda rāmastṃ bāṇairhṛdaye so'bhavajjaḍḥ|
meaning: Rama then hit the demon with arrows on his chest while he was running away from the broken chariot. The demon became numb.

sanskrit: सायकैश्चाप्रमेयात्मा सामर्षस्तस्य रक्षसः।।3.27.17।। शिरांस्यपातयद्रामो वेगवद्भिस्त्रिभिश्शितैः।
transliteration: sāyakaiścāprameyātmā sāmarṣastasya rakṣasḥ||3.27.17|| śirāṃsyapātayadrāmo vegavadbhistribhiśśitaiḥ|
meaning: The mighty Rama in fury dismembered the heads of that demon with three sharp and swift arrows.

sanskrit: स भूमौ रुधिरोद्गारी रामबाणाभिपीडितः।।3.27.18।। न्यपतत्पतितैः पूर्वं स्वशिरोभिर्निशाचरः।
transliteration: sa bhūmau rudhirodgārī rāmabāṇābhipīḍitḥ||3.27.18|| nyapatatpatitaiḥ pūrvṃ svaśirobhirniśācarḥ|
meaning: The demon with his heads decapitated, hit by Rama's arrows a little while ago, fell down, vomitting blood.

sanskrit: हतशेषास्ततो भग्ना राक्षसाः खरसंश्रया।।3.27.19।। द्रवन्ति स्म न तिष्ठन्ति व्याघ्रत्रस्ता मृगा इव।
transliteration: hataśeṣāstato bhagnā rākṣasāḥ kharasṃśrayā||3.27.19|| dravanti sma na tiṣṭhanti vyāghratrastā mṛgā iva|
meaning: Those surviving demons who were under the protection of Khara got scared and retreated fast and fled like deer frightened by a tiger.

sanskrit: तान्खरो द्रवतो दृष्ट्वा निवर्त्य रुषितस्स्वयम्।।3.27.20।। राममेवाभिदुद्राव राहुश्चन्द्रमसं यथा।
transliteration: tānkharo dravato dṛṣṭvā nivartya ruṣitassvayam||3.27.20|| rāmamevābhidudrāva rāhuścandramasṃ yathā|
meaning: Personally persuading the fleeing army to come back, the angry Khara leaped forward towards Rama just as Rahu approaches the moon. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्तविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the

sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा राक्षसं सैन्यमविसह्यं महाबलः। हतमेकेन रामेण त्रिशिरोदूषणावपि।।3.28.2।। तद्बलं हतभूयिष्ठं विमनाः प्रेक्ष्य राक
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā rākṣasṃ sainyamavisahyṃ mahābalḥ| hatamekena rāmeṇa triśirodūṣaṇāvapi||3.28.2|| tadbalṃ hatabhūyiṣṭhṃ vimanāḥ
meaning: Khara, the mighty demon, saw his large, irrepressible army killed. He saw Trisira and Dusana slain singlehanded by Rama. Nervous, he advanced towards Rama wage war just as Namuchi approached Indra.

sanskrit: विकृष्य बलवच्चापं नाराचान्रक्तभोजनान्। खरश्चिक्षेप रामाय क्रुद्धानाशीविषानिव।।3.28.4।।
transliteration: vikṛṣya balavaccāpṃ nārācānraktabhojanān| kharaścikṣepa rāmāya kruddhānāśīviṣāniva||3.28.4||
meaning: Khara drew his strong bowstring in anger and released the bloodhungry arrows, which appeared like venomous snakes.

sanskrit: ज्यां विधून्वंसुबहुशश्शिक्षयास्त्राणि दर्शयन्। चचार समरे मार्गाञ्छरै रथगतः खरः।।3.28.5।।
transliteration: jyāṃ vidhūnvṃsubahuśaśśikṣayāstrāṇi darśayan| cacāra samare mārgāñcharai rathagatḥ kharḥ||3.28.5||
meaning: Khara, sat on the chariot, and with a twang of his bowstring released arrows in all directions, exhibiting his skill in the use of weapons.

sanskrit: स सर्वाश्च दिशो बाणैः प्रदिशश्च महारथः। पूरयामास तं दृष्ट्वा रामोऽपि सुमहद्धनुः।।3.28.6।।
transliteration: sa sarvāśca diśo bāṇaiḥ pradiśaśca mahārathḥ| pūrayāmāsa tṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmo'pi sumahaddhanuḥ||3.28.6||
meaning: When Rama, the great warrior, saw Khara approaching him, he fixed powerful arrows on his bow and covered all directions and intermediate quarters with his arrows.

sanskrit: स सायकैर्दुर्विसहैस्सस्फुलिङ्गैरिवाग्निभिः। नभश्चकाराविवरं पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिभिः।।3.28.7।।
transliteration: sa sāyakairdurvisahaissasphuliṅgairivāgnibhiḥ| nabhaścakārāvivarṃ parjanya iva vṛṣṭibhiḥ||3.28.7||
meaning: He rained sparkling arrows which were irresistible. He filled the sky with arrows just as the raingod fills it with rain without leaving any space.

sanskrit: तद्बभूव शितैर्बाणैः खररामविसर्जितैः। पर्याकाशमनाकाशं सर्वतश्शरसङ्कुलम्।।3.28.8।।
transliteration: tadbabhūva śitairbāṇaiḥ khararāmavisarjitaiḥ| paryākāśamanākāśṃ sarvataśśarasaṅkulam||3.28.8||
meaning: The arrows released by Khara and Rama on one another filled the entire sky. Everywhere only arrows and no sky could be seen.

sanskrit: शरजालावृतस्सूर्यो न तदा स्म प्रकाशते। अन्योन्यवधसंरम्भादुभयोस्संप्रयुध्यतोः।।3.28.9।।
transliteration: śarajālāvṛtassūryo na tadā sma prakāśate| anyonyavadhasṃrambhādubhayossṃprayudhyatoḥ||3.28.9||
meaning: While they were engaged in the battle, eager to kill each other the sky was covered with arrow and the Sun could not be seen.

sanskrit: ततो नालीकनाराचैस्तीक्ष्णाग्रैश्च विकर्णिभिः। आजघान खरो रामं तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपम्।।3.28.10।।
transliteration: tato nālīkanārācaistīkṣṇāgraiśca vikarṇibhiḥ| ājaghāna kharo rāmṃ totrairiva mahādvipam||3.28.10||
meaning: Then Khara shot Rama with Nalika darts and darts called Vikarni like goads hit a mighty elephant.

sanskrit: तं रथस्थं धनुष्पाणिं राक्षसं पर्यवस्थितम्। ददृशुस्सर्वभूतानि पाशहस्तमिवान्तकम्।।3.28.11।।
transliteration: tṃ rathasthṃ dhanuṣpāṇiṃ rākṣasṃ paryavasthitam| dadṛśussarvabhūtāni pāśahastamivāntakam||3.28.11||
meaning: Demon Khara positioned on the chariot, bow in hand, appeared to all beings like Yama, god of death holding the noose.

sanskrit: हन्तारं सर्वसैन्यस्य पौरुषे पर्यवस्थितम्। परिश्रान्तं महासत्वं मेने रामं खरस्तदा।।3.28.12।।
transliteration: hantārṃ sarvasainyasya pauruṣe paryavasthitam| pariśrāntṃ mahāsatvṃ mene rāmṃ kharastadā||3.28.12||
meaning: Khara thought valiant Rama who had destroyed his whole army might be exhausted by now.

sanskrit: तं सिंहमिव विक्रान्तं सिंहविक्रान्तगामिनम्। दृष्ट्वा नोद्विजते रामः सिंहः क्षुद्रमृगं यथा।।3.28.13।।
transliteration: tṃ siṃhamiva vikrāntṃ siṃhavikrāntagāminam| dṛṣṭvā nodvijate rāmḥ siṃhḥ kṣudramṛgṃ yathā||3.28.13||
meaning: When Rama saw Khara aggressively advancing like a lion to attack him, he was not perturbed, for he knew he was a fawn before a lion (which Rama was).

sanskrit: ततः सूर्यनिकाशेन रथेन महता खरः। आससाद रणे रामं पतङ्ग इव पावकम्।।3.28.14।।
transliteration: tatḥ sūryanikāśena rathena mahatā kharḥ| āsasāda raṇe rāmṃ pataṅga iva pāvakam||3.28.14||
meaning: Then Khara mounting a great chariot which was glowing like the Sun, advanced towards Rama just as an insect hurtles towards fire.

sanskrit: ततोऽस्य सशरं चापं मुष्टिदेशे महात्मनः। खरश्चिच्छेद रामस्य दर्शयन्पाणिलाघवम्।।3.28.15।।
transliteration: tato'sya saśarṃ cāpṃ muṣṭideśe mahātmanḥ| kharaściccheda rāmasya darśayanpāṇilāghavam||3.28.15||
meaning: Exhibiting his agility of the hand, Khara shattered the bow and the arrow in the grip of Rama ,the great soul.

sanskrit: स पुनस्त्वपरान्सप्त शरानादाय वर्मणि। निजघान खरः क्रुद्धश्शक्राशनिसमप्रभान्।।3.28.16।।
transliteration: sa punastvaparānsapta śarānādāya varmaṇi| nijaghāna kharḥ kruddhaśśakrāśanisamaprabhān||3.28.16||
meaning: The influriated Khara this time took up seven arrows blazing like Indra's thunderbolt and hit his armour.

sanskrit: ततस्तत्प्रहतं बाणैः खरमुक्तैस्सुपर्वभिः। पपात कवचं भूमौ रामस्यादित्यवर्चसः।।3.28.17।।
transliteration: tatastatprahatṃ bāṇaiḥ kharamuktaissuparvabhiḥ| papāta kavacṃ bhūmau rāmasyādityavarcasḥ||3.28.17||
meaning: The armour of Rama who looked radiant like the Sun fell on the ground, struck by the welljointed darts released by Khara.

sanskrit: ततश्शरसहस्रेण राममप्रतिमौजसम्। अर्दयित्वा महानादं ननाद समरे खरः।।3.28.18।।
transliteration: tataśśarasahasreṇa rāmamapratimaujasam| ardayitvā mahānādṃ nanāda samare kharḥ||3.28.18||
meaning: Khara then attacked Rama of unequal strength in fight, with a thousand darts and roared loudly.

sanskrit: स शरैरर्दितः क्रुद्धस्सर्वगात्रेषु राघवः। रराज समरे रामो विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्।।3.28.19।।
transliteration: sa śarairarditḥ kruddhassarvagātreṣu rāghavḥ| rarāja samare rāmo vidhūmo'gniriva jvalan||3.28.19||
meaning: Rama, scion of the Raghu race, afflicted by the darts in all parts of the body, glowed in his anger like smokeless fire burning.

sanskrit: ततो गम्भीरनिर्ह्रादं रामश्शत्रुनिबर्हणः। चकारान्ताय स रिपोस्सज्यमन्यन्महद्धनुः।।3.28.20।।
transliteration: tato gambhīranirhrādṃ rāmaśśatrunibarhaṇḥ| cakārāntāya sa ripossajyamanyanmahaddhanuḥ||3.28.20||
meaning: Then Rama, destroyer of foes, strung another great bow of fearful sound in order to put an end to the enemy.

sanskrit: सुमहद्वैष्णवं यत्तदतिसृष्टं महर्षिणा। वरं तद्धनुरुद्यम्य खरं समभिधावत।।3.28.21।।
transliteration: sumahadvaiṣṇavṃ yattadatisṛṣṭṃ maharṣiṇā| varṃ taddhanurudyamya kharṃ samabhidhāvata||3.28.21||
meaning: Thereafter Rama advanced, aiming at Khara the superior Vaishnava bow given by sage Agastya.

sanskrit: ततः कनकपुङ्खैस्तु शरैस्सन्नतपर्वभिः। बिभेद रामस्सङ्क्रुद्धः खरस्य समरे ध्वजम्।।3.28.22।।
transliteration: tatḥ kanakapuṅkhaistu śaraissannataparvabhiḥ| bibheda rāmassaṅkruddhḥ kharasya samare dhvajam||3.28.22||
meaning: Rama took up in a rage the welljointed, smooth darts with golden feathers and broke the flag post of the chariot of Khara to pieces.

sanskrit: स दर्शनीयो बहुधा विकीर्णः काञ्चनध्वजः। जगाम धरणीं सूर्यो देवतानामिवाज्ञया।।3.28.23।।
transliteration: sa darśanīyo bahudhā vikīrṇḥ kāñcanadhvajḥ| jagāma dharaṇīṃ sūryo devatānāmivājñayā||3.28.23||
meaning: The beautiful, golden flag post, broken into several pieces, fell down on earth.It appeared as if the Sun had come down to earth at the behest of the gods.

sanskrit: तं चतुर्भिः खरः क्रुद्धो रामं गात्रेषु मार्गणैः। विव्याध युधि मर्मज्ञो मातङ्गमिव तोमरैः।।3.28.24।।
transliteration: tṃ caturbhiḥ kharḥ kruddho rāmṃ gātreṣu mārgaṇaiḥ| vivyādha yudhi marmajño mātaṅgamiva tomaraiḥ||3.28.24||
meaning: Quite enraged, Khara who knew how to hit the tender parts (of the body) in an encounter sent out four arrows on Rama. It was like poking an elephant's limbs with a javelin.

sanskrit: स रामो बहुभिर्बाणैः खरकार्मुकनिस्सृतैः। विद्धो रुधिरसिक्ताङ्गो बभूव रुषितो भृशम्।।3.28.25।।
transliteration: sa rāmo bahubhirbāṇaiḥ kharakārmukanissṛtaiḥ| viddho rudhirasiktāṅgo babhūva ruṣito bhṛśam||3.28.25||
meaning: Rama, hit by the arrows released from the bow of Khara, all his limbs drenched in blood, became very furious.

sanskrit: स धनुर्धन्विनां श्रेष्ठः प्रगृह्य परमाहवे। मुमोच परमेष्वासष्षट्छरानभिलक्षितान्।।3.28.26।।
transliteration: sa dhanurdhanvināṃ śreṣṭhḥ pragṛhya paramāhave| mumoca parameṣvāsaṣṣaṭcharānabhilakṣitān||3.28.26||
meaning: The best among archers and a supreme shooter, he lifted the bow, fixed his target and released six arrows in the great fight.

sanskrit: शिरस्येकेन बाणेन द्वाभ्यां बह्वोरथार्दयत्। त्रिभिश्चन्द्रार्धवक्त्रैश्च वक्षस्यभिजघान ह।।3.28.27।।
transliteration: śirasyekena bāṇena dvābhyāṃ bahvorathārdayat| tribhiścandrārdhavaktraiśca vakṣasyabhijaghāna ha||3.28.27||
meaning: Rama hit one arrow on the head, two on the shoulders and three of the shape of the crescent moon on the chest (of the enemy).

sanskrit: ततः पश्चान्महातेजा नाराचान्भास्करोपमान्। जिघांसू राक्षसङ्कृद्धस्त्रयोदश समाददे।।3.28.28।।
transliteration: tatḥ paścānmahātejā nārācānbhāskaropamān| jighāṃsū rākṣasaṅkṛddhastrayodaśa samādade||3.28.28||
meaning: Enraged and effulgent Rama took up thirteen darts, radiant like the Sun, with a wish to kill the demon.

sanskrit: ततोऽस्य युगमेकेन चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्। षष्ठेन तु शिरस्सङ्ख्ये खरस्य रथसारथेः।।3.28.29।। त्रिभिस्त्रिवेणुं बलवान्द्वाभ्या
transliteration: tato'sya yugamekena caturbhiścaturo hayān| ṣaṣṭhena tu śirassaṅkhye kharasya rathasāratheḥ||3.28.29|| tribhistriveṇuṃ ba
meaning: Rama, like Indra, strong and mighty, broke the yoke of Khara's chariot with one arrow, the four horses with four arrows, and with the sixth the charioteer's head, with three others the main pole of the chariot, with two

sanskrit: प्रभग्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः। गदापाणिरवप्लुत्य तस्थौ भूमौ खरस्तदा।।3.28.32।।
transliteration: prabhagnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ| gadāpāṇiravaplutya tasthau bhūmau kharastadā||3.28.32||
meaning: Then, with bow broken, chariot destroyed, horses and charioteer dead, Khara jumped down the chariot and stood on the ground holding a mace.

sanskrit: तत्कर्म रामस्य महारथस्य समेत्य देवाश्च महर्षयश्च। अपूजयन्प्राञ्जलयः प्रहृष्टाः तदा विमानाग्रगतास्समेताः।।3.28.33।।
transliteration: tatkarma rāmasya mahārathasya sametya devāśca maharṣayaśca| apūjayanprāñjalayḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ tadā vimānāgragatāssametāḥ||3.2
meaning: Then the gods, along with great sages came down in aerial chariots and assembled there. Delighted, they adored Rama, the great warrior, with folded hands for the work done. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकिय आदिकाव्ये अर

sanskrit: गजाश्वरथसम्बाधे बले महति तिष्ठता। कृतं सुदारुणं कर्म सर्वलोकजुगुप्सितम्।।3.29.2।।
transliteration: gajāśvarathasambādhe bale mahati tiṣṭhatā| kṛtṃ sudāruṇṃ karma sarvalokajugupsitam||3.29.2||
meaning: Although you command a huge army with many elephants, horses, chariots, etc. you have done such cruel deeds that the entire world despises you.

sanskrit: उद्वेजनीयो भूतानां नृशंसः पापकर्मकृत्। त्रयाणामपि लोकानामीश्वरोऽपि न तिष्ठति।।3.29.3।।
transliteration: udvejanīyo bhūtānāṃ nṛśṃsḥ pāpakarmakṛt| trayāṇāmapi lokānāmīśvaro'pi na tiṣṭhati||3.29.3||
meaning: One who is wicked, does sinful deeds and causes distress to all beings, will not survive even if he is the lord of the three worlds.

sanskrit: कर्म लोकविरुद्धं तु कुर्वाणं क्षणदाचर। तीक्ष्णं सर्वजनो हन्ति सर्पं दुष्टमिवागतम्।।3.29.4।।
transliteration: karma lokaviruddhṃ tu kurvāṇṃ kṣaṇadācara| tīkṣṇṃ sarvajano hanti sarpṃ duṣṭamivāgatam||3.29.4||
meaning: O nightranger, one who does a horrific deed which is against the world will be killed like an evil serpent come near.

sanskrit: लोभात्पापानि कुर्वाणः कामाद्वा यो न बुध्यते। भ्रष्टः पश्यति तस्यान्तं ब्राह्मणी करकादिव।।3.29.5।।
transliteration: lobhātpāpāni kurvāṇḥ kāmādvā yo na budhyate| bhraṣṭḥ paśyati tasyāntṃ brāhmaṇī karakādiva||3.29.5||
meaning: Whoever commits sinful deeds out of greed or passion and without realisation will be ruined at the end like a lizard that eats hailstone (and dies).

sanskrit: वसतो दण्डकारण्ये तापसान्धर्मचारिणः। किन्नु हत्वा महाभागान्फलं प्राप्स्यसि राक्षस।।3.29.6।।
transliteration: vasato daṇḍakāraṇye tāpasāndharmacāriṇḥ| kinnu hatvā mahābhāgānphalṃ prāpsyasi rākṣasa||3.29.6||
meaning: O demon what benefit will you get by killing the venerable ascetics, followers of righteous path residing in Dandaka forest?

sanskrit: न चिरं पापकर्माणः क्रूरा लोकजुगुप्सिताः। ऐश्वर्यं प्राप्य तिष्ठन्ति शीर्णमूला इव द्रुमाः।।3.29.7।।
transliteration: na cirṃ pāpakarmāṇḥ krūrā lokajugupsitāḥ| aiśvaryṃ prāpya tiṣṭhanti śīrṇamūlā iva drumāḥ||3.29.7||
meaning: Cruel people, who are despised by the world for their sinful deeds, will not be prosperous for long just like trees with decayed roots.

sanskrit: अवश्यं लभते जन्तुः फलं पापस्य कर्मणः। घोरं पर्यागते काले द्रुमाः पुष्पमिवार्तवम्।।3.29.8।।
transliteration: avaśyṃ labhate jantuḥ phalṃ pāpasya karmaṇḥ| ghorṃ paryāgate kāle drumāḥ puṣpamivārtavam||3.29.8||
meaning: Just as the trees bear flowers at the proper season, so also people will certainly reap the fruits of their terrible, sinful deeds at appropriate time.

sanskrit: नचिरात्प्राप्यते लोके पापानां कर्मणां फलम्। सविषाणामिवान्नानां भुक्तानां क्षणदाचर।।3.29.9।।
transliteration: nacirātprāpyate loke pāpānāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalam| saviṣāṇāmivānnānāṃ bhuktānāṃ kṣaṇadācara||3.29.9||
meaning: O nightranger people will reap the result of their sinful actions in this world soon like one eating poisonous food.

sanskrit: पापमाचरतां घोरं लोकस्याप्रियमिच्छताम्। अहमासादितो राजा प्राणान्हन्तुं निशाचर।।3.29.10।।
transliteration: pāpamācaratāṃ ghorṃ lokasyāpriyamicchatām| ahamāsādito rājā prāṇānhantuṃ niśācara||3.29.10||
meaning: O nightranger I have come with the orders of the king to put an end to the lives of the perpetrators of dreadful, sinful and offensive deeds in this world.

sanskrit: अद्य हि त्वां मया मुक्ताश्शराः काञ्चनभूषणाः। विदार्यातिपतिष्यन्ति वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः।।3.29.11।।
transliteration: adya hi tvāṃ mayā muktāśśarāḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ| vidāryātipatiṣyanti valmīkamiva pannagāḥ||3.29.11||
meaning: Now when I unleash the golden arrows, they will pierce through your body and come out like serpents emerging from the anthill.

sanskrit: ये त्वया दण्डकारण्ये भक्षिता धर्मचारिणः। तानद्य निहतस्सङ्ख्ये ससैन्योऽनुगमिष्यसि।।3.29.12।।
transliteration: ye tvayā daṇḍakāraṇye bhakṣitā dharmacāriṇḥ| tānadya nihatassaṅkhye sasainyo'nugamiṣyasi||3.29.12||
meaning: Slain by me in the battle today, you and your army will follow the righteous men eaten by you in Dandaka forest.

sanskrit: अद्य त्वां निहतं बाणैः पश्यन्तु परमर्षयः। निरयस्थं विमानस्था ये त्वया हिंसिताः पुरा।।3.29.13।।
transliteration: adya tvāṃ nihatṃ bāṇaiḥ paśyantu paramarṣayḥ| nirayasthṃ vimānasthā ye tvayā hiṃsitāḥ purā||3.29.13||
meaning: The great seers whom you have earlier tortured and killed will, from their aerial vehicles, see you fallen into hell.

sanskrit: प्रहर त्वं यथाकामं कुरु यत्नं कुलाधम। अद्य ते पातयिष्यामि शिरस्तालफलं यथा।।3.29.14।।
transliteration: prahara tvṃ yathākāmṃ kuru yatnṃ kulādhama| adya te pātayiṣyāmi śirastālaphalṃ yathā||3.29.14||
meaning: O vile fellow, now you may strike at me as you please. I will make your head fall down like a palm fruit.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण कृद्धस्संरक्तलोचनः। प्रत्युवाच खरो रामं प्रहसन्क्रोधमूर्छितः।।3.29.15।।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa kṛddhassṃraktalocanḥ| pratyuvāca kharo rāmṃ prahasankrodhamūrchitḥ||3.29.15||
meaning: Challenged by Rama in that manner, Khara, his senses switched off, eyes turned red due to anger, replied laughing :

sanskrit: प्राकृतान्राक्षसान्हत्वा युद्धे दशरथात्मज। आत्मना कथमात्मानमप्रशस्यं प्रशंससि।।3.29.16।।
transliteration: prākṛtānrākṣasānhatvā yuddhe daśarathātmaja| ātmanā kathamātmānamapraśasyṃ praśṃsasi||3.29.16||
meaning: O son of Dasaratha, it is not praiseworthy to kill ordinary demons in war. Why do you praise yourself for it?

sanskrit: विक्रान्ता बलवन्तो वा ये भवन्ति नरर्षभाः। कथयन्ति न ते किञ्चित्तेजसा स्वेन गर्विताः।।3.29.17।।
transliteration: vikrāntā balavanto vā ye bhavanti nararṣabhāḥ| kathayanti na te kiñcittejasā svena garvitāḥ||3.29.17||
meaning: The valiant, strong and the best of men do not at all speak proudly of themselves and their valour.

sanskrit: प्राकृतास्त्वकृतात्मानो लोके क्षत्रियपांसनाः। निरर्थकं विकत्थन्ते यथा राम विकत्थसे।।3.29.18।।
transliteration: prākṛtāstvakṛtātmāno loke kṣatriyapāṃsanāḥ| nirarthakṃ vikatthante yathā rāma vikatthase||3.29.18||
meaning: O Rama common people, having no control over themselves and the lowest of kshatriyas boast of themselves in the world in a meaningless way as you are doing (now).

sanskrit: कुलं व्यपदिशन्वीरस्समरे कोऽभिधास्यति। मृत्युकाले हि सम्प्राप्ते स्वयमप्रस्तवे स्तवम्।।3.29.19।।
transliteration: kulṃ vyapadiśanvīrassamare ko'bhidhāsyati| mṛtyukāle hi samprāpte svayamaprastave stavam||3.29.19||
meaning: When death comes in a battle no hero will name his race and boast of himself unnessarily.

sanskrit: सर्वथैव लघुत्वं ते कत्थनेन विदर्शितम्। सुवर्णप्रतिरूपेण तप्तेनेव कुशाग्निना।।3.29.20।।
transliteration: sarvathaiva laghutvṃ te katthanena vidarśitam| suvarṇapratirūpeṇa tapteneva kuśāgninā||3.29.20||
meaning: All your meanness is exhibited by your boasting just as the kusa grass caught by fire appears like gold.

sanskrit: न तु मामिह तिष्ठन्तं पश्यसि त्वं गदाधरम्। धराधरमिवाकम्प्यं पर्वतं धातुभिश्चितम्।।3.29.21।।
transliteration: na tu māmiha tiṣṭhantṃ paśyasi tvṃ gadādharam| dharādharamivākampyṃ parvatṃ dhātubhiścitam||3.29.21||
meaning: Indeed, (it is strange that) you do not see me holding a mace and standing here like an unshakeable mountain which contains minerals and supports the earth.

sanskrit: पर्याप्तोऽहं गदापाणिर्हन्तुं प्राणान्रणे तव। त्रयाणामपि लोकानां पाशहस्त इवान्तकः।।3.29.22।।
transliteration: paryāpto'hṃ gadāpāṇirhantuṃ prāṇānraṇe tava| trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ pāśahasta ivāntakḥ||3.29.22||
meaning: Just like lord Yama, holding a noose of death is alone enough to destroy the three worlds, I am alone sufficient to take away your life in war, a mace in hand.

sanskrit: कामं बह्वपि वक्तव्यं त्वयि वक्ष्यामि न त्वहम्। अस्तं गच्छेद्धि सविता युद्धविघ्नस्ततो भवेत्।।3.29.23।।
transliteration: kāmṃ bahvapi vaktavyṃ tvayi vakṣyāmi na tvaham| astṃ gaccheddhi savitā yuddhavighnastato bhavet||3.29.23||
meaning: Indeed, I shall not speak any more even though a lot can be said on you. But the Sun is about to set and it will be improper to wage war thereafter.

sanskrit: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि राक्षसानां हतानि ते। त्वद्विनाशात्करोम्येषां तेषामश्रुप्रमार्जनम्।।3.29.24।।
transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rākṣasānāṃ hatāni te| tvadvināśātkaromyeṣāṃ teṣāmaśrupramārjanam||3.29.24||
meaning: You have killed these fourteen thousand demons. Therefore, I will wipe their tears by destroying you.

sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा परमक्रुद्धस्तां गदां परमाङ्गदः। खरश्चिक्षेप रामाय प्रदीप्तामशनिं यथा।।3.29.25।।
transliteration: ityuktvā paramakruddhastāṃ gadāṃ paramāṅgadḥ| kharaścikṣepa rāmāya pradīptāmaśaniṃ yathā||3.29.25||
meaning: Having said this, highly enraged Khara adorned with large shoulder bands, hurled at Rama, his mace glowing like a thunderbolt.

sanskrit: खरबाहुप्रयुक्ता सा प्रदीप्ता महती गदा। भस्मवृक्षांश्च गुल्मांश्च कृत्वागात्तत्समीपतः।।3.29.26।।
transliteration: kharabāhuprayuktā sā pradīptā mahatī gadā| bhasmavṛkṣāṃśca gulmāṃśca kṛtvāgāttatsamīpatḥ||3.29.26||
meaning: The huge, blazing mace hurled by Khara's arms reduced the trees and shrubs into ashes and came close to Rama.

sanskrit: तामापतन्तीं ज्वलतां मृत्युपाशोपमां गदाम्। अन्तरिक्षगतां रामचशिच्छेद बहुधा शरैः।।3.29.27।।
transliteration: tāmāpatantīṃ jvalatāṃ mṛtyupāśopamāṃ gadām| antarikṣagatāṃ rāmacaśiccheda bahudhā śaraiḥ||3.29.27||
meaning: The mace, which moved in the sky burning like the noose of death was shattered to pieces by Rama.

sanskrit: सा विकीर्णा शरैर्भग्ना पपात धरणीतले। गदा मन्त्रौषधबलैर्व्यालीव विनिपातिता।।3.29.28।।
transliteration: sā vikīrṇā śarairbhagnā papāta dharaṇītale| gadā mantrauṣadhabalairvyālīva vinipātitā||3.29.28||
meaning: The mace shattered by the arrows of Rama , fell down scattered to pieces on the ground like a female serpent subdued by the force of mantras and medicine. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकोनत्रि

sanskrit: अथोवाच पुनर्वाक्यं विराधः पूरयन्वनम्। पृच्छतो मम हि ब्रूतं कौ युवां क्व गमिष्यथः।।3.3.2.।।
transliteration: athovāca punarvākyṃ virādhḥ pūrayanvanam| pṛcchato mama hi brūtṃ kau yuvāṃ kva gamiṣyathḥ||3.3.2.||
meaning: Then Viradha with his voice filling the forest said, Instead of asking about me you both should speak out who you are and where you are going

sanskrit: तमुवाच ततो रामो राक्षसं ज्वलिताननम्। पृच्छन्तं सुमहातेजा इक्ष्वाकुकुलमात्मनः।।3.3.3।।
transliteration: tamuvāca tato rāmo rākṣasṃ jvalitānanam| pṛcchantṃ sumahātejā ikṣvākukulamātmanḥ||3.3.3||
meaning: Questioned by the demon, who bore a burning countenance, the highly effulgent Rama introduced his Ikshvaku family:

sanskrit: क्षत्रियौ वृत्तसम्पन्नौ विद्धि नौ वनगोचरौ। त्वां तु वेदितुमिच्छावः कस्त्वं चरसि दण्डकान्।।3.3.4।।
transliteration: kṣatriyau vṛttasampannau viddhi nau vanagocarau| tvāṃ tu veditumicchāvḥ kastvṃ carasi daṇḍakān||3.3.4||
meaning: Know us to be both kshatriyas, endowed with a good lineage and yet moving in the forest. We both wish to know, who you are and why you are going about in Dandaka forest?

sanskrit: तमुवाच विराधस्तु रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्। हन्त वक्ष्यामि ते राजन्निबोध मम राघव।।3.3.5।।
transliteration: tamuvāca virādhastu rāmṃ satyaparākramam| hanta vakṣyāmi te rājannibodha mama rāghava||3.3.5||
meaning: Then Viradha said to Rama whose truth was his strength, I will tell you who I am. O, listen:

sanskrit: पुत्रः किल जयस्याहं माता मम शतह्रदा। विराध इति मामाहुः पृथिव्यां सर्वराक्षसाः।।3.3.6।।
transliteration: putrḥ kila jayasyāhṃ mātā mama śatahradā| virādha iti māmāhuḥ pṛthivyāṃ sarvarākṣasāḥ||3.3.6||
meaning: I am indeed son to Jaya. My mother is Satahrada. Verily all the demons on this earth call me Viradha.

sanskrit: तपसा चाभिसम्प्राप्ता ब्रह्मणो हि प्रसादजा। शस्त्रेणावध्यता लोकेऽच्छेद्याभेद्यत्वमेव च।।3.3.7।।
transliteration: tapasā cābhisamprāptā brahmaṇo hi prasādajā| śastreṇāvadhyatā loke'cchedyābhedyatvameva ca||3.3.7||
meaning: By the grace of Lord Brahma I was bestowed with this prowess through my penance. In this world none can kill me with a weapon nor split nor cut me to pieces.

sanskrit: उत्सृज्य प्रमदामेनामनपेक्षौ यथागतम्। त्वरमाणौ पलायेथां न वां जीवितमाददे।। 3.3.8।।
transliteration: utsṛjya pramadāmenāmanapekṣau yathāgatam| tvaramāṇau palāyethāṃ na vāṃ jīvitamādade|| 3.3.8||
meaning: Therefore, leave this lady and run away to the place you came from. I will not take away your life .

sanskrit: तं रामः प्रत्युवाचेदं कोपसंरक्तलोचनः। राक्षसं विकृताकारं विराधं पापचेतसम्।।3.3.9।।
transliteration: tṃ rāmḥ pratyuvācedṃ kopasṃraktalocanḥ| rākṣasṃ vikṛtākārṃ virādhṃ pāpacetasam||3.3.9||
meaning: With eyes reddened with anger Rama replied to the sinful, deformed Viradha:

sanskrit: क्षुद्र धिक्त्वां तु हीनार्थं मृत्युमन्वेषसे ध्रुवम्। रणे प्राप्स्यसे सन्तिष्ठ न मे जीवन् गमिष्यासि।।3.3.10।।
transliteration: kṣudra dhiktvāṃ tu hīnārthṃ mṛtyumanveṣase dhruvam| raṇe prāpsyase santiṣṭha na me jīvan gamiṣyāsi||3.3.10||
meaning: O vile, mean creature surely you are seeking death. Wait, you will meet it in the fight.

sanskrit: ततः सज्यं धनुः कृत्वा रामस्सुनिशिताञ्छरान्। सुशीघ्रमभिसन्धाय राक्षसं निजघान ह।।3.3.11।।
transliteration: tatḥ sajyṃ dhanuḥ kṛtvā rāmassuniśitāñcharān| suśīghramabhisandhāya rākṣasṃ nijaghāna ha||3.3.11||
meaning: Then Rama strung his bow immediately, shot the sharp arrows at Viradha and hit him verily.

sanskrit: धनुषा ज्यागुणवता सप्त बाणान्मुमोच ह। रुक्मपुङ्खान्महावेगान्सुपर्णानिलतुल्यगान्।।3.3.12।।
transliteration: dhanuṣā jyāguṇavatā sapta bāṇānmumoca ha| rukmapuṅkhānmahāvegānsuparṇānilatulyagān||3.3.12||
meaning: From his bow strung tight, Rama shot seven swift, goldenfeathered arrows comparable to Garuda and the Windgod in speed.

sanskrit: ते शरीरं विराधस्य भित्त्वाबर्हिणवाससः। निपेतुश्शोणितादिग्धा धरण्यां पावकोपमाः।।3.3.13।।
transliteration: te śarīrṃ virādhasya bhittvābarhiṇavāsasḥ| nipetuśśoṇitādigdhā dharaṇyāṃ pāvakopamāḥ||3.3.13||
meaning: The arrows tied with peacockfeathers, looking like fire, pierced the body of Viradha which, drenched in blood, fell on the ground.

sanskrit: स विद्धो न्यस्य वैदेहीं शूलमुद्यम्य राक्षसः। अभ्यद्रवत्सुसङ्कृद्धस्तदा रामं सलक्ष्मणम्।।3.3.14।।
transliteration: sa viddho nyasya vaidehīṃ śūlamudyamya rākṣasḥ| abhyadravatsusaṅkṛddhastadā rāmṃ salakṣmaṇam||3.3.14||
meaning: Hit by Rama and Lakshmana, the enraged demon left Vaidehi, lifted a sharp spear and ran towards them.

sanskrit: स विनद्य महानादं शूलं शक्रध्वजोपमम्। प्रगृह्याशोभत तदा व्यात्तानन इवान्तकः।।3.3.15।।
transliteration: sa vinadya mahānādṃ śūlṃ śakradhvajopamam| pragṛhyāśobhata tadā vyāttānana ivāntakḥ||3.3.15||
meaning: The demon who produced a great noise with his wide open mouth resembled the god of death. He lifted a sharp spike that looked like Indra's banner.

sanskrit: अथ तौ भ्रातरौ दीप्तं शरवर्षं ववर्षतुः। विराधे राक्षसे तस्मिन् कालान्तकयमोपमे।।3.3.16।।
transliteration: atha tau bhrātarau dīptṃ śaravarṣṃ vavarṣatuḥ| virādhe rākṣase tasmin kālāntakayamopame||3.3.16||
meaning: And then both the brothers showered bright arrows on the demon Viradha who looked like Yama, the god of death.

sanskrit: स प्रहस्य महारौद्रः स्थित्वाजृम्भत राक्षसः। जृम्भमाणस्य ते बाणाः कायान्निष्पेतुराशुगाः।।3.3.17।।
transliteration: sa prahasya mahāraudrḥ sthitvājṛmbhata rākṣasḥ| jṛmbhamāṇasya te bāṇāḥ kāyānniṣpeturāśugāḥ||3.3.17||
meaning: The demon who was extremely frightening stood there, laughing and yawning. As he yawned, all the swiftlyflying arrows fell out of his body.

sanskrit: स्पर्शात्तु वरदानेन प्राणान्सम्रोध्य राक्षसः। विराधः शूलमुद्यम्य राघवावभ्यधावत।।3.3.18।।
transliteration: sparśāttu varadānena prāṇānsamrodhya rākṣasḥ| virādhḥ śūlamudyamya rāghavāvabhyadhāvata||3.3.18||
meaning: By virtue of a boon Viradha, the demon, controlled the vital breath of his body by a mere touch and, raising the spike, ran towards the two Raghava princes.

sanskrit: तच्छूलं वज्रसङ्काशं गगने ज्वलनोपमम्। द्वाभ्यां शराभ्यां चिच्छेद रामः शस्त्रभृतांवरः।।3.3.19।।
transliteration: tacchūlṃ vajrasaṅkāśṃ gagane jvalanopamam| dvābhyāṃ śarābhyāṃ ciccheda rāmḥ śastrabhṛtāṃvarḥ||3.3.19||
meaning: With two arrows, Rama, the best among wielders of weapons, broke down the spike in the sky burning like fire, and resembling the thunderbolt of Indra.

sanskrit: तद्रामविशिखच्छिन्नं शूलं तस्यकराद्भुवि। पपाताशनिना छिन्नं मेरोरिव शिलातलम्।।3.3.20।।
transliteration: tadrāmaviśikhacchinnṃ śūlṃ tasyakarādbhuvi| papātāśaninā chinnṃ meroriva śilātalam||3.3.20||
meaning: The spike, broken down by Rama's arrow, fell like a slab of mount Meru splintered by Indra's thunder.

sanskrit: तौ खड्गौ क्षिप्रमुद्यम्य कृष्णसर्पोपमौशुभौ। तूर्णमापेततुस्तस्य तदा प्रहरतां बलात्।।3.3.21।।
transliteration: tau khaḍgau kṣipramudyamya kṛṣṇasarpopamauśubhau| tūrṇamāpetatustasya tadā praharatāṃ balāt||3.3.21||
meaning: Then both Rama and Lakshmana quickly raised their swords which looked like black serpents and at once fell upon the demon who was going to strike with great force.

sanskrit: स वध्यमानः सुभृशं भुजाभ्यां परिरभ्यतौ। अप्रकम्प्यौ नरव्याघ्रौ रौद्रः प्रस्थातुमैच्छत।।3.3.22।।
transliteration: sa vadhyamānḥ subhṛśṃ bhujābhyāṃ parirabhyatau| aprakampyau naravyāghrau raudrḥ prasthātumaicchata||3.3.22||
meaning: Struck down, the angry demon tightly caught hold of both of them under his arms and wanted to set out, carrying Rama and Lakshmana, the two unshakeable tigers among men.

sanskrit: तस्याभिप्रायमाज्ञाय रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्। वहत्वयमलं तावत्पथाऽनेन तु राक्षसः।।3.3.23।।
transliteration: tasyābhiprāyamājñāya rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt| vahatvayamalṃ tāvatpathā'nena tu rākṣasḥ||3.3.23||
meaning: Rama understood the intention of the demon and said to Lakshmana, Let him go his way, no need to stop him.

sanskrit: यथा चेच्छति सौमित्रे तथा वहतु राक्षसः। अयमेव हि नः पन्था येन याति निशाचरः।।3.3.24।।
transliteration: yathā cecchati saumitre tathā vahatu rākṣasḥ| ayameva hi nḥ panthā yena yāti niśācarḥ||3.3.24||
meaning: O Lakshmana, let the nightstalker go the way he wishes. That is, in fact, our path.

sanskrit: स तु स्वबलवीर्येण समुत्क्षिप्य निशाचरः। बालाविव स्कन्धगतौ चकारातिबलोद्धतः।।3.3.25।।
transliteration: sa tu svabalavīryeṇa samutkṣipya niśācarḥ| bālāviva skandhagatau cakārātibaloddhatḥ||3.3.25||
meaning: Puffed up with his own great strength, Viradha lifted them and placed them on his shoulders as though they were two children.

sanskrit: तावारोप्य ततः स्कन्धं राघवौ रजनीचरः। विराधो विनदन्घोरं जगामाभिमुखो वनम्।।3.3.26।।
transliteration: tāvāropya tatḥ skandhṃ rāghavau rajanīcarḥ| virādho vinadanghorṃ jagāmābhimukho vanam||3.3.26||
meaning: Then the nightstalker proceeded towards the forest, carrying both the scions of the Raghu race on his shouldersroaring.

sanskrit: एतत्ते बलसर्वस्वं दर्शितं राक्षसाधम। शक्तिहीनतरो मत्तो वृथा त्वमवगर्जसि।।3.30.2।।
transliteration: etatte balasarvasvṃ darśitṃ rākṣasādhama| śaktihīnataro matto vṛthā tvamavagarjasi||3.30.2||
meaning: O lowly demon, you have already exhibited all your strength. Inferior to me in energy, you are needlessly roaring.

sanskrit: एषा बाणविनिर्भिन्ना गदा भूमितलं गता। अभिधानप्रगल्भस्य तव प्रत्ययघातिनी।।3.30.3।।
transliteration: eṣā bāṇavinirbhinnā gadā bhūmitalṃ gatā| abhidhānapragalbhasya tava pratyayaghātinī||3.30.3||
meaning: The mace about which you boasted so much has betrayed your confidence. Shattered by my arrows it now lies on the ground.

sanskrit: यत्त्वयोक्तं विनष्टानामहमश्रुप्रमार्जनम्। राक्षसानां करोमीति मिथ्या तदपि ते वचः।।3.30.4।।
transliteration: yattvayoktṃ vinaṣṭānāmahamaśrupramārjanam| rākṣasānāṃ karomīti mithyā tadapi te vacḥ||3.30.4||
meaning: You said you will wipe the tears of the dead demons. (Now) those words have proved false.

sanskrit: नीचस्य क्षुद्रशीलस्य मिथ्यावृत्तस्य रक्षसः। प्राणानहं हरिष्यामि गरुत्मानमृतं यथा।।3.30.5।।
transliteration: nīcasya kṣudraśīlasya mithyāvṛttasya rakṣasḥ| prāṇānahṃ hariṣyāmi garutmānamṛtṃ yathā||3.30.5||
meaning: You are mean. You have false pride. You are of low behaviour. I shall take away your life, O demon,, Just as Garuda carried off the nectar.

sanskrit: अद्य ते छिन्नकण्ठस्य फेनबुद्बुदभूषितम्। विदारितस्य मद्बाणैर्मही पास्यति शोणितम्।।3.30.6।।
transliteration: adya te chinnakaṇṭhasya phenabudbudabhūṣitam| vidāritasya madbāṇairmahī pāsyati śoṇitam||3.30.6||
meaning: Now with your throat split open by my arrows , the earth will drink your foamy blood full of bubbles.

sanskrit: पांसुरूषितसर्वाङ्गस्स्रस्तन्यस्त भुजद्वयः। स्वप्स्यसे गां समालिङ्ग्य दुर्लभां प्रमदामिव।।3.30.7।।
transliteration: pāṃsurūṣitasarvāṅgassrastanyasta bhujadvayḥ| svapsyase gāṃ samāliṅgya durlabhāṃ pramadāmiva||3.30.7||
meaning: With all your limbs covered with dust, both the arms dropped down and stretched out on the ground, you will sleep as though hugging the earth, like embracing a rare woman.

sanskrit: प्रबद्धनिद्रे शयिते त्वयि राक्षसपांसने। भविष्यन्तिशरण्यानां शरण्या दण्डका इमे।।3.30.8।।
transliteration: prabaddhanidre śayite tvayi rākṣasapāṃsane| bhaviṣyantiśaraṇyānāṃ śaraṇyā daṇḍakā ime||3.30.8||
meaning: When you, O vile demon, will go into eternal sleep the Dandaka grounds will provide shelter to those who deserve it here.

sanskrit: जनस्थाने हतस्थाने तव राक्षस मच्छरैः। निर्भया विचरिष्यन्ति सर्वतो मुनयो वने।।3.30.9।।
transliteration: janasthāne hatasthāne tava rākṣasa maccharaiḥ| nirbhayā vicariṣyanti sarvato munayo vane||3.30.9||
meaning: O demon, when my arrows destroy your hold over Janasthana the sages will move freely without fear all over this forest.

sanskrit: अद्य विप्रसरिष्यन्ति राक्षस्यो हतबान्धवाः। बाष्पार्द्रवदना दीना भयादन्यभयावहाः।।3.30.10।।
transliteration: adya viprasariṣyanti rākṣasyo hatabāndhavāḥ| bāṣpārdravadanā dīnā bhayādanyabhayāvahāḥ||3.30.10||
meaning: Having lost all their relations, the demonesses, who were causing fear to others,will move away with faces full of tears.

sanskrit: अद्य शोकरसज्ञास्ता भविष्यन्ति निरर्थकाः। अनुरूपकुलाः पत्न्यो यासां त्वं पतिरीदृशः।।3.30.11।।
transliteration: adya śokarasajñāstā bhaviṣyanti nirarthakāḥ| anurūpakulāḥ patnyo yāsāṃ tvṃ patirīdṛśḥ||3.30.11||
meaning: Your wives, who have got a husband like you, must have been born to a befitting race. They will taste the pangs of sorrow today, for no reasons whatsoever.

sanskrit: नृशंस नीच क्षुद्रात्मन्नित्यं ब्राह्मणकण्टक। यत्कृते शङ्कितैरग्नौ मुनिभिः पात्यते हविः।।3.30.12।।
transliteration: nṛśṃsa nīca kṣudrātmannityṃ brāhmaṇakaṇṭaka| yatkṛte śaṅkitairagnau munibhiḥ pātyate haviḥ||3.30.12||
meaning: O cruel, mean, vile fellow, you had been always opposing the brahmins who pour oblations in fire under fear.

sanskrit: तमेवमभिसंरब्धं ब्रुवाणं राघवं रणे। खरो निर्भर्त्सयामास रोषात्खरतरस्वरः।।3.30.13।।
transliteration: tamevamabhisṃrabdhṃ bruvāṇṃ rāghavṃ raṇe| kharo nirbhartsayāmāsa roṣātkharatarasvarḥ||3.30.13||
meaning: When Rama was thus speaking in a state of excitement in the middle of war, the choleric Khara started abusing him in a harsher tone.

sanskrit: दृढं खल्ववलिप्तोऽसि भयेष्वपि च निर्भयः। वाच्यावाच्यं ततो हि त्वं मृत्युवश्यो न बुध्यसे।।3.30.14।।
transliteration: dṛḍhṃ khalvavalipto'si bhayeṣvapi ca nirbhayḥ| vācyāvācyṃ tato hi tvṃ mṛtyuvaśyo na budhyase||3.30.14||
meaning: You are very haughty. When there is every cause of fear you pretend fearlessness. Being in the grip of death you do not know what to speak and what not to speak.

sanskrit: कालपाशपरिक्षिप्ता भवन्ति पुरुषा हि ये। कार्याकार्यं न जानन्ति ते निरस्तषडिन्द्रियाः।।3.30.15।।
transliteration: kālapāśaparikṣiptā bhavanti puruṣā hi ye| kāryākāryṃ na jānanti te nirastaṣaḍindriyāḥ||3.30.15||
meaning: Those bound by the noose of death, do not know what to and what not to do, as their six senses cease to function.

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामं संरुध्य भ्रुकुटीं ततः। स ददर्श महासालमविदूरे निशाचरः।।3.30.16।। रणे प्रहरणस्यार्थे सर्वतो ह्यवलोकयन्
transliteration: evamuktvā tato rāmṃ sṃrudhya bhrukuṭīṃ tatḥ| sa dadarśa mahāsālamavidūre niśācarḥ||3.30.16|| raṇe praharaṇasyārthe sarva
meaning: Having said thus to Rama with a frown on his face, Khara, looking around for something to strike him with, saw a huge sal tree not very far.

sanskrit: स तमुत्पाटयामास संदश्य दशनच्छदम्।।3.30.17।। तं समुत्क्षिप्य बाहुभ्यां विनद्य च महाबलः। राममुद्दिश्य चिक्षेप हतस्त्वमिति
transliteration: sa tamutpāṭayāmāsa sṃdaśya daśanacchadam||3.30.17|| tṃ samutkṣipya bāhubhyāṃ vinadya ca mahābalḥ| rāmamuddiśya cikṣepa h
meaning: Khara, biting his lower lip, uprooted the tree , lifted it with his mighty arms, and shouting at Rama loudly hurled it at him, saying, 'You are dead'.

sanskrit: तमापतन्तं बाणौघैच्छित्वा रामः प्रतापवान्। रोषमाहारयत्तीव्रं निहन्तुं समरे खरम्।।3.30.19।।
transliteration: tamāpatantṃ bāṇaughaicchitvā rāmḥ pratāpavān| roṣamāhārayattīvrṃ nihantuṃ samare kharam||3.30.19||
meaning: Brave Rama shattered with a flood of arrows the tree falling over him and summoned sharp anger to end Khara in war.

sanskrit: जातस्वेदस्ततो रामो रोषाद्रक्तान्तलोचनः। निर्भिभेद सहस्रेण बाणानां समरे खरम्।।3.30.20।।
transliteration: jātasvedastato rāmo roṣādraktāntalocanḥ| nirbhibheda sahasreṇa bāṇānāṃ samare kharam||3.30.20||
meaning: Full of sweat and with the corners of his eyes turned red, Rama hit Khara with a thousand arrows in the encounter.

sanskrit: तस्य बाणान्तराद्रक्तं बहु सुस्राव फेनिलम्। गिरेः प्रस्रवणस्येव तोयधारापरिस्रवः।।3.30.21।।
transliteration: tasya bāṇāntarādraktṃ bahu susrāva phenilam| gireḥ prasravaṇasyeva toyadhārāparisravḥ||3.30.21||
meaning: With his body pierced with arrows his blood started flowing like the waterfalls flow from mount Prasravana.

sanskrit: विह्वलस्सकृतो बाणैः खरो रामेण संयुगे। मत्तो रुधिरगन्धेन तमेवाभ्यद्रवद्द्रुतम्।।3.30.22।।
transliteration: vihvalassakṛto bāṇaiḥ kharo rāmeṇa sṃyuge| matto rudhiragandhena tamevābhyadravaddrutam||3.30.22||
meaning: Completely struck by Rama's arrows, Khara, intoxicated with the smell of blood, ran speedily charging towards Rama.

sanskrit: तमापतन्तं संरब्धं कृतास्त्रो रुधिराप्लुतम्। अपासर्पत्प्रतिपदं किञ्चित्वरितविक्रमः।।3.30.23।।
transliteration: tamāpatantṃ sṃrabdhṃ kṛtāstro rudhirāplutam| apāsarpatpratipadṃ kiñcitvaritavikramḥ||3.30.23||
meaning: Rama who was an adept in the science of arms picked up his valour quickly and moved a step back (not to give him an opportunity to strike), looking at the highly agitated Khara falling upon him, with his body fully drenc

sanskrit: ततः पावकसङ्काशं वधाय समरे शरम्। खरस्य रामो जग्राह ब्रह्मदण्डमिवापरम्।।3.30.24।।
transliteration: tatḥ pāvakasaṅkāśṃ vadhāya samare śaram| kharasya rāmo jagrāha brahmadaṇḍamivāparam||3.30.24||
meaning: Rama took a dart glowing like fire which resembled another Brahmadanda to kill Khara in the war.

sanskrit: स तं दत्तं मघवता सुरराजेन धीमता। संदधे चापि धर्मात्मा मुमोच च खरं प्रति।।3.30.25।।
transliteration: sa tṃ dattṃ maghavatā surarājena dhīmatā| sṃdadhe cāpi dharmātmā mumoca ca kharṃ prati||3.30.25||
meaning: Righteous Rama placed on his bow the dart given him by wise Indra, king of the gods, and shot it at Khara.

sanskrit: स विमुक्तो महाबाणो निर्घातसमनिस्वनः। रामेण धनुरायम्य खरस्योरसिचापतत्।।3.30.26।।
transliteration: sa vimukto mahābāṇo nirghātasamanisvanḥ| rāmeṇa dhanurāyamya kharasyorasicāpatat||3.30.26||
meaning: Bending the bow fully, Rama released the arrow roaring like a violent gust of wind, which fell on Khara's chest.

sanskrit: स पपात खरो भूमौ दह्यमानश्शरानग्निना। रुद्रेणेव विनिर्दग्धश्वेतारण्ये यथान्तकः।।3.30.27।।
transliteration: sa papāta kharo bhūmau dahyamānaśśarānagninā| rudreṇeva vinirdagdhaśvetāraṇye yathāntakḥ||3.30.27||
meaning: Just as Yama was burnt by Rudra's fire(from his eyes) in Swetaranya, Khara collapsed on the ground consumed by the fire of Rama's arrow.

sanskrit: स वृत्र इव वज्रेण फेनेन नमुचिर्यथा। बलो वेन्द्राशनिहतो निपपात हतः खरः।।3.30.28।।
transliteration: sa vṛtra iva vajreṇa phenena namuciryathā| balo vendrāśanihato nipapāta hatḥ kharḥ||3.30.28||
meaning: Khara fell down just like Vrutra or Bala killed by Indra's thunderbolt or like Numuchi by the froth of the sea.

sanskrit: ततो राजर्षयस्सर्वे सङ्गताः परमर्षयः। सभाज्य मुदिता राममिदं वचनमब्रुवन्।।3.30.29।।
transliteration: tato rājarṣayassarve saṅgatāḥ paramarṣayḥ| sabhājya muditā rāmamidṃ vacanamabruvan||3.30.29||
meaning: Then the rajarsis, great seers gathered together, offered their worship to Rama and said these words joyfully :

sanskrit: एतदर्थं महातेजा महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः। शरभङ्गाश्रमं पुण्यमाजगाम पुरन्दरः।।3.30.30।।
transliteration: etadarthṃ mahātejā mahendrḥ pākaśāsanḥ| śarabhaṅgāśramṃ puṇyamājagāma purandarḥ||3.30.30||
meaning: For this purpose, killer of Paka, the gIorious Indra (who can break a fortress), came to the hermitage of Sarabhanga.

sanskrit: आनीतस्त्वमिमं देशमुपायेन महर्षिभिः। एषां वधार्थं क्रूराणां रक्षसां पापकर्मणाम्।।3.30.31।।
transliteration: ānītastvamimṃ deśamupāyena maharṣibhiḥ| eṣāṃ vadhārthṃ krūrāṇāṃ rakṣasāṃ pāpakarmaṇām||3.30.31||
meaning: You are brought to this place by the great sages who had cleverly devised a plan to kill the cruel sinners, these demons৷৷

sanskrit: तदिदं नः कृतं कार्यं त्वया दशरथात्मज। सुखं धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति दण्डकेषु महर्षयः।।3.30.32।।
transliteration: tadidṃ nḥ kṛtṃ kāryṃ tvayā daśarathātmaja| sukhṃ dharmṃ cariṣyanti daṇḍakeṣu maharṣayḥ||3.30.32||
meaning: O son of Dasaratha, you have accomplished such a task that hereafter the sages in Dandaka will discharge their rightful duties happily.

sanskrit: एतस्मिन्तरे देवाश्चारणैस्सह सङ्गताः। दुन्दुभींश्चाभिनिघ्नन्तः पुष्पवर्षं समन्ततः।।3.30.33।। रामस्योपरि संह्रुष्टा ववृषुर
transliteration: etasmintare devāścāraṇaissaha saṅgatāḥ| dundubhīṃścābhinighnantḥ puṣpavarṣṃ samantatḥ||3.30.33|| rāmasyopari sṃhruṣṭā va
meaning: Meanwhile the wonderstruck gods along with the charanas (celestial bards) got together and began beating the drums and raining showers of flowers on Rama from all sides.

sanskrit: अर्धाधिकमुहूर्तेन रामेण निशितैश्शरैः।।3.30.34।। चतुर्दशसहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्। खरदूषणमुख्यानां निहतानि महाहवे।।3.3
transliteration: ardhādhikamuhūrtena rāmeṇa niśitaiśśaraiḥ||3.30.34|| caturdaśasahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ bhīmakarmaṇām| kharadūṣaṇamukhyānāṃ nih
meaning: 'In a little more than half a moment of this great war Rama had accomplished the terrific task of killing with sharp darts fourteen thousand demons, led by Khara and Dusana.

sanskrit: अहो बत महत्कर्म रामस्य विदितात्मनः। अहो वीर्यमहो दाक्ष्यं विष्णोरिव हि दृश्यते।।3.30.36।। इत्येवमुक्त्वा ते सर्वे ययुर्द
transliteration: aho bata mahatkarma rāmasya viditātmanḥ| aho vīryamaho dākṣyṃ viṣṇoriva hi dṛśyate||3.30.36|| ityevamuktvā te sarve yayu
meaning: 'Rama who knows the self has performed a great work. Oh what prowess what efficiency only lord Visnu could do this'. So saying all the gods went back to their respective destinations.

sanskrit: तस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरो लक्ष्मणस्सह सीतया। गिरिदुर्गाद्विनिष्क्रम्य संविवेशाश्रमं सुखी।।3.30.37।।
transliteration: tasminnantare vīro lakṣmaṇassaha sītayā| giridurgādviniṣkramya sṃviveśāśramṃ sukhī||3.30.37||
meaning: In the mean time, heroic Lakshmana accompanied by Sita came out of the mountain cave happily and entered the hermitage.

sanskrit: ततो रामस्तु विजयी पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः। प्रविवेशाश्रमं वीरो लक्ष्मणेनाभिपूजितः।।3.30.38।।
transliteration: tato rāmastu vijayī pūjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ| praviveśāśramṃ vīro lakṣmaṇenābhipūjitḥ||3.30.38||
meaning: Then victorious Rama having been worshipped by the seers and also by Lakshmana entered the hermitage.

sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा शत्रुहन्तारं महर्षीणां सुखावहम्। बभूव हृष्टा वैदेही भर्तारं परिषस्वजे।।3.30.39।।
transliteration: tṃ dṛṣṭvā śatruhantārṃ maharṣīṇāṃ sukhāvaham| babhūva hṛṣṭā vaidehī bhartārṃ pariṣasvaje||3.30.39||
meaning: On seeing Rama killing the enemies of the great sages for their happiness Sita felt glad and embraced her husband.

sanskrit: मुदा परमया युक्ता दृष्ट्वा रक्षोगणान्हतान्। रामं चैवाव्यथं दृष्ट्वा तुतोष जनकात्मजा।।3.30.40।।
transliteration: mudā paramayā yuktā dṛṣṭvā rakṣogaṇānhatān| rāmṃ caivāvyathṃ dṛṣṭvā tutoṣa janakātmajā||3.30.40||
meaning: Sita, daughter of Janaka, was happy to see the demons killed by Rama who himself was unhurt.

sanskrit: ततस्तु तं राक्षससङ्घमर्दनं सभाज्यमानं मुदितैर्महर्षिभिः। पुनः परिष्वज्य शशिप्रभानना बभूव हृष्टा जनकात्मजा तदा।।3.30.41।।
transliteration: tatastu tṃ rākṣasasaṅghamardanṃ sabhājyamānṃ muditairmaharṣibhiḥ| punḥ pariṣvajya śaśiprabhānanā babhūva hṛṣṭā janakātma
meaning: Then the daughter of Janaka, cheerful Sita, who had a face bright like the moon, embraced Rama, destroyer of demons who was worshipped by the delighted sages. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे त्र

sanskrit: जनस्थानस्थिता राजन्राक्षसा बहवो हताः। खरश्च निहतस्सङ्ख्ये कथञ्चिदहमागतः।।3.31.2।।
transliteration: janasthānasthitā rājanrākṣasā bahavo hatāḥ| kharaśca nihatassaṅkhye kathañcidahamāgatḥ||3.31.2||
meaning: O king many demons dwelling at Janasthana including Khara have been killed. I manged to escape with much difficulty.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः क्रुद्ध स्संरक्तलोचनः। अकम्पनमुवाचेदं निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा।।3.31.3।।
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvḥ kruddha ssṃraktalocanḥ| akampanamuvācedṃ nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā||3.31.3||
meaning: When Akampana thus reported to the tenheaded Ravana, his eyes reddened with anger. He spoke to Akampana as if he was burning him with his eyes :

sanskrit: केन रम्यं जनस्थानं हतं मम परासुना। को हि सर्वेषु लोकेषु गतिं चाधिगमिष्यति।।3.31.4।।
transliteration: kena ramyṃ janasthānṃ hatṃ mama parāsunā| ko hi sarveṣu lokeṣu gatiṃ cādhigamiṣyati||3.31.4||
meaning: He who has destroyed my beautiful Janasthana is sure to die. His life is under the control of others (his enemies). Where can he be(alive) in all the worlds?

sanskrit: न हि मे विप्रियं कृत्वा शक्यं मघवता सुखम्। प्राप्तुं वैश्रवणेनापि न यमेन न विष्णुना।।3.31.5।।
transliteration: na hi me vipriyṃ kṛtvā śakyṃ maghavatā sukham| prāptuṃ vaiśravaṇenāpi na yamena na viṣṇunā||3.31.5||
meaning: One who has caused displeasure to me cannot be happy, be it Indra or Kubera, or Yama or even Visnu.

sanskrit: कालस्य चाप्यहं कालो दहेयमपि पावकम्। मृत्युं मरणधर्मेण संयोजयितुमुत्सहे।।3.31.6।।
transliteration: kālasya cāpyahṃ kālo daheyamapi pāvakam| mṛtyuṃ maraṇadharmeṇa sṃyojayitumutsahe||3.31.6||
meaning: I am the destroyer of the destroyer (Yama). I can burn even that which burns (fire). I can infuse Death with the characteristics of death itself.

sanskrit: दहेयमपि सङ्कृद्धस्तेजसाऽदित्यपावकौ। वातस्य तरसा वेगं निहन्तुमहमुत्सहे।।3.31.7।।
transliteration: daheyamapi saṅkṛddhastejasā'dityapāvakau| vātasya tarasā vegṃ nihantumahamutsahe||3.31.7||
meaning: If angry, I can burn the Sun and even fire with my radiance. I can arrest the speed of the wind instantly with my effort.

sanskrit: तथा क्रुद्धं दशग्रीवं कृताञ्जलिरकम्पनः। भयात्सन्दिग्धया वाचा रावणं याचतेऽभयम्।।3.31.8।।
transliteration: tathā kruddhṃ daśagrīvṃ kṛtāñjalirakampanḥ| bhayātsandigdhayā vācā rāvaṇṃ yācate'bhayam||3.31.8||
meaning: Akampana, out of fear, implored the inflamed Ravana with folded hands and faltering voice to spare him.

sanskrit: दशग्रीवोऽभयं तस्मै प्रददौ रक्षसां वरः। स विस्रब्धोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यमसन्दिग्धमकम्पनः।।3.31.9।।
transliteration: daśagrīvo'bhayṃ tasmai pradadau rakṣasāṃ varḥ| sa visrabdho'bravīdvākyamasandigdhamakampanḥ||3.31.9||
meaning: The tenheaded Ravana, lord of the demons, assured safety to Akampana, who gratefully said these words without hesitation:

sanskrit: पुत्रो दशरथस्यास्ति सिंहसंहननो युवा। रामो नाम वृषस्कन्धो वृत्तायतमहाभुजः।।3.31.10।।
transliteration: putro daśarathasyāsti siṃhasṃhanano yuvā| rāmo nāma vṛṣaskandho vṛttāyatamahābhujḥ||3.31.10||
meaning: Dasaratha has a young son, by name, Rama. He has a body like a lion's. He has strong, round arms and his shoulders resemble those of a bull.

sanskrit: वीरः पृथुयशाश्श्रीमानतुल्यबलविक्रमः। हतं तेन जनस्थानं खरश्च सह दूषणः।।3.31.11।।
transliteration: vīrḥ pṛthuyaśāśśrīmānatulyabalavikramḥ| hatṃ tena janasthānṃ kharaśca saha dūṣaṇḥ||3.31.11||
meaning: He is a hero of great fame and unequal prowess. He has destroyed your Janasthana and also Khara along with Dusana.

sanskrit: अकम्पनवच श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। नागेन्द्र इव निश्वस्य वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्।।3.31.12।।
transliteration: akampanavaca śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipḥ| nāgendra iva niśvasya vacanṃ cedamabravīt||3.31.12||
meaning: Having heard Akampana's words, Ravana, the lord of demons, sighed heavily like the king of serpents and said these words:

sanskrit: स सुरेन्द्रेण संयुक्तो रामस्सर्वामरैस्सह। उपयातो जनस्थानं ब्रूहि कच्चिदकम्पन।।3.31.13।।
transliteration: sa surendreṇa sṃyukto rāmassarvāmaraissaha| upayāto janasthānṃ brūhi kaccidakampana||3.31.13||
meaning: Did Rama come to Janasthana with Indra and the gods ? O Akampana speak.

sanskrit: रावणस्य पुनर्वाक्यं निशम्य तदकम्पनः। आचचक्षे बलं तस्य विक्रमं च महात्मनः।।3.31.14।।
transliteration: rāvaṇasya punarvākyṃ niśamya tadakampanḥ| ācacakṣe balṃ tasya vikramṃ ca mahātmanḥ||3.31.14||
meaning: Hearing Ravana's words, Akampana continued telling about great Rama's strength and his exploits in war.

sanskrit: रामो नाम महातेजा श्रेष्ठस्सर्वधनुष्मताम्। दिव्यास्त्रगुणसम्पन्नः पुरन्दरसमो युधि।।3.31.15।।
transliteration: rāmo nāma mahātejā śreṣṭhassarvadhanuṣmatām| divyāstraguṇasampannḥ purandarasamo yudhi||3.31.15||
meaning: Rama is his name. He looks very radiant. He is the best among the archers. Owner of divine weapons, he is comparable to Indra in war.

sanskrit: तस्यानुरूपो बलवान्रक्ताक्षो दन्दुभिस्वनः। कनीयान्लक्ष्मणो नाम भ्राता शशिनिभाननः।।3.31.16।।
transliteration: tasyānurūpo balavānraktākṣo dandubhisvanḥ| kanīyānlakṣmaṇo nāma bhrātā śaśinibhānanḥ||3.31.16||
meaning: He is strong with bright red eyes. He has a deep voice with the resonance of a drum. His face is like the moon. Lakshmana, his younger brother, is similar to him in appearance.

sanskrit: स तेन सह संयुक्तः पावकेनानिलो यथा। श्रीमान्राजवरस्तेन जनस्थानं निपातितम्।।3.31.17।।
transliteration: sa tena saha sṃyuktḥ pāvakenānilo yathā| śrīmānrājavarastena janasthānṃ nipātitam||3.31.17||
meaning: Rama is prosperous. He is the best among kings. Lakshmana with him is like wind with fire. Rama has pulled down Janasthana.

sanskrit: नैव देवा महात्मानो नात्र कार्या विचारणा। शरा रामेण तूत्सृष्टा रुक्मपुङ्खाः पतत्रिणः।।3.31.18।। सर्पाः पञ्चानना भूत्वा भक
transliteration: naiva devā mahātmāno nātra kāryā vicāraṇā| śarā rāmeṇa tūtsṛṣṭā rukmapuṅkhāḥ patatriṇḥ||3.31.18|| sarpāḥ pañcānanā bhūtv
meaning: Indeed, they are great men. No god came there (to lend him a hand). There is no need to investigate further about it. The goldenfeathered arrows released by Rama turned into fivehooded serpents and consumed the demons.

sanskrit: येन येन च गच्छन्ति राक्षसा भयकर्शिताः।3.31.19।। तेन तेन स्म पश्यन्ति राममेवाग्रतः स्थितम्। इत्थं विनाशितं तेन जनस्थानं त
transliteration: yena yena ca gacchanti rākṣasā bhayakarśitāḥ|3.31.19|| tena tena sma paśyanti rāmamevāgratḥ sthitam| itthṃ vināśitṃ tena
meaning: Wherever the demons went they, gripped by fear, only saw Rama in front. O sinless sire In this manner your Janasthana was destroyed by him.

sanskrit: अकम्पनवचश्रुत्वा रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। जनस्थानं गमिष्यामि हन्तुं रामं सलक्ष्मणम्।।3.31.21।।
transliteration: akampanavacaśrutvā rāvaṇo vākyamabravīt| janasthānṃ gamiṣyāmi hantuṃ rāmṃ salakṣmaṇam||3.31.21||
meaning: Hearing Akampana's words, Ravana said, I will go to Janasthana and kill Rama along with Lakshmana.

sanskrit: अथैवमुक्ते वचने प्रोवाचेदमकम्पनः। शृणु राजन्यथावृत्तं रामस्य बलपौरुषम्।।3.31.22।।
transliteration: athaivamukte vacane provācedamakampanḥ| śṛṇu rājanyathāvṛttṃ rāmasya balapauruṣam||3.31.22||
meaning: Thus said by Ravana, Akampana responded, I will tell you what happened there. O king listen to the strength and valour of Rama.

sanskrit: असाध्यः कुपितो रामो विक्रमेण महायशाः। आपगायास्सुपूर्णाया वेगं परिहरेच्छरैः।।3.31.23।।
transliteration: asādhyḥ kupito rāmo vikrameṇa mahāyaśāḥ| āpagāyāssupūrṇāyā vegṃ parihareccharaiḥ||3.31.23||
meaning: Rama is of great fame. When outraged, he is irrepressible. He can arrest with his arrows even the speed of a river (in spate).

sanskrit: सतारग्रहनक्षत्रं नभश्चाप्यवसादयेत्। असौ रामस्तु सीदन्तीं श्रीमानभ्युद्धरेन्महीम्।।3.31.24।।
transliteration: satāragrahanakṣatrṃ nabhaścāpyavasādayet| asau rāmastu sīdantīṃ śrīmānabhyuddharenmahīm||3.31.24||
meaning: Powerful Rama can pull down the sky along with the planets and stars. He can lift the drowning earth from the depth of the sea.

sanskrit: भित्त्वा वेलां समुद्रस्य लोकानाप्लावयेद्विभुः। वेगं वापि समुद्रस्य वायुं वा विधमेच्छरैः।।3.31.25।।
transliteration: bhittvā velāṃ samudrasya lokānāplāvayedvibhuḥ| vegṃ vāpi samudrasya vāyuṃ vā vidhameccharaiḥ||3.31.25||
meaning: He is so very powerful that he can drown the earth by breaking the boundary of the sea. He can arrest the speed of the sea or of the wind with his arrows.

sanskrit: संहृत्य वा पुनर्लोकान्विक्रमेण महायशाः। शक्तस्सपुरुषव्याघ्रः स्रष्टुं पुनरपि प्रजाः।।3.31.26।।
transliteration: sṃhṛtya vā punarlokānvikrameṇa mahāyaśāḥ| śaktassapuruṣavyāghrḥ sraṣṭuṃ punarapi prajāḥ||3.31.26||
meaning: He is a tiger among men. He is so powerful that he can destroy the world and recreate the creatures once again by his valour.

sanskrit: न हि रामो दशग्रीव शक्यो जेतुं त्वया युधि। रक्षसां वापि लोकेन स्वर्गः पापजनैरिव।।3.31.27।।
transliteration: na hi rāmo daśagrīva śakyo jetuṃ tvayā yudhi| rakṣasāṃ vāpi lokena svargḥ pāpajanairiva||3.31.27||
meaning: O tenheaded one, just as it is not possible for sinners to attain heaven it is not possible for you or for the entire world of demons to win him in war

sanskrit: न तं वध्यमहं मन्ये सर्वैर्देवासुरैरपि। अयं तस्य वधोपायस्तन्ममैकमनाश्शृणु।।3.31.28।।
transliteration: na tṃ vadhyamahṃ manye sarvairdevāsurairapi| ayṃ tasya vadhopāyastanmamaikamanāśśṛṇu||3.31.28||
meaning: I do not think it is possible for gods and demons together to kill him, yet there is a way for his destruction. You may listen to me with single mindedattention:

sanskrit: भार्या तस्योत्तमा लोके सीता नाम सुमध्यमा। श्यामा समविभक्ताङ्गी स्त्रीरत्नं रत्नभूषिता।।3.31.29।।
transliteration: bhāryā tasyottamā loke sītā nāma sumadhyamā| śyāmā samavibhaktāṅgī strīratnṃ ratnabhūṣitā||3.31.29||
meaning: Rama has a wife in this world, by name, Sita, who is beautiful, has a slender waist and a wellformed body. Adorned with gems, she is a jewel among women,

sanskrit: नैव देवी न गन्धर्वी नाप्सरा नापि दानवी। तुल्या सीमन्तिनी तस्या मानुषीषु कुतो भवेत्।।3.31.30।।
transliteration: naiva devī na gandharvī nāpsarā nāpi dānavī| tulyā sīmantinī tasyā mānuṣīṣu kuto bhavet||3.31.30||
meaning: She has no equal among goddesses nor among gandharvis nor apasaras nor among demonesses. How can there be a peer of her among human beings ?

sanskrit: तस्यापहर भार्यांत्वं प्रमथ्य तु महावने। सीतया रहितः कामी रामो हास्यति जीवितम्।।3.31.31।।
transliteration: tasyāpahara bhāryāṃtvṃ pramathya tu mahāvane| sītayā rahitḥ kāmī rāmo hāsyati jīvitam||3.31.31||
meaning: Abduct Rama's wife by force in that great forest and bereft of Sita, he will give up his life.

sanskrit: अरोचयत तद्वाक्यं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। चिन्तयित्वा महाबाहुरकम्पनमुवाच ह।।3.31.32।।
transliteration: arocayata tadvākyṃ rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipḥ| cintayitvā mahābāhurakampanamuvāca ha||3.31.32||
meaning: Ravana, the strongarmed king of demons, relished the words of Akampana and pondering over the matter, said to him :

sanskrit: बाढं काल्यं गमिष्यामि ह्येकस्सारथिना सह। आनयिष्यामि वैदेहीमिमां हृष्टो महापुरीम्।।3.31.33।।
transliteration: bāḍhṃ kālyṃ gamiṣyāmi hyekassārathinā saha| ānayiṣyāmi vaidehīmimāṃ hṛṣṭo mahāpurīm||3.31.33||
meaning: Yes, early in the morning I will go alone gladly with the charioteer and bring Vaidehi here to this great city.

sanskrit: अथैवमुक्त्वा प्रययौ खरयुक्तेन रावणः। रथेनादित्यवर्णेन दिशस्सर्वाः प्रकाशयन्।।3.31.34।।
transliteration: athaivamuktvā prayayau kharayuktena rāvaṇḥ| rathenādityavarṇena diśassarvāḥ prakāśayan||3.31.34||
meaning: Having said so, Ravana got on a chariot yoked with donkeys. It had the colour of the Sun. It illuminated all directions. Ravana left.

sanskrit: स रथो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य नक्षत्रपथगो महान्। सञ्चार्यमाणश्शुशुभे जलदे चन्द्रमा इव।।3.31.35।।
transliteration: sa ratho rākṣasendrasya nakṣatrapathago mahān| sañcāryamāṇaśśuśubhe jalade candramā iva||3.31.35||
meaning: The great chariot of the demon king (Ravana) flying in the sky shone like the Moon in the cloud.

sanskrit: स मारीचाश्रमं प्राप्य ताटकेयमुपागमत्। मारीचेनार्चितो राजा भक्ष्यभोज्यैरमानुषैः।।3.31.36।।
transliteration: sa mārīcāśramṃ prāpya tāṭakeyamupāgamat| mārīcenārcito rājā bhakṣyabhojyairamānuṣaiḥ||3.31.36||
meaning: Ravana reached the hermitage of Maricha and met him who was the son of Tataka. The demon king was treated with food that can be chewed and food that can be eaten.

sanskrit: तं स्वयं पूजयित्वा तु आसनेनोदकेन च। अर्थोपहितया वाचा मारीचो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।3.31.37।।
transliteration: tṃ svayṃ pūjayitvā tu āsanenodakena ca| arthopahitayā vācā mārīco vākyamabravīt||3.31.37||
meaning: Maricha personally offered Ravana a seat. He offered him water and paid him obeisance. Making meaningful enquiries he said in appropriate words :

sanskrit: कच्चित्सुकुशलं राजन्लोकानां राक्षसेश्वर। आशङ्के नाथ जाने त्वं यतस्तूर्णमिहागतः।।3.31.38।।
transliteration: kaccitsukuśalṃ rājanlokānāṃ rākṣaseśvara| āśaṅke nātha jāne tvṃ yatastūrṇamihāgatḥ||3.31.38||
meaning: O lord of demons O king hope every one is fine in the world of demons. O lord, (though) your sudden arrival puts me in doubt (about everything going right).

sanskrit: एवमुक्तो महातेजा मारीचेन स रावणः। ततः पश्चादिदं वाक्यमब्रवीद्वाक्यकोविदः।।3.31.39।।
transliteration: evamukto mahātejā mārīcena sa rāvaṇḥ| tatḥ paścādidṃ vākyamabravīdvākyakovidḥ||3.31.39||
meaning: Having thus been asked by Maricha, glorious Ravana, who was eloquent in speech, spoke to him :

sanskrit: आरक्षो मे हतस्तात रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। जनस्थानमवध्य तत्सर्वं युधि निपातितम्।।3.31.40।। तस्य मे कुरु साचिव्यं तस्य भार्या
transliteration: ārakṣo me hatastāta rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā| janasthānamavadhya tatsarvṃ yudhi nipātitam||3.31.40|| tasya me kuru sācivyṃ ta
meaning: O dear, Rama who is capable of doing difficult deeds has killed my sentinels. The indestructible Janasthana has been routed in war. Could you help me in abudcting his wife ? (That is the only way to bring him to his knee

sanskrit: राक्षसेन्द्रवचश्श्रुत्वा मारीचो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।3.31.41।। आख्याता केन सीता सा मित्ररूपेण शत्रुणा। त्वया राक्षसशार्दूल को
transliteration: rākṣasendravacaśśrutvā mārīco vākyamabravīt||3.31.41|| ākhyātā kena sītā sā mitrarūpeṇa śatruṇā| tvayā rākṣasaśārdūla ko
meaning: Having heard Ravana ,the king of demons, Maricha said these words: O king, who is that enemy of yours who, in the guise of a friend, has told you about Sita? Though obliged by you, who is he that is not happy with you, O

sanskrit: सीतामिहानयस्वेति को ब्रवीति ब्रवीहि मे। रक्षोलोकस्य सर्वस्य कश्शृङ्गं छेत्तुमिच्छति।।3.31.43।।
transliteration: sītāmihānayasveti ko bravīti bravīhi me| rakṣolokasya sarvasya kaśśṛṅgṃ chettumicchati||3.31.43||
meaning: Tell me who asked you to bring Sita ? Who wishes to demolish the peak of the entire clan of demons ?

sanskrit: प्रोत्साहयति कश्च त्वां स च शत्रुरसंशयः। अशीविषमुखाद्दंष्ट्रामुद्धर्तुं चेच्छति त्वया।।3.31.44।।
transliteration: protsāhayati kaśca tvāṃ sa ca śatrurasṃśayḥ| aśīviṣamukhāddṃṣṭrāmuddhartuṃ cecchati tvayā||3.31.44||
meaning: He who has encouraged you in this is your enemy, indeed. He wants you to pluck out the fangs from the serpent's mouth.

sanskrit: कर्मणा केन केनासि कापथं प्रतिपादितः। सुखसुप्तस्य ते राजन् प्रहृतं केन मूर्धनि।।3.31.45।।
transliteration: karmaṇā kena kenāsi kāpathṃ pratipāditḥ| sukhasuptasya te rājan prahṛtṃ kena mūrdhani||3.31.45||
meaning: By whose action have you been led into this wrong direction? Who has hit you on your forehead while you were sleeping comfortably?

sanskrit: विशुद्धवंशाभिजनाग्रहस्त स्तेजोमदस्संस्थितदोर्विषाणः। उदीक्षितुं रावण नेह युक्तः स संयुगे राघवगन्धहस्ती।।3.31.46।।
transliteration: viśuddhavṃśābhijanāgrahasta stejomadassṃsthitadorviṣāṇḥ| udīkṣituṃ rāvaṇa neha yuktḥ sa sṃyuge rāghavagandhahastī||3.31.
meaning: Rama is like a mighty tusker. His pure and high birth is his trunk. His wellbuilt and strong arms are his tusks. His brilliance in his ichor. Nobody can face this intoxicated elephant in battle.

sanskrit: असौ रणान्तः स्थितिसंधिवालो विदग्धरक्षोमृगहा नृसिंहः। सुप्तस्त्वया बोधयितुं न युक्तः शराङ्गपूर्णो निशितासिदंष्ट्रः।।3.31.
transliteration: asau raṇāntḥ sthitisṃdhivālo vidagdharakṣomṛgahā nṛsiṃhḥ| suptastvayā bodhayituṃ na yuktḥ śarāṅgapūrṇo niśitāsidṃṣṭrḥ||3
meaning: Rama is a lion in the form of man, a lion on warfront with its tail touching the waist when angry. This lion is deft in killing deer in the form of clever demons. His body is full of arrows. The sharp swords are his poin

sanskrit: चापापहारे भुजवेगपङ्के शरोर्मिमाले सुमहाहवौघे। न रामपातालमुखेऽतिघोरे प्रस्कन्दितुं राक्षसराज युक्तम्।।3.31.48।।
transliteration: cāpāpahāre bhujavegapaṅke śarormimāle sumahāhavaughe| na rāmapātālamukhe'tighore praskandituṃ rākṣasarāja yuktam||3.31.4
meaning: O king of demons it is not proper (for you) to jump into the extremely fierce mouth of the nether world known as Rama. Who can steal the bow from his mighty arms which are whirlpools of mud. His arrows are rows of waves

sanskrit: प्रसीद लङ्केश्वर राक्षसेन्द्र लङ्कां प्रसन्नो भव साधु गच्छ। त्वं स्वेषु दारेषु रमस्व नित्यं रामस्सभार्यो रमतां वनेषु।।3.
transliteration: prasīda laṅkeśvara rākṣasendra laṅkāṃ prasanno bhava sādhu gaccha| tvṃ sveṣu dāreṣu ramasva nityṃ rāmassabhāryo ramatāṃ
meaning: O lord of Lanka, chief of the demons, be pleased to return to Lanka and enjoy yourself in the company of your wives. Let Rama enjoy with his wife in the forest.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवो मारीचेन स रावणः। न्यवर्तत पुरीं लङ्कां विवेश च गृहोत्तमम्।।3.31.50।।
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvo mārīcena sa rāvaṇḥ| nyavartata purīṃ laṅkāṃ viveśa ca gṛhottamam||3.31.50||
meaning: Thus advised by Maricha ,the ten headed Ravana returned and entered his best of homes in the city of Lanka . इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfirst sarga of A

sanskrit: सा दृष्ट्वा कर्म रामस्य कृतमन्यैस्सुदुष्करम्। जगाम परमोद्विग्ना लङ्कां रावणपालिताम्।।3.32.3।।
transliteration: sā dṛṣṭvā karma rāmasya kṛtamanyaissuduṣkaram| jagāma paramodvignā laṅkāṃ rāvaṇapālitām||3.32.3||
meaning: Seeing the performance of Rama which is very difficult for others, Surpanakha got scared and went to Lanka, ruled by Ravana.

sanskrit: सा ददर्श विमानाग्रे रावणं दीप्ततेजसम्। उपोपविष्टं सचिवैर्मरुद्भिरिव वासवम्।।3.32.4।।
transliteration: sā dadarśa vimānāgre rāvaṇṃ dīptatejasam| upopaviṣṭṃ sacivairmarudbhiriva vāsavam||3.32.4||
meaning: Surpanakha saw Ravana shining brilliantly, seated like Indra along with ministers and Maruts on top of the aerial chariot.

sanskrit: आसीनं सूर्यसङ्काशे काञ्चने परमासने। रुक्मवेदिगतं प्राज्यं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम्।।3.32.5।।
transliteration: āsīnṃ sūryasaṅkāśe kāñcane paramāsane| rukmavedigatṃ prājyṃ jvalantamiva pāvakam||3.32.5||
meaning: Ravana, sitting on the magnificent golden seat on a golden altar looked radiant like the Sun or the blazing fire.

sanskrit: देवगन्धर्वभूतानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्। अजेयं समरे शूरं व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम्।।3.32.6।।
transliteration: devagandharvabhūtānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca mahātmanām| ajeyṃ samare śūrṃ vyāttānanamivāntakam||3.32.6||
meaning: Invincible to gods, gandharvas, all living beings, great sages and seers, he was like Yama, lord of death with wide open jaws.

sanskrit: देवासुरविमर्देषु वज्राशनिकृतव्रणम्। ऐरावतविषाणग्रैरुद्घृष्टकिणवक्षसम्।।3.32.7।।
transliteration: devāsuravimardeṣu vajrāśanikṛtavraṇam| airāvataviṣāṇagrairudghṛṣṭakiṇavakṣasam||3.32.7||
meaning: He had scars of wounds caused by the thunderbolt received in war between gods and demons, and marks of scars on his chest made by tips of the the tusks of elephant Airavata.

sanskrit: विंशद्भुजं दशग्रीवं दर्शनीयपरिच्छदम्। विशालवक्षसं वीरं राजलक्षण शोभितम्।।3.32.8।।
transliteration: viṃśadbhujṃ daśagrīvṃ darśanīyaparicchadam| viśālavakṣasṃ vīrṃ rājalakṣaṇa śobhitam||3.32.8||
meaning: Valiant Ravana had an attractive appearance with beautiful dresses twenty arms,ten heads, a broad chest and brilliant royal marks.

sanskrit: स्निग्धवैडूर्यसङ्काशं तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलम्। सुभुजं शुक्लदशनं महास्यं पर्वतोपमम्।।3.32.9।।
transliteration: snigdhavaiḍūryasaṅkāśṃ taptakāñcanakuṇḍalam| subhujṃ śukladaśanṃ mahāsyṃ parvatopamam||3.32.9||
meaning: Wearing burnished golden earrings, he looked bright like the glittering vaidurya. And with his wellformed arms, white teeth and wide mouth, he looked like a mountain.

sanskrit: विष्णुचक्रनिपातैश्च शतशो देवसंयुगे। अन्यैश्शस्त्रप्रहारैश्च महायुद्धेषु ताडितम्।।3.32.10।।
transliteration: viṣṇucakranipātaiśca śataśo devasṃyuge| anyaiśśastraprahāraiśca mahāyuddheṣu tāḍitam||3.32.10||
meaning: He was hit by the wheel of Visnu for hundreds of times during great wars and beaten by other weapons.

sanskrit: अहताङ्गं समस्तैश्च देवप्रहरणैस्तथा। अक्षोभ्याणां समुद्राणां क्षोभणं क्षिप्रकारिणम्।।3.32.11।।
transliteration: ahatāṅgṃ samastaiśca devapraharaṇaistathā| akṣobhyāṇāṃ samudrāṇāṃ kṣobhaṇṃ kṣiprakāriṇam||3.32.11||
meaning: Ravana whose body was not hurt by the weapons in war with gods, who could perturb even the imperturbable seas, was quick in action.

sanskrit: क्षेप्तारं पर्वतेन्द्राणां सुराणां च प्रमर्दनम्। उच्छेत्तारं च धर्माणां परदाराभिमर्शनम्।।3.32.12।।
transliteration: kṣeptārṃ parvatendrāṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca pramardanam| ucchettārṃ ca dharmāṇāṃ paradārābhimarśanam||3.32.12||
meaning: (He was) one who could lift and throw great mountains, torment even gods, violate dharma at the root, and cast an evil eye on the wives of others.

sanskrit: सर्वदिव्यास्त्रयोक्तारं यज्ञविघ्नकरं सदा। पुरीं भोगवतीं प्राप्य पराजित्य च वासुकिम्।।3.32.13।। तक्षकस्य प्रियां भार्यां
transliteration: sarvadivyāstrayoktārṃ yajñavighnakarṃ sadā| purīṃ bhogavatīṃ prāpya parājitya ca vāsukim||3.32.13|| takṣakasya priyāṃ bh
