meaning: He who could employ all divine weapons, disrupt sacrifices, had gone to the city of Bhogavati, defeated Vasuki and abducted the dear wife of Takshaka.

sanskrit: कैलासपर्वतं गत्वा विजित्य नरवाहनम्। विमानं पुष्पकं तस्य कामगं वै जहार यः।।3.32.14।।
transliteration: kailāsaparvatṃ gatvā vijitya naravāhanam| vimānṃ puṣpakṃ tasya kāmagṃ vai jahāra yḥ||3.32.14||
meaning: Ravana went to mount Kailasa, conquered Kubera and took away forcibly his aerial chariot Pushpaka which can fly as per the rider's desire

sanskrit: वनं चैत्ररथं दिव्यं नलिनीं नन्दनं वनम्। विनाशयति यः क्रोधाद्देवोद्यानानि वीर्यवान्।।3.32.15।।
transliteration: vanṃ caitrarathṃ divyṃ nalinīṃ nandanṃ vanam| vināśayati yḥ krodhāddevodyānāni vīryavān||3.32.15||
meaning: Out of anger he destroyed all the gardens of gods like Chitraratha of Kubera full of lotusponds and Nandana, the pleasuregarden of Indra.

sanskrit: चन्द्रसूर्यौ महाभागावुत्तिष्ठन्तौ परन्तपौ। निवारयति बाहुभ्यां यश्शैलशिखरोपमः।।3.32.16।।
transliteration: candrasūryau mahābhāgāvuttiṣṭhantau parantapau| nivārayati bāhubhyāṃ yaśśailaśikharopamḥ||3.32.16||
meaning: He was like the peak of a mountain. He could stop with his arms the great Moon and Sun from rising. He was a scorcher of enemies.

sanskrit: दशवर्षसहस्राणि तपस्तप्वा महावने। पुरा स्वयंभुवे धीरश्शिरांस्युपजहार यः।।3.32.17।।
transliteration: daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tapastapvā mahāvane| purā svayṃbhuve dhīraśśirāṃsyupajahāra yḥ||3.32.17||
meaning: This steadfast Ravana who had in the past performed penance for ten thousand years in a dense forest offered his heads to the selfborn Brahma.

sanskrit: देवदानवगन्धर्वपिशाचपतगोरगैः। अभयं यस्य सङ्ग्रामे मृत्युतो मानुषादृते।।3.32.18।।
transliteration: devadānavagandharvapiśācapatagoragaiḥ| abhayṃ yasya saṅgrāme mṛtyuto mānuṣādṛte||3.32.18||
meaning: He was unafraid of death in the hands of gods or demons or gandharvas or pisachas or birds or snakes in war except humans.

sanskrit: मन्त्रैरभिष्टुतं पुण्यमध्वरेषु द्विजातिभिः। हविर्धानेषु यस्सोममुपहन्ति महाबलः।।3.32.19।।
transliteration: mantrairabhiṣṭutṃ puṇyamadhvareṣu dvijātibhiḥ| havirdhāneṣu yassomamupahanti mahābalḥ||3.32.19||
meaning: The mighty Ravana defiled the sacred Soma juice, worthy of oblations, extracted by Brahmins by chanting mantras in scrifices.

sanskrit: आप्तयज्ञहरं क्रूरं ब्रह्मघ्नं दुष्टचारिणम्। कर्कशं निरनुक्रोशं प्रजानामहिते रतम्।।3.32.20।।
transliteration: āptayajñaharṃ krūrṃ brahmaghnṃ duṣṭacāriṇam| karkaśṃ niranukrośṃ prajānāmahite ratam||3.32.20||
meaning: He disrupted sacrifices at the final stage. He killed brahmins. He was ruthless, harsh, and merciless. He was involved in activities against human welfare.

sanskrit: रावणं सर्वभूतानां सर्वलोकभयावहम्। राक्षसी भ्रातरं शूरं सा ददर्श महाबलम्।।3.32.21।।
transliteration: rāvaṇṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvalokabhayāvaham| rākṣasī bhrātarṃ śūrṃ sā dadarśa mahābalam||3.32.21||
meaning: That demoness , Surpanakha saw her very strong,valiant brother Ravana who made all beings cry and created fear in all worlds

sanskrit: तं दिव्यवस्त्राभरणं दिव्यमाल्योपशोभितम्। आसने सूपविष्टं च कालकालमिवोद्यतम्।।3.32.22।।
transliteration: tṃ divyavastrābharaṇṃ divyamālyopaśobhitam| āsane sūpaviṣṭṃ ca kālakālamivodyatam||3.32.22||
meaning: Resplendently attired, adorned with jewels, wearing beautiful gardlands, seated on a raised throne, he(Ravana) was like death to even the lord of death

sanskrit: राक्षसेन्द्रं महाभागं पौलस्त्यकुलनन्दनम्। 3.32.23।। रावणं शत्रुहन्तारं मन्त्रिभिः परिवारितम्। अभिगम्याब्रवीद्वाक्यं राक्
transliteration: rākṣasendrṃ mahābhāgṃ paulastyakulanandanam| 3.32.23|| rāvaṇṃ śatruhantārṃ mantribhiḥ parivāritam| abhigamyābravīdvākyṃ
meaning: On reaching Ravana, the lord of demons, the delight of the Paulastya dynasty, and the destroyer of enemies surrounded by ministers, the terrified, Surpanakha said these words:

sanskrit: तमब्रवीद्दीप्तविशाललोचनं प्रदर्शयित्वा भयमोहमूर्छिता। सुदारुणं वाक्यमभीतचारिणी महात्मना शूर्पणखा विरूपिता।।3.32.25।।
transliteration: tamabravīddīptaviśālalocanṃ pradarśayitvā bhayamohamūrchitā| sudāruṇṃ vākyamabhītacāriṇī mahātmanā śūrpaṇakhā virūpitā||
meaning: Showing her body disfigured by great Lakshmana, Surpanakha, the fearless wanderer, overwhelmed with fear said these cruel words to Ravana sitting with large, glittering eyes: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये

sanskrit: प्रमत्तः कामभोगेषु स्वैरवृत्तो निरङ्कुशः। समुत्पन्नं भयं घोरं बोद्धव्यं नावबुध्यसे।।3.33.2।।
transliteration: pramattḥ kāmabhogeṣu svairavṛtto niraṅkuśḥ| samutpannṃ bhayṃ ghorṃ boddhavyṃ nāvabudhyase||3.33.2||
meaning: Intoxicated with the pleasures of passion, acting on your own, ungoaded and unguided, you do not understand the problems arising out of great fear, problems you ought to know.

sanskrit: सक्तं ग्राम्येषु भोगेषु कामवृत्तं महीपतिम्। लुब्धं न बहुमन्यन्ते श्मशानाग्निमिव प्रजाः।।3.33.3।।
transliteration: saktṃ grāmyeṣu bhogeṣu kāmavṛttṃ mahīpatim| lubdhṃ na bahumanyante śmaśānāgnimiva prajāḥ||3.33.3||
meaning: Lustful and greedy, you are addicted to vulgar pleasures. People will not respect you like the fire on the crematorium.

sanskrit: स्वयं कार्याणि यः काले नानुतिष्ठति पार्थिवः। स तु वै सह राज्येन तैश्च कार्यैर्विनश्यति।।3.33.4।।
transliteration: svayṃ kāryāṇi yḥ kāle nānutiṣṭhati pārthivḥ| sa tu vai saha rājyena taiśca kāryairvinaśyati||3.33.4||
meaning: A king who does not act at the right time will be ruined along with the kingdom and its works.

sanskrit: अयुक्तचारं दुर्दर्शमस्वाधीनं नराधिपम्। वर्जयन्ति नरा दूरान्नदीपङ्कामिव द्विपाः।।3.33.5।।
transliteration: ayuktacārṃ durdarśamasvādhīnṃ narādhipam| varjayanti narā dūrānnadīpaṅkāmiva dvipāḥ||3.33.5||
meaning: Just as elephants keep away from a muddy river, people will keep distance from the king who does not employ spies, does not give audience to his people and is not independent.

sanskrit: ये न रक्षन्ति विषयमस्वाधीना नराधिपाः। ते न वृद्ध्या प्रकाशन्ते गिरयस्सागरे यथा।।3.33.6।।
transliteration: ye na rakṣanti viṣayamasvādhīnā narādhipāḥ| te na vṛddhyā prakāśante girayassāgare yathā||3.33.6||
meaning: Kings who are not under their own control and cannot protect the country, do not attract the minds of the people like mountains inside sea water.

sanskrit: आत्मवद्भिर्विगृह्य त्वं देवगन्धर्वदानवैः। अयुक्तचारश्चपलः कथं राजा भविष्यसि।।3.33.7।।
transliteration: ātmavadbhirvigṛhya tvṃ devagandharvadānavaiḥ| ayuktacāraścapalḥ kathṃ rājā bhaviṣyasi||3.33.7||
meaning: Having created enmity with selfrespecting persons like gods, gandharvas and demons, with a fickle mind and without spies how long can you continue as king ?

sanskrit: त्वन्तु बालस्वभावश्च बुद्धिहीनश्च राक्षस। ज्ञातव्यन्तु न जानीषे कथं राजा भविष्यसि।।3.33.8।।
transliteration: tvantu bālasvabhāvaśca buddhihīnaśca rākṣasa| jñātavyantu na jānīṣe kathṃ rājā bhaviṣyasi||3.33.8||
meaning: O demon you are childish and foolish. You do not even know what ought to be known. How can you rule as a king?

sanskrit: येषां चारश्च कोशश्च नयश्च जयतां वर। अस्वाधीना नरेन्द्राणां प्राकृतैस्ते जनैस्समाः।।3.33.9।।
transliteration: yeṣāṃ cāraśca kośaśca nayaśca jayatāṃ vara| asvādhīnā narendrāṇāṃ prākṛtaiste janaissamāḥ||3.33.9||
meaning: The best among the victorious kings, who are not masters of their espionage, judicial system and their exchequer are equal to the laity.

sanskrit: यस्मात्पश्यन्ति दूरस्थान् सर्वानर्थान्नराधिपाः। चारेण तस्मादुच्यन्ते राजानो दीर्घचक्षुषः।।3.33.10।।
transliteration: yasmātpaśyanti dūrasthān sarvānarthānnarādhipāḥ| cāreṇa tasmāducyante rājāno dīrghacakṣuṣḥ||3.33.10||
meaning: Since kings can see things from a faroff place with the help of the spies they are called farsighted.

sanskrit: अयुक्तचारं मन्ये त्वां प्राकृतैस्सचिवैर्वृतम्। स्वजनं तु जनस्थाने हतं यो नावबुद्ध्यसे।।3.33.11।।
transliteration: ayuktacārṃ manye tvāṃ prākṛtaissacivairvṛtam| svajanṃ tu janasthāne hatṃ yo nāvabuddhyase||3.33.11||
meaning: Since you have not engaged any spy you do not know when your own relatives were killed in Janasthana. I take you to be a fool surrounded by ordinary ministers.

sanskrit: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसां क्रूरकर्मणाम्। हतान्येकेन रामेण खरश्च सहदूषणः।।3.33.12।।
transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ krūrakarmaṇām| hatānyekena rāmeṇa kharaśca sahadūṣaṇḥ||3.33.12||
meaning: One Rama alone killed all the fourteen thousand demons including Dusana and Khara, demons capable of fierce exploits.

sanskrit: ऋषीणामभयं दत्तं कृतक्षेमाश्च दण्डकाः। धर्षितं च जनस्थानं रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा।।3.33.13।।
transliteration: ṛṣīṇāmabhayṃ dattṃ kṛtakṣemāśca daṇḍakāḥ| dharṣitṃ ca janasthānṃ rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā||3.33.13||
meaning: Rama, the effortless performer of formindable tasks, has assured safety to the sages. Peace and happiness was restored to Dandaka forest but Janasthana has been ravaged.

sanskrit: त्वन्तु लुब्दः प्रमत्तश्च पराधीनश्च रावण। विषये स्वे समुत्पन्नं भयं यो नावबुध्यसे।।3.33.14।।
transliteration: tvantu lubdḥ pramattaśca parādhīnaśca rāvaṇa| viṣaye sve samutpannṃ bhayṃ yo nāvabudhyase||3.33.14||
meaning: O Ravana, you are not aware of what has happened to your own kingdom. You are avaricious, intoxicated, and under others' control. A great fear has been generated in your own kingdom.

sanskrit: तीक्ष्णमल्पप्रदातारं प्रमत्तं गर्वितं शठम्। व्यसने सर्वभूतानि नाभिधावन्ति पार्थिवम्।।3.33.15।।
transliteration: tīkṣṇamalpapradātārṃ pramattṃ garvitṃ śaṭham| vyasane sarvabhūtāni nābhidhāvanti pārthivam||3.33.15||
meaning: All living beings stop seeking refuge under a king who is, not a generous giver, but intoxicated, harsh, arrogant and fraudulent. They do not run to him for protection in times of calamity.

sanskrit: अतिमानिनमग्राह्यमात्मसम्भावितं नरम्। क्रोधिनं व्यसने हन्ति स्वजनोऽपि महीपतिम्।।3.33.16।।
transliteration: atimāninamagrāhyamātmasambhāvitṃ naram| krodhinṃ vyasane hanti svajano'pi mahīpatim||3.33.16||
meaning: A king who is extremely arrogant, who is not acceptable to good people, who is selfconceited and cholerictempered will be murdered even by his own people at the time of adversity.

sanskrit: नानुतिष्ठति कार्याणि भयेषु न बिभेति च। क्षिप्रं राज्याच्युतो दीनस्तृणैस्तुल्यो भविष्यति।।3.33.17।।
transliteration: nānutiṣṭhati kāryāṇi bhayeṣu na bibheti ca| kṣiprṃ rājyācyuto dīnastṛṇaistulyo bhaviṣyati||3.33.17||
meaning: A king who does not do what ought to be done, does not fear what ought to be feared, will surely be dislodged from the kingdom and live a wretched life like a blade of grass.

sanskrit: शुष्कैः काष्ठैर्भवेत्कार्यं लोष्टैरपि च पांसुभिः। न तु स्थानात्परिभ्रष्टैः कार्यं स्याद्वसुधाधिपैः।।3.33.18।।
transliteration: śuṣkaiḥ kāṣṭhairbhavetkāryṃ loṣṭairapi ca pāṃsubhiḥ| na tu sthānātparibhraṣṭaiḥ kāryṃ syādvasudhādhipaiḥ||3.33.18||
meaning: Even dried up logs, or clods of earth, or a handful of dust may have some value but not a king who is dethroned.

sanskrit: अपभुक्तं यथा वासस्स्रजो वा मृदिता यथा। एवं राज्यात्परिभ्रष्टस्समर्थोऽपि निरर्थकः।।3.33.19।।
transliteration: apabhuktṃ yathā vāsassrajo vā mṛditā yathā| evṃ rājyātparibhraṣṭassamartho'pi nirarthakḥ||3.33.19||
meaning: Like a piece of cloth that is worn and discarded, like garlands put on and crushed, a king dislodged from the kingdom is worthless even if he is capable.

sanskrit: अप्रमत्तश्च यो राजा सर्वज्ञो विजितेन्द्रियः। कृतज्ञो धर्मशीलश्च स राजा तिष्ठते चिरम्।।3.33.20।।
transliteration: apramattaśca yo rājā sarvajño vijitendriyḥ| kṛtajño dharmaśīlaśca sa rājā tiṣṭhate ciram||3.33.20||
meaning: A king who is alert, omniscient, has control over his senses, has a sense of gratitude and one of righteous conduct continues to rule for a long time.

sanskrit: नयनाभ्यां प्रसुप्तोऽपि जागर्ति नयचक्षुषा। त्यक्तक्रोधप्रमादश्च स राजा पूज्यते जनैः।।3.33.21।।
transliteration: nayanābhyāṃ prasupto'pi jāgarti nayacakṣuṣā| tyaktakrodhapramādaśca sa rājā pūjyate janaiḥ||3.33.21||
meaning: The king who keeps both his eyes shut but keeps the eye of justice open, one who is free from anger and remains ever alert, is worshipped by the people.

sanskrit: त्वं तु रावण दुर्बुद्धिर्गुणैरेतैर्विवर्जितः। यस्य तेऽविदितश्चारै रक्षसां सुमहान्वधः।।3.33.22।।
transliteration: tvṃ tu rāvaṇa durbuddhirguṇairetairvivarjitḥ| yasya te'viditaścārai rakṣasāṃ sumahānvadhḥ||3.33.22||
meaning: O Ravana you are evilminded. You are devoid of all these good qualities. Your spies could not know that there had been a great massacre of your fellowdemons.

sanskrit: परावमन्ता विषयेषु सङ्गतो न देशकालप्रविभागतत्ववित्। अयुक्तबुद्धिर्गुणदोषनिश्चये विपन्नराज्यो नचिराद्विपत्स्यसे।।3.33.23।।
transliteration: parāvamantā viṣayeṣu saṅgato na deśakālapravibhāgatatvavit| ayuktabuddhirguṇadoṣaniścaye vipannarājyo nacirādvipatsyase|
meaning: A king who accuses others, who is addicted to sensual pleasures, who lacks a sense of judgement of place and time, a sense of discrimination between virtue and vice and the right wisdom will destroy himself and the kingd

sanskrit: इति स्वदोषान् परिकीर्तितांस्तया समीक्ष्य बुद्ध्या क्षणदाचरेश्वरः। धनेन दर्पेण बलेन चान्वितो विचिन्तयामास चिरं स रावणः।।3
transliteration: iti svadoṣān parikīrtitāṃstayā samīkṣya buddhyā kṣaṇadācareśvarḥ| dhanena darpeṇa balena cānvito vicintayāmāsa cirṃ sa r
meaning: Ravana, king of demons, wealthy, arrogant and mighty, listened to Surpanakha and pondered over the mistakes she mentioned. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे त्रयस्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thir

sanskrit: कश्च रामः कथंवीर्यः किंरूपः किंपराक्रमः। किमर्थं दण्डकारण्यं प्रविष्टस्सुदुरासदम्।।3.34.2।।
transliteration: kaśca rāmḥ kathṃvīryḥ kiṃrūpḥ kiṃparākramḥ| kimarthṃ daṇḍakāraṇyṃ praviṣṭassudurāsadam||3.34.2||
meaning: Who is Rama? What is his strength? How does he look? How valiant is he? For what purpose has he entered the impenetrable Dandaka forest?

sanskrit: आयुधं किञ्च रामस्य निहता येन राक्षसाः। खरश्च निहतस्संख्ये दूषणस्त्रिशिरास्तथा।।3.34.3।।
transliteration: āyudhṃ kiñca rāmasya nihatā yena rākṣasāḥ| kharaśca nihatassṃkhye dūṣaṇastriśirāstathā||3.34.3||
meaning: With what weapons he has killed demons like Khara, Dusana and Trisira ?

sanskrit: इत्युक्ता राक्षसेन्द्रेण राक्षसी क्रोधमूर्छिता। ततो रामं यथातत्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे।।3.34.4।।
transliteration: ityuktā rākṣasendreṇa rākṣasī krodhamūrchitā| tato rāmṃ yathātatvamākhyātumupacakrame||3.34.4||
meaning: Thus questioned by Ravana, the demoness, overcome by anger, began telling him about Rama faithfully:

sanskrit: दीर्घबाहुर्विशालाक्ष श्चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरः। कन्दर्पसमरूपश्च रामो दशरथात्मजः।।3.34.5।।
transliteration: dīrghabāhurviśālākṣa ścīrakṛṣṇājināmbarḥ| kandarpasamarūpaśca rāmo daśarathātmajḥ||3.34.5||
meaning: Rama, Dasaratha's son, has long arms, large eyes. He is clad in deerskin and bark. He resembles Cupid.

sanskrit: शक्रचापनिभं चापं विकृष्य कनकाङ्गदम्। दीप्तान् क्षिपति नाराचान्सर्पानिव महाविषान्।।3.34.6।।
transliteration: śakracāpanibhṃ cāpṃ vikṛṣya kanakāṅgadam| dīptān kṣipati nārācānsarpāniva mahāviṣān||3.34.6||
meaning: His bow resembles Indra's, He is adorned with gold bands. Drawing the bow, he releases glittering arrows like highly poisonous snakes.

sanskrit: नाददानं शरान्घोरान्नमुञ्चन्तं शिलीमुखान्। न कार्मुकं विकर्षन्तं रामं पश्यामि संयुगे।।3.34.7।।
transliteration: nādadānṃ śarānghorānnamuñcantṃ śilīmukhān| na kārmukṃ vikarṣantṃ rāmṃ paśyāmi sṃyuge||3.34.7||
meaning: I could not see Rama in the dreadful war while he was pulling an arrow from the quiver, aiming the dart, and drawing the bowstring.

sanskrit: हन्यमानं तु तत्सैन्यं पश्यामि शरवृष्टिभिः। इन्द्रेणेवोत्तमं सस्यमाहतन्त्वश्मवृष्टिभिः।।3.34.8।।
transliteration: hanyamānṃ tu tatsainyṃ paśyāmi śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ| indreṇevottamṃ sasyamāhatantvaśmavṛṣṭibhiḥ||3.34.8||
meaning: Just as Indra destroys the crop ready for harvest by raining hailstones, I have seen Rama killing the army with a shower of arrows.

sanskrit: रक्षसां भीमरूपाणां सहस्राणि चतुर्दश। निहतानि शरै स्तीक्ष्णैस्तेनैकेन पदातिना।।3.34.9।। अर्धाधिकमुहूर्तेन खरश्च सहदूषणः।
transliteration: rakṣasāṃ bhīmarūpāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa| nihatāni śarai stīkṣṇaistenaikena padātinā||3.34.9|| ardhādhikamuhūrtena khar
meaning: Fighting alone on foot with his sharp arrows Rama killed within a span of one and a half muhurta, the fourteen thousand dreadful demons including Dusana and Khara.

sanskrit: ऋषीणामभयं दत्तं कृतक्षेमाश्च दण्डकाः।।3.34.10।। एका कथञ्चिन्मुक्ताहं परिभूय महात्मना। स्त्रीवधं शङ्कमानेन रामेण विदितात्
transliteration: ṛṣīṇāmabhayṃ dattṃ kṛtakṣemāśca daṇḍakāḥ||3.34.10|| ekā kathañcinmuktāhṃ paribhūya mahātmanā| strīvadhṃ śaṅkamānena rāme
meaning: Sages have been assured safety. Peace has been restored to Dandaka forest. As Rama, the great soul, who knows the self, hesitated to kill a woman, I was alone saved after this humiliation.

sanskrit: भ्राता चास्य महातेजा गुणतस्तुल्यविक्रमः। अनुरक्तश्च भक्तश्च लक्ष्मणो नाम वीर्यवान्।।3.34.12।।
transliteration: bhrātā cāsya mahātejā guṇatastulyavikramḥ| anuraktaśca bhaktaśca lakṣmaṇo nāma vīryavān||3.34.12||
meaning: His brother called Lakshmana looks radiant. He is virtuous and courageous like him, valiant, devoted and loyal.

sanskrit: अमर्षी दुर्जयो जेता विक्रान्तो बुद्धिमान्बली। रामस्य दक्षिणो बाहुर्नित्यं प्राणो बहिश्चरः।।3.34.13।।
transliteration: amarṣī durjayo jetā vikrānto buddhimānbalī| rāmasya dakṣiṇo bāhurnityṃ prāṇo bahiścarḥ||3.34.13||
meaning: He is impatient, invincible, victorious, bold, intelligent and strong. He is even the right hand of Rama, his outer life.

sanskrit: रामस्य तु विशालाक्षी पूर्णेन्दुसदृशानना। धर्मपत्नी प्रिया भर्तुर्नित्यं प्रियहिते रता।।3.34.14।।
transliteration: rāmasya tu viśālākṣī pūrṇendusadṛśānanā| dharmapatnī priyā bharturnityṃ priyahite ratā||3.34.14||
meaning: Rama's beloved consort is a largeeyed lady. Her face is like the full moon. She is engaged in the wellbeing of her husband.

sanskrit: सा सुकेशी सुनासोरुस्सुरूपा च यशस्विनी। देवतेव वनस्यास्य राजते श्रीरिवापरा।।3.34.15।।
transliteration: sā sukeśī sunāsorussurūpā ca yaśasvinī| devateva vanasyāsya rājate śrīrivāparā||3.34.15||
meaning: She is an illustrious lady. She is goodlooking with her long hair, wellshaped nose and things. She appears to be the presiding deity of the forest, another goddess of wealth (Laxmi).

sanskrit: तप्तकाञ्चनवर्णाभा रक्ततुङ्गनखी शुभा। सीता नाम वरारोहा वैदेही तनुमध्यमा।।3.34.16।।
transliteration: taptakāñcanavarṇābhā raktatuṅganakhī śubhā| sītā nāma varārohā vaidehī tanumadhyamā||3.34.16||
meaning: She is Sita, princess of Videha, a virtuous lady of golden complexion, a beautiful lady of slender waist and heavy hips.

sanskrit: नैव देवी न गन्धर्वी न यक्षी न च किन्नरी। नैवंरूपा मया नारी दृष्टपूर्वा महीतले।।3.34.17।।
transliteration: naiva devī na gandharvī na yakṣī na ca kinnarī| naivṃrūpā mayā nārī dṛṣṭapūrvā mahītale||3.34.17||
meaning: I had not seen such a beautiful woman earlier, among the gandharvas, or yakshas, or kinneras. I have not seen such a beauty among the humans on earth.

sanskrit: यस्य सीता भवेद्भार्या यं च हृष्टा परिष्वजेत्। अतिजीवेत्स सर्वेषु लोकेष्वपि पुरन्दरात्।।3.34.18।।
transliteration: yasya sītā bhavedbhāryā yṃ ca hṛṣṭā pariṣvajet| atijīvetsa sarveṣu lokeṣvapi purandarāt||3.34.18||
meaning: Whosoever gets Sita as his wife, whoever she embraces happily will wish to live longer than Indra, the breaker of fortresses in this world.

sanskrit: सा सुशीला वपुश्श्लाघ्या रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि। तवानुरूपा भार्या स्यात्त्वं च तस्यास्तथा पतिः।।3.34.19।।
transliteration: sā suśīlā vapuśślāghyā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi| tavānurūpā bhāryā syāttvṃ ca tasyāstathā patiḥ||3.34.19||
meaning: She is a woman of good conduct, of praiseworthy beauty. She is matchless in her beauty on earth. She will be a suitable wife for you and you, a suitable husband for her.

sanskrit: तां तु विस्तीर्णजघनां पीनश्रोणिपयोधराम्। भार्यार्थे च तवानेतुमुद्यताहं वराननाम्।।3.34.20।। विरूपितास्मि क्रूरेण लक्ष्मणे
transliteration: tāṃ tu vistīrṇajaghanāṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām| bhāryārthe ca tavānetumudyatāhṃ varānanām||3.34.20|| virūpitāsmi krūreṇa la
meaning: O mightyarmed one I have been disfigured by cruel Lakshmana as I was attempting to bring that lady of broad thighs, pointed breasts, heavy hips and a beautiful face to make her your wife.

sanskrit: तां तु दृष्ट्वाद्य वैदेहीं पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम्। मन्मथस्य शराणां वै त्वं विधेयो भविष्यसि।।3.34.21।।
transliteration: tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvādya vaidehīṃ pūrṇacandranibhānanām| manmathasya śarāṇāṃ vai tvṃ vidheyo bhaviṣyasi||3.34.21||
meaning: If you see her today, this lady with a face like the fullmoon, you will (instantaneously) fall a victim to the arrows of the god of love.

sanskrit: यदि तस्यामभिप्रायो भार्यार्थे तव जायते। शीघ्रमुद्ध्रियतां पादो जयार्थमिह दक्षिणः।।3.34.22।।
transliteration: yadi tasyāmabhiprāyo bhāryārthe tava jāyate| śīghramuddhriyatāṃ pādo jayārthamiha dakṣiṇḥ||3.34.22||
meaning: If you intend her to be your wife, raise your right foot now and proceed to win her over.

sanskrit: कुरु प्रियं तथा तेषां रक्षसां राक्षसेश्वर। वधात्तस्य नृशंसस्य रामस्याश्रमवासिनः।।3.34.23।।
transliteration: kuru priyṃ tathā teṣāṃ rakṣasāṃ rākṣaseśvara| vadhāttasya nṛśṃsasya rāmasyāśramavāsinḥ||3.34.23||
meaning: O lord of the demons, do a favour to your clan by killing that cruel Rama dwelling in the hermitage.

sanskrit: तं शरैर्निशितैर्हत्वा लक्ष्मणं च महारथम्। हतनाथां सुखं सीतां यथावदुपभोक्ष्यसि।।3.34.24।।
transliteration: tṃ śarairniśitairhatvā lakṣmaṇṃ ca mahāratham| hatanāthāṃ sukhṃ sītāṃ yathāvadupabhokṣyasi||3.34.24||
meaning: Kill Rama, that great warrior along with Lakshmana with sharp arrows and enjoy the company of Sita happily as you like, with her husband dead.

sanskrit: रोचते यति ते वाक्यं ममैतद्राक्षसेश्वर। क्रियतां निर्विशङ्केन वचनं मम रावण।।3.34.25।।
transliteration: rocate yati te vākyṃ mamaitadrākṣaseśvara| kriyatāṃ nirviśaṅkena vacanṃ mama rāvaṇa||3.34.25||
meaning: If you like what I have said, do accordingly without any hesitation, O Ravana, lord of the demons.

sanskrit: विज्ञायेहात्मशक्तिं च ह्रियतामबला बलात्। सीता सर्वानवद्याङ्गी भार्यार्थे राक्षसेश्वर।।3.34.26।।
transliteration: vijñāyehātmaśaktiṃ ca hriyatāmabalā balāt| sītā sarvānavadyāṅgī bhāryārthe rākṣaseśvara||3.34.26||
meaning: Assess your own strength, O Lord of the demons, before you forcefully abduct that delicate Sita who is charming in all respects and make her your wife.

sanskrit: निशम्य रामेण शरैरजिह्मगै र्हतान् जनस्थानगतान्निशाचरान्। खरं च बुद्ध्वा निहतं च दूषणं त्वमत्र कृत्यं प्रतिपत्तुमर्हसि।।3.
transliteration: niśamya rāmeṇa śarairajihmagai rhatān janasthānagatānniśācarān| kharṃ ca buddhvā nihatṃ ca dūṣaṇṃ tvamatra kṛtyṃ pratipa
meaning: On hearing about the death of the demons including Khara and Dusana who fell to the straight and swift arrows of Rama, you should decide your course of action. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे चतु

sanskrit: तत्कार्यमनुगम्याथ यथावदुपलभ्य च। दोषाणां च गुणानां च सम्प्रधार्य बलाबलम्।3.35.2।। इति कर्तव्यमित्येव कृत्वा निश्चयमात्मन
transliteration: tatkāryamanugamyātha yathāvadupalabhya ca| doṣāṇāṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca sampradhārya balābalam|3.35.2|| iti kartavyamityeva kṛt
meaning: Deliberating on the task ahead, duly considering the pros and cons, demerits and merits, strength and weakness, of the issue and having firmly decided within himself, he left for the beautiful coachshed.

sanskrit: यानशालां ततो गत्वा प्रच्छन्नो राक्षसाधिपः। सूतं सञ्चोदयामास रथस्संयोज्यतामिति।।3.35.4।।
transliteration: yānaśālāṃ tato gatvā pracchanno rākṣasādhipḥ| sūtṃ sañcodayāmāsa rathassṃyojyatāmiti||3.35.4||
meaning: Ravana went covertly to the coachshed and to the charioteer to get a chariot harnessed.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तः क्षेणेनैव सारथिर्लघुविक्रमः। रथं संयोजयामास तस्याभिमतमुत्तमम्।।3.35.5।।
transliteration: evamuktḥ kṣeṇenaiva sārathirlaghuvikramḥ| rathṃ sṃyojayāmāsa tasyābhimatamuttamam||3.35.5||
meaning: Thus ordered, the smart charioteer got the chariot of his choice harnessed in an instant.

sanskrit: काञ्चनं रथमास्थाय कामगं रत्नभूषितम्। पिशाचवदनैर्युक्तं खरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः।।3.35.6।। मेघप्रतिमनादेन स तेन धनदानुजः। राक्षस
transliteration: kāñcanṃ rathamāsthāya kāmagṃ ratnabhūṣitam| piśācavadanairyuktṃ kharaiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ||3.35.6|| meghapratimanādena sa
meaning: The younger brother of Kubera (Ravana), the prosperous lord of the demons ascended the chariot which could go where he desired. Embellished with gold, studded with gems, harnessed with demonfaced donkeys, the chariot rol

sanskrit: स श्वेतवालव्यजनः श्वेतच्छत्रो दशाननः। स्निग्धवैदूर्यसंकाश स्तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः।।3.35.8।। विंशद्भुजो दशग्रीवो दर्शनीयपरिच्
transliteration: sa śvetavālavyajanḥ śvetacchatro daśānanḥ| snigdhavaidūryasṃkāśa staptakāñcanakuṇḍalḥ||3.35.8|| viṃśadbhujo daśagrīvo da
meaning: Ravana, enemy of the gods, slayer of towering sages, with white yaktail fans, and white parasols, shining like smooth vaidurya, wearing pure gold earrings, clad in attractive attire, ten necks with twenty strong hands, t

sanskrit: स शैलं सागरानूपं वीर्यवानवलोकयन्। नानापुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैरनुकीर्णं सहस्रशः।।3.35.11।।
transliteration: sa śailṃ sāgarānūpṃ vīryavānavalokayan| nānāpuṣpaphalairvṛkṣairanukīrṇṃ sahasraśḥ||3.35.11||
meaning: Valiant Ravana wentwatching the mountains full of thousands of trees bearing flowers and fruits on the shore of the sea.

sanskrit: शीतमङ्गलतोयाभिः पद्मिनीभिस्समन्ततः। विशालैराश्रमपदैर्वेदिमद्भिस्समावृतम्।।3.35.12।।
transliteration: śītamaṅgalatoyābhiḥ padminībhissamantatḥ| viśālairāśramapadairvedimadbhissamāvṛtam||3.35.12||
meaning: (The area) surrounded on all sides with lotusladen ponds filled with cool, sacred water, sprawling hermitages with elevated altars.

sanskrit: कदल्याढकिसम्बाधं नारिकेलोपशोभितम्। सालैस्तालैस्तमालैश्च पुष्पितैस्तरुभिर्वृतम्।।3.35.13।।
transliteration: kadalyāḍhakisambādhṃ nārikelopaśobhitam| sālaistālaistamālaiśca puṣpitaistarubhirvṛtam||3.35.13||
meaning: The place covered with banana plants and coconut trees as well as blossoming sal and tamala trees was looking extremely beautiful.

sanskrit: नागैस्सुपर्णैर्गन्धैर्वैः किन्नरैश्च सहस्रशः। अजैर्वैखानसैर्माषैर्वालखिल्यैर्मरीचिपैः।।3.35.14।। अत्यन्तनियताहारैश्शोभित
transliteration: nāgaissuparṇairgandhairvaiḥ kinnaraiśca sahasraśḥ| ajairvaikhānasairmāṣairvālakhilyairmarīcipaiḥ||3.35.14|| atyantaniyat
meaning: The place looked charming with nagas, garudas, gandharvas, kinneras in their thousands and with the descendants of ajas, vaikhanasas, valakhilyas and with those who drink the rays of Sun and Moon for survival, with sages

sanskrit: दिव्याभरणमाल्याभिर्दिव्यरूपाभिरावृतम्। क्रीडारतिविधिज्ञाभिरप्सरोभिस्सहस्रशः।।3.35.16।।
transliteration: divyābharaṇamālyābhirdivyarūpābhirāvṛtam| krīḍāratividhijñābhirapsarobhissahasraśḥ||3.35.16||
meaning: (The place was) full of apsaras in their thousands and paragons of beauty adorned with divine ornaments and garlands, and experts in lovesports.

sanskrit: सेवितं देवपन्तीभिश्श्रीमतीभिश्श्रियाऽऽवृतम्। देवदानवसङ्घैश्च चरितं त्वमृताशिभिः।।3.35.17।।
transliteration: sevitṃ devapantībhiśśrīmatībhiśśriyā''vṛtam| devadānavasaṅghaiśca caritṃ tvamṛtāśibhiḥ||3.35.17||
meaning: It was chosen by prosperous wives of gods as a reosrt. Hosts of gods and demons were wandering, there in the hope of tasting nectar.

sanskrit: हंसक्रौञ्चप्लवाकीर्णं सारसैस्सम्प्रणादितम्। वैढूर्यप्रस्तरं रम्यं स्निग्धं सागरतेजसा।।3.35.18।।
transliteration: hṃsakrauñcaplavākīrṇṃ sārasaissampraṇāditam| vaiḍhūryaprastarṃ ramyṃ snigdhṃ sāgaratejasā||3.35.18||
meaning: (It was ) full of small floats, flocks of swans, kraunchas, sarasas cackling in the ponds, with great joy. It had stretches of vaidurya stones on the shore and shone with the radiance of the sea

sanskrit: पाण्डुराणि विशालानि दिव्यमाल्ययुतानि च। तूर्यगीताभिजुष्टानि विमानानि समन्ततः।।3.35.19।। तपसा जितलोकानां कामगान्यभिसम्पतन
transliteration: pāṇḍurāṇi viśālāni divyamālyayutāni ca| tūryagītābhijuṣṭāni vimānāni samantatḥ||3.35.19|| tapasā jitalokānāṃ kāmagānyabh
meaning: Speeding along, the brother of Kubera (Ravana) saw palewhite, spacious aerial chariots on all sides controlled by those who had conquered the higher worlds by their penances. These chariots, decked with heavenly garlands

sanskrit: निर्यासरसमूलानां चन्दनानां सहस्रशः। वनानि पश्यन्सौम्यानि घ्राणतृप्तिकराणि च।।3.35.21।।
transliteration: niryāsarasamūlānāṃ candanānāṃ sahasraśḥ| vanāni paśyansaumyāni ghrāṇatṛptikarāṇi ca||3.35.21||
meaning: He saw thousands of tree trunks with finesmelling resins and sandalwood trees.

sanskrit: अगरूणां च मुख्यानां वनान्युपवनानि च। तक्कोलानां च जात्यानां फलानां च सुगन्धिनाम्।।3.35.22।।
transliteration: agarūṇāṃ ca mukhyānāṃ vanānyupavanāni ca| takkolānāṃ ca jātyānāṃ phalānāṃ ca sugandhinām||3.35.22||
meaning: (He saw) very fine aguru trees in the forest as well as pleasuregroves of takkola fruits, fragrant trees of a fine variety and fragrant nutmegs.

sanskrit: पुष्पाणि च तमालस्य गुल्मानि मरिचस्य च। मुक्तानां च समूहानि शुष्यमाणानि तीरतः।।3.35.23।।
transliteration: puṣpāṇi ca tamālasya gulmāni maricasya ca| muktānāṃ ca samūhāni śuṣyamāṇāni tīratḥ||3.35.23||
meaning: (He saw) tamala flowers in bloom, pepper shrubs in clusters and hoards of pearls kept for drying on the shores.

sanskrit: शङ्खानां प्रसरं चैव प्रवालनिचयं तथा। काञ्चनानि च शैलानि राजतानि च सर्वशः।।3.35.24।।
transliteration: śaṅkhānāṃ prasarṃ caiva pravālanicayṃ tathā| kāñcanāni ca śailāni rājatāni ca sarvaśḥ||3.35.24||
meaning: He saw stretches of conches, heaps of corals and mounds of gold and silver too.

sanskrit: प्रस्रवाणि मनोज्ञानि प्रसन्नानि ह्रदानि च। धनधान्योपपन्नानि स्त्रीरत्नैश्शोभितानि च।।3.35.25।। हस्त्यश्वरथगाढानि नगराण्य
transliteration: prasravāṇi manojñāni prasannāni hradāni ca| dhanadhānyopapannāni strīratnaiśśobhitāni ca||3.35.25|| hastyaśvarathagāḍhān
meaning: He went watching fascinating waterfalls, pleasing ponds, cities filled with wealth and grain, looking splendid with beautiful women and full of elephants, horses and chariots.

sanskrit: तं समं सर्वतस्निग्धं मृदुसंस्पर्शमारुतम्। अनूपं सिन्धुराजस्य ददर्श त्रिदिवोपमम्।।3.35.26।।
transliteration: tṃ samṃ sarvatasnigdhṃ mṛdusṃsparśamārutam| anūpṃ sindhurājasya dadarśa tridivopamam||3.35.26||
meaning: It was a veritable heaven with the plain land flooded with the backwaters of the sea and gentle breeze blowing.

sanskrit: तत्रापश्यत्स मेघाभं न्यग्रोधमृषिभिर्वृतम्।।3.35.27।। समन्ताद्यस्य ताश्शाखाश्शतयोजनमायताः।
transliteration: tatrāpaśyatsa meghābhṃ nyagrodhamṛṣibhirvṛtam||3.35.27|| samantādyasya tāśśākhāśśatayojanamāyatāḥ|
meaning: He saw a banyan tree with its branches spread on all sides measuring a hundred yojanas, looking like a cloud and providing shelter to the sages.

sanskrit: यस्य हस्तिनमादाय महाकायं च कच्छपम्।।3.35.28।। भक्षार्थं गरुडश्शाखामाजगाम महाबलः।
transliteration: yasya hastinamādāya mahākāyṃ ca kacchapam||3.35.28|| bhakṣārthṃ garuḍaśśākhāmājagāma mahābalḥ|
meaning: In the past, the mighty Garuda brought an elephant and a huge tortoise and sat on a branch of this tree to feed on them.

sanskrit: तस्य तां सहसा शाखां भारेण पतगोत्तमः।।3.35.29।। सुपर्णः पर्णबहुलां बभञ्ज च महाबलः।
transliteration: tasya tāṃ sahasā śākhāṃ bhāreṇa patagottamḥ||3.35.29|| suparṇḥ parṇabahulāṃ babhañja ca mahābalḥ|
meaning: Due to the weight of this best of birds, the mighty Garuda, the leafy branch at once broke down.

sanskrit: तत्र वैखानसा माषा वालखिल्या मरीचिपाः।।3.35.30।। अजा बभूवुर्धूम्राश्च सङ्गताः परमर्षयः।
transliteration: tatra vaikhānasā māṣā vālakhilyā marīcipāḥ||3.35.30|| ajā babhūvurdhūmrāśca saṅgatāḥ paramarṣayḥ|
meaning: Gathered together under the great tree were great sages like vaikhanasas, mashas, marichipas, valakhilyas, ajas and dhumras.

sanskrit: तेषां दयार्थं गरुडस्तां शाखां शतयोजनाम्।।3.35.31।। जगामादाय वेगेन तौ चोभौ गजकच्छपौ।
transliteration: teṣāṃ dayārthṃ garuḍastāṃ śākhāṃ śatayojanām||3.35.31|| jagāmādāya vegena tau cobhau gajakacchapau|
meaning: Out of compassion for the (endangered) seers Garuda carried away that hundredyojanalong branch along with the elephant and the tortoise with great speed.

sanskrit: एकपादेन धर्मात्मा भक्षयित्वा तदामिषम्।।3.35.32।। निषादविषयं हत्वा शाखया पतगोत्तमः। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे मोक्षयित्वा महामुनी
transliteration: ekapādena dharmātmā bhakṣayitvā tadāmiṣam||3.35.32|| niṣādaviṣayṃ hatvā śākhayā patagottamḥ| praharṣamatulṃ lebhe mokṣay
meaning: Righteous Garuda, the best among the birds, stood on one foot and ate the flesh (of elephant and tortoise) and with the branch of the tree, destroyed the settlement of the demons. Over the destruction of the demons and d

sanskrit: स तेनैव प्रहर्षेण द्विगुणीकृतविक्रमः। अमृतानयनार्थं वै चकार मतिमान्मतिम्।।3.35.34।।
transliteration: sa tenaiva praharṣeṇa dviguṇīkṛtavikramḥ| amṛtānayanārthṃ vai cakāra matimānmatim||3.35.34||
meaning: Quite happy, his energy redoubled, wise Garuda made up his mind to obtain nectar.

sanskrit: अयोजालानि निर्मथ्य भित्वा रत्नमयं गृहम्। महेन्द्रभवनाद्गुप्तमाजहारामृतं ततः।।3.35.35।।
transliteration: ayojālāni nirmathya bhitvā ratnamayṃ gṛham| mahendrabhavanādguptamājahārāmṛtṃ tatḥ||3.35.35||
meaning: Twisting and twirling the grills of the window, he broke open the room made of gems and quietly carried away the nectar from Indra's mansion.

sanskrit: तं महर्षिगणैर्जुष्टं सुपर्णकृतलक्षणम्। नाम्ना सुभद्रं न्यग्रोधं ददर्श धनदानुजः।।3.35.36।।
transliteration: tṃ maharṣigaṇairjuṣṭṃ suparṇakṛtalakṣaṇam| nāmnā subhadrṃ nyagrodhṃ dadarśa dhanadānujḥ||3.35.36||
meaning: Ravana, the younger brother of Kubera, beheld that banyan tree called Subhadram ,which was a favoured resort of the sages bearing the ensignia of Garuda.

sanskrit: तं तु गत्वा परं पारं समुद्रस्य नदीपतेः। ददर्शाश्रममेकान्ते रम्ये पुण्ये वनान्तरे।।3.35.37।।
transliteration: tṃ tu gatvā parṃ pārṃ samudrasya nadīpateḥ| dadarśāśramamekānte ramye puṇye vanāntare||3.35.37||
meaning: Ravana crossed over to the other side of the sea, the lord of rivers, and beheld a hermitage in a beautiful, secluded, sacred place in the middle of the forest.

sanskrit: तत्र कृष्णाजिनधरं जटावल्कलधारिणम्। ददर्श नियताहारं मारीचं नाम राक्षसाम्।।3.35.38।।
transliteration: tatra kṛṣṇājinadharṃ jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇam| dadarśa niyatāhārṃ mārīcṃ nāma rākṣasām||3.35.38||
meaning: There he saw a demon Maricha, by name, clad in dark deerskin and bark ,with matted hair and living on restricted food.

sanskrit: स रावणस्समागम्य विधिवत्तेन रक्षसा। मारीचेनार्चितो राजा सर्वकामैरमानुषैः।।3.35.39।।
transliteration: sa rāvaṇassamāgamya vidhivattena rakṣasā| mārīcenārcito rājā sarvakāmairamānuṣaiḥ||3.35.39||
meaning: When king Ravana reached there, Maricha received him in accordance with tradition and made worshipful offering to the king, fulfilling all his superhuman desires.

sanskrit: तं स्वयं पूजयित्वा तु भोजनेनोदकेन च। अर्थोपहितया वाचा मारीचो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।3.35.40।।
transliteration: tṃ svayṃ pūjayitvā tu bhojanenodakena ca| arthopahitayā vācā mārīco vākyamabravīt||3.35.40||
meaning: Maricha extended his hospitality with appropriate food and water and said with meaningful words:

sanskrit: कच्चित्सुकुशलं राजन्लङ्कायां राक्षसेश्वर। केनार्थेन पुनस्त्वं वै तूर्णमेवमिहागतः।।3.35.41।।
transliteration: kaccitsukuśalṃ rājanlaṅkāyāṃ rākṣaseśvara| kenārthena punastvṃ vai tūrṇamevamihāgatḥ||3.35.41||
meaning: O king O lord of the demons hope all is well in Lanka. What brings you here again so soon ?

sanskrit: एवमुक्तो महातेजा मारीचेन स रावणः। ततः पश्चादिदं वाक्यमब्रवीद्वाक्यकोविदः।।3.35.42।।
transliteration: evamukto mahātejā mārīcena sa rāvaṇḥ| tatḥ paścādidṃ vākyamabravīdvākyakovidḥ||3.35.42||
meaning: Thus addressed by Maricha, the effulgent, eloquent Ravana replied with these words: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfifth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy

sanskrit: जानीषे त्वं जनस्थाने यथा भ्राता खरो मम। दूषणश्च महाबाहु स्वसा शूर्पणखा च मे।।3.36.2।। त्रिशिराश्च महातेजा राक्षसः पिशिता
transliteration: jānīṣe tvṃ janasthāne yathā bhrātā kharo mama| dūṣaṇaśca mahābāhu svasā śūrpaṇakhā ca me||3.36.2|| triśirāśca mahātejā r
meaning: You know that my brothers, Khara and Dusana, the strongarmed heroes, my sister Surpanakha and the mighty cannibal Trisira, and many other heroic demons successful in hitting their targets are bonafide residents. They hav

sanskrit: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्। शूराणां लब्धलक्षाणां खरचित्तानुवर्तिनाम्।।3.36.5।।
transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ bhīmakarmaṇām| śūrāṇāṃ labdhalakṣāṇāṃ kharacittānuvartinām||3.36.5||
meaning: These fourteen thousand heroes, perpetrators of terrible deeds, skilled in hitting the targets had been acting according to the direction of Khara.

sanskrit: ते त्विदानीं जनस्थाने वसमाना महाबलाः। सङ्गताः परमायत्ता रामेण सह संयुगे।।3.36.6।। नानाप्रहरणोपेताः खरप्रमुखराक्षसाः।
transliteration: te tvidānīṃ janasthāne vasamānā mahābalāḥ| saṅgatāḥ paramāyattā rāmeṇa saha sṃyuge||3.36.6|| nānāpraharaṇopetāḥ kharapra
meaning: These mighty demons, living in Janasthana, eqipped with different kinds of weapons, supported and led by Khara, met Rama in an encounter.

sanskrit: तेन सञ्जातरोषेण रामेण रणमूर्धनि। अनुक्त्वा परुषं किञ्चिच्छरैर्व्यापारितं धनुः।।3.36.7।।
transliteration: tena sañjātaroṣeṇa rāmeṇa raṇamūrdhani| anuktvā paruṣṃ kiñciccharairvyāpāritṃ dhanuḥ||3.36.7||
meaning: With his wrath generated, Rama, without even speaking anything, used his bow and the arrows.

sanskrit: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसामुग्रतेजसाम्। निहतानि शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मानुषेण पदातिना।।3.36.8।।
transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasāmugratejasām| nihatāni śaraistīkṣṇairmānuṣeṇa padātinā||3.36.8||
meaning: Being a human being who fought on foot, he killed fourteen thousand ferocious demons with his sharp arrows.

sanskrit: खरश्च निहतस्सङ्ख्ये दूषणश्च निपातितः। हतश्च त्रिशिराश्चापि निर्भया दण्डकाः कृताः।।3.36.9।।
transliteration: kharaśca nihatassaṅkhye dūṣaṇaśca nipātitḥ| hataśca triśirāścāpi nirbhayā daṇḍakāḥ kṛtāḥ||3.36.9||
meaning: Khara, Dusana and Trisira were killed in war.The residents of Dandaka forest are rendered safe and fearless.

sanskrit: पित्रा निरस्तः क्रुद्धेन सभार्यः क्षीणजीवितः। स हन्ता तस्य सैन्यस्य रामः क्षत्रियपांसनः।।3.36.10।।
transliteration: pitrā nirastḥ kruddhena sabhāryḥ kṣīṇajīvitḥ| sa hantā tasya sainyasya rāmḥ kṣatriyapāṃsanḥ||3.36.10||
meaning: Rama, a victim of his father's anger, banished into the forest with his wife, a shortlived mortal and a calumny on the kshatriyas has killed the army of demons.

sanskrit: दुश्शीलः कर्कशस्तीक्ष्णो मूर्खो लुब्धोऽजितेन्द्रियः।।3.36.11।। त्यक्तधर्मो ह्यधर्मात्मा भूतानामहिते रतः।
transliteration: duśśīlḥ karkaśastīkṣṇo mūrkho lubdho'jitendriyḥ||3.36.11|| tyaktadharmo hyadharmātmā bhūtānāmahite ratḥ|
meaning: He is a man of bad conduct, harsh, sharptonged, stupid, miserly and a slave to his senses. He is immoral and unrighteous, one who is busy harming others.

sanskrit: येन वैरं विनाऽरण्ये सत्वमाश्रित्य केवलम्।।3.36.12।। कर्णनासापहरणाद्भगिनी मे विरूपिता। तस्यभार्यां जनस्थानात्सीतां सुरसुत
transliteration: yena vairṃ vinā'raṇye satvamāśritya kevalam||3.36.12|| karṇanāsāpaharaṇādbhaginī me virūpitā| tasyabhāryāṃ janasthānātsī
meaning: With no enmity whatsoever, merely because he has strength, he cut off the nose and ears of my sister and mutilated her. His wife Sita is like the daughter of heaven. I would like to abduct her with force from Janasthana

sanskrit: त्वया ह्यहं सहायेन पार्श्वस्थेन महाबल।।3.36.14।। भ्रातृभिश्च सुरान्युद्धे समग्रान्नाभिचिन्तये। तत्सहायो भव त्वं मे समर्थ
transliteration: tvayā hyahṃ sahāyena pārśvasthena mahābala||3.36.14|| bhrātṛbhiśca surānyuddhe samagrānnābhicintaye| tatsahāyo bhava tvṃ
meaning: You are mighty. I do not care to fight even the gods when you and my brothers are by my side. Therefore, O demon, be my accomplice. (I know) you are capable of that.

sanskrit: वीर्ये युद्धे च दर्पे च न ह्यस्ति सदृशस्तव। उपायज्ञो महान्शूरस्सर्वमायाविशारदः।।3.36.16।।
transliteration: vīrye yuddhe ca darpe ca na hyasti sadṛśastava| upāyajño mahānśūrassarvamāyāviśāradḥ||3.36.16||
meaning: In valour, in war and in conceit there is no one equal to you. You know all means (of success). You are great. You are brave. You are an expert in all deceitful arts.

sanskrit: एतदर्थमहं प्राप्तस्त्वत्समीपं निशाचर। शृणु तत्कर्म साहाय्ये यत्कार्यं वचनान्मम।।3.36.17।।
transliteration: etadarthamahṃ prāptastvatsamīpṃ niśācara| śṛṇu tatkarma sāhāyye yatkāryṃ vacanānmama||3.36.17||
meaning: I have come to you for this purpose seeking your help. Listen to my words on what you should do:

sanskrit: सौवर्णस्त्वं मृगो भूत्वा चित्रो रजतबिन्दुभिः। आश्रमे तस्य रामस्य सीतायाः प्रमुखे चर।।3.36.18।।
transliteration: sauvarṇastvṃ mṛgo bhūtvā citro rajatabindubhiḥ| āśrame tasya rāmasya sītāyāḥ pramukhe cara||3.36.18||
meaning: Be a wonderful golden deer dappled with silver dots and roam in front of Sita in Rama's hermitage.

sanskrit: त्वां तु निस्संशयं सीता दृष्ट्वा तु मृगरूपिणम्। गृह्यतामिति भर्तारं लक्ष्मणं चाभिधास्यति।।3.36.19।।
transliteration: tvāṃ tu nissṃśayṃ sītā dṛṣṭvā tu mṛgarūpiṇam| gṛhyatāmiti bhartārṃ lakṣmaṇṃ cābhidhāsyati||3.36.19||
meaning: Seeing you in the form of a deer, Sita will undoubtedly ask her husband and Lakshmana to capture you.

sanskrit: ततस्तयोरपाये तु शून्ये सीतां यथासुखम्। निराबाधो हरिष्यामि राहुश्चन्द्रप्रभामिव।।3.36.20।।
transliteration: tatastayorapāye tu śūnye sītāṃ yathāsukham| nirābādho hariṣyāmi rāhuścandraprabhāmiva||3.36.20||
meaning: Then during their absence it will be easy for me to abduct Sita in an isolated place without obstruction, like Rahu eclipsing the light of the moon.

sanskrit: ततः पश्चात्सुखं रामे भार्याहरणकर्शिते। विस्रब्धः प्रहरिष्यामि कृतार्थेनान्तरात्मना।।3.36.21।।
transliteration: tatḥ paścātsukhṃ rāme bhāryāharaṇakarśite| visrabdhḥ prahariṣyāmi kṛtārthenāntarātmanā||3.36.21||
meaning: Thereafter, when Rama with his soul afflicted due to his wife's abduction. I can freely, happily, successfully strike him down.

sanskrit: तस्य रामकथां श्रुत्वा मारीचस्य महात्मनः। शुष्कं समभवद्वक्त्रं परितप्ता बभूव ह।।3.36.22।।
transliteration: tasya rāmakathāṃ śrutvā mārīcasya mahātmanḥ| śuṣkṃ samabhavadvaktrṃ paritaptā babhūva ha||3.36.22||
meaning: At the mention of Rama's name, great Maricha's mouth dried up and he became concerned.

sanskrit: ओष्ठौ परिलिहञ्चुष्कौ नेत्रैरनिमिषैरिव। मृतभूत इवार्तस्तु रावणं समुदैक्षत।।3.36.23।।
transliteration: oṣṭhau parilihañcuṣkau netrairanimiṣairiva| mṛtabhūta ivārtastu rāvaṇṃ samudaikṣata||3.36.23||
meaning: Licking his dried up lips, as though his eyes stopped winking like those of the dead, Maricha stared at Ravana, distressed.

sanskrit: स रावणं त्रस्तविषण्णचेता महावने रामपराक्रमज्ञः। कृताञ्जलिस्तत्वमुवाच वाक्यं हितं च तस्मै हितमात्मनश्च।।3.36.24।।
transliteration: sa rāvaṇṃ trastaviṣaṇṇacetā mahāvane rāmaparākramajñḥ| kṛtāñjalistatvamuvāca vākyṃ hitṃ ca tasmai hitamātmanaśca||3.36.2
meaning: Maricha who knows of Rama's valour was frightened and depressed at heart. He revealed to Ravana with folded hands some facts for mutual benefit. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षट् त्रिंशस्सर्गः

sanskrit: सुलभाः पुरुषा राजन्सततं प्रियवादिनः। अप्रियस्य तु पथ्यस्य वक्ता श्रोता च दुर्लभः।।3.37.2।।
transliteration: sulabhāḥ puruṣā rājansatatṃ priyavādinḥ| apriyasya tu pathyasya vaktā śrotā ca durlabhḥ||3.37.2||
meaning: O king, it is always easy to find men who speak pleasing words, but it is difficult to get a speaker and a listener who use words unpleasant (to the ears) but beneficial (in life).

sanskrit: न नूनं बुध्यसे रामं महावीर्यं गुणोन्नतम्। अयुक्तचारश्चपलो महेन्द्रवरुणोपमम्।।3.37.3।।
transliteration: na nūnṃ budhyase rāmṃ mahāvīryṃ guṇonnatam| ayuktacāraścapalo mahendravaruṇopamam||3.37.3||
meaning: You are fickleminded. You have employed no spy ( who could have told you the truth about Rama's character). Rama is very brave and virtuous comparable to Indra and Varuna. Surely you are not able to know what Rama is.

sanskrit: अपि स्वस्ति भवेत्तात सर्वेषां भुवि रक्षसाम्। अपि रामो नासङ्क्रुद्धः कुर्याल्लोकमराक्षसम्।।3.37.4।।
transliteration: api svasti bhavettāta sarveṣāṃ bhuvi rakṣasām| api rāmo nāsaṅkruddhḥ kuryāllokamarākṣasam||3.37.4||
meaning: O dear may there be good to all the demons in the world. If Rama gets enraged, he will make this world demonless.

sanskrit: अपि ते जीवितान्ताय नोत्पन्ना जनकात्मजा। अपि सीतानिमित्तं च न भवेद्व्यसनं मम।।3.37.5।।
transliteration: api te jīvitāntāya notpannā janakātmajā| api sītānimittṃ ca na bhavedvyasanṃ mama||3.37.5||
meaning: Hope the daughter of Janaka is not born to put an end to your life. Hope I will not face any disaster on account of Sita.

sanskrit: अपि त्वामीश्वरं प्राप्य कामवृत्तं निरङ्कुशम्। न विनश्येत्पुरी लङ्का त्वया सह सराक्षसा।।3.37.6।।
transliteration: api tvāmīśvarṃ prāpya kāmavṛttṃ niraṅkuśam| na vinaśyetpurī laṅkā tvayā saha sarākṣasā||3.37.6||
meaning: I hope the city of Lanka along with the (entire) race of demons will not be destroyed, with a dictator like you who is a slave to sensual pleasure.

sanskrit: त्वद्विधः कामवृत्तो हि दुश्शीलः पापमन्त्रितः। आत्मानं स्वजनं राष्ट्रं स राजा हन्ति दुर्मतिः।।3.37.7।।
transliteration: tvadvidhḥ kāmavṛtto hi duśśīlḥ pāpamantritḥ| ātmānṃ svajanṃ rāṣṭrṃ sa rājā hanti durmatiḥ||3.37.7||
meaning: A king who is a slave to passion, who is of bad conduct, of wicked thoughts, advised in evil ways destroys himself, his kith and kin and the entire kingdom.

sanskrit: न च पित्रा परित्यक्तो नामर्यादः कथञ्चन। न लुब्धो न च दुश्शीलो न च क्षत्रियपांसनः।।3.37.8।। न च धर्मगुणैर्हीनः कौसल्यानन्
transliteration: na ca pitrā parityakto nāmaryādḥ kathañcana| na lubdho na ca duśśīlo na ca kṣatriyapāṃsanḥ||3.37.8|| na ca dharmaguṇairh
meaning: Rama, the delight of Kausalya, has not forsaken by his father. He has never crossed the limits of dharma. He is not miserly. He has no bad conduct. He is not a slur on the kshatriyas. He does not lack in righteousness. H

sanskrit: वञ्चितं पितरं दृष्ट्वा कैकेय्या सत्यवादिनम्। करिष्यामीति धर्मात्मा तात प्रव्रजितो वनम्।।3.37.10।।
transliteration: vañcitṃ pitarṃ dṛṣṭvā kaikeyyā satyavādinam| kariṣyāmīti dharmātmā tāta pravrajito vanam||3.37.10||
meaning: O dear, seeing that his truthful father was going to be deceived by Kaikeyi, righteous Rama himself offered to fulfil the promise of his father and came away to the forest.

sanskrit: कैकेय्याः प्रियकामार्थं पितुर्दशरथस्य च। हित्वा राज्यं च भोगांश्च प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम्।।3.37.11।।
transliteration: kaikeyyāḥ priyakāmārthṃ piturdaśarathasya ca| hitvā rājyṃ ca bhogāṃśca praviṣṭo daṇḍakāvanam||3.37.11||
meaning: To satisfy the desire of Kaikeyi and to fulfil his father's word he came to Dandaka forest, leaving the kingdom and all royal pleasures, behind.

sanskrit: न रामः कर्कशस्तात नाविद्वान्नाजितेन्द्रियः। अनृतं दुश्श्रुतं चैव नैव त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि।।3.37.12।।
transliteration: na rāmḥ karkaśastāta nāvidvānnājitendriyḥ| anṛtṃ duśśrutṃ caiva naiva tvṃ vaktumarhasi||3.37.12||
meaning: O my dear, Rama is not harsh nor ignorant. It is not that he has no control over the senses. It is not proper for you to say what is false. You are illinformed.

sanskrit: रामो विग्रहवान् धर्मस्साधुस्सत्यपराक्रमः। राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवानां मघवानिव।।3.37.13।।
transliteration: rāmo vigrahavān dharmassādhussatyaparākramḥ| rājā sarvasya lokasya devānāṃ maghavāniva||3.37.13||
meaning: Rama is dharma incarnate. He is pious. His strength is truth. He is king of all the worlds like Indra to the gods.

sanskrit: कथं त्वं तस्य वैदेहीं रक्षितां स्वेन तेजसा। इच्छसि प्रसभं हर्तुं प्रभामिव विवस्वतः।।3.37.14।।
transliteration: kathṃ tvṃ tasya vaidehīṃ rakṣitāṃ svena tejasā| icchasi prasabhṃ hartuṃ prabhāmiva vivasvatḥ||3.37.14||
meaning: Sita is protected by the strength of her character. How do you desire to carry her away forcibly (from Rama) ? Can any one separate the radiance of the Sun from the Sun itself ?

sanskrit: शरार्चिषमाधृष्यं चापखङ्गेन्धनं रणे। रामाग्निं सहसा दीप्तं न प्रवेष्टुं त्वमर्हसि।।3.37.15।।
transliteration: śarārciṣamādhṛṣyṃ cāpakhaṅgendhanṃ raṇe| rāmāgniṃ sahasā dīptṃ na praveṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi||3.37.15||
meaning: You should not enter into the unquenchable fire that is Rama, the fire that has the arrows (of Rama) as its flames and his sword and bow as fuel.

sanskrit: धनुर्व्यादितदीप्तास्यं शरार्चिषममर्षणम्। चापबाणधरं तीक्ष्णं शत्रुसैन्यप्रहारिणम्।।3.37.16।। राज्यं सुखं च सन्त्यज्य जीवि
transliteration: dhanurvyāditadīptāsyṃ śarārciṣamamarṣaṇam| cāpabāṇadharṃ tīkṣṇṃ śatrusainyaprahāriṇam||3.37.16|| rājyṃ sukhṃ ca santyajy
meaning: You should not give up happiness,your dear life and kingdom and come to Rama who is a variable god of death. His bow is like on open burning mouth, and his flaming arrows are like fire. He is all anger. He is wielder of

sanskrit: अप्रमेयं हि तत्तेजो यस्य सा जनकात्मजा। न त्वं समर्थस्तां हर्तुं रामचापाश्रयं वने।।3.37.18।।
transliteration: aprameyṃ hi tattejo yasya sā janakātmajā| na tvṃ samarthastāṃ hartuṃ rāmacāpāśrayṃ vane||3.37.18||
meaning: Immeasurable indeed is the power of Rama to whom Sita, daughter of Janaka belongs. You are not competent to kidnap her, for she is under the refuge of Rama's bow in the forest.

sanskrit: तस्य सा नरसिंहस्य सिंहोरस्कस्य भामिनी। प्राणेभ्योऽपि प्रियतरा भार्या नित्यमनुव्रता।।3.37.19।।
transliteration: tasya sā narasiṃhasya siṃhoraskasya bhāminī| prāṇebhyo'pi priyatarā bhāryā nityamanuvratā||3.37.19||
meaning: Beautiful Sita happens to be the wife of Rama who is like a lion among men. Rama has a broad chest like that of a lion. He loves Sita who is ever loyal to him, more than his life.

sanskrit: न सा धर्षयितुं शक्या मैथिल्योजस्विनः प्रिया। दीप्तस्येव हुताशस्य शिखा सीता सुमध्यमा।।3.37.20।।
transliteration: na sā dharṣayituṃ śakyā maithilyojasvinḥ priyā| dīptasyeva hutāśasya śikhā sītā sumadhyamā||3.37.20||
meaning: Sita is the darling of mighty Rama. With her slender waist, she is like the leaping flames of blazing fire and it is not possible for you to touch her.

sanskrit: किमुद्यममिमं व्यर्थं कृत्वा ते राक्षसाधिप। दृष्टश्चेत्वं रणे तेन तदन्तं तव जीवितम्।।3.37.21।।
transliteration: kimudyamamimṃ vyarthṃ kṛtvā te rākṣasādhipa| dṛṣṭaścetvṃ raṇe tena tadantṃ tava jīvitam||3.37.21||
meaning: O chief of the demons, why do you make this futile attempt ? The moment you are seen by Rama in war will be the last of your life.

sanskrit: जीवितं च सुखं चैव राज्यं चैव सुदुर्लभम्। यदीच्छसि चिरं भोक्तुं मा कृथा रामविप्रियम्।।3.37.22।।
transliteration: jīvitṃ ca sukhṃ caiva rājyṃ caiva sudurlabham| yadīcchasi cirṃ bhoktuṃ mā kṛthā rāmavipriyam||3.37.22||
meaning: If you want to enjoy your life, happiness and even the kingdom which is not easily attainable for long, do not incur the displeasure of Rama.

sanskrit: स सर्वैस्सचिवैस्सार्धं विभीषणपुरोगमैः। मन्त्रयित्वा तु धर्मिष्ठैः कृत्वा निश्चयमात्मनः।।3.37.23।। दोषाणां च गुणानां च सम
transliteration: sa sarvaissacivaissārdhṃ vibhīṣaṇapurogamaiḥ| mantrayitvā tu dharmiṣṭhaiḥ kṛtvā niścayamātmanḥ||3.37.23|| doṣāṇāṃ ca guṇ
meaning: After consulting all your ministers and the righteous persons led by Vibhisana, you may take a decision. Assess the real strength and weakness, merits and demerits of your own and of Rama. Decide what is good or bad for

sanskrit: अहं तु मन्ये तव न क्षमं रणे समागमं कोसलराजसूनुना। इदं हि भूयश्श़ृणु वाक्यमुत्तमं क्षमं च युक्तं च निशाचरेश्वर।।3.37.25।।
transliteration: ahṃ tu manye tava na kṣamṃ raṇe samāgamṃ kosalarājasūnunā| idṃ hi bhūyaśśa़ṛṇu vākyamuttamṃ kṣamṃ ca yuktṃ ca niśācareśv
meaning: O Ravana I think it is not good on your part to confront the prince of Kosala in a war. Listen to my words and consider what is good for you. इत्यार्षे श्री मद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्तत्रिंशस्सर्गः।।

sanskrit: विश्वामित्रोऽथ धर्मात्मा मद्वित्रस्तो महामुनिः।।3.38.3।। स्वयं गत्वा दशरथं नरेन्द्रमिदमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: viśvāmitro'tha dharmātmā madvitrasto mahāmuniḥ||3.38.3|| svayṃ gatvā daśarathṃ narendramidamabravīt|
meaning: Hence the great sage, righteous Visvamitra afraid of me, went to king Dasaratha and said:

sanskrit: अद्य रक्षतु मां रामः पर्वकाले समाहितः।।3.38.4।। मारीचान्मे भयं घोरं समुत्पन्नं नरेश्वर।
transliteration: adya rakṣatu māṃ rāmḥ parvakāle samāhitḥ||3.38.4|| mārīcānme bhayṃ ghorṃ samutpannṃ nareśvara|
meaning: 'O king Maricha has created in me a great fear. Spare the self possessed Rama to protect me while I do the sacrifice.'

sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्तो धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथस्तदा।।3.38.5।। प्रत्युवाच महाभागं विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम्।
transliteration: ityevamukto dharmātmā rājā daśarathastadā||3.38.5|| pratyuvāca mahābhāgṃ viśvāmitrṃ mahāmunim|
meaning: When the great, venerable sage Visvamitra said so, the righteous king Dasaratha replied:

sanskrit: बालो द्वादशवर्षोऽयमकृतास्त्रश्च राघवः।।3.38.6।। कामं तु मम यत्सैन्यं मया सह गमिष्यति।
transliteration: bālo dvādaśavarṣo'yamakṛtāstraśca rāghavḥ||3.38.6|| kāmṃ tu mama yatsainyṃ mayā saha gamiṣyati|
meaning: 'My son Rama is only twelve. He is not experienced in the use of weapons. I shall accompany you with my army.

sanskrit: बलेन चतुरङ्गेण स्वयमेत्य निशाचरान्।।3.38.7।। वधिष्यामि मुनिश्रेष्ठ शत्रूंस्ते मनसेप्सितान्।
transliteration: balena caturaṅgeṇa svayametya niśācarān||3.38.7|| vadhiṣyāmi muniśreṣṭha śatrūṃste manasepsitān|
meaning: 'O distinguished sage with the four divisions of my army I will slay the enemies you want me to.'

sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्तस्समुनी राजानमिदमब्रवीत्।।3.38.8।। रामान्नान्यद्बलं लोके पर्याप्तं तस्य रक्षसः।
transliteration: ityevamuktassamunī rājānamidamabravīt||3.38.8|| rāmānnānyadbalṃ loke paryāptṃ tasya rakṣasḥ|
meaning: When the king thus responded to the sage, he told him that none other than Rama in this world is a match for that demon.

sanskrit: देवतानामपि भवान् समरेष्वभिपालकः।।3.38.9।। आसीत्तव कृतं कर्म त्रिलोके विदितं नृप।
transliteration: devatānāmapi bhavān samareṣvabhipālakḥ||3.38.9|| āsīttava kṛtṃ karma triloke viditṃ nṛpa|
meaning: 'O king, you have protected even gods in wars and have been a guardian. Your deeds are very wellknown in the three worlds.

sanskrit: काममस्तु महत्सैन्यं तिष्ठत्विह परन्तप।।3.38.10।। बालोऽप्येष महातेजास्समर्थस्तस्य निग्रहे। गमिष्ये राममादाय स्वस्ति तेऽस्
transliteration: kāmamastu mahatsainyṃ tiṣṭhatviha parantapa||3.38.10|| bālo'pyeṣa mahātejāssamarthastasya nigrahe| gamiṣye rāmamādāya sv
meaning: 'O scourge of foes as you wish, let your great army wait here. Even though Rama is young he is glorious, and capable of subduing the enemy. I will take him. Be blessed.'

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु स मुनिस्तमादाय नृपात्मजम्। जगाम परमप्रीतो विश्वामित्रस्स्वमाश्रमम्।।3.38.12।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu sa munistamādāya nṛpātmajam| jagāma paramaprīto viśvāmitrassvamāśramam||3.38.12||
meaning: Sage Visvamitra saying so took the son of the king and went back very happily to his hermitage.

sanskrit: तं तदा दण्डकारण्ये यज्ञमुद्दिश्य दीक्षितम्। बभूवोपस्थितो रामश्चित्रं विष्फारयन्धनुः।।3.38.13।।
transliteration: tṃ tadā daṇḍakāraṇye yajñamuddiśya dīkṣitam| babhūvopasthito rāmaścitrṃ viṣphārayandhanuḥ||3.38.13||
meaning: Then Rama was initiated for the protection of sacrifices and stood on guard, stretching his wonderful bow.

sanskrit: अजातव्यञ्जनश्रीमान्पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः। एकवस्त्रधरो धन्वी शिखी कनकमालया।।3.38.14।। शोभयन् दण्डकारण्यं दीप्तेन स्वेन तेजसा।
transliteration: ajātavyañjanaśrīmānpadmapatranibhekṣaṇḥ| ekavastradharo dhanvī śikhī kanakamālayā||3.38.14|| śobhayan daṇḍakāraṇyṃ dīpte
meaning: Thereafter, handsome Rama, with eyes like lotus petals, beards ungrown, clad in a single garment with knotted hair on the head, wielding a bow, with a chain of gold, luminous with his own lustre enhanced the glory of Dan

sanskrit: ततोऽहं मेघसङ्काशस्तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः। बली दत्तवरोदर्पादाजगाम तदाश्रमम्।।3.38.16।।
transliteration: tato'hṃ meghasaṅkāśastaptakāñcanakuṇḍalḥ| balī dattavarodarpādājagāma tadāśramam||3.38.16||
meaning: Then looking like a dark cloud, wearing bright golden earrings, proud of power bestowed on me with boons, I arrived at the hermitage.

sanskrit: तेन दृष्टः प्रविष्टोऽहं सहसैवोद्यतायुधः। मां तु दृष्ट्वा धनुस्सज्यमसम्भ्रान्तश्चकार सः।।3.38.17।।
transliteration: tena dṛṣṭḥ praviṣṭo'hṃ sahasaivodyatāyudhḥ| māṃ tu dṛṣṭvā dhanussajyamasambhrāntaścakāra sḥ||3.38.17||
meaning: I entered at once and lifted my weapons. Rama saw me and unperturbed, started stringing his bow.

sanskrit: अवजानन्नहं मोहाद्बालोऽयमिति राघवम्। विश्वामित्रस्य तां वेदिमभ्यधावं कृतत्वरः।।3.38.18।।
transliteration: avajānannahṃ mohādbālo'yamiti rāghavam| viśvāmitrasya tāṃ vedimabhyadhāvṃ kṛtatvarḥ||3.38.18||
meaning: Out of my delusion I underestimated the young boy, and screaming, ran towards Visvamitra's sacrificial altar.

sanskrit: तेन मुक्तस्ततो बाणः शितश्शत्रुनिबर्हणः। तेनाहं त्वाहतः क्षिप्तस्समुद्रे शतयोजने।।3.38.19।।
transliteration: tena muktastato bāṇḥ śitaśśatrunibarhaṇḥ| tenāhṃ tvāhatḥ kṣiptassamudre śatayojane||3.38.19||
meaning: Then Rama released a sharp arrow that could kill the enemy. It struck me and threw me at a distance of hundred yojanas into the sea.

sanskrit: नेच्छता तात मां हन्तुं तदा वीरेण रक्षितः। रामस्य शरवेगेन निरस्तोऽहमचेतनः।।3.38.20।।
transliteration: necchatā tāta māṃ hantuṃ tadā vīreṇa rakṣitḥ| rāmasya śaravegena nirasto'hamacetanḥ||3.38.20||
meaning: O dear being thrown away by the speed of his dart I lost my consciousness. I was protected by Rama who did not want to kill me.

sanskrit: पातितोऽहं तदा तेन गम्भीरे सागराम्भसि। प्राप्य संज्ञां चिरात्तात लङ्कां प्रतिगतः पुरीम्।।3.38.21।।
transliteration: pātito'hṃ tadā tena gambhīre sāgarāmbhasi| prāpya sṃjñāṃ cirāttāta laṅkāṃ pratigatḥ purīm||3.38.21||
meaning: O dear I was thrown into the deep sea and after a long time regained consciousness and returned to the city of Lanka.

sanskrit: एवमस्मि तदा मुक्तस्सहायास्तु निपातिताः। अकृतास्त्रेण बालेन रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा।।3.38.22।।
transliteration: evamasmi tadā muktassahāyāstu nipātitāḥ| akṛtāstreṇa bālena rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā||3.38.22||
meaning: That way I was spared by the young boy who was not versed in archery and who could still accomplish the task with ease.Those who accompanied me were destroyed.

sanskrit: तन्मया वार्यमाणस्त्वं यदि रामेण विग्रहम्। करिष्यस्यापदं घोरां क्षिप्रं प्राप्स्यसि रावण।।3.38.23।।
transliteration: tanmayā vāryamāṇastvṃ yadi rāmeṇa vigraham| kariṣyasyāpadṃ ghorāṃ kṣiprṃ prāpsyasi rāvaṇa||3.38.23||
meaning: If you pick up conflict with Rama even while being warned by me you will soon face a dreadful calamity.

sanskrit: क्रीडारतिविधिज्ञानां समाजोत्सवशालिनाम्। रक्षसां चैव सन्तापमनर्थं चाहरिष्यसि।।3.38.24।।
transliteration: krīḍāratividhijñānāṃ samājotsavaśālinām| rakṣasāṃ caiva santāpamanarthṃ cāhariṣyasi||3.38.24||
meaning: You will bring grief and disaster into the lives of demons who are sporting in love and who are in the habit of celebrating community festivals with joy.

sanskrit: हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधां नानारत्नविभूषिताम्। द्रक्ष्यसि त्वं पुरीं लङ्कां विनष्टां मैथिलीकृते।।3.38.25।।
transliteration: harmyaprāsādasambādhāṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitām| drakṣyasi tvṃ purīṃ laṅkāṃ vinaṣṭāṃ maithilīkṛte||3.38.25||
meaning: You will see the city of Lanka dotted with magnificent royal mansions embellished with different kinds of gems ruined for the sake of Sita.

sanskrit: अकुर्वन्तोऽपि पापानि शुचयः पापसंश्रयात्। परपापैर्विनश्यन्ति मत्स्या नागह्रदे यथा।।3.38.26।।
transliteration: akurvanto'pi pāpāni śucayḥ pāpasṃśrayāt| parapāpairvinaśyanti matsyā nāgahrade yathā||3.38.26||
meaning: Even without committing any sin those pure souls because they keep company with sinners will be destroyed for the sins of others just like fishes in a pool of serpents.

sanskrit: दिव्यचन्दनदिग्धाङ्गान्दिव्याभरणभूषितान्। द्रक्ष्यस्यभिहतान्भूमौ तव दोषात्तु राक्षसान्।।3.38.27।।
transliteration: divyacandanadigdhāṅgāndivyābharaṇabhūṣitān| drakṣyasyabhihatānbhūmau tava doṣāttu rākṣasān||3.38.27||
meaning: You will see the demons who smear their limbs with sandal paste and unguents, who are adorned with excellent ornaments slain and laid on the ground for your mistakes.

sanskrit: हृतदारान् सदारांश्च दश विद्रवतो दिशः। हतशेषानशरणान्द्रक्ष्यसि त्वं निशाचरान्।।3.38.28।।
transliteration: hṛtadārān sadārāṃśca daśa vidravato diśḥ| hataśeṣānaśaraṇāndrakṣyasi tvṃ niśācarān||3.38.28||
meaning: You will see the rest of the demons with their wives gone or fleeing in all directions helplessly with none to take care of them.

sanskrit: शरजालपरिक्षिप्तामग्निज्वालासमावृताम्। प्रदग्धभवनां लङ्कां द्रक्ष्यसि त्वं न संशयः।।3.38.29।।
transliteration: śarajālaparikṣiptāmagnijvālāsamāvṛtām| pradagdhabhavanāṃ laṅkāṃ drakṣyasi tvṃ na sṃśayḥ||3.38.29||
meaning: You will undoubtedly see Lanka filled with arrows, surrounded by flames of fire and its buildings on fire.

sanskrit: परदाराभिमर्शात्तु नान्यत्पापतरं महत्। प्रमदानां सहस्रं च तव राजन्परिग्रहः।।3.38.30।।
transliteration: paradārābhimarśāttu nānyatpāpatarṃ mahat| pramadānāṃ sahasrṃ ca tava rājanparigrahḥ||3.38.30||
meaning: O king there is no sin greater than violating the chastity of others wives, when you have married a thousand lovely women.

sanskrit: भव स्वदारनिरतस्वकुलं रक्ष राक्षस। मानमृद्धिं च राज्यं च जीवितं चेष्टमात्मनः।।3.38.31।।
transliteration: bhava svadāraniratasvakulṃ rakṣa rākṣasa| mānamṛddhiṃ ca rājyṃ ca jīvitṃ ceṣṭamātmanḥ||3.38.31||
meaning: Enjoy with your wives. Protect your race, prestige, kingdom, prosperity and your own dear life.

sanskrit: कलत्राणि च सौम्यानि मित्रवर्गं तथैव च। यदीच्छसि चिरं भोक्तं मा कृथा रामविप्रियम्।।3.38.32।।
transliteration: kalatrāṇi ca saumyāni mitravargṃ tathaiva ca| yadīcchasi cirṃ bhoktṃ mā kṛthā rāmavipriyam||3.38.32||
meaning: If you wish to enjoy your beautiful wives and your good friends for long, do not create enmity with Rama.

sanskrit: निवार्यमाणस्सुहृदा मया भृशं प्रसह्य सीतां यदि धर्षयिष्यसि। गमिष्यसि क्षीणबलस्सबान्धवो यमक्षयं रामशरात्तजीवितः।।3.38.33।।
transliteration: nivāryamāṇassuhṛdā mayā bhṛśṃ prasahya sītāṃ yadi dharṣayiṣyasi| gamiṣyasi kṣīṇabalassabāndhavo yamakṣayṃ rāmaśarāttajīv
meaning: If you violate Sita forcibly notwithstanding my friendly warning, your life will be drained by the arrows of Rama and you will reach the abode of Yama with your kith and kin, your strength depleted. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामा

sanskrit: राक्षसाभ्यामहं द्वाभ्यामनिर्विण्णस्तथा कृतः। सहितो मृगरूपाभ्यां प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम्।।3.39.2।।
transliteration: rākṣasābhyāmahṃ dvābhyāmanirviṇṇastathā kṛtḥ| sahito mṛgarūpābhyāṃ praviṣṭo daṇḍakāvanam||3.39.2||
meaning: Having done so, I picked up courage and entered Dandaka forest, accompanied by the two other demons in the form of deer .

sanskrit: दीप्तजिह्वो महाकायस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रो महाबलः। व्यचरं दण्डकारण्यं मांसभक्षो महामृगः।।3.39.3।।
transliteration: dīptajihvo mahākāyastīkṣṇadṃṣṭro mahābalḥ| vyacarṃ daṇḍakāraṇyṃ māṃsabhakṣo mahāmṛgḥ||3.39.3||
meaning: I wandered in Dandaka forest in the form of a huge animal with a big and strong body, a flaming red tongue and sharp teeth feeding on flesh.

sanskrit: अग्निहोत्रेषु तीर्थेषु चैत्यवृक्षेषु रावण। अत्यन्तघोरो व्यचरं तापसान्सम्प्रधर्षयन्।।3.39.4।।
transliteration: agnihotreṣu tīrtheṣu caityavṛkṣeṣu rāvaṇa| atyantaghoro vyacarṃ tāpasānsampradharṣayan||3.39.4||
meaning: O Ravana, assuming a very dreadful form, I wandered about sacrificial spots, sacred places, river banks, under huge trees planted at quadranglestorturing the ascetics.

sanskrit: निहत्य दण्डकारण्ये तापसान्धर्मचारिणः। रुधिराणि पिबंस्तेषां तथा मांसानि भक्षयन्।।3.39.5।।
transliteration: nihatya daṇḍakāraṇye tāpasāndharmacāriṇḥ| rudhirāṇi pibṃsteṣāṃ tathā māṃsāni bhakṣayan||3.39.5||
meaning: I wandered about the Dandaka forest slaying righteous ascetics, drinking their blood and eating their flesh.

sanskrit: ऋषिमांसाशनः क्रूरस्त्रासयन्वनगोचरान्। तथा रुधिरमत्तोऽहं विचरन्धर्मदूषकः।।3.39.6।।
transliteration: ṛṣimāṃsāśanḥ krūrastrāsayanvanagocarān| tathā rudhiramatto'hṃ vicarandharmadūṣakḥ||3.39.6||
meaning: While thus roaming, I harmed the wanderers of the forest. Intoxicated with their blood I used to frighten the righteous.

sanskrit: आसादयं तदा रामं तापसं धर्मचारिणम्। वैदेहीं च महाभागां लक्ष्मणं च महारथम्।।3.39.7।।
transliteration: āsādayṃ tadā rāmṃ tāpasṃ dharmacāriṇam| vaidehīṃ ca mahābhāgāṃ lakṣmaṇṃ ca mahāratham||3.39.7||
meaning: I encountered again the righteous Rama who was in the form of an ascetic, with venerable Sita and the great warrior Lakshmana.

sanskrit: तापसं नियताहारं सर्वभूतहिते रतम्। सोऽहं वनगतं रामं परिभूय महाबलम्।।3.39.8।। तापसोऽयमिति ज्ञात्वा पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन्। अभ्य
transliteration: tāpasṃ niyatāhārṃ sarvabhūtahite ratam| so'hṃ vanagatṃ rāmṃ paribhūya mahābalam||3.39.8|| tāpaso'yamiti jñātvā pūrvavair
meaning: Although Rama was very strong, he was living on restricted diet, engaged in the welfare of all beings. Treating him as a mere ascetic living in the forest, remembering my past hostility with him and disregarding his (fat

sanskrit: तेन मुक्तास्त्रयो बाणाश्शिताश्शत्रुनिबर्हणाः।।3.39.10।। विकृष्य बलवच्चापं सुपर्णानिलनिस्स्वनाः।
transliteration: tena muktāstrayo bāṇāśśitāśśatrunibarhaṇāḥ||3.39.10|| vikṛṣya balavaccāpṃ suparṇānilanissvanāḥ|
meaning: His mighty bow drawn, Rama released three sharp darts that came whizzing like Garuda or the wind. They could destroy the enemy.

sanskrit: ते बाणा वज्रसङ्काशास्सुमुक्ता रक्तभोजनाः। आजग्मुस्सहितास्सर्वे त्रयस्सन्नतपर्वणः।।3.39.11।।
transliteration: te bāṇā vajrasaṅkāśāssumuktā raktabhojanāḥ| ājagmussahitāssarve trayassannataparvaṇḥ||3.39.11||
meaning: All the three tightly jointed, welltargetted darts, strong as thunderbolt, and which could feed on blood came together all at once.

sanskrit: पराक्रमज्ञो रामस्य शठो दृष्टभयः पुरा। समुद्भान्तस्ततोमुक्तस्तावुभौ राक्षसौ हतौ।।3.39.12।।
transliteration: parākramajño rāmasya śaṭho dṛṣṭabhayḥ purā| samudbhāntastatomuktastāvubhau rākṣasau hatau||3.39.12||
meaning: Having known Rama's prowess earlier and experienced tremendous fear, I ran away in a bewildered state as I was deceitful. The other two demons (who had accompanied me) succumbed.

sanskrit: शरेण मुक्तो रामस्य कथञ्चित्प्राप्य जीवितम्। इह प्रव्राजितो युक्तस्तापसोऽहं समाहितः।।3.39.13।।
transliteration: śareṇa mukto rāmasya kathañcitprāpya jīvitam| iha pravrājito yuktastāpaso'hṃ samāhitḥ||3.39.13||
meaning: With my escape from Rama's darts I somehow got a fresh lease of life. Now I am composed. I have started living the life of a recluse here. I have turned an ascetic.

sanskrit: वृक्षे वृक्षे च पश्यामि चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरम्। गृहीतधनुषं रामं पाशहस्तमिवान्तकम्।।3.39.14।।
transliteration: vṛkṣe vṛkṣe ca paśyāmi cīrakṛṣṇājināmbaram| gṛhītadhanuṣṃ rāmṃ pāśahastamivāntakam||3.39.14||
meaning: I see Rama in every tree, clad in bark and deerskin, wielding the bow, holding a noose in hand like the god of death.

sanskrit: अपि रामसहस्राणि भीतः पश्यामि रावण। रामभूतमिदं सर्वमरण्यं प्रतिभाति मे।।3.39.15।।
transliteration: api rāmasahasrāṇi bhītḥ paśyāmi rāvaṇa| rāmabhūtamidṃ sarvamaraṇyṃ pratibhāti me||3.39.15||
meaning: O Ravana I see in my fear thousands of Ramas. The entire forest appears to me as though filled with Rama.

sanskrit: राममेव हि पश्यामि रहिते राक्षसाधिप। दृष्ट्वा स्वप्नगतं राममुद्भ्रमामि विचेतनः।।3.39.16।।
transliteration: rāmameva hi paśyāmi rahite rākṣasādhipa| dṛṣṭvā svapnagatṃ rāmamudbhramāmi vicetanḥ||3.39.16||
meaning: O king of the demons I see only Rama even in solitude. When I see him in a dream I lose my senses in a state of bewilderment.

sanskrit: रकारादीनि नामानि रामत्रस्तस्य रावण। रत्नानि च रथाश्चैव त्रासं संजनयन्ति मे।।3.39.17।।
transliteration: rakārādīni nāmāni rāmatrastasya rāvaṇa| ratnāni ca rathāścaiva trāsṃ sṃjanayanti me||3.39.17||
meaning: O Ravana, every name beginning with the letter 'Ra', such as Ratna (gems), Ratha (chariot), etc. strike terror in me.

sanskrit: अहं तस्य प्रभावज्ञो न युद्धं तेन ते क्षमम्। बलिं वा नमुचिं वापि हन्याद्धि रघुनन्दनः।।3.39.18।।
transliteration: ahṃ tasya prabhāvajño na yuddhṃ tena te kṣamam| baliṃ vā namuciṃ vāpi hanyāddhi raghunandanḥ||3.39.18||
meaning: I know his power.It is not proper to wage a war with him. Rama, delight of the Raghu dynasty, can slay even Bali or Namuchi.

sanskrit: बहवस्साधवो लोके युक्ता धर्ममनुष्ठिताः। परेषामपराधेन विनष्ठास्सपरिच्छदाः।।3.39.20।।
transliteration: bahavassādhavo loke yuktā dharmamanuṣṭhitāḥ| pareṣāmaparādhena vinaṣṭhāssaparicchadāḥ||3.39.20||
meaning: There were many pious men in this world who practise yoga and dharma .They have been destroyed along with their retinue due to mistakes committed by others.

sanskrit: सोऽऽहं तवापराधेन विनश्येयं निशाचर। कुरु यत्ते क्षमं तत्त्वमहं त्वा नानुयामि ह।।3.39.21।।
transliteration: so''hṃ tavāparādhena vinaśyeyṃ niśācara| kuru yatte kṣamṃ tattvamahṃ tvā nānuyāmi ha||3.39.21||
meaning: O demon As such, I will perish due to your offence. You may do anything you deem appropriate. I will not follow you.

sanskrit: रामश्च हि महातेजा महासत्त्वो महाबलः।।3.39.22।। अपि राक्षसलोकस्य न भवेदन्तकोऽपि सः।
transliteration: rāmaśca hi mahātejā mahāsattvo mahābalḥ||3.39.22|| api rākṣasalokasya na bhavedantako'pi sḥ|
meaning: Rama is brilliant, powerful and strong. I hope he will not be the god of death for the world of demons.

sanskrit: यदि शूर्पणखाहेतोर्जनस्थानगतः खरः।।3.39.23।। अतिवृत्तो हतः पूर्वं रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। अत्र ब्रूहि यथातत्त्वं को रामस्य व
transliteration: yadi śūrpaṇakhāhetorjanasthānagatḥ kharḥ||3.39.23|| ativṛtto hatḥ pūrvṃ rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā| atra brūhi yathātattvṃ ko r
meaning: For the sake of Surpanakha, Khara of Janasthana committed excesses and got killed by Rama who can accomplish things with ease.Tell me truly if Rama did violate anything here.

sanskrit: इदं वचो बन्धुहितार्थिनामया यथोच्यमानं यदि नाभिपत्स्यसे। सबान्धवस्त्यक्ष्यसि जीवितं रणे हतोऽऽद्य रामेण शरैरजिह्मगैः।।3.39
transliteration: idṃ vaco bandhuhitārthināmayā yathocyamānṃ yadi nābhipatsyase| sabāndhavastyakṣyasi jīvitṃ raṇe hato''dya rāmeṇa śaraira
meaning: If you do not follow my advice given for the welfare of our kith and kin, O Ravana, you are killed today. With your relations you will succumb to his straightmoving arrows. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अर

sanskrit: मामृका भक्षयिष्यन्ति शार्दूलाद्वीपिनस्तथा। मां हरोत्सृज काकुत्स्थौ नमस्ते राक्षसोत्तम।।3.4.3।।
transliteration: māmṛkā bhakṣayiṣyanti śārdūlādvīpinastathā| māṃ harotsṛja kākutsthau namaste rākṣasottama||3.4.3||
meaning: The wild bears, tigers and panthers will eat me up here. O best among demons, pray take me and leave both the Kakutsthas.

sanskrit: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वैदेह्या रामलक्ष्मणौ। वेगं प्रचक्रतुर्वीरौ वधे तस्य दुरात्मनः।।3.4.4।।
transliteration: tasyāstadvacanṃ śrutvā vaidehyā rāmalakṣmaṇau| vegṃ pracakraturvīrau vadhe tasya durātmanḥ||3.4.4||
meaning: On hearing those words of Sita, both the heroes, Rama and Lakshmana hastened to kill the wicked Viradha.

sanskrit: तस्य रौद्रस्य सौमित्रिः सव्यं बाहुं बभञ्ज ह। रामस्तु दक्षिणं बाहुं तरसा तस्य रक्षसः।।3.4.5।।
transliteration: tasya raudrasya saumitriḥ savyṃ bāhuṃ babhañja ha| rāmastu dakṣiṇṃ bāhuṃ tarasā tasya rakṣasḥ||3.4.5||
meaning: Lakshmana quickly broke the left and Rama the right shoulder of that dreadful demon.

sanskrit: स भग्नबाहुस्सविग्नो निपपाताशु राक्षसः। धरण्यां मेघसङ्काशो वज्रभिन्न इवाचलः।।3.4.6।।
transliteration: sa bhagnabāhussavigno nipapātāśu rākṣasḥ| dharaṇyāṃ meghasaṅkāśo vajrabhinna ivācalḥ||3.4.6||
meaning: With both shoulders broken, the demon, looking like a cloud (huge and dark) fell at once on the ground like a mountain split by a thunderbolt.

sanskrit: मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिः पद्भिः सूदयन्तौ तु राक्षसम्। उद्यम्योद्यम्य चाप्येनं स्थण्डिले निष्पिपेषतुः।।3.4.7।।
transliteration: muṣṭibhirjānubhiḥ padbhiḥ sūdayantau tu rākṣasam| udyamyodyamya cāpyenṃ sthaṇḍile niṣpipeṣatuḥ||3.4.7||
meaning: Striking the demon with fists, knees and feet, both of them smit him on the bare ground and pulverized him.

sanskrit: स विद्धो बहुभिर्बाणैः खङ्गाभ्यां च परिक्षतः। निष्पिष्टो बहुधा भूमौ न ममार स राक्षसः।।3.4.8।।
transliteration: sa viddho bahubhirbāṇaiḥ khaṅgābhyāṃ ca parikṣatḥ| niṣpiṣṭo bahudhā bhūmau na mamāra sa rākṣasḥ||3.4.8||
meaning: Although pierced by arrows, and wounded by the two swords, and pulverized on the ground, the demon did not die.

sanskrit: तं प्रेक्ष्य रामः सुभृशमवध्यमचलोपमम्। भयेष्वभयदश्श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.4.9।।
transliteration: tṃ prekṣya rāmḥ subhṛśamavadhyamacalopamam| bhayeṣvabhayadaśśrīmānidṃ vacanamabravīt||3.4.9||
meaning: Seeing the mountainlike Viradha not dying though seriously wounded, illustrious Rama, guaranter of safety from fear said to Lakshmana:

sanskrit: तपसा पुरुषव्याघ्र राक्षसोऽयं न शक्यते। शस्त्रेण युधि निर्जेतुं राक्षसं निखनावहे।।3.4.10।।
transliteration: tapasā puruṣavyāghra rākṣaso'yṃ na śakyate| śastreṇa yudhi nirjetuṃ rākṣasṃ nikhanāvahe||3.4.10||
meaning: O Lakshmana, best among men, this demon by virtue of his penance cannot be killed with any weapon in war. Therefore, let us bury him.

sanskrit: कुञ्जरस्येव रौद्रस्य राक्षसस्यास्य लक्ष्मण। वनेऽस्मिन् सुमहच्छ्वभ्रं खन्यतां रौद्रवर्चसः।।3.4.11।।
transliteration: kuñjarasyeva raudrasya rākṣasasyāsya lakṣmaṇa| vane'smin sumahacchvabhrṃ khanyatāṃ raudravarcasḥ||3.4.11||
meaning: Dig a deep pit to bury this demon, dreadful like an elephant and emitting a fearful glow.

sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं रामः प्रदरः खन्यतामिति। तस्थौ विराधमाक्रम्य कण्ठे पादेन वीर्यवान्।।3.4.12।।
transliteration: ityuktvā lakṣmaṇṃ rāmḥ pradarḥ khanyatāmiti| tasthau virādhamākramya kaṇṭhe pādena vīryavān||3.4.12||
meaning: Courageous Rama standing there put his foot firmly on the neck of Viradha and said to Lakshmana,' Dig up a crevice'.

sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवेणोक्तं राक्षसः प्रश्रितं वचः। इदं प्रोवाच काकुत्थ्सं विराधः पुरुषर्षभम्।।3.4.13।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā rāghaveṇoktṃ rākṣasḥ praśritṃ vacḥ| idṃ provāca kākutthsṃ virādhḥ puruṣarṣabham||3.4.13||
meaning: When the demon Viradha heard Rama saying so, he said these humble words to the scion of the Kakutsthas and the best of men :

sanskrit: हतोऽस्मि पुरुषव्याघ्र शक्रतुल्यबलेन वै। मया तु पूर्वं त्वं मोहान्न ज्ञातः पुरुषर्षभ।।3.4.14।।
transliteration: hato'smi puruṣavyāghra śakratulyabalena vai| mayā tu pūrvṃ tvṃ mohānna jñātḥ puruṣarṣabha||3.4.14||
meaning: You have killed me, O Rama, a tiger among men. You are equal to Indra in prowess. O best of men, out of delusion I could not recognise you earlier.

sanskrit: कौसल्यासुप्रजा राम तातस्त्वं विदितो मया। वैदेही च महाभागा लक्ष्मणश्च महायशाः।।3.4.15।।
transliteration: kausalyāsuprajā rāma tātastvṃ vidito mayā| vaidehī ca mahābhāgā lakṣmaṇaśca mahāyaśāḥ||3.4.15||
meaning: O dear Rama, I know now you are the blessed son of Kausalya, Sita is a noble lady and a glorious soul.

sanskrit: अभिशापादहं घोरां प्रविष्टो राक्षसीं तनुम्। तुम्बुरुर्नाम गन्धर्वः शप्तो वैश्रवणेन ह।।3.4.16।।
transliteration: abhiśāpādahṃ ghorāṃ praviṣṭo rākṣasīṃ tanum| tumbururnāma gandharvḥ śapto vaiśravaṇena ha||3.4.16||
meaning: I am Tumburu by name, a celestial singer of the gandharva clan. Cursed by Kubera, I got this dreadful body of a demon.

sanskrit: प्रसाद्यमानश्च मया सोऽब्रवीन्मां महायशाः। यदा दाशरथी रामस्त्वां वधिष्यति संयुगे। तदा प्रकृतिमापन्नो भवान्स्वर्गं गमिष्यत
transliteration: prasādyamānaśca mayā so'bravīnmāṃ mahāyaśāḥ| yadā dāśarathī rāmastvāṃ vadhiṣyati sṃyuge| tadā prakṛtimāpanno bhavānsvarg
meaning: When I appealed to him, that lord of great fame (Kubera) said that I would get back my original form and ascend to heaven when Rama, son of Dasaratha, would kill me in a duel.

sanskrit: अनुपस्थीयमानो मां स क्रुद्धो व्याजहार ह। इति वैश्रवणो राजा रम्भासक्तमुवाच ह।।3.4.18।।
transliteration: anupasthīyamāno māṃ sa kruddho vyājahāra ha| iti vaiśravaṇo rājā rambhāsaktamuvāca ha||3.4.18||
meaning: When king Kubera saw me absent (from duty) as I was infatuated with Rambha, he got angry and cursed me.

sanskrit: तव प्रसादान्मुक्तोऽहमिहशापात्सुदारुणात्। भुवनं स्वं गमिष्यामि स्वस्ति वोऽस्तु परन्तप।।3.4.19।।
transliteration: tava prasādānmukto'hamihaśāpātsudāruṇāt| bhuvanṃ svṃ gamiṣyāmi svasti vo'stu parantapa||3.4.19||
meaning: O scorcher of enemies by your grace I am rid of the curse. Delivered from my dreadful form, I will now go to my world. May both of you fare well.

sanskrit: इतो वसति धर्मात्मा शरभङ्गः प्रतापवान्।।3.4.20।। अध्यर्धयोजने तात महर्षिस्सूर्यसन्निभः। तं क्षिप्रमधिगच्छ त्वं स ते श्रेय
transliteration: ito vasati dharmātmā śarabhaṅgḥ pratāpavān||3.4.20|| adhyardhayojane tāta maharṣissūryasannibhḥ| tṃ kṣipramadhigaccha tv
meaning: O dear, there lives Sarabhanga, a righteous sage, comparable to the Sun, at a distance of one and a half yojanas from here. Go to him at once. He will bless you with your wellbeing.

sanskrit: अवटे चापि मां राम प्रक्षिप्य कुशली व्रज। रक्षसां गतसत्त्वानामेष धर्मस्ससनातनः। अवटे ये निधीयन्ते तेषां लोकास्सनातनाः।।3.
transliteration: avaṭe cāpi māṃ rāma prakṣipya kuśalī vraja| rakṣasāṃ gatasattvānāmeṣa dharmassasanātanḥ| avaṭe ye nidhīyante teṣāṃ lokās
meaning: Bury me in the pit, O Rama, and proceed happily. This is a great tradition for the dead demons. Those who are buried in the pit attain heaven.

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु काकुत्थ्सं विराधश्शरपीडितः। बभूव स्वर्गसम्प्राप्तो न्यस्तदेहो महाबलः।।3.4.23।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu kākutthsṃ virādhaśśarapīḍitḥ| babhūva svargasamprāpto nyastadeho mahābalḥ||3.4.23||
meaning: Having said so to Rama, the mighty Viradha, hit by the arrows left his body and attained heaven.

sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवो वाक्यं लक्ष्मणं व्यादिदेश ह। कुञ्जरस्येव रौद्रस्य राक्षसस्यास्य लक्ष्मण।।3.4.24।। वनेऽस्मिन् सुमहच्छ्व
transliteration: tacchrutvā rāghavo vākyṃ lakṣmaṇṃ vyādideśa ha| kuñjarasyeva raudrasya rākṣasasyāsya lakṣmaṇa||3.4.24|| vane'smin sumaha
meaning: When Rama heard those words, he said, O Lakshmana dig for this elephantlike demon of dreadful acts, a big pit. Having said so the mighty Rama stood firmly stamping the neck of Viradha with his foot.

sanskrit: ततः खनित्रमादाय लक्ष्मणश्श्वभ्रमुत्तमम्। अखनत्पार्श्वतस्तस्य विराधस्य महात्मनः।।3.4.26।।
transliteration: tatḥ khanitramādāya lakṣmaṇaśśvabhramuttamam| akhanatpārśvatastasya virādhasya mahātmanḥ||3.4.26||
meaning: Then Lakshmana fetched a spade and dug a sufficiently big pit by the side of the great soul Viradha.

sanskrit: तं मुक्तकण्ठंनिक्षिप्य शङ्कुकर्णं महास्वनम्। विराधं प्राक्षिपच्छ्वभ्रे नदन्तं भैरवस्वनम्।।3.4.27।।
transliteration: tṃ muktakaṇṭhṃnikṣipya śaṅkukarṇṃ mahāsvanam| virādhṃ prākṣipacchvabhre nadantṃ bhairavasvanam||3.4.27||
meaning: Rama took his foot off Viradha's neck and dropped his body with pointed ears into the pit while Viradha was groaning fearfully৷৷

sanskrit: तमाहवे दारुणमाशुविक्रमौ स्थिरावुभौ संयति रामलक्ष्मणौ। मुदान्वितौ चिक्षिपतुर्भयावहं नदन्तमुत्क्षिप्य बिले तु राक्षसम्।।3.
transliteration: tamāhave dāruṇamāśuvikramau sthirāvubhau sṃyati rāmalakṣmaṇau| mudānvitau cikṣipaturbhayāvahṃ nadantamutkṣipya bile tu r
meaning: Rama and Lakshmana, stable and firm, brave and quick, together lifted the body of Viradha who was fierce in battle and roaring and forcibly threw it into the pit with joy.

sanskrit: अवध्यतां प्रेक्ष्य महासुरस्य तौ शितेन शस्त्रेण तदा नरर्षभौ। समर्थ्य चात्यर्थविशारदावुभौ बिले विराधस्य वधं प्रचक्रतुः।।3.
transliteration: avadhyatāṃ prekṣya mahāsurasya tau śitena śastreṇa tadā nararṣabhau| samarthya cātyarthaviśāradāvubhau bile virādhasya v
meaning: The two princes, bulls among men, who were adept in archery saw that the great demon could not be killed by any other means. They reflected over the issue and undertook the task of killing him with sharp weapons and buri

sanskrit: स्वयं विराधेन हि मृत्युरात्मनः प्रसह्य रामेण यथार्थमीप्सितः। निवेदितः काननचारिणा स्वयं न मे वधः शस्त्रकृतो भवेदिति।।3.4.
transliteration: svayṃ virādhena hi mṛtyurātmanḥ prasahya rāmeṇa yathārthamīpsitḥ| niveditḥ kānanacāriṇā svayṃ na me vadhḥ śastrakṛto bha
meaning: Rama deliberately wanted to kill Viradha with weapons. Viradha the forestranger himself revealed that it was not possible to kill him with weapons and asked Rama to bury him in a pit.

sanskrit: तदेव रामेण निशम्य भाषितं कृता मतिस्तस्य बिलप्रवेशने। बिलं च रामेणातिबलेन रक्षसा प्रवेश्यमानेन वनं विनादितम्।।3.4.31।।
transliteration: tadeva rāmeṇa niśamya bhāṣitṃ kṛtā matistasya bilapraveśane| bilṃ ca rāmeṇātibalena rakṣasā praveśyamānena vanṃ vinādita
meaning: While Rama, who had made up his mind after hearing him, was putting the mighty demon in the pit, the forest rang with his roar.

sanskrit: प्रहृष्टरूपाविव रामलक्ष्मणौ विराधमुर्व्या प्रदरे निहत्य तौ। ननन्दतुर्वीतभयौ महावने शिलाभिरन्तर्दधतुश्च राक्षसम्।।3.4.32।
transliteration: prahṛṣṭarūpāviva rāmalakṣmaṇau virādhamurvyā pradare nihatya tau| nanandaturvītabhayau mahāvane śilābhirantardadhatuśca
