meaning: Rama and Lakshmana were happy to consign Viradha's body to the pit after killing him. They filled the pit with rocks in the great forest without fear.

sanskrit: तं पथ्यहितवक्तारं मारीचं राक्षसाधिपः। अब्रवीत्परुषं वाक्यमयुक्तं कालचोदितः।।3.40.2।।
transliteration: tṃ pathyahitavaktārṃ mārīcṃ rākṣasādhipḥ| abravītparuṣṃ vākyamayuktṃ kālacoditḥ||3.40.2||
meaning: The king of the demons, driven by fate, replied with improper and harsh words to Maricha whose advice was salutary and beneficial to him :

sanskrit: यत्किलैतदयुक्तार्थं मारीच मयि कथ्यते। वाक्यं निष्फलमत्यर्थमुप्तं बीजमिवोषरे।।3.40.3।।
transliteration: yatkilaitadayuktārthṃ mārīca mayi kathyate| vākyṃ niṣphalamatyarthamuptṃ bījamivoṣare||3.40.3||
meaning: O Maricha, the words addressed to me are not appropriate.Your advice is extremely fruitless like a seed sown in saline, barren soil.

sanskrit: त्वद्वाक्यैर्न तु मां शक्यं भेत्तुं रामस्य संयुगे। पापशीलस्य मूर्खस्य मानुषस्य विशेषतः।।3.40.4।।
transliteration: tvadvākyairna tu māṃ śakyṃ bhettuṃ rāmasya sṃyuge| pāpaśīlasya mūrkhasya mānuṣasya viśeṣatḥ||3.40.4||
meaning: It is not possible to dissuade me from my encounter with Rama who is sinful, foolish and especially an ordinary human being.

sanskrit: यस्त्यक्त्वा सुहृदो राज्यं मातरं पितरं तथा। स्त्रीवाक्यं प्राकृतं श्रुत्वा वनमेकपदे गतः।।3.40.5।।
transliteration: yastyaktvā suhṛdo rājyṃ mātarṃ pitarṃ tathā| strīvākyṃ prākṛtṃ śrutvā vanamekapade gatḥ||3.40.5||
meaning: On hearing the casual words of a woman, (this) Rama came to the forest at once, leaving his friends, kingdom, mother and father.

sanskrit: अवश्यन्तु मया तस्य संयुगे खरघातिनः। प्राणैः प्रियतरा सीता हर्तव्या तव सन्निधौ।।3.40.6।।
transliteration: avaśyantu mayā tasya sṃyuge kharaghātinḥ| prāṇaiḥ priyatarā sītā hartavyā tava sannidhau||3.40.6||
meaning: In your very presence I will surely abduct Sita, wife of Rama who killed Khara in war, Sita whom he loves more than his life.

sanskrit: एवं मे निश्चिता बुद्धिर्हृदि मारीच वर्तते। न व्यावर्तयितुं शक्या सेन्द्रैरपि सुरासुरैः।।3.40.7।।
transliteration: evṃ me niścitā buddhirhṛdi mārīca vartate| na vyāvartayituṃ śakyā sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ||3.40.7||
meaning: O Maricha I have made up my mind that way. Even demons or deities including Indra cannot alter this decision of mine.

sanskrit: दोषं गुणं वा सम्पृष्टस्त्वमेवं वक्तुमर्हसि। अपायं वाप्युपायं वा कार्यस्यास्य विनिश्चये।।3.40.8।।
transliteration: doṣṃ guṇṃ vā sampṛṣṭastvamevṃ vaktumarhasi| apāyṃ vāpyupāyṃ vā kāryasyāsya viniścaye||3.40.8||
meaning: If I asked you the merits or demerits, the risks involved or the way out while deciding a case, you should have said what you did.

sanskrit: सम्पृष्टेन तु वक्तव्यं सचिवेन विपश्चिता। उद्यताञ्जलिना राज्ञे य इच्छेद्भूतिमात्मनः।।3.40.9।।
transliteration: sampṛṣṭena tu vaktavyṃ sacivena vipaścitā| udyatāñjalinā rājñe ya icchedbhūtimātmanḥ||3.40.9||
meaning: A wise counsellor should give advice to the king only when his opinion is sought and that too with folded hands, if he wishes his own prosperity.

sanskrit: वाक्यमप्रितकूलं तु मृदुपूर्वं हितं शुभम्। उपचारेण युक्तं च वक्तव्यो वसुधाधिपः।।3.40.10।।
transliteration: vākyamapritakūlṃ tu mṛdupūrvṃ hitṃ śubham| upacāreṇa yuktṃ ca vaktavyo vasudhādhipḥ||3.40.10||
meaning: A king should be addressed with politeness and decorum, with words not unfavourble intended for his good luck and wellbeing.

sanskrit: सावमर्दं तु यद्वाक्यं मारीच हितमुच्यते। नाभिनन्दति तद्राजा मानार्हो मानवर्जितम्।।3.40.11।।
transliteration: sāvamardṃ tu yadvākyṃ mārīca hitamucyate| nābhinandati tadrājā mānārho mānavarjitam||3.40.11||
meaning: A king who deserves honour does not feel happy to hear even good words of advice if said in disrespectful or authoritarian way, O Maricha

sanskrit: पञ्च रूपाणि राजानो धारयन्त्यमितौजसः। अग्नेरिन्द्रस्य सोमस्य वरुणस्य यमस्य च।।3.40.12।।
transliteration: pañca rūpāṇi rājāno dhārayantyamitaujasḥ| agnerindrasya somasya varuṇasya yamasya ca||3.40.12||
meaning: Very powerful kings assume five forms like fire, Indra, Moon, Varuna and Yama.

sanskrit: औष्ण्यं तथा विक्रमं च सौम्यं दण्डं प्रसन्नताम्। धारयन्ति महात्मानो राजानः क्षणदाचर।।3.40.13।। तस्मात्सर्वास्ववस्थासु मान
transliteration: auṣṇyṃ tathā vikramṃ ca saumyṃ daṇḍṃ prasannatām| dhārayanti mahātmāno rājānḥ kṣaṇadācara||3.40.13|| tasmātsarvāsvavasth
meaning: Great kings possess heat, (of the firegod), valour (of Indra), coolness (of the Moon), command (of Varuna) and grace (of the Lord of death). Therefore kings at all stages deserve respect and reverence.

sanskrit: त्वं तु धर्ममविज्ञाय केवलं मोहमास्थितः। अभ्यागतं मां दौरात्म्यात्परुषं वक्तुमिच्छसि।।3.40.14।।
transliteration: tvṃ tu dharmamavijñāya kevalṃ mohamāsthitḥ| abhyāgatṃ māṃ daurātmyātparuṣṃ vaktumicchasi||3.40.14||
meaning: You do not know your rightful duty.Because of delusion and an evil mind, you want to speak only harsh words to me, a guest who has come to you.

sanskrit: गुणदोषौ न पृच्छामि क्षमं चात्मनि राक्षस। मयोक्तं तव चैतावत्संप्रत्यमितविक्रमः।।3.40.15।।
transliteration: guṇadoṣau na pṛcchāmi kṣamṃ cātmani rākṣasa| mayoktṃ tava caitāvatsṃpratyamitavikramḥ||3.40.15||
meaning: O demon O extremely valiant demon I ask you(to do) this much now. I am not asking you whether it is good or bad or whether it is for my welfare or not.

sanskrit: अस्मिंस्तु त्वं महाकृत्ये साहाय्यं कर्तुमर्हसि। शृणु तत्कर्म साहाय्ये यत्कार्यं वचनान्मम।।3.40.16।।
transliteration: asmiṃstu tvṃ mahākṛtye sāhāyyṃ kartumarhasi| śṛṇu tatkarma sāhāyye yatkāryṃ vacanānmama||3.40.16||
meaning: You have to help me in accomplishing this great task .Hear me on the kind of work you have to do.

sanskrit: सौवर्णस्त्वं मृगो भूत्वा चित्रो रजतबिन्दुभिः। आश्रमे तस्य रामस्य सीतायाः प्रमुखे चर। प्रलोभयित्वा वैदेहीं यथेष्टं गन्तुम
transliteration: sauvarṇastvṃ mṛgo bhūtvā citro rajatabindubhiḥ| āśrame tasya rāmasya sītāyāḥ pramukhe cara| pralobhayitvā vaidehīṃ yathe
meaning: Transform yourself into a wonderful golden deer with silver spots and move about in front of Sita at the hermitage of Rama. After fascinating her, you may go whereever you desire.

sanskrit: त्वां तु मायामृगं दृष्ट्वा काञ्चनं जातविस्मया। आनयैनमिति क्षिप्रं रामं वक्ष्यति मैथिली।।3.40.19।।
transliteration: tvāṃ tu māyāmṛgṃ dṛṣṭvā kāñcanṃ jātavismayā| ānayainamiti kṣiprṃ rāmṃ vakṣyati maithilī||3.40.19||
meaning: Seeing the illusory golden deer, Sita, wonderstruck, will at once ask Rama to get the deer.

sanskrit: अपक्रान्ते तु काकुत्स्थे दूरं यात्वाप्युदाहर। हा सीते लक्ष्मणेत्येवं रामवाक्यानुरूपकम्।।3.40.20।।
transliteration: apakrānte tu kākutsthe dūrṃ yātvāpyudāhara| hā sīte lakṣmaṇetyevṃ rāmavākyānurūpakam||3.40.20||
meaning: Divert Rama to a faroff place and cry, 'Alas, Sita, Alas, Lakshmana', imitating the voice of Rama.

sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा रामपदवीं सीतया च प्रचोदितः। अनुगच्छति सम्भ्रान्तः सौमित्रिरपि सौहृदात्।।3.40.21।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā rāmapadavīṃ sītayā ca pracoditḥ| anugacchati sambhrāntḥ saumitrirapi sauhṛdāt||3.40.21||
meaning: On hearing you, Lakshmana will be bewildered. Urged by Sita and out of love for Rama, Lakshmana will follow the same track as Rama.

sanskrit: अपक्रान्ते च काकुत्स्थे लक्ष्मणे च यथासुखम्। आनयिष्यामि वैदेहीं सहस्राक्षश्शचीमिव।।3.40.22।।
transliteration: apakrānte ca kākutsthe lakṣmaṇe ca yathāsukham| ānayiṣyāmi vaidehīṃ sahasrākṣaśśacīmiva||3.40.22||
meaning: When Rama and Lakshmana are away I will comfortably abduct Vaidehi like the thousandeyed Indra brought Sachi.

sanskrit: एवं कृत्वा त्विदं कार्यं यथेष्टं गच्छ राक्षस। राज्यस्यार्धं प्रयच्छामि मारीच तव सुव्रत।।3.40.23।।
transliteration: evṃ kṛtvā tvidṃ kāryṃ yatheṣṭṃ gaccha rākṣasa| rājyasyārdhṃ prayacchāmi mārīca tava suvrata||3.40.23||
meaning: You may go wherever you want after accomplishing this task. I will give you, O demon of determination half my kingdom.

sanskrit: गच्छ सौम्य शिवं मार्गं कार्यस्यास्य विवृद्धये। अहं त्वानुगमिष्यामि सरथो दण्डकावनम्।।3.40.24।।
transliteration: gaccha saumya śivṃ mārgṃ kāryasyāsya vivṛddhaye| ahṃ tvānugamiṣyāmi saratho daṇḍakāvanam||3.40.24||
meaning: Go and accomplish this task. Let your path be auspicious. I will follow you on the chariot into the Dandaka forest.

sanskrit: प्राप्य सीतामयुद्धेन वञ्चयित्वा तु राघवम्। लङ्कां प्रतिगमिष्यामि कृतकार्यस्सह त्वया।।3.40.25।।
transliteration: prāpya sītāmayuddhena vañcayitvā tu rāghavam| laṅkāṃ pratigamiṣyāmi kṛtakāryassaha tvayā||3.40.25||
meaning: I will deceive Rama and obtain Sita, without waging a war. With the work done, I will return to Lanka along with you.

sanskrit: न चेत्करोषि मारीच हन्मि त्वामहमद्य वै। एतत्कार्यमवश्यं मे बलादपि करिष्यसि। राज्ञो हि प्रतिकूलस्थो न जातु सुखमेधते।।3.40.
transliteration: na cetkaroṣi mārīca hanmi tvāmahamadya vai| etatkāryamavaśyṃ me balādapi kariṣyasi| rājño hi pratikūlastho na jātu sukha
meaning: O Maricha if you do not do this, I will kill you now. Or, by force make you do this work. No one who goes against the king lives in comfort.

sanskrit: आसाद्य तं जीवितसंशयस्ते मृत्युर्ध्रुवो ह्यद्य मया विरुध्य। एतद्यथावत्प्रतिगृह्य बुद्ध्या यदत्र पथ्यं कुरु तत्तथा त्वम्।।
transliteration: āsādya tṃ jīvitasṃśayaste mṛtyurdhruvo hyadya mayā virudhya| etadyathāvatpratigṛhya buddhyā yadatra pathyṃ kuru tattathā
meaning: Your survival is doubtful after facing Rama in combat. But your death is certain if you oppose me now. Think carefuly and do whatever is desirable for you in the present circumstances. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय

sanskrit: केनायमुपदिष्टस्ते विनाशः पापकर्मणा। सपुत्रस्य सराष्ट्रस्य सामात्यस्य निशाचर।।3.41.2।।
transliteration: kenāyamupadiṣṭaste vināśḥ pāpakarmaṇā| saputrasya sarāṣṭrasya sāmātyasya niśācara||3.41.2||
meaning: Who is that sinner who has given you this advice which will spell destruction on you, your sons, your kingdom and your ministers ?

sanskrit: कस्त्वया सुखिना राजन्नाभिनन्दति पापकृत्। केनेदमुपदिष्टं ते मृत्युद्वारमुपायतः।।3.41.3।।
transliteration: kastvayā sukhinā rājannābhinandati pāpakṛt| kenedamupadiṣṭṃ te mṛtyudvāramupāyatḥ||3.41.3||
meaning: Which sinner is not able to see you happy? O king by whom is this gate of death shown to you cunningly?

sanskrit: शत्रवस्तव सुव्यक्तं हीनवीर्या निशाचराः। इच्छन्ति त्वां विनश्यन्तमुपरुद्धं बलीयसा।।3.41.4।।
transliteration: śatravastava suvyaktṃ hīnavīryā niśācarāḥ| icchanti tvāṃ vinaśyantamuparuddhṃ balīyasā||3.41.4||
meaning: This is clear that your enemy demons are now powerless. Hence they want you to be engaged with a stronger power and be destroyed.

sanskrit: केनेदमुपदिष्टं ते क्षुद्रेणाहितवादिना। यस्त्वामिच्छति नश्यन्तं स्वकृतेन निशाचर।।3.41.5।।
transliteration: kenedamupadiṣṭṃ te kṣudreṇāhitavādinā| yastvāmicchati naśyantṃ svakṛtena niśācara||3.41.5||
meaning: O Ravana by which mean fellow is this advice given against your welfare? Who wants you to be destroyed by your own action.

sanskrit: वध्याः खलु न हन्यन्ते सचिवास्तव रावण। ये त्वामुत्पथमारूढं न निगृह्णन्ति सर्वशः।।3.41.6।।
transliteration: vadhyāḥ khalu na hanyante sacivāstava rāvaṇa| ye tvāmutpathamārūḍhṃ na nigṛhṇanti sarvaśḥ||3.41.6||
meaning: O Ravana the ministers should have prevented you by all means from adopting this wrong path. Since they have not done so, they deserve to be spain.

sanskrit: अमात्यैः कामवृत्तो हि राजा कापथमाश्रितः। निग्राह्यस्सर्वथा सदभिर्न निग्राह्यो निगृह्यसे।।3.41.7।।
transliteration: amātyaiḥ kāmavṛtto hi rājā kāpathamāśritḥ| nigrāhyassarvathā sadabhirna nigrāhyo nigṛhyase||3.41.7||
meaning: Good ministrers should always prevent a lustful king from taking resourse to an evil path. Why were you not stopped, even though you deserve to be checked.

sanskrit: धर्ममर्थं च कामं च यशश्च जयतां वर। स्वामिप्रसादात्सचिवाः प्राप्नुवन्ति निशाचर।।3.41.8।।
transliteration: dharmamarthṃ ca kāmṃ ca yaśaśca jayatāṃ vara| svāmiprasādātsacivāḥ prāpnuvanti niśācara||3.41.8||
meaning: O Ravana the best among the successful ministers attain piety, prosperity, pleasures and fame by the grace of the king.

sanskrit: विपर्यये तु तत्सर्वं व्यर्थं भवति रावण। व्यसनं स्वामिवैगुण्यात्प्राप्नुवन्तीतरे जनाः।।3.41.9।।
transliteration: viparyaye tu tatsarvṃ vyarthṃ bhavati rāvaṇa| vyasanṃ svāmivaiguṇyātprāpnuvantītare janāḥ||3.41.9||
meaning: Otherwise evrything will become useless, O Ravana Others will suffer calamities on account of their master's vices.

sanskrit: राजमूलो हि धर्मश्च जयश्च जयतां वर। तस्मात्सर्वास्ववस्थासु रक्षितव्या नराधिपाः।।3.41.10।।
transliteration: rājamūlo hi dharmaśca jayaśca jayatāṃ vara| tasmātsarvāsvavasthāsu rakṣitavyā narādhipāḥ||3.41.10||
meaning: O Ravana, the best among the victorious indeed the king is at the root of righteousness and victory.Therefore, the king should be protected by all at every stage.

sanskrit: राज्यं पालयितुं शक्यं न तीक्ष्णेन निशाचर। न चापि प्रतिकूलेन नाविनीतेन राक्षस।।3.41.11।।
transliteration: rājyṃ pālayituṃ śakyṃ na tīkṣṇena niśācara| na cāpi pratikūlena nāvinītena rākṣasa||3.41.11||
meaning: O nightwalking demon a kingdom cannnot be governed by a king who is rude or hostile or impolite.

sanskrit: ये तीक्ष्णमन्त्रास्सचिवा भज्यन्ते सह तेन वै। विषमे तुरगा श्शीघ्रा मन्दसारथयो यथा।।3.41.12।।
transliteration: ye tīkṣṇamantrāssacivā bhajyante saha tena vai| viṣame turagā śśīghrā mandasārathayo yathā||3.41.12||
meaning: Ministers who adopt improper strategies go down along with the king just like swift horses driven by a slow charioteer on a rugged terrain.

sanskrit: बहवस्साधवो लोके युक्ता धर्ममनुष्ठिताः। परेषामपराधेन विनष्टास्सपरिच्छदाः।।3.41.13।।
transliteration: bahavassādhavo loke yuktā dharmamanuṣṭhitāḥ| pareṣāmaparādhena vinaṣṭāssaparicchadāḥ||3.41.13||
meaning: Persons who walk the righteous path go down in this world along with their kith and kin due to the mistakes committed by others .

sanskrit: स्वामिना प्रतिकूलेन प्रजास्तीक्ष्णेन रावण। रक्ष्यमाणा न वर्धन्ते मेषा गोमायुना यथा।।3.41.14।।
transliteration: svāminā pratikūlena prajāstīkṣṇena rāvaṇa| rakṣyamāṇā na vardhante meṣā gomāyunā yathā||3.41.14||
meaning: O Ravana, people who are ruled by a cruel and hostile king will not grow like the sheep protected by a jackal.

sanskrit: अवश्यं विनशिष्यन्ति सर्वे रावण राक्षसाः। येषां त्वं कर्कशो राजा दुर्बुद्धिरजितेन्द्रियः।।3.41.15।।
transliteration: avaśyṃ vinaśiṣyanti sarve rāvaṇa rākṣasāḥ| yeṣāṃ tvṃ karkaśo rājā durbuddhirajitendriyḥ||3.41.15||
meaning: Under a rude, crooked king whose senses are not under his control the demons will surely perish.

sanskrit: तदिदं काकतालीयं घोरमासादितं मया। अत्र किं शोचनीयस्त्वं ससैन्यो विनशिष्यसि।।3.41.16।।
transliteration: tadidṃ kākatālīyṃ ghoramāsāditṃ mayā| atra kiṃ śocanīyastvṃ sasainyo vinaśiṣyasi||3.41.16||
meaning: I am faced with this dreadful disaster accidentally. You will not only be in a miserable state because of your misdeeds, you will perish along with your army.

sanskrit: मां निहत्य तु रामश्च न चिरात्त्वां वधिष्यति। अनेन कृतकृत्योऽस्मि म्रियेयमरिणा हतः।।3.41.17।।
transliteration: māṃ nihatya tu rāmaśca na cirāttvāṃ vadhiṣyati| anena kṛtakṛtyo'smi mriyeyamariṇā hatḥ||3.41.17||
meaning: Rama will kill you not long after killing me.Hence even if I die in the hands of the enemy, my desire will be fulfilled.

sanskrit: दर्शनादेव रामस्य हतं मामवधारय। आत्मानं च हतं विद्धि हृत्वा सीतां सबान्धवम्।।3.41.18।।
transliteration: darśanādeva rāmasya hatṃ māmavadhāraya| ātmānṃ ca hatṃ viddhi hṛtvā sītāṃ sabāndhavam||3.41.18||
meaning: Yu most understand that if I die at the very sight of Rama, you along with your relatives will perish with the abduction of Sita.

sanskrit: आनयिष्यसि चेत्सीतामाश्रमात्सहितो मया। नैवत्वमसि नाहं च नैव लङ्का न राक्षसाः।।3.41.19।।
transliteration: ānayiṣyasi cetsītāmāśramātsahito mayā| naivatvamasi nāhṃ ca naiva laṅkā na rākṣasāḥ||3.41.19||
meaning: If you bring Sita from the hermitage with my assistance, know that none of us will surviveyou nor I, nor Lanka , nor the demons.

sanskrit: निवार्यमाणस्तु मया हितैषिणा न मृष्यसे वाक्यमिदं निशाचर। परेतकल्पा हि गतायुषो नरा हितं न गृह्णन्ति सुहृद्भिरीरितम्।।3.41.
transliteration: nivāryamāṇastu mayā hitaiṣiṇā na mṛṣyase vākyamidṃ niśācara| paretakalpā hi gatāyuṣo narā hitṃ na gṛhṇanti suhṛdbhirīrit
meaning: O Ravana, you do not understand this word of warning coming from your wellwisher. Men who are going to die do not heed the advice given by their friends. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकचत्वारि

sanskrit: दृष्टश्चाहं पुनस्तेन शरचापासिधारिणा। मद्वधोद्यतशस्त्रेऽण विनष्टं जीवितं च मे।।3.42.2।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭaścāhṃ punastena śaracāpāsidhāriṇā| madvadhodyataśastre'ṇa vinaṣṭṃ jīvitṃ ca me||3.42.2||
meaning: If that warrior Rama carrying bow, arrows and sword sees me once again he will raise his weapon to kill me, and I will cease to be.

sanskrit: न हि रामं पराक्रम्य जीवन्प्रतिनिवर्तते। वर्तते प्रतिरूपोऽसौ यमदण्डहतस्य ते।।3.42.3।।
transliteration: na hi rāmṃ parākramya jīvanpratinivartate| vartate pratirūpo'sau yamadaṇḍahatasya te||3.42.3||
meaning: No one who exhibits his heroism before Rama will come back alive. To you, already hit by Yama's staff, he is another form of the same Yama.

sanskrit: किं नु शक्यं मया कर्तुमेवं त्वयि दुरात्मनि। एष गच्छाम्यहं तात स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु निशाचर।।3.42.4।।
transliteration: kiṃ nu śakyṃ mayā kartumevṃ tvayi durātmani| eṣa gacchāmyahṃ tāta svasti te'stu niśācara||3.42.4||
meaning: What can I do if you remain evilminded? O dear demon, I am going. May your path be auspicious

sanskrit: प्रहृष्टस्त्वभवत्तेन वचनेन स रावणः। परिष्वज्य सुसंश्लिष्टमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.42.5।।
transliteration: prahṛṣṭastvabhavattena vacanena sa rāvaṇḥ| pariṣvajya susṃśliṣṭamidṃ vacanamabravīt||3.42.5||
meaning: Ravana was so overwhelmed with joy to hear those words that he embraced him tightly and said:.

sanskrit: एतच्छौण्डीर्ययुक्तं ते मच्छन्दवशवर्तिनः। इदानीमसि मारीचः पूर्वमन्यो निशाचरः।।3.42.6।।
transliteration: etacchauṇḍīryayuktṃ te macchandavaśavartinḥ| idānīmasi mārīcḥ pūrvamanyo niśācarḥ||3.42.6||
meaning: Act according to my wish. It befits your valour. You were a different demon earlier. Now you are Maricha.

sanskrit: आरुह्यतामयं शीघ्रं रथो रत्नविभूषितः। मया सह तथा युक्तः पिशाचवदनैः खरैः।।3.42.7।।
transliteration: āruhyatāmayṃ śīghrṃ ratho ratnavibhūṣitḥ| mayā saha tathā yuktḥ piśācavadanaiḥ kharaiḥ||3.42.7||
meaning: Ascend quickly with me this chariot encrusted with gems and yoked with donkeys with devils' faces৷৷

sanskrit: प्रलोभयित्वा वैदेहीं यथेष्टं गन्तुमर्हसि। तां शून्ये प्रसभं सीतामानयिष्यामि मैथिलीम्।।3.42.8।।
transliteration: pralobhayitvā vaidehīṃ yatheṣṭṃ gantumarhasi| tāṃ śūnye prasabhṃ sītāmānayiṣyāmi maithilīm||3.42.8||
meaning: You may go whereever you like after tempting Vaidehi. When the princess of Mithila is alone, I will bring her by force.

sanskrit: ततो रावणमारीचौ विमानमिव तं रथम्। आरुह्य ययतुश्शीघ्रं तस्मादाश्रममण्डलात्।।3.42.9।।
transliteration: tato rāvaṇamārīcau vimānamiva tṃ ratham| āruhya yayatuśśīghrṃ tasmādāśramamaṇḍalāt||3.42.9||
meaning: Thereafter Ravana and Maricha ascended the chariot, which was like an aerial car, and quickly departed from that cluster of hermitages.

sanskrit: तथैव तत्र पश्यन्तौ पत्तनानि वनानि च। गीरींश्च सरितस्सर्वा राष्ट्राणि नगराणि च।।3.42.10।।
transliteration: tathaiva tatra paśyantau pattanāni vanāni ca| gīrīṃśca saritassarvā rāṣṭrāṇi nagarāṇi ca||3.42.10||
meaning: And likewise, they went past towns, forests, mountains, streams, states and cities.

sanskrit: समेत्य दण्डकारण्यं राघवस्याश्रमं ततः। ददर्श सह मारीचो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः।।3.42.11।।
transliteration: sametya daṇḍakāraṇyṃ rāghavasyāśramṃ tatḥ| dadarśa saha mārīco rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipḥ||3.42.11||
meaning: Ravana, king of the demons, accompanied by Maricha, then reached Dandaka forest and saw Rama's hermitage.

sanskrit: अवतीर्य रथात्तस्मात्ततः काञ्चनभूषणात्। हस्ते गृहीत्वा मारीचं रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।3.42.12।।
transliteration: avatīrya rathāttasmāttatḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇāt| haste gṛhītvā mārīcṃ rāvaṇo vākyamabravīt||3.42.12||
meaning: Then Ravana got off the chariot decorated with golden embellishments and, holding Maricha's hand, said:.

sanskrit: एतदाश्रमपदं दृश्यते कदलीवृतम्। क्रियतां तत्सखे शीघ्रं यदर्थं वयमागताः।।3.42.13।।
transliteration: etadāśramapadṃ dṛśyate kadalīvṛtam| kriyatāṃ tatsakhe śīghrṃ yadarthṃ vayamāgatāḥ||3.42.13||
meaning: O friend here is the site of the hermitage surrounded by banana plants. Quickly get to work on the purpose for which we have come.

sanskrit: स रावणवचश्श्रुत्वा मारीचो राक्षसस्तदा। मृगो भूत्वाऽश्रमद्वारि रामस्य विचचार ह।।3.42.14।।
transliteration: sa rāvaṇavacaśśrutvā mārīco rākṣasastadā| mṛgo bhūtvā'śramadvāri rāmasya vicacāra ha||3.42.14||
meaning: Hearing Ravana's words, Maricha transformed himself into a deer and started moving at the entrance of Rama's hermitage.

sanskrit: स तु तद्रूपमास्थाय महदद्भुतदर्शनम्। मणिप्रवरशृङ्गाग्रस्सितासितमुखाकृतिः।।3.42.15।।
transliteration: sa tu tadrūpamāsthāya mahadadbhutadarśanam| maṇipravaraśṛṅgāgrassitāsitamukhākṛtiḥ||3.42.15||
meaning: Maricha assumed the form of a wonderful and magnificent deer with his antlers studded with the most precious gems, his face dappled with luminous spots of white and black.

sanskrit: रक्तपद्मोत्पलमुख इन्द्रनीलोत्पलश्रवाः। किंचिदभ्युन्नतग्रीव इंद्रनीलदलाधरः।।3.42.16।।
transliteration: raktapadmotpalamukha indranīlotpalaśravāḥ| kiṃcidabhyunnatagrīva iṃdranīladalādharḥ||3.42.16||
meaning: The deer's face was like a pink lotus, his ears were like blue lotus. His neck slightly raised, his lips were like petals of blue lotus.

sanskrit: कुन्देन्दुवज्रसङ्काशमुदरं चास्य भास्वरम्। मधूकनिभपार्श्वश्च पद्मकिञ्जल्कसन्निभः।।3.42.17।। वैडूर्यसङ्काशखुरस्तनुजङ्घस्सु
transliteration: kundenduvajrasaṅkāśamudarṃ cāsya bhāsvaram| madhūkanibhapārśvaśca padmakiñjalkasannibhḥ||3.42.17|| vaiḍūryasaṅkāśakhuras
meaning: His bright belly was shining like kunda flowers or the Moon or diamond. His flanks were like the golden madhuka flowers. comparable to the filaments of lotus. His hooves were like vaidurya, and his legs were slim and wil

sanskrit: इन्द्रायुधसवर्णेन पुच्छेनोर्ध्वं विराजता।।3.42.18।। मनोहरस्स्निग्धवर्णो रत्नैर्नानाविधैर्वृतः।
transliteration: indrāyudhasavarṇena pucchenordhvṃ virājatā||3.42.18|| manoharassnigdhavarṇo ratnairnānāvidhairvṛtḥ|
meaning: His tail stood up looking magnificent like a colourful rainbow. Bedecked with various gems, he shone beautiful.

sanskrit: क्षणेन राक्षसो जातो मृगः परमशोभनः।।3.42.19।। वनं प्रज्वलयन्रम्यं रामाश्रमपदं च तत्।
transliteration: kṣaṇena rākṣaso jāto mṛgḥ paramaśobhanḥ||3.42.19|| vanṃ prajvalayanramyṃ rāmāśramapadṃ ca tat|
meaning: Transformed into a most beautiful deer in a moment, Maricha brightened the beautiful forest and Rama's hermitage.

sanskrit: मनोहरं दर्शनीयं रूपं कृत्वा स राक्षसः।।3.42.20।। प्रलोभनार्थं वैदेह्या नानाधातुविचित्रितम्। विचरन्गच्छते तस्माच्छाद्वलान
transliteration: manoharṃ darśanīyṃ rūpṃ kṛtvā sa rākṣasḥ||3.42.20|| pralobhanārthṃ vaidehyā nānādhātuvicitritam| vicarangacchate tasmācc
meaning: Transfigured into a beautiful, magnificent form painted with the colours of different minerals in order to tempt Sita, Maricha roamed all around the grassland.

sanskrit: रूप्यैर्बिन्दुशतैश्चित्रो भूत्वा स प्रियदर्शनः। विटपीनां किसलयान्भङ्त्क्वाऽदन्विचचार ह।।3.42.22।।
transliteration: rūpyairbinduśataiścitro bhūtvā sa priyadarśanḥ| viṭapīnāṃ kisalayānbhaṅtkvā'danvicacāra ha||3.42.22||
meaning: That deer with hundreds of silver spots on the body appeared enchanting and pleasing to the eyes while he wandered about nibbling the tender leaves of trees.

sanskrit: कदलीगृहकं गत्वा कर्णिकारानितस्ततः। समाश्रयन्मन्दगतिस्सीतासन्दर्शनं तथा।।3.42.23।।
transliteration: kadalīgṛhakṃ gatvā karṇikārānitastatḥ| samāśrayanmandagatissītāsandarśanṃ tathā||3.42.23||
meaning: The deer went wandering about the banana groves surrounding Rama's hermitage and moved slowly towards the karnikara trees in order to catch the attention of Sita.

sanskrit: राजीवचित्रपृष्ठस्स विरराज महामृगः। रामाश्रमपदाभ्याशे विचचार यथासुखम्।।3.42.24।।
transliteration: rājīvacitrapṛṣṭhassa virarāja mahāmṛgḥ| rāmāśramapadābhyāśe vicacāra yathāsukham||3.42.24||
meaning: That magnificent deer glittered with the colour of blue lotus on its back, wandered merrily in the vicinity of Rama's hermitage.

sanskrit: पुनर्गत्वा निवृत्तश्च विचचार मृगोत्तमः। गत्वा मुहूर्तं त्वरया पुनः प्रतिनिवर्तते।।3.42.25।।
transliteration: punargatvā nivṛttaśca vicacāra mṛgottamḥ| gatvā muhūrtṃ tvarayā punḥ pratinivartate||3.42.25||
meaning: The wonderful deer moved to and fro, now disappearing and now swiftly returning.

sanskrit: विक्रीडंश्च क्वचिद्भूमौ पुनरेव निषीदति। आश्रमद्वारमागम्य मृगयूथानि गच्छति।।3.42.26।।
transliteration: vikrīḍṃśca kvacidbhūmau punareva niṣīdati| āśramadvāramāgamya mṛgayūthāni gacchati||3.42.26||
meaning: The deer is now sporting, now sitting on the ground, now standing at the entrance of the hermitage and now running with the herds of deer.

sanskrit: मृगयूथैरनुगतः पुनरेव निवर्तते। सीतादर्शनमाकांक्षन्राक्षसो मृगतां गतः।।3.42.27।। परिभ्रमति चित्राणि मण्डलानि विनिष्पतन्।
transliteration: mṛgayūthairanugatḥ punareva nivartate| sītādarśanamākāṃkṣanrākṣaso mṛgatāṃ gatḥ||3.42.27|| paribhramati citrāṇi maṇḍalān
meaning: Followed by herds of deer and coming back to see Sita again and again, the deer cavorted and pranced and frisked in circles in a wonderful way.

sanskrit: समुद्वीक्ष्य च ते सर्वे मृगा ह्यन्ये वनेचराः।।3.42.28।। उपागम्य समाघ्राय विद्रवन्ति दिशो दश।
transliteration: samudvīkṣya ca te sarve mṛgā hyanye vanecarāḥ||3.42.28|| upāgamya samāghrāya vidravanti diśo daśa|
meaning: Seeing the deer, other animals wandering in the forest come near and sniffing him run away in all ten directions.

sanskrit: राक्षसस्सोऽपि तान्वन्यान्मृगान्मृगवधे रतः।।3.42.29।। प्रच्छादनार्थं भावस्य न भक्षयति संस्पृशन्।
transliteration: rākṣasasso'pi tānvanyānmṛgānmṛgavadhe ratḥ||3.42.29|| pracchādanārthṃ bhāvasya na bhakṣayati sṃspṛśan|
meaning: The demon who was interested in killing wild deer touched and felt them but did not kill or feed on them in order to hide his intention.

sanskrit: तस्मिन्नेव ततः काले वैदेही शुभलोचना।।3.42.30।। कुसुमावचयव्यग्रा पादपानभ्यवर्तत।
transliteration: tasminneva tatḥ kāle vaidehī śubhalocanā||3.42.30|| kusumāvacayavyagrā pādapānabhyavartata|
meaning: In the mean time Sita who, with her auspicious looks, was busy plucking flowers drew near the trees.

sanskrit: कर्णिकारानशोकांश्च चूतांश्च मदिरेक्षणा।।3.42.31।। कुसुमान्यवचिन्वन्ती चचार रुचिरानना।
transliteration: karṇikārānaśokāṃśca cūtāṃśca madirekṣaṇā||3.42.31|| kusumānyavacinvantī cacāra rucirānanā|
meaning: With her bewitching eyes and beautiful face, Sita, went about plucking flowers from karnikara, ashoka and mango trees.

sanskrit: अनर्हाऽरण्यवासस्य सा तं रत्नमयं मृगम्।।3.42.32।। मुक्तामणि विचित्राङ्गं ददर्श परमाङ्गना।
transliteration: anarhā'raṇyavāsasya sā tṃ ratnamayṃ mṛgam||3.42.32|| muktāmaṇi vicitrāṅgṃ dadarśa paramāṅganā|
meaning: The great lady Sita, unworthy of dwelling in the forest, saw the wonderful deer decked with gems, with spots of pearls all over the body.

sanskrit: सा तं रुचिरदन्तोष्ठी रूप्यधातुतनूरुहम्।।3.42.33।। विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना सस्नेहं समुदैक्षत।
transliteration: sā tṃ ruciradantoṣṭhī rūpyadhātutanūruham||3.42.33|| vismayotphullanayanā sasnehṃ samudaikṣata|
meaning: A lady with beautiful teeth and lips, Sita saw the deer having silver and mineral coloured hair on the body. She gazed at the animal with wonder and joy and love.

sanskrit: स च तां रामदयितां पश्यन्मायामयो मृगः।।3.42.34।। विचचार पुनश्चित्रं दीपयन्निव तद्वनम्।
transliteration: sa ca tāṃ rāmadayitāṃ paśyanmāyāmayo mṛgḥ||3.42.34|| vicacāra punaścitrṃ dīpayanniva tadvanam|
meaning: That illusory deer saw Rama's wife and moved around wonderfully as if illuminating the forest with his radiance.

sanskrit: अदृष्टपूर्वं तं दृष्ट्वा नानारत्नमयं मृगम्।।3.42.35।। विस्मयं परमं सीता जगाम जनकात्मजा।
transliteration: adṛṣṭapūrvṃ tṃ dṛṣṭvā nānāratnamayṃ mṛgam||3.42.35|| vismayṃ paramṃ sītā jagāma janakātmajā|
meaning: Seeing such an unprecedented deer decorated with different gems, Sita, daughter of Janaka, stood amazed. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे द्विचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysecond sarga of

sanskrit: तयाऽऽहूतौ नरव्याघ्रौ वैदेह्या रामलक्ष्मणौ। वीक्षमाणौ तु तौ देशं तदा ददृशतुर्मृगम्।।3.43.3।।
transliteration: tayā''hūtau naravyāghrau vaidehyā rāmalakṣmaṇau| vīkṣamāṇau tu tau deśṃ tadā dadṛśaturmṛgam||3.43.3||
meaning: When Sita called Rama and Lakshmana, the two tigers among men, they looked around and saw the deer.

sanskrit: शङ्कमानस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणो राममब्रवीत्। तमेवैनमहं मन्ये मारीचं राक्षसं मृगम्।।3.43.4।।
transliteration: śaṅkamānastu tṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇo rāmamabravīt| tamevainamahṃ manye mārīcṃ rākṣasṃ mṛgam||3.43.4||
meaning: Seeing the deer, Lakshmana suspected him to be Maricha and said this to Rama.

sanskrit: चरन्तोमृगयां हृष्टाः पापेनोपाधिना वने। अनेन निहता राजन् राजानः कामरूपिणा।।3.43.5।।
transliteration: carantomṛgayāṃ hṛṣṭāḥ pāpenopādhinā vane| anena nihatā rājan rājānḥ kāmarūpiṇā||3.43.5||
meaning: Many kings, while on hunting expedition in the forest, have been deceitfully killed by malicious Maricha, who could assume any form at his free will.

sanskrit: अस्य मायाविदो मायामृगरूपमिदं कृतम्। भानुमत्पुरुषव्याघ्र गन्धर्वपुरसन्निभम्।।3.43.6।।
transliteration: asya māyāvido māyāmṛgarūpamidṃ kṛtam| bhānumatpuruṣavyāghra gandharvapurasannibham||3.43.6||
meaning: O tiger among men, this deceitful demon (Maricha) has been transformed into the illusory form of a radiant deer which does not exist.

sanskrit: मृगो ह्येवंविधो रत्नविचित्रो नास्ति राघव। जगत्यां जगतीनाथ मायैषा हि न संशयः।।3.43.7।।
transliteration: mṛgo hyevṃvidho ratnavicitro nāsti rāghava| jagatyāṃ jagatīnātha māyaiṣā hi na sṃśayḥ||3.43.7||
meaning: O Rama, lord of the world nowhere on earth does exist this kind of wonderful deer sparkling with gems. That it is a mere trick, an illusion there is no doubt.

sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवाणं काकुत्स्थं प्रतिवार्य शुचिस्मिता। उवाच सीता संहृष्टा चर्मणा हृतचेतना।।3.43.8।।
transliteration: evṃ bruvāṇṃ kākutsthṃ prativārya śucismitā| uvāca sītā sṃhṛṣṭā carmaṇā hṛtacetanā||3.43.8||
meaning: Sita was too enchanted by the skin of the deer to retain her sense of discrimination. Intervening, she said to Rama joyfully with a pure smile on her face:

sanskrit: आर्यपुत्राभिरामोऽसौ मृगो हरति मे मनः। आनयैनं महाबाहो क्रीडार्थं नो भविष्यति।।3.43.9।।
transliteration: āryaputrābhirāmo'sau mṛgo harati me manḥ| ānayainṃ mahābāho krīḍārthṃ no bhaviṣyati||3.43.9||
meaning: O prince O longarmed one, this deer has captivated my mind. Fetch him for me.This will be our playmate.

sanskrit: इहाश्रमपदेऽस्माकं बहवः पुण्यदर्शनाः। मृगाश्चरन्ति सहिताश्चमरास्सृमरास्तथा।।3.43.10।।
transliteration: ihāśramapade'smākṃ bahavḥ puṇyadarśanāḥ| mṛgāścaranti sahitāścamarāssṛmarāstathā||3.43.10||
meaning: Here at the hermitage there are many lovely deer, yaks and antelopes wandering in herds.

sanskrit: ऋक्षाः पृषतसङ्घाश्च वानराः किन्नरास्तथा। विचरन्ति महाबाहो रुपश्रेष्ठा मनोहराः।।3.43.11।।
transliteration: ṛkṣāḥ pṛṣatasaṅghāśca vānarāḥ kinnarāstathā| vicaranti mahābāho rupaśreṣṭhā manoharāḥ||3.43.11||
meaning: O longarmed one, most beautiful animals like bears, antelopes and groups of monkeys and kinneras are wandering here.

sanskrit: न चास्य सदृशो राजन्दृष्टपूर्वो मृगो मया। तेजसा क्षमया दीप्त्या यथाऽयं मृगसत्तमः।।3.43.12।।
transliteration: na cāsya sadṛśo rājandṛṣṭapūrvo mṛgo mayā| tejasā kṣamayā dīptyā yathā'yṃ mṛgasattamḥ||3.43.12||
meaning: O prince this kind of beautiful, tame and glittering deer I have never seen before.

sanskrit: नानावर्णविचित्राङ्गो रत्नबिन्दुसमाचितः। द्योतयन्वनमव्यग्रं शोभते शशिसन्निभः।।3.43.13।।
transliteration: nānāvarṇavicitrāṅgo ratnabindusamācitḥ| dyotayanvanamavyagrṃ śobhate śaśisannibhḥ||3.43.13||
meaning: Its body glittering with different colours, speckled with gems of different kinds, is like the Moon shining and illuminating the forest.

sanskrit: अहो रूपमहो लक्ष्मीस्स्वरसम्पच्च शोभना। मृगोऽद्भुतो विचित्राङ्गो हृदयं हरतीव मे।।3.43.14।।
transliteration: aho rūpamaho lakṣmīssvarasampacca śobhanā| mṛgo'dbhuto vicitrāṅgo hṛdayṃ haratīva me||3.43.14||
meaning: Oh what a beauty, Oh what rich call what delightful, wonderful, graceful limbs This deer captivates my heart.

sanskrit: यदि ग्रहणमभ्येति जीवन्नेव मृगस्तव। आश्चर्यभूतं भवति विस्मयं जनयिष्यति।।3.43.15।।
transliteration: yadi grahaṇamabhyeti jīvanneva mṛgastava| āścaryabhūtṃ bhavati vismayṃ janayiṣyati||3.43.15||
meaning: If this deer can be caught alive, it will be thrilling, it will work wonders.

sanskrit: समाप्तवनवासानां राज्यस्थानां च नः पुनः। अन्तःपुरविभूषार्थो मृग एष भविष्यति।।3.43.16।।
transliteration: samāptavanavāsānāṃ rājyasthānāṃ ca nḥ punḥ| antḥpuravibhūṣārtho mṛga eṣa bhaviṣyati||3.43.16||
meaning: After the completion of exile in the forest, when we are back in the kingdom, this deer will add beauty to the harem.

sanskrit: भरतस्यार्यपुत्रस्य श्वश्रूणां मम च प्रभो। मृगरूपमिदं व्यक्तं विस्मयं जनयिष्यति।।3.43.17।।
transliteration: bharatasyāryaputrasya śvaśrūṇāṃ mama ca prabho| mṛgarūpamidṃ vyaktṃ vismayṃ janayiṣyati||3.43.17||
meaning: O king this deer will create amazement in Bharata, in mothersinlaw, in you and in me as well.

sanskrit: जीवन्न यदि तेऽभ्येति ग्रहणं मृगसत्तमः। अजिनं नरशार्दूल रुचिरं मे भविष्यति।।3.43.18।।
transliteration: jīvanna yadi te'bhyeti grahaṇṃ mṛgasattamḥ| ajinṃ naraśārdūla rucirṃ me bhaviṣyati||3.43.18||
meaning: O best among men, if this great deer cannot be captured alive, I will wear its beautiful skin.

sanskrit: निहतस्यास्य सत्त्वस्य जाम्बूनदमयत्वचि। शष्पबृस्यां विनीतायामिच्छाम्यहमुपासितुम्।।3.43.19।।
transliteration: nihatasyāsya sattvasya jāmbūnadamayatvaci| śaṣpabṛsyāṃ vinītāyāmicchāmyahamupāsitum||3.43.19||
meaning: If this animal is killed and its golden skin is spread on a tender grass cushion, there will I like to sit.

sanskrit: कामवृत्तमिदं रौद्रं स्त्रीणामसदृशं मतम्। वपुषा त्वस्य सत्त्वस्य विस्मयो जनितो मम।।3.43.20।।
transliteration: kāmavṛttamidṃ raudrṃ strīṇāmasadṛśṃ matam| vapuṣā tvasya sattvasya vismayo janito mama||3.43.20||
meaning: This kind of request arising out of a woman's desire may sound terrible, still then the beauty of this animal's skin has produced in me a wonder.

sanskrit: तेन काञ्चनवर्णेन मणिप्रवरशृङ्गिणा। तरुणादित्यवर्णेन नक्षत्रपथवर्चसा।।3.43.21।। बभूव राघवस्यापि मनो विस्मयमागतम्।
transliteration: tena kāñcanavarṇena maṇipravaraśṛṅgiṇā| taruṇādityavarṇena nakṣatrapathavarcasā||3.43.21|| babhūva rāghavasyāpi mano vis
meaning: By his golden colour resembling the rising Sun, by his horns with excellent gems shining like the milkyway, even Rama's mind was wonderstruck.

sanskrit: एवं सीतावचः श्रुत्वा तं दृष्ट्वा मृगमद्भुतम्।।3.43.22।। लोभितस्तेन रूपेण सीतया च प्रचोदितः। उवाच राघवो हृष्टो भ्रातरं लक
transliteration: evṃ sītāvacḥ śrutvā tṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛgamadbhutam||3.43.22|| lobhitastena rūpeṇa sītayā ca pracoditḥ| uvāca rāghavo hṛṣṭo bhrā
meaning: On hearing Sita's words and seeing the wonderful deer, Rama was tempted by its appearance.Prompted by Sita,he joyfully said this to Lakshmana:

sanskrit: पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेह्याः स्पृहां मृगगतामिमाम्। रूपश्रेष्ठतया ह्येष मृगोऽद्य न भविष्यति।।3.43.24।। न वने नन्दनोद्धेशे न चैत
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa vaidehyāḥ spṛhāṃ mṛgagatāmimām| rūpaśreṣṭhatayā hyeṣa mṛgo'dya na bhaviṣyati||3.43.24|| na vane nandanodd
meaning: O Lakshmana, see the eagerness of Sita. Such a deer of exceptional beauty will not be found in this forest. There is no equal to this animal even in the Nandan garden of Indra, or the Chaitraratha, the garden of Kubera.

sanskrit: प्रतिलोमानुलोमाश्च रुचिरा रोमराजयः। शोभन्ते मृगमाश्रित्य चित्राः कनकबिन्दवः।।3.43.26।।
transliteration: pratilomānulomāśca rucirā romarājayḥ| śobhante mṛgamāśritya citrāḥ kanakabindavḥ||3.43.26||
meaning: The stretches of hair on the deer's body bent both in the natural order and in the opposite direction look beautiful. The spots of gold on the skin are wonderful.

sanskrit: पश्यास्य जृम्भमाणस्य दीप्तामग्निशिखोपमाम्। जिह्वां मुखान्निस्सरन्तीं मेघादिव शतह्रदाम्।।3.43.27।।
transliteration: paśyāsya jṛmbhamāṇasya dīptāmagniśikhopamām| jihvāṃ mukhānnissarantīṃ meghādiva śatahradām||3.43.27||
meaning: Look at his tongue stretched out of the mouth while yawning. It is glowing like flaming fire. It is like the lightning sparkling in the cloud.

sanskrit: मसारगल्लर्कमुखश्शङ्खमुक्तानिभोदरः। कस्य नामाभिरूप्योऽसौ न मनो लोभयेन्मृगः।।3.43.28।।
transliteration: masāragallarkamukhaśśaṅkhamuktānibhodarḥ| kasya nāmābhirūpyo'sau na mano lobhayenmṛgḥ||3.43.28||
meaning: His face is a drinking pot of emerald, the belly is a conch or a pearl. Whose mind will not be attracted by this indescribable beauty ?

sanskrit: कस्य रूपमिदं दृष्ट्वा जाम्बूनद मयप्रभम्। नानारत्नमयं दिव्यं न मनो विस्मयं व्रजेत्।।3.43.29।।
transliteration: kasya rūpamidṃ dṛṣṭvā jāmbūnada mayaprabham| nānāratnamayṃ divyṃ na mano vismayṃ vrajet||3.43.29||
meaning: Whose mind will not be filled with wonder on seeing this divine beauty glittering like lustrous gold and studded with a variety of gems ?

sanskrit: मांसहेतोरपि मृगान्विनोदार्थं च धन्वनः। घ्नन्ति लक्ष्मण राजानो मृगयायां महावने।।3.43.30।।
transliteration: māṃsahetorapi mṛgānvinodārthṃ ca dhanvanḥ| ghnanti lakṣmaṇa rājāno mṛgayāyāṃ mahāvane||3.43.30||
meaning: O Lakshmana kings who wield bows in hunting expeditions kill deer in the forest for sport as well as for venison.

sanskrit: धनानि व्यवसायेन विचीयन्ते महावने। धातवो विविधाश्चापि मणिरत्नसुवर्णिनः।।3.43.31।।
transliteration: dhanāni vyavasāyena vicīyante mahāvane| dhātavo vividhāścāpi maṇiratnasuvarṇinḥ||3.43.31||
meaning: From huge forests a variety of mineral wealth consisting of gems, stones and gold are collected with great effort.

sanskrit: तत्सारमखिलं नृ़णां धनं निचयवर्धनम्। मनसा चिन्तितं सर्वं यथा शुक्रस्य लक्ष्मण।।3.43.32।।
transliteration: tatsāramakhilṃ nṛ़ṇāṃ dhanṃ nicayavardhanam| manasā cintitṃ sarvṃ yathā śukrasya lakṣmaṇa||3.43.32||
meaning: O Lakshmana the essence of forest wealth is mineral wealth, which helps the growth of the treasury. It is conceived mentally as in the case of Venus.

sanskrit: अर्थी येनार्थकृत्येन संव्रजत्यविचारयन्। तमर्थमर्थशास्त्रज्ञाः प्राहुरर्थ्याश्च लक्ष्मण।।3.43.33।।
transliteration: arthī yenārthakṛtyena sṃvrajatyavicārayan| tamarthamarthaśāstrajñāḥ prāhurarthyāśca lakṣmaṇa||3.43.33||
meaning: A materialist moves about thoughtlessly for making money. Economists call it material wealth.

sanskrit: न कादली न प्रियकी न प्रवेणी न चाविकी। भवेदेतस्य सदृशी स्पर्शनेनेति मे मतिः।।3.43.35।।
transliteration: na kādalī na priyakī na praveṇī na cāvikī| bhavedetasya sadṛśī sparśaneneti me matiḥ||3.43.35||
meaning: The skins of various types of deer like Priyaki, Kadali or goats or sheep cannot be compared in softness to the skin of this deer.

sanskrit: एष चैव मृगश्श्रीमान् यश्च दिव्यो नभश्चरः। उभावेतौ मृगौ दिव्यौ तारामृगमहीमृगौ।।3.43.36।।
transliteration: eṣa caiva mṛgaśśrīmān yaśca divyo nabhaścarḥ| ubhāvetau mṛgau divyau tārāmṛgamahīmṛgau||3.43.36||
meaning: This majestic deer and the deer flying in heaven (the deer's figure seen in the Moon called Mrgasira) both the deer of the star in the sky and the deer of the earth are divine.

sanskrit: यदि वाऽयं तथा यन्मां भवेद्वदसि लक्ष्मण। मायैषा राक्षसस्येति कर्तव्योस्य वधो मया।।3.43.37।।
transliteration: yadi vā'yṃ tathā yanmāṃ bhavedvadasi lakṣmaṇa| māyaiṣā rākṣasasyeti kartavyosya vadho mayā||3.43.37||
meaning: Lakshmana, as you say, if it is the illusion of a demon, even then it should be killed by me.

sanskrit: एतेन हि नृशंसेन मारीचेनाकृतात्मना। वने विचरता पूर्वं हिंसिता मुनिपुङ्गवाः।।3.43.38।।
transliteration: etena hi nṛśṃsena mārīcenākṛtātmanā| vane vicaratā pūrvṃ hiṃsitā munipuṅgavāḥ||3.43.38||
meaning: The great sages were tortured and killed earlier by this cruel, evilminded Maricha while wandering in the forest.

sanskrit: उत्थाय बहवो येन मृगयायां जनाधिपाः। निहताः परमेष्वासास्तस्माद्वध्यस्त्वयं मृगः।।3.43.39।।
transliteration: utthāya bahavo yena mṛgayāyāṃ janādhipāḥ| nihatāḥ parameṣvāsāstasmādvadhyastvayṃ mṛgḥ||3.43.39||
meaning: Many kings who were great archers who set out on hunting expedition were killed by him. Therefore, this animal deserves to be killed.

sanskrit: पुरस्तादिह वातापिः परिभूय तपस्विनः। उदरस्थो द्विजान्हन्तिस्वगर्भोऽश्वतरीमिव।।3.43.40।।
transliteration: purastādiha vātāpiḥ paribhūya tapasvinḥ| udarastho dvijānhantisvagarbho'śvatarīmiva||3.43.40||
meaning: Earlier in this forest, Vatapi used to humiliate the ascetic brahmins and to kill them by entering into their stomach like a womb killing the female mule.

sanskrit: स कदाचिच्चिराल्लोभादाससाद महामुनिम्। अगस्त्यं तेजसा युक्तं भक्षस्तस्य बभूव ह।।3.43.41।।
transliteration: sa kadāciccirāllobhādāsasāda mahāmunim| agastyṃ tejasā yuktṃ bhakṣastasya babhūva ha||3.43.41||
meaning: That Vatapi after a long time, once greedily entered into the stomach of the great lustrous sage Agastya and became his food.

sanskrit: समुत्थाने व तद्रूपं कर्तुकामं समीक्ष्य तम्। उत्स्मयित्वा तु भगवान्वातापिमिदमब्रवीत्।।3.43.42।।
transliteration: samutthāne va tadrūpṃ kartukāmṃ samīkṣya tam| utsmayitvā tu bhagavānvātāpimidamabravīt||3.43.42||
meaning: When the venerable sage Agastya got up (after eating), he observed Vatapi wishing to turn into his real form. So smiling at him, he said:

sanskrit: त्वयाऽविगण्य वातापे परिभूतास्स्वतेजसा। जीवलोके द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तस्मादसि जरां गतः।।3.43.43।।
transliteration: tvayā'vigaṇya vātāpe paribhūtāssvatejasā| jīvaloke dvijaśreṣṭhāstasmādasi jarāṃ gatḥ||3.43.43||
meaning: 'O Vatapi you killed the best of brahmins living in this world, disregarding them because of your power. Hence you were digested by me.'

sanskrit: तदेवं न भवेद्रक्षोवातापिरिव लक्ष्मण। मद्विधं योऽतिमन्येत धर्मनित्यं जितेन्द्रियम्।।3.43.44।। भवेद्धतोऽयं वातापिरगस्त्येन
transliteration: tadevṃ na bhavedrakṣovātāpiriva lakṣmaṇa| madvidhṃ yo'timanyeta dharmanityṃ jitendriyam||3.43.44|| bhaveddhato'yṃ vātāpi
meaning: O Lakshmana just like Vatapi, this demon will not live. Whoever violates a person of my kind who is ever righteous and selfcontrolled will be killed

sanskrit: इह त्वं भव सन्नद्दो यन्त्रितो रक्ष मैथिलीम्।।3.43.45।। अस्यामायत्तमस्माकं यत्कृत्यं रघुनन्दन।
transliteration: iha tvṃ bhava sannaddo yantrito rakṣa maithilīm||3.43.45|| asyāmāyattamasmākṃ yatkṛtyṃ raghunandana|
meaning: O Lakshmana, delight of the Raghu dynasty, be very alert and restrained and protect Sita. Whatever duty we have to perform depends on her protection.

sanskrit: अहमेनं वधिष्यामि ग्रहीष्याम्यपि वा मृगम्।।3.43.46।। यावद्गच्छामि सौमित्रे मृगमानयितुं द्रुतम्।
transliteration: ahamenṃ vadhiṣyāmi grahīṣyāmyapi vā mṛgam||3.43.46|| yāvadgacchāmi saumitre mṛgamānayituṃ drutam|
meaning: O Lakshmana I will go quickly and either kill the deer or catch it. Now let me go.

sanskrit: पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेहीं मृगत्वचि गतस्पृहाम्।।3.43.47।। त्वचा प्रधानया ह्येष मृगोऽद्य न भविष्यति।
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa vaidehīṃ mṛgatvaci gataspṛhām||3.43.47|| tvacā pradhānayā hyeṣa mṛgo'dya na bhaviṣyati|
meaning: See, how Vaidehi ardently longs for the skin of this deer I will not let the animal live, O Lakshmana

sanskrit: अप्रमत्तेन ते भाव्यमाश्रमस्थेन सीतया।।3.43.48।। यावत्पृषतमेकेन सायकेन निहन्म्यहम्। हत्वैतच्चर्म चादाय शीघ्रमेष्यामि लक्ष
transliteration: apramattena te bhāvyamāśramasthena sītayā||3.43.48|| yāvatpṛṣatamekena sāyakena nihanmyaham| hatvaitaccarma cādāya śīghr
meaning: Keep vigil over Sita at the hermitage, O Lakshmana I will certainly kill the speckled antelope with a single arrow, get his skin and come back quickly.

sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणेनातिबलेन पक्षिणा जटायुषा बुद्धिमता च लक्ष्मण। भवाप्रमत्तः परिगृह्य मैथिलीं प्रतिक्षणं सर्वत एव शङ्कितः।।3.43.5
transliteration: pradakṣiṇenātibalena pakṣiṇā jaṭāyuṣā buddhimatā ca lakṣmaṇa| bhavāpramattḥ parigṛhya maithilīṃ pratikṣaṇṃ sarvata eva ś
meaning: O Lakshmana, be vigilant in guarding Sita, suspecting danger every moment from all directions. Take the help of Jatayu, the mighty and wise bird who will be on his rounds. इत्याषे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्य

sanskrit: तत स्त्र्यवनतं चापमादायाऽत्मविभूषणम्। आबध्य च कलापौ द्वौ जगामोदग्रविक्रमः।।3.44.2।।
transliteration: tata stryavanatṃ cāpamādāyā'tmavibhūṣaṇam| ābadhya ca kalāpau dvau jagāmodagravikramḥ||3.44.2||
meaning: A man of indomitable prowess, he took the bow with three curves that was like an ornament to him, tied two quivers at the back and left.

sanskrit: तं वञ्चयानो राजेन्द्रमापतन्तं निरीक्ष्यवै। बभूवान्तर्हितस्त्रासात्पुनस्सन्दर्शनेऽभवत्।।च3.44.3।। बद्धासिर्धनुरादाय प्रदु
transliteration: tṃ vañcayāno rājendramāpatantṃ nirīkṣyavai| babhūvāntarhitastrāsātpunassandarśane'bhavat||ca3.44.3|| baddhāsirdhanurādāy
meaning: On seeing Rama approaching him, the deer disappeared due to fear and again came within sight. With his sword and the bow, Rama chased wherever the deer ran.

sanskrit: तं स्म पश्यति रूपेण द्योतमानमिवाग्रतः।।3.44.4।। अवेक्ष्यावेक्ष्य धावन्तं धनुष्पाणिर्महावने। अतिवृत्तमिषोः पाताल्लोभयानं
transliteration: tṃ sma paśyati rūpeṇa dyotamānamivāgratḥ||3.44.4|| avekṣyāvekṣya dhāvantṃ dhanuṣpāṇirmahāvane| ativṛttamiṣoḥ pātāllobhay
meaning: Rama, wielder of the bow, saw that splendid animal ahead of him. Holding the bow he saw the deer running away, bewldered into the great forest looking at him again and again. The deer was getting out of the range of his

sanskrit: मुहुर्तादेव ददृशे मुहुर्दूरात्प्रकाशते।।3.44.7।। दर्शनादर्शनादेवं सोऽपाकर्षत राघवम्। सुदूरमाश्रमस्यास्य मारीचो मृगतां गत
transliteration: muhurtādeva dadṛśe muhurdūrātprakāśate||3.44.7|| darśanādarśanādevṃ so'pākarṣata rāghavam| sudūramāśramasyāsya mārīco mṛ
meaning: Maricha, transformed into a deer, was seen now near, now faroff. He pulled Rama away from the hermitage through his exits and entrances.

sanskrit: आसीत् क्रुद्धस्तु काकुत्स्थो विवशस्तेन मोहितः। अथावतस्थे संभ्रान्तश्चायामाश्रित्य शाद्वले।।3.44.9।।
transliteration: āsīt kruddhastu kākutstho vivaśastena mohitḥ| athāvatasthe sṃbhrāntaścāyāmāśritya śādvale||3.44.9||
meaning: Deluded by that deer, Rama got tired, perplexed and angry. Then bewidered, he waited on a grassland under a shade.

sanskrit: स तमुन्मादयामास मृगरूपो निशाचरः। मृगैः परिवृतो वन्यैरदूरात्प्रत्यदृश्यत।।3.44.10।।
transliteration: sa tamunmādayāmāsa mṛgarūpo niśācarḥ| mṛgaiḥ parivṛto vanyairadūrātpratyadṛśyata||3.44.10||
meaning: That demon transformed himself into a deer and, surrounded by the animals of the forest at close range, attracted his attention.

sanskrit: गृहीतुकामं दृष्ट्वैवं पुनरेवाभ्यधावत। तत्क्षणादेव संत्रासात्पुनरन्तर्हितोऽभवत्।।3.44.11।।
transliteration: gṛhītukāmṃ dṛṣṭvaivṃ punarevābhyadhāvata| tatkṣaṇādeva sṃtrāsātpunarantarhito'bhavat||3.44.11||
meaning: Seeing Rama's intention to catch him, the deer ran away once again out of fear and disappeared in a moment.

sanskrit: पुनरेव ततो दूराद्वृक्षषण्डाद्विनिस्सृतम्। दृष्ट्वा रामो महातेजास्तं हन्तुं कृतनिश्चयः।।3.44.12।।
transliteration: punareva tato dūrādvṛkṣaṣaṇḍādvinissṛtam| dṛṣṭvā rāmo mahātejāstṃ hantuṃ kṛtaniścayḥ||3.44.12||
meaning: Resplendent Rama saw the deer coming out of a cluster of trees at a distance and determined to kill him.

sanskrit: भूयस्तु शरमुद्धृत्य कुपितस्तत्र राघवः। सूर्यरश्मिप्रतीकाशं ज्वलन्तमरिमर्दनः।।3.44.13।। सन्धाय सुदृढे चापे विकृष्य बलवद्ब
transliteration: bhūyastu śaramuddhṛtya kupitastatra rāghavḥ| sūryaraśmipratīkāśṃ jvalantamarimardanḥ||3.44.13|| sandhāya sudṛḍhe cāpe vi
meaning: Powerful Rama, destroyer of foes, lifted in a rage his arrow blazing like the light of the Sun, strung it to his sturdy bow and drew it with all his force. He then aimed at the deer and released the shining arrow created

sanskrit: शरीरं मृगरूपस्य विनिर्भिद्य शरोत्तमः।।3.44.15।। मारीचस्यैव हृदयं बिभेदाशनिसन्निभः।
transliteration: śarīrṃ mṛgarūpasya vinirbhidya śarottamḥ||3.44.15|| mārīcasyaiva hṛdayṃ bibhedāśanisannibhḥ|
meaning: The great arrow which was like a thunderbolt first pierced into the body of Maricha who had assumed the form of a deer and then tore his heart.

sanskrit: तालमात्रमथोत्प्लुत्य न्यपतत्सशरातुरः।।3.44.16।। विनदन्भैरवं नादं धरण्यामल्पजीवितः।
transliteration: tālamātramathotplutya nyapatatsaśarāturḥ||3.44.16|| vinadanbhairavṃ nādṃ dharaṇyāmalpajīvitḥ|
meaning: And, hurt by the dart, Maricha roared frighteningly, leaped as high as a palm tree and dropped down on earth almost dead.

sanskrit: म्रियमाणस्तु मारीचो जहौ तां कृत्रिमां तनुम्।।3.44.17।। स्मृत्वा तद्वचनं रक्षो दध्यौ केन तु लक्ष्मणम्। इह प्रस्थापयेत्सीत
transliteration: mriyamāṇastu mārīco jahau tāṃ kṛtrimāṃ tanum||3.44.17|| smṛtvā tadvacanṃ rakṣo dadhyau kena tu lakṣmaṇam| iha prasthāpay
meaning: Maricha gave up his false form of the deer and before breathing his last, remembered the words of Ravana. He thought over the means through which Sita could send Lakshmana to this spot so that Ravana would abduct her whe

sanskrit: स प्राप्तकालमाज्ञाय चकार च तत स्वनम्। सदृशं राघवस्येह हा सीते लक्ष्मणेति च।।3.44.19।।
transliteration: sa prāptakālamājñāya cakāra ca tata svanam| sadṛśṃ rāghavasyeha hā sīte lakṣmaṇeti ca||3.44.19||
meaning: Then Maricha realised that the appropriate time had come. In a voice similar to Rama's, he shouted loudly 'Alas Sita, Alas Lakshmana '

sanskrit: तेन मर्मणि निर्विद्धं शरेणानुपमेन हि। मृगरूपं तु तत्त्यक्त्वा राक्षसं रूपमास्थितः।।3.44.20।। चक्रे स सुमहाकायं मारीचो जी
transliteration: tena marmaṇi nirviddhṃ śareṇānupamena hi| mṛgarūpṃ tu tattyaktvā rākṣasṃ rūpamāsthitḥ||3.44.20|| cakre sa sumahākāyṃ mār
meaning: Struck in the vital part by Rama's matchless dart, Maricha gave up the form of the deer and assumed his huge body of the demon.

sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ राक्षसं घोरदर्शनम्।।3.44.21।। रामो रुधिरसिक्ताङ्गं चेष्टमानं महीतले। जगाम मनसा सीतां लक्ष्मणस्य व
transliteration: tṃ dṛṣṭvā patitṃ bhūmau rākṣasṃ ghoradarśanam||3.44.21|| rāmo rudhirasiktāṅgṃ ceṣṭamānṃ mahītale| jagāma manasā sītāṃ la
meaning: Seeing that terrific demon fallen on the ground, drenched in blood, and strring his limbs, Rama thought of Lakshmana's words and reached Sita mentally (thought of her).

sanskrit: मारीचस्य तु मायैषा पूर्वोक्तं लक्ष्मणेन तु। तत्तथा ह्यभवच्चाद्य मारीचोऽयं मया हतः।।3.44.23।।
transliteration: mārīcasya tu māyaiṣā pūrvoktṃ lakṣmaṇena tu| tattathā hyabhavaccādya mārīco'yṃ mayā hatḥ||3.44.23||
meaning: This is an illusion created by Maricha. It happened exactly the way Lakshmana had said earlier. Maricha is now killed.

sanskrit: हा सीते लक्ष्मणेत्येवमाक्रुश्य च महास्वरम्। ममार राक्षसस्सोऽयं श्रुत्वा सीता कथं भवेत्।।3.44.24।। लक्ष्मणश्च महाबाहुः का
transliteration: hā sīte lakṣmaṇetyevamākruśya ca mahāsvaram| mamāra rākṣasasso'yṃ śrutvā sītā kathṃ bhavet||3.44.24|| lakṣmaṇaśca mahābā
meaning: This demon Maricha screamed aloud saying, 'Alas, Sita, Alas, Lakshmana'. He is now dead. How would Sita react to this voice? What would be the condition of Lakshmana? While righteous Rama reflected on this, his hair stoo

sanskrit: तत्र रामं भयं तीव्रमाविवेश विषादजम्। राक्षसं मृगरूपं तं हत्वा श्रुत्वा च तत्स्वरम्।।3.44.26।।
transliteration: tatra rāmṃ bhayṃ tīvramāviveśa viṣādajam| rākṣasṃ mṛgarūpṃ tṃ hatvā śrutvā ca tatsvaram||3.44.26||
meaning: After killing the demon in the figure of a deer and hearing his voice, Rama was overtaken by intense fear born of despair.

sanskrit: निहत्य पृषतं चान्यं मांसमादाय राघवः। त्वरमाणो जनस्थानं ससाराभिमुखस्तदा।।3.44.27।।
transliteration: nihatya pṛṣatṃ cānyṃ māṃsamādāya rāghavḥ| tvaramāṇo janasthānṃ sasārābhimukhastadā||3.44.27||
meaning: Then Rama killed another deer, collected the venison and hastened to Janasthana. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे चतुश्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the fortyfourth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy

sanskrit: न हि मे हृदयं स्थाने जीवितं वाऽवतिष्ठति। क्रोशतः परमार्तस्य श्रुतश्शब्दो मया भृशम्।।3.45.2।। आक्रन्दमानं तु वने भ्रातरं
transliteration: na hi me hṛdayṃ sthāne jīvitṃ vā'vatiṣṭhati| krośatḥ paramārtasya śrutaśśabdo mayā bhṛśam||3.45.2|| ākrandamānṃ tu vane
meaning: I clearly heard Rama calling out in great distress. Indeed, my heart as well as my life is not in its place (restless). You ought to go and protect your brother who is crying in pain in the forest.

sanskrit: तं क्षिप्रमभिधाव त्वं भ्रातरं शरणैषिणम्।।3.45.3।। रक्षसां वशमापन्नं सिंहानामिव गोवृषम्।
transliteration: tṃ kṣipramabhidhāva tvṃ bhrātarṃ śaraṇaiṣiṇam||3.45.3|| rakṣasāṃ vaśamāpannṃ siṃhānāmiva govṛṣam|
meaning: Like a bull caught by lions, your brother is seeking help caught by demons. You should run at once to your brother.

sanskrit: न जगाम तथोक्तस्तु भ्रातुराज्ञाय शासनम्।।3.45.4।। तमुवाच ततस्तत्र कुपिता जनकात्मजा।
transliteration: na jagāma tathoktastu bhrāturājñāya śāsanam||3.45.4|| tamuvāca tatastatra kupitā janakātmajā|
meaning: When he did not budge in obedience to his brother's order (to protect Sita), the daughter of Janaka in a rage said :

sanskrit: सौमित्रे मित्ररूपेण भ्रातुस्त्वमसि शत्रुवत्।।3.45.5।। यस्त्वमस्यामवस्थायां भ्रातरं नाभिपत्स्यसे।
transliteration: saumitre mitrarūpeṇa bhrātustvamasi śatruvat||3.45.5|| yastvamasyāmavasthāyāṃ bhrātarṃ nābhipatsyase|
meaning: Since you, O son of Sumitra, are not reaching out to your brother in this situation, you are an enemy to your brother in the guise of a friend৷৷

sanskrit: इच्छसि त्वं विनश्यन्तं रामं लक्ष्मण मत्कृते।।3.45.6।। लोभात्त्वं मत्कृते नूनं नानुगच्छसि राघवम्।
transliteration: icchasi tvṃ vinaśyantṃ rāmṃ lakṣmaṇa matkṛte||3.45.6|| lobhāttvṃ matkṛte nūnṃ nānugacchasi rāghavam|
meaning: It is possess me that you wish Rama's death. You do not rush to him certainly because of greed for me.

sanskrit: व्यसनं ते प्रियं मन्ये स्नेहो भ्रातरिनास्तिते।।3.45.7।। तेन तिष्ठसि विश्रब्धंतमपश्यन्महाद्युतिम्।
transliteration: vyasanṃ te priyṃ manye sneho bhrātarināstite||3.45.7|| tena tiṣṭhasi viśrabdhṃtamapaśyanmahādyutim|
meaning: I think Rama's adversity is welcome to you. You do not have any love towards your brother. It is for this that you stand unconcerned instead of proceeding to help your brilliant brother.

sanskrit: किं हि संशयमापन्ने तस्मिन्निह मया भवेत्।।3.45.8।। कर्तव्यमिह तिष्ठन्त्या यत्प्रधानस्त्वमागतः।
transliteration: kiṃ hi sṃśayamāpanne tasminniha mayā bhavet||3.45.8|| kartavyamiha tiṣṭhantyā yatpradhānastvamāgatḥ|
meaning: When he for whose service you have primary come here, has met with difficulty, what is the use of your being here? What purpose you serve by staying here with me ?

sanskrit: इति ब्रुवाणां वैदेहीं बाष्पशोकपरिप्लुताम्।।3.45.9।। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणस्त्रस्तां सीतां मृगवधूमिव।
transliteration: iti bruvāṇāṃ vaidehīṃ bāṣpaśokapariplutām||3.45.9|| abravīllakṣmaṇastrastāṃ sītāṃ mṛgavadhūmiva|
meaning: While Sita thus spoke, flooded with tears of sorrow, frightened like a doe, Lakshmana replied :

sanskrit: पन्नगासुरगन्धर्वदेवमानुषराक्षसैः।।3.45.10।। अशक्यस्तव वैदेहि भर्ता जेतुं न संशयः।
transliteration: pannagāsuragandharvadevamānuṣarākṣasaiḥ||3.45.10|| aśakyastava vaidehi bhartā jetuṃ na sṃśayḥ|
meaning: O Vaidehi there is no doubt that pannagas, asuras, gandharvas, gods, men or even demons cannot defeat him.

sanskrit: देवि देवमनुष्येषु गन्धर्वेषु पतत्रिषु।।3.45.11।। राक्षसेषु पिशाचेषु किन्नरेषु मृगेषु च। दानवेषु च घोरेषु स न विद्येत शोभ
transliteration: devi devamanuṣyeṣu gandharveṣu patatriṣu||3.45.11|| rākṣaseṣu piśāceṣu kinnareṣu mṛgeṣu ca| dānaveṣu ca ghoreṣu sa na vi
meaning: O brilliant Devi none among gods or men, gandharvas, birds or goblins kinnaras, wild animals or dreadful demons can encounter Rama in war.

sanskrit: अवध्यस्समरे रामो नैवं त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि।।3.45.13।। न त्वामस्मिन्वने हातुमुत्सहे राघवं विना।
transliteration: avadhyassamare rāmo naivṃ tvṃ vaktumarhasi||3.45.13|| na tvāmasminvane hātumutsahe rāghavṃ vinā|
meaning: Rama is indestructible in war. It is not proper for you to say what you said. When he is not here I do not wish to leave you alone here in the forest.

sanskrit: अनिवार्यं बलं तस्य बलैर्बलवतामपि।।3.45.14।। त्रिभिर्लोकैस्समुद्युक्तैस्सेश्वरैरपि सामरैः।
transliteration: anivāryṃ balṃ tasya balairbalavatāmapi||3.45.14|| tribhirlokaissamudyuktaisseśvarairapi sāmaraiḥ|
meaning: He cannot be stopped by the strength of the mighty, or by Indra supported by gods or by the wellequipped armies of all the three worlds.

sanskrit: हृदयं निर्वृतं तेऽस्तुसन्तापस्त्यज्यतामयम्।।3.45.15।। आगमिष्यति ते भर्ता श्रीघ्रं हत्वा मृगोत्तमम्।
transliteration: hṛdayṃ nirvṛtṃ te'stusantāpastyajyatāmayam||3.45.15|| āgamiṣyati te bhartā śrīghrṃ hatvā mṛgottamam|
meaning: May your heart be relieved (of this fear) Give up this grief. Your husband will soon return with the excellent deer killed.

sanskrit: न च तस्य स्वरो व्यक्तं मायया केन चित्कृतः। गन्धर्वनगरप्रख्या माया सा तस्य रक्षसः।।3.45.16।।
transliteration: na ca tasya svaro vyaktṃ māyayā kena citkṛtḥ| gandharvanagaraprakhyā māyā sā tasya rakṣasḥ||3.45.16||
meaning: Surely it is not his voice. It is contrived by some one's illusory power. It is the illusion created by that demon, like the city of the gandharvas. (which does not exist.)

sanskrit: न्यासभूतासि वैदेहि न्यस्ता मयि महात्मना।।3.45.17।। रामेण त्वं वरारोहे न त्वां त्यक्तुमिहोत्सहे।
transliteration: nyāsabhūtāsi vaidehi nyastā mayi mahātmanā||3.45.17|| rāmeṇa tvṃ varārohe na tvāṃ tyaktumihotsahe|
meaning: O best of women Vaidehi great Rama has entrusted your safty to me. I do not wish to leave you here alone.

sanskrit: कृतवैराश्च वैदेहि वयमेतैर्निशाचरैः।।3.45.18।। खरस्य निधनादेव जनस्थानवधं प्रति।
transliteration: kṛtavairāśca vaidehi vayametairniśācaraiḥ||3.45.18|| kharasya nidhanādeva janasthānavadhṃ prati|
meaning: O Vaidehi since the killing of Khara and the residents of Janasthana we have developed enmity with the demons.

sanskrit: राक्षसा विविधा वाचो विसृजन्ति महावने।।3.45.19।। हिंसाविहारा वैदेहि न चिन्तयितुमर्हसि।
transliteration: rākṣasā vividhā vāco visṛjanti mahāvane||3.45.19|| hiṃsāvihārā vaidehi na cintayitumarhasi|
meaning: These demons wander about tormenting others and spreading rumours of all kinds. You need not worry about them.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणेनैवमुक्ता सा क्रुद्धा संरक्तलोचना।।3.45.20।। अब्रवीत्परुषं वाक्यं लक्ष्मणं सत्यवादिनम्।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇenaivamuktā sā kruddhā sṃraktalocanā||3.45.20|| abravītparuṣṃ vākyṃ lakṣmaṇṃ satyavādinam|
meaning: Addressed thus by Lakshmana, Sita got mighty angry. Her eyes turned red and she spoke harshly to truthful Lakshmana

sanskrit: अनार्याकरणारम्भ नृशंस कुलपांसन।।3.45.21।। अहं तव प्रियं मन्ये रामस्य व्यसनं महत्।
transliteration: anāryākaraṇārambha nṛśṃsa kulapāṃsana||3.45.21|| ahṃ tava priyṃ manye rāmasya vyasanṃ mahat|
meaning: O ignoble, cruel Lakshmana, you are a disgrace to your family. I think this great disaster of Rama is a pleasure to you.

sanskrit: रामस्य व्यसनं दृष्ट्वा तेनैतानि प्रभाषसे।।3.45.22।। नैतच्चित्रं सपत्नेषु पापं लक्ष्मण यद्भवेत्। त्वद्विधेषु नृशंसेषु नित
transliteration: rāmasya vyasanṃ dṛṣṭvā tenaitāni prabhāṣase||3.45.22|| naitaccitrṃ sapatneṣu pāpṃ lakṣmaṇa yadbhavet| tvadvidheṣu nṛśṃse
meaning: O Lakshmana,do you speak such words seeing the disaster of Rama? No wonder that cruel men who always move like you in disguise will thus resort to sinful action against rivals.

sanskrit: सुदुष्टस्त्वं वने राममेकमेकोऽनुगच्छसि। मम हेतोः प्रतिच्छन्नः प्रयुक्तोभरतेन वा।।3.45.24।।
transliteration: suduṣṭastvṃ vane rāmamekameko'nugacchasi| mama hetoḥ praticchannḥ prayuktobharatena vā||3.45.24||
meaning: You are very wicked. You are hiding your true identity, and employed by Bharata, you are following Rama in the forest as he is alone.

sanskrit: तन्नसिध्यति सौमित्रे तव वा भरतस्य वा। कथमिन्दीवरश्यामं पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणम्।।3.45.25।। उपसंश्रित्य भर्तारं कामयेयं पृथग्जन
transliteration: tannasidhyati saumitre tava vā bharatasya vā| kathamindīvaraśyāmṃ padmapatranibhekṣaṇam||3.45.25|| upasṃśritya bhartārṃ
meaning: O Lakshmana such intention of yours or even of Bharata's will not be fulfilled. I have held the hands of Rama who has eyes like the lotus petal, who has the complexion of the blue lotus. How can I prefer some other man?

sanskrit: समक्षं तव सौमित्रे प्राणांस्त्यक्षे न संशयः। रामं विना क्षणमपि न हि जीवामि भूतले।।3.45.26।।
transliteration: samakṣṃ tava saumitre prāṇāṃstyakṣe na sṃśayḥ| rāmṃ vinā kṣaṇamapi na hi jīvāmi bhūtale||3.45.26||
meaning: I will undoubtedly give up my life in your presence.I will not live even for a moment on earth without Rama, O son of Sumitra

sanskrit: इत्युक्तः परुषं वाक्यं सीतया रोमहर्षणम्।।3.45.27।। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणस्सीतां प्राञ्जलिर्विजितेन्द्रियः।
transliteration: ityuktḥ paruṣṃ vākyṃ sītayā romaharṣaṇam||3.45.27|| abravīllakṣmaṇassītāṃ prāñjalirvijitendriyḥ|
meaning: The selfcontrolled Lakshmana with folded palms replied to Sita's harsh, horripilating words:

sanskrit: उत्तरं नोत्सहे वक्तुं दैवतं भवती मम।।3.45.28।। वाक्यमप्रतिरूपं तु न चित्रं स्त्रीषु मैथिलि। स्वभावस्त्वेष नारीणामेवं लोक
transliteration: uttarṃ notsahe vaktuṃ daivatṃ bhavatī mama||3.45.28|| vākyamapratirūpṃ tu na citrṃ strīṣu maithili| svabhāvastveṣa nārīṇ
meaning: O princess from Mithila, I do not want to use such harsh words. To me you are a deity (worthy of adoration). It is not surprising that women of the world use such undeserving words. It is their nature.

sanskrit: विमुक्तधर्माश्चपलास्तीक्ष्णा भेदकराः स्त्रियः। न सहे हीदृशं वाक्यं वैदेहि जनकात्मजे।।3.45.30।। श्रोत्रयोरुभयोर्मेद्य तप्
transliteration: vimuktadharmāścapalāstīkṣṇā bhedakarāḥ striyḥ| na sahe hīdṛśṃ vākyṃ vaidehi janakātmaje||3.45.30|| śrotrayorubhayormedya
meaning: Women devoid dharma are fickle and inconsistent. They use sharp, piercing words. O daughter of Janaka, O princess from Videha, your words pierce my ears like redhot darts.I cannot tolerate them.

sanskrit: उपशृण्वन्तु मे सर्वे साक्षिभूता वनेचराः।।3.45.31।। न्यायवादी यथान्यायमुक्तोऽहं परुषं त्वया।
transliteration: upaśṛṇvantu me sarve sākṣibhūtā vanecarāḥ||3.45.31|| nyāyavādī yathānyāyamukto'hṃ paruṣṃ tvayā|
meaning: I speak what is just while you use harsh and unjust words. Let all beings who move in the forest bear witness.

sanskrit: धिक्त्वामद्य प्रणश्य त्वं यन्मामेवं विशङ्कसे। स्त्रीत्वलदुष्टं स्वभावेन गुरुवाक्ये व्यवस्थितम्।।3.45.32।।
transliteration: dhiktvāmadya praṇaśya tvṃ yanmāmevṃ viśaṅkase| strītvaladuṣṭṃ svabhāvena guruvākye vyavasthitam||3.45.32||
meaning: Fie upon you. Like a woman of wicked nature you doubt me when I stood firm by my brother's words. You will go to ruin.

sanskrit: गमिष्ये यत्र काकुत्स्थ स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु वरानने।।3.45.33।। रक्षन्तु त्वां विशालाक्षि समग्रा वनदेवताः।
transliteration: gamiṣye yatra kākutstha svasti te'stu varānane||3.45.33|| rakṣantu tvāṃ viśālākṣi samagrā vanadevatāḥ|
meaning: O beautiful lady, I will go to Rama wherever he may be. Be happy. O largeeyed one, may all the deities of the forest protect you.

sanskrit: निमित्तानि च घोराणि यानि प्रादुर्भवन्ति मे।।3.45.34।। अपि त्वां सह रामेण पश्येयं पुनरागतः। न वेत्येतन्न जानामि वैदेहि जन
transliteration: nimittāni ca ghorāṇi yāni prādurbhavanti me||3.45.34|| api tvāṃ saha rāmeṇa paśyeyṃ punarāgatḥ| na vetyetanna jānāmi vai
meaning: O daughter of Janaka O princess from Videha, I see dreadful omens. I do not know whether I will see you when I am back with Rama.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणेनैवमुक्ता सा रुदन्ती जनकात्मजा। प्रत्युवाच ततो वाक्यं तीव्रं बाष्पपरिप्लुता।।3.45.36।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇenaivamuktā sā rudantī janakātmajā| pratyuvāca tato vākyṃ tīvrṃ bāṣpapariplutā||3.45.36||
meaning: At these words of Lakshmana Sita started crying. With eyes filled with tears she replied with harshness :

sanskrit: गोदावरीं प्रवेक्ष्यामि विना रामेण लक्ष्मण। अबन्धिष्येऽथवा त्यक्ष्ये विषमे देहमात्मनः।।3.45.37।।
transliteration: godāvarīṃ pravekṣyāmi vinā rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇa| abandhiṣye'thavā tyakṣye viṣame dehamātmanḥ||3.45.37||
meaning: O Lakshmana without Rama I will drown myself in Godavari or hang myself or leap from a cliff into death.

sanskrit: पिबाम्यहं विषं तीक्ष्णं प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्। न त्वहं राघवादन्यं पदापि पुरुषं स्पृशे।।3.45.38।।
transliteration: pibāmyahṃ viṣṃ tīkṣṇṃ pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam| na tvahṃ rāghavādanyṃ padāpi puruṣṃ spṛśe||3.45.38||
meaning: I will drink deadly poison or enter fire and die, but will not touch any other man even with my feet.

sanskrit: इति लक्ष्मणमाक्रुश्य सीता दुःखसमन्विता। पाणिभ्यां रुदती दुःखादुदरं प्रजघान ह।।3.45.39।।
transliteration: iti lakṣmaṇamākruśya sītā duḥkhasamanvitā| pāṇibhyāṃ rudatī duḥkhādudarṃ prajaghāna ha||3.45.39||
meaning: Thus Sita cried in distress, sadly hitting her belly with both the hands, blaming Lakshmana (all the time).

sanskrit: तामार्तरूपां विमना रुदन्तीं सौमित्रिरालोक्य विशालनेत्राम्। आश्वासयामास न चैव भर्तु स्तं भ्रातरंकिञ्चिदुवाच सीता।।3.45.40
transliteration: tāmārtarūpāṃ vimanā rudantīṃ saumitrirālokya viśālanetrām| āśvāsayāmāsa na caiva bhartu stṃ bhrātarṃkiñciduvāca sītā||3.
meaning: Saumitri saw the largeeyed, dejected Sita crying in distress.He pacified and consoled her but she did not say anything at all to her husband's brother.

sanskrit: तदासाद्य दशग्रीवः क्षिप्रमन्तरमास्थितः। अभिचक्राम वैदेहीं परिव्राजकरूपधृक्।।3.46.2।।
transliteration: tadāsādya daśagrīvḥ kṣipramantaramāsthitḥ| abhicakrāma vaidehīṃ parivrājakarūpadhṛk||3.46.2||
meaning: The tenheaded Ravana who was in hiding assumed the guise of a wandering mendicant and approached Sita.

sanskrit: श्लक्ष्णकाषायसंवीतश्शिखी छत्री उपानही। वामे चांसेऽवसज्याथ शुभे यष्टिकमण्डलू।।3.46.3।। परिव्राजकरूपेण वैदेहीमन्वपद्यत।
transliteration: ślakṣṇakāṣāyasṃvītaśśikhī chatrī upānahī| vāme cāṃse'vasajyātha śubhe yaṣṭikamaṇḍalū||3.46.3|| parivrājakarūpeṇa vaidehī
meaning: And then Ravana wearing fine orange robes, with hair knotted on the head, carrying a parasol, wearing sandals, hanging a kamandalu (waterpot), and a staff on the auspicious left shoulder walked towards Vaidehi like a men

sanskrit: तामाससादातिबलो भ्रातृभ्यां रहितां वने।।3.46.4।। रहितां चन्द्रसूर्याभ्यां सन्ध्यामिव महत्तमः।
transliteration: tāmāsasādātibalo bhrātṛbhyāṃ rahitāṃ vane||3.46.4|| rahitāṃ candrasūryābhyāṃ sandhyāmiva mahattamḥ|
meaning: Mighty Ravana approached Sita deprived of both the brothers, Like darkness encompasses the evening twilight in the absence of the Sun and the Moon.

sanskrit: तामपश्यत्ततो बालां रामपत्नीं यशस्विनीम्।।3.46.5।। रोहिणीं शशिना हीनां ग्रहवद्भृशदारुणः।
transliteration: tāmapaśyattato bālāṃ rāmapatnīṃ yaśasvinīm||3.46.5|| rohiṇīṃ śaśinā hīnāṃ grahavadbhṛśadāruṇḥ|
meaning: The extremely cruel Ravana saw the illustrious young wife of Rama just as Ketu looks at Rohini star in the absence of the Moon.

sanskrit: तमुग्रतेजःकर्माणं जनस्थानरूहा द्रुमाः।।3.46.6।। समीक्ष्य सम्प्रकम्पन्ते न प्रवाति च मारुतः।
transliteration: tamugratejḥkarmāṇṃ janasthānarūhā drumāḥ||3.46.6|| samīkṣya samprakampante na pravāti ca mārutḥ|
meaning: Seeing the ferocious Ravana, the huge trees at Janasthana shook vidently. Even the wind ceased to blow.

sanskrit: शीघ्रस्रोताश्च तं दृष्ट्वा वीक्षन्तं रक्तलोचनम्।।3.46.7।। स्तिमितं गन्तुमारेभे भयाद्गोदावरी नदी।
transliteration: śīghrasrotāśca tṃ dṛṣṭvā vīkṣantṃ raktalocanam||3.46.7|| stimitṃ gantumārebhe bhayādgodāvarī nadī|
meaning: Seeing Ravana with his bloodred eyes, the swiftflowing river Godavari slowed down out of fear.

sanskrit: रामस्य त्वन्तरप्रेप्सुर्दशग्रीवस्तदन्तरे।।3.46.8।। उपतस्थे च वै देहीं भिक्षुरूपेण रावणः।
transliteration: rāmasya tvantaraprepsurdaśagrīvastadantare||3.46.8|| upatasthe ca vai dehīṃ bhikṣurūpeṇa rāvaṇḥ|
meaning: The tenheaded Ravana who was waiting for Rama's absence now got it. Disguised as a mendicant he stepped toward to where Sita was.

sanskrit: अभव्यो भव्यरूपेण भर्तारमनुशोचतीम्।।3.46.9।। अभ्यवर्तत वैदेहीं चित्रामिव शनैश्चरः।
transliteration: abhavyo bhavyarūpeṇa bhartāramanuśocatīm||3.46.9|| abhyavartata vaidehīṃ citrāmiva śanaiścarḥ|
meaning: The evilminded Ravana in the guise of a holy man, like Saturn moves towards Chitra star, came close to Sita who was brooding over her husband.

sanskrit: स पापो भव्यरूपेण तृणैः कूप इवावृतः।।3.46.10।। अतिष्ठत्प्रेक्ष्य वैदेहीं रामपत्निं यशस्विनीम्।
transliteration: sa pāpo bhavyarūpeṇa tṛṇaiḥ kūpa ivāvṛtḥ||3.46.10|| atiṣṭhatprekṣya vaidehīṃ rāmapatniṃ yaśasvinīm|
meaning: Just like a well is concealed by an overgrowth of grass, Ravana guised as a holy man stood looking at illustrious Sita, the wife of Rama.

sanskrit: शुभां रुचिरदन्तोष्ठीं पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम्।।3.46.11।। आसीनां पर्णशालायां बाष्पशोकाभिपीडिताम्। स तां पद्मपलाशाक्षीं पीतकौ
transliteration: śubhāṃ ruciradantoṣṭhīṃ pūrṇacandranibhānanām||3.46.11|| āsīnāṃ parṇaśālāyāṃ bāṣpaśokābhipīḍitām| sa tāṃ padmapalāśākṣīṃ
meaning: The wicked demon came close to that auspicious princess from Videha sitting in the cottage Her face was like the full moon. Her teeth and lips were lovely. She was clad in yellow silk. Her eyes were like lotus petals tor

sanskrit: तामुत्तमां स्त्रियं लोके पद्महीनामिव श्रियम्।।3.46.14।। विभ्राजमानां वपुषा रावणः प्रशशंस ह।
transliteration: tāmuttamāṃ striyṃ loke padmahīnāmiva śriyam||3.46.14|| vibhrājamānāṃ vapuṣā rāvaṇḥ praśaśṃsa ha|
meaning: Sita was the most lovely lady of the world shining in beauty. She was like the goddess of wealth (Laxmi) without her lotus. Ravana praised her thus:

sanskrit: का त्वं काञ्चनवर्णाभे पीतकौशेयवासिनि।।3.46.15।। कमलानां शुभां मालां पद्मिनीव हि बिभ्रती।
transliteration: kā tvṃ kāñcanavarṇābhe pītakauśeyavāsini||3.46.15|| kamalānāṃ śubhāṃ mālāṃ padminīva hi bibhratī|
meaning: Who are you with a golden complexion, clad in yellow silk, and looking like a lotuspond and wearing an auspicious lotus garland?

sanskrit: ह्रीः कीर्तिः श्रीश्शुभा लक्ष्मीरप्सरा वा शुभानने।।3.46.16।। भूतिर्वा त्वं वरारोहे रतिर्वा स्वैरचारिणी।
transliteration: hrīḥ kīrtiḥ śrīśśubhā lakṣmīrapsarā vā śubhānane||3.46.16|| bhūtirvā tvṃ varārohe ratirvā svairacāriṇī|
meaning: O lady with a beautiful face, with lovely thighs, are you 'hri', shyness personified? Are you the auspicious lovely Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth? Are you the goddess of fame? Are you an apsara? Are you Bhuti, the godde

sanskrit: समाश्शिखरिणस्स्निग्धाः पाण्डुरा दशनास्तव।।3.46.17।। विशाले विमले नेत्रे रक्तान्ते कृष्णतारके।
transliteration: samāśśikhariṇassnigdhāḥ pāṇḍurā daśanāstava||3.46.17|| viśāle vimale netre raktānte kṛṣṇatārake|
meaning: Your teeth are even and pointed, white and beautiful.Your eyes are large and clear and sparkling with dark pupils with a red tinge at the corner.

sanskrit: विशालं जघनं पीनमूरू करिकरोपमौ।।3.46.18।। एतावुपचितौ वृत्तौ संहतौ सम्प्रवल्गितौ। पीनोन्नतमुखौ कान्तौ स्निग्धौ तालफलोपमौ।।
transliteration: viśālṃ jaghanṃ pīnamūrū karikaropamau||3.46.18|| etāvupacitau vṛttau sṃhatau sampravalgitau| pīnonnatamukhau kāntau snig
meaning: Your big hips are stout and strong, Your smooth thighs are like the trunk of an elephant, your breasts adorned with gems, are round and robust like palm fruits and drooping with heaviness with projected stiff nipples, sh

sanskrit: चारुस्मिते चारुदति चारुनेत्रे विलासिनि।।3.46.20।। मनो हरसि मे कान्ते नदी कूलमिवाम्भसा। करान्तमितमध्यासि सुकेशी संहतस्तनी
transliteration: cārusmite cārudati cārunetre vilāsini||3.46.20|| mano harasi me kānte nadī kūlamivāmbhasā| karāntamitamadhyāsi sukeśī sṃ
meaning: O lady with an elegant smile, beautiful teeth, lovely eyes you are enticing.Your slender waist can be compassed by my fist.Your hair is beautiful and your large breasts are rubbing against each other.You are capturing my

sanskrit: नैव देवी न गन्धर्वी न यक्षी न च किन्नरी। नैवंरूपा मया नारी दृष्टपूर्वा महीतले।।3.46.22।।
transliteration: naiva devī na gandharvī na yakṣī na ca kinnarī| naivṃrūpā mayā nārī dṛṣṭapūrvā mahītale||3.46.22||
meaning: O beautiful lady I have not seen such a beauty earlier either among goddesses or among gandharavis, or yakshis or even among kinneris.

sanskrit: रूपमग्र्यं च लोकेषु सौकुमार्यं वयश्चते। इह वासश्च कान्तारे चित्तमुन्मादयन्ति मे।।3.46.23।।
transliteration: rūpamagryṃ ca lokeṣu saukumāryṃ vayaścate| iha vāsaśca kāntāre cittamunmādayanti me||3.46.23||
meaning: You are the most beautiful among women in the world. With all your tenderness and youth you are living in this forlorn forest. This maddens my heart.

sanskrit: सा प्रतिक्राम भद्रं ते नैवं वस्तुमिहार्हसि। राक्षसानामयं वासो घोराणां कामरूपिणाम्।।3.46.24।।
transliteration: sā pratikrāma bhadrṃ te naivṃ vastumihārhasi| rākṣasānāmayṃ vāso ghorāṇāṃ kāmarūpiṇām||3.46.24||
meaning: It is not safe for a lady like you to reside here. Move out at once. This is only fit for the dwelling of horrible demons who can change their form at will.

sanskrit: प्रासादाग्राणि रम्याणि नगरोपवनानि च। सम्पन्नानि सुगन्धीनि युक्तान्याचरितुं त्वया।।3.46.25।।
transliteration: prāsādāgrāṇi ramyāṇi nagaropavanāni ca| sampannāni sugandhīni yuktānyācarituṃ tvayā||3.46.25||
meaning: You deserve to stroll in the terraces of palaces, in beautiful, luxurious and fragrant city gardens.

sanskrit: वरं माल्यं वरं भोज्यं वरं वस्त्रं च शोभने। भर्तारं च वरं मन्ये त्वद्युक्तमसितेक्षणे।।3.46.26।।
transliteration: varṃ mālyṃ varṃ bhojyṃ varṃ vastrṃ ca śobhane| bhartārṃ ca varṃ manye tvadyuktamasitekṣaṇe||3.46.26||
meaning: O beautiful, blackeyed lady, I think you deserve the best of garlands, best of food, and clothes and a suitable husband.

sanskrit: का त्वं भवसि रुद्राणां मरुतां वा वरानने। वसूनां वा वरावोहे देवता प्रतिभासि मे।।3.46.27।।
transliteration: kā tvṃ bhavasi rudrāṇāṃ marutāṃ vā varānane| vasūnāṃ vā varāvohe devatā pratibhāsi me||3.46.27||
meaning: O best of women O lady with beautiful buttocks can you be one of the Rudras or Maruts or Vasus? To me, you appear like a goddess.

sanskrit: नेह गच्छन्ति गन्धर्वा न देवा न च किन्नराः। राक्षसानामयं वासः कथं नु त्वमिहागता।।3.46.28।।
transliteration: neha gacchanti gandharvā na devā na ca kinnarāḥ| rākṣasānāmayṃ vāsḥ kathṃ nu tvamihāgatā||3.46.28||
meaning: Neither gandharvas, nor kinnaras, nor gods move here. This is only a dwelling place for the demons. How did you come here ?

sanskrit: इह शाखामृगास्सिंहा द्वीपिव्याघ्रमृगास्तथा। ऋक्षास्तरक्षवः कङ्काः कथं तेभ्यो न बिभ्यसि।।3.46.29।।
transliteration: iha śākhāmṛgāssiṃhā dvīpivyāghramṛgāstathā| ṛkṣāstarakṣavḥ kaṅkāḥ kathṃ tebhyo na bibhyasi||3.46.29||
meaning: There are monkeys, lions, panthers, tigers, hyenas, bears, kanka birds and other wild animals here. How is it that you are not afraid of them?

sanskrit: मदान्वितानां घोराणां कुञ्जराणां तरस्विनाम्। कथमेका महारण्ये न बिभेषि वरानने।।3.46.30।।
transliteration: madānvitānāṃ ghorāṇāṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ tarasvinām| kathamekā mahāraṇye na bibheṣi varānane||3.46.30||
meaning: O Charming lady how is it that although alone you are not afraid of the dreadful, swift, powerful wild animals like elephants in rut ?

sanskrit: कासि कस्य कुतश्चित्त्वं किं निमित्तं च दण्डकान्। एका चरसि कल्याणि घोरान्राक्षससेवितान्।।3.46.31।।
transliteration: kāsi kasya kutaścittvṃ kiṃ nimittṃ ca daṇḍakān| ekā carasi kalyāṇi ghorānrākṣasasevitān||3.46.31||
meaning: Who are you, O auspicious lady ? Who are your people? Why are you here? From where have you come? For what reason are you going about alone in this fierce Dandaka tract, inhabited by demons?

sanskrit: इति प्रशस्ता वैदेही रावणेन दुरात्मना। द्विजातिवेशेण हि तं दृष्ट्वा रावणमागतम्।।3.46.32।। सर्वैरतिथिसत्कारैः पूजयामास मैथ
transliteration: iti praśastā vaidehī rāvaṇena durātmanā| dvijātiveśeṇa hi tṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇamāgatam||3.46.32|| sarvairatithisatkāraiḥ pūja
meaning: Seeing Ravana, a villain in the guise of a brahmin praising her, Sita, the princess of Videha, honoured him with all hospitality.

sanskrit: उपनीयासनं पूर्वं पाद्येनाभिनिमन्त्र्य च।।3.46.33।। अब्रवीत्सिद्धमित्येव तदा तं सौम्यदर्शनम्।
transliteration: upanīyāsanṃ pūrvṃ pādyenābhinimantrya ca||3.46.33|| abravītsiddhamityeva tadā tṃ saumyadarśanam|
meaning: She offered the handsome guest a seat first and then water for washing his feet with, and then invited him for food.

sanskrit: द्विजातिवेषेण समीक्ष्य मैथिली समागतं पात्रकुसुम्भधारिणम्। अशक्यमुद्वेष्टुमपायदर्शनम् न्यमन्त्रयद्ब्राह्मणवत्तदाङ्गना।।3.
transliteration: dvijātiveṣeṇa samīkṣya maithilī samāgatṃ pātrakusumbhadhāriṇam| aśakyamudveṣṭumapāyadarśanam nyamantrayadbrāhmaṇavattadā
meaning: Sita, being a lady, was unable to doubt him since he came in the guise of a brahmin, holding a bottlegourd and a begging bowl. Without knowing his illintention she invited him in, mistaking him for a brahmin.

sanskrit: इयं बृसी ब्राह्मण काममास्यतामिदं च पाद्यं प्रतिगृह्यतामिति। इदं च सिद्धं वनजातमुत्तमं त्वदर्थमव्यग्रमिहोपभुज्यताम्।।3.46
transliteration: iyṃ bṛsī brāhmaṇa kāmamāsyatāmidṃ ca pādyṃ pratigṛhyatāmiti| idṃ ca siddhṃ vanajātamuttamṃ tvadarthamavyagramihopabhujya
meaning: O brahmin, here is the seat for you. Feel free to sit. Here is water to wash your feet with. This is the best of food for you collected from the forest. Please partake this without hesitation.

sanskrit: निमन्त्र्यमाणः प्रतिपूर्णभाषिणीं नरेन्द्रपत्नीं प्रसमीक्ष्य मैथिलीम्। प्रसह्य तस्याहरणे धृतं मनः समर्पयत्स्वात्मवधाय राव
transliteration: nimantryamāṇḥ pratipūrṇabhāṣiṇīṃ narendrapatnīṃ prasamīkṣya maithilīm| prasahya tasyāharaṇe dhṛtṃ manḥ samarpayatsvātmav
meaning: Ravana was observing the princess from Mithila, wife of a king inviting him and speaking to him in cordial manner. Looking at her, he resolved to abduct her forcibly, inviting his own death.

sanskrit: ततः सुवेषं मृगयागतं पतिं प्रतीक्षमाणा सहलक्ष्मणं तदा। विवीक्षमाणा हरितं ददर्श तन्महद्वनं नैव तु रामलक्ष्णौ।।3.46.37।।
transliteration: tatḥ suveṣṃ mṛgayāgatṃ patiṃ pratīkṣamāṇā sahalakṣmaṇṃ tadā| vivīkṣamāṇā haritṃ dadarśa tanmahadvanṃ naiva tu rāmalakṣṇa
meaning: Sita looked out for the beautiful figure of Rama who had gone to hunt the deer along with Lakshmana. Waiting eagerly for her husband, she only saw the vast stretch of green forest but not Rama and Lakshmana. इत्यार्षे श्

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणश्चातिथिश्चायमनुक्तो हि शपेत माम्। इति ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं तु सीता वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.47.2।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇaścātithiścāyamanukto hi śapeta mām| iti dhyātvā muhūrtṃ tu sītā vacanamabravīt||3.47.2||
meaning: 'He is a brahmin and also a guest. If unanswered he may curse me'. Thinking this Sita thought for a moment and said:

sanskrit: दुहिता जनकस्याहं मैथिलस्य महात्मनः। सीता नाम्नास्मि भद्रं ते रामभार्या द्विजोत्तम।।3.47.3।।
transliteration: duhitā janakasyāhṃ maithilasya mahātmanḥ| sītā nāmnāsmi bhadrṃ te rāmabhāryā dvijottama||3.47.3||
meaning: O best of brahmins be pleased to know I am Sita by name, daughter of the great Janaka, king of Mithila and wife of Rama.

sanskrit: उषित्वा द्वादश समा इक्ष्वाकुणां निवेशने। भुञ्जाना मानुषान्भोगान्सर्वकामसमृद्धिनी।।3.47.4।।
transliteration: uṣitvā dvādaśa samā ikṣvākuṇāṃ niveśane| bhuñjānā mānuṣānbhogānsarvakāmasamṛddhinī||3.47.4||
meaning: I lived in the house of the Ikshvakus for twelve years and enjoyed all kinds of pleasures meant for mortals.

sanskrit: ततस्त्रयोदशे वर्षे राजामन्त्रयत प्रभुः। अभिषेचयितुं रामं समेतो राजमन्त्रिभिः।।3.47.5।।
transliteration: tatastrayodaśe varṣe rājāmantrayata prabhuḥ| abhiṣecayituṃ rāmṃ sameto rājamantribhiḥ||3.47.5||
meaning: In the thirteenth year, the king and lord Dasaratha consulted other kings and ministers to consecrate Rama.

sanskrit: तस्मिन्सम्भ्रियमाणे तु राघवस्याभिषेचने। कैकेयी नाम भर्तारमार्या सा याचते वरम्।।3.47.6।।
transliteration: tasminsambhriyamāṇe tu rāghavasyābhiṣecane| kaikeyī nāma bhartāramāryā sā yācate varam||3.47.6||
meaning: Arrangements for consecration were on when queen Kaikeyi sought a boon from the king.

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य तु कैकेयी श्वशुरं सुकृतेन मे। मम प्रव्राजनं भर्तुर्भरतस्याभिषेचनम्।।3.47.7।। द्वावयाचत भर्तारं सत्यसन्धं नृपो
transliteration: pratigṛhya tu kaikeyī śvaśurṃ sukṛtena me| mama pravrājanṃ bharturbharatasyābhiṣecanam||3.47.7|| dvāvayācata bhartārṃ sa
meaning: For the fulfilment of the promise made to Kaikeyi earlier by my truthful fatherin law, who, to my good luck, was the best of kings, she asked for two boons. One was banishment of my husband and second, consecration of Bh

sanskrit: नाद्य भोक्ष्ये न च स्वप्स्ये न पास्येच कथञ्चन।।3.47.8।। एष मे जीवितस्यान्तो रामो यद्यभिषिच्यते।
transliteration: nādya bhokṣye na ca svapsye na pāsyeca kathañcana||3.47.8|| eṣa me jīvitasyānto rāmo yadyabhiṣicyate|
meaning: 'I shall not eat, or sleep or even drink if Rama is consecrated and I shall put an end to my life itself' (said Kaikeyi).

sanskrit: इति ब्रुवाणां कैकेयीं श्वशुरो मे स मानदः।।3.47.9।। अयाचतार्थैरन्वर्थैर्न च याञ्चां चकार सा।
transliteration: iti bruvāṇāṃ kaikeyīṃ śvaśuro me sa mānadḥ||3.47.9|| ayācatārthairanvarthairna ca yāñcāṃ cakāra sā|
meaning: The king, my fatherinlaw, who respected her offered riches. Which she did not accept.
