sanskrit: मम भर्तामहातेजा वयसा पञ्चविंशकः।।3.47.10।। अष्टादश हि वर्षाणि मम जन्मनि गण्यते।
transliteration: mama bhartāmahātejā vayasā pañcaviṃśakḥ||3.47.10|| aṣṭādaśa hi varṣāṇi mama janmani gaṇyate|
meaning: My husband who was very bold was twentyfive years and I had completed eighteen years since my birth.

sanskrit: रामेति प्रथितो लोके गुणवान्सत्यवान्शुचिः।।3.47.11।। विशालाक्षो महाबाहुस्सर्वभूतहिते रतः।
transliteration: rāmeti prathito loke guṇavānsatyavānśuciḥ||3.47.11|| viśālākṣo mahābāhussarvabhūtahite ratḥ|
meaning: My husband known in the world as Rama is largeeyed, longarmed, virtuous, truthful, pure and is always engaged in the welfare of all beings.

sanskrit: कामार्तस्तु महातेजाः पिता दशरथस्स्वयम्।।3.47.12।। कैकेय्याः प्रियकामार्थं तं रामं नाभ्यषेचयत्।
transliteration: kāmārtastu mahātejāḥ pitā daśarathassvayam||3.47.12|| kaikeyyāḥ priyakāmārthṃ tṃ rāmṃ nābhyaṣecayat|
meaning: The brilliant king, Dasaratha, father of Rama, overcome by passion, did not consecrate Rama in order to please Kaikeyi.

sanskrit: अभिषेकाय तु पितुस्समीपं राममागतम्।।3.47.13।। कैकेयी मम भर्तारमित्युवाच धृतं वचः।
transliteration: abhiṣekāya tu pitussamīpṃ rāmamāgatam||3.47.13|| kaikeyī mama bhartāramityuvāca dhṛtṃ vacḥ|
meaning: When my husband Rama approached his father for the consecration she said these unhesitating words:

sanskrit: तव पित्रा समाज्ञप्तं ममेदं शृणु राघव।।3.47.14।। भरताय प्रदातव्यमिदं राज्यमकण्टकम्।
transliteration: tava pitrā samājñaptṃ mamedṃ śṛṇu rāghava||3.47.14|| bharatāya pradātavyamidṃ rājyamakaṇṭakam|
meaning: 'O Rama, listen, your father has ordered that this kingdom be bestowed on Bharata without any obstacles.

sanskrit: त्वया हि खलु वस्तव्यं नव वर्षाणि पञ्च च।।3.47.15।। वने प्रव्रज काकुत्स्थ पितरं मोचयानृतान्।
transliteration: tvayā hi khalu vastavyṃ nava varṣāṇi pañca ca||3.47.15|| vane pravraja kākutstha pitarṃ mocayānṛtān|
meaning: 'O Rama of the Kakutstha dynasty, you should live in the forest for fourteen years and save your father from falsehood'.

sanskrit: तथेत्युक्त्वा च तां रामः कैकेयीमकुतोभयः।।3.47.16।। चकार तद्वचस्तस्या मम भर्ता दृढव्रतः।
transliteration: tathetyuktvā ca tāṃ rāmḥ kaikeyīmakutobhayḥ||3.47.16|| cakāra tadvacastasyā mama bhartā dṛḍhavratḥ|
meaning: My husband Rama, a man of fearlessness and firm resolution, said to Kaikeyi 'Be it so' and carried out her words.

sanskrit: दद्यान्न प्रतिगृह्णीयात्सत्यं ब्रूयान्न चानृतम्।।3.47.17।। एतद्ब्राह्मण रामस्य ध्रृवं व्रतमनुत्तमम्।
transliteration: dadyānna pratigṛhṇīyātsatyṃ brūyānna cānṛtam||3.47.17|| etadbrāhmaṇa rāmasya dhrṛvṃ vratamanuttamam|
meaning: O brahmin this is his firm resolve and his great vow: 'One should give and never take one should speak the truth and nothing but he truth.'

sanskrit: तस्य भ्राता तु द्वैमात्रो लक्ष्मणो नाम वीर्यवान्।।3.47.18।। रामस्य पुरुषव्याघ्रस्सहायस्समरेरिहा।
transliteration: tasya bhrātā tu dvaimātro lakṣmaṇo nāma vīryavān||3.47.18|| rāmasya puruṣavyāghrassahāyassamarerihā|
meaning: Son to the second mother of Rama, his mighty halfbrother, by name, Lakshmana, a tiger among men and a slayer of enemies in battle is a companion to him.

sanskrit: स भ्राता लक्ष्मणो नाम धर्मचारी दृढव्रतः।।3.47.19।। अन्वगच्छद्दनुष्पाणिः प्रव्रजन्तं मया सह।
transliteration: sa bhrātā lakṣmaṇo nāma dharmacārī dṛḍhavratḥ||3.47.19|| anvagacchaddanuṣpāṇiḥ pravrajantṃ mayā saha|
meaning: Lakshmana, his brother, is righteous and steadfast. Bow in hand, he followed Rama along with me, into exile.

sanskrit: जटी तापसरूपेण मया सह सहानुजः।।3.47.20।। प्रविष्टो दण्डकारण्यं धर्मनित्यो जितेन्द्रियः।
transliteration: jaṭī tāpasarūpeṇa mayā saha sahānujḥ||3.47.20|| praviṣṭo daṇḍakāraṇyṃ dharmanityo jitendriyḥ|
meaning: Rama who is ever righteous and selfcontrolled entered the Dandaka forest with matted locks, his brother and me.

sanskrit: ते वयं प्रच्युता राज्यात्कैकेय्यास्तु कृते त्रयः।।3.47.21।। विचरामो द्विजश्रेष्ठ वनं गम्भीरमोजसा।
transliteration: te vayṃ pracyutā rājyātkaikeyyāstu kṛte trayḥ||3.47.21|| vicarāmo dvijaśreṣṭha vanṃ gambhīramojasā|
meaning: O best of brahmins three of us have been wandering with courage in the deep forest, dislodged from the kingdom on account of Kaikeyi.

sanskrit: समाश्वस मुहूर्तं तु शक्यं वस्तुमिह त्वया।।3.47.22।। आगमिष्यति मे भर्ता वन्यमादाय पुष्कलम्। रुरून्गोधा न्वराहांश्च हत्वाऽ
transliteration: samāśvasa muhūrtṃ tu śakyṃ vastumiha tvayā||3.47.22|| āgamiṣyati me bhartā vanyamādāya puṣkalam| rurūngodhā nvarāhāṃśca
meaning: Rest here awhile. My husband will return with plenty of meat of many kinds from the forest, killing deer, alligators and wild boars.

sanskrit: स त्वं नाम च गोत्रञ्च कुलं चाचक्ष्व तत्त्वतः। एकश्च दण्डकारण्ये किमर्थं चरसि द्विज।।3.47.24।।
transliteration: sa tvṃ nāma ca gotrañca kulṃ cācakṣva tattvatḥ| ekaśca daṇḍakāraṇye kimarthṃ carasi dvija||3.47.24||
meaning: O brahmin, tell me your name, your gotra and your pedigree. And the purpose for which you are going about all alone in this Dandaka forest

sanskrit: एवं बृवन्त्यां सीतायां रामपत्न्यां महाबलः। प्रत्युवाचोत्तरं तीव्रं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः।।3.47.25।।
transliteration: evṃ bṛvantyāṃ sītāyāṃ rāmapatnyāṃ mahābalḥ| pratyuvācottarṃ tīvrṃ rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipḥ||3.47.25||
meaning: To these words of Sita, Rama's wife, Ravana, the powerful king of demons, replied sharp:

sanskrit: येन वित्रासिता लोकास्सदेवासुरपन्नगाः। अहं तु रावणो नाम सीते रक्षोगणेश्वरः।।3.47.26।।
transliteration: yena vitrāsitā lokāssadevāsurapannagāḥ| ahṃ tu rāvaṇo nāma sīte rakṣogaṇeśvarḥ||3.47.26||
meaning: O Sita I am called Ravana, the lord of demons by whom all the worlds of demons, snakes and gods are frightened.

sanskrit: त्वां तु काञ्चनवर्णाभां दृष्ट्वा कौशेयवासिनीम्। रतिं स्वकेषु दारेषु नाधिगच्छाम्यनिन्दिते।।3.47.27।।
transliteration: tvāṃ tu kāñcanavarṇābhāṃ dṛṣṭvā kauśeyavāsinīm| ratiṃ svakeṣu dāreṣu nādhigacchāmyanindite||3.47.27||
meaning: O flawless beauty of golden complexion seeing you clad in silk, I am not inclined to show any interest in my own wives.

sanskrit: बह्वीनामुत्तमस्त्रीणामाहृतानामितस्ततः। सर्वासामेव भद्रं ते ममाग्रमहिषी भव।।3.47.28।।
transliteration: bahvīnāmuttamastrīṇāmāhṛtānāmitastatḥ| sarvāsāmeva bhadrṃ te mamāgramahiṣī bhava||3.47.28||
meaning: You will be the chief queen among the best of women I have won in wars. Be blessed.

sanskrit: लङ्कानाम समुद्रस्य मम मध्ये महापुरी। सागरेण परिक्षिस्ता निविष्टा नगमूर्धनि।।3.47.29।।
transliteration: laṅkānāma samudrasya mama madhye mahāpurī| sāgareṇa parikṣistā niviṣṭā nagamūrdhani||3.47.29||
meaning: My great city called Lanka is on the peak of a mountain surrounded by, and in the middle of, the sea.

sanskrit: तत्र सीते मया सार्धं वनेषु विहरिष्यसि। न चास्यारण्यवासस्य स्पृहयिष्यसि भामिनि।।3.47.30।।
transliteration: tatra sīte mayā sārdhṃ vaneṣu vihariṣyasi| na cāsyāraṇyavāsasya spṛhayiṣyasi bhāmini||3.47.30||
meaning: O Sita, you can stroll with me in my pleasuregardens. O beautiful lady, you will not like living in the forest (thereafter).

sanskrit: पञ्च दास्यस्सहस्राणि सर्वाभरणभूषिताः। सीते परिचरिष्यन्ति भार्या भवसि मे यदि।।3.47.31।।
transliteration: pañca dāsyassahasrāṇi sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ| sīte paricariṣyanti bhāryā bhavasi me yadi||3.47.31||
meaning: O Sita if you become my wife, five thousand female attendants adorned with all ornaments will attend on you.

sanskrit: रावणेनैवमुक्ता तु कुपिता जनकात्मजा। प्रत्युवाचानवद्याङ्गी तमनादृत्य राक्षसम्।।3.47.32।।
transliteration: rāvaṇenaivamuktā tu kupitā janakātmajā| pratyuvācānavadyāṅgī tamanādṛtya rākṣasam||3.47.32||
meaning: Thus addressed by Ravana, Janaki, a lady of blemishless limbs, got enraged and replied without caring for the demon:

sanskrit: महागिरिमिवाकम्प्यं महेन्द्रसदृशं पतिम्। महोदधिमिवाक्षोभ्यमहं राममनुव्रता।।3.47.33।।
transliteration: mahāgirimivākampyṃ mahendrasadṛśṃ patim| mahodadhimivākṣobhyamahṃ rāmamanuvratā||3.47.33||
meaning: I am devoted to Rama, my husband, who is unshakeable like a huge mountain, is comparable to lord Indra and is imperturbable like the mighty ocean.

sanskrit: सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नं न्यग्रोधपरिमण्डलम्। सत्यसन्धं महाभागमहं राममनुव्रता।।3.47.34।।
transliteration: sarvalakṣaṇasampannṃ nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalam| satyasandhṃ mahābhāgamahṃ rāmamanuvratā||3.47.34||
meaning: I am the loyal wife of venerable Rama who is endowed with all excellences, a refuge to all like a spreading banyan tree, and a votary of truth.

sanskrit: महाबाहुं महोरस्कं सिंहविक्रान्तगामिनम्। नृसिंहं सिंहसङ्काशमहं राममनुव्रता।।3.47.35।।
transliteration: mahābāhuṃ mahoraskṃ siṃhavikrāntagāminam| nṛsiṃhṃ siṃhasaṅkāśamahṃ rāmamanuvratā||3.47.35||
meaning: I am the faithful wife of the longarmed, broadchested Rama, a lion among men. His gait is the gait of an advancing, invincible lion.

sanskrit: पूर्णचन्द्राननं रामं राजवत्सं जितेन्द्रियम्। पृथुकीर्तिं महात्मानमहं राममनुव्रता।।3.47.36।।
transliteration: pūrṇacandrānanṃ rāmṃ rājavatsṃ jitendriyam| pṛthukīrtiṃ mahātmānamahṃ rāmamanuvratā||3.47.36||
meaning: I am the devoted wife of great Rama, whose face is like a fullmoon, who is the son of a king, who has conquered his senses and whose fame is widespread (on earth).

sanskrit: त्वं पुनर्जम्बुकस्सिंहीं मामिच्छसि सुदुर्लभाम्। नाहं शक्या त्वया स्प्रष्टुमादित्यस्य प्रभा यथा।।3.47.37।।
transliteration: tvṃ punarjambukassiṃhīṃ māmicchasi sudurlabhām| nāhṃ śakyā tvayā spraṣṭumādityasya prabhā yathā||3.47.37||
meaning: You are a jackal, and you want a lioness like me who is difficult to win. I am like the Sun's radiance whom you cannot even touch.

sanskrit: पादपान्काञ्चनान्नूनं बहून्पश्यसि मन्दभाक्। राघपस्य प्रियां भार्यां यस्त्वमिच्छसि रावण।।3.47.38।।
transliteration: pādapānkāñcanānnūnṃ bahūnpaśyasi mandabhāk| rāghapasya priyāṃ bhāryāṃ yastvamicchasi rāvaṇa||3.47.38||
meaning: O luckless Ravana you want the beloved wife of Rama.You will, for sure, see golden trees. (which those close to death do).

sanskrit: क्षुधितस्य हि सिंहस्य मृगशत्रोस्तरस्विनः। आशीविषस्य मुखाद्दंष्ट्रामादातुमिच्छसि।।3.47.39।।
transliteration: kṣudhitasya hi siṃhasya mṛgaśatrostarasvinḥ| āśīviṣasya mukhāddṃṣṭrāmādātumicchasi||3.47.39||
meaning: You are seeking to pull the teeth from the mouth of a hungry and powerful lion who is considered the enemy of the deer(which you are). You intend to pull the fang of a poisonous snake.

sanskrit: मन्दरं पर्वतश्रेष्ठं पाणिना हर्तुमिच्छसि। कालकूटं विषं पीत्वा स्वस्तिमान्गन्तुमिच्छसि।।3.47.40।।
transliteration: mandarṃ parvataśreṣṭhṃ pāṇinā hartumicchasi| kālakūṭṃ viṣṃ pītvā svastimāngantumicchasi||3.47.40||
meaning: You are trying to carry the greatest of mountains, the Mandara, with one hand. You are wishing to go safe after drinking deadly poison (produced from the churning of the ocean).

sanskrit: अक्षि सूच्या प्रमृजसि जिह्वया लेक्षि च क्षुरम्। राघवस्य प्रियां भार्यां योऽधिगन्तुं त्वमिच्छसि।।3.47.41।।
transliteration: akṣi sūcyā pramṛjasi jihvayā lekṣi ca kṣuram| rāghavasya priyāṃ bhāryāṃ yo'dhigantuṃ tvamicchasi||3.47.41||
meaning: You wish to violate the loving wife of Rama. You are rubbing your eyes with a needle and licking the razor with your tongue.

sanskrit: अवसज्य शिलां कण्ठे समुद्रं तर्तुमिच्छसि। सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ चोभौ पाणिभ्यां हर्तुमिच्छसि।।3.47.42।। यो रामस्य प्रियां भार्या
transliteration: avasajya śilāṃ kaṇṭhe samudrṃ tartumicchasi| sūryācandramasau cobhau pāṇibhyāṃ hartumicchasi||3.47.42|| yo rāmasya priyā
meaning: You want to assault Rama's dear wife. It is like girding a stone round the neck and trying to cross the sea.It is like intending to take the Sun and the Moon with both your hands.

sanskrit: अग्निं प्रज्वलितं दृष्ट्वा वस्त्रेणाहर्तुमिच्छसि।।3.47.43।। काल्याणवृत्तां रामस्य यो भार्यांहर्तुमिच्छसि।
transliteration: agniṃ prajvalitṃ dṛṣṭvā vastreṇāhartumicchasi||3.47.43|| kālyāṇavṛttāṃ rāmasya yo bhāryāṃhartumicchasi|
meaning: You intend to assaut the wife of Rama, who is a lady of virtuous conduct. You wish to hold blazing fire in your cloth.

sanskrit: अयोमुखानां शूलानामग्रे चरितुमिच्छसि।।3.47.44।। रामस्य सदृशीं भार्यां योऽधिगन्तुं त्वमिच्छसि।
transliteration: ayomukhānāṃ śūlānāmagre caritumicchasi||3.47.44|| rāmasya sadṛśīṃ bhāryāṃ yo'dhigantuṃ tvamicchasi|
meaning: You want to acquire Rama's worthy wife. You wish to walk on sharp ironheaded spear.

sanskrit: यदन्तरं सिंहशृगालयोर्वने यदन्तरं स्यन्दिनिका समुद्रयोः। सुराग्र्य सौवीरकयोर्यदन्तरं तदन्तरं वै तव राघवस्य च।।3.47.45।।
transliteration: yadantarṃ siṃhaśṛgālayorvane yadantarṃ syandinikā samudrayoḥ| surāgrya sauvīrakayoryadantarṃ tadantarṃ vai tava rāghavas
meaning: The difference between you and Rama is the difference between a jackal and a lion in the forest, between a ditch and the sea, and between sour gruel and the best of wines.

sanskrit: यदन्तरं काञ्चनसीसलोहयोर्यदन्तरं चन्दनवारिपङ्कयोः। यदन्तरं हस्तिबिडालयोर्वने तदन्तरं दाशरथेस्तवैव च।।3.47.46।।
transliteration: yadantarṃ kāñcanasīsalohayoryadantarṃ candanavāripaṅkayoḥ| yadantarṃ hastibiḍālayorvane tadantarṃ dāśarathestavaiva ca||
meaning: The difference between you and Rama is the difference between gold and lead, sandal and slime, an elephant and a cat of the forest.

sanskrit: यदन्तरं वायसवैनतेययोर्यदन्तरं मद्गुमयूरयोरपि। यदन्तरं सारसगृध्रयोर्वने तदन्तरं दाशरथेस्तवैव च।।3.47.47।।
transliteration: yadantarṃ vāyasavainateyayoryadantarṃ madgumayūrayorapi| yadantarṃ sārasagṛdhrayorvane tadantarṃ dāśarathestavaiva ca||3
meaning: The difference between you and Dasaratha's son is the difference between a crow and Garuda, a watercrane and a peacock, a vulture and a swan in the forest.

sanskrit: तस्मिन्सहस्राक्षसमप्रभावे रामे स्थिते कार्मुकबाणपाणौ। हृतापि तेहं न जरां गमिष्ये वज्रं यथा मक्षिकयावगीर्णम्।।3.47.48।।
transliteration: tasminsahasrākṣasamaprabhāve rāme sthite kārmukabāṇapāṇau| hṛtāpi tehṃ na jarāṃ gamiṣye vajrṃ yathā makṣikayāvagīrṇam||3
meaning: So long Rama, equal in prowess to the thousandeyed Indra stands with bow and arrows in hand, I will not, although abducted, wither away like a diamond gulped by an insect (fly).

sanskrit: इतीव तद्वाक्यमदुष्टभावा सुदुष्टमुक्त्वा रजनीचरं तम्। गात्रप्रकम्पाद्व्यथिता बभूव वातोद्धता सा कदलीव तन्वी।।3.47.49।।
transliteration: itīva tadvākyamaduṣṭabhāvā suduṣṭamuktvā rajanīcarṃ tam| gātraprakampādvyathitā babhūva vātoddhatā sā kadalīva tanvī||3.
meaning: Having said thus to the wicked nightwalker Ravana, Sita, pure in thought remained distressed.Her slender body started trembling like a banana plant becomes shaken by a violent wind.

sanskrit: तां वेपमानामुपलक्ष्य सीतां स रावणो मृत्युसमप्रभावः। कुलं बलं नाम च कर्म चात्मनः समाचचक्षे भयकारणार्थम्।।3.47.50।।
transliteration: tāṃ vepamānāmupalakṣya sītāṃ sa rāvaṇo mṛtyusamaprabhāvḥ| kulṃ balṃ nāma ca karma cātmanḥ samācacakṣe bhayakāraṇārtham||
meaning: Beholding Sita who was trembling, Ravana, powerful like death, started telling about himself, his clan, his strength and his deeds to instil more fear in her. इत्तयार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्

sanskrit: भ्राता वैश्रवणस्याहं सापत्न्यो वरवर्णिनि। रावणो नाम भद्रं ते दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्।।3.48.2।।
transliteration: bhrātā vaiśravaṇasyāhṃ sāpatnyo varavarṇini| rāvaṇo nāma bhadrṃ te daśagrīvḥ pratāpavān||3.48.2||
meaning: O paragon of beauty I am the halfbrother of Kubera, born of his stepmother. I am known as the tenheaded, powerful Ravana. Be blessed

sanskrit: यस्य देवास्सगन्धर्वाः पिशाचपतगोरगाः। विद्रवन्ति भयाद्भीता मृत्योरिव सदा प्रजाः।।3.48.3।।
transliteration: yasya devāssagandharvāḥ piśācapatagoragāḥ| vidravanti bhayādbhītā mṛtyoriva sadā prajāḥ||3.48.3||
meaning: Just as people get scared of death, all (creatures) including gandharvas, gods, evil spirits, birds and snakes run away from me.

sanskrit: येन वैश्रवणो राजा द्वैमात्रः कारणान्तरे। द्वन्द्वमासादितः क्रोधाद्रणे विक्रम्य निर्जितः।।3.48.4।।
transliteration: yena vaiśravaṇo rājā dvaimātrḥ kāraṇāntare| dvandvamāsāditḥ krodhādraṇe vikramya nirjitḥ||3.48.4||
meaning: For some reason or other a duel took place between me and king Kubera. With my prowess, I defeated him in the duel.

sanskrit: यद्भयार्तः परित्यज्य स्वमधिष्ठानमृद्धिमत्। कैलासं पर्वतश्रेष्ठमध्यास्ते नरवाहनः।।3.48.5।।
transliteration: yadbhayārtḥ parityajya svamadhiṣṭhānamṛddhimat| kailāsṃ parvataśreṣṭhamadhyāste naravāhanḥ||3.48.5||
meaning: Out of fear for me, Kubera is residing on the mighty mount Kailasa, leaving his own earlier prosperous place of residence.

sanskrit: यस्य तत्पुष्पकं नाम विमानं कामगं शुभम्। वीर्यादेवार्जितं भद्रे येन यामि विहायसम्।।3.48.6।।
transliteration: yasya tatpuṣpakṃ nāma vimānṃ kāmagṃ śubham| vīryādevārjitṃ bhadre yena yāmi vihāyasam||3.48.6||
meaning: O noble lady with my valour I gained over from Kubera the aerial chariot 'Pushpaka', which can go wherever one desires and in which I move about in the sky.

sanskrit: मम सञ्जातरोषस्य मुखं दृष्ट्वैव मैथिलि। विद्रवन्ति परित्रस्तास्सुराश्शक्रपुरोगमाः।।3.48.7।।
transliteration: mama sañjātaroṣasya mukhṃ dṛṣṭvaiva maithili| vidravanti paritrastāssurāśśakrapurogamāḥ||3.48.7||
meaning: O Princess from Mithila, seeing my angry face even gods led by Indra take to their heels in fear.

sanskrit: यत्र तिष्ठाम्यहं तत्र मारुतो वाति शङ्कितः। तीव्रांशुश्शिशिरांशुश्च भयात्सम्पद्यते रविः।।3.48.8।।
transliteration: yatra tiṣṭhāmyahṃ tatra māruto vāti śaṅkitḥ| tīvrāṃśuśśiśirāṃśuśca bhayātsampadyate raviḥ||3.48.8||
meaning: Wherever I am, the Windgod blows with hesitation. So are the Sun and the Moon afraid of me. Afraid of me the Sun duly discharges his duties.

sanskrit: निष्कम्पपत्रास्तरवो नद्यश्च स्तिमितोदकाः। भवन्ति यत्र यत्राहं तिष्ठामि विचरामि च।।3.48.9।।
transliteration: niṣkampapatrāstaravo nadyaśca stimitodakāḥ| bhavanti yatra yatrāhṃ tiṣṭhāmi vicarāmi ca||3.48.9||
meaning: Wherever I stay or move about, the leaves of trees do not shake, and the waters in rivers remain still.

sanskrit: मम पारे समुद्रस्य लङ्का नाम पुरी शुभा। सम्पूर्णा राक्षसैर्घोरैर्यथेन्द्रस्यामरावती।।3.48.10।।
transliteration: mama pāre samudrasya laṅkā nāma purī śubhā| sampūrṇā rākṣasairghorairyathendrasyāmarāvatī||3.48.10||
meaning: My city known as Lanka, teeming with terrific demons, is on the other side of the sea. It is beautiful like the city of Indra's Amaravati.

sanskrit: प्राकारेण परिक्षिप्ता पाण्डुरेण विराजता। हेमकक्ष्या पुरी रम्या वैढूर्यमयतोरणा।।3.48.11।।
transliteration: prākāreṇa parikṣiptā pāṇḍureṇa virājatā| hemakakṣyā purī ramyā vaiḍhūryamayatoraṇā||3.48.11||
meaning: The beautiful city of Lanka shines with its pale white ramparts and golden interiors. The entrance gates are encrusted with vaidurya (cat'seye).

sanskrit: हस्त्यश्वरथसम्बाधा तूर्यनादविनादिता। सर्वकालफलैर्वृक्षैस्सङ्कुलोद्द्यानशोभिता।।3.48.12।।
transliteration: hastyaśvarathasambādhā tūryanādavināditā| sarvakālaphalairvṛkṣaissaṅkuloddyānaśobhitā||3.48.12||
meaning: It is crowded with elephants, horses and chariots. It resounds with the music of trumpets. The trees in the delightful pleasuregardens yield fruits in all seasons.

sanskrit: तत्र त्वं वसती सीते राजपुत्रि मया सह। न स्मरिष्यसि नारीणां मानुषीणां मनस्विनि।।3.48.13।।
transliteration: tatra tvṃ vasatī sīte rājaputri mayā saha| na smariṣyasi nārīṇāṃ mānuṣīṇāṃ manasvini||3.48.13||
meaning: O highminded princess, O Sita while living with me, you will not even think of other women.

sanskrit: भुञ्जाना मानुषान्भोगान्दिव्यांश्च वरवर्णिनि। न स्मरिष्यसि रामस्य मानुषस्य गतायुषः।।3.48.14।।
transliteration: bhuñjānā mānuṣānbhogāndivyāṃśca varavarṇini| na smariṣyasi rāmasya mānuṣasya gatāyuṣḥ||3.48.14||
meaning: O blessed lady of fine complexion, while enjoying both human and heavenly pleasures with me there, you will not remember Rama who is a mortal of short lifespan.

sanskrit: स्थापयित्वा प्रियं पुत्रं राज्ञा दशरथेन यः। मन्दवीर्यस्सुतो ज्येष्ठस्ततः प्रस्थापितो वनम्।।3.48.15।।
transliteration: sthāpayitvā priyṃ putrṃ rājñā daśarathena yḥ| mandavīryassuto jyeṣṭhastatḥ prasthāpito vanam||3.48.15||
meaning: Considering the eldest son a weakling, king Dasaratha has sent him away to the forest so that he could consecrate his dear son(Bharata).

sanskrit: तेन किं भ्रष्टराज्येन रामेण गतचेतसा। करिष्यसि विशालाक्षि तापसेन तपस्विना।।3.48.16।।
transliteration: tena kiṃ bhraṣṭarājyena rāmeṇa gatacetasā| kariṣyasi viśālākṣi tāpasena tapasvinā||3.48.16||
meaning: O largeeyed Sita dislodged from the kingdom, Rama has lost his capacity to think. He is doing penance, assuming an ascetic role. What can he do (for you)?

sanskrit: सर्वराक्षसभर्तारं कामात्स्वयमिहागतम्। न मन्मथशराविष्टं प्रत्याख्यातुं त्वमर्हसि।।3.48.17।।
transliteration: sarvarākṣasabhartārṃ kāmātsvayamihāgatam| na manmathaśarāviṣṭṃ pratyākhyātuṃ tvamarhasi||3.48.17||
meaning: I am lord of all the demons. You should not reject me I am here (only because I am) overcome by the arrows of the god of love.

sanskrit: प्रत्याख्याय हि मां भीरु परितापं गमिष्यसि। चरणेनाभिहत्येव पुरूरवसमूर्वशी।।3.48.18।।
transliteration: pratyākhyāya hi māṃ bhīru paritāpṃ gamiṣyasi| caraṇenābhihatyeva purūravasamūrvaśī||3.48.18||
meaning: O timid lady if you reject me, you will regret like Urvasi who kicked Pururava and regretted later.

sanskrit: अङ्गुल्या न समो रामो मम युद्धे स मानुषः। तव भाग्येन सम्प्राप्तं भजस्व वरवर्णिनि।।3.48.19।।
transliteration: aṅgulyā na samo rāmo mama yuddhe sa mānuṣḥ| tava bhāgyena samprāptṃ bhajasva varavarṇini||3.48.19||
meaning: O lady of fine complexion, Rama is a (mere) mortal. In war he is no match (even) for my finger. It is your good fortune that you have got me here. Take refuge in me.

sanskrit: एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही क्रुद्धा संरक्तलोचना। अब्रवीत्परुषं वाक्यं रहिते राक्षसाधिपम्।।3.48.20।।
transliteration: evamuktā tu vaidehī kruddhā sṃraktalocanā| abravītparuṣṃ vākyṃ rahite rākṣasādhipam||3.48.20||
meaning: Thus addressed, Sita was enraged and her eyes turned red. She replied in harsh words to the chief of the demons in that solitary place:.

sanskrit: कथं वैश्रवणं देवं सर्वभूतनमस्कृतम्। भ्रातरं व्यपदिश्य त्वमशुभं कर्तुमिच्छसि।।3.48.21।।
transliteration: kathṃ vaiśravaṇṃ devṃ sarvabhūtanamaskṛtam| bhrātarṃ vyapadiśya tvamaśubhṃ kartumicchasi||3.48.21||
meaning: Why do you wish to do something inauspicious by calling Lord Kubera who is worshipped by all beings your brother ?

sanskrit: अवश्यं विनशिष्यन्ति सर्वे रावण राक्षसाः। येषां त्वं कर्कशो राजा दुर्बुद्धिरजितेन्द्रियः।।3.48.22।।
transliteration: avaśyṃ vinaśiṣyanti sarve rāvaṇa rākṣasāḥ| yeṣāṃ tvṃ karkaśo rājā durbuddhirajitendriyḥ||3.48.22||
meaning: O Ravana ,you are cruel and evilminded. You have no control over your senses. (And yet) you are the ruler of your breed. Surely they are going to be destroyed.

sanskrit: अपहृत्य शचीं भार्यां शक्यमिन्द्रस्य जीवितुम्। न च रामस्य भार्यां मामपनीयास्ति जीवितम्।।3.48.23।।
transliteration: apahṛtya śacīṃ bhāryāṃ śakyamindrasya jīvitum| na ca rāmasya bhāryāṃ māmapanīyāsti jīvitam||3.48.23||
meaning: It may be possible (for some one) to live after abducting Indra's wife, Sachi, but it is not possible for any one to live after kidnapping the wife of Rama.

sanskrit: जीवेच्चिरं वज्रधरस्य हस्ताच्छचीं प्रधृष्याप्रतिरूपरूपाम्। न मादृशीं राक्षस दूशयित्वा पीतामृतस्यापि तवास्ति मोक्षः।।3.48.
transliteration: jīveccirṃ vajradharasya hastācchacīṃ pradhṛṣyāpratirūparūpām| na mādṛśīṃ rākṣasa dūśayitvā pītāmṛtasyāpi tavāsti mokṣḥ||
meaning: O demon, you may live long after forcibly snatching the most beautiful Sachi, from the hands of Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, but after abusing a woman like me, you will not be released from death even if you dr

sanskrit: स मैथिलीं पुनर्वाक्यं बभाषे च ततो भृशम्। नोन्मत्तया श्रुतौ मन्ये मम वीर्यपराक्रमौ।।3.49.2।।
transliteration: sa maithilīṃ punarvākyṃ babhāṣe ca tato bhṛśam| nonmattayā śrutau manye mama vīryaparākramau||3.49.2||
meaning: Ravana again said to that princess from Mithila, I suppose you are too insane to disregard my strength and valour.

sanskrit: उद्वहेयं भुजाभ्यां तु मेदिनीमम्बरे स्थितः। आपिबेयं समुद्रं च हन्यां मृत्युं रणे स्थितः।।3.49.3।।
transliteration: udvaheyṃ bhujābhyāṃ tu medinīmambare sthitḥ| āpibeyṃ samudrṃ ca hanyāṃ mṛtyuṃ raṇe sthitḥ||3.49.3||
meaning: Standing in the sky, I can lift the earth with my arms. I can drink the oceans. I can kill even the god of death in a combat.

sanskrit: अर्कं ऱुन्ध्यां शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्विभिन्द्या हि महीतलम्। कामरूपिणमुन्मत्ते पश्य मां कामदं पतिम्।।3.49.4।।
transliteration: arkṃ ऱundhyāṃ śaraistīkṣṇairvibhindyā hi mahītalam| kāmarūpiṇamunmatte paśya māṃ kāmadṃ patim||3.49.4||
meaning: I can obstruct the Sun and shatter the earth with my sharp arrows. O mad woman I am a husband who can fulfil your desires, and can assume any form at my own free will. Look at me.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तवतस्तस्य सूर्यकल्पे शिखिप्रभे। क्रुद्धस्य हरिपर्यन्ते रक्ते नेत्रे बभूवतुः।।3.49.5।।
transliteration: evamuktavatastasya sūryakalpe śikhiprabhe| kruddhasya hariparyante rakte netre babhūvatuḥ||3.49.5||
meaning: As Ravana exploded in anger, his ambercoloured eyes turned red like the radiance of the flaming fire, and almost as bright as the Sun.

sanskrit: सद्यस्सौम्यं परित्यज्य भिक्षुरूपं स रावणः। स्वं रूपं कालरूपाभं भेजे वैश्रवणानुजः।।3.49.6।।
transliteration: sadyassaumyṃ parityajya bhikṣurūpṃ sa rāvaṇḥ| svṃ rūpṃ kālarūpābhṃ bheje vaiśravaṇānujḥ||3.49.6||
meaning: Ravana, brother of Kubera, shed the gentle figure of a mendicant and assumed the form of the god of death.

sanskrit: संरक्तनयनश्श्रीमांस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणः। क्रोधेन महताविष्टो नीलजीमूतसन्निभः।।3.49.7।। दशास्यः कार्मुकी बाणी बभूव क्षणदाचरः।
transliteration: sṃraktanayanaśśrīmāṃstaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇḥ| krodhena mahatāviṣṭo nīlajīmūtasannibhḥ||3.49.7|| daśāsyḥ kārmukī bāṇī babhūva
meaning: Overcome by intense anger, Ravana's eyes reddened. The nightranger, stood armed with bow and arrows and shining with glittering gold ornaments, appeared like a black cloud.

sanskrit: स परिव्राजकच्छद्म महाकायो विहाय तत्।।3.49.8।। प्रतिपद्य स्वकं रूपं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। संरक्तनयनः क्रोधाज्जीमूतनिचयप्रभः।
transliteration: sa parivrājakacchadma mahākāyo vihāya tat||3.49.8|| pratipadya svakṃ rūpṃ rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipḥ| sṃraktanayanḥ krodhājjīmū
meaning: Ravana, chief of the demons, shed the mendicant's form and assumed his real self. Clad in red garments, his eyes turned red in anger. Looking like layers of clouds, he stood in front of Sita, a gem among women.

sanskrit: स तामसितकेशान्तां भास्करस्य प्रभामिव।।3.49.10।। वसनाभरणोपेतां मैथिलीं रावणोऽब्रवीत्।
transliteration: sa tāmasitakeśāntāṃ bhāskarasya prabhāmiva||3.49.10|| vasanābharaṇopetāṃ maithilīṃ rāvaṇo'bravīt|
meaning: Ravana said to the princess from Mithila, whose black hair was shining, who was luminous like the Sun and was clad in the best of clothes and ornaments.

sanskrit: त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्यातं यदि भर्तारमिच्छसि।।3.49.11।। मामाश्रय वरारोहे तवाहं सदृशः पतिः।
transliteration: triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātṃ yadi bhartāramicchasi||3.49.11|| māmāśraya varārohe tavāhṃ sadṛśḥ patiḥ|
meaning: O beautiful lady if you desire a husband who is famous in the three worlds, take refuge in me. I am fit to be your husband.

sanskrit: मां भजस्व चिराय त्वमहं श्लाघ्यः प्रियस्तव।।3.49.12।। नैव चाहं क्वचिद्भद्रे करिष्ये तव विप्रियम्। त्यज्यतां मानुषे भावो म
transliteration: māṃ bhajasva cirāya tvamahṃ ślāghyḥ priyastava||3.49.12|| naiva cāhṃ kvacidbhadre kariṣye tava vipriyam| tyajyatāṃ mānuṣ
meaning: I am your praiseworthy husband. I will not cause any unpleasantness to you at any time. Abandon on your inclination towards, a (mere) mortal. Divert your love to me.

sanskrit: राज्याच्च्युतमसिद्धार्थं रामं परिमितायुषम्। कैर्गुणैरनुरक्तासि मूढे पण्डितमानिनि।।3.49.14।। यः स्त्रिया वचनाद्राज्यं विह
transliteration: rājyāccyutamasiddhārthṃ rāmṃ parimitāyuṣam| kairguṇairanuraktāsi mūḍhe paṇḍitamānini||3.49.14|| yḥ striyā vacanādrājyṃ v
meaning: O stupid woman you think you are very wise. What is there in Rama so that you are attached to him ? He has left the kingdom and his kith and kin due to the words of a woman. He has not accomplished anything (in life). He

sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा मैथिलीं वाक्यं प्रियार्हां प्रियवादिनीम्। अभिगम्य सुदुष्टात्मा राक्षसः काममोहितः।।3.49.16।। जग्राह रावणस्सीत
transliteration: ityuktvā maithilīṃ vākyṃ priyārhāṃ priyavādinīm| abhigamya suduṣṭātmā rākṣasḥ kāmamohitḥ||3.49.16|| jagrāha rāvaṇassītāṃ
meaning: Just as Budha (planet Mercury) catches Rohini (a cluster of five stars) in the sky, the evilminded, infatuated Ravana advanced towards the pitiable, pleasing Sita and caught hold of her.

sanskrit: वामेन सीतां पद्माक्षीं मूर्धजेषु करेण सः।।3.49.17।। ऊर्वोस्तु दक्षिणेनैव परिजग्राह पाणिना।
transliteration: vāmena sītāṃ padmākṣīṃ mūrdhajeṣu kareṇa sḥ||3.49.17|| ūrvostu dakṣiṇenaiva parijagrāha pāṇinā|
meaning: Ravana seized with his left hand the lotuseyed Sita by the hair and lifted her by the thighs with his right hand.

sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा मृत्युसङ्काशं तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रं महाभुजम्।।3.49.18।। प्राद्रवन्गिरिसङ्काशं भयार्ता वनदेवताः।
transliteration: tṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyusaṅkāśṃ tīkṣṇadṃṣṭrṃ mahābhujam||3.49.18|| prādravangirisaṅkāśṃ bhayārtā vanadevatāḥ|
meaning: The sylvan deities fled out of fear on seeing the dreadful appearance of Ravana who had sharp teeth and mighty arms. He looked like a mountain, a veritable god of death.

sanskrit: स च मायामयो दिव्यः खरयुक्तः खरस्वनः।।3.49.19।। प्रत्यदृश्यत हेमाङ्गो रावणस्य महारथः।
transliteration: sa ca māyāmayo divyḥ kharayuktḥ kharasvanḥ||3.49.19|| pratyadṛśyata hemāṅgo rāvaṇasya mahārathḥ|
meaning: There arrived the great golden chariot of Ravana, illusive and wonderful, harnessed with donkeys and braying like donkeys.

sanskrit: ततस्तां परुषैर्वाक्यैर्भर्त्सयन्स महास्वनः।।3.49.20।। अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीं रथमारोपयत्तदा।
transliteration: tatastāṃ paruṣairvākyairbhartsayansa mahāsvanḥ||3.49.20|| aṅkenādāya vaidehīṃ rathamāropayattadā|
meaning: Reproaching the princess from Videha loudly and harshly, Ravana took her on his lap and put her on the chariot.

sanskrit: सा गृहीता विचुक्रोश रावणेन यशस्स्विनी।।3.49.21।। रामेति सीता दुःखार्ता रामं दूरगतंवने।
transliteration: sā gṛhītā vicukrośa rāvaṇena yaśassvinī||3.49.21|| rāmeti sītā duḥkhārtā rāmṃ dūragatṃvane|
meaning: Seized by Ravana, illustrious Sita screamed aloud Alas, Rama. for one who was far away in the forest.

sanskrit: तामकामां स कामार्तः पन्नगेन्द्रवधूमिव।।3.49.22।। विवेष्टमानामादाय उत्पपाताथ रावणः।
transliteration: tāmakāmāṃ sa kāmārtḥ pannagendravadhūmiva||3.49.22|| viveṣṭamānāmādāya utpapātātha rāvaṇḥ|
meaning: Passionate Ravana took hold of Sita who was not willing and was writhing in pain. He seized her like (an eagle carrying away) a serpent queen and flew up.

sanskrit: ततस्सा राक्षसेन्द्रेण ह्रियमाणा विहायसा।।3.49.23।। भृशं चुक्रोश मत्तेव भ्रान्तचित्ता यथाऽऽतुरा।
transliteration: tatassā rākṣasendreṇa hriyamāṇā vihāyasā||3.49.23|| bhṛśṃ cukrośa matteva bhrāntacittā yathā''turā|
meaning: While Sita was being carried off in the sky by the king of demons, she screamed a lot in agony and anxiety like a mad woman in a bewildered state:

sanskrit: हा लक्ष्मण महाबाहो गुरुचित्तप्रसादक।।3.49.24।। ह्रियमाणां न जानीषे रक्षसा माममर्षिणा।
transliteration: hā lakṣmaṇa mahābāho gurucittaprasādaka||3.49.24|| hriyamāṇāṃ na jānīṣe rakṣasā māmamarṣiṇā|
meaning: Alas, O longarmed Lakshmana, you who used to entertain your brother do not know that I am being carried away by this ruthless demon.

sanskrit: जीवितं सुखमर्थांश्च धर्महेतोः परित्यजन्।।3.49.25।। ह्रियमाणामधर्मेण मां राघव न पश्यसि।
transliteration: jīvitṃ sukhamarthāṃśca dharmahetoḥ parityajan||3.49.25|| hriyamāṇāmadharmeṇa māṃ rāghava na paśyasi|
meaning: O Rama, you have given up your life, pleasure and treasure for the sake of righteousness. Do you not see me carried off by an unrighteous fellow ?

sanskrit: ननु नामाविनीतानां विनेतासि परन्तप।।3.49.26।। कथमेवंविधं पापं न त्वं शासि हि रावणम्।
transliteration: nanu nāmāvinītānāṃ vinetāsi parantapa||3.49.26|| kathamevṃvidhṃ pāpṃ na tvṃ śāsi hi rāvaṇam|
meaning: O scorcher of enemies you are the chastiser of the haughty. Why do you not punish such a sinner like Ravana.

sanskrit: ननु सद्योऽविनीतस्य दृश्यते कर्मणःफलम्।।3.49.27।। कालोऽप्यङ्गीभवत्यत्र सस्यानामिव पक्तये।
transliteration: nanu sadyo'vinītasya dṛśyate karmaṇḥphalam||3.49.27|| kālo'pyaṅgībhavatyatra sasyānāmiva paktaye|
meaning: The effect of arrogant action cannot be seen right away. Just as the crop yields results only after ripening, in the same way it takes time. Time acts as a supporting factor.

sanskrit: त्वं कर्म कृतवानेतत्कालोपहतचेतनः।।3.49.28।। जीवितान्तकरं घोरं रामाद्व्यसनमाप्नुहि।
transliteration: tvṃ karma kṛtavānetatkālopahatacetanḥ||3.49.28|| jīvitāntakarṃ ghorṃ rāmādvyasanamāpnuhi|
meaning: Time has taken a toll of your senses. This has made you do what you have done. A great calamity is awaiting you in the hands of Rama. It will end your life.

sanskrit: हन्तेदानीं सकामास्तु कैकेयी सह बान्धवैः।।3.49.29।। ह्रिये यद्धर्मकामस्य धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनः।
transliteration: hantedānīṃ sakāmāstu kaikeyī saha bāndhavaiḥ||3.49.29|| hriye yaddharmakāmasya dharmapatnī yaśasvinḥ|
meaning: Alas, the lawful wife of the glorious and righteous Rama is being abducted now. Let Kaikeyi along with her relations be happy with her desire fulfilled.

sanskrit: आमन्त्रये जनस्थाने कर्णिकारान्सुपुष्पितान्।।3.49.30।। क्षिप्रं रामाय शंसध्वं सीतां हरति रावणः।
transliteration: āmantraye janasthāne karṇikārānsupuṣpitān||3.49.30|| kṣiprṃ rāmāya śṃsadhvṃ sītāṃ harati rāvaṇḥ|
meaning: O karnikar trees in full bloom in Janasthana, tell Rama quickly that Ravana is kidnapping Sita.

sanskrit: माल्यवन्तं शिखरिणं वन्दे प्रस्रवणं गिरिम्।।3.49.31।। क्षिप्रं रामाय शंस त्वं सीतां हरति रावणः।
transliteration: mālyavantṃ śikhariṇṃ vande prasravaṇṃ girim||3.49.31|| kṣiprṃ rāmāya śṃsa tvṃ sītāṃ harati rāvaṇḥ|
meaning: I salute to Malyavan and Prasravana mountains. Tell Rama at once that Ravana is carrying away Sita.

sanskrit: हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णां वन्दे गोदावरीं नदीम्।।3.49.32।। क्षिप्रं रामाय शंस त्वं सीतां हरति रावणः।
transliteration: hṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇāṃ vande godāvarīṃ nadīm||3.49.32|| kṣiprṃ rāmāya śṃsa tvṃ sītāṃ harati rāvaṇḥ|
meaning: O river Godavari abounding in swans and cranes, my salutations to you Tell Rama immediately that Ravana is taking away Sita.

sanskrit: दैवतानि च यान्यस्मिन्वने विविधपादपे।।3.49.33।। नमस्करोम्यहं तेभ्योभर्तुश्शंसत मां हृताम्।
transliteration: daivatāni ca yānyasminvane vividhapādape||3.49.33|| namaskaromyahṃ tebhyobhartuśśṃsata māṃ hṛtām|
meaning: I offer my salutations to different deities residing in this forest abounding in trees of many kinds. Tell my husband about me that I am being whisked away.

sanskrit: यानि कानि चिदप्यत्र सत्त्वानि निवसन्त्युत।।3.49.34।। सर्वाणि शरणं यामि मृगपक्षिगणानपि।
transliteration: yāni kāni cidapyatra sattvāni nivasantyuta||3.49.34|| sarvāṇi śaraṇṃ yāmi mṛgapakṣigaṇānapi|
meaning: I seek refuge in all those living beings as well as herds of animals and birds in the forest.

sanskrit: ह्रियमाणां प्रियां भर्तुः प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसीम्।।3.49.35।। विवशाऽपहृता सीता रावणेनेति शंसत।
transliteration: hriyamāṇāṃ priyāṃ bhartuḥ prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasīm||3.49.35|| vivaśā'pahṛtā sītā rāvaṇeneti śṃsata|
meaning: Tell Rama that his dear wife Sita whom he loves more than his life is abducted helplessly.

sanskrit: विदित्वा मां महाबाहुरमुत्रापि महाबलः।।3.49.36।। आनेष्यति पराक्रम्य वैवस्वतहृतामपि।
transliteration: viditvā māṃ mahābāhuramutrāpi mahābalḥ||3.49.36|| āneṣyati parākramya vaivasvatahṛtāmapi|
meaning: If he knows that I am abducted by Yama, the god of death, that mighty, longarmed hero will save me even from there by virtue of his valour.

sanskrit: सा तदा करुणा वाचो विलपन्ती सुदुःखिता।।3.49.37।। वनस्पतिगतं गृध्रं ददर्शाऽयतलोचना।
transliteration: sā tadā karuṇā vāco vilapantī suduḥkhitā||3.49.37|| vanaspatigatṃ gṛdhrṃ dadarśā'yatalocanā|
meaning: When the griefstricken, largeeyed Sita was lamenting piteously, she saw the vulture (Jatayu) seated on a tree.

sanskrit: सा तमुद्वीक्ष्य सुश्रोणी रावणस्य वशं गता।3.49.38।। समाक्रन्दद्भयपरा दुःखोपहतया गिरा।
transliteration: sā tamudvīkṣya suśroṇī rāvaṇasya vaśṃ gatā|3.49.38|| samākrandadbhayaparā duḥkhopahatayā girā|
meaning: The heavyhipped Sita felt frightened in the grip of Ravana. When she saw Jatayu she screamed, shaken by sorrow:

sanskrit: जटायो पश्य मामद्य ह्रियमाणामनाथवत्।।3.49.39।। अनेन राक्षसेन्द्रेण करुणं पापकर्मणा।
transliteration: jaṭāyo paśya māmadya hriyamāṇāmanāthavat||3.49.39|| anena rākṣasendreṇa karuṇṃ pāpakarmaṇā|
meaning: O Jatayu, see me now being carried away by the sinful king of demons in this pitiable condition as though I am an orphan.

sanskrit: नैष वारयितुं शक्यस्तव क्रूरो निशाचरः।।3.49.40।। सत्त्वाञ्जितकाशी च सायुधश्चैव दुर्मतिः।
transliteration: naiṣa vārayituṃ śakyastava krūro niśācarḥ||3.49.40|| sattvāñjitakāśī ca sāyudhaścaiva durmatiḥ|
meaning: This nightranger is equipped with weapons. Cruel, strong and evilminded, he has won wars. You cannot stop him.

sanskrit: रामाय तु यथातत्त्वं जटायो हरणं मम।।3.49.41।। लक्ष्मणाय च तत्सर्वमाख्यातव्यमशेषतः।
transliteration: rāmāya tu yathātattvṃ jaṭāyo haraṇṃ mama||3.49.41|| lakṣmaṇāya ca tatsarvamākhyātavyamaśeṣatḥ|
meaning: O Jatayu narrate to Rama and Lakshmana the exact facts of my abduction and all the details without any omission. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकोनपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyninth sarga

sanskrit: कष्टं वनमिदं दुर्गं न च स्म वनगोचराः।।3.5.2।। अभिगच्छामहे शीघ्रं शरभङ्गं तपोधनम्।
transliteration: kaṣṭṃ vanamidṃ durgṃ na ca sma vanagocarāḥ||3.5.2|| abhigacchāmahe śīghrṃ śarabhaṅgṃ tapodhanam|
meaning: This wild forest with which we have not been acquainted earlier is difficult to pass. (Hence) let us proceed quickly to sage Sarabhanga.

sanskrit: आश्रमं शरभङ्गस्य राघवोऽभिजगाम ह।।3.5.3।। तस्य देवप्रभावस्य तपसा भावितात्मनः। समीपे शरभङ्गस्य ददर्श महदद्भुतम्।।3.5.4।।
transliteration: āśramṃ śarabhaṅgasya rāghavo'bhijagāma ha||3.5.3|| tasya devaprabhāvasya tapasā bhāvitātmanḥ| samīpe śarabhaṅgasya dadar
meaning: Rama went to the hermitage of Sarabhanga, a sage with divine grace who had realised the supreme (by his penance). Thus by the side of the sage he witnessed a huge wonder.

sanskrit: विभ्राजमानं वपुषा सूर्यवैश्वानरोपमम्। अवरुह्यरथोत्सङ्गादाकाशे विबुधानुगम।।3.5.5।। असंस्पृशन्तं वसुधां ददर्श विबुधेश्वरम्
transliteration: vibhrājamānṃ vapuṣā sūryavaiśvānaropamam| avaruhyarathotsaṅgādākāśe vibudhānugama||3.5.5|| asṃspṛśantṃ vasudhāṃ dadarśa
meaning: Rama saw the lord of the gods (Indra) in the sky getting off the chariot, with his body shining brightly like the sun or the fire, followed by the gods, his feet untouched by the earth. Clad in spotless attire and adorne

sanskrit: हरिभिर्वाजिभिर्युक्तमन्तरिक्षगतं रथम्।।3.5.7।। ददर्शादूरतस्तस्य तरुणादित्यसन्निभम्। पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रख्यं चन्द्रमण्डलसन्न
transliteration: haribhirvājibhiryuktamantarikṣagatṃ ratham||3.5.7|| dadarśādūratastasya taruṇādityasannibham| pāṇḍurābhraghanaprakhyṃ ca
meaning: Not far from that place, Rama saw a chariot, yoked with tawnycoloured horses, shining like the morning Sun. It looked like a palewhite cloud, resembling the lunar orb.

sanskrit: अपश्यद्विमलं छत्रं चित्रमाल्योपशोभितम्। चामरव्यजने चाग्र्ये रुक्मदण्डे महाधने।।3.5.9।। गृहीते वरनारीभ्यां धूयमाने च मूर्
transliteration: apaśyadvimalṃ chatrṃ citramālyopaśobhitam| cāmaravyajane cāgrye rukmadaṇḍe mahādhane||3.5.9|| gṛhīte varanārībhyāṃ dhūya
meaning: Rama saw a pure white umbrella with a highly expensive golden staff, decorated with variegated flower garlands.While near his (Indra's) head stood a pair of exquisite ladies with fans made of yak's tail.

sanskrit: गन्धर्वामरसिद्धाश्च बहवः परमर्षयः।।3.5.10।। अन्तरिक्षगतं देवं वाग्भिरग्य्राभिरीडिरे।
transliteration: gandharvāmarasiddhāśca bahavḥ paramarṣayḥ||3.5.10|| antarikṣagatṃ devṃ vāgbhiragyrābhirīḍire|
meaning: Many celestial singers of heaven, gods, great sages and siddhas sang with the choicest words the glory of this god stationed in the sky.

sanskrit: सह सम्भाषमाणे तु शरभङ्गेन वासवे।।3.5.11।। दृष्ट्वा शतक्रतुं तत्र रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: saha sambhāṣamāṇe tu śarabhaṅgena vāsave||3.5.11|| dṛṣṭvā śatakratuṃ tatra rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt|
meaning: While Indra was conversing with Sarabhanga, Rama saw him and said to Lakshmana.

sanskrit: रामोऽथ रथमुद्दिश्य लक्ष्मणायप्रदर्शयन्।।3.5.12।। अर्चिष्मन्तं श्रिया जुष्टमद्भुतं पश्य लक्ष्मण। प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यमन्तरिक
transliteration: rāmo'tha rathamuddiśya lakṣmaṇāyapradarśayan||3.5.12|| arciṣmantṃ śriyā juṣṭamadbhutṃ paśya lakṣmaṇa| pratapantamivādity
meaning: Pointing at the chariot, Rama said, Lakshmana, see this wonderful, effulgent chariot endowed with grace is shining like the Sun in the sky.

sanskrit: ये हयाः पुरुहूतस्य पुरा शक्रस्य नश्श्रुताः। अन्तरिक्षगता दिव्यास्त इमे हरयो ध्रुवम्।।3.5.14।।
transliteration: ye hayāḥ puruhūtasya purā śakrasya naśśrutāḥ| antarikṣagatā divyāsta ime harayo dhruvam||3.5.14||
meaning: The horses of Indra, who is often invoked (during sacrificial rituals) and about whom we have heard earlier, are now stationed in the sky.

sanskrit: इमे च पुरुषव्याघ्रा ये तिष्ठ्न्त्यभितो रथम्। शतं शतं कुण्डलिनो युवानः खङ्गपाणयः।।3.5.15।। विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः परिघायतब
transliteration: ime ca puruṣavyāghrā ye tiṣṭhntyabhito ratham| śatṃ śatṃ kuṇḍalino yuvānḥ khaṅgapāṇayḥ||3.5.15|| vistīrṇavipuloraskāḥ pa
meaning: O Lakshmana around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iro

sanskrit: एतद्दि किल देवानां वयो भवति नित्यदा। यथेमे पुरुषव्याघ्रा दृश्यन्ते प्रियदर्शनाः।।3.5.18।।
transliteration: etaddi kila devānāṃ vayo bhavati nityadā| yatheme puruṣavyāghrā dṛśyante priyadarśanāḥ||3.5.18||
meaning: These tigers among men have cheerful countenacess from which it can be deduced that the age of the gods always remains constant.

sanskrit: इहैव सह वैदेह्या मुहूर्तं तिष्ठ लक्ष्मण। यावज्जानाम्यहं व्यक्तं क एष द्युतिमान्रथे।।3.5.19।।
transliteration: ihaiva saha vaidehyā muhūrtṃ tiṣṭha lakṣmaṇa| yāvajjānāmyahṃ vyaktṃ ka eṣa dyutimānrathe||3.5.19||
meaning: Lakshmana, stay here with Sita awhile, until I ascertain who this dazzling being on the chariot is.

sanskrit: तमेवमुक्त्वा सौमित्रिमिहैव स्थीयतामिति। अभिचक्राम काकुत्स्थ श्शरभङ्गाश्रमं प्रति।।3.5.20।।
transliteration: tamevamuktvā saumitrimihaiva sthīyatāmiti| abhicakrāma kākutstha śśarabhaṅgāśramṃ prati||3.5.20||
meaning: Instructing Lakshmana to wait , Rama went towards Sarabhanga's hermitage.

sanskrit: ततस्समभिगच्छन्तं प्रेक्ष्य रामं शचीपतिः। शरभङ्गमनुप्राप्य विविक्त इदमब्रवीत्।।3.5.21।।
transliteration: tatassamabhigacchantṃ prekṣya rāmṃ śacīpatiḥ| śarabhaṅgamanuprāpya vivikta idamabravīt||3.5.21||
meaning: Then Indra (husband of Sachi) having seen Rama coming towards him, approached Sarabhanga and said this to him privately:

sanskrit: इहोपयात्यसौ रामो यावन्मां नाभिभाषते। निष्ठां नयतु तावत्तु ततो मा द्रष्टुमर्हति।।3.5.22।। जितवन्तं कृतार्थं हि तदाहमचिराद
transliteration: ihopayātyasau rāmo yāvanmāṃ nābhibhāṣate| niṣṭhāṃ nayatu tāvattu tato mā draṣṭumarhati||3.5.22|| jitavantṃ kṛtārthṃ hi t
meaning: Here comes Rama. Before he talks to me, take me to some other place from where he may not be able to see me. He has to do a great task which is difficult for others. I can see him when he accomplishes the taste and emerg

sanskrit: इति वज्री तमामन्त्र्य मानयित्वा च तापसम्। रथेन हययुक्तेन ययौ दिवमरिन्दमः।।3.5.24।।
transliteration: iti vajrī tamāmantrya mānayitvā ca tāpasam| rathena hayayuktena yayau divamarindamḥ||3.5.24||
meaning: This way honouring the sage Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, took leave of him and went to heaven in his chariot harressed with horses.

sanskrit: प्रयाते तु सहस्राक्षे राघवस्सपरिच्छदः। अग्निहोत्रमुपासीनं शरभङ्गमुपागमत्।।3.5.25।।
transliteration: prayāte tu sahasrākṣe rāghavassaparicchadḥ| agnihotramupāsīnṃ śarabhaṅgamupāgamat||3.5.25||
meaning: When Indra departed like that, Rama with his retinue (Sita and Lakshmana) went to Sarabhanga who was sitting by the side of the firealtar (for Agnihotra).

sanskrit: तस्य पादौ च सङ्गृह्य रामस्सीता च लक्ष्मणः। निषेदुस्समनुज्ञाता लब्धवासा निमन्त्रिताः।।3.5.26।।
transliteration: tasya pādau ca saṅgṛhya rāmassītā ca lakṣmaṇḥ| niṣedussamanujñātā labdhavāsā nimantritāḥ||3.5.26||
meaning: Rama, Sita and Lakshmana prostrated at Sarabhanga's feet. After being permitted to sit, they were invited to stay there.

sanskrit: ततश्शक्रोपयानं तु पर्यपृच्छत्स राघवः। शरभङ्गश्च तत्सर्यं राघवाय न्यवेदयत्।।3.5.27।।
transliteration: tataśśakropayānṃ tu paryapṛcchatsa rāghavḥ| śarabhaṅgaśca tatsaryṃ rāghavāya nyavedayat||3.5.27||
meaning: Thereafter on Rama's query Sarabhanga told him all about Indra's visit:

sanskrit: मामेष वरदो राम ब्रह्मलोकं निनीषति। जितमुग्रेण तपसा दुष्प्रापमकृतात्मभिः।।3.5.28।।
transliteration: māmeṣa varado rāma brahmalokṃ ninīṣati| jitamugreṇa tapasā duṣprāpamakṛtātmabhiḥ||3.5.28||
meaning: O Rama, Indra, the bestower of boons, wants to take me to the world of Brahma, earned by me through severe penance which is most difficult to be attained by those devoid of selfrealisation.

sanskrit: अहं ज्ञात्वा नरव्याघ्र वर्तमानमदूरतः। ब्रह्मलोकं न गच्छामि त्वामदृष्ट्वा प्रियातिथिम्।।3.5.29।।
transliteration: ahṃ jñātvā naravyāghra vartamānamadūratḥ| brahmalokṃ na gacchāmi tvāmadṛṣṭvā priyātithim||3.5.29||
meaning: O Rama, the best among men you are a very dear guest to me and knowing that you are near, I will not go to the world of Brahman without seeing you.

sanskrit: त्वयाऽहं पुरुषव्याघ्र धार्मिकेण महात्मना। समागम्य गमिष्यामि त्रिदिवं देवसेवितम्।।3.5.30।।
transliteration: tvayā'hṃ puruṣavyāghra dhārmikeṇa mahātmanā| samāgamya gamiṣyāmi tridivṃ devasevitam||3.5.30||
meaning: O Rama, the best of men (only) after seeing a great, virtuous soul like you shall I go to heaven, the abode of the gods.

sanskrit: अक्षया नरशार्दूल मया लोका जिताश्शुभा। ब्राह्म्याश्च नाकपृष्ठ्याश्च प्रतिगृह्णीष्व मामकान्।।3.5.31।।
transliteration: akṣayā naraśārdūla mayā lokā jitāśśubhā| brāhmyāśca nākapṛṣṭhyāśca pratigṛhṇīṣva māmakān||3.5.31||
meaning: O tiger among men, I have conquered heavenly abodes as well as the imperishable, auspicious worlds of Brahma. Accept them all that are mine (obtained through my penance)

sanskrit: एवमुक्तो नरव्याघ्रस्सर्वशास्त्र विशारदः। ऋषिणा शरभङ्गेण राघवो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।3.5.32।।
transliteration: evamukto naravyāghrassarvaśāstra viśāradḥ| ṛṣiṇā śarabhaṅgeṇa rāghavo vākyamabravīt||3.5.32||
meaning: To these words of sage Sarabhanga Rama, the best of men, the knower of all sastras, the scion of the Raghus replied:

sanskrit: अहमेवाहरिष्यामि सर्वांल्लोकान्महामुने। आवासं त्वहमिच्छामि प्रदिष्टमिह कानने।।3.5.33।।
transliteration: ahamevāhariṣyāmi sarvāṃllokānmahāmune| āvāsṃ tvahamicchāmi pradiṣṭamiha kānane||3.5.33||
meaning: O great sage, I will earn all the worlds myself if you direct me. But I need a proper dwellingplace in this forest.

sanskrit: राघवेणैवमुक्तस्तु शक्रतुल्यबलेन वै। शरभङ्गो महाप्राज्ञः पुनरेवाब्रवीद्वचः।।3.5.34।।
transliteration: rāghaveṇaivamuktastu śakratulyabalena vai| śarabhaṅgo mahāprājñḥ punarevābravīdvacḥ||3.5.34||
meaning: To this request of Rama who was equal to Indra in strength, sagacious Sarabhanga said these words:

sanskrit: इह राम महातेजास्सुतीक्ष्णो नाम धार्मिकः। वसत्यरण्ये धर्मात्मा स ते श्रेयो विधास्यति।।3.5.35।।
transliteration: iha rāma mahātejāssutīkṣṇo nāma dhārmikḥ| vasatyaraṇye dharmātmā sa te śreyo vidhāsyati||3.5.35||
meaning: Here dwells in this forest a brilliant saint, righteous and selfcontrolled, Sutikshna by name who will look to your welfare, O Rama

sanskrit: सुतीक्ष्णमभिगच्छ त्वं शुचौ देशे तपस्विनम्। रमणीये वनोद्देशे स ते वासं विधास्यति।।3.5.36।।
transliteration: sutīkṣṇamabhigaccha tvṃ śucau deśe tapasvinam| ramaṇīye vanoddeśe sa te vāsṃ vidhāsyati||3.5.36||
meaning: You may approach sage, Sutikshna residing in a sacred spot. He will provide you a delightful place for your stay in the forest.

sanskrit: इमां मन्दाकिनीं राम प्रतिस्रोतामनुव्रज। नदीं पुष्पोडुपवहां ततस्तत्र गमिष्यसि।।3.5.37।।
transliteration: imāṃ mandākinīṃ rāma pratisrotāmanuvraja| nadīṃ puṣpoḍupavahāṃ tatastatra gamiṣyasi||3.5.37||
meaning: Proceed, O Rama in the reverse direction of the river Mandakini carrying flowers and floats. And you will reach the place.

sanskrit: एष पन्था नरव्याघ्र मुहूर्तं पश्य तात माम्। यावज्जहामि गात्राणि जीर्णां त्वचमिवोरगः।।3.5.38।।
transliteration: eṣa panthā naravyāghra muhūrtṃ paśya tāta mām| yāvajjahāmi gātrāṇi jīrṇāṃ tvacamivoragḥ||3.5.38||
meaning: O Rama, the best among men, this is the way. Look at me for a while, my dear, until I shed my limbs just as a snake sheds its withered slough.

sanskrit: ततोऽग्निं स समाधाय हुत्वा चाज्येन मन्त्रवित्। शरभङ्गो महातेजाः प्रविवेश हुताशनम्।।3.5.39।।
transliteration: tato'gniṃ sa samādhāya hutvā cājyena mantravit| śarabhaṅgo mahātejāḥ praviveśa hutāśanam||3.5.39||
meaning: Then the effulgent Sarabhanga, knower of mantras (magical spells) kindled the fire with faggots and after offering oblations of ghee plunged in.

sanskrit: तस्य रोमाणि केशांश्च तदा वह्निर्महात्मनः। जीर्णां त्वचं तथाऽस्थीनि यच्च मांसं सशोणितम्।।3.5.40।।
transliteration: tasya romāṇi keśāṃśca tadā vahnirmahātmanḥ| jīrṇāṃ tvacṃ tathā'sthīni yacca māṃsṃ saśoṇitam||3.5.40||
meaning: Then were consumed that highsouled Sarabhanga's hair on the body and on the head, the wornout skin, the bones and flesh along with blood.

sanskrit: स च पावकसङ्काशः कुमारस्समपद्यत। उत्थायाग्निचयात्तस्माच्छरभङ्गो व्यरोचत।।3.5.41।।
transliteration: sa ca pāvakasaṅkāśḥ kumārassamapadyata| utthāyāgnicayāttasmāccharabhaṅgo vyarocata||3.5.41||
meaning: Sarabhanga then emerged youthful from that heap of fire, shining like a flame and looking very elegant৷৷

sanskrit: स लोकानाहिताग्नीनामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्। देवानां च व्यतिक्रम्य ब्रह्मलोकं व्यरोहत।।3.5.42।।
transliteration: sa lokānāhitāgnīnāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca mahātmanām| devānāṃ ca vyatikramya brahmalokṃ vyarohata||3.5.42||
meaning: Sarabhanga then went beyond the worlds of the gods, of the great sages who constantly kindle sacrificial fire, and ascended to the world of Brahman.

sanskrit: स पुण्यकर्मा भुवने द्विजर्षभः पितामहं सानुचरं ददर्श ह। पितामहश्चापि समीक्ष्य तं द्विजं ननन्द सुस्वागतमित्युवाच ह।।3.5.43
transliteration: sa puṇyakarmā bhuvane dvijarṣabhḥ pitāmahṃ sānucarṃ dadarśa ha| pitāmahaścāpi samīkṣya tṃ dvijṃ nananda susvāgatamityuvā
meaning: Sarabhanga, performer of sacred deeds, saw Brahma with his followers৷৷ Brahma also seeing Sarabhanga, the best among the brahmins, welcomed him gladly. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चमः सर्ग

sanskrit: ततः पर्वतकूटाभस्तीक्ष्णतुण्डः खगोत्तमः। वनस्पतिगतश्श्रीमान्व्याजहार शुभां गिरम्।।3.50.2।।
transliteration: tatḥ parvatakūṭābhastīkṣṇatuṇḍḥ khagottamḥ| vanaspatigataśśrīmānvyājahāra śubhāṃ giram||3.50.2||
meaning: Glorious Jatayu, the best among the birds, looked like the peak of a mountain. His beak was sharp. His words were auspious. He spoke from the top of the tree:

sanskrit: दशग्रीव स्थितो धर्मे पुराणे सत्यसंश्रयः। जटायुर्नाम नाम्नाहं गृध्रराजो महाबलः।।3.50.3।।
transliteration: daśagrīva sthito dharme purāṇe satyasṃśrayḥ| jaṭāyurnāma nāmnāhṃ gṛdhrarājo mahābalḥ||3.50.3||
meaning: O tenheaded Ravana, I am Jatayu, king of vultures. I am mighty. An eternal follower, of dharma, I am an adherent to truth.

sanskrit: राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य महेन्द्रवरुणोपमः। लोकानां च हिते युक्तो रामो दशरथात्मजः।।3.50.4।।
transliteration: rājā sarvasya lokasya mahendravaruṇopamḥ| lokānāṃ ca hite yukto rāmo daśarathātmajḥ||3.50.4||
meaning: Rama, Dasaratha's son, is the king of the entire world. He is equal to Indra and Varuna. He is ever engaged in the welfare of the entire world.

sanskrit: तस्यैषा लोकनाथस्य धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनी। सीता नाम वरारोहा यां त्वं हर्तुमिहेच्छसि।।3.50.5।।
transliteration: tasyaiṣā lokanāthasya dharmapatnī yaśasvinī| sītā nāma varārohā yāṃ tvṃ hartumihecchasi||3.50.5||
meaning: The lady you want to abduct from here is the famous Sita, the lawful wife of Rama, the lord of the world.

sanskrit: कथं राजास्थितो धर्मे परदारान्परामृशेत्। रक्षणीया विशेषेण राजदारा महाबल।।3.50.6।।
transliteration: kathṃ rājāsthito dharme paradārānparāmṛśet| rakṣaṇīyā viśeṣeṇa rājadārā mahābala||3.50.6||
meaning: How can a king who adheres to righteousness outrage another's wife ? O powerful one, a king's wife in particular should be protected.

sanskrit: निवर्तय मतिं नीचां परदाराभिमर्शनात्। न तत्समाचरेद्धीरो यत्परोऽस्य विगर्हयेत्।।3.50.7।। यथात्मनस्तथान्येषां दारा रक्ष्या
transliteration: nivartaya matiṃ nīcāṃ paradārābhimarśanāt| na tatsamācareddhīro yatparo'sya vigarhayet||3.50.7|| yathātmanastathānyeṣāṃ
meaning: Refrain yourself from the vile thought of violating other's wives. Wise men do not adopt what is censured by others. Just like one's own, the wise should protect other's wives.

sanskrit: धर्ममर्थं वा कामं वा शिष्टाश्शास्त्रेष्वनागतम्।।3.50.8।। व्यवस्यन्त्यनु राजानं धर्मं पौलस्त्यनन्दन।
transliteration: dharmamarthṃ vā kāmṃ vā śiṣṭāśśāstreṣvanāgatam||3.50.8|| vyavasyantyanu rājānṃ dharmṃ paulastyanandana|
meaning: O son of Paulastya learned men determine the path of dharma artha and kama, following a king's conduct even if they are not declared in sastras.

sanskrit: राजा धर्मस्य कामस्य द्रव्याणां चोत्तमो निधिः।।3.50.9।। धर्मश्शुभं वा पापं वा राजमूलं प्रवर्तते।
transliteration: rājā dharmasya kāmasya dravyāṇāṃ cottamo nidhiḥ||3.50.9|| dharmaśśubhṃ vā pāpṃ vā rājamūlṃ pravartate|
meaning: A king is the best repository of rigteousness, material wealth and pleasures. The king is the root of dharma, virtue and sin.

sanskrit: पापस्वभावश्चपलः कथं त्वं रक्षसां वर।।3.50.10।। ऐश्वर्यमभिसम्प्राप्तो विमानमिव दुष्कृतिः।
transliteration: pāpasvabhāvaścapalḥ kathṃ tvṃ rakṣasāṃ vara||3.50.10|| aiśvaryamabhisamprāpto vimānamiva duṣkṛtiḥ|
meaning: O best of demons by nature you are sinful, and fickleminded. You do all forbidden acts. Otherwise,how could you get this wealth, like the celestial chariot?

sanskrit: कामं स्वभावो यो यस्य न शक्यः परिमार्जितुम्।।3.50.11।। न हि दुष्टात्मनामार्यमावसत्यालये चिरम्।
transliteration: kāmṃ svabhāvo yo yasya na śakyḥ parimārjitum||3.50.11|| na hi duṣṭātmanāmāryamāvasatyālaye ciram|
meaning: Indeed, it is not possible to erase the nature of any one, whatever it be. Prosperity does not rest for long in the house of the evilminded.

sanskrit: विषये वा पुरे वा ते यदा रामो महाबलः।।3.50.12।। नापराध्यति धर्मात्मा कथं तस्यापराध्यसि।
transliteration: viṣaye vā pure vā te yadā rāmo mahābalḥ||3.50.12|| nāparādhyati dharmātmā kathṃ tasyāparādhyasi|
meaning: Powerful and righteous Rama has not offended you, your kingdom or your city. Why do you offend him?

sanskrit: यदि शूर्पणखाहेतोर्जनस्थानगतः खरः।।3.50.13।। अतिवृत्तो हतः पूर्वं रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। अत्र ब्रूहि यथातत्त्वं को रामस्य व
transliteration: yadi śūrpaṇakhāhetorjanasthānagatḥ kharḥ||3.50.13|| ativṛtto hatḥ pūrvṃ rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā| atra brūhi yathātattvṃ ko r
meaning: On account of Surpanakha, Khara trespassed into Janasthana and got killed by Rama, without much effort. Tell me truly, what transgression (of dharma) did he commit for which you are stealing away the wife of Rama who is

sanskrit: क्षिप्रं विसृज वैदेहीं मा त्वा घोरेण चक्षुषा।।3.50.15।। दहेद्दहनभूतेन वृत्रमिन्द्राशनिर्यथा।
transliteration: kṣiprṃ visṛja vaidehīṃ mā tvā ghoreṇa cakṣuṣā||3.50.15|| daheddahanabhūtena vṛtramindrāśaniryathā|
meaning: Leave Vaidehi at once lest with her fierce looks you should be burnt down like demon Vrtra by the thunderbolt of Indra.

sanskrit: सर्पमाशीविषं बद्ध्वा वस्त्रान्ते नावबुध्यसे।।3.50.16।। ग्रीवायां प्रतिसक्तं च कालपाशं न पश्यसि।
transliteration: sarpamāśīviṣṃ baddhvā vastrānte nāvabudhyase||3.50.16|| grīvāyāṃ pratisaktṃ ca kālapāśṃ na paśyasi|
meaning: You are not aware that you are tying a venomous snake with the skirt of your cloth. worn by you. You are not able to see the noose of death tightened around your neck.

sanskrit: स भारस्सौम्य भर्तव्यो यो नरं नावसादयेत्।।3.50.17।। तदन्नमपि भोक्तव्यं जीर्यते यदनामयम्।
transliteration: sa bhārassaumya bhartavyo yo narṃ nāvasādayet||3.50.17|| tadannamapi bhoktavyṃ jīryate yadanāmayam|
meaning: O gentle Ravana one should carry that much of weight which does not tire him. One should eat only that wholesome food which can be easily digested.

sanskrit: यत्कृत्वा न भवेद्धर्मो न कीर्तिर्न यशो भुवि।।3.50.18।। शरीरस्य भवेत्खेदः कस्तत्कर्म समाचरेत्।
transliteration: yatkṛtvā na bhaveddharmo na kīrtirna yaśo bhuvi||3.50.18|| śarīrasya bhavetkhedḥ kastatkarma samācaret|
meaning: Who will do such a deed which cannot beget dharma, fame or glory in the world? Who will do such deeds that bring only exhaustion to the body?

sanskrit: षष्टिर्वर्षसहस्राणि मम जातस्य रावण।।3.50.19।। पितृपैतामहं राज्यं यथावदनुतिष्ठतः।
transliteration: ṣaṣṭirvarṣasahasrāṇi mama jātasya rāvaṇa||3.50.19|| pitṛpaitāmahṃ rājyṃ yathāvadanutiṣṭhatḥ|
meaning: Sixty thousand years ago I was born, O Ravana Since then I have ruled justly my hereditary kingdom.

sanskrit: वृद्धोऽहं त्वं युवा धन्वी सशरः कवची रथी।।3.50.20।। तथाप्यादाय वैदेहीं कुशली न गमिष्यसि।
transliteration: vṛddho'hṃ tvṃ yuvā dhanvī saśarḥ kavacī rathī||3.50.20|| tathāpyādāya vaidehīṃ kuśalī na gamiṣyasi|
meaning: I am old, you are young, wielding a bow and arrows, with shield to protect and chariot to ride. Even then I will not let you go safe with Vaidehi kidnapped.

sanskrit: न शक्तस्त्वं बलाद्धर्तुं वैदेहीं मम पश्यतः।।3.50.21।। हेतुभिर्न्यायसंसिद्धैद्धृवां वेदश्रुतीमिव।
transliteration: na śaktastvṃ balāddhartuṃ vaidehīṃ mama paśyatḥ||3.50.21|| hetubhirnyāyasṃsiddhaiddhṛvāṃ vedaśrutīmiva|
meaning: You cannot carry Vaidehi by force within my very sight just as the everlasting revelations of the Vedas cannot be robbed by mere logic of reason.

sanskrit: युद्ध्यस्व यदि शूरोऽसि मुहूर्तं तिष्ठ रावण।।3.50.22।। शयिष्यसे हतो भूमौ यथापूर्वं खरस्तथा।
transliteration: yuddhyasva yadi śūro'si muhūrtṃ tiṣṭha rāvaṇa||3.50.22|| śayiṣyase hato bhūmau yathāpūrvṃ kharastathā|
meaning: O Ravana, if you are brave, fight with me. In a moment, you will be killed like Khara and lie down on the ground.

sanskrit: असकृत्संयुगे येन निहता दैत्यदानवाः।।3.50.23।। नचिराच्चीरवासास्त्वां रामो युधि वधिष्यति।
transliteration: asakṛtsṃyuge yena nihatā daityadānavāḥ||3.50.23|| nacirāccīravāsāstvāṃ rāmo yudhi vadhiṣyati|
meaning: Clad in bark garments, Rama, who has often slain demons in the past will soon kill you in war.

sanskrit: किं नु शक्यं मया कर्तुं गतौदूरं नृपात्मजौ।।3.50.24।। क्षिप्रं त्वं नश्यसे नीच तयोर्भीतो न संशयः।
transliteration: kiṃ nu śakyṃ mayā kartuṃ gataudūrṃ nṛpātmajau||3.50.24|| kṣiprṃ tvṃ naśyase nīca tayorbhīto na sṃśayḥ|
meaning: What can I do? O mean fellow the two princes have gone far away.You will soon be destroyed out of fear for them. There is no doubt.

sanskrit: न हि मे जीवमानस्य नयिष्यसि शुभामिमाम्।।3.50.25।। सीतां कमलपत्राक्षीं रामस्य महिषीं प्रियाम्।
transliteration: na hi me jīvamānasya nayiṣyasi śubhāmimām||3.50.25|| sītāṃ kamalapatrākṣīṃ rāmasya mahiṣīṃ priyām|
meaning: I will not let you take away the auspicious, lotuseyed Sita, the dear consort of Rama as long as I am alive.

sanskrit: अवश्यं तु मया कार्यं प्रियं तस्य महात्मनः।।3.50.26।। जीवितेनापि रामस्य तथा दशरथस्य च।
transliteration: avaśyṃ tu mayā kāryṃ priyṃ tasya mahātmanḥ||3.50.26|| jīvitenāpi rāmasya tathā daśarathasya ca|
meaning: I should do this important work of those great souls, Rama and Dasaratha, even if it claims my life.

sanskrit: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ दशग्रीव मुहूर्तं पश्य रावण।।3.50.27।। युद्धातिथ्यं प्रदास्यामि यथाप्राणं निशाचर। वृन्तादिव फलं त्वां तु पातय
transliteration: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha daśagrīva muhūrtṃ paśya rāvaṇa||3.50.27|| yuddhātithyṃ pradāsyāmi yathāprāṇṃ niśācara| vṛntādiva phalṃ tvā
meaning: O ten headed Ravana stay, stay for a while. O demon as long as I am alive I will treat you with the hospitality of war. You will be pulled down from this best of the chariots like a ripe fruit drops from the stalk. इत्या

sanskrit: संरक्तनयनः कोपात्तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः। राक्षसेन्द्रोऽभिदुद्राव पतगेन्द्रममर्षणः।।3.51.2।।
transliteration: sṃraktanayanḥ kopāttaptakāñcanakuṇḍalḥ| rākṣasendro'bhidudrāva patagendramamarṣaṇḥ||3.51.2||
meaning: As the bright gold earrings of the intolerant king of demons glittered, his eyes turned red in rage and he pounced upon Jatayu, the lord of birds.

sanskrit: स सम्प्रहारस्तुमुल स्तयोस्तस्मिन्महावने। बभूव वातोद्धतयोर्मेघयोर्गगने यथा।।3.51.3।।
transliteration: sa samprahārastumula stayostasminmahāvane| babhūva vātoddhatayormeghayorgagane yathā||3.51.3||
meaning: The clash between them was tumultuous and it appeared like the clash of two pieces of clouds in the sky raised by stormy winds.

sanskrit: तद्बभूवाद्भुतं युद्धं गृध्रराक्षसयोस्तदा। सपक्षयोर्माल्यवतोर्महापर्वतयोरिव।।3.51.4।।
transliteration: tadbabhūvādbhutṃ yuddhṃ gṛdhrarākṣasayostadā| sapakṣayormālyavatormahāparvatayoriva||3.51.4||
meaning: The duel between Ravana and Jatayu looked as though it was a fight between two huge winged mountains of Malyavan range.

sanskrit: ततो नालीकनाराचैस्तीक्ष्णाग्रैश्च विकर्णिभिः। अभ्यवर्षन्महाघोरैर्गृध्रराजं महाबलः।।3.51.5।।
transliteration: tato nālīkanārācaistīkṣṇāgraiśca vikarṇibhiḥ| abhyavarṣanmahāghorairgṛdhrarājṃ mahābalḥ||3.51.5||
meaning: Then the mighty Ravana rained sharp, dreadful shafts, spears and Vikarnis at Jatayu, king of vultures.

sanskrit: स तानि शरजालानि गृध्रः पत्त्ररथेश्वरः। जटायुः प्रतिजग्राह रावणास्त्राणि संयुगे।।3.51.6।।
transliteration: sa tāni śarajālāni gṛdhrḥ pattraratheśvarḥ| jaṭāyuḥ pratijagrāha rāvaṇāstrāṇi sṃyuge||3.51.6||
meaning: Jatayu, lord of the birds, faced the arrows and other weapons showered by Ravana.

sanskrit: तस्य तीक्ष्णनखाभ्यां तु चरणाभ्यां महाबलः। चकार बहुधा गात्रे व्रणान्पतगसत्तमः।।3.51.7।।
transliteration: tasya tīkṣṇanakhābhyāṃ tu caraṇābhyāṃ mahābalḥ| cakāra bahudhā gātre vraṇānpatagasattamḥ||3.51.7||
meaning: The mighty, virtuous vulture with his sharp claws wounded many parts of the body of Ravana.

sanskrit: अथ क्रोधाद्धशग्रीवो जग्राह दश मार्गणान्। मृत्युदण्डनिभान्घोरान्छत्रुमर्दनकाङ्क्षया।।3.51.8।।
transliteration: atha krodhāddhaśagrīvo jagrāha daśa mārgaṇān| mṛtyudaṇḍanibhānghorānchatrumardanakāṅkṣayā||3.51.8||
meaning: Ravana in a rage took ten dreadful darts (looking) like the staff of death with a desire to crush the enemy.

sanskrit: स तैर्बाणैर्महावीर्यः पूर्णमुक्तैरजिह्मगैः। बिभेद निशितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्गृध्रं घोरैश्शिलीमुखैः।।3.51.9।।
transliteration: sa tairbāṇairmahāvīryḥ pūrṇamuktairajihmagaiḥ| bibheda niśitaistīkṣṇairgṛdhrṃ ghoraiśśilīmukhaiḥ||3.51.9||
meaning: The mighty Ravana fully released his dreadful, sharp arrows that went straight and pierced the vulture.

sanskrit: स राक्षसरथे पश्यन्जानकीं बाष्पलोचनाम्। अचिन्तयित्वा तान्बाणान्राक्षसं समभिद्रवत्।।3.51.10।।
transliteration: sa rākṣasarathe paśyanjānakīṃ bāṣpalocanām| acintayitvā tānbāṇānrākṣasṃ samabhidravat||3.51.10||
meaning: Seeing Sita, daughter of Janaka, on the demon's chariot with eyes full of tears, Jatayu without minding the arrows renewed his attack.

sanskrit: ततोऽस्य सशरं चापं मुक्तामणिविभूषितम्। चरणाभ्यां महातेजा बभञ्ज पतगेश्वरः।।3.51.11।।
transliteration: tato'sya saśarṃ cāpṃ muktāmaṇivibhūṣitam| caraṇābhyāṃ mahātejā babhañja patageśvarḥ||3.51.11||
meaning: The glorious lord of birds crushed with his feet the bow and arrow of Ravana with pearls and gems encrusted.

sanskrit: ततोऽन्यद्धनुरादाय रावणः क्रोधमूर्छितः। ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।।3.51.12।।
transliteration: tato'nyaddhanurādāya rāvaṇḥ krodhamūrchitḥ| vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśḥ||3.51.12||
meaning: Overcome with anger, Ravana took another bow and rained (on him) hundreds and thousands of arrows.

sanskrit: शरैरावारितस्तस्य संयुगे पतगेश्वरः। कुलायमुपसम्प्राप्तः पक्षीव प्रबभौ तदा।।3.51.13।।
transliteration: śarairāvāritastasya sṃyuge patageśvarḥ| kulāyamupasamprāptḥ pakṣīva prababhau tadā||3.51.13||
meaning: Jatayu, shot with arrows on all sides in the combat, shone like the bird that returned to its nest.

sanskrit: स तानि शरवर्षाणि पक्षाभ्यां च विधूयच। चरणाभ्यां महातेजा बभञ्जास्य महद्धनुः।।3.51.14।।
transliteration: sa tāni śaravarṣāṇi pakṣābhyāṃ ca vidhūyaca| caraṇābhyāṃ mahātejā babhañjāsya mahaddhanuḥ||3.51.14||
meaning: Powerful Jatayu scattered the shower of arrows with his wings and broke down the great bow with his claws.

sanskrit: तच्चाग्निसदृशं दीप्तं रावणस्य शरावरम्। पक्षाभ्यां स महावीर्यो व्याधुनोत्पतगेश्वरः।।3.51.15।।
transliteration: taccāgnisadṛśṃ dīptṃ rāvaṇasya śarāvaram| pakṣābhyāṃ sa mahāvīryo vyādhunotpatageśvarḥ||3.51.15||
meaning: Mighty Jatayu, lord of the birds, shattered with his wings the armour of Ravana that was glowing like fire.

sanskrit: काञ्चनोरश्छदान्दिव्यान्पिशाचवदनान्खरान्। तांश्चास्य जवसम्पन्नाञ्जघान समरे बली।।3.51.16।।
transliteration: kāñcanoraśchadāndivyānpiśācavadanānkharān| tāṃścāsya javasampannāñjaghāna samare balī||3.51.16||
meaning: Powerful Jatayu killed in the combat, the splendid, swiftmoving, devilfaced asses with golden shields yoked to the chariot.

sanskrit: वरं त्रिवेणुसम्पन्नं कामगं पावकार्चिषम्। मणिहेमविचित्राङ्गं बभञ्ज च महारथम्।।3.51.17।।
transliteration: varṃ triveṇusampannṃ kāmagṃ pāvakārciṣam| maṇihemavicitrāṅgṃ babhañja ca mahāratham||3.51.17||
meaning: Then he(Jatayu) broke down the great chariot(of Ravana) glowing like fire, glittering with gold and gems, made of three bamboo reeds, and capable of flying wherever the rider willed.

sanskrit: पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतीकाशं छत्रं च व्यजनैस्सह। पातयामास वेगेन ग्राहिभी राक्षसैस्सह।।3.51.18।।
transliteration: pūrṇacandrapratīkāśṃ chatrṃ ca vyajanaissaha| pātayāmāsa vegena grāhibhī rākṣasaissaha||3.51.18||
meaning: Jatayu violently pulled down the parasol shining like the full moon and the fans of the chariot along with the demons holding them.

sanskrit: सारथेश्चास्य वेगेन तुण्डेनैव महच्छिरः। पुनर्व्यपाहरच्छ्रीमान्पक्षिराजो महाबलः।।3.51.19।।
transliteration: sāratheścāsya vegena tuṇḍenaiva mahacchirḥ| punarvyapāharacchrīmānpakṣirājo mahābalḥ||3.51.19||
meaning: Again the glorious, powerful king of birds swiftly shattered the huge head of the charioteer with his beak.

sanskrit: स भग्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः। अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीं पपात भुवि रावणः।।3.51.20।।
transliteration: sa bhagnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ| aṅkenādāya vaidehīṃ papāta bhuvi rāvaṇḥ||3.51.20||
meaning: With the bow broken, the chariot destroyed, asses (drawing the chariot) and the charioteer dead, Ravana fell down on the ground holding Vaidehi on his lap.

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा निपतितं भूमौ रावणं भग्नवाहनम्। साधुसाध्विति भूतानि गृध्रराजमपूजयन्।।3.51.21।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā nipatitṃ bhūmau rāvaṇṃ bhagnavāhanam| sādhusādhviti bhūtāni gṛdhrarājamapūjayan||3.51.21||
meaning: Seeing Ravana fallen on the ground with his broken chariot, all beings honoured the king of the birds, saying, Well done Well done

sanskrit: परिश्रान्तं तु तं दृष्टवा जरया पक्षियूथपम्। उत्पपात पुनर्हृष्टो मैथिलीं गृह्य रावणः।।3.51.22।।
transliteration: pariśrāntṃ tu tṃ dṛṣṭavā jarayā pakṣiyūthapam| utpapāta punarhṛṣṭo maithilīṃ gṛhya rāvaṇḥ||3.51.22||
meaning: Seeing the lord of the flocks of birds exhausted due to age still fighting, Ravana felt glad. He flew back into the sky taking Sita, princess of Mithila, with him.

sanskrit: तं प्रहृष्टं निधायाङ्के गच्छन्तं जनकात्मजाम्। गृध्रराजस्समुत्पत्य समभिद्रुत्य रावणम्।।3.51.23।। समावार्य महातेजा जटायुरि
transliteration: tṃ prahṛṣṭṃ nidhāyāṅke gacchantṃ janakātmajām| gṛdhrarājassamutpatya samabhidrutya rāvaṇam||3.51.23|| samāvārya mahātejā
meaning: Seeing Sita, Janaka's daughter, happily carried away into the sky by Ravana on his lap. Jatayu, the mighty king of vultures chased him, and obstructing his path said :

sanskrit: वज्रसंस्पर्शबाणस्य भार्यां रामस्य रावण।।3.51.24।। अल्पबुद्धे हरस्येनां वधाय खलु रक्षसाम्।
transliteration: vajrasṃsparśabāṇasya bhāryāṃ rāmasya rāvaṇa||3.51.24|| alpabuddhe harasyenāṃ vadhāya khalu rakṣasām|
meaning: Foolish Ravana, you are kidnapping this lady, wife of Rama, whose arrows can hit like a thunderbolt. This will lead to the destruction of all demons.

sanskrit: समित्रबन्धुस्सामात्यस्सबलस्सपरिच्छदः।।3.51.25।। विषपानं पिबस्येतत्पिपासित इवोदकम्।
transliteration: samitrabandhussāmātyassabalassaparicchadḥ||3.51.25|| viṣapānṃ pibasyetatpipāsita ivodakam|
meaning: You are drinking poison along with all your friends, relatives, ministers, the army and your allies. like a thirsty man drinks water.

sanskrit: अनुबन्धमजानन्तः कर्मणामविचक्षणाः।।3.51.26।। शीघ्रमेव विनश्यन्ति यथा त्वं विनशिष्यसि।
transliteration: anubandhamajānantḥ karmaṇāmavicakṣaṇāḥ||3.51.26|| śīghrameva vinaśyanti yathā tvṃ vinaśiṣyasi|
meaning: Fools who do not know the consequences of their action perish soon. Similarly you are going to die soon.

sanskrit: बद्धस्त्वं कालपाशेन क्व गतस्तस्य मोक्ष्यसे।।3.51.27।। वधाय बडिशं गृह्य सामिषं जलजो यथा।
transliteration: baddhastvṃ kālapāśena kva gatastasya mokṣyase||3.51.27|| vadhāya baḍiśṃ gṛhya sāmiṣṃ jalajo yathā|
meaning: You are bound by the noose of death like a fish holding on to the bait of the fishing hook. Where can you go now?

sanskrit: न हि जातु दुराधर्षौ काकुत्स्थौ तव रावण।।3.51.28।। धर्षणं चाश्रमस्यास्य क्षमिष्येते तु राघवौ।
transliteration: na hi jātu durādharṣau kākutsthau tava rāvaṇa||3.51.28|| dharṣaṇṃ cāśramasyāsya kṣamiṣyete tu rāghavau|
meaning: O Ravana know that Rama and Lakshmana, the Kakutsthas, are invincible. They will not forgive the asssault you have made on their hermitage.

sanskrit: यथा त्वया कृतं कर्म भीरुणा लोकगर्हितम्।।3.51.29।। तस्कराचरितो मार्गो नैव वीरनिषेवितः।
transliteration: yathā tvayā kṛtṃ karma bhīruṇā lokagarhitam||3.51.29|| taskarācarito mārgo naiva vīraniṣevitḥ|
meaning: Your cowardly action will be condemned by the whole world. The path you have chosen is the path of a thief and not of a hero.

sanskrit: युध्यस्व यदि शूरोऽसि मुहूर्तं तिष्ठरावण।।3.51.30।। शयिष्यसे हतो भूमौ यथा भ्राता खरस्तथा।
transliteration: yudhyasva yadi śūro'si muhūrtṃ tiṣṭharāvaṇa||3.51.30|| śayiṣyase hato bhūmau yathā bhrātā kharastathā|
meaning: O Ravana if you are courageous, tarry awhile and fight with me. Like your brother Khara, you will lie on the ground dead.

sanskrit: परेतकाले पुरुषो यत्कर्म प्रतिपद्यते।।3.51.31।। विनाशायात्मनोऽधर्म्यं प्रतिपन्नोऽसि कर्म तत्।
transliteration: paretakāle puruṣo yatkarma pratipadyate||3.51.31|| vināśāyātmano'dharmyṃ pratipanno'si karma tat|
meaning: You have resorted to unrighteous action like a dying man. This will spell your destruction.

sanskrit: पापानुबन्धो वै यस्य कर्मणः कर्मको नु तत्।।3.51.32।। कुर्वीत लोकाधिपतिस्स्वयंभूर्भगवानपि।
transliteration: pāpānubandho vai yasya karmaṇḥ karmako nu tat||3.51.32|| kurvīta lokādhipatissvayṃbhūrbhagavānapi|
meaning: If the consequences of an action be sin, who will do it ? Even the selfborn lord of the world may not.

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा शुभं वाक्यं जटायुस्तस्य रक्षसः।।3.51.33।। निपपात भृशं पृष्ठे दशग्रीवस्य वीर्यवान्।
transliteration: evamuktvā śubhṃ vākyṃ jaṭāyustasya rakṣasḥ||3.51.33|| nipapāta bhṛśṃ pṛṣṭhe daśagrīvasya vīryavān|
meaning: Brave Jatayu having thus said these cautious words to the demon dashed against his back again and again.

sanskrit: तं गृहीत्वा नखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्विददार समन्ततः।।3.51.34।। अधिरूढो गजारोहो यथा स्याद्दुष्टवारणम्।
transliteration: tṃ gṛhītvā nakhaistīkṣṇairvidadāra samantatḥ||3.51.34|| adhirūḍho gajāroho yathā syādduṣṭavāraṇam|
meaning: Thereafter, seizing Ravana, Jatayu ascended on his back and pierced his body all over with his sharp claws just as a rider goads an unruly elephant.

sanskrit: विददार नखैरस्य तुण्डं पृष्ठे समर्पयन्।।3.51.35।। केशांश्चोत्पाटयामास नखपक्षमुखायुधः।
transliteration: vidadāra nakhairasya tuṇḍṃ pṛṣṭhe samarpayan||3.51.35|| keśāṃścotpāṭayāmāsa nakhapakṣamukhāyudhḥ|
meaning: Jatayu who had his claws, wings and beak as the only weapons pierced and pricked Ravana all over with his nails by pressing his beak on his back and pulled out his hair.

sanskrit: स तथा गृध्रराजेन क्लिश्यमानो मुहुर्मुहुः।।3.51.36।। अमर्षस्फुरितोष्ठस्सन्प्राकम्पत च रावणः।
transliteration: sa tathā gṛdhrarājena kliśyamāno muhurmuhuḥ||3.51.36|| amarṣasphuritoṣṭhassanprākampata ca rāvaṇḥ|
meaning: Thus tormented again and again by the king of vultures, Ravana shook with anger, his lips quivering.

sanskrit: स परिष्वज्य च वैदेहीं वामेनाङ्केन रावणः।।3.51.37।। तलेनाभिजघानाशु जटायुं क्रोधमुर्छीतः।
transliteration: sa pariṣvajya ca vaidehīṃ vāmenāṅkena rāvaṇḥ||3.51.37|| talenābhijaghānāśu jaṭāyuṃ krodhamurchītḥ|
meaning: Losing his senses, with rage, Ravana held Vaidehi (Sita) with his left arm and hit Jatayu with his palm.

sanskrit: जटायुस्तमभिक्रम्य तुण्डेनास्य खगाधिपः।।3.51.38।। वामबाहून्दश तदा व्यपाहरदरिन्दमः।
transliteration: jaṭāyustamabhikramya tuṇḍenāsya khagādhipḥ||3.51.38|| vāmabāhūndaśa tadā vyapāharadarindamḥ|
meaning: Then Jatayu, lord of the birds, subduer of enemies, overpowered Ravana and dismembered his ten left arms with his beak.

sanskrit: सञ्छिन्नबाहोस्सद्यैव बाहवस्सहसाभवन्।।3.51.39।। विषज्वालावलीयुक्ता वल्मीकादिव पन्नगाः।
transliteration: sañchinnabāhossadyaiva bāhavassahasābhavan||3.51.39|| viṣajvālāvalīyuktā valmīkādiva pannagāḥ|
meaning: As the left arms were cut off, there came out from them all the ten arms instantaneously like serpents emitting poisonous flames from anthills

sanskrit: ततः क्रोधाद्दशग्रीवस्सीतामुत्सृज्य रावणः।।3.51.40।। मुष्टिभ्यां चरणाभ्यां च गृध्रराजमपोथयत्।
transliteration: tatḥ krodhāddaśagrīvassītāmutsṛjya rāvaṇḥ||3.51.40|| muṣṭibhyāṃ caraṇābhyāṃ ca gṛdhrarājamapothayat|
meaning: Then the tenheaded Ravana left Sita and attacked Jatayu with his fists and feet out of anger.

sanskrit: ततो मुहूर्तं सङ्ग्रामो बभूवातुल्यवीर्ययोः।।3.51.41।। राक्षसानां च मुख्यस्य पक्षिणां प्रवरस्य च।
transliteration: tato muhūrtṃ saṅgrāmo babhūvātulyavīryayoḥ||3.51.41|| rākṣasānāṃ ca mukhyasya pakṣiṇāṃ pravarasya ca|
meaning: Between the warriors of unequal valour, Ravana and Jatayu, the chief of the demons and the foremost of the birds, the fight took place for a moment.

sanskrit: तस्य व्यायच्छमानस्य रामस्यार्थे स रावणः।।3.51.42।। पक्षौ पार्श्वौ च पादौ च खड्गमुद्धृत्य सोऽच्छिनत्।
transliteration: tasya vyāyacchamānasya rāmasyārthe sa rāvaṇḥ||3.51.42|| pakṣau pārśvau ca pādau ca khaḍgamuddhṛtya so'cchinat|
meaning: Ravana lifted his sword and cut off both the wings and feet of Jatayu who was fighting relentlessly (for Rama's sake).

sanskrit: स च्छिन्नपक्षस्सहसा रक्षसा रौद्रकर्मणा।।3.51.43।। निपपात हतो गृद्रो धरण्यामल्पजीवितः।
transliteration: sa cchinnapakṣassahasā rakṣasā raudrakarmaṇā||3.51.43|| nipapāta hato gṛdro dharaṇyāmalpajīvitḥ|
meaning: (Seriously) wounded and almost dead,the vulture fell down on the ground all at once, when his wings were chipped by the demon of terrible deeds.

sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ क्षतजार्द्रं जटायुषम्।।3.51.44।। अभ्यधावत वैदेही स्वबन्धुमिव दुःखिता।
transliteration: tṃ dṛṣṭvā patitṃ bhūmau kṣatajārdrṃ jaṭāyuṣam||3.51.44|| abhyadhāvata vaidehī svabandhumiva duḥkhitā|
meaning: Sita, princess of Videha, saw the wounded Jatayu fallen on the ground drenched in blood. Grieving, she ran towards him as if he was her relative.

sanskrit: तं नीलजीमूतनिकाशकल्पं सुपाण्डुरोरस्कमुदारवीर्यम्। ददर्श लङ्काधिपतिः पृथिव्यां जटायुषं शान्तमिवाग्निदावम्।।3.51.45।।
transliteration: tṃ nīlajīmūtanikāśakalpṃ supāṇḍuroraskamudāravīryam| dadarśa laṅkādhipatiḥ pṛthivyāṃ jaṭāyuṣṃ śāntamivāgnidāvam||3.51.45
meaning: Lord of Lanka saw that very bold Jatayu of dark blue colour of the cloud, fair chest, fallen on the ground, looking like the forest fire that had been put out.

sanskrit: ततस्तु तं पत्ररथं महीतले निपातितं रावणवेगमर्दितम्। पुनः परिश्वज्य शशिप्रभानना रुरोद सीता जनकात्मजातदा।।3.51.46।।
transliteration: tatastu tṃ patrarathṃ mahītale nipātitṃ rāvaṇavegamarditam| punḥ pariśvajya śaśiprabhānanā ruroda sītā janakātmajātadā||
meaning: Sita, daughter of Janaka, whose face was radiant like the Moon once again embraced Jatayu, the winged warrior, fallen on the ground, crushed by Ravana's onslaught and wept. इतयार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण

sanskrit: निमित्तं लक्षणज्ञानं शकुनिस्वरदर्शनम्। अवश्यं सुखदुःखेषु नराणां प्रतिदृश्यते।।3.52.2।।
transliteration: nimittṃ lakṣaṇajñānṃ śakunisvaradarśanam| avaśyṃ sukhaduḥkheṣu narāṇāṃ pratidṛśyate||3.52.2||
meaning: People, for sure, foresee weal and woe in life from auspicious symptoms and ominous sounds.

sanskrit: नूनं राम न जानासि महद्व्यसनमात्मनः। धावन्ति नूनं काकुत्स्थं मदर्थं मृगपक्षिणः।।3.52.3।।
transliteration: nūnṃ rāma na jānāsi mahadvyasanamātmanḥ| dhāvanti nūnṃ kākutsthṃ madarthṃ mṛgapakṣiṇḥ||3.52.3||
meaning: O Rama you are, indeed, unaware of the great disaster that has befallen you. All the animals and birds are running for my sake to tell you about me, O scion of the Kakutsthas.

sanskrit: अयं हि पापचारेण मां त्रातुमभिसङ्गतः। शेते विनिहतो भूमौ ममाभाग्याद्विहंगमः।।3.52.4।।
transliteration: ayṃ hi pāpacāreṇa māṃ trātumabhisaṅgatḥ| śete vinihato bhūmau mamābhāgyādvihṃgamḥ||3.52.4||
meaning: 'This bird that came forward to save me is hit by the sinner(Ravana) and lies down on the ground, as ill luck would have it.

sanskrit: त्राहि मामद्य काकुत्स्थ लक्ष्मणेति वराङ्गना। सुसन्त्रस्ता समाक्रन्दच्छृण्वतां तु यथान्तिके।।3.52.5।।
transliteration: trāhi māmadya kākutstha lakṣmaṇeti varāṅganā| susantrastā samākrandacchṛṇvatāṃ tu yathāntike||3.52.5||
meaning: Terribly frightened, the beautiful lady (Sita) cried bitterly, 'O Rama, O Lakshmana, save me', as if they were close by and were listening to her.

sanskrit: तां क्लिष्टमाल्याभरणां विलपन्तीमनाथवत्। अभ्यधावत् वैदेहीं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः।।3.52.6।।
transliteration: tāṃ kliṣṭamālyābharaṇāṃ vilapantīmanāthavat| abhyadhāvat vaidehīṃ rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipḥ||3.52.6||
meaning: Ravana, king of the demons, ran towards Sita who was weeping like an orphan with her garlands and ornaments crushed.

sanskrit: तां लतामिव वेष्टन्तीमालिङ्गन्तीं महाद्रुमान्। मुञ्च मुञ्चेति बहुशः प्रवदन्राक्षसाधिपः।।3.52.7।। क्रोशन्तीं राम रामेति रा
transliteration: tāṃ latāmiva veṣṭantīmāliṅgantīṃ mahādrumān| muñca muñceti bahuśḥ pravadanrākṣasādhipḥ||3.52.7|| krośantīṃ rāma rāmeti r
meaning: Separated from Rama in the forest, Sita hugged huge trees, running round and round like a creeper coiled, crying loudly, 'Rama, O Rama' . The king of the demons, like Yama, caught hold of her hair only to invite his deat

sanskrit: प्रधर्षितायां सीतायां बभूव सचराचरम्। जगत्सर्वममर्यादं तमसान्धेन संवृतम्।।3.52.9।। न वाति मारुतस्तत्र निष्प्रभोऽभूद्दिवाक
transliteration: pradharṣitāyāṃ sītāyāṃ babhūva sacarācaram| jagatsarvamamaryādṃ tamasāndhena sṃvṛtam||3.52.9|| na vāti mārutastatra niṣp
meaning: While Sita was being assaulted, the earth with the animate and the inanimate crossed all limits of moral law and became enveloped in blinding darkness. The wind ceased to blow and the Sun, to shine.

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा सीतां परामृष्टां दीनां दिव्येन चक्षुषा।।3.52.10।। कृतं कार्यमिति श्रीमान्व्याजहार पितामहः।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā sītāṃ parāmṛṣṭāṃ dīnāṃ divyena cakṣuṣā||3.52.10|| kṛtṃ kāryamiti śrīmānvyājahāra pitāmahḥ|
meaning: Brahma, the glorious Grandfather, saw with his divine eyes, Sita in a desperate state caught by the enemy and said, 'The task is accomplished.

sanskrit: प्रहृष्टा व्यथिताश्चासन्सर्वे ते परमर्षयः।।3.52.11।। दृष्ट्वा सीतां परामृष्टां दण्डकारण्यवासिनः। रावणस्य विनाशं च प्राप्
transliteration: prahṛṣṭā vyathitāścāsansarve te paramarṣayḥ||3.52.11|| dṛṣṭvā sītāṃ parāmṛṣṭāṃ daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinḥ| rāvaṇasya vināśṃ ca p
meaning: All the great seers residing in Dandaka forest felt both happy and sad, happy because the destruction of Ravana is at hand and sad because Sita was in distress.

sanskrit: स तु तां राम रामेति रुदन्तीं लक्ष्मणेति च। जगामादाय चाकाशं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः।।3.52.13।।
transliteration: sa tu tāṃ rāma rāmeti rudantīṃ lakṣmaṇeti ca| jagāmādāya cākāśṃ rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipḥ||3.52.13||
meaning: While Sita was crying, 'O Rama, O Lakshmana', Ravana, lord of the demons, carried her back into the sky.

sanskrit: तप्ताभरणजुष्टाङ्गी पीतकौशेयवासिनी। रराजराजपुत्री तुविद्युत्सौदामिनी यथा।।3.52.14।।
transliteration: taptābharaṇajuṣṭāṅgī pītakauśeyavāsinī| rarājarājaputrī tuvidyutsaudāminī yathā||3.52.14||
meaning: SIta who had put on pure gold ornaments on her body and who was clad in yellow silk shone like lightning.

sanskrit: उद्धूतेन च वस्त्रेण तस्याः पीतेन रावणः। अधिकं परिबभ्राज गिरिर्दीप्त इवाग्निना।।3.52.15।।
transliteration: uddhūtena ca vastreṇa tasyāḥ pītena rāvaṇḥ| adhikṃ paribabhrāja girirdīpta ivāgninā||3.52.15||
meaning: Ravana was shining all the more with(her) yellow clothes blowing in the air, and looked like a mountain shining with fire burning around.
