sanskrit: तस्याः परमकल्याण्यास्ताम्राणि सुरभीणि च। पद्मपत्राणि वैदेह्या अभ्यकीर्यन्त रावणम्।।3.52.16।।
transliteration: tasyāḥ paramakalyāṇyāstāmrāṇi surabhīṇi ca| padmapatrāṇi vaidehyā abhyakīryanta rāvaṇam||3.52.16||
meaning: The red lotus petals worn by the most auspicious Sita, princess of Videha, were showered on Ravana.

sanskrit: तस्याः कौशेयमुद्धूतमाकाशे कनकप्रभम्। बभौ चादित्यरागेण ताम्रमभ्रमिवातपे।।3.52.17।।
transliteration: tasyāḥ kauśeyamuddhūtamākāśe kanakaprabham| babhau cādityarāgeṇa tāmramabhramivātape||3.52.17||
meaning: As the goldencoloured garment worn by Sita blew in the wind, it looked like a coppercoloured cloud illumined by the evening Sun in the sky.

sanskrit: तस्यास्तत्सुनसं वक्त्रमाकाशे रावणाङ्कगम्। न रराज विना रामं विनालमिव पङ्कजम्।।3.52.18।।
transliteration: tasyāstatsunasṃ vaktramākāśe rāvaṇāṅkagam| na rarāja vinā rāmṃ vinālamiva paṅkajam||3.52.18||
meaning: Sita's face with her beautiful nose on Ravana's lap and not on Rama's, shone no more like a lotus without its stalk.

sanskrit: बभूव जलदं नीलं भित्त्वा चन्द्र इवोदितः। सुललाटं सुकेशान्तं पद्मगर्भाभमव्रणम्।।3.52.19।। शुक्लैस्सुविमलैर्दन्तै प्रभावद्भ
transliteration: babhūva jaladṃ nīlṃ bhittvā candra ivoditḥ| sulalāṭṃ sukeśāntṃ padmagarbhābhamavraṇam||3.52.19|| śuklaissuvimalairdantai
meaning: Sita's face looked beautiful with her smooth forehead, shining hair and spotless complexion like the inside of a lotus, with clean, white, shining teeth, a nice nose and lovely red lips. She was continuously weeping and

sanskrit: राक्षसेन समाधूतं तस्यास्तद्वदनं शुभम्। शुशुभे न विना रामंदिवा चन्द्र इवोदितः।।3.52.22।।
transliteration: rākṣasena samādhūtṃ tasyāstadvadanṃ śubham| śuśubhe na vinā rāmṃdivā candra ivoditḥ||3.52.22||
meaning: Shaken up by the demon and deprived of Rama's company, Sita's beautiful face looked like the Moon during daytime without any glow.

sanskrit: सा हेमवर्णा नीलाङ्गं मैथिली राक्षसाधिपम्। शुशुभे काञ्चनी काञ्ची नीलं मणिमिवाश्रिता।।3.52.23।।
transliteration: sā hemavarṇā nīlāṅgṃ maithilī rākṣasādhipam| śuśubhe kāñcanī kāñcī nīlṃ maṇimivāśritā||3.52.23||
meaning: Goldencomplexioned Sita, princess of Mithila, held by the darkcoloured king of the demons, shone like a girdle resting on a dark blue sapphire.

sanskrit: सा पद्मगौरी हेमाभा रावणं जनकात्मजा। विद्युद्घनमिवाविश्य शुशुभे तप्तभूषणा।।3.52.24।।
transliteration: sā padmagaurī hemābhā rāvaṇṃ janakātmajā| vidyudghanamivāviśya śuśubhe taptabhūṣaṇā||3.52.24||
meaning: Bright like a golden lotus, adorned with gold ornaments, Sita, the daughter of Janaka, held by Ravana, looked like a streak of lightning shining bright in a dark cloud.

sanskrit: तस्या भूषणघोषेण वैदेह्या राक्षसाधिपः। बभौ सचपलो नीलस्सघोष इव तोयदः।।3.52.25।।
transliteration: tasyā bhūṣaṇaghoṣeṇa vaidehyā rākṣasādhipḥ| babhau sacapalo nīlassaghoṣa iva toyadḥ||3.52.25||
meaning: The lord of the demons by the side of Sita, princess of Videha with her jingling ornaments looked like the darkblue raincloud with its lightning and thunder.

sanskrit: उत्तमाङ्गाच्च्युता तस्याः पुष्पवृष्टिस्समन्ततः। सीताया ह्रिममाणायाः पपात धरणीतले।।3.52.26।।
transliteration: uttamāṅgāccyutā tasyāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭissamantatḥ| sītāyā hrimamāṇāyāḥ papāta dharaṇītale||3.52.26||
meaning: As Sita was being carried away, the shower of flowers dropped from her head and scattered on the earth.

sanskrit: सा तु रावणवेगेन पुष्पवृष्टिः समन्ततः। समाधूता दशग्रीवं पुनरेवाभ्यवर्तत।।3.52.27।।
transliteration: sā tu rāvaṇavegena puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ samantatḥ| samādhūtā daśagrīvṃ punarevābhyavartata||3.52.27||
meaning: The shower of flowers that fell flew towards the tenheaded Ravana again in the swirling motion (of the chariot).

sanskrit: अभ्यवर्तत पुष्पाणां धारा वैश्रवणानुजम्। नक्षत्रमाला विमला मेरुं नगमिवोन्नतम्।।3.52.28।।
transliteration: abhyavartata puṣpāṇāṃ dhārā vaiśravaṇānujam| nakṣatramālā vimalā meruṃ nagamivonnatam||3.52.28||
meaning: The shower of flowers that dropped went round towards Ravana, brother of Vaisravana, like the bright garland of stars move towards mount Meru.

sanskrit: चरणान्नूपुरं भ्रष्टं वैदेह्या रत्नभूषितम्। विद्युन्मण्डलसङ्काशं पपात मधुरस्वनम्।।3.52.29।।
transliteration: caraṇānnūpurṃ bhraṣṭṃ vaidehyā ratnabhūṣitam| vidyunmaṇḍalasaṅkāśṃ papāta madhurasvanam||3.52.29||
meaning: The gemstudded anklet of Sita, looking like an orb of lightning, dropped with a gentle sound.

sanskrit: तरुप्रवालरक्ता सा नीलाङ्गं राक्षसेश्वरम्। प्राशोभयत वैदेही गजं कक्ष्येव काञ्चनी।।3.52.30।।
transliteration: tarupravālaraktā sā nīlāṅgṃ rākṣaseśvaram| prāśobhayata vaidehī gajṃ kakṣyeva kāñcanī||3.52.30||
meaning: With her golden girdle, Sita whose complexion resembled tender leaves looked like a golden chain to bind an elephant with. (Here Ravana is the elephant).

sanskrit: तां महोल्कामिवाकाशे दीप्यमानां स्वतेजसा। जहाराऽकाशमाविस्य सीतां वैश्रवणानुजः।।3.52.31।।
transliteration: tāṃ maholkāmivākāśe dīpyamānāṃ svatejasā| jahārā'kāśamāvisya sītāṃ vaiśravaṇānujḥ||3.52.31||
meaning: The younger brother of Vaisravana (Ravana), like a massive comet, carried Sita, who was glowing in the radiance of her own beauty, and entered the sky.

sanskrit: तस्यास्तान्यग्निवर्णानि भूषणानि महीतले। सघोषाण्यवकीर्यन्त क्षीणास्तारा इवाम्बरात्।।3.52.32।।
transliteration: tasyāstānyagnivarṇāni bhūṣaṇāni mahītale| saghoṣāṇyavakīryanta kṣīṇāstārā ivāmbarāt||3.52.32||
meaning: Like the dim stars falling from the sky, her ornaments, bright as flame, scattered on the groundtinkling.

sanskrit: तस्यास्स्तनान्तराद्भ्रष्टो हारस्ताराधिपद्युतिः। वैदेह्या निपतन्भाति गङ्गेव गगनाच्च्युता।।3.52.33।।
transliteration: tasyāsstanāntarādbhraṣṭo hārastārādhipadyutiḥ| vaidehyā nipatanbhāti gaṅgeva gaganāccyutā||3.52.33||
meaning: Sita's necklace shining like the bright Moon slipped from between her breasts like the river Ganga falling down from the sky.

sanskrit: उत्पातवाताभिहता नानाद्विजगणायुताः। माभैरिति विधूताग्रा व्याजह्रुरिव पादपाः।।3.52.34।।
transliteration: utpātavātābhihatā nānādvijagaṇāyutāḥ| mābhairiti vidhūtāgrā vyājahruriva pādapāḥ||3.52.34||
meaning: The trees filled with birds of all kinds, shaken at the top by stormy winds seemed to be saying to Sita, 'Be not afraid'.

sanskrit: नलिन्यो ध्वस्तकमलास्त्रस्तमीनजलेचराः। सखीमिव गतोच्छ्वासामन्वशोचन्त मैथिलीम्।।3.52.35।।
transliteration: nalinyo dhvastakamalāstrastamīnajalecarāḥ| sakhīmiva gatocchvāsāmanvaśocanta maithilīm||3.52.35||
meaning: Lotusponds with withering lotuses and with disturbed aquatic life like fishes in fright were as if grieving for Sita as one would grieve for a companion who is unable to breathe.

sanskrit: समन्तादभिसम्पत्य सिंहव्याघ्रमृगद्विजाः। अन्वधावंस्तदा रोषात्सीतां छायानुगामिनः।।3.52.36।।
transliteration: samantādabhisampatya siṃhavyāghramṛgadvijāḥ| anvadhāvṃstadā roṣātsītāṃ chāyānugāminḥ||3.52.36||
meaning: Then the lions, tigers, deer and birds gathered together in anger (also anguish) and ran after Sita's shadow.

sanskrit: जलप्रपातास्रमुखाश्शृङ्गैरुच्छ्रितबाहुभिः। सीतायां ह्रियमाणायां विक्रोशन्तीव पर्वताः।।3.52.37।।
transliteration: jalaprapātāsramukhāśśṛṅgairucchritabāhubhiḥ| sītāyāṃ hriyamāṇāyāṃ vikrośantīva parvatāḥ||3.52.37||
meaning: The mountains were shedding tears in the form of waterfalls, and crying with hands lifted up in the form of peaks, while Sita was being carried away.

sanskrit: ह्रियमाणां तु वैदेहीं दृष्ट्वा दीनो दिवाकरः। प्रतिध्वस्तप्रभश्श्रीमानासीत्पाण्डरमण्डलः।।3.52.38।।
transliteration: hriyamāṇāṃ tu vaidehīṃ dṛṣṭvā dīno divākarḥ| pratidhvastaprabhaśśrīmānāsītpāṇḍaramaṇḍalḥ||3.52.38||
meaning: Seeing Sita abducted, the glorious Sun looked lustreless and distraught. He developed a pale white disk around him.

sanskrit: नास्ति धर्मः कुतस्सत्यं नार्जवं नानृशंसता। यत्र रामस्य वैदेहीं भार्यां हरति रावणः।।3.52.39।। इति सर्वाणि भूतानि गणशः पर्
transliteration: nāsti dharmḥ kutassatyṃ nārjavṃ nānṛśṃsatā| yatra rāmasya vaidehīṃ bhāryāṃ harati rāvaṇḥ||3.52.39|| iti sarvāṇi bhūtāni
meaning: When Rama's consort, the princess of Videha, is being carried away by Ravana, how can there be rightousness or truth or uprightness or compassion for men? Thus bewailed all beings in groups.

sanskrit: वित्रस्तका दीनमुखा रुरुदुर्मृगपोतकाः।।3.52.40।। उद्वीक्ष्योद्वीक्ष्य नयनैरस्रपाताविलेक्षणाः।
transliteration: vitrastakā dīnamukhā rurudurmṛgapotakāḥ||3.52.40|| udvīkṣyodvīkṣya nayanairasrapātāvilekṣaṇāḥ|
meaning: The young deer full of fear and distress looked again and again with eyes blurred with tears at the direction in which Sita went. And wept.

sanskrit: सुप्रवेपितगात्राश्च बभूवुर्वनदेवताः।।3.52.41।। विक्रोशन्तीं दृढं सीतां दृष्ट्वा दुःखं तथा गताम्।
transliteration: supravepitagātrāśca babhūvurvanadevatāḥ||3.52.41|| vikrośantīṃ dṛḍhṃ sītāṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhṃ tathā gatām|
meaning: The sylvan deities shivered, seeing Sita's grief and cried aloud.

sanskrit: तां तु लक्ष्मण रामेति क्रोशन्तीं मधुरस्वरम्।।3.52.42।। अवेक्षमाणां बहुशो वैदेहीं धरणीतलम्। स तामाकुलकेशान्तां विप्रमृष्ट
transliteration: tāṃ tu lakṣmaṇa rāmeti krośantīṃ madhurasvaram||3.52.42|| avekṣamāṇāṃ bahuśo vaidehīṃ dharaṇītalam| sa tāmākulakeśāntāṃ
meaning: The ten headed Ravana abducted Sita who was calling out, O Rama, O Lakshmana with her sweet voice, weeping , looking down on the earth her hair dishevelled and auspicious, (vermilion) mark on the forehead erased. Ravana

sanskrit: ततस्तु सा चारुदती शुचिस्मिता विनाकृता बन्धुजनेन मैथिली। अपश्यती राघवलक्ष्मणावुभौ विवर्णवक्त्राभयभारपीडिता।।3.52.44।।
transliteration: tatastu sā cārudatī śucismitā vinākṛtā bandhujanena maithilī| apaśyatī rāghavalakṣmaṇāvubhau vivarṇavaktrābhayabhārapīḍi
meaning: Then Sita whose teeth were beautiful and smile, sweet was distanced from her kins, and, unable to see both Rama and Lakshmana, grew pale in intense fear. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे द्विपञ्चा

sanskrit: रोषरोदनताम्राक्षी भीमाक्षं राक्षसाधिपम्। रुदन्ती करुणं सीता ह्रियमाणेदमब्रवीत्।।3.53.2।।
transliteration: roṣarodanatāmrākṣī bhīmākṣṃ rākṣasādhipam| rudantī karuṇṃ sītā hriyamāṇedamabravīt||3.53.2||
meaning: While being carried away, Sita wept piteously and her eyes went red with tears of anger and grief. Looking at the frightening eyes of the king of the demons, she said these words :

sanskrit: न व्यपत्रपसे नीच कर्मणानेन रावण। ज्ञात्वा विरहितां यन्मां चोरयित्वा पलायसे।।3.53.3।।
transliteration: na vyapatrapase nīca karmaṇānena rāvaṇa| jñātvā virahitāṃ yanmāṃ corayitvā palāyase||3.53.3||
meaning: O mean Ravana, are you not ashamed of kidnapping me when I was separated (from my husband)?

sanskrit: त्वयैव नूनं दुष्टात्मन् भीरुणा हर्तुमिच्छता। ममापवाहितो भर्ता मृगरूपेण मायया।।3.53.4।।
transliteration: tvayaiva nūnṃ duṣṭātman bhīruṇā hartumicchatā| mamāpavāhito bhartā mṛgarūpeṇa māyayā||3.53.4||
meaning: O wicked fellow, with an intention to abduct me you enticed my husband to a distance deceitfully in the form of a deer.

sanskrit: यो हि मामुद्यतस्त्रातुं सोऽप्ययं विनिपातितः। गृध्रराजः पुराणोऽसौ श्वशुरस्य सखा मम।।3.53.5।।
transliteration: yo hi māmudyatastrātuṃ so'pyayṃ vinipātitḥ| gṛdhrarājḥ purāṇo'sau śvaśurasya sakhā mama||3.53.5||
meaning: This Jatayu, an old friend of my fatherinlaw tried to protect me but he too has fallen a prey.

sanskrit: परमं खलु ते वीर्यं दृश्यते राक्षसाधम। विश्राव्य नामधेयं हि युद्धे नास्मि जिता त्वया।।3.53.6।।
transliteration: paramṃ khalu te vīryṃ dṛśyate rākṣasādhama| viśrāvya nāmadheyṃ hi yuddhe nāsmi jitā tvayā||3.53.6||
meaning: O lowly demon, you have, indeed, shown your heroism (in killing this old vulture). You have not won me in a battle declared by you.

sanskrit: ईदृशं गर्हितं कर्म कथं कृत्वा न लज्जसे। स्त्रियाश्च हरणं नीच रहिते च परस्य च।।3.53.7।।
transliteration: īdṛśṃ garhitṃ karma kathṃ kṛtvā na lajjase| striyāśca haraṇṃ nīca rahite ca parasya ca||3.53.7||
meaning: O lowly fellow how is it that you are not ashamed of commiting such a despicable act abducting another's wife when she is alone ?

sanskrit: कथयिष्यन्ति लोकेषु पुरुषाः कर्म कुत्सितम्। सुनृशंसमधर्मिष्ठं तव शौण्डीर्यमानिनः।।3.53.8।।
transliteration: kathayiṣyanti lokeṣu puruṣāḥ karma kutsitam| sunṛśṃsamadharmiṣṭhṃ tava śauṇḍīryamāninḥ||3.53.8||
meaning: You consider yourself to be brave after committing such a cruel, despicable and unrighteous act for which people of the world will condemn you.

sanskrit: धिक्ते शौर्यं च सत्त्वं च यत्त्वं कथितवांस्तदा। कुलाक्रोशकरं लोके धिक्ते चारित्रमीदृशम्।।3.53.9।।
transliteration: dhikte śauryṃ ca sattvṃ ca yattvṃ kathitavāṃstadā| kulākrośakarṃ loke dhikte cāritramīdṛśam||3.53.9||
meaning: Fie upon your heroism and strength about which you boasted. Fie upon your character that would bring calumny to the race and the world. I condemn such behaviour of yours.

sanskrit: किं कर्तुं शक्यमेवं हि यज्जवेनैव धावसि। मुहूर्तमपि तिष्ठस्व न जीवन्प्रतियास्यसि।।3.53.10।।
transliteration: kiṃ kartuṃ śakyamevṃ hi yajjavenaiva dhāvasi| muhūrtamapi tiṣṭhasva na jīvanpratiyāsyasi||3.53.10||
meaning: Tarry a little, you will not go back with life. What can be done now since you are running away so swiftly?

sanskrit: न हि चक्षुष्पथं प्राप्य तयोः पार्थिवपुत्रयोः। ससैन्योऽपि समर्थस्त्वं मुहूर्तमपि जीवितुम्।।3.53.11।।
transliteration: na hi cakṣuṣpathṃ prāpya tayoḥ pārthivaputrayoḥ| sasainyo'pi samarthastvṃ muhūrtamapi jīvitum||3.53.11||
meaning: If you come within sight of these two princes, it will not be possible for you to live for a moment even if you are with your entire army.

sanskrit: न त्वं तयोश्शरस्पर्शं सोढुं शक्तः कथञ्चन। वने प्रज्वलितस्येव स्पर्शमग्नेर्विहंगमः।।3.53.12।।
transliteration: na tvṃ tayośśarasparśṃ soḍhuṃ śaktḥ kathañcana| vane prajvalitasyeva sparśamagnervihṃgamḥ||3.53.12||
meaning: Just as a bird cannot bear the touch of forest fire, you will not be able to endure the mere touch of arrows of the two heroes indeed.

sanskrit: साधु कुर्वाऽऽत्मनः पथ्यं साधु मां मुञ्च रावण। मत्प्रधर्षणरुष्टो हि भ्रात्रा सह पतिर्मम।।3.53.13।। विधास्यति विनाशाय त्वं
transliteration: sādhu kurvā''tmanḥ pathyṃ sādhu māṃ muñca rāvaṇa| matpradharṣaṇaruṣṭo hi bhrātrā saha patirmama||3.53.13|| vidhāsyati vi
meaning: O Ravana be good and do whatever is beneficial to you. It is proper for you to release me. If you do not, enraged over my assault, my husband along with his brother, will bring about your destruction.

sanskrit: येन त्वं व्यवसायेन बलान्मां हर्तुमिच्छसि।।3.53.14।। व्यवसायस्स ते नीच भविष्यति निरर्थकः।
transliteration: yena tvṃ vyavasāyena balānmāṃ hartumicchasi||3.53.14|| vyavasāyassa te nīca bhaviṣyati nirarthakḥ|
meaning: O vile creature, the effort you are making to abduct me forcibly will be fruitless.

sanskrit: न ह्यहं तमपश्यन्ती भर्तारं विबुधोपमम्।।3.53.15।। उत्सहे शत्रुवशगा प्राणान्धारयितुं चिरम्।
transliteration: na hyahṃ tamapaśyantī bhartārṃ vibudhopamam||3.53.15|| utsahe śatruvaśagā prāṇāndhārayituṃ ciram|
meaning: I will not be eager to hold on to my life for long to live at the mercy of the enemy without being able to see my godlike husband.

sanskrit: न नूनं चात्मनः पथ्यं श्रेयो वा समवेक्षसे।।3.53.16।। मृत्युकाले यथा मर्त्यो विपरीतानि सेवते।
transliteration: na nūnṃ cātmanḥ pathyṃ śreyo vā samavekṣase||3.53.16|| mṛtyukāle yathā martyo viparītāni sevate|
meaning: At the time of death, mortals behave very differently. They act contrary to their own welfare. Likewise you are not able to foresee what is beneficial and good for you.

sanskrit: मुमूर्षूणां हि सर्वेषां यत्पथ्यं तन्न रोचते।।3.53.17।। पश्याम्यद्य हि कण्ठेत्वां कालपाशावपाशितम्।
transliteration: mumūrṣūṇāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ yatpathyṃ tanna rocate||3.53.17|| paśyāmyadya hi kaṇṭhetvāṃ kālapāśāvapāśitam|
meaning: Those who wish to die, do not like anything salutary. I see the noose of death wound round your neck now.

sanskrit: यथा चास्मिन्भयस्थाने न बिभेषि दशानन।।3.53.18।। व्यक्तं हिरण्मयान् हि त्वं सम्पश्यसि महीरुहान्।
transliteration: yathā cāsminbhayasthāne na bibheṣi daśānana||3.53.18|| vyaktṃ hiraṇmayān hi tvṃ sampaśyasi mahīruhān|
meaning: O tenheaded Ravana, since you do not fear the source of fear, evidently you see golden trees. (a symptom of death).

sanskrit: नदीं वैतरणीं घोरां रुधिरौघनिवाहिनीम्।।3.53.19।। असिपत्रवनं चैव भीमं पश्यसि रावण।
transliteration: nadīṃ vaitaraṇīṃ ghorāṃ rudhiraughanivāhinīm||3.53.19|| asipatravanṃ caiva bhīmṃ paśyasi rāvaṇa|
meaning: O Ravana, you see the dreadful river Vaitarani with torrents of blood flowing and frightening forest of trees with swords as leaves.

sanskrit: तप्तकाञ्चनपुष्पां च वैडूर्यप्रवरच्छदाम्।।3.53.20।। द्रक्ष्यसे शाल्मलीं तीक्ष्णामायसैः कण्टकैश्चिताम्।
transliteration: taptakāñcanapuṣpāṃ ca vaiḍūryapravaracchadām||3.53.20|| drakṣyase śālmalīṃ tīkṣṇāmāyasaiḥ kaṇṭakaiścitām|
meaning: You will see a log of salmali tree with bright golden flowers and excellent vaidurya stone with pointed iron thorns.

sanskrit: न हि त्वमीदृशं कृत्वा तस्यालीकं महात्मनः।।3.53.21।। धरितुं शक्ष्यसि चिरं विषं पीत्वेव निर्घृणः।
transliteration: na hi tvamīdṛśṃ kṛtvā tasyālīkṃ mahātmanḥ||3.53.21|| dharituṃ śakṣyasi cirṃ viṣṃ pītveva nirghṛṇḥ|
meaning: You are pitiless. You will not be able to survive for long after deceiving such noble Rama just as man cannot survive after drinking poison.

sanskrit: बद्धस्त्वं कालपाशेन दुर्निवारेण रावण।।3.53.22।। क्वगतो लप्स्यसे शर्म भर्तुर्मम महात्मनः।
transliteration: baddhastvṃ kālapāśena durnivāreṇa rāvaṇa||3.53.22|| kvagato lapsyase śarma bharturmama mahātmanḥ|
meaning: O Ravana you are bound by the inevitable noose of death. Where shall you get away from great Rama, my husband to obtain peace.

sanskrit: निमेषान्तरमात्रेण विना भ्रात्रा महावने।।3.53.23।। राक्षसा निहता येन सहस्राणि चतुर्दश। स कथं राघवो वीरस्सर्वास्त्रकुशलो ब
transliteration: nimeṣāntaramātreṇa vinā bhrātrā mahāvane||3.53.23|| rākṣasā nihatā yena sahasrāṇi caturdaśa| sa kathṃ rāghavo vīrassarvā
meaning: Rama has killed fourteen thousand demons alone without his brother within a moment. He is a strong warrior and wellversed in the use of all kinds of weapons. You have stolen his loving wife. How can he live without killi

sanskrit: तच्चान्यच्च परुषं वैदेही रावणाङ्कगा।।3.53.25।। भयशोकसमाविष्टा करुणं विललाप ह।
transliteration: taccānyacca paruṣṃ vaidehī rāvaṇāṅkagā||3.53.25|| bhayaśokasamāviṣṭā karuṇṃ vilalāpa ha|
meaning: Sita, daughter of Videha, full of sorrow and fear under Ravana's grip uttered these partly harsh and partly piteous wordsweeping.

sanskrit: तथा भृशार्तां बहुचैव भाषिणीं विलापपूर्वं करुणं च भामिनीम्। जहार पापः करुणं विचेष्टतीं नृपात्मजामागतगात्रवेपथुम्।।3.53.26
transliteration: tathā bhṛśārtāṃ bahucaiva bhāṣiṇīṃ vilāpapūrvṃ karuṇṃ ca bhāminīm| jahāra pāpḥ karuṇṃ viceṣṭatīṃ nṛpātmajāmāgatagātravep
meaning: Sinful Ravana carried away the beautiful princess trembling with great fear, struggling helplessly, crying pathetically and pleading in many mournful ways. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे त्रिपञ्

sanskrit: तेषां मध्ये विशालाक्षी कौशेयं कनकप्रभम्। उत्तरीयं वरारोहा शुभान्याभरणानि च।।3.54.2।। मुमोच यदि रामाय शंसेयुरिति मैथिली।
transliteration: teṣāṃ madhye viśālākṣī kauśeyṃ kanakaprabham| uttarīyṃ varārohā śubhānyābharaṇāni ca||3.54.2|| mumoca yadi rāmāya śṃseyu
meaning: Largeeyed, bright and beautiful Sita dropped her upper silk garment shining like gold and auspicious ornaments in their midst with a hope they may report this to Rama.

sanskrit: वस्त्रमुत्सृज्य तन्मध्ये निक्षिप्तं सहभूषणम्।।3.54.3।। सम्भ्रमात्तु दशग्रीवस्तत्कर्म न स बुद्धवान्।
transliteration: vastramutsṛjya tanmadhye nikṣiptṃ sahabhūṣaṇam||3.54.3|| sambhramāttu daśagrīvastatkarma na sa buddhavān|
meaning: In his excitement Ravana failed to notice when Sita dropped down that garment along with ornaments in their midst.

sanskrit: पिङ्गाक्षास्तां विशालाक्षीं नेत्रैरनिमिषैरिव।।3.54.4।। विक्रोशन्तीं तथा सीतां ददृशुर्वानरर्षभाः।
transliteration: piṅgākṣāstāṃ viśālākṣīṃ netrairanimiṣairiva||3.54.4|| vikrośantīṃ tathā sītāṃ dadṛśurvānararṣabhāḥ|
meaning: The best among the tawneyeyed monkeys gazed, without blinking, at the largeeyed Sita lamenting.

sanskrit: स च पम्पामतिक्रम्य लङ्कामभिमुखः पुरीम्।।3.54.5।। जगाम रुदतीं गृह्य वैदेहीं राक्षसेश्वरः।
transliteration: sa ca pampāmatikramya laṅkāmabhimukhḥ purīm||3.54.5|| jagāma rudatīṃ gṛhya vaidehīṃ rākṣaseśvarḥ|
meaning: Ravana crossed the lake Pampa and flew towards the city of Lanka carrying with him lamenting daughter of Videha.

sanskrit: तां जहार सुसंहृष्टो रावणो मृत्युमात्मनः।।3.54.6।। उत्सङ्गेनेव भुजगीं तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रां महाविषाम्।
transliteration: tāṃ jahāra susṃhṛṣṭo rāvaṇo mṛtyumātmanḥ||3.54.6|| utsaṅgeneva bhujagīṃ tīkṣṇadṃṣṭrāṃ mahāviṣām|
meaning: Delighted Ravana, carried off Sita, the very embodiment of his death, like one carrying a highly poisonous sharpfanged female snake on his lap.

sanskrit: वनानि सरितश्शैलांत्सरांसि च विहायसा।।3.54.7।। स क्षिप्रं समतीयाय शरश्चापादिव च्युतः।
transliteration: vanāni saritaśśailāṃtsarāṃsi ca vihāyasā||3.54.7|| sa kṣiprṃ samatīyāya śaraścāpādiva cyutḥ|
meaning: Like an arrow released from the bow, Ravana went through the sky, at once crossing forests, rivers mountains and tanks.

sanskrit: तिमिनक्रनिकेतं तु वरुणालयमक्षयम्।।3.54.8।। सरितां शरणं गत्वा समतीयाय सागरम्।
transliteration: timinakraniketṃ tu varuṇālayamakṣayam||3.54.8|| saritāṃ śaraṇṃ gatvā samatīyāya sāgaram|
meaning: Ravana soon crossed the refuge of rivers, the abode of Varuna, god of the sea, inexhaustible ocean, and the home for whales and crocodiles.

sanskrit: सम्भ्रमात्परिवृत्तोर्मी रुद्धमीनमहोरगः।।3.54.9।। वैदेह्यां ह्रियमाणायां बभूव वरुणालयः।
transliteration: sambhramātparivṛttormī ruddhamīnamahoragḥ||3.54.9|| vaidehyāṃ hriyamāṇāyāṃ babhūva varuṇālayḥ|
meaning: While Sita, princess of Videha was being carried away, the ocean, abode of Varuna got bewildered, waves rolled back, the movement of big serpents and fishes stopped.

sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षगता वाचस्ससृजुश्चारणास्तदा।।3.54.10।। एतदन्तो दशग्रीव इति सिद्धास्तदाब्रुवन्।
transliteration: antarikṣagatā vācassasṛjuścāraṇāstadā||3.54.10|| etadanto daśagrīva iti siddhāstadābruvan|
meaning: The charanas and siddhas moving in the sky said, O tenheaded Ravana this is your end .

sanskrit: स तु सीतां विवेष्टन्तीमङ्केनादाय रावणः।।3.54.11।। प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्कां रूपिणीं मृत्युमात्मनः।
transliteration: sa tu sītāṃ viveṣṭantīmaṅkenādāya rāvaṇḥ||3.54.11|| praviveśa purīṃ laṅkāṃ rūpiṇīṃ mṛtyumātmanḥ|
meaning: Ravana entered the city of Lanka holding Sita who was tossing from side to side and who was the very embodiment of his death.

sanskrit: सोऽभिगम्य पुरीं लङ्कां सुविभक्तमहापथाम्।।3.54.12।। संरूढकक्ष्याबहुलं स्वमन्तःपुरमाविशत्।
transliteration: so'bhigamya purīṃ laṅkāṃ suvibhaktamahāpathām||3.54.12|| sṃrūḍhakakṣyābahulṃ svamantḥpuramāviśat|
meaning: Ravana went through the well laidout roads of the city of Lanka and through the well many guarded halls of the palace and entered the inner apartment.

sanskrit: तत्र तामसितापाङ्गां शोकमोहपरायणाम्।।3.54.13।। निदधे रावणस्सीतां मयो मायामिवस्त्रियम्।
transliteration: tatra tāmasitāpāṅgāṃ śokamohaparāyaṇām||3.54.13|| nidadhe rāvaṇassītāṃ mayo māyāmivastriyam|
meaning: Sita, with her dark eye lashes and lost in utter sorrow was kept in the harem by Ravana, like demon Maya kept Mayamayi.

sanskrit: अब्रवीच्च दशग्रीवः पिशाचीर्घोरदर्शनाः।।3.54.14।। यथा नेमां पुमान् स्त्री वा सीतां पश्यत्यसम्मतः।
transliteration: abravīcca daśagrīvḥ piśācīrghoradarśanāḥ||3.54.14|| yathā nemāṃ pumān strī vā sītāṃ paśyatyasammatḥ|
meaning: Ravana ordered the female goblins of fearful appearance,'Let no outsider whether man or woman, see her, without my permission'.

sanskrit: मुक्तामणिसुवर्णानि वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च।।3.54.15।। यद्यदिच्छेत्तदेवास्या देयं मच्छन्दतो यथा।
transliteration: muktāmaṇisuvarṇāni vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca||3.54.15|| yadyadicchettadevāsyā deyṃ macchandato yathā|
meaning: Pearls, gems or gold, clothes or ornaments, whatever she desires, be made available to her without any hesitation.

sanskrit: या च वक्ष्यति वैदेहीं वचनं किञ्चिदप्रियम्।।3.54.16।। अज्ञानाद्यदि वा ज्ञानान्न तस्या जीवितं प्रियम्।
transliteration: yā ca vakṣyati vaidehīṃ vacanṃ  kiñcidapriyam||3.54.16|| ajñānādyadi vā jñānānna tasyā jīvitṃ priyam|
meaning: Whoever utters any unpleasant words knowingly or unknowingly to Sita, princess of Videha is not worthy to survive (must be killed).

sanskrit: तथोक्त्वा राक्षसीस्तास्तु राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्।।3.54.17।। निष्क्रम्यान्तः पुरात्तस्मात्किंकृत्यमिति चिन्तयन्। ददर्शा
transliteration: tathoktvā rākṣasīstāstu rākṣasendrḥ pratāpavān||3.54.17|| niṣkramyāntḥ purāttasmātkiṃkṛtyamiti cintayan| dadarśāṣṭau mah
meaning: The courageous lord of the demons, having said so to the demonesses, came out of the inner apartment. While contemplating the future course of action, he saw eight powerful, carnivorous demons.

sanskrit: स तान्दृष्ट्वा महावीर्यो वरदानेन मोहितः। उवाचैतानिदं वाक्यं प्रशस्य बलवीर्यतः।।3.54.19।।
transliteration: sa tāndṛṣṭvā mahāvīryo varadānena mohitḥ| uvācaitānidṃ vākyṃ praśasya balavīryatḥ||3.54.19||
meaning: The mighty Ravana, deluded by the boons, praised the strength and valour of the demons and said :

sanskrit: नानाप्रहरणाः क्षिप्रमितो गच्छत सत्वराः। जनस्थानं हतस्थानं भूतपूर्वं खरालयम्।।3.54.20।।
transliteration: nānāpraharaṇāḥ kṣipramito gacchata satvarāḥ| janasthānṃ hatasthānṃ bhūtapūrvṃ kharālayam||3.54.20||
meaning: Armed with different weapons, proceed at once to Janasthana where Khara lived and died.

sanskrit: तत्रोष्यतां जनस्थाने शून्ये निहतराक्षसे। पौरुषं बलमाश्रित्य त्रासमुत्सृज्य दूरतः।।3.54.21।।
transliteration: tatroṣyatāṃ janasthāne śūnye nihatarākṣase| pauruṣṃ balamāśritya trāsamutsṛjya dūratḥ||3.54.21||
meaning: Go and there in the desolate Janasthana where all demons had been killed, leaving all your apprehensions and relying on your strength and vigour.

sanskrit: बलं हि सुमहद्यन्मे जनस्थाने निवेशितम्। सदूषणखरं युद्धे हतं रामेण सायकैः।।3.54.22।।
transliteration: balṃ hi sumahadyanme janasthāne niveśitam| sadūṣaṇakharṃ yuddhe hatṃ rāmeṇa sāyakaiḥ||3.54.22||
meaning: I had stationed a great army at Janasthana, who were all killed along with Khara and Dusana by Rama's arrows.

sanskrit: तत क्रोधो ममामर्षाद्धैर्यस्योपरि वर्तते। वैरं च सुमहज्जातं रामं प्रति सुदारुणम्।।3.54.23।।
transliteration: tata krodho mamāmarṣāddhairyasyopari vartate| vairṃ ca sumahajjātṃ rāmṃ prati sudāruṇam||3.54.23||
meaning: My anger engineered by my intolerance has crossed the limits of my patience. It has created in me a terrific enmity against Rama.

sanskrit: निर्यातयितुमिच्छामि तच्च वैरमहं रिपोः। न हि लप्स्याम्यहं निद्रामहत्वा संयुगे रिपुम्।।3.54.24।।
transliteration: niryātayitumicchāmi tacca vairamahṃ ripoḥ| na hi lapsyāmyahṃ nidrāmahatvā sṃyuge ripum||3.54.24||
meaning: I want to take revenge on my foe. I shall not sleep until I kill him in a combat.

sanskrit: तं त्विदानीमहं हत्वा खरदूषणघातिनम्। रामं शर्मोपलप्स्यामि धनं लब्ध्वेव निर्धनः।।3.54.25।।
transliteration: tṃ tvidānīmahṃ hatvā kharadūṣaṇaghātinam| rāmṃ śarmopalapsyāmi dhanṃ labdhveva nirdhanḥ||3.54.25||
meaning: I will be happy only after killing the destroyer of Khara and Dusana, just as a poor man feels happy only on acquiring wealth.

sanskrit: जनस्थाने वसद्भिस्तु भवद्भीराममाश्रिता। प्रवृत्तिरुपनेतव्या किञ्करोतीति तत्त्वतः।।3.54.26।।
transliteration: janasthāne vasadbhistu bhavadbhīrāmamāśritā| pravṛttirupanetavyā kiñkarotīti tattvatḥ||3.54.26||
meaning: While dwelling at Janasthana, all of you should collect exact information about the activities of Rama.

sanskrit: अप्रमादाच्च गन्तव्यं सर्वैरपि निशाचरैः। कर्तव्यश्च सदा यत्नो राघवस्य वधं प्रति।।3.54.27।।
transliteration: apramādācca gantavyṃ sarvairapi niśācaraiḥ| kartavyaśca sadā yatno rāghavasya vadhṃ prati||3.54.27||
meaning: All of you, O nightrangers, should be on the alert there and it should be always your duty to try to kill Rama.

sanskrit: युष्माकं च बलज्ञोऽहं बहुशो रणमूर्धनि। अतश्चास्मिन् जनस्थाने मया यूयं नियोजिताः।।3.54.28।।
transliteration: yuṣmākṃ ca balajño'hṃ bahuśo raṇamūrdhani| ataścāsmin janasthāne mayā yūyṃ niyojitāḥ||3.54.28||
meaning: I have seen your strength on many war fronts. That is why you have been assigned this duty at Janasthana.

sanskrit: ततः प्रियं वाक्यमुपेत्य राक्षसा महार्थमष्टावभिवाद्य रावणम्। विहाय लङ्कां सहिताः प्रतस्थिरे यतो जनस्थानमलक्ष्यदर्शनाः।।3.
transliteration: tatḥ priyṃ vākyamupetya rākṣasā mahārthamaṣṭāvabhivādya rāvaṇam| vihāya laṅkāṃ sahitāḥ pratasthire yato janasthānamalakṣ
meaning: The eight demons were glad to hear the pleasing and meaningful words of Ravana. They offered him salutations and left Lanka in the direction of Janasthana without being seen by any one.

sanskrit: ततस्तु सीतामुपलभ्य रावणः सुसम्प्रहृष्टः परिगृह्य मैथिलीम्। प्रसज्य रामेण च वैरमुत्तमं बभूव मोहान्मुदितस्सराक्षसः।।3.54.3
transliteration: tatastu sītāmupalabhya rāvaṇḥ susamprahṛṣṭḥ parigṛhya maithilīm| prasajya rāmeṇa ca vairamuttamṃ babhūva mohānmuditassar
meaning: Then the demon Ravana felt greatly happy for getting Sita, princess of Mithila, without knowing in his delusion that he had created the bitterest enmity with Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वामलीकीये आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे

sanskrit: स चिन्तयानो वैदेहीं कामबाणसमर्पितः। प्रविवेश गृहं रम्यं सीतां द्रष्टुमभित्वरन्।।3.55.2।।
transliteration: sa cintayāno vaidehīṃ kāmabāṇasamarpitḥ| praviveśa gṛhṃ ramyṃ sītāṃ draṣṭumabhitvaran||3.55.2||
meaning: Thinking about Vaidehi and hit by the arrows of Cupid (the god of love). Ravana hastened to see Sita and entered the beautiful home.

sanskrit: स प्रविश्य तु तद्वेश्म रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। अपश्यद्राक्षसीमध्ये सीतां शोकपरायणाम्।।3.55.3।।
transliteration: sa praviśya tu tadveśma rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipḥ| apaśyadrākṣasīmadhye sītāṃ śokaparāyaṇām||3.55.3||
meaning: Ravana, lord of the demons, entered his residence and saw Sita full of grief in the midst of the demonesses.

sanskrit: अश्रुपूर्णमुखीं दीनां शोकभाराभिपीडिताम्। वायुवेगैरिवाक्रान्तां मज्जन्तीं नावमर्णवे।।3.55.4।। मृगयूथपरिभ्रष्टां मृगीं श्व
transliteration: aśrupūrṇamukhīṃ dīnāṃ śokabhārābhipīḍitām| vāyuvegairivākrāntāṃ majjantīṃ nāvamarṇave||3.55.4|| mṛgayūthaparibhraṣṭāṃ mṛ
meaning: The demon Ravana forcibly took Sita, her face full of tears, to show her his heavenlike home. Inflicted with grief she looked wretched. She resembled a female deer hounded out of the herd. With her head bent in grief, sh

sanskrit: हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधं स्त्रीसहस्रनिषेवितम्। नानापक्षिगणैर्जुष्टं नानारत्नसमन्वितम्।।3.55.7।। दान्तकैस्तापनीयैश्च स्फाटिकै
transliteration: harmyaprāsādasambādhṃ strīsahasraniṣevitam| nānāpakṣigaṇairjuṣṭṃ nānāratnasamanvitam||3.55.7|| dāntakaistāpanīyaiśca sph
meaning: His home was a complex of palaces and mansions served by thousands of women. It was an abode of different flocks of birds. It had captivating pillars studded with gold, crystals, silver, diamonds and vaiduryas. It resoun

sanskrit: सोपानं काञ्चनं चित्रमारुरोह तया सह।।3.55.9।। दान्तका राजताश्चैव गवाक्षाः प्रियदर्शनाः। हेमजालावताश्चासन्स्तत्र प्रासादपङ
transliteration: sopānṃ kāñcanṃ citramāruroha tayā saha||3.55.9|| dāntakā rājatāścaiva gavākṣāḥ priyadarśanāḥ| hemajālāvatāścāsanstatra p
meaning: He ascended the wonderful golden staircase taking Sita along with him.Beautiful looked the rows of mansions with silver and ivory windows and golden trellis.

sanskrit: सुधामणिविचित्राणि भूमिभागानि सर्वशः। दशग्रीवस्स्वभवने प्रादर्शयत मैथिलीम्।।3.55.11।।
transliteration: sudhāmaṇivicitrāṇi bhūmibhāgāni sarvaśḥ| daśagrīvassvabhavane prādarśayata maithilīm||3.55.11||
meaning: The tenheaded Ravana showed Sita, the princess from Mithila the floors with wonderful crystals.

sanskrit: दीर्घिकाः पुष्करिण्यश्च नानावृक्षसमन्विताः। रावणो दर्शयामास सीतां शोकपरायणाम्।।3.55.12।।
transliteration: dīrghikāḥ puṣkariṇyaśca nānāvṛkṣasamanvitāḥ| rāvaṇo darśayāmāsa sītāṃ śokaparāyaṇām||3.55.12||
meaning: Ravana showed Sita who was overwhelmed with sorrow, stepwells surrrounded by various trees and tanks.

sanskrit: दर्शयित्वा तु वैदेह्याः कृत्स्नं तद्भवनोत्तमम्। उवाच वाक्यं पापात्मा सीतां लोभितुमिच्छया।।3.55.13।।
transliteration: darśayitvā tu vaidehyāḥ kṛtsnṃ tadbhavanottamam| uvāca vākyṃ pāpātmā sītāṃ lobhitumicchayā||3.55.13||
meaning: The sinful Ravana showed Sita, princess of Videha, the best of all his mansions in order to allure her, saying:

sanskrit: दश राक्षसकोट्यश्च द्वाविंशतिरथापराः। तेषां प्रभुरहं सीते सर्वेषां भीमकर्मणाम्।।3.55.14।। वर्जयित्वा जरावृद्धान्बालांश्च
transliteration: daśa rākṣasakoṭyaśca dvāviṃśatirathāparāḥ| teṣāṃ prabhurahṃ sīte sarveṣāṃ bhīmakarmaṇām||3.55.14|| varjayitvā jarāvṛddhā
meaning: O Sita, leaving aside children and the aged, I am the lord of crores of nightrangers in addition to ten crore demons and twentytwo crore terrorists.

sanskrit: सहस्रमेकमेकस्य मम कार्यपुरस्सरम्।।3.55.15।। यदिदं राजतन्त्रं मे त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्। जीवितं च विशालाक्षि त्वं मे प्
transliteration: sahasramekamekasya mama kāryapurassaram||3.55.15|| yadidṃ rājatantrṃ me tvayi sarvṃ pratiṣṭhitam| jīvitṃ ca viśālākṣi tv
meaning: For me alone there are a thousand attendants.The administration of the kingdom and all my subjects will be under your control. O largeeyed Sita you are dearer to me than my life.

sanskrit: बहूनांस्त्रीसहस्राणां मम योऽसौ परिग्रहः। तासां त्वमीश्वरा सीते मम भार्या भव प्रिये।।3.55.17।।
transliteration: bahūnāṃstrīsahasrāṇāṃ mama yo'sau parigrahḥ| tāsāṃ tvamīśvarā sīte mama bhāryā bhava priye||3.55.17||
meaning: O Sita dear be my chief queen among the many thousands of women I have married.

sanskrit: साधु किं तेऽन्यया बुद्ध्या रोचयस्व वचो मम। भजस्वमाभितप्तस्य प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि।।3.55.18।।
transliteration: sādhu kiṃ te'nyayā buddhyā rocayasva vaco mama| bhajasvamābhitaptasya prasādṃ kartumarhasi||3.55.18||
meaning: Do not think otherwise. Be good and accept my request. I am consumed by thoughts of you. You should be gracious to me.

sanskrit: परिक्षिप्ता समुद्रेण लङ्केयं शतयोजना। नेयं धर्षयितुं शक्या सेन्द्रैरपि सुरासुरैः।।3.55.19।।
transliteration: parikṣiptā samudreṇa laṅkeyṃ śatayojanā| neyṃ dharṣayituṃ śakyā sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ||3.55.19||
meaning: This Lanka extending to a hundred yojanas and surrounded by the sea is vulnerable to neither demons nor gods including Indra.

sanskrit: न देवेषु न यक्षेषु न गन्धर्वेषु पक्षिषु। अहं पश्यामि लोकेषु यो मे वीर्यसमो भवेत्।।3.55.20।।
transliteration: na deveṣu na yakṣeṣu na gandharveṣu pakṣiṣu| ahṃ paśyāmi lokeṣu yo me vīryasamo bhavet||3.55.20||
meaning: I do not see any one equal to me in valour among gods, or yakshas or gandharvas or birds.

sanskrit: राज्यभ्रष्टेन दीनेन तापसेन गतायुषा। किं करिष्यसि रामेण मानुषेणाल्पतेजसा।।3.55.21।।
transliteration: rājyabhraṣṭena dīnena tāpasena gatāyuṣā| kiṃ kariṣyasi rāmeṇa mānuṣeṇālpatejasā||3.55.21||
meaning: Of what use is Rama who has lost his kingdom, who is depressed and leads an ascetic life and who is a shortlived, lacklustre human being.

sanskrit: भजस्व सीते मामेव भर्ताहं सदृशस्तव। यौवनं ह्यध्रुवं भीरु रमस्वेह मया सह।।3.55.22।।
transliteration: bhajasva sīte māmeva bhartāhṃ sadṛśastava| yauvanṃ hyadhruvṃ bhīru ramasveha mayā saha||3.55.22||
meaning: O Sita take refuge only in me. I am a befitting husband to you. O timid one youth is impermanent. Enjoy (your life) with me while it lasts.

sanskrit: दर्शने माकृथा बुद्धिं राघवस्य वरानने। कास्य शक्तिरिहागन्तुमपि सीते मनोरथैः।।3.55.23।।
transliteration: darśane mākṛthā buddhiṃ rāghavasya varānane| kāsya śaktirihāgantumapi sīte manorathaiḥ||3.55.23||
meaning: O lovely Sita, give up the thought of seeing Rama. Where does he possess the power to reach this place even on the mental plane ?

sanskrit: न शक्यो वायुराकाशे पाशैर्बद्धुं महाजवः। दीप्यमानस्य वाप्यग्नेर्गृहीतुं विमलां शिखाम्।।3.55.24।।
transliteration: na śakyo vāyurākāśe pāśairbaddhuṃ mahājavḥ| dīpyamānasya vāpyagnergṛhītuṃ vimalāṃ śikhām||3.55.24||
meaning: It is not possible to bind the wind blowing at high speed in the sky. Similarly it is not possible to catch the brilliant glow of flaming fire.

sanskrit: त्रयाणामपि लोकानां न तं पश्यामि शोभने। विक्रमेण नयेद्यस्त्वां मद्बाहुपरिपालिताम्।।3.55.25।।
transliteration: trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ na tṃ paśyāmi śobhane| vikrameṇa nayedyastvāṃ madbāhuparipālitām||3.55.25||
meaning: O lovely lady, I do not see any one in these three worlds who can, by his valour, take you away from me guarded by my arms.

sanskrit: लङ्कायां सुमहद्राज्यमिदं त्वमनुपालय। त्वत्प्रेष्या मद्विधाश्चैव देवाश्चापि चराचराः।।3.55.26।।
transliteration: laṅkāyāṃ sumahadrājyamidṃ tvamanupālaya| tvatpreṣyā madvidhāścaiva devāścāpi carācarāḥ||3.55.26||
meaning: Rule this vast kingdom of Lanka. People like me, even gods and all beings, mobile and immobile, will be at your beck and call.

sanskrit: अभिषेकोदकक्लिन्ना तुष्टा च रमयस्व माम्। दुष्कृतं यत्परा कर्म वनवासेन तद्गतम्।।3.55.27।। यश्च ते सुकृतो धर्मस्तस्येह फलमा
transliteration: abhiṣekodakaklinnā tuṣṭā ca ramayasva mām| duṣkṛtṃ yatparā karma vanavāsena tadgatam||3.55.27|| yaśca te sukṛto dharmast
meaning: Drenched with the waters of consecration, entertain me. The effect of the bad deeds done in the past are over with your dwelling in the forest. Now enjoy the fruits of your good and righteous deeds here with me.

sanskrit: इह माल्यानि सर्वाणि दिव्यगन्धानि मैथिलि।।3.55.28।। भूषणानि च मुख्यानि सेवस्व च मया सह।।
transliteration: iha mālyāni sarvāṇi divyagandhāni maithili||3.55.28|| bhūṣaṇāni ca mukhyāni sevasva ca mayā saha||
meaning: O princess from Mithila, put on all garlands of wonderful fragrance and finest of jewels here with me.

sanskrit: पुष्पकं नाम सुश्रोणि भ्रातुर्वैश्रवणस्य मे।।3.55.29।। विमानं सूर्यसङ्काशं तरसा निर्जितं मया।
transliteration: puṣpakṃ nāma suśroṇi bhrāturvaiśravaṇasya me||3.55.29|| vimānṃ sūryasaṅkāśṃ tarasā nirjitṃ mayā|
meaning: O finehipped lady, I won by my strength from my brother Vaisravana (Kubera) an aerial chariot called Pushpaka shining with the radiance of the Sun.

sanskrit: विशालं रमणीयं च तद्विमानमनुत्तम्।।3.55.30।। तत्र सीते मया सार्धं विहरस्व यथासुखम्।
transliteration: viśālṃ ramaṇīyṃ ca tadvimānamanuttam||3.55.30|| tatra sīte mayā sārdhṃ viharasva yathāsukham|
meaning: O Sita that excellent chariot is big and beautiful. Where on you can roam happily along with me.

sanskrit: वदनं पद्मसङ्काशममलं चारुदर्शनम्। शोकार्तंतु वरारोहे न भ्राजति वरानने।।3.55.31।।
transliteration: vadanṃ padmasaṅkāśamamalṃ cārudarśanam| śokārtṃtu varārohe na bhrājati varānane||3.55.31||
meaning: O heavyhipped lady your face which is a clean lotus pleasing to the eye has lost its shine, stricken with grief.

sanskrit: एवं वदति तस्मित्सा वस्त्रान्तेन वराङ्गना। पिधायेन्दुनिभं सीता मुखमश्रूण्यवर्तयत्।।3.55.32।।
transliteration: evṃ vadati tasmitsā vastrāntena varāṅganā| pidhāyendunibhṃ sītā mukhamaśrūṇyavartayat||3.55.32||
meaning: As Ravana went on speaking thus, Sita covered her beautiful, moonlike face with the edge of her garment and stood shedding tears.

sanskrit: ध्यायन्तीं तामिवास्वस्थां दीनां चिन्ताहतप्रभाम्। उवाच वचनं पापो रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः।।3.55.33।।
transliteration: dhyāyantīṃ tāmivāsvasthāṃ dīnāṃ cintāhataprabhām| uvāca vacanṃ pāpo rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvarḥ||3.55.33||
meaning: While Sita was lost in thought, feeling ill at lase, looking wretched with her beauty dulled by her anxiety, the sinful lord of the demons continued :

sanskrit: अलं व्रीडेन वैदेहि धर्मलोपकृतेन च।।3.55.34।। आर्षोऽयं दैवनिष्यन्दो यस्त्वामभिगमिष्यति।
transliteration: alṃ vrīḍena vaidehi dharmalopakṛtena ca||3.55.34|| ārṣo'yṃ daivaniṣyando yastvāmabhigamiṣyati|
meaning: O Sita you need not feel shamed that it is a violation of righteous conduct. Take it as godsend which has the approval of sages.

sanskrit: एतौ पादौ मया स्निग्धौ शिरोभिः परिपीडितौ।।3.55.35।। प्रसादं कुरु मे क्षिप्रं वश्यो दासोऽहमस्मिते।
transliteration: etau pādau mayā snigdhau śirobhiḥ paripīḍitau||3.55.35|| prasādṃ kuru me kṣiprṃ vaśyo dāso'hamasmite|
meaning: I am bowing down, pressing my heads at your shining feet. I am at your mercy. Grant me your favourI will remain your slave and remain ever under your control.

sanskrit: इमाश्शून्य मया वाचश्शुष्यमाणेन भाषिताः।।3.55.36।। न चापि रावणः काञ्चिन्मूर्ध्ना स्त्रीं प्रणमेत ह।
transliteration: imāśśūnya mayā vācaśśuṣyamāṇena bhāṣitāḥ||3.55.36|| na cāpi rāvaṇḥ kāñcinmūrdhnā strīṃ praṇameta ha|
meaning: My throat has dried up. I have spoken these words in a forlorn state. Ravana has never bowed down to a woman in obeisance.

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा दशग्रीवो मैथिलीं जनकात्मजाम्।।3.55.37।। कृतान्तवशमापन्नो ममेयमिति मन्यते।
transliteration: evamuktvā daśagrīvo maithilīṃ janakātmajām||3.55.37|| kṛtāntavaśamāpanno mameyamiti manyate|
meaning: Having said this to the daughter of Janaka, the tenheaded Ravana who had fallen under the control of Yama, lord of death, misconceived that she had become his own. इतयार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे प

sanskrit: राजा दशरथो नाम धर्मसेतुरिवाचलः। सत्यसन्धः परिज्ञातो यस्य पुत्रस्सराघवः।।3.56.2।।
transliteration: rājā daśaratho nāma dharmaseturivācalḥ| satyasandhḥ parijñāto yasya putrassarāghavḥ||3.56.2||
meaning: Rama is a son of the renowned king Dasaratha, who was a firm ambankment (protector) of righteousness and was true to his promise.

sanskrit: रामो नाम स धर्मात्मा त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः। दीर्घबाहुर्विशालाक्षो दैवतं हि पतिर्मम।।3.56.3।।
transliteration: rāmo nāma sa dharmātmā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutḥ| dīrghabāhurviśālākṣo daivatṃ hi patirmama||3.56.3||
meaning: The longarmed, largeeyed Rama is famous in all the three worlds. He is my husband, a righteous soul and a god to all.

sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले जातस्सिंहस्कन्धो महाद्युतिः। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा यस्ते प्राणान्हरिष्यति।।3.56.4।।
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇāṃ kule jātassiṃhaskandho mahādyutiḥ| lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā yaste prāṇānhariṣyati||3.56.4||
meaning: The brilliant Rama of the Ikshvaku dynasty with the lion's shoulders will come with his brother Lakshmana and take away your life.

sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षं यद्यहं तस्य त्वया स्यां धर्षिता बलात्। शयिता त्वं हतस्संख्ये जनस्थाने यथा खरः।।3.56.5।।
transliteration: pratyakṣṃ yadyahṃ tasya tvayā syāṃ dharṣitā balāt| śayitā tvṃ hatassṃkhye janasthāne yathā kharḥ||3.56.5||
meaning: Had you abducted me forcibly in his presence, you would have been lying down dead just as Khara in Janasthana.

sanskrit: य एते राक्षसाः प्रोक्ता घोररूपा महाबलाः। राघवे निर्विषास्सर्वे सुपर्णे पन्नगा यथा।।3.56.6।।
transliteration: ya ete rākṣasāḥ proktā ghorarūpā mahābalāḥ| rāghave nirviṣāssarve suparṇe pannagā yathā||3.56.6||
meaning: Those dreadful, mighty demons you have described are ineffective in his presence just like the serpents who with their venom are ineffective in the presence of Suparna (Garuda).

sanskrit: तस्य ज्याविप्रमुक्तास्ते शराः काञ्चनभूषणाः। शरीरं विधमिष्यन्ति गङ्गाकूलमिवोर्मयः।।3.56.7।।
transliteration: tasya jyāvipramuktāste śarāḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ| śarīrṃ vidhamiṣyanti gaṅgākūlamivormayḥ||3.56.7||
meaning: The goldtipped arrows released from his bowstring will shatter your body like the waves erode the banks of river Ganga.

sanskrit: असुरैर्वा सुरैर्वा त्वं यद्यवध्योऽसि रावण। उत्पाद्य सुमहद्वैरं जीवंस्तस्य न मोक्ष्यसे।।3.56.8।।
transliteration: asurairvā surairvā tvṃ yadyavadhyo'si rāvaṇa| utpādya sumahadvairṃ jīvṃstasya na mokṣyase||3.56.8||
meaning: O Ravana, even if you stand invulnerable to gods and demons, you will not come out alive in the combat with Rama with whom you have earned great enmity.

sanskrit: स ते जीवितशेषस्य राघवोऽन्तकरो बली। पशोर्यूपगतस्येव जीवितं तव दुर्लभम्।।3.56.9।।
transliteration: sa te jīvitaśeṣasya rāghavo'ntakaro balī| paśoryūpagatasyeva jīvitṃ tava durlabham||3.56.9||
meaning: Powerful Rama will put an end to whatever little life you are left with. Just as a beast tied to a sacrificial post, you will not survive.

sanskrit: यदि पश्येत्स रामस्त्वां रोषदीप्तेन चक्षुषा। रक्षस्त्वमद्य निर्धग्धो गच्छेस्सद्यः पराभवम्।।3.56.10।।
transliteration: yadi paśyetsa rāmastvāṃ roṣadīptena cakṣuṣā| rakṣastvamadya nirdhagdho gacchessadyḥ parābhavam||3.56.10||
meaning: O demon, you will be completely consumed if Rama looks at you with eyes burning in anger.

sanskrit: यश्चन्द्रं नभसो भूमौ पातयेन्नाशयेत वा। सागरं शोषयेद्वापि स सीतां मोचयेदिह।।3.56.11।।
transliteration: yaścandrṃ nabhaso bhūmau pātayennāśayeta vā| sāgarṃ śoṣayedvāpi sa sītāṃ mocayediha||3.56.11||
meaning: He who can bring down the Moon to the earth from the sky or even dash it down, he who can drain the sea dry will definitely release me from here.

sanskrit: गतायुस्त्वं गतश्रीको गतसत्त्व गतेन्द्रियः। लङ्का वैधव्यसंयुक्ता त्वत्कृतेन भविष्यति।।3.56.12।।
transliteration: gatāyustvṃ gataśrīko gatasattva gatendriyḥ| laṅkā vaidhavyasṃyuktā tvatkṛtena bhaviṣyati||3.56.12||
meaning: Your life is coming to an end. Your fortunes will wane, your strength will be sapped. Your senses will be dissipated. By your deeds Lanka will attain widowhood.

sanskrit: न ते पापमिदं कर्म शुखोदर्कं भविष्यति। याऽहं नीता विनाभावं पतिपार्श्वात्त्वया वने।।3.56.13।।
transliteration: na te pāpamidṃ karma śukhodarkṃ bhaviṣyati| yā'hṃ nītā vinābhāvṃ patipārśvāttvayā vane||3.56.13||
meaning: This evil deed(of abduction) will not yield happy results.You have brought me from my husband from the forest without any forethought.

sanskrit: स हि दैवतसंयुक्तो मम भर्ता महाद्युतिः। निर्भयो वीर्यमाश्रित्य शून्ये वसति दण्डके।।3.56.14।।
transliteration: sa hi daivatasṃyukto mama bhartā mahādyutiḥ| nirbhayo vīryamāśritya śūnye vasati daṇḍake||3.56.14||
meaning: My effulgent, valiant husband armed with divine power resides fearlessly in the desolate Dandaka.

sanskrit: स ते दर्पं बलं वीर्यमुत्सेकं च तथाविधम्। अपनेष्यति गात्रेभ्यश्शरवर्षेण संयुगे।।3.56.15।।
transliteration: sa te darpṃ balṃ vīryamutsekṃ ca tathāvidham| apaneṣyati gātrebhyaśśaravarṣeṇa sṃyuge||3.56.15||
meaning: He will remove your pride, your power, your valour and haughtiness from your limbs with a shower of arrows in the fight.

sanskrit: यदा विनाशो भूतानां दृश्यते कालचोदितः। तदा कार्ये प्रमाद्यन्ति नराः कालवशं गताः।।3.56.16।।
transliteration: yadā vināśo bhūtānāṃ dṛśyate kālacoditḥ| tadā kārye pramādyanti narāḥ kālavaśṃ gatāḥ||3.56.16||
meaning: When destruction draws near, people being prompted by time start commiting blunders in their deeds.

sanskrit: मां प्रधृष्य स ते कालः प्राप्तोऽयं राक्षसाधम। आत्मनो राक्षसानां च वधायान्तःपुरस्य च।।3.56.17।।
transliteration: māṃ pradhṛṣya sa te kālḥ prāpto'yṃ rākṣasādhama| ātmano rākṣasānāṃ ca vadhāyāntḥpurasya ca||3.56.17||
meaning: You vilest of demons, since you have assaulted me, the time of your death and destruction of all demons and of all women in the harem has drawn near.

sanskrit: न शक्या यज्ञमध्यस्था वेदी सृग्भाण्डमण्डिता। द्विजातिमन्त्रपूता च चण्डालेनावमर्दितुम्।।3.56.18।।
transliteration: na śakyā yajñamadhyasthā vedī sṛgbhāṇḍamaṇḍitā| dvijātimantrapūtā ca caṇḍālenāvamarditum||3.56.18||
meaning: The sacrificial altar adorned with ladles and vessels and sanctified by the sacred mantras recited by brahmins cannot be defiled by a chandala (man of lowest caste).

sanskrit: तथाऽहं धर्मनित्यस्य धर्मपत्नी पतिव्रता। त्वया स्पृष्टुं न शक्यास्मि राक्षसाधम पापिना।।3.56.19।।
transliteration: tathā'hṃ dharmanityasya dharmapatnī pativratā| tvayā spṛṣṭuṃ na śakyāsmi rākṣasādhama pāpinā||3.56.19||
meaning: O lowly demon similarly I am a chaste woman and wife of the ever righteous Rama who cannot be defiled by a sinner like you.

sanskrit: क्रीडन्ती राजहंसेन पद्मषण्डेषु नित्यदा। हंसी सा तृणषण्डस्थं कथं पश्येत मद्गुकम्।।3.56.20।।
transliteration: krīḍantī rājahṃsena padmaṣaṇḍeṣu nityadā| hṃsī sā tṛṇaṣaṇḍasthṃ kathṃ paśyeta madgukam||3.56.20||
meaning: How can a female swan ever sporting in lotusponds in the company of a royal swan look at the watercrow resting on a grassy land?

sanskrit: इदं शरीरं निस्संज्ञं बन्ध वा खातयस्व वा। नेदं शरीरं रक्षयं मे जीवितं वापि राक्षस।।3.56.21।। न तु शक्ष्याम्युपक्रोशं पृथि
transliteration: idṃ śarīrṃ nissṃjñṃ bandha vā khātayasva vā| nedṃ śarīrṃ rakṣayṃ me jīvitṃ vāpi rākṣasa||3.56.21|| na tu śakṣyāmyupakroś
meaning: O demon this body has (now) no consciousness. You may bind it or bury it. I do not think that this body or even this life need to be protected. But at no cost can I make this an object of censure on earth (must not be br

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु वैदेही क्रोधात्सुपरुषं वचः।।3.56.22।। रावणं मैथिली तत्र पुनर्नोवाच किञ्चन।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu vaidehī krodhātsuparuṣṃ vacḥ||3.56.22|| rāvaṇṃ maithilī tatra punarnovāca kiñcana|
meaning: Having uttered these very harsh words out of anger, the daughter of Videha, the princess from Mithila spoke no more.

sanskrit: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा परुषं रोमहर्षणम्।।3.56.23।। प्रत्युवाच ततस्सीतां भयसन्दर्शनं वचः।
transliteration: sītāyā vacanṃ śrutvā paruṣṃ romaharṣaṇam||3.56.23|| pratyuvāca tatassītāṃ bhayasandarśanṃ vacḥ|
meaning: Having heard such harsh, horripilating words from Sita, Ravana replied in a way designed to create fear in her:

sanskrit: शृणु मैथिलि मद्वाक्यं मासान्द्वादश भामिनि।।3.56.24।। कालेनानेन नाभ्येषि यदि मां चारुहासिनि। ततस्त्वां प्रातराशार्थं सूदा
transliteration: śṛṇu maithili madvākyṃ māsāndvādaśa bhāmini||3.56.24|| kālenānena nābhyeṣi yadi māṃ cāruhāsini| tatastvāṃ prātarāśārthṃ
meaning: O comely princess from Mithila, O lady with a sweet smile listen to my words. If you do not accept my hand in the course of twelve months, the cooks will cut you off into small bits for the (my) breakfast.

sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा परुषं वाक्यं रावणश्शत्रुरावणः। राक्षसीश्च ततः क्रुद्ध इदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.56.26।।
transliteration: ityuktvā paruṣṃ vākyṃ rāvaṇaśśatrurāvaṇḥ| rākṣasīśca tatḥ kruddha idṃ vacanamabravīt||3.56.26||
meaning: Enraged Ravana, who used to make enemies wail, turned to the demonesses and said these words.

sanskrit: शीघ्रमेव हि राक्षस्यो विकृता घोरदर्शनाः। दर्पमस्या विनेष्यध्वं मांसशोणितभोजनाः।।3.56.27।।
transliteration: śīghrameva hi rākṣasyo vikṛtā ghoradarśanāḥ| darpamasyā vineṣyadhvṃ māṃsaśoṇitabhojanāḥ||3.56.27||
meaning: Addressing the flesheating, blooddrinking, loathsome and fearful demonesses Ravana said, Humble her pride at once.

sanskrit: वचनादेव तास्तस्य सुघोरा राक्षसीगणाः। कृतप्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा मैथिलीं पर्यवारयन्।।3.56.28।।
transliteration: vacanādeva tāstasya sughorā rākṣasīgaṇāḥ| kṛtaprāñjalayo bhūtvā maithilīṃ paryavārayan||3.56.28||
meaning: No sooner had Ravana said it than the dreadful demonesses offered obeisance to him with folded hands and surrounded Sita.

sanskrit: स ताः प्रोवाच राजा तु रावणो घोरदर्शनः। प्रचाल्य चरणोत्कर्षैर्दारयन्निव मेदिनीम्।।3.56.29।।
transliteration: sa tāḥ provāca rājā tu rāvaṇo ghoradarśanḥ| pracālya caraṇotkarṣairdārayanniva medinīm||3.56.29||
meaning: Stamping his feet and shaking the ground as if tearing the earth, Ravana said to those fiercelooking demonesses:

sanskrit: अशोकवनिकामध्ये मैथिली नीयतामियम्। तत्रेयं रक्ष्यतां गूढं युष्माभिः परिवारिता।।3.56.30।।
transliteration: aśokavanikāmadhye maithilī nīyatāmiyam| tatreyṃ rakṣyatāṃ gūḍhṃ yuṣmābhiḥ parivāritā||3.56.30||
meaning: Let this Sita be led into the Asoka grove. There sit round her and protect her in secret (her presence there should not be made public).

sanskrit: तत्रैनां तर्जनैर्घोरैः पुनस्सान्त्वैश्च मैथिलीम्। आनयध्वं वशं सर्वा वन्यां गजवधूमिव।।3.56.31।।
transliteration: tatraināṃ tarjanairghoraiḥ punassāntvaiśca maithilīm| ānayadhvṃ vaśṃ sarvā vanyāṃ gajavadhūmiva||3.56.31||
meaning: There you all bring her under control through forcing and cajoling as one would do to tame a wild sheelephant.

sanskrit: इति प्रतिसमादिष्टा राक्षस्यो रावणेन ताः। अशोकवनिकां जग्मुर्मैथिलीं परिगृह्य तु।।3.56.32।। सर्वकालफलैर्वृक्षैर्नानापुष्पफ
transliteration: iti pratisamādiṣṭā rākṣasyo rāvaṇena tāḥ| aśokavanikāṃ jagmurmaithilīṃ parigṛhya tu||3.56.32|| sarvakālaphalairvṛkṣairnā
meaning: Thus instructed by Ravana, the demonesses took Sita into the Asoka grove, which was full of perenmal fruits and flowers of different kinds, where trees yielded fruits of all seasons and birds were always cheerful.

sanskrit: सा तु शोकपरीताङ्गी मैथिली जनकात्मजा। राक्षसीवशमापन्ना व्याघ्रीणां हरिणी यथा।।3.56.34।।
transliteration: sā tu śokaparītāṅgī maithilī janakātmajā| rākṣasīvaśamāpannā vyāghrīṇāṃ hariṇī yathā||3.56.34||
meaning: Sita, daughter of Janaka, engulfed in grief found herself like a doe under the control of tigresses.

sanskrit: शोकेन महता ग्रस्ता मैथिली जनकात्मजा। न शर्म लभते भीरुः पाशबद्धा मृगी यथा।।3.56.35।।
transliteration: śokena mahatā grastā maithilī janakātmajā| na śarma labhate bhīruḥ pāśabaddhā mṛgī yathā||3.56.35||
meaning: Sita, daughter of Janaka, immersed in deep grief knew no peace just like a doe caught in a snare.

sanskrit: न विन्दते तत्र तु शर्म मैथिली विरूपनेत्राभिरतीव तर्जिता। पतिं स्मरन्ती दयितं च देवतं विचेतनाऽभूद्भयशोकपीडिता।।3.56.36।।
transliteration: na vindate tatra tu śarma maithilī virūpanetrābhiratīva tarjitā| patiṃ smarantī dayitṃ ca devatṃ vicetanā'bhūdbhayaśokap
meaning: Sita had no peace as she was threatened excessively by those women of deformed looks. Remembering her beloved husband who was also her god, and overtaken by fear and grief , she fell unconscious. इतयार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे

sanskrit: तस्य सन्त्वरमाणस्य द्रष्टुकामस्य मैथिलीम्। क्रूरस्वनोऽथ गोमायुर्विननादास्य पृष्ठतः।।3.57.2।।
transliteration: tasya santvaramāṇasya draṣṭukāmasya maithilīm| krūrasvano'tha gomāyurvinanādāsya pṛṣṭhatḥ||3.57.2||
meaning: While Rama was hasting to see Sita, he heard from behind the ghastly howl of a jackal.

sanskrit: स तस्य स्वरमाज्ञाय दारुणं रोमहर्षणम्। चिन्तयामास गोमायोस्स्वरेण परिशङ्कितः।।3.57.3।।
transliteration: sa tasya svaramājñāya dāruṇṃ romaharṣaṇam| cintayāmāsa gomāyossvareṇa pariśaṅkitḥ||3.57.3||
meaning: Rama knew it was the horrible, horripilating cry of a jackal which made him apprehensive . It made him think.

sanskrit: अशुभं बत मन्येऽहं गोमायुर्वाश्यते यथा। स्वस्ति स्यादपि वैदेह्या राक्षसैर्भक्षणं विना।।3.57.4।।
transliteration: aśubhṃ bata manye'hṃ gomāyurvāśyate yathā| svasti syādapi vaidehyā rākṣasairbhakṣaṇṃ vinā||3.57.4||
meaning: 'The way the jackal is howling appears ominous. May Sita be safe without being eaten up by demons

sanskrit: मारीचेन तु विज्ञाय स्वरमालम्ब्य मामकम्। विक्रुष्टं मृगरूपेण लक्ष्मणश्शृणुयाद्यदि।।3.57.5।। स सौमित्रिस्स्वरं श्रुत्वा ता
transliteration: mārīcena tu vijñāya svaramālambya māmakam| vikruṣṭṃ mṛgarūpeṇa lakṣmaṇaśśṛṇuyādyadi||3.57.5|| sa saumitrissvarṃ śrutvā t
meaning: 'If Lakshmana listens to Maricha imitating my voice in the form of a deer, he, sent by Sita will come for me at once, leaving her behind.

sanskrit: राक्षसैस्सहितैर्नूनं सीताया ईप्सितो वधः। काञ्चनश्च मृगो भूत्वा व्यपनीयाश्रमात्तु माम्।।3.57.7।। दूरं नीत्वा तु मारीचो रा
transliteration: rākṣasaissahitairnūnṃ sītāyā īpsito vadhḥ| kāñcanaśca mṛgo bhūtvā vyapanīyāśramāttu mām||3.57.7|| dūrṃ nītvā tu mārīco r
meaning: 'Hence the murder of Sita must have been jointly planned by the demons. Maricha who had assumed the form of a golden deer, took me away from the hermitage to a faroff place where, killed by my arrows, he turned a demon u

sanskrit: अपि स्वस्ति भवेत्ताभ्यां रहिताभ्यां महावने। जनस्थाननिमित्तं हि कृतवैरोऽस्मि राक्षसैः।।3.57.9।। निमित्तानि च घोराणि दृश्य
transliteration: api svasti bhavettābhyāṃ rahitābhyāṃ mahāvane| janasthānanimittṃ hi kṛtavairo'smi rākṣasaiḥ||3.57.9|| nimittāni ca ghorā
meaning: 'On account of living in this dense forest in Janasthana I have earned enmity with the demons. Will Lakshmana and Sita be safe without my protection? I see many terrible portents.'

sanskrit: इत्येवं चिन्तयन्रामश्श्रुत्वा गोमायुनिस्स्वनम्।।3.57.10।। आत्मनश्चापनयनान्मृगरूपेण रक्षसा। आजगाम जनस्थानं राघवः परिशङ्कि
transliteration: ityevṃ cintayanrāmaśśrutvā gomāyunissvanam||3.57.10|| ātmanaścāpanayanānmṛgarūpeṇa rakṣasā| ājagāma janasthānṃ rāghavḥ p
meaning: On hearing the jackal's howl, Rama began thinking how the demon in the form of a deer drew him away. Thus in the midst of apprehensions he reached Janasthana.

sanskrit: तं दीनमनसो दीनमासेदुर्मृगपक्षिणः। सव्यं कृत्वा महात्मानं घोरांश्च ससृजुस्स्वरान्।।3.57.12।।
transliteration: tṃ dīnamanaso dīnamāsedurmṛgapakṣiṇḥ| savyṃ kṛtvā mahātmānṃ ghorāṃśca sasṛjussvarān||3.57.12||
meaning: Dejected at heart, the birds and animals piteously kept the great soul (Rama) to the left and produced a dreadful cacophony.

sanskrit: तानि दृष्ट्वा निमित्तानि महाघोराणि राघवः। न्यवर्तताथ त्वरितो जवेनाश्रममात्मनः।।3.57.13।।
transliteration: tāni dṛṣṭvā nimittāni mahāghorāṇi rāghavḥ| nyavartatātha tvarito javenāśramamātmanḥ||3.57.13||
meaning: On seeing such dreadfu omens at that time, Rama hurried back to his hermitage.

sanskrit: सीतां स तु वरारोहां लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्। आजगाम जनस्थानं चिन्तयन्नेव राघवः।।3.57.14।।
transliteration: sītāṃ sa tu varārohāṃ lakṣmaṇṃ ca mahābalam| ājagāma janasthānṃ cintayanneva rāghavḥ||3.57.14||
meaning: Rama arrived at Janasthana thinking (of the safety) of charming Sita and mighty Lakshmana.

sanskrit: ततो लक्ष्मणमायान्तं ददर्श विगतप्रभम्। ततोऽविदूरे रामेण समीयाय स लक्ष्मणः।।3.57.15।। विषण्णस्सुविषण्णेन दुःखितो दुःखभागिन
transliteration: tato lakṣmaṇamāyāntṃ dadarśa vigataprabham| tato'vidūre rāmeṇa samīyāya sa lakṣmaṇḥ||3.57.15|| viṣaṇṇassuviṣaṇṇena duḥkh
meaning: He then saw Lakshmana coming towards him with a cheerless face. When the sad, depressed Lakshmana came near, he saw Rama (equally) despondent and griefstricken.

sanskrit: सञ्जगर्हेऽथ तं भ्राता ज्येष्ठो लक्ष्मणमागतम्।।3.57.16।। विहाय सीतां विजने वने राक्षससेविते।
transliteration: sañjagarhe'tha tṃ bhrātā jyeṣṭho lakṣmaṇamāgatam||3.57.16|| vihāya sītāṃ vijane vane rākṣasasevite|
meaning: In this situation Rama the elder brother rebuked Lakshmana for having left Sita behind in a desolate forest infested with demons.

sanskrit: गृहीत्वा च करं सव्यं लक्ष्मणं रघुनन्दनः।।3.57.17।। उवाच मधुरोदर्कमिदं परुषमार्तिमत्।
transliteration: gṛhītvā ca karṃ savyṃ lakṣmaṇṃ raghunandanḥ||3.57.17|| uvāca madhurodarkamidṃ paruṣamārtimat|
meaning: Rama, the delight of the Raghus, took hold of Lakshmana's left hand, and in sadness said these sweet harsh words :

sanskrit: अहो लक्ष्मण गर्ह्यं ते कृतं यस्त्वं विहाय ताम्।।3.57.18।। सीतामिहाऽगतस्सौम्य कच्चित्स्वस्ति भवेदिह।
transliteration: aho lakṣmaṇa garhyṃ te kṛtṃ yastvṃ vihāya tām||3.57.18|| sītāmihā'gatassaumya kaccitsvasti bhavediha|
meaning: O gentle Lakshmana you are to blame for coming here, leaving Sita behind. Alas will she be safe now?

sanskrit: न मेऽस्ति संशयो वीर सर्वथा जनकात्मजा।।3.57.19।। विनष्टा भक्षिता वापि राक्षसैर्वनचारिभिः। अशुभान्येव भूयिष्ठं यथा प्रादुर
transliteration: na me'sti sṃśayo vīra sarvathā janakātmajā||3.57.19|| vinaṣṭā bhakṣitā vāpi rākṣasairvanacāribhiḥ| aśubhānyeva bhūyiṣṭhṃ
meaning: O heroic Lakshmana I see many inauspicious omens. I think Sita might have been lost or eaten away by the demons of the forest. There is no doubt about it.

sanskrit: अपि लक्ष्मण सीतायास्सामग्र्यं प्राप्नुयावहे। जीवन्त्याः पुरुषव्याघ्र सुताया जनकस्य वै।।3.57.21।।
transliteration: api lakṣmaṇa sītāyāssāmagryṃ prāpnuyāvahe| jīvantyāḥ puruṣavyāghra sutāyā janakasya vai||3.57.21||
meaning: O Lakshmana, a tiger among men, will we be able to see the daughter of Janaka, living in a state of total wellbeing? Will we be able to get her back ?

sanskrit: यथा वै मृगसङ्घाश्च गोमायुश्चैव भैरवम्। वाश्यन्ते शकुनाश्चापि प्रदीप्तामभितो दिशम्।।3.57.22।। अपि स्वस्ति भवेत्तस्या राजप
transliteration: yathā vai mṛgasaṅghāśca gomāyuścaiva bhairavam| vāśyante śakunāścāpi pradīptāmabhito diśam||3.57.22|| api svasti bhavett
meaning: O mighty Lakshmana from the way the beasts, jackals and birds too have turned in the bright direction of the Sun, crying in a frightful manner, can we hope princess Sita is safe ?

sanskrit: इदं हि रक्षो मृगसन्निकाशं प्रलोभ्य मां दूरमनुप्रयान्तम्। हतं कथञ्चिन्महता श्रमेण स राक्षसोऽभून्म्रियमाण एव।।3.57.23।।
transliteration: idṃ hi rakṣo mṛgasannikāśṃ pralobhya māṃ dūramanuprayāntam| hatṃ kathañcinmahatā śrameṇa sa rākṣaso'bhūnmriyamāṇa eva||3
meaning: Appearing in the guise of a deer, this demon allured me to a great distance. With much effort he was somehow killed. but he assumed his demoniac form while dying.

sanskrit: मनश्च मे दीनमिहाप्रहृष्टं चक्षुश्च सव्यं कुरुते विकारम्। असंशयं लक्ष्मण नास्ति सीता हृता मृता वा पथि वर्तते वा।।3.57.24।
transliteration: manaśca me dīnamihāprahṛṣṭṃ cakṣuśca savyṃ kurute vikāram| asṃśayṃ lakṣmaṇa nāsti sītā hṛtā mṛtā vā pathi vartate vā||3.
meaning: With my heart dejected and depressed, my left eye throbbing, O Lakshmana, I have no doubt that Sita is either abducted or dead or abandoned on the way. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्तपञ्चाशस

sanskrit: प्रस्थितं दण्डकारण्यं या मामनुजगाम ह। क्व सा लक्ष्मण वैदेही यां हित्वा त्वमिहागतः।।3.58.2।।
transliteration: prasthitṃ daṇḍakāraṇyṃ yā māmanujagāma ha| kva sā lakṣmaṇa vaidehī yāṃ hitvā tvamihāgatḥ||3.58.2||
meaning: Where is that princess from Videha who accompanied me when I entered Dandaka forest ? Why have you come here leaving her behind ?

sanskrit: राज्यभ्रष्टस्य दीनस्य दण्डकान्परिधावतः। क्व सा दुःखसहाया मे वैदेही तनुमध्यमा।।3.58.3।।
transliteration: rājyabhraṣṭasya dīnasya daṇḍakānparidhāvatḥ| kva sā duḥkhasahāyā me vaidehī tanumadhyamā||3.58.3||
meaning: Where is that princess from Videha, a sharer of my sorrows, Sita of slender waist who followed this hapless prince disloged from the kingdom into the Dandaka forest?

sanskrit: यां विना नोत्सहे वीर मुहूर्तमपि जीवितुम्। क्व सा प्राणसहाया मे सीता सुरसुतोपमा।।3.58.4।।
transliteration: yāṃ vinā notsahe vīra muhūrtamapi jīvitum| kva sā prāṇasahāyā me sītā surasutopamā||3.58.4||
meaning: O warrior Lakshmana where is that Sita without whom I have no interest to live for a moment, who was like the daughter of a god and a sustainer of my life?

sanskrit: पतित्वममराणां वा पृथिव्याश्चापि लक्ष्मण। तां विना तपनीयाभां नेच्छेयं जनकात्मजाम्।।3.58.5।।
transliteration: patitvamamarāṇāṃ vā pṛthivyāścāpi lakṣmaṇa| tāṃ vinā tapanīyābhāṃ neccheyṃ janakātmajām||3.58.5||
meaning: O Lakshmana I desire no lordship of the gods or of the entire earth without that daughter of Janaka, that lady of golden complexion.

sanskrit: कच्चिज्जीवति वैदेहि प्राणैः प्रियतरा मम। कच्चित्प्रव्राजनं सौम्य न मे मिथ्या भविष्यति।।3.58.6।।
transliteration: kaccijjīvati vaidehi prāṇaiḥ priyatarā mama| kaccitpravrājanṃ saumya na me mithyā bhaviṣyati||3.58.6||
meaning: O gentle Lakshmana I wonder if Vaidehi, who is dearer to me than my life is still alive I hope my banishment from the kingdom is not going to prove false.

sanskrit: सीतानिमित्तं सौमित्रे मृते मयि गते त्वयि। कच्चित्सकामा सुखिता कैकेयी सा भविष्यति।।3.58.7।।
transliteration: sītānimittṃ saumitre mṛte mayi gate tvayi| kaccitsakāmā sukhitā kaikeyī sā bhaviṣyati||3.58.7||
meaning: O Saumitri when I am dead on account of Sita, and you are back, Kaikeyi with her desire fulfilled will be happy, indeed.

sanskrit: सपुत्रराज्यां सिद्धार्थां मृतपुत्रा तपस्विनी। उपस्थास्यतिकौसल्या कच्चित्सौम्य न केकयीम्।।3.58.8।।
transliteration: saputrarājyāṃ siddhārthāṃ mṛtaputrā tapasvinī| upasthāsyatikausalyā kaccitsaumya na kekayīm||3.58.8||
meaning: O handsome one I wonder if that lady of renunciation, Kausalya with her son dead, will have to serve Kaikeyi whose desire would be fulfilled, and who will enjoy the power of the throne in the company of her son

sanskrit: यदि जीवति वैदेही गमिष्याम्याश्रमं पुनः। सुवृत्ता यदि वृत्ता प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यामि लक्ष्मण।।3.58.9।।
transliteration: yadi jīvati vaidehī gamiṣyāmyāśramṃ punḥ| suvṛttā yadi vṛttā prāṇāṃstyakṣyāmi lakṣmaṇa||3.58.9||
meaning: O Lakshmana, only if Vaidehi is alive will I enter the cottage again or else I will give up my life if that virtuous lady is no more.

sanskrit: यदि मामाश्रमगतं वैदेही नाभिभाषते। पुनः प्रहसिता सीता विनशिष्यामि लक्ष्मण।।3.58.10।।
transliteration: yadi māmāśramagatṃ vaidehī nābhibhāṣate| punḥ prahasitā sītā vinaśiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇa||3.58.10||
meaning: I will die if Sita, princess from Videha, is not there to speak to me with her sweet smile when I return to the cottage, O Lakshmana

sanskrit: ब्रूहि लक्ष्मण वैदेही यदि जीवति वा न वा। त्वयि प्रमत्ते रक्षोभिर्भक्षिता वा तपस्विनी।।3.58.11।।
transliteration: brūhi lakṣmaṇa vaidehī yadi jīvati vā na vā| tvayi pramatte rakṣobhirbhakṣitā vā tapasvinī||3.58.11||
meaning: Tell me, O Lakshmana if Sita is alive or not, whether she was eaten up by demons when you were off your guard.

sanskrit: सुकुमारी च बाला च नित्यं चादुःखदर्शिनी। मद्वियोगेन वैदेही व्यक्तं शोचति दुर्मनाः।।3.58.12।।
transliteration: sukumārī ca bālā ca nityṃ cāduḥkhadarśinī| madviyogena vaidehī vyaktṃ śocati durmanāḥ||3.58.12||
meaning: Vaidehi is delicate, young and she has never faced any sorrow.She will be certainly disheartened due to separation from me.

sanskrit: सर्वदा रक्षसा तेन जिह्मेन सुदुरात्मना। वदता लक्ष्मणेत्युच्चैस्तवापि जनितं भयम्।।3.58.13।।
transliteration: sarvadā rakṣasā tena jihmena sudurātmanā| vadatā lakṣmaṇetyuccaistavāpi janitṃ bhayam||3.58.13||
meaning: The evilminded, wicked demon calling out loudly 'O Lakshmana' must have by all means instilled fear in your mind.

sanskrit: श्रुतस्तु शङ्के वैदेह्या स स्वरस्सदृशो मम। त्रस्तया प्रेषितस्त्वं च द्रष्टुं मां शीघ्रमागतः।।3.58.14।।
transliteration: śrutastu śaṅke vaidehyā sa svarassadṛśo mama| trastayā preṣitastvṃ ca draṣṭuṃ māṃ śīghramāgatḥ||3.58.14||
meaning: I am afraid, Vaidehi, frightened by hearing the voice which was like mine sent you to see me, and you came all at once.

sanskrit: सर्वथा तु कृतं कष्टं सीतामुत्सृजता वने। प्रतिकर्तुं नृशंसानां रक्षसां दत्तमन्तरं।।3.58.15।।
transliteration: sarvathā tu kṛtṃ kaṣṭṃ sītāmutsṛjatā vane| pratikartuṃ nṛśṃsānāṃ rakṣasāṃ dattamantarṃ||3.58.15||
meaning: You have definitely done a great mistake by leaving Sita alone in the forest. This has given a chance to the cruel demons to wreak revenge.

sanskrit: दुःखिताः खरघातेन राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः। तैस्सीता निहता घोरैर्भविष्यति न संशयः।3.58.16।।
transliteration: duḥkhitāḥ kharaghātena rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ| taissītā nihatā ghorairbhaviṣyati na sṃśayḥ|3.58.16||
meaning: The dreadful, carnivorous demons aggrieved over my murder of Khara must have undoubtedly killed Sita.

sanskrit: अहोऽस्मिन् व्यसने मग्नस्सर्वथा शत्रुसूदन। किं न्विदानीं करिष्यामि शङ्के प्राप्तव्यमीदृशम्।।3.58.17।।
transliteration: aho'smin vyasane magnassarvathā śatrusūdana| kiṃ nvidānīṃ kariṣyāmi śaṅke prāptavyamīdṛśam||3.58.17||
meaning: O destroyer of enemies I am completely drowned in sorrow. What can I do at this moment. Alas, I am destined to suffer.

sanskrit: इति सीतां वरारोहां चिन्तयन्नेव राघवः। आजगाम जनस्थानं त्वरया सह लक्ष्मणः।।3.58.18।।
transliteration: iti sītāṃ varārohāṃ cintayanneva rāghavḥ| ājagāma janasthānṃ tvarayā saha lakṣmaṇḥ||3.58.18||
meaning: While thus brooding over the beautiful Sita, the scion of the Raghus along with Lakshmana hurried towards Janasthana.

sanskrit: विगर्हमाणोऽनुजमार्तरूपं क्षुधा श्रमाच्चैव पिपासया च। विनिश्श्वसन् शुष्कमुखो विवर्णः प्रतिश्रयं प्राप्य समीक्ष्य शून्यम्।
transliteration: vigarhamāṇo'nujamārtarūpṃ kṣudhā śramāccaiva pipāsayā ca| viniśśvasan śuṣkamukho vivarṇḥ pratiśrayṃ prāpya samīkṣya śūny
meaning: Thus blaming his dejected brother, the valiant Rama entered the hermitage, sighing deeply, his face pale and his throat dried up with hunger, exhaustion and thirst. Reaching his dwellingplace, he found it empty. He thoro

sanskrit: तमुवाच किमर्थं त्वमागतोऽपास्य मैथिलीम्। यदा सा तव विश्वासाद्वने विरहिता मया।।3.59.2।।
transliteration: tamuvāca kimarthṃ tvamāgato'pāsya maithilīm| yadā sā tava viśvāsādvane virahitā mayā||3.59.2||
meaning: Why did you come, leaving the princess from Mithila alone in the forest when I had left her under your trust ?

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वैवाभ्यागतं त्वां मे मैथिलीं त्यज्य लक्ष्मण। शङ्कमानं महत्पापं यत्सत्यं व्यथितं मनः।।3.59.3।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvaivābhyāgatṃ tvāṃ me maithilīṃ tyajya lakṣmaṇa| śaṅkamānṃ mahatpāpṃ yatsatyṃ vyathitṃ manḥ||3.59.3||
meaning: When I saw you, O Lakshmana, coming without Sita, my mind was oppressed with evil thought which have come true.

sanskrit: स्फुरते नयनं सव्यं बाहुश्च हृदयं च मे। दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मण दूरे त्वां सीताविरहितं पथि।।3.59.4।।
transliteration: sphurate nayanṃ savyṃ bāhuśca hṛdayṃ ca me| dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇa dūre tvāṃ sītāvirahitṃ pathi||3.59.4||
meaning: O Lakshmana, as I saw you from a distance without Sita, my left eye, my shoulder and my heart throbbed.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तन्तु सौमित्रिर्लक्ष्मणश्शुभलक्षणः। भूयो दुःखसमाविष्टो दुःखितं राममब्रवीत्।।3.59.5।।
transliteration: evamuktantu saumitrirlakṣmaṇaśśubhalakṣaṇḥ| bhūyo duḥkhasamāviṣṭo duḥkhitṃ rāmamabravīt||3.59.5||
meaning: Thus addressed, virtuous Lakshmana, overwhelmed with sorrow replied to the grief stricken Rama:

sanskrit: न स्वयं कामकारेण तां त्यक्त्वाहमिहागतः। प्रचोदित स्तयैवोग्रैस्त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः।।3.59.6।।
transliteration: na svayṃ kāmakāreṇa tāṃ tyaktvāhamihāgatḥ| pracodita stayaivograistvatsakāśamihāgatḥ||3.59.6||
meaning: I did not leave her on my own nor have I come here of my own accord. I came to you, provoked by her angry words.

sanskrit: आर्येणेव पराक्रुष्टं हासीते लक्ष्मणेति च। परित्राहीति यद्वाक्यं मैथिल्यास्तच्छ्रुतिं गतम्।।3.59.7।।
transliteration: āryeṇeva parākruṣṭṃ hāsīte lakṣmaṇeti ca| paritrāhīti yadvākyṃ maithilyāstacchrutiṃ gatam||3.59.7||
meaning: Uttered loudly, 'Alas Sita, Alas, Lakshmana, save me', as if these were the words of your noble self, reached Sita's ears.

sanskrit: सा तमार्तस्वरं श्रुत्वा तव स्नेहेन मैथिली। गच्छ गच्छेति मामाह रुदन्ती भयविह्वला।।3.59.8।।
transliteration: sā tamārtasvarṃ śrutvā tava snehena maithilī| gaccha gaccheti māmāha rudantī bhayavihvalā||3.59.8||
meaning: The princess from Mithila heard this cry of pain and, wild with fear, urged me out of her love for you to go.

sanskrit: प्रचोद्यमानेन मया गच्छेति बहुशस्तया। प्रत्युक्ता मैथिली वाक्यमिदं त्वत्प्रत्ययान्वितम्।3.59.9।।
transliteration: pracodyamānena mayā gaccheti bahuśastayā| pratyuktā maithilī vākyamidṃ tvatpratyayānvitam|3.59.9||
meaning: When I was repeated asked to go, I said this in order to instil confidence in the princess from Mithila :

sanskrit: न तत्पश्याम्यहं रक्षो यदस्य भयमावहेत्। निर्वृता भव नास्त्येतत्केनाप्येवमुदाहृतम्।।3.59.10।।
transliteration: na tatpaśyāmyahṃ rakṣo yadasya bhayamāvahet| nirvṛtā bhava nāstyetatkenāpyevamudāhṛtam||3.59.10||
meaning: 'No one can cause fear in Rama. I do not see any demon who can hold a threat to him. Give up fear. Some one might have said it.

sanskrit: विगर्हितं च नीचं च कथमार्योऽभिधास्यति। त्राहीति वचनं सीते यस्त्रायेत्रिदशानपि।।3.59.11।।
transliteration: vigarhitṃ ca nīcṃ ca kathamāryo'bhidhāsyati| trāhīti vacanṃ sīte yastrāyetridaśānapi||3.59.11||
meaning: 'How can Rama who is capable of saving even gods speak such unworthy, demeaning words, 'Save me, O Sita'

sanskrit: किं निमित्तं तु केनापि भ्रातुरालम्ब्य मे स्वरम्। राक्षसेनेरितं वाक्यं त्राहि त्राहीति शोभने।।3.59.12।।
transliteration: kiṃ nimittṃ tu kenāpi bhrāturālambya me svaram| rākṣaseneritṃ vākyṃ trāhi trāhīti śobhane||3.59.12||
meaning: O fair lady, for some reason some demon has uttered these words 'Save me, save me' adapting my brother's voice.

sanskrit: विस्वरं व्याहृतं वाक्यं लक्ष्मण त्राहि मामिति। न भवत्या व्यथा कार्या कुनारीजनसेविता।।3.59.13।।
transliteration: visvarṃ vyāhṛtṃ vākyṃ lakṣmaṇa trāhi māmiti| na bhavatyā vyathā kāryā kunārījanasevitā||3.59.13||
meaning: 'Lakshmana, save me' are the words uttered in an altered tone. Like an ordinary, lowborn woman you are not to feel concerned for this.

sanskrit: अलं वैक्लब्यमालम्ब्य स्वस्था भव निरुत्सुका। न सोऽस्ति त्रिषु लोकेषु पुमान्वै राघवं रणे।।3.59.14।। जातो वा जायमानो वा संय
transliteration: alṃ vaiklabyamālambya svasthā bhava nirutsukā| na so'sti triṣu lokeṣu pumānvai rāghavṃ raṇe||3.59.14|| jāto vā jāyamāno
meaning: 'You should not feel agitated or dispirited. Be composed. There is no one either born or going to be born in the three worlds who can defeat Rama in war. He cannot be conquered in a battle even by gods led by indra.'

sanskrit: एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही परिमोहितचेतना। उवाचाश्रूणि मुञ्चन्ती दारुणं मामिदं वचः।।3.59.16।।
transliteration: evamuktā tu vaidehī parimohitacetanā| uvācāśrūṇi muñcantī dāruṇṃ māmidṃ vacḥ||3.59.16||
meaning: Deluded by her senses, Vaidehi said these words, shedding tears when I tried to console her:

sanskrit: भावो मयि तवात्यर्थं पाप एव निवेशितः। विनष्टे भ्रातरि प्राप्तुं न च त्वं मामवाप्स्यसि।।3.59.17।।
transliteration: bhāvo mayi tavātyarthṃ pāpa eva niveśitḥ| vinaṣṭe bhrātari prāptuṃ na ca tvṃ māmavāpsyasi||3.59.17||
meaning: 'You have an extremely sinful intention of getting me when your brother is dead. But you will not be able to gain me.

sanskrit: सङ्केताद्भरतेन त्वं रामं समनुगच्छसि। क्रोशन्तं हि यथात्यर्थं नैवमभ्यवपद्यसे।।3.59.18।।
transliteration: saṅketādbharatena tvṃ rāmṃ samanugacchasi| krośantṃ hi yathātyarthṃ naivamabhyavapadyase||3.59.18||
meaning: 'Since you are not reaching out to Rama who is helplessly crying for his rescue, you must have followed Rama, instructed by Bharata (to do him harm)'৷৷

sanskrit: रिपुः प्रच्छन्नचारी त्वं मदर्थमनुगच्छसि। राघवस्यान्तरप्रेप्सुस्तथैनं नाभिपद्यसे।।3.59.19।।
transliteration: ripuḥ pracchannacārī tvṃ madarthamanugacchasi| rāghavasyāntaraprepsustathainṃ nābhipadyase||3.59.19||
meaning: 'You are an enemy moving in disguise with an interest in me. You are waiting for an opportunity to set aside Rama. That is why you are not rushing to him.'

sanskrit: एवमुक्तो हि वैदेह्या संरब्धो रक्तलोचनः। क्रोधात्प्रस्फुरमाणोष्ठ आश्रमादभिनिर्गतः।।3.59.20।।
transliteration: evamukto hi vaidehyā sṃrabdho raktalocanḥ| krodhātprasphuramāṇoṣṭha āśramādabhinirgatḥ||3.59.20||
meaning: At these words from the princess of Videha, I came out of the hermitage in an agitated mood with my eyes turned red and lips quivering in anger.

sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवाणं सौमित्रिं रामस्सन्तापमोहितः। अब्रवीद्दुष्कृतं सौम्य तां विना यत्त्वमागतः।।3.59.21।।
transliteration: evṃ bruvāṇṃ saumitriṃ rāmassantāpamohitḥ| abravīdduṣkṛtṃ saumya tāṃ vinā yattvamāgatḥ||3.59.21||
meaning: To Lakshmana thus reporting, Rama, overcome with grief, said,(Even then) O noble brother your coming here, leaving her behind, is a wrong step taken.

sanskrit: जानन्नपि समर्थं मां रक्षसां विनिवारणे। अनेन क्रोधवाक्येन मैथिल्या निस्सृतो भवान्।।3.59.22।।
transliteration: jānannapi samarthṃ māṃ rakṣasāṃ vinivāraṇe| anena krodhavākyena maithilyā nissṛto bhavān||3.59.22||
meaning: You have come out of the hermitage provoked by Maithili's angry words, even though you are aware that I am capable of warding off the demons.

sanskrit: न हि ते परितुष्यामि त्यक्त्वा यद्यासि मैथिलीम्। क्रुद्धायाः परुषं श्रुत्वा तां विहाय त्वमागतः।।3.59.23।।
transliteration: na hi te parituṣyāmi tyaktvā yadyāsi maithilīm| kruddhāyāḥ paruṣṃ śrutvā tāṃ vihāya tvamāgatḥ||3.59.23||
meaning: I am not happy with you as you have come here deserting Sita on the plea that she was angry and spoke harsh words.

sanskrit: सर्वथा त्वविनीतं ते सीतया यत्प्रचोदितः। क्रोधस्य वशमापन्नो नाकरोश्शासनं मम।।3.59.24।।
transliteration: sarvathā tvavinītṃ te sītayā yatpracoditḥ| krodhasya vaśamāpanno nākarośśāsanṃ mama||3.59.24||
meaning: Provoked by the words of Sita spoken in anger you came without respecting my orders. It is definitely an act of disobedience.

sanskrit: असौ हि राक्षसश्शेते शरेणाभिहतो मया। मृगरूपेण येनाहमाश्रमादपवाहितः।।3.59.25।।
transliteration: asau hi rākṣasaśśete śareṇābhihato mayā| mṛgarūpeṇa yenāhamāśramādapavāhitḥ||3.59.25||
meaning: This demon who misled me in the guise of a deer and took me away from the hermitage, lies dead, killed by my arrow.

sanskrit: विकृष्य चापं परिधाय सायकं सलीलबाणेन च ताडितो मया। मार्गीं तनुं त्यज्य स विक्लबस्वरो बभूव केयूरधरस्सराक्षसः।।3.59.26।।
transliteration: vikṛṣya cāpṃ paridhāya sāyakṃ salīlabāṇena ca tāḍito mayā| mārgīṃ tanuṃ tyajya sa viklabasvaro babhūva keyūradharassarāk
meaning: Bending the bow I fixed the arrow and released it at ease. Hit by that arrow he gave up his guise of the deer and assuming the form of a demon with a bracelet on his arm fell down groaning.

sanskrit: शराहतेनैव तदार्तया गिरा स्वरं समालम्ब्य सुदूरसुश्रवम्। उदाहृतं तद्वचनं सुदारुणं त्वमागतो येन विहाय मैथिलीम्।।3.59.27।।
transliteration: śarāhatenaiva tadārtayā girā svarṃ samālambya sudūrasuśravam| udāhṛtṃ tadvacanṃ sudāruṇṃ tvamāgato yena vihāya maithilīm
meaning: Hit by the arrow, the demon imitating my voice cried out in desperation which could be clearly audible even from a distance. On hearing the dreadful words you deserted Sita and came here. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीक

sanskrit: वैखानसा वालखिल्यास्सम्प्रक्षाला मरीचिपाः। अश्मकुट्टाश्च बहवः पत्राहाराश्च तापसाः।।3.6.2।। दन्तोलूखलिनश्चैव तथैवोन्मज्जका
transliteration: vaikhānasā vālakhilyāssamprakṣālā marīcipāḥ| aśmakuṭṭāśca bahavḥ patrāhārāśca tāpasāḥ||3.6.2|| dantolūkhalinaścaiva tath
meaning: Vaikhanasas, Valakhilyas, sages who continuously wash their bodies, Marichakas Asmakuttas sages who live on leaves only, those who have teeth like mortar, Unmajjakas, those who use limbs as their bed, those who practise

sanskrit: अभिगम्य च धर्मज्ञा रामं धर्मभृतां वरम्। ऊचुः परमधर्मज्ञमृषिसङ्घास्समाहिताः।।3.6.7।।
transliteration: abhigamya ca dharmajñā rāmṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varam| ūcuḥ paramadharmajñamṛṣisaṅghāssamāhitāḥ||3.6.7||
meaning: All groups of sages, who knew dharma, and were upholders of righteousness reached Rama, the supreme knower of dharma, and said:

sanskrit: त्वमिक्ष्वाकुकुलस्यास्य पृथिव्याश्च महारथ। प्रधानश्चासि नाथश्च देवानां मघवानिव।।3.6.8।।
transliteration: tvamikṣvākukulasyāsya pṛthivyāśca mahāratha| pradhānaścāsi nāthaśca devānāṃ maghavāniva||3.6.8||
meaning: O great charioteer you are the lord of the Ikshvaku race and of the world just like Indra, chief among the gods.

sanskrit: विश्रुतस्त्रिषु लोकेषु यशसा विक्रमेण च। पितृभक्तिश्च सत्यं च त्वयि धर्मश्च पुष्कलः।।3.6.9।।
transliteration: viśrutastriṣu lokeṣu yaśasā vikrameṇa ca| pitṛbhaktiśca satyṃ ca tvayi dharmaśca puṣkalḥ||3.6.9||
meaning: You are renowned in the three worlds for your valour, for your devotion to father, and in you lies enough evidence of your adherence to truth and righteousness.

sanskrit: त्वामासाद्य महात्मानं धर्मज्ञं धर्मवत्सलम्। अर्थित्वान्नाथ वक्ष्यामस्तच्च नः क्षन्तुमर्हसि।।3.6.10।।
transliteration: tvāmāsādya mahātmānṃ dharmajñṃ dharmavatsalam| arthitvānnātha vakṣyāmastacca nḥ kṣantumarhasi||3.6.10||
meaning: O lord, do excuse us. We sought your help to fulfil our needs since you are at hand. You are a great soul, knower and lover of dharma.

sanskrit: अधर्मस्सुमहांस्तात भवेत्तस्य महीपतेः। यो हरेद्बलिषड्भागां न च रक्षति पुत्रवत्।।3.6.11।।
transliteration: adharmassumahāṃstāta bhavettasya mahīpateḥ| yo haredbaliṣaḍbhāgāṃ na ca rakṣati putravat||3.6.11||
meaning: O Lord, a king who collect one sixth of the produce as tax and yet does not protect his subjects like his children commits an act of grave injustice.

sanskrit: युञ्जानस्स्वानिव प्राणान्प्राणैरिष्टान्सुतानिव। नित्ययुक्तस्सदा रक्षन्सर्वान्विषयवासिनः।।3.6.12।। प्राप्नोति शाश्वतीं रा
transliteration: yuñjānassvāniva prāṇānprāṇairiṣṭānsutāniva| nityayuktassadā rakṣansarvānviṣayavāsinḥ||3.6.12|| prāpnoti śāśvatīṃ rāma kī
meaning: O Rama, whoever protects the inhabitants of his kingdom at all times like his own son who he loves more than his own life will attain the world of Brahma and remain there for long years and will achieve prosperity therea

sanskrit: यत्करोति परं धर्म मुनिर्मूलफलाशनः। तत्र राज्ञश्चतुर्भाग प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षितः।।3.6.14।।
transliteration: yatkaroti parṃ dharma munirmūlaphalāśanḥ| tatra rājñaścaturbhāga prajā dharmeṇa rakṣitḥ||3.6.14||
meaning: One fourth of the supreme merit a sage earns by living on fruits and roots, accrues to the king through which the people are protected righteously.

sanskrit: सोऽयं ब्राह्मणभूयिष्ठो वानप्रस्थगणो महान्। त्वन्नाथोऽनाथवद्राम राक्षसैर्वध्यते भृशम्।।3.6.15।।
transliteration: so'yṃ brāhmaṇabhūyiṣṭho vānaprasthagaṇo mahān| tvannātho'nāthavadrāma rākṣasairvadhyate bhṛśam||3.6.15||
meaning: O Rama we are a group of great sages, mostly brahmins, leading a vanaprastha life. Yet with a protector like you, we are slaughtered in large numbers like orphans.

sanskrit: एहि पश्य शरीराणि मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्। हतानां राक्षसैर्घोरैर्बहूनां बहुधा वने।।3.6.16।।
transliteration: ehi paśya śarīrāṇi munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām| hatānāṃ rākṣasairghorairbahūnāṃ bahudhā vane||3.6.16||
meaning: Come and see the bodies of ascetics, who had perceived the Supreme Spirit, killed in large numbers in the forest by the fierce demons.

sanskrit: पम्पानदीनिवासानामनुमन्दाकिनीमपि। चित्रकूटालयानां च क्रियते कदनं महत्।।3.6.17।।
transliteration: pampānadīnivāsānāmanumandākinīmapi| citrakūṭālayānāṃ ca kriyate kadanṃ mahat||3.6.17||
