meaning: A great slaughter is taking place amongst those residing on the bank of the Pampa lake, near the river Mandakini, and on mount Chitrakuta.

sanskrit: एवं वयं न मृष्यामो विप्रकारं तपस्विनाम्। क्रियमाणं वने घोरं रक्षोभिर्भीमकर्मभिः।।3.6.18।।
transliteration: evṃ vayṃ na mṛṣyāmo viprakārṃ tapasvinām| kriyamāṇṃ vane ghorṃ rakṣobhirbhīmakarmabhiḥ||3.6.18||
meaning: We ascetics are not able to tolerate the fearful deeds perpetrated by the dreadful demons in the forest.

sanskrit: ततस्त्वां शरणार्थं च शरण्यं समुपस्थिताः। परिपालय नो राम वध्यमानान्निशाचरैः।।3.6.19।।
transliteration: tatastvāṃ śaraṇārthṃ ca śaraṇyṃ samupasthitāḥ| paripālaya no rāma vadhyamānānniśācaraiḥ||3.6.19||
meaning: O Rama, you are worthy of refuge. Hence we have come to you seeking your protection. We are being killed by the nightstalkers. Save us.

sanskrit: परा त्वत्तो गतिर्वीर पृथिव्यां नोपपद्यते। परिपालय न स्सर्वान्राक्षसेभ्यो नृपात्मज।।3.6.20।।
transliteration: parā tvatto gatirvīra pṛthivyāṃ nopapadyate| paripālaya na ssarvānrākṣasebhyo nṛpātmaja||3.6.20||
meaning: O great warrior here on this earth there is no protector as mighty as you. So, O prince save us all from these demons.

sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु काकुत्स्थस्तापसानां तपस्विनाम्। इदं प्रोवाच धर्मात्मा सर्वानेव तपस्विनः।।3.6.21।।
transliteration: etacchrutvā tu kākutsthastāpasānāṃ tapasvinām| idṃ provāca dharmātmā sarvāneva tapasvinḥ||3.6.21||
meaning: Having heard this, righteous Rama of the Kakutstha dynasty said to all the ascetics engaged in penance:

sanskrit: नैवमर्हथ मां वक्तुमाज्ञाप्योऽहं तपस्विनाम्। केवलेनात्मकार्येण प्रवेष्टव्यं मया वनं।।3.6.22।।
transliteration: naivamarhatha māṃ vaktumājñāpyo'hṃ tapasvinām| kevalenātmakāryeṇa praveṣṭavyṃ mayā vanṃ||3.6.22||
meaning: You should not speak to me this way. I deserve to be commanded by the ascetics. I have not entered this forest only on a personal mission.

sanskrit: विप्रकारमपाक्रष्टुं राक्षसैर्भवतामिमम्। पितुस्तु निर्देशकरः प्रविष्टोऽहमिदं वनम्।।3.6.23।।
transliteration: viprakāramapākraṣṭuṃ rākṣasairbhavatāmimam| pitustu nirdeśakarḥ praviṣṭo'hamidṃ vanam||3.6.23||
meaning: I came into this forest in obedience to my father's orders to repel the aggression of demons against you.

sanskrit: भवतामर्थसिद्ध्यर्थमागतोऽहं यदृच्छया। तस्य मेऽयं वने वासो भविष्यति महाफलः।।3.6.24।।
transliteration: bhavatāmarthasiddhyarthamāgato'hṃ yadṛcchayā| tasya me'yṃ vane vāso bhaviṣyati mahāphalḥ||3.6.24||
meaning: I came here to acomplish your task incidentally, Therefore, my stay in the forest will yield great results.

sanskrit: तपस्विनां रणे शत्रून्हन्तुमिच्छामि राक्षसान्। पश्यन्तु वीर्यमृषयस्सभ्रातुर्मे तपोधनाः।।3.6.25।।
transliteration: tapasvināṃ raṇe śatrūnhantumicchāmi rākṣasān| paśyantu vīryamṛṣayassabhrāturme tapodhanāḥ||3.6.25||
meaning: I wish to kill in the fight the demons who are your enemies. O great ascetics, you may witness my prowess supported by my brother.

sanskrit: दत्त्वाऽभयं चापि तपोधनानां धर्मे धृतात्मा सह लक्ष्मणेन। तपोधनैश्चापि सभाज्यवृत्तः सुतीक्ष्णमेवाभिजगाम वीरः।।3.6.26।।
transliteration: dattvā'bhayṃ cāpi tapodhanānāṃ dharme dhṛtātmā saha lakṣmaṇena| tapodhanaiścāpi sabhājyavṛttḥ sutīkṣṇamevābhijagāma vīrḥ
meaning: Brave Rama, steadfast in righteousness, worthy of honour, gave assurance to protect the ascetics endowed with the wealth of penance, and proceeded towards sage Sutikshna. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्

sanskrit: उपालक्ष्य निमित्तानि सोऽशुभानि मुहुर्मुहुः। अपि क्षेमं नु सीताया इति वै व्याजहार च।।3.60.2।।
transliteration: upālakṣya nimittāni so'śubhāni muhurmuhuḥ| api kṣemṃ nu sītāyā iti vai vyājahāra ca||3.60.2||
meaning: As inauspicious omens appeared again and again, doubting if all is well with Sita, he said to himself, Can Sita be safe?

sanskrit: त्वरमाणो जगामाथ सीतादर्शनलालसः। शून्यमावसथं दृष्ट्वा बभूवोद्विग्नमानसः।।3.60.3।।
transliteration: tvaramāṇo jagāmātha sītādarśanalālasḥ| śūnyamāvasathṃ dṛṣṭvā babhūvodvignamānasḥ||3.60.3||
meaning: Anxious to see Sita, he hastened to the hermitage and finding it empty, became restless.

sanskrit: उद्भ्रमन्निव वेगेन विक्षिपन्रघुनन्दनः। तत्र तत्रोटजस्थानमभिवीक्षय समन्ततः।।3.60.4।। ददर्श पर्णशालां च रहितां सीतया तदा।
transliteration: udbhramanniva vegena vikṣipanraghunandanḥ| tatra tatroṭajasthānamabhivīkṣaya samantatḥ||3.60.4|| dadarśa parṇaśālāṃ ca r
meaning: Rama, the delight of the Raghu dynasty, hurtled in, turning round, throwing his hands to and fro, casting his looks all around the cottage where she used to move. The cottage, devoid of Sita looked like a lotuspond, the

sanskrit: रुदन्तमिव वृक्षैश्च म्लानपुष्पमृगद्विजम्। श्रिया विहीनं विध्वस्तं सन्त्यक्तवनदेवतम्।।3.60.6।। विप्रकीर्णाजिनकुशं विप्रवि
transliteration: rudantamiva vṛkṣaiśca mlānapuṣpamṛgadvijam| śriyā vihīnṃ vidhvastṃ santyaktavanadevatam||3.60.6|| viprakīrṇājinakuśṃ vip
meaning: The trees with flowers withered, the animals and birds turned pale looked as if they were weeping. Bereft of their beauty they wore a ruinous look. The sylvan deities had left. The deerskin and kusa grass were strewn her

sanskrit: हृता मृता वा नष्टा वा भक्षिता वा भविष्यति। निलीनाप्यथवा भीरुरथवा वनमाश्रिता।।3.60.8।।
transliteration: hṛtā mṛtā vā naṣṭā vā bhakṣitā vā bhaviṣyati| nilīnāpyathavā bhīrurathavā vanamāśritā||3.60.8||
meaning: 'Timid Sita might have been abducted or dead or crushed or eaten up by demons. Or, she may be hiding for protection in the forest'

sanskrit: गता विचेतुं पुष्पाणि फलान्यपि च वा पुनः। अथवा पद्मिनीं याता जलार्थं वा नदीं गता।।3.60.9।।
transliteration: gatā vicetuṃ puṣpāṇi phalānyapi ca vā punḥ| athavā padminīṃ yātā jalārthṃ vā nadīṃ gatā||3.60.9||
meaning: 'Maybe she has gone to pluck flowers or fruits. Or to the lotuspond or river to fetch water.'

sanskrit: यत्नान्मृगयमाणस्तु नाससाद वने प्रियाम्। शोकरक्तेक्षणश्शोकादुन्मत्त इव लक्ष्यते।।3.60.10।।
transliteration: yatnānmṛgayamāṇastu nāsasāda vane priyām| śokaraktekṣaṇaśśokādunmatta iva lakṣyate||3.60.10||
meaning: He ransacked the forest, yet did not find his beloved. He appeared like a mad man, his eyes turned red with tears of sorrow.

sanskrit: वृक्षाद्वृक्षं प्रधावन्सगिरेश्चाद्रिं नदान्नदीम्। बभूव विलपन्रामश्शोकार्णवपरिप्लुतः।।3.60.11।।
transliteration: vṛkṣādvṛkṣṃ pradhāvansagireścādriṃ nadānnadīm| babhūva vilapanrāmaśśokārṇavapariplutḥ||3.60.11||
meaning: Running from tree to tree, hill to hill, and river to river and weeping, Rama was immersed in a sea of sorrow.

sanskrit: अपि काचित्त्वया दृष्टा सा कदम्बप्रिया प्रिया। कदम्ब यदि जानीषे शंस सीतां शुभाननाम्।।3.60.12।।
transliteration: api kācittvayā dṛṣṭā sā kadambapriyā priyā| kadamba yadi jānīṣe śṃsa sītāṃ śubhānanām||3.60.12||
meaning: O Kadamba tree, tell me if you have seen my beloved with a fair face and with love for kadamba flowers.

sanskrit: स्निग्धपल्लवसङ्काशा पीतकौशेयवासिनी। शंसस्व यदि वा दृष्टा बिल्व बिल्वोपमस्तनी।।3.60.13।।
transliteration: snigdhapallavasaṅkāśā pītakauśeyavāsinī| śṃsasva yadi vā dṛṣṭā bilva bilvopamastanī||3.60.13||
meaning: O Bilva tree, tell me if you have seen a lady delicate like your tender leaf, dressed in yellow silk, a lady whose breasts are round like Bilva fruits.

sanskrit: अथवाऽर्जुन शंस त्वं प्रियां तामर्जुनप्रियाम्। जनकस्य सुता भीरुर्यदि जीवति वा न वा।।3.60.14।।
transliteration: athavā'rjuna śṃsa tvṃ priyāṃ tāmarjunapriyām| janakasya sutā bhīruryadi jīvati vā na vā||3.60.14||
meaning: O Arjuna tree, tell me if you know a timid lady, daughter of Janaka and my beloved, fond of Arjuna tree. Is the living or not ?

sanskrit: ककुभः ककुभोरूं तां व्यक्तं जानाति मैथिलीम्। यथा पल्लवपुष्पाढ्यो भाति ह्येष वनस्पतिः।।3.60.15।।
transliteration: kakubhḥ kakubhorūṃ tāṃ vyaktṃ jānāti maithilīm| yathā pallavapuṣpāḍhyo bhāti hyeṣa vanaspatiḥ||3.60.15||
meaning: This Kakubha tree rich with tender leaves and flowers (perhaps)knows Maithili whose thighs are beautiful like the trunk of the Kakubha tree.

sanskrit: भ्रमरैरुपगीतश्च यथा द्रुमवरो ह्ययम्। एष व्यक्तं विजानाति तिलकस्तिलकप्रियाम्।।3.60.16।।
transliteration: bhramarairupagītaśca yathā drumavaro hyayam| eṣa vyaktṃ vijānāti tilakastilakapriyām||3.60.16||
meaning: This great Tilaka tree round which bees bumble surely knows the lady who loves to put tilaka marks on the forehead.

sanskrit: अशोक शोकापनुद शोकोपहतचेतसम्। त्वन्नामानं कुरु क्षिप्रं प्रियासन्दर्शनेन माम्।।3.60.17।।
transliteration: aśoka śokāpanuda śokopahatacetasam| tvannāmānṃ kuru kṣiprṃ priyāsandarśanena mām||3.60.17||
meaning: O Ashoka tree, dispeller of sorrow, by quickly showing me my darling make me ashoka (free from sorrow) as I am griefstricken at heart.

sanskrit: यदि ताल त्वया दृष्टा पक्वतालफलस्तनी। कथयस्व वरारोहां कारुण्यं यदि ते मयि।।3.60.18।।
transliteration: yadi tāla tvayā dṛṣṭā pakvatālaphalastanī| kathayasva varārohāṃ kāruṇyṃ yadi te mayi||3.60.18||
meaning: O Palmyra tree be kind to me and tell me if you have seen my beautiful beloved who has breasts like ripe palmyra fruit?

sanskrit: यदि दृष्टा त्वया सीता जम्बु जम्बूफलोपमा। प्रियां यदि विजानीषे निःशङ्कं कथयस्व मे।।3.60.19।।
transliteration: yadi dṛṣṭā tvayā sītā jambu jambūphalopamā| priyāṃ yadi vijānīṣe niḥśaṅkṃ kathayasva me||3.60.19||
meaning: O Jambu tree, do not hesitate to tell me if you know Sita whose body shines lovely like gold.

sanskrit: अहो त्वं कर्णिकाराद्य सुपुष्पैश्शोभसे भृशम्। कर्णिकारप्रिया साध्वी शंस दृष्टा प्रिया यदि।।3.60.20।।
transliteration: aho tvṃ karṇikārādya supuṣpaiśśobhase bhṛśam| karṇikārapriyā sādhvī śṃsa dṛṣṭā priyā yadi||3.60.20||
meaning: O Karnikara tree with flowers in full bloom, tell me if you have seen my faithful beloved who is fond of karnikara flowers.

sanskrit: चूतनीपमहासालान्पनसान्कुरवान्धवान्। दाडिमाननसान्गत्वा दृष्ट्वा रामो महायशाः।।3.60.21।। मल्लिका माधवीश्चैव चम्पकान्केतकीस्
transliteration: cūtanīpamahāsālānpanasānkuravāndhavān| dāḍimānanasāngatvā dṛṣṭvā rāmo mahāyaśāḥ||3.60.21|| mallikā mādhavīścaiva campakā
meaning: Renowned Rama, like a madman confused, approached the Mango, Kadamba , Sal and Jackfruit, Dhava, Champak, Ketaki trees and Pomegranate, Jasmine and Madhavi creepers, in order to make similar queries.

sanskrit: अथवा मृगशाबाक्षीं मृग जानासि मैथिलीम्। मृगविप्रेक्षणी कान्ता मृगीभिस्सहिता भवेत्।।3.60.23।।
transliteration: athavā mṛgaśābākṣīṃ mṛga jānāsi maithilīm| mṛgaviprekṣaṇī kāntā mṛgībhissahitā bhavet||3.60.23||
meaning: Or, O deer do you know about Maithili who has the eyes of a fawn? My beloved who has the restless eyes of a doe may be found in their company.

sanskrit: गज सा गजनासोरूर्यदि दृष्टा त्वया भवेत्। तां मन्ये विदितां तुभ्यमाख्याहि वरवारण।3.60.24।।
transliteration: gaja sā gajanāsorūryadi dṛṣṭā tvayā bhavet| tāṃ manye viditāṃ tubhyamākhyāhi varavāraṇa|3.60.24||
meaning: O elephant tell me if you have seen her whose thighs are like the trunk of an elephant. O best of elephants, tell me if you know her.

sanskrit: शार्दूल यदि सा दृष्टा प्रिया चन्द्रनिभानना। मैथिली मम विस्रब्धं कथयस्व न ते भयम्।।3.60.25।।
transliteration: śārdūla yadi sā dṛṣṭā priyā candranibhānanā| maithilī mama visrabdhṃ kathayasva na te bhayam||3.60.25||
meaning: O tiger tell me freely and fearlessly if you have seen my beloved princess from Mithila with a face like the moon.

sanskrit: किं धावसि प्रिये दूरे दृष्टासि कमलेक्षणे। वृक्षैराच्छाद्य चात्मानं किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे।।3.60.26।।
transliteration: kiṃ dhāvasi priye dūre dṛṣṭāsi kamalekṣaṇe| vṛkṣairācchādya cātmānṃ kiṃ māṃ na pratibhāṣase||3.60.26||
meaning: O lotus eyed darling, why are you running away? I have already seen you. Why are you hiding behind trees and not replying to me?

sanskrit: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ वरारोहे न तेऽस्ति करुणा मयि। नात्यर्थं हास्यशीलासि किमर्थं मामुपेक्षसे।।3.60.27।।
transliteration: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha varārohe na te'sti karuṇā mayi| nātyarthṃ hāsyaśīlāsi kimarthṃ māmupekṣase||3.60.27||
meaning: O my beautiful beloved, stay, stay Have you no compassion for me ? You are so fond of fun. Why do you avoid me?

sanskrit: पीतकौशेयकेनासि सूचिता वरवर्णिनि। धावन्त्यपि मया दृष्टा तिष्ठ यद्यस्ति सौहृदम्।।3.60.28।।
transliteration: pītakauśeyakenāsi sūcitā varavarṇini| dhāvantyapi mayā dṛṣṭā tiṣṭha yadyasti sauhṛdam||3.60.28||
meaning: O lady of lovely complexion, I can see your yellow silk (flying), while you are running away. If you have love for me, stay on.

sanskrit: नैव सा नूनमथवा हिंसिता चारुहासिनी। कृच्छ्रप्राप्तं न मां नूनं यथोपेक्षितुमर्हति।।3.60.29।।
transliteration: naiva sā nūnamathavā hiṃsitā cāruhāsinī| kṛcchraprāptṃ na māṃ nūnṃ yathopekṣitumarhati||3.60.29||
meaning: O lady with a sweet smile I have never hurt you. When I am in difficulty it does not behove you to ignore me.

sanskrit: व्यक्तं सा भक्षिता बाला राक्षसैः पिशिताशनैः। विभज्याङ्कानि सर्वाणि मया विरहिता प्रिया।।3.60.30।।
transliteration: vyaktṃ sā bhakṣitā bālā rākṣasaiḥ piśitāśanaiḥ| vibhajyāṅkāni sarvāṇi mayā virahitā priyā||3.60.30||
meaning: It is clear that separated from me, the body of my young beloved is torn off and eaten away by carnivorous demons.

sanskrit: नूनं तच्छुभदन्तोष्ठं सुनासं चारुकुण्डलम्। पूर्णचन्द्रनिभं ग्रस्तं मुखंनिष्प्रभतां गतम्।।3.60.31।।
transliteration: nūnṃ tacchubhadantoṣṭhṃ sunāsṃ cārukuṇḍalam| pūrṇacandranibhṃ grastṃ mukhṃniṣprabhatāṃ gatam||3.60.31||
meaning: Her beautiful face with her sparkling teeth and lips, wellshaped nose, shining earrings has been like the full moon, eclipsed and rendered pale.

sanskrit: सा हि चम्पकवर्णाभा ग्रीवा ग्रैवेयशोभिता। कोमला विलपन्त्यास्तु कान्ताया भक्षिता शुभा।।3.60.32।।
transliteration: sā hi campakavarṇābhā grīvā graiveyaśobhitā| komalā vilapantyāstu kāntāyā bhakṣitā śubhā||3.60.32||
meaning: That delicate, beautiful neck of my beloved having the complexion of a champak flower and adorned with necklaces was perhaps eaten up.

sanskrit: नूनं विक्षिप्यमाणौ तौ बाहू पल्लवकोमलौ। भक्षितौ वेपमानाग्रौ सहस्ताभरणाङ्गदौ।।3.60.33।।
transliteration: nūnṃ vikṣipyamāṇau tau bāhū pallavakomalau| bhakṣitau vepamānāgrau sahastābharaṇāṅgadau||3.60.33||
meaning: Her arms, delicate like tender leaves, their tips (fingers) quivering, adorned with armlets and bracelets have surely been eaten away.

sanskrit: मया विरहिता बाला रक्षसां भक्षणाय वै। सार्धेनेव परित्यक्ता भक्षिता बहुबान्धवा।।3.60.34।।
transliteration: mayā virahitā bālā rakṣasāṃ bhakṣaṇāya vai| sārdheneva parityaktā bhakṣitā bahubāndhavā||3.60.34||
meaning: The young lady having many relations, forsaken by me, has been (perhaps) picked up by a demon for food and later abandoned halfeaten.

sanskrit: हा लक्ष्मण महाबाहो पश्यसि त्वं प्रियां क्वचित्। हा प्रिये क्व गता भद्रे हा सीतेति पुनः पुनः।।3.60.35।।
transliteration: hā lakṣmaṇa mahābāho paśyasi tvṃ priyāṃ kvacit| hā priye kva gatā bhadre hā sīteti punḥ punḥ||3.60.35||
meaning: O longarmed Lakshmana, are you able to see my beloved anywhere? O noble lady, O darling, where have you gone? O Sita SIta

sanskrit: इत्येवं विलपन्रामः परिधावन्वनाद्वनम्। क्वचिदुद्भ्रमते वेगात्क्वचिद्विभ्रमते बलात्।।3.60.36।। क्वचिन्मत्त इवाभाति कान्तान
transliteration: ityevṃ vilapanrāmḥ paridhāvanvanādvanam| kvacidudbhramate vegātkvacidvibhramate balāt||3.60.36|| kvacinmatta ivābhāti kā
meaning: Rama ran from forest to forest, now jumping, now taking strong strides, but all the time weeping, a madman busy in search of his beloved.

sanskrit: स वनानि नदीश्शैलान् गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च।।3.60.37।। काननानि च वेगेन भ्रमत्यपरिसंस्थितः।
transliteration: sa vanāni nadīśśailān giriprasravaṇāni ca||3.60.37|| kānanāni ca vegena bhramatyaparisṃsthitḥ|
meaning: He rushed through forests, rivers, hills and mountain streams and through dense jungles with an unstable mind.

sanskrit: तथा स गत्वा विपुलम् महद्वनं परीत्य सर्वं त्वथ मैथिलीं प्रति। अनिष्ठिताशस्सचकार मार्गणे पुनः प्रियायाः परमं परिश्रमम्।।3.
transliteration: tathā sa gatvā vipulam mahadvanṃ parītya sarvṃ tvatha maithilīṃ prati| aniṣṭhitāśassacakāra mārgaṇe punḥ priyāyāḥ paramṃ
meaning: Rama went about the vast forest searching for the princess from Mithila all over not giving up hope of finding her. He continued to make great efforts for searching his beloved. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्

sanskrit: क्व नु लक्ष्मण वैदेही कं वा देशमितो गता। केनाहृता वा सौमित्रे भक्षिता केन वा प्रिया।।3.61.3।।
transliteration: kva nu lakṣmaṇa vaidehī kṃ vā deśamito gatā| kenāhṛtā vā saumitre bhakṣitā kena vā priyā||3.61.3||
meaning: O son of Sumitra, where is my beloved ? Where did she go? By whom was she abducted? Or, devoured? O Lakshmana

sanskrit: वृक्षेणाच्छाद्य यदि मां सीते हसितुमिच्छसि। अलं ते हसितेनाद्य मां भजस्व सुदुःखितम्।।3.61.4।।
transliteration: vṛkṣeṇācchādya yadi māṃ sīte hasitumicchasi| alṃ te hasitenādya māṃ bhajasva suduḥkhitam||3.61.4||
meaning: O Sita if you intend to make fun by hiding behind a tree, I tell you it is enough. Stop it and come to this extremely sorrowful man.

sanskrit: यैस्सह क्रीडसे सीते विश्वस्तैर्मृगपोतकैः। एते हीनास्त्वया सौम्ये ध्यायन्त्यस्राविलेक्षणाः।।3.61.5।।
transliteration: yaissaha krīḍase sīte viśvastairmṛgapotakaiḥ| ete hīnāstvayā saumye dhyāyantyasrāvilekṣaṇāḥ||3.61.5||
meaning: O gentle Sita those fawns who trusted you and played with you, are now separated from you. Brooding over you, their eyes are brimming with tears.

sanskrit: सीतया रहितोऽहं वै न हि जीवामि लक्ष्मण। मृतं शोकेन महता सीताहरणजेन माम्।।3.61.6।। परलोके महाराजो नूनं द्रक्ष्यति मे पिता।
transliteration: sītayā rahito'hṃ vai na hi jīvāmi lakṣmaṇa| mṛtṃ śokena mahatā sītāharaṇajena mām||3.61.6|| paraloke mahārājo nūnṃ drakṣ
meaning: O Lakshmana, I cannot live without Sita. I am filled with deep grief on account of Sita's abduction. My late father, the king will certainly see me in the other world (I will definitely commit suicide).

sanskrit: कथं प्रतिज्ञां संश्रुत्य मया त्वमभियोजितः।।3.61.7।। अपूरयित्वा तं कालं मत्सकाशमिहागतः। कामवृत्तमनार्यं मां मृषावादिनमेव
transliteration: kathṃ pratijñāṃ sṃśrutya mayā tvamabhiyojitḥ||3.61.7|| apūrayitvā tṃ kālṃ matsakāśamihāgatḥ| kāmavṛttamanāryṃ māṃ mṛṣāvā
meaning: My father say will surely in the other world: Without completing the appointed period of the vow taken, how could you come here ? Fie upon you You are irresponsible. You are ignoble. You are a liar.

sanskrit: विवशं शोकसन्तप्तं दीनं भग्नमनोरथम्।।3.61.9।। मामिहोत्सृज्य करुणं कीर्तिर्नरमिवानृजुम्। क्व गच्छसि वरारोहे मां नोत्सृज सु
transliteration: vivaśṃ śokasantaptṃ dīnṃ bhagnamanoratham||3.61.9|| māmihotsṛjya karuṇṃ kīrtirnaramivānṛjum| kva gacchasi varārohe māṃ n
meaning: O lovely lady where have you gone, leaving me here like fame deserting a crook? I am helpless griefstricken, pitiable, pathetic and disappointed. O lady of slender waist, leave me not. Separated from you, I will give up

sanskrit: इतीव विलपन्रामस्सीतादर्शनलालसः।।3.61.11।। न ददर्श सुदुःखार्तो राघवो जनकात्मजाम्।
transliteration: itīva vilapanrāmassītādarśanalālasḥ||3.61.11|| na dadarśa suduḥkhārto rāghavo janakātmajām|
meaning: Deeply distressed, Rama who was anxious to see Sita, daughter of Janaka, wailed and wailed but could not see her.

sanskrit: अनासादयमानं तं सीतां दशरथात्मजम्।।3.61.12।। पङ्कमासाद्य विपुलं सीदन्तमिव कुञ्जरम्। लक्ष्मणो राममत्यर्थमुवाच हितकाम्यया।।
transliteration: anāsādayamānṃ tṃ sītāṃ daśarathātmajam||3.61.12|| paṅkamāsādya vipulṃ sīdantamiva kuñjaram| lakṣmaṇo rāmamatyarthamuvāca
meaning: Lakshmana, dedicated to his wellbeing, spoke to Rama, son of Dasaratha, who was sinking like an elephant into the quagmire, when he failed to trace Sita.

sanskrit: मा विषादं महाबाहो कुरु यत्नं मया सह। इदं च हि वनं शूर बहुकन्दरशोभितम्।।3.61.14।।
transliteration: mā viṣādṃ mahābāho kuru yatnṃ mayā saha| idṃ ca hi vanṃ śūra bahukandaraśobhitam||3.61.14||
meaning: O longarmed, heroic Rama, do not grieve. This forest is full of caves. Let us try together.

sanskrit: प्रियकाननसञ्चारा वनोन्मत्ता च मैथिली। सा वनं वा प्रविष्टा स्यान्नलिनीं वा सुपुष्पिताम्।।3.61.15।।
transliteration: priyakānanasañcārā vanonmattā ca maithilī| sā vanṃ vā praviṣṭā syānnalinīṃ vā supuṣpitām||3.61.15||
meaning: Sita is madly in love with the forest. She might have entered deep into the jungle or into a fully blossomed lotuspond.

sanskrit: सरितं वापि सम्प्राप्ता मीनवञ्जुलसेविताम्। स्नातुकामा निलीना स्याद्धासकामा वने क्वचित्।।3.61.16।।
transliteration: saritṃ vāpi samprāptā mīnavañjulasevitām| snātukāmā nilīnā syāddhāsakāmā vane kvacit||3.61.16||
meaning: Maybe she has gone to take a dip in the river full of reeds and fishes Or has hidden somewhere for the sake of fun.

sanskrit: वित्रासयितुकामा वा लीना स्यात्कानने क्वचित्। जिज्ञासमाना वैदेही त्वां मां च पुरुषर्षभ।।3.61.17।। तस्याह्यन्वेषणे श्रीमन्
transliteration: vitrāsayitukāmā vā līnā syātkānane kvacit| jijñāsamānā vaidehī tvāṃ māṃ ca puruṣarṣabha||3.61.17|| tasyāhyanveṣaṇe śrīma
meaning: O best of men, maybe Vaidehi has hidden in the forest intending to scare you and me. She wishes to test our love. O blessed Rama let us ransack the forest immediately.

sanskrit: वनं सर्वं विचिनुवो यत्र सा जनकात्मजा।।3.61.18।। मन्यसे यदि काकुत्स्थ मा स्म शोके मनः कृथाः।
transliteration: vanṃ sarvṃ vicinuvo yatra sā janakātmajā||3.61.18|| manyase yadi kākutstha mā sma śoke manḥ kṛthāḥ|
meaning: O scion of the Kakutsthas, let us search all over the forest if you please. Do not indulge in sorrow.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु सौहार्दाल्लक्ष्मणेन समाहितः।।3.61.19।। सह सौमित्रिणा रामो विचेतुमुपचक्रमे।
transliteration: evamuktastu sauhārdāllakṣmaṇena samāhitḥ||3.61.19|| saha saumitriṇā rāmo vicetumupacakrame|
meaning: When Lakshmana consoled him so affectionately Rama became composed. He continued the search with Lakshmana, son of Sumitra.

sanskrit: तौ वनानि गिरींश्चैव सरितश्च सरांसि च।।3.61.20।। निखिलेन विचिन्वानौ सीतां दशरथात्मजौ।
transliteration: tau vanāni girīṃścaiva saritaśca sarāṃsi ca||3.61.20|| nikhilena vicinvānau sītāṃ daśarathātmajau|
meaning: The two sons of Dasaratha went on searching for Sita in forests, mountains, rivers, ponds everywhere.

sanskrit: तस्य शैलस्य सानूनि गुहाश्च शिखराणि च।।3.61.21।। निखिलेन विचिन्वानौ नैव तामभिजग्मतुः।
transliteration: tasya śailasya sānūni guhāśca śikharāṇi ca||3.61.21|| nikhilena vicinvānau naiva tāmabhijagmatuḥ|
meaning: They were not able to find Sita even though they searched all over the mountain slopes, caves and peaks.

sanskrit: विचित्य सर्वतश्शैलं रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवित्।।3.61.22।। नेह पश्यामि सौमित्रे वैदेहीं पर्वते शुभाम्।
transliteration: vicitya sarvataśśailṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravit||3.61.22|| neha paśyāmi saumitre vaidehīṃ parvate śubhām|
meaning: After searching her all over, Rama said Saumitri, I am unable to find the noble Vaidehi on the mountain

sanskrit: ततो दुःखाभिसन्तप्तो लक्ष्मणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।3.61.23।। विचरन्दण्डकारण्यं भ्रातरं दीप्ततेजसम्।
transliteration: tato duḥkhābhisantapto lakṣmaṇo vākyamabravīt||3.61.23|| vicarandaṇḍakāraṇyṃ bhrātarṃ dīptatejasam|
meaning: Going about the Dandaka forest Lakshmana, consumed by sorrow, said to his brother, glowing with brilliance:

sanskrit: प्राप्स्यसि त्वं महाप्राज्ञ मैथिलीं जनकात्मजाम्।।3.61.24।। यथा विष्णुर्महाबाहुर्बलिं बद्ध्वा महीमिमाम्।
transliteration: prāpsyasi tvṃ mahāprājña maithilīṃ janakātmajām||3.61.24|| yathā viṣṇurmahābāhurbaliṃ baddhvā mahīmimām|
meaning: O longarmed brother O wise sire just as Visnu obtained the earth by binding Bali you will obtain Sita certainly.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु सौहार्दाल्लक्ष्मणेन स राघवः।।3.61.25।। उवाच दीनया वाचा दुःखाभिहतचेतनः।
transliteration: evamuktastu sauhārdāllakṣmaṇena sa rāghavḥ||3.61.25|| uvāca dīnayā vācā duḥkhābhihatacetanḥ|
meaning: Having been addressed thus by Lakshmana, Raghava with a griefstriken heart said these piteous words :' Lakshmana,having spoken like that very affectionately to Rama,who was disturbed by excessive grief said these words p

sanskrit: वनं सर्वं सुविचितं पद्मिन्यः फुल्लपङ्कजाः।।3.61.26।। गिरिश्चायं महाप्राज्ञ बहुकन्दरनिर्झरः। न हि पश्यामि वैदेहीं प्राणेभ
transliteration: vanṃ sarvṃ suvicitṃ padminyḥ phullapaṅkajāḥ||3.61.26|| giriścāyṃ mahāprājña bahukandaranirjharḥ| na hi paśyāmi vaidehīṃ
meaning: O wise Lakshmana I have searched the entire forest, the ponds with fully blossomed lotuses, the mountains with many caves and streams. But could not see Vaidehi who is dearer to me than my life.

sanskrit: एवं स विलपन्रामस्सीताहरणकर्शितः। दीनश्शोकसमाविष्टो मुहूर्तं विह्वलोऽभवत्।।3.61.28।।
transliteration: evṃ sa vilapanrāmassītāharaṇakarśitḥ| dīnaśśokasamāviṣṭo muhūrtṃ vihvalo'bhavat||3.61.28||
meaning: Thus tormented by the abduction of Sita, Rama felt dejected and cried.Overpowered by grief he lost his consciousness for a moment.

sanskrit: सन्तप्तो ह्यवसन्नाङ्गो गतबुद्धिर्विचेतनः। निषसादातुरो दीनो निश्श्वस्याशीतमायतम्।।3.61.29।।
transliteration: santapto hyavasannāṅgo gatabuddhirvicetanḥ| niṣasādāturo dīno niśśvasyāśītamāyatam||3.61.29||
meaning: By grief tormented, limbs enervated, intellect atrophied, senses switched off, he felt anxious and depressed and sighed long and hot.

sanskrit: बहुलं स तु निश्श्वस्य रामो राजीवलोचनः। हा प्रियेति विचुक्रोश बहुशो बाष्पगद्गदः।।3.61.30।।
transliteration: bahulṃ sa tu niśśvasya rāmo rājīvalocanḥ| hā priyeti vicukrośa bahuśo bāṣpagadgadḥ||3.61.30||
meaning: Rama, his throat choked, shed propuse tears, sighing, O my darling.

sanskrit: तं ततस्सान्त्वयामास लक्ष्मणः प्रियबान्धवः। बहुप्रकारं धर्मज्ञः प्रश्रितं प्रश्रिताञ्जलिः।।3.61.31।।
transliteration: tṃ tatassāntvayāmāsa lakṣmaṇḥ priyabāndhavḥ| bahuprakārṃ dharmajñḥ praśritṃ praśritāñjaliḥ||3.61.31||
meaning: Then Lakshmana, the knower of dharma and a dear friend offered obeisance most humbly with folded palms and consoled Rama in many ways.

sanskrit: अनादृत्य तु तद्वाक्यं लक्ष्मणोष्ठपुटाच्च्युतम्। अपश्यंस्तां प्रियां सीतां प्राक्रोशत्स पुनः पुनः।।3.61.32।।
transliteration: anādṛtya tu tadvākyṃ lakṣmaṇoṣṭhapuṭāccyutam| apaśyṃstāṃ priyāṃ sītāṃ prākrośatsa punḥ punḥ||3.61.32||
meaning: Without caring for the words from the lips of Lakshmana, Rama sobbed loudly, unable to see his beloved Sita. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfirst sarga of A

sanskrit: पश्यन्निव च तां सीतामपश्यन्मदनार्दितः। उवाच राघवो वाक्यं विलापाश्रयदुर्वचम्।।3.62.2।।
transliteration: paśyanniva ca tāṃ sītāmapaśyanmadanārditḥ| uvāca rāghavo vākyṃ vilāpāśrayadurvacam||3.62.2||
meaning: Under the spell of Cupid, Rama uttered such words in grief which are otherwise unutterable. As if he was seeing Sita (before him) which was not a fact.

sanskrit: त्वमशोकस्य शाखाभिः पुष्पप्रियतया प्रिये। आवृणोषि शरीरं ते मम शोकविवर्धिनी।।3.62.3।।
transliteration: tvamaśokasya śākhābhiḥ puṣpapriyatayā priye| āvṛṇoṣi śarīrṃ te mama śokavivardhinī||3.62.3||
meaning: O my beloved as you love flowers you are hiding your body behind the branches of the Ashoke tree that enhances my sorrow (paradoxically).

sanskrit: कदलीस्कन्धसदृशौ कदल्या संवृतावुभौ। ऊरू पश्यामि ते देवि नासि शक्ता निगूहितुम्।।3.62.4।।
transliteration: kadalīskandhasadṛśau kadalyā sṃvṛtāvubhau| ūrū paśyāmi te devi nāsi śaktā nigūhitum||3.62.4||
meaning: O Devi I can see both your thighs which resemble banana trunk hidden behind a banana plant. It is not possible for you to hide them from me.

sanskrit: कर्णिकारवनं भद्रे हसन्ती देवि सेवसे। अलं ते परिहासेन मम बाधावहेन वै।।3.62.5।।
transliteration: karṇikāravanṃ bhadre hasantī devi sevase| alṃ te parihāsena mama bādhāvahena vai||3.62.5||
meaning: O gentle one you are wandering in the karnikara garden, laughing and making fun. Enough of this , that causes my pain.

sanskrit: परिहासेन किं सीते परिश्रान्तस्य मे प्रिये। अयं स परिहासोऽपि साधु देवि न रोचते।।3.62.6।।
transliteration: parihāsena kiṃ sīte pariśrāntasya me priye| ayṃ sa parihāso'pi sādhu devi na rocate||3.62.6||
meaning: O my dear Sita, why are you joking when I am exhausted? Such fun cannot be relished now.

sanskrit: विशेषेणाश्रमस्थाने हासोऽयं न प्रशस्यते। अवगच्छामि ते शीलं परिहासप्रियं प्रिये।।3.62.7।। आगच्छ त्वं विशालाक्षि शून्योऽयमु
transliteration: viśeṣeṇāśramasthāne hāso'yṃ na praśasyate| avagacchāmi te śīlṃ parihāsapriyṃ priye||3.62.7|| āgaccha tvṃ viśālākṣi śūnyo
meaning: O darling joking specially in a hermitage is not appreciated. I know your nature.You love fun. O largeeyed Sita, come here. This cottage of yours is empty.

sanskrit: सुव्यक्तं राक्षसैस्सीता भक्षिता वा हृतापि वा।।3.62.8।। न हि सा विलपन्तं मामुपसम्प्रैति लक्ष्मण।
transliteration: suvyaktṃ rākṣasaissītā bhakṣitā vā hṛtāpi vā||3.62.8|| na hi sā vilapantṃ māmupasampraiti lakṣmaṇa|
meaning: O Lakshmana surely Sita is either devoured by demons or abducted. When I am weeping like this she is not coming to me.

sanskrit: एतानि मृगयूथानि साश्रुनेत्राणि लक्ष्मण।।3.62.9।। शंसन्तीव हि वैदेहीं भक्षितां रजनीचरैः।
transliteration: etāni mṛgayūthāni sāśrunetrāṇi lakṣmaṇa||3.62.9|| śṃsantīva hi vaidehīṃ bhakṣitāṃ rajanīcaraiḥ|
meaning: O Lakshmana, these herds of deer with their eyes filled with tears are as if telling me that she is eaten away by the demons.

sanskrit: हा ममार्ये क्व यातासि हा साध्वि वरवर्णिनि।।3.62.10।। हा सकामा त्वया देवी कैकेयी सा भविष्यति।
transliteration: hā mamārye kva yātāsi hā sādhvi varavarṇini||3.62.10|| hā sakāmā tvayā devī kaikeyī sā bhaviṣyati|
meaning: Alas, my noble lady, where have you gone? O chaste lady of excellent complexion, that queen Kaikeyi's desire will be fulfilled now.

sanskrit: सीतया सह निर्यातो विना सीतामुपागतः।।3.62.11।। कथं नाम प्रवेक्ष्यामि शून्यमन्तःपुरं पुनः।
transliteration: sītayā saha niryāto vinā sītāmupāgatḥ||3.62.11|| kathṃ nāma pravekṣyāmi śūnyamantḥpurṃ punḥ|
meaning: I left home with Sita. How can I reenter the inner apartment without her ?

sanskrit: निर्वीर्य इति लोको मां निर्दयश्चेति वक्ष्यति।।3.62.12।। कातरत्वं प्रकाशं हि सीतापनयनेन मे।
transliteration: nirvīrya iti loko māṃ nirdayaśceti vakṣyati||3.62.12|| kātaratvṃ prakāśṃ hi sītāpanayanena me|
meaning: By Sita's abduction it will be clear to the world that I lack manliness and compassion. My cowardly nature will clearly manifest.

sanskrit: निवृत्तवनवासश्च जनकं मिथिलाधिपम्।।3.62.13।। कुशलं परिपृच्छन्तं कथं शक्ष्ये निरीक्षितुम्।
transliteration: nivṛttavanavāsaśca janakṃ mithilādhipam||3.62.13|| kuśalṃ paripṛcchantṃ kathṃ śakṣye nirīkṣitum|
meaning: After completing the period of my exile when Janaka , king of Mithila, enquires of her welfare how can I face him?

sanskrit: विदेहराजो नूनं मां दृष्ट्वा विरहितं तया।।3.62.14।। सुतास्नेहेन सन्तप्तो मोहस्य वशमेष्यति।
transliteration: videharājo nūnṃ māṃ dṛṣṭvā virahitṃ tayā||3.62.14|| sutāsnehena santapto mohasya vaśameṣyati|
meaning: If the king of Videha sees me without her, he will surely be distressed and will fall into a swoon for the love of his daughter.

sanskrit: अथवा न गमिष्यामि पुरीं भरतपालिताम्।।3.62.15।। स्वर्गोऽपि सीतया हीनश्शून्य एव मतो मम।
transliteration: athavā na gamiṣyāmi purīṃ bharatapālitām||3.62.15|| svargo'pi sītayā hīnaśśūnya eva mato mama|
meaning: Or else, I will not go to the city ruled by Bharata. Without Sita even heaven will be empty for me.

sanskrit: मामिहोत्सृज्य हि वने गच्छायोध्यां पुरीं शुभाम्।।3.62.16।। न त्वहं तां विना सीतां जीवेयं हि कथञ्चन।
transliteration: māmihotsṛjya hi vane gacchāyodhyāṃ purīṃ śubhām||3.62.16|| na tvahṃ tāṃ vinā sītāṃ jīveyṃ hi kathañcana|
meaning: Go to the auspicious city of Ayodhya, leaving me here in the woods. I can never live without Sita.

sanskrit: गाढमाश्लिष्य भरतो वाच्यो मद्वचनात्त्वया।।3.62.17।। अनुज्ञातोऽसि रामेण पालयेति वसुन्धराम्।
transliteration: gāḍhamāśliṣya bharato vācyo madvacanāttvayā||3.62.17|| anujñāto'si rāmeṇa pālayeti vasundharām|
meaning: While embracing Bharata tightly, repeat my words, 'You are permitted by Rama to rule the earth.'

sanskrit: अम्बा च मम कैकेयी सुमित्रा च त्वया विभो।।3.62.18।। कौसल्या च यथान्यायमभिवाद्या ममाऽज्ञया। रक्षणीया प्रयत्नेन भवता सूक्तक
transliteration: ambā ca mama kaikeyī sumitrā ca tvayā vibho||3.62.18|| kausalyā ca yathānyāyamabhivādyā mamā'jñayā| rakṣaṇīyā prayatnena
meaning: My mother Kaikeyi, Sumitra and Kausalya should also be offered due obeisance. You should protect them with great effort, carrying out my instructions.

sanskrit: सीतायाश्च विनाशोऽयं मम चामित्रकर्शन। विस्तरेण जनन्या मे विनिवेद्यस्त्वया भवेत्।।3.62.20।।
transliteration: sītāyāśca vināśo'yṃ mama cāmitrakarśana| vistareṇa jananyā me vinivedyastvayā bhavet||3.62.20||
meaning: O Lakshmana, subduer of the enemy this loss of Sita and me should be explained in detail to my mother.

sanskrit: इति विलपति राघवे सुदीने वनमुपगम्य तया विना सुकेश्या। भयविकलमुखस्तु लक्ष्मणोऽपि व्यथितमना भृशमातुरो बभूव।।3.62.21।।
transliteration: iti vilapati rāghave sudīne vanamupagamya tayā vinā sukeśyā| bhayavikalamukhastu lakṣmaṇo'pi vyathitamanā bhṛśamāturo ba
meaning: When Rama, devoid of Sita, the lady with beautiful hair, wailed piteously after reaching the forest, Lakshmana too, his face pale out of fear and mind dejected, felt extremely agitated. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय

sanskrit: स लक्ष्मणं शोकवशाभिपन्नं शोके निमग्नो विपुले तु रामः। उवाच वाक्यं व्यसनानुरूपमुष्णं विनिश्श्वस्य रुदंत्सशोकम्।।3.63.2।।
transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇṃ śokavaśābhipannṃ śoke nimagno vipule tu rāmḥ| uvāca vākyṃ vyasanānurūpamuṣṇṃ viniśśvasya rudṃtsaśokam||3.63.
meaning: Plunged in deep grief, Rama heaved hot sighs and said these words to griefstricken Lakshmanaweeping:

sanskrit: न मद्विधो दुष्कृतकर्मकारी मन्ये द्वितीयोऽस्ति वसुन्धरायाम्। शोकेन शोको हि परम्पराया मा मेति भिन्दन्हृदयं मनश्च।।3.63.3।।
transliteration: na madvidho duṣkṛtakarmakārī manye dvitīyo'sti vasundharāyām| śokena śoko hi paramparāyā mā meti bhindanhṛdayṃ manaśca||
meaning: I think there is none on earth like me who has performed such forbidden acts. One grief after the other is successively piercing my heart and my mind.

sanskrit: पूर्वं मया नूनमभीप्सितानि पापानि कर्माण्यसकृत्कृतानि। तत्रायमद्यापतितो विपाको दुःखेन दुःखं यदहं विशामि।।3.63.4।।
transliteration: pūrvṃ mayā nūnamabhīpsitāni pāpāni karmāṇyasakṛtkṛtāni| tatrāyamadyāpatito vipāko duḥkhena duḥkhṃ yadahṃ viśāmi||3.63.4|
meaning: In the past I had certainly done some sinful deeds I often liked the consequences of which have descended on me now as I am experiencing one sorrow after another.

sanskrit: राज्यप्रणाशस्स्वजनैर्वियोगः पितुर्विनाशो जननीवियोगः। सर्वाणि मे लक्ष्मण शोकवेगमापूरयन्ति प्रविचिन्तितानि।।3.63.5।।
transliteration: rājyapraṇāśassvajanairviyogḥ piturvināśo jananīviyogḥ| sarvāṇi me lakṣmaṇa śokavegamāpūrayanti pravicintitāni||3.63.5||
meaning: O Lakshmana, loss of kingdom, separation from kith and kin, death of father, separation from mother--all these thoughts augment my sorrow faster and in greater measure.

sanskrit: सर्वं तु दुःखं मम लक्ष्मणेदं शान्तं शरीरे वनमेत्य शून्यम्। सीतावियोगात्पुनरप्युदीर्णं काष्ठैरिवाग्निस्सहसा प्रदीप्तः।।3.
transliteration: sarvṃ tu duḥkhṃ mama lakṣmaṇedṃ śāntṃ śarīre vanametya śūnyam| sītāviyogātpunarapyudīrṇṃ kāṣṭhairivāgnissahasā pradīptḥ|
meaning: O Lakshmana, all this sorrow calmed down when I came to this solitary forest. But with Sita's separation, it was rekindled just as fire blazes forth again with logs of wood.

sanskrit: सा नूनमार्या मम राक्षसेन बलाद्दृता खं समुपेत्य भीरुः। अपस्वरं सस्वरविप्रलापा भयेन विक्रन्दितवत्यभीक्ष्णम्।।3.63.7।।
transliteration: sā nūnamāryā mama rākṣasena balāddṛtā khṃ samupetya bhīruḥ| apasvarṃ sasvaravipralāpā bhayena vikranditavatyabhīkṣṇam||3
meaning: The timid princess of mine forcibly carried away into the sky by a demon must have again and again cried aloud out of fear in a broken voice.

sanskrit: तौ लोहितस्य प्रियदर्शनस्य सदोचितावुत्तमचन्दनस्य। वृत्तौ स्तनौ शोणितपङ्कदिग्धौ नूनं प्रियाया मम नाभिभातः।।3.63.8।।
transliteration: tau lohitasya priyadarśanasya sadocitāvuttamacandanasya| vṛttau stanau śoṇitapaṅkadigdhau nūnṃ priyāyā mama nābhibhātḥ||
meaning: Her captivating copper coloured skin, smeared with the best of red sandal paste would not be surely pleasing now, drenched in blood and mud.

sanskrit: तच्छलक्ष्णसुव्यक्तमृदुप्रलापं तस्या मुखं कुञ्चितकेशभारम्। रक्षोवशं नूनमुपागताया न भ्राजते राहुमुखे यथेन्दुः।।3.63.9।।
transliteration: tacchalakṣṇasuvyaktamṛdupralāpṃ tasyā mukhṃ kuñcitakeśabhāram| rakṣovaśṃ nūnamupāgatāyā na bhrājate rāhumukhe yathenduḥ|
meaning: Her face with her clear, sweet and gentle words and her curly hair falling will no more look bright coming under the grip of demons like the moon eclipsed by Rahu.

sanskrit: तां हारपाशस्य सदोचिताया ग्रीवां प्रियाया मम सुव्रतायाः। रक्षांसि नूनं परिपीतवन्ति विभिद्य शून्ये रुधिराशनानि।।3.63.10।।
transliteration: tāṃ hārapāśasya sadocitāyā grīvāṃ priyāyā mama suvratāyāḥ| rakṣāṃsi nūnṃ paripītavanti vibhidya śūnye rudhirāśanāni||3.6
meaning: The bloodthirsty demons must have drunk the blood of my faithful beloved in a lonely place breaking her neck that used to wear beautiful necklaces.

sanskrit: मया विहीना विजने वने या रक्षोभिराहृत्य विकृष्यमाणा। नूनं निनादं कुररीव दीना सा मुक्तवत्यायतकान्तनेत्रा।।3.63.11।।
transliteration: mayā vihīnā vijane vane yā rakṣobhirāhṛtya vikṛṣyamāṇā| nūnṃ ninādṃ kurarīva dīnā sā muktavatyāyatakāntanetrā||3.63.11||
meaning: The lovely, largeeyed lady separated from me in the desolate forest, abducted and dragged by demons must have cried at that time desperately like a female osprey.

sanskrit: अस्मिन्मयासार्धमुदारशीला शिलातले पूर्वमुपोपविष्टा। कान्तस्मिता लक्ष्मण जातहासा त्वामाह सीता बहुवाक्यजातम्।।3.63.12।।
transliteration: asminmayāsārdhamudāraśīlā śilātale pūrvamupopaviṣṭā| kāntasmitā lakṣmaṇa jātahāsā tvāmāha sītā bahuvākyajātam||3.63.12||
meaning: On this rock, O Lakshmana, my goodnatured lady with her lovely smile sat with me in the past and chatted with you.

sanskrit: गोदावरीयं सरितां वरिष्ठा प्रिया प्रियाया मम नित्यकालम्। अप्यत्र गच्छेदिति चिन्तयामि नैकाकिनी याति हि सा कदाचित्।।3.63.13
transliteration: godāvarīyṃ saritāṃ variṣṭhā priyā priyāyā mama nityakālam| apyatra gacchediti cintayāmi naikākinī yāti hi sā kadācit||3.
meaning: Would she have gone to Godavari, the foremost of the rivers so dear at all times to my beloved ? But I think she has not gone there alone at any time.

sanskrit: पद्मानना पद्मविशालनेत्रा पद्मानि वानेतुमभिप्रयाता। तदप्ययुक्तं न हि सा कदाचिन्मया विना गच्छति पङ्कजानि।।3.63.14।।
transliteration: padmānanā padmaviśālanetrā padmāni vānetumabhiprayātā| tadapyayuktṃ na hi sā kadācinmayā vinā gacchati paṅkajāni||3.63.1
meaning: The lady whose face was like the lotus, whose large eyes were like lotus petals could have gone to fetch lotuses (but) that also is not possible as she has never gone there without me.

sanskrit: कामं त्विदं पुष्पितवृक्षषण्डं नानाविधैः पक्षिगणैरुपेतम्। वनं प्रयाता नु तदप्ययुक्त मेकाकिनी सातिबिभेति भीरुः।।3.63.15।।
transliteration: kāmṃ tvidṃ puṣpitavṛkṣaṣaṇḍṃ nānāvidhaiḥ pakṣigaṇairupetam| vanṃ prayātā nu tadapyayukta mekākinī sātibibheti bhīruḥ||3.
meaning: Could she have gone to the forest where there are many kinds of trees in full bloom inhabited by a variety of birds? That is also not possible as she is timid and too scared to go there alone.

sanskrit: आदित्य भो लोककृताकृतज्ञ लोकस्य सत्यानृतकर्मसाक्षिन्। मम प्रिया सा क्व गता हृता वा शंसस्व मे शोकवशस्य नित्यम्।।3.63.16।।
transliteration: āditya bho lokakṛtākṛtajña lokasya satyānṛtakarmasākṣin| mama priyā sā kva gatā hṛtā vā śṃsasva me śokavaśasya nityam||3
meaning: O Sungod, you know all the happenings of the world. You are witness to all the deeds of the people, true and false. Tell me where my beloved Sita has gone or has been carried off. My grief never ceases.

sanskrit: लोकेषु सर्वेषु च नास्ति किञ्चिद्यत्ते न नित्यं विदितं भवेत्तत्। शंसस्व वायो कुलशालिनीं तां हृता मृता वा पथि वर्तते वा।।3
transliteration: lokeṣu sarveṣu ca nāsti kiñcidyatte na nityṃ viditṃ bhavettat| śṃsasva vāyo kulaśālinīṃ tāṃ hṛtā mṛtā vā pathi vartate v
meaning: O Windgod, there is nothing that you know not in all the worlds. Do tell me if that lady of a noble race has been abducted or dead or is on the way.

sanskrit: इतीव तं शोकविधेयदेहं रामं विसंज्ञं विलपन्तमेवम्। उवाच सौमित्रिरदीनसत्त्वो न्याये स्थितः कालयुतं च वाक्यम्।।3.63.18।।
transliteration: itīva tṃ śokavidheyadehṃ rāmṃ visṃjñṃ vilapantamevam| uvāca saumitriradīnasattvo nyāye sthitḥ kālayutṃ ca vākyam||3.63.1
meaning: While Rama was thus in tears, in a state of sorrow and swoon, Lakshmana who was rational and courageous spoke to him words appropriate to the time :

sanskrit: शोकं विमुञ्चार्य धृतिं भजस्व सोत्साहता चास्तु विमार्गणेऽस्याः। उत्साहवन्तो हि नरा न लोके सीदन्ति कर्मस्वतिदुष्करेषु।।3.6
transliteration: śokṃ vimuñcārya dhṛtiṃ bhajasva sotsāhatā cāstu vimārgaṇe'syāḥ| utsāhavanto hi narā na loke sīdanti karmasvatiduṣkareṣu|
meaning: O noble prince, give up grief. Take courage. Show enthusiasm to search and find Sita. Enthusiastic people will not get despondent in carrying out the most difficult tasks.

sanskrit: इतीव सौमित्रिमुदग्रपौरुषं ब्रुवन्तमार्तो रघुवंशवर्धनः। न चिन्तयामास धृतिं विमुक्तवान्पुनश्च दुःखं महदभ्युपागमत्।।3.63.20
transliteration: itīva saumitrimudagrapauruṣṃ bruvantamārto raghuvṃśavardhanḥ| na cintayāmāsa dhṛtiṃ vimuktavānpunaśca duḥkhṃ mahadabhyup
meaning: Rama who carries on the (glorious) progeny of the Raghu dynasty, did not (however) consider seriously the words of Lakshmana, a man of great prowess. Forsaking his courage he was once again overtaken by deep sorrow. इत्य

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा।।3.64.2।। नदीं गोदावरीं रम्यां जगाम लघुविक्रमः।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇḥ paravīrahā||3.64.2|| nadīṃ godāvarīṃ ramyāṃ jagāma laghuvikramḥ|
meaning: Lakshmana, destroyer of enemywarriors, went to the beautiful river Godavari with quick steps following the instruction of Rama.

sanskrit: तां लक्ष्मणस्तीर्थवती विचित्वा राममब्रवीत्।।3.64.3।। नैनां पश्यामि तीर्थेषु क्रोशतो न शृणोति मे।
transliteration: tāṃ lakṣmaṇastīrthavatī vicitvā rāmamabravīt||3.64.3|| naināṃ paśyāmi tīrtheṣu krośato na śṛṇoti me|
meaning: Searching for Sita at the landings of river Godavari, Lakshmana said to Rama, I am unable to find her at these landings.No one responds to my call.

sanskrit: कं नु वा देशमापन्ना वैदेही क्लेशनाशिनी।।3.64.4।। न ह्यहं वेद तं देशं यत्र सा जनकात्मजा।
transliteration: kṃ nu vā deśamāpannā vaidehī kleśanāśinī||3.64.4|| na hyahṃ veda tṃ deśṃ yatra sā janakātmajā|
meaning: Where could Vaidehi, destroyer of sorrow, go? I wonder. I am unable to trace the spot where the daughter of Janaka could be found.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा दीनस्सन्तापमोहितः।।3.64.5।। रामस्समभिचक्राम स्वयं गोदावरीं नदीम्। स तामुपस्थितो रामः क्व सीतेत्य
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya vacaśśrutvā dīnassantāpamohitḥ||3.64.5|| rāmassamabhicakrāma svayṃ godāvarīṃ nadīm| sa tāmupasthito rāmḥ kva
meaning: Overwhelmed with grief on hearing Lakshmana's words, Rama himself went to river Godavari, and shouted, where are you, Sita?

sanskrit: भूतानि राक्षसेन्द्रेण वधार्हेण हृतामिति। न तां शशंसू रामाय तथा गोदावरी नदि।।3.64.7।।
transliteration: bhūtāni rākṣasendreṇa vadhārheṇa hṛtāmiti| na tāṃ śaśṃsū rāmāya tathā godāvarī nadi||3.64.7||
meaning: Like the elements of Nature, river Godavari did not disclose Rama that Sita had been abducted by the king of demons who deserved death.

sanskrit: ततः प्रचोदिता भूतैश्शंसास्मैतां प्रियामिति। न तु साभ्यवदतसितां पृष्टा रामेण शोचता।।3.64.8।।
transliteration: tatḥ pracoditā bhūtaiśśṃsāsmaitāṃ priyāmiti| na tu sābhyavadatasitāṃ pṛṣṭā rāmeṇa śocatā||3.64.8||
meaning: River Godavari (although) prompted by creatures (of Nature) to tell him about his beloved did not respond to brooding Rama.

sanskrit: रावणस्य तु तद्रूपं कर्माणि च दुरात्मनः। ध्यात्वा भयात्तु वैदेहीं सा नदी न शशंस ताम्।।3.64.9।।
transliteration: rāvaṇasya tu tadrūpṃ karmāṇi ca durātmanḥ| dhyātvā bhayāttu vaidehīṃ sā nadī na śaśṃsa tām||3.64.9||
meaning: Remembering the evilminded Ravana's appearance and action, the river revealed nothing about Vaidehi out of fear.

sanskrit: निराशस्तु तया नद्या सीताया दर्शने कृतः। उवाच रामस्सौमित्रिं सीतादर्शनकर्शितः।।3.64.10।।
transliteration: nirāśastu tayā nadyā sītāyā darśane kṛtḥ| uvāca rāmassaumitriṃ sītādarśanakarśitḥ||3.64.10||
meaning: Disappointed by the river and emaciated by not being able to see Sita, Rama said to Lakshmana :

sanskrit: एषा गोदावरी सौम्य किंचिन्न प्रति भाषते। किं नु लक्ष्मण वक्ष्यामि समेत्य जनकं वचः।।3.64.11।। मातरं चैव वैदेह्या विना तामह
transliteration: eṣā godāvarī saumya kiṃcinna prati bhāṣate| kiṃ nu lakṣmaṇa vakṣyāmi sametya janakṃ vacḥ||3.64.11|| mātarṃ caiva vaidehy
meaning: O handsome Lakshmana this Godavari does not at all respond. How can I go to Janaka and my mother without Sita and break this unhappy news?

sanskrit: या मे राज्यविहीनस्य वने वन्येन जीवतः।।3.64.12।। सर्वं व्यपनयेच्छोकं वैदेही क्व नु सा गता।
transliteration: yā me rājyavihīnasya vane vanyena jīvatḥ||3.64.12|| sarvṃ vyapanayecchokṃ vaidehī kva nu sā gatā|
meaning: Where could have gone that Vaidehi, who removed all my sorrows and sufferings when I lost my kingdom and survived on food available in the forest?

sanskrit: ज्ञातिपक्षविहीनस्य राजपुत्रीमपश्यतः।।3.64.13।। मन्ये दीर्घा भविष्यन्ति रात्रयो मम जाग्रतः।
transliteration: jñātipakṣavihīnasya rājaputrīmapaśyatḥ||3.64.13|| manye dīrghā bhaviṣyanti rātrayo mama jāgratḥ|
meaning: Away from relatives and away from the princess, I keep awake during nights which seem too long.

sanskrit: गोदावरीं जनस्थानमिमं प्रस्रवणं गिरिम्।।3.64.14।। सर्वाण्यनुगमिष्यामि यदि सीता हि दृश्यते।
transliteration: godāvarīṃ janasthānamimṃ prasravaṇṃ girim||3.64.14|| sarvāṇyanugamiṣyāmi yadi sītā hi dṛśyate|
meaning: I will roam about the river Godavari, Janasthana and this mount Prasravana till I find Sita.

sanskrit: एते मृगा महावीर्य मामीक्षन्ते मुहुर्मुहुः।।3.64.15।। वक्तुकामा इव हि मे इङ्गितान्युपलक्षये।
transliteration: ete mṛgā mahāvīrya māmīkṣante muhurmuhuḥ||3.64.15|| vaktukāmā iva hi me iṅgitānyupalakṣaye|
meaning: O mighty Lakshmana these deer are looking at me again and again indicating that they wish to tell me something.

sanskrit: तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा नरव्याघ्रो राघवः प्रत्युवाच ह।।3.64.16।। क्व सीतेति निरीक्षन्वै बाष्पसंरुद्धया दृशा।
transliteration: tāṃstu dṛṣṭvā naravyāghro rāghavḥ pratyuvāca ha||3.64.16|| kva sīteti nirīkṣanvai bāṣpasṃruddhayā dṛśā|
meaning: With his vision blurred by tears, Rama, the best among men, looked at them and asked them 'Where is Sita'?

sanskrit: एवमुक्ता नरेन्द्रेण ते मृगास्सहसोत्थिताः।।3.64.17।। दक्षिणाभिमुखास्सर्वे दर्शयन्तो नभस्थलम्। मैथिली ह्रियमाणा सा दिशं या
transliteration: evamuktā narendreṇa te mṛgāssahasotthitāḥ||3.64.17|| dakṣiṇābhimukhāssarve darśayanto nabhasthalam| maithilī hriyamāṇā s
meaning: Thus asked by the prince, all the deer got up suddenly, and pointed towards the southern sky, the direction in which the princess from Mithila was carried off. Looking at the Lord of men (Rama), they started running in t

sanskrit: येन मार्गं च भूमिं च निरीक्षन्ते स्म ते मृगाः।।3.64.19।। पुनश्च मार्गमिच्छन्ति लक्ष्मणेनोपलक्षिताः।
transliteration: yena mārgṃ ca bhūmiṃ ca nirīkṣante sma te mṛgāḥ||3.64.19|| punaśca mārgamicchanti lakṣmaṇenopalakṣitāḥ|
meaning: Even Lakshmana marked that the deer were showing and looking at the path lying in that direction.

sanskrit: तेषां वचनसर्वस्वं लक्षयामास चेङ्गितम्।।3.64.20।। उवाच लक्ष्मणो ज्येष्ठं धीमान्भ्रातरमार्तवत्।
transliteration: teṣāṃ vacanasarvasvṃ lakṣayāmāsa ceṅgitam||3.64.20|| uvāca lakṣmaṇo jyeṣṭhṃ dhīmānbhrātaramārtavat|
meaning: Observing intelligently their indications and understanding the meaning of their message, Lakshmana said to his distressed elder brother:

sanskrit: क्व सितेति त्वया पृष्टा यथेमे सहसोत्थिताः।।3.64.21।। दर्शयन्ति क्षितिं चैव दक्षिणां च दिशं मृगाः। साधु गच्छावहे देव दिशम
transliteration: kva siteti tvayā pṛṣṭā yatheme sahasotthitāḥ||3.64.21|| darśayanti kṣitiṃ caiva dakṣiṇāṃ ca diśṃ mṛgāḥ| sādhu gacchāvahe
meaning: O lord these deer are indicating the land on the southern side.Therefore it will be proper for both of us to proceed in the southwestern direction. Maybe we will get some clue or find that noble Sita.

sanskrit: बाढमित्येव काकुत्स्थः प्रस्थितो दक्षिणां दिशम्।।3.64.23।। लक्ष्मणानुगतश्शीमन्वीक्षमाणो वसुन्धराम्।
transliteration: bāḍhamityeva kākutsthḥ prasthito dakṣiṇāṃ diśam||3.64.23|| lakṣmaṇānugataśśīmanvīkṣamāṇo vasundharām|
meaning: Handsome Rama said, 'yes'and started in southern direction, carefully looking at the ground, followed by Lakshmana.

sanskrit: एवं सम्भाषमाणौ तावन्योन्यं भ्रातरावुभौ।।3.64.24।। वसुन्धरायां पतितं पुष्पमार्गमपश्यताम्।
transliteration: evṃ sambhāṣamāṇau tāvanyonyṃ bhrātarāvubhau||3.64.24|| vasundharāyāṃ patitṃ puṣpamārgamapaśyatām|
meaning: Talking with each other, the two brothers took the path on earth strewn with flowers.

sanskrit: तां पुष्पवृष्टिं पतितां दृष्ट्वा रामो महीतले।।3.64.25।। उवाच लक्ष्मणं वीरो दुःखितो दुःखितं वचः।
transliteration: tāṃ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ patitāṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmo mahītale||3.64.25|| uvāca lakṣmaṇṃ vīro duḥkhito duḥkhitṃ vacḥ|
meaning: Seeing showers of flowers fallen on the ground, valiant Rama sadly said these words to sorrowful Lakshmana:

sanskrit: अभिजानामि पुष्पाणि तानीमानीह लक्ष्मण।।3.64.26।। पिनद्धानि हि वैदेह्या मया दत्तानि कानने।
transliteration: abhijānāmi puṣpāṇi tānīmānīha lakṣmaṇa||3.64.26|| pinaddhāni hi vaidehyā mayā dattāni kānane|
meaning: O Lakshmana, here are the same flowers I had given Vaidehi to wear in the forest. I can recognize them.

sanskrit: मन्ये सूर्यश्च वायुश्च मेदिनी च यशस्विनी।।3.64.27।। अभिरक्षन्ति पुष्पाणि प्रकुर्वन्तो मम प्रियम्।
transliteration: manye sūryaśca vāyuśca medinī ca yaśasvinī||3.64.27|| abhirakṣanti puṣpāṇi prakurvanto mama priyam|
meaning: I think the Sun, the wind and the famed earth have done me a favour by preserving these flowers.

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुं लक्ष्मणं पुरुषर्षभः।।3.64.28।। उवाच रामो धर्मात्मा गिरिं प्रस्रवणाकुलम्।
transliteration: evamuktvā mahābāhuṃ lakṣmaṇṃ puruṣarṣabhḥ||3.64.28|| uvāca rāmo dharmātmā giriṃ prasravaṇākulam|
meaning: Rigteous Rama, the best among men, having said these words to the longarmed Lakshmana, asked mount Prasravana, full of streams:

sanskrit: कच्चित् क्षितिभृतां नाथ दृष्टा सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी।।3.64.29।। रामा रम्ये वनोद्देशे मया विरहिता त्वया।
transliteration: kaccit kṣitibhṛtāṃ nātha dṛṣṭā sarvāṅgasundarī||3.64.29|| rāmā ramye vanoddeśe mayā virahitā tvayā|
meaning: O king of the mountains have you seen a lady with beautiful limbs separated from me in this forest tract ?

sanskrit: क्रुद्धोऽब्रवीद्गिरिं तत्र सिंहः क्षुद्रमृगं यथा।।3.64.30।। तां हेमवर्णां हेमाभां सीतां दर्शय पर्वत। यावत्सानूनि सर्वाणि
transliteration: kruddho'bravīdgiriṃ tatra siṃhḥ kṣudramṛgṃ yathā||3.64.30|| tāṃ hemavarṇāṃ hemābhāṃ sītāṃ darśaya parvata| yāvatsānūni s
meaning: Like a lion aiming at a petty animal, angry Rama said, O Mountain before I destroy all your slopes show me that goldenhued Sita with lustre like gold.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण पर्वतो मैथिलीं प्रति। शंसन्निव ततस्सीतां नादर्शयत राघवे।।3.64.32।।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa parvato maithilīṃ prati| śṃsanniva tatassītāṃ nādarśayata rāghave||3.64.32||
meaning: Thus addressed by Rama, the mountain echoed as if it was telling about Sita but did not show her to Rama.

sanskrit: ततो दाशरथी राम उवाच च शिलोच्चयम्। मम बाणाग्निनिर्दग्धो भस्मीभूतो भविष्यसि।।3.64.33।। असेव्यः सततं चैव निस्तृणद्रुमपल्लवः
transliteration: tato dāśarathī rāma uvāca ca śiloccayam| mama bāṇāgninirdagdho bhasmībhūto bhaviṣyasi||3.64.33|| asevyḥ satatṃ caiva nis
meaning: Rama, Dasaratha's son said to the mountain, The fire of my arrows will reduce you to ashes.You will have no grass, no tree, no twig. You will be unfit to be served any more.

sanskrit: इमां वा सरितं चाद्य शोषयिष्यामि लक्ष्मण।।3.64.34।। यदि नाख्याति मे सीतामार्यां चन्द्रनिभाननाम्।
transliteration: imāṃ vā saritṃ cādya śoṣayiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇa||3.64.34|| yadi nākhyāti me sītāmāryāṃ candranibhānanām|
meaning: O Lakshmana if this river does not tell me about that noble Sita with countenance like the moon, I will drain it dry right now.

sanskrit: एवं स रुषितो रामो दिधक्षन्निव चक्षुषा।।3.64.35।। ददर्श भूमौ निष्क्रान्तं राक्षसस्य पदं महत्। त्रस्ताया रामकाङ्क्षिण्याः
transliteration: evṃ sa ruṣito rāmo didhakṣanniva cakṣuṣā||3.64.35|| dadarśa bhūmau niṣkrāntṃ rākṣasasya padṃ mahat| trastāyā rāmakāṅkṣiṇ
meaning: While Rama was angry with his eyes burning, he saw on the ground as he advanced large footprints of a demon and then the footprints of Maithili which signified as if chased by the demon, she was frightened and was runnin

sanskrit: स समीक्ष्य परिक्रान्तं सीताया राक्षसस्य च।।3.64.37।। भग्नं धनुश्च तूणी च विकीर्णं बहुधा रथम्। सम्भ्रान्तहृदयो रामश्शशंस
transliteration: sa samīkṣya parikrāntṃ sītāyā rākṣasasya ca||3.64.37|| bhagnṃ dhanuśca tūṇī ca vikīrṇṃ bahudhā ratham| sambhrāntahṛdayo
meaning: Bewildered to see the broken bow and quiver and many splinters of the chariot scattered all over, Rama said to his loving brother Lakshmana:

sanskrit: पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेह्याशशीर्णाः कनकबिन्दवः। भूषणानां हि सौमित्रे माल्यानि विविधानि च।।3.64.39।।
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa vaidehyāśaśīrṇāḥ kanakabindavḥ| bhūṣaṇānāṃ hi saumitre mālyāni vividhāni ca||3.64.39||
meaning: O Saumitri see the many broken bits of gold ornaments and garlands.

sanskrit: तप्तबिन्दुनिकाशैश्च चित्रैः क्षतजबिन्दुभिः। आवृतं पश्य सौमित्रे सर्वतो धरणीतलम्।3.64.40।।
transliteration: taptabindunikāśaiśca citraiḥ kṣatajabindubhiḥ| āvṛtṃ paśya saumitre sarvato dharaṇītalam|3.64.40||
meaning: See, O Lakshmana, the patches of blood looking like drops of shining gold spread all over the ground.

sanskrit: मन्ये लक्ष्मण वैदेही राक्षसैः कामरूपिभिः। भित्वाभित्वा विभक्ता वा भक्षिता वा भविष्यति।।3.64.41।।
transliteration: manye lakṣmaṇa vaidehī rākṣasaiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ| bhitvābhitvā vibhaktā vā bhakṣitā vā bhaviṣyati||3.64.41||
meaning: O Lakshmana, Vaidehi might have been cut into pieces, and eaten up by the demons who can assume any form at their free will.

sanskrit: तस्या निमित्तं वैदेह्या द्वयोर्विवदमानयोः। बभूव युद्धं सौमित्रे घोरं राक्षसयोरिह।।3.64.42।।
transliteration: tasyā nimittṃ vaidehyā dvayorvivadamānayoḥ| babhūva yuddhṃ saumitre ghorṃ rākṣasayoriha||3.64.42||
meaning: O Lakshmana, two demons might have fought a dreadful duel at this place contesting with each other for the sake of Vaidehi.

sanskrit: मुक्तामणिमयं चेदं तपनीयविभूषितम्। धरण्यां पतितं सौम्य कस्य भग्नं महद्धनुः।।3.64.43।।
transliteration: muktāmaṇimayṃ cedṃ tapanīyavibhūṣitam| dharaṇyāṃ patitṃ saumya kasya bhagnṃ mahaddhanuḥ||3.64.43||
meaning: O handsome Lakshmana whose is this huge bow embedded with pearls and gems and adorned with gold fallen on the ground?

sanskrit: तरुणादित्यसङ्काशं वैडूर्यगुलिकाचितम्। विशीर्णं पतितं भूमौ कवचं कस्य काञ्चनम्।।3.64.44।।
transliteration: taruṇādityasaṅkāśṃ vaiḍūryagulikācitam| viśīrṇṃ patitṃ bhūmau kavacṃ kasya kāñcanam||3.64.44||
meaning: Whose is this shield of gold studded with Vaidurya, broken and strewn all over the ground, shining like the morning Sun?

sanskrit: छत्रं शतशलाकं च दिव्यमाल्योपशोभितम्। भग्नदण्डमिदं कस्य भूमौ सम्यङ्निपातितम्।।3.64.45।।
transliteration: chatrṃ śataśalākṃ ca divyamālyopaśobhitam| bhagnadaṇḍamidṃ kasya bhūmau samyaṅnipātitam||3.64.45||
meaning: Whose parasol is this with a hundred spokes, festooned with wonderful flowers thrown down on the ground with broken staff ?

sanskrit: काञ्चनोरश्छदा श्चेमे पिशाचवदनाः खराः। भीमरूपा महाकायाः कस्य वा निहता रणे।।3.64.46।।
transliteration: kāñcanoraśchadā śceme piśācavadanāḥ kharāḥ| bhīmarūpā mahākāyāḥ kasya vā nihatā raṇe||3.64.46||
meaning: Whose are these donkeys, with golden chestcoverings, with the devil's face, fierceful and huge and slain in the encounter ?

sanskrit: दीप्तपावकसङ्काशो द्युतिमान्समरध्वजः। अपविद्धश्च भग्नश्च कस्य साङ्ग्रामिको रथः।।3.64.47।।
transliteration: dīptapāvakasaṅkāśo dyutimānsamaradhvajḥ| apaviddhaśca bhagnaśca kasya sāṅgrāmiko rathḥ||3.64.47||
meaning: Whose war chariot with a battle flag is this, shining like burning fire, turned upside down and broken?

sanskrit: रथाक्षमात्रा विशिखास्तपनीयविभूषणाः। कस्येमेऽभिहता बाणाः प्रकीर्णा घोरकर्मणः।।3.64.48।।
transliteration: rathākṣamātrā viśikhāstapanīyavibhūṣaṇāḥ| kasyeme'bhihatā bāṇāḥ prakīrṇā ghorakarmaṇḥ||3.64.48||
meaning: Whose are these pointless arrows of the size of a chariot axle adorned with bright gold destroyed and scattered ? Who is he that has performed such terrible deeds?

sanskrit: शरावरौ शरैः पूर्णौ विध्वस्तौ पश्य लक्ष्मण। प्रतोदाभीशुहस्तो वै कस्यायं सारथिर्हतः।।3.64.49।।
transliteration: śarāvarau śaraiḥ pūrṇau vidhvastau paśya lakṣmaṇa| pratodābhīśuhasto vai kasyāyṃ sārathirhatḥ||3.64.49||
meaning: O Lakshmana look at these two quivers filled with arrows and lying shattered. The charioteer is holding a whip and reins in his hands and is lying dead. To whom do they belong?

sanskrit: कस्येमौ पुरुषव्याघ्र शयाते निहतौ युधि। चामरग्राहिणौ सौम्य सोष्णीषमणिकुण्डलौ।।3.64.50।।
transliteration: kasyemau puruṣavyāghra śayāte nihatau yudhi| cāmaragrāhiṇau saumya soṣṇīṣamaṇikuṇḍalau||3.64.50||
meaning: O best among men, O handsome Lakshmana see these carriers of fans with head dress and earrings studded with gems lying slain in the combat. Whose are they ?

sanskrit: पदवीपुरुषस्यैषा व्यक्तं कस्यापि रक्षसः। वैरं शतगुणं पश्य ममेदं जीवितान्तकम्।।3.64.51।।
transliteration: padavīpuruṣasyaiṣā vyaktṃ kasyāpi rakṣasḥ| vairṃ śataguṇṃ paśya mamedṃ jīvitāntakam||3.64.51||
meaning: This indeed is the path the man or the demon has traversed. My enmity with him now has become hundredfold. This will end only with the extermination of his life.

sanskrit: सुघोरहृदयैस्सौम्य राक्षसैः कामरूपिभिः। हृता मृता वा सीता सा भक्षिता वा तपस्विनी।।3.64.52।। नधर्मस्त्रायते सीतां ह्रियमाण
transliteration: sughorahṛdayaissaumya rākṣasaiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ| hṛtā mṛtā vā sītā sā bhakṣitā vā tapasvinī||3.64.52|| nadharmastrāyate sīt
meaning: O handsome one, those demons can change their form at will and are of dreadful nature. Have they abducted or devoured or killed her in this great forest. Even her righteousness could not protect the helpless Sita.

sanskrit: भक्षितायां हि वैदेह्यां हृतायामपि लक्ष्मण।।3.64.53।। के हि लोके प्रियं कर्तुं शक्तास्सौम्य ममेश्वराः।
transliteration: bhakṣitāyāṃ hi vaidehyāṃ hṛtāyāmapi lakṣmaṇa||3.64.53|| ke hi loke priyṃ kartuṃ śaktāssaumya mameśvarāḥ|
meaning: If Sita has been devoured or kidnapped, none in this world or even gods could do anything to make me happy, O handsome Lakshmana

sanskrit: कर्तारमपि लोकानां शूरं करुणवेदिनम्।।3.64.54।। अज्ञानादवमन्येरत्सर्वभूतानि लक्ष्मण।
transliteration: kartāramapi lokānāṃ śūrṃ karuṇavedinam||3.64.54|| ajñānādavamanyeratsarvabhūtāni lakṣmaṇa|
meaning: O Lakshmana even the compassionate and heroic Creator of the worlds will be disrespected by all beings, however ignorantly (if such things are allowed to happen).

sanskrit: मृदुं लोकहिते युक्तं दान्तं करुणवेदिनम्।।3.64.55।। निर्वीर्य इति मन्यन्ते नूनं मां त्रिदशेश्वराः।
transliteration: mṛduṃ lokahite yuktṃ dāntṃ karuṇavedinam||3.64.55|| nirvīrya iti manyante nūnṃ māṃ tridaśeśvarāḥ|
meaning: The gods will certainly consider me a man engaged in the welfare of the world, a man of selfrestraint and compassion, but at the same time a weak man.

sanskrit: मां प्राप्य हि गुणो दोषस्संवृत्तः पश्य लक्ष्मण।।3.64.56।। अद्यैव सर्वभूतानां रक्षसामभवाय च। संहृत्यैव शशिज्योत्स्नां महा
transliteration: māṃ prāpya hi guṇo doṣassṃvṛttḥ paśya lakṣmaṇa||3.64.56|| adyaiva sarvabhūtānāṃ rakṣasāmabhavāya ca| sṃhṛtyaiva śaśijyot
meaning: O Lakshmana even demerits turn into merits when they come in contact with me. Just as the Sun shines, effacing the moonlight, my brilliance will outshine my demerits of exterminating all (wicked) beings including the dem

sanskrit: नैव यक्षा न गन्धर्वा न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः।।3.64.58।। किन्नरा वा मनुष्या वा सुखं प्राप्स्यन्ति लिक्ष्मण।
transliteration: naiva yakṣā na gandharvā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ||3.64.58|| kinnarā vā manuṣyā vā sukhṃ prāpsyanti likṣmaṇa|
meaning: O Lakshmana, neither yakshas, nor goblins nor demons nor kinneras nor humans will be in peace now.

sanskrit: ममास्त्रबाणसम्पूर्णमाकाशं पश्य लक्ष्मण।।3.64.59।। निस्सम्पातं करिष्यामि ह्यद्य त्रैलोक्यचारिणाम्।
transliteration: mamāstrabāṇasampūrṇamākāśṃ paśya lakṣmaṇa||3.64.59|| nissampātṃ kariṣyāmi hyadya trailokyacāriṇām|
meaning: O Lakshmana, just see, I will fill the sky with all my weapons and arrows and make all movements impossible in the three worlds.

sanskrit: सन्निरुद्धग्रहगणमावारितनिशाकरम्।।3.64.60।। विप्रणष्टानलमरुद्भास्करद्युतिसंवृतम्। विनिर्मथितशैलाग्रं शुष्यमाणजलाशयम्।।3.6
transliteration: sanniruddhagrahagaṇamāvāritaniśākaram||3.64.60|| vipraṇaṣṭānalamarudbhāskaradyutisṃvṛtam| vinirmathitaśailāgrṃ śuṣyamāṇa
meaning: I will obstruct the movement of planets and the Moon, destroy the radiance of the Sun, the fire and block the wind crush the mountain tops, dry up the tanks, destroy the trees shrubs and creepers and annihilate the ocean

sanskrit: न तां कुशलिनीं सीतां प्रदास्यन्ति ममेश्वराः। अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते सौमित्रे मम द्रक्ष्यन्ति विक्रमम्।।3.64.63।।
transliteration: na tāṃ kuśalinīṃ sītāṃ pradāsyanti mameśvarāḥ| asminmuhūrte saumitre mama drakṣyanti vikramam||3.64.63||
meaning: If the gods do not return my Sita safely to me, O Lakshmana they will witness my power right now.

sanskrit: नाकाशमुत्पतिष्यन्ति सर्वभूतानि लक्ष्मण। मम चापगुणोन्मुक्तैर्बाणजालैर्निरन्तरम्।।3.64.64।।
transliteration: nākāśamutpatiṣyanti sarvabhūtāni lakṣmaṇa| mama cāpaguṇonmuktairbāṇajālairnirantaram||3.64.64||
meaning: Lakshmana no beings will be able to move in the sky, blocked by arrows released from my bowstring there will be no space left there.

sanskrit: अर्दितं मम नाराचैर्ध्वस्तभ्रान्तमृगद्विजम्। समाकुलममर्यादं जगत्पश्याद्य लक्ष्मण।।3.64.65।।
transliteration: arditṃ mama nārācairdhvastabhrāntamṛgadvijam| samākulamamaryādṃ jagatpaśyādya lakṣmaṇa||3.64.65||
meaning: O Lakshmna now beasts and birds will be confused and destroyed by my darts.You will see them crossing all limits of propriety.

sanskrit: आकर्णपूर्णैरिषुभिर्जीवलोकं दुरावरैः। करिष्ये मैथिलीहेतोरपिशाचमराक्षसम्।।3.64.66।।
transliteration: ākarṇapūrṇairiṣubhirjīvalokṃ durāvaraiḥ| kariṣye maithilīhetorapiśācamarākṣasam||3.64.66||
meaning: For the sake of Maithili I will render this world devoid of goblins and demons with my irresistible arrows pulled up to my ears.

sanskrit: मम रोषप्रयुक्तानां सायकानां बलं सुराः। द्रक्ष्यन्त्यद्य विमुक्तानामतिदूरातिगामिनाम्।।3.64.67।।
transliteration: mama roṣaprayuktānāṃ sāyakānāṃ balṃ surāḥ| drakṣyantyadya vimuktānāmatidūrātigāminām||3.64.67||
meaning: Now the gods will witness the power of my arrows released in great rage which can hit distant targets.

sanskrit: नैव देवा न दैतेया न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः। भविष्यन्ति मम क्रोधात्त्रैलोक्ये विप्रणाशिते।।3.64.68।।
transliteration: naiva devā na daiteyā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ| bhaviṣyanti mama krodhāttrailokye vipraṇāśite||3.64.68||
meaning: My anger will destroy all the gods, demons and evil spirits. They will be extinghished from the three worlds.

sanskrit: देवदानवयक्षाणां लोका ये रक्षसामपि। बहुधा न भविष्यन्ति बाणौघैश्शकलीकृताः।।3.64.69।।
transliteration: devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ lokā ye rakṣasāmapi| bahudhā na bhaviṣyanti bāṇaughaiśśakalīkṛtāḥ||3.64.69||
meaning: The worlds of gods, yakshas or even demons torn into shreds by my arrows will not survive.

sanskrit: निर्मर्यादानिमान्लोकान्करिष्याम्यद्य सायकैः। हृतां मृतां वा सौमित्रे न दास्यन्ति ममेश्वराः।।3.64.70।।
transliteration: nirmaryādānimānlokānkariṣyāmyadya sāyakaiḥ| hṛtāṃ mṛtāṃ vā saumitre na dāsyanti mameśvarāḥ||3.64.70||
meaning: If the gods do not hand over Sita to me either carried away or dead I will transgress these worlds, O Lakshmana

sanskrit: तथारुपां हि वैदेहीं न दास्यन्ति यदि प्रियाम्। नाशयामि जगत्सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्।।3.64.71।।
transliteration: tathārupāṃ hi vaidehīṃ na dāsyanti yadi priyām| nāśayāmi jagatsarvṃ trailokyṃ sacarācaram||3.64.71||
meaning: If my beloved Vaidehi is not given back to me in her true form I will destroy the three worlds with all animate and inanimate beings.

sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा रोषताम्राक्षो रामो निष्पीड्य कार्मुकम्। शरमादाय सन्दीप्तं घोरमाशीविषोपमम्।।3.64.72।। सन्धाय धनुषि श्रीमान्रा
transliteration: ityuktvā roṣatāmrākṣo rāmo niṣpīḍya kārmukam| śaramādāya sandīptṃ ghoramāśīviṣopamam||3.64.72|| sandhāya dhanuṣi śrīmānr
meaning: After speaking these words, handsome Rama, his eyes red with anger, pressed his bow, took out the glowing arrow that was dreadful like a poisonous serpent, fixed it to his bow and said these words in a rage like the fire

sanskrit: यथा जरा यथा मृत्युर्यथा कालो यथा विधिः। नित्यं न प्रतिहन्यन्ते सर्वभूतेषु लक्ष्मण।।3.64.74।। तथाहं क्रोधसंयुक्तो न निवार
transliteration: yathā jarā yathā mṛtyuryathā kālo yathā vidhiḥ| nityṃ na pratihanyante sarvabhūteṣu lakṣmaṇa||3.64.74|| tathāhṃ krodhasṃ
meaning: Just as all beings in this world cannot avoid age and death, or defy time and fate so also none can prevent me at all when I am angry, O Lakshmana

sanskrit: पुरेव मे चारुदंतीमनिन्दितां दिशन्ति सीतां यदि नाद्य मैथिलीम्। सदेवगन्धर्वमनुष्यपन्नगं जगत्सशैलं परिवर्तयाम्यहम्।।3.64.75
transliteration: pureva me cārudṃtīmaninditāṃ diśanti sītāṃ yadi nādya maithilīm| sadevagandharvamanuṣyapannagṃ jagatsaśailṃ parivartayām
meaning: I will topsyturvy this entire world including the gods, the gandharvas, human beings, serpents and mountains if they do not show me the princess from Mithila, who is blemishless and whose teeth are beautiful इत्यार्शे श्

sanskrit: पुरा भूत्वा मृदुर्दान्तस्सर्वभूतहिते रतः। न क्रोधवशमापन्नः प्रकृतिं हातुमर्हसि।।3.65.4।।
transliteration: purā bhūtvā mṛdurdāntassarvabhūtahite ratḥ| na krodhavaśamāpannḥ prakṛtiṃ hātumarhasi||3.65.4||
meaning: Earlier you were gentle, self restrained and engaged in the welfare of all beings. (Now) it is not proper for you to give up your natural composure in anger.

sanskrit: चन्द्रे लक्ष्मीः प्रभा सूर्ये गतिर्वायौ भुवि क्षमा। एतत्तु नियतं सर्वं त्वयि चानुत्तमं यशः।।3.65.5।।
transliteration: candre lakṣmīḥ prabhā sūrye gatirvāyau bhuvi kṣamā| etattu niyatṃ sarvṃ tvayi cānuttamṃ yaśḥ||3.65.5||
meaning: In you are always present the grace of the Moon, the radiance of the Sun, the motion of the wind, the forbearance of the earth and reputation.

sanskrit: एकस्य नापराधेन लोकान् हन्तुं त्वमर्हसि। न तु जानामि कस्यायं भग्नस्साङ्ग्रामिको रथः।।3.65.6।। केन वा कस्य वा हेतोस्सायुधस
transliteration: ekasya nāparādhena lokān hantuṃ tvamarhasi| na tu jānāmi kasyāyṃ bhagnassāṅgrāmiko rathḥ||3.65.6|| kena vā kasya vā heto
meaning: To destroy the world for the mistake of a single person is not proper. Why and by whom is this warchariot broken with weapons and all its accesories I do not know.

sanskrit: खुरनेमिक्षतश्चायं सिक्तो रुधिरबिन्धुभिः।।3.65.7।। देशो निर्वृत्तसङ्ग्रामस्सुघोरः पार्थिवात्मज।
transliteration: khuranemikṣataścāyṃ sikto rudhirabindhubhiḥ||3.65.7|| deśo nirvṛttasaṅgrāmassughorḥ pārthivātmaja|
meaning: O prince, this place is damaged by the hooves of the horses and the rims of the chariot. It is soaked with drops of blood.Very dreadful must have been the fight here.

sanskrit: एकस्य तु विमर्धोऽयं न द्वयोर्वदतांवर।।3.65.8।। न हि वृत्तं हि पश्यामि बलस्य महतः पदम्।
transliteration: ekasya tu vimardho'yṃ na dvayorvadatāṃvara||3.65.8|| na hi vṛttṃ hi paśyāmi balasya mahatḥ padam|
meaning: O, best of the eloquent this fight involves only one and not two. I do not see the footprints of a big army.

sanskrit: नैकस्य तु कृते लोकान्विनाशयितुमर्हसि।।3.65.9।। युक्तदण्डा हि मृदवः प्रशान्ता वसुधाधिपाः।
transliteration: naikasya tu kṛte lokānvināśayitumarhasi||3.65.9|| yuktadaṇḍā hi mṛdavḥ praśāntā vasudhādhipāḥ|
meaning: To destroy the entire world for one individual is not right. The lords of the earth should remain gentle, peaceful and punish only the deserving.

sanskrit: सदा त्वं सर्वभूतानां शरण्यः परमा गतिः।।3.65.10।। को नु दारप्रणाशं ते साधु मन्येत राघव।
transliteration: sadā tvṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ śaraṇyḥ paramā gatiḥ||3.65.10|| ko nu dārapraṇāśṃ te sādhu manyeta rāghava|
meaning: You are the ultimate resort and refuge of all beings. Who would like that your wife should be abducted ?

sanskrit: सरितस्सागराश्शैला देवगन्धर्वदानवाः।।3.65.11।। नालं ते विप्रियं कर्तुं दीक्षितस्येव साधवः।
transliteration: saritassāgarāśśailā devagandharvadānavāḥ||3.65.11|| nālṃ te vipriyṃ kartuṃ dīkṣitasyeva sādhavḥ|
meaning: Just as pious men do not do anything disagreeable towards persons who observe religious vows, so also rivers, seas and mountains, gods, gandharvas and demons are not capable of causing unhappiness to you.

sanskrit: येन राजन्हृता सीता तमन्वेषितुमर्हसि।।3.65.12।। मद्वितीयो धनुष्पाणिस्सहायैः परमर्षिभिः।
transliteration: yena rājanhṛtā sītā tamanveṣitumarhasi||3.65.12|| madvitīyo dhanuṣpāṇissahāyaiḥ paramarṣibhiḥ|
meaning: O king bow in hands, followed by me and with the help of great sages you should search for the one who has abducted Sita.

sanskrit: समुद्रं च विचेष्यामः पर्वतांश्च वनानि च।।3.65.13।। गुहाश्च विविधा घोरा नदी पद्मवनानि च।
transliteration: samudrṃ ca viceṣyāmḥ parvatāṃśca vanāni ca||3.65.13|| guhāśca vividhā ghorā nadī padmavanāni ca|
meaning: We will search oceans, mountains, forests and several dreadful caves, rivers and lotusponds.

sanskrit: देवगन्धर्वलोकांश्च विचेष्यामस्समाहिताः।।3.65.14।। यावन्नाधिगमिष्यामस्तव भार्यापहारिणम्।
transliteration: devagandharvalokāṃśca viceṣyāmassamāhitāḥ||3.65.14|| yāvannādhigamiṣyāmastava bhāryāpahāriṇam|
meaning: We will search relentlessly for the abductor of your wife everywhere including the world of gods and gandharvas till we find her.

sanskrit: न चेत्साम्ना प्रदास्यन्ति पत्नीं ते त्रिदशेश्वराः।।3.65.15।। कोसलेन्द्र ततः पश्चात्प्राप्तकालं करिष्यसि।
transliteration: na cetsāmnā pradāsyanti patnīṃ te tridaśeśvarāḥ||3.65.15|| kosalendra tatḥ paścātprāptakālṃ kariṣyasi|
meaning: O lord of Kosala when gods do not restore Sita on request, then you can think of taking action at the appropriate time.

sanskrit: शीलेन साम्ना विनयेन सीतां नयेन न प्राप्स्यसि चेन्नरेन्द्र। ततस्समुत्सादय हेमपुङ्खै र्महेन्द्रवज्रप्रतिमैश्शरौघैः।।3.65.1
transliteration: śīlena sāmnā vinayena sītāṃ nayena na prāpsyasi cennarendra| tatassamutsādaya hemapuṅkhai rmahendravajrapratimaiśśaraugh
meaning: O king if you fail to get Sita through appeasement, through humility or diplomacy then you destroy (the three worlds) by your goldtipped stream of arrows comparable to Indra's thunderbolt. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मी

sanskrit: महता तपसा राम महता चापि कर्मणा। राज्ञा दशरथेनासि लब्धोऽमृतमिवामरैः।।3.66.3।।
transliteration: mahatā tapasā rāma mahatā cāpi karmaṇā| rājñā daśarathenāsi labdho'mṛtamivāmaraiḥ||3.66.3||
meaning: O Rama king Dasaratha begot you by doing a great penance and performing great deeds, just as gods begot the nectar.

sanskrit: तव चैव गुणैर्बद्धस्त्वद्वियोगान्महीपतिः। राजा देवत्वमापन्नो भरतस्य यथाश्रुतम्।।3.66.4।।
transliteration: tava caiva guṇairbaddhastvadviyogānmahīpatiḥ| rājā devatvamāpanno bharatasya yathāśrutam||3.66.4||
meaning: King Dasaratha, impelled by your virtues, and separation from you attained godhood as heard from Bharata.

sanskrit: दुःखितो हि भवान्लोकांस्तेजसा यदि धक्ष्यते। आर्ताः प्रजा नरव्याघ्र क्व नु यास्यन्ति निर्वृतिम्।।3.66.6।।
transliteration: duḥkhito hi bhavānlokāṃstejasā yadi dhakṣyate| ārtāḥ prajā naravyāghra kva nu yāsyanti nirvṛtim||3.66.6||
meaning: O best of men if you grieve and burn the world with your brilliance, wherefrom will the (ordinary) afflicted people get relief?

sanskrit: लोकस्वभाव एवैष ययातिर्नहुषात्मजः। गतश्शक्रेण सालोक्यमनयस्तं समस्पृशत्।।3.66.7।।
transliteration: lokasvabhāva evaiṣa yayātirnahuṣātmajḥ| gataśśakreṇa sālokyamanayastṃ samaspṛśat||3.66.7||
meaning: It is the go of the world. Yayati, son of Nahusa, shared heaven with Indra but because of his curse (for his bad conduct) suffered misfortune.

sanskrit: महर्षिर्यो वसिष्ठस्तु यः पितुर्नः पुरोहितः। अह्ना पुत्रशतं जज्ञे तथैवास्य पुनर्हतम्।।3.66.8।।
transliteration: maharṣiryo vasiṣṭhastu yḥ piturnḥ purohitḥ| ahnā putraśatṃ jajñe tathaivāsya punarhatam||3.66.8||
meaning: To sage Vasistha, our father's priest, were born a hundred sons in a day.But all of them were killed in one day the same way.

sanskrit: या चेयं जगतां माता देवी लोकनमस्कृता। अस्याश्च चलनं भूमेर्दृश्यते सत्यसंश्रव।।3.66.9।।
transliteration: yā ceyṃ jagatāṃ mātā devī lokanamaskṛtā| asyāśca calanṃ bhūmerdṛśyate satyasṃśrava||3.66.9||
meaning: You (rigidly) adhere to truth.(Like you) the mother earth who is adored by all the worlds, is unshakeable. Yet she is seen to be shaking at times.

sanskrit: यौ धर्मौ जगतां नेत्रौ यत्र सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्। आदित्यचन्द्रौ ग्रहणमभ्युपेतौ महाबलौ।।3.66.10।।
transliteration: yau dharmau jagatāṃ netrau yatra sarvṃ pratiṣṭhitam| ādityacandrau grahaṇamabhyupetau mahābalau||3.66.10||
meaning: The powerful Sun and Moon, righteous entities, who are the two eyes of these worlds and on whom everything rests firmly, also suffer eclipses sometimes.

sanskrit: सुमहान्त्यपि भूतानि देवाश्च पुरुषर्षभ। न दैवस्य प्रमुञ्चन्ति सर्वभूतानि देहिनः।।3.66.11।।
transliteration: sumahāntyapi bhūtāni devāśca puruṣarṣabha| na daivasya pramuñcanti sarvabhūtāni dehinḥ||3.66.11||
meaning: O best among men Fate spares none. Great beings, every creature, even the gods cannot escape fate.

sanskrit: शक्रादिष्वपि देवेषु वर्तमानौ नयानयौ। श्रूयेते नरशार्दूल न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि।।3.66.12।।
transliteration: śakrādiṣvapi deveṣu vartamānau nayānayau| śrūyete naraśārdūla na tvṃ śocitumarhasi||3.66.12||
meaning: It is I heard that Indra and other deities are also governed by the principle of justice. Therefore, you should not bewail, O tiger among men.

sanskrit: नष्टायामपि वैदेह्यां हृतायामपि चानघ शोचितुं नार्हसे वीर यथान्यः प्राकृतस्तथा।।3.66.13।।
transliteration: naṣṭāyāmapi vaidehyāṃ hṛtāyāmapi cānagha śocituṃ nārhase vīra yathānyḥ prākṛtastathā||3.66.13||
meaning: Even if Vaidehi is killed or abducted, you should not grieve like ordinary men, O sinless hero

sanskrit: त्वव्दिधा न हि शोचन्ति सततं सत्यदर्शिनः। सुमहत्स्वपि कृच्छ्रेषु रामानिर्विण्णदर्शनाः।।3.66.14।।
transliteration: tvavdidhā na hi śocanti satatṃ satyadarśinḥ| sumahatsvapi kṛcchreṣu rāmānirviṇṇadarśanāḥ||3.66.14||
meaning: O Rama, you always see the truth. So in the face of great difficulties men like you, whose vision is not blurred, should not lose heart.

sanskrit: तत्त्वतो हि नरश्रेष्ठ बुद्ध्या समनुचिन्तय। बुध्द्या युक्ता महाप्राज्ञा विजानन्ति शुभाशुभे।।3.66.15।।
transliteration: tattvato hi naraśreṣṭha buddhyā samanucintaya| budhdyā yuktā mahāprājñā vijānanti śubhāśubhe||3.66.15||
meaning: O best among men judge the facts rightly with your intellect. The wise apply their minds and know what is right and what is wrong.

sanskrit: अदृष्टगुणदोषाणामध्रुवाणां तु कर्मणाम्। नान्तरेण क्रियां तेषां फलमिष्टं प्रवर्तते।।3.66.16।।
transliteration: adṛṣṭaguṇadoṣāṇāmadhruvāṇāṃ tu karmaṇām| nāntareṇa kriyāṃ teṣāṃ phalamiṣṭṃ pravartate||3.66.16||
meaning: Good results are not expected from the actions of persons who cannot distinguish between their virtues and vices, from those who are unstable in their deeds.

sanskrit: त्वमेव हि पुरा राम मामेवं बहुशोऽन्वशाः। अनुशिष्याद्धि को नु त्वामपि साक्षाद्बृहस्पतिः।।3.66.17।।
transliteration: tvameva hi purā rāma māmevṃ bahuśo'nvaśāḥ| anuśiṣyāddhi ko nu tvāmapi sākṣādbṛhaspatiḥ||3.66.17||
meaning: O Rama you yourself in the past have instructed me many times that way. Who can be your adviser in this matter ? You are indeed like Brihaspati.

sanskrit: बुद्धिश्च ते महाप्राज्ञ देवैरपि दुरन्वया। शोकेनाभिप्रसुप्तं ते ज्ञानं सम्बोधयाम्यहम्।।3.66.18।।
transliteration: buddhiśca te mahāprājña devairapi duranvayā| śokenābhiprasuptṃ te jñānṃ sambodhayāmyaham||3.66.18||
meaning: Even gods cannot fathom your intellect. I am only trying to rouse your wisdom your sorrow has sent to sleep.

sanskrit: दिव्यं च मानुषं च त्वमात्मनश्च पराक्रमम्। इक्ष्वाकुवृषभावेक्ष्य यतस्व द्विषतां वधे।।3.66.19।।
transliteration: divyṃ ca mānuṣṃ ca tvamātmanaśca parākramam| ikṣvākuvṛṣabhāvekṣya yatasva dviṣatāṃ vadhe||3.66.19||
meaning: O bull among the Ikshvakus, weigh your divine and human prowess before you try to kill your enemies.

sanskrit: किं तेन सर्वनाशेन कृतेन पुरुषर्षभ। तमेव त्वं रिपुं पापं विज्ञायोद्धर्तुमर्हसि।।3.66.20।।
transliteration: kiṃ tena sarvanāśena kṛtena puruṣarṣabha| tameva tvṃ ripuṃ pāpṃ vijñāyoddhartumarhasi||3.66.20||
meaning: O best among men where is the good in the destruction of all? Know your sinful enemy before you uproot him. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकेय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षट्षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtysixth sarga of A

sanskrit: सन्निगृह्य महाबाहुः प्रवृत्तं कोपमात्मनः। अवष्टभ्य धनुश्चित्रं रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।।3.67.2।।
transliteration: sannigṛhya mahābāhuḥ pravṛttṃ kopamātmanḥ| avaṣṭabhya dhanuścitrṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt||3.67.2||
meaning: Restraining his anger, the longarmed Rama leaned over his wonderful bow and spoke to Lakshmana:

sanskrit: किं करिष्यावहे वत्स क्व वा गच्छाव लक्ष्मण। केनोपायेन गच्छेयं सीतामिति विचिन्तय।।3.67.3।।
transliteration: kiṃ kariṣyāvahe vatsa kva vā gacchāva lakṣmaṇa| kenopāyena gaccheyṃ sītāmiti vicintaya||3.67.3||
meaning: O dear Lakshmana, what shall we do? Where do we go ? Think of some means by which we can reach Sita.

sanskrit: तं तथा परितापार्तं लक्ष्मणो राममब्रवीत्। इदमेव जनस्थानं त्वमन्वेषितुमर्हसि।।3.67.4।। राक्षसैर्बहुभिः कीर्णं नानाद्रुमलता
transliteration: tṃ tathā paritāpārtṃ lakṣmaṇo rāmamabravīt| idameva janasthānṃ tvamanveṣitumarhasi||3.67.4|| rākṣasairbahubhiḥ kīrṇṃ nān
meaning: Lakshmana said to Rama, afflicted with grief, It is proper for you to (first) search in this Janasthana, covered with different kinds of trees and creepers, and teeming with demons.

sanskrit: सन्तीह गिरिदुर्गाणि निर्दराः कन्दराणि च।।3.67.5।। गुहाश्च विविधा घोरा नानामृगगणाकुलाः। आवासाः किन्नराणां च गन्धर्वभवनानि
transliteration: santīha giridurgāṇi nirdarāḥ kandarāṇi ca||3.67.5|| guhāśca vividhā ghorā nānāmṛgagaṇākulāḥ| āvāsāḥ kinnarāṇāṃ ca gandha
meaning: Here are difficult mountains, caves, valleys, dreadful caves full of different animals, dwellingplaces of kinneras and mansions of gandharvas.

sanskrit: तानि युक्तो मया सार्धं त्वमन्वेषितुमर्हसि। त्वद्विधा बुद्धिसम्पन्ना महात्मानो नरर्षभ।।3.67.7।। आपत्सु न प्रकम्पन्ते वायु
transliteration: tāni yukto mayā sārdhṃ tvamanveṣitumarhasi| tvadvidhā buddhisampannā mahātmāno nararṣabha||3.67.7|| āpatsu na prakampant
meaning: Accompanied by me you should search for her in those spots. Great people endowed with wisdom do not destabilise in difficulties just as mountains are not shaken by the speed of the wind.

sanskrit: इत्युक्तस्तद्वनं सर्वं विचचार सलक्ष्मणः।।3.67.8।। क्रुद्धो रामश्शरं घोरं सन्धाय धनुषि क्षुरम्।
transliteration: ityuktastadvanṃ sarvṃ vicacāra salakṣmaṇḥ||3.67.8|| kruddho rāmaśśarṃ ghorṃ sandhāya dhanuṣi kṣuram|
meaning: Thus advised, the angry Rama fixed a sharp arrow to his bow and roamed in the forest accompanied by Lakshmana.

sanskrit: ततः पर्वतकूटाभं महाभागं द्विजोत्तमम्।।3.67.9।। ददर्श पतितं भूमौ क्षतजार्द्रं जटायुषम्।
transliteration: tatḥ parvatakūṭābhṃ mahābhāgṃ dvijottamam||3.67.9|| dadarśa patitṃ bhūmau kṣatajārdrṃ jaṭāyuṣam|
meaning: Then he saw the great Jatayu, a wonderful bird, looking like a mountain top, drenched in blood and fallen on the ground.

sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा गिरिशृङ्गाभं रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।।3.67.10।। अनेन सीता वैदेही भक्षिता नात्र संशयः।
transliteration: tṃ dṛṣṭvā giriśṛṅgābhṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt||3.67.10|| anena sītā vaidehī bhakṣitā nātra sṃśayḥ|
meaning: On seeing Jatayu looking like the peak of a mountain, Rama said to Lakshmana, There is no doubt that this bird has devoured Vaidehi.

sanskrit: गृध्ररूपमिदं रक्षो व्यक्तं भवति कानने।।3.67.11।। भक्षयित्वा विशालाक्षीमास्ते सीतां यथासुखम्। एनं वधिष्ये दीप्तास्यैर्घोर
transliteration: gṛdhrarūpamidṃ rakṣo vyaktṃ bhavati kānane||3.67.11|| bhakṣayitvā viśālākṣīmāste sītāṃ yathāsukham| enṃ vadhiṣye dīptāsy
meaning: This demon in the guise of a vulture has evidently eaten away the largeeyed Sita and is happily relaxing in the forest. With my terrific arrows with burning tips that can go straight I will kill him.

sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वाभ्यपतद्गृध्रं सन्धाय धनुषि क्षुरम्। क्रुद्धो रामस्समुद्रान्तां कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्।।3.67.13।।
transliteration: ityuktvābhyapatadgṛdhrṃ sandhāya dhanuṣi kṣuram| kruddho rāmassamudrāntāṃ kampayanniva medinīm||3.67.13||
meaning: Having siad so, Rama took his bow, fixed the sharp arrow, and aimed at the vulture. The seabound earth trembled.

sanskrit: तं दीनं दीनया वाचा सफेनं रुधिरं वमन्। अभ्यभाषत पक्षी तु रामं दशरथात्मजम्।।3.67.14।।
transliteration: tṃ dīnṃ dīnayā vācā saphenṃ rudhirṃ vaman| abhyabhāṣata pakṣī tu rāmṃ daśarathātmajam||3.67.14||
