meaning: But the vulture who was in a piteous state, vomitting foamy blood, spoke these words pathetically to Rama, son of Dasaratha:

sanskrit: यामोषधिमिवायुष्मन्नन्वेषसि महावने। सा देवी मम च प्राणा रावणेनोभयं हृतम्।।3.67.15।।
transliteration: yāmoṣadhimivāyuṣmannanveṣasi mahāvane| sā devī mama ca prāṇā rāvaṇenobhayṃ hṛtam||3.67.15||
meaning: O Longlived one she who you are searching in the forest like herbal medicine has been carried away by Ravana along with my life.

sanskrit: त्वया विरहिता देवी लक्ष्मणेन च राघव। ह्रियमाणा मया दृष्टा रावणेन बलीयसा।।3.67.16।।
transliteration: tvayā virahitā devī lakṣmaṇena ca rāghava| hriyamāṇā mayā dṛṣṭā rāvaṇena balīyasā||3.67.16||
meaning: I have seen her snatched from you and from Lakshmana and carried off by powerful Ravana.

sanskrit: सीतामभ्यवपन्नोऽहं रावणश्च रणे मया। विध्वंसितरथश्चात्र पातितो धरणीतले।।3.67.17।।
transliteration: sītāmabhyavapanno'hṃ rāvaṇaśca raṇe mayā| vidhvṃsitarathaścātra pātito dharaṇītale||3.67.17||
meaning: I descended down to protect Sita, and in the battle with Ravana his chariot destroyed fell down here on the ground.

sanskrit: एतदस्य धनुर्भग्नमेतदस्य शरावरम्। अयमस्य रथो राम भग्नसाङ्ग्रामिको मया।।3.67.18।।
transliteration: etadasya dhanurbhagnametadasya śarāvaram| ayamasya ratho rāma bhagnasāṅgrāmiko mayā||3.67.18||
meaning: O Rama this is his broken bow, this is his quiver and this is his warchariot all devastated by me.

sanskrit: अयं तु सारथिस्तस्य मत्पक्षनिहतो युधि। परिश्रान्तस्य मे पक्षौ छित्त्वा खड्गेन रावणः।।3.67.19।। सीतामादाय वैदेहीमुत्पपात व
transliteration: ayṃ tu sārathistasya matpakṣanihato yudhi| pariśrāntasya me pakṣau chittvā khaḍgena rāvaṇḥ||3.67.19|| sītāmādāya vaidehī
meaning: He is Ravana's charioteer slain by my wings in the battle. As I was exhausted in the encounter Ravana clipped my wings, took Sita, and flew into the sky. You need not kill me. I am already slain by the demon.

sanskrit: रामस्तस्य तु विज्ञाय बाष्पपूर्णमुखस्तदा। द्विगुणीकृततापार्तस्सीतासक्तां प्रियां कथाम्।।3.67.21।।
transliteration: rāmastasya tu vijñāya bāṣpapūrṇamukhastadā| dviguṇīkṛtatāpārtassītāsaktāṃ priyāṃ kathām||3.67.21||
meaning: Having known from Jatayu the story of his beloved Sita, Rama was full of tears, his grief redoubled.

sanskrit: गृध्रराजं परिष्वज्य परित्यज्य महद्धनुः। निपपातावशो भूमौ रुरोद सहलक्ष्मणः।।3.67.22।।
transliteration: gṛdhrarājṃ pariṣvajya parityajya mahaddhanuḥ| nipapātāvaśo bhūmau ruroda sahalakṣmaṇḥ||3.67.22||
meaning: Rama dropped the bow and embraced the king of birds. He fell down despondent on the ground and began crying along with Lakshmana.

sanskrit: एकमेकायने दुर्गे निश्श्वसन्तं कथञ्चन। समीक्ष्य दुःखिततरो रामस्सौमित्रिमब्रवीत्।।3.67.23।।
transliteration: ekamekāyane durge niśśvasantṃ kathañcana| samīkṣya duḥkhitataro rāmassaumitrimabravīt||3.67.23||
meaning: Rama saw Jatayu breathing with difficulty in that solitary, inaccessible place.Overcome by greater grief he said to Lakshmana:

sanskrit: राज्यं भ्रष्टं वने वासस्सीता नष्टा हतो द्विजः। ईदृशीयं ममालक्ष्मीर्निर्दहेदपि पावकम्।।3.67.24।।
transliteration: rājyṃ bhraṣṭṃ vane vāsassītā naṣṭā hato dvijḥ| īdṛśīyṃ mamālakṣmīrnirdahedapi pāvakam||3.67.24||
meaning: I have been expelled from the kingdom. I am made to stay in the forest. I have lost Sita (my beloved wife). This bird (who was my wellwisher) has been slain. Such misfortune will burn even fire.

sanskrit: सम्पूर्णमपि चेदद्य प्रविशेयं महोदधिम्। सोऽपि नूनं ममालक्ष्म्या विशुष्येत्सरितांपतिः।।3.67.25।।
transliteration: sampūrṇamapi cedadya praviśeyṃ mahodadhim| so'pi nūnṃ mamālakṣmyā viśuṣyetsaritāṃpatiḥ||3.67.25||
meaning: Now if I enter even the great sea, the lord of the rivers filled with water, it will also dry up due to my misfortune.

sanskrit: नास्त्यभाग्यतरो लोके मत्तोऽस्मिन्सचराचरे। येनेयं महती प्राप्ता मया व्यसनवागुरा।।3.67.26।।
transliteration: nāstyabhāgyataro loke matto'sminsacarācare| yeneyṃ mahatī prāptā mayā vyasanavāgurā||3.67.26||
meaning: In this world of the animate and the inanimate there is no one more unfortunate than me fallen into the trap of adversities.

sanskrit: अयं पितृवयस्यो मे गृध्रराजो जरान्वितः। शेते विनिहतो भूमौ मम भाग्यविपर्ययात्।।3.67.27।।
transliteration: ayṃ pitṛvayasyo me gṛdhrarājo jarānvitḥ| śete vinihato bhūmau mama bhāgyaviparyayāt||3.67.27||
meaning: This aged king of birds is my father's friend. To my illluck, he is struck down and is lying on the ground.

sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्त्वा बहुशो राघवस्सहलक्ष्मणः। जटायुषं च पस्पर्श पितृस्नेहं विदर्शयन्।।3.67.28।।
transliteration: ityevamuktvā bahuśo rāghavassahalakṣmaṇḥ| jaṭāyuṣṃ ca pasparśa pitṛsnehṃ vidarśayan||3.67.28||
meaning: Saying such words and showing filial affection, he caressed Jatayu repeatedly with Lakshmana.

sanskrit: निकृत्तपक्षं रुधिरावसिक्तं स गृध्रराजं परिरभ्य रामः। क्व मैथिली प्राणसमा ममेति विमुच्य वाचं निपपात भूमौ।।3.67.29।।
transliteration: nikṛttapakṣṃ rudhirāvasiktṃ sa gṛdhrarājṃ parirabhya rāmḥ| kva maithilī prāṇasamā mameti vimucya vācṃ nipapāta bhūmau||3
meaning: Rama hugged the king of vultures with servered wings, drenched in blood and asking him where Sita who was as dear to him as his life was, he dropped him and fell down on the ground. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदि

sanskrit: ममायं नूनमर्थेषु यतमानो विहङ्गमः। राक्षसेन हतस्संख्ये प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यति दुस्त्यजान्।।3.68.2।।
transliteration: mamāyṃ nūnamartheṣu yatamāno vihaṅgamḥ| rākṣasena hatassṃkhye prāṇāṃstyakṣyati dustyajān||3.68.2||
meaning: Struck down by the demon in the combat on my account this bird is going to give up his life which is indeed difficult.

sanskrit: अयमस्य शरीरेऽस्मिन्प्राणो लक्ष्मण विद्यते। तथा हि स्वरहीनोऽयं विक्लबस्समुदीक्ष्यते।।3.68.3।।
transliteration: ayamasya śarīre'sminprāṇo lakṣmaṇa vidyate| tathā hi svarahīno'yṃ viklabassamudīkṣyate||3.68.3||
meaning: O Lakshmana, it appears he is frightened and is experiencing excruciating pain in the body. His voice sounds faint, too.

sanskrit: जटायो यदि शक्नोषि वाक्यं व्याहरितुं पुनः। सीतामाख्याहि भद्रं ते वधमाख्याहि चात्मनः।।3.68.4।।
transliteration: jaṭāyo yadi śaknoṣi vākyṃ vyāharituṃ punḥ| sītāmākhyāhi bhadrṃ te vadhamākhyāhi cātmanḥ||3.68.4||
meaning: O Jatayu If you are still able to speak, tell me about Sita and about how you have been struck down.

sanskrit: किं निमित्तोऽहरत्सीतां रावणस्तस्य किं मया। अपराद्धं तु यं दृष्ट्वा रावणेन हृता प्रिया।।3.68.5।।
transliteration: kiṃ nimitto'haratsītāṃ rāvaṇastasya kiṃ mayā| aparāddhṃ tu yṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇena hṛtā priyā||3.68.5||
meaning: Why did Ravana abduct Sita? What fault did he find with me so that he kidnapped my beloved ?

sanskrit: कथं तच्चन्द्रसङ्काशं मुखमासीन्मनोहरम्। सीतया कानि चोक्तानि तस्मिन्काले द्विजोत्तम।।3.68.6।।
transliteration: kathṃ taccandrasaṅkāśṃ mukhamāsīnmanoharam| sītayā kāni coktāni tasminkāle dvijottama||3.68.6||
meaning: O best of birds how did her delightful, Moonlike face look when she was hijacked. What did she say at that time?

sanskrit: कथं वीर्यः कथं रूपः किं कर्मा स च राक्षसः। क्व चास्य भवनं तात ब्रूहि मे परिपृच्छतः।।3.68.7।।
transliteration: kathṃ vīryḥ kathṃ rūpḥ kiṃ karmā sa ca rākṣasḥ| kva cāsya bhavanṃ tāta brūhi me paripṛcchatḥ||3.68.7||
meaning: O father how powerful is that demon ? How does he look?What work does he do? Where does he dwell? Do answer my questions?

sanskrit: तमुद्वीक्ष्याथ दीनात्मा विलपन्तमनन्तरम्। वाचातिसन्नया रामं जटायुरिदमब्रवीत्।।3.68.8।।
transliteration: tamudvīkṣyātha dīnātmā vilapantamanantaram| vācātisannayā rāmṃ jaṭāyuridamabravīt||3.68.8||
meaning: Thereafter Jatayu, a piteous soul, looked up at Rama who was crying incessantly and said this in a feeble voice:

sanskrit: हृता सा राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन विहायसा। मायामास्थाय विपुलां वातदुर्दिनसङ्कुलाम्।।3.68.9।।
transliteration: hṛtā sā rākṣasendreṇa rāvaṇena vihāyasā| māyāmāsthāya vipulāṃ vātadurdinasaṅkulām||3.68.9||
meaning: Ravana, the lord of the demons created violent winds through terrific magic and whisked her away in the sky.

sanskrit: परिश्रान्तस्य मे तात पक्षौ छित्वा स राक्षसः। सीतामादाय वैदेहीं प्रयातो दक्षिणां दिशम्।।3.68.10।।
transliteration: pariśrāntasya me tāta pakṣau chitvā sa rākṣasḥ| sītāmādāya vaidehīṃ prayāto dakṣiṇāṃ diśam||3.68.10||
meaning: O my child when I was exhausted, that demon cut off my wings and carried Sita off in the southern direction.

sanskrit: उपरुध्यन्ति मे प्राणा दृष्टिर्भ्रमति राघव। पश्यामि वृक्षान्सौवर्णानुशीरकृतमूर्धजान्।।3.68.11।।
transliteration: uparudhyanti me prāṇā dṛṣṭirbhramati rāghava| paśyāmi vṛkṣānsauvarṇānuśīrakṛtamūrdhajān||3.68.11||
meaning: O scion of the Raghu race, I am gasping for breath. My eyes are reeling. I see root hair growing on the tops of golden trees.

sanskrit: येन याति मुहूर्तेन सीतामादाय रावणः। विप्रणष्टं धनं क्षिप्रं तत्स्वामी प्रतिपद्यते।।3.68.12।। विन्दो नाम मुहूर्तोऽयं स च
transliteration: yena yāti muhūrtena sītāmādāya rāvaṇḥ| vipraṇaṣṭṃ dhanṃ kṣiprṃ tatsvāmī pratipadyate||3.68.12|| vindo nāma muhūrto'yṃ sa
meaning: The time Ravana kidnapped Sita is known as 'Vinda'. The effect (of that time), is that her husband will regain his lost wealth. O scion of the Kakutstha race he (Ravana )did not know it.

sanskrit: त्वत्प्रियां जानकीं हृत्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः।।3.68.13।। झषवद्बडिशं गृह्य क्षिप्रमेव विनश्यति।
transliteration: tvatpriyāṃ jānakīṃ hṛtvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvarḥ||3.68.13|| jhaṣavadbaḍiśṃ gṛhya kṣiprameva vinaśyati|
meaning: Ravana, king of the demons, will perish soon for running away with your beloved Janaki just like a fish carrying away a fishhook (which causes its destruction).

sanskrit: न च त्वया व्यथा कार्या जनकस्य सुतां प्रति।।3.68.14।। वैदेह्या रंस्यसे क्षिप्रं हत्वा तं राक्षसं रणे।
transliteration: na ca tvayā vyathā kāryā janakasya sutāṃ prati||3.68.14|| vaidehyā rṃsyase kṣiprṃ hatvā tṃ rākṣasṃ raṇe|
meaning: You need not worry about Janaka's daughter. You will soon enjoy the company of your beloved, Vaidehi after killing that demon.

sanskrit: असम्मूढस्य गृध्रस्य रामं प्रत्यनुभाषतः।।3.68.15।। आस्यात्सुस्राव रुधिरं म्रियमाणस्य सामिषम्।
transliteration: asammūḍhasya gṛdhrasya rāmṃ pratyanubhāṣatḥ||3.68.15|| āsyātsusrāva rudhirṃ mriyamāṇasya sāmiṣam|
meaning: As he(Jatayu) was speaking to Rama with an alert mind even while dying, blood mixed with flesh started oozing from Jatayu's mouth.

sanskrit: पुत्रो विश्रवसस्साक्षाद्भ्राता वैश्रवणस्य च।।3.68.16।। इत्युक्त्वा दुर्लभान्प्राणान्मुमोच पतगेश्वरः।
transliteration: putro viśravasassākṣādbhrātā vaiśravaṇasya ca||3.68.16|| ityuktvā durlabhānprāṇānmumoca patageśvarḥ|
meaning: Ravana was Visrava's son and Vaisravana's (Kubera's) brother, said Jatayu and gave up his rare life.

sanskrit: ब्रूहि ब्रूहीति रामस्य ब्रुवाणस्य कृताञ्जलेः।।3.68.17।। त्वक्त्वा शरीरं गृध्रस्य जग्मुः प्राणा विहायसम्।
transliteration: brūhi brūhīti rāmasya bruvāṇasya kṛtāñjaleḥ||3.68.17|| tvaktvā śarīrṃ gṛdhrasya jagmuḥ prāṇā vihāyasam|
meaning: As Rama was saying to the vulture with folded palms 'Tell me, tell me'( about Ravana) the life breath of the vulture soared into the sky leaving the body.

sanskrit: स निक्षिप्य शिरो भूमौ प्रसार्य चरणौ तदा।।3.68.18।। विक्षिप्य च शरीरं स्वं पपात धरणीतले।
transliteration: sa nikṣipya śiro bhūmau prasārya caraṇau tadā||3.68.18|| vikṣipya ca śarīrṃ svṃ papāta dharaṇītale|
meaning: Then Jatayu dropped his head down, his feet thrown about, his body outstretched on earth.

sanskrit: तं गृध्रं प्रेक्ष्य ताम्राक्षं गतासुमचलोपमम्।।3.68.19।। रामस्सुबहुभिर्दुःखैर्दीनस्सौमित्रिमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: tṃ gṛdhrṃ prekṣya tāmrākṣṃ gatāsumacalopamam||3.68.19|| rāmassubahubhirduḥkhairdīnassaumitrimabravīt|
meaning: Stricken with deep grief, his eyes red (with tears) Rama saw the vulture looking like a mountain. Seeing him dead, he said to Lakshmana:

sanskrit: बहूनि रक्षसां वासे वर्षाणि वसता सुखम्।।3.68.20।। अनेन दण्डकारण्ये विशीर्णमिह पक्षिणा।
transliteration: bahūni rakṣasāṃ vāse varṣāṇi vasatā sukham||3.68.20|| anena daṇḍakāraṇye viśīrṇamiha pakṣiṇā|
meaning: Dwelling for many years happily in Dandaka forest, the abode of demons, the bird lost his life (on our account).

sanskrit: अनेकवार्षिको यस्तु चिरकालसमुत्थितः।।3.68.21।। सोऽयमद्य हतश्शेते कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः।
transliteration: anekavārṣiko yastu cirakālasamutthitḥ||3.68.21|| so'yamadya hataśśete kālo hi duratikramḥ|
meaning: This Jatayu, who lived for long years, is lying dead now. (The dictate of) destiny is inescapable.

sanskrit: पश्य लक्ष्मण गृध्रोऽयमुपकारी हतश्च मे।।3.68.22।। सीतामभ्यवपन्नो वै रावणेन बलीयसा।
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa gṛdhro'yamupakārī hataśca me||3.68.22|| sītāmabhyavapanno vai rāvaṇena balīyasā|
meaning: O Lakshmana, see this Jatayu, my benefactor, killed by the powerful Ravana while he was reaching out to help Sita.

sanskrit: गृध्रराज्यं परित्यज्य पितृपैतामहं महत्।।3.68.23।। मम हेतोरयं प्राणान्मुमोच पतगेश्वरः।
transliteration: gṛdhrarājyṃ parityajya pitṛpaitāmahṃ mahat||3.68.23|| mama hetorayṃ prāṇānmumoca patageśvarḥ|
meaning: This lord of the birds left his ancestral kingdom of viltures and gave up life for my sake.

sanskrit: सर्वत्र खलु दृश्यन्ते साधवो धर्मचारिणः।।3.68.24।। शूराश्शरण्यास्सौमित्रे तिर्यग्योनिगतेष्वपि।
transliteration: sarvatra khalu dṛśyante sādhavo dharmacāriṇḥ||3.68.24|| śūrāśśaraṇyāssaumitre tiryagyonigateṣvapi|
meaning: O Lakshmana valiant souls and protectors, being righteous and honest are found even among animals and birds.

sanskrit: सीताहरणजं दुःखं न मे सौम्य तथाविधम्।।3.68.25।। यथा विनाशे गृध्रस्य मत्कृते च परन्तप।
transliteration: sītāharaṇajṃ duḥkhṃ na me saumya tathāvidham||3.68.25|| yathā vināśe gṛdhrasya matkṛte ca parantapa|
meaning: O scorcher of enemies, O handsome Lakshmana the grief I experience due to Jatayu's death on my account is more intense than Sita's abduction.

sanskrit: राजा दशरथश्श्रीमान्यथा मम महायशाः।।3.68.26।। पूजनीयश्च मान्यश्च तथाऽयं पतगेश्वरः।
transliteration: rājā daśarathaśśrīmānyathā mama mahāyaśāḥ||3.68.26|| pūjanīyaśca mānyaśca tathā'yṃ patageśvarḥ|
meaning: This lord of the birds for me is as worthy of reverence and honour as the famous and prosperous king Dasaratha.

sanskrit: सौमित्रे हर काष्ठानि निर्मथिष्यामि पावकम्।।3.68.27।। गृध्रराजं दिधक्षामि मत्कृते निधनं गतम्।
transliteration: saumitre hara kāṣṭhāni nirmathiṣyāmi pāvakam||3.68.27|| gṛdhrarājṃ didhakṣāmi matkṛte nidhanṃ gatam|
meaning: O Saumitri fetch firewood. I shall generate fire by rubbing them and cremate the king of the birds who has laid down his life for my sake.

sanskrit: नाथं पतगलोकस्य चितामारोप्य राघव।।3.68.28।। इमं धक्ष्यामि सौमित्रे हतं रौद्रेण रक्षसा।
transliteration: nāthṃ patagalokasya citāmāropya rāghava||3.68.28|| imṃ dhakṣyāmi saumitre hatṃ raudreṇa rakṣasā|
meaning: O scion of the Raghus I will place the body of the lord of the world of birds, killed by the fierce demon, on the funeral pyre and crimate him with honour.

sanskrit: या गतिर्यज्ञशीलानामाहिताग्नेश्च या गतिः।।3.68.29।। अपरावर्तिनां या च या च भूमिप्रदायिनाम्। मया त्वं समनुज्ञातो गच्छ लोका
transliteration: yā gatiryajñaśīlānāmāhitāgneśca yā gatiḥ||3.68.29|| aparāvartināṃ yā ca yā ca bhūmipradāyinām| mayā tvṃ samanujñāto gacc
meaning: O mighty lord of the birds by my grace attain the state of those who perform sacrifices, who kindle and maintain sacrificial fires, who beat no retreat from the battlefield and who offer land in charity. Purified by my o

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा चितां दीप्तामारोप्य पतगेश्वरम्।।3.68.31।। ददाह रामो धर्मात्मा स्वबन्धुमिव दुःखितः।
transliteration: evamuktvā citāṃ dīptāmāropya patageśvaram||3.68.31|| dadāha rāmo dharmātmā svabandhumiva duḥkhitḥ|
meaning: Thus said, righteous Rama laid him on the pyre and sadly cremated the lord of the birds as one would do to his own relative.

sanskrit: रामोऽथ सहसौमित्रिर्वनं गत्वा स वीर्यवान्।।3.68.32।। स्थूलान्हत्वा महारोहीननुतस्तार तं द्विजम्।
transliteration: rāmo'tha sahasaumitrirvanṃ gatvā sa vīryavān||3.68.32|| sthūlānhatvā mahārohīnanutastāra tṃ dvijam|
meaning: Then the mighty Rama, accompanied by Saumitri, got into the forest and killed a huge deer, brought it and spread it as an offering (to the dead Jatayu).

sanskrit: रोहिमांसानि चोत्कृत्य पेशीकृत्य महायशाः।।3.68.33।। शकुनाय ददौ रामो रम्ये हरितशाद्वले।
transliteration: rohimāṃsāni cotkṛtya peśīkṛtya mahāyaśāḥ||3.68.33|| śakunāya dadau rāmo ramye haritaśādvale|
meaning: Tearing the flesh of the deer to pieces and making them into balls, the celebrated Rama laid it on a lovely, green grassy land as offering to the bird.

sanskrit: यत्तत्प्रेतस्य मर्त्यस्य कथयन्ति द्विजातयः।।3.68.34।। तत्स्वर्गगमनं तस्य पित्र्यं रामो जजाप ह।
transliteration: yattatpretasya martyasya kathayanti dvijātayḥ||3.68.34|| tatsvargagamanṃ tasya pitryṃ rāmo jajāpa ha|
meaning: Rama muttered the mantras recommended by brahmins for dead mortals as one would do for his father, to help him ascend to heaven.

sanskrit: ततो गोदावरीं गत्वा नदीं नरवरात्मजौ।।3.68.35।। उदकं चक्रतुस्तस्मै गृध्रराजाय तावुभौ।
transliteration: tato godāvarīṃ gatvā nadīṃ naravarātmajau||3.68.35|| udakṃ cakratustasmai gṛdhrarājāya tāvubhau|
meaning: Then both the princes went down to river Godavari and offered libations for the king of vultures.

sanskrit: शास्त्रदृष्टेन विधिना जले गृध्राय राघवौ।।3.68.36।। स्नात्वा तौ गृध्रराजाय उदकं चक्रतुस्तदा।
transliteration: śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā jale gṛdhrāya rāghavau||3.68.36|| snātvā tau gṛdhrarājāya udakṃ cakratustadā|
meaning: Thereafter both the scions of the Raghu dynasty bathed in water, offered libations for the king of vultures as ordained in the scriptures.

sanskrit: स गृध्रराजः कृतवान्यशस्करं सुदुष्करं कर्म रणे निपातितः। महर्षिकल्पेन च संस्कृतस्तदा जगाम पुण्यां गतिमात्मनश्शुभाम्।।3.68
transliteration: sa gṛdhrarājḥ kṛtavānyaśaskarṃ suduṣkarṃ karma raṇe nipātitḥ| maharṣikalpena ca sṃskṛtastadā jagāma puṇyāṃ gatimātmanaśś
meaning: The king of vultures had performed a very difficult and glorious feat by laying down his life fighting. Sanctified by Rama's offering as laid down in scriptures by the seers, he attained a holy, auspicious and divine sta

sanskrit: कृतोदकौ तावपि पक्षिसत्तमे स्थिरां च बुद्धिं प्रणिधाय जग्मतुः। प्रवेश्य सीताधिगमे ततो मनो वनं सुरेन्द्रविव विष्णुवासवौ।।3
transliteration: kṛtodakau tāvapi pakṣisattame sthirāṃ ca buddhiṃ praṇidhāya jagmatuḥ| praveśya sītādhigame tato mano vanṃ surendraviva v
meaning: Rama and Lakshmana, like two lords of gods, Indra and Visnu, offered libations for the great bird with their settled minds and concentrated and then entered deeper into the forest turning their attention to the search fo

sanskrit: तौ दिशं दक्षिणां गत्वा शरचापासिधारिणौ। अविप्रहतमैक्ष्वाकौ पन्थानं प्रतिपेदतुः।।3.69.2।।
transliteration: tau diśṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gatvā śaracāpāsidhāriṇau| aviprahatamaikṣvākau panthānṃ pratipedatuḥ||3.69.2||
meaning: Wielding bow, arrows and sword, both the princes of the Ikshvaku race went southward and entered an untrodden (densely wooded) tract.

sanskrit: गुल्मैर्वृक्षैश्च बहुभिर्लताभिश्च प्रवेष्टितम्। आवृतं सर्वतो दुर्गं गहनं घोरदर्शनम्।।3.69.3।।
transliteration: gulmairvṛkṣaiśca bahubhirlatābhiśca praveṣṭitam| āvṛtṃ sarvato durgṃ gahanṃ ghoradarśanam||3.69.3||
meaning: It was a dense, impenetrable and dreadful forest covered with shrubs, trees and creepers spread all over.

sanskrit: व्यतिक्रम्य तु वेगेन व्यालसिंहनिषेवितम्। सुभीमं तन्महारण्यं व्यतियातौ महाबलौ।।3.69.4।।
transliteration: vyatikramya tu vegena vyālasiṃhaniṣevitam| subhīmṃ tanmahāraṇyṃ vyatiyātau mahābalau||3.69.4||
meaning: The two mighty heroes swiftly forged through the great forest, which was an abode of serpents and lions.

sanskrit: ततः परं जनस्थानातत्रिक्रोशं गम्य राघवौ। क्रौञ्चारण्यं विविशतुर्गहनं तौ महौजसौ।।3.69.5।।
transliteration: tatḥ parṃ janasthānātatrikrośṃ gamya rāghavau| krauñcāraṇyṃ viviśaturgahanṃ tau mahaujasau||3.69.5||
meaning: Both the mighty princes of the Raghu dynasty covered a distance of three krosas from Janasthana and entered the impassable kraunchaforest.

sanskrit: नानामेघघनप्रख्यं प्रहृष्टमिव सर्वतः। नानापक्षिगणैर्युक्तं नानाव्यालमृगैर्युतम्।।3.69.6।। दिदृक्षमाणौ वैदेहीं तद्वनं तौ व
transliteration: nānāmeghaghanaprakhyṃ prahṛṣṭamiva sarvatḥ| nānāpakṣigaṇairyuktṃ nānāvyālamṛgairyutam||3.69.6|| didṛkṣamāṇau vaidehīṃ ta
meaning: Tormented due to abduction of Sita, the two princes anxious to see her searched all over the dense forest stopping here and there on the way. The thick forest looked like a conglomeration of big clouds. It was filled wit

sanskrit: ततः पूर्वेण तौ गत्वा त्रिक्रोशं भ्रातरौ तदा। क्रौञ्चारण्यमतिक्रम्य मतङ्गाश्रममन्तरा।।3.69.8।। दृष्ट्वा तु तद्वनं घोरं बह
transliteration: tatḥ pūrveṇa tau gatvā trikrośṃ bhrātarau tadā| krauñcāraṇyamatikramya mataṅgāśramamantarā||3.69.8|| dṛṣṭvā tu tadvanṃ g
meaning: Then both the sons of Dasaratha, went further east, crossed the kraunchaforest after three krosas. They saw a dreadful forest which was full of fierce animals and birds near the hermitage of sage Matanga. It was densely

sanskrit: आसाद्य तौ नरव्याघ्रौ दर्यास्तस्याविदूरतः। ददृशाते महारूपां राक्षसीं विकृताननाम्।।3.69.11।।
transliteration: āsādya tau naravyāghrau daryāstasyāvidūratḥ| dadṛśāte mahārūpāṃ rākṣasīṃ vikṛtānanām||3.69.11||
meaning: Both the princes,the best among men, reached the cave and saw a huge demoness with a disfigured face not far from the cave.

sanskrit: भयदामल्पसत्त्वानां बीभत्सां रौद्रदर्शनाम्। लम्बोदरीं तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रां करालीं परुषत्वचम्।।3.69.12।। भक्षयन्तीं मृगान्भीमा
transliteration: bhayadāmalpasattvānāṃ bībhatsāṃ raudradarśanām| lambodarīṃ tīkṣṇadṃṣṭrāṃ karālīṃ paruṣatvacam||3.69.12|| bhakṣayantīṃ mṛ
meaning: Then the two brothers saw a fearful demoness who could strike terror in the mind of the timid, an uncouth figure with huge curved skins, with a big stomach, dishevelled hair, sharp and long teeth, devouring wild animals.

sanskrit: सा समासाद्य तौ वीरौ व्रजन्तं भ्रातुरग्रतः। एहि रंस्यावहेत्युक्त्वा समालम्बत लक्ष्मणम्।।3.69.14।।
transliteration: sā samāsādya tau vīrau vrajantṃ bhrāturagratḥ| ehi rṃsyāvahetyuktvā samālambata lakṣmaṇam||3.69.14||
meaning: She came close to them, held Lakshmana who was walking ahead of his brother and said Come, let us enjoy.

sanskrit: उवाच चैनं वचनं सौमित्रिमुपगूह्य सा। अहं त्वयोमुखी नाम लब्धा ते त्वमसि प्रियः।।3.69.15।। नाथ पर्वतकूटेषु नदीनां पुलिनेषु
transliteration: uvāca cainṃ vacanṃ saumitrimupagūhya sā| ahṃ tvayomukhī nāma labdhā te tvamasi priyḥ||3.69.15|| nātha parvatakūṭeṣu nadī
meaning: Taking hold of Saumitri the demoness said 'I am Ayomukhi and I have been obtained by you. You got me, O hero, O lord For the rest of your life you will sport with me on the lofty hills and river banks.'

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु कुपितः खड्गमुद्धृत्य लक्ष्मणः। कर्णनासास्तनं तस्या निचकर्तारिसूदनः।।3.69.17।।
transliteration: evamuktastu kupitḥ khaḍgamuddhṛtya lakṣmaṇḥ| karṇanāsāstanṃ tasyā nicakartārisūdanḥ||3.69.17||
meaning: Thus addressed, Lakshmana, subduer of enemies, became angry, took out the sword and cut off her ears, nose and breasts.

sanskrit: कर्णनासे निकृत्ते तु विस्वरं सा विनद्य च। यथागतं प्रदुद्राव राक्षसी भीमदर्शना।।3.69.18।।
transliteration: karṇanāse nikṛtte tu visvarṃ sā vinadya ca| yathāgatṃ pradudrāva rākṣasī bhīmadarśanā||3.69.18||
meaning: When the ears and nose of the frightening demoness were cut off she shouted in a fierce tone and ran away in the direction she had come from.

sanskrit: तस्यां गतायां गहनं व्रजन्तौ वनमोजसा। आसेदतुरमित्रघ्नौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।।3.69.19।।
transliteration: tasyāṃ gatāyāṃ gahanṃ vrajantau vanamojasā| āsedaturamitraghnau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau||3.69.19||
meaning: The destroyers of enemies, Rama and Lakshmana of great valour went through the dense forest after she ran away.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणस्तु महातेजास्सत्त्ववान् शीलवान् शुचिः। अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं भ्रातरं दीप्ततेजसम्।।3.69.20।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇastu mahātejāssattvavān śīlavān śuciḥ| abravītprāñjalirvākyṃ bhrātarṃ dīptatejasam||3.69.20||
meaning: Lakshmana of great brilliance and power, of good conduct and pure character spoke to his highly effulgent brother with folded hands:

sanskrit: स्पन्दते च दृढं बाहुरुद्विग्नमिव मे मनः। प्रायशश्चाप्यनिष्टानि निमित्तान्युपलक्षये।।3.69.21।।
transliteration: spandate ca dṛḍhṃ bāhurudvignamiva me manḥ| prāyaśaścāpyaniṣṭāni nimittānyupalakṣaye||3.69.21||
meaning: My arm is throbbing heavily. My mind is agitated. The omens I see foretell some undesirable events.

sanskrit: तस्मात्सज्जीभवार्य त्वं कुरुष्व वचनं हितम्। ममैव हि निमित्तानि सद्यश्शंसन्ति सम्भ्रमम्।।3.69.22।।
transliteration: tasmātsajjībhavārya tvṃ kuruṣva vacanṃ hitam| mamaiva hi nimittāni sadyaśśṃsanti sambhramam||3.69.22||
meaning: O noble brother be alert. Heed my words of good advice. The bad omens I see presage perils.

sanskrit: एष वञ्चुलको नाम पक्षी परमदारुणः। आवयोर्विजयं युद्धे शंसन्निव विनर्दति।।3.69.23।।
transliteration: eṣa vañculako nāma pakṣī paramadāruṇḥ| āvayorvijayṃ yuddhe śṃsanniva vinardati||3.69.23||
meaning: This vanchulaka bird's loud and dreadful screams suggest our triumph in war.

sanskrit: तयोरन्वेषतोरेवं सर्वं तद्वनमोजसा। संजज्ञे विपुलः शब्दो प्रभञ्जन्निव तद्वनम्।।3.69.24।।
transliteration: tayoranveṣatorevṃ sarvṃ tadvanamojasā| sṃjajñe vipulḥ śabdo prabhañjanniva tadvanam||3.69.24||
meaning: As both the brothers with great prowess were searching for Sita all over, a huge sound exploded as if shattering the forest.

sanskrit: संवेष्टितमिवात्यर्थं गगनं मातरिश्वना। वनस्य तस्य शब्दोऽभूद्दिवमापूरयन्निव।।3.69.25।।
transliteration: sṃveṣṭitamivātyarthṃ gaganṃ mātariśvanā| vanasya tasya śabdo'bhūddivamāpūrayanniva||3.69.25||
meaning: It appeared as though a fierce wind rose from the forest and filled the sky.

sanskrit: तं शब्दं काङ्क्षमाणस्तु रामः कक्षे सहानुजः। ददर्श सुमहाकायं राक्षसं विपुलोदरम्।।3.69.26।।
transliteration: tṃ śabdṃ kāṅkṣamāṇastu rāmḥ kakṣe sahānujḥ| dadarśa sumahākāyṃ rākṣasṃ vipulodaram||3.69.26||
meaning: While looking for the sound, Rama with his brother saw a demon with a huge body and a big belly.

sanskrit: आसेदतुस्ततस्तत्र तावुभौ प्रमुखे स्थितम्। विवृद्धमशिरोग्रीवं कबन्धमुदरे मुखम्।।3.69.27।।
transliteration: āsedatustatastatra tāvubhau pramukhe sthitam| vivṛddhamaśirogrīvṃ kabandhamudare mukham||3.69.27||
meaning: Then both the brothers saw a very tall figure with a trunk that stood facing them. He had neither neck nor head. His face was in the stomach.

sanskrit: रोमभिर्निचितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्महागिरिमिवोछ्रितम्। नीलमेघनिभं रौद्रं मेघस्तनितनिस्वनम्।।3.69.28।।
transliteration: romabhirnicitaistīkṣṇairmahāgirimivochritam| nīlameghanibhṃ raudrṃ meghastanitanisvanam||3.69.28||
meaning: With sharp bristled hair all over the body, he was a mammoth figure who looked like a mountain resembling a dark cloud with his voice like the thunder.

sanskrit: अग्निज्वालानिकाशेन ललाटस्थेन दीप्यता। महापक्ष्मेण पिङ्गेन विपुलेनायतेन च।।3.69.29।। एकेनोरसि घोरेण नयनेनाशुदर्शिना। महाद
transliteration: agnijvālānikāśena lalāṭasthena dīpyatā| mahāpakṣmeṇa piṅgena vipulenāyatena ca||3.69.29|| ekenorasi ghoreṇa nayanenāśuda
meaning: He had a single eye that was reddishbrown in colour resembling flaming fire. It was fixed in the chest. His eyelashes glowed. He had instant vision with massive fangs in his huge mouth. He was licking his lips.

sanskrit: भक्षयन्तं महाघोरानृक्षसिंहमृगद्विपान्। घोरौ भुजौ विकुर्वाणमुभौ योजनमायतौ।।3.69.31।।
transliteration: bhakṣayantṃ mahāghorānṛkṣasiṃhamṛgadvipān| ghorau bhujau vikurvāṇamubhau yojanamāyatau||3.69.31||
meaning: The terrific demon kept eating bears, lions, deer and elephants, catching with both his arms stretching up to one yojana.

sanskrit: कराभ्यां विविधान्गृह्यऋक्षान्पक्षिगणान्मृगान्। आकर्षन्तं विकर्षन्तमनेकान्मृगयूथपान्।।3.69.32।। स्थितमावृत्य पन्थानं तयोर
transliteration: karābhyāṃ vividhāngṛhyaṛkṣānpakṣigaṇānmṛgān| ākarṣantṃ vikarṣantamanekānmṛgayūthapān||3.69.32|| sthitamāvṛtya panthānṃ t
meaning: He stood rooted there, catching bears, flocks of birds and deer with both his hands stretching up to one yojana, pulling and pushing them. (Now) he obstructed the path of the two brothers.

sanskrit: अथ तौ समभिक्रम्य क्रोशमात्रे ददर्शतुः।।3.69.33।। महान्तं दारुणं भीमं कबन्धं भुजसंवृम्। कबन्धमिव संस्थानादतिघोरप्रदर्शनम्
transliteration: atha tau samabhikramya krośamātre dadarśatuḥ||3.69.33|| mahāntṃ dāruṇṃ bhīmṃ kabandhṃ bhujasṃvṛm| kabandhamiva sṃsthānād
meaning: Then the brothers after covering one krosa (2 miles) saw a cruel, fierce, mighty monster named Kabandha looking like a trunk. He had a dreadful appearance and his arms encircled the area.

sanskrit: स महाबाहुरत्यर्थं प्रसार्य विपुलौ भुजौ। जग्राह सहितावेव राघवौ पीडयन्बलात्।।3.69.35।।
transliteration: sa mahābāhuratyarthṃ prasārya vipulau bhujau| jagrāha sahitāveva rāghavau pīḍayanbalāt||3.69.35||
meaning: The longarmed demon spread his hands and caught hold of Rama and Lakshmana together by pressing them with all his force.

sanskrit: खड्गिनौ दृढधन्वानौ तिग्मतेजोवपुर्धरौ। भ्रातरौ विवशं प्राप्तौ कृष्यमाणौ महाबलौ।।3.69.36।।
transliteration: khaḍginau dṛḍhadhanvānau tigmatejovapurdharau| bhrātarau vivaśṃ prāptau kṛṣyamāṇau mahābalau||3.69.36||
meaning: The two mighty brothers who wielded swords and strong bows and whose bodies were of fiery splendour became helpless, seized by the hands of Kabandha.

sanskrit: तत्र धैर्येण शूरस्तु राघवो नैव विव्यथे। बाल्यादनाश्रयत्वाच्च लक्ष्मणस्त्वतिविव्यथे।।3.69.37।। उवाच स विषण्णस्सन्राघवं रा
transliteration: tatra dhairyeṇa śūrastu rāghavo naiva vivyathe| bālyādanāśrayatvācca lakṣmaṇastvativivyathe||3.69.37|| uvāca sa viṣaṇṇas
meaning: Of the two heroes, Rama being courageous was not worried but Lakshmana being younger and not having as much courage, was very much concerned and depressed. He said to Rama:

sanskrit: पश्य मां वीर विवशं राक्षसस्य वशं गतम्।।3.69.38।। मयैकेन विनिर्युक्तः परिमुञ्चस्व राघव।
transliteration: paśya māṃ vīra vivaśṃ rākṣasasya vaśṃ gatam||3.69.38|| mayaikena viniryuktḥ parimuñcasva rāghava|
meaning: O heroic Rama see how helpless I am under the control of the demon. Set yourself free, leaving me alone and using me as an offering.

sanskrit: मां हि भूतबलिं दत्वा पलायस्व यथासुखम्।।3.69.39।। अधिगन्तासि वैदेहीमचिरेणेति मे मतिः।
transliteration: māṃ hi bhūtabaliṃ datvā palāyasva yathāsukham||3.69.39|| adhigantāsi vaidehīmacireṇeti me matiḥ|
meaning: Giving me to this monstor as an offering, you may run away happily. I think you will soon obtain Vaidehi.

sanskrit: प्रतिलभ्य च काकुत्स्थ पितृपैतामहीं महीम्।।3.69.40।। तत्र मां राम राज्यस्थस्स्मर्तुमर्हसि सर्वदा।
transliteration: pratilabhya ca kākutstha pitṛpaitāmahīṃ mahīm||3.69.40|| tatra māṃ rāma rājyasthassmartumarhasi sarvadā|
meaning: O scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, on getting the hereditary kingdom and ruling over it you should always remember me.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणेनैवमुक्तस्तु रामस्सौमित्रिमब्रवीत्।।3.69.41।। मा स्म त्रासं कृथा वीर न हि त्वादृग्विषीदति।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇenaivamuktastu rāmassaumitrimabravīt||3.69.41|| mā sma trāsṃ kṛthā vīra na hi tvādṛgviṣīdati|
meaning: O valiant Lakshmana, a hero like you should not get desparate. said Rama to Saumitri when he was thus entreated by Lakshmana.

sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रूरो भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।।3.69.42।। पप्रच्छ घननिर्घोषः कबन्धो दानवोत्तमः।
transliteration: etasminnantare krūro bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau||3.69.42|| papraccha ghananirghoṣḥ kabandho dānavottamḥ|
meaning: In the meanwhile the foremost of the demons, Kabandha, rumbling like thunder questioned the brothers, Rama and Lakshmana:

sanskrit: कौ युवां वृषभस्कन्धौ महाखड्गधनुर्धरौ।।3.69.43।। घोरं देशमिमं प्राप्तौ मम भक्षावुपस्थितौ।
transliteration: kau yuvāṃ vṛṣabhaskandhau mahākhaḍgadhanurdharau||3.69.43|| ghorṃ deśamimṃ prāptau mama bhakṣāvupasthitau|
meaning: Who are you with bulllike shoulders, wielding big swords, bows and arrows? By coming to this place you have become my food.

sanskrit: वदतं कार्यमिह वां किमर्थं चागतौ युवाम्।।3.69.44।। इमं देशमनुप्राप्तौ क्षुधार्तस्येह तिष्ठतः।
transliteration: vadatṃ kāryamiha vāṃ kimarthṃ cāgatau yuvām||3.69.44|| imṃ deśamanuprāptau kṣudhārtasyeha tiṣṭhatḥ|
meaning: For what purpose have you come? What work have you here ? You have come at the right time as my food, since I am hungry.

sanskrit: सबाणचापखड्गौ च तीक्ष्णशृङ्गाविवर्षभौ।।3.69.45।। ममास्यमनुसम्प्राप्तौ दुर्लभं जीवितं पुनः।
transliteration: sabāṇacāpakhaḍgau ca tīkṣṇaśṛṅgāvivarṣabhau||3.69.45|| mamāsyamanusamprāptau durlabhṃ jīvitṃ punḥ|
meaning: Holding bows, arrows and swords, looking like bulls with pointed horns you have entered my mouth. It is impossible for you to live any more.

sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कबन्धस्य दुरात्मनः।।3.69.46।। उवाच लक्ष्मणं रामो मुखेन परिशुष्यता।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanṃ śrutvā kabandhasya durātmanḥ||3.69.46|| uvāca lakṣmaṇṃ rāmo mukhena pariśuṣyatā|
meaning: On hearing the words of the evilminded Kabandha, Rama said to Lakshmana with dried up mouth:

sanskrit: कृच्छ्रात् कृच्छ्रतरं प्राप्य दारुणं सत्यविक्रमः।।3.69.47।। व्यसनं जीवितान्ताय प्राप्तमप्राप्य तां प्रियाम्।
transliteration: kṛcchrāt kṛcchratarṃ prāpya dāruṇṃ satyavikramḥ||3.69.47|| vyasanṃ jīvitāntāya prāptamaprāpya tāṃ priyām|
meaning: O Lakshmana, your valour is truth.We have gone through from one calamity to a greater one without finding the beloved Sita. Now we have landed into a terrible crisis which will put an end to our own life.

sanskrit: कालस्य सुमहद्वीर्यं सर्वभूतेषु लक्ष्मण।।3.69.48।। त्वां च मां च नरव्याघ्र व्यसनैः पश्य मोहितौ।
transliteration: kālasya sumahadvīryṃ sarvabhūteṣu lakṣmaṇa||3.69.48|| tvāṃ ca māṃ ca naravyāghra vyasanaiḥ paśya mohitau|
meaning: O tiger among men see how powerful the might of time is for all beings Just see yourself and myself afflicted wth this great calamity.

sanskrit: नातिभारोस्ति कालस्य सर्वभूतेषु लक्ष्मण।।3.69.49।। शूराश्च बलवन्तश्च कृतास्त्राश्च रणाजिरे। कालाभिपन्नास्सीदन्ति यथा वालु
transliteration: nātibhārosti kālasya sarvabhūteṣu lakṣmaṇa||3.69.49|| śūrāśca balavantaśca kṛtāstrāśca raṇājire| kālābhipannāssīdanti ya
meaning: O Lakshmana look at the power of time over all creatures There is nothing too heavy for time. Even those who know the use of arms in war, or are brave or strong enough, cannot withstand the force of time like the barrier

sanskrit: इति ब्रुवाणो दृढसत्यविक्रमो महायशा दाशरथिः प्रतापवान्। अवेक्ष्य सौमित्रिमुदग्रपौरुषं स्थिरां तदा स्वां मतिमात्मनाऽकरोत्।
transliteration: iti bruvāṇo dṛḍhasatyavikramo mahāyaśā dāśarathiḥ pratāpavān| avekṣya saumitrimudagrapauruṣṃ sthirāṃ tadā svāṃ matimātma
meaning: Firm in the strength of truth, famous and powerful Rama, son of Dasaratha, determined to act with a steadfast mind, spoke to Lakshmana of mighty manliness on seeing him. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यक

sanskrit: स गत्वा दीर्घमध्वानं नदीस्तीर्त्वा बहूदकाः। ददर्श विमलं शैलं महामेघमिवोन्नतम्।।3.7.2।।
transliteration: sa gatvā dīrghamadhvānṃ nadīstīrtvā bahūdakāḥ| dadarśa vimalṃ śailṃ mahāmeghamivonnatam||3.7.2||
meaning: After covering a long distance and crossing the river (Ganga) with plenty of water, Rama saw a huge mountain looking like a lofty cloud.

sanskrit: तत स्तदिक्ष्वाकुवरौ सन्ततं विविधैर्द्रुमैः। काननं तौ विविशतुस्सीतया सह राघवौ।।3.7.3।।
transliteration: tata stadikṣvākuvarau santatṃ vividhairdrumaiḥ| kānanṃ tau viviśatussītayā saha rāghavau||3.7.3||
meaning: Rama and Lakshmana, the best of the Ikshvaku family, accompanied by Sita entered the dense forest filled with trees all over.

sanskrit: प्रविष्टस्तु वनं घोरं बहुपुष्पफलद्रुमम्। ददर्शाश्रममेकान्ते चीरमालापरिष्कृतम्।।3.7.4।।
transliteration: praviṣṭastu vanṃ ghorṃ bahupuṣpaphaladrumam| dadarśāśramamekānte cīramālāpariṣkṛtam||3.7.4||
meaning: Entering that dreadful forest, they saw trees full of flowers and fruits, and a hermitage in a lonely place with lines of bark robes hanging.

sanskrit: तत्र तापसमासीनं मलपङ्कजटाधरम्। रामस्सुतीक्ष्णं विधिवत्तपोवृद्धमभाषत।।3.7.5।।
transliteration: tatra tāpasamāsīnṃ malapaṅkajaṭādharam| rāmassutīkṣṇṃ vidhivattapovṛddhamabhāṣata||3.7.5||
meaning: There at the hermitage was Sutikshna, an ascetic grown old with (long) penance, wearing soiled, matted locks and seated. Rama (first) addressed him as per custom.

sanskrit: रामोऽहमस्मि भगवन्भवन्तं द्रष्टुमागतः। त्वं माभिवद धर्मज्ञ महर्षे सत्यविक्रम।।3.7.6।।
transliteration: rāmo'hamasmi bhagavanbhavantṃ draṣṭumāgatḥ| tvṃ mābhivada dharmajña maharṣe satyavikrama||3.7.6||
meaning: O venerable one, I am Rama.You are a great sage, armed with truth as your prowess and a knower of dharma. I have come to see you. Could you speak to me?

sanskrit: स निरीक्ष्य ततो धीरो रामं धर्मभृतां वरम्। समाश्लिष्य च बाहुभ्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.7.7।।
transliteration: sa nirīkṣya tato dhīro rāmṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varam| samāśliṣya ca bāhubhyāmidṃ vacanamabravīt||3.7.7||
meaning: Thereafter the composed Sutikshna, looked at Rama, the best among righteous men, and embracing him with both his arms said:

sanskrit: स्वागतं ते रघुश्रेष्ठ राम सत्यभृतां वर। आश्रमोऽयं त्वयाक्रान्तस्सनाथ इव साम्प्रतम्।।3.7.8।।
transliteration: svāgatṃ te raghuśreṣṭha rāma satyabhṛtāṃ vara| āśramo'yṃ tvayākrāntassanātha iva sāmpratam||3.7.8||
meaning: O Rama, the best among the Raghavas and among the upholders of truth, you are welcome. With your presence this hermitage will have a protector now.

sanskrit: प्रतीक्षमाणस्त्वामेव नारोहेऽहं महायशः। देवलोकमितो वीर देहं त्यक्त्वा महीतले। चित्रकूटमुपादाय राज्यभ्रष्टोऽसि मे श्रुतः।।
transliteration: pratīkṣamāṇastvāmeva nārohe'hṃ mahāyaśḥ| devalokamito vīra dehṃ tyaktvā mahītale| citrakūṭamupādāya rājyabhraṣṭo'si me ś
meaning: O renowned hero, I had heard that you have come to Chitrakuta, renouncing your kingdom. I have been waiting so long to see you here. Unable to give up this body, I did not even leave the earth for heaven, the world of th

sanskrit: इहोपयातः काकुत्थ्स देवराजश्शतक्रतुः।।3.7.10।। उपागम्य च मे देवो महादेवस्सुरेश्वरः। सर्वान् लोकाञ्जितानाह मम पुण्येन कर्म
transliteration: ihopayātḥ kākutthsa devarājaśśatakratuḥ||3.7.10|| upāgamya ca me devo mahādevassureśvarḥ| sarvān lokāñjitānāha mama puṇy
meaning: O scion of the Kakutstha family, Indra, king of the gods came to me and said that by my meritorious deeds I have won all the worlds.

sanskrit: तेषु देवर्षिजुष्टेषु जितेषु तपसा मया। मत्प्रसादात्सभार्यस्त्वं विहरस्व सलक्ष्मणः।।3.7.12।।
transliteration: teṣu devarṣijuṣṭeṣu jiteṣu tapasā mayā| matprasādātsabhāryastvṃ viharasva salakṣmaṇḥ||3.7.12||
meaning: Along with your wife and Lakshmana you may roam by my grace the worlds won by me and served by divine sages like devarsi Narada.

sanskrit: तमुग्रतपसायुक्तं महर्षिं सत्यवादिनम्। प्रत्युवाचात्मवान्रामो ब्रह्माणमिव काश्यपः।।3.7.13।।
transliteration: tamugratapasāyuktṃ maharṣiṃ satyavādinam| pratyuvācātmavānrāmo brahmāṇamiva kāśyapḥ||3.7.13||
meaning: Selfpossessed Rama replied to the truthful ascetic who had performed intense penance. Just as Kasyapa would address Lord Brahma:

sanskrit: अहमेवाहरिष्यामि सर्वान् लोकान्महामुने। आवासं त्वहमिच्छामि प्रदिष्टमिह कानने।।3.7.14।।
transliteration: ahamevāhariṣyāmi sarvān lokānmahāmune| āvāsṃ tvahamicchāmi pradiṣṭamiha kānane||3.7.14||
meaning: O great sage I will win all the worlds myself. I (only) want to live in this forest. Allow me.

sanskrit: भवान्सर्वत्र कुशलस्सर्वभूतहिते रतः। आख्यातश्शरभङ्गेण गौतमेन महात्मना।।3.7.15।।
transliteration: bhavānsarvatra kuśalassarvabhūtahite ratḥ| ākhyātaśśarabhaṅgeṇa gautamena mahātmanā||3.7.15||
meaning: You are ever engaged in the welfare of all beings. I have heard this from the great sage Sarabhanga of Gautama's clan.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण महर्षिर्लोकविश्रुतः। अब्रवीन्मधुरं वाक्यं हर्षेण महताऽप्लुतः।।3.7.16।।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa maharṣirlokaviśrutḥ| abravīnmadhurṃ vākyṃ harṣeṇa mahatā'plutḥ||3.7.16||
meaning: Thus addressed by Rama, Sutikshna, the great sage, wellknown to the world was highly delighted. He (then) said these sweet words:

sanskrit: अयमेवाश्रमो राम गुणवान्रम्यतामिह। ऋषिसङ्घानुचरितस्सदा मूलफलैर्युतः।।3.7.17।।
transliteration: ayamevāśramo rāma guṇavānramyatāmiha| ṛṣisaṅghānucaritassadā mūlaphalairyutḥ||3.7.17||
meaning: O Rama this is a salubrious hermitage where hosts of sages live and which is full of roots and fruits, you may enjoy yourself here.

sanskrit: इममाश्रममागम्य मृगसङ्घा महायशः। अहत्वा प्रतिगच्छन्ति लोभयित्वाऽकुतोभयाः।।3.7.18।।
transliteration: imamāśramamāgamya mṛgasaṅghā mahāyaśḥ| ahatvā pratigacchanti lobhayitvā'kutobhayāḥ||3.7.18||
meaning: O illustrious Rama, herds of animals visit this place fearlessly, enticing the inmates and (then) go back without harming any one.

sanskrit: नान्यद्धोषं भवेदत्र मृगेभ्योऽन्यत्र विद्धि वै। तच्छृत्वा वचनं तस्य महर्षेर्लक्ष्मणाग्रजः।।3.7.19।। उवाच वचनं धीरो विकृष्
transliteration: nānyaddhoṣṃ bhavedatra mṛgebhyo'nyatra viddhi vai| tacchṛtvā vacanṃ tasya maharṣerlakṣmaṇāgrajḥ||3.7.19|| uvāca vacanṃ d
meaning: When heroic Rama heard that there was no other problem from the wild animals except their frequent incursions, he lifted his bow with an arrow and said these words:

sanskrit: तानहं सुमहाभाग मृगसङ्घान्समागतान्।।3.7.20।। हन्यां निशितधारेण शरेणाशनिवर्चसा।
transliteration: tānahṃ sumahābhāga mṛgasaṅghānsamāgatān||3.7.20|| hanyāṃ niśitadhāreṇa śareṇāśanivarcasā|
meaning: O reverend one, I will kill with a sharpedged arrow, glowing like a thunderbolt, all those herds of animals who keep coming here.

sanskrit: भवांस्तत्राभिषज्येत किंस्यात्कृच्छ्रतरं ततः।।3.7.21।। एतस्मिन्नाश्रमे वासं चिरं तु न समर्थये।
transliteration: bhavāṃstatrābhiṣajyeta kiṃsyātkṛcchratarṃ tatḥ||3.7.21|| etasminnāśrame vāsṃ cirṃ tu na samarthaye|
meaning: What can be more agonizing for you (than my killing animals). I (therefore) do not foresee our long stay in this hermitage.

sanskrit: तमेवमुक्त्वोपरमं रामस्सन्ध्यामुपागमत्।।3.7.22।। अन्वास्य पश्चिमां स्नध्यां तत्र वासमकल्पयत्। सुतीक्ष्णस्याऽश्रमे रम्ये स
transliteration: tamevamuktvoparamṃ rāmassandhyāmupāgamat||3.7.22|| anvāsya paścimāṃ snadhyāṃ tatra vāsamakalpayat| sutīkṣṇasyā'śrame ram
meaning: Rama stopped with this. And then the evening drew to a close. Offering his evening oblation, he arranged for his stay along with Sita and Lakshmana in the delightful hermitage of Sutikshna.

sanskrit: तमेवमुक्त्वोपरमं रामस्सन्ध्यामुपागमत्।।3.7.22।। अन्वास्य पश्चिमां संंध्यां तत्र वासमकल्पयत्। सुतीक्ष्णस्याश्रमे रम्ये सी
transliteration: tamevamuktvoparamṃ rāmassandhyāmupāgamat||3.7.22|| anvāsya paścimāṃ sṃṃdhyāṃ tatra vāsamakalpayat| sutīkṣṇasyāśrame ramy
meaning: Rama stopped with this. And then the evening drew to a close. Offering his evening oblation, he arranged for his stay along with Sita and Lakshmana in the delightful hermitage of Sutikshna.

sanskrit: ततश्शुभं तापसभोज्यमन्नं स्वयं सुतीक्ष्णः पुरुषर्षभाभ्याम्। ताभ्यां सुसत्कृत्य ददौ महात्मा सन्ध्यानिवृत्तौ रजनीं मवेक्ष्य
transliteration: tataśśubhṃ tāpasabhojyamannṃ svayṃ sutīkṣṇḥ puruṣarṣabhābhyām| tābhyāṃ susatkṛtya dadau mahātmā sandhyānivṛttau  rajanīṃ
meaning: Seeing that the evening had passed and night had set in, the great sage Sutikshna with due hospitality, served those best of men, food fit for ascetics. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्तमस्सर्

sanskrit: तिष्ठतः किं नु मां दृष्ट्वा क्षुधार्तं क्षत्रियर्षभौ। आहारार्थं तु सन्दिष्टौ दैवेन गतचेतसौ।।3.70.2।।
transliteration: tiṣṭhatḥ kiṃ nu māṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣudhārtṃ kṣatriyarṣabhau| āhārārthṃ tu sandiṣṭau daivena gatacetasau||3.70.2||
meaning: O bulls among the kshatriyas You are sent by destiny as food to appease my hunger. Seeing me hungry, why do you stand there with your senses switched off ?

sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं प्राप्तकालं हितं तदा। उवाचाऽर्तिं समापन्नो विक्रमे कृतलक्षणः।।3.70.3।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā lakṣmaṇo vākyṃ prāptakālṃ hitṃ tadā| uvācā'rtiṃ samāpanno vikrame kṛtalakṣaṇḥ||3.70.3||
meaning: Having heard this, Lakshmana, who was greatly suffering gathered courage at appropriate time and said these salutary words:

sanskrit: त्वां च मां च पुरा तूर्णमादत्ते राक्षसाधमः। तस्मादसिभ्यामस्याशु बाहू छिन्दावहै गुरू।।3.70.4।।
transliteration: tvāṃ ca māṃ ca purā tūrṇamādatte rākṣasādhamḥ| tasmādasibhyāmasyāśu bāhū chindāvahai gurū||3.70.4||
meaning: Before this vile demon gulps you and me let us cut off his long arms with our swords.

sanskrit: भीषणोऽयं महाकायो राक्षसो भुजविक्रमः। लोकं ह्यतिजितं कृत्वा ह्यावां हन्तुमिहेच्छति।।3.70.5।।
transliteration: bhīṣaṇo'yṃ mahākāyo rākṣaso bhujavikramḥ| lokṃ hyatijitṃ kṛtvā hyāvāṃ hantumihecchati||3.70.5||
meaning: This huge, horrible demon with the strength of his arms has conquered the world, and now intends to kill us here.

sanskrit: निश्चेष्टानां वधो राजन्कुत्सितो जगतीपतेः। क्रतुमध्योपनीतानां पशूनामिव राघव।।3.70.6।।
transliteration: niśceṣṭānāṃ vadho rājankutsito jagatīpateḥ| kratumadhyopanītānāṃ paśūnāmiva rāghava||3.70.6||
meaning: O prince of the Raghu race just as the animal brought in the midst of a sacrifice should not be killed, so also for a king to kill any harmless creature is despicable.

sanskrit: एतत्सञ्जल्पितं श्रुत्वा तयोः क्रुद्धस्तु राक्षसः। विदार्याऽस्यं तदा रौद्रस्तौ भक्षयितुमारभत्।।3.70.7।।
transliteration: etatsañjalpitṃ śrutvā tayoḥ kruddhastu rākṣasḥ| vidāryā'syṃ tadā raudrastau bhakṣayitumārabhat||3.70.7||
meaning: The cruel, ferocious demon heard them talk. He opened his mouth and attempted to eat both of them.

sanskrit: ततस्तौ देशकालज्ञौ खड्गाभ्यामेव राघवौ। अच्छिन्दतां सुसंविग्नौ बाहू तस्यांसदेशतः।।3.70.8।।
transliteration: tatastau deśakālajñau khaḍgābhyāmeva rāghavau| acchindatāṃ susṃvignau bāhū tasyāṃsadeśatḥ||3.70.8||
meaning: Then the agitated brothers, aware of time and space, quickly pulled out their swords and cut off both his arms from the shoulders.

sanskrit: दक्षिणो दक्षिणं बाहुमसक्तमसिना ततः। चिच्छेद रामो वेगेन सव्यं वीरस्तु लक्ष्मणः।।3.70.9।।
transliteration: dakṣiṇo dakṣiṇṃ bāhumasaktamasinā tatḥ| ciccheda rāmo vegena savyṃ vīrastu lakṣmaṇḥ||3.70.9||
meaning: While standing on the right, Rama cut off his right arm and the brave Lakshmana cut off the left.

sanskrit: स पपात महाबाहुश्छिन्नबाहुर्महास्वनः। खं च गां च दिशश्चैव नादयञ्जलदो यथा।।3.70.10।।
transliteration: sa papāta mahābāhuśchinnabāhurmahāsvanḥ| khṃ ca gāṃ ca diśaścaiva nādayañjalado yathā||3.70.10||
meaning: The strongarmed demon, his arms severed, rumbling like a raincloud filling the sky, the earth and the quarters, fell down.

sanskrit: स निकृत्तौ भुजौ दृष्ट्वा शोणितौघपरिप्लुतः। दीनः पप्रच्छ तौ वीरौ कौ युवामिति दानवः।।3.70.11।।
transliteration: sa nikṛttau bhujau dṛṣṭvā śoṇitaughapariplutḥ| dīnḥ papraccha tau vīrau kau yuvāmiti dānavḥ||3.70.11||
meaning: The demon with his arms amputated, drenched in a pool of blood looked pathetic and asked them, Who are you?

sanskrit: इति तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य लक्ष्मणश्शुभलक्षणः। शशंस राघवं तस्य कबन्धस्य महात्मनः।।3.70.12।।
transliteration: iti tasya bruvāṇasya lakṣmaṇaśśubhalakṣaṇḥ| śaśṃsa rāghavṃ tasya kabandhasya mahātmanḥ||3.70.12||
meaning: Imbued with auspicious signs, Lakshmana revealed the identity of Rama to great Kabandha.

sanskrit: अयमिक्ष्वाकुदायादो रामो नाम जनैश्श्रुतः। अस्यैवावरजं विद्दि भ्रातरं मां च लक्ष्मणम्।।3.70.13।।
transliteration: ayamikṣvākudāyādo rāmo nāma janaiśśrutḥ| asyaivāvarajṃ viddi bhrātarṃ māṃ ca lakṣmaṇam||3.70.13||
meaning: Here is Rama, an heir of the Ikshvaku family, known to the people and I am his younger brother Lakshmana for your information.

sanskrit: अस्य देवप्रभावस्य वसतो विजने वने। रक्षसाऽपहृता पत्नी यामिच्छन्ताविहागतौ।।3.70.14।।
transliteration: asya devaprabhāvasya vasato vijane vane| rakṣasā'pahṛtā patnī yāmicchantāvihāgatau||3.70.14||
meaning: He is equal to a god in prowess. While living in this desolate forest his wife has been carried off by a demon. We both came here searching for her.

sanskrit: त्वं तु को वा किमर्थं वा कबन्धसदृशो वने। आस्येनोरसि दीप्तेन भग्नजङ्घो विचेष्टसे।।3.70.15।।
transliteration: tvṃ tu ko vā kimarthṃ vā kabandhasadṛśo vane| āsyenorasi dīptena bhagnajaṅgho viceṣṭase||3.70.15||
meaning: Who are you with only the trunk of the body, and a glittering mouth in the chest with your calf muscles broken rolling down in the forest?

sanskrit: एवमुक्तः कबन्धस्तु लक्ष्मणेनोत्तरं वचः। उवाच परमप्रीत स्तदिन्द्रवचनं स्मरन्।।3.70.16।।
transliteration: evamuktḥ kabandhastu lakṣmaṇenottarṃ vacḥ| uvāca paramaprīta stadindravacanṃ smaran||3.70.16||
meaning: While hearing Lakshmana, Kabandha, reminded of Indra's words, replied to him in great joy :

sanskrit: स्वागतं वां नरव्याघ्रौ दिष्ट्या पश्यामि चाप्यहम्। दिष्ट्या चेमौ निकृत्तौ मे युवाभ्यां बाहुबन्धनौ।।3.70.17।।
transliteration: svāgatṃ vāṃ naravyāghrau diṣṭyā paśyāmi cāpyaham| diṣṭyā cemau nikṛttau me yuvābhyāṃ bāhubandhanau||3.70.17||
meaning: O tigers among men you are welcome. It is my good luck that I am able to see you. It is my good luck also that the arms that bound you have been amputated.

sanskrit: विरूपं यच्च मे रूपं प्राप्तं ह्यविनयाद्यथा। तन्मे शृणु नरव्याघ्र तत्त्वतश्शंसतस्तव।।3.70.18।।
transliteration: virūpṃ yacca me rūpṃ prāptṃ hyavinayādyathā| tanme śṛṇu naravyāghra tattvataśśṃsatastava||3.70.18||
meaning: O best among men hear how I have been deformed due to my haughtiness. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventieth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first

sanskrit: सोऽहं रूपमिदं कृत्वा लोकवित्रासनं महत्।।3.71.2।। ऋषीन्वनगतान्राम त्रासयामि ततस्ततः।
transliteration: so'hṃ rūpamidṃ kṛtvā lokavitrāsanṃ mahat||3.71.2|| ṛṣīnvanagatānrāma trāsayāmi tatastatḥ|
meaning: With my appearance, I was a great nuisance to the world and used to terrorise the sages living in the forest.

sanskrit: ततस्स्थूलशिरा नाम महर्षिः कोपितो मया।।3.71.3।। सञ्चिन्वन्विविधं वन्यं रूपेणानेन धर्षितः।
transliteration: tatassthūlaśirā nāma maharṣiḥ kopito mayā||3.71.3|| sañcinvanvividhṃ vanyṃ rūpeṇānena dharṣitḥ|
meaning: With my appearance I invited the wrath of Sthulasira who I assaulted among the many seers, while he was collecting food in the forest.

sanskrit: तेनाहमुक्तः प्रेक्ष्यैवं घोरशापाभिधायिना।।3.71.4।। एतदेव नृशंसं ते रूपमस्तु विगर्हितम्।
transliteration: tenāhamuktḥ prekṣyaivṃ ghoraśāpābhidhāyinā||3.71.4|| etadeva nṛśṃsṃ te rūpamastu vigarhitam|
meaning: Seeing me he pronounced a dreadful curse on me saying, 'You will get a cruel, despicable form.'

sanskrit: स मया याचितः क्रुद्धश्शापस्योन्तो भवेदिति।।3.71.5।। अभिशापकृतस्येति तेनेदं भाषितं वचः।
transliteration: sa mayā yācitḥ kruddhaśśāpasyonto bhavediti||3.71.5|| abhiśāpakṛtasyeti tenedṃ bhāṣitṃ vacḥ|
meaning: When I sought to know how the curse angrily pronounced on me would come to an end, he said:

sanskrit: यदा छित्त्वा भुजौ रामस्त्वां दहेद्विजने वने।।3.71.6।। तदा त्वं प्राप्स्यसे रूपं स्वमेव विपुलं शुभम्।
transliteration: yadā chittvā bhujau rāmastvāṃ dahedvijane vane||3.71.6|| tadā tvṃ prāpsyase rūpṃ svameva vipulṃ śubham|
meaning: 'When Rama gets your arms in a desolate forest amputated and your body cremated, you would get back your gloriously auspicious form.'

sanskrit: श्रिया विराजितं पुत्रं दनोस्त्वं विद्धि लक्ष्मण।।3.71.7।। इन्द्रकोपादिदं रूपं प्राप्तमेवं रणाजिरे।
transliteration: śriyā virājitṃ putrṃ danostvṃ viddhi lakṣmaṇa||3.71.7|| indrakopādidṃ rūpṃ prāptamevṃ raṇājire|
meaning: O Lakshmana know that I was the prosperous son of demon Danu. By the wrath of Indra in the battlefeild I obtained this form.

sanskrit: अहं हि तपसोग्रेण पितामहमतोषयम्।।3.71.8।। दीर्घमायुस्स मे प्रादात्ततो मां विभ्रमोऽस्पृशत्।
transliteration: ahṃ hi tapasogreṇa pitāmahamatoṣayam||3.71.8|| dīrghamāyussa me prādāttato māṃ vibhramo'spṛśat|
meaning: I pleased the creator Brahma with great penance. He blessed me with long life. Then this pride and confusion overtook me.

sanskrit: दीर्घमायुर्मया प्राप्तं किं मे शक्रः करिष्यति।।3.71.9।। इत्येवं बुद्धिमास्थाय रणे शक्रमधर्षयम्।
transliteration: dīrghamāyurmayā prāptṃ kiṃ me śakrḥ kariṣyati||3.71.9|| ityevṃ buddhimāsthāya raṇe śakramadharṣayam|
meaning: Having been blessed with long life and thinking, what can Indra do to me?, I attacked him.

sanskrit: तस्य बाहुप्रयुक्तेन वज्रेण शतपर्वणा।।3.71.10।। सक्थिनी चैव मूर्धा च शरीरे सम्प्रवेशितम्।
transliteration: tasya bāhuprayuktena vajreṇa śataparvaṇā||3.71.10|| sakthinī caiva mūrdhā ca śarīre sampraveśitam|
meaning: The thunderbolt having a hundred nodes deployed by Indra pierced my thighs and my head.

sanskrit: स मया याच्यमानस्सन्नानयद्यमसादनम्।।3.71.11।। पितामहवचस्सत्यं तदस्त्विति ममाब्रवीत्।
transliteration: sa mayā yācyamānassannānayadyamasādanam||3.71.11|| pitāmahavacassatyṃ tadastviti mamābravīt|
meaning: Entreated, he did not send me to the abode of Yama ( lord of death) and said, 'Let the words of the creator be true' .

sanskrit: अनाहारः कथं शक्तो भग्नसक्थिशिरोमुखः।।3.71.12।। वज्रेणाभिहतः कालं सुदीर्घमपि जीवितुम्।
transliteration: anāhārḥ kathṃ śakto bhagnasakthiśiromukhḥ||3.71.12|| vajreṇābhihatḥ kālṃ sudīrghamapi jīvitum|
meaning: Hit by the thunderbolt, my thighbones, head and face were broken. Somehow I could manage to live for a long time without food.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु मे शक्रो बाहू योजनमायतौ।।3.71.13।। प्रादादास्यं च मे कुक्षौ तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रमकल्पयत्।
transliteration: evamuktastu me śakro bāhū yojanamāyatau||3.71.13|| prādādāsyṃ ca me kukṣau tīkṣṇadṃṣṭramakalpayat|
meaning: Having been entreated, Indra created in me two long arms extending upto a yojana and set my mouth with sharp teeth in the stomach.

sanskrit: सोऽहं भुजाभ्यां दीर्घाभ्यां संकृष्यास्मिन्वने चरान्।।3.71.14।। सिंहव्दिपमृगव्याघ्रान् भक्षयामि समन्ततः।
transliteration: so'hṃ bhujābhyāṃ dīrghābhyāṃ sṃkṛṣyāsminvane carān||3.71.14|| siṃhavdipamṛgavyāghrān bhakṣayāmi samantatḥ|
meaning: Stretching the long arms in the forest, I dragged creatures like lions, tigers, elephants and deer moving in the forest and ate them.

sanskrit: स तु मामब्रवीदिन्द्रो यदा रामस्सलक्ष्मणः।।3.71.15।। छेत्स्यते समरे बाहू तदा स्वर्गं गमिष्यसि।
transliteration: sa tu māmabravīdindro yadā rāmassalakṣmaṇḥ||3.71.15|| chetsyate samare bāhū tadā svargṃ gamiṣyasi|
meaning: Indra too had said, 'When Rama along with Lakshmana cuts off your arms in a fight, you would reach heaven.'

sanskrit: अनेन वपुषा राम वनेऽस्मिन्राजसत्तम।।3.71.16।। यद्यत्पश्यामि सर्वस्य ग्रहणं साधु रोचये।
transliteration: anena vapuṣā rāma vane'sminrājasattama||3.71.16|| yadyatpaśyāmi sarvasya grahaṇṃ sādhu rocaye|
meaning: O Rama, the best of kings I thought it was only proper in this forest and with this body to catch whatever creature I saw.

sanskrit: अवश्यं ग्रहणं रामो मन्येऽहं समुपैष्यति।।3.71.17।। इमां बुद्धिं पुरस्कृत्य देहन्यासकृतश्रमः।
transliteration: avaśyṃ grahaṇṃ rāmo manye'hṃ samupaiṣyati||3.71.17|| imāṃ buddhiṃ puraskṛtya dehanyāsakṛtaśramḥ|
meaning: O Rama, I was struggling to preserve my body all the time thinking that some day you would certainly come into my arms.

sanskrit: स त्वं रामोऽसि भद्रं ते नाहमन्येन राघव।।3.71.18।। शक्यो हन्तुं यथातत्त्वमेवमुक्तं महर्षिणा।
transliteration: sa tvṃ rāmo'si bhadrṃ te nāhamanyena rāghava||3.71.18|| śakyo hantuṃ yathātattvamevamuktṃ maharṣiṇā|
meaning: You are that Rama. Be blessed. As stated by the seer I cannot be really killed by any one except you.

sanskrit: अहं हि मतिसाचिव्यं करिष्यामि नरर्षभ।।3.71.19।। मित्रं चैवोपदेक्ष्यामि युवाभ्यां संस्कृतोऽग्निना।
transliteration: ahṃ hi matisācivyṃ kariṣyāmi nararṣabha||3.71.19|| mitrṃ caivopadekṣyāmi yuvābhyāṃ sṃskṛto'gninā|
meaning: O best among men I will help you with my wisdom and give you friendly advice when I am purified by you both through cremation on the funeral pyre.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा दनुना तेन राघवः।।3.71.20।। इदं जगाद वचनं लक्ष्मणस्योपशृण्वतः।
transliteration: evamuktastu dharmātmā danunā tena rāghavḥ||3.71.20|| idṃ jagāda vacanṃ lakṣmaṇasyopaśṛṇvatḥ|
meaning: Rigteous Rama spoke the following words in response to the story of Danu within Lakshmana's earshot:

sanskrit: रावणेन हृता भार्या मम सीता यशस्स्विनी।।3.71.21।। निष्क्रान्तस्य जनस्थानात्सहभ्रात्रा यथासुखम्।
transliteration: rāvaṇena hṛtā bhāryā mama sītā yaśassvinī||3.71.21|| niṣkrāntasya janasthānātsahabhrātrā yathāsukham|
meaning: My illlustrious wife Sita was carried away by Ravana comfortably when I was away from Janasthana along with my brother.

sanskrit: नाममात्रं तु जानामि न रूपं तस्य रक्षसः।।3.71.22।। निवासं वा प्रभावं वा वयं तस्य न विद्महे।
transliteration: nāmamātrṃ tu jānāmi na rūpṃ tasya rakṣasḥ||3.71.22|| nivāsṃ vā prabhāvṃ vā vayṃ tasya na vidmahe|
meaning: I only know his name. We do not know how he looks, where he lives and what influence he has.

sanskrit: शोकार्तानामनाथानामेवं विपरिधावताम्।।3.71.23।। कारुण्यं सदृशं कर्तुमुपकारे च वर्तताम्।
transliteration: śokārtānāmanāthānāmevṃ viparidhāvatām||3.71.23|| kāruṇyṃ sadṛśṃ kartumupakāre ca vartatām|
meaning: Creatures like you may help those who, like orphans, run here and there, stricken with sorrow.

sanskrit: काष्ठान्यादाय शुष्काणि काले भग्नानि कुञ्जरैः।।3.71.24।। धक्ष्यामस्त्वां वयं वीर श्वभ्रे महति कल्पिते।
transliteration: kāṣṭhānyādāya śuṣkāṇi kāle bhagnāni kuñjaraiḥ||3.71.24|| dhakṣyāmastvāṃ vayṃ vīra śvabhre mahati kalpite|
meaning: O hero we will cremate you in a huge pit to be prepared for this occasion, collecting dry logs of wood broken by elephants.

sanskrit: स त्वं सीतां समाचक्ष्व येन वा यत्र वा हृता।।3.71.25।। कुरु कल्याणमत्यर्थं यदि जानासि तत्त्वतः।
transliteration: sa tvṃ sītāṃ samācakṣva yena vā yatra vā hṛtā||3.71.25|| kuru kalyāṇamatyarthṃ yadi jānāsi tattvatḥ|
meaning: If you really know where SIta has been kidnapped and by whom, tell me. You will be doing a great service.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण वाक्यं दनुरनुत्तमम्।।3.71.26।। प्रोवाच कुशलो वक्तुं वक्तारमपि राघवम्।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa vākyṃ danuranuttamam||3.71.26|| provāca kuśalo vaktuṃ vaktāramapi rāghavam|
meaning: Danu who was proficient in speech spoke with chosen words to Rama who was a great speaker himself:

sanskrit: दिव्यमस्ति न मे ज्ञानं नाभिजानामि मैथिलीम्।।3.71.27।। यस्तां ज्ञास्यति तं वक्ष्ये दग्धस्स्वं रूपमास्थितः।
transliteration: divyamasti na me jñānṃ nābhijānāmi maithilīm||3.71.27|| yastāṃ jñāsyati tṃ vakṣye dagdhassvṃ rūpamāsthitḥ|
meaning: I do not have divine wisdom (now). Nor do I know Sita. When you cremate me, I shall assume my original form and will tell you the name of the person who knows it.

sanskrit: अदग्धस्य तु विज्ञातुं शक्तिरस्ति न मे प्रभो।।3.71.28।। राक्षसं तं महावीर्यं सीता येन हृता तव।
transliteration: adagdhasya tu vijñātuṃ śaktirasti na me prabho||3.71.28|| rākṣasṃ tṃ mahāvīryṃ sītā yena hṛtā tava|
meaning: O lord before I am cremated, I do not have the ability to know about that powerful demon by whom Sita has been abducted.

sanskrit: विज्ञानं हि मम भ्रष्टं शापदोषेण राघव।।3.71.29।। स्वकृतेन मया प्राप्तं रूपं लोकविगर्हितम्।
transliteration: vijñānṃ hi mama bhraṣṭṃ śāpadoṣeṇa rāghava||3.71.29|| svakṛtena mayā prāptṃ rūpṃ lokavigarhitam|
meaning: O Rama due to the curse I have lost my wisdom. By my own deed, I have attained this form despicable to the world.

sanskrit: किं तु यावन्न यात्यस्तं सविता श्रान्तवाहनः।।3.71.30।। तावन्मामवटे क्षिप्त्वा दह राम यथाविधि।
transliteration: kiṃ tu yāvanna yātyastṃ savitā śrāntavāhanḥ||3.71.30|| tāvanmāmavaṭe kṣiptvā daha rāma yathāvidhi|
meaning: Before the Sun disappears with his tired horses drop me into a pit and cremate me in accordance with tradition, O Rama

sanskrit: दग्धस्त्वयाहमवटे न्यायेन रघुनन्धन।।3.71.31।। वक्ष्यामि तमहं वीर यस्तं ज्ञास्यति राक्षसम्।
transliteration: dagdhastvayāhamavaṭe nyāyena raghunandhana||3.71.31|| vakṣyāmi tamahṃ vīra yastṃ jñāsyati rākṣasam|
meaning: O heroic Rama, delight of the Raghus, if you drop me in a pit and cremate me as per custom, I will tell you about him who knows the demon.

sanskrit: तेन सख्यं च कर्तव्यं न्याय्यवृत्तेन राघव।।3.71.32।। कल्पयिष्यति ते प्रीतस्साहाय्यं लघुविक्रमः।
transliteration: tena sakhyṃ ca kartavyṃ nyāyyavṛttena rāghava||3.71.32|| kalpayiṣyati te prītassāhāyyṃ laghuvikramḥ|
meaning: O Rama you should establish friendship with him in a just manner. That hero of swift action will help you when he is pleased.

sanskrit: न हि तस्यास्त्यविज्ञातं त्रिषु लेकेषु राघव।।3.71.33।। सर्वान्परिसृतो लोकान्पुरासौ कारणान्तरे।
transliteration: na hi tasyāstyavijñātṃ triṣu lekeṣu rāghava||3.71.33|| sarvānparisṛto lokānpurāsau kāraṇāntare|
meaning: O Rama, there is nothing that he does not know in the three worlds. In the past for a different reason he roamed all the (three) worlds. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकसप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus en

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणस्तु महोल्काभिर्ज्वलिताभिस्समन्ततः। चितामादीपयामास सा प्रजज्वाल सर्वतः।।3.72.2।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇastu maholkābhirjvalitābhissamantatḥ| citāmādīpayāmāsa sā prajajvāla sarvatḥ||3.72.2||
meaning: Lakshmana lit the pyre with big meteorlike logs on all sides and it burned.

sanskrit: तच्छरीरं कबन्धस्य घृतपिण्डोपमं महत्। मेदसा पच्यमानस्य मन्दं दहति पावकः।।3.72.3।।
transliteration: taccharīrṃ kabandhasya ghṛtapiṇḍopamṃ mahat| medasā pacyamānasya mandṃ dahati pāvakḥ||3.72.3||
meaning: As the flesh of Kabandha's body decomposed, if burnt slowly in the fire although it was like a huge mass of fat.

sanskrit: स विधूय चितामाशु विधूमोऽग्निरिवोत्थितः। अरजे वाससी बिभ्रन्मालां दिव्यां महाबलः।।3.72.4।।
transliteration: sa vidhūya citāmāśu vidhūmo'gnirivotthitḥ| araje vāsasī bibhranmālāṃ divyāṃ mahābalḥ||3.72.4||
meaning: Mighty Kabandha shook himself off the funeral pyre and rose like smokeless fire, wearing a pair of clean clothes and a divine garland.

sanskrit: ततश्चिताया वेगेन भास्वरो विमलाम्बरः। उत्पपाताशु संहृष्टस्सर्वप्रत्यङ्गभूषणः।।3.72.5।।
transliteration: tataścitāyā vegena bhāsvaro vimalāmbarḥ| utpapātāśu sṃhṛṣṭassarvapratyaṅgabhūṣaṇḥ||3.72.5||
meaning: Thereafter shining brightly in pure clothes and wearing ornaments all over the body, Kabandha hurtled out happily and instantaneously from the pyre.

sanskrit: विमाने भास्वरे तिष्ठन्हंसयुक्ते यशस्करे। प्रभया च महातेजा दिशो दश विराजयन्।।3.72.6।। सोऽन्तरिक्षगतो रामं कबन्धो वाक्यमब्
transliteration: vimāne bhāsvare tiṣṭhanhṃsayukte yaśaskare| prabhayā ca mahātejā diśo daśa virājayan||3.72.6|| so'ntarikṣagato rāmṃ kaba
meaning: The effulgent Kabandha rose into the sky on a famous aerial chariot harnessed to swans. Seated on it, he illuminated all ten directions and spoke from the sky,'O Raghava I will truly tell you how you will get Sita, liste

sanskrit: राम षड्युक्तयो लोके याभिस्सर्वं विमृश्यते। परिमृष्टो दशान्तेन दशाभागेन सेव्यते।।3.72.8।।
transliteration: rāma ṣaḍyuktayo loke yābhissarvṃ vimṛśyate| parimṛṣṭo daśāntena daśābhāgena sevyate||3.72.8||
meaning: O Rama there are six expedients (peace,war,marching,neutrality, alliance, making peace with one and waging war with another, for attaining your goal in the world. Only the unlucky can help the unfortunate.

sanskrit: दशाभागगतो हीनस्त्वं हि राम सलक्ष्मणः। यत्कृते व्यसनं प्राप्तं त्वया दारप्रधर्षणम्।।।3.72.9।।
transliteration: daśābhāgagato hīnastvṃ hi rāma salakṣmaṇḥ| yatkṛte vyasanṃ prāptṃ tvayā dārapradharṣaṇam|||3.72.9||
meaning: Along with Lakshmna you are passing through a bad period on account of which your wife has been kidnapped and you, lying low, are experiencing great grief, O Rama

sanskrit: तदवश्यं त्वया कार्यस्ससुहृत्सुहृदां वर। अकृत्वा हि न ते सिद्धिमहं पश्यामि चिन्तयन्।।3.72.10।।
transliteration: tadavaśyṃ tvayā kāryassasuhṛtsuhṛdāṃ vara| akṛtvā hi na te siddhimahṃ paśyāmi cintayan||3.72.10||
meaning: O Rama, the best of friends you should certainly make friendship with him. As I think over the matter, I do not see any success if you do not adopt this method.

sanskrit: श्रूयतां राम वक्ष्यामि सुग्रीवो नाम वानरः। भ्रात्रा निरस्तः क्रुद्धेन वालिना शक्रसूनुना।।3.72.11।।
transliteration: śrūyatāṃ rāma vakṣyāmi sugrīvo nāma vānarḥ| bhrātrā nirastḥ kruddhena vālinā śakrasūnunā||3.72.11||
meaning: O Rama, listen. I shall tell you. A monkey named Sugriva has been banished from the kingdom in a fit of anger by his brother Vali, the son of Indra.

sanskrit: ऋश्यमूके गिरिवरे पम्पापर्यन्तशोभिते। निवसत्यात्मवान्वीरश्चतुर्भिस्सह वानरैः।।3.72.12।।
transliteration: ṛśyamūke girivare pampāparyantaśobhite| nivasatyātmavānvīraścaturbhissaha vānaraiḥ||3.72.12||
meaning: A hero of great selfrespect, he lives with four monkeys on a beautiful mountain Rishyamuka extending up to lake Pampa.

sanskrit: वानरेन्द्रो महावीर्यस्तेजोवानमितप्रभः। सत्यसन्धो विनीतश्च धृतिमान्मतिमान्महान्।।3.72.13।।
transliteration: vānarendro mahāvīryastejovānamitaprabhḥ| satyasandho vinītaśca dhṛtimānmatimānmahān||3.72.13||
meaning: This king of monkeys is energetic with great strength and limitless lustre. He is humble and truthful, valiant, patient and intelligent. He is great.

sanskrit: दक्षः प्रगल्भो द्युतिमान्महाबलपराक्रमः। भ्रात्रा विवासितो राम राज्यहेतोर्महाबलः।।3.72.14।।
transliteration: dakṣḥ pragalbho dyutimānmahābalaparākramḥ| bhrātrā vivāsito rāma rājyahetormahābalḥ||3.72.14||
meaning: He is efficient, eloquent, brilliant. He is mighty and strong. (But) he is banished by his brother from the kingdom, O Rama

sanskrit: स ते सहायो मित्रं च सीतायाः परिमार्गणे। भविष्यति हिते राम मा च शोके मनः कृथाः।।3.72.15।।
transliteration: sa te sahāyo mitrṃ ca sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇe| bhaviṣyati hite rāma mā ca śoke manḥ kṛthāḥ||3.72.15||
meaning: O Rama he will help you as a benevolent friend in searching out Sita. Do not indulge in sorrow.

sanskrit: भवितव्यं हि यच्चापि न तच्छक्यमिहान्यथा। कर्तुमिक्ष्वाकुशार्दूल कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः।।3.72.16।।
transliteration: bhavitavyṃ hi yaccāpi na tacchakyamihānyathā| kartumikṣvākuśārdūla kālo hi duratikramḥ||3.72.16||
meaning: O best of the Ikshvaku race whatever is due to happen cannot be otherwise. It is not possible to transgress time (fate).

sanskrit: गच्छ श्रीघ्रमितो राम सुग्रीवं तं महाबलम्। वयस्यं तं कुरु क्षिप्रमितो गत्वाऽद्य राघव।।3.72.17।। अद्रोहाय समागम्य दीप्यमान
transliteration: gaccha śrīghramito rāma sugrīvṃ tṃ mahābalam| vayasyṃ tṃ kuru kṣipramito gatvā'dya rāghava||3.72.17|| adrohāya samāgamya
meaning: O Rama, immediately proceed today from here to mighty Sugriva. Having reached him, make him your friend without malice in the presence of burning fire.

sanskrit: स च ते नावमन्तव्यस्सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः।।3.72.18।। कृतज्ञः कामरूपी च सहायार्थी च वीर्यवान्।
transliteration: sa ca te nāvamantavyassugrīvo vānarādhipḥ||3.72.18|| kṛtajñḥ kāmarūpī ca sahāyārthī ca vīryavān|
meaning: Thinking that Sugriva is only a vanara king, he should not be disrespected. He has a sense of gratitude. He can take any form at will. He is in need of your help although he is very strong.

sanskrit: शक्तौह्यद्य युवां कर्तुं कार्यं तस्य चिकीर्षितम्।।3.72.19।। कृतार्थो वाऽकृतार्थो वा कृत्यं तव करिष्यति।
transliteration: śaktauhyadya yuvāṃ kartuṃ kāryṃ tasya cikīrṣitam||3.72.19|| kṛtārtho vā'kṛtārtho vā kṛtyṃ tava kariṣyati|
meaning: You are both young and able to do the work he wants. Whether his work is done or not, he will fulfil your task.

sanskrit: स ऋक्षरजसः पुत्रः पम्पामटति शङ्कितः।।.3.72.20।। भास्करस्यौरसः पुत्रो वालिना कृतकिल्बिषः।
transliteration: sa ṛkṣarajasḥ putrḥ pampāmaṭati śaṅkitḥ||.3.72.20|| bhāskarasyaurasḥ putro vālinā kṛtakilbiṣḥ|
meaning: Born of Riksharaja, he is the offspring of the Sungod. He has developed enmity with Vali, and is roaming about the banks of Pampa, suspecting danger from Vali.

sanskrit: सन्निधायायुधं क्षिप्रमृष्यमूकालयं कपिम्।।3.72.21।। कुरु राघव सत्येन वयस्यं वनचारिणम्।
transliteration: sannidhāyāyudhṃ kṣipramṛṣyamūkālayṃ kapim||3.72.21|| kuru rāghava satyena vayasyṃ vanacāriṇam|
meaning: O Rama, with your weapons kept ready, go to Sugriva, king of the monkeys, a resident of Rishyamuka. He is wandering in the forest. Establish friendship with him.

sanskrit: स हि स्थानानि सर्वाणि कार्त्स्न्येन कपिकुञ्जरः।।3.72.22।। नरमांसाशिनां लोके नैपुण्यादधिगच्छति।
transliteration: sa hi sthānāni sarvāṇi kārtsnyena kapikuñjarḥ||3.72.22|| naramāṃsāśināṃ loke naipuṇyādadhigacchati|
meaning: He is the foremost of the monkeys. He knows well by his wisdom all the dwellingplaces of the carnivorous demons in the world.

sanskrit: न तस्याविदितं लोकेकिञ्चिदस्ति हि राघव।।3.72.23।। यावत्सूर्यः प्रतपति सहस्रांशुररिन्दम।
transliteration: na tasyāviditṃ lokekiñcidasti hi rāghava||3.72.23|| yāvatsūryḥ pratapati sahasrāṃśurarindama|
meaning: There is nothing unknown to Sugriva in this world as far as the Sun shines, O subduer of enemies

sanskrit: स नदीर्विपुलान्शैलान् गिरिदुर्गाणि कन्दरान्।।3.72.24।। अन्वीक्ष्य वानरैस्सार्धं पत्नीं तेऽधिगमिष्यति।
transliteration: sa nadīrvipulānśailān giridurgāṇi kandarān||3.72.24|| anvīkṣya vānaraissārdhṃ patnīṃ te'dhigamiṣyati|
meaning: Along with his monkeys, he will search all rivers, mountains and caves and will find out your consort.

sanskrit: वानरांश्च महाकायान्प्रेषयिष्यति राघव।।3.72.25।। दिशो विचेतुं तां सीतां त्वद्वियोगेन शोचतीम्। स ज्ञास्यति वरारोहां निर्मल
transliteration: vānarāṃśca mahākāyānpreṣayiṣyati rāghava||3.72.25|| diśo vicetuṃ tāṃ sītāṃ tvadviyogena śocatīm| sa jñāsyati varārohāṃ n
meaning: Sugriva will find out the lady of purity and chastity brooding over you in separation in the abode of Ravana. He can send gigantic monkeys in different directions in order to search for her.

sanskrit: स मेरुशृङ्गाग्रगतामनिन्दितां प्रविश्य पातालतलेऽपि वा श्रिताम्। प्लवङ्गमानां प्रवरस्तव प्रियां निहत्य रक्षांसि पुनः प्रदा
transliteration: sa meruśṛṅgāgragatāmaninditāṃ praviśya pātālatale'pi vā śritām| plavaṅgamānāṃ pravarastava priyāṃ nihatya rakṣāṃsi punḥ
meaning: Sugriva, king of the monkeys, will reach the demons and restore you that blameless, beloved consort of yours, even if she is there on top of mount Meru or in the deep underworld. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्

sanskrit: एष राम शिवः पन्था यत्रैते पुष्पिता द्रुमाः। प्रतीचीं दिशमाश्रित्य प्रकाशन्ते मनोरमाः।।3.73.2।। जम्बूप्रियालपनसप्लक्षन्यग
transliteration: eṣa rāma śivḥ panthā yatraite puṣpitā drumāḥ| pratīcīṃ diśamāśritya prakāśante manoramāḥ||3.73.2|| jambūpriyālapanasapla
meaning: O Rama the delightful path going westward is auspicious for you. It is shining with trees in bloom. There are jambu (rose apple) trees, priyala trees, jackfruit trees, banyan trees, plaksha trees (a tree from which milky

sanskrit: तानारुह्याथवा भूमौ पातयित्वा च तान्बलात्।।3.73.5।। फलान्यमृतकल्पानि भक्षयन्तौ गमिष्यथः।
transliteration: tānāruhyāthavā bhūmau pātayitvā ca tānbalāt||3.73.5|| phalānyamṛtakalpāni bhakṣayantau gamiṣyathḥ|
meaning: Climbing those trees or else pulling them down with your strength, both of you eat the nectarlike sweet fruits and proceed ahead.

sanskrit: तदतिक्रम्य काकुत्स्थ वनं पुष्पितपादपम्।।3.73.6।। नन्दनप्रतिमं चान्यत्कुरवो ह्युत्तरा इव।
transliteration: tadatikramya kākutstha vanṃ puṣpitapādapam||3.73.6|| nandanapratimṃ cānyatkuravo hyuttarā iva|
meaning: O scion of the Kakutstha race proceeding further you will find another forest of the North Kuru state with trees in bloom resembling the pleasuregardens of Nandana.

sanskrit: सर्वकालफला यत्र पादपास्तु मधुस्रवाः।।3.73.7।। सर्वे च ऋतवस्तत्र वने चैत्ररथे यथा।
transliteration: sarvakālaphalā yatra pādapāstu madhusravāḥ||3.73.7|| sarve ca ṛtavastatra vane caitrarathe yathā|
meaning: The trees in that garden with fruits of all seasons drip honey. Like the Chaitraratha garden (of Kubera), it bears fruits of all seasons.

sanskrit: फलभारानतास्तत्र महाविटपधारिणः।।3.73.8।। शोभन्ते सर्वतस्तत्र मेघपर्वतसन्निभाः।
transliteration: phalabhārānatāstatra mahāviṭapadhāriṇḥ||3.73.8|| śobhante sarvatastatra meghaparvatasannibhāḥ|
meaning: The trees with huge branches bent down with fruits look like mountains or clouds.

sanskrit: तानारुह्याथवा भूमौ पातयित्वा यथासुखम्।।3.73.9।। फलान्यमृतकल्पानि लक्ष्मणस्ते प्रदास्यति।
transliteration: tānāruhyāthavā bhūmau pātayitvā yathāsukham||3.73.9|| phalānyamṛtakalpāni lakṣmaṇaste pradāsyati|
meaning: Lakshmana will get you the nectarlike fruits either by climbing the trees or by pulling them down.

sanskrit: चङ्क्रमन्तौ वरान्देशान्शैलाच्छैलं वनाद्वनम्।।3.73.10।। ततः पुष्करिणीं वीरौ पम्पां नाम गमिष्यथः।
transliteration: caṅkramantau varāndeśānśailācchailṃ vanādvanam||3.73.10|| tatḥ puṣkariṇīṃ vīrau pampāṃ nāma gamiṣyathḥ|
meaning: O brave men, pass from hill to hill, forest to forest in great countries until you reach a lake named Pampa.

sanskrit: अशर्करामविभ्रंशां समतीर्थामशैवलाम्।।3.73.11।। राम सञ्जातवालूकां कमलोत्पलशालिनीम्।
transliteration: aśarkarāmavibhrṃśāṃ samatīrthāmaśaivalām||3.73.11|| rāma sañjātavālūkāṃ kamalotpalaśālinīm|
meaning: The slopes of Pampa are without stones or pebbles, O Rama They are not slippery slopes. They are without moss. The water is neither deep nor shallow. It has smooth beds of sand on the banks and it is full of lotuses and

sanskrit: तत्र हंसाः प्लवाः क्रौञ्चाः कुरराश्चैव राघव।।3.73.12।। वल्गुस्वना विकूजन्ति पम्पासलिलगोचराः।
transliteration: tatra hṃsāḥ plavāḥ krauñcāḥ kurarāścaiva rāghava||3.73.12|| valgusvanā vikūjanti pampāsalilagocarāḥ|
meaning: Moving in the waters of Pampa you will see swans, ducks, krauncha birds and curlews cackling and cooing, O Son of the Raghus.

sanskrit: नोद्विजन्ते नरान्दृष्ट्वा वधस्याकोविदाश्शुभाः।।3.73.13।। घृतपिण्डोपमान् स्थूलांस्तान्द्विजान्भक्षयिष्यथः।
transliteration: nodvijante narāndṛṣṭvā vadhasyākovidāśśubhāḥ||3.73.13|| ghṛtapiṇḍopamān sthūlāṃstāndvijānbhakṣayiṣyathḥ|
meaning: Not knowing that they may be killed, the innocent creatures will not be scared of human beings. Both of you can kill and eat the fat birds comparable to balls of ghee.

sanskrit: रोहितान्वक्रतुण्डांश्च नडमीनांश्च राघव।।3.73.14।। पम्पायामिषुभिर्मत्स्यांस्तत्र राम वरान्हतान्। निस्त्वक्पक्षानयस्तप्तान
transliteration: rohitānvakratuṇḍāṃśca naḍamīnāṃśca rāghava||3.73.14|| pampāyāmiṣubhirmatsyāṃstatra rāma varānhatān| nistvakpakṣānayastap
meaning: O Rama, scion of the Raghu dynasty there at Pampa, by shooting an arrow at the choicest fishes with a single bone, prawns and big fishes, crookedfaced fishes, fishes without scales and fins, baked on iron skewers and coo

sanskrit: भृशते खादतो मत्स्यान्पम्पायाः पुष्पसञ्चये।।3.73.16।। पद्मगन्धि शिवं वारि सुखशीतमनामयम्। उद्धृत्य सतताक्लिष्टं रौप्यस्फाट
transliteration: bhṛśate khādato matsyānpampāyāḥ puṣpasañcaye||3.73.16|| padmagandhi śivṃ vāri sukhaśītamanāmayam| uddhṛtya satatākliṣṭṃ
meaning: While you delightedly eat the fishes, Lakshmana will fetch you water in a lotus leaf from the Pampa to drink. The waters of Pampa full of lotuses carry their scent, It is enjoyable, cool, healthy and clear, resembling si

sanskrit: स्थूलान्गिरिगुहाशय्यान्वराहान्वनचारिणः।।3.73.18।। अपां लोभादुपावृत्तान्वृषभानिव नर्दतः। रूपावनितांश्च पम्पायांद्रक्ष्यसि
transliteration: sthūlāngiriguhāśayyānvarāhānvanacāriṇḥ||3.73.18|| apāṃ lobhādupāvṛttānvṛṣabhāniva nardatḥ| rūpāvanitāṃśca pampāyāṃdrakṣy
meaning: O best of men you will see huge boars of delightful appearance that roar like bulls resting in mountain caves, roaming in the forest and coming to Pampa for its water.

sanskrit: सायाह्ने विचरन्राम विटपीन्माल्यधारिणः। शीतोदकं च पम्पाया दृष्ट्वा शोकं विहास्यसि।।3.73.20।।
transliteration: sāyāhne vicaranrāma viṭapīnmālyadhāriṇḥ| śītodakṃ ca pampāyā dṛṣṭvā śokṃ vihāsyasi||3.73.20||
meaning: When you stroll in the evening, you will see the trees laden with blossoms and lake Pampa full of cool water. You will forget your grief.

sanskrit: सुमनोभिश्चितांस्तत्र तिलकान्नक्तमालकान्। उत्पलानि च फुल्लानि पङ्कजानि च राघव।।3.73.21।।
transliteration: sumanobhiścitāṃstatra tilakānnaktamālakān| utpalāni ca phullāni paṅkajāni ca rāghava||3.73.21||
meaning: O son of the Raghus there you will see tilaka trees, night jasmines full of flowers. You will also see blossoming water lilies and lotuses in Pampa.

sanskrit: न तानि कश्चिन्माल्यानि तत्रारोपयिता नरः। न च वै म्लानतां यान्ति न च शीर्यन्ति राघव।।3.73.22।।
transliteration: na tāni kaścinmālyāni tatrāropayitā narḥ| na ca vai mlānatāṃ yānti na ca śīryanti rāghava||3.73.22||
meaning: There is no one to wear those flowers. Those garlands do not wilt or wither O Rama

sanskrit: मतङ्गशिष्यास्तत्राऽसन्नृषयस्सुसमाहिताः। तेषां भाराभितप्तानां वन्यमाहरतां गुरोः।।3.73.23।। ये प्रपेतुर्महीं तूर्णं शरीरात
transliteration: mataṅgaśiṣyāstatrā'sannṛṣayassusamāhitāḥ| teṣāṃ bhārābhitaptānāṃ vanyamāharatāṃ guroḥ||3.73.23|| ye prapeturmahīṃ tūrṇṃ
meaning: While drops of sweat from the bodies of sage Matanga's disciples fell on earth under the heavy load of forest products they carried for their preceptor, they remained in a calm state. Those drops of sweat turned into flo

sanskrit: तेषां गतानामद्यापि दृश्यते परिचारिणी।।3.73.25।। श्रमणी शबरी नाम काकुत्स्थ चिरजीविनी।
transliteration: teṣāṃ gatānāmadyāpi dṛśyate paricāriṇī||3.73.25|| śramaṇī śabarī nāma kākutstha cirajīvinī|
meaning: O Kakutstha even now their attendant, named Sabari, an old ascetic is there even though they have left long ago.

sanskrit: त्वां तु धर्मे स्थिता नित्यं सर्वभूतनमस्कृतम्।।3.73.26।। दृष्ट्वा देवोपमं राम स्वर्गलोकं गमिष्यति।
transliteration: tvāṃ tu dharme sthitā nityṃ sarvabhūtanamaskṛtam||3.73.26|| dṛṣṭvā devopamṃ rāma svargalokṃ gamiṣyati|
meaning: O Rama, she is established in righteousness, and you are godlike, and revered by all beings. When she sees you, she will attain heaven.

sanskrit: ततस्तद्राम पम्पायास्तीरमासाद्य पश्चिमम्।।3.73.27।। आश्रमस्थानमतुलं गुह्यं काकुत्स्थ पश्यसि।
transliteration: tatastadrāma pampāyāstīramāsādya paścimam||3.73.27|| āśramasthānamatulṃ guhyṃ kākutstha paśyasi|
meaning: O Rama of the Kakutstha family, you will see on reaching the western bank of Pampa an incomparable site of hermitage concealed in a remote place.

sanskrit: न तत्राक्रमितुं नागाश्शक्नुवन्ति तमाश्रमम्।।3.73.28।। विविधास्तत्र वै नागा वने तस्मिंश्च पर्वते। ऋषेस्तत्र मतङ्गस्य विधा
transliteration: na tatrākramituṃ nāgāśśaknuvanti tamāśramam||3.73.28|| vividhāstatra vai nāgā vane tasmiṃśca parvate| ṛṣestatra mataṅgas
meaning: The elephants of the forest and on the mountains do not attack the hermitage forbidden by sage Matanga.

sanskrit: तस्मिन्नन्दनसङ्काशे देवारण्योपमे वने। नानाविहगसङ्कीर्णे रंस्यसे राम निर्वृतः।।3.73.30।।
transliteration: tasminnandanasaṅkāśe devāraṇyopame vane| nānāvihagasaṅkīrṇe rṃsyase rāma nirvṛtḥ||3.73.30||
meaning: O Rama, you will enjoy your stay in that forest which is like Nandana garden, the garden of the gods, full of various birds.

sanskrit: ऋष्यमूकश्च पम्पायाः पुरस्तात्पुष्पितद्रुमः। सुदुःखारोहणो नाम शिशुनागाभिरक्षितः।।3.73.31।। उदारो ब्रह्मणा चैव पूर्वकाले व
transliteration: ṛṣyamūkaśca pampāyāḥ purastātpuṣpitadrumḥ| suduḥkhārohaṇo nāma śiśunāgābhirakṣitḥ||3.73.31|| udāro brahmaṇā caiva pūrvak
meaning: Mount Rishyamuka situated on the bank of Pampa has trees filled with blossoms. It is difficult to climb and is protected by young elephants.This lofty mountain was created by Brahma in olden days.

sanskrit: शयानः पुरुषो राम तस्य शैलस्य मूर्धनि।।3.73.32।। यत्स्वप्ने लभते वित्तं तत्प्रबुद्धोऽधिगच्छति।
transliteration: śayānḥ puruṣo rāma tasya śailasya mūrdhani||3.73.32|| yatsvapne labhate vittṃ tatprabuddho'dhigacchati|
meaning: Whatever wealth one dreams of in sleep on top of that mountain he will get on waking up, O Rama

sanskrit: नत्वेनं विषमाचार पापकर्माऽधिरोहति।।3.73.33।। यस्तु तं विषमाचारः पापकर्माऽधिरोहति। तत्रैव प्रहऱन्त्येनं सुप्तमादाय राक्षस
transliteration: natvenṃ viṣamācāra pāpakarmā'dhirohati||3.73.33|| yastu tṃ viṣamācārḥ pāpakarmā'dhirohati| tatraiva prahaऱntyenṃ suptamā
meaning: If an evildoer or a sinner ascends the (Rishyamuka) mountain, he, in his sleep, will be thrown down with asleep by the demons from there itself. A sinner does not climb this mountain of uneven terrain.

sanskrit: तत्रापि शिशुनागानामाक्रन्धश्श्रूयते महान्। क्रीडतां राम पम्पायां मतङ्गारण्यवासिनाम्।।3.73.35।।
transliteration: tatrāpi śiśunāgānāmākrandhaśśrūyate mahān| krīḍatāṃ rāma pampāyāṃ mataṅgāraṇyavāsinām||3.73.35||
meaning: O Rama, the trumpeting of the young playful elephants inhabiting sage Matanga's forest can be heard at Pampa.

sanskrit: सिक्ता रुधिरधाराभिस्संहृत्य परमद्विपाः। प्रचरन्ति पृथक्कीर्णा मेघवर्णास्तरस्विनः।।3.73.36।।
transliteration: siktā rudhiradhārābhissṃhṛtya paramadvipāḥ| pracaranti pṛthakkīrṇā meghavarṇāstarasvinḥ||3.73.36||
meaning: The great, nimble elphants, dark like clouds, drenched with the flow of ichor come together and then separate and scatter.

sanskrit: ते तत्र पीत्वा पानीयं विमलं शीतमव्ययम्। निर्वृतास्संविगाहन्ते वनानि वनगोचराः।।3.73.37।।
transliteration: te tatra pītvā pānīyṃ vimalṃ śītamavyayam| nirvṛtāssṃvigāhante vanāni vanagocarāḥ||3.73.37||
meaning: The wandering elephants of the forest drink plentiful water, pure and cool, from Pampa and contented, plunge into the forest.

sanskrit: ऋक्षांश्च द्वीपिनश्चैव नीलकोमलकप्रभान्। रुरूनपेतापजयान् दृष्ट्वा शोकं जयिष्यसि।।3.73.38।।
