meaning: O Bharata, the tears falling from the eyes of persons, who are falsely accused and punished for the pleasure of the king will destroy his progeny and cattle as well.

sanskrit: कच्चिद्वृद्धांश्च बालांश्च वैद्यामुख्यांश्च राघव। दानेन मनसा वाचा त्रिभिरेतैर्बुभूषसे।।2.100.60।।
transliteration: kaccidvṛddhāṃśca bālāṃśca vaidyāmukhyāṃśca rāghava| dānena manasā vācā tribhiretairbubhūṣase||2.100.60||
meaning: O Bharata, I trust you wish to thrive by treating the old, children and foremost of learned people with the three expedients namely gifts, affection and kind words.

sanskrit: कच्चिद्गुरूंश्च वृद्धांश्च तापसान् देवतातिथीन्। चैत्यांश्च सर्वान्सिध्दार्थान्ब्राह्मणांश्च नमस्यसि।।2.100.61।।
transliteration: kaccidgurūṃśca vṛddhāṃśca tāpasān devatātithīn| caityāṃśca sarvānsidhdārthānbrāhmaṇāṃśca namasyasi||2.100.61||
meaning: I trust you pay homage to the preceptors, the aged ones, ascetics, gods and guests, to shrines and to accomplished brahmins.

sanskrit: कच्चिदर्थेन वा धर्ममर्थं धर्मेण वा पुनः। उभौ वा प्रीतिलोभेन कामेन च न बाधसे।।2.100.62।।
transliteration: kaccidarthena vā dharmamarthṃ dharmeṇa vā punḥ| ubhau vā prītilobhena kāmena ca na bādhase||2.100.62||
meaning: I trust, righteousness for the sake of prosperity or prosperity for the sake of righteousness or both for the sake of sensual pleasure are not thwarted by you.

sanskrit: कच्चिदर्थं च धर्मं च कामं च जयतां वर। विभज्य काले कालज्ञ सर्वान्वरद सेवसे।।2.100.63।।
transliteration: kaccidarthṃ ca dharmṃ ca kāmṃ ca jayatāṃ vara| vibhajya kāle kālajña sarvānvarada sevase||2.100.63||
meaning: O Bharata, the best among the victorious, conversant with timely actions and a bestower of boons you are the best of men. I trust, you allocate adequate time for attending to all the three expedients of life like dharma,

sanskrit: कच्चित्ते ब्राह्मणा श्शर्म सर्वशास्त्रार्थकोविदाः। आशंसन्ते महाप्राज्ञ पौरजानपदैस्सह।।2.100.64।।
transliteration: kaccitte brāhmaṇā śśarma sarvaśāstrārthakovidāḥ| āśṃsante mahāprājña paurajānapadaissaha||2.100.64||
meaning: O highly sagacious Bharata, those brahmins who can comprehend the meaning of all scriptures along with the inhabitants of the city and country, I trust, are seeking your happiness.

sanskrit: नास्तिक्यमनृतं क्रोधं प्रमादं दीर्घसूत्रताम्। अदर्शनं ज्ञानवतामालस्यं पञ्चवृत्तिताम्।।2.100.65।। एकचिन्तनमर्थानामनर्थज्ञ
transliteration: nāstikyamanṛtṃ krodhṃ pramādṃ dīrghasūtratām| adarśanṃ jñānavatāmālasyṃ pañcavṛttitām||2.100.65|| ekacintanamarthānāmana
meaning: I trust you eschew the fourteen faults of kings, like atheism, falsehood, anger, inattention, procrastination, evading the wise, indolence, gratification of all five senses, planning alone in the affairs of the kingdom,

sanskrit: दशपञ्चचतुर्वर्गान्सप्तवर्गं च तत्त्वतः। अष्टवर्गं त्रिवर्गं च विद्यास्तिस्रश्च राघव।।2.100.68।। इन्द्रियाणां जयं बुद्ध्य
transliteration: daśapañcacaturvargānsaptavargṃ ca tattvatḥ| aṣṭavargṃ trivargṃ ca vidyāstisraśca rāghava||2.100.68|| indriyāṇāṃ jayṃ bud
meaning: O highly sagacious Bharata, I trust, having understood their true nature you are appropriately following the ten, five and four divisions, the seven divisions, the eight divisions, the three divisions, three kinds of kno

sanskrit: मन्त्रिभिस्त्वं यथोद्दिष्टैश्चतुर्भिस्त्रिभिरेव वा। कच्चित्समस्तैर्व्यस्तैश्च मन्त्रं मन्त्रयसे मिथः।।2.100.71।।
transliteration: mantribhistvṃ yathoddiṣṭaiścaturbhistribhireva vā| kaccitsamastairvyastaiśca mantrṃ mantrayase mithḥ||2.100.71||
meaning: I trust you deliberate in secrecy on your counsel with three or four counsellors, together and separately with each one, as laid down in sacred texts.

sanskrit: कच्चित्ते सफला वेदाः कच्चित्ते सफलाः क्रियाः। कच्चित्ते सफला दाराः कच्चित्ते सफलं श्रुतम्।।2.100.72।।
transliteration: kaccitte saphalā vedāḥ kaccitte saphalāḥ kriyāḥ| kaccitte saphalā dārāḥ kaccitte saphalṃ śrutam||2.100.72||
meaning: I trust, the Vedas you have studied are fruitful, the acts which you commenced are productive, your wife is fruitful (blessed with a son) and the scriptures you studied are useful.

sanskrit: कच्चिदेषैव ते बुद्धिर्यथोक्ता मम राघव। आयुष्या च यशस्या च धर्मकामार्थ संहिता।।2.100.73।।
transliteration: kaccideṣaiva te buddhiryathoktā mama rāghava| āyuṣyā ca yaśasyā ca dharmakāmārtha sṃhitā||2.100.73||
meaning: O Bharata, I trust your intellect is in conformity with what I said conducive to long life, and fame in accordance with righteousness, (legitimate) pleasure and prosperity.

sanskrit: यां वृत्तिं वर्तते तातो यां च नः प्रपितामहाः। तां वृत्तिं वर्तसे कच्चिद्याच सत्पथगा शुभा।।2.100.74।।
transliteration: yāṃ vṛttiṃ vartate tāto yāṃ ca nḥ prapitāmahāḥ| tāṃ vṛttiṃ vartase kaccidyāca satpathagā śubhā||2.100.74||
meaning: I trust, you walk the auspicious path of truth (virtue) followed by our father and forefathers.

sanskrit: कच्चित्स्वादु कृतं भोज्यमेको नाश्नासि राघव। कच्चिदाशंसमानेभ्यो मित्रेभ्य स्सम्प्रयच्छसि।।2.100.75।।
transliteration: kaccitsvādu kṛtṃ bhojyameko nāśnāsi rāghava| kaccidāśṃsamānebhyo mitrebhya ssamprayacchasi||2.100.75||
meaning: O Bharata, I trust you do not partake delicious food all by yourself, and you share it with your friends when they want it.

sanskrit: राजा तु धर्मेण हि पालयित्वा महामतिर्दण्डधरः प्रजानाम्। अवाप्य कृत्स्नां वसुधां यथावदितश्च्युत स्स्वर्गमुपैति विद्वान्।।2
transliteration: rājā tu dharmeṇa hi pālayitvā mahāmatirdaṇḍadharḥ prajānām| avāpya kṛtsnāṃ vasudhāṃ yathāvaditaścyuta ssvargamupaiti vid
meaning: The highly sagacious and learned king, having acquired the entire earth and punishing the people in accordance with tradition and righteously ruling the kingdom, will ascend the his release (from this world). इत्यार्षे श

sanskrit: शाश्वतोऽयं सदा धर्मः स्थितोऽस्मासु नरर्षभ। ज्येष्ठेे पुत्रे स्थिते राजा न कनीयान् भवेन्नृपः।।2.101.2।।
transliteration: śāśvato'yṃ sadā dharmḥ sthito'smāsu nararṣabha| jyeṣṭhee putre sthite rājā na kanīyān bhavennṛpḥ||2.101.2||
meaning: O best of men there is an ancient tradition in our race that the younger son cannot become king when the eldest is there.

sanskrit: स समृद्धां मया सार्धमयोध्यां गच्छ राघव। अभिषेचयचात्मानं कुलस्यास्य भवाय नः।।2.101.3।।
transliteration: sa samṛddhāṃ mayā sārdhamayodhyāṃ gaccha rāghava| abhiṣecayacātmānṃ kulasyāsya bhavāya nḥ||2.101.3||
meaning: Therefore, O scion of the Raghu race, return along with me to prosperous Ayodhya and for the good of our race get your self coronated.

sanskrit: राजानं मानुषं प्राहु र्देवत्वे सम्मतो मम। यस्य धर्मार्थसहितं वृत्तमाहुरमानुषम्।।2.101.4।।
transliteration: rājānṃ mānuṣṃ prāhu rdevatve sammato mama| yasya dharmārthasahitṃ vṛttamāhuramānuṣam||2.101.4||
meaning: Other think the king to be a human, but to me, he is divine since his conduct and the statecraft are superhuman as they are in conformity with righteousness.

sanskrit: केकयस्थे च मयि तु त्वयि चारण्य माश्रिते। दिवमार्यो गतो राजा यायजूक: सतां मतः।।2.101.5।।
transliteration: kekayasthe ca mayi tu tvayi cāraṇya māśrite| divamāryo gato rājā yāyajūka: satāṃ matḥ||2.101.5||
meaning: While I was in Kekaya and you took refuge in the forest, venerable king (Dasaratha), who was always engaged in sacrifices and was held in high esteem by the virtuous, ascended to heaven.

sanskrit: निष्क्रान्तमात्रे भवति ससीते सहलक्ष्मणे। दुःखशोकाभिभूतस्तु राजा त्रिदिवमभ्यगात्।।2.101.6।।
transliteration: niṣkrāntamātre bhavati sasīte sahalakṣmaṇe| duḥkhaśokābhibhūtastu rājā tridivamabhyagāt||2.101.6||
meaning: As soon as you set out for the forest along with Sita and Lakshmana, the king, overwhelmed with grief, attained heaven.

sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठ पुरुषव्याघ्र क्रियतामुदकं पितुः। अहं चायं च शत्रुघ्नः पूर्वमेव कृतोदकौ।।2.101.7।।
transliteration: uttiṣṭha puruṣavyāghra kriyatāmudakṃ pituḥ| ahṃ cāyṃ ca śatrughnḥ pūrvameva kṛtodakau||2.101.7||
meaning: Arise, O best of men and offer libations to our father. I and Satrughna have already done so.

sanskrit: प्रियेण किल दत्तं हि पितृलोकेषु राघव। अक्षय्यं भवतीत्याहुर्भवांश्चैव पितुः प्रियः।।2.101.8।।
transliteration: priyeṇa kila dattṃ hi pitṛlokeṣu rāghava| akṣayyṃ bhavatītyāhurbhavāṃścaiva pituḥ priyḥ||2.101.8||
meaning: O son of Raghu's race, it is said that whatever is offered by a dear son becomes eternal in the world of manes. You alone are the beloved son of our father.

sanskrit: त्वामेव शोचंस्तव दर्शनेप्सुस्त्वय्येव सक्तामनिवर्त्य बुद्धिम्। त्वया विहीन स्तव शोकमग्नस्त्वां संस्मरन्नस्तमितः पिता ते।
transliteration: tvāmeva śocṃstava darśanepsustvayyeva saktāmanivartya buddhim| tvayā vihīna stava śokamagnastvāṃ sṃsmarannastamitḥ pitā
meaning: Your father, deprived of you, brooding over you, wishing to behold you, unable to divert his mind fixed on you, remembering you alone and immersed in sorrow departed (from this world). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय

sanskrit: तं तु वज्रमिवोत्सृष्टमाहवे दानवारिणा वाग्वज्रंभरते नोक्त ममनोज्ञं परन्तपः।।2.102.2।। प्रगृह्य रामो बाहू वैपुष्पिताग्रो य
transliteration: tṃ tu vajramivotsṛṣṭamāhave dānavāriṇā vāgvajrṃbharate nokta mamanojñṃ parantapḥ||2.102.2|| pragṛhya rāmo bāhū vaipuṣpit
meaning: On hearing the thunderlike words spoken by Bharata afflicting the mind, like the thunderbolt hurled by Indra (enemy of demons) in a battle, Rama, the scorcher of enemies, stretching forth both his arms, fell down on the

sanskrit: तथा हि पतितं रामं जगत्यां जगतीपतिम्। कूलघातपरिश्रान्तं प्रसुप्तमिव कुञ्जरम्।।2.102. 4।। भ्रातरस्ते महेष्वासं सर्वतश्शोकक
transliteration: tathā hi patitṃ rāmṃ jagatyāṃ jagatīpatim| kūlaghātapariśrāntṃ prasuptamiva kuñjaram||2.102. 4|| bhrātaraste maheṣvāsṃ s
meaning: Those brothers on all sides, with Sita lamenting, sprinkled water on Rama, the great archer and lord of the earth who, afflicted with grief, had fallen down on the ground, and was lying like an elephant exhausted from re

sanskrit: स तु संज्ञां पुनर्लब्ध्वा नेत्राभ्यामस्रमुत्सृजन्। उपाक्रामत काकुत्स्थ कृपणं बहु भाषितुम्।।2.102.6।।
transliteration: sa tu sṃjñāṃ punarlabdhvā netrābhyāmasramutsṛjan| upākrāmata kākutstha kṛpaṇṃ bahu bhāṣitum||2.102.6||
meaning: On regaining consciousness, shedding tears profusely, Rama again started speaking piteously.

sanskrit: स रामस्स्वर्गतं श्रुत्वा पितरं पृथिवीपतिम्। उवाच भरतं वाक्यं धर्मात्मा धर्मसंहितम्।।2.102.7।।
transliteration: sa rāmassvargatṃ śrutvā pitarṃ pṛthivīpatim| uvāca bharatṃ vākyṃ dharmātmā dharmasṃhitam||2.102.7||
meaning: On hearing that his father, king Dasaratha, the lord of the world had attained heaven, righteous Rama said to Bharata in conformty with his rightful conduct.

sanskrit: किं करिष्याम्ययोध्यायां ताते दिष्टां गतिं गते। कस्तां राजवराध्दीनामयोध्यां पालयिष्यति।।2.102.8।।
transliteration: kiṃ kariṣyāmyayodhyāyāṃ tāte diṣṭāṃ gatiṃ gate| kastāṃ rājavarādhdīnāmayodhyāṃ pālayiṣyati||2.102.8||
meaning: What shall I do in Ayodhya now that my father has followed the path ordained by the gods? Who will rule that Ayodhya deprived of that best of kings?

sanskrit: किं नु तस्य मया कार्यं दुर्जातेन महात्मनः। यो मृतो मम शोकेन मया चापि न संस्कृतः।।2.102.9।।
transliteration: kiṃ nu tasya mayā kāryṃ durjātena mahātmanḥ| yo mṛto mama śokena mayā cāpi na sṃskṛtḥ||2.102.9||
meaning: I could not even perform the last rites of that magnanimous one who died of grief on account of me. What use is my life with an unlucky birth?

sanskrit: अहो भरत सिद्धार्थो येन राजा त्वयाऽनघ। शत्रुघ्नेन च सर्वेषु प्रेतकृत्येषु सत्कृतः।।2.102.10।।
transliteration: aho bharata siddhārtho yena rājā tvayā'nagha| śatrughnena ca sarveṣu pretakṛtyeṣu satkṛtḥ||2.102.10||
meaning: O irreproachable Bharata, it is gratifying that you and Satrughna are indeed fortunate to have fulfilled your cherished desire since the king was wellhonoured by you with all the obsequial rites.

sanskrit: निष्प्रधानामनेकाग्रां नरेन्द्रेण विनाकृताम्। निवृत्तवनवासोऽपि नायोध्यां गन्तु मुत्सहे।।2.102.11।।
transliteration: niṣpradhānāmanekāgrāṃ narendreṇa vinākṛtām| nivṛttavanavāso'pi nāyodhyāṃ gantu mutsahe||2.102.11||
meaning: Even after the completion of my exile I do not wish to return to Ayodhya which is directionless, bereft of its chief, the king.

sanskrit: समाप्तवनवासं मामयोध्यायां परन्तप। कोऽनु शासिष्यति पुनस्ताते लोकान्तरं गते।।2.102.12।।
transliteration: samāptavanavāsṃ māmayodhyāyāṃ parantapa| ko'nu śāsiṣyati punastāte lokāntarṃ gate||2.102.12||
meaning: O subduer of enemies, when father has gone to the other world, who will guide me in Ayodhya after I complete my term of exile?

sanskrit: पुरा प्रेक्ष्य सुवृत्तं मां पिता यान्याह सान्त्वयन्। वाक्यानि तानि श्रोष्यामि कुतश्श्रोत्रसुखान्यहम्।।2.102.13।।
transliteration: purā prekṣya suvṛttṃ māṃ pitā yānyāha sāntvayan| vākyāni tāni śroṣyāmi kutaśśrotrasukhānyaham||2.102.13||
meaning: On seeing my good conduct our father used to say comforting words to me. Now from whom can I hear such words pleasing to the ears?

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा स भरतं भार्यामभ्येत्य राघवः। उवाच शोकसन्तप्तः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम्।।2.102.14।।
transliteration: evamuktvā sa bharatṃ bhāryāmabhyetya rāghavḥ| uvāca śokasantaptḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanām||2.102.14||
meaning: Having thus spoken to Bharata, Rama, overwhelmed with grief, approached his wife Sita whose face looked like the full Moon, and said to her.

sanskrit: सीते मृतस्ते श्वशुरः पित्रा हीनोऽसि लक्ष्मण। भरतो दुःखमाचष्टे स्वर्गतं पृथिवीपतिम्।।2.102.15।।
transliteration: sīte mṛtaste śvaśurḥ pitrā hīno'si lakṣmaṇa| bharato duḥkhamācaṣṭe svargatṃ pṛthivīpatim||2.102.15||
meaning: O Sita, your fatherinlaw is dead. O Lakshmana, you are deprived of your father. Bharata is relating to me the sad news that king Dasaratha has attained his heavenly abode.

sanskrit: ततो बहुगुणं तेषां बाष्पं नेत्रेष्वजायत। तथा ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे कुमाराणां यशस्विनाम्।।2.102.16।।
transliteration: tato bahuguṇṃ teṣāṃ bāṣpṃ netreṣvajāyata| tathā bruvati kākutsthe kumārāṇāṃ yaśasvinām||2.102.16||
meaning: While the scion of the Kakutsthas was saying thus, copious tears welled up from the eyes of all those illustrious sons of Dasaratha.

sanskrit: ततस्ते भ्रातर स्रव्रॆ भृशमाश्वास्य दु:खितम्। अब्रुवन् जगतीभर्तुः क्रियतामुदकं पितुः।।2.102.17।।
transliteration: tataste bhrātara  sravraॆ bhṛśamāśvāsya du:khitam| abruvan jagatībhartuḥ kriyatāmudakṃ pituḥ||2.102.17||
meaning: All the brothers, having consoled Rama as best they could, told him, Let the libations be offered to our father, the protector of the world.

sanskrit: सा सीता स्वर्गतं श्रुत्वा श्वशुरं तं महानृपम्। नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्या शशाकेक्षितुं प्रियम्।।2.102.18।।
transliteration: sā sītā svargatṃ śrutvā śvaśurṃ  tṃ mahānṛpam| netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyā śaśākekṣituṃ priyam||2.102.18||
meaning: On hearing that her fatherinlaw, king Dasaratha, had attained heaven, Sita, her eyes filled with tears could not look at her husband in the face.

sanskrit: सान्त्वयित्वा तु तां रामो रुदन्तीं जनकात्मजाम्। उवाच लक्ष्मणं तत्र दुःखितो दुःखितं वचः।।2.102.19।।
transliteration: sāntvayitvā tu tāṃ rāmo rudantīṃ janakātmajām| uvāca lakṣmaṇṃ tatra duḥkhito duḥkhitṃ vacḥ||2.102.19||
meaning: Having consoled Sita, daughter of Janaka, griefstricken Rama said to Lakshmana who was also distressed with grief.

sanskrit: आनयेङ्गुदिपिण्याकं चीरमाहर चोत्तरम्। जलक्रियार्थं तातस्य गमिष्यामि महात्मनः।।2.102.20।।
transliteration: ānayeṅgudipiṇyākṃ cīramāhara cottaram| jalakriyārthṃ tātasya gamiṣyāmi mahātmanḥ||2.102.20||
meaning: I shall go and offer libations to my magnanimous father. Go and fetch the dried pulp of ingudi fruit and an upper garment made of bark.

sanskrit: सीता पुरस्ताद्व्रजतु त्वमेनामभितो व्रज। अहं पश्चाद्गमिष्यामि गतिर्ह्येषा सुदारुणा।।2.102.21।।
transliteration: sītā purastādvrajatu tvamenāmabhito vraja| ahṃ paścādgamiṣyāmi gatirhyeṣā sudāruṇā||2.102.21||
meaning: Let us proceed in this order -- you first, Sita second and I last. This procession in mourning is terrible indeed.

sanskrit: ततो नित्यानुगस्तेषां विदितात्मा महामतिः। मृदुर्दान्तश्च कान्तश्च रामे च दृढभक्तिमान्।।2.102.22।। सुमन्त्र स्तैर्नृपसुतैस
transliteration: tato nityānugasteṣāṃ viditātmā mahāmatiḥ| mṛdurdāntaśca kāntaśca rāme ca dṛḍhabhaktimān||2.102.22|| sumantra stairnṛpasu
meaning: Thereafter, their constant follower Sumantra who was conversant in spiritual knowledge, a highminded person, softnatured, selfcontrolled, tranquilminded and staunchly devoted to Rama consoled him. Holding the hands of th

sanskrit: ततो नित्यानुगस्तेषां विदितात्मा महामतिः। मृदुर्दान्तश्च शान्तश्च रामे च दृढभक्तिमान्।।2.102.22।। सुमन्त्रस्तैर्नृपसुतैः
transliteration: tato nityānugasteṣāṃ viditātmā mahāmatiḥ| mṛdurdāntaśca śāntaśca rāme ca dṛḍhabhaktimān||2.102.22|| sumantrastairnṛpasut
meaning: Thereafter, their constant follower Sumantra who was conversant in spiritual knowledge, a highminded person, softnatured, selfcontrolled, tranquilminded and staunchly devoted to Rama consoled him. Holding the hands of th

sanskrit: ते सुतीर्थां ततः कृच्छ्रादुपागम्य यशस्विनः। नदीं मन्दाकिनीं रम्यां सदा पुष्पितकाननाम्।।2.102.24।। शीघ्रस्रोतसमासाद्य तीर
transliteration: te sutīrthāṃ tatḥ kṛcchrādupāgamya yaśasvinḥ| nadīṃ mandākinīṃ ramyāṃ sadā puṣpitakānanām||2.102.24|| śīghrasrotasamāsād
meaning: The illustrious brothers approached with great difficulty the swiftflowing and enchanting river Mandakini which had convenient descent and endowed with forests always in bloom. They descended at an auspicious place that

sanskrit: ते सुतीर्थां ततः कृच्छ्रादुपागम्य यशस्विनः। नदीं मन्दाकिनीं रम्यां सदा पुष्पितकाननाम्।।2.102.24।। शीघ्रस्रोतसमासाद्य तीर
transliteration: te sutīrthāṃ tatḥ kṛcchrādupāgamya yaśasvinḥ| nadīṃ mandākinīṃ ramyāṃ sadā puṣpitakānanām||2.102.24|| śīghrasrotasamāsād
meaning: The illustrious brothers approached with great difficulty the swiftflowing and enchanting river Mandakini which had convenient descent and endowed with forests always in bloom. They descended at an auspicious place that

sanskrit: प्रगृह्य च महीपालो जलपूरितमञ्जलिम्। दिशं याम्यामभिमुखो रुदन्वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.102.26।।
transliteration: pragṛhya ca mahīpālo jalapūritamañjalim| diśṃ yāmyāmabhimukho rudanvacanamabravīt||2.102.26||
meaning: Rama, the ruler of the earth, held water with both palms cupped and, facing the south, the direction of Yama (the god of death) said these words, sobbing:

sanskrit: एतत्ते राजशार्दूल विमलं तोयमक्षयम्। पितृलोकगत स्याद्य मद्दत्तमुपतिष्ठतु।।2.102.27।।
transliteration: etatte rājaśārdūla vimalṃ toyamakṣayam| pitṛlokagata syādya maddattamupatiṣṭhatu||2.102.27||
meaning: 'O best of kings, you are gone to the world of the manes, and let this inexhaustible libation of pure water reach you'.

sanskrit: ततो मन्दाकिनीतीरात्प्रत्युत्तीर्य स राघवः। पितुश्चकार तेजस्वी निर्वापं भ्रातृभि सह।।2.102.28।।
transliteration: tato mandākinītīrātpratyuttīrya sa rāghavḥ| pituścakāra tejasvī nirvāpṃ bhrātṛbhi saha||2.102.28||
meaning: Then, the powerful scion of the Raghu race reached bank, from the bathing spot of the river Mandakini along with his brothers and offered pinda (an offering of rice flour to the departed) to his late lamented father.

sanskrit: ऐङ्गुदं बदरीमिश्रं पिण्याकं दर्भसंस्तरे। न्यस्य रामस्सदुःखार्तो रुदन्वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.102.29।।
transliteration: aiṅgudṃ badarīmiśrṃ piṇyākṃ darbhasṃstare| nyasya rāmassaduḥkhārto rudanvacanamabravīt||2.102.29||
meaning: Placing the balls of ingudi pulp mixed with badari fruit on a spread of darbha grass, Rama, was overcome with grief and weeping, said:

sanskrit: इदं भुङ्क्ष्वमहाराज प्रीतो यदशना वयम्। यदन्नः पुरुषो भवति तदन्ना स्तस्य देवताः।।2.102.30।।
transliteration: idṃ bhuṅkṣvamahārāja prīto yadaśanā vayam| yadannḥ puruṣo bhavati tadannā stasya devatāḥ||2.102.30||
meaning: O great king, we offer you such food as we partake now. Be pleased to accept it. For, his gods are offered the food a man takes.

sanskrit: तत स्तेनैव मार्गेण प्रत्युत्तीर्य सरित्तटात्। आरुरोह नरव्याघ्रो रम्यसानुं महीधरम्।।2.102.31।।
transliteration: tata stenaiva mārgeṇa pratyuttīrya sarittaṭāt| āruroha naravyāghro ramyasānuṃ mahīdharam||2.102.31||
meaning: Rama, the tiger among men, ascending the riverbank and proceeding on the same path (he had come), climbed the (Chitrakuta) mountain of charming slopes.

sanskrit: ततः पर्णकुटीद्वारमासाद्य जगतीपतिः। परिजग्राह बाहुभ्यामुभौ भरतलक्ष्मणौ।।2.102.32।।
transliteration: tatḥ parṇakuṭīdvāramāsādya jagatīpatiḥ| parijagrāha bāhubhyāmubhau bharatalakṣmaṇau||2.102.32||
meaning: Rama, lord of the earth, reached the door of the leafhut and took Bharata and Lakshmana in his arms.

sanskrit: तेषां तु रुदतां शब्दात् प्रतिशब्दोऽभवद् गिरौ। भ्रातॄणां सह वैदेह्या सिंहानां नर्दतामिव।।2.102.33।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ tu rudatāṃ śabdāt pratiśabdo'bhavad girau| bhrātṝṇāṃ saha vaidehyā siṃhānāṃ nardatāmiva||2.102.33||
meaning: The mountain echoed with the sound of lamentations of all the brothers along with Sita which resembled the roar of lions.

sanskrit: महाबलानां रुदतां कुर्वतामुदकं पितुः। विज्ञाय तुमुलं शब्दं त्रस्ता भरत सैनिकाः।।2.102.34।
transliteration: mahābalānāṃ rudatāṃ kurvatāmudakṃ pituḥ| vijñāya tumulṃ śabdṃ trastā bharata sainikāḥ||2.102.34|
meaning: The soldiers of Bharata were alarmed on hearing the tumultuous sounds raised by those mighty brothers offering libations of water and lamenting.

sanskrit: अब्रुवंश्चापि रामेण भरत संगतो ध्रुवम्। तेषामेव महान् श‌ब्द: शोचतां पितरं मृतम्।।2.102.35।।
transliteration: abruvṃścāpi rāmeṇa bharata sṃgato dhruvam| teṣāmeva mahān śa‌bda: śocatāṃ pitarṃ mṛtam||2.102.35||
meaning: They said, 'Bharata must have joined Rama. That loud noise must be their wailing over their deceased father'.

sanskrit: अथ वासान्परित्यज्य तं सर्वेऽभिमुखास्स्वनम्। अप्येकमनसो जग्मुर्यथास्थानं प्रधाविताः।।2.102.36।।
transliteration: atha vāsānparityajya tṃ sarve'bhimukhāssvanam| apyekamanaso jagmuryathāsthānṃ pradhāvitāḥ||2.102.36||
meaning: Then all of them left their camps with one single thought (of seeing Rama) in their minds and ran in the direction from where that sound emanated.

sanskrit: हयैरन्ये गजैरन्ये रथैरन्ये स्वलङ्कृतैः। सुकुमारा स्तथैवान्ये पद्भिरेव नरा ययुः।।2.102.37।।
transliteration: hayairanye gajairanye rathairanye svalaṅkṛtaiḥ| sukumārā stathaivānye padbhireva narā yayuḥ||2.102.37||
meaning: Some rode horses, some, elephants, while others mounted welldecorated chariots, while the young went on foot.

sanskrit: अचिरप्रोषितं रामं चिरविप्रोषितं यथा। द्रष्टुकामो जनः सर्वो जगाम सहसाऽऽश्रमम्।।2.102.38।।
transliteration: aciraproṣitṃ rāmṃ ciraviproṣitṃ yathā| draṣṭukāmo janḥ sarvo jagāma sahasā''śramam||2.102.38||
meaning: The whole multitude of people at once rushed towards the hermitage wishing to see Rama as if he had left long ago though he had gone on exile very recently.

sanskrit: भ्रातृ़णां त्वरितास्ते तु द्रष्टुकामा स‌मागमम्। ययुर्बहुविधैर्यानै: खुरनेमिस्वनाकुलैः।।2.102.39।।
transliteration: bhrātṛ़ṇāṃ tvaritāste tu draṣṭukāmā sa‌māgamam| yayurbahuvidhairyānai: khuranemisvanākulaiḥ||2.102.39||
meaning: Eager to see the union of brothers, all those people went by every sort of vehicle filled with the sounds of hooves and wheels.

sanskrit: सा भूमिर्बहुभिर्यानैः रथ‌नेमिसमाहता। मुमोच तुमुलं शब्दं द्यौरिवाभ्रसमागमे।।2.102.40।।
transliteration: sā bhūmirbahubhiryānaiḥ ratha‌nemisamāhatā| mumoca tumulṃ śabdṃ dyaurivābhrasamāgame||2.102.40||
meaning: The earth crushed by several vehicles, hooves (of horses) and wheels (of chariots) emitted tumultuous sounds like the sky in the gathering stormclouds.

sanskrit: तेन वित्रासिता नागाः करेणुपरिवारिताः। आवासयन्तो गन्धेन जग्मुरन्यद्वनं ततः।।2.102.41।।
transliteration: tena vitrāsitā nāgāḥ kareṇuparivāritāḥ| āvāsayanto gandhena jagmuranyadvanṃ tatḥ||2.102.41||
meaning: Frightened by the sound, the elephants followed by their females, spreading all the way the odour of the ichor, moved to other forests.

sanskrit: वराह वृकसङ्घाश्च महिषा: सृमरास्तथा । व्याघ्रगोकर्णगवया वित्रेसुः पृषतै स‌ह।।2.102.42।।
transliteration: varāha vṛkasaṅghāśca mahiṣā: sṛmarāstathā | vyāghragokarṇagavayā vitresuḥ pṛṣatai sa‌ha||2.102.42||
meaning: Hearing that sound, hosts of boars and deer, buffaloes, serpents and apes, tigers, antelopes with ears like the cows', gavayas as well as dappled antelopes were all frightened.

sanskrit: रथाङ्गसाह्वा नत्यूहा हंसाः कारण्डवाः परे। तथा पुंस्कोकिलाः क्रौञ्चा विसंज्ञा भेजिरे दिशः।।2.102.43।।
transliteration: rathāṅgasāhvā natyūhā hṃsāḥ kāraṇḍavāḥ pare| tathā puṃskokilāḥ krauñcā visṃjñā bhejire diśḥ||2.102.43||
meaning: Ducks, watercranes, geese, karandavas, cranes, male cuckoos and kraunchas fled senselessly in different directions.

sanskrit: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्तैराकाशं पक्षिभिर्वृतम्। मनुष्यैरावृता भूमिरुभयं प्रबभौ तदा।।2.102.44।।
transliteration: tena śabdena vitrastairākāśṃ pakṣibhirvṛtam| manuṣyairāvṛtā bhūmirubhayṃ prababhau tadā||2.102.44||
meaning: The sky was filled with birds frightened by the sound and the earth covered with people. Both looked extremely beautiful.

sanskrit: ततस्तं पुरषव्याघ्रं यशस्विनमकल्पषम्। आसीनं स्थण्डिले रामं ददर्श सहसा जनः।।2.102.45।।
transliteration: tatastṃ puraṣavyāghrṃ yaśasvinamakalpaṣam| āsīnṃ sthaṇḍile rāmṃ dadarśa sahasā janḥ||2.102.45||
meaning: All at once the people saw the illustrious Rama, the best of men, and the subduer of enemies squatting on the bare earth.

sanskrit: विगर्हमाणः कैकेयीं मन्थरासहितामपि। अभिगम्य जनो रामं बाष्पपूर्णमुखोऽभवत्।।2.102.46।।
transliteration: vigarhamāṇḥ kaikeyīṃ mantharāsahitāmapi| abhigamya jano rāmṃ bāṣpapūrṇamukho'bhavat||2.102.46||
meaning: All those men with faces full of tears, reproaching Kaikeyi and Manthara (all the way), approached Rama.

sanskrit: तान्नरान्बाष्पपूर्णाक्षान्समीक्ष्याथ सुदुःखितान्। पर्यष्वजत धर्मज्ञः पितृवन्मातृवच्च सः।।2.102.47।।
transliteration: tānnarānbāṣpapūrṇākṣānsamīkṣyātha suduḥkhitān| paryaṣvajata dharmajñḥ pitṛvanmātṛvacca sḥ||2.102.47||
meaning: Thereafter, beholding those people deeply afflicted, their eyes full of tears, Rama embraced them as if they were his own father and mother.

sanskrit: स तत्र कांश्चित्परिषस्वजे नरान्नरास्तु केचित्तु तमभ्यवादयन्। चकार सर्वान्सवयस्यबान्धवान्यथार्ह मासाद्य तदा नृपात्मजः।।2.
transliteration: sa tatra kāṃścitpariṣasvaje narānnarāstu kecittu tamabhyavādayan| cakāra sarvānsavayasyabāndhavānyathārha māsādya tadā n
meaning: Rama embraced some, while others paid him obeisance. Therafter, he honoured his erstwhile companions and relations in accordance with their status.

sanskrit: स तत्र तेषां रुदतां महात्मनां भुवं च खं चानुनिनादयन्स्वनः। गुहा गिरीणां च दिशश्च सन्ततं मृदङ्गघोषप्रतिमः प्रशुश्रुवे।।2.
transliteration: sa tatra teṣāṃ rudatāṃ mahātmanāṃ bhuvṃ ca khṃ cānuninādayansvanḥ| guhā girīṇāṃ ca diśaśca santatṃ mṛdaṅgaghoṣapratimḥ p
meaning: The weeping and the tumult of those magnanimous people made the earth, sky, mountaincaves and all quarters reverberate incessantly like the beating of drums. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्व

sanskrit: राजपत्न्यश्च गच्छन्त्यो मन्दं मन्दाकिनीं प्रति। ददृशु स्तत्र तत् तीर्थं रामलक्ष्मणसेवितम्।।2.103.2।।
transliteration: rājapatnyaśca gacchantyo mandṃ mandākinīṃ prati| dadṛśu statra tat tīrthṃ rāmalakṣmaṇasevitam||2.103.2||
meaning: The wives of the king while proceeding slowly towards the river Mandakini beheld the bathing place frequented by Rama and Lakshmana.

sanskrit: कौसल्या बाष्पपूर्णेन मुखेन परिशुष्यता। सुमित्रामब्रवीद्दीना याश्चान्या राजयोषितः।।2.103.3।।
transliteration: kausalyā bāṣpapūrṇena mukhena pariśuṣyatā| sumitrāmabravīddīnā yāścānyā rājayoṣitḥ||2.103.3||
meaning: Kausalya, with eyes filled with tears and her face emaciated, addressing Sumitra and the other wives of the king sadly said:

sanskrit: इदं तेषामनाथानां क्लिष्टमक्लिष्टकर्मणाम्। वने प्राक्कलनं तीर्थं ये ते निर्विषयीकृताः।।2.103.4।।
transliteration: idṃ teṣāmanāthānāṃ kliṣṭamakliṣṭakarmaṇām| vane prākkalanṃ tīrthṃ ye te nirviṣayīkṛtāḥ||2.103.4||
meaning: This is a sacred place to the east of the forest used by the unfortunate Rama, and Lakshmana of untiring energy and Sita expelled from the country and undergoing suffering.

sanskrit: इत स्सुमित्रे पुत्रस्ते सदा जलमतन्द्रितः। स्वयं हरति सौमित्रिर्मम पुत्रस्य कारणात्।।2.103.5।।
transliteration: ita ssumitre putraste sadā jalamatandritḥ| svayṃ harati saumitrirmama putrasya kāraṇāt||2.103.5||
meaning: O Sumitra, your son Lakshmana, free from laziness, always carries water from here for the sake of my son.

sanskrit: जघन्यमपि ते पुत्रः कृतवान् न तु गर्हितः। भ्रातुर्यदर्थरहितं सर्वं तद् गर्हितंं गुणैः।।2.103.6।।
transliteration: jaghanyamapi te putrḥ kṛtavān na tu garhitḥ| bhrāturyadartharahitṃ sarvṃ tad garhitṃṃ guṇaiḥ||2.103.6||
meaning: Your son, though engaged in servile tasks (like bringing water), is not to be held contemptible because all the services intended for the benefit of his brother are prompted by virtue.

sanskrit: अद्यायमपि ते पुत्रः क्लेशानामतथोचितः। नीचानर्थ समाचारं सज्जं कर्म प्रमुञ्चतु।।2.103.7।।
transliteration: adyāyamapi te putrḥ kleśānāmatathocitḥ| nīcānartha samācārṃ sajjṃ karma pramuñcatu||2.103.7||
meaning: This your son unaccustomed to, and undeserving of, any suffering may now give up this mean and distressing duty entrusted to him.

sanskrit: दक्षिणाग्रेषु दर्भेषु सा ददर्श महीतले। पितुरिङ्गुदिपिण्याकं न्यस्तमायतलोचना।।2.103.8।।
transliteration: dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu sā dadarśa mahītale| pituriṅgudipiṇyākṃ nyastamāyatalocanā||2.103.8||
meaning: That largeeyed Kausalya beheld the cakes of ingudi pulp placed by Rama for his father on a spread of darbha grass whose blades pointed toward the south.

sanskrit: तं भूमौ पितुरार्तेन न्यस्तं रामेण वीक्ष्य सा। उवाच देवी कौसल्या सर्वा दशरथस्त्रियः।।2.103.9।।
transliteration: tṃ bhūmau piturārtena nyastṃ rāmeṇa vīkṣya sā| uvāca devī kausalyā sarvā daśarathastriyḥ||2.103.9||
meaning: Seeing the pinda (edible offering made to the departed soul) placed on the ground for his father by the distressed Rama, queen Kausalya, addressing all the wives of Dasaratha, said:

sanskrit: इदमिक्ष्वाकुनाथस्य राघवस्य महात्मनः। राघवेण पितुर्दत्तं पश्यतैतद्यथाविधि।।2.103.10।।
transliteration: idamikṣvākunāthasya rāghavasya mahātmanḥ| rāghaveṇa piturdattṃ paśyataitadyathāvidhi||2.103.10||
meaning: Have darsan of this pinda offered by Rama according to tradition to his magnanimous father, Dasaratha, lord of the Ikshvaku race.

sanskrit: तस्य देवसमानस्य पार्थिवस्य महात्मनः। नैतदौपयिकं मन्ये भुक्तभोगस्य भोजनम्।।2.103.11।।
transliteration: tasya devasamānasya pārthivasya mahātmanḥ| naitadaupayikṃ manye bhuktabhogasya bhojanam||2.103.11||
meaning: I do not think that this is an appropriate food for that godlike and great lord of the earth who enjoyed all luxury.

sanskrit: चतुरन्तां महीं भुक्त्वा महेन्द्रसदृशो विभुः। कथमिङ्गुदिपिण्याकं स भुक्ते वसुधाधिपः।।2.103.12।।
transliteration: caturantāṃ mahīṃ bhuktvā mahendrasadṛśo vibhuḥ| kathamiṅgudipiṇyākṃ sa bhukte vasudhādhipḥ||2.103.12||
meaning: How can Indralike Dasaratha, having ruled the earth bounded by four oceans, eat a cake of ingudi pulp?

sanskrit: अतो दुःखतरं लोके न किञ्चित्प्रतिभाति मा। यत्र रामः पितुर्दद्यादिङ्गुदिक्षोदमृद्धिमान्।।2.103.13।।
transliteration: ato duḥkhatarṃ loke na kiñcitpratibhāti mā| yatra rāmḥ piturdadyādiṅgudikṣodamṛddhimān||2.103.13||
meaning: Rama (who was once) highly prosperous, had to offer the cake of ingudi pulp to his father. Nothing appears more painful to me than this in this world.

sanskrit: रामेणेङ्गुदिपिण्याकं पितुर्दत्तं समीक्ष्य मे। कथं दुःखेन हृदयं न स्फोटति सहस्रधा।।2.103.14।।
transliteration: rāmeṇeṅgudipiṇyākṃ piturdattṃ samīkṣya me| kathṃ duḥkhena hṛdayṃ na sphoṭati sahasradhā||2.103.14||
meaning: Seeing the offering of cake of ingudi pulp by Rama to his father, how is it that my heart does not break into a thousand pieces in sorrow?

sanskrit: श्रुतिस्तु खल्वियं सत्या लौकिकी प्रतिभाति मा। यदन्नः पुरुषो भवति तदन्नास्तस्य देवताः।।2.103.15।।
transliteration: śrutistu khalviyṃ satyā laukikī pratibhāti mā| yadannḥ puruṣo bhavati tadannāstasya devatāḥ||2.103.15||
meaning: The wellknown saying in this world is that 'whatever food a man partakes, his gods also partake the same'. This dictum appears true (now).

sanskrit: एवमार्तां सपत्न्यस्ता जग्मुराश्वास्य तां तदा। ददृशुश्चाश्रमे रामं स्वर्गच्युतमिवामरम्।।2.103.16।।
transliteration: evamārtāṃ sapatnyastā jagmurāśvāsya tāṃ tadā| dadṛśuścāśrame rāmṃ svargacyutamivāmaram||2.103.16||
meaning: The cowives, having thus consoled the distressed Kausalya, went to the hermitage. There they beheld Rama who looked like a god dislodged from heaven.

sanskrit: सर्वभोगैः परित्यक्तं रामं सम्प्रेक्ष्य मातरः। आर्ता मुमुचुरश्रूणि सस्वरं शोककर्शिताः।।2.103.17।।
transliteration: sarvabhogaiḥ parityaktṃ rāmṃ samprekṣya mātarḥ| ārtā mumucuraśrūṇi sasvarṃ śokakarśitāḥ||2.103.17||
meaning: Beholding Rama devoid of all luxury, his mothers afflicted with grief, and overcome with sorrow, cried aloud, tears streaming down.

sanskrit: तासां रामस्समुत्थाय जग्राह चरणान् शुभान्। मात्रूणां मनुजव्याघ्रस्सर्वासां सत्यसङ्गरः।।2.103.18।।
transliteration: tāsāṃ rāmassamutthāya jagrāha caraṇān śubhān| mātrūṇāṃ manujavyāghrassarvāsāṃ satyasaṅgarḥ||2.103.18||
meaning: Rama, the best among men and true to his promise, rose and touched the auspicious feet of all his mothers (in reverence).

sanskrit: ताः पाणिभि स्सुखस्पर्शैर्मृद्वङ्गुलितलै श्शुभैः। प्रममार्जू रजः पृष्ठाद्रामस्यायतलोचनाः।।2.103.19।।
transliteration: tāḥ pāṇibhi ssukhasparśairmṛdvaṅgulitalai śśubhaiḥ| pramamārjū rajḥ pṛṣṭhādrāmasyāyatalocanāḥ||2.103.19||
meaning: Those largeeyed queens, their palms with delicate fingers and with auspicious hands with a pleasant touch, wiped the dust from the back of his body.

sanskrit: सौमित्रिरपि ता स्सर्वा मातृ़स्सम्प्रेक्ष्य दुःखितः। अभ्यवादयतासक्तं शनै रामादनन्तरम्।।2.103.20।।
transliteration: saumitrirapi tā ssarvā mātṛ़ssamprekṣya duḥkhitḥ| abhyavādayatāsaktṃ śanai rāmādanantaram||2.103.20||
meaning: On seeing his mothers, Lakshmana, too, was overcome with grief and with devotion followed Rama and slowly bowed to them with reverence.

sanskrit: यथा रामे तथा तस्मिन्सर्वा ववृतिरे स्त्रियः। वृत्तिं दशरथाज्जाते लक्ष्मणे शुभलक्षणे।।2.103.21।।
transliteration: yathā rāme tathā tasminsarvā vavṛtire striyḥ| vṛttiṃ daśarathājjāte lakṣmaṇe śubhalakṣaṇe||2.103.21||
meaning: All the queens treated Lakshmana, born of Dasaratha and endowed with auspicious qualities, with the same love as they did to Rama.

sanskrit: सीताऽपि चरणांस्तासामुपसङ्गृह्य दुःखिता। श्वश्रूणामश्रुपूर्णाक्षी सा बभूवाग्रतः स्थिता।।2.103.22।।
transliteration: sītā'pi caraṇāṃstāsāmupasaṅgṛhya duḥkhitā| śvaśrūṇāmaśrupūrṇākṣī sā babhūvāgratḥ sthitā||2.103.22||
meaning: Sita, too, overcome with grief, grasped the feet of her mothersinlaw and stood before them, her eyes full of tears.

sanskrit: तां परिष्वज्य दुःखार्तां माता दुहितरं यथा। वनवासकृशां दीनां कौसल्या वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।2.103.23।।
transliteration: tāṃ pariṣvajya duḥkhārtāṃ mātā duhitarṃ yathā| vanavāsakṛśāṃ dīnāṃ kausalyā vākyamabravīt||2.103.23||
meaning: Like a mother to her daughter, Kausalya embraced the wretched Sita, who was afflicted with sorrow, and emaciated due to her stay in the forest, and said to her:

sanskrit: विदेहराजस्य सुता स्नुषा दशरथस्य च। रामपत्नी कथं दुःखं सम्प्राप्ता निर्जने वने।।2.103.24।।
transliteration: videharājasya sutā snuṣā daśarathasya ca| rāmapatnī kathṃ duḥkhṃ samprāptā nirjane vane||2.103.24||
meaning: How is it that Sita, daughter of Janaka, king of Videha, daughterinlaw of Dasaratha and wife of Rama, has to undergo such hardships in the lonely forest.

sanskrit: पद्ममातपसन्तप्तं परिक्लिष्टमिवोत्पलम्। काञ्चनं रजसा ध्वस्तं क्लिष्टं चन्द्रमिवाम्बुदैः।।2.103.25।। मुखं ते प्रेक्ष्य मां
transliteration: padmamātapasantaptṃ parikliṣṭamivotpalam| kāñcanṃ rajasā dhvastṃ kliṣṭṃ candramivāmbudaiḥ||2.103.25|| mukhṃ te prekṣya m
meaning: O Sita, after looking at your countenance, which is like a lotus, scorched by the sunshine, or like a withered waterlily or gold defiled by dust or the Moon obscured by the clouds, the fire of sorrow is burning my mind.

sanskrit: ब्रुवन्त्यामेवमार्तायां जनन्यां भरताग्रजः। पादावासाद्य जग्राह वसिष्ठस्य च राघवः।।2.103.27।।
transliteration: bruvantyāmevamārtāyāṃ jananyāṃ bharatāgrajḥ| pādāvāsādya jagrāha vasiṣṭhasya ca rāghavḥ||2.103.27||
meaning: While Rama's mother was uttering such words in anguish, Rama reached Vasistha and clasped his feet with reverence.

sanskrit: पुरोहितस्याग्निसमस्य वै तदा बृहस्पतेरिन्द्रमिवामराधिपः। प्रगृह्य पादौ सुसमृद्धतेजसस्सहैव तेनोपविवेश राघवः।।2.103.28।।
transliteration: purohitasyāgnisamasya vai tadā bṛhaspaterindramivāmarādhipḥ| pragṛhya pādau susamṛddhatejasassahaiva tenopaviveśa rāghav
meaning: Rama touched the feet of the family priest Vasistha, a man equivalent to effulgent fire like Indra, the lord of the gods, does to Brihaspati and sat down along with him.

sanskrit: ततो जघन्यं सहितै स्समन्त्रिभिः पुरप्रधानैश्च सहैव सैनिकैः। जनेन धर्मज्ञतमेन धर्मवानुपोपविष्टो भरत स्तदाऽग्रजम्।।2.103.29
transliteration: tato jaghanyṃ sahitai ssamantribhiḥ purapradhānaiśca sahaiva sainikaiḥ| janena dharmajñatamena dharmavānupopaviṣṭo bhara
meaning: After Vasistha and Rama sat down, righteous Bharata sat close to his elder brother. Behind him sat his companions, leading citizens, soldiers and righteous men.

sanskrit: उपोपविष्ट स्तु तदा स वीर्यवांस्तपस्विवेषेण समीक्ष्य राघवम्। श्रिया ज्वलन्तं भरतः कृताञ्जलिर्यथा महेन्द्रः प्रयतः प्रजापत
transliteration: upopaviṣṭa stu tadā sa vīryavāṃstapasviveṣeṇa samīkṣya rāghavam| śriyā jvalantṃ bharatḥ kṛtāñjaliryathā mahendrḥ prayatḥ
meaning: Beholding Rama attired like an ascetic but radiant with a majestic glow, the extremely valiant Bharata sat near him with folded palms like the great Indra purified by religious austerities sits near Brahma, the creator.

sanskrit: किमेष वाक्यं भरतोऽद्य राघवं प्रणम्य सत्कृत्य च साधु वक्ष्यति। इतीव तस्यार्यजनस्य तत्त्वतो बभूव कौतूहलमुत्तमं तदा।।2.103.
transliteration: kimeṣa vākyṃ bharato'dya rāghavṃ praṇamya satkṛtya ca sādhu vakṣyati| itīva tasyāryajanasya tattvato babhūva kautūhalamu
meaning: All noble people were truly filled with great curiosity as to what Bharata was going to speak, after paying his homage and honouring Rama.

sanskrit: स राघव स्सत्यधृति श्च लक्ष्मणो महानुभावो भरत श्च धार्मिकः। वृताः सुहृद्भि श्च विरेजुरध्वरे यथा सदस्यै स्सहितास्त्रयोऽग्न
transliteration: sa rāghava ssatyadhṛti śca lakṣmaṇo mahānubhāvo bharata śca dhārmikḥ| vṛtāḥ suhṛdbhi śca virejuradhvare yathā sadasyai s
meaning: Rama who was steadfast in truth, Lakshmana of great dignity and righteous Bharata surrounded by their friends were as resplendent as three sacrificial fires encircled by officiating priests. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्

sanskrit: किमेतदिच्छेयमहं श्रोतुं प्रव्याहृतं त्वया। यस्मात्त्वमागतो देशमिमं चीरजटाजिनः।।2.104.2।।
transliteration: kimetadiccheyamahṃ śrotuṃ pravyāhṛtṃ tvayā| yasmāttvamāgato deśamimṃ cīrajaṭājinḥ||2.104.2||
meaning: I want to hear what brought you to this region with your barkrobes, matted locks and antelope skin.

sanskrit: यन्निमित्तमिमं देशं कृष्णाजिनजटाधरः। हित्वा राज्यं प्रविष्टस्त्वं तत्सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि।।2.104.3।।
transliteration: yannimittamimṃ deśṃ kṛṣṇājinajaṭādharḥ| hitvā rājyṃ praviṣṭastvṃ tatsarvṃ vaktumarhasi||2.104.3||
meaning: What made you come to this region, leaving the kingdom and wearing deer skin and matted hair? You should tell me everything.

sanskrit: इत्युक्तः कैकयीपुत्रः काकुत्स्थेन महात्मना। प्रगृह्य बलवद्भूयः प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।2.104.4।।
transliteration: ityuktḥ kaikayīputrḥ kākutsthena mahātmanā| pragṛhya balavadbhūyḥ prāñjalirvākyamabravīt||2.104.4||
meaning: Thus enquired by the magnanimous Rama, Bharata, joining his palms tightly, replied:

sanskrit: आर्यं तातः परित्यज्य कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्। गत: स्वर्ग महाबाहुः पुत्रशोकाभिपीडितः।।2.104.5।।
transliteration: āryṃ tātḥ parityajya kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram| gata: svarga mahābāhuḥ putraśokābhipīḍitḥ||2.104.5||
meaning: O my revered sire our mighty father, having performed an impossible task of banishing you to the forest, and tortured by grief due to separation from his son, went to heaven.

sanskrit: स्त्रिया नियुक्तः कैकेय्या मम मात्रा परन्तप। चकार सा महत्पापमिदमात्मयशोहरम्।।2.104.6।।
transliteration: striyā niyuktḥ kaikeyyā mama mātrā parantapa| cakāra sā mahatpāpamidamātmayaśoharam||2.104.6||
meaning: O Rama, tormentor of enemies having been instigated by a woman, my mother Kaikeyi, committed this great sin of destroying his (Dasaratha's) reputation.

sanskrit: सा राज्यफलमप्राप्य विधवा शोककर्शिता। पतिष्यति महाघोरे निरये जननी मम।।2.104.7।।
transliteration: sā rājyaphalamaprāpya vidhavā śokakarśitā| patiṣyati mahāghore niraye jananī mama||2.104.7||
meaning: My mother, formented with grief and with the fruit of the kingdom forfeited, and cursed with widowhood, will fall into the dreadful hell.

sanskrit: तस्य मे दासभूतस्य प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि। अभिषिञ्चस्व चाद्येव राज्येन मघवानिव।।2.104.8।।
transliteration: tasya me dāsabhūtasya prasādṃ kartumarhasi| abhiṣiñcasva cādyeva rājyena maghavāniva||2.104.8||
meaning: It behoves you to grant me a favour. I am like your servant. Now get yourself coronated in the kingdom like Indra.

sanskrit: इमाः प्रकृतय स्सर्वा विधवा मातरश्च याः। त्वत्सकाशमनुप्राप्ता प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि।।2.104.9।।
transliteration: imāḥ prakṛtaya ssarvā vidhavā mātaraśca yāḥ| tvatsakāśamanuprāptā prasādṃ kartumarhasi||2.104.9||
meaning: All these subjects and your widowed mothers have come to you. It behoves you to grant them this favour.

sanskrit: तदानुपूर्व्या युक्तं च युक्तं चात्मनि मानद। राज्यं प्राप्नुहि धर्मेण सकामान्सुहृदः कुरु।।2.104.10।।
transliteration: tadānupūrvyā yuktṃ ca yuktṃ cātmani mānada| rājyṃ prāpnuhi dharmeṇa sakāmānsuhṛdḥ kuru||2.104.10||
meaning: O bestower of honour by the law of primogeniture and as a worthy successor it is appropriate that you should accept the kingdom righteously and fulfil the desire of your friends.

sanskrit: भवत्वविधवा भूमि स्समग्रा पतिना त्वया। शशिना विमलेनेव शारदी रजनी यथा।।2.104.11।।
transliteration: bhavatvavidhavā bhūmi ssamagrā patinā tvayā| śaśinā vimaleneva śāradī rajanī yathā||2.104.11||
meaning: Like an autumnal night with the immaculate Moon, let this entire earth cease to be a widow by securing you as her lord.

sanskrit: एभिश्च सचिवैस्सार्धं शिरसा याचितो मया। भ्रातु शिष्यस्य दासस्य प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि।।2.104.12।।
transliteration: ebhiśca sacivaissārdhṃ śirasā yācito mayā| bhrātu  śiṣyasya dāsasya prasādṃ kartumarhasi||2.104.12||
meaning: With my head bowed down, I beseech you along with all these ministers to show favour to me who is your brother, disciple and slave.

sanskrit: तदिदं शाश्वतं पित्र्यं सर्वं प्रकृतिमण्डलम्। पूजितं पुरुषव्याघ्र नातिक्रमितुमर्हसि।।2.104.13।।
transliteration: tadidṃ śāśvatṃ pitryṃ sarvṃ prakṛtimaṇḍalam| pūjitṃ puruṣavyāghra nātikramitumarhasi||2.104.13||
meaning: O best among men, it does not behove you to transgress the prayers of the whole order of subjects and ministers to assume this hereditary and perpetual order.

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहु स्सबाष्पः कैकयीसुतः। रामस्य शिरसा पादौ जग्राह भरत: पुन:।।2.104.14।।
transliteration: evamuktvā mahābāhu ssabāṣpḥ kaikayīsutḥ| rāmasya śirasā pādau jagrāha bharata: puna:||2.104.14||
meaning: Having said thus, the mightyarmed Bharata, in accordance with tradition, grasped with tearful eyes the feet of Rama again with his head.

sanskrit: तं मत्तमिव मातङ्गं निःश्वसन्तं पुन पुनः। भ्रातरं भरतं रामः परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत्।।2.104.15।।
transliteration: tṃ mattamiva mātaṅgṃ niḥśvasantṃ puna punḥ| bhrātarṃ bharatṃ rāmḥ pariṣvajyedamabravīt||2.104.15||
meaning: Rama embraced his brother Bharata who repeatedly heaved sighs and resembled an elephant in rut, and said:

sanskrit: कुलीन:सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्तेजस्वी चरितव्रतः। राज्यहेतोः कथं पापमाचरेत्त्वद्विधो जनः।।2.104.16।।
transliteration: kulīna:sattvasampannastejasvī caritavratḥ| rājyahetoḥ kathṃ pāpamācarettvadvidho janḥ||2.104.16||
meaning: How can a man like you, born of a noble race, endowed with energy, powerful and adherent to vows, commit a sin for the sake of a kingdom?

sanskrit: न दोषं त्वयि पश्यामि सूक्ष्ममप्यरिसूदन। न चापि जननीं बाल्यात्त्वं विगर्हितुमर्हसि।।2.104.17।।
transliteration: na doṣṃ tvayi paśyāmi sūkṣmamapyarisūdana| na cāpi jananīṃ bālyāttvṃ vigarhitumarhasi||2.104.17||
meaning: O destroyer of enemies, I do not find even slightest fault with you. Like a child, it does not behove you to reproach your mother.

sanskrit: कामकारो महाप्राज्ञ गुरूणां सर्वदाऽनघ। उपपन्नेषु दारेषु पुत्रेषु च विधीयते।।2.104.18।।
transliteration: kāmakāro mahāprājña gurūṇāṃ sarvadā'nagha| upapanneṣu dāreṣu putreṣu ca vidhīyate||2.104.18||
meaning: O sagacious and sinless one, it is laid down (in sastras) that elders when married can always act at their free will towards their wives and sons.

sanskrit: वयमस्य यथा लोके सङ्ख्याता: सौम्य साधुभिः। भार्याः पुत्राश्च शिष्याश्च त्वमनुज्ञातुमर्हसि।।2.104.19।।
transliteration: vayamasya yathā loke saṅkhyātā: saumya sādhubhiḥ| bhāryāḥ putrāśca śiṣyāśca tvamanujñātumarhasi||2.104.19||
meaning: O handsome one, you should treat us the way the virtuous treat their wives, sons and disciples in this world.

sanskrit: वने वा चीरवसनं सौम्य कृष्णाजिनाम्बरम्। राज्ये वाऽपि महाराजो मां वासयितुमीश्वरः।।2.104.20।।
transliteration: vane vā cīravasanṃ saumya kṛṣṇājināmbaram| rājye vā'pi mahārājo māṃ vāsayitumīśvarḥ||2.104.20||
meaning: O handsome one, king Dasaratha is alone competent to accommodate me in the forest wearing bark robes and antelope skin as garment or install me in the kingdom.

sanskrit: यावत पितरि धर्मज्ञे गौरवं लोकसत्कृतम्। तावद्धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठ जनन्यामपि गौरवम्।।2.104.21।।
transliteration: yāvata pitari dharmajñe gauravṃ lokasatkṛtam| tāvaddharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha jananyāmapi gauravam||2.104.21||
meaning: O best among the protectors of righteousness the honour shown to our father who is conversant with the ways of righteousness and much revered by the world ought to be shown towards our mother also.

sanskrit: एताभ्यां धर्मशीलाभ्यां वनं गच्छेति राघव। मातापितृभ्यामुक्तोऽहं कथमन्यत्समाचरे।।2.104.22।।
transliteration: etābhyāṃ dharmaśīlābhyāṃ vanṃ gaccheti rāghava| mātāpitṛbhyāmukto'hṃ kathamanyatsamācare||2.104.22||
meaning: O Bharata, I have been commanded by our righteous father and mother to go to the forest. How can any one act otherwise?

sanskrit: त्वया राज्यमयोध्यायां प्राप्तव्यं लोकसत्कृतम्। वस्तव्यं दण्डकारण्ये मया वल्कलवाससा।।2.104.23।।
transliteration: tvayā rājyamayodhyāyāṃ prāptavyṃ lokasatkṛtam| vastavyṃ daṇḍakāraṇye mayā valkalavāsasā||2.104.23||
meaning: You shall rule the kingdom wellhonoured by the people in Ayodhya and I shall live in Dandaka forest wearing bark as garments.

sanskrit: एवं कृत्वा महाराजो विभागं लोकसन्निधौ। व्यादिश्य च महातेजा दिवं दशरथो गतः।।2.104.24।।
transliteration: evṃ kṛtvā mahārājo vibhāgṃ lokasannidhau| vyādiśya ca mahātejā divṃ daśaratho gatḥ||2.104.24||
meaning: The maharja of great radiance made this division in the presence of people and after commanding thus, ascended heaven.

sanskrit: स च प्रमाणं धर्मात्मा राजा लोकगुरुस्तव। पित्रा दत्तं यथाभागमुपभोक्तुं त्वमर्हसि।।2.104.25।।
transliteration: sa ca pramāṇṃ dharmātmā rājā lokagurustava| pitrā dattṃ yathābhāgamupabhoktuṃ tvamarhasi||2.104.25||
meaning: The proclamation of that righteous king revered by the world shall be your guide. You should enjoy that portion bestowed by father.

sanskrit: चतुर्दश समास्सौम्य दण्डकारण्यमाश्रितः। उपभोक्ष्ये त्वहं दत्तं भागं पित्रा महात्मना।।2.104.26।।
transliteration: caturdaśa samāssaumya daṇḍakāraṇyamāśritḥ| upabhokṣye tvahṃ dattṃ bhāgṃ pitrā mahātmanā||2.104.26||
meaning: O handsome one, as for myself, I shall enjoy the portion bestowed on me by my magnanimous father and shall take refuge in the Dandaka forest for fourteen years.

sanskrit: यदब्रवीन्मां नरलोकसत्कृतः पिता महात्मा विबुधाधिपोपमः। तदेव मन्ये परमात्मनो हितं न सर्वलोकेश्वर भावमप्ययम्।।2.104.27।।
transliteration: yadabravīnmāṃ naralokasatkṛtḥ pitā mahātmā vibudhādhipopamḥ| tadeva manye paramātmano hitṃ na sarvalokeśvara bhāvamapyay
meaning: I think what my great father, who is honoured by all men, and an equal to Indra, ordered is for my highest welfare. The will of the overlord of the world should not be done away with. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आ

sanskrit: रजन्यां सुप्रभातायां भ्रातरस्ते सुहृद्वृताः। मन्दाकिन्यां हुतं जप्यं कृत्वा राममुपागमन्।।2.105.2।।
transliteration: rajanyāṃ suprabhātāyāṃ bhrātaraste suhṛdvṛtāḥ| mandākinyāṃ hutṃ japyṃ kṛtvā rāmamupāgaman||2.105.2||
meaning: When the night dawned, those brothers surrounded by their friends made (morning) ablutions and, after the prayers, returned to Rama.

sanskrit: तूष्णीं ते समुपासीना न कश्चित्किञ्चिदब्रवीत्। भरतस्तु सुहृन्मध्ये रामं वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.105.3।।
transliteration: tūṣṇīṃ te samupāsīnā na kaścitkiñcidabravīt| bharatastu suhṛnmadhye rāmṃ vacanamabravīt||2.105.3||
meaning: All of them sat together silently and no one uttered a word. Bharata alone from among them addressed Rama saying:

sanskrit: सान्त्विता मामिका माता दत्तं राज्यमिदं मम। तद्ददामि तवैवाहं भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यमकण्टकम्।।2.105.4।।
transliteration: sāntvitā māmikā mātā dattṃ rājyamidṃ mama| taddadāmi tavaivāhṃ bhuṅkṣva rājyamakaṇṭakam||2.105.4||
meaning: This kingdom was given to me for the satisfaction of my mother. I am bestowing it back on you. Enjoy it without any obstacles.

sanskrit: महतेवाम्बुवेगेन भिन्नस्सेतुर्जलागमे। दुरावारं त्वदन्येन राज्यखण्डमिदं महत्।।2.105.5।।
transliteration: mahatevāmbuvegena bhinnasseturjalāgame| durāvārṃ tvadanyena rājyakhaṇḍamidṃ mahat||2.105.5||
meaning: Like a dyke bursts under pressure by the great surge of waters during the rainy season, this vast kingdom cannot be sustained by any one except yourself.

sanskrit: गतिं खर इवाश्वस्य तार्क्ष्यस्येव पतत्रिणः। अनुगन्तुं न शक्तिर्मे गतिं तव महीपते।।2.105.6।।
transliteration: gatiṃ khara ivāśvasya tārkṣyasyeva patatriṇḥ| anugantuṃ na śaktirme gatiṃ tava mahīpate||2.105.6||
meaning: O lord of the earth as an ass cannot follow the pace of a horse or a bird, the pace of Tarkshya (Garuda), I do not have the capability to follow you.

sanskrit: सुजीवं नित्यशस्तस्य यः परैरुपजीव्यते। राम तेन तु दुर्जीवं यः परानुपजीवति।।2.105.7।।
transliteration: sujīvṃ nityaśastasya yḥ parairupajīvyate| rāma tena tu durjīvṃ yḥ parānupajīvati||2.105.7||
meaning: O Rama, the life of a man on whom others depend for their sustenance is a happy life and the life of one who depends on others for his own mintenance is miserable.

sanskrit: यथा तु रोपितो वृक्षः पुरुषेण विवर्धितः। ह्रस्वकेण दुरारोहो रूढस्कन्धो महाद्रुमः।।2.105.8।। स यदा पुष्पितो भूत्वा फलानि न
transliteration: yathā tu ropito vṛkṣḥ puruṣeṇa vivardhitḥ| hrasvakeṇa durāroho rūḍhaskandho mahādrumḥ||2.105.8|| sa yadā puṣpito bhūtvā
meaning: O mightyarmed Rama, a man plants a tree, rears it till it grows into such a large tree with a big trunk that it becomes difficult for a dwarf to climb. When the tree flowers but does not bear fruit, the man who planted i

sanskrit: श्रेणयस्त्वां महाराज पश्यन्त्वग्य्राश्च सर्वशः। प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यं राज्ये स्थित मरिन्दमम्।।2.105.11।।
transliteration: śreṇayastvāṃ mahārāja paśyantvagyrāśca sarvaśḥ| pratapantamivādityṃ rājye sthita marindamam||2.105.11||
meaning: O great king and subduer of enemies, may all the leading guilds of traders and other subjects behold you all over installed in the kingdom like the resplendent Sun.

sanskrit: तवानुयाने काकुत्स्थ मत्ता नर्दन्तु कुञ्जराः। अन्तःपुरगता नार्यो नन्दन्तु सुसमाहिताः।।2.105.12।।
transliteration: tavānuyāne kākutstha mattā nardantu kuñjarāḥ| antḥpuragatā nāryo nandantu susamāhitāḥ||2.105.12||
meaning: O Rama, let the elephants following you, intoxicated with ichor, be heard trumpeting. Let the women of the inner apartment rejoice with composed minds (when they hear of your return).

sanskrit: तस्य साध्वित्यमन्यन्त नागरा विविधा जनाः। भरतस्य वच श्श्रुत्वा रामं प्रत्यनुयाचतः।।2.105.13।।
transliteration: tasya sādhvityamanyanta nāgarā vividhā janāḥ| bharatasya vaca śśrutvā rāmṃ pratyanuyācatḥ||2.105.13||
meaning: Hearing the words of Bharata beseeching Rama to return, various classes of people of the city of Ayodhya, in approbation exclaimed well said.

sanskrit: तमेवं दुःखितं प्रेक्ष्य विलपन्तं यशस्विनम्। रामः कृतात्मा भरतं समाश्वासयदात्मवान्।।2.105.14।।
transliteration: tamevṃ duḥkhitṃ prekṣya vilapantṃ yaśasvinam| rāmḥ kṛtātmā bharatṃ samāśvāsayadātmavān||2.105.14||
meaning: Having seen the illustrious Bharata lamenting that way, Rama, a man of firm determination and selfpossession, consoled him thus:

sanskrit: नाऽत्मनः कामकारोऽस्ति पुरुषोऽयमनीश्वरः। इतश्चेतरतश्चैनं कृतान्तः परिकर्षति।।2.105.15।।
transliteration: nā'tmanḥ kāmakāro'sti puruṣo'yamanīśvarḥ| itaścetarataścainṃ kṛtāntḥ parikarṣati||2.105.15||
meaning: A man is neither independent nor competent to do any act on his free will. Fate pulls him this way or the other.

sanskrit: सर्वे क्षयान्ताः निचयाः पतनान्ता समुच्छ्रयाः। संयोगा विप्रयोगान्ता मरणान्तं च जीवितम्।।2.105.16।।
transliteration: sarve kṣayāntāḥ nicayāḥ patanāntā samucchrayāḥ| sṃyogā viprayogāntā maraṇāntṃ ca jīvitam||2.105.16||
meaning: All accumulations of wealth deplete at the end. Every man who attains elevated positions falls at the end. Every union culminates in separation. Every life ends in death.

sanskrit: यथा फलानां पक्वानां नान्यत्र पतनाद्भयम्। एवं नरस्य जातस्य नान्यत्र मरणाद्भयम्।।2.105.17।।
transliteration: yathā phalānāṃ pakvānāṃ nānyatra patanādbhayam| evṃ narasya jātasya nānyatra maraṇādbhayam||2.105.17||
meaning: The only fear of a ripened fruit is the fear of falling down (from the tree). In the same way every man who is born has no other fear except the fear of death.

sanskrit: यथाऽगारं दृढस्थूणं जीर्णं भूत्वाऽवसीदति। तथैव सीदन्ति नरा जरामृत्युवशं गताः।।2.105.18।।
transliteration: yathā'gārṃ dṛḍhasthūṇṃ jīrṇṃ bhūtvā'vasīdati| tathaiva sīdanti narā jarāmṛtyuvaśṃ gatāḥ||2.105.18||
meaning: Even a house constructed with sturdy pillars gets dilapidated and ultimately decays. In the same way people under the sway of old age and death are destroyed (at last).

sanskrit: अत्येति रजनी या तु सा न प्रतिनिवर्तते। यात्येव यमुना पूर्णा समुद्रमुदकाकुलम्।।2.105.19।।
transliteration: atyeti rajanī yā tu sā na pratinivartate| yātyeva yamunā pūrṇā samudramudakākulam||2.105.19||
meaning: A night that once passe off does not return like the waters of river Yamuna that flow into the ocean filled with water (the water do not flow back into Yamuna).

sanskrit: अहोरात्राणि गच्छन्ति सर्वेषां प्राणिनामिह। अायूंषि क्षपयन्त्याशु ग्रीष्मे जलमिवांशवः।।2.105.20।।
transliteration: ahorātrāṇi gacchanti sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmiha| aāyūṃṣi kṣapayantyāśu grīṣme jalamivāṃśavḥ||2.105.20||
meaning: The passing days and nights quickly decrease the life span of all living beings in this world, like sunrays drying up the water in summer.

sanskrit: आत्मानमनुशोच त्वं किमन्यमनुशोचसि। आयुस्ते हीयते यस्य स्थितस्य च गतस्य च।।2.105.21।।
transliteration: ātmānamanuśoca tvṃ kimanyamanuśocasi| āyuste hīyate yasya sthitasya ca gatasya ca||2.105.21||
meaning: Whether you are static or moving, your lifespan decreases. Therefore, you should only grieve about yourself and not for any one else.

sanskrit: सहैव मृत्युर्व्रजति सह मृत्युर्निषीदति। गत्वासुदीर्घमध्वानं सहमृत्युर्निवर्तते।।2.105.22।।
transliteration: sahaiva mṛtyurvrajati saha mṛtyurniṣīdati| gatvāsudīrghamadhvānṃ sahamṛtyurnivartate||2.105.22||
meaning: Death follows a man wherever he goes. When he sits, death sits with him. Even after travelling a very long distance, the man returns along with death.

sanskrit: गात्रेषु वलयः प्राप्ता श्श्वेताश्चैव शिरोरुहाः। जरया पुरुषो जीर्णः किं हि कृत्वा प्रभावयेत्।।2.105.23।।
transliteration: gātreṣu valayḥ prāptā śśvetāścaiva śiroruhāḥ| jarayā puruṣo jīrṇḥ kiṃ hi kṛtvā prabhāvayet||2.105.23||
meaning: Wrinkels form on the body and hair turns grey in old age. In this way, decayed with age, what can a man do to have control over death.

sanskrit: नन्दन्त्युदित आदित्ये नन्दन्त्यस्तमितेऽहनि। आत्मनो नावबुध्यन्ते मनुष्या जीवितक्षयम्।।2.105.24।।
transliteration: nandantyudita āditye nandantyastamite'hani| ātmano nāvabudhyante manuṣyā jīvitakṣayam||2.105.24||
meaning: People rejoice when the Sun rises and rejoice when the Sun sets. But they are unaware of the decline of the life span of their own.

sanskrit: हृष्यन्त्यृतुमुखं दृष्ट्वा नवं नवमिहागतम्। ऋतूनां परिवर्तेन प्राणिनां प्राणसङ्क्षयः।।2.105.25।।
transliteration: hṛṣyantyṛtumukhṃ dṛṣṭvā navṃ navamihāgatam| ṛtūnāṃ parivartena prāṇināṃ prāṇasaṅkṣayḥ||2.105.25||
meaning: At the advent of each new season men feel delighted to see the newly blossomed flowers and fruits. But with the change of the scasons the life span also diminishes.

sanskrit: यथा काष्ठं च काष्ठं च समेयातां महार्णवे। समेत्य च व्यपेयातां कालमासाद्य कञ्चन।।2.105.26।। एवं भार्याश्चपुत्राश्च ज्ञातयश
transliteration: yathā kāṣṭhṃ ca kāṣṭhṃ ca sameyātāṃ mahārṇave| sametya ca vyapeyātāṃ kālamāsādya kañcana||2.105.26|| evṃ bhāryāścaputrāś
meaning: In a mighty ocean, two pieces of logs meet one another, float together and in due course get separated. In the same way wives, sons, relatives and riches remain together for some time and thereafter get separated. Their

sanskrit: यथा काष्ठं च काष्ठं च समेयातां महार्णवे। समेत्य च व्यपेयातां कालमासाद्य कञ्चन।।2.105.26।। एवं भार्याश्चपुत्राश्च ज्ञातयश
transliteration: yathā kāṣṭhṃ ca kāṣṭhṃ ca sameyātāṃ mahārṇave| sametya ca vyapeyātāṃ kālamāsādya kañcana||2.105.26|| evṃ bhāryāścaputrāś
meaning: In a mighty ocean, two pieces of logs meet one another, float together and in due course get separated. In the same way wives, sons, relatives and riches remain together for some time and thereafter get separated. Their

sanskrit: नात्र कश्चिद्यथाभावं प्राणी समभिवर्तते। तेन तस्मिन्न सामर्थ्यं प्रेतस्या स्त्यनुशोचतः।।2.105.28।।
transliteration: nātra kaścidyathābhāvṃ prāṇī samabhivartate| tena tasminna sāmarthyṃ pretasyā styanuśocatḥ||2.105.28||
meaning: No living being in this world can act as he likes. Therefore, no one should grieve for the dead.

sanskrit: यथा हि सार्थं गच्छन्तं ब्रूयात्कश्चित्पथि स्थितः। अहमप्यागमिष्यामि पृष्ठतो भवता मिति।।2.105.29।। एवं पूर्वैर्गतो मार्गः
transliteration: yathā hi sārthṃ gacchantṃ brūyātkaścitpathi sthitḥ| ahamapyāgamiṣyāmi pṛṣṭhato bhavatā miti||2.105.29|| evṃ pūrvairgato
meaning: Like a man standing on the wayside says to a passing caravan, 'I am following you', and follows them, the road taken by our fathers and forefathers is certain for every one and cannot be violated by a person treading tha

sanskrit: वयसः पतमानस्य स्रोतसो वाऽनिवर्तिनः। आत्मा सुखे नियोक्तव्यस्सुखभाजः प्रजाः स्मृताः।।2.105.31।।
transliteration: vayasḥ patamānasya srotaso vā'nivartinḥ| ātmā sukhe niyoktavyassukhabhājḥ prajāḥ smṛtāḥ||2.105.31||
meaning: Like the flow of water which never reverts to its source, age passes. Therefore, a man must employ his self in righteous acts that bring him happiness. By doing so, it is said, people will always be happy.

sanskrit: धर्मात्मा स शुभैः कृत्स्नैः क्रतुभिश्चाप्तदक्षिणैः। स्वर्गं दशरथः प्राप्तः पिता नः पृथिवीपतिः।।2.105.32।।
transliteration: dharmātmā sa śubhaiḥ kṛtsnaiḥ kratubhiścāptadakṣiṇaiḥ| svargṃ daśarathḥ prāptḥ pitā nḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ||2.105.32||
meaning: Our righteous father and lord of the earth, Dasaratha, attained heaven by giving abundant charities and performing several sacrifices in accordance with tradition.

sanskrit: भृत्यानां भरणात्सम्यक्प्रजानां परिपालनात्। अर्थादानाच्च धर्मेण पिता न स्त्रिदिवंगतः।।2.105.33।।
transliteration: bhṛtyānāṃ bharaṇātsamyakprajānāṃ paripālanāt| arthādānācca dharmeṇa pitā na stridivṃgatḥ||2.105.33||
meaning: Our father nourished his dependents, splendidly governed his subjects and accepted wealth through righteous ways. Because of these pious acts, he could go to heaven.

sanskrit: कर्मभि स्तु शुभैरिष्टैः क्रतुभिश्चाप्तदक्षिणैः। स्वर्गं दशरथः प्राप्तः पिता नः पृथिवीपतिः।।2.105.34।।
transliteration: karmabhi stu śubhairiṣṭaiḥ kratubhiścāptadakṣiṇaiḥ| svargṃ daśarathḥ prāptḥ pitā nḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ||2.105.34||
meaning: Dasaratha, our father and lord of the earth, reached heaven by performing auspicious acts and offering abundant charities in sacrifices.

sanskrit: इष्ट्वा बहुविधैर्यज्ञैर्भोगां श्चावाप्य पुष्कलान्। उत्तमं चायुरासाद्य स्वर्गतः पृथिवीपतिः।।2.105.35।।
transliteration: iṣṭvā bahuvidhairyajñairbhogāṃ ścāvāpya puṣkalān| uttamṃ cāyurāsādya svargatḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ||2.105.35||
meaning: King Dasaratha, lord of the earth, having performed various kinds of sacrifices and securing a long life, enjoyed abundance of pleasures and attained heaven.

sanskrit: आयुरुत्तममासाद्य भोगानपि च राघवः। स न शोच्यः पिता तात स्वर्गत स्सत्कृत स्सताम्।।2.105.36।।
transliteration: āyuruttamamāsādya bhogānapi ca rāghavḥ| sa na śocyḥ pitā tāta svargata ssatkṛta ssatām||2.105.36||
meaning: O dear our father, king Dasaratha, who was honoured by the virtuous and enjoyed the best of pleasures attained heaven after a long life. Therefore, he is not to be grieved over.

sanskrit: स जीर्णं मानुषं देहं परित्यज्य पिता हि नः। दैवीमृद्धिमनुप्राप्तो ब्रह्मलोकविहारिणीम्।।2.105.37।।
transliteration: sa jīrṇṃ mānuṣṃ dehṃ parityajya pitā hi nḥ| daivīmṛddhimanuprāpto brahmalokavihāriṇīm||2.105.37||
meaning: Our father, king Dasaratha, abandoned the wornout mortal body, and obtained divine prosperity of wandering in the world of Brahma.

sanskrit: तं तु नैवंविधः कश्चित्प्राज्ञ श्शोचितुमर्हति। तत्विधो मद्विधश्चापि श्रुतवान्बुद्धिमत्तरः।।2.105.38।।
transliteration: tṃ tu naivṃvidhḥ kaścitprājña śśocitumarhati| tatvidho madvidhaścāpi śrutavānbuddhimattarḥ||2.105.38||
meaning: No one like you or me should ever mourn about this highly sagacious and learned king who was proficient in scriptural knowledge.

sanskrit: एते बहुविधा शोका विलापरुदिते तथा। वर्जनीया हि धीरेण सर्वावस्थासु धीमता।।2.105.39।।
transliteration: ete bahuvidhā śokā vilāparudite tathā| varjanīyā hi dhīreṇa sarvāvasthāsu dhīmatā||2.105.39||
meaning: A wise man, holding on to his fortitude in all circumstances, should avoid such occasions of grief, these words of lamentation and this crying.

sanskrit: स स्वस्थो भव मा शोचेर्यात्वा चावसतां पुरीम्। तथा पित्रा नियुक्तोऽसि वशिना वदतां वर।।2.105.40।।
transliteration: sa svastho bhava mā śoceryātvā cāvasatāṃ purīm| tathā pitrā niyukto'si vaśinā vadatāṃ vara||2.105.40||
meaning: O foremost of the eloquent, compose yourself. Do not grieve. Return to the city (Ayodhya) and reside there. You have been commanded so by our father who was a man of selfcontrol.

sanskrit: यत्राहमपि तेनैव नियुक्तः पुण्यकर्मणा। तत्रैवाहं करिष्यामि पितुरार्यस्य शासनम्।।2.105.41।।
transliteration: yatrāhamapi tenaiva niyuktḥ puṇyakarmaṇā| tatraivāhṃ kariṣyāmi piturāryasya śāsanam||2.105.41||
meaning: I shall also stick to the command of our noble father who was a man of sacred deeds.

sanskrit: न मया शासनं तस्य त्यक्तुं न्याय्य मरिन्दम। स त्वयापि सदा मान्यं स वै बन्धु स नः पिता।।2.105.42।।
transliteration: na mayā śāsanṃ tasya tyaktuṃ nyāyya marindama| sa tvayāpi sadā mānyṃ sa vai bandhu sa nḥ pitā||2.105.42||
meaning: O subduer of enemies, I cannot violate the order of the king. You also must respect it for he is our father and friend indeed.

sanskrit: तद्वचः पितुरेवाहं सम्मतं धर्मचारिणः। कर्मणा पालयिष्यामि वनवासेन राघव।।2.105.43।।
transliteration: tadvacḥ piturevāhṃ sammatṃ dharmacāriṇḥ| karmaṇā pālayiṣyāmi vanavāsena rāghava||2.105.43||
meaning: O Bharata, I will, therefore, obey the command of our venerable father, the champion of righteousness, by living in the forest.

sanskrit: धार्मिकेणानृशंसेन नरेण गुरुवर्तिना। भवितव्यं नरव्याघ्र परलोकं जिगीषता।।2.105.44।।
transliteration: dhārmikeṇānṛśṃsena nareṇa guruvartinā| bhavitavyṃ naravyāghra paralokṃ jigīṣatā||2.105.44||
meaning: O best of men, if a man aspires to conquer the higher world, he should remain virtuous, compassionate and obedient to his preceptors.

sanskrit: आत्मानमनुतिष्ठत्वं स्वभावेन नरर्षभ। निशाम्यतु शुभं वृत्तं पितुर्दशरथस्य नः।।2.105.45।।
transliteration: ātmānamanutiṣṭhatvṃ svabhāvena nararṣabha| niśāmyatu śubhṃ vṛttṃ piturdaśarathasya nḥ||2.105.45||
meaning: O best of men, having seen the auspicious life of our father Dasaratha and his conduct, you also stick to your own duty.

sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं महात्मा पितुर्निदेश प्रतिपालनार्थम्। यवीयसं भ्रातरमर्थवच्च प्रभुर्मुहूर्ताद्विरराम रामः।।2.105.46।।
transliteration: ityevamuktvā vacanṃ mahātmā piturnideśa pratipālanārtham| yavīyasṃ bhrātaramarthavacca prabhurmuhūrtādvirarāma rāmḥ||2.1
meaning: Rama, the magnanimous lord, addressed his younger brother Bharata with words full of significance, saying, Obey father's command and remained silent in a moment. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे

sanskrit: को हि स्यादीदृशो लोके यादृश स्त्वमरिन्दमः।।2.106.2।। न त्वां प्रव्यथयेद्दुःखं प्रीतिर्वा नप्रहर्षयेत्। सम्मतश्चासि वृद्ध
transliteration: ko hi syādīdṛśo loke yādṛśa stvamarindamḥ||2.106.2|| na tvāṃ pravyathayedduḥkhṃ prītirvā napraharṣayet| sammataścāsi vṛd
meaning: O subduer of enemies, you are of such nature that neither sorrow pains you nor pleasure delights you. There are none in this world like you. You are loved by the elders, for you seek their counsel whenever you have doubt

sanskrit: को हि स्यादीदृशो लोके यादृश स्त्वमरिन्दम।।2.106.2।। न त्वां प्रव्यथयेद्दुःखं प्रीतिर्वा नप्रहर्षयेत्। सम्मतश्चासि वृद्धा
transliteration: ko hi syādīdṛśo loke yādṛśa stvamarindama||2.106.2|| na tvāṃ pravyathayedduḥkhṃ prītirvā napraharṣayet| sammataścāsi vṛd
meaning: O subduer of enemies, you are of such nature that neither sorrow pains you nor pleasure delights you. There are none in this world like you. You are loved by the elders, for you seek their counsel whenever you have doubt

sanskrit: यथा मृत स्तथा जीवन्यथाऽसति तथा सति। यस्यैष बुद्धिलाभ स्स्यात्परितप्येत केन सः।।2.106.4।।
transliteration: yathā mṛta stathā jīvanyathā'sati tathā sati| yasyaiṣa buddhilābha ssyātparitapyeta kena sḥ||2.106.4||
meaning: One should accept life and death, vice and virtue equally. How can one be afflicted when he has gained such an intellect?

sanskrit: परावरज्ञो यश्च स्याद् यथा त्वं मनुजाधिप। स एव व्यसनं प्राप्य न विषीदितुमर्हति।।2.106.5।।
transliteration: parāvarajño yaśca syād yathā tvṃ manujādhipa| sa eva vyasanṃ prāpya na viṣīditumarhati||2.106.5||
meaning: O lord of men, it is not proper for a person like you who knows the past and the future of human beings to feel distressed and lament over it.

sanskrit: अमरोपमसत्त्व स्त्वं महात्मा सत्यसङ्गरः। सर्वज्ञ स्सर्वदर्शी च बुद्धिमांश्चासि राघव।।2.106.6।।
transliteration: amaropamasattva stvṃ mahātmā satyasaṅgarḥ| sarvajña ssarvadarśī ca buddhimāṃścāsi rāghava||2.106.6||
meaning: O magnanimous Rama, your nature is divine and you are true to your promises. You are omniscient, allseeing and wise.

sanskrit: न त्वामेवं गुणैर्युक्तं प्रभवाभवकोविदम्। अविषह्यतमं दुःखमासादयितुमर्हति।।2.106.7।।
transliteration: na tvāmevṃ guṇairyuktṃ prabhavābhavakovidam| aviṣahyatamṃ duḥkhamāsādayitumarhati||2.106.7||
meaning: It is not proper for a virtuous man like you, who is cognizant in matters of life and death, to be overwhelmed by such insufferable grief.

sanskrit: प्रोषिते मयि यत्पापं मात्रा मत्कारणात्कृतम्। क्षुद्रया तदनिष्टं मे प्रसीदतु भवान्मम।।2.106.8।।
transliteration: proṣite mayi yatpāpṃ mātrā matkāraṇātkṛtam| kṣudrayā tadaniṣṭṃ me prasīdatu bhavānmama||2.106.8||
meaning: When I was away from home, my meanminded mother committed a sin for my sake which I never wished. You may pardon me graciously.

sanskrit: धर्मबन्धेन बद्धोऽस्मि तेनेमां नेह मातरम्। हन्मितीव्रेण दण्डेन दण्डार्हां पापकारिणीम्।।2.106.9।।
transliteration: dharmabandhena baddho'smi tenemāṃ neha mātaram| hanmitīvreṇa daṇḍena daṇḍārhāṃ pāpakāriṇīm||2.106.9||
meaning: I am bound by a bond of righteousness for which I am unble to slay my mother who deserves severe punishment for her sinful acts.

sanskrit: कथं दशरथा ज्जात श्शुद्धाभिजनकर्मणः। जानन् धर्ममधर्मिष्ठं कुर्यां कर्म जुगुप्सितम्।।2.106.10।।
transliteration: kathṃ daśarathā jjāta śśuddhābhijanakarmaṇḥ| jānan dharmamadharmiṣṭhṃ kuryāṃ karma jugupsitam||2.106.10||
meaning: How shall I, born to Dasaratha of noble race and righteous deeds, with the knowledge of dharma, do such a reprehensible and unrighteous deed?

sanskrit: गुरुः क्रियावान्वृद्धश्च राजा प्रेतः पितेतिच। तातं न परिगर्हेयं दैवतं चेति संसदि।।2.106.11।।
transliteration: guruḥ kriyāvānvṛddhaśca rājā pretḥ pitetica| tātṃ na parigarheyṃ daivatṃ ceti sṃsadi||2.106.11||
meaning: King Dasaratha, my father and preceptor, is godlike to me. Devoted to meritorious acts, he departed from this world in his old age. For this reason, I cannot reproach him (publicly) in this assembly (of men).

sanskrit: को हि धर्मार्थयोर्हीनमीदृशं कर्म किल्बिषम्। स्त्रियाः प्रियं चिकीर्षु स्सन्कुर्याद्धर्मज्ञ धर्मवित्।।2.106.12।।
transliteration: ko hi dharmārthayorhīnamīdṛśṃ karma kilbiṣam| striyāḥ priyṃ cikīrṣu ssankuryāddharmajña dharmavit||2.106.12||
meaning: O Rama, conversant with righteousness, will any one who knows the meaning of righteousness, do such a sinful act contrary to dharma and artha to please a woman?

sanskrit: अन्तकाले हि भूतानि मुह्यन्तीति पुरा श्रुतिः। राज्ञैवं कुर्वता लोके प्रत्यक्षं सा श्रुतिः कृता।।2.106.13।।
transliteration: antakāle hi bhūtāni muhyantīti purā śrutiḥ| rājñaivṃ kurvatā loke pratyakṣṃ sā śrutiḥ kṛtā||2.106.13||
meaning: There is an ancient saying that at the time of death, the intellect of people is deluded. By conducting himself in this way, king Dasaratha has proved it.

sanskrit: साध्वर्थमभिसन्धाय क्रोधान्मोहाच्च साहसात्। तातस्य यदतिक्रान्तं प्रत्याहरतु तद्भवान्।।2.106.14।।
transliteration: sādhvarthamabhisandhāya krodhānmohācca sāhasāt| tātasya yadatikrāntṃ pratyāharatu tadbhavān||2.106.14||
meaning: Our father has trangressed righteousness due to anger or delusion or recklessness. Therefore, you may think over the matter prudently and set it right.

sanskrit: पितुर्हि समतिक्रान्तं पुत्रो यस्साधु मन्यते। तदपत्यं मतं लोके विपरीतमतोऽन्यथा।।2.106.15।।
transliteration: piturhi samatikrāntṃ putro yassādhu manyate| tadapatyṃ matṃ loke viparītamato'nyathā||2.106.15||
meaning: One who sets right the wrongs done by his father is a true son. Otherwise the son becomes just the opposite. (He is not a son to the father).

sanskrit: तदपत्यं भवानस्तु मा भवान् दुष्कृतं पितुः। अभिपत्ता कृतं कर्म लोके धीरविगर्हितम्।।2.106.16।।
transliteration: tadapatyṃ bhavānastu mā bhavān duṣkṛtṃ pituḥ| abhipattā kṛtṃ karma loke dhīravigarhitam||2.106.16||
meaning: So be a worthy son and let not the sinful act committed by our father and condemned by men of wisdom be approved by you.

sanskrit: कैकेयीं मां च तातं च सुहृदो बान्धवांश्च नः। पौरजानपदान्सर्वांस्त्रातु सर्वमिदं भवान्।।2.106.17।।
transliteration: kaikeyīṃ māṃ ca tātṃ ca suhṛdo bāndhavāṃśca nḥ| paurajānapadānsarvāṃstrātu sarvamidṃ bhavān||2.106.17||
meaning: Protect this entire kingdom, Kaikeyi, me and father, our friends and relations, citizens of the city and inhabitants of the countryside.

sanskrit: क्व चारण्यं क्वच क्षात्रं क्व जटाः क्व च पालनम्। ईदृशं व्याहतं कर्म न भवान्कर्तुमर्हति।।2.106.18।।
transliteration: kva cāraṇyṃ kvaca kṣātrṃ kva jaṭāḥ kva ca pālanam| īdṛśṃ vyāhatṃ karma na bhavānkartumarhati||2.106.18||
meaning: Where is the forest and where is kshatriya's duty? Where are matted locks and where is governance of the kingdom? It does not behave you to do such acts antithetical to each other.

sanskrit: एष हि प्रथमो धर्मः क्षत्रियस्याभिषेचनम्। येन शक्यं महाप्राज्ञ प्रजानां परिपालनम्।।2.106.19।।
transliteration: eṣa hi prathamo dharmḥ kṣatriyasyābhiṣecanam| yena śakyṃ mahāprājña prajānāṃ paripālanam||2.106.19||
meaning: O sagacious one, the primary duty of a kshatriya is to be crowned. This enables him to rule his subjects.

sanskrit: कश्च प्रत्यक्षमुत्सृज्य संशयस्थ मलक्षणम्। आयतिस्थं चरे द्धर्मं क्षत्रबन्दुरनिश्चितम्।।2.106.20।।
transliteration: kaśca pratyakṣamutsṛjya sṃśayastha malakṣaṇam| āyatisthṃ care ddharmṃ kṣatrabanduraniścitam||2.106.20||
meaning: Will any kshatriya, setting aside his first duty, follow an uncertain course of piety which is contrary to his dharma and whose impact may be felt in a remote future.

sanskrit: अथ क्लेशज मेव त्वं धर्मं चरितु मिच्छसि। धर्मेण चतुरो वर्णान्पालयन् क्लेश माप्नुहि।।2.106.21।।
transliteration: atha kleśaja meva tvṃ dharmṃ caritu micchasi| dharmeṇa caturo varṇānpālayan kleśa māpnuhi||2.106.21||
meaning: If you so desire to follow the path of dharma acquired out of physical exertion, then bear the trouble of governing the four castes of the social order righteously.

sanskrit: चतुर्णामाश्रमाणां हि गार्हस्थ्यं श्रेष्ठमुत्तमम्। आहुर्धर्मज्ञ धर्मज्ञास्तं कथं त्यक्तु मर्हसि।।2.106.22।।
transliteration: caturṇāmāśramāṇāṃ hi gārhasthyṃ śreṣṭhamuttamam| āhurdharmajña dharmajñāstṃ kathṃ tyaktu marhasi||2.106.22||
meaning: O Rama, you are the one who knows his duty. The knowers of dharma maintain that the life of a householder is the foremost among the four modes of life. How can you renounce it?

sanskrit: श्रुतेन बालः स्थानेन जन्मना भवतो ह्यहम्। स कथं पालयिष्यामि भूमिं भवति तिष्ठति।।2.106.23।।
transliteration: śrutena bālḥ sthānena janmanā bhavato hyaham| sa kathṃ pālayiṣyāmi bhūmiṃ bhavati tiṣṭhati||2.106.23||
meaning: Being younger to you in knowledge, position and birth, how can I rule the earth when you are present?

sanskrit: हीनबुद्धिगुणो बालो हीनः स्थानेन चाप्यहम्। भवता च विनाभूतो न वर्तयितुमुत्सुहे।।2.106.24।।
transliteration: hīnabuddhiguṇo bālo hīnḥ sthānena cāpyaham| bhavatā ca vinābhūto na vartayitumutsuhe||2.106.24||
meaning: I am a child, deficient in intelligence and virtue and even inferior in position. Deserted by you, I do not wish to live.

sanskrit: इदं निखिल मव्यग्रं राज्यं पित्र्यमकण्टकम्। अनुशाधि स्वधर्मेण धर्मज्ञ सहबान्धवैः।।2.106.25।।
transliteration: idṃ nikhila mavyagrṃ rājyṃ pitryamakaṇṭakam| anuśādhi svadharmeṇa dharmajña sahabāndhavaiḥ||2.106.25||
meaning: O one, conversant with righteousness rule unhindered this entire kingdom along with our relations inherited from our father.

sanskrit: इहैव त्वाऽभिषिञ्चन्तु सर्वाः प्रकृतय स्सह। ऋत्विज स्सवसिष्ठाश्च मन्त्रविन्मन्त्रकोविदाः।।2.106.26।।
transliteration: ihaiva tvā'bhiṣiñcantu sarvāḥ prakṛtaya ssaha| ṛtvija ssavasiṣṭhāśca mantravinmantrakovidāḥ||2.106.26||
meaning: Let all ministers, subjects, and priests including Vasistha who are wellversed in Vedic hymns consecrate you here itself.

sanskrit: अभिषिक्तस्त्वमस्माभिरयोध्यां पालने व्रज। विजित्य तरसा लोकान्मरुद्भिरिव वासवः।।2.106.27।।
transliteration: abhiṣiktastvamasmābhirayodhyāṃ pālane vraja| vijitya tarasā lokānmarudbhiriva vāsavḥ||2.106.27||
meaning: After consecration, you too return to rule Ayodhya along with all of us like Indra who went back (to heaven), accompanied by Maruts after conquering all the worlds with his prowess.

sanskrit: ऋणानि त्रीण्यपाकुर्वन्दुर्हृदस्साधु निर्दहन्। सुहृदस्तर्पयन्कामैस्त्वमेवात्रानुशाधि माम्।।2.106.28।।
transliteration: ṛṇāni trīṇyapākurvandurhṛdassādhu nirdahan| suhṛdastarpayankāmaistvamevātrānuśādhi mām||2.106.28||
meaning: Discharging completely the three debts, to gods, to ancestors and to sages, subduing your enemies and gratifying your friends, you alone (have the right) to dictate me.

sanskrit: अद्याऽर्य मुदिता स्सन्तु सुहृदस्तेऽभिषेचने। अद्य भीताः पलायन्तां दुर्हृदस्ते दिशो दश।।2.106.29।।
transliteration: adyā'rya muditā ssantu suhṛdaste'bhiṣecane| adya bhītāḥ palāyantāṃ durhṛdaste diśo daśa||2.106.29||
meaning: O my esteemed brother let all your friends be delighted today at your enthronement and your enemies flee in terror in ten different directions.

sanskrit: आक्रोशं मम मातुश्च प्रमृज्य पुरुषर्षभ। अद्य तत्र भवन्तं च पितरं रक्ष किल्बिषात्।।2.106.30।।
transliteration: ākrośṃ mama mātuśca pramṛjya puruṣarṣabha| adya tatra bhavantṃ ca pitarṃ rakṣa kilbiṣāt||2.106.30||
meaning: O best of men, wiping out all the censure on my mother, redeem our revered father from sin.

sanskrit: शिरसा त्वाऽभियाचेऽहं कुरुष्व करुणां मयि। बान्धवेषु च सर्वेषु भूतेष्विव महेश्वरः।।2.106.31।।
transliteration: śirasā tvā'bhiyāce'hṃ kuruṣva karuṇāṃ mayi| bāndhaveṣu ca sarveṣu bhūteṣviva maheśvarḥ||2.106.31||
meaning: I beseech you with my head bowed low, show mercy on me and every one of our relations, like Maheswara showing compassion on all living beings.

sanskrit: अथैतत्पृष्ठतः कृत्वा वनमेव भवानितः। गमिष्यति गमिष्यामि भवता सार्धमप्यहम्।।2.106.32।।
transliteration: athaitatpṛṣṭhatḥ kṛtvā vanameva bhavānitḥ| gamiṣyati gamiṣyāmi bhavatā sārdhamapyaham||2.106.32||
meaning: If you turn your back on my solicitations and set out for the forest I shall also go along with you from here itself.

sanskrit: तथाहि रामो भरतेन ताम्यता प्रसाद्यमानश्शिरसा महीपतिः। नचैव चक्रे गमनाय सत्त्ववान्मतिं पितुस्तद्वचने प्रतिष्ठितः।।2.106.33
transliteration: tathāhi rāmo bharatena tāmyatā prasādyamānaśśirasā mahīpatiḥ| nacaiva cakre gamanāya sattvavānmatiṃ pitustadvacane prati
meaning: Thus besought and propitiated by Bharata with his head bowed low and distressed, the virtuous lord of the world, Rama, firmly established in the words of his father, resolved not to go back to Ayodhya.

sanskrit: तदद्भुतं स्थैर्यमवेक्ष्य राघवे समं जनो हर्षमवाप दुःखितः। न यात्ययोध्यामिति दुःखितोऽभवत् स्थिरप्रतिज्ञत्वमवेक्ष्य हर्षितः
transliteration: tadadbhutṃ sthairyamavekṣya rāghave samṃ jano harṣamavāpa duḥkhitḥ| na yātyayodhyāmiti duḥkhito'bhavat sthirapratijñatva
meaning: Having seen the wonderful deternmination of Rama, people were, at once, anguished and delighted, anguished because he would not return to Ayodhya, and delighted because he was firm in his resolve.

sanskrit: तमृत्विजो नैगमयूथवल्लभास्तदा विसंज्ञाश्रुकलाश्च मातरः। तथा ब्रुवाणं भरतं प्रतुष्टुवुः प्रणम्य रामं च ययाचिरे सह।।2.106.3
transliteration: tamṛtvijo naigamayūthavallabhāstadā visṃjñāśrukalāśca mātarḥ| tathā bruvāṇṃ bharatṃ pratuṣṭuvuḥ praṇamya rāmṃ ca yayācir
meaning: All the priests, the chiefs of merchant organizations and mothers who had their senses switched off and theif tears drained dry extolled Bharata for his words. All of them, reverentially saluting Rama, implored him. इत्य

sanskrit: उपपन्नमिदं वाक्यं यत्त्वमेवमभाषथाः। जातः पुत्रो दशरथात्कैकेय्यां राजसत्तमात्।।2.107.2।।
transliteration: upapannamidṃ vākyṃ yattvamevamabhāṣathāḥ| jātḥ putro daśarathātkaikeyyāṃ rājasattamāt||2.107.2||
meaning: Appropriate are the words spoken by you born to the celebrated king Dasaratha through Kaikeyi.

sanskrit: पुरा भ्रातः पिता न स्स मातरं ते समुद्वहन्। मातामहे समाश्रौषीद्राज्यशुल्कमनुत्तमम्।।2.107.3।।
transliteration: purā bhrātḥ pitā na ssa mātarṃ te samudvahan| mātāmahe samāśrauṣīdrājyaśulkamanuttamam||2.107.3||
meaning: Earlier when our father was to wed your mother, O dear brother, he had promised to your maternal grandfather that he would confer (on her) a kingdom with good revenue.

sanskrit: दैवासुरे च सङ्ग्रामे जनन्यै तव पार्थिवः। सम्प्रहृष्टो ददौ राजा वरमाराधितः प्रभुः।।2.107.4।।
transliteration: daivāsure ca saṅgrāme jananyai tava pārthivḥ| samprahṛṣṭo dadau rājā varamārādhitḥ prabhuḥ||2.107.4||
meaning: Thereafter in the battle between gods and demons, the able king (Dasaratha) pleased (with your mother) granted her a boon (as a token of gratitude).

sanskrit: ततस्सा सम्प्रतिश्राव्य तव माता यशस्विनी। अयाचत नरश्रेष्ठं द्वौ वरौ वरवर्णिनी।।2.107.5।। तव राज्यं नरव्याघ्र मम प्रव्राजन
transliteration: tatassā sampratiśrāvya tava mātā yaśasvinī| ayācata naraśreṣṭhṃ dvau varau varavarṇinī||2.107.5|| tava rājyṃ naravyāghra
meaning: Thereafter, O tiger among men, your illustrious mother of fair complexion, under oath demanded of that best of men, king Dasaratha, the two boons, namely kingdom for you and banishment for me. Bound by such agreement (oa

sanskrit: ततः सा सम्प्रतिश्राव्य तव माता यशस्विनी। अयाचत नरश्रेष्ठं द्वौ वरौ वरवर्णिनी।।2.107.5।। तव राज्यं नरव्याघ्र मम प्रव्राजन
transliteration: tatḥ sā sampratiśrāvya tava mātā yaśasvinī| ayācata naraśreṣṭhṃ dvau varau varavarṇinī||2.107.5|| tava rājyṃ naravyāghra
meaning: Thereafter, O tiger among men, your illustrious mother of fair complexion, under oath demanded of that best of men, king Dasaratha, the two boons, namely kingdom for you and banishment for me. Bound by such agreement (oa

sanskrit: तेन पित्राऽहमप्यत्र नियुक्तः पुरुषर्षभ। चतुर्दश वने वासं वर्षाणि वरदानिकम्।।2.107.7।।
transliteration: tena pitrā'hamapyatra niyuktḥ puruṣarṣabha| caturdaśa vane vāsṃ varṣāṇi varadānikam||2.107.7||
meaning: O best of men, that is why I have been ordered by father to live in the forest for fourteen years as per the (condition of the) boon.
