sanskrit: सोऽहं वनमिदं प्राप्तो निर्जनं लक्ष्मणान्वितः। सीतया चाप्रतिद्वन्द्व स्सत्यवादे स्थितः पितुः।।2.107.8।।
transliteration: so'hṃ vanamidṃ prāpto nirjanṃ lakṣmaṇānvitḥ| sītayā cāpratidvandva ssatyavāde sthitḥ pituḥ||2.107.8||
meaning: I have come to this lonely forest accompanied by Lakshmana and Sita, bent upon upholding the truth of our unrivalled father's words.

sanskrit: भवानपि तथेत्येव पितरं सत्यवादिनम्। कर्तुमर्हति राजेन्द्र क्षिप्रमेवाभिषेचनात्।।2.107.9।।
transliteration: bhavānapi tathetyeva pitarṃ satyavādinam| kartumarhati rājendra kṣipramevābhiṣecanāt||2.107.9||
meaning: O Indra among kings, let your coronation be performed without delay since you are worthy and at the same time the truthfulness of our father's words be honoured.

sanskrit: ऋणान्मोचय राजानं मत्कृते भरत प्रभुम्। पितरं चापि धर्मज्ञं मातरं चाभिनन्दय।।2.107.10।।
transliteration: ṛṇānmocaya rājānṃ matkṛte bharata prabhum| pitarṃ cāpi dharmajñṃ mātarṃ cābhinandaya||2.107.10||
meaning: O Bharata, release for my sake the competent king from his debt (of vow) and honour the righteous father and the mother as well.

sanskrit: श्रूयते धीमता तात श्रुतिर्गीता यशस्विना। गयेन यजमानेन गयेष्वेव पितॄन् प्रति।।2.107.11।।
transliteration: śrūyate dhīmatā tāta śrutirgītā yaśasvinā| gayena yajamānena gayeṣveva pitṝn prati||2.107.11||
meaning: Dear (brother), it is heard that long ago an illustrious king while performing a sacrifice intended for ancestors at a sacred place known as Gaya, the sacrificer Gaya chanted a Vedic hymn as follows:

sanskrit: पुन्नाम्नो नरकाद् यस्मात् पितरं त्रायते सुतः। तस्मात् पुत्र इति प्रोक्तः पितॄन् यः पाति सर्वतः।।2.107.12।।
transliteration: punnāmno narakād yasmāt pitarṃ trāyate sutḥ| tasmāt putra iti proktḥ pitṝn yḥ pāti sarvatḥ||2.107.12||
meaning: Putra is so called as he delivers his father from a hell known as Put and protects the ancestors in all possible ways.

sanskrit: एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा गुणवन्तो बहुश्रुताः। तेषां वै समवेतानामपि कश्चिद्गयां व्रजेत्।।2.107.13।।
transliteration: eṣṭavyā bahavḥ putrā guṇavanto bahuśrutāḥ| teṣāṃ vai samavetānāmapi kaścidgayāṃ vrajet||2.107.13||
meaning: One should desire many virtuous and learned sons so that at least one of them may go to Gaya (to perform the father's obsequies).

sanskrit: एवं राजर्षय स्सर्वे प्रतीता राजनन्दन। तस्मात्राहि नरश्रेष्ठ पितरं नरकात्प्रभो।।2.107.14।।
transliteration: evṃ rājarṣaya ssarve pratītā rājanandana| tasmātrāhi naraśreṣṭha pitarṃ narakātprabho||2.107.14||
meaning: O enhancer of the king's delight, O best of men rajarsis have decided this way. You may, therefore, O lord, protect your father against hell.

sanskrit: अयोध्यां गच्छ भरत प्रकृतीरनुरञ्जय। शत्रुघ्नसहितो वीर सह सर्वैर्द्विजातिभिः।।2.107.15।।
transliteration: ayodhyāṃ gaccha bharata prakṛtīranurañjaya| śatrughnasahito vīra saha sarvairdvijātibhiḥ||2.107.15||
meaning: O valiant Bharata, go to Ayodhya accompanied by Satrughna and the twiceborn (brahmins) and keep the subjects delighted like pleased (with your rule).

sanskrit: प्रवेक्ष्ये दण्डकारण्यमहमप्यविलम्बयन्। आभ्यान्तु सहितो राजन् वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च।।2.107.16।।
transliteration: pravekṣye daṇḍakāraṇyamahamapyavilambayan| ābhyāntu sahito rājan vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena ca||2.107.16||
meaning: O king (Bharata) I shall also enter the Dandaka forest without delay in the company of only these two -- the princess from Videha (Sita) and Lakshmana.

sanskrit: त्वं राजा भरत भव स्वयं नराणां वन्यानामहमपि राजराण्मृगाणाम्। गच्छ त्वं पुरवरमद्य सम्प्रहृष्टस्संहृष्टस्त्वहमपि दण्डकान्प्
transliteration: tvṃ rājā bharata bhava svayṃ narāṇāṃ vanyānāmahamapi rājarāṇmṛgāṇām| gaccha tvṃ puravaramadya samprahṛṣṭassṃhṛṣṭastvaham
meaning: O Bharata, be the king of men. I shall also become the supreme king of the wild beasts in the forest. Go now happily to Ayodhya, the best of cities, and I shall enter Dandaka forest with delight.

sanskrit: छायां ते दिनकरभाः प्रबाधमानां वर्षत्रं भरत करोतु मूर्ध्नि शीताम्। एतेषामहमपि काननद्रुमाणां छायां तामतिशयिनीं सुखी श्रयिष
transliteration: chāyāṃ te dinakarabhāḥ prabādhamānāṃ varṣatrṃ bharata karotu mūrdhni śītām| eteṣāmahamapi kānanadrumāṇāṃ chāyāṃ tāmatiśa
meaning: Let an umbrella protect you against (scorching) sunshine and provide its cool shade over your head, O Bharata As for me, I shall happily seek the shade of these dense woodland trees.

sanskrit: शत्रुघ्नः कुशलमतिस्तु ते सहायस्सौमित्रिर्मम विदितः प्रधानमित्रम्। चत्वारस्तनयवरा वयं नरेन्द्रं सत्यस्थं भरत चराम मा विषी
transliteration: śatrughnḥ kuśalamatistu te sahāyassaumitrirmama viditḥ pradhānamitram| catvārastanayavarā vayṃ narendrṃ satyasthṃ bharat
meaning: O Bharata, intelligent Satrughna will be your support and son of Sumitra (Lakshmana) as is wellknown will remain my best friend. All four of us, worthy sons of Dasaratha, shall follow the path of truth of our father. इत्

sanskrit: साधु राघव माऽभूत्ते बुध्दिरेवं निरर्थिका। प्राकृतस्य नरस्येव ह्यार्यबुद्धेर्मनस्विनः।।2.108.2।।
transliteration: sādhu rāghava mā'bhūtte budhdirevṃ nirarthikā| prākṛtasya narasyeva hyāryabuddhermanasvinḥ||2.108.2||
meaning: Very well, O scion of the Raghu race, you are nobleminded and highsouled. You, like a common man, must not entertain such nonsensical thought.

sanskrit: कः कस्य पुरुषो बन्धुः किमाप्यं कस्य केनचित्। यदेको जायते जन्तुरेक एव विनश्यति।।2.108.3।।
transliteration: kḥ kasya puruṣo bandhuḥ kimāpyṃ kasya kenacit| yadeko jāyate jantureka eva vinaśyati||2.108.3||
meaning: Who is whose friend? who is to get what and from whom? Man is born alone and will die alone.

sanskrit: तस्मान्माता पिता चेति राम सज्जेत यो नरः। उन्मत्त इव स ज्ञेयो नास्ति कश्चिद्धि कस्यचित्।।2.108.4।।
transliteration: tasmānmātā pitā ceti rāma sajjeta yo narḥ| unmatta iva sa jñeyo nāsti kaściddhi kasyacit||2.108.4||
meaning: O Rama one who establishes relationship by saying, 'She is my mother he is my father' is to be regarded as a lunatic. In fact, no one belongs to any one.

sanskrit: यथा ग्रामान्तरं गच्छन्नरः कश्चित्क्वचिद्वसेत्। उत्सृज्य च तमावासं प्रतिष्ठेतापरेऽहनि।।2.108.5।। एवमेव मनुष्याणां पिता मा
transliteration: yathā grāmāntarṃ gacchannarḥ kaścitkvacidvaset| utsṛjya ca tamāvāsṃ pratiṣṭhetāpare'hani||2.108.5|| evameva manuṣyāṇāṃ p
meaning: A man who goes from one village to another takes rest somewhere on the way and the next day leaves the place and proceeds on his journey. Similarly, father, mother, home and wealth are restingplaces to a man. The wise do

sanskrit: पित्र्यं राज्यं परित्यज्य स नार्हसि नरोत्तम। आस्थातुं कापथं दुःखं विषमं बहुकण्टकम्।।2.108.7।।
transliteration: pitryṃ rājyṃ parityajya sa nārhasi narottama| āsthātuṃ kāpathṃ duḥkhṃ viṣamṃ bahukaṇṭakam||2.108.7||
meaning: O most virtuous of men, you ought not to abandon this patrimonial kingdom, adopt a course, which is painful, difficult and full of thorns (dangers). This (course) is unwise and unworthy of you.

sanskrit: समृद्धायामयोध्यायामात्मानमभिषेचय। एकवेणीधरा हि त्वां नगरी सम्प्रतीक्षते।।2.108.8।।
transliteration: samṛddhāyāmayodhyāyāmātmānamabhiṣecaya| ekaveṇīdharā hi tvāṃ nagarī sampratīkṣate||2.108.8||
meaning: Go back to that prosperous city of Ayodhya and get yourself coronated. That city is a chaste woman wearing a single braid of hair awaiting you, her lord.

sanskrit: राजभोगाननुभवन्महार्हान्पार्थिवात्मज। विहर त्वमयोध्यायां यथा शक्रस्त्रिविष्टपे।।2.108.9।।
transliteration: rājabhogānanubhavanmahārhānpārthivātmaja| vihara tvamayodhyāyāṃ yathā śakrastriviṣṭape||2.108.9||
meaning: O king's son, enjoy inestimable royal pleasures in the city of Ayodhya like Indra in heaven.

sanskrit: न ते कश्चिद्धशरथ स्त्वं च तस्य न कश्चन। अन्यो राजा त्वमन्य स्तस्मात्कुरु यदुच्यते।।2.108.10।।
transliteration: na te kaściddhaśaratha stvṃ ca tasya na kaścana| anyo rājā tvamanya stasmātkuru yaducyate||2.108.10||
meaning: Dasaratha was nobody to you and you are nobody to him. That king is one person and you are another. Therefore, do what I tell you. (It does not matter what you are to him and what he means to you).

sanskrit: बीजमात्रं पिता जन्तो श्शुक्लं रुधिरमेव च। संयुक्तमृतुमन्मात्रा पुरुषस्येह जन्म तत्।।2.108.11।।
transliteration: bījamātrṃ pitā janto śśuklṃ rudhirameva ca| sṃyuktamṛtumanmātrā puruṣasyeha janma tat||2.108.11||
meaning: For a living being, the father is only a drop of white blood (semen). During her menstrual period this is blended in the mother's womb due to which a man is born in this world.

sanskrit: गत स्स नृपतिस्तत्र गन्तव्यं यत्र तेन वै। प्रवृततिरेषा मर्त्यानां त्वं तु मिथ्या विहन्यसे।।2.108.12।।
transliteration: gata ssa nṛpatistatra gantavyṃ yatra tena vai| pravṛtatireṣā martyānāṃ tvṃ tu mithyā vihanyase||2.108.12||
meaning: That king (Dasaratha) has gone to the place where he ought to go. Such is the nature of mortals. You are fruitlessly undergoing difficulties.

sanskrit: अर्थधर्मपरा ये ये तांस्तांछोचामि नेतरान्। ते हि दुःखमिह प्राप्य विनाशं प्रेत्य भेजिरे।।2.108.13।।
transliteration: arthadharmaparā ye ye tāṃstāṃchocāmi netarān| te hi duḥkhamiha prāpya vināśṃ pretya bhejire||2.108.13||
meaning: I prity those who yearn for dharma and artha and not for other things since those who have experienced adversities in this world (disregarding their own interest), will be ultimately destroyed any way by death.

sanskrit: अष्टका पितृदैवत्यमित्ययं प्रसृतो जनः। अन्नस्योपद्रवं पश्य मृतो हि किमशिष्यति।।2.108.14।।
transliteration: aṣṭakā pitṛdaivatyamityayṃ prasṛto janḥ| annasyopadravṃ paśya mṛto hi kimaśiṣyati||2.108.14||
meaning: People perform ashtaka ceremony for the spirits of ancestors and offer them food. Look at the amount of food being wasted. Will the dead (ever) eat food?

sanskrit: यदि भुक्तमिहान्येन देहमन्यस्य गच्छति। दद्यात्प्रवसत श्श्राद्धं न तत्पथ्यशनं भवेत्।।2.108.15।।
transliteration: yadi bhuktamihānyena dehamanyasya gacchati| dadyātpravasata śśrāddhṃ na tatpathyaśanṃ bhavet||2.108.15||
meaning: If something eaten by one in this world can enter the body of another, then a shraddha can be performed for a person who has set out on a distant journey. Will that offering turn into food for him on his way?

sanskrit: दानसंवनना ह्येते ग्रन्था मेधाविभिः कृताः। यजस्व देहि दीक्षस्व तपस्तप्यस्व सन्त्यज।।2.108.16।।
transliteration: dānasṃvananā hyete granthā medhāvibhiḥ kṛtāḥ| yajasva dehi dīkṣasva tapastapyasva santyaja||2.108.16||
meaning: It was to induce people to give charity that treatises are composed by intelligent men exhorting, 'perform sacrifices', 'give charity', 'be initiated', 'practise religious austerities', 'renounce', etc.

sanskrit: स नास्ति परमित्येव कुरु बुद्धिं महामते। प्रत्यक्षं यत्तदातिष्ठ परोक्षं पृष्ठतः कुरु।।2.108.17।।
transliteration: sa nāsti paramityeva kuru buddhiṃ mahāmate| pratyakṣṃ yattadātiṣṭha parokṣṃ pṛṣṭhatḥ kuru||2.108.17||
meaning: O highminded one thinking that the next world does not exist, practise whichever is evident and perceivable. And turn your back on what is beyond perception.

sanskrit: सतां बुद्धिं पुरस्कृत्य सर्वलोकनिदर्शिनीम्। राज्यं त्वं प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भरतेन प्रसादितः।।2.108.18।।
transliteration: satāṃ buddhiṃ puraskṛtya sarvalokanidarśinīm| rājyṃ tvṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva bharatena prasāditḥ||2.108.18||
meaning: Honour the decision of the wise that serves as an instance to all and accept the kingdom offered by Bharata with pleasure इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the on

sanskrit: भवान्मे प्रियकामार्थं वचनं यदिहोक्तवान्। अकार्यं कार्यसङ्काशमपथ्यं पथ्यसम्मतम्।।2.109.2।।
transliteration: bhavānme priyakāmārthṃ vacanṃ yadihoktavān| akāryṃ kāryasaṅkāśamapathyṃ pathyasammatam||2.109.2||
meaning: Althoug what you have said appears to be salutary, it is actually unwholesome. It appears to be beneficial but is really detrimental.

sanskrit: निर्मर्यादस्तु पुरुषः पापाचारसमन्वितः। मानं न लभते सत्सु भिन्नचारित्रदर्शनः।।2.109.3।।
transliteration: nirmaryādastu puruṣḥ pāpācārasamanvitḥ| mānṃ na labhate satsu bhinnacāritradarśanḥ||2.109.3||
meaning: A man not bound by morality, engaged in evil deeds and conducts himself contrary to good character is not respected by the virtuous.

sanskrit: कुलीनमकुलीनं वा वीरं पुरुषमानिनम्। चारित्रमेव व्याख्याति शुचिं वा यदि वाऽशुचिम्।।2.109.4।।
transliteration: kulīnamakulīnṃ vā vīrṃ puruṣamāninam| cāritrameva vyākhyāti śuciṃ vā yadi vā'śucim||2.109.4||
meaning: It is only the character that tells whether a man is highborn or not, brave or only proud of his manliness, honest or dishonest.

sanskrit: अनार्यस्त्वार्यसङ्काश श्शौचाद्दीनस्ताथाऽशुचिः। लक्षण्यवदलक्षण्यो दुश्शीलश्शीलवानिव।।2.109.5।। अधर्मं धर्मवेशेण यदीमं लोक
transliteration: anāryastvāryasaṅkāśa śśaucāddīnastāthā'śuciḥ| lakṣaṇyavadalakṣaṇyo duśśīlaśśīlavāniva||2.109.5|| adharmṃ dharmaveśeṇa ya
meaning: If like a man who appears noble, though ignoble, clean, though unclean or dishonest, auspicious, though inauspicious, a man of character, though depraved, I forsake auspicious ways for unrighteousness, abandon pious acts

sanskrit: कस्य दास्याम्यहं वृत्तं केन वा स्वर्गमाप्नुयाम्। आनया वर्तमानो हि वृत्त्या हीनप्रतिज्ञया।।2.109.8।।
transliteration: kasya dāsyāmyahṃ vṛttṃ kena vā svargamāpnuyām| ānayā vartamāno hi vṛttyā hīnapratijñayā||2.109.8||
meaning: How can I advise others for a virtuous conduct or how can I attain heaven if I break the vow which I follow at present.

sanskrit: कामवृत्तस्त्वयं लोकः कृत्स्न स्समुपवर्तते। यद्वृत्ता स्सन्ति राजानस्तद्वृत्ता स्सन्ति हि प्रजाः।।2.109.9।।
transliteration: kāmavṛttastvayṃ lokḥ kṛtsna ssamupavartate| yadvṛttā ssanti rājānastadvṛttā ssanti hi prajāḥ||2.109.9||
meaning: The entire world conducts itself as per its own sweet will. Therefore the subjects will follow the same path as their kings.

sanskrit: सत्यमेवानृशंसं च राजवृत्तं सनातनम्। तस्मात्सत्यात्मकं राज्यं सत्ये लोकः प्रतिष्ठितः।।2.109.10।।
transliteration: satyamevānṛśṃsṃ ca rājavṛttṃ sanātanam| tasmātsatyātmakṃ rājyṃ satye lokḥ pratiṣṭhitḥ||2.109.10||
meaning: Truth and nonviolence are the perpetual principles of kings. Therefore, a kingdom is based on truth. This world is firmly established in truth.

sanskrit: ऋषयश्चैव देवाश्च सत्यमेव हि मेनिरे। सत्यवादी हि लोकेऽस्मिन्परमं गच्छति क्षयम्।।2.109.11।।
transliteration: ṛṣayaścaiva devāśca satyameva hi menire| satyavādī hi loke'sminparamṃ gacchati kṣayam||2.109.11||
meaning: Sages and gods all accept truth (as the supreme virtue). A truthful man of this world, attains the highest state (abode).

sanskrit: उद्विजन्ते यथा सर्पान्नरादनृतवादिनः। धर्म स्सत्यं परो लोके मूलं स्वर्गस्य चोच्यते।।2.109.12।।
transliteration: udvijante yathā sarpānnarādanṛtavādinḥ| dharma ssatyṃ paro loke mūlṃ svargasya cocyate||2.109.12||
meaning: People are frightened at the sight of a man speaking untruth as though they have seen a serpent. Truth in this world is the greatest virtue and is said to be the very foundation of heaven.

sanskrit: सत्यमेवेश्वरो लोके सत्यं पद्माश्रिता सदा। सत्यमूलानि सर्वाणि सत्यान्नास्ति परं पदम्।।2.109.13।।
transliteration: satyameveśvaro loke satyṃ padmāśritā sadā| satyamūlāni sarvāṇi satyānnāsti parṃ padam||2.109.13||
meaning: Truth is God. The goddess of wealth always takes refuge in truth. Truth is the root of everything. It is supreme and there is nothing above it.

sanskrit: दत्तमिष्टं हुतं चैव तप्तानि च तपांसि च। वेदा स्सत्यप्रतिष्ठाना स्तस्मात्सत्यपरो भवेत्।।2.109.14।।
transliteration: dattamiṣṭṃ hutṃ caiva taptāni ca tapāṃsi ca| vedā ssatyapratiṣṭhānā stasmātsatyaparo bhavet||2.109.14||
meaning: Charity, sacrifice, libations, mortifications, asceticism and the Vedas have truth as their foundation. Therefore, every one should be an adherent of truth.

sanskrit: एकः पालयते लोकमेकः पालयते कुलम्। मज्जत्येको हि निरय एक स्स्वर्गे महीयते।।2.109.15।।
transliteration: ekḥ pālayate lokamekḥ pālayate kulam| majjatyeko hi niraya eka ssvarge mahīyate||2.109.15||
meaning: One protects the world. Another runs his family. One plunges into hell. Another is honoured in heaven. (These are the fruits of truth and untruth).

sanskrit: सोऽहं पितुर्नियोगं तु किमर्थं नानुपालये। सत्यप्रतिश्रव स्सत्यं सत्येन समयीकृतः।।2.109.16।।
transliteration: so'hṃ piturniyogṃ tu kimarthṃ nānupālaye| satyapratiśrava ssatyṃ satyena samayīkṛtḥ||2.109.16||
meaning: I am always true to any promise. I am bound by truth. Why shouId I (now) disobey my father's command (to keep his promise)?

sanskrit: नैव लोभान्न मोहाद्वा न ह्यज्ञानात्तमोऽन्वितः। सेतुं सत्यस्य भेत्स्यामि गुरो स्सत्यप्रतिश्रवः।।2.109.17।।
transliteration: naiva lobhānna mohādvā na hyajñānāttamo'nvitḥ| setuṃ satyasya bhetsyāmi guro ssatyapratiśravḥ||2.109.17||
meaning: I am always true to my promise. I will not break the bridge of truth of my father out of either greed or delusion or ignorance or illusion.

sanskrit: असत्यसन्धस्य सतश्चलस्यास्थिरचेतसः। नैव देवा न पितरः प्रतीच्छन्तीति नः श्रुतम्।।2.109.18।।
transliteration: asatyasandhasya sataścalasyāsthiracetasḥ| naiva devā na pitarḥ pratīcchantīti nḥ śrutam||2.109.18||
meaning: We have heard that the offerings of a man inclined to untruth, of an unstable and unsteady mind are accepted neither by the gods nor by the ancestors.

sanskrit: प्रत्यगात्ममिमं धर्मं सत्यं पश्याम्यहं स्वयम्। भार स्सत्पुरुषाचीर्णस्तदर्थमभिमन्यते।।2.109.19।।
transliteration: pratyagātmamimṃ dharmṃ satyṃ paśyāmyahṃ svayam| bhāra ssatpuruṣācīrṇastadarthamabhimanyate||2.109.19||
meaning: I personally regard this righteousness practised by the virtuous as an evident form of truth, as the supreme self. Therefore, this burden (difficult task of living as an exile) is gratifying to me.

sanskrit: क्षात्रं धर्ममहंत्यक्ष्ये ह्यधर्मं धर्मसंहितम्। क्षुद्रैर्नृशंसैर्लुब्धैश्च सेवितं पापकर्मभिः।।2.109.20।।
transliteration: kṣātrṃ dharmamahṃtyakṣye hyadharmṃ dharmasṃhitam| kṣudrairnṛśṃsairlubdhaiśca sevitṃ pāpakarmabhiḥ||2.109.20||
meaning: I renounce the socalled kshatriya code of conduct followed by the mean the cruel, the greedy and by men of evil deeds which is unrighteousness under the cloak of righteousness.

sanskrit: कायेन कुरुते पापं मनसा सम्प्रधार्य तत्। अनृतं जिह्वया चाह त्रिविधं कर्मपातकम्।।2.109.21।।
transliteration: kāyena kurute pāpṃ manasā sampradhārya tat| anṛtṃ jihvayā cāha trividhṃ karmapātakam||2.109.21||
meaning: At first a man conceives an evil idea in his mind, then executes it through evil deed with his body and tells a lie through his tongue. Thus sinful action is three dimensional (mental, physical and vocal).

sanskrit: भूमिः कीर्तिर्यशो लक्ष्मीः पुरुषं प्रार्थयन्ति हि। सत्यं समनुवर्तने सत्यमेव भजेत तत:।।2.109.22।।
transliteration: bhūmiḥ kīrtiryaśo lakṣmīḥ puruṣṃ prārthayanti hi| satyṃ samanuvartane satyameva bhajeta tata:||2.109.22||
meaning: Land (kingdom) glory, and wealth pursue a man, they long for him even if he is in heaven. Therefore, every one must take recourse to truth alone.

sanskrit: श्रेष्ठं ह्यनार्यमेव स्याद्यद्भवानवधार्य माम्। आह युक्ति करैर्वाक्यैरिदं भद्रं कुरुष्व ह।।2.109.23।।
transliteration: śreṣṭhṃ hyanāryameva syādyadbhavānavadhārya mām| āha yukti karairvākyairidṃ bhadrṃ kuruṣva ha||2.109.23||
meaning: The course you thought excellent and 'this auspicious act' you urged me in a cleverlyworded statement to perform is ignoble indeed.

sanskrit: कथं ह्यहं प्रतिज्ञाय वनवासमिमं गुरॊ:। भरतस्य करिष्यामि वचो हित्वा गुरोर्वचः।।2.109.24।।
transliteration: kathṃ hyahṃ pratijñāya vanavāsamimṃ guraॊ:| bharatasya kariṣyāmi vaco hitvā gurorvacḥ||2.109.24||
meaning: Having sworn before my father that I would live in the forest, how can I act upon Bharata's request in disregard to my father's words?

sanskrit: स्थिरा मया प्रतिज्ञाता प्रतिज्ञा गुरुसन्निधौ। प्रहृष्यमाणा सा देवी कैकेयी चाभवत्तदा।।2.109.25।।
transliteration: sthirā mayā pratijñātā pratijñā gurusannidhau| prahṛṣyamāṇā sā devī kaikeyī cābhavattadā||2.109.25||
meaning: I had taken a firm vow in the presence of my father (about my stay in the forest). And then Devi Kaikeyi was immensely delighted.

sanskrit: वनवासं वसन्नेव शुचिर्नियतभोजनः। मूलपुष्पफलैः पुण्यैः पित्रून् देवांश्च तर्पयन्।।2.109.26।। सन्तुष्टपञ्चवर्गोऽहं लोकयात्र
transliteration: vanavāsṃ vasanneva śucirniyatabhojanḥ| mūlapuṣpaphalaiḥ puṇyaiḥ pitrūn devāṃśca tarpayan||2.109.26|| santuṣṭapañcavargo'
meaning: I shall spend the term of my forest life with faith and holiness and purity of mind and with regulated food and with ancestors and gods satisfied with offerings of roots, flowers and fruits, with my five senses contented

sanskrit: वनवासं वसन्नेवं शुचिर्नियतभोजनः। मूलैः पुष्पैः फलैः पुण्यैः पित्रून् देवांश्च तर्पयन्।।2.109.26।। सन्तुष्टपञ्चवर्गोऽहं ल
transliteration: vanavāsṃ vasannevṃ śucirniyatabhojanḥ| mūlaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ puṇyaiḥ pitrūn devāṃśca tarpayan||2.109.26|| santuṣṭapañca
meaning: I shall spend the term of my forest life with faith and holiness and purity of mind and with regulated food and with ancestors and gods satisfied with offerings of roots, flowers and fruits, with my five senses contented

sanskrit: कर्मभूमिमां प्राप्य कर्तव्यं कर्म यच्छुभम्। अग्निर्वायुश्च सोमश्च कर्मणां फलभागिनः।।2.109.28।।
transliteration: karmabhūmimāṃ prāpya kartavyṃ karma yacchubham| agnirvāyuśca somaśca karmaṇāṃ phalabhāginḥ||2.109.28||
meaning: Having reached this land of (religious) actions, one should perform auspicious rites. As fruit of their actions, Agni, Vayu and Soma have obtained their status.

sanskrit: शतं क्रतूनामाहृत्य देवराट् त्रिदिवं गतः। तपांस्युग्राणि चास्थाय दिवं याता महर्षयः।।2.109.29।।
transliteration: śatṃ kratūnāmāhṛtya devarāṭ tridivṃ gatḥ| tapāṃsyugrāṇi cāsthāya divṃ yātā maharṣayḥ||2.109.29||
meaning: After performing a hundred sacrifices, king of the gods (Indra) obtained (dominion over) heaven. Great sages attained heaven after resorting to intense mortifications.

sanskrit: अमृष्यमाणः पुनरुग्रतेजाः निशम्य तं नास्तिकवाक्यहेतुम्। अथाब्रवीत्तं नृपतेस्तनूजो विगर्हमाणो वचनानि तस्य।।2.109.30।।
transliteration: amṛṣyamāṇḥ punarugratejāḥ niśamya tṃ nāstikavākyahetum| athābravīttṃ nṛpatestanūjo vigarhamāṇo vacanāni tasya||2.109.30|
meaning: The highly energetic prince, Rama, could not tolerate these atheistic arguments of Jabali for which he had to utter these words full of disdain:

sanskrit: सत्यं च धर्मं च पराक्रमं च भूतानुकम्पां प्रियवादितां च। द्विजातिदेवातिधिपूजनं च पन्थानमाहुस्त्रिदिवस्य सन्तः।।2.109.31।।
transliteration: satyṃ ca dharmṃ ca parākramṃ ca bhūtānukampāṃ priyavāditāṃ ca| dvijātidevātidhipūjanṃ ca panthānamāhustridivasya santḥ||
meaning: The virtuous maintain that truthfulness, righteousness, valour, compassion towards all beings, speaking pleasing words, paying homage to gods, brahmins and guests -- all these are paths to heaven.

sanskrit: तेनैवमाज्ञाय यथावदर्थमेकोदयं सम्प्रतिपद्य विप्राः। धर्मं चरन्त स्सकलं यथावत्काङ्क्षन्ति लोकागममप्रमत्ताः।।2.109.32।।
transliteration: tenaivamājñāya yathāvadarthamekodayṃ sampratipadya viprāḥ| dharmṃ caranta ssakalṃ yathāvatkāṅkṣanti lokāgamamapramattāḥ|
meaning: Therefore, brahmins who have rightly understood the meaning of righteousness and adopt, with unmost care, the righteous ways as laid down in the scriptures seek attainment of higher positions.

sanskrit: निन्दाम्यहं कर्म कृतं पितुस्तद्यस्त्वामगृह्णाद्विषमस्थबुद्धिम्। बुद्ध्याऽनयैवंविधया चरन्तं सुनास्तिकं धर्मपथादपेतम्।।2.1
transliteration: nindāmyahṃ karma kṛtṃ pitustadyastvāmagṛhṇādviṣamasthabuddhim| buddhyā'nayaivṃvidhayā carantṃ sunāstikṃ dharmapathādapet
meaning: You are a great atheist, you have fallen from the path of righteousness. You are guided by an intellect which is extremely peridous. I, therefore, disapprove of my father's decision in inducting a man like you (into the

sanskrit: यथा हि चोर: स‌ तथा हि बुद्धस्तथागतं नास्तिकमत्र विद्धि। तस्माद्धि य: श‌ङ्क्यतमः प्रजानाम् न नास्तिकेनाभिमुखो बुध: स्यात्
transliteration: yathā hi cora: sa‌ tathā hi buddhastathāgatṃ nāstikamatra viddhi| tasmāddhi ya: śa‌ṅkyatamḥ prajānām na nāstikenābhimukh
meaning: Just as a thief, so is the Buddha (a wise men). Know that the Tathagatas are atheists. They are men most distrusted among the people. A learned man should avoid atheists. (Note: Verses 31 to 39 appear to be interpolation

sanskrit: त्वत्तो जनाः पूर्वतरे द्विजाच्श्र शुभानि कर्माणि बहूनि चक्रुः। जित्वा सदेमं च परं च लोकं तस्माव्दिजा स्व‌स्ति हुतं कृतं
transliteration: tvatto janāḥ pūrvatare  dvijācśra śubhāni karmāṇi bahūni cakruḥ| jitvā sademṃ ca parṃ ca lokṃ tasmāvdijā sva‌sti hutṃ kṛ
meaning: Men superior to you in preceding generations had conquered this world and the other world by always performing many auspicious acts. Twiceborn brahmins perform religious acts and offer libations for the welfare of the wo

sanskrit: धर्मे रता: स‌त्पुरुषै: स‌मेतास्तेजस्विनो दानगुणप्रधानाः। अहिंसका वीतमलाश्च लोके भवन्ति पूज्या मुनयः प्रधानाः।।2.109.36।।
transliteration: dharme ratā: sa‌tpuruṣai: sa‌metāstejasvino dānaguṇapradhānāḥ| ahiṃsakā vītamalāśca loke bhavanti pūjyā munayḥ pradhānāḥ
meaning: Those supreme ascetics who are radiant, devoted to righteousness and associated with men of virtue, with charity as their chief virtue, eschewing violence and purged of their impurities are truly worthy of reverence in t

sanskrit: इति ब्रुवन्तं वचनं सरोषं रामं महात्मानमदीनसत्त्वम्। उवाच पथ्यं पुनरास्तिकं च सत्यं वच: सानुनयं च विप्रः।।2.109.37।।
transliteration: iti bruvantṃ vacanṃ saroṣṃ rāmṃ mahātmānamadīnasattvam| uvāca pathyṃ punarāstikṃ ca satyṃ vaca: sānunayṃ ca viprḥ||2.109
meaning: Having heard the wrathful words of the magnanimous Rama of fearless intellect, that brahmin (Jabali) thus humbly replied in palatable, truthful words full of faith (in god).

sanskrit: न नास्तिकानां वचनं ब्रवीम्यहं न नास्तिकोऽहं न च नास्ति किञ्चन। समीक्ष्य कालं पुनरास्तिकोऽभवं भवेय काले पुनरेव नास्तिकः।।
transliteration: na nāstikānāṃ vacanṃ bravīmyahṃ na nāstiko'hṃ na ca nāsti kiñcana| samīkṣya kālṃ punarāstiko'bhavṃ bhaveya kāle punareva
meaning: I do not speak the language of atheists. I am not an atheist. I do not say that the next world does not exist. In keeping with time (occasion) I shall speak the language of a believer or a nonbeliever.

sanskrit: न चापि कालोऽय मुपागतश्शनैर्यथा मया नास्तिकवागुदीरिता। निवर्तनार्थं तव राम कारणात् प्रसादनार्थं च मयैतदीरितम्।।2.109.39।।
transliteration: na cāpi kālo'ya mupāgataśśanairyathā mayā nāstikavāgudīritā| nivartanārthṃ tava rāma kāraṇāt prasādanārthṃ ca mayaitadīr
meaning: O Rama, since the appropriate time has slowly come, I have uttered this. In order to persuade you to return and to propitiate you I have said these words. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे नवोत्त

sanskrit: आवलिप्ते न जानासि त्वत्तः प्रियतरो मम। मनुजो मनुजव्याघ्राद्रामादन्यो न विद्यते।।2.11.5।।
transliteration: āvalipte na jānāsi tvattḥ priyataro mama| manujo manujavyāghrādrāmādanyo na vidyate||2.11.5||
meaning: O proud lady, don't you know there exists for me no woman dearer than you and no man other than Rama who is the best among men.

sanskrit: तेनाजय्येन मुख्येन राघवेण महात्मना। शपे ते जीवनार्हेण ब्रूहि यन्मनसेच्छासि।।2.11.6।।
transliteration: tenājayyena mukhyena rāghaveṇa mahātmanā| śape te jīvanārheṇa brūhi yanmanasecchāsi||2.11.6||
meaning: I swear in the name of the scion of the Raghu dynasty, the invincible, broadminded Rama, the best among men worthy of long life. Tell me what you have in mind.

sanskrit: चन्द्रादित्यौ नभश्चैव ग्रहा रात्र्यहनी दिशः। जगच्च पृथिवी चेयं सगन्धर्वा सराक्षसा।।2.11.14।। निशाचराणि भूतानि गृहेषु गृह
transliteration: candrādityau nabhaścaiva grahā rātryahanī diśḥ| jagacca pṛthivī ceyṃ sagandharvā sarākṣasā||2.11.14|| niśācarāṇi bhūtāni
meaning: Let the Moon and the Sun, the sky, the planets, night and day, the (ten) quarters the world, gandharvas, rakshasas, this earth, the nocturnal spirits all beings, family deities of every house and all other beings listen

sanskrit: ततः परमुवाचेदं वरदं काममोहितम्। वरौ यौ मे त्वया देव तदा दत्तौ महीपते।।2.11.23।। तौ तावदहमद्यैव वक्ष्यामि शृणु मे वचः।
transliteration: tatḥ paramuvācedṃ varadṃ kāmamohitam| varau yau me tvayā deva tadā dattau mahīpate||2.11.23|| tau tāvadahamadyaiva vakṣy
meaning: Thereafter, she said to the infatuated king who had promised to confer her boons, O lord of the earth, O king, right now I shall speak to you about the two boons granted by you. Listen to my words.

sanskrit: अभिषेकसमारम्भो राघवस्योपकल्पितः।।2.11.24।। अनेनैवाभिषेकेण भरतो मेऽभिषिच्यताम्।
transliteration: abhiṣekasamārambho rāghavasyopakalpitḥ||2.11.24|| anenaivābhiṣekeṇa bharato me'bhiṣicyatām|
meaning: Preparations for Rama's consecration have been made. With these very materials for installation, my son Bharata should be consecrated.

sanskrit: यो द्वितीयो वरो देव दत्तः प्रीतेन मे त्वया।।2.11.25।। तदा दैवासुरे युद्धे तस्य कालोऽयमागत।
transliteration: yo dvitīyo varo deva dattḥ prītena me tvayā||2.11.25|| tadā daivāsure yuddhe tasya kālo'yamāgata|
meaning: Then in the war between gods and asuras, O lord, pleased with me you have promised a second boon and the time has come to grant it.

sanskrit: नव प़ञ्च च वर्षाणि दण्डकारण्यमाश्रितः।।2.11.26।। चीराजिनजटाधारी रामो भवतु तापसः।
transliteration: nava pa़ñca ca varṣāṇi daṇḍakāraṇyamāśritḥ||2.11.26|| cīrājinajaṭādhārī rāmo bhavatu tāpasḥ|
meaning: Consigned to the Dandaka forest for fourteen years, clad in bark and deer skin and wearing matted hair, Rama shall live like an ascetic.

sanskrit: भरतो भजतामद्य यौवराज्यमकण्टकम्।।2.11.27।। एष मे परमः कामो दत्तमेव वरं वृणे। अद्य चैव हि पश्येयं प्रयान्तं राघवं वनम्।।2.
transliteration: bharato bhajatāmadya yauvarājyamakaṇṭakam||2.11.27|| eṣa me paramḥ kāmo dattameva varṃ vṛṇe| adya caiva hi paśyeyṃ prayā
meaning: Let Bharata be princeregent without any rivals. This is my great desire. I am asking for an already granted boon. Let me see Rama's departure to the forest today itself.

sanskrit: निवर्तयितुकामस्तु त्वामेतद्वाक्यमब्रवीत्। इमां लोकसमुत्पत्तिं लोकनाथ निबोध मे।।2.110.2।।
transliteration: nivartayitukāmastu tvāmetadvākyamabravīt| imāṃ lokasamutpattiṃ lokanātha nibodha me||2.110.2||
meaning: O lord of the worlds, Jabali had spoken all this only with the intention to make you return (to Ayodhya). Listen I shall (now) relate to you the origin of the world.

sanskrit: सर्वं सलिलमेवासीत्पृथिवी यत्र निर्मिता। तत: स‌मभवद्ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूर्दैवतै: स‌ह।।2.110.3।।
transliteration: sarvṃ salilamevāsītpṛthivī yatra nirmitā| tata: sa‌mabhavadbrahmā svayambhūrdaivatai: sa‌ha||2.110.3||
meaning: At the beginning, all this was water from which the earth was created. Thereafter, the selfexistent Brahma along with the gods came into existence.

sanskrit: स वराहस्ततो भूत्वा प्रोज्जहार वसुन्धराम्। असृजच्च जगत्सर्वं सह पुत्रैः कृतात्मभिः।।2.110.4।।
transliteration: sa varāhastato bhūtvā projjahāra vasundharām| asṛjacca jagatsarvṃ saha putraiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ||2.110.4||
meaning: Then he assumed the form of a boar and uplifted the earth and created this world with his progeny of purified souls.

sanskrit: आकाशप्रभवो ब्रह्मा शाश्वतो नित्य अव्ययः। तस्मान्मरीचि: संज‌ज्ञे मरीचेः कश्यप: सुतः।।2.110.5।।
transliteration: ākāśaprabhavo brahmā śāśvato nitya avyayḥ| tasmānmarīci: sṃja‌jñe marīceḥ kaśyapa: sutḥ||2.110.5||
meaning: Eternal, changeless and imperishable Brahma arose from space and to him was born Marichi and to Marichi, Kasyapa.

sanskrit: विवस्वान्काश्यपात् जज्ञे मनुर्वैवस्वत: स्वयम्। स तु प्रजापतिः पूर्वमिक्ष्वाकुस्तु मनो: सुतः।।2.110.6।।
transliteration: vivasvānkāśyapāt jajñe manurvaivasvata: svayam| sa tu prajāpatiḥ pūrvamikṣvākustu mano: sutḥ||2.110.6||
meaning: Kasyapa begot Vivaswat (the Sun) and Vivaswat, Manu. This Manu was the first Prajapati to him whom was born Ikshvaku.

sanskrit: यस्येयं प्रथमं दत्ता समृद्धा मनुना मही। तमिक्ष्वाकुमयोध्यायां राजानं विद्धि पूर्वकम्।।2.110.7।।
transliteration: yasyeyṃ prathamṃ dattā samṛddhā manunā mahī| tamikṣvākumayodhyāyāṃ rājānṃ viddhi pūrvakam||2.110.7||
meaning: Manu had orginally bestowed the most prosperous earth on Ikshvaku and you know Ikshvaku was the first king of Ayodhya.

sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकोस्तु सुत श्रीमान्कुक्षिरेवेति विश्रुतः। कुक्षेरथात्मजो वीरो विकुक्षिरुदपद्यत।।2.110.8।।
transliteration: ikṣvākostu suta  śrīmānkukṣireveti viśrutḥ| kukṣerathātmajo vīro vikukṣirudapadyata||2.110.8||
meaning: Ikshvaku had an illustrious son, wellknown as Kukshi and to Kukshi was born the heroic Vikukshi.

sanskrit: विकुक्षेस्तु महातेजा बाणः पुत्र प्रतापवान्। बाणस्य तु महाबाहुरनरण्यो महात‌पा:।।2.110.9।।
transliteration: vikukṣestu mahātejā bāṇḥ putra pratāpavān| bāṇasya tu mahābāhuranaraṇyo mahāta‌pā:||2.110.9||
meaning: The son of Vikukshi was highly energetic and powerful Bana and to him was born the mightyarmed Anaranya of great renown.

sanskrit: नानावृष्टिर्बभूवास्मिन्नदुर्भिक्षं सतां वरे। अनरण्ये महाराजे तस्करो नापि कश्चन।।2.110.10।।
transliteration: nānāvṛṣṭirbabhūvāsminnadurbhikṣṃ satāṃ vare| anaraṇye mahārāje taskaro nāpi kaścana||2.110.10||
meaning: When Anaranya, the best of the virtuous, was ruling the kingdom, there was no drought, no famine and not even a thief (in his kingdom).

sanskrit: अनरण्यान्महाबाहुः पृथु राजा बभूव ह। तस्मात्पृथोमेहाराजस्त्रिशङ्कुरुदपद्यत।।2.110.11।। स सत्यवचनाद् वीर: स‌शरीरो दिवं गतः
transliteration: anaraṇyānmahābāhuḥ pṛthu rājā babhūva ha| tasmātpṛthomehārājastriśaṅkurudapadyata||2.110.11|| sa satyavacanād vīra: sa‌ś
meaning: Mightyarmed king Prithu was the son of Anaranya and Prithu was father of the great king Trishanku. That heroic Trishanku, on account of his truthfulness ascended the heaven with his physical body.

sanskrit: त्रिशङ्कोरभवत्सूनुर्दुन्धुमारो महायशाः।।2.110.12।। दुन्धुमारान्महातेजा युवनाश्वो व्यजायत।
transliteration: triśaṅkorabhavatsūnurdundhumāro mahāyaśāḥ||2.110.12|| dundhumārānmahātejā yuvanāśvo vyajāyata|
meaning: Trishanku's son was illustrious Dundhumara, father of the exceedingly powerful Yuvanaswa.

sanskrit: युवनाश्वसुत श्श्रीमान्मान्धाता समपद्यत।।2.110.13।। मान्धातुस्त महातेजा: सुसन्धिरुदपद्यत। सुसन्धेरपि पुत्रौ द्वौ ध्रुवसन्
transliteration: yuvanāśvasuta śśrīmānmāndhātā samapadyata||2.110.13|| māndhātusta mahātejā: susandhirudapadyata| susandherapi putrau dva
meaning: Majestic Mandhata was Yuvanasva's son and father of mighty Susandhi. Sudsandhi had two sons Dhruvasandhi and Prasenjit. Renowned Bharata, slayer of enemies, was the son of Dhruvasandhi.

sanskrit: युवनाश्वसुत श्श्रीमान्मान्धाता समपद्यत।।2.110.13।। मान्धातुस्त महातेजा स्सुसन्धिरुदपद्यत। सुसन्धेरपि पुत्रौ द्वौ ध्रुवसन
transliteration: yuvanāśvasuta śśrīmānmāndhātā samapadyata||2.110.13|| māndhātusta mahātejā ssusandhirudapadyata| susandherapi putrau dva
meaning: Majestic Mandhata was Yuvanasva's son and father of mighty Susandhi. Sudsandhi had two sons Dhruvasandhi and Prasenjit. Renowned Bharata, slayer of enemies, was the son of Dhruvasandhi.

sanskrit: भरतात्तु महाबाहोरसितो नाम जायत।।2.110.15।। यस्यैते प्रतिराजान उदपद्यन्त शत्रवः। हैहयास्तालजङ्घाश्च शूराश्च शशिबिन्दवः।।2
transliteration: bharatāttu mahābāhorasito nāma jāyata||2.110.15|| yasyaite pratirājāna udapadyanta śatravḥ| haihayāstālajaṅghāśca śūrāśc
meaning: Mightyarmed Bharata had a son named Asita against whom the Haihayas, Talajanghas and the indomitable Sasibindus, the rival kings rose as enenmies.

sanskrit: तांस्तु सर्वान्प्रतिव्यूह्य युद्धे राजा प्रवासितः। स च शैलवरे रम्ये बभूवाभिरतो मुनिः।।2.110.17।।
transliteration: tāṃstu sarvānprativyūhya yuddhe rājā pravāsitḥ| sa ca śailavare ramye babhūvābhirato muniḥ||2.110.17||
meaning: Although king Asita engaged all of them in a battle, he was (defeated and) driven into exile. He retired to a delightful, tall mountain and lived a life of contentment of a sage.

sanskrit: द्वे चास्य भार्ये गर्भिण्यौ बभूवतुरिति श्रुतिः। एका गर्भविनाशाय सपत्न्यै गरलं ददौ।।2.110.18।।
transliteration: dve cāsya bhārye garbhiṇyau babhūvaturiti śrutiḥ| ekā garbhavināśāya sapatnyai garalṃ dadau||2.110.18||
meaning: Both his wives became pregnant. It is said that one of them gave the other poison (with the motive) to destroy the embryo.

sanskrit: पुत्रस्ते भविता देवि महात्मा लोकविश्रुतः।।2.110.20।। धार्मिकश्च सुशीलश्च वंशकर्ताऽरिसूदनः।
transliteration: putraste bhavitā devi mahātmā lokaviśrutḥ||2.110.20|| dhārmikaśca suśīlaśca vṃśakartā'risūdanḥ|
meaning: O queen, you will beget a son who will be magnanimous, virtuous, renowned in the world. He will be the perpetuator of the race and destroyer of enemies.

sanskrit: कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं हृष्टा मुनिंतमनुमान्य च।।2.110.21।। पद्मपत्रसमानाक्षं पद्मगर्भसमप्रभम्। तत: सा गृहमागम्य देवी पुत्रं व
transliteration: kṛtvā pradakṣiṇṃ hṛṣṭā muniṃtamanumānya ca||2.110.21|| padmapatrasamānākṣṃ padmagarbhasamaprabham| tata: sā gṛhamāgamya
meaning: The queen was happy. She circumambulated the sage, took leave of him and came back home. Thereafter, she gave birth to a son who had eyes like lotus petals and who looked resplendent like Brahma.

sanskrit: सपत्न्या तु गरस्तस्यै दत्तो गर्भजिघांसया। गरेण सह तेनैव जात स्स सगरोऽभवत्।।2.110.23।।
transliteration: sapatnyā tu garastasyai datto garbhajighāṃsayā| gareṇa saha tenaiva jāta ssa sagaro'bhavat||2.110.23||
meaning: With a motive to destroy the embryo her cowife had poisoned her. That child was born with gara or poison for which he was called Sagara.

sanskrit: स राजा सगरो नाम य: स‌मुद्रमखानयत्। इष्ट्वा पर्वणि वेगेन त्रासयन इमाः प्रजाः।।2.110.24।
transliteration: sa rājā sagaro nāma ya: sa‌mudramakhānayat| iṣṭvā parvaṇi vegena trāsayana imāḥ prajāḥ||2.110.24|
meaning: The king Sagara performed a sacrifice on the fullmoon day. And swiftly dug the ocean that frightened the people.

sanskrit: असमञ्जस्तु पुत्रोऽभूत्सगरस्येति न श्श्रुतम्। जीवन्नेव स पित्रा तु निरस्तः पापकर्मकृत्।।2.110.25।।
transliteration: asamañjastu putro'bhūtsagarasyeti na śśrutam| jīvanneva sa pitrā tu nirastḥ pāpakarmakṛt||2.110.25||
meaning: We have heard that a son, Asamanja by name, was born to Sagara. For his sinful deeds he was banished by his father while he was still alive.

sanskrit: अंशुमानिति पुत्रोऽभूदसमञ्जस्य वीर्यवान्। दिलीपोंशुमतः पुत्रो दिलीपस्य भगीरथः।।2.110.26।।
transliteration: aṃśumāniti putro'bhūdasamañjasya vīryavān| dilīpoṃśumatḥ putro dilīpasya bhagīrathḥ||2.110.26||
meaning: Valiant Anshuman was the son of Asamanja and the father of Dilipa. Dilipa's son was Bhagiratha.

sanskrit: भगीरथात्ककुत्स्थस्तु काकुत्स्था येन विश्रुताः। ककुत्स्थस्य च पुत्रोऽभूद्रघुर्येन च राघवाः।।2.110.27।।
transliteration: bhagīrathātkakutsthastu kākutsthā yena viśrutāḥ| kakutsthasya ca putro'bhūdraghuryena ca rāghavāḥ||2.110.27||
meaning: To Bhagiratha was born Kakutstha, by whom your race is wellknown. A son Raghu was born to Kakutstha and hence all of you are known as Raghavas.

sanskrit: रघोस्तु पुत्रस्तेजस्वी प्रवृद्धः पुरुषादकः। कल्माषपाद स्सौदास इत्येवं प्रथितो भुवि।।2.110.28।।
transliteration: raghostu putrastejasvī pravṛddhḥ puruṣādakḥ| kalmāṣapāda ssaudāsa ityevṃ prathito bhuvi||2.110.28||
meaning: The illustrious son of Raghu became famous in the world under the names of Kalmasapada and Sowdasa. The curse of a sage turned him a devourer of men for some years.

sanskrit: कल्माषपादपुत्रोऽभूच्छङ्खणस्त्विति विश्रुतः। यस्तु तद्वीर्यमासाद्य सहसैन्यो व्यनीनशत्।।2.110.29।।
transliteration: kalmāṣapādaputro'bhūcchaṅkhaṇastviti viśrutḥ| yastu tadvīryamāsādya sahasainyo vyanīnaśat||2.110.29||
meaning: Shankhana was the famous son of Kalmashapada. Whoever challenged his prowess was routed with his entire army.

sanskrit: शङ्खणस्य च पुत्रोऽभूच्छूर श्रीमान्सुदर्शनः। सुदर्शनस्याग्निवर्णः अग्निवर्णस्य शीघ्रगः।।2.110.30।। शीघ्रगस्य मरुः पुत्रो
transliteration: śaṅkhaṇasya ca putro'bhūcchūra śrīmānsudarśanḥ| sudarśanasyāgnivarṇḥ agnivarṇasya śīghragḥ||2.110.30|| śīghragasya maruḥ
meaning: The son of Shankhana was the glorious Sudarshana, father of Agnivarna. Shighraga was the son of Agnivarna whose son was Maru. Maru's son was Prashushruva and to Prashushruva was born splendid Ambarisha. Nahusha of indisp

sanskrit: तस्य ज्येष्ठोऽसि दायादो राम इत्यभिविश्रुतः। तद्गृहाण स्वकं राज्यमवेक्षस्व जनं नृप।।2.110.34।।
transliteration: tasya jyeṣṭho'si dāyādo rāma ityabhiviśrutḥ| tadgṛhāṇa svakṃ rājyamavekṣasva janṃ nṛpa||2.110.34||
meaning: Being the eldest son of king Dasaratha and widely known as Rama you happen to be the heir apparent. Hence, O king, accept the kingdom and look after the people.

sanskrit: पुरुषस्येह जातस्य भवन्ति गुरवस्त्रयः। आचार्यश्चैव काकुत्स्थ पिता माता च राघव।।2.111.2।।
transliteration: puruṣasyeha jātasya bhavanti guravastrayḥ| ācāryaścaiva kākutstha pitā mātā ca rāghava||2.111.2||
meaning: Every man born has three preceptors. They are his teacher, father and mother.

sanskrit: पिता ह्येवं जनयति पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ। प्रज्ञां ददाति चाचार्यस्तस्मात्स गुरुरुच्यते।।2.111.3।।
transliteration: pitā hyevṃ janayati puruṣṃ puruṣarṣabha| prajñāṃ dadāti cācāryastasmātsa gururucyate||2.111.3||
meaning: O best of men, the father brings forth a son. The teacher imparts him wisdom. Therefore, the teacher is considered superior.

sanskrit: सोऽहं ते पितुराचार्यस्तव चैव परन्तप। मम त्वं वचनं कुर्वन्नातिवर्तेस्सतां गतिम्।।2.111.4।।
transliteration: so'hṃ te piturācāryastava caiva parantapa| mama tvṃ vacanṃ kurvannātivartessatāṃ gatim||2.111.4||
meaning: I was preceptor to your father and also to you. O destroyer of foes, by following my words, you will not transgress the path of the virtuous.

sanskrit: इमा हि ते परिषद श्श्रेणयश्च द्विजास्तथा। एषु तात चरन्धर्मं नातिवर्ते: स‌तां गतिम्।।2.111.5।।
transliteration: imā hi te pariṣada śśreṇayaśca dvijāstathā| eṣu tāta carandharmṃ nātivarte: sa‌tāṃ gatim||2.111.5||
meaning: All these learned men, guilds of merchants and the twiceborn (brahmins) of this assembly are your men. By fulfilling your duty towards them, you will never swerve from the path of the virtuous.

sanskrit: वृद्धाया धर्मशीलाया मातुर्नार्हस्यवर्तितुम्। अस्या हि वचनं कुर्वन्नातिवर्तेस्सतां गतिम्।।2.111.6।।
transliteration: vṛddhāyā dharmaśīlāyā māturnārhasyavartitum| asyā hi vacanṃ kurvannātivartessatāṃ gatim||2.111.6||
meaning: Here is your aged and righteous mother. It does not behove you to deny your service to her. By obeying her, you will never deviate from the path of the virtuous.

sanskrit: भरतस्य वचः कुर्वन्याचमानस्य राघव। आत्मानं नातिवर्तेस्त्वं सत्यधर्मपराक्रम।।2.111.7।।
transliteration: bharatasya vacḥ kurvanyācamānasya rāghava| ātmānṃ nātivartestvṃ satyadharmaparākrama||2.111.7||
meaning: O scion of the Raghus whose strength springs from truth and righteousness, if you accede to the prayers of Bharata, you will not ignore the call of your soul.

sanskrit: एवं मधुरमुक्तस्सन् गुरुणा राघवस्स्वयम्। प्रत्युवाच समासीनं वसिष्ठं पुरुषर्षभः।।2.111.8।।
transliteration: evṃ madhuramuktassan guruṇā rāghavassvayam| pratyuvāca samāsīnṃ vasiṣṭhṃ puruṣarṣabhḥ||2.111.8||
meaning: When Rama, the best of men, was advised personally by Vasistha, the preceptor, with sweet words, he replied to him who was sitting beside him:

sanskrit: यन्मातापितरौ वृत्तं तनये कुरुत: स‌दा। न सुप्रतिकरं तत् तु मात्रा पित्रा च यत्कृतम्।।2.111.9।। यथाशक्ति प्रदानेन स्वापनोच
transliteration: yanmātāpitarau vṛttṃ tanaye kuruta: sa‌dā| na supratikarṃ tat tu mātrā pitrā ca yatkṛtam||2.111.9|| yathāśakti pradānena
meaning: The course of action the parents always adopt in respect of their son, the benefits they confer on him according to their resources, the way they lull him to sleep and clothe him, the affectionate words they always speak

sanskrit: यन्मातापितरौ वृत्तं तनये कुरुतस्सदा। न सुप्रतिकरं तत्तु मात्रा पित्रा च यत्कृतम्।।2.111.9।। यथाशक्तिप्रदानेन स्वापनोच्छा
transliteration: yanmātāpitarau vṛttṃ tanaye kurutassadā| na supratikarṃ tattu mātrā pitrā ca yatkṛtam||2.111.9|| yathāśaktipradānena svā
meaning: The course of action the parents always adopt in respect of their son, the benefits they confer on him according to their resources, the way they lull him to sleep and clothe him, the affectionate words they always speak

sanskrit: स हि राजा जनयिता पिता दशरथो मम। आज्ञातं यन्मया तस्य न तन्मिथ्या भविष्यति।।2.111.11।।
transliteration: sa hi rājā janayitā pitā daśaratho mama| ājñātṃ yanmayā tasya na tanmithyā bhaviṣyati||2.111.11||
meaning: King Dasaratha is my father who begot me. The promise I made him shall not prove false.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण भरतः प्रत्यनन्तरम्। उवाच परमोदारस्सूतं परमदुर्मनाः।।2.111.12।।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa bharatḥ pratyanantaram| uvāca paramodārassūtṃ paramadurmanāḥ||2.111.12||
meaning: Having been addressed by Rama in this way, Bharata of great generosity, in extreme distress, addressing the charioteer who was standing nearby said:

sanskrit: इह मे स्थण्डिले शीघ्रं कुशानास्तर सारथे। आर्यं प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यामि यावन्मे न प्रसीदति।।2.111.13।।
transliteration: iha me sthaṇḍile śīghrṃ kuśānāstara sārathe| āryṃ pratyupavekṣyāmi yāvanme na prasīdati||2.111.13||
meaning: O charioteer, quickly spread kusa grass on the bare ground. Until my esteemed brother shows his grace, I shall lie down here -- waiting.

sanskrit: अनाहारो निरालोको धनहीनो यथा द्विजः। शेष्ये पुरस्ताच्छालाया यावन्न प्रतियास्यति।।2.111.14।।
transliteration: anāhāro nirāloko dhanahīno yathā dvijḥ| śeṣye purastācchālāyā yāvanna pratiyāsyati||2.111.14||
meaning: Like a poor brahmin, starving, my face muffled, I shall lie down in front of the hut until he agrees to return.

sanskrit: स तु राममवेक्षन्तं सुमन्त्रं पेक्ष्य दुर्मनाः। कुशोत्तरमुपस्थाप्य भूमावेवाऽस्तरत्स्वयम्।।2.111.15।।
transliteration: sa tu rāmamavekṣantṃ sumantrṃ pekṣya durmanāḥ| kuśottaramupasthāpya bhūmāvevā'staratsvayam||2.111.15||
meaning: Bharata was mentally disturbed saw Sumantra waiting for Rama's order. Then he himself brought a heap of kusa grass and spread it on the ground.

sanskrit: तमुवाच महातेजा रामो राजर्षिसत्तमः। किं मां भरत कुर्वाणं तात प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यसि।।2.111.16।।
transliteration: tamuvāca mahātejā rāmo rājarṣisattamḥ| kiṃ māṃ bharata kurvāṇṃ tāta pratyupavekṣyasi||2.111.16||
meaning: Rama, the foremost of royal sages and highly powerful said, 'Dear Bharata, what wrong have I done that you should prevent me by lying down in front of me?'

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणो ह्येकपार्श्वेन नरान्रोद्धुमिहार्हति। न तु मूर्धाभिषिक्तानां विधिः प्रत्युपवेशने।।2.111.17।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇo hyekapārśvena narānroddhumihārhati| na tu mūrdhābhiṣiktānāṃ vidhiḥ pratyupaveśane||2.111.17||
meaning: A brahmin alone is competent in this world to prevent a person by lying down on one side (in front of him). One who is anointed king is not permitted by (scriptural) tradition to squat in protest.

sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल हित्वैतद्दारुणं व्रतम्। पुरवर्यामितः क्षिप्रमयोध्यां याहि राघव।।2.111.18।।
transliteration: uttiṣṭha naraśārdūla hitvaitaddāruṇṃ vratam| puravaryāmitḥ kṣipramayodhyāṃ yāhi rāghava||2.111.18||
meaning: O Bharata, O tiger among men, O scion of the Raghu race give up this formidable vow. Arise and quickly return to Ayodhya, the best of cities.

sanskrit: आसीनस्त्वेव भरतः पौरजानपदं जनम्। उवाच सर्वतः प्रेक्ष्य किमार्यं नानुशासथ।।2.111.19।।
transliteration: āsīnastveva bharatḥ paurajānapadṃ janam| uvāca sarvatḥ prekṣya kimāryṃ nānuśāsatha||2.111.19||
meaning: While remaining seated, Bharata looking all around at the inhabitants from towns and villages, questioned them 'why don't you all persuade my esteemed brother to return'.

sanskrit: ते तदोचुर्महात्मानं पौरजानपदा जनाः। काकुत्स्थमभिजानीमः सम्यग् वदति राघवः।।2.111.20।।
transliteration: te tadocurmahātmānṃ paurajānapadā janāḥ| kākutsthamabhijānīmḥ samyag vadati rāghavḥ||2.111.20||
meaning: Those inhabitants from towns and villages replied to the magnanimous Bharata 'we know the scion of the Kakutha dynasty, Rama, very well. What he has said is proper'.

sanskrit: एषोऽपि हि महाभागः पितुर्वचसि तिष्ठति। अत एव न शक्ताः स्मो व्यावर्तयितुमञ्जसा।।2.111.21।।
transliteration: eṣo'pi hi mahābhāgḥ piturvacasi tiṣṭhati| ata eva na śaktāḥ smo vyāvartayitumañjasā||2.111.21||
meaning: Highly distinguished Rama is firmly fixed on the command of his father. That is why we are incapable of making him return quickly.

sanskrit: तेषामाज्ञाय वचनं रामो वचनमब्रवीत्। एवं निबोध वचनं सुहृदां धर्मचक्षुषाम्।।2.111.22।।
transliteration: teṣāmājñāya vacanṃ rāmo vacanamabravīt| evṃ nibodha vacanṃ suhṛdāṃ dharmacakṣuṣām||2.111.22||
meaning: Having understood their words, Rama said to him, 'Listen to the words of our friends who have a righteous vision.'

sanskrit: एतच्चैवोभयं श्रुत्वा सम्यक्सम्पश्य राघव। उत्तिष्ठ त्वं महाबाहो मां च स्पृश तथोदकम्।।2.111.23।।
transliteration: etaccaivobhayṃ śrutvā samyaksampaśya rāghava| uttiṣṭha tvṃ mahābāho māṃ ca spṛśa tathodakam||2.111.23||
meaning: O mightyarmed son of the Raghus, you have heard both (them and me). Carefully think over. Arise. Touch me and sip water.

sanskrit: अथोत्थाय जलंस्पृष्ट्वा भरतो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। श्रुण्वन्तु मे परिषदो मन्त्रिण श्श्रेणयस्तथा।।2.111.24।।
transliteration: athotthāya jalṃspṛṣṭvā bharato vākyamabravīt| śruṇvantu me pariṣado mantriṇa śśreṇayastathā||2.111.24||
meaning: Then Bharata stood up and performed achamana (sipping of water) and said 'let the assembly of learned men, counsellors and guildsmen hear me'.

sanskrit: न याचे पितरं राज्यं नानुशासामि मातरम्। आर्यं परमधर्मज्ञं नानुजानामि राघवम्।।2.111.25।।
transliteration: na yāce pitarṃ rājyṃ nānuśāsāmi mātaram| āryṃ paramadharmajñṃ nānujānāmi rāghavam||2.111.25||
meaning: I never asked my father to confer the kingdom on me. I never urged my mother to seek the kingdom for me. I never supported the exile of my esteemed brother Rama, who is supreme in the knowleldge of righteousness.

sanskrit: यदित्ववश्यं वस्तव्यं कर्तव्यं च पितुर्वचः। अहमेव निवत्स्यामि चतुर्दश समा वने।।2.111.26।।
transliteration: yaditvavaśyṃ vastavyṃ kartavyṃ ca piturvacḥ| ahameva nivatsyāmi caturdaśa samā vane||2.111.26||
meaning: If it is absolutely essential to live in the forest in accordance with the command of my father, I myself shall also dwell in the forest for fourteen years.

sanskrit: धर्मात्मा तस्य तथ्येन भ्रातुर्वाक्येन विस्मितः। उवाच राम स्सम्प्रेक्ष्य पौरजानपदं जनम्।।2.111.27।।
transliteration: dharmātmā tasya tathyena bhrāturvākyena vismitḥ| uvāca rāma ssamprekṣya paurajānapadṃ janam||2.111.27||
meaning: On hearing the genuine sentiments of his brother, righteous Rama was astonished. He said to the inhabitants from towns and villages:

sanskrit: विक्रीतमाहितं क्रीतं यत्पित्रा जीवता मम। न तल्लोपयितुं शक्यं मया वा भरतेन वा।।2.111.28।।
transliteration: vikrītamāhitṃ krītṃ yatpitrā jīvatā mama| na tallopayituṃ śakyṃ mayā vā bharatena vā||2.111.28||
meaning: Neither Bharata nor I can in any way annul anything which was sold, pledged or bought by my father during his lifetime.

sanskrit: उपधिर्न मया कार्यो वनवासे जुगुप्सितः। युक्तमुक्तं च कैकेय्या पित्रा मे सुकृतं कृतम्।।2.111.29।।
transliteration: upadhirna mayā kāryo vanavāse jugupsitḥ| yuktamuktṃ ca kaikeyyā pitrā me sukṛtṃ kṛtam||2.111.29||
meaning: As far as living in the forest is concerned it is reprehensible to keep a subsitute for me and it shall not be done. Kaikeyi has acted rightfully and my father has taken the proper decision.

sanskrit: जानामि भरतं क्षान्तं गुरुसत्कारकारिणम्। सर्वमेवात्र कल्याणं सत्यसन्धे महात्मनि।।2.111.30।।
transliteration: jānāmi bharatṃ kṣāntṃ gurusatkārakāriṇam| sarvamevātra kalyāṇṃ satyasandhe mahātmani||2.111.30||
meaning: I know Bharata as a man of forbearance and one who honours elders. Everything will turn out well for this great soul wedded to truth.

sanskrit: अनेन धर्मशीलेन वनात्प्रत्यागतः पुनः। भ्रात्रा सह भविष्यामि पृथिव्याः पतिरुत्तमः।।2.111.31।।
transliteration: anena dharmaśīlena vanātpratyāgatḥ punḥ| bhrātrā saha bhaviṣyāmi pṛthivyāḥ patiruttamḥ||2.111.31||
meaning: On returning from the forest, I shall become the supreme lord of this earth along with this virtuous brother.

sanskrit: वृतो हि राजा कैकेय्या मया तद्वचनं कृतम्। अनृतान्मोचयानेन पितरं तं महीपतिम्।।2.111.32।।
transliteration: vṛto hi rājā kaikeyyā mayā tadvacanṃ kṛtam| anṛtānmocayānena pitarṃ tṃ mahīpatim||2.111.32||
meaning: The king (Dasaratha) was solicited by Kaikeyi and I shall abide. Therefore, you also release the lord of the earth, our father from the charge of falsehood. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकाद

sanskrit: अन्तर्हिता मुनिगणास्सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। तौ भ्रातरौ महात्मानौ काकुत्स्थौ प्रशशंसिरे।।2.112.2।।
transliteration: antarhitā munigaṇāssiddhāśca paramarṣayḥ| tau bhrātarau mahātmānau kākutsthau praśaśṃsire||2.112.2||
meaning: The hosts of sages, siddhas and devarshis watching invisible the two Kakutstha brothers extoled them.

sanskrit: स धन्यो यस्य पुत्रौ द्वौ धर्मज्ञौ धर्मविक्रमौ। श्रुत्वा वयं हि सम्भाषामुभयोस्स्पृहयामहे।।2.112.3।।
transliteration: sa dhanyo yasya putrau dvau dharmajñau dharmavikramau| śrutvā vayṃ hi sambhāṣāmubhayosspṛhayāmahe||2.112.3||
meaning: On hearing their dialogue we are deeply drawn towards them, these two sons of king Dasaratha who was fortunate to have these practioners of righteousness and whose strength is dharma.

sanskrit: ततस्त्वृषिगणाः क्षिप्रं दशग्रीववधैषिणः। भरतं राजशार्दूलमित्यूचु: स‌ङ्गता वचः।।2.112.4।।
transliteration: tatastvṛṣigaṇāḥ kṣiprṃ daśagrīvavadhaiṣiṇḥ| bharatṃ rājaśārdūlamityūcu: sa‌ṅgatā vacḥ||2.112.4||
meaning: Thereafter hosts of rishis desiring the speedy destruction of tenheaded Ravana said these words to Bharata, the best of kings.

sanskrit: कुले जात महाप्राज्ञ महावृत्त महायशः। ग्राह्यं रामस्य वाक्यं ते पितरं यद्यवेक्षसे।।2.112.5।।
transliteration: kule jāta mahāprājña mahāvṛtta mahāyaśḥ| grāhyṃ rāmasya vākyṃ te pitarṃ yadyavekṣase||2.112.5||
meaning: O Bharata, born in an illustrious race, highly sagacious and a man of virtuous conduct and great renown, accept Rama's proposal if you have any regard for your father.

sanskrit: सदाऽनृणमिमं रामं वयमिच्छामहे पितुः। आनृणत्वाच्च कैकेय्या: स्वर्गम् दशरथो गतः।।2.112.6।।
transliteration: sadā'nṛṇamimṃ rāmṃ vayamicchāmahe pituḥ| ānṛṇatvācca kaikeyyā: svargam daśaratho gatḥ||2.112.6||
meaning: We always desire that Rama should discharge his debt to his father. Dasaratha, who by redeeming himself of his obligation to Kaikeyi, had ascended heaven.

sanskrit: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं गन्धर्वा: स‌महर्षयः। राजर्षयश्चैव तदा सर्वे स्वां स्वां गतिं गताः।।2.112.7।।
transliteration: etāvaduktvā vacanṃ gandharvā: sa‌maharṣayḥ| rājarṣayaścaiva tadā sarve svāṃ svāṃ gatiṃ gatāḥ||2.112.7||
meaning: Then the great rishis, gandharvas and royal sages having said this, returned to their respective abodes.

sanskrit: ह्लादितस्तेन वाक्येन शुभेन शुभदर्शनः। राम स्संहृष्टवदनस्तानृषीनभ्यपूजयत्।।2.112.8।।
transliteration: hlāditastena vākyena śubhena śubhadarśanḥ| rāma ssṃhṛṣṭavadanastānṛṣīnabhyapūjayat||2.112.8||
meaning: Of pleasing appearance, Rama, gladdened by the auspicious statements (of the sages), paid them homage with a cheerful countenance.

sanskrit: त्रस्तगात्रस्तु भरतस्स वाचा सज्जमानया। कृताञ्जलिरिदं वाक्यं राघवं पुनरब्रवीत्।।2.112.9।।
transliteration: trastagātrastu bharatassa vācā sajjamānayā| kṛtāñjaliridṃ vākyṃ rāghavṃ punarabravīt||2.112.9||
meaning: Before Bharata, with his limbs trembling and with palms folded (in reverence) was ready to depart, he said to Rama:

sanskrit: राजधर्ममनुप्रेक्ष्य कुलधर्मानुसन्ततिम्। कर्तुमर्हसि काकुत्स्थ मम मातुश्च याचनाम्।।2.112.10।।
transliteration: rājadharmamanuprekṣya kuladharmānusantatim| kartumarhasi kākutstha mama mātuśca yācanām||2.112.10||
meaning: O Rama, keeping in view the code of kings and tradition of our family, it behoves you to consider my supplication and that of my mother.

sanskrit: रक्षितुं सुमहद्राज्यमहमेकस्तु नोत्सहे। पौरजानपदांश्चापि रक्तान्रञ्जयितुं तथा।।2.112.11।।
transliteration: rakṣituṃ sumahadrājyamahamekastu notsahe| paurajānapadāṃścāpi raktānrañjayituṃ tathā||2.112.11||
meaning: I do not venture to protect this kingdom all by myself and keep the inhabitants of the towns and villages who are loyal to you pleased.

sanskrit: ज्ञातयश्च हि योधाश्च मित्राणि सुहृदश्च नः। त्वामेव प्रतिवीक्षन्ते पर्जन्यमिव कर्षकाः।।2.112.12।।
transliteration: jñātayaśca hi yodhāśca mitrāṇi suhṛdaśca nḥ| tvāmeva prativīkṣante parjanyamiva karṣakāḥ||2.112.12||
meaning: All our relatives, warriors, friends and wellwishers long to see you like farmers yearn for the raincloud.

sanskrit: इदं राज्यं महाप्राज्ञ स्थापय प्रतिपद्य हि। शक्तिमानसि काकुत्स्थ लोकस्य परिपालने।।2.112.13।।
transliteration: idṃ rājyṃ mahāprājña sthāpaya pratipadya hi| śaktimānasi kākutstha lokasya paripālane||2.112.13||
meaning: O sagacious Rama, accept this kingdom and ensure its stability. You are powerful enough to govern this world. So accept this kingdom and restore its stability.

sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा न्यपतद्भ्रातुः पादयोर्भरतस्तदा। भृशं सम्प्रार्थयामास राममेव प्रियंवदः।।2.112.14।।
transliteration: ityuktvā nyapatadbhrātuḥ pādayorbharatastadā| bhṛśṃ samprārthayāmāsa rāmameva priyṃvadḥ||2.112.14||
meaning: Having said this, Bharata, fell at the feet of his brother, and speaking sweetly, he profusely entreated Rama.

sanskrit: तमङ्के भरतं कृत्वा रामो वचनमब्रवीत्। श्यामं नलिनपत्राक्षं मत्तहंसस्वरं स्वयम्।।2.112.15।।
transliteration: tamaṅke bharatṃ kṛtvā rāmo vacanamabravīt| śyāmṃ nalinapatrākṣṃ mattahṃsasvarṃ svayam||2.112.15||
meaning: Rama took his in his arms Bharata who had a darkblue complexion, whose eyes were like petals of lotus and whose voice was the voice of an amorous swan.

sanskrit: आगता त्वामियं बुद्धिस्स्वजा वैनयिकी च या। भृशमुत्सहसे तात रक्षितुं पृथिवीमपि।।2.112.16।।
transliteration: āgatā tvāmiyṃ buddhissvajā vainayikī ca yā| bhṛśamutsahase tāta rakṣituṃ pṛthivīmapi||2.112.16||
meaning: O child, this wisdom of yours is both inborn and imbibed through training. With this, you are perfectly capable of protecting the earth.

sanskrit: अमात्यैश्च सुहृद्भिश्च बुद्धिमद्भिश्च मन्त्रिभिः। सर्वकार्याणि सम्मन्त्र्य सुमहन्त्यपि कारय।।2.112.17।।
transliteration: amātyaiśca suhṛdbhiśca buddhimadbhiśca mantribhiḥ| sarvakāryāṇi sammantrya sumahantyapi kāraya||2.112.17||
meaning: After due consultation with ministers, friends, counsellors and prudent persons, accomplish all tasks, however formidable they may appear.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मीश्चन्द्रादपेयाद्वा हिमवान्वा हिमं त्यजेत्। अतीयात्सागरो वेलां न प्रतिज्ञामहं पितुः।।2.112.18।।
transliteration: lakṣmīścandrādapeyādvā himavānvā himṃ tyajet| atīyātsāgaro velāṃ na pratijñāmahṃ pituḥ||2.112.18||
meaning: The Moon might lose its splendour, snow might abandon the Himavat mountain, the ocean might overstep its shores, but I shall not forsake the promise made to my father.

sanskrit: कामाद्वा तात लोभाद्वा मात्रातुभ्यमिदं कृतम्। न तन्मनसि कर्तव्यं वर्तितव्यं च मातृवत्।।2.112.19।।
transliteration: kāmādvā tāta lobhādvā mātrātubhyamidṃ kṛtam| na tanmanasi kartavyṃ vartitavyṃ ca mātṛvat||2.112.19||
meaning: Dear brother, whether out of affection or greed, your mother has done this for your sake. It should not agitate your mind. You should conduct yourself as one should towards one's mother.

sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवाणं भरतः कौसल्यासुतमब्रवीत्। तेजसाऽऽदित्यसङ्काशं प्रतिपच्चन्द्रदर्शनम्।।2.112.20।।
transliteration: evṃ bruvāṇṃ bharatḥ kausalyāsutamabravīt| tejasā''dityasaṅkāśṃ pratipaccandradarśanam||2.112.20||
meaning: On hearing this, Bharata replied to the son of Kausalya who looked like the Sun or the new Moon in brilliance:

sanskrit: आधिरोहाऽर्य पादाभ्यां पादुके हेमभूषिते। एतेहि सर्वलोकस्य योगक्षेमं विधास्यतः।।2.112.21।।
transliteration: ādhirohā'rya pādābhyāṃ pāduke hemabhūṣite| etehi sarvalokasya yogakṣemṃ vidhāsyatḥ||2.112.21||
meaning: O noble one, place your feet on these sandals decorated with gold. They will secure the prosperity and safety of the entire world.

sanskrit: सोऽधिरुह्य नरव्याघ्रः पादुके ह्यवरुह्य च। प्रायच्छत्सुमहातेजा भरताय महात्मने।।2.112.22।।
transliteration: so'dhiruhya naravyāghrḥ pāduke hyavaruhya ca| prāyacchatsumahātejā bharatāya mahātmane||2.112.22||
meaning: Rama, the best of men, one with great brilliance, put on and then put off the sandals and presented them to the magnanimous Bharata.

sanskrit: स पादुके सम्प्रणम्य रामं वचनमब्रवीत् चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि जटाचीरधरो ह्याहम्।।2.112.23।। फलमूलाशनो वीर भवेयं रघुनन्दन। तवाऽ
transliteration: sa pāduke sampraṇamya rāmṃ vacanamabravīt caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi jaṭācīradharo hyāham||2.112.23|| phalamūlāśano vīra bhave
meaning: Bharata bowed before the sandals and said to Rama, 'O tormentorr of enemies, O hero, wearing matted locks and bark garments, living on fruits and roots, placing the responsibility of ruling the kingdom on your sandals an

sanskrit: चतुर्दशे तु संपूर्णे वर्षेऽहनि रघूत्तम।।2.112.25।। न द्रक्ष्यामि यदि त्वां तु प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्।
transliteration: caturdaśe tu sṃpūrṇe varṣe'hani raghūttama||2.112.25|| na drakṣyāmi yadi tvāṃ tu pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam|
meaning: O best of the Raghus, if I do not behold you on the day after completion of fourteen years I shall enter the blazing fire.

sanskrit: तथेति च प्रतिज्ञाय तं परिष्वज्य सादरम्।।2.112.26।। शत्रुघ्नं च परिष्वज्य भरतं चेदमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: tatheti ca pratijñāya tṃ pariṣvajya sādaram||2.112.26|| śatrughnṃ ca pariṣvajya bharatṃ cedamabravīt|
meaning: 'Be it so', assured Rama and then affectionately embracing both Bharata and Satrughna, said to Bharata:

sanskrit: मातरं रक्ष कैकेयीं मा रोषं कुरु तां प्रति।।2.112.27।। मया च सीतया चैव शप्तोऽसि रघुसत्तम। इत्युक्त्वाऽश्रुपरीताक्षो भ्रात
transliteration: mātarṃ rakṣa kaikeyīṃ mā roṣṃ kuru tāṃ prati||2.112.27|| mayā ca sītayā caiva śapto'si raghusattama| ityuktvā'śruparītāk
meaning: Look after your mother, O chief of the Raghus Do not be angry with her. Swear in my name and in the name of Sita. So saying, eyes filled with tears, Rama took leave of his brother.

sanskrit: स पादुके ते भरतः प्रतापवान् स्वलङ्कृते सम्परिपूज्य धर्मवित्। प्रदक्षिणं चैव चकार राघवम् चकार ते चोत्तमनागमूर्धनि।।2.112.
transliteration: sa pāduke te bharatḥ pratāpavān svalaṅkṛte samparipūjya dharmavit| pradakṣiṇṃ caiva cakāra rāghavam cakāra te cottamanāg
meaning: The valiant and righteous Bharata, worshipped the welldecorated sandals and after circumambulating Rama reverentially placed them atop the best of elephants.

sanskrit: अथाऽनुपूर्व्यात्प्रतिनन्द्य तं जनं गुरूंश्च मन्त्रिप्रकृतीस्तथाऽनुजौ। व्यसर्जयद्राघववंशवर्धनस्थिरः स्वधर्मे हिमवानिवाचलः
transliteration: athā'nupūrvyātpratinandya tṃ janṃ gurūṃśca mantriprakṛtīstathā'nujau| vyasarjayadrāghavavṃśavardhanasthirḥ svadharme him
meaning: Inflexibly fixed in his own code of righteouness, like the Himavat mountain, Rama, the enhancer of the progeny of the Raghu dynasty, paid respect due to the preceptors, ministers and subjects in accordance with their ran

sanskrit: तं मातरो बाष्पगृहीतकण्ठ्यो दुःखेन नामन्त्रयितुं हि शेकुः। स त्वेव मात्रृ़रभिवाद्य सर्वारुदन्कुटीं स्वां प्रविवेश राघवः।।
transliteration: tṃ mātaro bāṣpagṛhītakaṇṭhyo duḥkhena nāmantrayituṃ hi śekuḥ| sa tveva mātrṛ़rabhivādya sarvārudankuṭīṃ svāṃ praviveśa r
meaning: His mothers were unable to bid him farewell their throats were choked with tears of sorrow but Rama himself paid obeisance to them and entered his hut in tears. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे

sanskrit: वसिष्ठो वामदेवश्च जाबालिश्च दृढव्रतः। अग्रतः प्रययु स्सर्वे मन्त्रिणो मन्त्रपूजिताः।।2.113.2।।
transliteration: vasiṣṭho vāmadevaśca jābāliśca dṛḍhavratḥ| agratḥ prayayu ssarve mantriṇo mantrapūjitāḥ||2.113.2||
meaning: Vasishta, Vamadeva, Jabali of rigorous penance and all the ministers honoured for their counsel proceeded ahead.

sanskrit: मन्दाकिनीं नदीं रम्यां प्राङ्मुखास्ते ययुस्तदा। प्रदक्षिणं च कुर्वाणाश्चित्रकूटं महागिरिम्।।2.113.3।।
transliteration: mandākinīṃ nadīṃ ramyāṃ prāṅmukhāste yayustadā| pradakṣiṇṃ ca kurvāṇāścitrakūṭṃ mahāgirim||2.113.3||
meaning: All of them circumambulated the mighty mountain Chitrakuta and proceeded east towards the charming river Mandakini.

sanskrit: पश्यन्धातुसहस्राणि रम्याणि विविधानि च। प्रययौ तस्य पार्श्वेन ससैन्यो भरतस्तदा।।2.113.4।।
transliteration: paśyandhātusahasrāṇi ramyāṇi vividhāni ca| prayayau tasya pārśvena sasainyo bharatastadā||2.113.4||
meaning: Beholding a thousand varieties of beautiful minerals, Bharata with his army proceeded alongside the mountain.

sanskrit: अदूराच्चित्रकूटस्य ददर्श भरतस्तदा। आश्रमं यत्र स मुनिर्भरद्वाजः कृतालयः।।2.113.5।।
transliteration: adūrāccitrakūṭasya dadarśa bharatastadā| āśramṃ yatra sa munirbharadvājḥ kṛtālayḥ||2.113.5||
meaning: Not far from Chitrakuta mountain, Bharata beheld a hermitage where sage Bharadwaja resided.

sanskrit: स तमाश्रममागम्य भरद्वाजस्य बुद्धिमान्। अवतीर्य रथात्पादौ ववन्दे भरतस्तदा।।2.113.6।।
transliteration: sa tamāśramamāgamya bharadvājasya buddhimān| avatīrya rathātpādau vavande bharatastadā||2.113.6||
meaning: On approaching the hermitage of sage Bharadwaja, Bharata alighted from the chariot, and prostrated at his feet.

sanskrit: ततो हृष्टो भरद्वाजो भरतं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। अपि कृत्यं कृतं तात रामेण च समागतम्।।2.113.7।।
transliteration: tato hṛṣṭo bharadvājo bharatṃ vākyamabravīt| api kṛtyṃ kṛtṃ tāta rāmeṇa ca samāgatam||2.113.7||
meaning: Then Bhardwaja asked Bharata in delight, My son, have you accomplished your task? Did you meet Rama?

sanskrit: एवमुक्त स्स तु ततो भरद्वाजेन धीमता। प्रत्युवाच भरद्वाजं भरतो धर्मवत्सलः।।2.113.8।।
transliteration: evamukta ssa tu tato bharadvājena dhīmatā| pratyuvāca bharadvājṃ bharato dharmavatsalḥ||2.113.8||
meaning: Having been thus addressed by wise Bharadwaja, Bharata, devoted to righteousness, replied:

sanskrit: स याच्यमानो गुरुणा मया च दृढविक्रमः। राघवः परमप्रीतो वसिष्ठं वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।2.113.9।।
transliteration: sa yācyamāno guruṇā mayā ca dṛḍhavikramḥ| rāghavḥ paramaprīto vasiṣṭhṃ vākyamabravīt||2.113.9||
meaning: Entreated by me and by preceptor (Vasistha), the highly pleased Rama with his firmness of mind replied to Vasistha:

sanskrit: पितुः प्रतिज्ञां तामेव पालयिष्यामि तत्त्वतः। चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि या प्रतिज्ञा पितुर्मम।।2.113.10।।
transliteration: pituḥ pratijñāṃ tāmeva pālayiṣyāmi tattvatḥ| caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi yā pratijñā piturmama||2.113.10||
meaning: In sooth, I shall honour the words of promise given by my father and live in the forest for fourteen years, as promised.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तो महाप्राज्ञो वसिष्ठः प्रत्युवाच ह। वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकुशलं राघवं वचनं महत्।।2.113.11।।
transliteration: evamukto mahāprājño vasiṣṭhḥ pratyuvāca ha| vākyajño vākyakuśalṃ rāghavṃ vacanṃ mahat||2.113.11||
meaning: On hearing him, Vasistha a great intellectual and highly eloquent one replied to Rama, skilled in words of deep significance.

sanskrit: एते प्रयच्छ संहृष्टः पादुके हेमभूषिते। अयोध्यायां महाप्राज्ञ योगक्षेमकरे तव।।2.113.12।।
transliteration: ete prayaccha sṃhṛṣṭḥ pāduke hemabhūṣite| ayodhyāyāṃ mahāprājña yogakṣemakare tava||2.113.12||
meaning: O extremely sagacious one, bestow with pleasure your sandals decked with gold for security and safety of Ayodhya.

sanskrit: एवमुक्तो वसिष्ठेन राघवः प्राङ्मुखः स्थितः। पादुके ह्यधिरुह्यैते मम राज्याय वै ददौ।।2.113.13।।
transliteration: evamukto vasiṣṭhena rāghavḥ prāṅmukhḥ sthitḥ| pāduke hyadhiruhyaite mama rājyāya vai dadau||2.113.13||
meaning: Thus addressed by Vasistha, Rama stood facing eastward wearing these sandals. and bestowed them on me for the sake of ruling the kingdom.

sanskrit: निवृत्तोऽहमनुज्ञातो रामेण सुमहात्मना। अयोध्यामेव गच्छामि गृहीत्वा पादुके शुभे।।2.113.14।।
transliteration: nivṛtto'hamanujñāto rāmeṇa sumahātmanā| ayodhyāmeva gacchāmi gṛhītvā pāduke śubhe||2.113.14||
meaning: I am now returning to Ayodhya with these auspicious sandals permitted by the magnanimous Rama.

sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं भरतस्य महात्मनः। भरद्वाजश्शुभतरं मुनिर्वाक्यमुवाच तम्।।2.113.15।।
transliteration: etacchrutvā śubhṃ vākyṃ bharatasya mahātmanḥ| bharadvājaśśubhatarṃ munirvākyamuvāca tam||2.113.15||
meaning: Hearing the auspicious words of the magnanimous Bharata, sage Bharadwaja said to him in words still more auspicious.

sanskrit: नैतच्चित्रं नरव्याघ्र शीलवृत्तवतां वर। यदार्यं त्वयि तिष्ठेत्तु निम्ने सृष्टमिवोदकम्।।2.113.16।।
transliteration: naitaccitrṃ naravyāghra śīlavṛttavatāṃ vara| yadāryṃ tvayi tiṣṭhettu nimne sṛṣṭamivodakam||2.113.16||
meaning: O best of men, foremost among men of excellent character and dispositon, it is not surprising that all noble qualities come to reside in you naturally like water poured flowing downward.

sanskrit: अमृत स्समहाबाहुः पिता दशरथस्तव। यस्य त्वमीदृश: पुत्रो धर्मज्ञो धर्मवत्सलः।।2.113.17।।
transliteration: amṛta ssamahābāhuḥ pitā daśarathastava| yasya tvamīdṛśa: putro dharmajño dharmavatsalḥ||2.113.17||
meaning: With you as his son, endowed with qualities of righteousness and devotion to duty, your mightyarmed father Dasaratha is not dead. (He lives through you).

sanskrit: तमृषिं तु महात्मानमुक्तवाक्यं कृताञ्जलिः। आमन्त्रयितुमारेभे चरणावुपगृह्य च।।2.113.18।।
transliteration: tamṛṣiṃ tu mahātmānamuktavākyṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ| āmantrayitumārebhe caraṇāvupagṛhya ca||2.113.18||
meaning: Hearing the words of the magnanimous Bharadwaja, Bharata paid his respect, folding his palms, and clasping the feet of the sage and sought his permission to leave.

sanskrit: ततः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा भरद्वाजं पुनः पुनः। भरतस्तु ययौ श्रीमानयोध्यां सह मन्त्रिभिः।।2.113.19।।
transliteration: tatḥ pradakṣiṇṃ kṛtvā bharadvājṃ punḥ punḥ| bharatastu yayau śrīmānayodhyāṃ saha mantribhiḥ||2.113.19||
meaning: Then illustrious Bharata circumambulated the sage several times in homage before he set out for Ayodhya with his counsellors.

sanskrit: यानैश्च शकटैश्चैव हयैर्नागैश्च सा चमूः। पुनर्निवृत्ता विस्तीर्णा भरतस्यानुयायिनी।।2.113.20 ।।
transliteration: yānaiśca śakaṭaiścaiva hayairnāgaiśca sā camūḥ| punarnivṛttā vistīrṇā bharatasyānuyāyinī||2.113.20 ||
meaning: The vast army of Bharata with all its carriages, carts, horses and elephants following him again turned back towards Ayodhya.

sanskrit: ततस्ते यमुनां दिव्यां नदीं तीर्त्वोर्मिमालिनीम्। ददृशुस्तां पुन स्सर्वे गङ्गां शुभजलां नदीम्।।2.113.21।।
transliteration: tataste yamunāṃ divyāṃ nadīṃ tīrtvormimālinīm| dadṛśustāṃ puna ssarve gaṅgāṃ śubhajalāṃ nadīm||2.113.21||
meaning: Thereafter, all of them crossed the divine river Yamuna wreathed in waves and, beheld the Ganga of sacred waters once again.

sanskrit: तां रम्यजलसंपूर्णां सन्तीर्य सहबान्धवः शृङ्गिबेरपुरं रम्यं प्रविवेश ससैनिकः। शृङ्गिबेरपुराद्भूय स्त्वयोध्यां सन्ददर्श ह।
transliteration: tāṃ ramyajalasṃpūrṇāṃ santīrya sahabāndhavḥ śṛṅgiberapurṃ ramyṃ praviveśa sasainikḥ| śṛṅgiberapurādbhūya stvayodhyāṃ san
meaning: Bharata along with his kins and his army crossed the Ganga with its overflowing, wonderful waters and entered the beautiful city of Sringiberapura and from there he proceeded until he beheld the city of Ayodhya.

sanskrit: अयोध्यां च ततो दृष्ट्वा पित्रा भ्रात्रा विवर्जिताम्। भरतो दुःख सन्तप्त स्सारथिं चेदमब्रवीत्।।2.113.23।।
transliteration: ayodhyāṃ ca tato dṛṣṭvā pitrā bhrātrā vivarjitām| bharato duḥkha santapta ssārathiṃ cedamabravīt||2.113.23||
meaning: On seeing the city of Ayodhya bereft of his father and brothers, Bharata, consumed with grief, said to the charioteer:

sanskrit: सारथे पश्य विध्वस्ता साऽयोध्या न प्रकाशते। निराकारा निरानन्दा दीना प्रतिहतस्वरा।।2.113.24।।
transliteration: sārathe paśya vidhvastā sā'yodhyā na prakāśate| nirākārā nirānandā dīnā pratihatasvarā||2.113.24||
meaning: O charioteer, look, Ayodhya is in shapeless shambles. It is silent and cheerless. It is dull and desolate. It shines no more. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्रयोदशोरशततमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the

sanskrit: राहुशत्रोः प्रियां पत्नीं श्रिया प्रज्वलितप्रभाम्। ग्रहेणाभ्युत्थितेनैकां रोहिणीमिव पीडिताम्।।2.114.3।।
transliteration: rāhuśatroḥ priyāṃ patnīṃ śriyā prajvalitaprabhām| graheṇābhyutthitenaikāṃ rohiṇīmiva pīḍitām||2.114.3||
meaning: (The city looked) like Rohini, the beloved consort of the Moon, the star which was majesticlly radiating flaming brilliance and now, tormented by the exalted Rahu which has eclipsed the Moon, shines alone.

sanskrit: अल्पोष्णक्षुब्धसलिलां घर्मोत्तप्तविहङ्गमाम्। लीनमीनझषग्राहां कृशां गिरिनदीमिव।।2.114.4।।
transliteration: alpoṣṇakṣubdhasalilāṃ gharmottaptavihaṅgamām| līnamīnajhaṣagrāhāṃ kṛśāṃ girinadīmiva||2.114.4||
meaning: (It appeared) like a lean mountainstream with scant, hot and turbid waters, with scorched aquatic birds and with small and large fishes and crocodiles dead due to the heat of the Sun.

sanskrit: विध्वस्तकवचां रुग्णगजवाजिरथध्वजाम्। हतप्रवीरामापन्नां चमूमिव महाहवे।।2.114.6।।
transliteration: vidhvastakavacāṃ rugṇagajavājirathadhvajām| hatapravīrāmāpannāṃ camūmiva mahāhave||2.114.6||
meaning: warriors slain in the great battle (the city appeared desolate).

sanskrit: गोष्ठमध्ये स्थितामार्तामचरन्तीं तृणं नवम्। गोवृषेण परित्यक्तां गवां पक्तिमिवोत्सुकाम्।।2.114.9।।
transliteration: goṣṭhamadhye sthitāmārtāmacarantīṃ tṛṇṃ navam| govṛṣeṇa parityaktāṃ gavāṃ paktimivotsukām||2.114.9||
meaning: the midst of the herd despairs and no longer grazes the new grass.

sanskrit: पुष्पनद्धां वसन्तान्ते मत्तभ्रमरनादिताम्। द्रुतदावाग्नि विप्लुष्टां क्लान्तां वनलतामिव।।2.114.12।।
transliteration: puṣpanaddhāṃ vasantānte mattabhramaranāditām| drutadāvāgni vipluṣṭāṃ klāntāṃ vanalatāmiva||2.114.12||
meaning: with the melodious humming of intoxicated bees and suddenly shrivelling, ravaged by the fastspreading forest fire.

sanskrit: सम्मूढनिगमांस्तब्धां संक्षिप्तविपणापणाम्। प्रच्छन्नशशिनक्षत्रां द्यामिवाम्बुधरैर्वृताम्।।2.114.13।।
transliteration: sammūḍhanigamāṃstabdhāṃ sṃkṣiptavipaṇāpaṇām| pracchannaśaśinakṣatrāṃ dyāmivāmbudharairvṛtām||2.114.13||
meaning: Ayodhya with its markets and shops closed, and its merchants in a daze looked like the sky covered with clouds obscuring the Moon and stars.

sanskrit: क्षीणपानोत्तमैर्भग्नैः शरावैरभिसंवृताम्। हतशौण्डामिव ध्वस्तांं पानभूमिमसंस्कृताम्।।2.114.14।।
transliteration: kṣīṇapānottamairbhagnaiḥ śarāvairabhisṃvṛtām| hataśauṇḍāmiva dhvastāṃṃ pānabhūmimasṃskṛtām||2.114.14||
meaning: (Ayodhya looked) like an uncleansed drinking place with broken pitchers emptied of excellent wine scattered around and with drunkards lying dead in the open.

sanskrit: वृक्णभूमितलां निम्नां वृक्णपात्रैस्समावृताम्। उपयुक्तोदकां भग्नां प्रपां निपतितामिव।।2.114.15।।
transliteration: vṛkṇabhūmitalāṃ nimnāṃ vṛkṇapātraissamāvṛtām| upayuktodakāṃ bhagnāṃ prapāṃ nipatitāmiva||2.114.15||
meaning: (Ayodhya appeared) like a ruined well, its foundations broken and sunken into the earth, its water used up, with broken pots scattered around, its riven surface forming a dale.

sanskrit: भरतस्तु रथस्थ स्सन् श्रीमान्दशरथात्मजः। वाहयन्तं रथश्रेष्ठं सारथिं वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।2.114.21।।
transliteration: bharatastu rathastha ssan śrīmāndaśarathātmajḥ| vāhayantṃ rathaśreṣṭhṃ sārathiṃ vākyamabravīt||2.114.21||
meaning: Illustrious Bharata, son of Dasaratha, seated in his chariot, addressed the charioteer as he drove the most excellent of chariots saying:

sanskrit: किं नु खल्वद्य गम्भीरो मूर्छितो न निशम्यते। यथापुरमयोध्यायां गीतवादित्रनिस्वनः।।2.114.22।।
transliteration: kiṃ nu khalvadya gambhīro mūrchito na niśamyate| yathāpuramayodhyāyāṃ gītavāditranisvanḥ||2.114.22||
meaning: How is it that in Ayodhya, the deep and allpervasive songs and sounds of musical instruments of the former days are not heard now?

sanskrit: वारुणीमदगन्धश्च माल्यगन्धश्च मूर्छितः। धूपितागुरुगन्धश्च न प्रवाति समन्ततः।।2.114.23।।
transliteration: vāruṇīmadagandhaśca mālyagandhaśca mūrchitḥ| dhūpitāgurugandhaśca na pravāti samantatḥ||2.114.23||
meaning: The breeze no longer carries the intoxicating odour of spirituous liquor, the pervading fragrance of flower garlands and agaru (incense).

sanskrit: यानप्रवरघोषश्च स्निग्धश्च हयनिस्वनः। प्रमत्तगजनादश्च महांश्च रथनिस्वनः।।2.114.24।। नेदानीं श्रूयते पुर्यामस्यां रामे विव
transliteration: yānapravaraghoṣaśca snigdhaśca hayanisvanḥ| pramattagajanādaśca mahāṃśca rathanisvanḥ||2.114.24|| nedānīṃ śrūyate puryām
meaning: After Rama's the exile the clatter of excellent carriages, the pleasing neighing of horses and trumpeting of elephants in rut and the rattle of chariots are no longer heard now.

sanskrit: चन्दनागरुगन्धांश्च महार्हाश्च नवस्रजः। गते हि रामे तरुणा स्संतप्ता नोपभुञ्जते।।2.114.25।।
transliteration: candanāgarugandhāṃśca mahārhāśca navasrajḥ| gate hi rāme taruṇā ssṃtaptā nopabhuñjate||2.114.25||
meaning: Since Rama has departed, the young men in distress do not enjoy expensive incense of agaru and sandalwood paste and garlands of fresh flowers.

sanskrit: बहिर्यात्रां न गच्छन्ति चित्रमाल्यधरा नराः। नोत्सवा स्सम्प्रवर्तन्ते रामशोकार्दिते पुरे।।2.114.27।।
transliteration: bahiryātrāṃ na gacchanti citramālyadharā narāḥ| notsavā ssampravartante rāmaśokārdite pure||2.114.27||
meaning: This city is stricken with grief on account of Rama's departure. Men do not go out on pleasure jaunts wearing garlands of variegated flowers. Festivities are not celebrated.

sanskrit: सह नूनं मम भ्रात्रा पुरस्यास्य द्युतिर्गता। न हि राजत्ययोध्येयं सासारेवार्जुनी क्षपा।।2.114.28।।
transliteration: saha nūnṃ mama bhrātrā purasyāsya dyutirgatā| na hi rājatyayodhyeyṃ sāsārevārjunī kṣapā||2.114.28||
meaning: Certainly splendour has left along with my brother. Like the night when the rain pours down during the waning of the Moon, Ayodhya shines not.

sanskrit: कदा नु खलु मे भ्राता महोत्सव इवाऽगतः। जनयिष्यत्ययोध्यायां हर्षं ग्रीष्म इवाम्बुदः।।2.114.29।।
transliteration: kadā nu khalu me bhrātā mahotsava ivā'gatḥ| janayiṣyatyayodhyāyāṃ harṣṃ grīṣma ivāmbudḥ||2.114.29||
meaning: When will my brother return to Ayodhya like a carnival and cause delight to every one like summer clouds?

sanskrit: तरुणैश्चारुवेषैश्च नरैरुन्नतगामिभिः। सम्पतद्भिरयोध्यायां नाभिभान्ति महापथाः।।2.114.30।।
transliteration: taruṇaiścāruveṣaiśca narairunnatagāmibhiḥ| sampatadbhirayodhyāyāṃ nābhibhānti mahāpathāḥ||2.114.30||
meaning: The highways of Ayodhya thronged with groups of elegantly attired young men or adults with their majestic gait, do not shine.

sanskrit: एवं बहुविधं जल्पन्विवेश वसतिं पितुः। तेन हीनां नरेन्द्रेण सिंहहीनां गुहामिव।।2.114.31।।
transliteration: evṃ bahuvidhṃ jalpanviveśa vasatiṃ pituḥ| tena hīnāṃ narendreṇa siṃhahīnāṃ guhāmiva||2.114.31||
meaning: Thus mourning in several ways, Bharata entered his fathers' palace (now) bereft of the king like a cave without the lion.

sanskrit: नन्दिग्रामं गमिष्यामि सर्वानामन्त्रयेऽद्य वः। तत्र दुःखमिदं सर्वं सहिष्ये राघवं विना।।2.115.2।।
transliteration: nandigrāmṃ gamiṣyāmi sarvānāmantraye'dya vḥ| tatra duḥkhamidṃ sarvṃ sahiṣye rāghavṃ vinā||2.115.2||
meaning: I take leave of all of you. I am going to Nandigrama where I shall keep company with grief on account of Rama's absence.

sanskrit: गतश्च वा दिवं राजा वनस्थश्च गुरुर्मम। रामं प्रतीक्षे राज्याय स हि राजा महायशाः।।2.115.3।।
transliteration: gataśca vā divṃ rājā vanasthaśca gururmama| rāmṃ pratīkṣe rājyāya sa hi rājā mahāyaśāḥ||2.115.3||
meaning: King Dasaratha has gone to heaven. My elder brother and guru is in the forest. I shall await his return for ruling the kingdom since he alone is the illustrious king of Ayodhya.

sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं भरतस्य महात्मनः। अब्रुवन्मन्त्रिणस्सर्वे वसिष्ठश्च पुरोहितः।।2.115.4।।
transliteration: etacchrutvā śubhṃ vākyṃ bharatasya mahātmanḥ| abruvanmantriṇassarve vasiṣṭhaśca purohitḥ||2.115.4||
meaning: Hearing the auspicious words of the magnanimous Bharata the counsellors, priests including Vasistha replied:

sanskrit: सुभृशं श्लाघनीयं च यदुक्तं भरत त्वया। वचनं भ्रातृवात्सल्यादनुरूपं तवैव तत्।।2.115.5।।
transliteration: subhṛśṃ ślāghanīyṃ ca yaduktṃ bharata tvayā| vacanṃ bhrātṛvātsalyādanurūpṃ tavaiva tat||2.115.5||
meaning: O Bharata, the words you have uttered out of devotion to your brother which befit you alone are highly praiseworthy.

sanskrit: नित्यं ते बन्धुलुब्धस्य तिष्ठतो भ्रातृसौहृदे। आर्यमार्गं प्रपन्नस्य नानुमन्येत कः पुमान्।।2.115.6।।
transliteration: nityṃ te bandhulubdhasya tiṣṭhato bhrātṛsauhṛde| āryamārgṃ prapannasya nānumanyeta kḥ pumān||2.115.6||
meaning: You are always attached to your relations, firmly established in the welfare of your brothers and are pursuing a noble path. Who would not approve of this?

sanskrit: मन्त्रिणां वचनं श्रुत्वा यथाभिलषितं प्रियम्। अब्रवीत्सारथिं वाक्यं रथो मे युज्यतामिति।।2.115.7।।
transliteration: mantriṇāṃ vacanṃ śrutvā yathābhilaṣitṃ priyam| abravītsārathiṃ vākyṃ ratho me yujyatāmiti||2.115.7||
meaning: On hearing the pleasing words of the counsellors which were in conformity with his desire, Bharata said to his charioteer, 'Harness my chariot'.

sanskrit: प्रहृष्टवदन स्सर्वा मातृ़ स्समभिवाद्य सः। आरुरोह रथं श्रीमान् शत्रुघ्नेन समन्वितः।।2.115.8।।
transliteration: prahṛṣṭavadana ssarvā mātṛ़ ssamabhivādya sḥ| āruroha rathṃ śrīmān śatrughnena samanvitḥ||2.115.8||
