meaning: With a cheerful countenance illustrious Bharata paid obeisance to all his mothers and, acompanied by Satrughna, ascended the chariot.

sanskrit: आरुह्य च रथं शीघ्रं शत्रुघ्नभरतावुभौ। ययतुः परमप्रीतौ वृतौ मन्त्रिपुरोहितैः।।2.115.9।।
transliteration: āruhya ca rathṃ śīghrṃ śatrughnabharatāvubhau| yayatuḥ paramaprītau vṛtau mantripurohitaiḥ||2.115.9||
meaning: Highly pleased, Bharata and Satrughna ascended the chariot and, surrounded by counsellors and priests, set out speedily.

sanskrit: अग्रतो गुरव: सर्वे वसिष्ठप्रमुखा द्विजाः। प्रययुः प्राङ्ग्मुखा स्सर्वे नन्दिग्रामो यतोऽभवत्।।2.115.10।।
transliteration: agrato gurava: sarve vasiṣṭhapramukhā dvijāḥ| prayayuḥ prāṅgmukhā ssarve nandigrāmo yato'bhavat||2.115.10||
meaning: Preceded by preceptors, like Vasistha and other brahmins, all of them proceeded eastward in the direction of Nandigrama.

sanskrit: बलं च तदनाहूतं गजाश्वरथसङ्कुलम्। प्रययौ भरते याते सर्वे च पुरवासिनः।।2.115.11।।
transliteration: balṃ ca tadanāhūtṃ gajāśvarathasaṅkulam| prayayau bharate yāte sarve ca puravāsinḥ||2.115.11||
meaning: When Bharata left, the army with hordes of elephants, horses and chariots and inhabitants of Ayodhya followed him unbidden.

sanskrit: रथस्थः स तु धर्मात्मा भरतो भ्रातृवत्सलः। नन्दिग्रामं ययौ तूर्णं शिरस्यादाय पादुके।।2.115.12।।
transliteration: rathasthḥ sa tu dharmātmā bharato bhrātṛvatsalḥ| nandigrāmṃ yayau tūrṇṃ śirasyādāya pāduke||2.115.12||
meaning: Righteous Bharata who was deeply attached to his brother proceeded speedily towards Nandigrama on the chariot bearing the sandals of Rama on his head.

sanskrit: ततस्तु भरतः क्षिप्रं नन्दिग्रामं प्रविश्य सः। अवतीर्य रथात्तूर्णं गुरूनिदमुवाच ह।।2.115.13।।
transliteration: tatastu bharatḥ kṣiprṃ nandigrāmṃ praviśya sḥ| avatīrya rathāttūrṇṃ gurūnidamuvāca ha||2.115.13||
meaning: Bharata entered Nandigrama quickly, alighted from the chariot and then, addressing, the preceptors, said:

sanskrit: एतद्राज्यं मम भ्रात्रा दत्तं सन्नयासवत्स्वयम्। योगक्षेमवहे चेमे पादुके हेमभूषिते।।2.115.14।।
transliteration: etadrājyṃ mama bhrātrā dattṃ sannayāsavatsvayam| yogakṣemavahe ceme pāduke hemabhūṣite||2.115.14||
meaning: My brother gave me this kingdom as a trust. He gave me the sandals decorated with gold for securing the prosperity and security (of the kingdom).

sanskrit: भरत श्शिरसा कृत्वा सन्न्यासं पादुके ततः। अब्रवीद्धुःखसंतप्त स्सर्वं प्रकृतिमण्डलम्।।2.115.15।।
transliteration: bharata śśirasā kṛtvā sannyāsṃ pāduke tatḥ| abravīddhuḥkhasṃtapta ssarvṃ prakṛtimaṇḍalam||2.115.15||
meaning: Then Bharata placed the sandals held in trust on his head and, overcome with grief, he addressed the concourse of subjects:

sanskrit: छत्रं धारयत क्षिप्रमार्यपादाविमौ मतौ। आभ्यां राज्ये स्थितो धर्मः पादुकाभ्यां गुरोर्मम।।2.115.16।।
transliteration: chatrṃ dhārayata kṣipramāryapādāvimau matau| ābhyāṃ rājye sthito dharmḥ pādukābhyāṃ gurormama||2.115.16||
meaning: Hold the royal paresol now. This is the accepted symbol of the exalted feet of my brother. These sandals shall establish righteousness in the kingdom.

sanskrit: भ्रात्रा हि मयि संन्यासो निक्षिप्त स्सौहृदादयम्। तमिमं पालयिष्यामि राघवागमनं प्रति।।2.115.17।।
transliteration: bhrātrā hi mayi sṃnyāso nikṣipta ssauhṛdādayam| tamimṃ pālayiṣyāmi rāghavāgamanṃ prati||2.115.17||
meaning: This kingdom has been given me by my brother out of affection as a trust. I shall safeguard it until Rama's return.

sanskrit: क्षिप्रं संयोजयित्वातु राघवस्य पुनस्स्वयम्। चरणौ तौ तु रामस्य द्रक्ष्यामि सहपादुकौ।।2.115.18।।
transliteration: kṣiprṃ sṃyojayitvātu rāghavasya punassvayam| caraṇau tau tu rāmasya drakṣyāmi sahapādukau||2.115.18||
meaning: 'I myself shall see soon Rama's feet reunited with these sandals.

sanskrit: ततो निक्षिप्तभारोऽहं राघवेण समागतः। निवेद्य गुरवे राज्यं भजिष्ये गुरुवृत्तिताम्।।2.115.19।।
transliteration: tato nikṣiptabhāro'hṃ rāghaveṇa samāgatḥ| nivedya gurave rājyṃ bhajiṣye guruvṛttitām||2.115.19||
meaning: The burden of this kingdom has been cast on me. On reunion with Rama, I shall hand it over to my brother, my guru and shall be engaged in his service.

sanskrit: राघवाय च सन्यासं दत्त्वेमे वरपादुके। राज्यं चेदमयोध्यां च धूतपापो भवामि च।।2.115.20।।
transliteration: rāghavāya ca sanyāsṃ dattveme varapāduke| rājyṃ cedamayodhyāṃ ca dhūtapāpo bhavāmi ca||2.115.20||
meaning: Restoring the sacred sandals, the kingdom and this city of Ayodhya held as a trust by me, I shall be cleansed of the sin.

sanskrit: अभिषिक्ते तु काकुत्स्थे प्रहृष्टमुदिते जने। प्रीतिर्मम यशश्चैव भवेद्राज्याच्चतुर्गुणम्।।2.115.21।।
transliteration: abhiṣikte tu kākutsthe prahṛṣṭamudite jane| prītirmama yaśaścaiva bhavedrājyāccaturguṇam||2.115.21||
meaning: After Rama is coronated and the people are delighted and pleased, the renown and pleasure for me will be fourfold (what is obtained from ruling the kingdom).

sanskrit: एवं तु विलपन्दीनो भरत स्समहायशाः। नन्दिग्रामेऽकरोद्राज्यं दुःखितो मन्त्रिभिस्सह।।2.115.22।।
transliteration: evṃ tu vilapandīno bharata ssamahāyaśāḥ| nandigrāme'karodrājyṃ duḥkhito mantribhissaha||2.115.22||
meaning: Thus lamenting in desolation and grief, the illustrious Bharata lived in Nandigrama along with his counsellors and started ruling the kingdom.

sanskrit: स वल्कलजटाधारी मुनिवेषधरः प्रभुः। नन्दिग्रामेऽवसद्वीर स्ससैन्यो भरतस्तदा।।2.115.23।।
transliteration: sa valkalajaṭādhārī muniveṣadharḥ prabhuḥ| nandigrāme'vasadvīra ssasainyo bharatastadā||2.115.23||
meaning: Bharata, the warrior and lord, wore bark garments and matted locks and lived the life of an ascetic in Nandigrama along with his army.

sanskrit: रामागमनमाकाङ्क्षन्भरतो भ्रातृवत्सलः। भ्रातुर्वचनकारी च प्रतिज्ञापारगस्तथा।।2.115.24।। पादुके त्वभिषिच्याथ नन्दिग्रामेऽवस
transliteration: rāmāgamanamākāṅkṣanbharato bhrātṛvatsalḥ| bhrāturvacanakārī ca pratijñāpāragastathā||2.115.24|| pāduke tvabhiṣicyātha na
meaning: Bharata who was attached to his brother and ever obedient to him, fulfilled his vow. He coronated the sandals and lived at Nandigrama longing for the return of Rama.

sanskrit: स वालव्यजनं छत्रं धारयामास स स्वयं। भरत श्शासनं सर्वं पादुकाभ्यां निवेदयन्।।2.115.25।।
transliteration: sa vālavyajanṃ chatrṃ dhārayāmāsa sa svayṃ| bharata śśāsanṃ sarvṃ pādukābhyāṃ nivedayan||2.115.25||
meaning: Bharata reported everything relating to the kingdom to the sandals first. Waving the chamaras (a fan made of yak tail) himself, he held the royal parasol over them.

sanskrit: ततस्तु भरत शश्रीमानभिषिच्याऽऽर्यपादुके। तदधीनस्तदा राज्यं कारयामास सर्वदा।।2.115.26।।
transliteration: tatastu bharata śaśrīmānabhiṣicyā''ryapāduke| tadadhīnastadā rājyṃ kārayāmāsa sarvadā||2.115.26||
meaning: After the coronation of the sandals of his esteemed brother Rama, illustrious Bharata ruled the kingdom, subordianating himself to them.

sanskrit: तदा हि यत्कार्यमुपैति किञ्चिदुपायनं चोपहृतं महार्हम्। स पादुकाभ्यां प्रथमं निवेद्य चकार पश्चाद्भरतो यथावत्।।2.115.27।।
transliteration: tadā hi yatkāryamupaiti kiñcidupāyanṃ copahṛtṃ mahārham| sa pādukābhyāṃ prathamṃ nivedya cakāra paścādbharato yathāvat||
meaning: Whenever an issue, however small, arose, Bharata kept the sandals informed. Whenever a valuable gift was presented, he offered it to the sandals before he accepted it. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्या

sanskrit: ये तत्र चित्रकूटस्य पुरस्तात्तापसाश्रमे। राममाश्रित्य निरतास्तानलक्षयदुत्सुकान्।।2.116.2।।
transliteration: ye tatra citrakūṭasya purastāttāpasāśrame| rāmamāśritya niratāstānalakṣayadutsukān||2.116.2||
meaning: Rama observed that the sages who earlier sought to stay with him near his hermitage under his protection on chitrakuta were filled with anxiety (now).

sanskrit: नयनैर्ब्रुकुटीभिश्च रामं निर्दिश्य शङ्किताः। अन्योन्यमुपजल्पन्त श्शनैश्चक्रुर्मिथः कथाः।।2.116.3।।
transliteration: nayanairbrukuṭībhiśca rāmṃ nirdiśya śaṅkitāḥ| anyonyamupajalpanta śśanaiścakrurmithḥ kathāḥ||2.116.3||
meaning: Those sages, glancing at Rama with suspicious eyes, knitting their eyebrows and murmering among themselves, conversed secretly.

sanskrit: तेषामौत्सुक्यमालक्ष्य रामस्त्वात्मनि शङ्कितः। कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदमृषिं कुलपतिं ततः।।2.116.4।।
transliteration: teṣāmautsukyamālakṣya rāmastvātmani śaṅkitḥ| kṛtāñjaliruvācedamṛṣiṃ kulapatiṃ tatḥ||2.116.4||
meaning: Having observed their anxiety, Rama apprehending somethig in his mind approached the chief of the hermitage with folded palms and said:

sanskrit: न कच्चिद्भगवन्किञ्चित्पूर्ववृत्तमिदं मयि। दृश्यते विकृतं येन विक्रियन्ते तपस्विनः।।2.116.5।।
transliteration: na kaccidbhagavankiñcitpūrvavṛttamidṃ mayi| dṛśyate vikṛtṃ yena vikriyante tapasvinḥ||2.116.5||
meaning: O revered sire, have you seen any change in my conduct? For what reason are the sages looking perturbed?

sanskrit: प्रमादाच्चरितं कच्चित्किञ्चिन्नावरजस्य मे। लक्ष्मणस्यर्षिभिदृष्टं नानुरूपमिवात्मनः।।2.116.6।।
transliteration: pramādāccaritṃ kaccitkiñcinnāvarajasya me| lakṣmaṇasyarṣibhidṛṣṭṃ nānurūpamivātmanḥ||2.116.6||
meaning: Have the sages found my younger brother Lakshmana doing something unbecoming of him through inadvertence?

sanskrit: कच्चिच्छुश्रूषमाणा व श्शुश्रूषणपरा मयि। प्रमदाऽभ्युचितां वृत्तिं सीता युक्तं न वर्तते।।2.116.7।।
transliteration: kaccicchuśrūṣamāṇā va śśuśrūṣaṇaparā mayi| pramadā'bhyucitāṃ vṛttiṃ sītā yuktṃ na vartate||2.116.7||
meaning: Has Sita devoted in her service to me and engaged in serving you failed to follow the conduct befitting a woman?

sanskrit: अथर्षिर्जरया वृद्धस्तपसा च जरां गतः। वेपमान इवोवाच रामं भूतदयापरम्।।2.116.8।।
transliteration: atharṣirjarayā vṛddhastapasā ca jarāṃ gatḥ| vepamāna ivovāca rāmṃ bhūtadayāparam||2.116.8||
meaning: Hearing those words, an ascetic old in age and austerities, as though trembling said to Rama who is compassionate to all beings:

sanskrit: कुतः कल्याणसत्त्वायाः कल्याणाभिरतेस्तथा। चलनं तात वैदेह्यास्तपस्विषु विशेषतः।।2.116.9।।
transliteration: kutḥ kalyāṇasattvāyāḥ kalyāṇābhiratestathā| calanṃ tāta vaidehyāstapasviṣu viśeṣatḥ||2.116.9||
meaning: O dear child, how can goodnatured Sita who is always engaged in performing auspicious deeds, especially towards ascetics be associated with violation of duty?

sanskrit: त्वन्निमित्तमिदं तावत्तापसान्प्रतिवर्तते। रक्षोभ्यस्तेन संविग्नाः कथयन्ति मिथः कथाः।।2.116.10।।
transliteration: tvannimittamidṃ tāvattāpasānprativartate| rakṣobhyastena sṃvignāḥ kathayanti mithḥ kathāḥ||2.116.10||
meaning: There is apprehension for ascetics from the demons on acount of your presence here. That is why they are conversing with one another about the likely fallout.

sanskrit: रावणावरजः कश्चित् खरो नामेह राक्षसः। उत्पाट्य तापसान्सर्वाञ्जनस्थाननिकेतनान्।।2.116.11।। धृष्टश्च जितकाशी च नृशंसः पुरुष
transliteration: rāvaṇāvarajḥ kaścit kharo nāmeha rākṣasḥ| utpāṭya tāpasānsarvāñjanasthānaniketanān||2.116.11|| dhṛṣṭaśca jitakāśī ca nṛś
meaning: O dear child, Khara, one of the brothers of Ravana is dwelling in nearby 'Janasthana'. He is impudent, reportedly winner of battles, cruel, sinful, a maneater and haughty. He has uprooted all the ascetics from Janasthana

sanskrit: त्वं यदाप्रभृति ह्यस्मिन्नाश्रमे तात वर्तसे। तदाप्रभृति रक्षांसि विप्रकुर्वन्ति तापसान्।।2.116.13।।
transliteration: tvṃ yadāprabhṛti hyasminnāśrame tāta vartase| tadāprabhṛti rakṣāṃsi viprakurvanti tāpasān||2.116.13||
meaning: O dear child, ever since you started residing in this hermitage rakshasas have been tormenting the ascetics.

sanskrit: दर्शयन्ति हि बीभत्सैः क्रूरैर्भीषणकैरपि। नानारूपैर्विरूपैश्च रूपैर्विकृतदर्शनैः।।2.116.14।।
transliteration: darśayanti hi bībhatsaiḥ krūrairbhīṣaṇakairapi| nānārūpairvirūpaiśca rūpairvikṛtadarśanaiḥ||2.116.14||
meaning: They appear in various distorted forms now rapacious, now fearful, now deformed.

sanskrit: अप्रशस्तैशुचिभिस्सम्प्रयोज्य च तापसान्। प्रतिध्नन्त्यपरान्क्षिप्रमनार्याः पुरतः स्थिताः।।2.116.15।।
transliteration: apraśastaiśucibhissamprayojya ca tāpasān| pratidhnantyaparānkṣipramanāryāḥ puratḥ sthitāḥ||2.116.15||
meaning: Those wicked rakshasas employ forbidden and dirty means against ascetics and kill them by suddenly appearing in front of them.

sanskrit: तेषु तेष्वाश्रमस्थानेष्वबुद्धमवलीय च। रमन्ते तापसां स्तत्र नाशयन्तोऽल्पचेतसः।।2.116.16।।
transliteration: teṣu teṣvāśramasthāneṣvabuddhamavalīya ca| ramante tāpasāṃ statra nāśayanto'lpacetasḥ||2.116.16||
meaning: These debased rakshasas, concealing themselves in various ashram sites take delight in harassing and killing the ascetics.

sanskrit: अपक्षिपन्ति स्रुग्भाण्डानग्नीस्निञ्चन्ति वारिणा। कलशांश्च प्रमध्नन्ति हवने समुपस्थिते।।2.116.17।।
transliteration: apakṣipanti srugbhāṇḍānagnīsniñcanti vāriṇā| kalaśāṃśca pramadhnanti havane samupasthite||2.116.17||
meaning: When sacrifices are about to start, they throw away the sacrificial ladels and vessels containing sacrificial materials and sprinkle water on sacrificial fire. They also break down the earthen vessels used in the sacrifi

sanskrit: तैर्दुरात्मभिरामृष्टानाश्रमान्प्रजिहासवः। गमनायान्यदेशस्य चोदयन्त्यृषयोऽद्य माम्।।2.116.18।।
transliteration: tairdurātmabhirāmṛṣṭānāśramānprajihāsavḥ| gamanāyānyadeśasya codayantyṛṣayo'dya mām||2.116.18||
meaning: Now all these sages are urging me to abandon this hermitage infested by these wicked rakshasas and move to another region.

sanskrit: तत्पुरा राम शारीरामुपहिंसां तपस्विषु। दर्शयन्ति हि दुष्टास्ते त्यक्ष्याम इममाश्रमम्।।2.116.19।।
transliteration: tatpurā rāma śārīrāmupahiṃsāṃ tapasviṣu| darśayanti hi duṣṭāste tyakṣyāma imamāśramam||2.116.19||
meaning: O Rama, those vile creatures resort to physical violence against ascetics, we have therefore, resolved to quit this ashram.

sanskrit: बहुमूलफलं चित्रमविदूरादितो वनम्। पुराणाश्रममेवाहं श्रयिष्ये सगणः पुनः।।2.116.20।।
transliteration: bahumūlaphalṃ citramavidūrādito vanam| purāṇāśramamevāhṃ śrayiṣye sagaṇḥ punḥ||2.116.20||
meaning: Not very far from here stands an ancient ashram in a lovely forest abounding in roots and fruits and I with my companions will seek shelter there.

sanskrit: खरस्त्वय्यपि चायुक्तं पुरा तात प्रवर्तते। सहास्माभिरितो गच्छ यदि बुद्धिः प्रवर्तते।।2.116.21।।
transliteration: kharastvayyapi cāyuktṃ purā tāta pravartate| sahāsmābhirito gaccha yadi buddhiḥ pravartate||2.116.21||
meaning: Dear child, Khara will also misbehave with you as usual. (Therefore), if you so decide you may come along with us.

sanskrit: सकलत्रस्य सन्देहो नित्यं यत्तस्य राघव। समर्थस्यापि हि सतो वासो दुःखमिहाद्य ते।।2.116.22।।
transliteration: sakalatrasya sandeho nityṃ yattasya rāghava| samarthasyāpi hi sato vāso duḥkhamihādya te||2.116.22||
meaning: O Rama, even though you are always vigilant and capable in all possible ways to defend youself, a doubt arises in our mind. It is perilous for you to live here with your wife.

sanskrit: इत्युक्तवन्तं स्तंराम राजपुत्रस्तपस्विनम्। न शशाकोत्तरैर्वाक्यैरवरोद्धुं समुत्सुकम्।।2.116.23।।
transliteration: ityuktavantṃ stṃrāma rājaputrastapasvinam| na śaśākottarairvākyairavaroddhuṃ samutsukam||2.116.23||
meaning: It was not possible for prince Rama to hold back by mere words that ascetic who was saying like this and was anxious to quit the hermitage.

sanskrit: अभिनन्द्य समापृच्छ्य समाधाय च राघवम्। स जगामाश्रमं त्यक्त्वा कुलैः कुलपतिस्सह।।2.116.24।।
transliteration: abhinandya samāpṛcchya samādhāya ca rāghavam| sa jagāmāśramṃ tyaktvā kulaiḥ kulapatissaha||2.116.24||
meaning: The leader of the group quit the hermitage along with his companions after paying respect to Rama, convincing him and taking leave of him.

sanskrit: रामः संसाद्य ऋषिगणमनुगमनाद्देशात्तस्मात्कुलपतिमभिवाद्य ऋषिम्। सम्यक्प्रीतैस्तैरनुमत उपदिष्टार्थः पुण्यं वासाय स्वनिलयमुप
transliteration: rāmḥ sṃsādya ṛṣigaṇamanugamanāddeśāttasmātkulapatimabhivādya ṛṣim| samyakprītaistairanumata upadiṣṭārthḥ puṇyṃ vāsāya sv
meaning: Rama, followed the sages for some distance to bid them farewell. He paid obeisance to the chief of the group and having grasped the instruction of the highly pleased sages, he with their consent returned to his holy herm

sanskrit: आश्रममृषिविरहितं प्रभुः क्षणमपिन जहौ स राघवः। राघवं हि सततमनुगता स्तापसाश्चार्षचरित धृतगुणाः।।2.116.26।।
transliteration: āśramamṛṣivirahitṃ prabhuḥ kṣaṇamapina jahau sa rāghavḥ| rāghavṃ hi satatamanugatā stāpasāścārṣacarita dhṛtaguṇāḥ||2.116
meaning: Lord Rama, did not leave that hermitage deserted by the sages even for a moment. Those who had adopted the traditions of the sages and had acquired many virtues followed Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये

sanskrit: इह मे भरतो दृष्टो मातरश्च सनागराः। सा च मे स्मृतिरन्वेति तान्नित्यमनुशोचतः।।2.117.2।।
transliteration: iha me bharato dṛṣṭo mātaraśca sanāgarāḥ| sā ca me smṛtiranveti tānnityamanuśocatḥ||2.117.2||
meaning: It is here that Bharata, mothers along with citizens of Ayodhya have visited me. That memory soaked with grief is chasing me.

sanskrit: स्कन्धावारनिवेशेन तेन तस्य महात्मनः। हयहस्तिकरीषैश्च उपमर्दः कृतो भृशम्।।2.117.3।।
transliteration: skandhāvāraniveśena tena tasya mahātmanḥ| hayahastikarīṣaiśca upamardḥ kṛto bhṛśam||2.117.3||
meaning: Due to the encampment of the army of the magnanimous Bharata (here), this place has been filled with the dung of horses and elephants and made exceedingly dirty.

sanskrit: तस्मादन्यत्र गच्छाम इति सञ्चिन्त्य राघवः। प्रातिष्ठत स वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च सङ्गतः।।2.117.4।।
transliteration: tasmādanyatra gacchāma iti sañcintya rāghavḥ| prātiṣṭhata sa vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena ca saṅgatḥ||2.117.4||
meaning: We shall, therefore, go to some other place, having resolved thus, Rama accompanied by Sita and Lakshmana set forth.

sanskrit: सोऽत्रेराश्रममासाद्य तं ववन्दे महायशाः। तं चापि भगवानत्रिः पुत्रवत्प्रत्यपद्यत।।2.117.5।।
transliteration: so'trerāśramamāsādya tṃ vavande mahāyaśāḥ| tṃ cāpi bhagavānatriḥ putravatpratyapadyata||2.117.5||
meaning: Having reached the hermitage of the revered sage Atri, illustrious Rama prostrated before him and Atri also received him as his son.

sanskrit: स्वयमातिथ्यमादिश्य सर्वमन्यत्सुसत्कृतम्। सौमित्रिं च महाभागां सीतां च समसान्त्वयत्।।2.117.6।।
transliteration: svayamātithyamādiśya sarvamanyatsusatkṛtam| saumitriṃ ca mahābhāgāṃ sītāṃ ca samasāntvayat||2.117.6||
meaning: That sage Atri himself extended to Rama the hospitality befitting him in all possible ways and treated Lakshmana and highly virtuous Sita with kind words.

sanskrit: पत्नीं च समनुप्राप्तां वृद्धामामन्त्र्य सत्कृताम्। सान्त्वयामास धर्मज्ञः सर्वभूतहिते रतः।।2.117.7।।
transliteration: patnīṃ ca samanuprāptāṃ vṛddhāmāmantrya satkṛtām| sāntvayāmāsa dharmajñḥ sarvabhūtahite ratḥ||2.117.7||
meaning: Conversant in the ways of righteousness and eagaged in the welfate of all beings, sage Atri called out his aged wife who is revered by all and spoke kind words to her.

sanskrit: आनसूयां महाभागां तापसीं धर्मचारिणीम् प्रतिगृह्णीष्व वैदेहीमब्रवीदृषिसत्तमः। रामाय चाऽचचक्षे तां तापसीं धर्मचारिणीम्।।2.1
transliteration: ānasūyāṃ mahābhāgāṃ tāpasīṃ dharmacāriṇīm pratigṛhṇīṣva vaidehīmabravīdṛṣisattamḥ| rāmāya cā'cacakṣe tāṃ tāpasīṃ dharmac
meaning: Atri, who was excellent among the sages said to his ascetic wife who was highly virtuous and an adherent of righteousness, Welcome Sita. Thereafter, he related to Rama a story about his asetic wife who follows the ways o

sanskrit: दश वर्षाण्यनावृष्ट्या दग्धे लोके निरन्तरम्।।2.117.9।। यया मूलफले सृष्टे जाह्नवी च प्रवर्तिता। उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता नियमैश्
transliteration: daśa varṣāṇyanāvṛṣṭyā dagdhe loke nirantaram||2.117.9|| yayā mūlaphale sṛṣṭe jāhnavī ca pravartitā| ugreṇa tapasā yuktā
meaning: O blameless one (Rama), once this world was consecutively ravaged by drought for ten years. It was the virtuous Anasuya who created roots and fruits and caused Ganga to flow. She was engaged in severe mortifications and

sanskrit: दश वर्षाण्यनावृष्ट्या दग्धे लोके निरन्तरम्।।2.117.9।। यया मूलफले सृष्टे जाह्नवी च प्रवर्तिता। उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता नियमैश्

meaning: O blameless one (Rama), once this world was consecutively ravaged by drought for ten years. It was the virtuous Anasuya who created roots and fruits and caused Ganga to flow. She was engaged in severe mortifications and

transliteration: daśa varṣāṇyanāvṛṣṭyā dagdhe loke nirantaram||2.117.9|| yayā mūlaphale sṛṣṭe jāhnavī ca pravartitā| ugreṇa tapasā yuktā
meaning: O blameless one (Rama), once this world was consecutively ravaged by drought for ten years. It was the virtuous Anasuya who created roots and fruits and caused Ganga to flow. She was engaged in severe mortifications and

sanskrit: तामिमां सर्वभूतानां नमस्कार्यां यशस्विनीम् अभिगच्छतु वैदेही वृद्धामक्रोधनां सदा। अनसूयेति या लोके कर्मभिः ख्यातिमागता।।2
transliteration: tāmimāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ namaskāryāṃ yaśasvinīm abhigacchatu vaidehī vṛddhāmakrodhanāṃ sadā| anasūyeti yā loke karmabhiḥ kh
meaning: 'She is renowned throughout this world for her deeds as Anasuya, (one who is free from anger). Aged, illustrious she is free frm anger, worthy of adoration by all beings. Let Sita approach her'.

sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवाणं तमृषिं तथेत्युक्त्वा स राघवः। सीतामुवाच धर्मज्ञामिदं वचनमुत्तमम्।।2.117.14।।
transliteration: evṃ bruvāṇṃ tamṛṣiṃ tathetyuktvā sa rāghavḥ| sītāmuvāca dharmajñāmidṃ vacanamuttamam||2.117.14||
meaning: Hearing those words of the sage, Rama said be it so and said to righteous Sita these choice words.

sanskrit: राजपुत्रि श्रुतमिदं मुनेरस्य समीरितम्। श्रेयोऽर्थमात्मनश्शीघ्रमभिगच्छ तपस्विनीम्।।2.117.15।।
transliteration: rājaputri śrutamidṃ munerasya samīritam| śreyo'rthamātmanaśśīghramabhigaccha tapasvinīm||2.117.15||
meaning: O princess, you have heard the message of the sage. Without delay approach the ascetic (Anasuya) for your welfare.

sanskrit: सीता त्वेतद वचः श्रुत्वा राघवस्य हितैषिणः। तामत्रिपन्तीं धर्मज्ञामभिचक्राम मैथिली।।2.117.16।।
transliteration: sītā tvetada vacḥ śrutvā rāghavasya hitaiṣiṇḥ| tāmatripantīṃ dharmajñāmabhicakrāma maithilī||2.117.16||
meaning: Having heard the words of Rama, intended for her welfare, Sita, daughter of the king of Mithila, approached the consort of Atri (Devi Anasuya), knower of righteousness, and reverently circumambulated her.

sanskrit: शिथिलां वलितां वृद्धां जरापाण्डुरमूर्धजाम्। सततं वेपमानाङ्गीं प्रवाते कदलीं यथा।। 2.117.17।। तां तु सीता महाभागामनसूयां
transliteration: śithilāṃ valitāṃ vṛddhāṃ jarāpāṇḍuramūrdhajām| satatṃ vepamānāṅgīṃ pravāte kadalīṃ yathā|| 2.117.17|| tāṃ tu sītā mahābh
meaning: Highly chaste and fortunate Anasuya was very old and feeble. Her skin was wrinkled and her hair turned grey due to old age. Her body was constantly trembling like a plantain tree in a stormy wind. Pronouncing her name to

sanskrit: शिथिलां वलितां वृद्धां जरापाण्डुरमूर्धजाम्। सततं वेपमानाङ्गीं प्रवाते कदलीं यथा।। 2.117.17।। तां तु सीता महाभागामनसूयां
transliteration: śithilāṃ valitāṃ vṛddhāṃ jarāpāṇḍuramūrdhajām| satatṃ vepamānāṅgīṃ pravāte kadalīṃ yathā|| 2.117.17|| tāṃ tu sītā mahābh
meaning: Highly chaste and fortunate Anasuya was very old and feeble. Her skin was wrinkled and her hair turned grey due to old age. Her body was constantly trembling like a plantain tree in a stormy wind. Pronouncing her name to

sanskrit: अभिवाद्य च वैदेही तापसीं तामनिन्दिताम्। बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा हृष्टा पर्यपृच्छदनामयम्।।2.117.19।।
transliteration: abhivādya ca vaidehī tāpasīṃ tāmaninditām| baddhāñjalipuṭā hṛṣṭā paryapṛcchadanāmayam||2.117.19||
meaning: Sita offered her obeisance to the blameless ascetic, Anasuya, folding her palms and enquired of her wellbeing in delight.

sanskrit: ततस्सीतां महाभागां दृष्ट्वा तां धर्मचारिणीम्। सान्त्वयन्त्यब्रवीद्धृष्टा दिष्ट्या धर्ममवेक्षसे।।2.117.20।।
transliteration: tatassītāṃ mahābhāgāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ dharmacāriṇīm| sāntvayantyabravīddhṛṣṭā diṣṭyā dharmamavekṣase||2.117.20||
meaning: Anasuya was delighted to see the glorious Sita who was always engaged in righteous acts and said in kind words, You are fortunate. You are observing your rightful duty.

sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा ज्ञातिजनं सीते मानमृद्धं च भामिनि। अवरुद्धं वने रामं दिष्ट्या त्वमनुगच्छसि।।2.117.21।।
transliteration: tyaktvā jñātijanṃ sīte mānamṛddhṃ ca bhāmini| avaruddhṃ vane rāmṃ diṣṭyā tvamanugacchasi||2.117.21||
meaning: O noble Sita, by the grace of heaven you are following Rama, forsaking your kinsmen and wealth and confining yourself to the forest.

sanskrit: नगरस्थो वनस्थो वा पापो वा यदि वा शुभः। यासां स्त्रीणां प्रियो भर्ता तासां लोका महोदयाः।।2.117.22।।
transliteration: nagarastho vanastho vā pāpo vā yadi vā śubhḥ| yāsāṃ strīṇāṃ priyo bhartā tāsāṃ lokā mahodayāḥ||2.117.22||
meaning: One who is devoted to her husband, whether he be in the city or in the forest, whether he is sinful or virtuous, will attain the most prosperous worlds.

sanskrit: दुश्शीलः कामवृत्तो वा धनैर्वा परिवर्जितः। स्त्रीणामार्यस्वभावानां परमं दैवतं पतिः।।2.117.23।।
transliteration: duśśīlḥ kāmavṛtto vā dhanairvā parivarjitḥ| strīṇāmāryasvabhāvānāṃ paramṃ daivatṃ patiḥ||2.117.23||
meaning: For a woman of noble nature her husband, whether he be licentious or of bad character or devoid of riches, is her supreme lord.

sanskrit: नातो विशिष्टं पश्यामि बान्धवं विमृशन्त्यहम्। सर्वत्र योग्यं वैदेहि तपः कृतमिवाव्ययम्।।2.117.24।।
transliteration: nāto viśiṣṭṃ paśyāmi bāndhavṃ vimṛśantyaham| sarvatra yogyṃ vaidehi tapḥ kṛtamivāvyayam||2.117.24||
meaning: O Sita, on reflection I know of none who is a better friend than the husband. He, like an imperishable penance, once acquired is never lost.

sanskrit: न त्वेवमवगच्छन्ति गुणदोषमसत्त्स्रियः। कामवक्तव्यहृदया भर्तृनाथाश्चरन्ति याः।।2.117.25।।
transliteration: na tvevamavagacchanti guṇadoṣamasattsriyḥ| kāmavaktavyahṛdayā bhartṛnāthāścaranti yāḥ||2.117.25||
meaning: Those wicked women whose minds are overpowered by carnal desires, ranging at will as lords of their husbands, do not understand about vice and virtue.

sanskrit: प्राप्नुवन्त्य यशश्चैव धर्मभ्रंशं च मैथिलि। अकार्यवशमापन्नाः स्त्रियो याः खलु तद्विधाः।।2.117.26।।
transliteration: prāpnuvantya yaśaścaiva dharmabhrṃśṃ ca maithili| akāryavaśamāpannāḥ striyo yāḥ khalu tadvidhāḥ||2.117.26||
meaning: O Sita, those women under the control of unworthy acts are dislodged from the path of righteousness and get infamy.

sanskrit: त्वद्विधास्तु गुणैर्युक्ता दृष्ट लोक परावराः। स्त्रिय स्स्वर्गे चरिष्यन्ति यथा धर्मकृतस्तथा।।2.117.27।।
transliteration: tvadvidhāstu guṇairyuktā dṛṣṭa loka parāvarāḥ| striya ssvarge cariṣyanti yathā dharmakṛtastathā||2.117.27||
meaning: Women like you who are endowed with virtues and can distinguish between good and bad in this world, like those who perform virtuous deeds, will move about in heaven.

sanskrit: नैतदाश्चर्यमार्याया यन्मां त्वमभिभाषसे। विदितन्तु ममाप्येतद्यथा नार्याः पतिर्गुरुः।।2.118.2।।
transliteration: naitadāścaryamāryāyā yanmāṃ tvamabhibhāṣase| viditantu mamāpyetadyathā nāryāḥ patirguruḥ||2.118.2||
meaning: It is no wonder that a noble lady like you should instruct me this way. It is known to me that a husband is a guru to his wife.

sanskrit: यद्यप्येष भवेद्भर्ता ममाऽर्ये वृत्तवर्जितः। अद्वैधमुपचर्तव्यस्तथाप्येष मया भवेत्।।2.118.3।।
transliteration: yadyapyeṣa bhavedbhartā mamā'rye vṛttavarjitḥ| advaidhamupacartavyastathāpyeṣa mayā bhavet||2.118.3||
meaning: O noble lady, even if my husband is devoid of good conduct, he should be obeyed without showing any hesitation.

sanskrit: किं पुनर्यो गुणश्लाघ्य स्सानुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रियः। स्थिरानुरागो धर्मात्मा मातृवत्पितृवत्प्रियः।।2.118.4।।
transliteration: kiṃ punaryo guṇaślāghya ssānukrośo jitendriyḥ| sthirānurāgo dharmātmā mātṛvatpitṛvatpriyḥ||2.118.4||
meaning: What to speak of a husband if he is worthy of applause for his virtues, is compassionate, a subduer of the senses, righteous and ever affectionate like a mother and a father?

sanskrit: यां वृत्तिं वर्तते रामः कौसल्यायां महाबलः। तामेव नृपनारीणामन्यासामपि वर्तते।।2.118.5।।
transliteration: yāṃ vṛttiṃ vartate rāmḥ kausalyāyāṃ mahābalḥ| tāmeva nṛpanārīṇāmanyāsāmapi vartate||2.118.5||
meaning: Mighty Rama shows the same behaviour and treatment towards the other consorts of the king as he does towards his own mother Kausalya.

sanskrit: सकृद्दृष्टास्वपि स्त्रिषु नृपेण नृपवत्सलः। मातृवद्वर्तते वीरो मानमुत्सृज्य धर्मवित्।।2.118.6।।
transliteration: sakṛddṛṣṭāsvapi striṣu nṛpeṇa nṛpavatsalḥ| mātṛvadvartate vīro mānamutsṛjya dharmavit||2.118.6||
meaning: Heroic Rama is affectionate towards king Dasaratha and is conversant with righteousness. Renouncing the sense of selfrespect he honours all the women on whom his father had cast his glance even once just as his own mothe

sanskrit: आगच्छन्त्याश्च विजनं वनमेवं भयावहम्। समाहितं मे श्वश्र्वा च हृदये तद्धृतं महत्।।2.118.7।।
transliteration: āgacchantyāśca vijanṃ vanamevṃ bhayāvaham| samāhitṃ me śvaśrvā ca hṛdaye taddhṛtṃ mahat||2.118.7||
meaning: When departing for this frightful and desolate forest, the great (advice) imparted by my motherinlaw is firmly fixed in my mind.

sanskrit: पाणिप्रदानकाले च यत्पुरात्वग्नि सन्निधौ। अनुशिष्टा जनन्याऽस्मि वाक्यं तदपि मे धृतम्।।2.118.8।।
transliteration: pāṇipradānakāle ca yatpurātvagni sannidhau| anuśiṣṭā jananyā'smi vākyṃ tadapi me dhṛtam||2.118.8||
meaning: When I have been taught by my mother earlier, at the time of bestowal of my hand to Rama in the presence of the sacrificial fire (as witness) is etched in my mind.

sanskrit: नवीकृतं तु तत्सर्वं वाक्यैस्ते धर्मचारिणि। पतिशुश्रूषणान्नार्यास्तपो नान्यद्विधीयते।।2.118.9।।
transliteration: navīkṛtṃ tu tatsarvṃ vākyaiste dharmacāriṇi| patiśuśrūṣaṇānnāryāstapo nānyadvidhīyate||2.118.9||
meaning: O righteous one (Anasuya), after listening to your words the instructions given by my motherinlaw and my mother are renewed (remembered again). For a woman, no other penance is laid down (in scriptures) except service to

sanskrit: सावित्री पतिशुश्रूषां कृत्वा स्वर्गे महीयते। तथावृत्तिश्च याता त्वं पतिशुश्रूषया दिवम्।।2.118.10।।
transliteration: sāvitrī patiśuśrūṣāṃ kṛtvā svarge mahīyate| tathāvṛttiśca yātā tvṃ patiśuśrūṣayā divam||2.118.10||
meaning: Having served her husband (faithfully), Savitri is honoured in heaven. You also, by following the same path of serving your husband, shall reach the heaven.

sanskrit: वरिष्ठा सर्वनारीणामेषा च दिवि देवता। रोहिणी न विनाचन्द्रं मुहूर्तमपि दृश्यते।।2.118.11।।
transliteration: variṣṭhā sarvanārīṇāmeṣā ca divi devatā| rohiṇī na vinācandrṃ muhūrtamapi dṛśyate||2.118.11||
meaning: Rohini, the very best among all women and the goddess of heaven, is never seen in the sky separated from the moon even for a moment.

sanskrit: एवंविधाश्च प्रवराः स्त्रियो भर्तृदृढव्रताः। देवलोके महीयन्ते पुण्येन स्वेन कर्मणा।।2.118.12।।
transliteration: evṃvidhāśca pravarāḥ striyo bhartṛdṛḍhavratāḥ| devaloke mahīyante puṇyena svena karmaṇā||2.118.12||
meaning: Execellent women such as these, firm in their vows to their husband are highly revered in the world of gods through their own meritorious deeds.

sanskrit: ततोऽनसूया संहृष्टा श्रुत्वोक्तं सीतया वचः। शिरस्याघ्राय चोवाच मैथिलीं हर्षयन्त्युत।।2.118.13।।
transliteration: tato'nasūyā sṃhṛṣṭā śrutvoktṃ sītayā vacḥ| śirasyāghrāya covāca maithilīṃ harṣayantyuta||2.118.13||
meaning: Thereafter hearing Sita's words, Anasuya affectionately kissed her forehead and said this in order to make her happy:

sanskrit: नियमैर्विविधैराप्तं तपो हि महदस्ति मे। तत्संश्रित्य बलं सीते छन्दये त्वां शुचिव्रते।।2.118.14।।
transliteration: niyamairvividhairāptṃ tapo hi mahadasti me| tatsṃśritya balṃ sīte chandaye tvāṃ śucivrate||2.118.14||
meaning: O Sita of pure conduct, I have great ascetic power obtained through practising various austerities. With its strength I shall give what you want for your enjoyment.

sanskrit: उपपन्नं मनोज्ञं च वचनं तव मैथिलि। प्रीता चास्म्युचितं किं ते करवाणि ब्रवीहि मे।।2.118.15।।
transliteration: upapannṃ manojñṃ ca vacanṃ tava maithili| prītā cāsmyucitṃ kiṃ te karavāṇi bravīhi me||2.118.15||
meaning: O Sita, I am glad to hear your befitting and pleasing words. Tell me what appropriate thing you desire and I shall give you.

sanskrit: तस्यास्तद् वचनं श्रूत्वा विस्मिता मन्दविस्मया। कृतमित्यब्रवीत् सीता तपोबलसमन्विताम्।।2.118.16।।
transliteration: tasyāstad  vacanṃ śrūtvā vismitā mandavismayā| kṛtamityabravīt sītā tapobalasamanvitām||2.118.16||
meaning: On hearing her words Sita was surprised. With a gentle smile she said, to Anasuya who was endowed with ascetic power, 'I think you have already granted me the boons'.

sanskrit: सा त्वेवमुक्ता धर्मज्ञा तया प्रीततराऽभवत्। सफलं च प्रहर्षं ते हन्त सीते करोम्यहम्।।2.118.17।।
transliteration: sā tvevamuktā dharmajñā tayā prītatarā'bhavat| saphalṃ ca praharṣṃ te hanta sīte karomyaham||2.118.17||
meaning: When Sita said so, Anasuya who knew her righteous duty was immensely pleased. and replied, 'What a joy I shall make the words you have spoken come true'.

sanskrit: इदं दिव्यं वरं माल्यं वस्त्रमाभरणानि च। अङ्गरागं च वैदेहि महार्हं चानुलेपनम्।।2.118.18।। मया दत्तमिदं सीते तव गात्राणि श
transliteration: idṃ divyṃ varṃ mālyṃ vastramābharaṇāni ca| aṅgarāgṃ ca vaidehi mahārhṃ cānulepanam||2.118.18|| mayā dattamidṃ sīte tava
meaning: O princess of Videha, O Sita, I bestow on you this best garland of the gods, raiment, jewellery, fragrant unguents, and precious ointment for anointing your body with. All this will beautify your limbs. It is convenient

sanskrit: अङ्गरागेण दिव्येन लिप्ताङ्गी जनकात्मजे। शोभयिष्यसि भर्तारं यथा श्रीर्विष्णुमव्ययम्।।2.118.20।।
transliteration: aṅgarāgeṇa divyena liptāṅgī janakātmaje| śobhayiṣyasi bhartārṃ yathā śrīrviṣṇumavyayam||2.118.20||
meaning: O daughter of Janaka, you will enhance the glory of your husband by anointing your body with this divine, fragrant unguent to your body like Lakshmi enhancing the glory of eternal Visnu.

sanskrit: सा वस्त्रमङ्गरागं च भूषणानि स्रजस्तथा। मैथिली प्रतिजग्राह प्रीतिदानमनुत्तमम्।।2.118.21।।
transliteration: sā vastramaṅgarāgṃ ca bhūṣaṇāni srajastathā| maithilī pratijagrāha prītidānamanuttamam||2.118.21||
meaning: That princess from Mithila accepted the incomparable gifts of love, the raiment, fragrant unguents, jewellery and also the garland.

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य च तत्सीता प्रीतिदानं यशस्विनी। श्लिष्टाञ्जलिपुटा तत्र समुपास्त तपोधनाम्।।2.118.22।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya ca tatsītā prītidānṃ yaśasvinī| śliṣṭāñjalipuṭā tatra samupāsta tapodhanām||2.118.22||
meaning: Illustrious Sita accepted the gifts of love and with palms folded in reverence sat beside her, an ascetic.

sanskrit: तथा सीतामुपासीनामनसूया दृढव्रता। वचनं प्रष्टुमारेभे काञ्चित्प्रियकथामनु।।2.118.23।।
transliteration: tathā sītāmupāsīnāmanasūyā dṛḍhavratā| vacanṃ praṣṭumārebhe kāñcitpriyakathāmanu||2.118.23||
meaning: Anasuya who was firm in her vows commenced to ask Sita this way about a certain tale (that was close to her heart).

sanskrit: स्वयं वरे किल प्राप्ता त्वमनेन यशस्विना। राघवेणेति मे सिते कथा श्रुतिमुपागता।।2.118.24।।
transliteration: svayṃ vare kila prāptā tvamanena yaśasvinā| rāghaveṇeti me site kathā śrutimupāgatā||2.118.24||
meaning: O Sita, I have heard that you have been won by the illustrious Rama in the swayamvara. At least that is the story which reached my ears.

sanskrit: तां कथां श्रोतुमिच्छामि विस्तरेण च मैथिलि। यथाऽनुभूतं कार्त्स्न्येन तन्मे त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि।।2.118.25।।
transliteration: tāṃ kathāṃ śrotumicchāmi vistareṇa ca maithili| yathā'nubhūtṃ kārtsnyena tanme tvṃ vaktumarhasi||2.118.25||
meaning: O daughter of Mithila, I would like to hear the story in detail. You should tell me the whole story as you experienced it.

sanskrit: एवमुक्ता तु सा सीता तां ततो धर्मचारिणीम्। श्रूयतामिति चोक्त्वा वै कथयामास तां कथाम्।।2.118.26।।
transliteration: evamuktā tu sā sītā tāṃ tato dharmacāriṇīm| śrūyatāmiti coktvā vai kathayāmāsa tāṃ kathām||2.118.26||
meaning: 'Listen' said Sita, thus addressed, and began relating the story to Anasuya, a performer of austerities.

sanskrit: मिथिलाधिपतिर्वीरो जनको नाम धर्मवित्। क्षत्रधर्मे ह्यभिरतो न्यायतश्शास्ति मेदिनीम्।।2.118.27।।
transliteration: mithilādhipatirvīro janako nāma dharmavit| kṣatradharme hyabhirato nyāyataśśāsti medinīm||2.118.27||
meaning: There is a king in Mithila, Janaka by name. He is heroic and is conversant with righteousness. Engaged in the duties of a kshatriya, he is rules the earth with justice.

sanskrit: तस्य लाङ्गलहस्तन्य कर्षतः क्षेत्रमण्डलम्। अहं किलोत्थिता भित्वा जगतीं नृपतेस्सुता।।2.118.28।।
transliteration: tasya lāṅgalahastanya karṣatḥ kṣetramaṇḍalam| ahṃ kilotthitā bhitvā jagatīṃ nṛpatessutā||2.118.28||
meaning: When he was ploughing the circular plot of land for performing a sacrifice, it is said I emerged from the earth by breaking it and therefore I became his dauhghter.

sanskrit: स मां दृष्ट्वा नरपतिर्मुष्टिविक्षेपतत्परः। पांसुकुण्ठितसर्वाङ्गीं जनको विस्मितोऽभवत्।।2.118.29।।
transliteration: sa māṃ dṛṣṭvā narapatirmuṣṭivikṣepatatparḥ| pāṃsukuṇṭhitasarvāṅgīṃ janako vismito'bhavat||2.118.29||
meaning: Engaged in sowing fistfuls of seeds, king Janaka found me covered with dust and was astonished.

sanskrit: अनपत्येन च स्नेहादङ्कमारोप्य च स्वयम्। ममेयं तनयेत्युक्त्वा स्नेहो मयि निपातितः।।2.118.30।।
transliteration: anapatyena ca snehādaṅkamāropya ca svayam| mameyṃ tanayetyuktvā sneho mayi nipātitḥ||2.118.30||
meaning: As he had no children, he, on his own accord, lifted me up and placing me on his lap, saying, This is my daughter, he began showering (lots of) love on me.

sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षे च वागुक्ताऽप्रतिमाऽमानुषी किल। एवमेतन्नरपते धर्मेण तनया तव।।2.118.31।।
transliteration: antarikṣe ca vāguktā'pratimā'mānuṣī kila| evametannarapate dharmeṇa tanayā tava||2.118.31||
meaning: 'O king, she is an incomparable divine being. By right she is your daughter'. These were the words (Janaka) heard from out of the sky.

sanskrit: ततः प्रहृष्टो धर्मात्मा पिता मे मिथिलाधिपः। अवाप्तो विपुलां बुद्धिं मामवाप्य नराधिपः।।2.118.32।।
transliteration: tatḥ prahṛṣṭo dharmātmā pitā me mithilādhipḥ| avāpto vipulāṃ buddhiṃ māmavāpya narādhipḥ||2.118.32||
meaning: Thereafter, my father and the righteous lord of Mithila was delighted in possessing me when a noble thought struck his mind.

sanskrit: दत्ता चास्मीष्टवद्देव्यै ज्येष्ठायै पुण्यकर्मणा। तया सम्भाविता चास्मि स्निग्धया मातृसौहृदात्।।2.118.33।।
transliteration: dattā cāsmīṣṭavaddevyai jyeṣṭhāyai puṇyakarmaṇā| tayā sambhāvitā cāsmi snigdhayā mātṛsauhṛdāt||2.118.33||
meaning: Bestowed as the choicest one of meritorious acts on the chief queen, I was brought up by her, by nature affectionate, with the love of a mother.

sanskrit: पतिसंयोगसुलभं वयो दृष्ट्वा तु मे पिता। चिन्तामभ्यगमद्धीनो वित्तनाशादिवाधनः।।2.118.34।।
transliteration: patisṃyogasulabhṃ vayo dṛṣṭvā tu me pitā| cintāmabhyagamaddhīno vittanāśādivādhanḥ||2.118.34||
meaning: When my father saw I had attained the marriageable age, he was immersed in sorrow like an indigent man who had lost all his wealth.

sanskrit: सदृशाच्चापकृष्टाच्च लोके कन्यापिता जनात्। प्रधर्षणामवाप्नोति शक्रेणापि समो भुवि।।2.118.35।।
transliteration: sadṛśāccāpakṛṣṭācca loke kanyāpitā janāt| pradharṣaṇāmavāpnoti śakreṇāpi samo bhuvi||2.118.35||
meaning: Even though he was an Indra on earth, as a father of an unmarried girl he would be humiliated by men who are his equal or inferior in this world.

sanskrit: तां धर्षणामदूरस्थां दृष्ट्वा चात्मनि पार्थिवः। चिन्तार्णवगतः पारं नाससादाप्लवो यथा।।2.118.36।।
transliteration: tāṃ dharṣaṇāmadūrasthāṃ dṛṣṭvā cātmani pārthivḥ| cintārṇavagatḥ pārṃ nāsasādāplavo yathā||2.118.36||
meaning: Having perceived that the humiliation is not very far, king Janaka was plunged in a sea of sorrow like one who cannot reach the shore without a float.

sanskrit: अयोनिजां हि मां ज्ञात्वा नाध्यगच्छद्विचिन्तयन्। सदृशं चानुरूपं च महीपालः पतिं मम।।2.118.37।।
transliteration: ayonijāṃ hi māṃ jñātvā nādhyagacchadvicintayan| sadṛśṃ cānurūpṃ ca mahīpālḥ patiṃ mama||2.118.37||
meaning: The ruler of the earth knew that I was not born from a woman's womb, and could not find a suitable husband for me after deep reflection.

sanskrit: तस्य बुद्धिरियं जाता चिन्तयानस्य सन्ततम्। स्वयंवरं तनूजायाः करिष्यामीति धीमतः।।2.118.38।।
transliteration: tasya buddhiriyṃ jātā cintayānasya santatam| svayṃvarṃ tanūjāyāḥ kariṣyāmīti dhīmatḥ||2.118.38||
meaning: After constantly pondering over the matter, the wise king arrived at the decision to perform a swayamvara for his daughter.

sanskrit: महायज्ञे तदा तस्य वरुणेन महात्मना। दत्तं धनुर्वरं प्रीत्या तूणी चाक्षयसायकौ।।2.118.39।।
transliteration: mahāyajñe tadā tasya varuṇena mahātmanā| dattṃ dhanurvarṃ prītyā tūṇī cākṣayasāyakau||2.118.39||
meaning: Magnanimous Varuna out of his affection had given him, on the occasion of a great sacrifice, an excellent bow with inexhaustible arrows and a pair of quivers.

sanskrit: असञ्चाल्यं मनुष्यैश्च यत्नेनापि च गौरवात्। तन्न शक्ता नमयितुं स्वप्नेष्वपि नराधिपाः।।2.118.40।।
transliteration: asañcālyṃ manuṣyaiśca yatnenāpi ca gauravāt| tanna śaktā namayituṃ svapneṣvapi narādhipāḥ||2.118.40||
meaning: Because of its weight, no human could move that bow despite great effort nor were the kings capable of bending it even in their dreams.

sanskrit: तद्धनुः प्राप्य मे पित्रा व्याहृतं सत्यवादिना। समवाये नरेन्द्राणां पूर्वमामन्त्र्य पार्थिवान्।।2.118.41।।
transliteration: taddhanuḥ prāpya me pitrā vyāhṛtṃ satyavādinā| samavāye narendrāṇāṃ pūrvamāmantrya pārthivān||2.118.41||
meaning: My truthful father, after having acquired the bow, invited all the princes and placed the great bow before them in the assembly where he declared:

sanskrit: तच्च दृष्ट्वा धनुश्श्रेष्ठं गौरवाद्गिरिसन्निभम्। अभिवाद्य नृपा जग्मुरशक्तास्तस्य तोलने।।2.118.43।।
transliteration: tacca dṛṣṭvā dhanuśśreṣṭhṃ gauravādgirisannibham| abhivādya nṛpā jagmuraśaktāstasya tolane||2.118.43||
meaning: Beholding the mighty bow resembling a mountain in weight, the kings, unable to lift it, paid their homage and left.

sanskrit: सुदीर्घस्य तु कालस्य राघवोऽयं महाद्युतिः। विश्वामित्रेण सहितो यज्ञं द्रष्टुं समागतः।।2.118.44।। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा रा
transliteration: sudīrghasya tu kālasya rāghavo'yṃ mahādyutiḥ| viśvāmitreṇa sahito yajñṃ draṣṭuṃ samāgatḥ||2.118.44|| lakṣmaṇena saha bhr
meaning: After a long time, resplendent Rama whose prowess was truth, arrived along with his brother Lakshman and sage Viswamitra in order to witness the sacrifice.

sanskrit: विश्वामित्रस्तु धर्मात्मा मम पित्रा सुपूजितः।।2.118.45।। प्रोवाच पितरं तत्र भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।
transliteration: viśvāmitrastu dharmātmā mama pitrā supūjitḥ||2.118.45|| provāca pitarṃ tatra bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau|
meaning: Having accepted the honour extended by my father, righteous Viswamitra spoke to him about those two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana.

sanskrit: सुतौ दशरथस्येमौ धनुर्दर्शकाङ्क्षिणौ। धनुर्दर्शय रामाय राजपुत्राय दैविकम्।।2.118.46।।
transliteration: sutau daśarathasyemau dhanurdarśakāṅkṣiṇau| dhanurdarśaya rāmāya rājaputrāya daivikam||2.118.46||
meaning: 'Both these sons of king Dasaratha wish to see the bow. Show the divine bow to prince Rama'.

sanskrit: इत्युक्तस्तेन विप्रेण तद्धनुस्समुपानयत्।।2.118.47।। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण तदाऽनम्य महाबलः। ज्यां समारोप्य झडिति पूरयामास वीर
transliteration: ityuktastena vipreṇa taddhanussamupānayat||2.118.47|| nimeṣāntaramātreṇa tadā'namya mahābalḥ| jyāṃ samāropya jhaḍiti pūr
meaning: At the words of that ascetic, my father brought out the bow. Mighty and valiant Rama bent it and strung it and drew it in the twinkling of an eye.

sanskrit: तेन पूरयता वेगान्मध्ये भग्नं द्विधा धनुः। तस्य शब्दो भवद्भीमः पतितस्याशनेरिव।।2.118.49।।
transliteration: tena pūrayatā vegānmadhye bhagnṃ dvidhā dhanuḥ| tasya śabdo bhavadbhīmḥ patitasyāśaneriva||2.118.49||
meaning: When Rama was stringing the bow with force, it was broken into two in the middle and fell down with a dreadful sound like that of thunder.

sanskrit: ततोऽहं तत्र रामाय पित्रा सत्याभिसन्धिना। निश्चिता दातुमुद्यम्य जलभाजनमुत्तमम्।।2.118.50।।
transliteration: tato'hṃ tatra rāmāya pitrā satyābhisandhinā| niścitā dātumudyamya jalabhājanamuttamam||2.118.50||
meaning: Then, my father steadfast in truth, held a vessel of pure water and declared his decision to offer me to Rama.

sanskrit: दीयमानां न तु तदा प्रतिजग्राह राघवः। अविज्ञाय पितुश्छन्दमयोध्याऽधिपतेः प्रभोः।।2.118.51।।
transliteration: dīyamānāṃ na tu tadā pratijagrāha rāghavḥ| avijñāya pituśchandamayodhyā'dhipateḥ prabhoḥ||2.118.51||
meaning: Then Rama did not accept the offer of my father straightaway before he knew the opinion of his father Dasaratha, king of Ayodhya.

sanskrit: तत श्श्वशुरमामन्त्र्य वृद्धं दशरथं नृपम्। मम पित्रा त्वहं दत्ता रामाय विदितात्मने।।2.118.52।।
transliteration: tata śśvaśuramāmantrya vṛddhṃ daśarathṃ nṛpam| mama pitrā tvahṃ dattā rāmāya viditātmane||2.118.52||
meaning: Thereafter, my fatherinlaw, the aged king Dasaratha was invited and my father offered me to Rama known for his sagacity.

sanskrit: मम चैवानुजा साध्वी ऊर्मिला प्रियदर्शना। भार्यार्थे लक्ष्मणस्यापि दत्ता पित्रा मम स्वयम्।।2.118.53।।
transliteration: mama caivānujā sādhvī ūrmilā priyadarśanā| bhāryārthe lakṣmaṇasyāpi dattā pitrā mama svayam||2.118.53||
meaning: My father, on his own accord, bestowed Urmila, my younger sister of chaste and of pleasing appearance as wife to Lakshmana.

sanskrit: एवं दत्ताऽस्मि रामाय तदा तस्मिन्स्वयंवरे। अनुरक्ताऽस्मि धर्मेण पतिं वीर्यवतां वरम्।।2.118.54।।
transliteration: evṃ dattā'smi rāmāya tadā tasminsvayṃvare| anuraktā'smi dharmeṇa patiṃ vīryavatāṃ varam||2.118.54||
meaning: In this way my father bestowed me on Rama in that swayamvara and I remain devoted to my husband who is the foremost among the valiant in treading the path of righteousness. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अय

sanskrit: व्यक्ताक्षरपदं चित्रं भाषितं मधुरं त्वया। यथा स्वयंवरं वृत्तं तत्सर्वं हि श्रुतं मया।।2.119.2।। रमेऽहं कथया ते तु दृढं म
transliteration: vyaktākṣarapadṃ citrṃ bhāṣitṃ madhurṃ tvayā| yathā svayṃvarṃ vṛttṃ tatsarvṃ hi śrutṃ mayā||2.119.2|| rame'hṃ kathayā te
meaning: You have related wonderfully and sweetly your Swayamvara with each word and each syllable uttered clearly. I have heard everything as it happened. O sweetspeaking Sita, I have greatly enjoyed your story.

sanskrit: रविरस्तङ्गतश्श्रीमानुपोह्य रजनीं शिवाम्।।2.119.3।। दिवसं प्रतिकीर्णानामाहारार्थं पतत्रिणाम्। सन्ध्याकाले निलीनानां निद्र
transliteration: ravirastaṅgataśśrīmānupohya rajanīṃ śivām||2.119.3|| divasṃ pratikīrṇānāmāhārārthṃ patatriṇām| sandhyākāle nilīnānāṃ nid
meaning: The resplendent Sun has set. The auspcious night is drawing near. The birds who forage far and wide for food during the day return to their nests to rest for the night. You can hear them twittering.

sanskrit: एते चाप्यभिषेकार्द्रा मुनयः कलशोद्यताः। सहिता उपवर्तन्ते सलिलाप्लुतवल्कलाः।।2.119.5।।
transliteration: ete cāpyabhiṣekārdrā munayḥ kalaśodyatāḥ| sahitā upavartante salilāplutavalkalāḥ||2.119.5||
meaning: The sages also are returning in groups with waterpitchers filled with water and their bark robes soaked with water after their ceremonial bath.

sanskrit: ऋषीणामग्निहोत्रेषु हुतेषु विधिपूर्वकम्। कपोताङ्गारुणो धूमो दृश्यते पवनोद्धतः।।2.119.6।।
transliteration: ṛṣīṇāmagnihotreṣu huteṣu vidhipūrvakam| kapotāṅgāruṇo dhūmo dṛśyate pavanoddhatḥ||2.119.6||
meaning: The ascetics have duly offered oblations to the fire in Agnihotra sacrifices and the smoke, tawny like the pigeon's body, emanates wafted by the wind.

sanskrit: अल्पपर्णा हि तरवो घनीभूतास्समन्ततः। विप्रकृष्टेन्द्रिये देशेऽस्मिन्न प्रकाशन्ति वै दिशः।।2.119.7।।
transliteration: alpaparṇā hi taravo ghanībhūtāssamantatḥ| viprakṛṣṭendriye deśe'sminna prakāśanti vai diśḥ||2.119.7||
meaning: The trees with sparse leaves all over have grown dense, the quarters in the distant region are no longer discernible by the senses.

sanskrit: रजनीचरसत्त्वानि प्रचरन्ति समन्ततः। तपोवनमृगा ह्येते वेदितीर्थेषु शेरते।।2.119.8।।
transliteration: rajanīcarasattvāni pracaranti samantatḥ| tapovanamṛgā hyete veditīrtheṣu śerate||2.119.8||
meaning: The night rangers have started moving everywhere and the deer in the penance grove are beginning to sleep around the sacred altars.

sanskrit: सम्प्रवृत्तानिशा सीते नक्षत्रसमलङ्कृता। ज्योत्स्नाप्रावरणश्चन्द्रो दृश्यतेऽभ्युदितोऽम्बरे।।2.119.9।।
transliteration: sampravṛttāniśā sīte nakṣatrasamalaṅkṛtā| jyotsnāprāvaraṇaścandro dṛśyate'bhyudito'mbare||2.119.9||
meaning: O Sita, adorned with stars, the night has commenced. You can see the moon rising in the sky spreading his mantle of light.

sanskrit: गम्यतामनुजानामि रामस्यानुचरी भव। कथायन्त्या हि मधुरं त्वयाऽहं परितोषिता।।2.119.10।।
transliteration: gamyatāmanujānāmi rāmasyānucarī bhava| kathāyantyā hi madhurṃ tvayā'hṃ paritoṣitā||2.119.10||
meaning: With my permission you may go now and be a companion of Rama. I am thoroughly contented with your story told so sweetly.

sanskrit: अलङ्कुरु च तावत्त्वं प्रत्यक्षं मम मैथिलि। प्रीतिं जनय मे वत्से दिव्यालङ्कारशोभिता।।2.119.11।।
transliteration: alaṅkuru ca tāvattvṃ pratyakṣṃ mama maithili| prītiṃ janaya me vatse divyālaṅkāraśobhitā||2.119.11||
meaning: O Sita, adorn yourself in my presence. Dear child, permit me the pleasure of adorning you with these divine ornaments.

sanskrit: सा तथा समलङ्कृत्य सीता सुरसुतोपमा। प्रणम्य शिरसा तस्यै रामं त्वभिमुखी ययौ।।2.119.12।।
transliteration: sā tathā samalaṅkṛtya sītā surasutopamā| praṇamya śirasā tasyai rāmṃ tvabhimukhī yayau||2.119.12||
meaning: Sita, adorned, looked like the daughter of a god. She bowed at the feet of Anasuya in reverence and set out to meet Rama.

sanskrit: तथा तु भूषितां सीतां ददर्श वदतां वरः। राघवः प्रीतिदानेन तपस्विन्या जहर्ष च।।2.119.13।।
transliteration: tathā tu bhūṣitāṃ sītāṃ dadarśa vadatāṃ varḥ| rāghavḥ prītidānena tapasvinyā jaharṣa ca||2.119.13||
meaning: Rama, the most eloquent among men, saw Sita adorned, and rejoiced at the gifts of love given by the ascetic Anasuya.

sanskrit: न्यवेदयत्ततस्सर्वं सीता रामाय मैथिली। प्रीतिदानं तपस्विन्या वसनाभरणस्रजम्।।2.119.14।।
transliteration: nyavedayattatassarvṃ sītā rāmāya maithilī| prītidānṃ tapasvinyā vasanābharaṇasrajam||2.119.14||
meaning: Sita the princess of Mithila related everything to Rama and showed him the gifts of love given by ascetic Anasuya -- raiment, jewellery and garlands.

sanskrit: प्रहृष्टस्त्वभवद्रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महारथः। मैथिल्यास्सत्क्रियां दृष्ट्वा मानुषेषु सुदुर्लभाम्।।2.119.15।।
transliteration: prahṛṣṭastvabhavadrāmo lakṣmaṇaśca mahārathḥ| maithilyāssatkriyāṃ dṛṣṭvā mānuṣeṣu sudurlabhām||2.119.15||
meaning: Rama the great charioteer and Lakshmana were exceedingly gratified to see the honour conferred on Sita, rare among mortals.

sanskrit: ततस्तां शर्वरीं प्रीतः पुण्यां शशिनिभाननः। अर्चितस्तापसै स्सिद्धैरुवास रघुनन्दनः।।2.119.16।।
transliteration: tatastāṃ śarvarīṃ prītḥ puṇyāṃ śaśinibhānanḥ| arcitastāpasai ssiddhairuvāsa raghunandanḥ||2.119.16||
meaning: Thereafter, the descendant of Raghu, whose countenance resembled the Moon, having received the hospitality of the accomplished ascetics, passed that holy night in delight.

sanskrit: तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायामभिषिच्य हुताग्निकान्। आपृच्छेतां नरव्याघ्रौ तापसान्वनगोचरान्।।2.119.17।।
transliteration: tasyāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāmabhiṣicya hutāgnikān| āpṛcchetāṃ naravyāghrau tāpasānvanagocarān||2.119.17||
meaning: Night over, the two best men, Rama and Lakshmana, after their ablution took leave of the ascetics inhabiting the forest who offered morning oblations to the fire .

sanskrit: तावूचुस्ते वनचरास्तापसा धर्मचारिणः। वनस्य तस्य सञ्चारं राक्षसैस्समभिप्लुतम्।।2.119.18।।
transliteration: tāvūcuste vanacarāstāpasā dharmacāriṇḥ| vanasya tasya sañcārṃ rākṣasaissamabhiplutam||2.119.18||
meaning: The righteous ascetics dwelling in the forest informed both Rama and Lakshmana that part of the forest infested by demons.

sanskrit: रक्षांसि पुरुषादानि नानारूपाणि राघव। वसन्त्यस्मिन्महारण्ये व्यालाश्च रुधिराशनाः।।2.119.19।।
transliteration: rakṣāṃsi puruṣādāni nānārūpāṇi rāghava| vasantyasminmahāraṇye vyālāśca rudhirāśanāḥ||2.119.19||
meaning: O Rama, this great forest is haunted by carnivorous demons who can assume any form and by blooddrinking wild animals.

sanskrit: उच्छिष्टं वा प्रमत्तं वा तापसं धर्मचारिणम्। अदन्त्यस्मिन्महारण्ये तान्निवारय राघव।।2.119.20।।
transliteration: ucchiṣṭṃ vā pramattṃ vā tāpasṃ dharmacāriṇam| adantyasminmahāraṇye tānnivāraya rāghava||2.119.20||
meaning: O Rama, in this great forest demons will devour the ascetics if they find them impure or intoxicated or indolent. Prevent them.

sanskrit: एष पन्था महर्षीणां फलान्याहरतां वने। अनेन तु वनं दुर्गं गन्तुं राघव ते क्षमम्।।2.119.21।।
transliteration: eṣa panthā maharṣīṇāṃ phalānyāharatāṃ vane| anena tu vanṃ durgṃ gantuṃ rāghava te kṣamam||2.119.21||
meaning: O Rama, this is the one path in the forest used by the ascetics to gather fruits. You can safely cross the otherwise impassable forest through this path.

sanskrit: इतीव तैः प्राञ्जलिभिस्तपस्विभिर्द्विजैः कृतस्वस्त्ययनः परन्तपः। वनं सभार्यः प्रविवेश राघवस्सलक्ष्मणस्सूर्य इवाभ्रमण्डलम्
transliteration: itīva taiḥ prāñjalibhistapasvibhirdvijaiḥ kṛtasvastyayanḥ parantapḥ| vanṃ sabhāryḥ praviveśa rāghavassalakṣmaṇassūrya iv
meaning: The ascetics offered their blessings to Rama the tormentor of enemies. Thereafter, accompanied by his wife and Lakshmana, he entered the great forest like the Sun entering the mass of clouds. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे श्र

sanskrit: इति सञ्चिन्त्य तद्राजा नाध्यगच्छत्तदासुखम्। प्रतिलभ्य चिरात्संज्ञां कैकेयीवाक्यताडितः।।2.12.3।। व्यथितो विक्लबश्चैव व्या
transliteration: iti sañcintya tadrājā nādhyagacchattadāsukham| pratilabhya cirātsṃjñāṃ kaikeyīvākyatāḍitḥ||2.12.3|| vyathito viklabaścai
meaning: The King absorbed in such thoughts did not get solace. He was startled and distressed like a deer beholding a tigress. He had long lost the senses struck by the (ruthless) words of Kaikeyi. He sank down upon the bare flo

sanskrit: किमिदं चिन्तितं पापे त्वया परमदारुणम्।।2.12.15।। अथ जिज्ञाससे मां त्वं भरतस्य प्रियाप्रिये। अस्तु यत्तत्त्वया पूर्वं व्य
transliteration: kimidṃ cintitṃ pāpe tvayā paramadāruṇam||2.12.15|| atha jijñāsase māṃ tvṃ bharatasya priyāpriye| astu yattattvayā pūrvṃ
meaning: O sinful one why have you got this most dreadful thought? Do you want to know my likes or dislikes about Bharata? Let them be so.But speaking of Rama earlier, you used to say, 'Rama is my eldest son. He is noble and fore

sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले देवि सम्प्राप्तस्सुमहानयम्। अनयो नयसम्पन्ने यत्र ते विकृता मतिः।।2.12.19।।
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇāṃ kule devi samprāptassumahānayam| anayo nayasampanne yatra te vikṛtā matiḥ||2.12.19||
meaning: O queen, till now you had a moral sense. With your mind debased (now), a very great immorality has infected the Ikshvaku race.

sanskrit: नहि किञ्चिदयुक्तं वा विप्रियं वा पुरा मम। अकरोस्त्वं विशालाक्षि तेन न श्रद्दधाम्यहम्।।2.12.20।।
transliteration: nahi kiñcidayuktṃ vā vipriyṃ vā purā mama| akarostvṃ viśālākṣi tena na śraddadhāmyaham||2.12.20||
meaning: O largeeyed lady, you have never done anything improper or unpalatable towards me in the past. Therefore I do not believe your words.

sanskrit: तस्य धर्मात्मनो देवि वनवासं यशस्विनः। कथं रोचयसे भीरु नव वर्षाणि पञ्च च।।2.12.22।।
transliteration: tasya dharmātmano devi vanavāsṃ yaśasvinḥ| kathṃ rocayase bhīru nava varṣāṇi pañca ca||2.12.22||
meaning: O lady how do you wish this righteous and illustrious Rama to dwell in the forest for fourteen years?

sanskrit: अत्यन्तसुकुमारस्य तस्य धर्मे धृतात्मनः। कथं रोचयसे वासमरण्ये भृशदारुणे।।2.12.23।।
transliteration: atyantasukumārasya tasya dharme dhṛtātmanḥ| kathṃ rocayase vāsamaraṇye bhṛśadāruṇe||2.12.23||
meaning: Why do you want Rama who is so tender and a firm follower of dharma to dwell in the highly dreadful forest?

sanskrit: परिवादोऽपवादो वा राघवे नोपपद्यते।।2.12.27।। सान्त्वयन्सर्वभूतानि राम श्शुद्धेन चेतसा। गृह्णाति मनुजव्याघ्र प्रियैर्विषयव
transliteration: parivādo'pavādo vā rāghave nopapadyate||2.12.27|| sāntvayansarvabhūtāni rāma śśuddhena cetasā| gṛhṇāti manujavyāghra pri
meaning: The best among men, Rama has won the trust of the inhabitants of the country by securing their affection with a pure heart and by doing acts dear to them. Therefore, neither a word of blame nor reproach applies to this s

sanskrit: न स्मराम्यप्रियं वाक्यं लोकस्य प्रियवादिनः। स कथं त्वत्कृते रामं वक्ष्यामि प्रियमप्रियम्।।2.12.32।।
transliteration: na smarāmyapriyṃ vākyṃ lokasya priyavādinḥ| sa kathṃ tvatkṛte rāmṃ vakṣyāmi priyamapriyam||2.12.32||
meaning: How can I, for your sake, speak harsh to my beloved Rama who uses pleasing words to the people of the world, and never an unpleasant word which I can recall?

sanskrit: क्षमा यस्मिन्दमस्त्याग सत्यं धर्मः कृतज्ञता। अप्यहिंसा च भूतानां तमृते का गतिर्मम।।2.12.33।।
transliteration: kṣamā yasmindamastyāga satyṃ dharmḥ kṛtajñatā| apyahiṃsā ca bhūtānāṃ tamṛte kā gatirmama||2.12.33||
meaning: Where is the refuge for me without him in whom dwell forgiveness, forbearance, renunciation, truthfulness, righteousness, gratefulness and also nonviolence towards all living beings?

sanskrit: इति दुःखाभिसन्तप्तं विलपन्तमचेतनम्। घूर्णमानं महाराजं शोकेन समभिप्लुतम्।।2.12.37।। पारं शोकार्णवस्याशु प्रार्थयन्तं पुनः
transliteration: iti duḥkhābhisantaptṃ vilapantamacetanam| ghūrṇamānṃ mahārājṃ śokena samabhiplutam||2.12.37|| pārṃ śokārṇavasyāśu prārth
meaning: Then the fierce Kaikeyi used fiercer words in reply to the king who was tormented with grief and filled with tears, senses switched off, head reeling, overwhelmed with pain, beseeching again and again to ferry him across

sanskrit: यदि दत्त्वा वरौ राजन्पुनः प्रत्यनुतप्यसे। धार्मिकत्वं कथं वीर पृथिव्यां कथयिष्यसि।।2.12.39।।
transliteration: yadi dattvā varau rājanpunḥ pratyanutapyase| dhārmikatvṃ kathṃ vīra pṛthivyāṃ kathayiṣyasi||2.12.39||
meaning: O valiant king, if you repent like this after having given two boons, how will you talk about your righteousness on this earth?

sanskrit: यदा समेता बहवस्त्वया राजर्षय स्सह। कथयिष्यन्ति धर्मज्ञ तत्र किं प्रतिवक्ष्यसि।।2.12.40।।
transliteration: yadā sametā bahavastvayā rājarṣaya ssaha| kathayiṣyanti dharmajña tatra kiṃ prativakṣyasi||2.12.40||
meaning: O knower of righteousness when innumerable rajarshis assemble and ask you on this what answer will you give?

sanskrit: यस्याः प्रसादे जीवामि या च मामभ्यपालयत्। तस्याः कृतम् मया मिथ्या कैकेय्या इति वक्षयसि।।2.12.41।।
transliteration: yasyāḥ prasāde jīvāmi yā ca māmabhyapālayat| tasyāḥ kṛtam mayā mithyā kaikeyyā iti vakṣayasi||2.12.41||
meaning: Will you say, 'To such a Kaikeyi by whose mercy I am alive and by whom I was protected, I have broken the promise given'?

sanskrit: किल्बिषत्वं नरेन्द्राणां करिष्यसि नराधिप। यो दत्वा वरमद्यैव पुनरन्यानि भाषसे।।2.12.42।।
transliteration: kilbiṣatvṃ narendrāṇāṃ kariṣyasi narādhipa| yo datvā varamadyaiva punaranyāni bhāṣase||2.12.42||
meaning: O king, right now having given two boons, you are speaking otherwise. You are bringing blemish to kings (of the Ikshwaku race)

sanskrit: शैब्यश्श्येनकपोतीये स्वमांसं पक्षिणे ददौ। अलर्कश्चक्षुषी दत्वा जगाम गतिमुत्तमाम्।।2.12.43।।
transliteration: śaibyaśśyenakapotīye svamāṃsṃ pakṣiṇe dadau| alarkaścakṣuṣī datvā jagāma gatimuttamām||2.12.43||
meaning: (King) Saibya gave his own flesh to the hawk in the conflict between the hawk and the pigeon. (King) Alarka gave his eyes (to a blind man) and attained the highest state.

sanskrit: सागरस्समयं कृत्वा न वेलामतिवर्तते। समयं माऽनृतं कार्षीः पूर्ववृत्तमनुस्मरन्।।2.12.44।।
transliteration: sāgarassamayṃ kṛtvā na velāmativartate| samayṃ mā'nṛtṃ kārṣīḥ pūrvavṛttamanusmaran||2.12.44||
meaning: Having made the vow (to the gods), the ocean does not advance beyond the shore. Recollect the history of the earlier kings and do not make the vow false.

sanskrit: स त्वं धर्मं परित्यज्य रामं राज्येऽभिषिच्य च। सह कौसल्यया नित्यं रन्तुमिच्छसि दुर्मते।।2.12.45।।
transliteration: sa tvṃ dharmṃ parityajya rāmṃ rājye'bhiṣicya ca| saha kausalyayā nityṃ rantumicchasi durmate||2.12.45||
meaning: O wickedminded one, deserting righteousness and installing Rama in the kingdom, you want to enjoy life with Kausalya everafter?

sanskrit: भवत्वधर्मो धर्मो वा सत्यं वा यदि वाऽनृतम्। यत्त्वया संश्रुतं मह्यं तस्य नास्ति व्यतिक्रमः।।2.12.46।।
transliteration: bhavatvadharmo dharmo vā satyṃ vā yadi vā'nṛtam| yattvayā sṃśrutṃ mahyṃ tasya nāsti vyatikramḥ||2.12.46||
meaning: Whether righteous or unrighteous, true or false, there is no deviation from what you have promised to me.

sanskrit: अहं हि विषमद्यैव पीत्वा बहु तवाग्रतः। पश्यतस्ते मरिष्यामि रामो यद्यभिषिच्यते।।2.12.47।।
transliteration: ahṃ hi viṣamadyaiva pītvā bahu tavāgratḥ| paśyataste mariṣyāmi rāmo yadyabhiṣicyate||2.12.47||
meaning: If Rama is coronated I will die while as you are watching right in your presence today itself by drinking excessive poison.

sanskrit: एकाहमपि पश्येयं यद्यहं राममातरम्। अञ्जलिं प्रतिगृह्णन्तीं श्रेयो ननु मृतिर्मम।।2.12.48।।
transliteration: ekāhamapi paśyeyṃ yadyahṃ rāmamātaram| añjaliṃ pratigṛhṇantīṃ śreyo nanu mṛtirmama||2.12.48||
meaning: If I were to see Rama's mother receiving homage from everybody even for a day, I shall prefer my death.

sanskrit: भरतेनात्मना चाहं शपे ते मनुजाधिप। यथा नान्येन तुष्येयमृते रामविवासनात्।।2.12.49।।
transliteration: bharatenātmanā cāhṃ śape te manujādhipa| yathā nānyena tuṣyeyamṛte rāmavivāsanāt||2.12.49||
meaning: O king, I swear on Bharata and on my own life that nothing less than Rama's banishment will satisfy me.

sanskrit: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं कैकेयी विरराम ह। विलपन्तं च राजानं न प्रतिव्याजहार सा।।2.12.50।।
transliteration: etāvaduktvā vacanṃ kaikeyī virarāma ha| vilapantṃ ca rājānṃ na prativyājahāra sā||2.12.50||
meaning: Kaikeyi, having spoken to this extent remained silent. She heeded not the lament of the king.

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु राजा कैकेय्या वृतं परमशोभनम्। रामस्य च वने वासमैश्वर्यं भरतस्य च।।2.12.51।। नाभ्यभाषत कैकेयीं मुहूर्तं व्याक
transliteration: śrutvā tu rājā kaikeyyā vṛtṃ paramaśobhanam| rāmasya ca vane vāsamaiśvaryṃ bharatasya ca||2.12.51|| nābhyabhāṣata kaikey
meaning: Having heard of the highly unfair demands by Kaikeyi for Rama's exile to the forest and Bharata's prosperity (enthronement), the king was dumbstruck for a while with his senses agitated. He did not speak to Kaikeyi.

sanskrit: प्रैक्षतानिमिषो देवीं प्रियामप्रियवादिनीम्।।2.12.52।। तां हि वज्रसमां वाचमाकर्ण्य हृदयाप्रियाम्। दुःखशोकमयीं घोरां राजा
transliteration: praikṣatānimiṣo devīṃ priyāmapriyavādinīm||2.12.52|| tāṃ hi vajrasamāṃ vācamākarṇya hṛdayāpriyām| duḥkhaśokamayīṃ ghorāṃ
meaning: The unhappy king intently fixed his gaze at his beloved queen speaking unpleasant words charged with grief and anguish, unpleasant to the heart like the dreadful thunderbolt.

sanskrit: स देव्या व्यवसायं च घोरं च शपथं कृतम्। ध्यात्वा रामेति निश्श्वस्य छिन्न स्तरुरिवापतत्।।2.12.54।।
transliteration: sa devyā vyavasāyṃ ca ghorṃ ca śapathṃ kṛtam| dhyātvā rāmeti niśśvasya chinna starurivāpatat||2.12.54||
meaning: Reflecting on the determination of the queen and her dreadful vow, the king sighed and cried, 'O Rama' and then fell down like a tree severed.

sanskrit: नष्टचित्तो यथोन्मत्तो विपरीतो यथाऽतुरः। हृततेजा यथा सर्पो बभूव जगतीपतिः।।2.12.55।।
transliteration: naṣṭacitto yathonmatto viparīto yathā'turḥ| hṛtatejā yathā sarpo babhūva jagatīpatiḥ||2.12.55||
meaning: The lord of the earth (Dasaratha) became like a man with the mind deranged, like a sick man behaving to the contrary, like a serpent with its energy drained (through mantra).

sanskrit: दीनया तु गिरा राजा इति होवाच कैकयीम्। अनर्थमिममर्थाभं केन त्वमुपदर्शिता।।2.12.56।। भूतोपहतचित्तेव ब्रुवन्ती मां न लज्जसे
transliteration: dīnayā tu girā rājā iti hovāca kaikayīm| anarthamimamarthābhṃ kena tvamupadarśitā||2.12.56|| bhūtopahatacitteva bruvantī
meaning: The king addressed Kaikeyi in humble words saying, Why did you exhibit this unfortunate act apparently beneficial to you? You are not ashamed of saying this like one whose faculties are possessed by an evil spirit.

sanskrit: शीलव्यसनमेतत्ते नाभिजानाम्यहं पुरा।।2.12.57।। बालायास्तत्त्वितिदानीं ते लक्षये विपरीतवत्।
transliteration: śīlavyasanametatte nābhijānāmyahṃ purā||2.12.57|| bālāyāstattvitidānīṃ te lakṣaye viparītavat|
meaning: I never knew earlier when you were young that you possessed such perverse behaviour. But now I perceive the reverse (of what I knew).

sanskrit: कुतो वा ते भयं जातं या त्वमेवंविधं वरम्।।2.12.58।। राष्ट्रे भरतमासीनं वृणीषे राघवं वने।
transliteration: kuto vā te bhayṃ jātṃ yā tvamevṃvidhṃ varam||2.12.58|| rāṣṭre bharatamāsīnṃ vṛṇīṣe rāghavṃ vane|
meaning: You are asking for a boon that Bharata should be enthroned in the kingdom while Rama should live in the forest. From where did you get this apprehension?

sanskrit: विरमैतेन भावेन त्वमेतेनानृतेन वा।।2.12.59।। यदि भर्तुः प्रियं कार्यं लोकस्य भरतस्य च।
transliteration: viramaitena bhāvena tvametenānṛtena vā||2.12.59|| yadi bhartuḥ priyṃ kāryṃ lokasya bharatasya ca|
meaning: If you wish to do good to your husband, to the world and also to Bharata, refrain from this illusory thought.

sanskrit: नृशंसे पापसङ्कल्पे क्षुद्रे दुष्कृतकारिणि।।2.12.60।। किन्नु दुखमलीकं वा मयि रामे च पश्यसि।
transliteration: nṛśṃse pāpasaṅkalpe kṣudre duṣkṛtakāriṇi||2.12.60|| kinnu dukhamalīkṃ vā mayi rāme ca paśyasi|
meaning: O cruel one, O woman of sinful resolve, O vile (creature), O woman of evil deeds, what wrong or sin do you really see in Rama or in me.

sanskrit: न कथञ्चिदृते रामाद्भरतो राज्यमावसेत्।।2.12.61।। रामादपि हि तं मन्ये धर्मतो बलवत्तरम्।
transliteration: na kathañcidṛte rāmādbharato rājyamāvaset||2.12.61|| rāmādapi hi tṃ manye dharmato balavattaram|
meaning: Depriving Rama, Bharata in no way will occupy the kingdom because in the matter of righteousness I think he is superior even to Rama.

sanskrit: कथं द्रक्ष्यामि रामस्य वनं गच्छेति भाषिते।।2.12.62।। मुखवर्णं विवर्णं तु तं यथैवेन्दुमुपप्लुतम्।
transliteration: kathṃ drakṣyāmi rāmasya vanṃ gaccheti bhāṣite||2.12.62|| mukhavarṇṃ vivarṇṃ tu tṃ yathaivendumupaplutam|
meaning: While instructing Rama to go to the forest, how can I look at his face, pale like the eclipsed moon?

sanskrit: तां हि मे सुकृतां बुद्धिं सुहृद्भिस्सह निश्चिताम्।।2.12.63।। कथं द्रक्ष्याम्यपावृत्तां परैरिव हतां चमूम्। किं मां वक्ष्य
transliteration: tāṃ hi me sukṛtāṃ buddhiṃ suhṛdbhissaha niścitām||2.12.63|| kathṃ drakṣyāmyapāvṛttāṃ parairiva hatāṃ camūm| kiṃ māṃ vakṣ
meaning: I have taken this decision in consultation with friends to install Rama. How can I see such a decision being reversed like a retreating army defeated by enemies? Kings from different quarters have already arrived and the

sanskrit: यदा तु बहवो वृद्धा गुणवन्तो बहुश्रुताः।।2.12.65।। परिप्रक्ष्यन्ति काकुत्स्थं वक्ष्यामि किमहं तदा।
transliteration: yadā tu bahavo vṛddhā guṇavanto bahuśrutāḥ||2.12.65|| pariprakṣyanti kākutsthṃ vakṣyāmi kimahṃ tadā|
meaning: When several virtuous and learned elders ask me about Rama, what shall I tell them?

sanskrit: कैकेय्या क्लिश्यमानेन रामः प्रव्राजितो मया।।2.12.66।। यदि सत्यं ब्रवीम्येतत्तदसत्यं भविष्यति।
transliteration: kaikeyyā kliśyamānena rāmḥ pravrājito mayā||2.12.66|| yadi satyṃ bravīmyetattadasatyṃ bhaviṣyati|
meaning: If I tell the truth 'Tortured by Kaikeyi, I have sent Rama to the forest', none will believe it and they will consider it untruth.

sanskrit: किं मां वक्ष्यति कौशल्या राघवे वनमास्थिते।।2.12.67।। किं चैनां प्रतिवक्ष्यामि कृत्वा विप्रियमीदृशम्।
transliteration: kiṃ māṃ vakṣyati kauśalyā rāghave vanamāsthite||2.12.67|| kiṃ caināṃ prativakṣyāmi kṛtvā vipriyamīdṛśam|
meaning: If Rama takes refuge in the forest, what will Kausalya say to me? Having committed such an unpleasant act, what reply can I give her?

sanskrit: यदा यदा हि कौशल्या दासीवच्च सखीव च।।2.12.68।। भार्यावद्भगिनीवच्च मातृवच्चोपतिष्ठति। सततं प्रियकामा मे प्रियपुत्रा प्रियं
transliteration: yadā yadā hi kauśalyā dāsīvacca sakhīva ca||2.12.68|| bhāryāvadbhaginīvacca mātṛvaccopatiṣṭhati| satatṃ priyakāmā me pri
meaning: Sweetspoken Kausalya who always cherishes my welfare. who has given me my beloved son, who has served me like an attendant, a friend, a wife, a sister and a mother deserved courteous treatment from me, but because of you

sanskrit: इदानीं तत्तपति मां यन्मया सुकृतं त्वयि।।2.12.70।। अपथ्यव्यञ्जनोपेतं भुक्तमन्नमिवातुरम्।
transliteration: idānīṃ tattapati māṃ yanmayā sukṛtṃ tvayi||2.12.70|| apathyavyañjanopetṃ bhuktamannamivāturam|
meaning: I have done many favours to you. Like a sick person afflicted by eating rice mixed with unwholesome curry, those acts of kindness are burning me now.

sanskrit: विप्रकारं च रामस्य सम्प्रयाणं वनस्य च।।2.12.71।। सुमित्रा प्रेक्ष्य वै भीता कथं मे विश्वसिष्यति।
transliteration: viprakārṃ ca rāmasya samprayāṇṃ vanasya ca||2.12.71|| sumitrā prekṣya vai bhītā kathṃ me viśvasiṣyati|
meaning: In seeing the insult meted out to Rama and his journey to the forest, how will frightened Sumitra have confidence in me?

sanskrit: कृपणं बत वैदेही श्रोष्यति द्वयमप्रियम्।।2.12.72।। मां च पञ्चत्वमापन्नं रामं च वनमाश्रितम्।
transliteration: kṛpaṇṃ bata vaidehī śroṣyati dvayamapriyam||2.12.72|| māṃ ca pañcatvamāpannṃ rāmṃ ca vanamāśritam|
meaning: Alas Sita will listen in a pitiable state the two unpleasant events namely my death and Rama's exile to the foest.

sanskrit: वैदेही बत मे प्राणान्शोचन्ती क्षपयिष्यति।।2.12.73।। हीना हिमवतः पार्श्वे किन्नरेणेव किन्नरी।
transliteration: vaidehī bata me prāṇānśocantī kṣapayiṣyati||2.12.73|| hīnā himavatḥ pārśve kinnareṇeva kinnarī|
meaning: What a pity Vaidehi, lamenting like a Kinnari forsaken by a Kinnara on the Himalayan slopes, will cause death to me.

sanskrit: न हि राममहं दृष्ट्वा प्रवसन्तं महावने।।2.12.74।। चिरं जीवितुमाशंसे रुदन्तीं चापि मैथिलीम्।
transliteration: na hi rāmamahṃ dṛṣṭvā pravasantṃ mahāvane||2.12.74|| cirṃ jīvitumāśṃse rudantīṃ cāpi maithilīm|
meaning: With Rama living in the wilderness and Sita crying, I do not hope to survive for long, indeed.

sanskrit: सा नूनं विधवा राज्यं सपुत्रा कारयिष्यसि।।2.12.75।। न हि प्रव्राजिते रामे देवि जीवितुमुत्सहे।
transliteration: sā nūnṃ vidhavā rājyṃ saputrā kārayiṣyasi||2.12.75|| na hi pravrājite rāme devi jīvitumutsahe|
meaning: O Devi you will certainly rule the kingdom as a widow along with your son. (But) I do not wish to live after Rama is exiled.

sanskrit: सतीं त्वामहमत्यन्तं व्यवस्याम्यसतीं सतीम्। रूपिणीं विषसंयुक्तां पीत्वेव मदिरां नरः।।2.12.76।।
transliteration: satīṃ tvāmahamatyantṃ vyavasyāmyasatīṃ satīm| rūpiṇīṃ viṣasṃyuktāṃ pītveva madirāṃ narḥ||2.12.76||
meaning: Like people regarding wine mixed with poison as fine before drinking it, I had a firm belief that you were a chaste woman, but while you who look extremely beautiful you are actually not so.

sanskrit: अनृतैर्बहु मां सान्त्वै स्सान्त्वयन्ती स्म भाषसे। गीतशब्देन संरुध्य लुब्धो मृगमिवावधीः।।2.12.77।।
transliteration: anṛtairbahu māṃ sāntvai ssāntvayantī sma bhāṣase| gītaśabdena sṃrudhya lubdho mṛgamivāvadhīḥ||2.12.77||
meaning: You used to console me with so many words pleasing but untrue and you killed me like a hunter getting the deer trapped and slaughtered through the melody of music.

sanskrit: अनार्य इति मामार्याः पुत्रविक्रायकं ध्रुवम्। धिक्करिष्यन्ति रथ्यासु सुरापं ब्राह्मणं यथा।।2.12.78।।
transliteration: anārya iti māmāryāḥ putravikrāyakṃ dhruvam| dhikkariṣyanti rathyāsu surāpṃ brāhmaṇṃ yathā||2.12.78||
meaning: Respectable people on the highway will certainly say 'He sold away his son' and censure me as a mean person like a brahmin consuming liquor.

sanskrit: अहो दुःखमहो कृच्छ्रं यत्र वाचः क्षमे तव। दुःखमेवंविधं प्राप्तं पुराकृतमिवाशुभम्।।2.12.79।।
transliteration: aho duḥkhamaho kṛcchrṃ yatra vācḥ kṣame tava| duḥkhamevṃvidhṃ prāptṃ purākṛtamivāśubham||2.12.79||
meaning: What suffering What a calamity that I am made to put up with your words. I am subject to this suffering may be as expiation for the sin formerly committed.

sanskrit: चिरं खलु मया पापे त्वं पापेनाभिरक्षिता। अज्ञानादुपसम्पन्ना रज्जुरुद्बन्धिनी यथा।।2.12.80।।
transliteration: cirṃ khalu mayā pāpe tvṃ pāpenābhirakṣitā| ajñānādupasampannā rajjurudbandhinī yathā||2.12.80||
meaning: O wretch I protected you in my folly for a long time through ignorance, like a rope preserved which turned out to be a noose to hang me with.

sanskrit: रममाणस्त्वया सार्धं मृत्युं त्वां नाभिलक्षये। बालो रहसि हस्तेन कृष्णसर्पमिवास्पृशम्।।2.12.81।।
transliteration: ramamāṇastvayā sārdhṃ mṛtyuṃ tvāṃ nābhilakṣaye| bālo rahasi hastena kṛṣṇasarpamivāspṛśam||2.12.81||
meaning: While sporting with you, I did not realize you were death incarnate. Like a child handling a black cobra I caressed you.

sanskrit: मया ह्यपितृकः पुत्र स्समहात्मा दुरात्मना। तं तु मां जीवलोकोऽयं नूनमाक्रोष्टुमर्हति।।2.12.82।।
transliteration: mayā hyapitṛkḥ putra ssamahātmā durātmanā| tṃ tu māṃ jīvaloko'yṃ nūnamākroṣṭumarhati||2.12.82||
meaning: Wicked I am, I have made that magnanimous Rama fatherless. This world of living beings is certainly entitled to condemn me.

sanskrit: बालिशो बत कामात्मा राजा दशरथो भृशम्। यः स्त्रीकृते प्रियं पुत्रं वनं प्रस्थापयिष्यति।।2.12.83।।
transliteration: bāliśo bata kāmātmā rājā daśaratho bhṛśam| yḥ strīkṛte priyṃ putrṃ vanṃ prasthāpayiṣyati||2.12.83||
meaning: (They will say), 'Alas how utterly foolish and lustful is king Dasaratha who is sending his beloved son to the forest for the sake of a woman'.

sanskrit: व्रतैश्च ब्रह्मचर्यैश्च गुरुभिश्चोपकर्शितः। भोगकाले महत्कृच्छ्रं पुनरेव प्रपत्स्यते।।2.12.84।।
transliteration: vrataiśca brahmacaryaiśca gurubhiścopakarśitḥ| bhogakāle mahatkṛcchrṃ punareva prapatsyate||2.12.84||
meaning: '(Rama) already emaciated by observing vows related to ritual and celibacy in compliance with the orders of the preceptors has to undergo hardships again at a time when he should enjoy pleasures (of life)'.

sanskrit: नालं द्वितीयं वचनं पुत्रो मां प्रतिभाषितुम्। स वनं प्रव्रजेत्युक्तो बाढमित्येव वक्ष्यति।।2.12.85।।
transliteration: nālṃ dvitīyṃ vacanṃ putro māṃ pratibhāṣitum| sa vanṃ pravrajetyukto bāḍhamityeva vakṣyati||2.12.85||
meaning: My son Rama will not say a second word to me, if I tell him 'Go to the forest'.He will say, 'Certainly so'.

sanskrit: यदि मे राघवः कुर्याद्वनं गच्छेति चोदितः। प्रतिकूलं प्रियं मे स्यान्न तु वत्सः करिष्यति।।2.12.86।।
transliteration: yadi me rāghavḥ kuryādvanṃ gaccheti coditḥ| pratikūlṃ priyṃ me syānna tu vatsḥ kariṣyati||2.12.86||
meaning: If this scion of the Raghu race (Rama) urged to go to the forest acts against my order, it will be welcome but my son will not do it.

sanskrit: शुद्धभावो हि भावं मे न तु ज्ञास्यति राघवः।।2.12.87।। स वनं प्रब्रजे त्युक्तो बाढ मित्येव वक्षयति।
transliteration: śuddhabhāvo hi bhāvṃ me na tu jñāsyati rāghavḥ||2.12.87|| sa vanṃ prabraje tyukto bāḍha mityeva vakṣayati|
meaning: The descendant of the Raghus (Rama) who is pure in thought will not come to know my intention. Therefore if I tell him 'Go to the forest,' he will say, 'Certainly so'.

sanskrit: राघवे हि वनं प्राप्ते सर्वलोकस्य धिक्कृतम्।।2.12.88।। मृत्युरक्षमणीयं मां नयिष्यति यमक्षयम्।
transliteration: rāghave hi vanṃ prāpte sarvalokasya dhikkṛtam||2.12.88|| mṛtyurakṣamaṇīyṃ māṃ nayiṣyati yamakṣayam|
meaning: If Rama goes to the forest, the god of death will conduct me to his abode, for condemned by the entire world, I shall not be forgiven (even by Yama).

sanskrit: मृते मयि गते रामे वनं मनुजपुङ्गवे।।2.12.89।। इष्टे मम जने शेषे किं पापं प्रतिपत्स्यसे।
transliteration: mṛte mayi gate rāme vanṃ manujapuṅgave||2.12.89|| iṣṭe mama jane śeṣe kiṃ pāpṃ pratipatsyase|
meaning: With me dead and Rama, the best among men, banished, what harmful acts are you contemplating against my wellwishers?

sanskrit: कौशल्या मां च रामं च पुत्रौ च यदि हास्यति।।2.12.90।। दुःखान्यसहती देवी मामेवानुमरिष्यति।
transliteration: kauśalyā māṃ ca rāmṃ ca putrau ca yadi hāsyati||2.12.90|| duḥkhānyasahatī devī māmevānumariṣyati|
meaning: If queen Kausalya loses me, Rama, Lakshmana and Satrughna will follow me into death, unable to bear the grief.

sanskrit: कौसल्यां च सुमित्रां च मां च पुत्रैस्त्रिभिस्सह।।2.12.91।। प्रक्षिप्य नरके सा त्वं कैकेयि सुखिता भव।
transliteration: kausalyāṃ ca sumitrāṃ ca māṃ ca putraistribhissaha||2.12.91|| prakṣipya narake sā tvṃ kaikeyi sukhitā bhava|
meaning: O Kaikeyi consign Kausalya, Sumitra, me and my three sons into hell and be happy.

sanskrit: मया रामेण च त्यक्तं शाश्वतं सत्कृतं गुणैः।।2.12.92।। इक्ष्वाकुकुलमक्षोभ्यमाकुलं पालयिष्यसि।
transliteration: mayā rāmeṇa ca tyaktṃ śāśvatṃ satkṛtṃ guṇaiḥ||2.12.92|| ikṣvākukulamakṣobhyamākulṃ pālayiṣyasi|
meaning: You will rule undisturbed the Ikshvaku race honoured for its divine virtues. Now abandoned by me and Rama it will be afflicted with grief.

sanskrit: प्रियं चेद्भरतस्यैतद्रामप्रव्राजनं भवेत्।।2.12.93।। मा स्म मे भरतः कार्षीत्प्रेतकृत्यं गतायुषः।
transliteration: priyṃ cedbharatasyaitadrāmapravrājanṃ bhavet||2.12.93|| mā sma me bharatḥ kārṣītpretakṛtyṃ gatāyuṣḥ|
meaning: If Rama's exile is approved by Bharata, then let him not perform my funeral rites after my death.

sanskrit: हन्तानार्ये ममामित्रे सकामा भव कैकयि।।2.12.94।। मृते मयि गते रामे वनं पुरुषपुङ्गवे। सेदानीं विधवा राज्यं सपुत्रा कारयिष्
transliteration: hantānārye mamāmitre sakāmā bhava kaikayi||2.12.94|| mṛte mayi gate rāme vanṃ puruṣapuṅgave| sedānīṃ vidhavā rājyṃ saput
meaning: O my enemy, O wicked Kaikeyi, after Rama, the foremost of men, has left for the forest your desires will be fulfilled. And after my death, you as a widow along with your son will rule the kingdom.

sanskrit: त्वं राजपुत्रीवादेन न्यवसो मम वेश्मनि। अकीर्तिश्चातुला लोके ध्रुवः परिभवश्च मे।।2.12.96।। सर्वभूतेषु चावज्ञा यथा पापकृतस
transliteration: tvṃ rājaputrīvādena nyavaso mama veśmani| akīrtiścātulā loke dhruvḥ paribhavaśca me||2.12.96|| sarvabhūteṣu cāvajñā yath
meaning: You lived in my palace under the name of a princess. You have brought me, for sure, unparalleled dishonour and disgrace. Everybody will look upon me with contempt as if I have committed a sinful act.

sanskrit: कथं रथैर्विभुर्यात्वा गजाश्वैश्च मुहुर्मुहुः।।2.12.97।। पद्भ्यां रामो महारण्ये वत्सो मे विचरिष्यति।
transliteration: kathṃ rathairvibhuryātvā gajāśvaiśca muhurmuhuḥ||2.12.97|| padbhyāṃ rāmo mahāraṇye vatso me vicariṣyati|
meaning: How will my son, Rama, who used to ride on chariots, elephants and horses roam the wilderness barefoot?

sanskrit: यस्य त्वाहारसमये सूदाः कुण्डलधारिणः।।2.12.98।। अहंपूर्वाः पचन्ति स्म प्रशस्तं पानभोजनम्। स कथन्नु कषायाणि तिक्तानि कटुका
transliteration: yasya tvāhārasamaye sūdāḥ kuṇḍaladhāriṇḥ||2.12.98|| ahṃpūrvāḥ pacanti sma praśastṃ pānabhojanam| sa kathannu kaṣāyāṇi ti
meaning: How will my son for whom the cooks with kundalas in their ears used to proudly prepare enough food and beverages subsist on astringent, pungent, bitter wild fruits and roots?

sanskrit: महार्हवस्त्रसंवीतो भूत्वा चिरसुखोषितः।।2.12.100।। काषायपरिधानस्तु कथं भूमौनिवत्स्यति।
transliteration: mahārhavastrasṃvīto bhūtvā cirasukhoṣitḥ||2.12.100|| kāṣāyaparidhānastu kathṃ bhūmaunivatsyati|
meaning: How will he who was habituated to wearing expensive apparels and to (royal) comforts over a long period of time live (sleep) on the ground, putting on saffron robes?

sanskrit: कस्यैतद्धारुणं वाक्यमेवंविधमचिन्तितम्।।2.12.101।। रामस्यारण्यगमनं भरतस्याभिषेचनम्।
transliteration: kasyaitaddhāruṇṃ vākyamevṃvidhamacintitam||2.12.101|| rāmasyāraṇyagamanṃ bharatasyābhiṣecanam|
meaning: Whose are these dreadful words, this inconceivable plan of Rama's exilement and Bharata's enthronement?

sanskrit: धिगस्तु योषितो नाम शठा स्स्वार्थपरास्सदा। न ब्रवीमि स्त्रिय स्सर्वा भरतस्यैव मातरम्।।2.12.102।।
transliteration: dhigastu yoṣito nāma śaṭhā ssvārthaparāssadā| na bravīmi striya ssarvā bharatasyaiva mātaram||2.12.102||
meaning: A woman means one who secretly harms others. This is shameful indeed. They always seek selfish interests. I do not say this of all women, only of Bharata's mother.

sanskrit: अनर्थभावेऽर्थपरे नृशंसे ममानुतापाय निविष्टभावे। किमप्रियं पश्यसि मन्निमित्तं हितानुकारिण्यथवाऽपि रामे।।2.12.103।।
transliteration: anarthabhāve'rthapare nṛśṃse mamānutāpāya niviṣṭabhāve| kimapriyṃ paśyasi mannimittṃ hitānukāriṇyathavā'pi rāme||2.12.10
meaning: O malicious one, O covetous one, O cruel one, O woman determined to torment me, what fault have you seen in Rama who is always devoted to the welfare of others?

sanskrit: परित्यजेयुः पितरो हि पुत्रान्भार्याः पतींश्चापि कृतानुरागाः। कृत्स्नं हि सर्वं कुपितं जगत्स्याद्दृष्ट्वैव रामं व्यसने नि
transliteration: parityajeyuḥ pitaro hi putrānbhāryāḥ patīṃścāpi kṛtānurāgāḥ| kṛtsnṃ hi sarvṃ kupitṃ jagatsyāddṛṣṭvaiva rāmṃ vyasane nima
meaning: This entire world will be inflamed to see Rama plunged in adversity. Fathers will abandon their sons. Wives, attached to their husbands, will forsake them.
