sanskrit: अहं पुनर्देवकुमाररूपमलङ्कृतं तं सुतमाव्रजन्तम्। नन्दामि पश्यन्नपि दर्शनेन भवामि दृष्ट्वैव च पुनर्युवेव।।2.12.105।।
transliteration: ahṃ punardevakumārarūpamalaṅkṛtṃ tṃ sutamāvrajantam| nandāmi paśyannapi darśanena bhavāmi dṛṣṭvaiva ca punaryuveva||2.12
meaning: When I see my son, handsome and welladorned like the son of a celestial deity, coming towards me, I rejoice. Even his very sight makes me grow young again.

sanskrit: विनाऽपि सूर्येण भवेत्प्रवृत्तिरवर्षता वज्रधरेण वाऽपि। रामं तु गच्छन्तमित स्समीक्ष्य जीवेन्न कश्चित्त्विति चेतना मे।।2.12
transliteration: vinā'pi sūryeṇa bhavetpravṛttiravarṣatā vajradhareṇa vā'pi| rāmṃ tu gacchantamita ssamīkṣya jīvenna kaścittviti cetanā m
meaning: Nature's activity will continue even without the Sun or even if Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, sends no rain but none will live to see Rama departing to the forest. This is my conviction.

sanskrit: विनाशकामामहिताममित्रामावासयं मृत्युमिवात्मनस्त्वाम्। चिरं बताङ्केन धृतासि सर्पी महाविषा तेन हतोऽस्मि मोहात्।।2.12.107।।
transliteration: vināśakāmāmahitāmamitrāmāvāsayṃ mṛtyumivātmanastvām| cirṃ batāṅkena dhṛtāsi sarpī mahāviṣā tena hato'smi mohāt||2.12.107
meaning: Alas I carried all along on my lap a highly poisonous female snake I gave you shelter while you were like death .This delusion is the cause of my ruin.You were my enemy. You wished me harm. You wished my destruction.

sanskrit: मया च रामेण च लक्ष्मणेन प्रशास्तु हीनो भरतस्त्वया सह। पुरं च राष्ट्रं च निहत्य बान्धवान् ममाहितानां च भवाभिहर्षिणी।।2.12
transliteration: mayā ca rāmeṇa ca lakṣmaṇena praśāstu hīno bharatastvayā saha| purṃ ca rāṣṭrṃ ca nihatya bāndhavān mamāhitānāṃ ca bhavāb
meaning: With Rama and Lakshmana withdrawn from me, my kinsmen killed, let Bharata along with you rule the city and the kingdom causing delight to my enemies.

sanskrit: नृशंसवृत्ते व्यसनप्रहारिणि प्रसह्य वाक्यं यदिहाद्य भाषसे। न नाम ते केन मुखात्पतन्त्यधो विशीर्यमाणा दशना स्सहस्रधा।।2.12.
transliteration: nṛśṃsavṛtte vyasanaprahāriṇi prasahya vākyṃ yadihādya bhāṣase| na nāma te kena mukhātpatantyadho viśīryamāṇā daśanā ssah
meaning: O cruelhearted woman, you strike one in adversity. Why are your teeth with which you are now speaking (such harsh words) do not fall to the ground, broken into a thousand fragments?

sanskrit: न किञ्चिदाहाहितमप्रियं वचो न वेत्ति रामः परुषाणि भाषितुम्। कथन्नु रामे ह्यभिरामवादिनि ब्रवीषि दोषान्गुणनित्यसम्मते।।2.12
transliteration: na kiñcidāhāhitamapriyṃ vaco na vetti rāmḥ paruṣāṇi bhāṣitum| kathannu rāme hyabhirāmavādini bravīṣi doṣānguṇanityasamma
meaning: How do you find fault with Rama who does not utter even one harmful or unpalatable word, who does not know how to use harsh words, and who speaks pleasingly and who is always honoured for his virtues?

sanskrit: प्रताम्य वा प्रज्वल वा प्रणश्य वा सहस्रशो वा स्फुटिता महीं व्रज। न ते करिष्यामि वच स्सुदारुणं ममाहितं केकयराजपांसनि।।2.1
transliteration: pratāmya vā prajvala vā praṇaśya vā sahasraśo vā sphuṭitā mahīṃ vraja| na te kariṣyāmi vaca ssudāruṇṃ mamāhitṃ kekayarāj
meaning: O obloquy on the house of Kekaya, you may grieve or burn yourself in the fire, or get destroyed. Even if you fall down on earth broken into a thousand pieces I will not act on your terrible, harmful words.

sanskrit: क्षुरोपमां नित्यमसत्प्रियंवदां प्रदुष्टभावां स्वकुलोपघातिनीम्। न जीवितुं त्वां विषहेऽमनोरमां दिधक्षमाणां हृदयं सबन्धनम्।
transliteration: kṣuropamāṃ nityamasatpriyṃvadāṃ praduṣṭabhāvāṃ svakulopaghātinīm| na jīvituṃ tvāṃ viṣahe'manoramāṃ didhakṣamāṇāṃ hṛdayṃ
meaning: You are like a knife. You always speak palatable lies. You are malevolent. You are a destroyer of your own race. You displease the mind. You are intent on burning down all the links of my heart. I cannot bear to see you

sanskrit: न जीवितं मेऽस्ति पुनःकुत स्सुखं विनाऽऽत्मजेनाऽत्मवतः कुतो रतिः। ममाहितं देवि न कर्तुमर्हसि स्पृशामि पादावपि ते प्रसीद मे
transliteration: na jīvitṃ me'sti punḥkuta ssukhṃ vinā''tmajenā'tmavatḥ kuto ratiḥ| mamāhitṃ devi na kartumarhasi spṛśāmi pādāvapi te pra
meaning: There is no life for me without my son (Rama). What to speak of happiness again? Where is pleasure for a selfrespecting man like me? O queen, it does not behove you to do this harmful act. I will touch your feet. Show pi

sanskrit: स भूमिपालो विलपन्ननाथवत्स्त्रिया गृहीतो हृदयेऽतिमात्रया। पपात देव्याश्चरणौ प्रसारितावुभावसम्स्पृश्य यथाऽतुरस्तथा।।2.12.1
transliteration: sa bhūmipālo vilapannanāthavatstriyā gṛhīto hṛdaye'timātrayā| papāta devyāścaraṇau prasāritāvubhāvasamspṛśya yathā'turas
meaning: The king, with his heart in the grip of a woman, wailing like an orphan tried to reach her feet, exceeding the limit of selfrespect but, unable to touch them as she pulled them apart, he collapsed like a sick man. इत्यार

sanskrit: अथवा गम्यतां शीघ्रं नाहमिच्छामि निर्घृणाम्।।2.13.18।। नृशंसां कैकयीं द्रष्टुं यत्कृते व्यसनं महत्।
transliteration: athavā gamyatāṃ śīghrṃ nāhamicchāmi nirghṛṇām||2.13.18|| nṛśṃsāṃ kaikayīṃ draṣṭuṃ yatkṛte vyasanṃ mahat|
meaning: 'Or, pass off quickly. I do not want to see this merciless, malicious Kaikeyi who is the cause of this great misfortune'.

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजा कैकेयीं संयताञ्जलिः।।2.13.19।। प्रसादयामास पुनः कैकेयीं चेदमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: evamuktvā tato rājā kaikeyīṃ sṃyatāñjaliḥ||2.13.19|| prasādayāmāsa punḥ kaikeyīṃ cedamabravīt|
meaning: Having said this, the king spoke again with folded hands to Kaikeyi in order to appease her:

sanskrit: सत्यमेकपदं ब्रह्म सत्ये धर्मः प्रतिष्टितः। सत्यमेवाक्षया वेदा सत्येनैवाप्यते स्परम्।।2.14.7।।
transliteration: satyamekapadṃ brahma satye dharmḥ pratiṣṭitḥ| satyamevākṣayā vedā satyenaivāpyate sparam||2.14.7||
meaning: Truth is Brahman in one word. Righteousness is firmly established in truth. Truth is the imperishable Vedas. The supreme state can be attained by means of truth.

sanskrit: सत्यं समनुवर्तस्व यदि धर्मे धृता मतिः। सफलस्स वरो मेऽस्तु वरदो ह्यसि सत्तम।।2.14.8।।
transliteration: satyṃ samanuvartasva yadi dharme dhṛtā matiḥ| saphalassa varo me'stu varado hyasi sattama||2.14.8||
meaning: O excellent one, if your mind is firmly fixed in righteousness, then by following it fulfil the boon granted to me.You are the bestower of boons indeed

sanskrit: धर्मस्यैहाभिकामार्थं मम चैवाभिचोदनात्। प्रव्राजय सुतं रामं त्रिःखलु त्वां ब्रवीम्यहम्।।2.14.9।।
transliteration: dharmasyaihābhikāmārthṃ mama caivābhicodanāt| pravrājaya sutṃ rāmṃ triḥkhalu tvāṃ bravīmyaham||2.14.9||
meaning: You must uphold righteousness. I also urge you to do that. Send your son Rama to the forest. I am repeating this statememt thrice.

sanskrit: न च शक्तोऽस्म्यहं द्रष्टुं दृष्ट्वा पूर्वं तथासुखम्। हतहर्षं निरानन्दं पुनर्जनमवाङ्मुखम्।।2.14.18।।
transliteration: na ca śakto'smyahṃ draṣṭuṃ dṛṣṭvā pūrvṃ tathāsukham| hataharṣṃ nirānandṃ punarjanamavāṅmukham||2.14.18||
meaning: Having seen people formerly enjoying happiness, I cannot see them again with their downcast, cheerless faces devoid of all happiness.

sanskrit: तां तथा ब्रुवतस्तस्य भूमिपस्य महात्मनः। प्रभाता शर्वरी पुण्या चन्द्रनक्षत्रशालिनी।।2.14.19।।
transliteration: tāṃ tathā bruvatastasya bhūmipasya mahātmanḥ| prabhātā śarvarī puṇyā candranakṣatraśālinī||2.14.19||
meaning: While the king was thus speaking to her (Kaikeyi) that holy night resplendent with the Moon and the stars, the day dawned.

sanskrit: किमिदं भाषसे राजन्वाक्यं गररुजोपमम्। आनाययितुमक्लिष्टं पुत्रं राममिहार्हसि।।2.14.21।।
transliteration: kimidṃ bhāṣase rājanvākyṃ gararujopamam| ānāyayitumakliṣṭṃ putrṃ rāmamihārhasi||2.14.21||
meaning: O king, why are you speaking these painful, poisonous words? What is this? It behoves you to summon your son Rama who does not expearience this pain.

sanskrit: स्थाप्य राज्ये मम सुतं कृत्वा रामं वनेचरम्। निस्सपत्नां च मां कृत्वा कृतकृत्यो भविष्यसि।।2.14.22।।
transliteration: sthāpya rājye mama sutṃ kṛtvā rāmṃ vanecaram| nissapatnāṃ ca māṃ kṛtvā kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyasi||2.14.22||
meaning: Only after you have installed my son in the kingdom and sent Rama to the forest and made me free from rivals, you shall have your duty fulfiled.

sanskrit: ततः प्रभातां रजनीमुदिते च दिवाकरे। पुण्ये नक्षत्रयोगे च मुहूर्ते च समाहिते।।2.14.25।। वसिष्ठो गुणसम्पन्न श्शिष्यै परिवृत
transliteration: tatḥ prabhātāṃ rajanīmudite ca divākare| puṇye nakṣatrayoge ca muhūrte ca samāhite||2.14.25|| vasiṣṭho guṇasampanna śśiṣ
meaning: The night dawned. Ths Sun rose. The auspicious time with the sacred star in (favourable) conjunction arrived. The virtuous Vasistha, surrounded by his disciples, soon entered the best of abodes with the articles collecte

sanskrit: सिक्तसम्मार्जितपथां पताकोत्तम भूषिताम्। विचित्रकुसुमाकीर्णां नानास्रग्भिर्विराजिताम्।।2.14.27।। संहृष्टमनुजोपेतां समृद्ध
transliteration: siktasammārjitapathāṃ patākottama bhūṣitām| vicitrakusumākīrṇāṃ nānāsragbhirvirājitām||2.14.27|| sṃhṛṣṭamanujopetāṃ samṛ
meaning: The streets in Ayodhya were swept and sprinkled with water, decorated with excellent flags, strewn with flowers of variegated colours and bedecked with various flower garlands. The streets were crowded with curious peopl

sanskrit: इमे गङ्गोदकघटा स्सागरेभ्यश्च काञ्चनाः।।2.14.34।। औदुम्बरं भद्रपीठमभिषेकार्थमागतम्। सर्वबीजानि गन्धाश्च रत्नानि विविधानि
transliteration: ime gaṅgodakaghaṭā ssāgarebhyaśca kāñcanāḥ||2.14.34|| audumbarṃ bhadrapīṭhamabhiṣekārthamāgatam| sarvabījāni gandhāśca r
meaning: Here are the pots filled with water from river Ganga and golden vessels with water from the seas. And throne made of udumbara wood for the installation ceremony. All kinds of seeds, perfumes, different kinds of precious

sanskrit: त्वरयस्व महाराजं यथा समुदितेऽहनि।।2.14.42।। पुष्ये नक्षत्रयोगे च रामो राज्यमवाप्नुयात्।
transliteration: tvarayasva mahārājṃ yathā samudite'hani||2.14.42|| puṣye nakṣatrayoge ca rāmo rājyamavāpnuyāt|
meaning: Hasten the maharaja as Rama has to be installed in the kingdom as soon as the day breaks under the conjunction of the sacred Pushya star.

sanskrit: इति तस्य वच श्श्रुत्वा सूतपुत्रो महात्मनः।।2.14.43।। स्तुवन्नृपतिशार्दूलं प्रविवेश निवेशनम्।
transliteration: iti tasya vaca śśrutvā sūtaputro mahātmanḥ||2.14.43|| stuvannṛpatiśārdūlṃ praviveśa niveśanam|
meaning: Having heard the words of the great Vasistha, charioteer Sumantra entered the inner apartment, singing the praise of this tiger among kings (Dasaratha).

sanskrit: तं तु पूर्वोदितं वृध्दं द्वारस्था राज सम्मतम्।।2.14.44।। न शेकुरभिसंरोध्दुं राज्ञः प्रियचिकीर्षवः।
transliteration: tṃ tu pūrvoditṃ vṛdhdṃ dvārasthā rāja sammatam||2.14.44|| na śekurabhisṃrodhduṃ rājñḥ priyacikīrṣavḥ|
meaning: The doorkeepers, beloved wellwishers of the king, did not detain aged Sumantra who was liked by the king and who had arrived early.

sanskrit: स समीपस्थितो राज्ञस्तामवस्थामजज्ञिवान्।।2.14.45।। वाग्भिः परमतुष्टाभिरभिष्टोतुं प्रचक्रमे।
transliteration: sa samīpasthito rājñastāmavasthāmajajñivān||2.14.45|| vāgbhiḥ paramatuṣṭābhirabhiṣṭotuṃ pracakrame|
meaning: Sumantra approached the king unaware of the state of his mind and commenced praising him in highly pleasing words (as usual).

sanskrit: तत स्सूतो यथाकालं पार्थिवस्य निवेशने।।2.14.46।। सुमन्त्रः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा तुष्टाव जगतीपतिम्।
transliteration: tata ssūto yathākālṃ pārthivasya niveśane||2.14.46|| sumantrḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā tuṣṭāva jagatīpatim|
meaning: Thereafter the charioteer Sumantra entered the inner apartment of the king, and with folded hands began singing the praise of the lord of the earth appropriate to the hour.

sanskrit: यथा नन्दति तेजस्वी सागरो भास्करोदये।।2.14.47।। प्रीतः प्रीतेन मनसा तथाऽनन्दघन स्स्वतः।
transliteration: yathā nandati tejasvī sāgaro bhāskarodaye||2.14.47|| prītḥ prītena manasā tathā'nandaghana ssvatḥ|
meaning: Just as the mighty ocean rejoices at sunrise, the inherently cheerful Sumantra became delighted to see the king.

sanskrit: इन्द्रमस्यां तु वेलायामभितुष्टाव मातलिः।।2.14.48।। सोऽजयद्दानवान्सर्वांस्तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम्।
transliteration: indramasyāṃ tu velāyāmabhituṣṭāva mātaliḥ||2.14.48|| so'jayaddānavānsarvāṃstathā tvāṃ bodhayāmyaham|
meaning: Just as Indra's charioteer at this time (at dawn) extols him, the conquerer of demons, so do I rouse you (with a song).

sanskrit: वेदास्सहाङ्गविद्याश्च यथाह्यात्मभुवं विभुम्।।2.14.49। ब्रह्माणं बोधयन्त्यद्य तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम्।
transliteration: vedāssahāṅgavidyāśca yathāhyātmabhuvṃ vibhum||2.14.49| brahmāṇṃ bodhayantyadya tathā tvāṃ bodhayāmyaham|
meaning: Just as the Vedas and Vedangas awaken the selfborn lord Brahma, so do I awaken you.

sanskrit: आदित्यस्सह चन्द्रेण यथा भूतधरां शुभाम्।।2.14.50।। बोधयत्यद्य पृथिवीं तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम्।
transliteration: ādityassaha candreṇa yathā bhūtadharāṃ śubhām||2.14.50|| bodhayatyadya pṛthivīṃ tathā tvāṃ bodhayāmyaham|
meaning: As the Sun along with the Moon awakens the auspicious earth which supports all beings, in the same way I am awakening you today.

sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठाशु महाराज कृतकौतुकमङ्गलः।।2.14.51।। विराजमानो वपुषा मेरोरिव दिवाकरः।
transliteration: uttiṣṭhāśu mahārāja kṛtakautukamaṅgalḥ||2.14.51|| virājamāno vapuṣā meroriva divākarḥ|
meaning: O mighty king get up at once like the Sun rising up mount Meru. Put on your beautiful body auspicious robes befitting the festivity.

sanskrit: सोमसूर्यौ च काकुत्स्थ शिववैश्रवणावपि।।2.14.52।। वरुणश्चाग्निरिन्द्रश्च विजयं प्रदिशन्तु ते।
transliteration: somasūryau ca kākutstha śivavaiśravaṇāvapi||2.14.52|| varuṇaścāgnirindraśca vijayṃ pradiśantu te|
meaning: O descendent of Kakutstha, may Moon and Sun, Siva and Kubera, Varuna, Agni and Indra bestow victory on you.

sanskrit: गता भगवती रात्रिः कृतं कृत्यमिदं तव।।2.14.53।। बुद्ध्यस्व नृपशार्दूल कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम्। उदतिष्ठत रामस्य समग्रमभिषेचनम्।
transliteration: gatā bhagavatī rātriḥ kṛtṃ kṛtyamidṃ tava||2.14.53|| buddhyasva nṛpaśārdūla kuru kāryamanantaram| udatiṣṭhata rāmasya sa
meaning: O best among kings the holy night has passed. Having been acquainted with the acts accomplished so far, perform whatever is further necessary for the installation ceremony. All preparations for Rama's coronation ceremony

sanskrit: पौरजानापदैश्चापि नैगमैश्च कृताञ्जलिः। स्वयं वशिष्ठो भगवान्ब्राह्मणै स्सह तिष्ठति।।2.14.55।।
transliteration: paurajānāpadaiścāpi naigamaiśca kṛtāñjaliḥ| svayṃ vaśiṣṭho bhagavānbrāhmaṇai ssaha tiṣṭhati||2.14.55||
meaning: Venerable Vasistha along with inhabitants of the city and countryside including merchants and brahmins with folded hands awaits you.

sanskrit: क्षिप्रमाज्ञाप्यतां राजन्राघवस्याभिषेचनम्। यथा ह्यपालाः पशवो यथा सेना ह्यनायका।।2.14.56।। यथा चन्द्रं विना रात्रिर्यथा ग
transliteration: kṣipramājñāpyatāṃ rājanrāghavasyābhiṣecanam| yathā hyapālāḥ paśavo yathā senā hyanāyakā||2.14.56|| yathā candrṃ vinā rāt
meaning: O king Rama's installation may be promptly ordered. As herds without herdsman, army without commander, night without the Moon, and cows without a bull, so is a kingdom without a king.

sanskrit: इति तस्य वच श्शृत्वा सान्त्वपूर्वमिवार्थवत्। अभ्यकीर्यत शोकेन भूय एव महीपतिः।।2.14.58।।
transliteration: iti tasya vaca śśṛtvā sāntvapūrvamivārthavat| abhyakīryata śokena bhūya eva mahīpatiḥ||2.14.58||
meaning: Hearing these meaningful words of Sumantra uttered in an appealing tone, the lord of the earth relapsed into grief.

sanskrit: तत स्सराजा तं सूतं सन्नहर्ष स्सुतं प्रति। शोकरक्तेक्षण श्श्रीमानुद्वीक्ष्योवाच धार्मिकः।।2.14.59।। वाक्यैस्तु खलु मर्माण
transliteration: tata ssarājā tṃ sūtṃ sannaharṣa ssutṃ prati| śokaraktekṣaṇa śśrīmānudvīkṣyovāca dhārmikḥ||2.14.59|| vākyaistu khalu marm
meaning: The virtuous and glorious king thinking of his son without cheer looked upward with eyes red with tears and said to the charioteer, You are causing my heart excruciating pain with your words.

sanskrit: सुमन्त्रः करुणं श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा दीनं च पार्थिवम्। प्रगृहीताञ्जलिः किञ्चित्तस्माद्देशादपाक्रमत्।।2.14.60।।
transliteration: sumantrḥ karuṇṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā dīnṃ ca pārthivam| pragṛhītāñjaliḥ kiñcittasmāddeśādapākramat||2.14.60||
meaning: Having heard the sorrowful words of the king and having seen his wretched state Sumantra with palms folded moved away a little from the place.

sanskrit: यदा वक्तुं स्वयं दैन्यान्न शशाक महीपतिः।।2.14.61।। तदा सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रज्ञा कैकेयी प्रत्युवाच ह।
transliteration: yadā vaktuṃ svayṃ dainyānna śaśāka mahīpatiḥ||2.14.61|| tadā sumantrṃ mantrajñā kaikeyī pratyuvāca ha|
meaning: When the king himself in that wretched state was not able to speak to Sumantra, crafty Kaikeyi said to him in reply:

sanskrit: सुमन्त्र राजा रजनीं रामहर्षसमुत्सुकः।।2.14.62।। प्रजागरपरिश्रान्तो निद्राया वशमुपेयिवान्।
transliteration: sumantra rājā rajanīṃ rāmaharṣasamutsukḥ||2.14.62|| prajāgarapariśrānto nidrāyā vaśamupeyivān|
meaning: O Sumantra, excited with joy on account of the (proposed) installation of Rama, the king did not have a wink of sleep all night. He is weary and overpowered with sleep.

sanskrit: तद्गच्छ त्वरितं सूत राजपुत्रं यशस्विनम्।।2.14.63।। राममानय भद्रं ते नात्र कार्या विचारणा।
transliteration: tadgaccha tvaritṃ sūta rājaputrṃ yaśasvinam||2.14.63|| rāmamānaya bhadrṃ te nātra kāryā vicāraṇā|
meaning: So, O Sumantra quickly fetch the gentle, illustrious prince Rama. Let there be no hesitation in this matter.

sanskrit: स मन्यमानः कल्याणं हृदयेन ननन्द च।।2.14.64।। निर्जगाम च सम्प्रीत्या त्वरितो राजशासनात्।
transliteration: sa manyamānḥ kalyāṇṃ hṛdayena nananda ca||2.14.64|| nirjagāma ca samprītyā tvarito rājaśāsanāt|
meaning: Thinking that an auspicious event will take place, he rejoiced at heart and in obedience to royal order, left at once.

sanskrit: सुमन्त्रश्चिन्तयामास त्वरितं चोदितस्तया।।2.14.65।। व्यक्तं रामोऽभिषेकार्थमिहायास्यति धर्मवित्।
transliteration: sumantraścintayāmāsa tvaritṃ coditastayā||2.14.65|| vyaktṃ rāmo'bhiṣekārthamihāyāsyati dharmavit|
meaning: Urged by Kaikeyi, Sumantra thought 'Righteous Rama will definitely come here for the purpose of installation'.

sanskrit: इति सूतो मतिं कृत्वा हर्षेण महताऽऽवृतः।।2.14.66।। निर्जगाम महाबाहो राघवस्य दिदृक्षया।
transliteration: iti sūto matiṃ kṛtvā harṣeṇa mahatā''vṛtḥ||2.14.66|| nirjagāma mahābāho rāghavasya didṛkṣayā|
meaning: So thought the charioteer and filled with great delight left (the inner apartment), eager to see the mightyarmed Rama.

sanskrit: सागरह्रदसङ्काशात्सुमन्त्रोऽन्तःपुराच्छुभात्।।2.14.67।। निष्क्रम्य जनसम्बाधं ददर्श द्वारमग्रतः।
transliteration: sāgarahradasaṅkāśātsumantro'ntḥpurācchubhāt||2.14.67|| niṣkramya janasambādhṃ dadarśa dvāramagratḥ|
meaning: Sumantra, departed from the auspcious inner apartment which looked like the deep waters of the sea and saw people thronging the gate.

sanskrit: ततः पुरस्तात्सहसा विनिर्गतो महीपतीन्द्वारगतो विलोकयन्। ददर्श पौरान्विविधान्महाधना नुपस्थितान्द्वारमुपेत्य विष्ठितान्।।2.
transliteration: tatḥ purastātsahasā vinirgato mahīpatīndvāragato vilokayan| dadarśa paurānvividhānmahādhanā nupasthitāndvāramupetya viṣṭ
meaning: Then Sumantra hastened towards the gate where he saw kings, wealthy people and citizens who had already arrived and waiting there. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुर्दशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the

sanskrit: काञ्चना जलकुम्भाश्च भद्रपीठं स्वलंकृतम्।।2.15,4।। रथः च सम्यगास्तीर्णो भास्वता व्याघ्रचर्मणा।
transliteration: kāñcanā jalakumbhāśca bhadrapīṭhṃ svalṃkṛtam||2.15,4|| rathḥ ca samyagāstīrṇo bhāsvatā vyāghracarmaṇā|
meaning: Golden jars filled with water, the welldecorated throne and a chariot spread well with bright tigerskin (were kept ready).

sanskrit: गङ्गायमुनयोःपुण्यात्सङ्गमादाहृतं जलम्।।2.15.5।। याश्चान्या स्सरितः पुण्या ह्रदाः कूपा स्सरांसि च। प्राग्वाहाश्चोर्ध्ववाह
transliteration: gaṅgāyamunayoḥpuṇyātsaṅgamādāhṛtṃ jalam||2.15.5|| yāścānyā ssaritḥ puṇyā hradāḥ kūpā ssarāṃsi ca| prāgvāhāścordhvavāhāśc
meaning: Water had been fetched from the sacred confluence of Ganga and Yamuna, from other holy streams, wells, ponds and lakes, from rivers flowing eastward, westward, and zigzag, from rivers from all directions joined together.

sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकूणां यथा राज्ये संभ्रियेताभिषेचनम्।।2.15.13।। तथाजातीयमादाय राजपुत्राभिषेचनम्। ते राजवचनात्तत्र समवेतामहीपतिम्।।
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇāṃ yathā rājye sṃbhriyetābhiṣecanam||2.15.13|| tathājātīyamādāya rājaputrābhiṣecanam| te rājavacanāttatra samave
meaning: Just as articles necessary for the consecration of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, are customarily arranged in the kingdom, in the same way things were arranged for the coronation of the prince belonging to that race.

sanskrit: इति तेषु ब्रुवाणेषु सार्वभौमान् महीपतीन्।।2.15.16।। अब्रवीत्तानिदं सर्वान्सुमन्त्रो राजसत्कृतः।
transliteration: iti teṣu bruvāṇeṣu sārvabhaumān mahīpatīn||2.15.16|| abravīttānidṃ sarvānsumantro rājasatkṛtḥ|
meaning: While the sovereign monarchs who hailed from different parts of the earth were thus talking Sumantra the king's confidant said:

sanskrit: रामं राज्ञो नियोगेन त्वरया प्रस्थितोऽस्म्यहम्।।2.15.17।। पूज्या राज्ञो भवन्तस्तु रामस्य च विशेषतः।
transliteration: rāmṃ rājño niyogena tvarayā prasthito'smyaham||2.15.17|| pūjyā rājño bhavantastu rāmasya ca viśeṣatḥ|
meaning: In obedience to the king's command I am hurrying for Rama. All of you are honourable to king Dasaratha, especially to Rama.

sanskrit: अयं पृच्छामि वचनात्सुखमायुष्मतामहम्।।2.15.18।। राज्ञः संप्रति बुद्धस्य यच्चागमनकारणम्।
transliteration: ayṃ pṛcchāmi vacanātsukhamāyuṣmatāmaham||2.15.18|| rājñḥ sṃprati buddhasya yaccāgamanakāraṇam|
meaning: On your behalf I shall enquire from the king who is awake now about his welfare and the reason for calling me here.

sanskrit: सोऽत्यासाद्य तु तद्वेश्म तिरस्करणिमन्तरा।।2.15.21।। आशीर्भिर्गुणयुक्ताभि रभितुष्टाव राघवम्।
transliteration: so'tyāsādya tu tadveśma tiraskaraṇimantarā||2.15.21|| āśīrbhirguṇayuktābhi rabhituṣṭāva rāghavam|
meaning: Having approached the king's bedchamber Sumatra stood behind the screen, singing his glory and seeking the blessings (of God) on this son of Raghus dynasty.

sanskrit: सोमसूर्यौ च काकुत्स्थ शिववैश्रवणावपि।।2.15.22।। वरुणश्चाग्निरिन्द्रश्च विजयं प्रदिशन्तु ते।
transliteration: somasūryau ca kākutstha śivavaiśravaṇāvapi||2.15.22|| varuṇaścāgnirindraśca vijayṃ pradiśantu te|
meaning: O scion of the kakutsthas (Dasaratha), may Moon and Sun, Siva and Kubera, Varuna, Agni and Indra grant you victory

sanskrit: गता भगवती रात्रिरहः शिवमुपस्थितम्।।2.15.23।। बुद्ध्यस्व नृपशार्दूल कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम्।
transliteration: gatā bhagavatī rātrirahḥ śivamupasthitam||2.15.23|| buddhyasva nṛpaśārdūla kuru kāryamanantaram|
meaning: The holy night has passed and the auspicious day has arrived. O tiger among kings, awaken and attend to your duties.

sanskrit: महाकवाटविहितं वितर्दिशतशोभितम्।।2.15.32।। काञ्चनप्रतिमैकाग्रं मणिविद्रुमतोरणम्। शारदाभ्रघनप्रख्यं दीप्तं मेरुगुहोपमम्।।2
transliteration: mahākavāṭavihitṃ vitardiśataśobhitam||2.15.32|| kāñcanapratimaikāgrṃ maṇividrumatoraṇam| śāradābhraghanaprakhyṃ dīptṃ me
meaning: The charioteer (Sumantra) beheld Rama's palace closed with two heavypanelled doors. Adorned with hundreds of galleries, it had a peak mounted with golden idols. The arches were studded with different gems and corals. Bri

sanskrit: स वाजियुक्तेन रथेन सारथिः नराकुलं राजकुलं विराजयन्। वरूथिना रामगृहाभिपातिना पुरस्य सर्वस्य मनांसि हर्षयन्।।2.15.41।।
transliteration: sa vājiyuktena rathena sārathiḥ narākulṃ rājakulṃ virājayan| varūthinā rāmagṛhābhipātinā purasya sarvasya manāṃsi harṣay
meaning: Mounted on a chariot, attached with a fender and driven by horses, the charioteer advanced towards the royal palace of Rama delighting the minds of the people of the city.

sanskrit: ततस्समासाद्य महाधनं महत् प्रहृष्टरोमा स बभूब सारथिः। मृर्गैर्मयूरैश्च समाकुलोल्बणं गृहं वरार्हस्य शचीपतेरिव।।2.15.42।।
transliteration: tatassamāsādya mahādhanṃ mahat prahṛṣṭaromā sa babhūba sārathiḥ| mṛrgairmayūraiśca samākulolbaṇṃ gṛhṃ varārhasya śacīpat
meaning: Having reached the palace abounding in deer and peacocks which resembled the magnificent and opulent abode of Indra, the charioteer was thrilled at the allpervading beauty of the place befitting Rama.

sanskrit: स तत्र कैलासनिभास्स्वलंकृताः प्रविश्य कक्ष्यास्त्रिदशालयोपमाः। प्रियान्वरान् राममते स्थितान् बहून् व्यपोह्य शुद्धान्तमुप
transliteration: sa tatra kailāsanibhāssvalṃkṛtāḥ praviśya kakṣyāstridaśālayopamāḥ| priyānvarān rāmamate sthitān bahūn vyapohya śuddhānta
meaning: Having entered the welldecorated palace which was (lofty) like Kailasa, he crossed the courtyards comparable to the abode of the celestials, passed through the many bosom friends of Rama and entered the private apartment

sanskrit: स तत्र शुश्राव च हर्षयुक्ताः रामाभिषेकार्थकृता जनानाम्। नरेन्द्रसूनोरभिमङ्गलार्थाः सर्वस्य लोकस्य गिरः प्रहृष्टः।।2.15.4
transliteration: sa tatra śuśrāva ca harṣayuktāḥ rāmābhiṣekārthakṛtā janānām| narendrasūnorabhimaṅgalārthāḥ sarvasya lokasya girḥ prahṛṣṭ
meaning: There he heard the happy words spoken by people about the enthronement of prince Rama and his future wellbeing.

sanskrit: महेन्द्रसद्मप्रतिमं तु वेश्म रामस्य रम्यं मृगपक्षि जुष्टम्। ददर्श मेरोरिव श्रुङ्गमुच्चं विभ्राजमानं प्रभया सुमन्त्रः।।2.
transliteration: mahendrasadmapratimṃ tu veśma rāmasya ramyṃ mṛgapakṣi juṣṭam| dadarśa meroriva śruṅgamuccṃ vibhrājamānṃ prabhayā sumantr
meaning: Sumantra beheld Rama's palace which resembled the high summit of mount Meru shining with splendour. Filled with animals and birds, if looked like the abode of Indra.

sanskrit: उपस्थितैरञ्जलिकारकैश्च सोपायनैर्जानपदैर्जनैश्च। कोट्या परार्धैश्च विमुक्तयानैः समाकुलं द्वारपथं ददर्श।।2.15.46।।
transliteration: upasthitairañjalikārakaiśca sopāyanairjānapadairjanaiśca| koṭyā parārdhaiśca vimuktayānaiḥ samākulṃ dvārapathṃ dadarśa||
meaning: He saw villagers and others in crores and parardhas, leaving their chariots and thronging the gateway, (some) paying obeisance with folded palms and (some) carrying gifts in their hands.

sanskrit: ततो महामेघमहीधराभं प्रभिन्नमत्यङ्कुशमत्यसह्यम्। रामौपवाह्यं रुचिरं ददर्श शत्रुञ्जयं नागमुदग्रकायम्।।2.15.47।।
transliteration: tato mahāmeghamahīdharābhṃ prabhinnamatyaṅkuśamatyasahyam| rāmaupavāhyṃ rucirṃ dadarśa śatruñjayṃ nāgamudagrakāyam||2.15
meaning: He beheld a beautiful elephant named Satrunjaya with a huge body on which Rama was to mount. It looked like a vast mountain or a huge cloud. With ichor flowing from his temples and without caring for the goad, the elepha

sanskrit: स्वलङ्कृतान् साश्वरथान् सकुञ्जरा नमात्य मुख्यांश्च ददर्श वल्लभान्। व्यपोह्य सूतस्सहितान् समन्ततः समृद्धमन्तःपुरमाविवेश ह
transliteration: svalaṅkṛtān sāśvarathān sakuñjarā namātya mukhyāṃśca dadarśa vallabhān| vyapohya sūtassahitān samantatḥ samṛddhamantḥpur
meaning: Important ministers who were dear to the king and welladorned arrived there on their horses, chariots and elephants. Sumantra finding his way through the crowd of the people who assembled on all sides, entered the glorio

sanskrit: तदन्द्रिकूटाचलमेघसन्निभं महाविमानोपमवेश्मसंयुतम्। अवार्यमाणः प्रविवेश सारथिः प्रभूतरत्नं मकरो यथार्णवम्।।2.15.49।।
transliteration: tadandrikūṭācalameghasannibhṃ mahāvimānopamaveśmasṃyutam| avāryamāṇḥ praviveśa sārathiḥ prabhūtaratnṃ makaro yathārṇavam
meaning: The palace looked like a mountain peak covered by a cloud and a great vimana surrounded by splendid apartments. The charioteer entered the palace unobstructed like a crocodile entering the ocean bristling with many gems.

sanskrit: तं वैश्रवणसङ्काशमुपविष्टं स्वलङ्कृतम्। ददर्श सूतः पर्य्यङ्के सौवर्णे सोत्तरच्छदे।।2.16.8।। वराहरुधिराभेण शुचिना च सुगन्ध
transliteration: tṃ vaiśravaṇasaṅkāśamupaviṣṭṃ svalaṅkṛtam| dadarśa sūtḥ paryyaṅke sauvarṇe sottaracchade||2.16.8|| varāharudhirābheṇa śu
meaning: Sumantra beheld Rama, who resembled Kubera. Rama was sitting on a richlycovered golden couch, welladorned and anointed with precious, pure, fragrant red sandalpaste the colour of which appeared like the blood of a hog. W

sanskrit: अथ मध्यमकक्ष्यायां समागच्छत्सुहृज्जनैः। स सर्वानर्थिनो दृष्ट्वा समेत्य प्रतिनन्द्य च।।2.16.27।। ततः पावकसङ्काशमारुरोह रथ
transliteration: atha madhyamakakṣyāyāṃ samāgacchatsuhṛjjanaiḥ| sa sarvānarthino dṛṣṭvā sametya pratinandya ca||2.16.27|| tatḥ pāvakasaṅk
meaning: Rama, the best among men, met all his friends in the middle courtyard. Having seen them all eager to see him, he approached and greeted them. Thereafter, he mounted the best silver chariot covered with tigerskin and glow

sanskrit: मेघनादमसम्बाधं मणिहेमविभूषितम्। मुष्णन्तमिव चक्षूंषि प्रभया सूर्यवर्चसम्।।2.16.29।। करेणुशिशुकल्पैश्च युक्तं परमवाजिभिः।
transliteration: meghanādamasambādhṃ maṇihemavibhūṣitam| muṣṇantamiva cakṣūṃṣi prabhayā sūryavarcasam||2.16.29|| kareṇuśiśukalpaiśca yukt
meaning: The sound emanating from the chariot resembled the thunder. The spacious chariot was decorated with gold and gems which dazzled the eyes as though they shed the lustre of the Sun. The swiftmoving chariot was harnessed by

sanskrit: स पर्जन्य इवाकाशे स्वनवानभिनादयन्।।2.16.31।। निकेतान्निर्ययौ श्रीमान्महाभ्रादिव चन्द्रमाः।
transliteration: sa parjanya ivākāśe svanavānabhinādayan||2.16.31|| niketānniryayau śrīmānmahābhrādiva candramāḥ|
meaning: The magnificent chariot, rumbling like a stormcloud in the sky, emerged from (Rama's) residence like the Moon peeping through a huge cloud.

sanskrit: छत्रचामरपाणिस्तु लक्ष्मणो राघवानुजः।।2.16.32।। जुगोप भ्रातरं भ्राता रथमास्थाय पृष्ठतः।
transliteration: chatracāmarapāṇistu lakṣmaṇo rāghavānujḥ||2.16.32|| jugopa bhrātarṃ bhrātā rathamāsthāya pṛṣṭhatḥ|
meaning: Holding an umbrella and a fan made of yak's tail in his hand Lakshmana boarded the chariot at the rear, guarding his brother.

sanskrit: इति प्रासादशृङ्गेषु प्रमदाभिर्नरोत्तमः।।2.16.42।। शुश्राव राजमार्गस्थः प्रिया वाच उदाहृताः। आत्मसंपूजनै शृण्वन् ययौ रामौ
transliteration: iti prāsādaśṛṅgeṣu pramadābhirnarottamḥ||2.16.42|| śuśrāva rājamārgasthḥ priyā vāca udāhṛtāḥ| ātmasṃpūjanai śṛṇvan yayau
meaning: Rama, the best among men, while riding along the highway overheard the pleasing words uttered by women standing on the elevation of their buildings. Thus hearing his own praise Rama proceeded along the highway.

sanskrit: स राघवस्तत्र कथाप्रपञ्चान् शुश्राव लोकस्य समागतस्य। आत्माधिकारा विविधाश्च वाचः प्रहृष्टरूपस्य पुरो जनस्य।।2.16.44।।
transliteration: sa rāghavastatra kathāprapañcān śuśrāva lokasya samāgatasya| ātmādhikārā vividhāśca vācḥ prahṛṣṭarūpasya puro janasya||2
meaning: Rama heard these various words of admiration by people who had assembled there, and (witnessed) the rejoicings of the citizens.

sanskrit: एष श्रियं गच्छति राघवोऽद्य राजप्रसादाद्विपुलां गमिष्यन्। एते वयं सर्व समृद्धकामा येषामयं नो भविता प्रशास्ता।।2.16.45।।
transliteration: eṣa śriyṃ gacchati rāghavo'dya rājaprasādādvipulāṃ gamiṣyan| ete vayṃ sarva samṛddhakāmā yeṣāmayṃ no bhavitā praśāstā||2
meaning: This scion of the Raghus (Rama) is going to acquire the earth and the wealth today by the king's grace. He will be our protector and fulfil all our desires.

sanskrit: लाभो जनस्यास्य यदेष सर्वं प्रपत्स्यते राष्ट्रमिदं चिराय। न ह्यप्रियं किञ्चन जातु कश्चि त्पश्येन्न दुःखं मनुजाधिपेऽस्मिन्
transliteration: lābho janasyāsya yadeṣa sarvṃ prapatsyate rāṣṭramidṃ cirāya| na hyapriyṃ kiñcana jātu kaści tpaśyenna duḥkhṃ manujādhipe
meaning: If this Rama obtains the entire kingdom for a long time, it will be in the interest of the people. If he becomes king none will ever witness anything unpleasant or sad. (They observed).

sanskrit: स घोषवद्भिश्च मतङ्गाजैर्ययैः पुरस्सरै स्स्वस्तिकसूतमागधैः। महीयमानः प्रवरैश्च वादकै रभिष्टुतो वैश्रवणो यथा ययौ।।2.16.47।
transliteration: sa ghoṣavadbhiśca mataṅgājairyayaiḥ purassarai ssvastikasūtamāgadhaiḥ| mahīyamānḥ pravaraiśca vādakai rabhiṣṭuto vaiśrav
meaning: With bards, panegyrists and great musical performers invoking blessings and walking ahead, he (Rama) proceeded, like Kubera amid intoxicated elephants and horses.

sanskrit: चन्दनानां च मुख्यानामगरूणां च सञ्चयैः।।2.17.3।। उत्तमानां च गन्धानां क्षौमकोशाम्बरस्य च। अविद्धाभिश्च मुक्ताभिरुत्तमैस्स
transliteration: candanānāṃ ca mukhyānāmagarūṇāṃ ca sañcayaiḥ||2.17.3|| uttamānāṃ ca gandhānāṃ kṣaumakośāmbarasya ca| aviddhābhiśca muktā
meaning: The highway (Rama entered) was splendid and spacious with heaps of sandal and agaru of the highest quality, excellent fragrant substances and bundles of white silken cloth. It gleamed with unholed (pristine) pearls, arti

sanskrit: अशीर्वादान्बहून् शृण्वन्सुहृद्भिस्समुदीरितान्।।2.17.7।। यथार्हं चापि सम्पूज्य सर्वानेव नरान्ययौ।
transliteration: aśīrvādānbahūn śṛṇvansuhṛdbhissamudīritān||2.17.7|| yathārhṃ cāpi sampūjya sarvāneva narānyayau|
meaning: Hearing many words of blessings uttered by his friends and honouring each person according to his rank, he passed on.

sanskrit: पितामहैराचरितं तथैव प्रपितामहैः।।2.17.8।। अद्योपादाय तं मार्गमभिषिक्तोऽनुपालय।
transliteration: pitāmahairācaritṃ tathaiva prapitāmahaiḥ||2.17.8|| adyopādāya tṃ mārgamabhiṣikto'nupālaya|
meaning: (They said) Consecrated today, rule the kingdom by adopting the same path followed by your grandfathers and greatgrandfathers.

sanskrit: यथास्म पोषिताः पित्रा यथा सर्वैः पितामहैः।।2.17.9।। ततस्सुखतरं रामे वत्स्यामस्सति राजनि।
transliteration: yathāsma poṣitāḥ pitrā yathā sarvaiḥ pitāmahaiḥ||2.17.9|| tatassukhatarṃ rāme vatsyāmassati rājani|
meaning: Once Rama assumes kingship, we shall all live in happiness greater than when we were ruled by his father and grandfather.

sanskrit: अलमद्य हि भुक्तेन परमार्थैरलं च नः।।2.17.10।। यदि पश्याम निर्यान्तं रामं राज्ये प्रतिष्ठितम्।
transliteration: alamadya hi bhuktena paramārthairalṃ ca nḥ||2.17.10|| yadi paśyāma niryāntṃ rāmṃ rājye pratiṣṭhitam|
meaning: If only we can see Rama enthroned today and going in a procession, there will be no need for food and no greater object of life to be accomplished.

sanskrit: अतो हि नः प्रियतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिद्भविष्यति।।2.17.11।। यथाऽभिषेको रामस्य राज्येनामिततेजसः।
transliteration: ato hi nḥ priyatarṃ nānyatkiñcidbhaviṣyati||2.17.11|| yathā'bhiṣeko rāmasya rājyenāmitatejasḥ|
meaning: For us, there is nothing dearer in the kingdom than the consecration of Rama of undimmed brilliance.

sanskrit: एताश्चान्याश्च सुहृदामुदासीनः कथाश्शुभाः।।2.17.12।। आत्मसम्पूजनीश्शृण्वन्ययौ रामो महापथम्।
transliteration: etāścānyāśca suhṛdāmudāsīnḥ kathāśśubhāḥ||2.17.12|| ātmasampūjanīśśṛṇvanyayau rāmo mahāpatham|
meaning: Indifferent to such warm words by his friends in his favour Rama passed along the highway.

sanskrit: स राजकुलमासाद्य मेघसङ्घोपमै श्शुभैः।।2.17.17।। प्रासादशृङ्गैर्विविधैःकैलास शिखरोपमैः। आवारयद्भिर्गगनं विमानैरिव पाण्डुरै
transliteration: sa rājakulamāsādya meghasaṅghopamai śśubhaiḥ||2.17.17|| prāsādaśṛṅgairvividhaiḥkailāsa śikharopamaiḥ| āvārayadbhirgaganṃ
meaning: That prince (Rama) arrived at the excellent palace of the king, which looked like the abode of Indra on earth, blazing with splendour. The various towers of the palace touching the sky resembled clusters of white clouds,

sanskrit: स सर्वा स्समतिक्रम्य कक्ष्या दशरथात्मजः। सन्निवर्त्य जनं सर्वं शुद्धान्तः पुरमभ्यगात्।।2.17.21।।
transliteration: sa sarvā ssamatikramya kakṣyā daśarathātmajḥ| sannivartya janṃ sarvṃ śuddhāntḥ puramabhyagāt||2.17.21||
meaning: Crossing the courtyards on his way Rama sent back his followers and entered the private apartment of the king.

sanskrit: तस्मिन् प्रविष्टे पितुरन्तिकं तदा जन स्स सर्वो मुदितो नृपात्मजे। प्रतीक्षते तस्य पुनः स्म निर्गमं यथोदयं चन्द्रमसस्सरित्
transliteration: tasmin praviṣṭe piturantikṃ tadā jana ssa sarvo mudito nṛpātmaje| pratīkṣate tasya punḥ sma nirgamṃ yathodayṃ candramasa
meaning: When the prince approached his father all the people were delighted and awaited his return like the ocean waiting for the rise of the Moon. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तदशस्सर्गः।। Thus

sanskrit: इन्द्रियैरप्रहृष्टैस्तं शोकसन्तापकर्शितम्। निश्श्वसन्तं महाराजं व्यथिताकुलचेतसम्।।2.18.5।। ऊर्मिमालिनमक्षोभ्यं क्षुभ्यन्
transliteration: indriyairaprahṛṣṭaistṃ śokasantāpakarśitam| niśśvasantṃ mahārājṃ vyathitākulacetasam||2.18.5|| ūrmimālinamakṣobhyṃ kṣubh
meaning: Maharaja (Dasaratha) with his senses dulled had become emaciated due to sorrow and suffering. With an agitated and troubled mind, he was breathing heavily. Although unshakable, he looked agitated like an ocean with succe

sanskrit: एतत्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा कैकेय्या समुदाहृतम्। उवाच व्यथितो रामस्तां देवीं नृपसन्निधौ।।2.18.27।।
transliteration: etattu vacanṃ śrutvā kaikeyyā samudāhṛtam| uvāca vyathito rāmastāṃ devīṃ nṛpasannidhau||2.18.27||
meaning: Very much depressed on hearing the words of Kaikeyi, Rama thus said to her in the presence of the king:

sanskrit: अहो धिङ्नार्हसे देवि वक्तुं मामीदृशं वचः। अहं हि वचनाद्राज्ञः पतेयमपि पावके।।2.18.28।। भक्षयेयं विषं तीक्ष्णं मज्जेयमपि
transliteration: aho dhiṅnārhase devi vaktuṃ māmīdṛśṃ vacḥ| ahṃ hi vacanādrājñḥ pateyamapi pāvake||2.18.28|| bhakṣayeyṃ viṣṃ tīkṣṇṃ majje
meaning: Alas, what a pity, O queen, it does not behove you to speak to me such words. I can jump into fire. Since he is my father, preceptor and wellwisher, I shall consume deadly poison or even get drowned in the sea if he so c

sanskrit: तद्ब्रूहि वचनं देवि राज्ञो यदभिकाङ्क्षितम्। करिष्ये प्रतिजाने च रामो द्विर्नाभिभाषते।।2.18.30।।
transliteration: tadbrūhi vacanṃ devi rājño yadabhikāṅkṣitam| kariṣye pratijāne ca rāmo dvirnābhibhāṣate||2.18.30||
meaning: Hence tell me, O Devi Whatever be the desire of the king: I promise I shall carry out, Rama does not say two things (does not go back on his word).

sanskrit: तमार्जवसमायुक्तमनार्या सत्यवादिनम्। उवाच रामं कैकेयी वचनं भृशदारुणम्।।2.18.31।।
transliteration: tamārjavasamāyuktamanāryā satyavādinam| uvāca rāmṃ kaikeyī vacanṃ bhṛśadāruṇam||2.18.31||
meaning: To Rama who was devoted to truth and to rectitude of conduct the ignobale Kaikeyi said:

sanskrit: पुरा दैवासुरे युद्धे पित्रा ते मम राघव। रक्षितेन वरौ दत्तौ सशल्येन महारणे।।2.18.32।।
transliteration: purā daivāsure yuddhe pitrā te mama rāghava| rakṣitena varau dattau saśalyena mahāraṇe||2.18.32||
meaning: O descendant of Raghu in the great war between gods and demons in the past your father had granted me two boons for protecting him when he was wounded by a shaft.

sanskrit: तत्र मे याचितो राजा भरतस्याभिषेचनम्। गमनं दण्डकारण्ये तव चाद्यैव राघव।।2.18.33।।
transliteration: tatra me yācito rājā bharatasyābhiṣecanam| gamanṃ daṇḍakāraṇye tava cādyaiva rāghava||2.18.33||
meaning: O scion of the Raghus, hence I have asked the king for consecration of Bharata and your departure to Dandaka forest today itself.

sanskrit: यदि सत्यप्रतिज्ञं त्वं पितरं कर्तुमिच्छसि। आत्मानं च नरश्रेष्ठ मम वाक्यमिदं शृणु।।2.18.34।।
transliteration: yadi satyapratijñṃ tvṃ pitarṃ kartumicchasi| ātmānṃ ca naraśreṣṭha mama vākyamidṃ śṛṇu||2.18.34||
meaning: O the best of men if you want to be true to the word given by you and your father, listen to what I say.

sanskrit: सन्निदेशे पितुस्तिष्ठ यथा तेन प्रतिश्रुतम्। त्वयाऽरण्यं प्रवेष्टव्यं नव वर्षाणि पञ्च च।।2.18.35।।
transliteration: sannideśe pitustiṣṭha yathā tena pratiśrutam| tvayā'raṇyṃ praveṣṭavyṃ nava varṣāṇi pañca ca||2.18.35||
meaning: Abide by your father's command. As promised by him go to the forest for fourteen years.

sanskrit: भरतस्त्वभिषिच्येत यदेतदभिषेचनम्। त्वदर्थे विहितं राज्ञा तेन सर्वेण राघव।।2.18.36।।
transliteration: bharatastvabhiṣicyeta yadetadabhiṣecanam| tvadarthe vihitṃ rājñā tena sarveṇa rāghava||2.18.36||
meaning: Bharata shall be consecrated, O descendant of the Raghu dynasty with all these preparations made by the king to install you.

sanskrit: सप्त सप्त च वर्षाणि दण्डकारण्यमाश्रितः। अभिषेकमिमं त्यक्त्वा जटाजिनधरो वस।।2.18.37।।
transliteration: sapta sapta ca varṣāṇi daṇḍakāraṇyamāśritḥ| abhiṣekamimṃ tyaktvā jaṭājinadharo vasa||2.18.37||
meaning: Forsake this consecration, wear matted locks and deerskin and take refuge in Dandaka forest for fourteen years.

sanskrit: भरतः कोसलपुरे प्रशास्तु वसुधामिमाम्। नानारत्न समाकीर्णां सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम्।।2.18.38।।
transliteration: bharatḥ kosalapure praśāstu vasudhāmimām| nānāratna samākīrṇāṃ savājirathakuñjarām||2.18.38||
meaning: Let Bharata live in Ayodhya, the capital of Kosala and rule this kingdom rich in gems of different kinds in horses, chariots and elephants.

sanskrit: एतेन त्वां नरेन्द्रोऽयं कारुण्येन समाप्लुतः। शोकसंक्लिष्ट वदनो न शक्नोति निरीक्षितुम्।।2.18.39।।
transliteration: etena tvāṃ narendro'yṃ kāruṇyena samāplutḥ| śokasṃkliṣṭa vadano na śaknoti nirīkṣitum||2.18.39||
meaning: This is why the king with his face tortured by tears and (his heart) overwhelmed with compassion for you, is unable to look at you.

sanskrit: एतत्कुरु नरेन्द्रस्य वचनं रघुनन्दन। सत्येन महता राम तारयस्व नरेश्वरम्।।2.18.40।।
transliteration: etatkuru narendrasya vacanṃ raghunandana| satyena mahatā rāma tārayasva nareśvaram||2.18.40||
meaning: O Joy of the Raghus, O son of the Raghu race, carry out the word of promise given by the king and save him by helping him keep the truth which is great.

sanskrit: इतीव तस्यां परुषं वदन्त्यां न चैव रामः प्रविवेश शोकम्। प्रविव्यथे चापि महानुभावो राजा तु पुत्रव्यसनाभितप्तः।।2.18.41।।
transliteration: itīva tasyāṃ paruṣṃ vadantyāṃ na caiva rāmḥ praviveśa śokam| pravivyathe cāpi mahānubhāvo rājā tu putravyasanābhitaptḥ||
meaning: Even though she was speaking harsh words, Rama did not come to grief. But the magnanimous king was greatly afflicted to see the calamity on his son. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टादशस्सर्

sanskrit: तव त्वहं क्षमं मन्ये नोत्सुकस्य विलम्बनम्। राम तस्मादित श्शीघ्रं वनं त्वं गन्तुमर्हसि।।2.19.14।।
transliteration: tava tvahṃ kṣamṃ manye notsukasya vilambanam| rāma tasmādita śśīghrṃ vanṃ tvṃ gantumarhasi||2.19.14||
meaning: Since you are eager (to go to the forest), I do not think it is proper to delay. O Rama therefore it behoves you to proceed immediately from here to the forest.

sanskrit: व्रीडान्वित स्स्वयं यच्च नृपस्त्वां नाभिभाषते। नैतत्किञ्चिन्नरश्रेष्ठ मन्युरेषोऽपनीयताम्।।2.19.15।।
transliteration: vrīḍānvita ssvayṃ yacca nṛpastvāṃ nābhibhāṣate| naitatkiñcinnaraśreṣṭha manyureṣo'panīyatām||2.19.15||
meaning: Out of shame the king is unable to speak to you. There is nothing other than this. O Rama, the best of men, dispel this distress (of mind).

sanskrit: स रामस्य वचश्श्रृत्वा भृशं दुःखहतः पिता। शोकादशक्नुवन्वकतुं प्ररुरोद महास्वनम्।।2.19.27।।
transliteration: sa rāmasya vacaśśrṛtvā bhṛśṃ duḥkhahatḥ pitā| śokādaśaknuvanvakatuṃ praruroda mahāsvanam||2.19.27||
meaning: Father (Dasaratha), too tormented with grief to speak cried out loudly on hearing the words of Rama.

sanskrit: वन्दित्वा चरणौ रामो विसंज्ञस्य पितुस्तथा। कैकेय्याश्चाप्यनार्यायाः निष्पपात महाद्युतिः।।2.19.28।।
transliteration: vanditvā caraṇau rāmo visṃjñasya pitustathā| kaikeyyāścāpyanāryāyāḥ niṣpapāta mahādyutiḥ||2.19.28||
meaning: Effulgent Rama bowed at the feet of his father who had fallen into a swoon. He bowed at the feet of the ignoble Kaikeyi and set out.

sanskrit: स रामः पितरं कृत्वा कैकेयीं च प्रदक्षिणम्। निष्क्रम्यान्तःपुरात्तस्मात्स्वं ददर्श सुहृज्जनम्।।2.19.29।।
transliteration: sa rāmḥ pitarṃ kṛtvā kaikeyīṃ ca pradakṣiṇam| niṣkramyāntḥpurāttasmātsvṃ dadarśa suhṛjjanam||2.19.29||
meaning: Hardly had Rama withdrawn from the harem after circumambulating his father and Kaikeyi when he saw his friends .

sanskrit: तं बाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्षः पृष्ठतोऽनुजगाम ह। लक्ष्मणः परमक्कृध्दः स्सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः।।2.19.30।।
transliteration: tṃ bāṣpaparipūrṇākṣḥ pṛṣṭhato'nujagāma ha| lakṣmaṇḥ paramakkṛdhdḥ ssumitrānandavardhanḥ||2.19.30||
meaning: Lakshmana, the enhancer of Sumitra's delight, with his eyes brimming with tears, followed him in a rage.

sanskrit: अभिषेचनिकं भाण्डं कृत्वा रामः प्रदक्षिणम्। शनैर्जगाम सापेक्षो दृष्टिं तत्राविचालयन्।।2.19.31।।
transliteration: abhiṣecanikṃ bhāṇḍṃ kṛtvā rāmḥ pradakṣiṇam| śanairjagāma sāpekṣo dṛṣṭiṃ tatrāvicālayan||2.19.31||
meaning: Rama circumambulated the vessels meant for the consecration ceremony and steadily glancing at them with attention slowly moved away.

sanskrit: न चास्य महतीं लक्ष्मीं राज्यनाशोऽपकर्षति। लोककान्तस्य कान्तत्वाच्छीतरश्मेरिव क्षपा।।2.19.32।।
transliteration: na cāsya mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ rājyanāśo'pakarṣati| lokakāntasya kāntatvācchītaraśmeriva kṣapā||2.19.32||
meaning: Rama was the beloved of the people. Loss of kingdom did not diminish his splendour just like night cannot diminish the splendour of the coolrayed Moon.

sanskrit: न वनं गन्तुकामस्य त्यजतश्च वसुन्धराम्। सर्वलोकातिगस्येव लक्ष्यते चित्तविक्रिया।।2.19.33।।
transliteration: na vanṃ gantukāmasya tyajataśca vasundharām| sarvalokātigasyeva lakṣyate cittavikriyā||2.19.33||
meaning: Rama was determined to renounce the kingdom and go to the forest. So none could see any change in his mind. (For) he was one beyond all worldly affairs.

sanskrit: प्रतिषिध्य शुभं छत्रं व्यजने च स्वलङ्कृते। विसर्जयित्वा स्वजनं रथं पौरांस्तथा जनान्।।2.19.34।। धारयन् मनसा दुःखमिन्द्रिय
transliteration: pratiṣidhya śubhṃ chatrṃ vyajane ca svalaṅkṛte| visarjayitvā svajanṃ rathṃ paurāṃstathā janān||2.19.34|| dhārayan manasā
meaning: Selfpossessed Rama held back his sorrow within his mind, abandoned the auspicious umbrella, welldecorated fans and chariot, sent away kinsmen, citydwellers and others and entered his mother's residence to break the unple

sanskrit: सर्वोह्यभिजनश्श्रीमान् श्रीमतस्सत्यवादिनः। नालक्षयत रामस्य किञ्चिदाकारमानने।।2.19.36।।
transliteration: sarvohyabhijanaśśrīmān śrīmatassatyavādinḥ| nālakṣayata rāmasya kiñcidākāramānane||2.19.36||
meaning: All the glorious people around him did not observe any change in the countenance of that dignified and truthful Rama.

sanskrit: उचितं च महाबाहुर्नजहौहर्षमात्मनः। शारद स्समुदीर्णांशुश्चन्द्रस्तेज इवात्मजम्।।2.19.37।।
transliteration: ucitṃ ca mahābāhurnajahauharṣamātmanḥ| śārada ssamudīrṇāṃśuścandrasteja ivātmajam||2.19.37||
meaning: The mightyarmed (Rama) did not leave his habitual cheerfulness like the autumnal Moon his own brightness.

sanskrit: वाचा मधुरया रामस्सर्वं सम्मानयञ्जनम्। मातुस्समीपं धीरात्मा प्रविवेश महायशाः।।2.19.38।।
transliteration: vācā madhurayā rāmassarvṃ sammānayañjanam| mātussamīpṃ dhīrātmā praviveśa mahāyaśāḥ||2.19.38||
meaning: Firmminded and illustrious Rama treated all people with sweet words and approached his mother.

sanskrit: तं गुणैस्समतां प्राप्तो भ्राता विपुलविक्रमः। सौमित्रिरनुवव्राज धारयन्दुःखमात्मजम्।।2.19.39।।
transliteration: tṃ guṇaissamatāṃ prāpto bhrātā vipulavikramḥ| saumitriranuvavrāja dhārayanduḥkhamātmajam||2.19.39||
meaning: Mighty Lakshmana as virtuous as his brother held the sorrow in his mind and followed him.

sanskrit: प्रविश्य वेश्मातिभृशं मुदाऽन्वितं समीक्ष्य तां चार्थविपत्तिमागताम्। न चैव रामोऽत्रजगामविक्रियां सुहृज्जनस्यात्मविपत्तिशङ
transliteration: praviśya veśmātibhṛśṃ mudā'nvitṃ samīkṣya tāṃ cārthavipattimāgatām| na caiva rāmo'trajagāmavikriyāṃ suhṛjjanasyātmavipat
meaning: Rama entered the palace which was full of great rejoicing. He did not disclose the obstruction that had come on the way of achieving his objective for fear of causing distress to his friends. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल

sanskrit: यदिदं मेऽनुरूपार्थं मया साधु सुमन्त्रितम्। भवन्तो मेऽनुमन्यन्तां कथं वा करवाण्यहम्।।2.2.15।।
transliteration: yadidṃ me'nurūpārthṃ mayā sādhu sumantritam| bhavanto me'numanyantāṃ kathṃ vā karavāṇyaham||2.2.15||
meaning: Although it (this decision) is personally favourable to me and I have decided after seeking good counsel, you should also give me your consent and tell me what I should do.

sanskrit: यद्यप्येषा मम प्रीतिर्हितमन्यद्विचिन्त्यताम्। अन्या मध्यस्थचिन्ता हि विमर्दाभ्यधिकोदया।।2.2.16।।
transliteration: yadyapyeṣā mama prītirhitamanyadvicintyatām| anyā madhyasthacintā hi vimardābhyadhikodayā||2.2.16||
meaning: Although this is what I would like to do, please suggest alternative ways of achieving the welfare (of this kingdom). Deliberations by the unbiased (on this issue) may bring good.

sanskrit: गुणान् गुणवतो देव देवकल्पस्य धीमतः। प्रियानानन्दनान्कृत्स्नान्प्रवक्ष्यामोऽद्य तान् शृणु।।2.2.27।।
transliteration: guṇān guṇavato deva devakalpasya dhīmatḥ| priyānānandanānkṛtsnānpravakṣyāmo'dya tān śṛṇu||2.2.27||
meaning: O king, we shall now speak about those great virtues of the sagacious (Rama). Comparable to those of the gods, they are dear and a source of delight for every one. Please listen.

sanskrit: दिव्यैर्गुणैश्शक्रसमो रामस्सत्यपराक्रमः। इक्ष्वाकुभ्योऽपि सर्वेभ्यो ह्यतिरिक्तो विशांपते।।2.2.28।।
transliteration: divyairguṇaiśśakrasamo rāmassatyaparākramḥ| ikṣvākubhyo'pi sarvebhyo hyatirikto viśāṃpate||2.2.28||
meaning: Lord of the people Rama with his divine virtues is equal to Indra. He with his proven valour is exceptional among all the descendents of the Iksvakus.

sanskrit: राम स्सत्पुरुषो लोके सत्यधर्मपरायणः। साक्षाद्रामाद्विनिर्वृत्तो धर्मश्चापि श्रिया सह।।2.2.29।।
transliteration: rāma ssatpuruṣo loke satyadharmaparāyaṇḥ| sākṣādrāmādvinirvṛtto dharmaścāpi śriyā saha||2.2.29||
meaning: Devoted to truth and righteousness Rama is the most venerable among men in this world. Even righteousness along with prosperity flows directly from Rama.

sanskrit: प्रजासुखत्त्वे चन्द्रस्य वसुधायाः क्षमागुणैः। बुद्ध्या बृहस्पतेस्तुल्यो वीर्ये साक्षाच्छचीपतेः।।2.2.30।।
transliteration: prajāsukhattve candrasya vasudhāyāḥ kṣamāguṇaiḥ| buddhyā bṛhaspatestulyo vīrye sākṣācchacīpateḥ||2.2.30||
meaning: He is equal to the Moon in causing happiness to the people, to the earth in forbearance, to Brihaspati in wisdom and to Indra in prowess.

sanskrit: ﻿﻿धर्मज्ञः सत्यसन्धश्च शीलवाननसूयकः। क्षान्तः सान्त्वयिता श्लक्ष्णः कृतज्ञो विजितेन्द्रियः।।2.2.31।।
transliteration: ﻿﻿dharmajñḥ satyasandhaśca śīlavānanasūyakḥ| kṣāntḥ sāntvayitā ślakṣṇḥ kṛtajño vijitendriyḥ||2.2.31||
meaning: ﻿﻿ Rama knows the ways of righteousness. He is true to his word and free from envy. He possesses a sound character with forbearance, gentleness and a sense of gratitude. With his senses under control, he is a source of c

sanskrit: मृदुश्च स्थिरचित्तश्च सदा भव्योऽनसूयकः। प्रियवादी च भूतानां सत्यवादी च राघवः।।2.2.32।। बहुश्रुतानां वृद्धानां ब्राह्मणान
transliteration: mṛduśca sthiracittaśca sadā bhavyo'nasūyakḥ| priyavādī ca bhūtānāṃ satyavādī ca rāghavḥ||2.2.32|| bahuśrutānāṃ vṛddhānāṃ
meaning: This son of the Raghus (Rama) is softspoken, steadfast, always serene, truthful and free from envy. He is pleasing to all beings. He serves those elderly brahmins versed in many lores. With these virtues his incomparable

sanskrit: देवासुरमनुष्याणां सर्वास्त्रेषु विशारदः। सम्यग्विद्याव्रतस्नातो यथावत्साङ्गवेदवित्।।2.2.34।।
transliteration: devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ sarvāstreṣu viśāradḥ| samyagvidyāvratasnāto yathāvatsāṅgavedavit||2.2.34||
meaning: He is an expert in wielding all kinds of weapons available to devas, asuras and men. He has achieved mastery over all sciences and has appropriately acquired knowledge of the Vedas and its ancillary sciences.

sanskrit: गान्धर्वे च भुवि श्रेष्ठो बभूव भरताग्रजः। कल्याणाभिजन स्साधुरदीनात्मा महामतिः।।2.2.35।।
transliteration: gāndharve ca bhuvi śreṣṭho babhūva bharatāgrajḥ| kalyāṇābhijana ssādhuradīnātmā mahāmatiḥ||2.2.35||
meaning: This elder brother of Bharata is the greatest exponent in music on earth. Pious, sagacious, free from meanness, he is of noble descent.

sanskrit: द्विजैरभिविनीतश्च श्रेष्ठैर्धर्मार्थनैपुणैः। यदा व्रजति सङ्ग्रामं ग्रामार्थे नगरस्य वा।।2.2.36।। गत्वा सौमित्रिसहितो नाऽ
transliteration: dvijairabhivinītaśca śreṣṭhairdharmārthanaipuṇaiḥ| yadā vrajati saṅgrāmṃ grāmārthe nagarasya vā||2.2.36|| gatvā saumitri
meaning: Whenever he, wellinstructed in all matters by the best of brahmins wellversed in dharma and artha proceeds along with Lakshmana to wage a war for the sake of a village or a town, he never returns without conquering the e

sanskrit: सङ्ग्रामात्पुनरागम्य कुञ्जरेण रथेन वा।2.2.37।। पौरान् स्वजनवन्नित्यं कुशलं परिपृच्छति।। पुत्रेष्वग्निषु दारेषु प्रेष्यशि
transliteration: saṅgrāmātpunarāgamya kuñjareṇa rathena vā|2.2.37|| paurān svajanavannityṃ kuśalṃ paripṛcchati|| putreṣvagniṣu dāreṣu pre
meaning: While returning from the battlefield, either on a chariot or an elephant Rama stops and enquires in detail and in order, the welfare of the citizens as he would do for his kith and kin. He enquires about the welfare of t

sanskrit: शुश्रूषन्ते च व श्शिष्याः कच्चित्कर्मसु दंशिताः।।2.2.39।। इति नः पुरुषव्याघ्र स्सदा रामोऽभिभाषते।
transliteration: śuśrūṣante ca va śśiṣyāḥ kaccitkarmasu dṃśitāḥ||2.2.39|| iti nḥ puruṣavyāghra ssadā rāmo'bhibhāṣate|
meaning: Rama, a tiger among men, always enquires whether our disciples discharge their duties.

sanskrit: व्यसनेषु मनुष्याणां भृशं भवति दुःखितः।।2.2.40।। उत्सवेषु च सर्वेषु पितेव परितुष्यति।
transliteration: vyasaneṣu manuṣyāṇāṃ bhṛśṃ bhavati duḥkhitḥ||2.2.40|| utsaveṣu ca sarveṣu piteva parituṣyati|
meaning: He grieves profoundly whenever people are afflicted by misfortunes (and) rejoices like a father on festive occasions.

sanskrit: सत्यवादी महेष्वासो वृद्धसेवी जितेन्द्रियः।।2.2.41।। स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषी च धर्मं सर्वात्मना श्रितः।
transliteration: satyavādī maheṣvāso vṛddhasevī jitendriyḥ||2.2.41|| smitapūrvābhibhāṣī ca dharmṃ sarvātmanā śritḥ|
meaning: . He is one who speaks the truth. He is a great archer, one who has conquered his senses and serves the aged. He speaks with a smile and protects dharma with all his heart.

sanskrit: सम्यग्योक्ता श्रेयसां च न विगृह्य कथारुचिः।।2.2.42।। उत्तरोत्तरयुक्तौ च वक्ता वाचस्पतिर्यथा।
transliteration: samyagyoktā śreyasāṃ ca na vigṛhya kathāruciḥ||2.2.42|| uttarottarayuktau ca vaktā vācaspatiryathā|
meaning: He helps those who take refuge in him. He is not interested in conversation leading to dissentions. But during debates he is eloquent like Brihaspati (establing the truth on the basis of reasoning).

sanskrit: ﻿सुभ्रूः आयतताम्राक्षः साक्षाद्विष्णुरिव स्वयम्।।2.2.43।। रामो लोकाभिरामोऽयं शौर्यवीर्यपराक्रमैः।
transliteration: ﻿subhrūḥ āyatatāmrākṣḥ sākṣādviṣṇuriva svayam||2.2.43|| rāmo lokābhirāmo'yṃ śauryavīryaparākramaiḥ|
meaning: ﻿ Rama, who is the source of delight to the world, has charming eyebrows and large coppercoloured eyes. He is endowed with heroism, bravery and valour like Visnu manifested.

sanskrit: प्रजापालनतत्त्वज्ञो न रागोपहतेन्द्रियः।।2.2.44।। शक्तस्त्रैलोक्यमप्येको भोक्तुं किन्नु महीमिमाम्।
transliteration: prajāpālanatattvajño na rāgopahatendriyḥ||2.2.44|| śaktastrailokyamapyeko bhoktuṃ kinnu mahīmimām|
meaning: He is proficient in the ways and means of ruling the people. His senses are not overpowered by passion. He alone is capable of ruling the three worlds, what to speak the earth

sanskrit: नास्य क्रोधः प्रसादश्च निरर्थोऽस्ति कदाचन।।2.2.45।। हन्त्येव नियमाद्वध्यानवध्ये न च कुप्यति।
transliteration: nāsya krodhḥ prasādaśca nirartho'sti kadācana||2.2.45|| hantyeva niyamādvadhyānavadhye na ca kupyati|
meaning: His anger or favour never goes in vain. He kills those who rightly deserve to be killed and flares not at those whose life is to be spared.

sanskrit: युनक्त्यर्थैः प्रहृष्टश्च तमसौ यत्र तुष्यति।।2.2.46।। शान्तै स्सर्वप्रजाकान्तैः प्रीतिसञ्जननैर्नृणाम्। गुणैर्विरुरुचे रा
transliteration: yunaktyarthaiḥ prahṛṣṭaśca tamasau yatra tuṣyati||2.2.46|| śāntai ssarvaprajākāntaiḥ prītisañjananairnṛṇām| guṇairviruru
meaning: When pleased, Rama bestows wealth. Like the Sun shining with his rays, He shines with his qualities of tranquil, charming and loving nature.

sanskrit: तमेवंगुणसम्पन्नं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्। लोकपालोपमं नाथमकामयत मेदिनी।।2.2.48।।
transliteration: tamevṃguṇasampannṃ rāmṃ satyaparākramam| lokapālopamṃ nāthamakāmayata medinī||2.2.48||
meaning: The earth desired to have Rama, richly endowed with such virtues, possessing proven prowess, comparable to Indra and other regents of the world, as her lord.

sanskrit: वत्सश्श्रेयसि जातस्ते दिष्ट्याऽसौ तव राघव। दिष्ट्या पुत्रगुणैर्युक्तो मारीच इव काश्यपः।।2.2.49।।
transliteration: vatsaśśreyasi jātaste diṣṭyā'sau tava rāghava| diṣṭyā putraguṇairyukto mārīca iva kāśyapḥ||2.2.49||
meaning: O son of the Raghus (Dasaratha), because of your good fortune that Rama, endowed with the qualities of an ideal son like Kasyapa to Maricha was born to you for the welfare of this world.

sanskrit: ﻿बलमारोग्यमायुश्च रामस्य विदितात्मनः। देवासुरमनुष्येषु सगन्धर्वोरगेषु च।।2.2.50।। आशंसते जनस्सर्वो राष्ट्रे पुरवरे तथा।
transliteration: ﻿balamārogyamāyuśca rāmasya viditātmanḥ| devāsuramanuṣyeṣu sagandharvorageṣu ca||2.2.50|| āśṃsate janassarvo rāṣṭre pura
meaning: ﻿ Gandharvas, uragas, devas, asuras, the inhabitants of towns and villages, all men living in neighbouring or distant regions are wish the illustrious Rama strength, health and long life.

sanskrit: स्त्रियो वृद्धास्तरुण्यश्च सायं प्रातस्समाहिताः। सर्वान् देवान् नमस्यन्ति रामस्यार्थे यशस्विनः।।2.2.52।।
transliteration: striyo vṛddhāstaruṇyaśca sāyṃ prātassamāhitāḥ| sarvān devān namasyanti rāmasyārthe yaśasvinḥ||2.2.52||
meaning: Women, young and old alike devoutly invoke at dusk and at dawn all the gods for the sake of the celebrated Rama.

sanskrit: तेषामायाचितं देव त्वत्प्रसादात्समृद्ध्यताम्। राममिन्दीवरश्यामं सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम्।।2.2.53।। पश्यामो यौवराज्यस्थं तव राजो
transliteration: teṣāmāyācitṃ deva tvatprasādātsamṛddhyatām| rāmamindīvaraśyāmṃ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇam||2.2.53|| paśyāmo yauvarājyasthṃ tav
meaning: O Lord let the peoples' prayer be fulfilled by your blessings. We would like to see your son Rama of the complexion of a bluelotus and destroyer of enemies as prince regent.

sanskrit: तं देव देवोपममात्मजं ते सर्वस्य लोकस्य हिते निविष्टम्। हिताय नः क्षिप्रमुदारजुष्टं मुदाऽभषेक्तुं वरद त्वमर्हसि।।2.2.54।।
transliteration: tṃ deva devopamamātmajṃ te sarvasya lokasya hite niviṣṭam| hitāya nḥ kṣipramudārajuṣṭṃ mudā'bhaṣektuṃ varada tvamarhasi|
meaning: O bestower of boons it behoves you to install with delight and without delay your son (Rama) endowed with all virtues equal to god of the gods and committed to our wellbeing and to the welfare of this world, as your heir

sanskrit: देवकार्यनिमित्तं च तत्रापश्यत्समुद्यतम्। दध्यक्षतं घृतं चैव मोदकान्हविषस्तथा।।2.20.17।। लाजान्माल्यानि शुक्लानि पायसं कृ
transliteration: devakāryanimittṃ ca tatrāpaśyatsamudyatam| dadhyakṣatṃ ghṛtṃ caiva modakānhaviṣastathā||2.20.17|| lājānmālyāni śuklāni p
meaning: There Rama saw curd, grains of rice, clarified butter, sweetmeats, oblations, parched grain, white garlands, porridge of cooked rice mixed with sesame seeds, sacrirficial faggots, vessels filled with water, etc. kept rea

sanskrit: वृद्धानां धर्मशीलानां राजर्षीणां महात्मनाम्। प्राप्नुह्यायुश्च कीर्तिं च धर्मं चोपहितं कुले।।2.20.23।।
transliteration: vṛddhānāṃ dharmaśīlānāṃ rājarṣīṇāṃ mahātmanām| prāpnuhyāyuśca kīrtiṃ ca dharmṃ copahitṃ kule||2.20.23||
meaning: May you attain long life and fame like those of the aged, virtuous and great rajarsis who upheld the righteousness in the race.

sanskrit: स स्वभावविनीतश्च गौरवाच्च तदा नतः। प्रस्थितो दण्डकारण्यमाप्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे।।2.20.26।।
transliteration: sa svabhāvavinītaśca gauravācca tadā natḥ| prasthito daṇḍakāraṇyamāpraṣṭumupacakrame||2.20.26||
meaning: Modest by nature, Rama with respectful humility began seeking her permission for his departure to Dandaka forest:

sanskrit: देवि नूनं न जानीषे महद्भयमुपस्थितम्। इदं तव च दुःखाय वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणस्य च।।2.20.27।।
transliteration: devi nūnṃ na jānīṣe mahadbhayamupasthitam| idṃ tava ca duḥkhāya vaidehyā lakṣmaṇasya ca||2.20.27||
meaning: O mother surely you do not know that a great misfortune has befallen, causing distress to you, Sita and Lakshmana, too.

sanskrit: गमिष्ये दण्डकारण्यं किमनेनासनेन मे। विष्टरासनयोग्यो हि कालोऽयं मामुपस्थितः।।2.20.28।।
transliteration: gamiṣye daṇḍakāraṇyṃ kimanenāsanena me| viṣṭarāsanayogyo hi kālo'yṃ māmupasthitḥ||2.20.28||
meaning: I am setting forth to Dandaka forest. What is this seat for? A time has come for me when I am fit for a seat of kusa grass.

sanskrit: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वत्स्यामि विजने वने। मधुमूलफलैर्जीवन्हित्वा मुनिवदामिषम्।।2.20.29।।
transliteration: caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi vatsyāmi vijane vane| madhumūlaphalairjīvanhitvā munivadāmiṣam||2.20.29||
meaning: Abstaining from eating meat like hermits and living on honey, fruits and roots, I am to live in the solitary forest for fourteen years.

sanskrit: भरताय महाराजो यौवराज्यं प्रयच्छति। मां पुनर्दण्डकारण्ये विवासयति तापसम्।।2.20.30।।
transliteration: bharatāya mahārājo yauvarājyṃ prayacchati| māṃ punardaṇḍakāraṇye vivāsayati tāpasam||2.20.30||
meaning: The great king is conferring the status of heirapparent on Bharata while he is banishing me to Dandaka forest to live like an ascetic.

sanskrit: स षट्चाष्टौ च वर्षाणि वत्स्यामि विजने वने। आसेवमानो वन्यानि फलमूलैश्च वर्तयन्।।2.20.31।।
transliteration: sa ṣaṭcāṣṭau ca varṣāṇi vatsyāmi vijane vane| āsevamāno vanyāni phalamūlaiśca vartayan||2.20.31||
meaning: Living on things available in the forest, on fruits and roots, I am to dwell in the uninhabited jungle for fourteen years.

sanskrit: सा निकृत्तेव सालस्य यष्टिः परशुना वने। पपात सहसा देवी देवतेव दिवश्च्युता।।2.20.32।।
transliteration: sā nikṛtteva sālasya yaṣṭiḥ paraśunā vane| papāta sahasā devī devateva divaścyutā||2.20.32||
meaning: All on a sidden Kausalya fell down on the ground like the branch of a sal tree in the forest severed by an axe, like a goddess dropped from heaven.

sanskrit: तामदुःखोचितां दृष्ट्वा पतितां कदलीमिव। रामस्तूत्थापयामास मातरं गतचेतसम्।।2.20.33।।
transliteration: tāmaduḥkhocitāṃ dṛṣṭvā patitāṃ kadalīmiva| rāmastūtthāpayāmāsa mātarṃ gatacetasam||2.20.33||
meaning: Seeing his mother who had done nothing to deserve (this) suffering and who had fallen down like a plantain tree, deprived of her senses, Rama raised her up (from the ground).

sanskrit: उपावृत्त्योत्थितां दीनां बडबामिव वाहिताम्। पांसुकुण्ठितसर्वाङ्गीं विममर्श च पाणिना।।2.20.34।।
transliteration: upāvṛttyotthitāṃ dīnāṃ baḍabāmiva vāhitām| pāṃsukuṇṭhitasarvāṅgīṃ vimamarśa ca pāṇinā||2.20.34||
meaning: Rama gently wiped away the dust that had covered her body as Kausalya stood miserable, like a mare who stands up after having rolled on the ground while pulling the load.

sanskrit: सा राघवमुपासीनमसुखार्ता सुखोचिता। उवाच पुरुषव्याघ्रमुपशृण्वति लक्ष्मणे।।2.20.35।।
transliteration: sā rāghavamupāsīnamasukhārtā sukhocitā| uvāca puruṣavyāghramupaśṛṇvati lakṣmaṇe||2.20.35||
meaning: Kausalya who deserved happiness yet was struck down by (this) distress spoke to Rama, the tiger among men who was sitting nearby, while Lakshmana was listening.

sanskrit: यदि पुत्र न जायेथा मम शोकाय राघव। न स्म दुःखमतो भूयः पश्येयमहमप्रजाः।।2.20.36।।
transliteration: yadi putra na jāyethā mama śokāya rāghava| na sma duḥkhamato bhūyḥ paśyeyamahamaprajāḥ||2.20.36||
meaning: O my son, if you were not born to me, I, even as a woman without progeny, would not have experienced grief, more intense than this.

sanskrit: एक एव हि वन्ध्याया श्शोको भवति मानसः। अप्रजाऽस्मीति सन्तापो न ह्यन्यः पुत्र विद्यते।।2.20.37।।
transliteration: eka eva hi vandhyāyā śśoko bhavati mānasḥ| aprajā'smīti santāpo na hyanyḥ putra vidyate||2.20.37||
meaning: O my son a barren woman has only one mental agony that she has no progeny. Except that she does not have any other sorrow.

sanskrit: न दृष्टपूर्वं कल्याणं सुखं वा पतिपौरुषे। अपि पुत्रे ऽपि पश्येयमिति रामाऽस्थितं मया।।2.20.38।।
transliteration: na dṛṣṭapūrvṃ kalyāṇṃ sukhṃ vā patipauruṣe| api putre 'pi paśyeyamiti rāmā'sthitṃ mayā||2.20.38||
meaning: I did not have the fortune, O Rama, to enjoy any auspicious moment or pleasure earlier when my husband was in authority. I exist with the hope that I will have it when my son assumes authority.

sanskrit: सा बहून्यमनोज्ञानि वाक्यानि हृदयच्छिदाम्। अहं श्रोष्ये सपत्नीनामवराणां वरा सती।।2.20.39।।
transliteration: sā bahūnyamanojñāni vākyāni hṛdayacchidām| ahṃ śroṣye sapatnīnāmavarāṇāṃ varā satī||2.20.39||
meaning: I, being the eldest (of the queens) will have to listen to many heartbreaking and unpleasant words from my fellowwives who are younger to me.

sanskrit: अतो दुःखतरं किं नु प्रमदानां भविष्यति। मम शोको विलापश्च यादृशोऽयमनन्तकः।।2.20.40।।
transliteration: ato duḥkhatarṃ kiṃ nu pramadānāṃ bhaviṣyati| mama śoko vilāpaśca yādṛśo'yamanantakḥ||2.20.40||
meaning: There cannnot be greater distress for any woman than such unending grief and lamentation (which I am now experiencing).

sanskrit: त्वयि सन्निहितेऽप्येवमहमासं निराकृता। किं पुनः प्रोषिते तात ध्रुवं मरणमेव मे।।2.20.41।।
transliteration: tvayi sannihite'pyevamahamāsṃ nirākṛtā| kiṃ punḥ proṣite tāta dhruvṃ maraṇameva me||2.20.41||
meaning: O child even when you are nearby I am neglected like this. What to say when you are banished. Death is certain to me.

sanskrit: अत्यन्तनिगृहीतास्मि भर्तुर्नित्यमतन्त्रिता। परिवारेण कैकेय्या स्समा वाप्यथवाऽवरा।।2.20.42।।
transliteration: atyantanigṛhītāsmi bharturnityamatantritā| parivāreṇa kaikeyyā ssamā vāpyathavā'varā||2.20.42||
meaning: Treating me as an equal or inferior to the attendants of Kaikeyi and making me always dependent, my husband has greatly suppressed me.

sanskrit: योऽहि मां सेवते कश्चिदथवाप्यनुवर्तते। कैकेय्याः पुत्रमन्वीक्ष्य स्वश्चि जनो नाभिभाषते।।2.20.43।।
transliteration: yo'hi māṃ sevate kaścidathavāpyanuvartate| kaikeyyāḥ putramanvīkṣya svaści jano nābhibhāṣate||2.20.43||
meaning: Any one who serves me or follows me will not talk to me after seeing Bharata (installed as heirapparent).

sanskrit: नित्यक्रोधतया तस्याः कथं नु खरवादितत्। कैकेय्या वदनं द्रष्टुं पुत्र शक्ष्यामि दुर्गता।।2.20.44।।
transliteration: nityakrodhatayā tasyāḥ kathṃ nu kharavāditat| kaikeyyā vadanṃ draṣṭuṃ putra śakṣyāmi durgatā||2.20.44||
meaning: Fallen into an unfortunate state how can I look at Kaikeyi's face who is always harsh and in temper?

sanskrit: दश सप्त च वर्षाणि जातस्य तव राघव अतितानि प्रकाङ्क्षन्त्या मया दुःखपरिक्षयम्।।2.20.45।।
transliteration: daśa sapta ca varṣāṇi jātasya tava rāghava atitāni prakāṅkṣantyā mayā duḥkhaparikṣayam||2.20.45||
meaning: O Rama, I have spent the last seventeen years after your birth with the expectaion that my sorrows would come to an end.

sanskrit: तदक्षयं महद्दुःखं नोत्सहे सहितुं चिरम्। विप्रकारं सपत्नीनामेवं जीर्णाऽपि राघव।।2.20.46।।
transliteration: tadakṣayṃ mahadduḥkhṃ notsahe sahituṃ ciram| viprakārṃ sapatnīnāmevṃ jīrṇā'pi rāghava||2.20.46||
meaning: Therefore, O Rama, I cannot at this old age endure this great, endless sorrow and the insults from cowives for long.

sanskrit: अपश्यन्ती तव मुखं परिपूर्णशशिप्रभम्। कृपणा वर्तयिष्यामि कथं कृपणजीविकाम्।।2.20.47।।
transliteration: apaśyantī tava mukhṃ paripūrṇaśaśiprabham| kṛpaṇā vartayiṣyāmi kathṃ kṛpaṇajīvikām||2.20.47||
meaning: Without beholding your face that is as bright as the full Moon, how can this wretched woman live this pitiable life?

sanskrit: उपवासैश्च योगैश्च बहुभिश्च परिश्रमैः। दुःखं संवर्धितो मोघं त्वं हि दुर्गतया मया।।2.20.48।।
transliteration: upavāsaiśca yogaiśca bahubhiśca pariśramaiḥ| duḥkhṃ sṃvardhito moghṃ tvṃ hi durgatayā mayā||2.20.48||
meaning: Through meditation, through fasts and with a great deal of efforts you have been brought up by this luckless (mother). But alas this is all in vain.

sanskrit: स्थिरं तु हृदयं मन्ये ममेदं यन्न दीर्यते। प्रावृषीव महानद्या स्पृष्टं कूलं नवाम्भसा।।2.20.49।।
transliteration: sthirṃ tu hṛdayṃ manye mamedṃ yanna dīryate| prāvṛṣīva mahānadyā spṛṣṭṃ kūlṃ navāmbhasā||2.20.49||
meaning: I think my heart must be very firm (hard) like the bark of a great river which, touched by (a flood of) fresh water in the rainy season does not disintegrate.

sanskrit: ममैव नूनं मरणं न विद्यते न चावकाऽशोस्ति यमक्षयेऽमम। यदन्तकोऽद्यैव न मां जिहीर्षति। प्रसह्य सिंहो रुदतीं मृगीमिव।।2.20.50
transliteration: mamaiva nūnṃ maraṇṃ na vidyate na cāvakā'śosti yamakṣaye'mama| yadantako'dyaiva na māṃ jihīrṣati| prasahya siṃho rudatīṃ
meaning: There is no room for me in the abode of Yama (the god of death). If he does not carry me off forcibly like a lion carrying away a crying female deer, certainly there is no death for me.

sanskrit: स्थिरं हि नूनं हृदयं ममायसं न भिद्यते यद्भुवि नावदीर्यते। अनेन दुःखेन च देहमर्पितं ध्रुवं ह्यकाले मरणं न विद्यते।।2.20.5
transliteration: sthirṃ hi nūnṃ hṛdayṃ mamāyasṃ na bhidyate yadbhuvi nāvadīryate| anena duḥkhena ca dehamarpitṃ dhruvṃ hyakāle maraṇṃ na
meaning: Surely my still (hard) heart is made of iron. It neither bursts nor breaks down on the ground. Pervaded by grief, there is no untimely death for this my body, too.

sanskrit: इदं हि दुःखं यदनर्थकानि मे व्रतानि दानानि च संयमाश्च हि। तपश्च तप्तं यदपत्यकारणा त्सुनिष्फलं बीजमिवोप्तमूषरे।।2.20.52।।
transliteration: idṃ hi duḥkhṃ yadanarthakāni me vratāni dānāni ca sṃyamāśca hi| tapaśca taptṃ yadapatyakāraṇā tsuniṣphalṃ bījamivoptamūṣ
meaning: My regret is that all my mortifications, gifts of charity and penances are of no avail. Even the asceticism which I practised for the sake of progeny was fruitless like a seed sown in a barren land.

sanskrit: यदि ह्यकाले मरणं स्वयेच्छया लभेत कश्चिद्गुरुदुःखकर्शितः। गताहमद्यैव परेतसंसदं विना त्वया धेनुरिवात्मजेन वै।।2.20.53।।
transliteration: yadi hyakāle maraṇṃ svayecchayā labheta kaścidguruduḥkhakarśitḥ| gatāhamadyaiva paretasṃsadṃ vinā tvayā dhenurivātmajena
meaning: If any one, tormented with great sorrow, could willingly commit suicide I would have gone the way to the assembly of Yama (the lord of death) right away as without you I will be now like a cow without a calf.

sanskrit: अथापि किं जीवितमद्य मे वृथा त्वया विना चन्द्रनिभाननप्रभ। अनुव्रजिष्यामि वनं त्वयैव गौ स्सुदुर्बला वत्समिवानुकाङ्क्षया।।2
transliteration: athāpi kiṃ jīvitamadya me vṛthā tvayā vinā candranibhānanaprabha| anuvrajiṣyāmi vanṃ tvayaiva gau ssudurbalā vatsamivānu
meaning: What is the use of this life now? What is life without you whose countenance glows like the full Moon? Like a cow emaciated by its search for the calf, I will follow you into the forest.

sanskrit: भृशमसुखममर्षिता तदा बहु विललाप समीक्ष्य राघवम्। व्यसनमुपनिशम्य सा मह त्सुतमिव बद्धमवेक्ष्य किन्नरी।।2.20.55।।
transliteration: bhṛśamasukhamamarṣitā tadā bahu vilalāpa samīkṣya rāghavam| vyasanamupaniśamya sā maha tsutamiva baddhamavekṣya kinnarī|
meaning: Kausalya, filled with anger due to extreme sorrow reflected over her misfortune, and burst into harrowing tears, looking at Rama, like a kinnari looking at her grownup son taken captive. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकी

sanskrit: भ्रातुस्ते वदतः पुत्र लक्ष्मणस्य श्रुतं त्वया। यदत्रानन्तरं कार्यं कुरुष्व यदि रोचते।।2.21.20।।
transliteration: bhrātuste vadatḥ putra lakṣmaṇasya śrutṃ tvayā| yadatrānantarṃ kāryṃ kuruṣva yadi rocate||2.21.20||
meaning: O my son you have heard what your brother Lakshmana said and if it pleases you, do later what is to be done.

sanskrit: न चाधर्म्यं वच श्रुत्वा सपत्न्या मम भाषितम्। विहाय शोकसन्तप्तां गन्तुमर्हसि मामितः।।2.21.21।।
transliteration: na cādharmyṃ vaca śrutvā sapatnyā mama bhāṣitam| vihāya śokasantaptāṃ gantumarhasi māmitḥ||2.21.21||
meaning: By heeding the unrighteous words of my cowife (Kaikeyi) it does not behove you to leave me griefstricken and go away from here.

sanskrit: शुश्रूषुर्जननीं पुत्र स्वगृहे नियतो वसन्। परेण तपसा युक्तः काश्यपस्त्रिदिवं गतः।।2.21.23।।
transliteration: śuśrūṣurjananīṃ putra svagṛhe niyato vasan| pareṇa tapasā yuktḥ kāśyapastridivṃ gatḥ||2.21.23||
meaning: O son Kasyapa who led a life of selfdiscipline and served his mother at home, attained heaven credited with (the merit of) the highest penance.

sanskrit: यथैव राजा पूज्यस्ते गौरवेण तथाऽस्म्यहम्। त्वां नाहमनुजानामि न गन्तव्यमितो वनम्।।2.21.24।।
transliteration: yathaiva rājā pūjyaste gauraveṇa tathā'smyaham| tvāṃ nāhamanujānāmi na gantavyamito vanam||2.21.24||
meaning: Just as the king is worthy of your respectful homage, so am I. I will not permit you to go from here to the forest.

sanskrit: त्वद्वियोगान्न मे कार्यं जीवितेन सुखेन वा। त्वया सह मम श्रेयस्तृणानामपि भक्षणम्।।2.21.25।।
transliteration: tvadviyogānna me kāryṃ jīvitena sukhena vā| tvayā saha mama śreyastṛṇānāmapi bhakṣaṇam||2.21.25||
meaning: Separated from you, I have no use of this life or happiness. I prefer to live with you even if it means eating grass.

sanskrit: यदि त्वं यास्यसि वनं त्यक्त्वा मां शोकलालसाम्। अहं प्रायमिहासिष्ये न हि शक्ष्यामि जीवितुम्।।2.21.26।।
transliteration: yadi tvṃ yāsyasi vanṃ tyaktvā māṃ śokalālasām| ahṃ prāyamihāsiṣye na hi śakṣyāmi jīvitum||2.21.26||
meaning: If you depart for the forest leaving me griefstricken I cannot live. Here I shall seek death by fasting.

sanskrit: ततस्त्वं प्राप्स्यसे पुत्र निरयं लोकविश्रुतम्। ब्रह्महत्यामिवाधर्मात्समुद्र स्सरितां पतिः।।2.21.27।।
transliteration: tatastvṃ prāpsyase putra nirayṃ lokaviśrutam| brahmahatyāmivādharmātsamudra ssaritāṃ patiḥ||2.21.27||
meaning: O son you will then fall into hell. As wellknown in the world, the ocean, the lord of rivers, incurred the guilt of slaying a brahmin through unrighteous conduct.

sanskrit: विलपन्तीं तथा दीनां कौसल्यां जननीं ततः। उवाच रामो धर्मात्मा वचनं धर्मसंहितम्।।2.21.28।।
transliteration: vilapantīṃ tathā dīnāṃ kausalyāṃ jananīṃ tatḥ| uvāca rāmo dharmātmā vacanṃ dharmasṃhitam||2.21.28||
meaning: Thereafter, virtuous Rama addressed these words consistent with righteousness to his miserable mother Kausalya who was thus lamenting:

sanskrit: नास्ति शक्तिः पितुर्वाक्यं समतिक्रमितुं मम। प्रसादये त्वां शिरसा गन्तुमिच्छाम्यहं वनम्।।2.21.29।।
transliteration: nāsti śaktiḥ piturvākyṃ samatikramituṃ mama| prasādaye tvāṃ śirasā gantumicchāmyahṃ vanam||2.21.29||
meaning: I do not have the power to transgress the orders of my father. Bowing my head I beseech you, allow me to go to the forest.

sanskrit: ऋषिणा च पितुर्वाक्यं कुर्वता व्रतचारिणा। गौर्हता जानता धर्मं कण्डुनाऽपि विपश्चिता।।2.21.30।।
transliteration: ṛṣiṇā ca piturvākyṃ kurvatā vratacāriṇā| gaurhatā jānatā dharmṃ kaṇḍunā'pi vipaścitā||2.21.30||
meaning: Learned sage Kandu who knew what is righteousness and a strict observant of vows, slew a cow for carrying out the command of his father.

sanskrit: अस्माकं च कुले पूर्वं सगरस्याज्ञया पितुः। खनद्भिस्सागरैर्भूमिमवाप्तस्सुमहान्वधः।।2.21.31।।
transliteration: asmākṃ ca kule pūrvṃ sagarasyājñayā pituḥ| khanadbhissāgarairbhūmimavāptassumahānvadhḥ||2.21.31||
meaning: Earlier the sons of Sagara, born in our family, while excavating the earth by the order of their father met a terrible death.

sanskrit: जामद्ग्न्येन रामेण रेणुका जननी स्वयम्। कृत्ता परशुनाऽरण्ये पितुर्वचनकारिणा।।2.21.32।।
transliteration: jāmadgnyena rāmeṇa reṇukā jananī svayam| kṛttā paraśunā'raṇye piturvacanakāriṇā||2.21.32||
meaning: Parasurama, son of Jamadagni himself in obedience to the words of his father, decapitated his mother Renuka in the forest with an axe.

sanskrit: एतैरन्यैश्च बहुभिर्देवि देवसमैः कृतम्। पितुर्वचनमक्लीबं करिष्यामि पितुर्हितम्।।2.21.33।।
transliteration: etairanyaiśca bahubhirdevi devasamaiḥ kṛtam| piturvacanamaklībṃ kariṣyāmi piturhitam||2.21.33||
meaning: All of them including many other godlike persons, O Mother fulfilled the words of their father. I shall also make my father's wish come true.

sanskrit: न खल्वेतन्मयैकेन क्रियते पितृशासनम्। एतैरपि कृतं देवि ये मया तव कीर्तिताः।।2.21.34।।
transliteration: na khalvetanmayaikena kriyate pitṛśāsanam| etairapi kṛtṃ devi ye mayā tava kīrtitāḥ||2.21.34||
meaning: I am not O Devi the only one obeying my father's command. All I have mentioned to you did.

sanskrit: नाहं धर्ममपूर्वं ते प्रतिकूलं प्रवर्तये। पूर्वैरयमभिप्रेतो गतो मार्गोऽनुगम्यते।।2.21.35।।
transliteration: nāhṃ dharmamapūrvṃ te pratikūlṃ pravartaye| pūrvairayamabhipreto gato mārgo'nugamyate||2.21.35||
meaning: I am not advancing anything new, contrary to the existing practice. I am only following the trodden path of our ancestors.

sanskrit: तदेतत्तु मया कार्यं क्रियते भुवि नान्यथा। पितुर्हि वचनं कुर्वन्न कश्चिन्नाम हीयते।।2.21.36।।
transliteration: tadetattu mayā kāryṃ kriyate bhuvi nānyathā| piturhi vacanṃ kurvanna kaścinnāma hīyate||2.21.36||
meaning: I will not do as duty anything contrary to what is done by others in this world. No one who obeys the commands of his father falls off the path of righteousness.

sanskrit: तामेवमुक्त्वा जननीं लक्ष्मणं पुनरब्रवीत्। वाक्यं वाक्यविदां श्रेष्ठश्श्रेष्ठस्सर्वधनुष्मताम्।।2.21.37।।
transliteration: tāmevamuktvā jananīṃ lakṣmaṇṃ punarabravīt| vākyṃ vākyavidāṃ śreṣṭhaśśreṣṭhassarvadhanuṣmatām||2.21.37||
meaning: One who is the best among the knowers of speech and best of all archers, Rama spoke to his mother in this manner and then said to Lakshmana:

sanskrit: तव लक्ष्मण जानामि मयि स्नेहमनुत्तमम्। विक्रमं चैव सत्त्वं च तेजश्च सुदुरासदम्।।2.21.38।।
transliteration: tava lakṣmaṇa jānāmi mayi snehamanuttamam| vikramṃ caiva sattvṃ ca tejaśca sudurāsadam||2.21.38||
meaning: I know, O Lakshmana, your profound affection for me. I also know your valour, strength and unassailable energy.

sanskrit: मम मातुर्महद्दुःखमतुलं शुभलक्षण। अभिप्रायमविज्ञाय सत्यस्य च शमस्य च।।2.21.39।।
transliteration: mama māturmahadduḥkhamatulṃ śubhalakṣaṇa| abhiprāyamavijñāya satyasya ca śamasya ca||2.21.39||
meaning: O Lakshamana of auspicious qualities, since my mother is not aware of the significance of truth and selfrestraint, she is overcome with grief, great and incomparable.

sanskrit: धर्मो हि परमो लोके धर्मे सत्यं प्रतिष्ठितम्। धर्मसंश्रितमेतच्च पितुर्वचनमुत्तमम्।।2.21.40।।
transliteration: dharmo hi paramo loke dharme satyṃ pratiṣṭhitam| dharmasṃśritametacca piturvacanamuttamam||2.21.40||
meaning: Righteousness alone is supreme in this world and truth is established in righteousness. This excellent command of our father is supported by righteousness.

sanskrit: संश्रुत्य च पितुर्वाक्यं मातुर्वा ब्राह्मणस्य वा। न कर्तव्यं वृथा वीर धर्ममाश्रित्य तिष्ठता।।2.21.41।।
transliteration: sṃśrutya ca piturvākyṃ māturvā brāhmaṇasya vā| na kartavyṃ vṛthā vīra dharmamāśritya tiṣṭhatā||2.21.41||
meaning: Any one, O hero, who has taken recourse to righteousness should not allow the promise made to his father, mother or a brahmin to go in vain.

sanskrit: सोऽहं न शक्ष्यामि पितुर्नियोगमतिवर्तितुम्। पितुर्हिवचनाद्वीर कैकेय्याऽहं प्रचोदितः।।2.21.42।।
transliteration: so'hṃ na śakṣyāmi piturniyogamativartitum| piturhivacanādvīra kaikeyyā'hṃ pracoditḥ||2.21.42||
meaning: O hero I cannot transgress the command of my father since at his instance only Kaikeyi urged me (to go to the forest).

sanskrit: तदेतां विसृजानार्यां क्षत्रधर्माश्रितां मतिम्। धर्ममाश्रय मा तैक्ष्ण्यं मद्बुद्धिरनुगम्यताम्।।2.21.43।।
transliteration: tadetāṃ visṛjānāryāṃ kṣatradharmāśritāṃ matim| dharmamāśraya mā taikṣṇyṃ madbuddhiranugamyatām||2.21.43||
meaning: Therefore, leave this ignoble thought, resort to the duty of a kshatriya, take the righteous path. Do not adopt violence. Follow my decision.

sanskrit: तमेवमुत्त्वा सौहार्दाद्भ्रातरं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः। उवाच भूयः कौसल्यां प्राञ्जलिश्शिरसानतः।।2.21.44।।
transliteration: tamevamuttvā sauhārdādbhrātarṃ lakṣmaṇāgrajḥ| uvāca bhūyḥ kausalyāṃ prāñjaliśśirasānatḥ||2.21.44||
meaning: Speaking affectionately to his brother Lakshmana, Rama with folded hands and head bowed again addressed Kausalya:

sanskrit: अनुमन्यस्व मां देवि गमिष्यन्तमितो वनम्। शापिताऽसि मम प्राणैः कुरु स्वस्त्ययनानि मे।।2.21.45।।
transliteration: anumanyasva māṃ devi gamiṣyantamito vanam| śāpitā'si mama prāṇaiḥ kuru svastyayanāni me||2.21.45||
meaning: I have decided, O mother to go to the forest from here. Grant me the permission to do so. I swear on my life. Perform all the ceremonies for securing prosperity for me.

sanskrit: तीर्णप्रतिज्ञश्च वनात्पुनरेष्याम्यहं पुरीम्। ययातिरिव राजर्षिःपुरा हित्वा पुनर्दिवम्।।2.21.46।।
transliteration: tīrṇapratijñaśca vanātpunareṣyāmyahṃ purīm| yayātiriva rājarṣiḥpurā hitvā punardivam||2.21.46||
meaning: Like rajarshi Yayati of yore who lost heaven and rejained it, I shall return from the forest to the city (of Ayodhya) after the vow is fulfilled.

sanskrit: शोकस्सन्धार्यतां मात र्हृदये साधु मा शुचः। वनवासादिहैष्यामि पुनः कृत्वा पितुर्वचः।।2.21.47।।
transliteration: śokassandhāryatāṃ māta rhṛdaye sādhu mā śucḥ| vanavāsādihaiṣyāmi punḥ kṛtvā piturvacḥ||2.21.47||
meaning: Do not grieve, O mother Be prudent enough to subdue your sorrow in your heart. Having fulfilled father's words, I shall come back from my sojourn in the forest.

sanskrit: त्वया मया च वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन सुमित्रया। पितुर्नियोगे स्थातव्यमेष धर्मस्सनातनः।।2.21.48।।
transliteration: tvayā mayā ca vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena sumitrayā| piturniyoge sthātavyameṣa dharmassanātanḥ||2.21.48||
meaning: You, Sita, Lakshmana, Sumitra and I -- all of us shall abide by the words of my father. This indeed is eternal law.
