sanskrit: अम्ब संहृत्य सम्भारान् दुःखं हृदि निगृह्य च। वनवासकृता बुद्धिर्मम धर्म्याऽनु वर्त्यताम्।।2.21.49।।
transliteration: amba sṃhṛtya sambhārān duḥkhṃ hṛdi nigṛhya ca| vanavāsakṛtā buddhirmama dharmyā'nu vartyatām||2.21.49||
meaning: O mother in withdrawing the articles (for consecration) and also in subduing the sorrow in your heart approve of my plan to dwell in the forest.

sanskrit: एतद्वचस्तस्य निशम्य माता सुधर्म्यमव्यग्रमविक्लबं च। मृतेव संज्ञां प्रतिलभ्य देवी समीक्ष्य रामं पुनरित्युवाच।।2.21.50।।
transliteration: etadvacastasya niśamya mātā sudharmyamavyagramaviklabṃ ca| mṛteva sṃjñāṃ pratilabhya devī samīkṣya rāmṃ punarityuvāca||2
meaning: Having heard these words so unruffled and tranquil which conformed to righteousness, mother (Kausalya), like a dead person regaining consciousness spoke to Rama again:

sanskrit: यथैव ते पुत्र पिता तथाऽहं गुरु स्स्वधर्मेण सुहृत्तया च। न त्वाऽनुजानामि न मां विहाय सुदुःखितामर्हसि गन्तुमेवम्।।2.21.51।
transliteration: yathaiva te putra pitā tathā'hṃ guru ssvadharmeṇa suhṛttayā ca| na tvā'nujānāmi na māṃ vihāya suduḥkhitāmarhasi gantumev
meaning: By virtue of my own duty and affection towards you, O my son I am as much your preceptor as your father is. I will not grant you permission. You should not go, leaving me deeply distressed.

sanskrit: किं जीवितेनेह विना त्वया मे लोकेन वा किं स्वधयाऽमृतेन। श्रेयो मुहूर्तं तव सन्निधानं ममेह कृत्स्नादपि जीवलोकात्।।2.21.52।
transliteration: kiṃ jīviteneha vinā tvayā me lokena vā kiṃ svadhayā'mṛtena| śreyo muhūrtṃ tava sannidhānṃ mameha kṛtsnādapi jīvalokāt||2
meaning: What is the purpose of my life in this world without you? What purpose do I have with the other world or with the oblations (offered to manes) or with nectar (availble to the gods). I would prefer one moment in your comp

sanskrit: नरैरिवोल्काभिरपोह्यमानो महागजोऽध्वानमनुप्रविष्टः। भूयः प्रजज्वाल विलापमेवं निशम्य रामः करुणं जनन्याः।।2.21.53।।
transliteration: narairivolkābhirapohyamāno mahāgajo'dhvānamanupraviṣṭḥ| bhūyḥ prajajvāla vilāpamevṃ niśamya rāmḥ karuṇṃ jananyāḥ||2.21.5
meaning: At the (inconsolable) lamentations of his mother, Rama was in flames (within) like a mighty elephant prevented from entering the highway by men with fireworks.

sanskrit: स मातरं चैव विसंज्ञकल्पा मार्तं च सौमित्रिमभिप्रतप्तम्। धर्मे स्थितो धर्म्यमुवाच वाक्यं यथा स एवार्हति तत्र वक्तुम्।।2.2
transliteration: sa mātarṃ caiva visṃjñakalpā mārtṃ ca saumitrimabhiprataptam| dharme sthito dharmyamuvāca vākyṃ yathā sa evārhati tatra
meaning: Rama, centred on righteousness, again addressed his mother who had almost fainted and Lakshmana who was deeply distressed. As his words were consistent with righteousness, he alone was competent to speak that way.

sanskrit: अहं हि ते लक्ष्मण नित्यमेव जानामि भक्तिं च पराक्रमं च। मम त्वभिप्रायमसन्निरीक्ष्य मात्रा सहाभ्यर्दसि मां सुदुःखम्।।2.21.
transliteration: ahṃ hi te lakṣmaṇa nityameva jānāmi bhaktiṃ ca parākramṃ ca| mama tvabhiprāyamasannirīkṣya mātrā sahābhyardasi māṃ suduḥ
meaning: I know your devotion (to me) and your valour, O Lakshmana But now, without understanding my intention you are causing me and mother severe pain and torment.

sanskrit: धर्मार्थकामाः खलु तात लोके समीक्षिता धर्मफलोदयेषु। ते तत्र सर्वे स्युरसंशयं मे भार्येव वश्याऽभिमता सुपुत्रा।।2.21.56।।
transliteration: dharmārthakāmāḥ khalu tāta loke samīkṣitā dharmaphalodayeṣu| te tatra sarve syurasṃśayṃ me bhāryeva vaśyā'bhimatā suputr
meaning: Dharma,artha and kama, O my dear are adjudged in this world according to the fruits of righteous action. All these three are doubtless there (in my decision to go to the forest), like obedience in a wife and love for the

sanskrit: यस्मिंस्तु सर्वे स्युरसन्निविष्टा धर्मो यत स्स्यात्तदुपक्रमेत। द्वेष्यो भवत्यर्थपरो हि लोके कामात्मता खल्वपि न प्रशस्ता।
transliteration: yasmiṃstu sarve syurasanniviṣṭā dharmo yata ssyāttadupakrameta| dveṣyo bhavatyarthaparo hi loke kāmātmatā khalvapi na pr
meaning: If actions which combine these three (dharma, artha and kama), cannot be performed (which is likely), resort to righteousness. (For) one who seeks wealth is abhorred and one who seeks fulfilment of desires does not attra

sanskrit: गुरुश्च राजा च पिता च वृद्धः क्रोधात्प्रहर्षाद्यदि वाऽपि कामात्। यद्व्यादिशेत्कार्यमवेक्ष्य धर्मं कस्तन्न कुर्यादनृशंसवृ
transliteration: guruśca rājā ca pitā ca vṛddhḥ krodhātpraharṣādyadi vā'pi kāmāt| yadvyādiśetkāryamavekṣya dharmṃ kastanna kuryādanṛśṃsav
meaning: Whatever a preceptor, an old man, a king and a father commands whether it is out of anger or pleasure or passion must be carried out as dharma. Who will not do it unless he is heartless?

sanskrit: स वै न शक्नोमि पितुः प्रतिज्ञा मिमामकर्तुं सकलां यथावत्। स ह्यावयोस्तात गुरुर्नियोगे देव्याश्च भर्ता स गति स्सधर्मः।।2.2
transliteration: sa vai na śaknomi pituḥ pratijñā mimāmakartuṃ sakalāṃ yathāvat| sa hyāvayostāta gururniyoge devyāśca bhartā sa gati ssad
meaning: It is impossible for me not to execute the promise completely, O my dear, he (Dasaratha) is our preceptor and, therefore, fit to command us. Even for mother Kausalya, he is her husband, her refuge and her dharma.

sanskrit: तस्मिन्पुनर्जीवति धर्मराजे विशेषतस्स्वे पथि वर्तमाने। देवी मया सार्धमितोऽपगच्छेत् कथं स्विदन्या विधवेव नारी।।2.21.60।।
transliteration: tasminpunarjīvati dharmarāje viśeṣatassve pathi vartamāne| devī mayā sārdhamito'pagacchet kathṃ svidanyā vidhaveva nārī|
meaning: While the righteous king is living, more importantly treading the righteous path, how can mother Kausalya, like an ordinary widow, accompany me leaving this city?

sanskrit: सा माऽनुमन्यस्व वनं व्रजन्तं कुरुष्व न स्स्वस्त्ययनानि देवि। यथा समाप्ते पुनराव्रजेयं यथा हि सत्येन पुनर्ययातिः।।2.21.61
transliteration: sā mā'numanyasva vanṃ vrajantṃ kuruṣva na ssvastyayanāni devi| yathā samāpte punarāvrajeyṃ yathā hi satyena punaryayātiḥ
meaning: Grant me permission O mother, to depart for the forest. Bless me and perform ceremonies for my wellbeing so that I shall return (to the city) after completion (of my exile) like Yayati (who came back to heaven) with the

sanskrit: यशो ह्यहं केवलराज्यकारणा न्न पृष्ठतः कर्तुमलं महोदयम्। अदीर्घकाले न तु देवि जीविते वृणेऽवरामद्य महीमधर्मतः।।2.21.62।।
transliteration: yaśo hyahṃ kevalarājyakāraṇā nna pṛṣṭhatḥ kartumalṃ mahodayam| adīrghakāle na tu devi jīvite vṛṇe'varāmadya mahīmadharma
meaning: I will not forsake this great glory (of fulfilling my father's promise) for the sake of the kingdom. In this transient existence O mother, I do not wish to acquire this insignificant earth unrighteously.

sanskrit: प्रसादयन्नरवृषभ स्समातरं पराक्रमाज्जिगमिषुरेव दण्डकान्। अथानुजं भृशमनुशास्य दर्शनं चकार तां हृदि जननीं प्रदक्षिणम्।।2.21
transliteration: prasādayannaravṛṣabha ssamātarṃ parākramājjigamiṣureva daṇḍakān| athānujṃ bhṛśamanuśāsya darśanṃ cakāra tāṃ hṛdi jananīṃ
meaning: Rama, the best among men, thus pacified his mother insisting on his desire to depart for Dandaka forest with courage. And elaborately instructed his brother about his good intentions after which he circumambulated his mo

sanskrit: निगृह्य रोषं शोकं च धैर्यमाश्रित्य केवलम्। अवमानं निरस्येमं गृहीत्वा हर्षमुत्तमम्।।2.22.3।। उपक्लृप्तं हि यत्किञ्चिदभिषे
transliteration: nigṛhya roṣṃ śokṃ ca dhairyamāśritya kevalam| avamānṃ nirasyemṃ gṛhītvā harṣamuttamam||2.22.3|| upaklṛptṃ hi yatkiñcidab
meaning: Restrain your anger and sorrow. Dismiss this humiliation (from the mind). Achieve great happiness through fortitude. Remove whatever preparations have been made for the purpose of (my) consecration today, and act quickly

sanskrit: बुद्धिः प्रणीता येनेयं मनश्च सुसमाहितम्। तं तु नार्हामि संक्लेष्टुं प्रव्रजिष्यामि मा चिरम्।।2.22.14।।
transliteration: buddhiḥ praṇītā yeneyṃ manaśca susamāhitam| tṃ tu nārhāmi sṃkleṣṭuṃ pravrajiṣyāmi mā ciram||2.22.14||
meaning: With wellcomposed mind this decision has been taken. I do not like to inflict pain (on Dasaratha or Kaikeyi). I shall, therefore, depart to the forest without delay.

sanskrit: कृतान्तस्त्वेव सौमित्रे द्रष्टव्यो मत्प्रवासने। राज्यस्य च वितीर्णस्य पुनरेव निवर्तने।।2.22.15।।
transliteration: kṛtāntastveva saumitre draṣṭavyo matpravāsane| rājyasya ca vitīrṇasya punareva nivartane||2.22.15||
meaning: If the award of the kingdom to me is revoked, O Lakshmana, and if I am banished in this manner, see, it is destiny.

sanskrit: कैकेय्याः प्रतिपत्तिर्हि कथं स्यान्मम पीडने। यदि भावो न दैवोऽयं कृतान्तविहितो भवेत्।।2.22.16।।
transliteration: kaikeyyāḥ pratipattirhi kathṃ syānmama pīḍane| yadi bhāvo na daivo'yṃ kṛtāntavihito bhavet||2.22.16||
meaning: If this thought and my misfortune were not caused in Kaikeyi by destiny, how could she muster such determination to inflict pain on me?

sanskrit: यदचिन्त्यन्तु तद्दैवं भूतेष्वपि न विहन्यते। व्यक्तं मयि च तस्यां च पतितो हि विपर्ययः।।2.22.20।।
transliteration: yadacintyantu taddaivṃ bhūteṣvapi na vihanyate| vyaktṃ mayi ca tasyāṃ ca patito hi viparyayḥ||2.22.20||
meaning: Inconceivable is the power of destiny. Its impact on all beings cannot be averted. That an adversity has befallen me and Kaikeyi is (therefore) evident.

sanskrit: कश्चिद्दैवेन सौमित्रे योद्धुमुत्सहते पुमान्। यस्य न ग्रहणं किञ्चित्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र दृश्यते।।2.22.21।।
transliteration: kaściddaivena saumitre yoddhumutsahate pumān| yasya na grahaṇṃ kiñcitkarmaṇo'nyatra dṛśyate||2.22.21||
meaning: O Lakshmana which mortal has the power to fight with destiny the grip of which can be comprehended by following its course only through its effect and nowhere else.

sanskrit: सुखदुःखे भयक्रोधौ लाभालाभौ भवाभवौ। यच्च किञ्चित्तथाभूतं ननु दैवस्य कर्म तत्।।2.22.22।।
transliteration: sukhaduḥkhe bhayakrodhau lābhālābhau bhavābhavau| yacca kiñcittathābhūtṃ nanu daivasya karma tat||2.22.22||
meaning: Happiness or misery, fear or anger, gain or loss, birth or death, and all such things are surely the acts of destiny.

sanskrit: एभिरेव घटै स्सर्वैरभिषेचनसम्भृतैः। मम लक्ष्मण तापस्ये व्रतस्नानं भविष्यति।।2.22.27।।
transliteration: ebhireva ghaṭai ssarvairabhiṣecanasambhṛtaiḥ| mama lakṣmaṇa tāpasye vratasnānṃ bhaviṣyati||2.22.27||
meaning: With these very pots (of holy water) brought for the purpose of consecration, O Lakshmana I shall take bath at the time of taking vow for practising penance.

sanskrit: अथवा किं ममैतेन राजद्रव्यमयेन तु। उद्धृतं मे स्वयं तोयं व्रतादेशं करिष्यति।।2.22.28।।
transliteration: athavā kiṃ mamaitena rājadravyamayena tu| uddhṛtṃ me svayṃ toyṃ vratādeśṃ kariṣyati||2.22.28||
meaning: Or else, for me what is the use of these pots of holy water which are the king's property? The water drawn with my own hands will be made use of for my religious bath.

sanskrit: मा च लक्ष्मण सन्तापं कार्षीर्लक्ष्म्या विपर्यये। राज्यं वा वनवासो वा वनवासो महोदयः।।2.22.29।।
transliteration: mā ca lakṣmaṇa santāpṃ kārṣīrlakṣmyā viparyaye| rājyṃ vā vanavāso vā vanavāso mahodayḥ||2.22.29||
meaning: Do not grieve, O Lakshmana, over the loss of the kingdom. Living in exile is more glorious than running the kingdom.

sanskrit: न लक्ष्मणास्मिन्खलु कर्मविघ्ने माता यवीयस्यतिशङ्कनीया। दैवाभिपन्ना हि वदत्यनिष्टं जानासि दैवं च तथा प्रभावम्।।2.22.30।।
transliteration: na lakṣmaṇāsminkhalu karmavighne mātā yavīyasyatiśaṅkanīyā| daivābhipannā hi vadatyaniṣṭṃ jānāsi daivṃ ca tathā prabhāva
meaning: O Lakshmana our younger mother (Kaikeyi) cannot be blamed for her obstruction to my coronation. Overpowered by destiny, she is speaking such unpleasant words. This you know is the impact of destiny. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामा

sanskrit: अस्थाने सम्भ्रमो यस्य जातो वै सुमहानयम्।।2.23.5।। धर्मदोष प्रसङ्गेन लोकस्यानतिशङ्कया। कथंह्येतदसम्भ्रान्तस्त्वद्विधो वक्
transliteration: asthāne sambhramo yasya jāto vai sumahānayam||2.23.5|| dharmadoṣa prasaṅgena lokasyānatiśaṅkayā| kathṃhyetadasambhrāntas
meaning: O Rama, the greatest among the brave kshatriyas you say this because of your fear that (by disobeying father's command) harm will be done to righteousness. This great haste is unwarranted for there is the least apprehens

sanskrit: येनेय मागता द्वैधं तव बुद्धिर्महामते। स हि धर्मो मम द्वेष्यः प्रसङ्गाद्यस्य मुह्यसि।।2.23.11।।
transliteration: yeneya māgatā dvaidhṃ tava buddhirmahāmate| sa hi dharmo mama dveṣyḥ prasaṅgādyasya muhyasi||2.23.11||
meaning: O noble minded one I hate this righteousness which has deluded your intellect and created this dilemma about this issue.

sanskrit: कथं त्वं कर्मणा शक्तः कैकेयीवशवर्तिनः। करिष्यसि पितुर्वाक्यमधर्मिष्ठं विगर्हितम्।।2.23.12।।
transliteration: kathṃ tvṃ karmaṇā śaktḥ kaikeyīvaśavartinḥ| kariṣyasi piturvākyamadharmiṣṭhṃ vigarhitam||2.23.12||
meaning: When you are able to counter (this move), why do you want to execute the unjustifiable and contemptible words of the king who is under the spell of Kaikeyi?

sanskrit: स चेद्राजन्यनेकाग्रे राज्यविभ्रमशङ्कया। नैवमिच्छसि धर्मात्मन् राज्यं राम त्वमात्मनि।।2.23.27।। प्रतिजाने च ते वीर माऽभूव
transliteration: sa cedrājanyanekāgre rājyavibhramaśaṅkayā| naivamicchasi dharmātman rājyṃ rāma tvamātmani||2.23.27|| pratijāne ca te vīr
meaning: O righteous one, if you apprehend chaos in the kingdom for want of wholehearted support from the (feudatory) kings then, O my valiant brother, I swear to you, I will protect your kingdom like the shore protecting the oce

sanskrit: मङ्गलैरभिषिञ्चस्व तत्र त्वं व्यापृतो भव। अहमेको महीपालानलं वारयितुं बलात्।।2.23.29।।
transliteration: maṅgalairabhiṣiñcasva tatra tvṃ vyāpṛto bhava| ahameko mahīpālānalṃ vārayituṃ balāt||2.23.29||
meaning: The consecration may be performed with these auspicious materials. I am alone capable of facing these kings with my valour.

sanskrit: न शोभार्थाविमौ बाहू न धनुर्भूषणाय मे। नाऽसिराबन्धनार्थाय न शरास्तम्भहेतवः।।2.23.30।। अमित्रदमनार्थं मे सर्वमेतच्चतुष्टयम
transliteration: na śobhārthāvimau bāhū na dhanurbhūṣaṇāya me| nā'sirābandhanārthāya na śarāstambhahetavḥ||2.23.30|| amitradamanārthṃ me
meaning: These my arms are not intended to enhance the beauty (of my body). This bow is not for decoration. The sword is not for the sake of strapping my waist. The arrows are not meant to be fixed to my quiver. All these four ar

sanskrit: न चाहं कामयेऽत्यर्थं यस्स्याच्छत्रुर्मतो मम।।2.23.31।। असिना तीक्ष्णधारेण विद्युच्चलितवर्चसा। प्रगृहीतेन वै शत्रुं वज्रि
transliteration: na cāhṃ kāmaye'tyarthṃ yassyācchatrurmato mama||2.23.31|| asinā tīkṣṇadhāreṇa vidyuccalitavarcasā| pragṛhītena vai śatru
meaning: Any one who turns my enemy will not be allowed to remain alive. Holding my sharpedged sword, lustrous as a flash of lightning, I shall exterminate my enemy even if it were Indra, the bearer of thunder.

sanskrit: खड्गनिष्पेषनिष्पिष्टैर्गहना दुश्चरा च मे। हस्त्यश्वनरहस्तोरुशिरोभिर्भविता मही।।2.23.33।।
transliteration: khaḍganiṣpeṣaniṣpiṣṭairgahanā duścarā ca me| hastyaśvanarahastoruśirobhirbhavitā mahī||2.23.33||
meaning: This entire earth will become impenetrable and impassable, scattered with the trunks, thighs and heads of elephants, horses and warriors hacked off with my sword.

sanskrit: बहुभिश्चैकमत्यस्यन्नेकेन च बहून्जनान्। विनियोक्ष्याम्यहं बाणान्नृवाजिगजमर्मसु।।2.23.36।।
transliteration: bahubhiścaikamatyasyannekena ca bahūnjanān| viniyokṣyāmyahṃ bāṇānnṛvājigajamarmasu||2.23.36||
meaning: Striking each of my foes with many arrows and many with one arrow, I shall aim them at the vitals of men, horses and elephants.

sanskrit: अद्य मेऽस्त्रप्रभावस्य प्रभावः प्रभविष्यति। राज्ञश्चाप्रभुतां कर्तुं प्रभुत्वं तव च प्रभोः।।2.23.37।।
transliteration: adya me'straprabhāvasya prabhāvḥ prabhaviṣyati| rājñaścāprabhutāṃ kartuṃ prabhutvṃ tava ca prabhoḥ||2.23.37||
meaning: O Lord today you shall see the power of my glorious weapons in depriving the king (Dasaratha) of his authority and establishing your supremacy over the kingdom.

sanskrit: अद्य चन्दनसारस्य केयूरामोक्षणस्य च। वसूनां च विमोक्षस्य सुहृदां पालनस्य च।।2.23.38।। अनुरूपाविमौ बाहू राम कर्म करिष्यतः।
transliteration: adya candanasārasya keyūrāmokṣaṇasya ca| vasūnāṃ ca vimokṣasya suhṛdāṃ pālanasya ca||2.23.38|| anurūpāvimau bāhū rāma ka
meaning: These arms, O Rama which are fit for sandalwood cream, for wearing armlets, for distributing wealth and for protecting friends, will perform the worthy act of subduing those who are creating obstruction to your consecrat

sanskrit: ब्रवीहि कोऽद्यैव मया वियुज्यताम् तवा सुहृत्प्राणयशस्सुहृज्जनैः। यथा तवेयं वसुधा वशे भवे त्तथैव मां शाधि तवास्मि किङ्करः।
transliteration: bravīhi ko'dyaiva mayā viyujyatām tavā suhṛtprāṇayaśassuhṛjjanaiḥ| yathā taveyṃ vasudhā vaśe bhave ttathaiva māṃ śādhi t
meaning: Tell me your enemy who should be deprived of his life, fame and friends. Command me as to how this earth shall come under your control. Now itself I shall do that. I am your servant.

sanskrit: अयं तु मामात्मभव स्तवादर्शनमारुतः। विलापदुःखसमिधो रुदिताश्रुहुताहुतिः।।2.24.6।। चिन्ताबाष्पमहाधूमस्तवागमनचित्तजः। कर्शयि
transliteration: ayṃ tu māmātmabhava stavādarśanamārutḥ| vilāpaduḥkhasamidho ruditāśruhutāhutiḥ||2.24.6|| cintābāṣpamahādhūmastavāgamanac
meaning: After your departure, O son, an incomparably huge fire of grief with sighs of exhaustion will burst from my body, fanned by the wind of your absence and fuelled by lamentation and affliction. My wailing tears will be the

sanskrit: भरतश्चापि धर्मात्मा सर्वभूतप्रियंवदः। भवतीमनुवर्तेत स हि धर्मरतस्सदा।।2.24.22।।
transliteration: bharataścāpi dharmātmā sarvabhūtapriyṃvadḥ| bhavatīmanuvarteta sa hi dharmaratassadā||2.24.22||
meaning: Bharata, who is virtuous and speaks pleasantly to all beings and who is always attached to righteousness will surely remain obedient to you.

sanskrit: यथा मयि तु निष्क्रान्ते पुत्रशोकेन पार्थिवः। श्रमं नावाप्नुयात्किञ्चिदप्रमत्ता तथा कुरु।।2.24.23।।
transliteration: yathā mayi tu niṣkrānte putraśokena pārthivḥ| śramṃ nāvāpnuyātkiñcidapramattā tathā kuru||2.24.23||
meaning: After my departure, you must see that the king is not overpowered by grief for his son and struggles as little as possible.

sanskrit: अग्निकार्येषु च सदा सुमनोभिश्च देवताः। पूज्यास्ते मत्कृते देवि बाह्मणाश्चैव सुव्रताः।।2.24.28।।
transliteration: agnikāryeṣu ca sadā sumanobhiśca devatāḥ| pūjyāste matkṛte devi bāhmaṇāścaiva suvratāḥ||2.24.28||
meaning: For my sake, O devi worship the firegod with offerings of oblations and flowers, and brahmins who are true to religious vows.

sanskrit: एवं कालं प्रतीक्षस्व ममागमनकाङ्क्षिणी। नियता नियताहारा भर्तृशुश्रूषणे रता।।2.24.29।।
transliteration: evṃ kālṃ pratīkṣasva mamāgamanakāṅkṣiṇī| niyatā niyatāhārā bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇe ratā||2.24.29||
meaning: Looking forward to my return, spend your time this way with moderate intake, a mind under control and a life devoted to the service of your husband.

sanskrit: तथा हि रामं वनवासनिश्चितं समीक्ष्य देवी परमेण चेतसा। उवाच रामं शुभलक्षणं वचो बभूव च स्वस्त्ययनाभिकाङ्क्षिणी।।2.24.38।।
transliteration: tathā hi rāmṃ vanavāsaniścitṃ samīkṣya devī parameṇa cetasā| uvāca rāmṃ śubhalakṣaṇṃ vaco babhūva ca svastyayanābhikāṅkṣ
meaning: Seeing Rama full of auspicious qualities resolved to go to the forest and having spoken to him with the fullness of her heart, Devi Kausalya now braced herself up to perform ceremonies in the interest of Rama's wellbeing

sanskrit: स्मृतिर्धृतिश्च धर्मश्च पातु त्वां पुत्र सर्वतः।।2.25.10।। स्कन्दश्च भगवान्देव स्सोमश्च स बृहस्पतिः। सप्तर्षयो नारदश्च त
transliteration: smṛtirdhṛtiśca dharmaśca pātu tvāṃ putra sarvatḥ||2.25.10|| skandaśca bhagavāndeva ssomaśca sa bṛhaspatiḥ| saptarṣayo nā
meaning: O my son may Smriti, Dhriti and Dharma always guard you. May divine personages and gods, Skanda, Soma, Brihaspati, the seven rishis and Narada protect you at all times

sanskrit: शैलास्सर्वे समुद्राश्च राजा वरुण एव च। द्यौरन्तरिक्षं पृथिवी नद्यस्सर्वास्तथैव च।।2.25.13।। नक्षत्राणि च सर्वाणि ग्रहाश्
transliteration: śailāssarve samudrāśca rājā varuṇa eva ca| dyaurantarikṣṃ pṛthivī nadyassarvāstathaiva ca||2.25.13|| nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvā
meaning: When you dwell in the forest may all the mountains, seas, lord Varuna, heaven, space, and earth and also all rivers, all stars and planets with their presiding deities, day, night, dawn and dusk protect you

sanskrit: स्वस्ति ते ऽस्त्वन्तरिक्षेभ्यः पार्थिवेभ्यः पुनः पुनः। सर्वेभ्यश्चैव देवेभ्यो ये च वै परिपन्थिनः।।2.25.22।।
transliteration: svasti te 'stvantarikṣebhyḥ pārthivebhyḥ punḥ punḥ| sarvebhyaścaiva devebhyo ye ca vai paripanthinḥ||2.25.22||
meaning: May gods from the sky, the earth and all other gods protect you and let there be no harm to you from your foes.

sanskrit: गुरुस्सोमश्च सूर्यश्च धनदोऽथ यमस्तथा। पान्तु त्वामर्चिता राम दण्डकारण्यवासिनम्।।2.25.23।।
transliteration: gurussomaśca sūryaśca dhanado'tha yamastathā| pāntu tvāmarcitā rāma daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinam||2.25.23||
meaning: Propitiated by my worship, O Rama may Brihaspati, Moon, Sun, Kubera and Yama protect you when you are in Dandaka forest

sanskrit: अमृतोत्पादने दैत्यान् घ्नतो वज्रधरस्य यत्। अदितिर्मङ्गलं प्रादात्तत्ते भवतु मङ्गलम्।।2.25.34।।
transliteration: amṛtotpādane daityān ghnato vajradharasya yat| aditirmaṅgalṃ prādāttatte bhavatu maṅgalam||2.25.34||
meaning: May you be bestowed with the same blessings conferred by Aditi on Indra, the wielder of thunder for the killing of daityas at the time nectar was generated

sanskrit: त्रीन्विक्रमान्प्रक्रमतो विष्णोरमिततेजसः। यदासीन्मङ्गलं राम तत्ते भवतु मङ्गलम्।।2.25.35।।
transliteration: trīnvikramānprakramato viṣṇoramitatejasḥ| yadāsīnmaṅgalṃ rāma tatte bhavatu maṅgalam||2.25.35||
meaning: O Rama by occupying three footsteps of space, highly lustrous Visnu owned the three worlds and obtained glory. May you obtain similar auspiciousness

sanskrit: ऋतवस्सागरा द्वीपा वेदा लोका दिशश्च ते। मङ्गलानि महाबाहो दिशन्तु शुभमङ्गलाः।।2.25.36।।
transliteration: ṛtavassāgarā dvīpā vedā lokā diśaśca te| maṅgalāni mahābāho diśantu śubhamaṅgalāḥ||2.25.36||
meaning: O mightyarmed Rama may the auspicious and prosperous seasons, seas, islands. the Vedas, the worlds and the quarters bless you

sanskrit: इति पुत्रस्य शेषांश्च कृत्वा शिरसि भामिनी। गन्धैश्चापि समालभ्य राममायतलोचना।।2.25.37।। ओषधीं चापि सिद्धार्थां विशल्यकरणी
transliteration: iti putrasya śeṣāṃśca kṛtvā śirasi bhāminī| gandhaiścāpi samālabhya rāmamāyatalocanā||2.25.37|| oṣadhīṃ cāpi siddhārthāṃ
meaning: The largeeyed Kausalya placed the remains of the offerings on his (Rama's) head and applied sandal cream to his body. She tied an auspicious medicinal herb known as Vishalyakarani to his arm for attainment of his objecti

sanskrit: भद्रासनगतं राम वनवासादिहागतम्। द्रक्ष्यामि च पुनस्त्वां तु तीर्णवन्तं पितुर्वचः।।2.25.43।।
transliteration: bhadrāsanagatṃ rāma vanavāsādihāgatam| drakṣyāmi ca punastvāṃ tu tīrṇavantṃ piturvacḥ||2.25.43||
meaning: After you have fulfilled your father's words and returned from your exile I shall behold you seated on the throne, O Rama

sanskrit: मङ्गलैरुपसपन्नो वनवासादिहागतः। वध्वा मम च नित्यं त्वं कामान्संवर्ध याहि भोः।।2.25.44।।
transliteration: maṅgalairupasapanno vanavāsādihāgatḥ| vadhvā mama ca nityṃ tvṃ kāmānsṃvardha yāhi bhoḥ||2.25.44||
meaning: O Rama, credited with auspicious events on return from the forest, fulfil my desires and those of my daughterinlaw (Sita).

sanskrit: मयाऽर्चिता देवगणाश्शिवादयो महर्षयो भूतमहासुरोरगाः। अभिप्रयातस्य वनं चिराय ते हितानि काङ्क्षन्तु दिशश्च राघव।।2.25.45।।
transliteration: mayā'rcitā devagaṇāśśivādayo maharṣayo bhūtamahāsuroragāḥ| abhiprayātasya vanṃ cirāya te hitāni kāṅkṣantu diśaśca rāghav
meaning: O son of the Raghu race Lord Siva and other gods, the great rishis, bhutas, great asuras and serpents and four quarters worshipped by me will always promote your welfare when you dwell in the forest.

sanskrit: इतीव साऽश्रुप्रतिपूर्णलोचना समाप्य च स्वस्त्ययनं यथाविधि। प्रदक्षिणं चैव चकार राघवं पुनः पुनश्चापि निपीड्य सस्वजे।।2.25.
transliteration: itīva sā'śrupratipūrṇalocanā samāpya ca svastyayanṃ yathāvidhi| pradakṣiṇṃ caiva cakāra rāghavṃ punḥ punaścāpi nipīḍya s
meaning: Thus with her eyes brimming with tears, she duly completed the benedictory rites and circumambulated the scion of the Raghus and embraced him again and again holding him tight.

sanskrit: तथा तु देव्या स कृतप्रदक्षिणो निपीड्य मातुश्चरणौ पुनः पुनः। जगाम सीतानिलयं महायशा स्स राघवः प्रज्वलित स्स्वया श्रिया।।2.
transliteration: tathā tu devyā sa kṛtapradakṣiṇo nipīḍya mātuścaraṇau punḥ punḥ| jagāma sītānilayṃ mahāyaśā ssa rāghavḥ prajvalita ssvay
meaning: Circumambulated by mother Kausalya, the illustrious scion of the Raghu race clasped his mother's feet again and again. And shining in his glory, proceeded to the palace of Sita. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्

sanskrit: अद्य बार्हस्पत श्श्रीमान्युक्तः पुष्योऽनु राघव। प्रोच्यते ब्राह्मणैः प्राज्ञैः केन त्वमसि दुर्मनाः।।2.26.9।।
transliteration: adya bārhaspata śśrīmānyuktḥ puṣyo'nu rāghava| procyate brāhmaṇaiḥ prājñaiḥ kena tvamasi durmanāḥ||2.26.9||
meaning: O scion of the Raghu race, today has been declared by learned brahmins a suitable and auspicious day for consecration under Pushya star with Brihaspati as presiding deity. Then why are you dejected?

sanskrit: न ते शतशलाकेन जलफेननिभेन च। आवृतं वदनं वल्गु छत्रेणापि विराजते।।2.26.10।।
transliteration: na te śataśalākena jalaphenanibhena ca| āvṛtṃ vadanṃ valgu chatreṇāpi virājate||2.26.10||
meaning: How is it that your charming face shines not today under a hundredribbed umbrella (white) like foam in water?

sanskrit: व्यजनाभ्यां च मुख्याभ्यां शतपत्रनिभेक्षणम्। चन्द्रहंसप्रकाशाभ्यां वीज्यते न तवाननम्।।2.26.11।।
transliteration: vyajanābhyāṃ ca mukhyābhyāṃ śatapatranibhekṣaṇam| candrahṃsaprakāśābhyāṃ vījyate na tavānanam||2.26.11||
meaning: (How is it that) your face, with its lotuslike eyes is not being fanned by excellent fans of the colour of the Moon or the swan.

sanskrit: कुले महति सम्भूते धर्मज्ञे धर्मचारिणि। शृणु जानकि येनेदं क्रमेणाभ्यागतं मम।।2.26.20।।
transliteration: kule mahati sambhūte dharmajñe dharmacāriṇi| śṛṇu jānaki yenedṃ krameṇābhyāgatṃ mama||2.26.20||
meaning: You were born in a noble family. You know and practise dharma. I shall tell you how this banishment has come about. Do listen.

sanskrit: राज्ञा सत्यप्रतिज्ञेन पित्रा दशरथेन च। कैकेय्यै मम मात्रे तु पुरा दत्तौ महावरौ।।2.26.21।।
transliteration: rājñā satyapratijñena pitrā daśarathena ca| kaikeyyai mama mātre tu purā dattau mahāvarau||2.26.21||
meaning: My father, king Dasaratha, true to his promise, had earlier granted two great boons to my mother Kaikeyi.

sanskrit: नापि त्वं तेन भर्तव्या विशेषेण कदाचन। अनुकूलतया शक्यं समीपे त्वस्य वर्तितुम्।।2.26.26।।
transliteration: nāpi tvṃ tena bhartavyā viśeṣeṇa kadācana| anukūlatayā śakyṃ samīpe tvasya vartitum||2.26.26||
meaning: Never expect special treatment from Bharata. You can (continue to) stay with him (here) by conducting yourself in a favourable manner.

sanskrit: तस्मै दत्तं नृपतिना यौवराज्यं सनातनम्। स प्रसाद्यस्त्वया सीते नृपतिश्च विशेषतः।।2.26.27।।
transliteration: tasmai dattṃ nṛpatinā yauvarājyṃ sanātanam| sa prasādyastvayā sīte nṛpatiśca viśeṣatḥ||2.26.27||
meaning: O Sita the king has conferred the hereditary regency on him. Therefore, O Sita, you must make efforts to win his favour, especially a king's.

sanskrit: अहं चापि प्रतिज्ञां तां गुरोस्समनुपालयन्। वनमद्यैव यास्यामि स्थिरा भव मनस्विनी।।2.26.28।।
transliteration: ahṃ cāpi pratijñāṃ tāṃ gurossamanupālayan| vanamadyaiva yāsyāmi sthirā bhava manasvinī||2.26.28||
meaning: I am leaving for the forest right away for fulfilling my father's pledge. O highminded Sita be steady.

sanskrit: अहं गमिष्यामि वनं सुदुर्गमं मृगायुतं वानरवारणैर्युतम्। वने निवत्स्यामि यथा पितुर्गृहे तवैव पादावुपगृह्य संयता।।2.27.21।।
transliteration: ahṃ gamiṣyāmi vanṃ sudurgamṃ mṛgāyutṃ vānaravāraṇairyutam| vane nivatsyāmi yathā piturgṛhe tavaiva pādāvupagṛhya sṃyatā|
meaning: I shall go (along with you) to the highly impenetrable forest infested with animals like monkeys and elephants. I shall live in the forest in (full) discipline as in my father's abode, taking shelter at your feet.

sanskrit: अनन्यभावामनुरक्तचेतसं त्वया वियुक्तां मरणायनिश्चिताम्। नयस्व मां साधु कुरुष्व याचनाम् न ते मयाऽतो गुरुता भविष्यति।।2.27.
transliteration: ananyabhāvāmanuraktacetasṃ tvayā viyuktāṃ maraṇāyaniścitām| nayasva māṃ sādhu kuruṣva yācanām na te mayā'to gurutā bhavi
meaning: Since I have no thought other than you and my heart is (irretrievably) attached to you I have resolved to die if separated from you. Pray, be favourably disposed to take me. I shall not be a burden to you.

sanskrit: तथा ब्रुवाणामपि धर्मवत्सलो न च स्म सीतां नृवरो निनीषति। उवाच चैनां बहु सन्निवर्तने वने निवासस्य च दुःखितां प्रति।।2.27.2
transliteration: tathā bruvāṇāmapi dharmavatsalo na ca sma sītāṃ nṛvaro ninīṣati| uvāca caināṃ bahu sannivartane vane nivāsasya ca duḥkhi
meaning: Although Sita was thus appealing, Rama, devoted to righteousness, was (still) unwilling to take her. In order to dissuade her, he began to describe to the mournful Sita the many hardships of forest life. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद

sanskrit: सान्त्वयित्वा पुनस्तां तु बाष्पदूषितलोचनाम्। निवर्तनार्थे धर्मात्मा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह।।2.28.2।।
transliteration: sāntvayitvā punastāṃ tu bāṣpadūṣitalocanām| nivartanārthe dharmātmā vākyametaduvāca ha||2.28.2||
meaning: Righteous Rama consoled Sita whose eyes were blurred with tears, and in order to dissuade her (from going to the forest) said again:

sanskrit: सीते महाकुलीनाऽसि धर्मे च निरता सदा। इहाऽचर स्वधर्मं त्वं मे यथा मनसस्सुखम्।।2.28.3।।
transliteration: sīte mahākulīnā'si dharme ca niratā sadā| ihā'cara svadharmṃ tvṃ me yathā manasassukham||2.28.3||
meaning: Born in a noble race, O Sita, you are always devoted to duty. Follow your duty, here. It will make me happy.

sanskrit: मृगा स्सिंहा गजाश्चैव शार्दूला श्शरभास्तथा। पक्षिण स्सृमराश्चैव ये चान्ये वनचारिणः।।2.29.3।। अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात्सर्वे त
transliteration: mṛgā ssiṃhā gajāścaiva śārdūlā śśarabhāstathā| pakṣiṇa ssṛmarāścaiva ye cānye vanacāriṇḥ||2.29.3|| adṛṣṭapūrvarūpatvātsa
meaning: O scion of the Raghu race antelopes, lions, elephants, tigers, sarabhas, birds, srimaras and other wild beasts wandering in the forest have not seen your beauty before. Now on seeing you, they will flee away. In fact, wh

sanskrit: प्रेत्यभावे हि कल्याण स्सङ्गमो मे सह त्वया। श्रुतिर्हि श्रूयते पुण्या ब्राह्मणानां यशस्विनाम्।।2.29.17।। इहलोके च पितृभि
transliteration: pretyabhāve hi kalyāṇa ssaṅgamo me saha tvayā| śrutirhi śrūyate puṇyā brāhmaṇānāṃ yaśasvinām||2.29.17|| ihaloke ca pitṛb
meaning: My union with you, O highminded one, is auspicious even beyond death. A woman, given away by her parents in accordance with traditional offerings of water belongs to him even after death and lives with him. This is a sta

sanskrit: ﻿सुवर्णादीनि रत्नानि बलीन् सर्वौषधीरपि।।2.3.8।। शुक्लमाल्यांश्च लाजांश्च पृथक्च मधुसर्पिषी। अहतानि च वासांसि रथं सर्वायु
transliteration: ﻿suvarṇādīni ratnāni balīn sarvauṣadhīrapi||2.3.8|| śuklamālyāṃśca lājāṃśca pṛthakca madhusarpiṣī| ahatāni ca vāsāṃsi ra
meaning: ﻿ By tomorrow early morning arrange in the place set aside for sacred fire in the king's palace gold and other metals, gems, articles of worship, also herbs, garlands of white flowers, roasted corn, honey and clarified b

sanskrit: यच्चान्यत्किञ्चिदेष्टव्यं तत्सर्वमुपकल्प्यताम्।।2.3.12।। अन्तःपुरस्य द्वाराणि सर्वस्य नगरस्य च। चन्दनस्रग्भिरर्च्यन्तां
transliteration: yaccānyatkiñcideṣṭavyṃ tatsarvamupakalpyatām||2.3.12|| antḥpurasya dvārāṇi sarvasya nagarasya ca| candanasragbhirarcyant
meaning: Even the smallest items required be arranged. Let the gates of the inner apartment and of the entire city be decorated with sandalpaste and garlands. Let fragrant incense be burnt for worship.

sanskrit: अथ तत्र समासीना स्तदा दशरथं नृपम्।।2.3.24।। प्राच्योदीच्याः प्रतीच्याश्च दाक्षिणात्याश्च भूमिपाः। म्लेच्छाश्चार्याश्च ये
transliteration: atha tatra samāsīnā stadā daśarathṃ nṛpam||2.3.24|| prācyodīcyāḥ pratīcyāśca dākṣiṇātyāśca bhūmipāḥ| mlecchāścāryāśca ye
meaning: After Sumantra had gone, the kings from eastern, northern, western, southern nonAryan and Aryan countries, rulers from forests and mountains paid homage to king Dasaratha, as devatas do to Indra.

sanskrit: गन्धर्वराजप्रतिमं लोके विख्यातपौरुषम्।।2.3.27।। दीर्घबाहुं महासत्त्वं मत्तमातङ्गगामिनम्। चन्द्रकान्ताननं राममतीव प्रियदर
transliteration: gandharvarājapratimṃ loke vikhyātapauruṣam||2.3.27|| dīrghabāhuṃ mahāsattvṃ mattamātaṅgagāminam| candrakāntānanṃ rāmamat
meaning: Rama appeared as the very image of king of the gandharvas known for his courage in this world. With his long arms, he was extremely handsome with a countenance of the colour of moonstone possessed of immense strength, he

sanskrit: ﻿अवतार्य सुमन्त्रस्तं राघवं स्यन्दनोत्तमात्।।2.3.30।। पितुस्समीपं गच्छन्तं प्राञ्जलिः पृष्ठतोऽन्वगात्।
transliteration: ﻿avatārya sumantrastṃ rāghavṃ syandanottamāt||2.3.30|| pitussamīpṃ gacchantṃ prāñjaliḥ pṛṣṭhato'nvagāt|
meaning: ﻿ Sumantra assisted Rama while alighting from that splendid chariot and followed him with folded palms as Rama was proceeding towards his father.

sanskrit: ﻿स तं कैलासशृङ्गाभं प्रासादं नरपुङ्गवः।।2.3.31।। आरुरोह नृपं द्रष्टुं सह सूतेन राघवः।
transliteration: ﻿sa tṃ kailāsaśṛṅgābhṃ prāsādṃ narapuṅgavḥ||2.3.31|| āruroha nṛpṃ draṣṭuṃ saha sūtena rāghavḥ|
meaning: ﻿ Best among men, Rama accompanied by charioteer Sumantra ascended that palace that was lofty as the peak of Kailasa mountain in order to see the king.

sanskrit: स प्राञ्जलिरभिप्रेत्य प्रणतः पितुरन्तिके।।2.3.32।। नाम स्वं श्रावयन्रामो ववन्दे चरणौ पितुः।
transliteration: sa prāñjalirabhipretya praṇatḥ piturantike||2.3.32|| nāma svṃ śrāvayanrāmo vavande caraṇau pituḥ|
meaning: Rama, approached his father with folded palms and bowed low near him, pronounced his (own) name and touched his father's feet with reverence.

sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा प्रणतं पार्श्वे कृताञ्जलिपुटं नृपः।।2.3.33।। गृह्याञ्जलौ समाकृष्य सस्वजे प्रियमात्मजम्।
transliteration: tṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇatṃ pārśve kṛtāñjalipuṭṃ nṛpḥ||2.3.33|| gṛhyāñjalau samākṛṣya sasvaje priyamātmajam|
meaning: Seeing his beloved son Rama who was standing by his side with folded hands in supplication, king Dasaratha, held his folded hands and drew him near and embraced him.

sanskrit: तस्मै चाभ्युदितं दिव्यं मणिकाञ्चनभूषितम्।।2.3.34।। दिदेश राजा रुचिरं रामाय परमासनम्।
transliteration: tasmai cābhyuditṃ divyṃ maṇikāñcanabhūṣitam||2.3.34|| dideśa rājā rucirṃ rāmāya paramāsanam|
meaning: The king (Dasaratha) offered Rama a seat on the lofty, glorious throne splendidly decorated with gold and gems.

sanskrit: तदासनवरं प्राप्य व्यदीपयत राघवः।।2.3.35।। स्वयैव प्रभया मेरुमुदये विमलो रविः।
transliteration: tadāsanavarṃ prāpya vyadīpayata rāghavḥ||2.3.35|| svayaiva prabhayā merumudaye vimalo raviḥ|
meaning: The lofty seat Rama occupied was illuminated by him resplenderce like mount Meru in the translucent rays of the morning Sun.

sanskrit: ﻿तेन विभ्राजता तत्र सा सभाऽभिव्यरोचत।।2.3.36।। विमलग्रहनक्षत्रा शारदी द्यौरिवेन्दुना।
transliteration: ﻿tena vibhrājatā tatra sā sabhā'bhivyarocata||2.3.36|| vimalagrahanakṣatrā śāradī dyaurivendunā|
meaning: ﻿ That assembly was illumined by (the presence of) Rama like the Moon dazzling the clear autumnal sky bespangled with sparkling planets and stars.

sanskrit: तं पश्यमानो नृपतिस्तुतोष प्रियमात्मजम्।।2.3.37।। अलङ्कृतमिवात्मानमादर्शतलसंस्थितम्।
transliteration: tṃ paśyamāno nṛpatistutoṣa priyamātmajam||2.3.37|| alaṅkṛtamivātmānamādarśatalasṃsthitam|
meaning: The king was delighted to see his beloved son as though he saw his own reflection adorning a mirror.

sanskrit: स तं सस्मितमाभाष्य पुत्रं पुत्रवतां वरः।।2.3.38।। उवाचेदं वचो राजा देवेन्द्रमिव काश्यपः।
transliteration: sa tṃ sasmitamābhāṣya putrṃ putravatāṃ varḥ||2.3.38|| uvācedṃ vaco rājā devendramiva kāśyapḥ|
meaning: The best among fathers, he (Dasaratha) said these words to his son with a smile, like Kasyapa addressing Devendra.

sanskrit: ज्येष्ठायामसि मे पत्न्यां सदृश्यां सदृशस्सुतः।।2.3.39।। उत्पन्नस्त्वं गुणश्रेष्ठो मम रामात्मजः प्रियः।
transliteration: jyeṣṭhāyāmasi me patnyāṃ sadṛśyāṃ sadṛśassutḥ||2.3.39|| utpannastvṃ guṇaśreṣṭho mama rāmātmajḥ priyḥ|
meaning: A worthy son of my worthy eldest wife, O Rama, your great virtues have endeared you to me.

sanskrit: यतस्त्वया प्रजाश्चेमा स्स्वगुणैरनुरञ्जिताः।।2.3.40।। तस्मात्त्वं पुष्ययोगेन यौवराज्यमवाप्नुहि।
transliteration: yatastvayā prajāścemā ssvaguṇairanurañjitāḥ||2.3.40|| tasmāttvṃ puṣyayogena yauvarājyamavāpnuhi|
meaning: As you have endeared yourself to these subjects with your virtues, you shall assume the office of heirapparent when Pushya star is in conjunction with the Moon.

sanskrit: कामतस्त्वं प्रकृत्यैव विनीतो गुणवानसि।।2.3.41।। गुणवत्यपि तु स्नेहात्पुत्र वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्।
transliteration: kāmatastvṃ prakṛtyaiva vinīto guṇavānasi||2.3.41|| guṇavatyapi tu snehātputra vakṣyāmi te hitam|
meaning: Admittedly gentle by nature, you are gifted with virtues. O son, even though virtuous, I shall offer you counsel for your good out of affection for you.

sanskrit: भूयो विनयमास्थाय भव नित्यं जितेन्द्रियः।।2.3.42।। कामक्रोधसमुत्थानि त्यजेथा व्यसनानि च।
transliteration: bhūyo vinayamāsthāya bhava nityṃ jitendriyḥ||2.3.42|| kāmakrodhasamutthāni tyajethā vyasanāni ca|
meaning: With humility, always keep your senses under control. Keep off all violations arising out of lust and anger.

sanskrit: परोक्षया वर्तमानो वृत्त्या प्रत्यक्षया तथा।।2.3.43।। अमात्यप्रभृतीस्सर्वाःप्रकृतीश्चानुरञ्जय।
transliteration: parokṣayā vartamāno vṛttyā pratyakṣayā tathā||2.3.43|| amātyaprabhṛtīssarvāḥprakṛtīścānurañjaya|
meaning: With your behaviour keep the ministers and the people satisfied by means direct or indirect.

sanskrit: कोष्ठागारायुधागारैःकृत्वा सन्निचयान्बहून्।।2.3.44।। तुष्टानुरक्तप्रकृतिर्यः पालयति मेदिनीम्। तस्यनन्दन्ति मित्राणि लब्ध्
transliteration: koṣṭhāgārāyudhāgāraiḥkṛtvā sannicayānbahūn||2.3.44|| tuṣṭānuraktaprakṛtiryḥ pālayati medinīm| tasyanandanti mitrāṇi labd
meaning: You shall rule the earth by filling granaries of foodgrains and arsenals and keeping the subjects loyal and contented. The friends of such a person will memain pleased like devatas with nectar. Hence conduct yourself wit

sanskrit: ﻿तच्छ्रुत्वा सुहृदस्तस्य रामस्य प्रियकारिणः।।2.3.46।। त्वरिताः शीघ्रमभ्येत्य कौसल्यायै न्यवेदयन्।
transliteration: ﻿tacchrutvā suhṛdastasya rāmasya priyakāriṇḥ||2.3.46|| tvaritāḥ śīghramabhyetya kausalyāyai nyavedayan|
meaning: ﻿ Having heard this, Rama's friends quickly reported the matter to Kausalya so that she might be happy.

sanskrit: ﻿सा हिरण्यं च गाश्चैव रत्नानि विविधानि च।।2.3.47।। व्यादिदेश प्रियाख्येभ्यः कौसल्या प्रमदोत्तमा।
transliteration: ﻿sā hiraṇyṃ ca gāścaiva ratnāni vividhāni ca||2.3.47|| vyādideśa priyākhyebhyḥ kausalyā pramadottamā|
meaning: ﻿ The foremost of women, Kausalya ordered gifts of gold, cows and various kinds of gems to be given to the messengers who brought this good tiding.

sanskrit: अथाऽभिवाद्य राजानं रथमारुह्य राघवः।।2.3.48।। ययौ स्वं द्युतिमद्वेश्म जनौघैः प्रतिपूजितः।
transliteration: athā'bhivādya rājānṃ rathamāruhya rāghavḥ||2.3.48|| yayau svṃ dyutimadveśma janaughaiḥ pratipūjitḥ|
meaning: Having paid his obeisance to the king, Rama ascended the chariot amidst the acclaim of multitudes of men and left for his splendid abode.

sanskrit: ते चापि पौरा नृपतेर्वचस्त च्छृत्वा तथा लाभमिवेष्टमाशु। नरेन्द्रमामन्त्र्य गृहाणि गत्वा देवान्समानर्चुरतिप्रहृष्टाः।।2.3.
transliteration: te cāpi paurā nṛpatervacasta cchṛtvā tathā lābhamiveṣṭamāśu| narendramāmantrya gṛhāṇi gatvā devānsamānarcuratiprahṛṣṭāḥ|
meaning: On hearing such pronouncement by the king, the citizens also felt they have got something beneficial for themselves. They took leave of the king (Dasaratha) and hastening home, full of joy, began worshipping their gods.

sanskrit: न च तत्र ततः किञ्चिद्द्रष्टुमर्हसि विप्रियम्। मत्कृते न च ते शोको न भविष्यामि दुर्भरा।।2.30.17।।
transliteration: na ca tatra tatḥ kiñciddraṣṭumarhasi vipriyam| matkṛte na ca te śoko na bhaviṣyāmi durbharā||2.30.17||
meaning: Therefore, you should not anticipate any problem from me in the forest. Neither shall I be burdensome to you nor shall I make you experience any sorrow on my account.

sanskrit: य स्त्वया सह स स्वर्गो निरयो यस्त्वया विना। इति जानन्परां प्रीतिं गच्छ राम मया सह।।2.30.18।।
transliteration: ya stvayā saha sa svargo nirayo yastvayā vinā| iti jānanparāṃ prītiṃ gaccha rāma mayā saha||2.30.18||
meaning: Wherever I be with you is heaven and without, hell. O Rama, recognise this truth, and derive great pleasure in my company.

sanskrit: यत्त्रयं तत्त्रयो लोकाः पवित्रं तत्समं भुवि। नान्यदस्ति शुभापाङ्गे तेनेदमभिराध्यते।।2.30.34।।
transliteration: yattrayṃ tattrayo lokāḥ pavitrṃ tatsamṃ bhuvi| nānyadasti śubhāpāṅge tenedamabhirādhyate||2.30.34||
meaning: Where these three(mother,father and preceptor) equal to the three worlds are, O one with loverly sideglances, there is none in this world as holy. Therefore, they are to be worshipped.

sanskrit: न सत्यं दानमानौ वा न यज्ञाश्चाप्तदक्षिणाः। तथा बलकरा स्सीते यथा सेवा पितुर्हिता।।2.30.35।।
transliteration: na satyṃ dānamānau vā na yajñāścāptadakṣiṇāḥ| tathā balakarā ssīte yathā sevā piturhitā||2.30.35||
meaning: Truth or munificence or homage or distribution of gifts to the revered ones or sacrifices, O Sita, are not considered as efficacious as service to father.

sanskrit: आरभस्व शुभश्रोणि वनवासक्षमाः क्रियाः। नेदानीं त्वदृते सीते स्वर्गोऽपि मम रोचते।।2.30.42।।
transliteration: ārabhasva śubhaśroṇi vanavāsakṣamāḥ kriyāḥ| nedānīṃ tvadṛte sīte svargo'pi mama rocate||2.30.42||
meaning: O Sita, begin right now all preparations necessary for residing in the forest. O one, with beautiful buttocks, without you even the very heaven does not please me.

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च रत्नानि भिक्षुकेभ्यश्च भोजनम्। देहि चाशंसमानेभ्य स्सन्त्वरस्व च मा चिरम्।।2.30.43।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇebhyaśca ratnāni bhikṣukebhyaśca bhojanam| dehi cāśṃsamānebhya ssantvarasva ca mā ciram||2.30.43||
meaning: Give away your jewels to brahmins who need them and food to religious mendicants. Hurry up Do not delay.

sanskrit: भूषणानि महार्हाणि वरवस्त्राणि यानि च। रमणीयाश्च ये केचित्क्रीडार्थाश्चाप्युपस्कराः।।2.30.44।। शयनीयानि यानानि मम चान्यान
transliteration: bhūṣaṇāni mahārhāṇi varavastrāṇi yāni ca| ramaṇīyāśca ye kecitkrīḍārthāścāpyupaskarāḥ||2.30.44|| śayanīyāni yānāni mama
meaning: Distribute among your attendants highly valuable ornaments and excellent clothing, charming articles meant for (court) sport, my couches, chariots and all other things. Offer the rest to brahmins.

sanskrit: अनुकूलं तु सा भर्तुर्ज्ञात्वा गमनमात्मनः। क्षिप्रं प्रमुदिता देवी दातुमेवोपचक्रमे।।2.30.46।।
transliteration: anukūlṃ tu sā bharturjñātvā gamanamātmanḥ| kṣiprṃ pramuditā devī dātumevopacakrame||2.30.46||
meaning: Having come to know that her departure to the forest is acceptable to her husband, Sita, highly delighted, quickly got ready to give away (things).

sanskrit: तवैव तेजसा वीर भरतः पूजयिष्यति। कौसल्यां च सुमित्रां च प्रयतो नात्र संशयः।।2.31.19।।
transliteration: tavaiva tejasā vīra bharatḥ pūjayiṣyati| kausalyāṃ ca sumitrāṃ ca prayato nātra sṃśayḥ||2.31.19||
meaning: Aware of your power O valiant one, Bharata will undoubtedly pay respect to Kausalya and Sumitra with all humility.

sanskrit: कौशल्या बिभृयादार्या सहस्रमपि मद्विधान्। यस्यास्सहस्रं ग्रामाणां सम्प्राप्त मुपजीवनम्।।2.31.20।।
transliteration: kauśalyā bibhṛyādāryā sahasramapi madvidhān| yasyāssahasrṃ grāmāṇāṃ samprāpta mupajīvanam||2.31.20||
meaning: Noble Kausalya has under her charge a thousand villages for her sustenance. She can support a thousand men like me.

sanskrit: ये च राज्ञो ददौ दिव्ये महात्मा वरुण स्स्वयम्। जनकस्य महायज्ञे धनुषी रौद्रदर्शने।।2.31.27।। अभेद्यकवचे दिव्ये तूणी चाक्षय
transliteration: ye ca rājño dadau divye mahātmā varuṇa ssvayam| janakasya mahāyajñe dhanuṣī raudradarśane||2.31.27|| abhedyakavace divye
meaning: O Lakshmana in the great sacrifice performed by the highsouled Janaka, Varuna himself gave him two aweinspiring celestial bows, two impenetrable divine armours, two quivers with inexhaustible arrows, two swords plated wi

sanskrit: तं विप्रमग्न्यगारस्थं वन्दित्वा लक्ष्मणोऽब्रवीत्। सखेऽभ्यागच्छ पश्य त्वं वेश्म दुष्करकारिणः।।2.32.2।।
transliteration: tṃ vipramagnyagārasthṃ vanditvā lakṣmaṇo'bravīt| sakhe'bhyāgaccha paśya tvṃ veśma duṣkarakāriṇḥ||2.32.2||
meaning: Lakshmana paid homage to him who was in the firesanctuary, and said O friend, come and see the palace of Rama who is the accomplisher of all difficult tasks.

sanskrit: जातरूपमयैर्मुख्यैरङ्गदैः कुण्डलैः शुभैः। सहेमसूत्रैर्मणिभिः केयूरैर्वलयैरपि।।2.32.5।। अन्यैश्च रत्नैर्बहुभिः काकुत्स्थः
transliteration: jātarūpamayairmukhyairaṅgadaiḥ kuṇḍalaiḥ śubhaiḥ| sahemasūtrairmaṇibhiḥ keyūrairvalayairapi||2.32.5|| anyaiśca ratnairba
meaning: Rama, scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, worshipped Suyajna with a collection of golden ornaments such as earrings, anklets, armlets, bracelets and many other ornaments of precious stones. Then urged by Sita, Rama said to h

sanskrit: कौसल्यां च य आशीर्भिर्भक्तः पर्युपतिष्ठति। आचार्यस्तैत्तिरीयाणामभिरूपश्च वेदवित्।।2.32.15।। तस्य यानं च दासीश्च सौमित्रे
transliteration: kausalyāṃ ca ya āśīrbhirbhaktḥ paryupatiṣṭhati| ācāryastaittirīyāṇāmabhirūpaśca vedavit||2.32.15|| tasya yānṃ ca dāsīśca
meaning: O Lakshmana, give away chariots, maidservants, silk clothes to learned brahmins of Taittiriya branch and wellversed in the Vedas, to agreeable and faithful brahmins attending on Kausalya with their blessings till they ar

sanskrit: ये चेमे कठकालापा बहवो दण्डमाणवाः।।2.32.18।। नित्यस्वाध्यायशीलत्वान्नान्यत्कुर्वन्ति किञ्चन। अलसा स्वादुकामाश्च महतां चाप
transliteration: ye ceme kaṭhakālāpā bahavo daṇḍamāṇavāḥ||2.32.18|| nityasvādhyāyaśīlatvānnānyatkurvanti kiñcana| alasā svādukāmāśca maha
meaning: O Lakshmana many brahmacharis with a staff (as a mark of religious authority) wellversed in Katha and Kalapa portions of the Vedas engaged daily in the study of the Vedas and nothing else. Not active otherwise, they are

sanskrit: तत स्सपुरुषव्याघ्रस्तद्धनं लक्ष्मणः स्वयम्।।2.32.23।। यथोक्तं ब्राह्मणेन्द्राणांमददाद्धनदो यथा।
transliteration: tata ssapuruṣavyāghrastaddhanṃ lakṣmaṇḥ svayam||2.32.23|| yathoktṃ brāhmaṇendrāṇāṃmadadāddhanado yathā|
meaning: Thereupon Lakshmana, a tiger among men, personally distributed like Kubera, gifts of riches to all those Indras among brahmins (best of brahmins) in accordance with the instructions of Rama.

sanskrit: अथाऽब्रवीद्बाष्पकलांस्तिष्ठतश्चोपजीविनः।।2.32.24।। सम्प्रदायबहुद्रव्यमेकैकस्योपजीवनम्।
transliteration: athā'bravīdbāṣpakalāṃstiṣṭhataścopajīvinḥ||2.32.24|| sampradāyabahudravyamekaikasyopajīvanam|
meaning: Rama then bestowed abundant wealth on each of the dependents as they stood with their throats choked with tears, saying:

sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा दुःखितं सर्वं जनं तमुपजीविनम्।।2.32.26।। उवाचेदं धनाध्यक्षं धनमानीयतामिति।
transliteration: ityuktvā duḥkhitṃ sarvṃ janṃ tamupajīvinam||2.32.26|| uvācedṃ dhanādhyakṣṃ dhanamānīyatāmiti|
meaning: Having spoken thus to all dependents who were overcome with grief, Rama ordered the treasury officer to bring the entire treasure.

sanskrit: ततोऽस्य धनमाजह्रुस्सर्वमेवोपजीविनः।।2.32.27।। स राशिस्सुमहांस्तत्र दर्शनीयो ह्यदृश्यत।
transliteration: tato'sya dhanamājahrussarvamevopajīvinḥ||2.32.27|| sa rāśissumahāṃstatra darśanīyo hyadṛśyata|
meaning: When all the dependents fetched the entire wealth of Rama, they were pleased to see the great heap of wealth.

sanskrit: ततस्सपुरुषव्याघ्र स्तद्धनं सहलक्ष्मणः।।2.32.28।। द्विजेभ्यो बालवृद्धेभ्यः कृपणेभ्योऽह्यदापयत्।
transliteration: tatassapuruṣavyāghra staddhanṃ sahalakṣmaṇḥ||2.32.28|| dvijebhyo bālavṛddhebhyḥ kṛpaṇebhyo'hyadāpayat|
meaning: Rama, best among men, got the entire wealth distributed among indigent brahmins, and young and old alike with the help of Lakshmana.

sanskrit: तत्रासीत्पिङ्गलो गार्ग्यस्त्रिजटो नाम वै द्विजः।।2.32.29।। क्षतवृत्तिर्वने नित्यं फालकुद्दाललाङ्गली।
transliteration: tatrāsītpiṅgalo gārgyastrijaṭo nāma vai dvijḥ||2.32.29|| kṣatavṛttirvane nityṃ phālakuddālalāṅgalī|
meaning: A brahmin by name, Trijata, a descendant of sage Garga and of reddishbrown colour used to live in that region earning his livelihood in the forest by digging the earth with an ironspade and a plough.

sanskrit: तं वृद्धं तरुणी भार्या बालानादाय दारकान्।।2.32.30।। अब्रवीद्बाह्मणं वाक्यं दारिद्र्येणाभिपीडिता।
transliteration: tṃ vṛddhṃ taruṇī bhāryā bālānādāya dārakān||2.32.30|| abravīdbāhmaṇṃ vākyṃ dāridryeṇābhipīḍitā|
meaning: His young wife, highly distressed due to poverty, keeping her young sons before her said to the aged brahmin:

sanskrit: अपास्य फालं कुद्दालं कुरुष्व वचनं मम।।2.32.31।। रामं दर्शय धर्मज्ञं यदि किञ्चिदवाप्स्यसि।
transliteration: apāsya phālṃ kuddālṃ kuruṣva vacanṃ mama||2.32.31|| rāmṃ darśaya dharmajñṃ yadi kiñcidavāpsyasi|
meaning: Listen to me throw away this ironspade. Go and see the righteous Rama.You may obtain something.

sanskrit: स भार्यावचनं श्रुत्वा शाटीमाच्छाद्य दुश्छदाम्।।2.32.32।। स प्रातिष्ठत पन्थानं यत्र रामनिवेशनम्।
transliteration: sa bhāryāvacanṃ śrutvā śāṭīmācchādya duśchadām||2.32.32|| sa prātiṣṭhata panthānṃ yatra rāmaniveśanam|
meaning: At the words of his wife, Trijata took the path to Rama's palace, having wrapped himself with a torn upper garment .

sanskrit: भृग्वङ्गिरसमं दीप्त्या त्रिजटं जनसंसदि।।2.32.33।। आपञ्चमायाः कक्ष्यायाः नैनं कश्चिदवारयत्।
transliteration: bhṛgvaṅgirasamṃ dīptyā trijaṭṃ janasṃsadi||2.32.33|| āpañcamāyāḥ kakṣyāyāḥ nainṃ kaścidavārayat|
meaning: No one in the crowd stopped Tirjata until he reached the fifth courtyard as he looked like Bhrigu and Angirasa in brilliance.

sanskrit: स राजपुत्रमासाद्य त्रिजटो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।2.32.34।। निर्धनो बहुपुत्रोऽस्मि राजपुत्र महायशः। उञ्छवृत्तिर्वने नित्यं प्रत्य
transliteration: sa rājaputramāsādya trijaṭo vākyamabravīt||2.32.34|| nirdhano bahuputro'smi rājaputra mahāyaśḥ| uñchavṛttirvane nityṃ pr
meaning: Trijata approached Rama and said O illustrious prince I am a destitute and have many children. I am living in the forest by collecting leftover grains. Look at me.

sanskrit: तमुवाच ततो राम: परिहास समन्वितम्। गवां सहस्रमप्येकं न नु विश्राणितं मया।।2.32.36।। परिक्षिपसि दण्डेन यावत्तावदवाप्स्यसि।
transliteration: tamuvāca tato rāma: parihāsa samanvitam| gavāṃ sahasramapyekṃ na nu viśrāṇitṃ mayā||2.32.36|| parikṣipasi daṇḍena yāvatt
meaning: Rama jokingly replied to him, I have not yet gifted one thousand cows. Throw your staff and the cows on the space your staff covers will be yours.

sanskrit: स शाटीं त्वरितः कट्यां सम्भ्रान्तः परिवेष्ट्य ताम्।।2.32.37।। आविद्ध्य दण्डं चिक्षेप सर्वप्राणेन वेगितः।
transliteration: sa śāṭīṃ tvaritḥ kaṭyāṃ sambhrāntḥ pariveṣṭya tām||2.32.37|| āviddhya daṇḍṃ cikṣepa sarvaprāṇena vegitḥ|
meaning: Bewildered Trijata swiftly tightened up his upper garment around his waist, set the direction for his staff and hurled it with all his might.

sanskrit: स तीर्त्वा सरयूपारं दण्डस्तस्य कराच्च्युतः।।2.32.38।। गोव्रजे बहुसाहस्रे पपातोक्षणसन्निधौ।
transliteration: sa tīrtvā sarayūpārṃ daṇḍastasya karāccyutḥ||2.32.38|| govraje bahusāhasre papātokṣaṇasannidhau|
meaning: The staff he hurled crossed the bank of the river Sarayu and fell near a bull in the midst of a thousands cows.

sanskrit: तं परिष्वज्य धर्मात्मा आतस्मात्सरयूतटात्।।2.32.39।। आनयामास ता गोपै स्त्रिजटायाश्रमं प्रति।
transliteration: tṃ pariṣvajya dharmātmā ātasmātsarayūtaṭāt||2.32.39|| ānayāmāsa tā gopai strijaṭāyāśramṃ prati|
meaning: The virtuous Rama embraced Trijata, and despatched all the cattle extending up to the bank of Sarayu to his hermitage.

sanskrit: उवाच स ततो रामस्तं गार्ग्यमभिसान्त्वयन्। मन्युर्न खलु कर्तव्यः परिहासो ह्ययं मम।।2.32.40।।
transliteration: uvāca sa tato rāmastṃ gārgyamabhisāntvayan| manyurna khalu kartavyḥ parihāso hyayṃ mama||2.32.40||
meaning: Afterwards Rama sought to placate Trijata, that descendant of Ganga, saying: This was a joke. Do not be angry.

sanskrit: इदं हि तेजस्तव यद्दुरत्ययं तदेव जिज्ञासितुमिच्छता मया। इमं भवानर्थमभि प्रचोदितो वृणीष्व किं चेदपरं व्यवस्यति।।2.32.41।।
transliteration: idṃ hi tejastava yadduratyayṃ tadeva jijñāsitumicchatā mayā| imṃ bhavānarthamabhi pracodito vṛṇīṣva kiṃ cedaparṃ vyavasy
meaning: Your power is unsurpassable and to ascertain this, I incited you to do this act. If there is anything else, ask for it.

sanskrit: ब्रवीमि सत्येन नतेऽस्ति यन्त्रणा धनं हि यद्यन्मम विप्रकारणात्। भवत्सु सम्यक्प्रतिपादनेन त न्मयार्जितं प्रीतियशस्करं भवेत
transliteration: bravīmi satyena nate'sti yantraṇā dhanṃ hi yadyanmama viprakāraṇāt| bhavatsu samyakpratipādanena ta nmayārjitṃ prītiyaśa
meaning: Truly speaking, there is no limit to seeking wealth. My wealth is specifically meant for brahmins. By distributing all the wealth earned by me, I get pleasure and renown.

sanskrit: तत स्सभार्य स्त्रिजटो महामुनि र्गवामनीकं प्रतिगृह्य मोदितः। यशोबलप्रीतिसुखोपबृंहणी स्तदाशिष: प्रत्यवदन्महात्मनः।।2.32.43
transliteration: tata ssabhārya strijaṭo mahāmuni rgavāmanīkṃ pratigṛhya moditḥ| yaśobalaprītisukhopabṛṃhaṇī stadāśiṣa: pratyavadanmahātm
meaning: Thereafter that great sage Trijata along with his wife, immensely happy to receive multitudes of cows, pronounced blessings on the magnanimous Rama for glory, power, pleasure and prosperity.

sanskrit: स चापि रामः प्रतिपूर्णमानसो महद्धनं धर्मबलैरुपार्जितम्। नियोजयामास सुहृज्जनेऽचिरा द्यथार्हसम्मानवचः प्रचोदितः।।2.32.44।।
transliteration: sa cāpi rāmḥ pratipūrṇamānaso mahaddhanṃ dharmabalairupārjitam| niyojayāmāsa suhṛjjane'cirā dyathārhasammānavacḥ pracodi
meaning: Prompted by the deserving words of acclaim from his friends, Rama distributed with joy and without delay the entire wealth earned by him through dharma.

sanskrit: द्विज स्सुहृद्भृत्यजनोऽथवा तदा दरिद्रभिक्षाचरणश्च योऽभवत्। न तत्र कश्चिन्न बभूव तर्पितो यथार्हसम्मानन दान सम्भ्रमैः।।2.3
transliteration: dvija ssuhṛdbhṛtyajano'thavā tadā daridrabhikṣācaraṇaśca yo'bhavat| na tatra kaścinna babhūva tarpito yathārhasammānana
meaning: Thus there was none among those brahmins, attendants, poor people, and beggars, who was not satisfied with the honour (received) or with the charity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्वात्रिंशस

sanskrit: समुद्धृतनिधानानि परिध्वस्ताजिराणि च। उपात्त धनधान्यानि हृतसाराणि सर्वशः।।2.33.18।। रजसाभ्यवकीर्णानि परित्यक्तानि दैवतैः।
transliteration: samuddhṛtanidhānāni paridhvastājirāṇi ca| upātta dhanadhānyāni hṛtasārāṇi sarvaśḥ||2.33.18|| rajasābhyavakīrṇāni paritya
meaning: Let Kaikeyi take possession of our deserted and dilapidated homes with ruined courtyards which seem as though struck by calamities. They are drained of wealth and foodgrains, covered with dust and abandoned by the gods.

sanskrit: तृणमांस फलादानां देशं व्यालमृगद्विजम्।।2.33.24।। प्रपद्यतां हि कैकेयी सपुत्रा सह बान्धवैः। राघवेण वने सर्वे वयं वत्स्याम
transliteration: tṛṇamāṃsa phalādānāṃ deśṃ vyālamṛgadvijam||2.33.24|| prapadyatāṃ hi kaikeyī saputrā saha bāndhavaiḥ| rāghaveṇa vane sarv
meaning: Let Kaikeyi along with her son and her relatives acquire that country which will be inhabited by birds and animals living on grass, fruits, and flesh. Withdrawn, we shall happily live in the forest along with Rama.

sanskrit: इत्येवं विविधा वाचो नानाजनसमीरिताः। शुश्राव रामः श्रुत्वा च न विचक्रेऽस्य मानसम्।।2.33.26।।
transliteration: ityevṃ vividhā vāco nānājanasamīritāḥ| śuśrāva rāmḥ śrutvā ca na vicakre'sya mānasam||2.33.26||
meaning: Such were the various words uttered by the people. Even after hearing them his (Rama's) mind remained unmoved (from his resolve).

sanskrit: स तु वेश्म पितुर्दूरात्कैलासशिखरप्रभम्। अभिचक्राम धर्मात्मा मत्तमातङ्गविक्रमः।।2.33.27।।
transliteration: sa tu veśma piturdūrātkailāsaśikharaprabham| abhicakrāma dharmātmā mattamātaṅgavikramḥ||2.33.27||
meaning: Dutiful Rama, endowed with the prowess of an intoxicated elephant, approached the residence of his father that resembled from a distance the peak of mount Kailasa in splendour.

sanskrit: विनीतवीरपुरुषं प्रविश्य तु नृपालयम्। ददर्शावस्थितं दीनं सुमन्त्रमविदूरतः।।2.33.28।।
transliteration: vinītavīrapuruṣṃ praviśya tu nṛpālayam| dadarśāvasthitṃ dīnṃ sumantramavidūratḥ||2.33.28||
meaning: Rama entered the royal palace guarded by welltrained warriors and not from very far saw Sumantra who stood a picture of dejection.

sanskrit: प्रतीक्षमाणोऽपि जनं तदार्त मनार्तरूपः प्रहसन्निवाथ। जगाम रामः पितरं दिदृक्षुः पितुर्निदेशं विधिवच्चिकीर्षुः।।2.33.29।।
transliteration: pratīkṣamāṇo'pi janṃ tadārta manārtarūpḥ prahasannivātha| jagāma rāmḥ pitarṃ didṛkṣuḥ piturnideśṃ vidhivaccikīrṣuḥ||2.33
meaning: Even after observing the people in grief, Rama did not reveal his sorrowful feelings. Bound by duty he went in as if with a smile to see his father.

sanskrit: तत्पूर्वमैक्ष्वाकसुतो महात्मा रामो गमिष्यन्वनमार्तरूपम्। व्यतिष्ठत प्रेक्ष्य तदा सुमन्त्रं पितुर्महात्मा प्रतिहारणार्थम्
transliteration: tatpūrvamaikṣvākasuto mahātmā rāmo gamiṣyanvanamārtarūpam| vyatiṣṭhata prekṣya tadā sumantrṃ piturmahātmā pratihāraṇārth
meaning: Seeing Sumantra stricken with grief for the first time the magnanimous Rama, scion of the Ikshvaku dynasty, on the way to the forest waited there for his father to be informed of his arrival.

sanskrit: पितुर्निदेशेन तु धर्मवत्सलः वनप्रवेशे कृतबुद्धिनिश्चयः। स राघवः प्रेक्ष्य सुमन्त्रमब्रवी न्निवेदयस्वागमनं नृपाय मे।।2.33
transliteration: piturnideśena tu dharmavatsalḥ vanapraveśe kṛtabuddhiniścayḥ| sa rāghavḥ prekṣya sumantramabravī nnivedayasvāgamanṃ nṛpā
meaning: Rama, lover of righteousness, determined to go to the forest in obedience to his father's command said to Sumantra, Inform the king of my arrival. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्रयस्त्रिंशस्

sanskrit: सुमंन्त्रानय मे दारान् ये केचिदिह मामकाः। दारैः परिवृतस्सर्वैर्द्रष्टुमिच्छामि धार्मिकम्।।2.34.10।।
transliteration: sumṃntrānaya me dārān ye kecidiha māmakāḥ| dāraiḥ parivṛtassarvairdraṣṭumicchāmi dhārmikam||2.34.10||
meaning: O Sumantra bring all my consorts who are here. In the company of all my wives, I desire to give audience to virtuous Rama.

sanskrit: सोऽन्तःपुरमतीत्यैव स्त्रियस्ता वाक्यमब्रवीत्। आर्याह्वयति वो राजा गम्यतां तत्र मा चिरम्।।2.34.11।।
transliteration: so'ntḥpuramatītyaiva striyastā vākyamabravīt| āryāhvayati vo rājā gamyatāṃ tatra mā ciram||2.34.11||
meaning: O venerable ones, king Dasaratha summons you. Go there without delay, said Sumantra to the king's consorts after crossing the inner apartment.

sanskrit: भवान्वर्ष सहस्राय पृथिव्या नृपते पतिः। अहं त्वरण्येवत्स्यामि न मे कार्यं त्वयाऽनृतम्।।2.34.28।।
transliteration: bhavānvarṣa sahasrāya pṛthivyā nṛpate patiḥ| ahṃ tvaraṇyevatsyāmi na me kāryṃ tvayā'nṛtam||2.34.28||
meaning: You will remain the lord of this earth for a thousand years to come, O king As for me, I will dwell in the forest. Do not deviate from truth on my account.

sanskrit: नव पञ्च च वर्षाणि वनवासे विहृत्य ते। पुनःपादौ ग्रहीष्यामि प्रतिज्ञान्ते नराधिप।।2.34.29।।
transliteration: nava pañca ca varṣāṇi vanavāse vihṛtya te| punḥpādau grahīṣyāmi pratijñānte narādhipa||2.34.29||
meaning: Having fulfilled the vow on the completion of fourteen years of wandering in the forest I shall come back to touch your feet, O lord of men

sanskrit: रुदन्नार्तः प्रियं पुत्रं सत्यपाशेन संयतः। कैकेय्या चोद्यमानस्तु मिथो राजा तमब्रवीत्।।2.34.30।।
transliteration: rudannārtḥ priyṃ putrṃ satyapāśena sṃyatḥ| kaikeyyā codyamānastu mitho rājā tamabravīt||2.34.30||
meaning: The king who was bound by the cord of truth and instigated by Kaikeyi said, wailing in distress:

sanskrit: श्रेयसे वृद्धये तात पुनरागमनाय च। गच्छस्वारिष्टमव्यग्रः पन्थानमकुतोभयम्।।2.34.31।।
transliteration: śreyase vṛddhaye tāta punarāgamanāya ca| gacchasvāriṣṭamavyagrḥ panthānamakutobhayam||2.34.31||
meaning: Go, my dear child, wish you wellMay your path be auspicious, free from obstacles and fear (from any quarters). Come back (after fulfilment of the pledge)

sanskrit: न हि सत्यात्मनस्तात धर्माभिमनस स्तव। विनिवर्तयितुं बुद्धिः शक्यते रघुनन्दन।।2.34.32।।
transliteration: na hi satyātmanastāta dharmābhimanasa stava| vinivartayituṃ buddhiḥ śakyate raghunandana||2.34.32||
meaning: O my beloved son O delight of the Raghus you are devoted to truth and duty. It is difficult to dissuade you from your resolve .

sanskrit: अद्य त्विदानीं रजनीं पुत्र मा गच्छ सर्वथा। एकाहदर्शनेनापि साधु तावच्चराम्यहम्।।2.34.33।।
transliteration: adya tvidānīṃ rajanīṃ putra mā gaccha sarvathā| ekāhadarśanenāpi sādhu tāvaccarāmyaham||2.34.33||
meaning: O son, by all means, do not go now, today, tonight Give me, at least, one day more to see (by with) you to my satisfaction.

sanskrit: मातरं मां च सम्पश्यन् वसेमामद्य शर्वरीम्। तर्पित स्सर्वकामैस्त्वं श्वः काले साधयिष्यसि।।।2.34.34।।
transliteration: mātarṃ māṃ ca sampaśyan vasemāmadya śarvarīm| tarpita ssarvakāmaistvṃ śvḥ kāle sādhayiṣyasi|||2.34.34||
meaning: Stay tonight in the company of your mother and me. With all our desire satisfied, you can set out tomorrow at the appropriate time.

sanskrit: दुष्करं क्रियते पुत्र सर्वथा राघव त्वया। मत्प्रियार्थं प्रियांस्त्यक्त्वा यद्यासि विजनं वनम्।।2.34.35।।
transliteration: duṣkarṃ kriyate putra sarvathā rāghava tvayā| matpriyārthṃ priyāṃstyaktvā yadyāsi vijanṃ vanam||2.34.35||
meaning: O my son, O descendant of the Raghus, you are called upon to accomplish, by all means, a very difficult task. For the sake of my pleasure you are forsaking your dear ones and going to the desolate forest.

sanskrit: न चैतन्मे प्रियं पुत्र शपे सत्येन राघव। छन्नया चलितस्त्वस्मि स्त्रिया छन्नाग्निकल्पया।।2.34.36।।
transliteration: na caitanme priyṃ putra śape satyena rāghava| channayā calitastvasmi striyā channāgnikalpayā||2.34.36||
meaning: I swear by truth, O my beloved son, that your departure to the forest is in no way a pleasure to me. With a hidden motive, this woman who is like fire concealed by ashes has duped me.

sanskrit: वञ्चना या तु लब्धा मे तां त्वं निस्तर्तुमिच्छसि। अनया वृत्तसादिन्या कैकेय्याऽभिप्रचोदितः।।.2.34.37।।
transliteration: vañcanā yā tu labdhā me tāṃ tvṃ nistartumicchasi| anayā vṛttasādinyā kaikeyyā'bhipracoditḥ||.2.34.37||
meaning: Instigated by this Kaikeyi, the destroyer of traditions (of the race) I have been deceived for which you wish to pay.

sanskrit: न चैतदाश्चर्यतमं यत्तज्येष्ठस्सुतो मम। अपानृतकथं पुत्र पितरं कर्तुमिच्छसि।।2.34.38।।
transliteration: na caitadāścaryatamṃ yattajyeṣṭhassuto mama| apānṛtakathṃ putra pitarṃ kartumicchasi||2.34.38||
meaning: It is not a great surprise that you, O my son, being the eldest, want to make your father free from a false promise.

sanskrit: अथ रामस्तथा श्रुत्वा पितुरार्तस्य भाषितम्। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा दीनो वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.34.39।।
transliteration: atha rāmastathā śrutvā piturārtasya bhāṣitam| lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā dīno vacanamabravīt||2.34.39||
meaning: Rama and Lakshmana were sad to hear the words of their anguished father. Rama replies:

sanskrit: प्राप्स्यामि यानद्य गुणान्को मे श्वस्तान् प्रदास्यति। अपक्रमणमेवातः सर्वकामैरहं वृणे।।2.34.40।।
transliteration: prāpsyāmi yānadya guṇānko me śvastān pradāsyati| apakramaṇamevātḥ sarvakāmairahṃ vṛṇe||2.34.40||
meaning: Who will give me the merit (of propriety) I earn today? Therefore, I want to depart (today), discarding all my desires.

sanskrit: इयं सराष्ट्रा सजना धनधान्यसमाकुला। मया विसृष्टा वसुधा भरताय प्रदीयताम्।।2.34.41।।
transliteration: iyṃ sarāṣṭrā sajanā dhanadhānyasamākulā| mayā visṛṣṭā vasudhā bharatāya pradīyatām||2.34.41||
meaning: The kingdom abdicated by me with all its people, its wealth and foodgrains may be bestowed on Bharata.

sanskrit: वनवासकृता बुद्धिर्न च मेऽद्य चलिष्यति। यस्तुष्टेन वरो दत्तः कैकेय्यै वरद त्वया।।2.34.42।। दीयतां निखिलेनैव सत्यस्त्वं भव
transliteration: vanavāsakṛtā buddhirna ca me'dya caliṣyati| yastuṣṭena varo dattḥ kaikeyyai varada tvayā||2.34.42|| dīyatāṃ nikhilenaiva
meaning: My decision to go to the forest remains unchanged. O bestower of boons, O king honour to the last word the boons you had granted Kaikeyi. And adhere to truth.

sanskrit: अहं निदेशं भवतो यथोक्तमनुपालयन्।।2.34.43।। चतुर्दश समा वत्स्ये वने वनचरैस्सह।
transliteration: ahṃ nideśṃ bhavato yathoktamanupālayan||2.34.43|| caturdaśa samā vatsye vane vanacaraissaha|
meaning: As already said, I shall dwell in the forest for fourteen years with forest rangers, in obedience to your commands.

sanskrit: मा विमर्शो वसुमती भरताय प्रदीयताम्।।2.34.44।। न हि मे काङ्क्षितं राज्यं सुखमात्मनि वा प्रियम्। यथानिदेशं कर्तुं वै तवैव
transliteration: mā vimarśo vasumatī bharatāya pradīyatām||2.34.44|| na hi me kāṅkṣitṃ rājyṃ sukhamātmani vā priyam| yathānideśṃ kartuṃ v
meaning: Do not brood. Bestow the kingdom on Bharata. I do not have any desire for the kingdom or pleasure. Nothing is dearer to me than compliance with your order, O Delight of the Raghu race

sanskrit: अपगच्छतु ते दु:खं माभूर्बाष्पपरिप्लुतः। न हि क्षुभ्यति दुर्धर्षः समुद्रः सरितां पतिः।।2.34.46।।
transliteration: apagacchatu te du:khṃ mābhūrbāṣpapariplutḥ| na hi kṣubhyati durdharṣḥ samudrḥ saritāṃ patiḥ||2.34.46||
meaning: Let your grief go. Do not shed tears. The indomitable ocean, Lord of rivers, is never perturbed.

sanskrit: नैवाहं राज्यमिच्छामि न सुखं न च मेदिनीम्। नैव सर्वानिमान् कामा न्नस्वर्गं नैव जीवितम्।।2.34.47।।
transliteration: naivāhṃ rājyamicchāmi na sukhṃ na ca medinīm| naiva sarvānimān kāmā nnasvargṃ naiva jīvitam||2.34.47||
meaning: I desire no kingdom, no comfort, not this earth nor any pleasure nor heaven nor even life.

sanskrit: त्वामहं सत्यमिच्छामि नानृतं पुरुषर्षभ। प्रत्यक्षं तव सत्येन सुकृतेन च ते शपे।।2.34.48।।
transliteration: tvāmahṃ satyamicchāmi nānṛtṃ puruṣarṣabha| pratyakṣṃ tava satyena sukṛtena ca te śape||2.34.48||
meaning: I wish you, O best of men, to uphold truth and not falsehood. I swear this in your presence in the name of truth and on my merits acquired.

sanskrit: न च शक्यं मया तात स्थातुं क्षणमपि प्रभो। स शोकं धारयस्वेमं न हि मेऽस्ति विपर्ययः।।2.34.49।।
transliteration: na ca śakyṃ mayā tāta sthātuṃ kṣaṇamapi prabho| sa śokṃ dhārayasvemṃ na hi me'sti viparyayḥ||2.34.49||
meaning: It is not possible for me, O father to stay here for a moment any longer. Restrain your grief. There can be no change in my resolve, O king

sanskrit: अर्थितो ह्यस्मि कैकेय्या वनं गच्छेति राघव। मया चोक्तं व्रजामीति तत्सत्यमनुपालये।।2.34.50।।
transliteration: arthito hyasmi kaikeyyā vanṃ gaccheti rāghava| mayā coktṃ vrajāmīti tatsatyamanupālaye||2.34.50||
meaning: 'O Rama, go to the forest', Kaikeyi had said, and I have given her word I would go. I must fulfil my promise.

sanskrit: मा चोत्कण्ठां कृथा देव वने रंस्यामहे वयम्। प्रशान्तहरिणाकीर्णे नानाशकुनिनादिते।।2.34.51।।
transliteration: mā cotkaṇṭhāṃ kṛthā deva vane rṃsyāmahe vayam| praśāntahariṇākīrṇe nānāśakuninādite||2.34.51||
meaning: Do not worry, O Lord We will enjoy (our stay in) the peaceful forest full of deer and resounding with the chirpings of various birds.

sanskrit: पिता हि दैवतं तात देवतानामपि स्मृतम्। तस्माद्दैवतमित्येव करिष्यामि पितुर्वचः।।2.34.52।।
transliteration: pitā hi daivatṃ tāta devatānāmapi smṛtam| tasmāddaivatamityeva kariṣyāmi piturvacḥ||2.34.52||
meaning: Father is divine even for the gods as cited in scriptures, therefore, looking upon father as my god, I will carry out his words, O father

sanskrit: चतुर्दशसु वर्षेषु गतेषु नरसत्तम। पुनर्द्रक्ष्यसि मां प्राप्तं सन्तापोऽयं विमुच्यताम्।।2.34.53।।
transliteration: caturdaśasu varṣeṣu gateṣu narasattama| punardrakṣyasi māṃ prāptṃ santāpo'yṃ vimucyatām||2.34.53||
meaning: I shall return after fourteen years have passed, O best among men you will see me back, Give up this grief.

sanskrit: येन संस्तम्भनीयोऽयं सर्वो बाष्पगलो जनः। स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल किमर्थं विक्रियां गतः।।2.34.54।।
transliteration: yena sṃstambhanīyo'yṃ sarvo bāṣpagalo janḥ| sa tvṃ puruṣaśārdūla kimarthṃ vikriyāṃ gatḥ||2.34.54||
meaning: When you, O tiger among men, are required (as king) to pacify those whose throats are choked with tears, why this change in you?

sanskrit: पुरं च राष्ट्रं च मही च केवला मया निसृष्टा भरताय दीयताम्। अहं निदेशं भवतोऽनुपालयन् वनं गमिष्यामि चिराय सेवितुम्।।2.34.55
transliteration: purṃ ca rāṣṭrṃ ca mahī ca kevalā mayā nisṛṣṭā bharatāya dīyatām| ahṃ nideśṃ bhavato'nupālayan vanṃ gamiṣyāmi cirāya sevi
meaning: I am renouncing this city, kingdom and this entire earth, and let all this be conferred on Bharata. In obedience to your order, I shall go and live in the forest for a long time.

sanskrit: मया निसृष्टां भरतो महीमिमां सशैलषण्डां सपुरां सकाननाम्। शिवां सुसीमामनुशास्तु केवलं त्वया यदुक्तं नृपते तथास्तु तत्।।2.3
transliteration: mayā nisṛṣṭāṃ bharato mahīmimāṃ saśailaṣaṇḍāṃ sapurāṃ sakānanām| śivāṃ susīmāmanuśāstu kevalṃ tvayā yaduktṃ nṛpate tathā
meaning: I am leaving behind, O king this (auspicious) land with its welllaid boundaries, mountain ranges, cities and forests, which Bharata alone should rule. Let it happen the way you have said.

sanskrit: न मे तथा पार्थिव धीयते मनो महत्सु कामेषु न चात्मनःप्रिये। यथा निदेशे तव शिष्टसम्मते व्यपैतु दुःखं तव मत्कृतेऽनघ।।2.34.57
transliteration: na me tathā pārthiva dhīyate mano mahatsu kāmeṣu na cātmanḥpriye| yathā nideśe tava śiṣṭasammate vyapaitu duḥkhṃ tava ma
meaning: O king my mind derives no happiness from great enjoyment or personal comfort as it does from carrying out your order. This is corroborated by the wise. Your grief (relating to filfilment of the vow) on mt account will be

sanskrit: तदद्य नैवानघ राज्यमव्ययं न सर्वकामान्न सुखं न मैथिलीम्। न जीवितं त्वामनृतेन योजयन् वृणीय सत्यं व्रतमस्तु ते तथा।।2.34.58
transliteration: tadadya naivānagha rājyamavyayṃ na sarvakāmānna sukhṃ na maithilīm| na jīvitṃ tvāmanṛtena yojayan vṛṇīya satyṃ vratamast
meaning: O sinless one by associating you with falsehood I will neither seek this eternal kingdom nor objects of desires nor objects of happiness nor Maithili nor even my life. I only wish that your vow comes true.

sanskrit: फलानि मूलानि च भक्षयन्वने गिरींश्च पश्यन् सरितस्सरांसि च। वनं प्रविश्यैव विचित्रपादपम् सुखी भविष्यामि तवास्तु निर्वृतिः।
transliteration: phalāni mūlāni ca bhakṣayanvane girīṃśca paśyan saritassarāṃsi ca| vanṃ praviśyaiva vicitrapādapam sukhī bhaviṣyāmi tavā
meaning: Entering the forest full of various kinds of trees I shall be happy to view the mountains, rivers and the lakes and to eat fruits and roots. (Hence) do not grieve.

sanskrit: एवं स राजा व्यसनाभिपन्नः शोकेन दुःखेन च ताम्यमानः। आलिङ्ग्य पुत्रं सुविनष्टसंज्ञो मोहं गतो नैव चिचेष्ट किंञ्चित्।।2.34.6
transliteration: evṃ sa rājā vyasanābhipannḥ śokena duḥkhena ca tāmyamānḥ| āliṅgya putrṃ suvinaṣṭasṃjño mohṃ gato naiva ciceṣṭa kiṃñcit||
meaning: The king, immersed in anguish and distressed with tears of grief embraced his son and then fell down unconscious on the floor and lay motionless.

sanskrit: देव्यस्तत स्संरुरुदुस्समेता स्तां वर्जयित्वा नरदेवपत्नीम्। रुदन् सुमन्त्रोऽऽपि जगाम मूर्छां हाहाकृतं तत्र बभूव सर्वम्।।2
transliteration: devyastata ssṃrurudussametā stāṃ varjayitvā naradevapatnīm| rudan sumantro''pi jagāma mūrchāṃ hāhākṛtṃ tatra babhūva sar
meaning: Thereupon all the queens except Kaikeyi, wailed loudly. Sumantra, too, cried and fell unconscious. The entire palace cried 'Alas, Alas'. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुस्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thu

sanskrit: मावमंस्था दशरथं भर्तारं वरदं पतिम्। भर्तुरिच्छा हि नारीणां पुत्रकोट्या विशिष्यते।।2.35.8।।
transliteration: māvamṃsthā daśarathṃ bhartārṃ varadṃ patim| bharturicchā hi nārīṇāṃ putrakoṭyā viśiṣyate||2.35.8||
meaning: Do not have contempt for Dasaratha who is your husband, nourisher and bestower of boons. For a wife, the desire of her husband is considered worthier than ten million sons.

sanskrit: यथावयो हि राज्यानि प्राप्नुवन्ति नृपक्षये। इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाथेऽस्मिं स्तल्लोपयितुमिच्छसि।।2.35.9।।
transliteration: yathāvayo hi rājyāni prāpnuvanti nṛpakṣaye| ikṣvākukulanāthe'smiṃ stallopayitumicchasi||2.35.9||
meaning: After the death of the king, the princes will obtain the kingdom according to seniority. Why do you want to break this tradition in the case of Rama, the lord of the Ikshvaku dynasty?

sanskrit: राजा भवतु ते पुत्रो भरतश्शास्तु मेदिनीम्। वयं तत्र गमिष्यामो रामो यत्र गमिष्यति।।2.35.10।।
transliteration: rājā bhavatu te putro bharataśśāstu medinīm| vayṃ tatra gamiṣyāmo rāmo yatra gamiṣyati||2.35.10||
meaning: Let your son Bharata be king and rule the earth. All of us will go whereever Rama goes.

sanskrit: नूनं सर्वे गमिष्यामो मार्गं रामनिषेवितम्। त्यक्ताया बान्धवैः सर्वैर्ब्राह्मणैः साधुभिः सदा।।2.35.12।। का प्रीती राज्यलाभ
transliteration: nūnṃ sarve gamiṣyāmo mārgṃ rāmaniṣevitam| tyaktāyā bāndhavaiḥ sarvairbrāhmaṇaiḥ sādhubhiḥ sadā||2.35.12|| kā prītī rājya
meaning: All of us certainly will follow the path pursued by Rama. Abandoned by relatives, brahmins and virtuous men for all times, what pleasure will you derive by your lust for this kingdom? O Kaikeyi, why do you intend to tran

sanskrit: आश्चर्यमिव पश्यामि यस्यास्ते वृत्तमीदृशम्। आचरन्त्या न विवृता सद्यो भवति मेदिनी।।2.35.14।।
transliteration: āścaryamiva paśyāmi yasyāste vṛttamīdṛśam| ācarantyā na vivṛtā sadyo bhavati medinī||2.35.14||
meaning: It is a wonder that the earth does not split right away when you are perpetrating such an (abominable) act.

sanskrit: महाब्रह्मर्षिसृष्टाः वा ज्वलन्तो भीमदर्शनाः। धिग्वाग्दण्डा न हिंसन्ति रामप्रव्राजने स्थिताम्।।2.35.15।।
transliteration: mahābrahmarṣisṛṣṭāḥ vā jvalanto bhīmadarśanāḥ| dhigvāgdaṇḍā na hiṃsanti rāmapravrājane sthitām||2.35.15||
meaning: It is a wonder that while bent upon banishing Rama, you are not destroyed by frightening fire created by great brahmarsis, crying, 'Shame, shame'

sanskrit: तव मातुरसद्ग्राहं विद्मः पूर्वं यथाश्रुतम्। पितुस्ते वरदः कश्चिद्ददौ वरमनुत्तमम्।।2.35.18।। सर्वभूतरुतं तस्मात्संजज्ञे व
transliteration: tava māturasadgrāhṃ vidmḥ pūrvṃ yathāśrutam| pituste varadḥ kaściddadau varamanuttamam||2.35.18|| sarvabhūtarutṃ tasmāts
meaning: We have heard in the past about the evil (stubborn) nature of your mother. Once a bestower of boons conferred an extraordinary boon on your father by virtue of which he could tell the sounds of all living beings. He also

sanskrit: ततो जृम्भस्य शयने विरुताद्भूरिवर्चसः। पितुस्ते विदितो भाव स्स तत्र बहुधाऽहसत्।।2.35.20।।
transliteration: tato jṛmbhasya śayane virutādbhūrivarcasḥ| pituste vidito bhāva ssa tatra bahudhā'hasat||2.35.20||
meaning: Then one day near his bed your highly brilliant father laughed repeatedly over what an ant or a bird said, for he knew the meaning from its sound.

sanskrit: ज्येष्ठो वदान्यः कर्मण्यः स्वधर्मपरिरक्षिता। रक्षिता जीवलोकस्य बली रामोऽभिषिच्यताम्।।2.35.32।।
transliteration: jyeṣṭho vadānyḥ karmaṇyḥ svadharmaparirakṣitā| rakṣitā jīvalokasya balī rāmo'bhiṣicyatām||2.35.32||
meaning: Let his eldest son Rama, valiant, generous, skilful, dutiful and protector of this world, be consecrated.

sanskrit: परिवादो हि ते देवि महाल्लोके चरिष्यति। यदि रामो वनं याति विहाय पितरं नृपम्।।2.35.33।।
transliteration: parivādo hi te devi mahālloke cariṣyati| yadi rāmo vanṃ yāti vihāya pitarṃ nṛpam||2.35.33||
meaning: O Devi, if Rama goes to the forest leaving his father, the king, you will be squarely blamed by the people of the world.

sanskrit: सूत रत्नसुसम्पूर्णा चतुर्विधबला चमूः। राघवस्यानुयात्रार्थं क्षिप्रं प्रतिविधीयताम्।।2.36.2।।
transliteration: sūta ratnasusampūrṇā caturvidhabalā camūḥ| rāghavasyānuyātrārthṃ kṣiprṃ pratividhīyatām||2.36.2||
meaning: O Sumantra arrange immediately four divisions of the army, wellequipped with precious stones to escort Rama in his journey to (the forest).

sanskrit: रूपाजीवाश्च वादिन्यो वणिजश्च महाधनाः। शोभयन्तु कुमारस्य वाहिनीं सुप्रसारिताः।।2.36.3।।
transliteration: rūpājīvāśca vādinyo vaṇijaśca mahādhanāḥ| śobhayantu kumārasya vāhinīṃ suprasāritāḥ||2.36.3||
meaning: Let the sweettongued courtesans, opulent merchants with well spreadout merchandise make the army of my son graceful.

sanskrit: ये चैनमुपजीवन्ति रमते यैश्च वीर्यतः। तेषां बहुविधं दत्त्वा तानप्यत्र नियोजय ।।2.38.4।।
transliteration: ye cainamupajīvanti ramate yaiśca vīryatḥ| teṣāṃ bahuvidhṃ dattvā tānapyatra niyojaya ||2.38.4||
meaning: Bestow immense wealth on those who depended on Rama for their living and on the gallant youths with whom he used to sport. Send them along with the entourage.

sanskrit: राज्यं गतजनं साधो पीतमण्डां सुरामिव। निरास्वाद्यतमं शून्यं भरतो नाभिपत्स्यते।।2.36.12।।
transliteration: rājyṃ gatajanṃ sādho pītamaṇḍāṃ surāmiva| nirāsvādyatamṃ śūnyṃ bharato nābhipatsyate||2.36.12||
meaning: O virtuous king Bharata will not take charge of the kingdom abandoned by men, drained of wealth and incapable of being enjoyed, like wine with its essence evaporated.

sanskrit: कैकेय्यां मुक्तलज्जायां वदन्त्यामतिदारुणाम्। राजा दशरथो वाक्यमुवाचायतलोचनाम्।।2.36.13।।
transliteration: kaikeyyāṃ muktalajjāyāṃ vadantyāmatidāruṇām| rājā daśaratho vākyamuvācāyatalocanām||2.36.13||
meaning: King Dasaratha heard the terribly cruel and shameless words of that largeeyed Kaikeyi, and said:

sanskrit: वहन्तं किं तुदसि मां नियुज्य धुरि माऽहिते। अनार्ये कृत्यमारब्धं किं न पूर्वमुपारुधः।।2.36.14।।
transliteration: vahantṃ kiṃ tudasi māṃ niyujya dhuri mā'hite| anārye kṛtyamārabdhṃ kiṃ na pūrvamupārudhḥ||2.36.14||
meaning: O brutal Kaikeyi, you fastened me to the yoke and when I am drawing forward, why do you beat me? O vile woman why did you not prevent me in the beginning itself?

sanskrit: तस्यैतत्क्रोधसंयुक्तमुक्तं श्रुत्वा वराङ्गना। कैकेयी द्विगुणं क्रुद्धा राजानमिदमब्रवीत्।।2.36.15।।
transliteration: tasyaitatkrodhasṃyuktamuktṃ śrutvā varāṅganā| kaikeyī dviguṇṃ kruddhā rājānamidamabravīt||2.36.15||
meaning: At these wrathful words of Dasaratha, Kaikeyi with redoubled fury replied to the king:

sanskrit: स फालपिटकं गृह्य गिरिदुर्गाण्यलोडयत्। दिश स्सर्वास्त्वनुचरन् स यथा पापकर्मकृत्।।2.36.25।।
transliteration: sa phālapiṭakṃ gṛhya giridurgāṇyaloḍayat| diśa ssarvāstvanucaran sa yathā pāpakarmakṛt||2.36.25||
meaning: Like an evildoer wandering about in different directions, holding a spade and a basket in his hand, he went about digging the impenetrable mountains.

sanskrit: इत्येनमत्यजद्राजा सगरो वै सुधार्मिकः। रामः किमकरोत्पापं येनैवमुपरुध्यते।।2.36.26।।
transliteration: ityenamatyajadrājā sagaro vai sudhārmikḥ| rāmḥ kimakarotpāpṃ yenaivamuparudhyate||2.36.26||
meaning: Highly righteous king Sagara thus banished his son. What sin has Rama committed to secure a similar banishment?

sanskrit: न हि कञ्चन पश्यामो राघवस्यागुणं वयम्। दुर्लभो ह्यस्य निरय श्शशाङ्कस्येव कल्मषम्।।2.36.27।।
transliteration: na hi kañcana paśyāmo rāghavasyāguṇṃ vayam| durlabho hyasya niraya śśaśāṅkasyeva kalmaṣam||2.36.27||
meaning: We see no fault in Rama. Unlike the stain in the Moon it is difficult to find any blemish in him.

sanskrit: अथवा देवि दोषं त्वं कञ्चित्पश्यसि राघवे। तमद्य ब्रूहि तत्वेन तदा रामो विवास्यताम्।।2.36.28।।
transliteration: athavā devi doṣṃ tvṃ kañcitpaśyasi rāghave| tamadya brūhi tatvena tadā rāmo vivāsyatām||2.36.28||
meaning: O Kaikeyi speak truly if you find any fault in this scion of the Raghu race (Rama). Then he will be exiled.

sanskrit: अदुष्टस्य हि संत्यागः सत्पथे निरतस्य च। निर्दहेदपि शक्रस्य द्युतिं धर्मनिरोधनात्।2.36.29।।
transliteration: aduṣṭasya hi sṃtyāgḥ satpathe niratasya ca| nirdahedapi śakrasya dyutiṃ dharmanirodhanāt|2.36.29||
meaning: The act of banishment of an innocent one walking the righteous path is like destroying the brilliance of Indra by restraining his righteousness.

sanskrit: तदलं देवि रामस्य श्रिया विहतया त्वया। लोकतोऽपि हि ते रक्ष्यः परिवादः शुभानने।।2.36.30।।
transliteration: tadalṃ devi rāmasya śriyā vihatayā tvayā| lokato'pi hi te rakṣyḥ parivādḥ śubhānane||2.36.30||
meaning: O Devi, there is no use obstructing Rama's prosperity. O one with an auspicious countenance, save yourself from the censure of the world.

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु सिद्धार्थवचो राजा श्रान्ततरस्वनः। शोकोपहतया वाचा कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत्।।2.36.31।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu siddhārthavaco rājā śrāntatarasvanḥ| śokopahatayā vācā kaikeyīmidamabravīt||2.36.31||
meaning: Having heard Siddhartha, the king, stricken with grief, said to Kaikeyi in a gradually feeble voice.

sanskrit: एतद्वचो नेच्छसि पापवृत्ते हितं न जानासि ममात्मनो वा। आस्थाय मार्गं कृपणं कुचेष्टा चेष्टा हि ते साधुपथादपेता।।2.36.32।।
transliteration: etadvaco necchasi pāpavṛtte hitṃ na jānāsi mamātmano vā| āsthāya mārgṃ kṛpaṇṃ kuceṣṭā ceṣṭā hi te sādhupathādapetā||2.36
