meaning: O Kaikeyi of vicious behaviour, you do not aceept even the words of Siddhartha. You woman of wicked acts, having adopted vile ways, and abjured the right path cannot know what is good either for you or for me.

sanskrit: अनुव्रजिष्याम्यहमद्य रामं राज्यं परित्यज्य सुखं धनं च। सहैव राज्ञा भरतेन च त्वं यथासुखं भुङ्क्ष्व चिराय राज्यम्।।2.36.33
transliteration: anuvrajiṣyāmyahamadya rāmṃ rājyṃ parityajya sukhṃ dhanṃ ca| sahaiva rājñā bharatena ca tvṃ yathāsukhṃ bhuṅkṣva cirāya rā
meaning: Abandoning this kingdom, these comforts and this wealth, I shall follow Rama. Enjoy the kingdom for a long time happily along with king Bharata. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षट्त्रिंशस्सर्गः

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणश्चापि तत्रैव विहाय वसने शुभे। तापसाच्छादने चैव जग्राह पितुरग्रतः।।2.37.8।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇaścāpi tatraiva vihāya vasane śubhe| tāpasācchādane caiva jagrāha pituragratḥ||2.37.8||
meaning: Lakshmana also removed his auspicious raiment in front (presence) of his father and accepted (put on) the robes of an ascetic.

sanskrit: अथाऽत्मपरिधानार्थं सीता कौशेयवासिनी। समीक्ष्य चीरं सन्त्रस्ता पृषती वागुरामिव।।2.37.9।।
transliteration: athā'tmaparidhānārthṃ sītā kauśeyavāsinī| samīkṣya cīrṃ santrastā pṛṣatī vāgurāmiva||2.37.9||
meaning: Then Sita in silk clothes glanced at the bark robes meant for her to wear and was frightened like a doe seeing a (fowler's) snare.

sanskrit: सा व्यपत्रपमाणेव प्रगृह्य च सुदुर्मनाः। कैकेयी कुशचीरे ते जानकी शुभलक्षणा।।2.37.10।। अश्रुसम्पूर्ण नेत्रा च धर्मज्ञा धर्
transliteration: sā vyapatrapamāṇeva pragṛhya ca sudurmanāḥ| kaikeyī kuśacīre te jānakī śubhalakṣaṇā||2.37.10|| aśrusampūrṇa netrā ca dha
meaning: Sita of auspicious nature who knew her duties and understood righteousness, took the garments made of kusa grass from Kaikeyi. With a sense of abashment her eyes suffused with tears, she said to her husband who was the v

sanskrit: ऊचुश्च परमायस्ता रामं ज्वलिततेजसम्। वत्स नैवं नियुक्तेयं वनवासे मनस्विनी।।2.37.16।।
transliteration: ūcuśca paramāyastā rāmṃ jvalitatejasam| vatsa naivṃ niyukteyṃ vanavāse manasvinī||2.37.16||
meaning: Profoundly distressed, they said to Rama glowing with burning lustre O dear, no one has ordered this highminded Sita to dwell in the forest.

sanskrit: पितुर्वाक्यानुरोधेन गतस्य विजनं वनम्। तावद्दर्शनमस्या नः सफलं भवतु प्रभो।।2.37.17।।
transliteration: piturvākyānurodhena gatasya vijanṃ vanam| tāvaddarśanamasyā nḥ saphalṃ bhavatu prabho||2.37.17||
meaning: In obedience to the words of your father, O lord you are going to the forest. Till you return, please allow us to have her (Sita's) audience.

sanskrit: न गन्तव्यं वनं देव्या सीतया शीलवर्जिते। अनुष्ठास्यति रामस्य सीता प्रकृतमासनम्।।2.37.23।।
transliteration: na gantavyṃ vanṃ devyā sītayā śīlavarjite| anuṣṭhāsyati rāmasya sītā prakṛtamāsanam||2.37.23||
meaning: You are devoid of good conduct, O Kaikeyi Divine Sita need not go to the forest. Remaining here she should occupy the royal throne of Rama.

sanskrit: आत्मा हि दारास्सर्वेषां दारसङ्ग्रहवर्तिनाम्। आत्मेयमिति रामस्य पालयिष्यति मेदिनीम्।।2.37.24।।
transliteration: ātmā hi dārāssarveṣāṃ dārasaṅgrahavartinām| ātmeyamiti rāmasya pālayiṣyati medinīm||2.37.24||
meaning: For every householder, his wife is the soul. Since Sita is the soul of Rama, she can rule this earth.

sanskrit: अन्तपालाश्च यास्यन्ति सदारो यत्र राघवः। सहोपजीव्यं राष्ट्रं च पुरं च सपरिच्छदम्।।2.37.26।।
transliteration: antapālāśca yāsyanti sadāro yatra rāghavḥ| sahopajīvyṃ rāṣṭrṃ ca purṃ ca saparicchadam||2.37.26||
meaning: The guardians of the harem, its patron king Dasaratha with his retinue and, the people of this city will go wherever Rama lives with his wife.

sanskrit: भरतश्च सशत्रुघ्नश्चीरवासा वनेचरः। वने वसन्तं काकुत्स्थ मनुवत्स्यति पूर्वजम्।।2.37.27।।
transliteration: bharataśca saśatrughnaścīravāsā vanecarḥ| vane vasantṃ kākutstha manuvatsyati pūrvajam||2.37.27||
meaning: Wandering in the forest and wearing bark, Satrughna and Bharata will live in the company of their elder brother (Rama) in the jungle.

sanskrit: तत श्शून्यां गतजनां वसुधां पादपै स्सह। त्वमेका शाधि दुर्वृत्ता प्रजानामहिते स्थिता।।2.37.28।।
transliteration: tata śśūnyāṃ gatajanāṃ vasudhāṃ pādapai ssaha| tvamekā śādhi durvṛttā prajānāmahite sthitā||2.37.28||
meaning: Intent upon doing harm to the people with your vile behaviour, you alone rule this kingdom full of trees and deserted by men.

sanskrit: न हि तद्भविता राष्ट्रं यत्र रामो न भूपतिः। तद्वनं भविता राष्ट्रं यत्र रामो निवत्स्यति।।2.37.29।।
transliteration: na hi tadbhavitā rāṣṭrṃ yatra rāmo na bhūpatiḥ| tadvanṃ bhavitā rāṣṭrṃ yatra rāmo nivatsyati||2.37.29||
meaning: That is not a kingdom where Rama does not rule. If Rama lives in the forest, that shall be the kingdom.

sanskrit: न ह्यदत्तां महीं पित्रा भरतः शास्तुमर्हति। त्वयि वा पुत्रवद्वस्तुं यदि जातो महीपतेः।।2.37.30।।
transliteration: na hyadattāṃ mahīṃ pitrā bharatḥ śāstumarhati| tvayi vā putravadvastuṃ yadi jāto mahīpateḥ||2.37.30||
meaning: If Bharata is truly born to the king, he will not rule the kingdom which has not been bestowed on him (wholeheartedly) by his father. Nor will he live like a son to you.

sanskrit: यद्यपि त्वं क्षितितलाद्गगनं चोत्पतिष्यसि। पितृर्वंशचरित्रज्ञः सोऽन्यथा न करिष्यति।।2.37.31।।
transliteration: yadyapi tvṃ kṣititalādgaganṃ cotpatiṣyasi| pitṛrvṃśacaritrajñḥ so'nyathā na kariṣyati||2.37.31||
meaning: Even if you were to fly from earth to sky, Bharata who knows the traditions of his father's dynasty, will not act otherwise.

sanskrit: तत्त्वया पुत्रगर्धिन्या पुत्रस्य कृतमप्रियम्। लोके हि स न विद्येत यो न राममनुव्रतः।।2.37.32।।
transliteration: tattvayā putragardhinyā putrasya kṛtamapriyam| loke hi sa na vidyeta yo na rāmamanuvratḥ||2.37.32||
meaning: Therefore, by greedily guarding your son's interest you are doing him harm. There is none in this world who will not follow Rama.

sanskrit: द्रक्ष्यस्यद्यैव कैकेयी पशुव्यालमृगद्विजान्। गच्छतस्सह रामेण पादपांश्च तदुन्मुखान्।।2.37.33।।
transliteration: drakṣyasyadyaiva kaikeyī paśuvyālamṛgadvijān| gacchatassaha rāmeṇa pādapāṃśca tadunmukhān||2.37.33||
meaning: Today you shall see, O Kaikeyi, flocks of cattle, elephants, deer and birds following Rama, even the trees bending towards him.

sanskrit: अथोत्तमान्याभरणानि देवि देहि स्नुषायै व्यपनीय चीरम्। न चीरमस्याः प्रविधीयतेति न्यवारयत्तद्वसनं वसिष्टः।।2.37.34।।
transliteration: athottamānyābharaṇāni devi dehi snuṣāyai vyapanīya cīram| na cīramasyāḥ pravidhīyateti nyavārayattadvasanṃ vasiṣṭḥ||2.37
meaning: O Kaikeyi remove those bark robes and bestow on your daughterinlaw precious ornaments. She was not ordained to wear the bark. Vaisishta, saying so, prevented Sita from wearing that garment.

sanskrit: एकस्य रामस्य वने निवास स्त्वया वृतःकेकयराजपुत्री। विभूषितेयं प्रतिकर्मनित्या वसत्वरण्ये सह राघवेण।।2.37.35।।
transliteration: ekasya rāmasya vane nivāsa stvayā vṛtḥkekayarājaputrī| vibhūṣiteyṃ pratikarmanityā vasatvaraṇye saha rāghaveṇa||2.37.35|
meaning: O Kaikeyi, you asked that Rama only should dwell in the forest (wearing bark robes). Therefore let Sita, adorn her body daily, while she lives in the forest with Rama.

sanskrit: यानैश्च मुख्यैः परिचारकैश्च सुसंवृता गच्छतु राजपुत्री। वस्त्रैश्च सर्वैस्सहितैर्विधानै र्नेयं वृता ते वरसम्प्रदाने।।2.37
transliteration: yānaiśca mukhyaiḥ paricārakaiśca susṃvṛtā gacchatu rājaputrī| vastraiśca sarvaissahitairvidhānai rneyṃ vṛtā te varasampr
meaning: Equipped with excellent chariots, attendants, garments, and all other needs let the princess (Sita) go. While seeking boons, you did not include Sita.

sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तथा जल्पति विप्रमुख्ये गुरौ नृपस्याप्रतिमप्रभावे। नैव स्म सीता विनिवृत्तभावा प्रियस्य भर्तुः प्रतिकारकामा।।2.37.
transliteration: tasmiṃstathā jalpati vipramukhye gurau nṛpasyāpratimaprabhāve| naiva sma sītā vinivṛttabhāvā priyasya bhartuḥ pratikārak
meaning: (Though) Vasistha, endowed with matchless power, the preceptor of the king and foremost among the brahmins thus expressed himself, Sita was not willing to swerve from her resolve in order to serve her beloved husband. इत

sanskrit: तेन तत्र प्रणादेन दुःखितस्स महीपतिः। चिच्छेद जीविते श्रद्धां धर्मे यशसि चात्मनः।।2.38.2।।
transliteration: tena tatra praṇādena duḥkhitassa mahīpatiḥ| ciccheda jīvite śraddhāṃ dharme yaśasi cātmanḥ||2.38.2||
meaning: Hearing that tumult the distressed Dasaratha lost faith in his own life and in his righteousness.

sanskrit: ननु पर्याप्त मेतत्ते पापे रामविवासनम्। किमेभिः कृपणैर्भूय: पातकैरपि ते कृतैः।।2.38.10।।
transliteration: nanu paryāpta metatte pāpe rāmavivāsanam| kimebhiḥ kṛpaṇairbhūya: pātakairapi te kṛtaiḥ||2.38.10||
meaning: Rama's exile, O wicked woman, is enough for you. What are you committing further heinous crimes for?

sanskrit: प्रतिज्ञातं मया तावत् त्वयोक्तं देवि शृण्वता। रामं यदभिषेकाय त्वमिहागतमब्रवीः।।2.38.11।।
transliteration: pratijñātṃ mayā tāvat tvayoktṃ devi śṛṇvatā| rāmṃ yadabhiṣekāya tvamihāgatamabravīḥ||2.38.11||
meaning: I have heard you, O Devi speaking to Rama when he came here in connection with the coronation. I promised you to that extent only.

sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवन्तं पितरं रामस्सम्प्रस्थितो वनम्। अवाक्छिरसमासीनमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.38.14।।
transliteration: evṃ bruvantṃ pitarṃ rāmassamprasthito vanam| avākchirasamāsīnamidṃ vacanamabravīt||2.38.14||
meaning: Rama who was about to leave for the forest addressed his father who sat with his head bent once again:

sanskrit: यं धार्मिक कौशल्या मम माता यशस्विनी। वृद्धा चाक्षुद्रशीला च न च त्वां देव गर्हते।।2.38.15।।
transliteration: yṃ dhārmika kauśalyā mama mātā yaśasvinī| vṛddhā cākṣudraśīlā ca na ca tvāṃ deva garhate||2.38.15||
meaning: O righteous father O king my aged and illustrious mother, Kausalya possesses neither a mean character nor does she blame you.

sanskrit: न त्वेवानागते काले देहाच्च्यवति जीवितम्। कैकेय्या क्लिश्यमानस्य मृत्युर्मम न विद्यते।।2.39.5।। योऽहं पावकसङ्काशं पश्यामि
transliteration: na tvevānāgate kāle dehāccyavati jīvitam| kaikeyyā kliśyamānasya mṛtyurmama na vidyate||2.39.5|| yo'hṃ pāvakasaṅkāśṃ paś
meaning: Unless the destined hour arrives, life does not leave the body. Therefore, even though I am tormented by Kaikeyi and even after seeing my son, standing before me, (bright) like fire, taking off his fine clothes and weari

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु वचनं बाष्पेण पिहितेन्द्रियः। रामेति सकृदेवोक्त्वा व्याहर्तुं न शशाक ह।।2.39.8।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu vacanṃ bāṣpeṇa pihitendriyḥ| rāmeti sakṛdevoktvā vyāhartuṃ na śaśāka ha||2.39.8||
meaning: Having uttered these words and muttering, 'O Rama' only once, his vision blurred by tears, he could speak no more.

sanskrit: संज्ञां तु प्रतिलभ्यैव मुहूर्तात्स महीपतिः। नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां सुमन्त्रमिदमब्रवीत्।।2.39.9।।
transliteration: sṃjñāṃ tu pratilabhyaiva muhūrtātsa mahīpatiḥ| netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyāṃ sumantramidamabravīt||2.39.9||
meaning: Regaining his senses in a moment, the king, with eyes filled with tears, said to Sumantra:

sanskrit: तां भुजाभ्यां परिष्वज्य श्वश्रूर्वचनमब्रवीत्। अनाचरन्ती कृपणं मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय मैथिलीम्।।2.39.19।।
transliteration: tāṃ bhujābhyāṃ pariṣvajya śvaśrūrvacanamabravīt| anācarantī kṛpaṇṃ mūrdhnyupāghrāya maithilīm||2.39.19||
meaning: Kausalya, Sita's motherinlaw, took her in her arms, embraced her, kissed her on the forehead, and said to her who conducted herself without evoking any pity.

sanskrit: न कुलं न कृतं विद्या न दत्तं नापि सङ्ग्रहः। स्त्रीणां गृह्णाति हृदयमनित्यहृदया हि ताः।।2.39.23।।
transliteration: na kulṃ na kṛtṃ vidyā na dattṃ nāpi saṅgrahḥ| strīṇāṃ gṛhṇāti hṛdayamanityahṛdayā hi tāḥ||2.39.23||
meaning: Neither family traditions nor benefits received, nor education nor affection nor gifts nor even accumulated wealth attract women's hearts. Their minds are unstable indeed.

sanskrit: साध्वीनां हि स्थितानां तु शीले सत्ये श्रुते शमे। स्त्रीणां पवित्रं परमं पतिरेको विशिष्यते।।2.39.24।।
transliteration: sādhvīnāṃ hi sthitānāṃ tu śīle satye śrute śame| strīṇāṃ pavitrṃ paramṃ patireko viśiṣyate||2.39.24||
meaning: But for those virtuous women whose minds are fixed in chastity, truth, scriptures and stability, the husband occupies a distinguished place and is considered supremely holy.

sanskrit: विज्ञाय वचनं सीता तस्या धर्मार्थसंहितम्। कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदं श्वश्रूमभिमुखे स्थिताम्।।2.39.26।।
transliteration: vijñāya vacanṃ sītā tasyā dharmārthasṃhitam| kṛtāñjaliruvācedṃ śvaśrūmabhimukhe sthitām||2.39.26||
meaning: Sita who understood the import of these words which were in conformity with dharma and artha, repiled to her motherinlaw facing her with folded palms:

sanskrit: करिष्ये सर्वमेवाहमार्या यदनुशास्ति माम्। अभिज्ञास्मि यथा भर्तुर्वर्तितव्यं श्रुतं च मे।।2.39.27।।
transliteration: kariṣye sarvamevāhamāryā yadanuśāsti mām| abhijñāsmi yathā bharturvartitavyṃ śrutṃ ca me||2.39.27||
meaning: I shall do exactly all that the venerable motherinlaw instructs me. I have heard it earlier and have fully understood as to how I should conduct myself towards my husband.

sanskrit: न मामसज्जनेनार्या समानयितुमर्हति। धर्माद्विचलितुं नाहमलं चन्द्रादिव प्रभा।।2.39.28।।
transliteration: na māmasajjanenāryā samānayitumarhati| dharmādvicalituṃ nāhamalṃ candrādiva prabhā||2.39.28||
meaning: My worshipful motherinlaw should not equate me with wicked people (women). I cannot swerve from the path of virtue like radiance which never leaves the Moon.

sanskrit: नातन्त्री वाद्यते वीणा नाचक्रो वर्तते रथः। नापतिस्सुखमेधेत या स्यादपि शतात्मजा।।2.39.29।।
transliteration: nātantrī vādyate vīṇā nācakro vartate rathḥ| nāpatissukhamedheta yā syādapi śatātmajā||2.39.29||
meaning: A veena (lute) sans strings cannot be played. A chariot without wheels cannot move. Similarly, a woman without her husband finds no happiness even though she has one hundred sons.

sanskrit: मितं ददाति हि पिता मितं माता मितं सुतः। अमितस्य हि दातारं भर्तारं का न पूजयेत्।।2.39.30।।
transliteration: mitṃ dadāti hi pitā mitṃ mātā mitṃ sutḥ| amitasya hi dātārṃ bhartārṃ kā na pūjayet||2.39.30||
meaning: While the happiness that the father, mother and son give is limited, a husband gives unlimited happiness. Which wife will not worship such a husband?

sanskrit: साहमेवं गता श्रेष्ठा श्रुतधर्मपरावरा। आर्ये किमवमन्येऽहं स्त्रीणां भर्ता हि दैवतम्।।2.39.31।।
transliteration: sāhamevṃ gatā śreṣṭhā śrutadharmaparāvarā| ārye kimavamanye'hṃ strīṇāṃ bhartā hi daivatam||2.39.31||
meaning: Instructed about my obligations by an eminent lady (her mother?), imbued with these ideals, how can I, O exalted one, underestimate him (my husband)? For a woman the husband is a god indeed

sanskrit: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा कौशल्या हृदयङ्गमम्। शुद्धसत्त्वा मुमोचाश्रु सहसा दुःखहर्षजम्।।2.39.32।।
transliteration: sītāyā vacanṃ śrutvā kauśalyā hṛdayaṅgamam| śuddhasattvā mumocāśru sahasā duḥkhaharṣajam||2.39.32||
meaning: Listening to the heartstirring words of Sita, Kausalya with her heart so pure burst instantaneously into tears of joy and grief.

sanskrit: तां प्राञ्जलिरभिक्रम्य मातृमध्येऽतिसत्कृताम्। रामः परमधर्मात्मा मातरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।2.39.33।।
transliteration: tāṃ prāñjalirabhikramya mātṛmadhye'tisatkṛtām| rāmḥ paramadharmātmā mātarṃ vākyamabravīt||2.39.33||
meaning: Most virtuous Rama approached his mother, that highly revered lady among all his mothers, and with folded hands said:

sanskrit: अम्ब मा दुःखिता भूस्त्वं पश्य त्वं पितरं मम।। क्षयो हि वनवासस्य क्षिप्रमेव भविष्यति।।2.39.34।।
transliteration: amba mā duḥkhitā bhūstvṃ paśya tvṃ pitarṃ mama|| kṣayo hi vanavāsasya kṣiprameva bhaviṣyati||2.39.34||
meaning: O mother, do not grieve. Look after my father. My stay in the forest will soon come to an end.

sanskrit: सुप्तायास्ते गमिष्यन्ति नव वर्षाणि पञ्च च। सा समग्रमिह प्राप्तं मां द्रक्ष्यसि सुहृद्वृतम्।।2.39.35।।
transliteration: suptāyāste gamiṣyanti nava varṣāṇi pañca ca| sā samagramiha prāptṃ māṃ drakṣyasi suhṛdvṛtam||2.39.35||
meaning: Fourteen years will pass off like a night's sleep. You will see me come home safe and sound, surrounded by my friends.

sanskrit: एतावदभिनीतार्थमुक्त्वा स जननीं वचः। त्रयश्शतशतार्धाश्च ददर्शा वेक्ष्य मातरः।।2.39.36।।
transliteration: etāvadabhinītārthamuktvā sa jananīṃ vacḥ| trayaśśataśatārdhāśca dadarśā vekṣya mātarḥ||2.39.36||
meaning: Speaking thus to his mother with highly polished words, he then turned his gaze at his other three hundred and fifty mothers.

sanskrit: ता श्चापि स तथैवार्ता मातृ़र्दशरथात्मजः। धर्मयुक्तमिदं वाक्यं निजगाद कृताञ्जलिः।।2.39.37।।
transliteration: tā ścāpi sa tathaivārtā mātṛ़rdaśarathātmajḥ| dharmayuktamidṃ vākyṃ nijagāda kṛtāñjaliḥ||2.39.37||
meaning: To all the mothers who stood deeply distressed with grief the son of Dasaratha spoke with folded hands these words suffused with virtue:

sanskrit: संवासात्परुषं किञ्चिदज्ञानाद्वापि यत्कृतम्। तन्मे समनुजानीत सर्वाश्चामन्त्रयामि वः।।2.39.38।।
transliteration: sṃvāsātparuṣṃ kiñcidajñānādvāpi yatkṛtam| tanme samanujānīta sarvāścāmantrayāmi vḥ||2.39.38||
meaning: If I have been harsh towards you, on account of our living together or through ignorance may you forgive me. I (now) seek leave of you all.

sanskrit: वचनं राघवस्यैतध्दर्मयुक्तं समाहितम्। शुश्रुवुस्ताः स्त्रियंस्सर्वा श्शोकोपहतचेतसः।।2.39.39।।
transliteration: vacanṃ rāghavasyaitadhdarmayuktṃ samāhitam| śuśruvustāḥ striyṃssarvā śśokopahatacetasḥ||2.39.39||
meaning: All the women with their senses afflicted by grief heard the virtuous and wellbalanced words of the scion of the Raghu race:

sanskrit: जज्ञेऽथ तासां सन्नादः क्रौञ्चीनामिव निस्वनः। मानवेन्द्रस्य भार्याणामेवं वदति राघवे।।2.39.40।।
transliteration: jajñe'tha tāsāṃ sannādḥ krauñcīnāmiva nisvanḥ| mānavendrasya bhāryāṇāmevṃ vadati rāghave||2.39.40||
meaning: While Rama said so, there arose a loud cry of the wives of the king like the cry of the female herons.

sanskrit: मुरजपणवमेघघोषवत् दशरथवेश्म बभूव यत्पुरा। विलपितपरिदेवनाकुलं व्यसनगतं तदभूत्सुदुःखितम्।।2.39.41।।
transliteration: murajapaṇavameghaghoṣavat daśarathaveśma babhūva yatpurā| vilapitaparidevanākulṃ vyasanagatṃ tadabhūtsuduḥkhitam||2.39.4
meaning: Dasaratha's palace which reverberated, like the rumblings of the cloud, with the sounds of drums and other musical instruments earlier, now immensely griefsticken and trapped in calamity, is filled with wailings and lame

sanskrit: तद्यावदेव मे चेतो न विमुह्यति राघव। तावदेवाभिषिञ्चस्व चला हि प्राणिनां मतिः।।2.4.20।।
transliteration: tadyāvadeva me ceto na vimuhyati rāghava| tāvadevābhiṣiñcasva calā hi prāṇināṃ matiḥ||2.4.20||
meaning: Therefore, before my mind is deluded I wish to see you installed as heirapparent for a man's mind is unstable indeed, O Rama.

sanskrit: अद्य चन्द्रोऽभ्युपगतः पुष्यात्पूर्वं पुनर्वसू। श्वः पुष्ययोगं नियतं वक्ष्यन्ते दैवचिन्तकाः।।2.4.21।।
transliteration: adya candro'bhyupagatḥ puṣyātpūrvṃ punarvasū| śvḥ puṣyayogṃ niyatṃ vakṣyante daivacintakāḥ||2.4.21||
meaning: Today the Moon is in conjunction with the Punarvasu constellation. Tomorrow the Moon's conjunction with the Pushya constellation is certain and the astrologers say this auspicious time is highly suitable for the purpose

sanskrit: सुहृदश्चाप्रमत्तास्त्वां रक्षन्त्वद्य समन्ततः। भवन्ति बहु विघ्नानि कार्याण्येवंविधानि हि।।2.4.24।।
transliteration: suhṛdaścāpramattāstvāṃ rakṣantvadya samantatḥ| bhavanti bahu vighnāni kāryāṇyevṃvidhāni hi||2.4.24||
meaning: Many impediments befall acts of this sort indeed. Alert your friends to protect you from all sides today onwards.

sanskrit: विप्रोषितश्च भरतो यावदेव पुरादितः। तावदेवाभिषेकस्ते प्राप्तकालो मतो मम।।2.4.25।।
transliteration: viproṣitaśca bharato yāvadeva purāditḥ| tāvadevābhiṣekaste prāptakālo mato mama||2.4.25||
meaning: While Bharata is away from the city, the time is favourable for your installation. This is my opinion.

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा पुष्येण पुत्रस्य यौवराज्याऽभिषेचनम्। प्राणायामेन पुरुषं ध्यायमाना जनार्दनम्।।2.4.33।।
transliteration: śrutvā puṣyeṇa putrasya yauvarājyā'bhiṣecanam| prāṇāyāmena puruṣṃ dhyāyamānā janārdanam||2.4.33||
meaning: Having heard that installation of her son as heirapparent was planned in Pushya constellation, Kausalya was meditating upon the Supreme Person, Lord Visnu by controlling her breath (Pranayama).

sanskrit: तथा सनियमामेव सोऽभिगम्याभिवाद्य च। उवाच वचनं रामो हर्षयंस्तामनिन्दिताम्।।2.4.34।।
transliteration: tathā saniyamāmeva so'bhigamyābhivādya ca| uvāca vacanṃ rāmo harṣayṃstāmaninditām||2.4.34||
meaning: While she (Kausalya) was in that state of meditation, Rama approached her, offered reverential salutation and said these words of praise enhancing her joy:

sanskrit: तथैवायुधजालानि भ्रातृभ्यां कवचानि च। रथोपस्थे प्रतिन्यस्य सचर्म कठिनं च तत्।।2.40.16।। सीतातृतीयानारूढान् दृष्ट्वा दृष्ट
transliteration: tathaivāyudhajālāni bhrātṛbhyāṃ kavacāni ca| rathopasthe pratinyasya sacarma kaṭhinṃ ca tat||2.40.16|| sītātṛtīyānārūḍhā
meaning: So also Dasaratha secured a multitude of weapons, shields and protective leathercoverings for hands and placed them at the centre of the chariot, for use by the brothers. When Sumantra ensured that Sita, Rama and Lakshma

sanskrit: अथ राजा वृत स्त्रीभिर्दीनाभिर्दीनचेतनः। निर्जगाम प्रियं पुत्रं द्रक्ष्यामीति ब्रुवन् गृहात्।।2.40.28।।
transliteration: atha rājā vṛta strībhirdīnābhirdīnacetanḥ| nirjagāma priyṃ putrṃ drakṣyāmīti bruvan gṛhāt||2.40.28||
meaning: I wish to see my beloved son said the king with a sense of desolation and emerged, surrounded by forlorn women, from the palace.

sanskrit: शुश्रुवे चाग्रतः स्त्रीणां रुदन्तीनां महास्वनः। यथा नादः करेणूनां बद्धे महति कुञ्जरे।।2.40.29।।
transliteration: śuśruve cāgratḥ strīṇāṃ rudantīnāṃ mahāsvanḥ| yathā nādḥ kareṇūnāṃ baddhe mahati kuñjare||2.40.29||
meaning: He heard the women crying loudly in front like wailings of cowelephants when their bull elephant is captured.

sanskrit: पिता हि राजा काकुत्स्थः श्रीमान् सन्नस्तदाऽभवत्। परिपूर्णः शशी काले ग्रहेणोपप्लुतो यथा।।2.40.30।।
transliteration: pitā hi rājā kākutsthḥ śrīmān sannastadā'bhavat| paripūrṇḥ śaśī kāle graheṇopapluto yathā||2.40.30||
meaning: The king born in the race of Kakutstha, though bright, looked dull then like the full Moon eclipsed (by Rahu).

sanskrit: स च श्रीमानचिन्त्यात्मा रामो दशरथात्मजः। सूतं सञ्चोदयामास त्वरितं वाह्यतामिति।।2.40.31।।
transliteration: sa ca śrīmānacintyātmā rāmo daśarathātmajḥ| sūtṃ sañcodayāmāsa tvaritṃ vāhyatāmiti||2.40.31||
meaning: The son of Dasaratha, glorious Rama of inconceivable courage, exhorted the charioteer to drive the chariot fast.

sanskrit: रामो याहीति सूतं तं तिष्ठेति स जनस्तदा। उभयं नाशकत्सूतः कर्तुमध्वनि चोदितः।।2.40.32।।
transliteration: rāmo yāhīti sūtṃ tṃ tiṣṭheti sa janastadā| ubhayṃ nāśakatsūtḥ kartumadhvani coditḥ||2.40.32||
meaning: Urged by Rama to drive fast on the one hand and by the citizens to stay, on the other, the charioteer could do neither on the way.

sanskrit: निर्गच्छति महाबाहौ रामे पौरजनाश्रुभिः। पतितैरभ्यवहितं प्रशशाम महीरजः।।2.40.33।।
transliteration: nirgacchati mahābāhau rāme paurajanāśrubhiḥ| patitairabhyavahitṃ praśaśāma mahīrajḥ||2.40.33||
meaning: As the mightyarmed Rama was going away, the dust raised from the earth subsided with the tears falling from the citizens' (eyes).

sanskrit: रुदिताश्रुपरिद्यूनं हाहाकृतमचेतनम्। प्रयाणे राघवस्यासीत्पुरं परमपीडितम्।।2.40.34।।
transliteration: ruditāśruparidyūnṃ hāhākṛtamacetanam| prayāṇe rāghavasyāsītpurṃ paramapīḍitam||2.40.34||
meaning: At the time of Rama's departure, the insensate city was drenched with tears of the deeply afflicted people crying, 'Alas, Alas'.

sanskrit: सुस्राव नयनैः स्त्रीणामस्रमायाससम्भवम्। मीनसङ्क्षोभचलितै स्सलिलं पङ्कजैरिव।।2.40.35।।
transliteration: susrāva nayanaiḥ strīṇāmasramāyāsasambhavam| mīnasaṅkṣobhacalitai ssalilṃ paṅkajairiva||2.40.35||
meaning: Tears born of anguish fell from the eyes of women just as waterdrops fall from lotuses shaken by the movements of fishes.

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तु नृपति श्श्रीमानेकचित्तगतं पुरम्। निपपातैव दुःखेन हतमूल इव द्रुमः।।2.40.36।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu nṛpati śśrīmānekacittagatṃ puram| nipapātaiva duḥkhena hatamūla iva drumḥ||2.40.36||
meaning: Having seen the city (people) absorbed in one single thought, the prosperous king, griefstricken, fell down on the ground like a tree severed at its root.

sanskrit: ततो हलहलाशब्दो जज्ञे रामस्य पृष्ठतः। नराणां प्रेक्ष्य राजानं सीदन्तं भृशदुःखितम्।।2.40.37।।
transliteration: tato halahalāśabdo jajñe rāmasya pṛṣṭhatḥ| narāṇāṃ prekṣya rājānṃ sīdantṃ bhṛśaduḥkhitam||2.40.37||
meaning: When the people saw the king enfeebled by deep grief, they raised an uproar behind Rama's (chariot).

sanskrit: हा रामेति जनाः केचिद्राममातेति चापरे। अन्तःपुरं समृद्धं च क्रोशन्तः पर्यदेवयन्।।2.40.38।।
transliteration: hā rāmeti janāḥ kecidrāmamāteti cāpare| antḥpurṃ samṛddhṃ ca krośantḥ paryadevayan||2.40.38||
meaning: Some among them wailed 'Oh Rama', while some others cried 'Oh mother of Rama' By crying loudly, they made the women in the inner apartment cry too.

sanskrit: अन्वीक्षमाणो रामस्तु विषण्णं भ्रान्तचेतसम्। राजानं मातरं चैव ददर्शानुगतौ पथि।।2.40.39।।
transliteration: anvīkṣamāṇo rāmastu viṣaṇṇṃ bhrāntacetasam| rājānṃ mātarṃ caiva dadarśānugatau pathi||2.40.39||
meaning: When Rama glanced back, he saw his mother and father trailing behind him on the highway, with an agitated and dejected mind.

sanskrit: स बद्ध इव पाशेन किशोरो मातरं यथा। धर्मपाशेन सङ्क्षिप्तः प्रकाशं नाभ्युदैक्षत।।2.40.40।।
transliteration: sa baddha iva pāśena kiśoro mātarṃ yathā| dharmapāśena saṅkṣiptḥ prakāśṃ nābhyudaikṣata||2.40.40||
meaning: Like a fastened foal cannot see its mother, Rama restrained by bonds of duty could not see his parents clearly.

sanskrit: पदातिनौ च यानार्हावदुःखार्हौ सुखोचितौ। दृष्ट्वा सञ्चोदयामास शीघ्रं याहीति सारथिम्।।2.40.41।।
transliteration: padātinau ca yānārhāvaduḥkhārhau sukhocitau| dṛṣṭvā sañcodayāmāsa śīghrṃ yāhīti sārathim||2.40.41||
meaning: Seeing his parents, who were worthy of riding a chariot now going on foot, who were accustomed to comforts and did not deserve any suffering, Rama urged his charioteer to drive fast.

sanskrit: न हि तत्पुरुषव्याघ्रो दुःखदं दर्शनं पितुः। मातुश्च सहितुं शक्तस्तोत्रार्दित इव द्विपः।।2.40.42।।
transliteration: na hi tatpuruṣavyāghro duḥkhadṃ darśanṃ pituḥ| mātuśca sahituṃ śaktastotrārdita iva dvipḥ||2.40.42||
meaning: Rama the best among men, could not, like an elephant tormented by the goad, endure that pitiful sight of his father and mother.

sanskrit: प्रत्यगारमिवायान्ती वत्सला वत्सकारणात्। बद्धवत्सा यथा धेनू राममाताभ्यधावत।।2.40.43।।
transliteration: pratyagāramivāyāntī vatsalā vatsakāraṇāt| baddhavatsā yathā dhenū rāmamātābhyadhāvata||2.40.43||
meaning: Rama's mother ran after the chariot, like an affectionate cow running towards the shed to join its fastened calf.

sanskrit: तथा रुदन्तीं कौसल्यां रथं तमनुधावतीम्। क्रोशन्तीं राम रामेति हा सीते लक्ष्मणेति च।।2.40.44।। रामलक्ष्मणसीतार्थं स्रवन्ती
transliteration: tathā rudantīṃ kausalyāṃ rathṃ tamanudhāvatīm| krośantīṃ rāma rāmeti hā sīte lakṣmaṇeti ca||2.40.44|| rāmalakṣmaṇasītārt
meaning: While Kausalya was weeping and running after the chariot, crying O 'Rama, O Sita, O Lakshmana, shedding tears for them, Rama repeatedly glanced at her who was twisting and bending as if in a dancing pose.

sanskrit: तिष्ठेति राजा चुक्रोश याहि याहीति राघवः। सुमन्त्रस्य बभूवात्मा चक्रयोरिव चान्तरा।।2.40.46।।
transliteration: tiṣṭheti rājā cukrośa yāhi yāhīti rāghavḥ| sumantrasya babhūvātmā cakrayoriva cāntarā||2.40.46||
meaning: The king cried, 'Stay, Stay', while Rama said 'Go on, Go on'. Sumantra's mind was caught as if in between two wheels.

sanskrit: नाश्रौषमिति राजानमुपालब्धोऽपि वक्ष्यसि। चिरं दुःखस्य पापिष्ठमिति रामस्तमब्रवीत्।।2.40.47।।
transliteration: nāśrauṣamiti rājānamupālabdho'pi vakṣyasi| cirṃ duḥkhasya pāpiṣṭhamiti rāmastamabravīt||2.40.47||
meaning: When the king reproaches you for not stopping the chariot, you can say 'I could not hear'.Prolonging agony is sinful, said Rama to Sumantra.

sanskrit: रामस्य स वचः कुर्वन्ननुज्ञाप्य च तं जनम्। व्रजतोऽपि हयान् शीघ्रं चोदयामास सारथिः।।2.40.48।।
transliteration: rāmasya sa vacḥ kurvannanujñāpya ca tṃ janam| vrajato'pi hayān śīghrṃ codayāmāsa sārathiḥ||2.40.48||
meaning: Obeying the command of Rama and after taking leave of the people, Sumantra hastened the horses although they were galloping.

sanskrit: न्यवर्तत जनो राज्ञो रामं कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम्। मनसाप्यश्रुवेगैश्च न न्यवर्तत मानुषम्।।2.40.49।।
transliteration: nyavartata jano rājño rāmṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam| manasāpyaśruvegaiśca na nyavartata mānuṣam||2.40.49||
meaning: The king's men returned, with Rama circumambulated (on the plane of their minds). But from their minds they could not hold back their tears (grief).

sanskrit: यमिच्छेत्पुनरायान्तं नैनं दूरमनुव्रजेत्। इत्यमात्या महाराजमूचुर्दशरथं वचः।।2.40.50।।
transliteration: yamicchetpunarāyāntṃ nainṃ dūramanuvrajet| ityamātyā mahārājamūcurdaśarathṃ vacḥ||2.40.50||
meaning: We should not follow over a long distance those we wish to return, said the ministers to king Dasaratha.

sanskrit: तेषां वचः सर्वगुणोपपन्नं प्रस्विन्नगात्रः प्रविषण्णरूपः। निशम्य राजा कृपणः सभार्यो व्यवस्थितस्तं सुतमीक्षमाणः।।2.40.51।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ vacḥ sarvaguṇopapannṃ prasvinnagātrḥ praviṣaṇṇarūpḥ| niśamya rājā kṛpaṇḥ sabhāryo vyavasthitastṃ sutamīkṣamāṇḥ||2.
meaning: Dasaratha and his wives, overcome with grief, heard their words steeped in virtue (wisdom). The king stood there with his perspiring body and melancholic appearance, fixing his gaze on his son. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे व

sanskrit: ततस्त्वयोध्या रहिता महात्मना पुरन्दरेणेव मही सपर्वता। चचाल घोरं भयशोकपीडिता सनागयोधाश्वगणा ननाद च।।2.41.21।।
transliteration: tatastvayodhyā rahitā mahātmanā purandareṇeva mahī saparvatā| cacāla ghorṃ bhayaśokapīḍitā sanāgayodhāśvagaṇā nanāda ca|
meaning: Without magnanimous Rama, Ayodhya thereafter looked like the earth along with its mountains bereft of Indra. Afflicted with fear and sorrow it started shaking dreadfully with the sounds of horses, elephants and warriors.

sanskrit: यः सुखेषूपधानेषु शेते चन्दनरूषितः। वीज्यमानो महार्हाभिः स्त्रीभिर्मम सुतोत्तमः।।2.42.15।। स नूनं क्वचिदेवाद्य वृक्षमूलमु
transliteration: yḥ sukheṣūpadhāneṣu śete candanarūṣitḥ| vījyamāno mahārhābhiḥ strībhirmama sutottamḥ||2.42.15|| sa nūnṃ kvacidevādya vṛk
meaning: Rama, the best of all my sons who, smeared with sandalpaste and fanned by graceful women used to sleep (with his head) on comfortable cushions will surely, from now on, lie down somewhere at the foot of a tree, (his head

sanskrit: अनभिज्ञा वनानां सा नूनं भयमुपैष्यति। श्वापदानर्दितं श्रुत्वा गम्भीरं रोमहर्षणम्।।2.42.20।।
transliteration: anabhijñā vanānāṃ sā nūnṃ bhayamupaiṣyati| śvāpadānarditṃ śrutvā gambhīrṃ romaharṣaṇam||2.42.20||
meaning: Sita who knows not the forest will now live in terror, listening to the hairraising, horrible roars of wild animals.

sanskrit: सकामा भव कैकेयि विधवा राज्यमावस। न हि तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं विना जीवितुमुत्सहे।।2.42.21।।
transliteration: sakāmā bhava kaikeyi vidhavā rājyamāvasa| na hi tṃ puruṣavyāghrṃ vinā jīvitumutsahe||2.42.21||
meaning: O Kaikeyi, your desire is fulfilled. Rule the kingdom as a widow. Without Rama, the best of men, I don't desire to live.

sanskrit: शून्यचत्वरवेश्मान्तां संवृतापणदेवताम्। क्लान्तदुर्बलदुःखार्तां नात्याकीर्णमहापथाम्।।2.42.23।। तामवेक्ष्य पुरीं सर्वां रा
transliteration: śūnyacatvaraveśmāntāṃ sṃvṛtāpaṇadevatām| klāntadurbaladuḥkhārtāṃ nātyākīrṇamahāpathām||2.42.23|| tāmavekṣya purīṃ sarvāṃ
meaning: There the mansions and squares on the highways were all deserted. The temples and marketplaces were closed. The people were weak, fatigued and tormented with grief. The highways were not much crowded. Having seen such a

sanskrit: राघवे नरशार्दूले विषमुप्त्वाहिजिह्मगा। विचरिष्यति कैकेयी निर्मुक्तेव हि पन्नगी।।2.43.2।।
transliteration: rāghave naraśārdūle viṣamuptvāhijihmagā| vicariṣyati kaikeyī nirmukteva hi pannagī||2.43.2||
meaning: Moving crookedly like a snake, Kaikeyi has released her venom on Rama, the best among men. Now she will move about freely like a sheserpent that has cast off its slough.

sanskrit: यस्तवार्ये गतः पुत्रस्त्यक्त्वा राज्यं महाबलः। साधु कुर्वन् महात्मानं पितरं सत्यवादिनम्।।2.44.3।। शिष्टैराचरिते सम्यक्छश
transliteration: yastavārye gatḥ putrastyaktvā rājyṃ mahābalḥ| sādhu kurvan mahātmānṃ pitarṃ satyavādinam||2.44.3|| śiṣṭairācarite samyak
meaning: In order to vindicate the words of his great and truthful father, O noble lady,your mighty son has renounced the kingdom and has gone (to the forest). He has stuck to the path so scrupulously followed by the wise, the ev

sanskrit: वर्तते चोत्तमां वृत्तिं लक्ष्मणोऽस्मिन् सदानघः। दयावान् सर्वभूतेषु लाभस्तस्य महात्मनः।।2.44.5।।
transliteration: vartate cottamāṃ vṛttiṃ lakṣmaṇo'smin sadānaghḥ| dayāvān sarvabhūteṣu lābhastasya mahātmanḥ||2.44.5||
meaning: Blameless Lakshmana, compassionate to all beings, has acted most nobly in this matter for the benefit of his great soul.

sanskrit: अरण्यवासे यद्दुःखं जानती वै सुखोचिता। अनुगच्छति वैदेही धर्मात्मानं तवात्मजम्।।2.44.6।।
transliteration: araṇyavāse yadduḥkhṃ jānatī vai sukhocitā| anugacchati vaidehī dharmātmānṃ tavātmajam||2.44.6||
meaning: The daughter of Videha (Sita) who was used to comforts has knowingly followed your virtuous son into the hardships of forest life.

sanskrit: कीर्तिभूतां पताकां यो लोके भ्रमयति प्रभुः। धर्मसत्यव्रतधनः किं न प्राप्तस्तवात्मजः।।2.44.7।।
transliteration: kīrtibhūtāṃ patākāṃ yo loke bhramayati prabhuḥ| dharmasatyavratadhanḥ kiṃ na prāptastavātmajḥ||2.44.7||
meaning: Your allcompetent son who considers righteousness and truth as wealth, is waving the flag of fame in this world. What is that which your son did not gain ?

sanskrit: व्यक्तं रामस्य विज्ञाय शौचं माहात्म्यमुत्तमम्। न गात्रमंशुभि स्सूर्य स्सन्तापयितुमर्हति।।2.44.8।।
transliteration: vyaktṃ rāmasya vijñāya śaucṃ māhātmyamuttamam| na gātramṃśubhi ssūrya ssantāpayitumarhati||2.44.8||
meaning: Knowing Rama's sterling purity and greatness the Sun evidently dare not scorch his body with its rays.

sanskrit: ददौ चास्त्राणि दिव्यानि यस्मै ब्रह्मा महौजसे। दानवेन्द्रं हतं दृष्ट्वा तिमिध्वजसुतं रणे।।2.44.11।। स शूरः पुरुषव्याघ्रः
transliteration: dadau cāstrāṇi divyāni yasmai brahmā mahaujase| dānavendrṃ hatṃ dṛṣṭvā timidhvajasutṃ raṇe||2.44.11|| sa śūrḥ puruṣavyāg
meaning: To the mighty, heroic Rama, that best of men, Brahmalike Viswamitra has bequeathed many divine weapons, seeing him slay Timidhwaja's son (Subahu), lord of demons, in the battle. He will stay fearless in the forest, relyi

sanskrit: यस्येषुपथमासाद्य विनाशं यान्ति शत्रवः। कथं न पृथिवी तस्य शासने स्थातुमर्हति।।2.44.13।।
transliteration: yasyeṣupathamāsādya vināśṃ yānti śatravḥ| kathṃ na pṛthivī tasya śāsane sthātumarhati||2.44.13||
meaning: When enemies who are targets of his arrows are destoyed, how can this earth, not stay under the command of Rama?

sanskrit: या श्री श्शौर्यं च रामस्य या च कल्याणसत्वता। निवृत्तारण्यवास स्स क्षिप्रं राज्यमवाप्स्यति।।2.44.14।।
transliteration: yā śrī śśauryṃ ca rāmasya yā ca kalyāṇasatvatā| nivṛttāraṇyavāsa ssa kṣiprṃ rājyamavāpsyati||2.44.14||
meaning: On return from his sojourn in the forest, Rama, endowed with splendour, valour and a strength that brings wellbeing will quickly regain his kingdom.

sanskrit: सूर्यस्यापि भवेत्सूर्यो ह्यग्नेरग्नि प्रभोः प्रभुः। श्रियः श्रीश्च भवेदग्र्या कीर्तिः कीर्त्याः क्षमाक्षमा।।2.44.15।। दै
transliteration: sūryasyāpi bhavetsūryo hyagneragni prabhoḥ prabhuḥ| śriyḥ śrīśca bhavedagryā kīrtiḥ kīrtyāḥ kṣamākṣamā||2.44.15|| daivat
meaning: O Devi Rama is the Sun (light) of the Sun, fire (splendour) of the fire, master (command) of masters, prosperity of the prosperous, the fame of the famous, forbearance of the forbearing, god of the gods and supreme among

sanskrit: पृथिव्या सह वैदेह्या श्रिया च पुरुषर्षभः। क्षिप्रं तिसृभिरेताभि स्सह रामोऽभिषेक्ष्यते।।2.44.17।।
transliteration: pṛthivyā saha vaidehyā śriyā ca puruṣarṣabhḥ| kṣiprṃ tisṛbhiretābhi ssaha rāmo'bhiṣekṣyate||2.44.17||
meaning: Rama, the best among men, will soon be coronated with these three namely the earth, the goddess of fortune and Sita.

sanskrit: दुःखजं विसृजन्त्यस्रं निष्क्रामन्तमुदीक्ष्य यम्। अयोध्यायां जनास्सर्वे शोकवेगसमाहताः।2.44.18।। कुशचीरधरं देवं गच्छन्तमपर
transliteration: duḥkhajṃ visṛjantyasrṃ niṣkrāmantamudīkṣya yam| ayodhyāyāṃ janāssarve śokavegasamāhatāḥ|2.44.18|| kuśacīradharṃ devṃ gac
meaning: When the people of Ayodhya saw the godlike Rama departing, clad in robes of kusha and bark, they were moved to tears of grief. What is impossible for him who is unconquerable and whom Sita, like the goddess of fortune, f

sanskrit: निवृत्तवनवासं तं द्रष्टासि पुनरागतम्। जहिशोकं च मोहं च देवि सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते।।2.44.21।।
transliteration: nivṛttavanavāsṃ tṃ draṣṭāsi punarāgatam| jahiśokṃ ca mohṃ ca devi satyṃ bravīmi te||2.44.21||
meaning: I tell you the truth, Kausalya, that you will see Rama's return when the period of exile is complete. Hence give up your sorrow and delusion.

sanskrit: शिरसा चरणावेतौ वन्दमानमनिन्दिते पुनर्द्रक्ष्यसि कल्याणि पुत्रं चन्द्रमिवोदितम्।।2.44.22।।
transliteration: śirasā caraṇāvetau vandamānamanindite punardrakṣyasi kalyāṇi putrṃ candramivoditam||2.44.22||
meaning: O irreproachable and auspicious one you will see your son, like the rising Moon, touching your feet with his head.

sanskrit: मा शोको देवि दुःखं वा न रामे दृश्यतेऽशिवम्। क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि पुत्रं त्वं ससीतं सहलक्ष्मणम्।।2.44.24।।
transliteration: mā śoko devi duḥkhṃ vā na rāme dṛśyate'śivam| kṣiprṃ drakṣyasi putrṃ tvṃ sasītṃ sahalakṣmaṇam||2.44.24||
meaning: Desist from grief or tear for Rama, O Devi nothing inauspicious will happen to him you will soon see your son along with Sita and Lakshmana.

sanskrit: त्वया शेषो जनश्चैव समाश्वास्यो यदाऽनघे। किमिदानीमिदं देवि करोषि हृदि विक्लबम्।।2.44.25।।
transliteration: tvayā śeṣo janaścaiva samāśvāsyo yadā'naghe| kimidānīmidṃ devi karoṣi hṛdi viklabam||2.44.25||
meaning: O sinless lady, O queen when you are overcome by fear, how can you console others?

sanskrit: पुत्रस्ते वरदः क्षिप्रमयोध्यां पुनरागतः। पाणिभ्यां मृदुपीनाभ्यां चरणौ पीडयिष्यति।।2.44.28।।
transliteration: putraste varadḥ kṣipramayodhyāṃ punarāgatḥ| pāṇibhyāṃ mṛdupīnābhyāṃ caraṇau pīḍayiṣyati||2.44.28||
meaning: Your son, bestower of boons, will soon return to Ayodhya and press your feet with his soft, tender hands.

sanskrit: अभिवाद्य नमस्यन्तं शूरं ससुहृदं सुतम्। मुदाऽस्रैः प्रोक्ष्यसि पुनर्मेघराजिरिवाचलम्।।2.44.29।।
transliteration: abhivādya namasyantṃ śūrṃ sasuhṛdṃ sutam| mudā'sraiḥ prokṣyasi punarmegharājirivācalam||2.44.29||
meaning: While paying obeisance to you, you will drench your brave son, surrounded by friends, with tears of joy like a mass of clouds drenching the mountain.

sanskrit: आश्वासयन्ती विविधैश्च वाक्यै र्वाक्योपचारे कुशलाऽनवद्या। रामस्य तां मातरमेवमुक्त्वा देवी सुमित्रा विरराम रामा।।2.44.30।।
transliteration: āśvāsayantī vividhaiśca vākyai rvākyopacāre kuśalā'navadyā| rāmasya tāṃ mātaramevamuktvā devī sumitrā virarāma rāmā||2.4
meaning: Irreproachable and skilful in the use of words, queen Sumitra of cheerful disposition fell silent after thus consoling Rama's mother in various ways.

sanskrit: निशम्य तल्लक्ष्मणमातृवाक्यं रामस्य मातुर्नरदेवपत्न्या:। सद्यश्शरीरे विननाश शोकः शरद्गतो मेघ इवाल्पतोयः।।2.44.31।।
transliteration: niśamya tallakṣmaṇamātṛvākyṃ rāmasya māturnaradevapatnyā:| sadyaśśarīre vinanāśa śokḥ śaradgato megha ivālpatoyḥ||2.44.3
meaning: On hearing the words of Lakshmana's mother the grief in the heart of the queen (Kausalya), mother of Rama, instantly disappeared like the autumnal cloud that holds but little rain. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिक

sanskrit: यथा यथा दाशरथि र्धर्म एवास्थितोऽभवत्। तथा तथा प्रकृतयो रामं पतिमकामयन्।।2.45.11।।
transliteration: yathā yathā dāśarathi rdharma evāsthito'bhavat| tathā tathā prakṛtayo rāmṃ patimakāmayan||2.45.11||
meaning: The more the son of Dasaratha (Rama) committed to righteousness, the more the subjects desired that he should be their king.

sanskrit: बाष्पेण पिहितं दीनं रामः सौमित्रिणा सह। चकर्षेव गुणैर्बद्ध्वा जनं पुरनिवासिनम्।।2.45.12।।
transliteration: bāṣpeṇa pihitṃ dīnṃ rāmḥ saumitriṇā saha| cakarṣeva guṇairbaddhvā janṃ puranivāsinam||2.45.12||
meaning: Rama along with Lakshmana attracted the citydwellers who, choked with tears, were looking miserable. It appeared they were bound with his virtues.

sanskrit: वाजपेयसमुत्थानि छत्राण्येतानि पश्य नः। पृष्ठतोऽनुप्रयातानि मेघानिव जलात्यये।।2.45.22।।
transliteration: vājapeyasamutthāni chatrāṇyetāni paśya nḥ| pṛṣṭhato'nuprayātāni meghāniva jalātyaye||2.45.22||
meaning: See these umbrellas acquired by us while performing Vajapeya sacrifice are following you like the clouds at the end of the rainy season.

sanskrit: अनवाप्तातपत्रस्य रश्मिसन्तापितस्य ते। एभिश्छायां करिष्यामः स्वैश्छत्रैर्वाजपेयिकैः।।2.45.23।।
transliteration: anavāptātapatrasya raśmisantāpitasya te| ebhiśchāyāṃ kariṣyāmḥ svaiśchatrairvājapeyikaiḥ||2.45.23||
meaning: You do not have a royal umbrella and you are scorched by the rays of the Sun. We will offer you shade with the umbrellas acquired during Vajapeya sacrifice.

sanskrit: बहूनां वितता यज्ञा द्विजानां य इहागताः। तेषां समाप्तिरायत्ता तव वत्स निवर्तने।।2.45.28।।
transliteration: bahūnāṃ vitatā yajñā dvijānāṃ ya ihāgatāḥ| teṣāṃ samāptirāyattā tava vatsa nivartane||2.45.28||
meaning: Many of those brahmins who arrived here have commenced their sacrifices. O dear child, their consummation depends on your return.

sanskrit: भक्तिमन्ति हि भूतानि जङ्गमाजङ्गमानि च। याचमानेषु राम त्वं भक्तिं भक्तेषु दर्शय।।2.45.29।।
transliteration: bhaktimanti hi bhūtāni jaṅgamājaṅgamāni ca| yācamāneṣu rāma tvṃ bhaktiṃ bhakteṣu darśaya||2.45.29||
meaning: O Rama, all these living beings, movable and immovable, are devoted to you and are entreating you with devotion to return. Show consideration to those supplicants.

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु सौमित्रिं सुमन्त्रमपि राघवः। अप्रमत्तस्त्वमश्वेषु भव सौम्येत्युवाच ह।।2.46.11।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu saumitriṃ sumantramapi rāghavḥ| apramattastvamaśveṣu bhava saumyetyuvāca ha||2.46.11||
meaning: Having said so to Lakshmana, he turned to Sumantra to say O gentle friend, tend the horses with care.

sanskrit: सोऽश्वान्सुमन्त्रः संयम्य सूर्येऽस्तं समुपागते। प्रभूतयवसान् कृत्वा बभूव प्रत्यनन्तरः।।2.46.12।।
transliteration: so'śvānsumantrḥ sṃyamya sūrye'stṃ samupāgate| prabhūtayavasān kṛtvā babhūva pratyanantarḥ||2.46.12||
meaning: As the Sun was setting, Sumantra tethered the horses, fed them with abundant fodder and sat close to them.

sanskrit: उपास्य तु शिवां सन्ध्यां दृष्ट्वा रात्रिमुपस्थिताम्। रामस्य शयनं चक्रे सूतः सौमित्रिणा सह।।2.46.13।।
transliteration: upāsya tu śivāṃ sandhyāṃ dṛṣṭvā rātrimupasthitām| rāmasya śayanṃ cakre sūtḥ saumitriṇā saha||2.46.13||
meaning: Then the charioteer worshipping the auspicious Sandhya (twilight), and seeing the night approach made bed for Rama and Lakshmana.

sanskrit: उत्थाय स महातेजाः प्रकृतीस्ता निशाम्य च। अब्रवीद्भ्रातरं रामो लक्ष्मणं पुण्यलक्षणम्।।2.46.18।।
transliteration: utthāya sa mahātejāḥ prakṛtīstā niśāmya ca| abravīdbhrātarṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇṃ puṇyalakṣaṇam||2.46.18||
meaning: On getting up, the brilliant Rama looked at his subjects and said to his brother Lakshmana full of noble qualities:

sanskrit: अस्मद्व्यपेक्षान् सौमित्रे निरपेक्षान् गृहेष्वपि। वृक्षमूलेषु संसुप्तान् पश्य लक्ष्मण साम्प्रतम्।।2.46.19।।
transliteration: asmadvyapekṣān saumitre nirapekṣān gṛheṣvapi| vṛkṣamūleṣu sṃsuptān paśya lakṣmaṇa sāmpratam||2.46.19||
meaning: O Lakshmana, son of Sumitra look at these people, fast alseep under the trees. Out of affection for us, they are even indifferent to their home.

sanskrit: यथैते नियमं पौराः कुर्वन्त्यस्मन्निवर्तने। अपि प्राणान्न्यसिष्यन्ति न तु त्यक्ष्यन्ति निश्चयम्।।2.46.20।।
transliteration: yathaite niyamṃ paurāḥ kurvantyasmannivartane| api prāṇānnyasiṣyanti na tu tyakṣyanti niścayam||2.46.20||
meaning: On seeing the people's resolve to take us back, it appears they are prepared to give up their lives rather than abandon their determination.

sanskrit: यावदेव तु संसुप्ता स्तावदेव वयं लघु। रथमारुह्य गच्छामः पन्थानमकुतोभयम्।।2.46.21।।
transliteration: yāvadeva tu sṃsuptā stāvadeva vayṃ laghu| rathamāruhya gacchāmḥ panthānamakutobhayam||2.46.21||
meaning: While they are asleep, we shall quickly mount the chariot and fearlessly proceed on the way.

sanskrit: मोहनार्थं तु पौराणां सूतं रामोऽब्रवीद्वचः। उदङ्मुखः प्रयाहि त्वं रथमास्थाय सारथे।।2.46.30।। मुहूर्तं त्वरितं गत्वा निवर्
transliteration: mohanārthṃ tu paurāṇāṃ sūtṃ rāmo'bravīdvacḥ| udaṅmukhḥ prayāhi tvṃ rathamāsthāya sārathe||2.46.30|| muhūrtṃ tvaritṃ gatv
meaning: With the intention of confusing the citizens, Rama said to the charioteer, O Sumantra, having seated in the chariot proceed speedly for a while in northerly direction and again turn back the chariot. Accomplish this feat

sanskrit: उपद्रुतमिदं सर्वमनालम्बमनायकम्। कैकेय्या हि कृते सर्वं विनाशमुपयास्यति।।2.48.25।।
transliteration: upadrutamidṃ sarvamanālambamanāyakam| kaikeyyā hi kṛte sarvṃ vināśamupayāsyati||2.48.25||
meaning: The entire kingdom, for the sake of Kaikeyi, is under a great calamity. With no support or leader it will definitely go to ruin.

sanskrit: न हि प्रव्रजिते रामे जीविष्यति महीपतिः। मृते दशरथे व्यक्तं विलापस्तदनन्तरम्।।2.48.26।।
transliteration: na hi pravrajite rāme jīviṣyati mahīpatiḥ| mṛte daśarathe vyaktṃ vilāpastadanantaram||2.48.26||
meaning: Now that Rama has been banished, the king will not live (long). After his death there will be evidently only lamentations.

sanskrit: ते विषं पिबतालोड्य क्षीणपुण्या स्सुदुर्गताः। राघवं वानुगच्छध्वमश्रुतिं वापि गच्छत।।2.48.27।।
transliteration: te viṣṃ pibatāloḍya kṣīṇapuṇyā ssudurgatāḥ| rāghavṃ vānugacchadhvamaśrutiṃ vāpi gacchata||2.48.27||
meaning: Where you are in deep trouble with merits exhausted, it is better to take poison, or follow Rama or walk into the unknown.

sanskrit: मिथ्याप्रव्राजितो राम स्ससीत स्सहलक्ष्मणः। भरते सन्निसृष्टास्स्म स्सौनिके पशवो यथा।।2.48.28।।
transliteration: mithyāpravrājito rāma ssasīta ssahalakṣmaṇḥ| bharate sannisṛṣṭāssma ssaunike paśavo yathā||2.48.28||
meaning: Rama along with Sita and Lakshmana has been deceitfully exiled and all of us delivered to Bharata like beasts to a butcher (for protection).

sanskrit: पूर्णचन्द्रानन श्श्यामो गूढजत्रुररिन्दमः। आजानुबाहुः पद्माक्षो रामो लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः।।2.48.29।। पूर्वाभिभाषी मधुर स्सत्यवा
transliteration: pūrṇacandrānana śśyāmo gūḍhajatrurarindamḥ| ājānubāhuḥ padmākṣo rāmo lakṣmaṇapūrvajḥ||2.48.29|| pūrvābhibhāṣī madhura ss
meaning: Rama, elder brother to Lakshmana is a tiger among men, a subduer of enemies, powerful like an intoxicated elephant, and a great charioteer. Blue in complexion, he has a face like the full Moon. He has lotuslike eyes, kne

sanskrit: तास्तथा विलपन्त्यस्तु नगरे नागरस्त्रियः। चुक्रुशु र्दुःखसन्तप्ता मृत्योरिव भयागमे।।2.48.32।।
transliteration: tāstathā vilapantyastu nagare nāgarastriyḥ| cukruśu rduḥkhasantaptā mṛtyoriva bhayāgame||2.48.32||
meaning: Such was the lamentation of the women of the city. Overcome with grief as if frightened at the approach of death, they wept bitterly.

sanskrit: इत्येवं विलपन्तीनां स्त्रीणां वेश्मसु राघवम्। जगामास्तं दिनकरो रजनी चाभ्यवर्तत।।2.48.33।।
transliteration: ityevṃ vilapantīnāṃ strīṇāṃ veśmasu rāghavam| jagāmāstṃ dinakaro rajanī cābhyavartata||2.48.33||
meaning: As the women of the city were thus lamenting over the scion of the Raghus (Rama) (sitting) at home, the sun set. Night fell.

sanskrit: नष्टज्वलनसन्तापा प्रशान्ताध्यायसत्कथा। तिमिरेणाभिलिप्तेव सा तदा नगरी बभौ।।2.48.34।।
transliteration: naṣṭajvalanasantāpā praśāntādhyāyasatkathā| timireṇābhilipteva sā tadā nagarī babhau||2.48.34||
meaning: With sacrificial fires extinguished and the reading of holy scriptures and sacred recitations stopped, Ayodhya looked as if besmeared with darkness.

sanskrit: उपशान्तवणिक्पण्या नष्टहर्षा निराश्रया। अयोध्या नगरी चासीन्नष्टतारमिवाम्बरम्।।2.48.35।।
transliteration: upaśāntavaṇikpaṇyā naṣṭaharṣā nirāśrayā| ayodhyā nagarī cāsīnnaṣṭatāramivāmbaram||2.48.35||
meaning: With markets closed, the city of Ayodhya cheerless and shelterless looked like the sky without stars.

sanskrit: तथा स्त्रियो रामनिमित्तमातुरा यथा सुते भ्रातरि वा विवासिते। विलप्य दीना रुरुदुर्विचेतस स्सूतैर्हि तासामधिको हि सोऽभवत्।।
transliteration: tathā striyo rāmanimittamāturā yathā sute bhrātari vā vivāsite| vilapya dīnā rurudurvicetasa ssūtairhi tāsāmadhiko hi so
meaning: The women grieved over Rama as if a son or a brother had been exiled. Depressed and distressed, they wept and sobbed. For them, Rama was indeed more than their sons.

sanskrit: प्रशान्तगीतोत्सवनृत्तवादना व्यपास्तहर्षा पिहितापणोदया। तदा ह्ययोध्या नगरी बभूव सा महार्णव स्सङ्क्षपितोदको यथा।।2.48.37।।
transliteration: praśāntagītotsavanṛttavādanā vyapāstaharṣā pihitāpaṇodayā| tadā hyayodhyā nagarī babhūva sā mahārṇava ssaṅkṣapitodako ya
meaning: With the cessation of singing, celebrations, dance and music, there was no rejoicing in the city. The markets displaying merchandise were shut down. The city of Ayodhya looked like the ocean with its waters diminished. इ

sanskrit: राजानं धिग्दशरथं कामस्य वशमागतम्।।2.49.4।। हा नृशंसाद्य कैकेयी पापा पापानुबन्धिनी। तीक्ष्णा सम्भिन्नमर्यादा तीक्ष्णकर्मण
transliteration: rājānṃ dhigdaśarathṃ kāmasya vaśamāgatam||2.49.4|| hā nṛśṃsādya kaikeyī pāpā pāpānubandhinī| tīkṣṇā sambhinnamaryādā tīk
meaning: (The villagers were speaking among themselves) Fie on the king who is overtaken by passion Alas, the heartless, sinful Kaikeyi, indulging in evil has banished into the forest this prince who is righteous and sagacious, c

sanskrit: अहो दशरथो राजा निस्नेहः स्वसुतं प्रियम्। प्रजानामनघं रामं परित्यक्तुमिहेच्छति।।2.49.8।।
transliteration: aho daśaratho rājā nisnehḥ svasutṃ priyam| prajānāmanaghṃ rāmṃ parityaktumihecchati||2.49.8||
meaning: Alas, the loveless king Dasaratha now intends to abandon his own sinless son Rama who is dear to the subjects.

sanskrit: एता वाचो मनुष्याणां ग्रामसंवासवासिनाम्। शृण्वन्नतिययौ वीरः कोसलान् कोसलेश्वरः।।2.49.9।।
transliteration: etā vāco manuṣyāṇāṃ grāmasṃvāsavāsinām| śṛṇvannatiyayau vīrḥ kosalān kosaleśvarḥ||2.49.9||
meaning: Such were the words of people living in villages and hamlets that Rama the valiant lord of Kosala happened to hear as he was crossing the boundaries of Kosala.

sanskrit: गोमतीं चाप्यतिक्रम्य राघवः शीघ्रगैर्हयैः। मयूरहंसाभिरुतां ततार स्यन्दिकां नदीम्।।2.49.12।।
transliteration: gomatīṃ cāpyatikramya rāghavḥ śīghragairhayaiḥ| mayūrahṃsābhirutāṃ tatāra syandikāṃ nadīm||2.49.12||
meaning: Gomati gone, Rama with the swiftmoving horses crossed the river Syandika echoing with the cries of peacocks and swans.

sanskrit: स महीं मनुना राज्ञा दत्तामिक्ष्वाकवे पुरा। स्फीतां राष्ट्रावृतां रामो वैदेहीमन्वदर्शयत्।।2.49.13।।
transliteration: sa mahīṃ manunā rājñā dattāmikṣvākave purā| sphītāṃ rāṣṭrāvṛtāṃ rāmo vaidehīmanvadarśayat||2.49.13||
meaning: Rama showed Sita vast tracts of land encircled by kingdoms which were formerly bestowed upon Ikshvaku by emperor Manu.

sanskrit: सूत इत्येव चाभाष्य सारथिं तमभीक्ष्णशः। हंसमत्तस्वरश्श्रीमानुवाच पुरुषर्षभः।।2.19.14।।
transliteration: sūta ityeva cābhāṣya sārathiṃ tamabhīkṣṇaśḥ| hṃsamattasvaraśśrīmānuvāca puruṣarṣabhḥ||2.19.14||
meaning: Graceful Rama, best among men with a voice resembling that of an intoxicated swan, called the charioteer again and again and said:

sanskrit: कदाऽहं पुनरागम्य सरय्वा पुष्पिते वने। मृगयां पर्यटिष्यामि मात्रा पित्रा च सङ्गतः।।2.49.15।।
transliteration: kadā'hṃ punarāgamya sarayvā puṣpite vane| mṛgayāṃ paryaṭiṣyāmi mātrā pitrā ca saṅgatḥ||2.49.15||
meaning: When shall I return and reunite with my father and mother and go hunting in the blooming forest on the bank of the river Sarayu?

sanskrit: स रामभवनं प्राप्य पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रभम्। तिस्रः कक्ष्या रथेनैव विवेशमुनिसत्तमः।।2.5.5।।
transliteration: sa rāmabhavanṃ prāpya pāṇḍurābhraghanaprabham| tisrḥ kakṣyā rathenaiva viveśamunisattamḥ||2.5.5||
meaning: Having crossed the three courtyards in the chariot, that foremost of ascetics (Vasistha) entered Rams's abode, shining like a mass of white clouds.

sanskrit: तमागतमृषिं रामस्त्वरन्निव ससम्भ्रमः। मानयिष्यन्समानार्हं निश्चक्राम निवेशनात्।।2.5.6।।
transliteration: tamāgatamṛṣiṃ rāmastvaranniva sasambhramḥ| mānayiṣyansamānārhṃ niścakrāma niveśanāt||2.5.6||
meaning: Seeing the venerable sage(Vasitha) arrive, Rama quickly came out of his abode in great excitement to receive him with honour.

sanskrit: अभ्येत्य त्वरमाणश्च रथाभ्याशं मनीषिणः। ततोऽवतारयामास परिगृह्य रथात्स्वयम्।।2.5.7।।
transliteration: abhyetya tvaramāṇaśca rathābhyāśṃ manīṣiṇḥ| tato'vatārayāmāsa parigṛhya rathātsvayam||2.5.7||
meaning: Hastening with rapid strides, Rama approached the chariot of the sagacious Vasistha and personally helped him alight from the chariot.

sanskrit: स चैनं प्रश्रितं दृष्ट्वा सम्भाष्याभिप्रसाद्य च। प्रियार्हं हर्षयन्राममित्युवाच पुरोहितः।।2.5.8।।
transliteration: sa cainṃ praśritṃ dṛṣṭvā sambhāṣyābhiprasādya ca| priyārhṃ harṣayanrāmamityuvāca purohitḥ||2.5.8||
meaning: The family priest Vasistha also, having gratified him by enquiring about his welfare, said thus to Rama, who was humble and lovable:

sanskrit: ततो यथावद्रामेण स राज्ञो गुरुरर्चितः। अभ्यनुज्ञाप्य काकुत्स्थं ययौ रामनिवेशनात्।।2.5.12।।
transliteration: tato yathāvadrāmeṇa sa rājño gururarcitḥ| abhyanujñāpya kākutsthṃ yayau rāmaniveśanāt||2.5.12||
meaning: Thereafter, Vasistha, preceptor of the king duly honoured by the descendant of Kakutstha (Rama) left his abode.

sanskrit: सुहृद्भिस्तत्र रामोऽपि सहासीनः प्रियंवदैः। सभाजितो विवेशाऽथ ताननुज्ञाप्य सर्वशः।।2.5.13।।
transliteration: suhṛdbhistatra rāmo'pi sahāsīnḥ priyṃvadaiḥ| sabhājito viveśā'tha tānanujñāpya sarvaśḥ||2.5.13||
meaning: Rama also sat for a while in the company of his sweettongued friends and duly honoured by them in every way took leave of them and entered his apartment.

sanskrit: स राजभवनप्रख्यात्तस्माद्रामनिवेशानात्। निर्गत्य ददृशे मार्गं वसिष्ठो जनसंवृतम्।।2.5.15।।
transliteration: sa rājabhavanaprakhyāttasmādrāmaniveśānāt| nirgatya dadṛśe mārgṃ vasiṣṭho janasṃvṛtam||2.5.15||
meaning: Vasistha thereafter emerged from the abode of Rama resembling a royal palace and beheld the highways filled with people.

sanskrit: बृन्दबृन्दैरयोध्यायां राजमार्गास्समन्ततः। बभूवुरभिसम्बाधाः कुतूहलजनैर्वृताः।।2.5.16।।
transliteration: bṛndabṛndairayodhyāyāṃ rājamārgāssamantatḥ| babhūvurabhisambādhāḥ kutūhalajanairvṛtāḥ||2.5.16||
meaning: The royal highways in the city of Ayodhya were jammed on all sides with groups of curious people.

sanskrit: जनबृन्दोर्मिसंघर्षहर्षस्वनवतस्तदा। बभूव राजमार्गस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः।।2.5.17।।
transliteration: janabṛndormisṃgharṣaharṣasvanavatastadā| babhūva rājamārgasya sāgarasyeva nisvanḥ||2.5.17||
meaning: The highways resembled the sea and the exultation of the multitudes, the roar that emanated from the clashing of waves.

sanskrit: सिताभ्रशिखरप्रख्यं प्रासादमधिरुह्य सः। समीयाय नरेन्द्रेण शक्रेणेव बृहस्पतिः।।2.5.22।।
transliteration: sitābhraśikharaprakhyṃ prāsādamadhiruhya sḥ| samīyāya narendreṇa śakreṇeva bṛhaspatiḥ||2.5.22||
meaning: Having ascended the royal palace resembling the peak of a mountain covered with white clouds, Vasistha approached the king like Brihaspati meeting Indra.

sanskrit: तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य हित्वा राजासनं नृपः। पप्रच्छ स च तस्मै तत्कृतमित्यभ्यवेदयत्।।2.5.23।।
transliteration: tamāgatamabhiprekṣya hitvā rājāsanṃ nṛpḥ| papraccha sa ca tasmai tatkṛtamityabhyavedayat||2.5.23||
meaning: On seeing Vasistha the king descended from the throne and enquired whether he had performed the mission to which the ascetic replied affirmatively.

sanskrit: ततो धान्यधनोपेतान् दानशीलजनान् शिवान्। अकुतश्चिद्भयान् रम्यांश्चैत्ययूपसमावृतान्।।2.50.8।। उद्यानाम्रवनोपेतान् सम्पन्नसल
transliteration: tato dhānyadhanopetān dānaśīlajanān śivān| akutaścidbhayān ramyāṃścaityayūpasamāvṛtān||2.50.8|| udyānāmravanopetān sampa
meaning: Rama, the best of men, crossed the auspicious land of Kosala which was worth seeing by kings. It looked charming with sacrificial posts and altars, pleasure gardens and mango groves and tanks filled with water. It was ri

sanskrit: आश्रमैरविदूरस्थैः श्रीमद्भिस्समलङ्कृताम्। कालेऽप्सरोभिर्हृष्टाभि स्सेविताम्भोह्रदां शिवाम्।।2.50.13।।
transliteration: āśramairavidūrasthaiḥ śrīmadbhissamalaṅkṛtām| kāle'psarobhirhṛṣṭābhi ssevitāmbhohradāṃ śivām||2.50.13||
meaning: The holy Ganga, adorned with graceful hermitages situated not far away is visited at times by delightful nymphs who sport in her lakes.

sanskrit: देवदानवगन्धर्वैः किन्नरैरुपशोभिताम्। नानागन्धर्वपत्नीभि स्सेवितां सततं शिवाम्।।2.50.14।।
transliteration: devadānavagandharvaiḥ kinnarairupaśobhitām| nānāgandharvapatnībhi ssevitāṃ satatṃ śivām||2.50.14||
meaning: The Ganga is graced by devatas, danavas, gandharvas and kinneras. Wives of several gandharvas always visit this auspicious river.

sanskrit: प्रमदामिव यत्नेन भूषितां भूषणोत्तमैः।।2.50.23।। फलैः पुष्पैः किसलयैर्वृतां गुल्मैर्द्विजैस्तथा। शिंशुमारैश्च नक्रैश्च भु
transliteration: pramadāmiva yatnena bhūṣitāṃ bhūṣaṇottamaiḥ||2.50.23|| phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kisalayairvṛtāṃ gulmairdvijaistathā| śiṃśumāraiśc
meaning: Just like a lady, Ganga is decorated with the best of ornaments her banks are filled with fruits, flowers, tender leaves or shoots and (flowering) shrubs. It is inhabited by birds and brahmins and infested with sisumaras

sanskrit: विष्णुपादच्युतां दिव्यामपापां पापनाशिनीम्। तां शङ्करजटाजूटाद्भ्रष्टां सागरतेजसा।।2.50.25।। समुद्रमहिषीं गङ्गां सारसक्रौञ
transliteration: viṣṇupādacyutāṃ divyāmapāpāṃ pāpanāśinīm| tāṃ śaṅkarajaṭājūṭādbhraṣṭāṃ sāgaratejasā||2.50.25|| samudramahiṣīṃ gaṅgāṃ sār
meaning: Mightyarmed Rama reached Srngaberapura on the bank of this consort of the ocean, this Ganga loud with the cries of kraunchas and herons. This sinless, divine Ganga, destroyer of sins who flows from the feet of lord Visnu

sanskrit: यो मन्त्रतपसा लब्धो विविधैश्च पराश्रमैः। एको दशरथस्येष्टः पुत्रः सदृशलक्षणः।।2.51.11।। अस्मिन् प्रव्राजिते राजा न चिरं व
transliteration: yo mantratapasā labdho vividhaiśca parāśramaiḥ| eko daśarathasyeṣṭḥ putrḥ sadṛśalakṣaṇḥ||2.51.11|| asmin pravrājite rājā
meaning: This favourite son of Dasaratha who has similar traits like his father was born after he rigorously practised austerities accompanied by (Vedic) mantras. When he is banished, the king will not live long. Surely this land

sanskrit: रम्यचत्वरसंस्थानां सुविभक्तमहापथाम्। हर्म्यप्रासादसम्पन्नाम् गणिकावरशोभिताम्।।2.51.21।। रथाश्वगजसम्बाधां तूर्यनादविनादित
transliteration: ramyacatvarasṃsthānāṃ suvibhaktamahāpathām| harmyaprāsādasampannām gaṇikāvaraśobhitām||2.51.21|| rathāśvagajasambādhāṃ t
meaning: They will roam about happily in the capital city of my father with its lovely squares, wellaligned broad highways, its mansions and palaces, full of chariots, elephants, horses. It will be echoing with the sound of trump

sanskrit: तं निशम्य समादेशं गुहामात्यगणो महान्। उपोह्य रुचिरां नावं गुहाय प्रत्यवेदयत्।।2.52.7।।
transliteration: tṃ niśamya samādeśṃ guhāmātyagaṇo mahān| upohya rucirāṃ nāvṃ guhāya pratyavedayat||2.52.7||
meaning: The ministers heard the orders, soon brought a beautiful boat and informed Guha (that his orders have been carried out).

sanskrit: ततः स प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा गुहो राघवमब्रवीत्। उपस्थितेयं नौर्देव भूयः किं करवाणि ते।।2.52.8।।
transliteration: tatḥ sa prāñjalirbhūtvā guho rāghavamabravīt| upasthiteyṃ naurdeva bhūyḥ kiṃ karavāṇi te||2.52.8||
meaning: Then Guha with folded palms said to Rama: O king, the boat ready. Tell me what else can I do for you.

sanskrit: ततः कलापान् सन्नह्य खड्गौ बध्वा च धन्विनौ। जग्मतुर्येन तौ गङ्गां सीतया सह राघवौ।।2.52.11।।
transliteration: tatḥ kalāpān sannahya khaḍgau badhvā ca dhanvinau| jagmaturyena tau gaṅgāṃ sītayā saha rāghavau||2.52.11||
meaning: Rama and Lakshmana then put on their quivers, fastened their swords and holding their bows went towards Ganga along with Sita.

sanskrit: राममेव तु धर्मज्ञमुपगम्य विनीतवत्। किमहं करवाणीति सूतः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत्।।2.52.12।।
transliteration: rāmameva tu dharmajñamupagamya vinītavat| kimahṃ karavāṇīti sūtḥ prāñjalirabravīt||2.52.12||
meaning: The charioteer (Sumantra) approached the righteous Rama and asked him with folded hands: What can I do?

sanskrit: वयं खलु हता राम ये त्वयाप्युपवञ्चिताः। कैकेय्या वशमेष्यामः पापाया दुःखभागिनः।।2.52.19।।
transliteration: vayṃ khalu hatā rāma ye tvayāpyupavañcitāḥ| kaikeyyā vaśameṣyāmḥ pāpāyā duḥkhabhāginḥ||2.52.19||
meaning: Deprived of you, O Rama we will come under the control of that sinful Kaikeyi. We will suffer and die.

sanskrit: इति ब्रुवन्नात्मसमं सुमन्त्रः सारथिस्तदा। दृष्ट्वा दूरगतं रामं दुःखार्तो रुरुदे चिरम्।।2.52.20।।
transliteration: iti bruvannātmasamṃ sumantrḥ sārathistadā| dṛṣṭvā dūragatṃ rāmṃ duḥkhārto rurude ciram||2.52.20||
meaning: Rama was like his (Sumantra's) own self. When Sumantra, the charioteer, saw that Rama was preparing to go afar for a long time, he started weeping aloud in deep distress.

sanskrit: ततस्तु विगते बाष्पे सूतं स्पृष्टोदकं शुचिम्। रामस्तु मधुरं वाक्यं पुनः पुनरुवाच तम्।।2.52.21।।
transliteration: tatastu vigate bāṣpe sūtṃ spṛṣṭodakṃ śucim| rāmastu madhurṃ vākyṃ punḥ punaruvāca tam||2.52.21||
meaning: After the flow of tears ceased Sumantra took a sip of water and became sanctified. Then Rama addressed him with sweet words over and over again:

sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु राजानं मातरं च सुमन्त्र मे। अन्याश्च देवीस्सहिताः कैकेयीं च पुनः पुनः।।2.52.30।। आरोग्यं ब्रूहि कौशल्यामथ
transliteration: evamuktvā tu rājānṃ mātarṃ ca sumantra me| anyāśca devīssahitāḥ kaikeyīṃ ca punḥ punḥ||2.52.30|| ārogyṃ brūhi kauśalyāma
meaning: Having said this to the king, O Sumantra tell my mother, the other queens including Kaikeyi again and again about my wellbeing and the wellbeing of Lakshmana and Sita. Convey our respectful salutations at the feet of mot

sanskrit: दूरेऽपि निवसन्तं त्वां मानसेनाग्रतः स्थितम्। चिन्तयन्तोऽद्य नूनं त्वां निराहाराः कृताः प्रजाः।।2.52.42।।
transliteration: dūre'pi nivasantṃ tvāṃ mānasenāgratḥ sthitam| cintayanto'dya nūnṃ tvāṃ nirāhārāḥ kṛtāḥ prajāḥ||2.52.42||
meaning: Although living at a distance, the subjects feel in their minds that you are just ahead of them. Today they will certainly go without food, brooding over you.

sanskrit: दृष्टं तद्धि त्वया राम यादृशं त्वत्प्रवासने। प्रजानां सङ्कुलं वृत्तं त्वच्छोकक्लान्तचेतसाम्।।2.52.43।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭṃ taddhi tvayā rāma yādṛśṃ tvatpravāsane| prajānāṃ saṅkulṃ vṛttṃ tvacchokaklāntacetasām||2.52.43||
meaning: At the time of your departure, O Rama, you have seen all that happened, the hearts of the people exhausted with grief.

sanskrit: अहं किं चापि वक्ष्यामि देवीं तव सुतो मया। नीतोऽसौ मातुलकुलं सन्तापं मा कृथा इति।।2.52.45।।
transliteration: ahṃ kiṃ cāpi vakṣyāmi devīṃ tava suto mayā| nīto'sau mātulakulṃ santāpṃ mā kṛthā iti||2.52.45||
meaning: What shall I say to Kausalya? Shall I say 'O venerable queen I have left your son at his maternal uncle's, hence don't grieve'.

sanskrit: असत्यमपि नैवाहं ब्रूयां वचनमीदृशम्। कथमप्रियमेवाहं ब्रूयां सत्यमिदं वचः।।2.52.46।।
transliteration: asatyamapi naivāhṃ brūyāṃ vacanamīdṛśam| kathamapriyamevāhṃ brūyāṃ satyamidṃ vacḥ||2.52.46||
meaning: How can I lie to her? How can I tell her the unpleasent truth?

sanskrit: मम तावन्नियोगस्थास्त्वद्बन्धुजनवाहिनः। कथं रथं त्वया हीनं प्रवक्ष्यन्ति हयोत्तमाः।।2.52.47।।
transliteration: mama tāvanniyogasthāstvadbandhujanavāhinḥ| kathṃ rathṃ tvayā hīnṃ pravakṣyanti hayottamāḥ||2.52.47||
meaning: How can these excellent horses who used to carry you and your friends till now draw this chariot without you even though they are at my command?

sanskrit: तन्न शक्ष्याम्यहं गन्तुमयोध्यां त्वदृतेऽनघ। वनवासानुयानाय मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि।।2.52.48।।
transliteration: tanna śakṣyāmyahṃ gantumayodhyāṃ tvadṛte'nagha| vanavāsānuyānāya māmanujñātumarhasi||2.52.48||
meaning: That is why, O sinless one I cannot go back to Ayodhya without you. Allow me to accompany you into your exile.

sanskrit: यदि मे याचमानस्य त्यागमेव करिष्यसि। सरथोऽग्निं प्रवेक्ष्यामि त्यक्तमात्र इह त्वया।।2.52.49।।
transliteration: yadi me yācamānasya tyāgameva kariṣyasi| saratho'gniṃ pravekṣyāmi tyaktamātra iha tvayā||2.52.49||
meaning: If you forsake me in spite of my request I shall immediately enter fire along with my chariot.

sanskrit: भविष्यन्ति वने यानि तपोविघ्नकराणि ते। रथेन प्रतिबाधिष्ये तानि सत्त्वानि राघव।।2.52.50।।
transliteration: bhaviṣyanti vane yāni tapovighnakarāṇi te| rathena pratibādhiṣye tāni sattvāni rāghava||2.52.50||
meaning: With my chariot I shall retaliate and prevent all those animals in the forest causing obstacles to your austerities, O Rama

sanskrit: त्वत्कृते न मयाऽवाप्तं रथचर्याकृतं सुखम्। आशंसे त्वत्कृते नाहं वनवासकृतं सुखम्।।2.52.51।।
transliteration: tvatkṛte na mayā'vāptṃ rathacaryākṛtṃ sukham| āśṃse tvatkṛte nāhṃ vanavāsakṛtṃ sukham||2.52.51||
meaning: By your grace I experienced the pleasure of driving your chariot, and by your grace, too, I am looking forward to deriving the pleasure of dwelling in the forest.

sanskrit: प्रसीदेच्छामि तेऽरण्ये भवितुं प्रत्यनन्तरः। प्रीत्याऽभिहितमिच्छामि भव मे प्रत्यनन्तरः।।2.52.52।।
transliteration: prasīdecchāmi te'raṇye bhavituṃ pratyanantarḥ| prītyā'bhihitamicchāmi bhava me pratyanantarḥ||2.52.52||
meaning: Be pleased. I wish to stay with you in the forest I long to hear from you these favourable words, 'Stay with me'.

sanskrit: इमे चापि हया वीर यदि ते वनवासिनः। परिचर्यां करिष्यन्ति प्राप्स्यन्ति परमां गतिम्।।2.52.53।।
transliteration: ime cāpi hayā vīra yadi te vanavāsinḥ| paricaryāṃ kariṣyanti prāpsyanti paramāṃ gatim||2.52.53||
meaning: O valiant one, if these horses too could render services to you while you dwell in the forest, they would attain the supreme state.

sanskrit: तव शुश्रूषणं मूर्ध्ना करिष्यामि वने वसन्। अयोध्यां देवलोकं वा सर्वथा प्रजहाम्यहम्।।2.52.54।।
transliteration: tava śuśrūṣaṇṃ mūrdhnā kariṣyāmi vane vasan| ayodhyāṃ devalokṃ vā sarvathā prajahāmyaham||2.52.54||
meaning: As I dwell in the forest, I shall serve you with my head bowed. For this I may altogether relinquish Ayodhya or even heaven.

sanskrit: न हि शक्या प्रवेष्टुं सा मयाऽयोध्या त्वया विना। राजधानी महेन्द्रस्य यथा दुष्कृतकर्मणा।।2.52.55।।
transliteration: na hi śakyā praveṣṭuṃ sā mayā'yodhyā tvayā vinā| rājadhānī mahendrasya yathā duṣkṛtakarmaṇā||2.52.55||
meaning: Just as a sinner cannot enter the capital of Indra (heaven), it is impossible for me to enter Ayodhya without you.

sanskrit: वनवासे क्षयं प्राप्ते ममैष हि मनोरथः। यदनेन रथेनैव त्वां वहेयं पुरीं पुनः।।2.52.56।।
transliteration: vanavāse kṣayṃ prāpte mamaiṣa hi manorathḥ| yadanena rathenaiva tvāṃ vaheyṃ purīṃ punḥ||2.52.56||
meaning: It is my cherished desire to take you after the completion of your exile, back to the city (Ayodhya) in this chariot alone.

sanskrit: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि सहितस्य त्वया वने। क्षणभूतानि यास्यन्ति शतसङ्ख्यान्यतोऽन्यथा।।2.52.57।।
transliteration: caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi sahitasya tvayā vane| kṣaṇabhūtāni yāsyanti śatasaṅkhyānyato'nyathā||2.52.57||
meaning: If I accompany you into the forest, fourteen years will pass like a moment, otherwise it will seem like a hundred years.

sanskrit: भृत्यवत्सल तिष्ठन्तं भर्तृपुत्रगते पथि। भक्तं भृत्यं स्थितं स्थित्यां त्वं न मां हातुमर्हसि।।2.52.58।।
transliteration: bhṛtyavatsala tiṣṭhantṃ bhartṛputragate pathi| bhaktṃ bhṛtyṃ sthitṃ sthityāṃ tvṃ na māṃ hātumarhasi||2.52.58||
meaning: O Rama you are affectionate towards your servants. I abide in the path followed by you, my master's son. I am your devoted servant. It does not behove you to forsake me who is faithful.

sanskrit: एवं बहुविधं दीनं याचमानं पुनः पुनः। रामो भृत्यानुकम्पी तु सुमन्त्रमिदमब्रवीत्।।2.52.59।।
transliteration: evṃ bahuvidhṃ dīnṃ yācamānṃ punḥ punḥ| rāmo bhṛtyānukampī tu sumantramidamabravīt||2.52.59||
meaning: Repeatedly implored in various ways by the miserable Sumantra, Rama who is compassionate to his servants replied:

sanskrit: जानामि परमां भक्तिं मयि ते भर्तृवत्सल। शृणु चापि यदर्थं त्वां प्रेषयामि पुरीमितः।।2.52.60।।
transliteration: jānāmi paramāṃ bhaktiṃ mayi te bhartṛvatsala| śṛṇu cāpi yadarthṃ tvāṃ preṣayāmi purīmitḥ||2.52.60||
meaning: O Sumantra, listen I know your deep devotion to me (I also know) you are loyal to your master (Dasaratha). So I am sending you to the city (Ayodhya) from here.

sanskrit: नगरीं त्वां गतं दृष्ट्वा जननी मे यवीयसी। कैकेयी प्रत्ययं गच्छेदिति रामो वनं गतः।।2.52.61।।
transliteration: nagarīṃ tvāṃ gatṃ dṛṣṭvā jananī me yavīyasī| kaikeyī pratyayṃ gacchediti rāmo vanṃ gatḥ||2.52.61||
meaning: When my younger mother Kaikeyi sees that you have returned to Ayodhya, she will believe that Rama has really gone to the forest.

sanskrit: परितुष्टा हि सा देवी वनवासं गते मयि। राजानं नातिशङ्केत 'मिथ्यावादी'ति धार्मिकम्।।2.52.62।।
transliteration: parituṣṭā hi sā devī vanavāsṃ gate mayi| rājānṃ nātiśaṅketa 'mithyāvādī'ti dhārmikam||2.52.62||
meaning: If queen Kaikeyi is fully satisfied that I have gone to dwell in the forest, she will no longer have any doubt and will believe that righteous king Dasaratha is not a liar.

sanskrit: एष मे प्रथमः कल्पो यदम्बा मे यवीयसी। भरतारक्षितं स्फीतं पुत्रराज्यमवाप्नुयात्।।2.52.63।।
transliteration: eṣa me prathamḥ kalpo yadambā me yavīyasī| bharatārakṣitṃ sphītṃ putrarājyamavāpnuyāt||2.52.63||
meaning: My prime resolve is that my younger mother should enjoy this prosperous and vast kingdom ruled by her son Bharata.

sanskrit: मम प्रियार्थं राज्ञश्च सरथस्त्वं पुरीं व्रज। सन्दिष्टश्चासि यानर्थांस्तां स्तान् ब्रूयास्तथा तथा।।2.52.64।।
transliteration: mama priyārthṃ rājñaśca sarathastvṃ purīṃ vraja| sandiṣṭaścāsi yānarthāṃstāṃ stān brūyāstathā tathā||2.52.64||
meaning: Sumantra, return to the city with the chariot for my pleasure and also for the pleasure of the king and convey to each of the persons concerned the message exactly as instructed.

sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा वचनं सूतं सान्त्वयित्वा पुनः पुनः। गुहं वचनमक्लीबो रामो हेतुमदब्रवीत्।।2.52.65।।
transliteration: ityuktvā vacanṃ sūtṃ sāntvayitvā punḥ punḥ| guhṃ vacanamaklībo rāmo hetumadabravīt||2.52.65||
meaning: Having spoken to the charioteer and consoling him again and again, indefatigable Rama spoke to Guha words full of reasoning:

sanskrit: नेदानीं गुह योग्योऽयं वासो मे सजने वने। आवश्यं ह्याश्रमे वासः कर्तव्यस्तद्गतो विधिः।।2.52.66।।
transliteration: nedānīṃ guha yogyo'yṃ vāso me sajane vane| āvaśyṃ hyāśrame vāsḥ kartavyastadgato vidhiḥ||2.52.66||
meaning: Guha this forest where people live is not suitable for my stay. It is necessary that I live in a hermitage. So please do the needful.

sanskrit: सोऽहं गृहीत्वा नियमं तपस्वि जनभूषणम्। हितकामः पितुर्भूयः सीताया लक्ष्मणस्य च।।2.52.67।। जटाः कृत्वा गमिष्यामि न्यग्रोधक्
transliteration: so'hṃ gṛhītvā niyamṃ tapasvi janabhūṣaṇam| hitakāmḥ piturbhūyḥ sītāyā lakṣmaṇasya ca||2.52.67|| jaṭāḥ kṛtvā gamiṣyāmi ny
meaning: Seeking the welfare of my father, Sita and Lakshmana I shall enter the forest with matted hair and practise the prescribed austerities which are the adornments of ascetics. Do fetch me the sap of a banyan tree.

sanskrit: तत् क्षीरं राजपुत्राय गुहः क्षिप्रमुपाहरत्।।2.52.68।। लक्ष्मणस्यात्मनश्चैव रामस्तेनाकरोज्जटाः।
transliteration: tat kṣīrṃ rājaputrāya guhḥ kṣipramupāharat||2.52.68|| lakṣmaṇasyātmanaścaiva rāmastenākarojjaṭāḥ|
meaning: Guha fetched the latex quickly and gave it to the prince (Rama) and with that Rama matted his own hair and Lakshmana's.

sanskrit: दीर्घबाहुर्नरव्याघ्रो जटिलत्वमधारयत्।।2.52.69।। तौ तदा चीरवसनौ जटामण्डलधारिणौ। आशोभेतामृषिसमौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।।2.52.
transliteration: dīrghabāhurnaravyāghro jaṭilatvamadhārayat||2.52.69|| tau tadā cīravasanau jaṭāmaṇḍaladhāriṇau| āśobhetāmṛṣisamau bhrāta
meaning: The longarmed Rama, the best of men, put on locks of matted hair. As the two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana stood dressed in bark wearing crowns of matted hair, they resembled two resplendent ascetics.

sanskrit: ततो वैखानसं मार्गमास्थितः सह लक्ष्मणः। व्रतमादिष्टवान् रामः सखायं गुहमब्रवीत्।।2.52.71।।
transliteration: tato vaikhānasṃ mārgamāsthitḥ saha lakṣmaṇḥ| vratamādiṣṭavān rāmḥ sakhāyṃ guhamabravīt||2.52.71||
meaning: Having adopted the path of ascetics along with Lakshmana, Rama said to his friend Guha:

sanskrit: अप्रमत्तो बले कोशे दुर्गे जनपदे तथा। भवेथा गुह राज्यं हि दुरारक्षतमं मतम्।।2.52.72।।
transliteration: apramatto bale kośe durge janapade tathā| bhavethā guha rājyṃ hi durārakṣatamṃ matam||2.52.72||
meaning: O Guha you must be vigilant about your army, treasury, forts and provinces. A kingdom, it is (rightly) said, is protected with great difficulty.

sanskrit: ततस्तं समनुज्ञाय गुहमिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः। जगाम तूर्णमव्यग्रः सभार्यः सह लक्ष्मणः।।2.52.73।।
transliteration: tatastṃ samanujñāya guhamikṣvākunandanḥ| jagāma tūrṇamavyagrḥ sabhāryḥ saha lakṣmaṇḥ||2.52.73||
meaning: Rama, Delight of the Iksvakus, then permitted Guha to take leave. And departed quickly with his consort and Lakshmana in peace.

sanskrit: स तु दृष्ट्वा नदीतीरे नावमिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः। तितीर्षुः शीघ्रगां गङ्गामिदं लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।।2.52.74।।
transliteration: sa tu dṛṣṭvā nadītīre nāvamikṣvākunandanḥ| titīrṣuḥ śīghragāṃ gaṅgāmidṃ lakṣmaṇamabravīt||2.52.74||
meaning: Seeing the boat on the river bank and intending to cross the swiftly flowing Ganga, Rama, descendant of the Iksvakus said to Lakshmana:

sanskrit: आरोह त्वं नरव्याघ्र स्थितां नावमिमां शनैः। सीतां चारोपयान्वक्षं परिगृह्य मनस्विनीम्।।2.52.75।।
transliteration: āroha tvṃ naravyāghra sthitāṃ nāvamimāṃ śanaiḥ| sītāṃ cāropayānvakṣṃ parigṛhya manasvinīm||2.52.75||
meaning: O Lakshmana, the best of men the boat stands ready, get into it slowly (carefully), and then help the noble Sita board it by holding the beam (which balances the boat).

sanskrit: स भ्रातुः शासनं श्रुत्वा सर्वमप्रतिकूलयन्। आरोप्य मैथिलीं पूर्वमारुरोहाऽऽत्मवां स्ततः।।2.52.76।।
transliteration: sa bhrātuḥ śāsanṃ śrutvā sarvamapratikūlayan| āropya maithilīṃ pūrvamārurohā''tmavāṃ statḥ||2.52.76||
meaning: Having heard his brother's command the selfcontrolled Lakshmana did as he was told.He first helped Sita get into the boat and thereafter boarded it himself.

sanskrit: अथारुरोह तेजस्वी स्वयं लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः। ततो निषादाधिपतिर्गुहो ज्ञातीनचोदयत्।।2.52.77।।
transliteration: athāruroha tejasvī svayṃ lakṣmaṇapūrvajḥ| tato niṣādādhipatirguho jñātīnacodayat||2.52.77||
meaning: With the boat boarded by the glorious Rama, Lakshmana's elder brother, Guha, king of the nishadas urged his kinsmen (to row the boat).

sanskrit: राघवोऽपि महातेजा नावमारुह्य तां ततः। ब्रह्मवत् क्षत्रवच्चैव जजाप हितमात्मनः।।2.52.78।।
transliteration: rāghavo'pi mahātejā nāvamāruhya tāṃ tatḥ| brahmavat kṣatravaccaiva jajāpa hitamātmanḥ||2.52.78||
meaning: Resplendent Rama boarded the boat and muttered for his own safety mantras befitting brahmins and kshatriyas.

sanskrit: आचम्य च यथाशास्त्रं नदीं तां सह सीतया। प्राणमत्प्रीतिसंहृष्टो लक्ष्मणश्चामितप्रभः।।2.52.79।।
transliteration: ācamya ca yathāśāstrṃ nadīṃ tāṃ saha sītayā| prāṇamatprītisṃhṛṣṭo lakṣmaṇaścāmitaprabhḥ||2.52.79||
meaning: Rama of undimmed radiance sipped the waters (of the Ganga) in accordance with the scriptures and with great pleasure and paid obeisance to the river with Sita and Lakshmana.

sanskrit: अनुज्ञाय सुमन्त्रं च सबलं चैव तं गुहम्। आस्थाय नावं रामस्तु चोदयामास नाविकान्।।2.52.80।।
transliteration: anujñāya sumantrṃ ca sabalṃ caiva tṃ guham| āsthāya nāvṃ rāmastu codayāmāsa nāvikān||2.52.80||
meaning: Having permitted Sumantra and Guha with his army to leave, Rama seated on the boat urged the boatmen to proceed.

sanskrit: ततस्तैश्चोदिता सा नौः कर्णधारसमाहिता। शुभस्फ्यवेगाभिहता शीघ्रं सलिलमत्यगात्।।2.52.81.।।
transliteration: tatastaiścoditā sā nauḥ karṇadhārasamāhitā| śubhasphyavegābhihatā śīghrṃ salilamatyagāt||2.52.81.||
meaning: The wellruddered boat rowed by the helmsmen and propelled by strong oars, swiftly crossed the waters of the river.

sanskrit: मध्यं तु समनुप्राप्य भागीरथ्यास्त्वनिन्दिता। वैदेही प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा तां नदीमिदमब्रवीत्।।2.52.82।।
transliteration: madhyṃ tu samanuprāpya bhāgīrathyāstvaninditā| vaidehī prāñjalirbhūtvā tāṃ nadīmidamabravīt||2.52.82||
meaning: When the boat reached the midstream that unblemished Sita with palms folded invoked the river thus:

sanskrit: पुत्रो दशरथस्यायं महाराजस्य धीमतः। निदेशं पारयित्वेमं गङ्गे त्वदभिरक्षितः।।2.52.83।। चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि समग्राण्युष्य का
transliteration: putro daśarathasyāyṃ mahārājasya dhīmatḥ| nideśṃ pārayitvemṃ gaṅge tvadabhirakṣitḥ||2.52.83|| caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi samag
meaning: O Ganga, protected by you, this son (Rama) of Dasaratha, the sagacious maharaja, will carry out his father's command. He along with his brother will return after living in the forest for full fourteen years. O fortunate

sanskrit: त्वं हि त्रिपथगा देवि ब्रह्मलोकं समीक्षसे। भार्या चोदधिराजस्य लोकेऽस्मिन् सम्प्रदृश्यसे।।2.52.86।।
transliteration: tvṃ hi tripathagā devi brahmalokṃ samīkṣase| bhāryā codadhirājasya loke'smin sampradṛśyase||2.52.86||
meaning: O Devi, you are Tripathaga, flowing in three directions (worlds). You behold the region of Brahma and happen to be the spouse of the king of the ocean in this world (of mortals).

sanskrit: सा त्वां देवि नमस्यामि प्रशंसामि च शोभने। प्राप्तराज्ये नरव्याघ्रे शिवेन पुनरागते।।2.52.87।। गवां शतसहस्राणि वस्त्राण्यन
transliteration: sā tvāṃ devi namasyāmi praśṃsāmi ca śobhane| prāptarājye naravyāghre śivena punarāgate||2.52.87|| gavāṃ śatasahasrāṇi va
meaning: O Devi O lovely Ganga I offer you my obeisance and my adorations. After the safe return of Rama, the tiger (best) among men, from the forest and after he regains the kingdom I shall give a hundred thousand cows, clothing

sanskrit: सुराघटसहस्रेण मांसभूतौदनेन च। यक्ष्ये त्वां प्रयता देवि पुरीं पुनरुपागता।।2.52.89।।
transliteration: surāghaṭasahasreṇa māṃsabhūtaudanena ca| yakṣye tvāṃ prayatā devi purīṃ punarupāgatā||2.52.89||
meaning: O Devi after my return to Ayodhya purified by my austerities, I shall worship you by offering a thousand pots of nectar and food in the form of meat.

sanskrit: यानि त्वत्तीरवासीनि दैवतानि च सन्ति हि। तानि सर्वाणि यक्ष्यामि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च।।2.52.90।।
transliteration: yāni tvattīravāsīni daivatāni ca santi hi| tāni sarvāṇi yakṣyāmi tīrthānyāyatanāni ca||2.52.90||
meaning: I shall worship all those deities inhabiting your banks and all sacred spots and temples.

sanskrit: पुनरेव महाबाहुर्मया भ्रात्रा च सङ्गतः। अयोध्यां वनवासात्तु प्रविशत्वनघोऽनघे।।2.52.91।।
transliteration: punareva mahābāhurmayā bhrātrā ca saṅgatḥ| ayodhyāṃ vanavāsāttu praviśatvanagho'naghe||2.52.91||
meaning: O sacred one may the blemishless, mightyarmed Rama accompanied by me and his brother reenter Ayodhya after the exile.

sanskrit: तथा सम्भाषमाणा सा सीता गङ्गामनिन्दिता। दक्षिणा दक्षिणं तीरं क्षिप्रमेवाभ्युपागमत्।।2.52.92।।
transliteration: tathā sambhāṣamāṇā sā sītā gaṅgāmaninditā| dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇṃ tīrṃ kṣipramevābhyupāgamat||2.52.92||
meaning: While the unblemished, auspicious Sita was thus addressing (the river), the boat swiftly reached the south bank.

sanskrit: तीरं तु समनुप्राप्य नावं हित्वा नरर्षभः। प्रातिष्ठत सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या च परन्तपः।।2.52.93।।
transliteration: tīrṃ tu samanuprāpya nāvṃ hitvā nararṣabhḥ| prātiṣṭhata saha bhrātrā vaidehyā ca parantapḥ||2.52.93||
meaning: Rama, the best of men and tormentor of enemies, after reaching the other side of the river, left the boat and proceeded with Sita and his brother.

sanskrit: अथाब्रवीन्महाबाहुः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनम्। भव संरक्षणार्थाय सजने विजनेऽपि वा।।2.52.94।।
transliteration: athābravīnmahābāhuḥ sumitrānandavardhanam| bhava sṃrakṣaṇārthāya sajane vijane'pi vā||2.52.94||
meaning: The longarmed Rama then said to Lakshmana, enhancer of the joy of Sumitra: Whether in populated areas or in solitary places, excercise alacrity in the matter of protection.

sanskrit: अवश्यं रक्षणं कार्यमदृष्टे विजने वने। अग्रतो गच्छ सौमित्रे सीता त्वामनुगच्छतु।।.2.52.95।।
transliteration: avaśyṃ rakṣaṇṃ kāryamadṛṣṭe vijane vane| agrato gaccha saumitre sītā tvāmanugacchatu||.2.52.95||
meaning: In this desolate forest which we had never seen before we must certainly be concerned about our protection. O Lakshmana , let Sita follow you

sanskrit: पृष्ठतोऽहं गमिष्यामि त्वां च सीतां च पालयन्। अन्योन्यस्येह नो रक्षा कर्तव्या पुरुषर्षभ।।2.52.96।।
transliteration: pṛṣṭhato'hṃ gamiṣyāmi tvāṃ ca sītāṃ ca pālayan| anyonyasyeha no rakṣā kartavyā puruṣarṣabha||2.52.96||
meaning: O best of men, I will follow you and Sita and keep watch. We must ensure mutual protection.
