sanskrit: न हि तावदतिक्रान्ता सुकरा काचन क्रिया। अद्य दुःखं तु वैदेही वनवासस्य वेत्स्यति।।2.52.97।।
transliteration: na hi tāvadatikrāntā sukarā kācana kriyā| adya duḥkhṃ tu vaidehī vanavāsasya vetsyati||2.52.97||
meaning: We have not yet confronted any hardship. From now on Sita will come to know the difficulties of forest life.

sanskrit: प्रणष्टजनसम्बाधं क्षेत्रारामविवर्जितम्। विषमं च प्रपातं च वनमद्य प्रवेक्ष्यति।।2.52.98।।
transliteration: praṇaṣṭajanasambādhṃ kṣetrārāmavivarjitam| viṣamṃ ca prapātṃ ca vanamadya pravekṣyati||2.52.98||
meaning: Now she will enter the forest which is devoid of concourse of people, farms and pleasure groves and which is uneven and inaccessible and full of deep ditches.

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा रामस्य वचनं प्रतस्थे लक्ष्मणोऽग्रतः। अनन्तरं च सीताया राघवो रघुनन्दनः।।2.52.99।।
transliteration: śrutvā rāmasya vacanṃ pratasthe lakṣmaṇo'gratḥ| anantarṃ ca sītāyā rāghavo raghunandanḥ||2.52.99||
meaning: Having heard the words of Rama, Lakshmana went ahead and Rama, delight of the Raghus, walked behind Sita.

sanskrit: गतं तु गङ्गापरपारमाशु रामं सुमन्त्रः प्रततं निरीक्ष्य। अध्वप्रकर्षाद्विनिवृत्तदृष्टि र्मुमोच बाष्पं व्यथित स्तपस्वी।।2.5
transliteration: gatṃ tu gaṅgāparapāramāśu rāmṃ sumantrḥ pratatṃ nirīkṣya| adhvaprakarṣādvinivṛttadṛṣṭi rmumoca bāṣpṃ vyathita stapasvī||
meaning: The wretched Sumantra kept gazing at Rama who swiftly reached the other side of the Ganga and only when he could not see him because of long distance, he turned away his gaze and, overcome with grief, shed tears.

sanskrit: स लोकपालप्रतिमप्रभाववां स्तीर्त्वा महात्मा वरदो महानदीम्। ततः समृद्धान् शुभसस्यमालिनः क्रमेण वत्सान् मुदितानुपागमत्।।2.5
transliteration: sa lokapālapratimaprabhāvavāṃ stīrtvā mahātmā varado mahānadīm| tatḥ samṛddhān śubhasasyamālinḥ krameṇa vatsān muditānup
meaning: Having crossed that mighty river, the highsouled Rama, bestower of boons and equal in splendour, to the Protector of the world reached Vatsa by and by, a highly prosperous country inhabited by happy people.

sanskrit: तौ तत्र हत्वा चतुरो महामृगान् वराहमृश्यं पृषतं महारुरुम्। आदाय मेध्यं त्वरितं बुभुक्षितौ वासाय काले ययतुर्वनस्पतिम्।।2.5
transliteration: tau tatra hatvā caturo mahāmṛgān varāhamṛśyṃ pṛṣatṃ mahārurum| ādāya medhyṃ tvaritṃ bubhukṣitau vāsāya kāle yayaturvanas
meaning: Famished, they (Rama and Lakshmana) killed a boar, a rishya (whitefooted male antelope), a spotted deer and a great deer with black stripes. They partook the meat and reached a tree by evening where they rested for the n

sanskrit: शोचन्त्या अल्पभाग्याया न किञ्चिदुपकुर्वता। पुत्रेण किमपुत्राया मया कार्यमरिन्दम।।2.53.23।।
transliteration: śocantyā alpabhāgyāyā na kiñcidupakurvatā| putreṇa kimaputrāyā mayā kāryamarindama||2.53.23||
meaning: My mother has less fortune and more grief like a woman without a son, O Lakshmana, subduer of enemies For her, what is the use of a son like me who cannot render any service to her?

sanskrit: अल्पभाग्या हि मे माता कौशल्या रहिता मया। शेते परमदुःखार्ता पतिता शोकसागरे।।2.53.24।।
transliteration: alpabhāgyā hi me mātā kauśalyā rahitā mayā| śete paramaduḥkhārtā patitā śokasāgare||2.53.24||
meaning: My mother is unlucky as she has been separated from me. Extremely distressed, she must have plunged into an ocean of grief.

sanskrit: एतदन्यश्च करुणं विलप्य विजने वने। अश्रुपूर्णमुखो रामो निशि तूष्णीमुपाविशत्।।2.53.27।।
transliteration: etadanyaśca karuṇṃ vilapya vijane vane| aśrupūrṇamukho rāmo niśi tūṣṇīmupāviśat||2.53.27||
meaning: Like this and in many other ways Rama lamented pitifully in that desolate forest. When his face was filled with tears, he sat silently in the night.

sanskrit: विलप्योपरतं रामं गतार्चिषमिवानलम्। समुद्रमिव निर्वेगमाश्वासयत लक्ष्मणः।।2.53.28।।
transliteration: vilapyoparatṃ rāmṃ gatārciṣamivānalam| samudramiva nirvegamāśvāsayata lakṣmaṇḥ||2.53.28||
meaning: Lakshmana consoled Rama who ceased to lament like fire with extinguished flames or like a motionless sea:

sanskrit: ध्रुवमद्य पुरी राजन्नयोध्यायुधिनां वर। निष्प्रभा त्वयि निष्क्रान्ते गतचन्द्रेव शर्वरी।।2.53.29।।
transliteration: dhruvamadya purī rājannayodhyāyudhināṃ vara| niṣprabhā tvayi niṣkrānte gatacandreva śarvarī||2.53.29||
meaning: O Rama, foremost of warriors, it is certain that since your departure, the city of Ayodhya must be lustreless like night without the Moon.

sanskrit: नैतदौपयिकं राम यदिदं परितप्यते। विषादयसि सीतां च मां चैव पुरुषर्षभ।।2.53.30।।
transliteration: naitadaupayikṃ rāma yadidṃ paritapyate| viṣādayasi sītāṃ ca māṃ caiva puruṣarṣabha||2.53.30||
meaning: This is not the way you should lament, O Rama. O foremost of men, by doing so you are disheartening me and Sita as well.

sanskrit: न च सीता त्वया हीना न चाहमपि राघव। मुहूर्तमपि जीवावो जलान्मत्स्याविनोद्धृतौ।।2.53.31।।
transliteration: na ca sītā tvayā hīnā na cāhamapi rāghava| muhūrtamapi jīvāvo jalānmatsyāvinoddhṛtau||2.53.31||
meaning: Without you Sita or I will not survive even for a moment like a fish taken out of water, O Rama

sanskrit: नहि तातं न शत्रुघ्नं न सुमित्रां परन्तप। द्रष्टुमिच्छेयमद्याहं स्वर्गं चापि त्वया विना।।2.53.32।।
transliteration: nahi tātṃ na śatrughnṃ na sumitrāṃ parantapa| draṣṭumiccheyamadyāhṃ svargṃ cāpi tvayā vinā||2.53.32||
meaning: Without you, O Rama, tormentor of enemies, I wish to see neither father nor Satrughna nor Sumitra nor even heaven itself
